items.desc:
Do you want to solve real customer problems through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on scalable services in a collaborative team environment? Do you want to see your code directly impact millions of customers worldwide? 
At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. Customer obsession is part of our company DNA, which has made us one of the world's most beloved brands. 
Our Software Development Engineer (SDE) interns use modern technology to solve complex problems while seeing their work's impact first-hand. The challenges SDE interns solve at Amazon are meaningful and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products globally. We seek individuals passionate about creating new products, features, and services while managing ambiguity in an environment where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years. 
At Amazon, we believe in ownership at every level. As an SDE intern, you'll own the entire lifecycle of your code - from design through deployment and ongoing operations. This ownership mindset, combined with our commitment to operational excellence, ensures we deliver the highest quality solutions for our customers. 
We're looking for curious minds who think big and want to define tomorrow's technology. At Amazon, you'll grow into the high-impact engineer you know you can be, supported by a culture of learning and mentorship. Every day brings exciting new challenges and opportunities for personal growth. 
Amazon internships across all seasons are full-time positions, and interns should expect to work in office, Monday-Friday, up to 40 hours per week typically between 8am-5pm. Specific team norms around working hours will be communicated by your manager. Interns should not have conflicts such as classes or other employment during the Amazon work-day. Applicants should have a minimum of one quarter/semester/trimester remaining in their studies after their internship concludes. 
Key job responsibilities
- Collaborate and communicate effectively with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to design, build, and operate innovative products and services that delight our customers, while participating in technical discussions to drive solutions forward. 
- Break down complex, ambiguous problems into well-defined, solvable components before implementation. 
- Contribute to the design and development of scalable, reliable services, with distributed-systems scope varying by team. 
- Participate in code reviews as a core engineering practice, providing constructive feedback and validating correctness. 
- Contribute to clear and accurate technical documentation. 
- Use GenAI and AI-powered tools to enhance development productivity, and critically validate, verify, and integrate AI-generated code, exercising sound judgement about when to trust AI output. 
- Write clean, maintainable code following best practices and design patterns. 
- Work in an agile environment practicing CI/CD principles while participating in operational responsibilities including on-call duties. 
- Demonstrate operational excellence through monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues. 
A day in the life
As an intern, you will be matched to a manager and a mentor and will have the opportunity to influence the evolution of Amazon technology and lead critical projects early in your career. 
In addition to working on an impactful project, you will have the opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional development, expand your network, and participate in activities with other interns throughout your internship. No matter the location of your internship, we give you the tools to own your project and learn in a real-world setting. 
About the team
Intern Community: 
As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a vibrant, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests. 
Support: 
The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive. 
Learning Sessions: 
Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's cutting-edge learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career. 
Opportunities: 
Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.

Job Description Summary 
Developpement Capteurs 3D et systèmes autonomes pour application médicale 
 Job Description 
 GE HealthCare 
 GE HealthCare est l’un des leaders mondiaux dans le domaine des technologies médicales et des solutions numériques. Sur le site de Buc, vous intégrerez l’équipe Robotic Software et contribuerez à une application médicale en lien avec la robotique, les systèmes embarqués et la perception 3D. 
 Objectifs principauxdu stage 
 Dans le cadre de nos activités de recherche et développement, nous avons mis en place un environnement permettant de modéliser un système médical ainsi que son environnement grâce à l’utilisation de capteurs 3D. Un prototype intégrant ces capteurs est également disponible sur un système réel. 
 Objectif 
 L’objectif principal du stage est de caractériser les performances de ces capteurs afin d’évaluer leur adéquation avec les applications envisagées, notamment la détection de collisions, la modélisation de l’environnement à partir des données issues des capteurs et d’autres fonctionnalités basées sur la perception 3D. Le/la stagiaire sera également amené à poursuivre le développement du démonstrateur existant, en contribuant à son amélioration et à l’intégration des résultats issus de la caractérisation des capteurs. 
 Missions 
 Comprendre l’environnement embarqué, les capteurs et les traitements existants. 
 Analyser la qualité des données et améliorer la robustesse des traitements. 
 Mettre en œuvre la calibration, la fusion, le filtrage et le traitement des nuages de points. 
 Intégrer et interfacer les composants électroniques avec le système embarqué. 
 Améliorer la reconstruction de surfaces 3D et la couverture de la scène. 
 Intégrer, tester et documenter les solutions proposées. 
 Profil du candidat 
 Élève ingénieur(e) en dernière année ou étudiant(e) en Master 2 en robotique, informatique, mécatronique ou domaine équivalent. 
 Bonnes connaissances en C/C++ et Python. 
 Expérience pratique des microcontrôleurs, des capteurs et de l’intégration électronique. 
 Connaissances en géométrie 3D et transformations spatiales. 
 Une expérience des frameworks 3D tels que VTK, du traitement de données 3D, de la vision 3D, des nuages de points ou des systèmes embarqués serait appréciée. 
 Capacité d’analyse, autonomie, rigueur et communication claire. 
 Informations pratiques 
 Niveau - Bac+5 
 Durée - 6 mois 
 Lieu - Buc (78530) 
 ___________________________________________________________________________
 GE HealthCare 
 GE HealthCare is a global leader in medical technology and digital solutions. At the Buc site, you will join the Robotic Software team and contribute to a medical application involving robotics, embedded systems and 3D perception. 
 Internship objective 
 As part of our research and development activities, an environment has been created to model a medical system and its surroundings using 3D sensors. A prototype integrating these sensors is also available on a real system. 
 Main objectives 
 The main objective of the internship is to characterise the performance of these sensors and assess their suitability for the intended applications, including collision detection, environment modelling based on sensor data, and other 3D-perception functions. The intern will also continue the development of the existing demonstrator by improving it and integrating the sensor-characterisation results. 
 Main responsibilities 
 Understand the embedded environment, the sensors and the existing processing methods. 
 Analyse data quality and improve the robustness of existing methods. 
 Implement calibration, fusion, filtering and point-cloud processing. 
 Integrate and interface the electronic components with the embedded system. 
 Improve 3D surface reconstruction and scene coverage. 
 Integrate, test and document the proposed solutions. 
 Candidate profile 
 Final-year engineering or Master’s student in robotics, computer science, mechatronics or a related field. 
 Good knowledge of C/C++ and Python. 
 Hands-on experience with microcontrollers, sensors and electronic integration. 
 Knowledge of 3D geometry and spatial transformations. 
 Experience with 3D frameworks such as VTK, 3D data processing, 3D vision, point clouds or embedded systems would be appreciated. 
 Analytical skills, autonomy, thoroughness and clear communication. 
 Practical information 
 Level - Master’s degree / Bac+5 
 Duration - 6 months 
 Location - Buc (78530), France

Les décisions relatives à l'emploi sont prises sans tenir compte de l’origine nationale ou ethnique, de la religion, du sexe, de l'orientation sexuelle, de l'identité ou de l'expression de genre, de l'âge, du handicap, du statut d'ancien combattant protégé ou d'autres caractéristiques protégées par la loi.

 Contexte 
 Soulager la douleur, rétablir la santé et prolonger la vie, c’est guidé par cette mission que Medtronic continue de faire bénéficier ses thérapies innovantes à des millions de patients. Location: Bristol, UK
 Salary: £2500 per month
 Start date: June 2027
 Application deadline : Midnight, 29th November 2026 
 We encourage you to apply early, as we may close applications before the advertised deadline. 
 The Internship Programme at Graphcore
 Explore a career at Graphcore through a 12-week summer internship, gaining hands-on experience on real projects. You’ll bring fresh ideas, put your learning into practice and help shape what we’re creating. Along the way, you’ll tackle challenging problems with a team who welcome your questions and support you as you build your skills and confidence.
 What you’ll work on
 Use your programming skills and curiosity to help AI models run efficiently on next-generation Graphcore hardware. 
 In AI Compute Libraries & Performance, you’ll contribute to C++ libraries and compute kernels for machine learning workloads. Your work will include: 
 Developing compute kernels: Implement and improve operations such as matrix multiplication (GEMM), convolutions, reductions, elementwise operations and fused kernels that combine multiple operations. 
 Understanding and improving performance: Use profiling and microbenchmarks to measure execution speed and investigate how threading, cache locality, memory layout and kernel launch efficiency affect performance. 
 Checking correctness and reliability: Build regression tests and numerical checks, investigate issues and improve the quality of the libraries our customers use. 
 Through these projects, you’ll develop practical experience connecting numerical computing with how code runs on hardware, helping deliver software that is fast, accurate and reliable. 
 Your team and support
 You’ll join a team building high-performance compute libraries that help customers get more from Graphcore hardware. Our work brings together machine learning, numerical computing and accelerator performance, with colleagues sharing their expertise to solve engineering problems.
 You’ll contribute to clearly scoped projects and build your skills with guidance from engineers working in performance and low-level software. Together, we use profiling, experiments and technical reviews to compare approaches, understand trade-offs and improve our solutions. 
 Your buddy will help you settle in, get familiar with our tools and ways of working, and find the right people to ask. Your manager will meet with you regularly to agree goals, offer feedback and discuss your development, including time for learning. 
 We welcome different perspectives and make space for everyone to contribute. Questions, alternative approaches and requests for help are part of how we work. As you take on more responsibility, your colleagues will help you work through challenges, and your ideas will be listened to and discussed respectfully. 
 How you’ll learn and grow
 Over the 12 weeks, you’ll build performance engineering skills through hands-on work on compute kernels, benchmarks and tests. 
 Profiling and experiments will help you understand where time is spent and how changes to code and data layout affect performance. Numerical validation and regression testing will show you how to check that an optimisation preserves correct results and continues to work as software changes. 
 Working with specialists and discussing technical trade-offs will help you develop your engineering judgement, explain your findings and connect mathematical operations to efficient implementations on hardware. 
 What we're looking for
 Currently studying towards a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Maths, Machine Learning, Data Science or a related field
 Experience with C or C++11, plus familiarity with Python or scripting tools for automation and testing
 An understanding of linear algebra, numerical methods or scientific computing
 Problem-solving skills and collaborative approach to unfamiliar technical challenges
 Previous industry experience is not required. Tell us what you built or investigated through coursework, personal or team projects or other relevant experience, how you approached it and what you learned.
 Coursework or experience with machine learning frameworks, parallel programming, code optimisation, maths libraries or performance analysis would be useful. These are additional strengths, rather than essential requirements.

Job Description: 
 Envie de rejoindre l'aventure ATR ? Une offre de stage vient de s'ouvrir sur notre site à Blagnac ! 
 En 2025, ATR est labellisée Happy Trainees. 94.3% des étudiants recommandent notre entreprise à l’issue de leur alternance ou de leur stage. 
 Ce que nous allons faire ensemble : 
 Être stagiaire chez ATR, c’est être intégré au sein d’une équipe comme un membre à part entière avec un véritable périmètre d’intervention et des responsabilités. 
 Descriptif des missions proposées 
 L'objectif principal du stage est de concevoir et développer une solution capable de : 
 Collecter automatiquement des données issues de documents de différentes sources documentaires : 
 Exemple de sources documentaires à exploiter : rapports d'essais, documents de maintenance, rapports d'inspection, synthèses d'incidents, bases de données existantes, ainsi que d’autres documents techniques (PDF, Word, Excel, etc…). 
 - Identifier, extraire et structurer les informations pertinentes grâce à des techniques de traitement automatique de documents. 
 - Exploiter, lorsque pertinent, les technologies d'Intelligence Artificielle pour améliorer la qualité et la robustesse de l'extraction des données. 
 Développer des fonctionnalités permettant la génération ou l'assistance à la rédaction de notes techniques à partir des données collectées. 
 Alimenter automatiquement une base de données centralisée avec les informations extraites. 
 Participer à la définition de l'architecture logicielle, aux tests, à la validation et à la documentation de la solution. 
 Ce stage est fait pour vous : 
 Étudiant(e) en dernière année d'école d'ingénieur (Bac+5) ou en Master 2 avec une spécialisation en Informatique, Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle
 Compétences techniques recherchées : 
 Maîtrise du développement en Python et des librairies (Pandas, Numpy, …) pour le traitement et l’analyse des données.
 Connaissances en SQL et conception de bases de données relationnelles.
 Notions ou expérience en Intelligence Artificielle et Machine Learning.
 Connaissances des technologies OCR et d'extraction de données à partir de documents.
 Compréhension des formats documentaires courants (PDF, Word, Excel).
 Savoir être recherchés : 
 Capacité à comprendre et à formaliser un besoin métier.
 Forte capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes.
 Autonomie et prise d'initiative.
 Rigueur et sens de l'organisation.
 Capacité à travailler en équipe pluridisciplinaire.
 Bonnes compétences en communication orale et écrite.
 Force de proposition pour identifier des solutions innovantes.
 undefined

 Français : courant ou langue maternelle
 Anglais : intermédiaire à avancé (B2 minimum recommandé)

Job Description: 
 Want to join the ATR adventure? An internship opportunity has just opened on our site in Blagnac 
 In 2025, ATR has been awarded the Happy Trainees label. 94.3% of students recommend our company after their work-study or internship. 
 What we will do together: 
 Being an apprentice at ATR means being integrated into a team as a full member with a real scope of intervention and responsibilities. You will have the opportunity to learn and develop your skills and experience within a market leading company! 
 Detailed description of the mission 
 The flight physics “Aircraft performance and weight” department is in charge of, among other things, the generation of performance data (low and high speed) for all ATR aircrafts.
 In the context of the TOPAAS project (Take-Off Performance Awareness and Alerting System), ATR is developing a system to reinforce take-off operations safety. This work is done in the frame of the future EASA regulation about take-off performance events prevention and implementation of TOPMS (Take-Off Performance Monitoring System)-like functionalities. 
 This internship objective is to analyze the impact of the main input errors on take-off performance and to deduce an algorithm able to anticipate these errors. 
 The internship will take place in 2 big steps: 
 1. Study of input errors impacts on take-off performance 
 At first, the intern will perform an analysis of the different events considered in EASA’s TOPMS to evaluate their impact on aircraft performance for ATR aircrafts. 
 This activity will include non-exhaustively: 
 The comprehension of the regulatory and operational context of the TOPMS events, 
 The identification of the different input errors which can affect take-off performance (weight, atmospheric conditions, etc.), 
 The evaluation of these errors impact on take-off distances for key parameters. 
 2. Development of TOPMS aircraft performance algorithm first blocks 
 In a second time, the intern will participate in the development of the first blocks of a model which can estimate expected take-off performance from aircraft and environmental parameters. 
 This activity will include non-exhaustively: 
 The definition of parameters and data necessary for the computation, 
 The implementation of algorithm to detect delta between expected and real performance, 
 The completion of first computations on representative cases. 
 To complete this activity, the intern will work in the Aircraft Performance and Weight team in closed collaboration with Aircraft and Engine Models Development and Aircraft Systems teams. 
 This internship is designed for you 
 Engineering student or equivalent education with specialization in aeronautics
 Final year internship
 Knowledge of aircraft performance and flight mechanics
 Knowledge in model and data analysis
 Knowledge in Python will be highly appreciated
 Analytical mind, scientific rigor and autonomy
 Capacity to work in a multidisciplinary team
 French and/or English fluent
 Calendar 
 Starting date: First quarter of 2027 
 Duration of 6 months 
 How does the recruitment process work? 
 The recruitment process takes place in two stages after receiving your application: 
 Analysis of your resume

 Descriptif des missions proposées 
 Le département "Aircraft Performance and Weight" est en charge entre autres de la génération des données de performance (basse et haute vitesse) pour tous les avions ATR.
 Dans le cadre du projet TOPAAS (Take-Off Performance Awareness and Alerting System), ATR développe un système visant à renforcer la sécurité des opérations au décollage. Ces travaux s'inscrivent dans le cadre d’une future réglementation de l'EASA concernant la prévention des événements liés aux performances au décollage et la mise en œuvre de fonctionnalités de type TOPMS (Take-Off Performance Monitoring System).

Job Title
Product Innovation & AI Prototyping Internship – Philips Avent Experience Innovation 
 Job Description
 Start Date: flexible Q3/Q4 2026 
 Duration: at least / 6 months 
 Type: Internship (non-thesis) 
 Weekly Presence: 40h (minimum 32h) 
 Location: Eindhoven 
 Mentor: Coen Claassen 
 Product Innovation & AI Prototyping Internship – Philips Avent Experience Innovation 
 Do you enjoy turning early ideas into products, prototypes and experiences that people can see, understand and test?
 Within Philips Avent Experience Innovation, we explore new product and experience directions that can make a meaningful difference for parents and babies. We work where consumer needs, design and technology come together.
 We are looking for a curious, hands-on product innovator with both a strong product perspective and technical curiosity. You do not need to be an expert in every discipline; we are looking for someone who learns quickly, asks sharp questions and enjoys making ideas tangible.
 Your role 
 You will join a multidisciplinary team of designers, researchers, scientists and technologists. Your work may span new physical products, connected experiences and early technology explorations.
 You will:
 Explore new product and experience opportunities for parents and babies.
 Turn insights and ideas into product concepts, prototypes, mock-ups and visualisations.
 Work with designers and engineers to understand feasibility, product mechanisms, materials and user experience.
 Use a mix of sketching, CAD, physical prototyping and digital tools to make ideas tangible.
 Help create clear presentations and stories that support innovation decisions.
 Use AI-supported tools to create concept visualisations, animations or short videos where they help bring an idea to life.
 AI-supported video creation is part of the role, but not its sole focus. It is one of the tools you may use to make a new product or experience understandable and compelling.
 You are the right fit if 
 You are studying Industrial Design, Integrated Product Design, Mechanical Engineering with a design affinity, Design Engineering, or a comparable programme.
 You are interested in both how products are experienced and how they work.
 You enjoy working on open-ended challenges and moving between thinking and making.
 You are curious, proactive and able to communicate your ideas clearly.
 You have experience with some relevant tools, such as sketching, CAD, prototyping, rendering, Adobe tools, Figma, video/animation tools or AI-supported creative tools.
 Please include a portfolio or examples that show how you think and make. This could be a product, prototype, technical exploration, system concept or other project that demonstrates your curiosity and problem-solving approach.
 What you can expect 
 You will contribute to real innovation work for Philips Avent and collaborate with experienced professionals across design, research, science and technology. You will receive coaching throughout your internship and gain experience in how early ideas are translated into future products and experiences for parents and babies.
 If you are excited to combine product thinking, technical curiosity and creative prototyping, we would love to hear from you.
 Does this sound like you? 
 Apply now and share your resume together with a portfolio, videos, animations or other self-made work that shows your creativity, technical curiosity and ability to make ideas tangible.
 Graduation: We prefer this to be a regular 6-month internship. A graduation assignment is possible, but only if it can be clearly connected to our innovation projects and leaves enough time to contribute broadly to other team activities.
 How we work together 
 We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.
 This is an onsite role.
 We offer you: 
A non-stop growth opportunity within a global multinational company. In addition, we also want to renumerate you well for the opportunity. This includes:
 Monthly full-time allowance between €500 - €700 gross, depending on your education level and if you need to relocate to The Netherlands. Part-time internships receive the allowance pro-rata.

items.desc:
RIVR, part of Amazon is a robotics company pioneering Physical AI through real-world doorstep delivery. Founded in 2024 as an ETH Zurich spin-off, RIVR, part of Amazon developed wheeled-legged robots designed to operate in complex, unstructured environments such as stairs, gates, doors, and uneven urban terrain. We believe that achieving general physical intelligence requires solving real customer problems in the real world, where robots can learn from rich operational data at scale.
Following our acquisition by Amazon in March 2026, we are continuing this mission with greater reach and speed. By combining custom robot hardware, onboard autonomy, and cloud-based coordination, RIVR, part of Amazon is building the next generation of safe, reliable autonomous robots for last-mile delivery.
Important Notice: For this position, we can unfortunately only accept applications from citizens of Schengen Area countries. This restriction does not apply to ETHZ and EPFL students who are required to complete compulsory internships as part of their studies.


Job Description
As a SLAM Intern, you will join our team to advance the localization and mapping capabilities of our last-mile delivery robot. Your work will directly shape how our robot perceives and navigates complex urban environments — from benchmarking existing approaches to prototyping novel algorithms and validating them on hardware. This role offers hands-on experience in spatial perception, algorithm development, and real-world deployment within a dynamic and collaborative environment. We are committed to finding and nurturing exceptional talent; our internships are a key pathway to recruiting outstanding graduates who can make a significant impact in our team.

What you'll be doing:
Work closely with senior engineers to integrate SLAM modules with hardware components and contribute ideas to enhance system robustness and accuracy.
 Support the team in benchmarking, evaluating, and developing novel state-of-the-art localization and mapping algorithms for robotic applications.
 Engage in continuous learning and gain exposure to recent developments from the SLAM and computer vision literature.
What you should have:
At least a BSc in Computer Science, Robotics, Engineering, or equivalent discipline.
 Previous coursework or projects related to computer vision, SLAM, or 3D geometry.
 Experience with C++ and / or Python.
 Eagerness to learn and contribute in a team environment.
 Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Get some bonus points:
Proven experience implementing or extending SLAM systems.
 Exposure to state of the art dense visual SLAM or multi-view stereo approaches.
 Familiarity with sensor fusion techniques involving cameras, LiDAR, or IMUs.
 Knowledge of relevant frameworks or libraries such as OpenCV, GTSAM, Ceres, Eigen, or similar.
 Experience with ROS/ROS 2 and real-world robotic data collection.
RIVR, part of Amazon is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that values every perspective. If you’re passionate about driving innovation in robotics and creating meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply and bring your unique self to our team.
 
We believe the best work is done when collaborating and therefore require in-person presence in our office locations.

items.desc:
Huawei is a leading global information and communications technology (ICT) solutions provider. Through our constant dedication to customer-centric innovation and strong partnerships, we have established leading end-to-end capabilities and strengths across the carrier networks, enterprise, consumer, and cloud computing fields. Our products and solutions have been deployed in over 170 countries serving more than one third of the world’s population. 
 With 20+ sites across Europe and 1500 researchers, Huawei’s European Research Institute (ERI) oversees fundamental and applied technology research, academic research cooperation projects, and strategic technical planning across our network of European R&D facilities. Huawei’s ERI includes the Zurich Research Center (ZRC), located in Zurich, Switzerland. A major element of ZRC is a rapidly growing research laboratory focused on fundamental research in the area of computing systems (new hardware, new software, new algorithms). 
 The research work of the lab will be carried out not only by Huawei’s internal research staff but also by our academic research partners in universities across Europe. The lab will provide an open research environment where academics will be encouraged to visit and work on fundamental long-term research alongside Huawei staff in an environment that, like the best universities and research institutes, is open and conducive to such world-leading scientific work. 
 Job Responsibilities:
1. Design and optimize arithmetic building blocks for AI accelerators (multipliers, multiply-accumulate and dot-product units) for integer and low-precision floating-point formats, advancing the area/delay/power trade-off.
2. Build and apply agentic engineering workflows in which LLM-based agents propose, implement and evaluate RTL and netlist transformations in a closed loop with synthesis, formal verification (equivalence checking) and PPA analysis tools.
3. Read and analyze research papers from EDA and computer arithmetic venues (DAC, ICCAD, DATE, ARITH, MLCAD, TCAD, etc.) and reproduce state-of-the-art results as baselines.
4. Perform experiments, gather insights, contribute to patents and research papers.
Required Skills:
1. Enrolled in a Masters/PhD program or completed Masters in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related field.
2. Understanding of AI accelerator architectures (e.g., systolic arrays, tensor cores) and the numerical formats used in AI workloads (e.g., INT8, FP8, MX).
3. Experience in RTL design (Verilog/SystemVerilog) and Python, and with logic synthesis and digital implementation flows (e.g., Yosys, ABC, OpenROAD or commercial equivalents). Experience with hardware construction languages (e.g., Chisel, Amaranth) is a plus.
4. Familiarity with training and inference of ML models (e.g., LLMs, diffusion models, classifiers) and model quantization is a plus.
5. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a proven ability to present complex technical information clearly and concisely to a variety of audiences. Collaborative work style with the ability to work in a multicultural environment.
 Please clearly indicate your preferred starting date on your motivation letter. 
 The starting date is flexible, though we give preference to candidates who can start in the near future. The duration of our internships can fluctuate depending on the university regulations and agreements. 
 To be considered for this role, applicants must be either Swiss citizens, EU-nationals or are eligible to live and work in Switzerland. 
 Due to regulations non-EU/EFTA citizens must provide a certificate from the university stating that an internship is mandatory as part of the application documents. 
 We will only consider candidates whose profile and qualifications meet our requirements.

items.desc:
Mission 
 The Limnology Center ( http://limnc.epfl.ch ) coordinates the LéXPLORE platform (www.lexplore.ch), a unique floating research infrastructure on Lake Geneva. LéXPLORE provides state-of-the-art instrumentation for the continuous monitoring of physical, chemical, and biological processes in aquatic ecosystems. Data and metadata collected on the platform are openly available through the DATALAKES portal ( www.datalakes-eawag.ch ).
 Building on nearly a decade of successful operation, the next phase of LéXPLORE, led by EPFL, Eawag, and the University of Lausanne, will combine long-term high-frequency observations with targeted sampling strategies to address emerging scientific and environmental challenges.
 The technician will join a small and highly collaborative operational team and work closely with a second technician to ensure the smooth day-to-day operation of the platform. The position involves regular interactions with researchers, engineers, students, and the general public, as well as collaborations with national and international research teams.
 The successful candidate will contribute to the operation, maintenance, and continued development of LéXPLORE, helping to ensure reliable instrumentation, secure infrastructure, high-quality data, and the successful implementation of research and outreach activities. The position combines fieldwork, technical maintenance, instrumentation, data quality control, and support for scientific projects in a dynamic and collaborative environment.
 Main duties and responsibilities 
 Contribute to the operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of LéXPLORE.
 Install, maintain, and troubleshoot scientific instrumentation, including sensor calibration, sampling system configuration, technical procedures, and data quality control.
 Maintain, repair, and improve the platform’s infrastructure and equipment. This includes installations, cleaning, routine maintenance activities, power supply systems, ROV inspections and recovery operations.
 Provide technical support to research groups and contribute to the successful implementation of scientific projects on LéXPLORE.
 Contribute to data management and curation activities, and collaborate with the DATALAKES team to ensure efficient data flows and clear documentation of datasets.
 Support outreach and communication activities, including public visits and media events.
 Profile 
 Technical training ranging from CFC, ES/HES, or EPF level in a relevant field (electronics, mechanics, automation, environmental sciences, instrumentation, data management, or equivalent).
 Hands-on experience with technical systems and field operations.
 Experience in installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting technical equipment.
 Interest in instrumentation, metrology, and environmental monitoring.
 Good computer skills and interest in data management and visualization; experience with Python, MATLAB, or R is an asset.
 Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a small team.
 Resourceful problem-solver with a proactive attitude and a strong practical mindset.
 Versatile, curious, and motivated to learn new tools, technologies, and scientific methods.
 Good organizational, reporting, and communication skills.
 Comfortable working outdoors, including on lakes and in all weather conditions.
 Flexible and adaptable, with occasional variability in working hours depending on field activities.
 Good command of French and English; German is an asset.
 Valid driving license required; boat and trailer licenses are an advantage (or willingness to obtain them).
 Experience in a similar position, field operations, or technical support is an advantage.
 Experience with maker projects, electronics, microcontrollers, 3D printing, CNC machining, or similar hands-on activities is an advantage.
 We offer 
 We offer a stimulating and diverse working environment with a high level of autonomy, opportunities to develop a broad range of technical skills, and the chance to contribute directly to the next phase of LéXPLORE, a leading research platform addressing major environmental challenges. 
 At EPFL, we believe that people achieve great results when they feel supported, respected and enabled to succeed. By joining our community, you will help shape the future of society through education, research and innovation. 
 Beyond work, our campuses host a vibrant community and unique environment, enriched by initiatives promoting equality, inclusion, diversity, well-being and sustainability as well as an engaging program of cultural, sports and community activities throughout the year.

 Votre quotidien 
Le site de Cannes est en charge de la conception des systèmes satellitaires & plateformes, de l’assemblage/intégration/test des satellites ainsi que des opérations en orbite. Le site a une expertise en instrumentation optique et en avionique. 
 Sur le site de Thales Alenia Space Cannes , au sein de la Direction de la Recherche , vous intégrerez l' équipe de recherche Math4Space , composé de 6 personnes .
 Ce stage cherche à répondre à la problématique : un modèle pré-entraîné sur nos propres données multimodales fait-il mieux, avec moins d'annotations et face à une modalité manquante, que les réseaux mono-canal déjà entraînés par l'équipe et que les modèles de fondation publics ? 
 Il s'agit d' apprendre des représentations communes aux images optiques , infrarouges et SAR à partir de données non annotées, puis de mesurer ce qu'elles apportent à la détection d'objets d'intérêt avec peu d'annotations.
 Vos principales missions seront les suivantes : 
 Établir l'état de l'art du pré-entraînement auto-supervisé multimodal (optique, infrarouge MWIR/LWIR, SAR ; approches contrastives ou par masquage) et reproduire deux ou trois méthodes de référence comme points de comparaison,
 Constituer et recaler les paires d'images multimodales, puis pré-entraîner un modèle (PyTorch ou JAX) sur la base d'images non annotées de l'équipe, et le comparer à des modèles de fondation publics pour mesurer l'apport de nos données,
 Étudier dans quelle mesure les annotations d'une modalité, peuvent servir à une autre par pseudo-labels et apprentissage actif, et tracer la performance en détection d'objets en fonction du nombre d'annotations face aux réseaux monocanal déjà entraînés par l'équipe,
 Évaluer la robustesse et la calibration des modèles lorsqu'une modalité est dégradée ou absente, puis proposer des stratégies pour y remédier, en vue d'un usage opérationnel et d'une possible implémentation embarquée,
 Exploiter la physique de formation des images (géométrie de visée et speckle du SAR, émission thermique de l'IR, réflexion en optique) comme biais inductif, par exemple en intégrant un modèle physique différentiable à l'architecture ou à la fonction de perte,
 Documenter les résultats (code reproductible, rapport, publication).
 L'objectif est une publication des résultats qui orienteront les choix de Thales Alenia Space en matière de coût d'annotation et de robustesse en exploitation.

 Votre quotidien 
Rejoignez-nous sur le campus Vélizy qui héberge une grande diversité d’activités Thales, aéro, défense, civile,... A l'ouest de Paris, ce site offre un environnement de travail équipé des dernières innovations technologiques et propose des services permettant de concilier vie professionnelle et personnelle. 
 Votre quotidien
 Au sein de l’équipe Simulation de Thales MIS, vous participerez à l’amélioration des outils numériques dédiés à la conception et à l’optimisation des tubes électroniques, en vous concentrant sur la simulation du champ magnétique.
 Les performances de ces équipements dépendent fortement de la précision de leur conception et des tolérances de fabrication. 
Afin de mieux prendre en compte les variations géométriques et physiques, l’objectif du stage est de développer un métamodèle capable de prédire le champ magnétique en trois dimensions, tout en réduisant les temps de calcul nécessaires aux simulations numériques.
 À partir de résultats issus de simulations par éléments finis, vous étudierez et mettrez en œuvre différentes méthodes de réduction de modèles, notamment les méthodes POD (Proper Orthogonal Decomposition) et SVD (Singular Value Decomposition), associées à des techniques de régression.
 Accompagné par votre tuteur, vos principales missions seront les suivantes :
 Réaliser une étude bibliographique sur les phénomènes physiques liés aux tubes électroniques et sur les méthodes de réduction de modèles adaptées à la problématique.
 Développer en Python différentes approches fondées sur les méthodes POD et SVD, associées à des techniques de régression.
 Tester et valider les méthodes développées à partir des résultats de simulations numériques existantes.
 Analyser les performances des différentes approches et comparer les résultats obtenus, éventuellement avec des outils spécialisés tels que pSeven ou Ansys.
 Évaluer la capacité des métamodèles à représenter le champ magnétique en trois dimensions en tenant compte de la variabilité des paramètres physiques et géométriques.
 Rédiger un rapport de synthèse et présenter les résultats obtenus à l’issue du stage.
 Ce stage de six mois vous permettra d’appliquer vos connaissances en mathématiques appliquées et en science des données à une problématique industrielle concrète, tout en développant vos compétences en modélisation numérique et en simulation électromagnétique.

 Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau Bac+5, au sein d’une école d’ingénieurs ou d’une université, avec une spécialisation en mathématiques appliquées, en science des données ou dans un domaine équivalent.
 Vous possédez de solides connaissances en mathématiques appliquées à la modélisation de phénomènes physiques, ainsi qu’en science des données, notamment en régression et en réduction de modèles.
 Vous maîtrisez Python et ses principales bibliothèques scientifiques, telles que NumPy, pandas, SciPy et scikit-learn. Des connaissances en TensorFlow ou PyTorch constituent un atout.
 Des connaissances en électromagnétisme sont appréciées. Vous disposez également d’un bon niveau d’anglais, vous permettant de consulter et d’analyser des publications scientifiques.
 Rigoureux et méthodique, vous possédez de bonnes capacités d’analyse et de synthèse. 
Vous savez faire preuve d’autonomie, de curiosité scientifique et de force de proposition dans la résolution de problèmes techniques.
 Vous souhaitez mettre vos compétences en mathématiques appliquées et en programmation au service d’un projet innovant associant simulation numérique, modélisation physique et intelligence artificielle.

 We are a global leader in the tire industry, specialized in designing, developing, manufacturing, and marketing high-performance tires for cars, motorcycles, and bicycles. With a presence in over 160 countries and around 18 production facilities, we pride ourselves on our cutting-edge technology and commitment to sustainability. Innovation is at the heart of everything we do, and it is fueled by our commitment to the inclusion of unique perspectives and different experiences. Because power is nothing without our people!
 WHY JOIN US 
 We are offering a rewarding role with scope for career progression along with:
 International, engaging, and supportive working environment.
 Competitive reimbursement.
 Free company restaurant.
 Personal and professional development.
 DRIVE YOUR FUTURE 
 You will join the Finance Transformation team within the Group Process area in our HQ, getting exposure with the Head of Finance Transformation. The role focuses on supporting Operational Excellence initiatives through the development of performance cockpits, KPI frameworks, and analytical models used to measure the adoption and effectiveness of digital finance solutions. You will also explore how AI and digital tools can improve analysis, reporting, automation, and decision-making across the Finance organization. This internship offers hands-on experience in real transformation projects within an international environment.
 WHAT YOU WILL LEARN 
 You will collaborate with your tutor in:
 Developing and maintaining KPI dashboards and performance cockpits using Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and other analytics tools.
 Analyzing operational and process data to monitor adoption, performance, and business impact of Finance Transformation initiatives.
 Using AI tools, including Microsoft Copilot and other generative AI solutions, to support analysis, reporting, and knowledge sharing.
 Designing performance measurement frameworks and translating data into clear insights for business stakeholders and management.
 Supporting process improvement and automation initiatives across Finance processes.
 Gaining exposure to enterprise platforms such as SAP, Serrala, and Tungsten, and understanding how global transformation programs are designed, measured, and implemented.
 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR 
 Degree in Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science or other STEM disciplines.
 Fluency in English and Italian.
 Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Python for data analysis or automation.
 Familiarity with Power BI or similar analytics tools is considered a plus.
 Analytical mindset and good communication skills with a proactive mindset
 Interest in Artificial Intelligence, digital technologies, process improvement, and Finance Transformation.
 APPLY NOW, DRIVE YOUR FUTURE!

items.card: What you will be doing: Study and develop cutting-edge techniques in deep learning, graphs, machine learning, and data analytics, and perform in-depth analysis and optimization to ensure the best possible performance on current- and next-generation GPU architectures. Work directly with key customers to understand the current and future problems they are solving and provide the best AI solutions using GPUs.
items.desc:
NVIDIA is looking for a passionate, computer science student to work in its Compute Developer Technology (Devtech) team as an AI Developer Technology intern. Artificial intelligence, the dream of computer scientists for over half a century, is no longer science fiction. And in the next few years, it will transform every industry. Soon, self-driving cars will reduce congestion and improve road safety. AI travel agents will know your preferences and arrange every detail of your family vacation. And medical instruments will read and understand patient DNA to detect and treat early signs of cancer. Where engines made us stronger and powered the first industrial revolution, AI will make us smarter and power the next. What will make this intelligent industrial revolution possible? A new computing model — GPU deep learning — that enables computers to learn from data and write software that is too complex for people to code. 
 What you will be doing: 
 Study and develop cutting-edge techniques in deep learning, graphs, machine learning, and data analytics, and perform in-depth analysis and optimization to ensure the best possible performance on current- and next-generation GPU architectures. 
 Work directly with key customers to understand the current and future problems they are solving and provide the best AI solutions using GPUs. 
 Collaborate closely with the architecture, research, libraries, tools, and system software teams at NVIDIA to influence the design of next-generation architectures, software platforms, and programming models. 
 What we need to see: 
 Pursuing a Bachelor degree or a Master degree or a PhD degree in an engineering, computer science or natural science related discipline with a strong computational profile. 
 Good knowledge of C/C++, DL frameworks, programming techniques, and AI algorithms. 
 Firsthand work experience with parallel programming, ideally CUDA C/C++. 
 Strong communication and organization skills, with a logical approach to problem solving, good time management, and task prioritization skills. 
 Some travel is required for conferences and for on-site visits with developers. 
 NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

 We have a fantastic opportunity to move into Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence, key technologies for the future of computing. Working on innovative Arm IP, crafting technology that powers the next generation of mobile apps, portable devices, home automation, smart cities, self-driving cars, and much more!
 Arm is entering a new growth phase to develop innovative technologies and products for existing and new markets. We need hardworking and motivated people to join our team. Working with the world’s best companies as they build sector-leading products from our inventions, you’ll share ideas with and learn new skills from top engineers globally.  Hold (or are on track to hold) a degree by the programme start date. This can be a Master’s or PhD degree in Machine learning, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Computer Science, or similar technical field.

 Comfortable working in a fast paced and dynamic environment.

 Genuine interest and strong skills in programming (preferably C, C++).

 Source control skills (Git, Gerrit, Repo).
 Understanding of SystemC and HLS flows.
 Understanding of HW build and/or modelling.
 Knowledge of agile SW development methods.
 Knowledge of Machine Learning applications and frameworks.
 Understanding of signal processing and control systems.
 Additional Information:
 We encourage early applications as we review them on a first come/first served basis. Please provide an academic transcript as part of your application.

 In Return:
 You’ll receive a starting salary of SEK 545,000 (Bachelor level) or SEK 555,000 (Master level), alongside a comprehensive rewards package. As you develop in role, you’ll have clear opportunities to progress within the salary range at Arm. With mid-year and year-end reviews, you’ll have two formal progression windows each year, recognising your growth.
 You can also attend our “Grad-teach-Grads” workshops, guest speaker series, and social events to expand your knowledge. If you’d like to get more involved, you can join the Graduate Committee to further develop your planning, networking, and coordination skills.
 You’ll be invited to our Global Graduate Conference (GGC) — an annual event where graduates hear from executive leaders, guest speakers, and build lasting connections.

items.desc:
What You'll Do: 
 Criteo is looking for new talented interns able to start from September 2026! 
 The Product Analytics & Data Science team uses cutting-edge technology, advanced statistics and machine learning to tackle some of the most complex Product challenges at Criteo. We help Criteo validate and evolve our products while exploring strategic game-changers to vault Criteo ahead in a fast-evolving media landscape. The team brings data and business expertise to feature teams, a unique understanding of complex Criteo machinery and supports Product Managers to design and build products with difference. 
 Wondering how is the life in the Product Analytics & Data Science​ team?
 Take a peek at : https://careers.criteo.com/en/criteo-life-blog/from-the-inside/live-my-life-with-the-product-analytics-data-science-team/ 
 You will be assigned to one or several projects. The topics we tackle are wide and always evolving! 
 Support the Measurement and R&D teams to build a comprehensive, practical, and universal measurement framework that frames the way CMOs understand their online marketing efficiency along the entire buyer journey 
 Improve Identity & Privacy solutions by optimizing our capability to recognize users across all their devices and their interactions in the open-internet 
 Work with the Quality Ad Experience team to pivot our user-level personalization engine and delivery rules to contextual and/or audience-based strategy 
 Explore and support the development of our New Marketing Outcomes: Video & CTV, Contextual, and Omnichannel. 
 Build the Buyer Index, a decision support service to improve the performance of digital ad campaigns in meeting clients’ goals across all addressability scenarios: addressable, cohort-based, or contextual. 
 Work with the Trading Strategies team, to offer a suite of controls to our advertisers and enhance the performance of our business models: budget, audience, targeting.
 Overall, your responsibilities include: 
 Mine large data sets and turn them into understandable and actionable insights 
 Build scalable analytic solutions using state of the art tools based on large and granular datasets 
 Design and execute a stream of analysis and tests to measure the impact of your solutions 
 Master our internal analytic datasets and reporting tools 
 Who You Are: 
 Master’s degree student or higher (Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Engineering, Economics, etc.)
 Available for at least 5 to 6 months from September
 End of study or gap year internship
 Outstanding analytical skills and creative thinking 
 Fluency in the core toolkit of Data Science: 
 Python; SQL
 Manipulating large-scale data sets 
 Building data pipelines 
 Descriptive and predictive modeling 
 Implementing visualizations, dashboards, and reports 
 Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, pro-active and independent to work with!
 PS: Please apply with an English resume 
 We acknowledge that many candidates may not meet every single role requirement listed above. If your experience looks a little different from our requirements but you believe that you can still bring value to the role, we’d love to see your application!​
 Who We Are: 
 We’re Criteo, the Commerce Intelligence Platform. Criteo helps businesses turn shopper signals into commerce outcomes while delivering more relevant experiences for shoppers. We use proprietary commerce intelligence and AI decisioning to drive relevance for shoppers and performance for businesses.
At Criteo, our culture is as unique as it is diverse. From our offices across the globe or from the comfort of home, our 3,600 Criteos collaborate together to build an open, impactful, and forward-thinking environment.
We foster a workplace where everyone is valued, and employment decisions are based solely on skills, qualifications, and business needs—never on non-job-related factors or legally protected characteristics.
 What We Offer: 
 🏢 Ways of working – Our hybrid model blends home with in-office experiences, making space for both.   
 📈 Grow with us – Learning, mentorship & career development programs.   
 💪 Your wellbeing matters – Health benefits, wellness perks & mental health support.   
 🤝 A team that cares – Diverse, inclusive, and globally connected.   
 💸 Fair pay & perks – Attractive salary, with performance-based rewards and family-friendly policies, plus the potential for equity depending on role and level.   
 Additional benefits may vary depending on the country where you work and the nature of your employment with Criteo.

items.desc:
The future starts here! Ready to join NXP ? 
 Become part of a dynamic Product Engineering team that is working on products driving One of the mega trends in the evolution towards highly automated vehicles. NXP offers sensor and processing technology that drives all aspects of the secure connected cars of today and the autonomous cars of tomorrow. Product line In-Vehicle Networking is with CAN, LIN, Flexray and Ethernet solutions, enabling communications within architectures designed for secure and hyper-connected autonomous vehicles. 
 Your Team 
 The Product Engineering: 
 You will be part of our product development team , Product Line, In-Vehicle Networking, in Nijmegen, Netherlands, who is working rigorously to deliver the best products to market on time while ensuring our brand's reputation for leadership in total quality at optimal cost.  
 As a Product Engineer ing intern , you are in a central position (a spider in the web) in the New IC Product development . You get to work with all the disciplines needed to design an IC and several external teams to prepare it for mass production . There is a lot of room for new ideas and innovations and you will be supported to have a continuous focus on development, coaching and creating a supportive environment from your team. 
 Your Responsibilities 
 Using your knowledge of artificial intelligence and machine learning develop innovative solutions to use within Product Engineering at NXP . 
 You analyze semiconductor test & characterization data using Statistical Data Analysis Tools. 
 You will be part of internal project sub-teams and supporting external interfaces. You work closely with the team lead to execute changes across functions to deliver your result on time, at optimal quality and cost. 
 Support development of New Machine learning solutions to provide best in class Data analytic s to the Product Engineering team. 
 You support the vision of product quality by implementing the best zero-defect screening methods and by continuously searching for the best screening techniques that meet the increasing market demand. 
 What’s in it for you 
 A great opportunity to develop your skills (technical, soft skills, communication, etc.) 
 Gaining experience in a multinational and diverse environment 
 Possibility to become part of NXP’s Young Professional Talent Pool 
 Working on real assignments which contribute to NXP’s objectives 
 Your P rofile 
 Master’s student with major in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a closely related quantitative field . Additional course work in Electronics and/or VLSI Design is a plus. 
 Strong programming skills in Python and experience working with data analysis or machine learning workflows. 
 Comfortable translating analytical results into practical engineering decisions and collaborating with cross-functional technical stakeholders. 
 Interest in semiconductor test data, production analytics, and developing ML solutions in an industrial setting. 
 Available for a minimum 6 months of internship. 
 Duration 
 This is a full-time internship ( 40 hours per week) with a duration of 6 months or longer. This assignment would not be suitable as a MSc thesis/graduation project.

Job Description 
 When you work at NXP Semiconductors you become part of a dynamic company. We have an informal culture, a can-do mentality and we learn from each other every day. This combination contributes to the success of our organization, our teams, and our people.
 WHO ARE WE ? 
 You will be a part of a diverse and experienced team of 8 Local People Partners (formerly HR managers) supporting corporate headquarters, business lines, R&D organizations and a factory. Next to that we have about 37 NL-based HR professionals in recruitment, rewards, legal, HR systems, HR analytics, administration and payroll, plus another ~300 HR colleagues worldwide.
 YOUR PROFILE 
 You are an enrolled Bachelor or Master student in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Psychology, or a related field.
 You have a strong interest in the future of HR and the impact of AI on people-related processes.
 You are analytical, curious, and able to translate insights into practical recommendations.
 You are self-driven and take ownership of your work.
 You have excellent communication and organizational skills.
 You are fluent in English and Dutch.
 Research question: 
 This research explores how the adoption of Artificial Intelligence is reshaping the role of Local People Partners. The study will examine the impact of AI on HR processes, required competencies, decision-making, and the future strategic positioning of local people partners within NXP.
 Possible research question: How will the adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI) transform the role, responsibilities, competencies, and strategic contribution of Local People Partners within NXP? 
 The research may include topics such as the augmentation of HR activities, the changing skill set of HR professionals, the impact of AI on employee experience and talent management, and the ethical and governance considerations associated with AI-driven HR practices. The outcome of the study should provide practical insights and recommendations for the HR function preparing for an AI-enabled future.
 DURATION 
 The duration of the internship will be a minimum of 4-6 months.
 Please note that in order to be considered for an internship/thesis assignment, you need to be registered as a student during the entire period.

items.desc:
At Light, we’re redefining how software is built, how it’s delivered, and how it works.
 We’re building organic software . Software that heals itself. Software that adapts to the user and the business. Software that learns and gets better as it’s used.
 Our starting point is finance. Companies including Legora, Lovable, and Fuse Energy already run on Light. We’re building towards a platform that understands how each business operates and evolves with it.
 As an AI Engineering Intern, you’ll help make that happen: building systems that identify mistakes, improve their own behaviour, and prove those improvements work. You’ll work on the agents, models, and infrastructure that turn organic software into something customers can rely on.
 Who this is for 
 You must meet both of these requirements:
 Currently studying at University of Oxford, or University of Cambridge. 
 A silver medal or higher at the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) or International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI), or an equivalent level of achievement in another highly competitive endeavour. 
 If you’re applying with an equivalent achievement, explain the competition or field, your result, and the standard required to achieve it. If you’re at Oxford/Cambridge and you don’t have an equivalent level of achievement we encourage you to not apply.
 Our bar for internships at Light is high. You will need the curiosity to explore unfamiliar areas, the willingness to go the extra mile to get things right, the discipline to test your assumptions, and the persistence to keep going when your first approach does not work.
 What you’ll work on 
 You’ll have access to our repositories, real engineering problems, and an internal coding agent that already opens pull requests against production code. Your work will help make these systems more capable and reliable.
 Help agents learn from their work. Our agent reviews merged pull requests and corrections to update its repository-specific instructions. You’ll shape that process, catch misleading lessons, and test whether new instructions improve its performance.
 Train and deploy LLM and ML models. Fine-tune SoA LLM models. Run experiments, compare results against the existing pipeline, and establish whether a model is ready for production. Leverage ML tools to enhance the ability of our Agents via e.g. K-means, t-sne, PCA, random forest trees etc. etc.
 Build Agents. Take full end to end ownership of an agent. Agent do pre-emptive support for the self-healing pipeline; they fix; they communicate with customers; etc.
 Build evaluations and review tools. Define what a correct answer looks like, create tests that expose failures, and help catch poor output before it reaches customers.
 Own projects through delivery. Scope the problem, build the solution, debug regressions, and follow through until the customer can rely on what you’ve shipped.
 You’ll work alongside exceptional colleagues.
 What else we’re looking for 
 Strong programming ability.
 Something you’ve built beyond coursework or tutorials: a model, agent, tool, or application that does useful work.
 Hands-on experience with AI tooling, such as LLM APIs, agent frameworks, model fine-tuning, or automated workflows.
 A habit of investigating why a system failed and testing whether your fix addresses the cause.
 Clear thinking and the ability to explain your decisions, including what you tried and why it didn’t work.
 Open-source contributions, deployed models, and experience building evaluation pipelines are a plus.
 How we’ll measure success 
 Your work should produce measurable improvements: more correct agent-generated changes, better model accuracy, fewer failures reaching users, or tools the team continues to use. You’ll help define those measures and use them to assess what you build.
 What you’ll get 
 Internship compensation above the standard market rate. 
 A role based in our London office, working alongside the product and engineering team.
 Ownership from your first day, with a path to shipping work into production.
 How to apply 
 Send your CV.
 Include a link to something you’ve shipped. Tell us what it does, which parts you built yourself, where it failed, and how you fixed it. Then explain why you want to work on organic software at Light.
 We want to understand how you think, what you can build, and what you’re ready to take on next.
 Light is an equal opportunity employer.

items.desc: Paris, 75, FR ABOUT CFM Founded in 1991, we are a global quantitative and systematic asset management firm applying a scientific approach to finance to develop alternative investment strategies that create value for our clients. We value innovation, dedication, collaboration, and the ability to make an impact. Together, we create a stimulating environment for talented and passionate experts in research, technology, and business to explore new ideas and challenge existing assumptions. Your Role Market Data – Front Office Support is responsible for ensuring the integrity, accuracy and timely availability of the market data that feeds the CFM trading activities. It operates at the intersection of data management, technology and finance, and relies on data from multiple external providers to drive diversified investment strategies. The team relies on an internal web tool that centralizes announcements issued by several market data providers, matches them against the financial instruments referential, enables review and validation by business teams, and forwards them to a ticketing tool. Developed several years ago and recently migrated to newer infrastructure, the tool has never been fundamentally redesigned. It suffers from an aging architecture (hard to maintain, slow), fragile provider integrations, security debt, a poorly responsive UI with repetitive manual review steps, and no automated tests. As a result, operators spend a lot of time on manual reviews, and many announcements require little or no action. The central project of your internship is to rebuild this application on a more robust, faster and more maintainable foundation, and to use LLM-based agents to assist operators in reviewing and processing announcements, so that they can focus only on the cases that truly require human attention. Key Responsibilities Audit the existing tool and gather needs from Market Data operators. Design a more robust, faster and maintainable architecture. Build the new application (or an advanced prototype) and define a migration plan. Secure access management and the handling of secrets and sensitive data. Make external provider integrations reliable and resilient. Automate repetitive tasks (imports, synchronizations, notifications). Research AI assistance for current and past announcement review: matching, summarization. Simplify communication with users. Modernize the user interface for better responsiveness. Set up automated tests and a CI pipeline, and document the solution. Your Skills You are pursuing a Master's or engineering school degree (Bac+4/5) in computer science. You have a solid foundation in web development, with practical knowledge of Python, Node.js and databases. You have an interest in applied AI, particularly LLMs and agent-based approaches. You can understand and evolve existing code. You are autonomous, take initiative, and are rigorous, curious and have a strong team spirit. You are comfortable in both French and English. A plus: experience with testing and CI/CD, API integrations, application security, data quality and validation methodologies, financial data or corporate actions. Aujourd'hui, notre Groupe est : Numéro 1 mondial des solutions haut débit (box internet et services logiciels associés) Leader technologique des solutions audio-vidéo (hubs vidéo 4K et Video SoundBox™ ) Leader européen des solutions smart-grid (comptage communicant, réseaux intelligents, électrification rurale, IoT) En 2024, Sagemcom a réalisé un chiffre d'affaires de 2.3 milliards d'euros, et s'appuie sur 6 500 collaborateurs répartis dans plus de 50 pays. Intégrer le groupe Sagemcom, c'est rejoindre un groupe de dimension internationale, où vous pourrez chaque jour relever de nouveaux défis. Si le travail en équipe, l'agilité, la créativité et les nouvelles technologies vous intéressent, rejoignez l'aventure ! » Référence 2026-2407 Description du poste Titre du poste Ingénieur développement logiciel AI-native – Software Suite 5G H/F Contrat CDI Description de l'équipe Vous rejoignez l'équipe Software Suite 5G de notre R&D Broadband Solutions, en charge du développement logiciel middleware de nos passerelles résidentielles FWA. Ces produits, déployés chez des opérateurs télécoms, apportent le très haut débit fixe par la 5G et intègrent les dernières générations de Wi-Fi (Wi-Fi 8). Nous engageons une évolution de nos pratiques avec une approche de développement AI-native, intégrant l'IA et les agents IA à chaque étape du cycle de développement. Description de la mission En tant que Développeur·se logiciel senior AI-native, vous concevez et développez les composants middleware de nos passerelles 5G, principalement en C, dans un environnement Linux embarqué. Vous intervenez directement sur la conception et le développement des solutions et contribuez aux choix techniques avec les architectes et les autres développeurs de l'équipe. Principales activités Concevoir et développer des composants middleware embarqués robustes, performants et sécurisés dans un environnement Linux embarqué. Participer à la personnalisation de la Software Suite utilisée pour les produits gateways. Développer les services de gestion de la connectivité 5G : pilotage du modem, connexion WAN cellulaire, bascule et supervision du lien. Implémenter des services système en user space : gestion réseau, Wi-Fi, TR-181/USP, sécurité, diagnostics, supervision. Interagir avec les couches BSP et drivers Linux, les fournisseurs de modems et chipsets, ainsi qu'avec les équipes applicatives (UI, cloud). Intégrer des composants open source et développer des modules spécifiques. Garantir la qualité des développements par les tests automatisés, les revues de code et l'analyse des performances sur cible. Utiliser de manière avancée les outils et agents IA tout au long du cycle de développement, tout en gardant la maîtrise du résultat. Contribuer au partage des bonnes pratiques techniques au sein de l'équipe, notamment sur l'usage de l'IA. Profil recherché : Vous disposez d'une solide expérience dans le développement de logiciels embarqués sous Linux, idéalement sur des équipements réseau, télécoms ou cellulaires. Vous maîtrisez particulièrement : Le langage C et la programmation système Linux (processus, IPC, sockets, gestion mémoire), ainsi que les problématiques de performance et de concurrence. Les distributions Linux embarquées et leurs outils de build. Les protocoles réseau : TCP/IP, routage, DHCP, DNS, IPv6, firewalling. Le débogage sur cible (gdb, strace, valgrind, analyse de traces et de core dumps), le shell et Python pour l'outillage et les tests, ainsi que les pratiques CI/CD. L'utilisation avancée d'outils de développement assisté par IA tels que Claude Code, GitHub Copilot ou équivalents, incluant le pilotage d'agents IA, la décomposition des tâches, la revue du code généré et la validation des résultats. Une expérience de l'intégration de modems cellulaires (4G/5G) ou des passerelles FWA est appréciée. La connaissance d'interfaces et protocoles tels que QMI, MBIM, commandes AT, TR-181 ou USP (TR-369) constitue un plus. Nous recherchons un profil très opérationnel et autonome, capable de prendre en charge un sujet de bout en bout, de challenger les solutions techniques proposées, y compris celles produites par l'IA, et de contribuer aux choix de conception. Une connaissance du Wi-Fi (Wi-Fi 6/7, EasyMesh) est appréciée. Sagemcom est une entreprise handi-accueillante. items.desc: At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards. In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate. A few examples of your responsibilities Build software that matters. Take real ownership from idea to production, creating systems used by millions and evolving them into products at scale. Amplify your impact with AI. Integrate the most powerful AI tools directly into your development workflow—design, implementation, testing, and documentation—to move faster while maintaining high standards for correctness, reliability, and maintainability. Master your toolkit. Work across diverse stacks with end-to-end ownership, choosing the right technologies for each challenge. From monoliths to microservices, gRPC to REST, Kubernetes to Docker, Python to Rust—you’ll apply technologies thoughtfully, focusing on depth and purpose rather than trends. Simplify relentlessly. Question every layer of complexity. Improve architectures, pipelines, and codebases to build systems that are simpler, more scalable, and easier to maintain. What we look for Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter. Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar. Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent. Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English. What we offer Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field. An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too. All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work. A flexible start date and part-time options. You don't need to wait until graduation to apply. We offer flexible start dates and the possibility to begin part-time, transitioning to full-time as you complete your degree. Many Spooners joined before graduating and progressively took on greater responsibility, with arrangements that allowed them to do so without compromising their education. Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity. The selection process In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.
