items.desc: ¿Qué tipo de Data & AI techie eres? Data Analytics, Big Data, Inteligencia Artificial, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, Cloud Data Platforms… Si te interesa cómo los datos y la IA transforman los negocios y la sociedad, tenemos mucho en común. Accenture Data & AI es el área desde la que ayudamos a nuestros clientes a extraer valor real de sus datos, aplicando analítica avanzada, inteligencia artificial y soluciones de datos a gran escala para impulsar la toma de decisiones, la automatización y la innovación. En Accenture Data & AI trabajamos en programas de transformación empresarial y tecnológica de gran impacto para clientes globales, utilizando tecnologías punteras en entornos cloud y arquitecturas modernas de datos. Buscamos estudiantes universitarios con interés en iniciar su carrera en el área de Data & IA. No requerimos experiencia previa ni una tecnología concreta de entrada: recibirás formación al incorporarte y te asignaremos un proyecto en función de tu perfil, motivación y necesidades del negocio, trabajando con herramientas actuales y metodologías Agile. Aporta curiosidad, pensamiento analítico y ganas de aprender para ayudar a nuestros clientes a convertir los datos en conocimiento, innovación y crecimiento sostenible. ¡El cambio empieza por ti! Únete a Accenture Data & IA. Funciones Participar en el diseño, desarrollo y mantenimiento de soluciones de datos, colaborando en procesos de ingestión, transformación y explotación de información utilizando herramientas de analítica y plataformas de datos en entornos cloud. Apoyar en el análisis de datos estructurados y no estructurados para la elaboración de informes, dashboards y modelos analíticos que faciliten la toma de decisiones de negocio. Colaborar en proyectos de inteligencia artificial y analítica avanzada, participando en tareas de preparación de datos, entrenamiento, validación y evaluación de modelos de machine learning. Trabajar en equipos multidisciplinares bajo metodologías Agile (Scrum/Kanban), documentando desarrollos, participando en ceremonias y asegurando la calidad de los entregables. Responsabilidades Ejecutar las tareas asignadas cumpliendo los estándares técnicos, de calidad y de seguridad definidos en el proyecto. Documentar procesos de datos, análisis y modelos desarrollados, asegurando su correcta comprensión y reutilización. Aprender y aplicar nuevas herramientas, tecnologías y metodologías relacionadas con Data & IA según las necesidades del proyecto. Colaborar activamente con perfiles senior, data engineers, data scientists y consultores para la correcta entrega de soluciones de valor al cliente. ¿Qué ofrecemos? Formaciones diseñadas específicamente para tu desarrollo técnico y competencial en Data, Analytics e Inteligencia Artificial. Un programa de mentoring que te ayudará a explorar tus opciones en Accenture y a construir tu propio camino profesional con nosotros. Otros requisitos son: Formación universitaria en Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Estadística, Física u otras titulaciones STEM relacionadas. Nivel mínimo de inglés B2. Otros idiomas serán valorables. Curiosidad intelectual y mentalidad analítica. Capacidad de trabajo en equipo en entornos multidisciplinares. Pasión por la tecnología, los datos y la inteligencia artificial. Igualdad de Oportunidades en el Empleo Todas las decisiones de empleo se tomarán sin importar la edad, raza, credo, color, religión, sexo, origen nacional, ascendencia, grado de discapacidad, estado de veterano, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género, información genética, estado civil, estado de ciudadanía o cualquier otro motivo o circunstancias protegidas por las leyes federales, estatales o locales.

items.desc: En Tecdata Engineering buscamos un/a Data Scientist especializado/a en Machine Learning y modelado predictivo para participar en el desarrollo y la puesta en producción de soluciones analíticas avanzadas dentro del ecosistema Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Buscamos un perfil con sólidos conocimientos de Python, SQL y Machine Learning, experiencia trabajando con grandes volúmenes de datos y capacidad para desarrollar modelos escalables, eficientes y orientados a producción. ¿Cuáles serán tus funciones? Diseñar, desarrollar y entrenar modelos avanzados de Machine Learning, especialmente modelos de forecasting y predicción. Desarrollar modelos de propensión para analizar y anticipar el comportamiento de los usuarios. Diseñar e implementar algoritmos de optimización basados en técnicas de programación lineal. Realizar procesos de ingesta, limpieza, transformación y preparación de grandes volúmenes de datos, incluyendo escenarios de miles de millones de registros. Desarrollar y optimizar pipelines de datos y modelos analíticos utilizando Google Cloud Platform. Trabajar con BigQuery para la extracción, transformación y análisis de datos a gran escala. Orquestar flujos de trabajo y procesos de entrenamiento mediante Apache Airflow. Desplegar y gestionar modelos de Machine Learning en producción utilizando Vertex AI. Utilizar Apache Spark para el procesamiento distribuido de datos cuando sea necesario. Desarrollar algoritmos robustos, escalables y preparados para producción, minimizando las diferencias entre los entornos de desarrollo y producción. Automatizar procesos analíticos y optimizar el rendimiento de los modelos y las soluciones implementadas. Atender y resolver incidencias de nivel 3N relacionadas con los proyectos desplegados en producción que estén bajo su responsabilidad. Requisitos imprescindibles Experiencia demostrable como Data Scientist en proyectos de Machine Learning y analítica avanzada. Experiencia en diseño y entrenamiento de modelos de forecasting. Experiencia desarrollando modelos de propensión. Conocimientos de algoritmos de optimización y programación lineal. Dominio avanzado de Python para desarrollo de modelos, automatización y procesamiento de datos. Nivel experto de SQL para extracción, transformación y manipulación de grandes volúmenes de información. Experiencia práctica con Google Cloud Platform (GCP) . Experiencia trabajando con: BigQuery: consulta y procesamiento de datos a gran escala. Apache Airflow: orquestación y automatización de workflows. Vertex AI: entrenamiento, despliegue y gestión de modelos de Machine Learning. Apache Spark: procesamiento distribuido de datos. Experiencia desarrollando y manteniendo algoritmos en entornos productivos. Capacidad para diagnosticar y resolver incidencias técnicas en producción. ¿Qué valoramos? Experiencia procesando volúmenes masivos de datos, de miles de millones de registros. Conocimientos de MLOps y automatización del ciclo de vida de los modelos. Experiencia optimizando pipelines de datos y procesos de entrenamiento. Capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma, identificar problemas y proponer soluciones técnicas eficientes. ¿Te interesa el reto? Si tienes experiencia en Data Science, Machine Learning y Google Cloud Platform, y te motiva desarrollar modelos predictivos de alto impacto preparados para producción, ¡queremos conocerte! Envíanos tu CV y valoraremos tu encaje con el proyecto.

items.desc: OM JOBBET Vi söker en Digitalisation & AI Coordinator som vill driva digitalisering och AI-initiativ i en internationell industrikoncern. Du får en central roll där du samordnar projekt, identifierar förbättringsmöjligheter och omsätter verksamhetens behov till konkreta digitala lösningar. Företaget har redan utvecklat flera interna applikationer och identifierat ett 20-tal nya utvecklingsmöjligheter. Ditt uppdrag blir att skapa struktur, prioritera initiativ och driva projekten från idé till implementering. OM FÖRETAGET Vår kund är en internationell industrikoncern med cirka 23 000 medarbetare globalt, varav 3 300 i Sverige. Företaget satsar aktivt på digitalisering, AI och teknisk innovation för att effektivisera processer och utveckla verksamheten. ARBETSUPPGIFTER I rollen arbetar du nära verksamheten, interna intressenter och utvecklingsteam för att samordna och driva digitala utvecklingsprojekt. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att: Koordinera och driva digitaliserings- och AI-projekt från idé till implementering. Identifiera verksamhetsbehov och omsätta dem till digitala lösningar. Planera, prioritera och följa upp projekt, aktiviteter och tidsplaner. Samordna interna intressenter och externa utvecklingsteam. Leda möten, workshops och presentationer. Ta fram business case, kostnads- och nyttoanalyser. Stötta testning, implementering och utveckling av nya digitala arbetssätt. Projekten kan exempelvis omfatta AI-baserade stödsystem, identifiering av affärsmöjligheter och automatisering av interna processer. ERFARENHETER OCH EGENSKAPER Vi söker dig med relevant utbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet inom IT, teknik, digitalisering, AI eller verksamhetsutveckling. Vi ser gärna att du har: Cirka 3–5 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet. Erfarenhet av projektledning eller projektkoordinering, gärna inom AI och digitalisering. God förståelse för AI och hur tekniken kan skapa verksamhetsnytta. Erfarenhet av processförbättringar och digital utveckling. Förmåga att samordna olika intressenter och driva projekt framåt. items.title: Clinical Research Fellow in Respiratory Viral Infections
items.card: About the role We are looking for a highly motivated clinician in training (Internal Medicine/Specialty Registrar Grade or equivalent) with a strong interest in infectious diseases and their prevention to investigate immunity in clinical volunteer studies involving rhinovirus and RSV controlled human infection. You will be part of a multi-disciplinary team focusing on human immunity against respiratory viral
items.desc: Job number MED06020 Faculties Faculty of Medicine Departments Department of Infectious Disease Salary or Salary range £55,355 - £67,325 per annum Location/campus Hammersmith Campus - On site only Contract type work pattern Full time - Fixed term Posting End Date 29 Nov 2026 About the role We are looking for a highly motivated clinician in training (Internal Medicine/Specialty Registrar Grade or equivalent) with a strong interest in infectious diseases and their prevention to investigate immunity in clinical volunteer studies involving rhinovirus and RSV controlled human infection. You will be part of a multi-disciplinary team focusing on human immunity against respiratory viral infections using exciting and unique studies designs alongside cutting-edge laboratory techniques. You will join a dynamic group of clinical fellows, research nurses and scientists led by Prof Chris Chiu (www.imperial.ac.uk/people/c.chiu) in the Department of Infectious Disease, to characterise the response to respiratory viruses in older adults. This will accelerate the development of improved prophylactic interventions respiratory viruses, while providing you with unparalleled experience in translational research, experimental medicine and laboratory analyses. What you would be doing You will work closely with research nurses, clinical programme manager, other clinical fellows and laboratory scientists to set up and implement human challenge studies to identify determinants of susceptibility and protection against rhinovirus and RSV in older adult volunteers. You will manage the clinical studies, working with research nurses and other clinicians to recruit and screen and care for volunteers, administer virus, and obtain samples. What we are looking for You should have a degree in Medicine and full GMC registration. It is essential that you are confident and skilled in practical clinical procedures and management of medical emergencies. You will have a strong background in acute medicine and, ideally, in one of the following disciplines: infectious diseases, virology, microbiology, immunology, ENT or respiratory medicine. You should also have good written and verbal communication skills, analytical and proven problem solving/project completion abilities, demonstrable ability to work to deadlines and to work in a team. What we can offer you You will be appointed on an honorary contract with Imperial College Healthcare NHS Trust. There will be no fixed clinical duties and no on-call, but as part of the Academic Health Science Centre you may be able to participate in clinical activities to maintain your skills and support the clinical respiratory or infection services (up to 6 hours per week maximum), which will facilitate delivery of the research programme. Training will be provided for all aspects of your role, from the clinical skills required to the organisational responsibilities and research skills that will allow your development as a clinical academic. In addition, you will Grow in your career with tailored training programmes for clinical staff including dedicated support with navigating your career and managing research as well as a transparent promotion process. Sector-leading salary and remuneration package (including 41 days off a year and generous pension schemes). Be part of a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative work culture with various staff networks and resources designed to support your personal and professional wellbeing. Further information This is a full-time post (35 hours per week). It is available to start in February/March 2027 and based mainly at the Hammersmith Campus with some travelling to the St Mary’s and Charing Cross Campuses or Chelsea and Westminster Hospital as required. This role is for a fixed-term contract for 24 months. If you require any further details about the role, please contact: Prof Chris Chiu (c.chiu@imperial.ac.uk; https://profiles.imperial.ac.uk/c.chiu). Available documents Attached documents are available under links. Clicking a document link will initialize its download. Please note that job descriptions are not exhaustive, and you may be asked to take on additional duties that align with the key responsibilities mentioned above. We reserve the right to close the advert before the stated closing date, should we receive a high volume of applications. Please submit your application as early as possible to avoid disappointment. If you have any general queries about this vacancy, please contact the hiring manager listed in the ‘Further Information’ section. Alternatively, you can contact the Recruitment Hub at recruitmenthub@imperial.ac.uk, and we will be happy to assist you. If you experience any technical issues that prevent you from submitting an application, please contact our Technical Support team at support.jobs@imperial.ac.uk, who will be able to help resolve the issue. Gemeinsam mit führenden Partnern aus Wissenschaft und Industrie entwickeln wir im Bereich »Center Nanoelectronic Technologies« (CNT) innovative Hardwarelösungen für energieeffiziente Künstliche Intelligenz. Dabei erforschen wir unter anderem ferroelektrische Speicher in resistiven Crossbar-Architekturen sowie moderne CMOS-Technologien wie FDSOI. Mit unserer Forschung tragen wir dazu bei, intelligente Sensorsysteme der nächsten Generation zu ermöglichen und bauen unsere Kompetenzen in den Bereichen Embedded Machine Learning, neuromorphe Hardware und Deep-Learning-Beschleuniger kontinuierlich weiter aus. items.desc:
Vous recherchez un stage en IA et vous avez un intérêt pour l’environnement bancaire ? Alors cette offre est faite pour vous ! 
La Direction des Risques et du Contrôle Permanent (RPC) maîtrise et contrôle l’ensemble des risques du groupe Crédit Agricole CIB: risques individuels (ou risques de contrepartie), risques de marché, risques pays ou de portefeuille, risques opérationnels. Elle exerce ses missions dans le cadre de la ligne métier Risques du Groupe Crédit Agricole.
 VRM est le département de RPC responsable de la validation des modèles de mesure des risques de marché et de gestion financière, et de la surveillance des risques de modèles. Il est constitué d’analystes quantitatifs en charge de challenger les méthodologies et leur implémentation, et de mettre en place des processus et des outils de surveillance des risques de modèles. 
 Concrètement vos missions seront les suivantes : 
Dans le cadre de l’automatisation partielle de la documentation des validations de modèle, nous souhaitons développer un outil utilisant l’IA générative. Il faudra donc développer “from scratch” un agent autonome dans le cadre d’une Risk Team au sein de la banque.
Les Large Language Models (LLMs) , entraînés pour effectuer une modélisation causale du langage, peuvent s’attaquer à un large éventail de tâches, mais ils ont souvent du mal avec les tâches de base comme la logique, le calcul et la recherche. Lorsqu’on les invite à entrer dans des domaines dans lesquels ils ne sont pas performants, ils ne parviennent souvent pas à générer la réponse que nous attendons d’eux.
Une approche pour surmonter cette faiblesse est de créer un agent . Un agent est un système qui utilise un LLM comme moteur et qui a accès à des fonctions appelées outils
L’organisation du stage sera composée de différentes phases :
 Revue de la littérature existante ;
 Construction de l’agent : définition du type et du périmètre souhaité ;
 Proposition de moyens pour l’implémenter dans le pipeline existant au sein de l’équipe.
Rejoindre Crédit Agricole CIB, c’est profiter d’une communauté importante de jeunes, évoluer sur un campus moderne offrant de nombreux services (boulangerie, salle de sport, etc.), bénéficier d’un suivi RH (matinée d’accueil, suivi régulier, etc.) et d’opportunités en alternance, VIE, CDD et CDI.

items.desc: Data Scientist at Fidorn London | On-site Fidorn builds AI-powered software for accounting firms. We're working directly with firms to understand how they operate, analyse their workflows and develop technology that automates repetitive work. We're hiring a data scientist who can work with complex, real-world data and turn it into practical solutions. You'll work closely with our engineering team, using operational data to identify opportunities, develop models and improve the performance of our products. The role involves working with messy datasets, building data pipelines, testing hypotheses and translating findings into improvements that can be deployed in production. items.desc: KAVE es una marca global de diseño de mobiliario y decoración para el hogar, dedicada a inspirar a personas únicas e inconformistas como nosotros. La industria del mueble y la decoración es una de las mayores industrias minoristas a nivel mundial. El potencial es enorme y apuntamos alto. Somos un grupo de más de 1.100 profesionales internacionales, talentosos y motivados, con la misión de transformar por completo la experiencia desde el diseño hasta el cliente, ofreciendo diseños sostenibles, una excelente relación calidad-precio y una experiencia de compra omnicanal de primer nivel. Buscamos un/a Junior AI Automation Engineer para incorporarse a nuestro equipo de Business Process Automation (BPA) y crecer con nosotros en la transformación de cómo trabajamos mediante Inteligencia Artificial, automatización y tecnología. Esta posición está pensada para una persona que esté iniciando su carrera profesional, con una buena base tecnológica, curiosidad por la IA y muchas ganas de aprender y construir. Trabajarás junto a otros perfiles del equipo BPA y diferentes áreas de Kave para entender procesos y convertir oportunidades de mejora en soluciones reales de automatización e IA. Funciones: Colaborar con el equipo BPA y diferentes áreas de negocio para entender procesos e identificar tareas manuales, repetitivas o ineficientes que puedan simplificarse o automatizarse. Participar en el diseño y desarrollo de automatizaciones y workflows utilizando principalmente n8n y otras tecnologías Low-Code/No-Code. Desarrollar progresivamente soluciones basadas en Inteligencia Artificial, participando en casos de uso con LLMs, agentes de IA y workflows inteligentes. Crear y mantener integraciones sencillas entre aplicaciones y fuentes de datos mediante APIs, webhooks y otros mecanismos de integración. Utilizar programación, especialmente Python y/o JavaScript, para complementar y ampliar las automatizaciones cuando sea necesario. Participar en las diferentes fases de desarrollo de una solución: diseño, desarrollo, testing, despliegue, monitorización, documentación y mejora continua. Detectar errores e incidencias en automatizaciones existentes y colaborar en su resolución y evolución. Documentar de forma clara las automatizaciones y soluciones desarrolladas para facilitar su mantenimiento y reutilización. Aprender y aplicar progresivamente las buenas prácticas de desarrollo, seguridad, calidad y escalabilidad definidas por el equipo. Participar en el seguimiento de las soluciones implantadas para entender su adopción y el impacto generado en los procesos. Requisitos: Formación universitaria o técnica en Ingeniería Informática, Telecomunicaciones, Matemáticas, Data Science, Inteligencia Artificial, Ingeniería Industrial o titulaciones afines. No necesitas experiencia profesional previa. Valoraremos especialmente proyectos universitarios, TFG/TFM, prácticas o proyectos personales relacionados con programación, automatización, datos o Inteligencia Artificial. Conocimientos básicos de programación, preferiblemente Python y/o JavaScript. Interés por la Inteligencia Artificial generativa, los LLMs y los agentes de IA, y muchas ganas de profundizar en su aplicación a problemas reales. Conocimientos básicos o interés en aprender sobre APIs, JSON, bases de datos e integración entre aplicaciones. Se valorará haber experimentado con herramientas de automatización como n8n, Make, Zapier o Power Platform, aunque no es imprescindible. Capacidad para analizar problemas, estructurarlos y buscar soluciones de forma lógica. Curiosidad tecnológica y capacidad de aprendizaje, con interés por experimentar con nuevas herramientas y entender cómo pueden generar valor real. Capacidad para trabajar en equipo y explicar de forma sencilla lo que estás construyendo. Inglés que te permita desenvolverte en un entorno tecnológico e internacional. Ofrecemos: La oportunidad de iniciar tu carrera profesional trabajando directamente con automatización e Inteligencia Artificial aplicada a procesos reales de negocio. Un entorno donde aprender de perfiles técnicos con experiencia y asumir progresivamente mayor autonomía y complejidad. La posibilidad de trabajar con diferentes áreas de la compañía y entender cómo tecnología, procesos y negocio se conectan. Espacio para experimentar, proponer ideas, aprender de los errores y convertir nuevas tecnologías en soluciones reales. Un proyecto en crecimiento en el que podrás evolucionar hacia posiciones de mayor especialización y responsabilidad dentro del ámbito de AI & Automation.

items.desc: Location: Marseille (Vieux-Port) Type: 6-month Internship Start Date: Flexible 2026 🌊 About Syroco Syroco is building the technologies that will help decarbonise maritime transportation. Every day, hundreds of vessels generate streams of operational, environmental and navigational data. We transform these data into optimisation decisions that reduce fuel consumption and emissions at sea. This requires combining physics, machine learning, software engineering and large-scale data systems. We are a team of engineers, scientists and naval architects working on problems that are both intellectually challenging and immediately connected to the real world. 🎯 The Role Every day, our platform receives and processes data from vessels operating all around the world. These data are used to understand vessel behaviour, evaluate performance, support operational decisions and ultimately help reduce fuel consumption and emissions. As the platform grows, so does the challenge of operating it. How do we know when a data source can no longer be trusted? How do we identify the origin of an unexpected behaviour? How do we help engineers investigate issues more eﬃciently? How do we turn operational knowledge into software rather than manual processes? How can AI help us better understand and operate our data systems? These are some of the questions you will work on.As part of the Data team, you will contribute to the development of the internal tools, analyses and automation that support our platform on a daily basis. You will work with maritime datasets, production systems and engineering teams, while collaborating closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Software Engineers and Naval Architects. The role is intentionally broad. Depending on your interests and on ongoing projects, you may spend time analysing data, investigating anomalies, improving internal tooling, automating operational workflows or exploring new applications of AI. More than a predefined list of tasks, we see this internship as an opportunity to take ownership of meaningful problems and help us build the next generation of tools used to understand and operate our data platform. 🧰 Who We Are Looking For You are currently completing a Master’s degree or the final year of an engineering school. You are comfortable working with open-ended questions where the path to the answer is not always obvious. You like combining analytical thinking with practical implementation, and you care about building solutions that are useful in practice. Your background may be in computer science, mathematics, statistics, physics or engineering. Previous experience in data science, software engineering or machine learning is welcome, but not required. More than a particular technical stack, we value curiosity, sound judgement, autonomy and the ability to learn quickly. Most importantly, you are excited by the idea of working on real-world problems with data, software and AI, alongside a team of engineers and scientists building products that are used every day. 💡 What You Can Expect This is a hands-on internship with real ownership. You will work closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Software Engineers and Naval Architects, contribute to production systems and see your work used by teams across the company. Understanding vessel behaviour often requires combining observations from data with engineering intuition and maritime expertise. You’ll regularlyinteract with specialists from different backgrounds and learn how operational, physical and data-driven perspectives complement one another. items.desc: Who we are: Open-minded intellectuals who embrace emerging technologies on our mission to create innovative Software Engineering Solutions that will impact millions of users around the world. We are looking for: We are looking for an AI Engineer to build the platform that reconstructs and validates software specifications from an existing system’s own assets — its source code, its existing documentation, and its existing test cases. What you will do: Build the Analysis Pipeline Implement the agents and stages that map components, analyse them in depth, and draft specifications from source evidence. Decompose complex analysis into focused sub-tasks with clear inputs, outputs, and verification expectations, following the agreed architecture. Implement the verification pass that checks each claim back against its source. Cross-Validation & Reconciliation Build the logic that reconstructs understanding independently from source code, existing documentation, and existing test cases. Implement comparison and reconciliation that flags inconsistencies, missing coverage, stale information, and likely defects. Apply the explicit rules that allow only low-risk, evidence-backed discrepancies to be resolved automatically, escalating the rest for human review. Faithfulness, Traceability & Quality Outputs Implement and uphold the first-class outputs: claim-to-source traceability, confidence marking, gap register, discrepancy register, open decision list, and adjudication status. Ensure the system distinguishes implementation facts from inferred behavior, and marks unsupported assumptions instead of promoting them to fact. Make sure gaps are recorded openly and never silently filled. Evaluation, Testing & Reliability Write tests and contribute to evaluation harnesses that measure extraction accuracy, faithfulness, and run-to-run consistency. Debug pipeline failures and reconciliation edge cases, and improve the signal-to-noise ratio of what reaches the SME. Implement the concise, high-value review packages SMEs adjudicate, keeping the human gate mandatory before completion. Work closely with the Technical Lead and, where relevant, with SMEs to validate that outputs are faithful and reviewable. Raise design concerns and propose improvements within the direction set by the Technical Lead. What you need to have: Solid software engineering fundamentals: clean, testable code and disciplined debugging. Practical experience building AI- or NLP-powered features — information extraction, document analysis, agent behavior, or similar — beyond simple prompt-and-response usage. Ability to read and understand existing codebases and reason about components, dependencies, interfaces, and behavior. Comfort with prompt and agent design, and with evaluating and improving the quality of generated outputs. Attention to evidence and provenance: a habit of tracing claims to sources and marking uncertainty rather than guessing. Ability to work effectively under technical direction and within defined quality gates. Clear written communication for technical notes, test results, and decisions. A reliable, detail-oriented ownership mindset over the components you build. What's in it for you: Extended compensation and benefits package. Continuous learning opportunities to enhance your professional and soft skills. A great working environment with people who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do and understand the importance of team spirit. We really welcome open-minded and committed people: Eager to take on new challenges and learn new things. Who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do. Who enjoy sharing knowledge and understand the importance of teams. Only eligible candidates will be contacted to move forward in the recruitment process. #LI-AT2

items.desc: About InterDigital InterDigital is a global research and development company focused primarily on wireless, video, artificial intelligence (“AI”), and related technologies. We design and develop foundational technologies that enable connected, immersive experiences in a broad range of communications and entertainment products and services. We license our innovations worldwide to companies providing such products and services, including makers of wireless communications devices, consumer electronics, IoT devices, cars and other motor vehicles, and providers of cloud-based services such as video streaming. As a leader in wireless technology, our engineers have designed and developed a wide range of innovations that are used in wireless products and networks, from the earliest digital cellular systems to 5G and today’s most advanced Wi-Fi technologies. We are also a leader in video processing and video encoding/decoding technology, with a significant AI research effort that intersects with both wireless and video technologies. Founded in 1972, InterDigital is listed on Nasdaq. InterDigital is a registered trademark of InterDigital, Inc. For more information, visit: www.interdigital.com. Summary The objective of this internship is to investigate how Reinforcement Learning (RL) techniques can improve the energy efficiency of adaptive video streaming while maintaining a high Quality of Experience (QoE) for end users. The study will consider optimization opportunities across the entire streaming chain, from video encoding and bitrate-ladder generation to content delivery through Multi-CDN architectures [1], client-side Adaptive Bitrate (ABR) selection, decoding, and display. Building on recent research in energy-aware adaptive streaming [2] and reinforcement-learning-based Multi-CDN optimization [3], the internship will explore how energy consumption can be dynamically incorporated into streaming adaptation decisions, alongside traditional criteria such as video quality, rebuffering, latency, throughput, delivery cost, and resilience. The work will investigate RL-based optimization strategies at different levels of the streaming chain. At the client side, RL models may dynamically adjust the cost functions, weighting parameters, or decision criteria of existing heuristic-based energy-aware ABR algorithms. Such adaptation may consider network and playback conditions, device energy policies, device characteristics and operating conditions, as well as the user's viewing context. At a broader system level, the internship will also investigate the joint optimization of video representation selection and CDN/delivery-pathway selection. Particular attention may be given to Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), where multiple agents responsible for different adaptation decisions cooperate to achieve a common energy-efficiency and QoE objective. This includes investigating coordination between agents to avoid conflicting optimization decisions. The intern will first review existing approaches and identify the most influential parameters, decision points, and promising RL-based optimization strategies. Selected solutions will then be implemented and evaluated on an end-to-end adaptive streaming platform. A benchmark will quantify the achievable energy savings, assess their impact on QoE and other performance metrics, and compare the proposed solutions with conventional adaptive streaming and independently optimized approaches. Masters thesis, KTH University. [3] Joshi, Chidambar (2025) Video Streaming Optimizations via Collaborative Multi-CDN Selection with Deep Reinforcement Learning . Masters thesis, Concordia University. Responsibilities Conduct a state-of-the-art review, identifying the advantages, limitations, and challenges of existing approaches. Set up the experimental environment, implement and document AI-based technologies and solutions. Evaluate performance, analyze experimental results, and report key findings. items.desc: About Telnyx Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network , to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications. We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team. Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers. The Role As a Machine Learning Engineer on the Messaging team, you will own the systems that decide — in real time — which of the many millions of outbound messages a day reach real people and which get stopped. You'll build and operate fraud and abuse detection for our messaging platform: phishing and smishing, brand impersonation, artificially inflated traffic (AIT), and social-engineering scams targeting real users. You'll join at an inflection point. We're rebuilding our detection stack on a modern decision-engine architecture — inline hot-path decisioning, a complete decision audit ledger, and entity-level risk state — with active programs in social-engineering, phishing, and brand-impersonation detection. What You Will Do Design, train, evaluate, and operate text classifiers end-to-end: data curation, labeling, offline evaluation, deployment, and production drift monitoring. Run shadow-mode evaluations against labeled fraud corpora and human-reviewed legitimate controls before any model earns enforcement authority; report precision, recall, and calibration per abuse archetype. Build detection that holds up against adversarial content: obfuscated and confusable brand text, URL and domain evasion, and cross-account template fingerprinting. Serve detection models inline on the message send path under strict latency budgets, with deliberate fail-open/fail-closed behavior per dependency. Power human-in-the-loop fraud review: reviewer tooling, label quality, and turning fraud dispositions into replay and training signals. Collaborate with fraud operations, trust & safety, and cross-functional engineering teams. Participate in code reviews and help raise code quality and standards. What You Bring 3+ years of software development and/or machine learning experience. Strong proficiency in async Python webservice frameworks (e.g. FastAPI). Production experience building and operating text classification systems in fraud, spam, abuse, or trust & safety. Rigorous evaluation methodology: labeled corpora, holdout sets, precision/recall tradeoffs, and calibration. Experience using LLMs as classifiers or judges within a larger decision pipeline. Experience deploying and maintaining ML models in production. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams. Nice to Have Familiarity with A2P messaging abuse: artificially inflated traffic, smishing, brand impersonation, and 10DLC / toll-free verification regimes. Adversarial ML experience: evasion-resilient detection, obfuscation handling, or attack-surface hardening. High-scale data experience with ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, Redis, and streaming systems such as Kafka. Experience with a cloud-native stack (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes, Prometheus). Experience with distributed batch scoring (e.g. Ray).

items.desc: Project Description: AMD is building a hardware-assisted security platform that uses silicon-level Performance Monitoring Counters (PMCs) and on-chip machine learning to detect advanced endpoint threats, including ransomware, fileless malware, and cryptojacking, at the processor layer, below OS-based evasion. The platform collects CPU behavioral telemetry, classifies it through an ML inference engine, and exposes threat signals to security-software partners through a standardized API. The project covers the full engineering path from silicon telemetry and data generation through ML training and validation, real-time inference, lab qualification, and partner integration. The Real-Time Developer will lead the runtime and integration workstream, including the low-latency Windows data pipeline, integration with the ML inference runtime, and development of the SDK/API layer used by security-software partners. This is a Windows-focused role requiring regular on-site work in Gdańsk. Additional implementation details will be shared during the recruitment process in line with the applicable confidentiality requirements. Responsibilities: Design and implement high-throughput, low-latency data pipelines that transfer CPU telemetry from a Windows kernel-mode component to a user-space ML inference runtime. Develop reliable communication mechanisms between Windows kernel-mode and user-space components. Develop and maintain the real-time inference integration layer, including model loading, input preparation, inference execution, result handling, and error recovery. Integrate production-compatible ML inference runtimes such as ONNX Runtime, OpenVINO, or equivalent technologies. Design and implement a stable SDK/API layer for delivering approved threat signals to security-software partners. Support API lifecycle concerns such as consumer registration, compatibility, versioning, error handling, and integration documentation. Implement accurate per-process and per-thread attribution of collected telemetry and inference results. Profile and optimize pipeline throughput, latency, memory use, synchronization, and CPU overhead. Design for concurrency and predictable performance using suitable mechanisms such as shared memory, ring buffers, lock-free queues, asynchronous processing, or equivalent techniques. Develop unit, integration, regression, load, and stress tests for the runtime pipeline and partner-integration layer. Support hardware-in-the-loop verification across relevant Windows platforms and system configurations. Collaborate with Lab and ML Engineers to replay captured telemetry, validate model integration, and investigate end-to-end behavior. Diagnose and resolve issues across kernel-mode components, user-space services, inference runtimes, and partner-facing interfaces. Document the runtime architecture, communication protocols, API specifications, performance characteristics, integration procedures, and known limitations. Work regularly on-site in Gdańsk and collaborate closely with the hardware validation environment. Mandatory Skills Description: Experience developing Windows kernel-mode drivers and/or closely related low-level Windows components. 4+ years of professional experience in systems programming using C or C++. Rust experience is also relevant when supported by strong low-level systems experience. Hands-on experience with Windows kernel programming concepts and driver-to-user-space communication mechanisms. Experience building real-time, near-real-time, high-throughput, or low-latency software. Practical knowledge of one or more high-performance communication or concurrency mechanisms, such as shared memory, memory-mapped I/O, ring buffers, lock-free queues, asynchronous I/O, or multi-threaded pipelines. Strong understanding of concurrency, synchronization, memory management, process and thread behavior, and performance-sensitive software design. Strong debugging and profiling skills across kernel-mode and user-space Windows components. Experience developing reliable production-oriented software with clear error handling, diagnostics, testing, and maintainability. Experience developing unit, integration, regression, load, or stress tests for systems software. Ability to analyze and reduce latency, CPU overhead, memory use, contention, and other runtime-performance bottlenecks. Ability to work with technical specifications and document architecture, interfaces, protocols, and integration procedures. Ability to work regularly on-site in Gdańsk. University degree in computer science, electrical engineering, computer engineering, or an equivalent field. Nice-to-Have Skills Description: Experience integrating ML inference runtimes such as ONNX Runtime, OpenVINO, TensorRT, DirectML, or equivalent technologies. Experience developing SDKs, libraries, or APIs used by external partners or multiple independent consumers. Experience with API versioning, backward compatibility, schema design, subscriber management, …

Our teams consist of passionate and dedicated experts, providing an environment conducive to learning and collaboration. You will have access to state-of-the-art equipment and top-tier research resources to carry out your assignments. The work performed may potentially lead to a scientific publication. Context Please read the attached file for proper formatting and illustration. Autonomous driving requires long term understanding of the 3D driving environment in order to correctly perceive both its coarse general structure (HD map, road topology) and its fine constituting elements (vehicles, pedestriand, traffic signs ...) . In this internship, we propose to generate gaussians from multimodal inputs (camera, LIDAR, RADAR) . These gaussians will then be used as an input that contains both global and fine-grained context necessary for 3D perception in the scene. The candidate will then adapt 3D perception algorithms to this input modality in order to achieve SOTA performance on perception tasks such as 3D detection and HD map estimation. What do we expect from you? To achieve these objectives, the intern will be expected to: Review the state of the art on gaussian splatting reconstruction and 3D perception Design, develop and evaluate a novel deep learning pipeline for perception in autonomous driving scenes Contribute to research reports and potential publications References: [1] LU, Yiren, YE, Xin, YAMAN, Burhaneddin, et al. items.desc: Locatie: Almere | Stage | 32–40 uur per week | Start: z.s.m. | €500 stagevergoeding Ben jij bezig met een softwarestudie en lijkt het je interessant om te werken aan een concrete technische opdracht binnen de energietransitie? Dan is deze stage iets voor jou. Tijdens deze stage werk je aan het ontwikkelen van een tool waarmee we vanuit één bronbestand zowel documentatie als softwareprotocollen kunnen genereren. Een project waar al een eerste opzet voor ligt, maar waar nog verdere invulling en implementatie voor nodig is. Wat ga je doen? Je gaat aan de slag binnen het softwareteam dat werkt aan onze batterijsystemen. Hier werk je aan een specifieke opdracht, maar je bent ook onderdeel van het team en schakelt met verschillende collega’s. De focus van je stage ligt op het ontwikkelen van een generatieve tool voor documentatie en protocollen. Denk hierbij aan het combineren van softwareontwikkeling met AI‑achtige toepassingen. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Ontwikkelen van een tool die documentatie en protocollen genereert vanuit een bronbestand Toepassen van AI tooling / LLM’s binnen de oplossing Ophalen van requirements bij eindgebruikers en deze vertalen naar functionaliteit Meedenken over de verdere uitwerking en implementatie van het bestaande voorstel Wie ben jij? Je bent iemand die het leuk vindt om technisch bezig te zijn en zelfstandig kan werken, maar ook makkelijk de samenwerking opzoekt. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende: Je volgt een HBO- of WO-opleiding richting software (bijv. Informatica, Software Engineering) Je bent bekend met Python of een andere high‑level programmeertaal om applicaties te ontwikkelen Je hebt interesse in AI, LLM’s of automatisering Ervaring met front‑end en/of back‑end development is mooi meegenomen Je kunt werken met Windows en/of Linux Je beheerst Engels goed (Nederlands is handig, maar geen must) Wat bieden wij jou? Je krijgt een stageplek waarin je aan een concrete opdracht werkt die ook echt gebruikt gaat worden. Je maakt onderdeel uit van het team en krijgt begeleiding waar nodig, maar ook genoeg vrijheid om zelf dingen uit te zoeken. Daarnaast kun je rekenen op: Een stagevergoeding van €500 per maand Een Windows laptop van Alfen De mogelijkheid om deels thuis te werken (richtlijn: 3 dagen op kantoor) Een omgeving waarin je veel kunt leren van verschillende disciplines Over het team Je komt terecht in een multidisciplinair team van ongeveer 15 collega’s die werken aan de software voor onze batterijsystemen. In het team zitten onder andere software developers, electrical en mechanical engineers, testers en technical writers. Er zijn verschillende productteams (zoals een core team en een gridtech team), maar er wordt intensief samengewerkt, waardoor je een goed beeld krijgt van hoe een product vanuit verschillende perspectieven wordt ontwikkeld. Over Alfen Alfen bestaat al meer dan 80 jaar en speelt een belangrijke rol in het energienet van vandaag. Het bedrijf ontwikkelt en produceert onder andere transformatorstations, energieopslagsystemen en laadpunten voor elektrische voertuigen. Veel van deze producten worden in‑house ontworpen en gebouwd in Almere. Hiermee levert Alfen dagelijks oplossingen die nodig zijn voor de energietransitie. Klinkt dit als een stage die bij je past? Dan zien we jouw sollicitatie graag tegemoet! Solliciteer via de “Solliciteren”-button met jouw CV en motivatie. We nemen daarna snel contact met je op. Vragen over de inhoud van de stage? Neem contact op met Niels Langendorff, Discipline Expert, via n.langendorff@alfen.com of +31613546489. Vragen over de sollicitatieprocedure? Neem contact op met Ilse Neijmeijer, Campus Recruiter, via Ilse.Neijmeijer@alfen.com of +31365260058.

items.title: Internship Regulatory Data & AI
items.card: What you will do As an intern, you will support a variety of strategic and operational activities, including: Supporting regulatory monitoring and horizon scanning activities Assisting in mapping regulations to internal policies, controls and risk frameworks Analysing regulatory and risk-related datasets and helping improve data quality Contributing to process improvement and digitalisation initiatives within Risk
items.desc: About The Team The ERM Frameworks team is part of ING's Enterprise Risk Management department and plays a central role in shaping the bank's risk governance and regulatory framework. The team is responsible for maintaining the Enterprise Risk Management Framework, managing regulatory change and horizon scanning processes, and driving simplification and digitalisation initiatives across Risk. We are looking for a curious and motivated intern who is passionate about regulations, data and emerging technologies. This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a global banking environment while contributing to innovative RegTech and AI initiatives. What you will do As an intern, you will support a variety of strategic and operational activities, including: Supporting regulatory monitoring and horizon scanning activities Assisting in mapping regulations to internal policies, controls and risk frameworks Analysing regulatory and risk-related datasets and helping improve data quality Contributing to process improvement and digitalisation initiatives within Risk Supporting the development and testing of AI and GenAI use cases for regulatory and policy management Helping structure and organise regulatory knowledge repositories and data sources Assisting with stakeholder workshops, presentations and project coordination Exploring new RegTech solutions and identifying opportunities to streamline regulatory processes What we are looking for You Are A university student (Bachelor's or Master's) in Data Science, Business Analytics, Economics, Finance, Law, AI, Computer Science or a related field Curious about how regulations shape the financial industry Interested in the intersection of regulation, technology, data and AI Comfortable working with data and learning new digital tools Proactive, eager to learn and willing to take ownership A strong communicator who enjoys working with different stakeholders Fluent in English Experience with Power BI, Python, SQL, AI tools, data analytics or regulatory technology is a plus, but not a requirement. What you'll learn During Your Internship, You Will Gain Exposure To Enterprise Risk Management and Risk Governance in a global bank Regulatory Change Management and Horizon Scanning AI and GenAI applications within Risk and Compliance Data management and regulatory data mapping Large-scale transformation and digitalisation initiatives Working with senior stakeholders across multiple risk domains Why join us? This internship offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of Risk, Regulations, Data, and AI . You will be part of a highly collaborative team, gain insight into how a global bank manages regulatory change, and contribute to innovative initiatives that help shape the future of Risk management. Rewards And Benefits This is a great opportunity to train with highly skilled people who are experts in their field. You’ll do a lot and learn a lot – not only about your specialist area and the bank, but also about yourself and whether this type of environment is right for you. You’ll Also Benefit From Internship allowance of 700 EUR based on 36 hours work week Your own work laptop Hybrid working to blend home working for focus and office working for collaboration and co-creation Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities An informal working environment with innovative colleagues During the duration of your internship at ING, it is mandatory to be enrolled at a Dutch university (or EU-university for EU passport holders). Want to apply directly? Please upload your CV and motivation letter by clicking the ‘Apply’ button. About Our Internships Every year, more than 350 students join our internship program. While there are no guarantees about your future, many of our former interns move into a permanent role or onto our International Talent Programme (traineeship). Whatever happens, an internship at ING is the ideal opportunity to meet a wide variety of people, to build up your own network, and to learn about many different aspects of banking – put simply, it’s a great start to your career.

items.desc: Stellenbezeichnung: Praktikant im Bereich AI Engineering: AI-ready Processes (w/m/d) Startdatum der Ausschreibung: 28.09.26 Zu besetzen ab 01.12.2026 Dein Arbeitsumfeld Wir bei MAN Truck & Bus sind Teil eines starken internationalen Teams und einer der führenden europäischen Nutzfahrzeughersteller und Anbieter von Transportlösungen. Zusammen mit den Marken Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus und International gehören wir zur TRATON GROUP. Als Teil dieses Verbundes stehen wir vor großen Herausforderungen: Unsere Fahrzeuge werden immer autonomer und vernetzter, um emissionsärmer unterwegs zu sein. Dafür arbeiten wir an nachhaltigen Lösungen. Eine Karriere bei MAN Truck & Bus bietet unzählige Möglichkeiten, sich an diesem Wandel zu beteiligen. Der Kunde an erster Stelle, Respekt, Teamgeist, Verantwortung und Verschwendung vermeiden – das sind unsere Unternehmenswerte, die wir bei MAN leben. Zieh mit uns an einem Strang. Als Teil unseres globalen Teams von über 32.000 Mitarbeitenden wirst du Zukunftsvisionen mit uns gemeinsam Wirklichkeit werden lassen. Wir sehen Individualität unserer Mitarbeitenden als Stärke an und freuen uns über vielfältige Bewerbungen von Personen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen. Falls du während deiner Bewerbung Unterstützung benötigst, melde dich bitte bei uns. Künstliche Intelligenz verändert nicht nur einzelne Tools, sondern die Art, wie Engineering künftig denkt, entscheidet und zusammenarbeitet. Damit daraus echte Wirkung entsteht, müssen Prozesse, Methoden und Entscheidungslogiken klarer, konsistenter und AI-ready werden. Genau hier setzen wir an: Wir übersetzen komplexe Engineering-Abläufe in Strukturen, mit denen Menschen besser arbeiten und AI sinnvoll unterstützen kann, am besten mit Dir. Darauf kannst Du dich freuen Du unterstützt proaktiv den Bereich Engineering Strategy bei der Analyse, Strukturierung und Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen, Methoden und Steuerungslogiken im Entwicklungsumfeld mit dem Ziel, diese AI-ready zu gestalten Du erhebst und verdichtest Informationen aus bestehenden Prozessbeschreibungen, Dokumentationen, Workshops und Abstimmungen und überführst diese in klare, konsistente und maschinenlesbar gedachte Prozess- und Wissensstrukturen Du analysierst eigenverantwortlich Schnittstellen, Rollen, Verantwortlichkeiten, Entscheidungslogiken und Abhängigkeiten zwischen Prozessen, Tools und Organisationseinheiten und identifizierst Ansatzpunkte für Standardisierung, Automatisierung und AI-Unterstützung Du wirkst bei der Ableitung von Anforderungen an AI-ready Process Design mit, z. B. hinsichtlich klarer Inputs/Outputs, Datenverfügbarkeit, Prozessvarianten, Governance-Punkten und Human-in-the-Loop-Entscheidungen Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Präsentationen, Entscheidungsvorlagen, Prozessübersichten, Reifegradbetrachtungen und Management-Unterlagen Darauf freuen wir uns Du bist in einem technischen oder wirtschaftsnahen Studium immatrikuliert Du verfügst über ein gutes Verständnis für Prozesse, Organisationen und Schnittstellen und hast Freude daran, komplexe Zusammenhänge strukturiert zu durchdringen Du besitzt ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen und die Fähigkeit, in einem komplexen Umfeld durch methodische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise präzise neues Wissen zu erarbeiten Du bist sicher im Umgang mit MS-Office-Anwendungen, insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel, und kannst Ergebnisse klar, nachvollziehbar und managementtauglich darstellen Du gehst sicher mit gängigen AI-Tools (z. B. Microsoft 365 Copilot) um und setzt diese zielgerichtet und reflektiert ein Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Bei erfolgreichem Verlauf des Praktikums besteht die Möglichkeit, im Anschluss eine thematisch angrenzende Abschlussarbeit in der Engineering Strategie zu erarbeiten. Hat MAN Dein Interesse geweckt? Wir freuen uns auf deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung für ein Pflichtpraktikum von mindestens 3 Monaten (auch als Kombination aus einem Pflichtpraktikum und einem freiwilligen Praktikum möglich). items.desc: Internship – Market Data Announcements Tool Redesign & AI Assistance Duration: 6 months Start date: Early 2027 (flexible) Location: Paris 7e ABOUT CFM Founded in 1991, we are a global quantitative and systematic asset management firm applying a scientific approach to finance to develop alternative investment strategies that create value for our clients. We value innovation, dedication, collaboration, and the ability to make an impact. Together, we create a stimulating environment for talented and passionate experts in research, technology, and business to explore new ideas and challenge existing assumptions. YOUR ROLE Market Data – Front Office Support is responsible for ensuring the integrity, accuracy and timely availability of the market data that feeds the CFM trading activities. It operates at the intersection of data management, technology and finance, and relies on data from multiple external providers to drive diversified investment strategies. The team relies on an internal web tool that centralizes announcements issued by several market data providers, matches them against the financial instruments referential, enables review and validation by business teams, and forwards them to a ticketing tool. Developed several years ago and recently migrated to newer infrastructure, the tool has never been fundamentally redesigned. It suffers from an aging architecture (hard to maintain, slow), fragile provider integrations, security debt, a poorly responsive UI with repetitive manual review steps, and no automated tests. As a result, operators spend a lot of time on manual reviews, and many announcements require little or no action. The central project of your internship is to rebuild this application on a more robust, faster and more maintainable foundation, and to use LLM-based agents to assist operators in reviewing and processing announcements, so that they can focus only on the cases that truly require human attention. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Audit the existing tool and gather needs from Market Data operators. Design a more robust, faster and maintainable architecture. Build the new application (or an advanced prototype) and define a migration plan. Secure access management and the handling of secrets and sensitive data. Make external provider integrations reliable and resilient. Automate repetitive tasks (imports, synchronizations, notifications). Research AI assistance for current and past announcement review: matching, summarization. Simplify communication with users. Modernize the user interface for better responsiveness. Set up automated tests and a CI pipeline, and document the solution. YOUR SKILLS You are pursuing a Master's or engineering school degree (Bac+4/5) in computer science. You have a solid foundation in web development, with practical knowledge of Python, Node.js and databases. You have an interest in applied AI, particularly LLMs and agent-based approaches. You can understand and evolve existing code. You are autonomous, take initiative, and are rigorous, curious and have a strong team spirit. You are comfortable in both French and English. A plus: experience with testing and CI/CD, API integrations, application security, data quality and validation methodologies, financial data or corporate actions. EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES STATEMENT We are continuously striving to be an equal opportunity employer and we prohibit any discrimination based on sex, disability, origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, race, or religion. We believe that our diversity, breadth of experience, and multiple points of view are among the leading factors in our success. CFM is a signatory of the Women Empowerment Principles. FOLLOW US Follow us on Twitter or LinkedIn or visit our website to find out more about CFM.

Als Bank für Deutschland suchen wir Menschen, die mutige Ideen nicht nur denken, sondern umsetzen. items.desc: Vi bygger en ekonomifunktion i framkant. Målet är att automatisera bort allt manuellt arbete i den löpande redovisningen – och vi söker en student från Handelshögskolan som vill vara med och göra det på riktigt. Hos oss är AI inte ett framtidsord utan ett verktyg du använder dagligen. Omfattning: Deltid, ca 30–40% Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse - gärna så snart som möjligt Placering: Göteborg Rollen Du blir en del av PPAB:s ekonomifunktion och jobbar brett över koncernens bolag. Själva poängen med rollen är inte att göra jobbet som det görs idag – det är att hitta sätt att göra det smartare och mer automatiserat. I rollen kommer du bland annat att: · Vara bollplank när vi automatiserar våra flöden – från avstämningar och periodiseringar till rapportsammanställningar · Bygga och förvalta AI-drivna lösningar tillsammans med oss – prompts, agenter, kopplingar mellan system · Vara med och analysera våra processer, hitta det som fortfarande görs manuellt och föreslå hur det kan lösas smartare · Delta i de löpande flödena där det krävs, t.ex. fakturering, leverantörsfakturahantering och avstämningar · Vara med i den dagliga driften av ekonomifunktionen i en finansiell koncern med flera legala enheter och överlappande regelverk Du jobbar nära seniora kollegor och får djup inblick i hur en finansiell koncern fungerar. Fungerar samarbetet bra är ambitionen att det kan leda till en fast tjänst efter examen – och på sikt en karriär hos oss. Kravprofil Vi söker dig som studerar ekonomi vid Handelshögskolan, gärna med inriktning mot redovisning, finans eller något digitalt/analytiskt spår. Vidare ser vi att du har: · Grundläggande kunskaper inom redovisning från dina studier · Ett genuint intresse för AI och automation – du har testat verktyg själv, byggt något litet, eller läst in dig på egen hand · Nyfikenhet på kod och system även om du inte är utvecklare · Förmåga att kommunicera väl på svenska samt god förståelse för engelska · Du är en driven person som förstår värdet av att själv ta ansvar för sin egen utveckling och sitt lärande Du behöver inte ha jobbat med redovisning tidigare. Det viktigaste är att du är nyfiken av naturen, inte rädd för att testa nytt, och ser ett manuellt arbete som ett problem värt att lösa snarare än något att vänja sig vid. Vill du bli en av oss? Tjänstgöringsort är Göteborg. Sista ansökningsdag är den 12 november 2026, men urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan. CV och personligt brev skickas till nedan e-post. Om du har frågor om tjänsten ring eller skicka e-post till Malin Ahrenberg. Redovisningschef, Malin Ahrenberg E-post: malin.ahrenberg@strivo.se Mobil: 0723-41 60 03 Om oss Du blir en del av ekonomifunktionen i Primrose Partners – en privatägd finansiell koncern inom värdepapper, fond och försäkring, med Strivo, Sensor Fonder, Svensk Värdepappersservice och Idun Liv. Sedan 2009 har vi byggt en verksamhet i stadig tillväxt, idag cirka 75 medarbetare i Stockholm och Göteborg, med en kultur präglad av entreprenörsanda och korta beslutsvägar. Hos oss är ekonomifunktionen inte den som skickar vidare arbete – vi gör saker själva och har höga ambitioner för hur ekonomifunktionen ska se ut framåt. Med IFRS i koncernen, ÅRKL i värdepappersbolagen och ÅRFL i försäkringsbolaget finns gott om komplexitet att ta sig an. Vi använder AI där det tillför värde och tycker det är mer intressant att lösa ett problem en gång för alla än att göra samma sak varje månad.

items.desc: L’entreprise. En France métropolitaine, VINCI Construction s’appuie sur un réseau de filiales de proximité pour concevoir, financer, réaliser et maintenir tout projet de construction dans les métiers du bâtiment, du génie civil, de la route et des réseaux. Présentes dans toutes les régions, les entreprises de proximité de VINCI Construction mobilisent les ressources de ses collaborateurs pour réaliser des ouvrages, infrastructures de transport et aménagements urbains utiles aux Hommes et aux territoires. Les missions. Dans le service Structures de la Délégation Génie Civil Ouest, votre mission principale sera de dimensionner un ouvrage en phase d’exécution. Vous serez épaulé par votre maître de stage qui vous accompagnera à toutes les étapes de l’étude d’un projet dès la phase de démarrage de l’étude jusqu’à la fourniture de tous les livrables. Dans le service Structures Génie Civil Ouest ; vous participerez au développement d'un assistant IA destiné à automatiser le contrôle des plans de ferraillage et à générer des rapports de vérification pour les ouvrages de génie civil. Rattaché au Directeur du bureau d’études, vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du projet Analyse métier Réalisation des principes de ferraillage à destination des projeteurs sur la base de notes de calculs Comprendre les méthodes de contrôle des plans de ferraillage. Identifier les règles techniques applicables et les points de vigilance. Participer à la constitution d'une base de données de cas réels. Développement de la solution Structurer et exploiter les données techniques issues des plans et documents d'études existants Développer des outils de contrôle automatisé à l'aide de Python et d’agents IA Exploiter des technologies d'OCR, de Computer Vision et des modèles d'IA générative. Validation et amélioration Comparer les résultats obtenus avec les vérifications réalisées par les ingénieurs structures. Évaluer les gains en termes de productivité, de fiabilité et de qualité. Formuler des recommandations en vue d'un déploiement à plus grande échelle. Ce stage vous permettra de travailler sur un sujet concret à la croisée de l'ingénierie des structures et des nouvelles technologies, avec un réel potentiel d'application opérationnelle. Vous êtes en dernière année du cycle ingénieur ou en master universitaire dans le domaine du Génie Civil. Vous possédez : De solides connaissances en béton armé et en lecture de plans de ferraillage. Une bonne maîtrise des fondamentaux des Eurocodes, notamment l'Eurocode 2. Une appétence pour les outils numériques et l'innovation. Des bases en programmation Python. Des connaissances en IA, automatisation, BIM, Computer Vision ou traitement de données seraient un plus. Curieux, rigoureux et autonome, vous aimez comprendre les problématiques techniques et développer des solutions concrètes en collaboration avec les équipes opérationnelles. Stage basé à Saint-Herblain. Durée 6 mois. Un accompagnement personnalisé avec un suivi RH et opérationnel Une organisation décentralisée avec une prise de décision au plus proche du terrain Un modèle managérial qui valorise l’autonomie et la responsabilité, l’écoute et la concertation, l’innovation et les démarches collaboratives, les femmes et les hommes plus que les systèmes Une offre de formation présentielle et numérique ouverte à tous Des tickets restaurant Une gratification de stage selon le barème en vigueur au sein de l’entreprise

items.desc: Wil jij in de praktijk leren hoe je een contentstrategie ontwikkelt én uitvoert voor een snelgroeiend AI-bedrijf? En daarbij ontdekken hoe je AI slim inzet in je eigen vak? Blackbirds is een AI-bedrijf uit Rotterdam. Met een team van ruim tien mensen bouwen we AI-oplossingen voor organisaties in de zorg, overheid, verzekeringen en logistiek. Denk aan slimmere roosterplanning in de zorg of het automatiseren van administratief werk, zodat professionals meer tijd overhouden voor waar het echt om draait. Wat ga je leren? In deze meewerkstage pas je toe wat je in je opleiding hebt geleerd, en ontdek je hoe dat werkt in de praktijk. De rode draad zijn twee contentstrategieën: één voor de zorgsector en één voor onze planningsoplossing. Daarbinnen werk je aan deze leerdoelen: Onderzoeken: je analyseert de markt en doelgroepen, zoals zorgbestuurders en planners, en ontdekt welke vragen en uitdagingen bij hen spelen. Positioneren: je leert een heldere boodschap te formuleren die aansluit bij de doelgroep en Blackbirds onderscheidt. Strategie ontwikkelen: je bepaalt contentpijlers, kanalen en een contentkalender, en leert je keuzes te onderbouwen. Content maken: je schrijft en maakt zelf content, van LinkedIn-posts tot artikelen, en leert complexe onderwerpen helder te vertellen. Meten en bijsturen: je leert resultaten te analyseren en op basis daarvan je aanpak te verbeteren. Werken met AI: je zet AI-tools gericht in bij onderzoek, strategie en contentcreatie, en leert kritisch te beoordelen wat ze opleveren. Adviseren en presenteren: je presenteert je strategie aan het team en de oprichters, en leert omgaan met feedback. Bij de start stellen we samen je persoonlijke leerdoelen vast, afgestemd op de eisen van je opleiding. Hoe we je begeleiden Je begeleider is onze Chief of Staff, met ruim 20 jaar ervaring in marketing en groei. Je hebt twee keer per week werkoverleg, elke twee weken een 1-op-1 over je ontwikkeling en dagelijks ruimte om te sparren. Tijd voor je schoolopdrachten hoort bij je stage. Wat je verder krijgt Een leerzame stage met een echt project: je ziet je werk live gaan Werk met maatschappelijke impact voor klanten in zorg en overheid Een klein, ambitieus team waarin je direct met de oprichters werkt Een stagevergoeding van €400 bruto per maand Wie jij bent Je zit in je derde jaar hbo, bijvoorbeeld Commerciële Economie, Marketing of Communicatie (wo-studenten zijn ook welkom) Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands Je bent creatief én denkt strategisch Je schrijft graag en goed Je bent nieuwsgierig naar AI, ervaring is niet nodig Praktisch Duur: 13 tot 20 weken, fulltime Start: januari of februari 2027, in overleg Locatie: ons kantoor in Rotterdam, 4 tot 5 dagen per week Solliciteren Reageer via de knop op deze pagina, met je LinkedIn-profiel of je cv en een korte motivatie (een paar zinnen is genoeg). We plannen daarna een kennismaking. Reageer liefst vóór eind november. We starten de selectie zodra de eerste reacties binnenkomen. Is de plek vergeven, dan sluiten we de vacature, ook als er nog gesprekken lopen. Wacht dus niet te lang.

items.desc: Do you have great skills and experience organizing and managing data? Interested in a role contributing to improve lives? Looking for your next challenge? We are recruiting a Data Scientist to provide data to researchers in academia and industry, through cohort discovery by mining phenotypic and genomic data, and to manage metadata assets of the NIHR BioResource projects under the guidance of the line manager. To succeed in this role, you will need to be experienced in the manipulation of big and/or genomics data, the analysis and integration of different data types and the use of meta-data standards and vocabularies. About NIHR BioResource Our mission is to facilitate human health research and its transformation into medical practice. NIHR BioResource is a unique and powerful resource for studying disease mechanisms and for investigating the links between genes, the environment, health and disease, enabling scientific discoveries as well as facilitating translational medicine for the benefit of patients. Further details on the NIHR BioResource, including some of our COVID-19 research studies, can be found on our website https://bioresource.nihr.ac.uk. About The Job You will be responsible for: Linking of omics data (especially genomics) and biomedical, demographic, and phenotypic data that form a major part of NIHR BioResource data assets to enable participant selection for proposed research studies Contribute to more complex linkage experiments, e.g. where omics data is joined to sample holdings and rich clinical phenotype Prepare datasets for recall-based research studies identifying potential volunteers Prepare de-identified datasets for release to researchers Discussions with researchers re expected standards on data protection, anonymisation and security About You Ideally you will have: Experience and in-depth knowledge of phenotypic and genomic data and database modelling with proficiency in MySQL and No-SQL or equivalent Proven programming ability in Python is a must with experience in using libraries (such as Pandas and Numpy) Good knowledge of Linux and shell scripting Ability to prioritise and plan work efficiently and meet deadlines and work unsupervised What We Offer The University offers a wide range of benefits including flexible working, family friendly policies, an attractive pension scheme (employer's contribution is 14.5%). and 41 days' annual holiday (inclusive of public holidays). We encourage career development by providing extensive training & development opportunities. This appointment is full-time, 37 hours per week; part-time to 80% will be considered. Work / life balance is important, and we are open to discussion on flexible working, including hybrid working. The post is available on a fixed-term basis until 31 March 2028 in the first instance. NIHR BioResource is funded by the National Institute for Health & Care Research (NIHR) on a 4-year funding cycle. Our offices are on the Cambridge Biomedical Campus CB2 0QQ (approximately 2 miles south of the city centre). See the Further Information link below for full details and Person Specification. This appointment requires a Research Passport application. We encourage informal queries about the job or the application process - please contact Stephane Ballereau, Lead Bioinformatician, Stephane.Ballereau@bioresource.nihr.ac.uk. Click the 'Apply' button below to register an account with our recruitment system (if you have not already) and apply online. Please ensure that you upload a covering letter and CV in the Upload section of the online application. The covering letter should outline how you match the criteria for the post and why you are applying for this role. If you upload any additional documents which have not been requested, we will not be able to consider these as part of your application. Please include details of your referees, including email address and phone number, one of which must be your most recent line manager. Please quote reference RW51514 on your application and in any correspondence about this vacancy. The University actively supports equality, diversity and inclusion and encourages applications from all sections of society. The University has a responsibility to ensure that all employees are eligible to live and work in the UK.

items.desc: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office The AI and Automation Engineer turns equipment and operational challenges into safe, reliable digital and automation solutions. Based in Operations Engineering, the role works with operations, maintenance, quality, engineering, and IT/OT teams to improve equipment availability, performance, product quality, and ease of operation. The engineer supports the full solution lifecycle: identifying needs, assessing data, piloting and validating solutions, deploying them, and providing ongoing support. Description How you will make an impact: You will deliver practical AI and automation solutions that improve equipment reliability, performance, and operational efficiency. What you will do: Identify and prioritize opportunities by working with equipment and operations teams to understand recurring losses, define problems, establish baselines, and agree on measurable outcomes such as uptime, cycle time, quality, safety, and maintenance effort Design and integrate automation by developing equipment solutions using controls, sensors, robotics, machine vision, and equipment interfaces, partnering with controls and equipment engineers as needed Connect equipment and operational data using PLC, HMI, SCADA, and other approved systems to make relevant data usable, traceable, and suitable for analysis or real-time applications Develop electrical and pneumatic systems by creating and updating system designs and documentation, and supporting troubleshooting of electrical equipment Develop and integrate practical AI solutions by building, adapting, or integrating AI models and applications for operational needs such as document processing, anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, computer vision, and decision support Test solutions before deployment by setting acceptance criteria, assessing results against the baseline, and planning for safe fallback, operator oversight, and rollback where appropriate Deploy and sustain solutions by supporting commissioning and handover, monitoring reliability, model performance, data quality, and user adoption, and maintaining solutions through documented change and support processes Build capability across teams by documenting designs and lessons learned, training users and maintainers, and sharing reusable standards and practices with Operations Equipment Engineering and partner teams Requirements How you will get here: Education: Bachelor's degree in industrial engineering, mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience Experience and skills: At least 2 years of experience in industrial automation, equipment engineering, manufacturing analytics, or delivering AI and automation solutions, or equivalent practical experience Ability to read and work with electrical and pneumatic schematics, maintain documentation, and troubleshoot electrical equipment Working knowledge of equipment controls and industrial systems, including PLCs, sensors, HMI/SCADA, and production data platforms Experience implementing PID control strategies and the ability to work effectively with controls and IT/OT specialists Ability to use Python, SQL, JavaScript, C, or comparable tools for data analysis, prototyping, or automation, and to work with structured equipment or process data Ability to assess data quality, choose an appropriate technical approach, test it against operational needs, and explain results and limitations Understanding of safe design, change control, documentation, cybersecurity, and applicable validation and quality controls Able to translate user needs into clear technical requirements, collaborate across functions, and work effectively both independently and as part of a team Strong written and spoken English communication skills are required Dutch language skills are an advantage Preferred qualifications: Master's degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, mechatronics, or a related field Experience with predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, computer vision, robotics, or process optimization Experience deploying applications or models at the equipment edge or in a managed cloud environment, including monitoring and lifecycle support Familiarity with industrial data exchange standards or protocols such as OPC UA or MQTT Experience in regulated manufacturing, equipment qualification, validation, or data integrity practices Experience commissioning equipment or working directly with technicians and operators in a manufacturing environment
