En Banco Sabadell, #QueremosQueSeasTú, porque sabemos que el talento único de cada persona es lo que nos hace #SerSabadell. ¿Qué estamos buscando? Actualmente estamos buscando a nuestro/nuestra futuro/futura Data Scientist cuya misión principal es la validación de modelos de Machine Learning e Inteligencia Artificial. Además, colaborarás en la validación de modelos de Machine Learning e Inteligencia Artificial, para asegurar que los modelos, sistemas o agentes sean confiables, justos, apropiados y conformes con las políticas internas y regulaciones externas. Hablemos del proyecto... Como Data Scientist, tus principales funciones serán: Colaborar en las validaciones de modelos de Machine Learning e IA, evaluando su diseño metodológico, calidad de datos, rendimiento, robustez, estabilidad y adecuación al uso previsto. Evaluar riesgos específicos de modelos de IA, incluyendo sesgos y discriminación, explicabilidad, alineamiento, calidad y suficiencia de las evidencias, inferencias no justificadas, consistencia de resultados y robustez ante cambios en los datos o inputs. Diseñar y ejecutar pruebas independientes y modelos challenger, mediante análisis estadísticos, benchmarking y contrafactuales, para contrastar las hipótesis, decisiones metodológicas y resultados del modelo. Colaborar en la elaboración de los marcos, manuales, procedimientos etc. De validación y control de modelos de Inteligencia Artificial y agentes. Documentar y comunicar las conclusiones de validación, identificando limitaciones, riesgos y recomendaciones, y trasladando resultados técnicos de forma clara, colaborando en la elaboración de materiales para su presentación a senior management y órganos competentes, como el Comité de Modelos o el Comité Asesor en Modelos e Inteligencia Artificial. ¿Qué valoramos de tu candidatura? Tienes experiencia previa (2-4 años) en modelos analíticos, de inteligencia artificial o cognitivos, sea en su desarrollo, revisión o monitorización. Tienes experiencia de programación de modelos en Python. Posees conocimientos de desarrollo de aplicaciones basadas en IA y agentes. Experiencia con Copilot Studio/Power Platform, Hugging Face, Azure ML, Foundry. Tienes capacidad crítica, buenas capacidades comunicativas, autonomía, ganas de aprender y proactividad. Tu nivel de inglés es medio-alto. Además valoraríamos… Conocimientos funcionales del ámbito de IA responsable e IA segura. Conocimientos sobre riesgos financieros o acreditaciones tipo FRM, CFA, etc. Posgrado en Data Science o similar. Ser Sabadell, también es sumarte a... Un entorno inclusivo y diverso, donde apreciamos el valor único de cada persona. items.card: Le service Validation et Gouvernance Déploiement IA recherche un(e) : Data Scientist F/H Rattaché(e) au Responsable Gouvernance et Validation des modèles, Qualité des données et Déploiement de l’IA, au sein de la Direction des Risques Groupe, vous mobilisez votre expertise en Data Science pour analyser et valoriser les données, renforcer leur qualité et développer des solutions utiles à la gestion des risques. Vous
items.desc: Le service Validation et Gouvernance Déploiement IA recherche un(e) : Data Scientist F/H Rattaché(e) au Responsable Gouvernance et Validation des modèles, Qualité des données et Déploiement de l’IA, au sein de la Direction des Risques Groupe, vous mobilisez votre expertise en Data Science pour analyser et valoriser les données, renforcer leur qualité et développer des solutions utiles à la gestion des risques. Vous contribuez également à l’automatisation des travaux et au déploiement opérationnel de l’IA, en lien avec les équipes métiers, IT et Data. Responsabilités clés Data Science et modélisation Réaliser des analyses exploratoires et traduire les besoins métiers en cas d’usage Data Science, avec des critères de réussite mesurables. Concevoir, entraîner et évaluer des modèles statistiques et de machine learning, notamment pour la détection d’anomalies, la prédiction et la segmentation. Évaluer la performance, la robustesse et l’explicabilité des modèles développés et définir les indicateurs de suivi dans le temps. Préparation et qualité des données Extraire, structurer et analyser les données nécessaires aux travaux de qualité des données et de gestion des risques, notamment sur les périmètres Solvabilité II et IFRS 17. Développer des traitements et contrôles automatisés, fiables et reproductibles pour détecter les données manquantes, aberrantes ou incohérentes. Contribuer au lignage et à la documentation des données et restituer les résultats au moyen d’analyses et de tableaux de bord utiles à la décision. Déploiement de l’IA et accompagnement des métiers Identifier et mettre en œuvre des cas d’usage Data et IA pour automatiser les contrôles, analyses et reportings de la DRG. Contribuer à la mise en production et à la maintenance des solutions avec les équipes IT et Data, et mesurer les gains obtenus. Accompagner les utilisateurs dans l’appropriation des solutions, partager les bonnes pratiques et assurer une veille technologique ciblée. Profil Profil Recherché Formation Bac+5 en Data Science, mathématiques appliquées, ingénierie ou actuariat ; au moins 3 ans d’expérience en Data Science ou analyse de données. Maîtrise de Python et SQL et des méthodes statistiques et de machine learning. R et le deep learning constituent des atouts. Pratique du versionnement de code avec Git ; une expérience de Databricks, GitLab et VS Code est appréciée. Autonomie, rigueur, sens des besoins métiers et capacité à expliquer les résultats à des interlocuteurs non spécialistes. Une connaissance de l’assurance, de Solvabilité II ou d’IFRS 17 et un anglais professionnel sont appréciés. Classe CCNA 6 Fonction ANALYSTE RISQUES - 422

items.desc: Data Science Analyst (Sofia, Bulgaria) (F/M/D) About Enery: At Enery, we're powering the future…literally. We are an independent renewable energy provider dedicated to delivering reliable, affordable, and long-term green energy to our customers. We have scaled rapidly to over 2.1 GW of operating capacity, with a development pipeline of close to 10 GW across around 10 CEE countries — alongside a leading position in revenue optimization for utility-scale renewable and storage assets. Present in 10 countries across Central and Eastern Europe, our reach reflects our commitment to making a meaningful climate impact across the region. But we're more than just energy and infrastructure. With a diverse, multidisciplinary team representing over 30 nationalities, we value transparency, ownership, and continuous learning. We move fast, collaborate across disciplines, and celebrate wins, big and small, together. At Enery, ESG isn't a checkbox. It's embedded into every decision we make, from project development and construction to long-term operations. This is a highly dynamic role in a fast-evolving market ideal for someone who is curious, analytical, and excited about shaping the future of renewable energy trading. What you'll do: Data Collection & Cleaning Gather data from a variety of sources — market operators, grid operators, weather services, and energy platforms. Ensure data is accurate, complete, and timely. Clean and preprocess datasets for analysis. Analysis & Forecasting Perform exploratory data analysis to uncover patterns and insights. Evaluate market drivers like demand, weather, grid conditions, and fuel prices. Quantify risks linked to price volatility and market shifts. Build predictive models to forecast power prices, supply, and demand. Visualization & Reporting Translate complex data into digestible visuals using Tableau, Power BI, or Python (e.g., Matplotlib, Seaborn). Create dashboards and reports to support internal stakeholders. Present actionable insights clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Collaboration & Strategy Work closely with traders, risk managers, and analysts to support real-time and strategic decisions. Contribute to the development of trading strategies using data-driven insights. Stay updated on power market dynamics and technological advancements. What we're looking for: Technical Skills Proficient in Python, SQL, R or similar tools Comfortable working with large datasets and automating workflows Solid understanding of statistics and predictive modeling Experience with data visualization tools and libraries Knowledge of machine learning algorithms (Scikit-learn, TensorFlow) is a plus Soft Skills Analytical thinker with strong problem-solving ability Able to explain complex data insights in a clear, simple way Team player who thrives in fast-paced, evolving environments Background & Experience Degree in Physics, Meteorology, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field Market knowledge of power trading, balancing markets, renewables, or storage is a strong advantage Fluent English is required; other CEE languages (Bulgarian, German, Romanian, Czech, Slovakian, Polish, etc.) are a plus Certifications (Nice to Have) Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate Google Data Analytics Certificate SAS Certified Data Scientist Our team is proud to have a diverse workforce, enriched by individuals from various backgrounds, nationalities, perspectives, and experiences. Our common values and commitment to sustainability unite us as we work toward shared goals. To continue fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation, we welcome candidates from all walks of life to join us. Your unique contributions will help us grow stronger together and make a meaningful impact on our collective mission. The offered salary is in line with the Bulgarian market rate for the role and is calibrated to professional experience and qualifications. Data Protection & Privacy Notice By submitting an application for this position, you acknowledge and consent to the processing of your personal data for recruitment and selection purposes, in accordance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable data protection laws. Your personal data will be processed solely for purposes related to the recruitment process, including candidate assessment, communication, and documentation, and will be handled with strict confidentiality and appropriate security measures. For further information on how Enery processes and protects candidate personal data, including details on data retention, rights of data subjects, and contact information, please refer to our Recruitment Privacy Notice , available on our website.

items.desc:
Do you want a role with deep meaning and the ability to make a major impact? As part of Intelligent Talent Acquisition (ITA), you'll have the opportunity to reinvent the hiring process and deliver unprecedented scale, sophistication, and accuracy for Amazon Talent Acquisition operations. ITA is an industry-leading people science and technology organization made up of scientists, engineers, analysts, product professionals and more, all with the shared goal of connecting the right people to the right jobs in a way that is fair and precise. Last year we delivered over 6 million online candidate assessments, and helped Amazon deliver billions of packages around the world by making it possible to hire hundreds of thousands of workers in the right quantity, at the right location and at exactly the right time. You’ll work on state-of-the-art research, advanced software tools, new AI systems, and machine learning algorithms, leveraging Amazon's in-house tech stack to bring innovative solutions to life. Join ITA in using technologies to transform the hiring landscape and make a meaningful difference in people's lives. Together, we can solve the world's toughest hiring problems.
Key job responsibilities
Design and implement machine learning models that power recommendation systems for job seekers and recruiters, ensuring high performance, scalability, and reliability at global scale. Our ideal candidate has a strong scientific foundation and experience of statistical analysis and model building and has a passion for fairness and explainability in ML systems.
Collaborate with engineers, scientists, and product managers to define requirements, create solutions, and deliver products that improve the hiring experience.
Participate in the full software development lifecycle including scoping, design, coding, testing, documentation, deployment, and maintenance of recommendation systems and ML models.
Solve complex ML problems using optimal data structures and algorithms, making thoughtful trade-offs between efficiency and maintainability.
Stay current with scientific literature and develop novel approaches that address business challenges in talent acquisition. You will have the opportunity to provide feedback on scientific work across the organization helping the entire Intelligent Talent Acquisition organization improve.
A day in the life
You might spend the morning reviewing a colleague’s code for a new recommendation algorithm feature, then collaborate with product managers to refine requirements for an upcoming enhancement. After lunch, you’ll dive into model development, analyzing performance metrics from recent A/B tests and implementing improvements to the job-seeker recommendation pipeline. Throughout the day, you’ll participate in scientific discussions with peers across the organization, providing valuable feedback while continuing to refine your expertise.
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
- Are enrolled in a PhD in a relevant field
- Experience building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application
- Experience in designing experiments and statistical analysis of results
- Experience in professional software development
- Experience programming or scripting language like Python, Java, C or C++

items.desc:
Job Description Summary 
The Systems Engineering team at GE HealthCare Austria develops and supports advanced technologies and laboratory processes for medical ultrasound products. Our work spans image-quality optimization, acoustic simulation, certified laboratory measurements, ultrasound probe integration, and the development of next-generation ultrasound platforms.
In this role, you will take ownership of production sampling processes and coordinate sampling requirements across global GE HealthCare sites and ultrasound product lines. You will implement and configure measurement equipment and software, analyze measurement data, support laboratory operators, and coordinate laboratory activities. Your work will help ensure reliable product performance, regulatory compliance, and the successful release of high-quality ultrasound products.
At GE HealthCare, our machines, our software, our solutions, our services, and our people make a genuine difference to medical professionals and patients all over the world. That’s because we never lose sight of what healthcare really needs—the human touch. 
 Job Description 
 Responsibilities: 
 Implement, configure, and maintain measurement equipment and supporting software tools.
 Coordinate production sampling requirements and laboratory activities across global GE HealthCare sites and ultrasound product lines.
 Plan and lead verification and validation activities for laboratory processes, measurement equipment, and software tools.
 Analyze measurement data, identify trends, and translate results into clear technical conclusions and actions.
 Lead cross-functional investigations and coordinate global activities when product-performance deviations occur.
 Provide technical guidance and support to laboratory and measurement operators.
 Collaborate closely with Systems Engineering, product teams, manufacturing functions, laboratory operators, and global sites.
 Qualifications: 
 University degree in Medical Engineering or another relevant technical discipline; alternatively, a qualification from a higher technical college (HTL) 
 Several years of relevant technical experience
 Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills
 Experience in project coordination or project management
 Knowledge of measurement technology and technical laboratory processes
 Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
 German language skills are an advantage
 What we offer: 
 We offer a role specific compensation and a competitive salary and fringe benefit package reflecting your profile and experience.
 In Austria we are required to state the minimum pay. For this position, the annual compensation package starts at € 60.000. We will be pleased to discuss the appropriate effective salary based on your qualifications and experience.
 An exciting and diverse range of responsibilities in a growth-oriented company
 An interdisciplinary team and an international work environment
 Flextime and flexible working hours
 Free electric charging stations and ample parking facilities on the company premises
 An additional day off for your birthday
 Convenient public transportation access with a complimentary company shuttle to the Redl-Zipf train station, located 2 km away
 If you are interested in learning more we are looking forward to your online-application!
 Don't meet all the requirements? We are aware that there is almost never a perfect profile. You can learn (almost) anything as long as you are interested and enjoy new topics and challenges. In short: we look forward to receiving your application, even if you do not yet meet the requirements 100%!
 About us 
 GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator with over 100 years of healthcare industry experience and around 50,000 employees globally. We enable clinicians to make faster, more informed decisions through intelligent devices, data analytics, applications and services, supported by our Edison intelligence platform. We operate at the center of an ecosystem working toward precision health - digitizing healthcare, helping drive productivity and improving outcomes for patients, providers, health systems and researchers around the world.
 Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.
 GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
 GE HealthCare - Creating a world where healthcare has no limits

Join our Team
 About this opportunity: 
 RAN system management at BNEW is responsible for setting the north star for the RAN evolution through early exploration. We explore future scenarios, develop and evaluate promising solutions, and translate findings into recommendations for new products. We collaborate with RAN experts and other teams across Ericsson, sharing expertise and helping move new ideas toward impact. Your work will shape how AI and Machine Learning can contribute to new RAN solutions and improve 6G RAN.
 What you will do: 
 • Ensure RAN leadership and profitable business for Ericsson by driving and contributing to the evolution of AI in RAN.
• Initiate and conduct studies on AI in RAN, including Radio Resource Management.
• Develop and evaluate innovative solutions for new opportunities and scenarios, using simulations and hands-on implementation to assess the results.
• Translate findings into recommendations for new architecture and products.
• Identify promising ideas and contribute to the development of intellectual property, including patents.
• Communicate results to stakeholders, contribute with expertise, and collaborate with different Ericsson units and external partners.
 The skills you bring: 
 • PhD or MSc in Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, or equivalent.
• Strong technical leadership skills, analytical with ability to develop strategies, understand complex technical challenges, and drive innovative solutions.
• Excellent depth in AI with techniques and algorithms e.g. Reinforcement Learning (RL), exploration and learning strategies.
• Genuine interest in wireless communication e.g. Radio Resource Management, network modelling and performance evaluations.
• Software engineering knowledge and hands-on programming experience, including Python.
• Knowledge of mobile networks and the telecommunications industry.
• Experience in research, simulation tools, or development of AI or RAN solutions is an advantage.
• Ability to collaborate, engage and mobilize colleagues and partners to achieve results.
• Strong presentation and communication skills, with proficiency in English.
 Why join Ericsson? 
 At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. Software Engineer - Systems (New College Graduate)
 Location: Bucharest, Romania
 Business Unit Description
 NXP's Edge Processing Business Unit empowers the next generation of intelligent edge devices through a scalable portfolio of processors and microcontrollers that deliver industry-leading performance, security, connectivity, and AI capabilities. Our solutions enable innovation across automotive, industrial, consumer, healthcare, smart home, and communications markets.
 Department Description
 Join the Systems Engineering team in Bucharest, Romania, responsible for supporting NXP's advanced processor and microcontroller platforms. The team works closely with customers, software and hardware development organizations, product architects, and validation teams to accelerate product adoption and ensure customer success.
 As a Software Engineer - Systems, you will contribute to platform enablement, software integration, customer support, and system-level validation activities while developing expertise in embedded software and hardware technologies.
 Scope of Responsibilities / Expectations
 You will work within the global Systems Engineering organization and collaborate with teams across Europe, North America, and Asia. Your responsibilities will include:
 Customer and Product Enablement

Entreprise à mission depuis 2022, Sagemcom est leader technologique dans le monde des télécoms et de l'énergie, et ses équipes s'engagent chaque jour à fournir des solutions sur mesure et responsables, adaptées aux besoins de leurs clients opérateurs télécom et utilities. Aujourd'hui, notre Groupe est : Numéro 1 mondial des solutions haut débit (box internet et services logiciels associés) Leader technologique des solutions audio-vidéo (hubs vidéo 4K et Video SoundBox™ ) Leader européen des solutions smart-grid (comptage communicant, réseaux intelligents, électrification rurale, IoT) En 2024, Sagemcom a réalisé un chiffre d'affaires de 2.3 milliards d'euros, et s'appuie sur 6 500 collaborateurs répartis dans plus de 50 pays. Intégrer le groupe Sagemcom, c'est rejoindre un groupe de dimension internationale, où vous pourrez chaque jour relever de nouveaux défis. Si le travail en équipe, l'agilité, la créativité et les nouvelles technologies vous intéressent, rejoignez l'aventure ! » Référence 2026-2406 Description du poste Titre du poste Ingénieur.e développement logiciel AI-native – BSP H/F Contrat CDI Description de l'équipe Vous rejoignez l'équipe BSP de notre R&D Broadband Solutions, en charge des couches basses logicielles de nos passerelles résidentielles : bootloader, noyau Linux, drivers et adaptation aux plateformes matérielles. Ces produits, déployés à grande échelle chez des opérateurs télécoms, intègrent des technologies d'accès avancées (GPON, DOCSIS, FTTH, 5G) et les dernières générations de Wi-Fi (Wi-Fi 8). L'équipe fournit aux équipes Software Suite (prplOS, 5G) une base logicielle fiable, performante et sécurisée. Nous engageons une évolution de nos pratiques avec une approche de développement AI-native, intégrant l'IA et les agents IA à chaque étape du cycle de développement. Description de la mission En tant que Développeur·se logiciel senior AI-native, vous développez et maintenez le BSP de nos passerelles (bootloader, noyau Linux et drivers), principalement en C. Vous intervenez directement sur la conception et le développement des solutions et contribuez aux choix techniques avec les architectes, les équipes hardware et les autres développeurs de l'équipe. Principales activités Porter et maintenir le BSP sur de nouvelles plateformes : bring-up de cartes, bootloader (U-Boot), Device Tree, configuration du noyau. Développer, intégrer et maintenir des drivers Linux : interfaces réseau, Wi-Fi, stockage, GPIO, I2C, SPI, USB. Intégrer les SDK des fondeurs de SoC et suivre leurs évolutions ainsi que celles du noyau upstream. Mettre en œuvre les mécanismes de sécurité bas niveau : secure boot, chaîne de confiance, mises à jour logicielles robustes. Analyser et résoudre les problèmes complexes sur cible : démarrage, stabilité, performance, consommation, crashs noyau. Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes hardware, les fournisseurs de chipsets et les équipes Software Suite. Garantir la qualité des développements par les tests automatisés, les revues de code et la validation sur cible. Utiliser de manière avancée les outils et agents IA tout au long du cycle de développement, tout en gardant la maîtrise du résultat. Contribuer au partage des bonnes pratiques techniques au sein de l'équipe, notamment sur l'usage de l'IA. Profil recherché : Vous disposez d'une solide expérience dans le développement de BSP et de drivers Linux, idéalement sur des équipements réseau ou télécoms. Vous maîtrisez particulièrement : Le langage C et le développement dans le noyau Linux : drivers, Device Tree, gestion des interruptions, DMA, gestion mémoire. Les bootloaders (U-Boot) et les phases de démarrage d'un SoC. Les architectures ARM et les interfaces matérielles courantes (I2C, SPI, UART, USB, PCIe, Ethernet). Les outils de build embarqué (Buildroot, Yocto ou OpenWrt), les chaînes de compilation croisée et le débogage bas niveau (JTAG, console série, analyse de crashs noyau). L'utilisation avancée d'outils de développement assisté par IA tels que Claude Code, GitHub Copilot ou équivalents, incluant le pilotage d'agents IA, la décomposition des tâches, la revue du code généré et la validation des résultats. Une expérience des SoC Broadband (Broadcom, Qualcomm, MediaTek…) ou des drivers Wi-Fi est appréciée. La connaissance du secure boot, des mises à jour sécurisées ou de la contribution au noyau upstream constitue un plus. Nous recherchons un profil très opérationnel et autonome, capable de prendre en charge un sujet de bout en bout, de challenger les solutions techniques proposées, y compris celles produites par l'IA, et de contribuer aux choix de conception. Une aptitude à lire des schémas électroniques et à travailler au contact du hardware est appréciée. …

items.card: you will be part of the In Vitro Operations team, working alongside scientists who develop and produce cell-line, organoid, and primary-tissue cultures, as well as in vitro assays for commercial projects. Your main responsibilities will include carrying out cell-culture activities and related preparations, and supporting customer and internal projects under the guidance of experienced scientists and Study Directors.
items.desc: Grow Your Career Where Talent Meets Innovation Research Associate – In Vitro Operations As a Research Associate, you will be part of the In Vitro Operations team, working alongside scientists who develop and produce cell-line, organoid, and primary-tissue cultures, as well as in vitro assays for commercial projects. Your main responsibilities will include carrying out cell-culture activities and related preparations, and supporting customer and internal projects under the guidance of experienced scientists and Study Directors. You will also contribute to general laboratory duties and other support tasks. This role offers the opportunity to build hands-on experience in in vitro research and laboratory operations while developing your technical skills as part of a collaborative team. Main Responsibilities Passaging and expansion of (immune) cell, organoid cultures and primary patient samples Maintaining stocks of cryopreserved cell models Executing experiments for commercial and internal projects under the direction of Study Directors Performing laboratory tasks: cell culture, seed screening plates using liquid handlers, prepare compound dilutions and dispense to assay plates, fix culture plates, capture images using automated microscopes or other readout methods Carry out tasks and quality control accurately by following standard operating procedures Able to speak and record activities in lab books in English Prepare and store samples and reagents Help to keep equipment and labs in a clean and workable condition to maintain quality of our work Contribute to other routine laboratory tasks that may be required Qualifications HBO, BSc, or MSc degree. Experience with 3D cell cultures is an advantage. Experience understanding and following SOPs. Good numeracy and basic computer skills. Eligible to live and work in the Netherlands. Personal Skills Good time-management and organizational skills. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English. Ability to work both independently and as part of a team. Accurate, precise, and clean working style. Good record-keeping skills. Careful and meticulous approach, with a strong work ethic. The gross annual salary for this role lays between 33.000 and 35.000 EU on fulltime basis (excl. 8% holiday allowance). Crown Bioscience is a leading global preclinical pharmacology CRO with the largest collection of tumor models (PDX, organoids, ex vivo) and provides drug screening services to pharmaceutical and biotech companies globally. Crown Bioscience made a direct contribution to nearly half FDA-approved oncology drugs in 2020. Over the years, we have extensively profiled several thousand tumor models for their genomics, pharmacology, and histopathology. These rich data resources provide an ideal basis for studying cancer genomics, with direct impact on the discovery and development of novel cancer therapeutics. Crown Bioscience Netherlands is based in the Leiden Bio Science Parc, and is fully dedicated to in vitro preclinical research.

items.desc: ¿Qué tipo de Data & AI techie eres? Data Analytics, Big Data, Inteligencia Artificial, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, Cloud Data Platforms… Si te interesa cómo los datos y la IA transforman los negocios y la sociedad, tenemos mucho en común. Accenture Data & AI es el área desde la que ayudamos a nuestros clientes a extraer valor real de sus datos, aplicando analítica avanzada, inteligencia artificial y soluciones de datos a gran escala para impulsar la toma de decisiones, la automatización y la innovación. En Accenture Data & AI trabajamos en programas de transformación empresarial y tecnológica de gran impacto para clientes globales, utilizando tecnologías punteras en entornos cloud y arquitecturas modernas de datos. Buscamos estudiantes universitarios con interés en iniciar su carrera en el área de Data & IA. No requerimos experiencia previa ni una tecnología concreta de entrada: recibirás formación al incorporarte y te asignaremos un proyecto en función de tu perfil, motivación y necesidades del negocio, trabajando con herramientas actuales y metodologías Agile. Aporta curiosidad, pensamiento analítico y ganas de aprender para ayudar a nuestros clientes a convertir los datos en conocimiento, innovación y crecimiento sostenible. ¡El cambio empieza por ti! Únete a Accenture Data & IA. Funciones Participar en el diseño, desarrollo y mantenimiento de soluciones de datos, colaborando en procesos de ingestión, transformación y explotación de información utilizando herramientas de analítica y plataformas de datos en entornos cloud. Apoyar en el análisis de datos estructurados y no estructurados para la elaboración de informes, dashboards y modelos analíticos que faciliten la toma de decisiones de negocio. Colaborar en proyectos de inteligencia artificial y analítica avanzada, participando en tareas de preparación de datos, entrenamiento, validación y evaluación de modelos de machine learning. Trabajar en equipos multidisciplinares bajo metodologías Agile (Scrum/Kanban), documentando desarrollos, participando en ceremonias y asegurando la calidad de los entregables. Responsabilidades Ejecutar las tareas asignadas cumpliendo los estándares técnicos, de calidad y de seguridad definidos en el proyecto. Documentar procesos de datos, análisis y modelos desarrollados, asegurando su correcta comprensión y reutilización. Aprender y aplicar nuevas herramientas, tecnologías y metodologías relacionadas con Data & IA según las necesidades del proyecto. Colaborar activamente con perfiles senior, data engineers, data scientists y consultores para la correcta entrega de soluciones de valor al cliente. ¿Qué ofrecemos? Formaciones diseñadas específicamente para tu desarrollo técnico y competencial en Data, Analytics e Inteligencia Artificial. Un programa de mentoring que te ayudará a explorar tus opciones en Accenture y a construir tu propio camino profesional con nosotros. Otros requisitos son: Formación universitaria en Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Estadística, Física u otras titulaciones STEM relacionadas. Nivel mínimo de inglés B2. Otros idiomas serán valorables. Curiosidad intelectual y mentalidad analítica. Capacidad de trabajo en equipo en entornos multidisciplinares. Pasión por la tecnología, los datos y la inteligencia artificial. Igualdad de Oportunidades en el Empleo Todas las decisiones de empleo se tomarán sin importar la edad, raza, credo, color, religión, sexo, origen nacional, ascendencia, grado de discapacidad, estado de veterano, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género, información genética, estado civil, estado de ciudadanía o cualquier otro motivo o circunstancias protegidas por las leyes federales, estatales o locales.

Vår kund är en väletablerad, internationell industrikoncern med cirka 23 000 medarbetare globalt, varav 3 300 i Sverige. Företaget har ett starkt fokus på teknisk utveckling och innovation och arbetar kontinuerligt med att förbättra sina processer och arbetssätt genom digitalisering, data och AI. Här får du möjlighet att bli en del av en global organisation där samarbete, teknik och verksamhetsutveckling står i centrum. Målet är att förenkla arbetssätt, förbättra beslutsfattandet och omsätta idéer till konkreta lösningar som skapar värde i verksamheten. Organisationen har redan framgångsrikt utvecklat flera interna applikationer och identifierat ytterligare ett 20-tal potentiella lösningar. Ditt huvudsakliga fokus blir att skapa struktur, samla in behov, prioritera initiativ och säkerställa att idéerna utvecklas till fungerande lösningar. Du kommer att arbeta tvärfunktionellt och samarbeta med ett stort antal medarbetare och kravställare från olika avdelningar. Utvecklingsarbetet sker i nära samarbete med projektansvariga och utvecklare, där du har en central roll i att samordna arbetet och skapa en tydlig koppling mellan verksamhetens behov och utvecklingsteamets arbete. Under din första tid kommer du bland annat att arbeta med flera initiativ som exempelvis: AI-baserat stöd för ingenjörer: En applikation som hjälper ingenjörer att förbereda sig inför arbete ombord på fartyg, bland annat genom relevant information och säkerhetsunderlag. AI-baserad leadshantering: Utveckling av lösningar för att identifiera och prioritera affärsmöjligheter. Matchning av kundbehov: En digital lösning som gör det enklare för servicetekniker att hitta och ta sig an relevanta uppdrag. AI kommer att vara en viktig del av rollen men du kommer även att arbeta med digitalisering, processförbättringar, verksamhetsutveckling och förändringsarbete. Skapa engagemang och öka förståelsen för hur AI, data och digitala verktyg kan användas i det dagliga arbetet. Bygga relationer och främja samarbete mellan olika team och funktioner. items.desc: Autonomy Systems Engineer Description About Us Textron Specialized Vehicles are a global manufacturer of golf cars, utility and personal transportation vehicles, side-by-sides, all-terrain vehicles, professional turf-care equipment, and ground support equipment. At Ransomes Jacobsen Ltd, we design and manufacture professional turf-care equipment under the brands of Ransomes and Jacobsen. Our mission is to be the premier supplier of high-quality and environmentally conscious turf equipment, providing superior performance for our customers. From prestigious championship golf courses to the World Cup, for more than a century, the most important turf in the world has been manicured by our brand. We recognise that our success, and future success, is tied directly to our people. We are looking for an Autonomy Systems Engineer to join the Company in Ipswich, Suffolk. About the Role As an Autonomy Systems Engineer, you will develop and integrate the onboard autonomy stack for Jacobsen vehicles. This role focuses on vehicle-level system integration, safety-critical architecture, and embedded implementation, supporting the transition from prototype systems to production-ready autonomous platforms. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Lead integration of the autonomy stack (perception, localisation, planning, control) onto vehicle platforms; Design and implement safety systems, including safety controllers and safe stop functionality; Develop and integrate embedded software and vehicle control interfaces (CAN, drive-by-wire); Define and deliver sensor integration (LiDAR, radar, cameras, GPS/IMU); Execute vehicle-level testing and validation, including field trials; Support functional safety activities (HARA, safety case, certification readiness); Other duties as required. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics/Mechatronics or similar. A minimum of two years’ experience in autonomous or robotic systems integration, or similar roles. Required Skills: Strong understanding of functional safety (ISO 13849 / ISO 12100); Experience with embedded systems and real-time control; Knowledge of sensor systems and vehicle interfaces (CAN); Hands-on experience with system testing and validation; Self-motivating and able to work with low levels of supervision to defined objectives; Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills. Desirable Skills: ROS2 and robotics software stacks; Sensor fusion and perception systems; Safety-rated controllers / safety PLCs; Off-highway or automotive systems experience. What we Offer Work life balance promoted with every other Friday off; 30 days annual leave; Competitive rate of pay, reviewed annually; Enhanced Company pension; Life assurance of four times your annual salary; Comprehensive Employee Assistance Program for you and your immediate family; Access to Textron University’s self-service training platform; Eye care scheme; Discounts on gym memberships, shopping and travel through Perks at Work; Onsite golf course and football pitch; Winter flu vaccination voucher. AI Readiness: Textron expects employees to use AI-enabled tools responsibly and effectively. Candidates should be comfortable learning and applying these tools, evaluating AI-generated output with sound judgment, and using AI in line with company policy and ethical standards. Prior experience with specific tools is not required — we value curiosity, adaptability, and good judgment. items.desc: About the Role The BMS is where software meets power. As our Hardware Engineer, you'll own the hardware side of the Anori BMS with a focus on the power stage: power electronics, cell connection and protection circuits. At the same time, you'll be our go-to person for hardware testing and make sure every board holds up under real-world conditions, from HiL test benches to stress tests and EMC pre-compliance. You'll work closely with Stefan, our CTO, and our firmware engineers to take the BMS from a tested prototype to a fully certified product. The technology is proven, the funding is secured, and the hardware decisions you make now will define how every future Anori BMS works. Start date : from January 1, 2027 What You'll Do Design and develop the power stage of our BMS: the highest power density on the market Make the trade-off between performance, reliability, supply chain and price for each part Build and run hardware tests: HiL setups, stress tests, HALTs and failure analysis Plan and run EMC pre-compliance testing and prepare the path to conformity Bring up new boards and debug them together with the firmware team Contribute across the entire BMS hardware, wherever you are needed What You Bring Must have Solid foundation in electrical engineering, from the schematic to the PCB. You know the parasitic effects of every practical circuit and you design with them Deep knowledge of power electronics: MOSFET switch design, SOA, gate drive, current sensing and loss budgets Experience with protection circuits, e.g. overcurrent, short circuit, over- and undervoltage, reverse polarity Circuit and thermal simulation, for example in LTspice, with model-to-hardware correlation on the bench Confident in the lab: oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads, thermal measurements and of course hand-soldering 01005 components Critical, analytical, systematic thinking: you reason from first principles, make your assumptions explicit and challenge existing paradigms Strongly preferred A broad hardware skill set beyond the power stage: microcontroller circuits, analog sensing, communication interfaces (CAN, LIN, BLE, …) Proven hands-on testing experience, including HiL tests and stress tests Knowledge of DfM and new electronic manufacturing techniques, materials and general mechanical integration knowledge Thermal design and cooling concepts for high-current paths Wide-bandgap semiconductors and new switch topologies, and an interest to research and develop novel gate-drive techniques beyond standard drivers Nice to have High-voltage design above 60V: creepage and clearance, isolation, isolation monitoring and safe discharge Experience with battery systems, cell connection and cell monitoring ICs (AFEs) Test automation with Python A background in safety-critical systems (IEC 61508, ISO 26262, …) Knowledge in MBSE and requirements engineering methods (the skills, not the paper) You don't tick every box? Apply anyway. No one matches a job description 100%. If this role excites you and you see yourself growing into it, we want to hear from you. What We Offer Work on a product with purpose that redefines the state of art: our product is a key part to enable competitive battery energy storage. Work directly with the founding team on decisions that shape the company. The team is small, so your ideas will matter. A lot. Challenging engineering in an industrial, but research-near environment. items.desc: About us Most labs still count cells under a microscope by hand. It's slow, repetitive, and error-prone. We're replacing that manual work with software. By combining a standard microscope with a smartphone, we run computer vision models that locate, track, and measure cells automatically in real time. We're starting with semen analysis and expanding to other routine microscopic samples. We're a small, well-funded team in Berlin, founded in 2026. Our goal is to make automated, reliable diagnostic analysis accessible on any phone connected to a microscope. The role We're looking for an iOS engineer who loves the camera. Our app turns an iPhone on a microscope into a lab instrument, and the hard problems live on the device: holding focus on a moving sample, running computer vision in real time, and capturing a recording precise enough for a clinical result. On top of that, the app has to be simple enough for a technician in a busy lab. You'll own it end to end, together with the founders. What you'll do Own the app end to end, from architecture to release. Push the iPhone camera and on-device models to their limits, so every recording is good enough to analyse. Design the capture workflow with lab staff, so technicians get it right the first time. Spend time in the lab, measure what works, and decide what to build next. What you bring Camera depth. You've built on the iOS camera stack, not just used it: AVFoundation with manual focus, exposure and white balance, and real-time frame processing. You know where the hardware's limits are. On-device ML. You've run models on the phone and made them fast: Core ML and Vision, quantisation, the Neural Engine, profiling with Instruments. Apps you've owned. You've shipped iOS apps in Swift and SwiftUI and owned them in production. You design an architecture one engineer can carry, and you can explain the trade-offs behind it. Product and UX sense. You turn a messy real-world workflow into something simple, and you test it with the people who use it. Built for real conditions. Offline-first, background uploads, interruptions, data protection. The app works when the network doesn't. Beyond the app. iOS is your home, but when the app needs it, you read the backend and change an API yourself. Correctness. You validate with numbers, not by eye. Tests are part of the feature. You reproduce bugs first and fix the cause, not the symptom. AI-native engineering. Coding agents are part of your daily work. You give them good context, split work into reviewable steps, and stand behind every line you ship. Ownership. You help shape the roadmap, push back on weak ideas, set your own priorities and raise problems early. Nobody has to chase you. Range. You've worked across several companies, stacks or environments. How you work counts far more than how many years you've done it. Nice to have Optics or microscopy imaging. Apps for professional users: lab, field, clinical or enterprise. Regulated environments with audits: medical devices, health, finance. What we offer Ownership from day one. As a founding engineer, you're part of the company through our virtual share option plan (VSOP). You grow with us. As the company grows, your role grows with it. Real influence. You decide how we build software, and you shape the engineering team we build. A competitive salary. A product that matters: a medical device for real clinics, built together with clinicians and lab staff. Flexible hours and office days. We work from Berlin and meet in person regularly, up to several days a week. This isn't a fully remote role. English is our working language. German isn't required. We sponsor the EU Blue Card if you're moving to Berlin.

items.desc: Bouw jij de brug tussen complexe klantvragen en innovatieve hardware en softwareoplossingen? Bij Confed ontwikkelen we niet zomaar producten; we creëren de intelligentie achter de apparaten van morgen! Als System Architect speel je een sleutelrol in ons ontwikkelproces. Jij zit met de klant aan tafel om de vraag achter de vraag te begrijpen en vertaalt deze naar een realiseerbare, toekomstbestendige oplossing voor onze engineeringteams. Wat ga je doen? Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het conceptuele en technische ontwerp van embedded systemen waarin hardware, firmware en software samenkomen. Je overziet het gehele spectrum en zorgt ervoor dat alle onderdelen functioneel en technisch op elkaar aansluiten. Je bent de technische gesprekspartner voor onze klanten en actief betrokken bij klantpresentaties, offertes en technische haalbaarheidsstudies. Je stelt de juiste vragen om requirements boven tafel te krijgen en vertaalt deze naar heldere specificaties en architectuurrichtingen. Je werkt nauw samen met klanten, onze sales- en projectmanagers en multidisciplinaire engineeringteams om tot gedragen en haalbare systeemkeuzes te komen. Je stelt high-level designs op en maakt cruciale keuzes over platformen, interfaces, protocollen en systeemgrenzen. Daarbij weeg je functionaliteit af tegen onder andere aspecten als betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid, kostprijs en time-to-market. Je bewaakt de samenhang tussen hardware, firmware, software en integratie, en borgt dat keuzes op systeemniveau technisch, functioneel én commercieel verantwoord zijn. Je bewaakt tijdens het ontwikkelproces de rode draad. Je ondersteunt de lead engineers en bewaakt de integriteit van de gekozen oplossing. Je signaleert technische risico’s vroegtijdig en helpt teams bij het maken van afgewogen keuzes in haalbaarheid, performance, maakbaarheid en onderhoudbaarheid. Je volgt relevante marktontwikkelingen nauwlettend zoals IoT-beveiliging, Edge AI, low-power design of nieuwe connectiviteitsstandaarden en past deze toe waar ze waarde toevoegen. Wie ben jij? Je bent een ervaren professional die het overzicht bewaart zonder de technische details uit het oog te verliezen. Je spreekt de taal van zowel de business als de bit-shifters en kan complexe technische keuzes helder uleggen. Wij zoeken iemand die zich herkent in het volgende profiel: Je hebt een afgeronde WO/HBO-opleiding in de richting van Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems of vergelijkbaar. Je hebt 5 tot 10 jaar ervaring in embedded productontwikkeling, waarvan een substantieel deel in een architecturale rol. Je hebt aantoonbare kennis van embedded systemen en begrijpt printplaatontwerp op schema- en lay-outniveau Je hebt inzicht in microcontrollers, SoC’s, FPGA’s, sensoren, actuatoren, bussen en voedingstopologieën. Je bent vertrouwd met elektronica tools zoals de oscilloscoop, logic analyzer, altium en LTSpice. Je bent niet alleen een denker, maar ook een doener; je kunt zelfstandig prototypen, debuggen en indien nodig code of hardware analyseren om teams verder te helpen. Je bent analytisch sterk, pragmatisch ingesteld en beschikt over uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden. Je beheerst zowel de Nederlandse als de Engelse taal goed in woord en geschift. Wat bieden wij? Bij Confed kom je terecht in een hecht en bevlogen team waar passie voor techniek centraal staat. Je krijgt de ruimte om inhoudelijk richting te geven aan complexe embedded vraagstukken en werkt aan oplossingen die daadwerkelijk worden geproduceerd en toegepast. Wij bieden onder andere: Een uitdagende functie in een betrokken ontwikkelorganisatie met korte lijnen. Veel ruimte voor eigen inbreng, technische verdieping en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Een werkomgeving dichtbij onze productielocatie waardoor je snel kunt schakelen met collega’s op de productievloer en jouw oplossingen direct in uitvoering ziet komen. Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden; zoals flexibele werktijden, reiskostenvergoeding, laptop, mobiele telefoon, pensioenbijdrage. Salaris: €4.500,00 - €6.000,00 per maand Arbeidsvoorwaarden: Kosteloos parkeren Reiskostenvergoeding Telefoon van de zaak Werklocatie: Fysiek

We share office space with Epidemic Sound near Medborgarplatsen, Stockholm. A chance to work hard and grow very fast with an extremely ambitious team. We want to start with a 3 month freelance assignment with a good chance to be extended further. Equal opportunity employer We believe that bringing people together from different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives makes for a healthy workplace, a more successful business and a better world. We value diversity and encourage everyone to apply.

items.desc: Overall, Purpose of the Job We are looking for one Research Associate to work on the development, implementation and testing of predictive control algorithms for the optimal coordination of available multi-energy resources and network infrastructure and thus support and improve the operation of the energy networks and the performance and the sustainability of the urban energy system. Learning-based techniques (e.g., deep neural networks) will be used to automatically learn the system dynamics and the modelling errors, as well as to obtain an automatic tuning of the cost parameters/constraints or approximators of the control law. This will alleviate the modelling complexities and the online computational requirements of the control algorithms and provide them with learning, self-regulating and adaptive capabilities. The appointed Research Associate will collaborate with researchers from other UK universities working around multi-energy networks and multi-energy technologies, focusing on their modelling, optimisation and control, within the EPSRC-funded project Supergen Energy Network Hub. This research will contribute to provide leadership, research and networking for the energy networks and systems community to grow and come together to develop a deeper understanding of the interconnected and interdependent energy network infrastructure, e.g. electricity, heat, gas, hydrogen, as well as of the urban energy systems. Please note this post will also require UK travel to collaborating universities, as well as opportunities to present research at leading international conferences, as well as the ability to interact effectively with researchers from other disciplines and industrial partners. The post duration is likely to be extended by a time depending on the available funds and the performance. items.desc: Votre environnement Renault Group investit dans l’IA pour répondre à des besoins métiers variés, de la conception à la production. Vous rejoindrez le Centre d’Excellence IA de Renault Digital, qui réunit une quinzaine de data scientists et porte les projets d’IA transverses du groupe. Vous travaillerez en lien direct avec les équipes des usines ou métier qui seront vos interlocuteurs pour définir les cas d’usage et valider vos recommandations. Vous aurez accès à des cas d’usage issus de plusieurs directions (industrie, ingénierie, finance, qualité, après-vente) et à des données variées : séries temporelles, images, audio, vidéo, verbatims. Moyens techniques : environnement GCP, accès à des API de modèles en ligne, matériel embarqué de test si besoin. Lieu : Boulogne-Billancourt (3 j/sem) et télétravail (2 j/sem), avec déplacements ponctuels au Technocentre de Guyancourt et sur sites de production. Encadrement : T. Phe-Neau, PhD, Chapter Leader, Data Scientist @ Renault Digital A. Vouillon, Head of AI CoE @ Renault Group Votre mission Déterminer, pour les cas d’usage industriel définis, quel type de modèle multimodal déployer, et outiller ce choix de façon durable. La durée de vie des modèles déployés est aujourd’hui d’environ un an. Les modèles open source (ex. Gemma, DeepSeek, Qwen) déployés en interne peuvent s’affranchir du cycle de vie des fournisseurs. Mais en usine, le bon choix dépend aussi de la latence, de la connectivité, de la confidentialité, du matériel en bord de ligne et du coût. Vous comparerez donc trois familles d’approches : modèles en ligne via API (référence de performance), modèles open source auto-hébergés sur GCP et modèles embarqués sur matériel edge. L’évaluation pourra porter sur deux problématiques, précisées avec les équipes métier : la détection d’anomalies sur images ou la transcription vocale (speech-to-text) avec vocabulaire spécifique. Vos missions principales Cadrer les cas d’usage avec les équipes des usines et les équipes data science du AI CoE: données disponibles, contraintes terrain, critères de succès. Benchmarker les modèles : revue bibliographique, analyse comparative des caractéristiques, sélection de modèles par famille. Définir les métriques de chaque cas d’usage : qualité métier (ex : rappel à taux de fausse alarme fixé et F1 pour les anomalies, WER et taux d’erreur sur le vocabulaire métier pour la transcription) ; robustesse (ex : éclairage, bruit d’atelier, accents) ; opérationnel et coût (ex : latence, débit, mémoire, coût par inférence) ; pérennité (ex : licence, souveraineté, dépendance fournisseur). Construire le framework d’évaluation en Python, reproductible et extensible à de nouveaux modèles et cas d’usage. Déployer et comparer les solutions retenues sur GCP ou sur matériel embarqué, en testant des leviers d’optimisation (fine-tuning léger, quantisation). Rédiger la guideline d’usage : recommandation d’approche et de modèle par cas d’usage, validée avec les usines, et bonnes pratiques pour un usage pérenne (long-term support). Votre profil Vous êtes en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur ou de Master 2, avec une spécialisation en data science, IA ou vision par ordinateur. Solides bases en Machine Learning, Deep Learning et traitement multimodal (vision, audio). Maîtrise de Python et des frameworks IA. Connaissance des environnements cloud avec déploiement d’endpoints et de conteneurs (GCP apprécié). Notions d’inférence optimisée ou d’embarqué appréciées (quantification, vLLM, ONNX, TensorRT, Jetson). Rigueur expérimentale et capacité à analyser et synthétiser des résultats scientifiques. Autonomie, curiosité pour le terrain et aisance pour échanger avec des équipes opérationnelles en usine. Apports pour l’étudiant Expertise sur les modèles multimodaux open source et commerciaux, et sur leur intégration en environnement industriel, du cloud à l’embarqué. Expérience pratique sur des problématiques réelles et variées, au contact des équipes des usines. Contribution à un framework et à des guidelines stratégiques pour l’IA générative en entreprise. Connaissance des bonnes pratiques MLOps pour le déploiement des projets IA chez Renault Group. Intégration aux équipes du AI CoE, aux séances de best practices et découverte des sujets IA de bout en bout.

items.desc: Role: AI Engineer Experience: 1-5years Location: Gloucester, England Job Description: As an AI Software Engineer within the Engineering Methods & Tools Department, you will contribute directly to the design, development, testing and deployment of AI solutions supporting engineering activities. Working onsite at our Gloucester location, you will work closely with AI software engineers, data scientists, product owners and engineering stakeholders to deliver practical, reliable and efficient solutions that improve productivity. Main activities: Hands-on development: Prototype, design and test AI and machine-learning solutions for engineering applications. Software implementation: Build maintainable and scalable ML systems and AI solutions. AI solution reliability: Develop robust, production-ready AI solutions, ensuring reliability, maintainability, scalability, and appropriate handling of model limitations and failures Data Pipeline Management: Manage data pipelines and ensure data quality. Deployment and support: Support solution integration, cloud deployment, maintenance and transition into operation. Teamwork: Work efficiently as part of the AI Software Engineering team, share progress, contribute to reviews and support collective delivery. Troubleshooting: Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve problems with deployed AI systems. Evaluation and benchmarking: Design and implement evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and automated tests to measure AI model performance, output quality, and reliability, and identify regressions Continuous improvement: Promote and implement AI best practices and continuous improvement Documentation: Document all steps in the development process. Candidate skills & requirements: Programming Languages: Python (other languages are an advantage) Strong background in software engineering principles, including deployment and maintenance of AI systems Experience with LLMs, machine learning, deep learning, NLP, or computer vision; including evaluation, testing, and production deployment of AI/LLM-based applications Cloud Computing: Knowledge of cloud platforms; experience with AWS is an advantage Databases: Experience with databases and data stores Data Analysis: Statistical analysis, data visualisation Communication: Strong communication skills to collaborate with other team members. Who We Are Scalian UK is a consultancy, specialising in digital systems and business management and performance, working in 12 countries, including France, Spain, Belgium, the UK, Germany, the USA, and Canada. Ranked in the top 10 engineering consulting firms in France, the Group provides services in industrial project management, quality management, supply chain performance and development of digital and information systems. It also helps clients address digital transformation challenges for the industry and the service sectors. As of 2024, the Group includes 5,500 people, with a turnover of €550 million. More information can be found at - https://www.scalian.com/en/ Note: Visa sponsorship is not currently available for this position. However, we are open to considering candidates who may require visa sponsorship in the future, subject to business needs and eligibility requirements.

items.title: Founding Data Scientist
items.card: What You'll Do Own incrementality testing across marketing, product, and rewards — proving its value from hypothesis to business impact. Build the data pipelines and measurement stack behind it, tying experiments to real shifts in user behaviour, monetisation, and multi-touch attribution. Drive experimentation strategy across growth and product: design, run, and interpret tests with a sharp focus on causal validity
items.desc: This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000). We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 95 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world. Founding Data Scientist We're looking for a Founding Data Scientist to work directly with leadership on zero-to-one measurement and growth problems. This is not a role for maintaining existing systems — it's for someone who can take an ambiguous, high-stakes question and build the data infrastructure to answer it reliably, then own what comes next. We value people who combine measurement rigour with builder instincts: someone equally comfortable designing a causal experiment and shipping the pipeline that operationalises its output. What You'll Do Own incrementality testing across marketing, product, and rewards — proving its value from hypothesis to business impact. Build the data pipelines and measurement stack behind it, tying experiments to real shifts in user behaviour, monetisation, and multi-touch attribution. Drive experimentation strategy across growth and product: design, run, and interpret tests with a sharp focus on causal validity — not just p-values. Own data products end-to-end: scoping, architecture, implementation, rollout. Partner with C-level, engineering, and business stakeholders to turn measurement into live operational decisions. Set the frameworks and practices the team can scale on. What You Need Deep expertise applying causal inference and experimental design in practice, in real business contexts. Hands-on experience building and operationalising attribution models in a real business context — not just running models, but making them useful. Proven zero-to-one experience: ambiguous problem, built the infrastructure, shipped something production-ready. Proficiency in Python and SQL; GCP preferred; comfortable with modern data stack tools (dbt). Experience with programmatic advertising, ML pricing, or mobile measurement — MMPs, probabilistic attribution, or similar is a strong plus. Familiarity with AI and LLM tooling is a plus — whether that's integrating language models into data workflows, using AI-assisted analysis to move faster, or exploring how generative and predictive AI can sharpen measurement and personalisation at scale. We're an AI-native team and expect this role to grow alongside those capabilities. You Are A builder with a strong ownership mindset — you don't wait for a spec. Rigorous but pragmatic: the stats matter, but the business question matters more. Someone who, if they have to debug something twice, automates it. A clear communicator — you can translate model outputs into decisions that non-technical stakeholders can act on. Why Almedia? Own Our Growth: Competitive package with meaningful equity. High Impact: Work on company-defining projects, not tickets in a queue. Scale With Almedia: Join a profitable, high-growth startup early. Great Environment: Central Berlin office, transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more. We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

items.desc: Ihre Mission: NRW erklären Bei IT.NRW geht es um mehr als nur einen Job. Es geht um einen wichtigen gesellschaftlichen Auftrag. Als Referentin/Referent im Bereich Experimentelle Statistik (m/w/d) tragen Sie mit dazu bei, Nordrhein-Westfalen mit hochwertigen und verlässlichen Daten zu versorgen. Bringen Sie sich jetzt ein und leisten Sie einen wichtigen Beitrag für 18 Millionen Bürgerinnen und Bürger in NRW. Jetzt bewerben Ihr Bereich: Mathematisch-statistische Methoden und Experimentelle Statistik Im Bereich „Mathematisch-statistische Methoden und Experimentelle Statistik“ sind wir die zentrale Anlaufstelle für alle Fragestellungen rund um folgende Themen: Erprobung und Einsatz maschineller Lernverfahren und experimenteller Statistik Erschließung neuer digitaler Datenquellen, inkl. der Verwendung von Webscraping und ggf. Fernerkundungsdaten Beratung und Unterstützung bei Fragen zu den Themen Statistische Geheimhaltung, Künstliche Intelligenz sowie zum Einsatz von klassischen datenanalytischen Verfahren und experimentellen Methoden Dabei arbeiten wir sowohl mit anderen Fachbereichen im Geschäftsbereich Statistik zusammen als auch mit dem statistischen Verbund. Bei einzelnen Aufgaben wie dem Maschinellen Lernen oder der Geheimhaltung haben wir dabei innerhalb des Verbunds eine Federführung. Stiftet Sinn: Ihre Aufgaben Ihre Haupttätigkeit Sie übernehmen die Steuerung der Aufgaben im Themenfeld „Experimentelle Statistik“. Dafür erproben Sie in den folgenden Bereichen systematisch die potentiellen Einsatzmöglichkeiten und bewerten diese im Hinblick auf Reifegrad und Qualität: statistische Methoden, die bislang nicht standardmäßig in der Statistikproduktion eingesetzt werden (z. B. Supervised Learning, Small Area-Modelle, Nowcasting) sowie alternative Datenquellen (z. B. Daten aus Webscraping). Sie beraten die Fachbereiche im Geschäftsbereich Statistik zu Anwendungsmöglichkeiten von Methoden und Datenquellen mit experimentellem Charakter. Sie koordinieren Projekte zur Entwicklung von Anwendungen und Prototypen mit dem Ziel, die Statistikproduktion effizienter zu gestalten. Dabei arbeiten Sie eng mit den zuständigen Stellen im Haus zusammen. Sie befähigen die betroffenen Fachbereiche zum selbstständigen Einsatz der entwickelten Anwendungen und Prototypen. Die gewonnenen Erkenntnisse und Ergebnisse präsentieren Sie hausintern und im statistischen Verbund. Bei der Durchführung der Aufgaben übernehmen Sie die Führung und Steuerung von Projektteams. Ihr Aufgabenfeld Umfasst Zudem Sie unterstützen bei der Beratung zu statistisch-methodischen Fragestellungen im Geschäftsbereich Statistik. Bei Bedarf arbeiten Sie in Gremien des Verbundes der Statistischen Ämter des Bundes und der Länder mit und vertreten dort das Statistische Landesamt NRW. Bewegt mehr: Ihr Profil Sie Bringen Mit Diplom oder Master einer wissenschaftlichen Hochschule (oder vergleichbar) im Bereich Wirtschafts-, Sozial- oder Politikwissenschaften, Mathematik, Statistik, Data Sciences, Geografie oder einen entsprechenden Abschluss aus einem vergleichbaren Studiengang Ausgeprägte Kompetenzen in der Leitung und Durchführung von Projekten Erfahrung in der Anwendung von mathematisch-statistischen Verfahren sowie maschinellen Lernverfahren Know-how in der Umsetzung von Innovationen Fähigkeit komplexe methodische Sachverhalte zu vermitteln Sicheres Deutsch (in Wort und Schrift) Wünschenswert Sind Zudem Erfahrung in Präsentation und Moderation Vertrautheit mit der Strukturierung von Aufgaben und Steuerung von Teams Sicherer Umgang mit Statistik-Software, vorzugsweise R und/oder Phython Ihre Persönlichkeit Teamgeist und Serviceorientierung Initiative und Offenheit im Umgang mit Veränderungen Lösungsorientierung und selbstständige Arbeitsweise Zusätzliche Stelleninfos Eine spätere Übernahme in das Beamtenverhältnis ist bei Vorliegen der haushaltsrechtlichen und laufbahnrechtlichen Voraussetzungen möglich. Über die Ausschreibung wird nicht die berufliche Entwicklung innerhalb der Laufbahngruppe 2 (vgl. 25 - 27 LVO NRW) eröffnet. Eine Übertragung der vollständigen Tätigkeit und Verantwortlichkeiten und damit eine Eingruppierung in die Entgeltgruppe 14 TV-L erfolgt, wenn Sie nach Abschluss Ihres Studiums über eine mindestens dreijährige, einschlägige Berufs- und Führungserfahrung verfügen. In allen anderen Fällen werden Sie zunächst in der Entgeltgruppe 13 TV-L eingestellt und auf höherwertige Tätigkeiten vorbereitet. Wir bieten Ihre Benefits Gute Entwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten Gute Work-Life-Balance sowie Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie durch hohe Flexibilität (z. B. flexible Arbeitszeiten, Option auf Teilzeitarbeit, bis zu 80 % Homeoffice) Betriebliche Altersvorsorge Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement Ein offenes Arbeitsklima Standortabhängig: Kantine sowie kostenfreie Parkplätze IT.NRW Der richtige Schritt : Ihre Bewerbung Bewerben Sie sich jetzt einfach online und leisten Sie mit uns gemeinsam einen wichtigen Beitrag für 18 Millionen Menschen …

Document technical architectures and perform knowledge transfer to internal technical teams. Requirements 1+ years of experience in data science and AI development using Python. 1+ years of experience with cloud-native data platforms including Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, and Microsoft Fabric. Experience with containerization and application hosting using Docker and Azure App Service. You possess knowledge of semantic search indexing and fuzzy matching methodologies. You have experience setting up CI/CD and monitoring within cloud environments. You are proactive and solution-oriented with a focus on knowledge sharing. You have an active knowledge of French or Dutch. Nice to Haves Knowledge of English. Entreprise à mission depuis 2022, Sagemcom est leader technologique dans le monde des télécoms et de l'énergie, et ses équipes s'engagent chaque jour à fournir des solutions sur mesure et responsables, adaptées aux besoins de leurs clients opérateurs télécom et utilities. Aujourd'hui, notre Groupe est : * Numéro 1 mondial des solutions haut débit (box internet et services logiciels associés) * Leader technologique des solutions audio-vidéo (hubs vidéo 4K et Video SoundBox™ ) * Leader européen des solutions smart-grid (comptage communicant, réseaux intelligents, électrification rurale, IoT) En 2024, Sagemcom a réalisé un chiffre d'affaires de 2.3 milliards d'euros, et s'appuie sur 6 500 collaborateurs répartis dans plus de 50 pays. Intégrer le groupe Sagemcom, c'est rejoindre un groupe de dimension internationale, où vous pourrez chaque jour relever de nouveaux défis. Si le travail en équipe, l'agilité, la créativité et les nouvelles technologies vous intéressent, rejoignez l'aventure ! » Vous rejoignez l'équipe Software Suite 5G de notre R&D Broadband Solutions, en charge du développement logiciel middleware de nos passerelles résidentielles FWA. Ces produits, déployés chez des opérateurs télécoms, apportent le très haut débit fixe par la 5G et intègrent les dernières générations de Wi-Fi (Wi-Fi 8). Nous engageons une évolution de nos pratiques avec une approche de développement AI-native, intégrant l'IA et les agents IA à chaque étape du cycle de développement. En tant que Développeur·se logiciel senior AI-native, vous concevez et développez les composants middleware de nos passerelles 5G, principalement en C, dans un environnement Linux embarqué. Vous intervenez directement sur la conception et le développement des solutions et contribuez aux choix techniques avec les architectes et les autres développeurs de l'équipe. Principales activités: Concevoir et développer des composants middleware embarqués robustes, performants et sécurisés dans un environnement Linux embarqué. Participer à la personnalisation de la Software Suite utilisée pour les produits gateways. Développer les services de gestion de la connectivité 5G : pilotage du modem, connexion WAN cellulaire, bascule et supervision du lien. Implémenter des services système en user space : gestion réseau, Wi-Fi, TR-181/USP, sécurité, diagnostics, supervision. Interagir avec les couches BSP et drivers Linux, les fournisseurs de modems et chipsets, ainsi qu'avec les équipes applicatives (UI, cloud). Intégrer des composants open source et développer des modules spécifiques. Garantir la qualité des développements par les tests automatisés, les revues de code et l'analyse des performances sur cible. Utiliser de manière avancée les outils et agents IA tout au long du cycle de développement, tout en gardant la maîtrise du résultat. Contribuer au partage des bonnes pratiques techniques au sein de l'équipe, notamment sur l'usage de l'IA. Profil recherché: Vous disposez d'une solide expérience dans le développement de logiciels embarqués sous Linux, idéalement sur des équipements réseau, télécoms ou cellulaires. Vous maîtrisez particulièrement : - Le langage C et la programmation système Linux (processus, IPC, sockets, gestion mémoire), ainsi que les problématiques de performance et de concurrence. - Les distributions Linux embarquées et leurs outils de build. - Les protocoles réseau : TCP/IP, routage, DHCP, DNS, IPv6, firewalling. - Le débogage sur cible (gdb, strace, valgrind, analyse de traces et de core dumps), le shell et Python pour l'outillage et les tests, ainsi que les pratiques CI/CD. - L'utilisation avancée d'outils de développement assisté par IA tels que Claude Code, GitHub Copilot ou équivalents, incluant le pilotage d'agents IA, la décomposition des tâches, la revue du code généré et la validation des résultats. - Une expérience de l'intégration de modems cellulaires (4G/5G) ou des passerelles FWA est appréciée. La connaissance d'interfaces et protocoles tels que QMI, MBIM, commandes AT, TR-181 ou USP (TR-369) constitue un plus. Nous recherchons un profil très opérationnel et autonome, capable de prendre en charge un sujet de bout en bout, de challenger les solutions techniques proposées, y compris celles produites par l'IA, et de contribuer aux choix de conception. Une connaissance du Wi-Fi (Wi-Fi 6/7, EasyMesh) est appréciée. Ce que vous trouverez chez Sagemcom : > Un cadre de travail stimulant dans une entreprise internationale et engagée > Des perspectives d’évolution et de formation régulière > Un management de proximité et une grande autonomie dans les missions > Des accords d’intéressement et de participation, la possibilité de devenir salarié(e) actionnaire > RTT, Mutuelle, CE, conciergerie, coiffeur, et restaurant d’entreprise > …

items.desc: About The Role Neural Concept's Vertical Solutions team turns the most common engineering use cases into streamlined, production-grade workflows empowered by leading AI technologies. As an AI Workflows Engineer , you will own the design and delivery of AI-powered, Python-first engineering solutions for a specific industry application. You will collaborate with the Vertical Solutions Product Manager and key customers to define the roadmap and build workflows that integrate design, simulation, and machine learning—helping to shorten product development cycles and amplify impact. As the primary developer, you will work closely with CAD and CAE specialists to implement, maintain, and evolve these solutions. You will also identify reusable components that can be integrated into the Neural Concept platform, ensuring consistency, driving innovation, and accelerating adoption across applications. What You Will Do Lead the design and delivery of AI-powered engineering workflows for specific industry applications and integrate them into the Neural Concept platform for scalable adoption. Build & integrate: act as primary Python developer — define clean interfaces with CAD/CAE specialists; own coding, testing, CI, packaging, and releases Upstream reusable components to the Neural Concept platform. Standardize: stay close to active projects; spot recurring pain points and patterns, and turn them into reusable templates, presets, and best practices. Engage reference customers and end users to gather feedback, and drive adoption. Help define and review documentation, playbooks and hands-on training sessions. Who You Are Must have: Experience building and shipping production Python tools in fast-moving, cross-functional teams. Hands-on Python engineer with strong software practices: packaging, testing (pytest), CI, code review, docs, and git. Contribute to technical direction and architecture while acting as a hands-on developer for vertical workflows; comfortable integrating external tools and defining clean data/interfaces for specialists. Background in physics or engineering, or equivalent experience. Clear, concise communicator who collaborates effectively across teams. Location: Cambridge (UK), or willing to relocate; hybrid setup with up to 2 remote days/week. Nice To Have Industry exposure (e.g., automotive, aerospace, energy) and familiarity with product design processes is a strong plus. Familiarity with CAD and/or CAE Familiarity with ML and common libraries (scikit-learn, PyTorch, Tensorflow...) Experience with agentic AI orchestration What You Get Work with a world-class technology team – our engineers are top-notch, and we always aim for excellence. Benefit from a competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale. Thrive in a collaborative, multicultural environment where your work is visible and recognized. Develop professionally alongside talented colleagues who share knowledge freely and support one another. Make a global impact by helping customers shift to AI-assisted design, making innovation faster, smarter, and more sustainable. Balance life and work with a hybrid model and flexible hours—we care about results, not rigid schedules. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.
