items.desc: Over Conversal Conversal bouwt slimme groeisystemen voor bedrijven: AI-agents, automatisaties, koppelingen en dashboards die zorgen voor meer leads, minder manueel werk en betere beslissingen. We combineren strategie, creatie, tech en marketing in één team van zo’n 20 mensen. Websites maken we nog altijd, maar ze zijn een onderdeel van het geheel, niet het doel. Jouw rol Je bent geen developer die tickets afwerkt. Je zit mee aan tafel bij klanten, bepaalt mee wat er gebouwd moet worden en bouwt het daarna zelf. Claude en agents doen een groot deel van het bouwwerk. Jij stuurt, controleert en draagt de eindverantwoordelijkheid. Wat je doet Je voert gesprekken met klanten, brengt hun processen in kaart en zoekt waar AI en automatisatie het meeste opleveren. Je bouwt de oplossing zelf: AI-agents, automatisaties, interne tools, dashboards en koppelingen met CRM, ERP en marketingtools. Je werkt dagelijks met Claude, Claude Code en MCP, en zet agents in voor het zware werk. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit: wat AI bouwt, test en controleer jij. Elk systeem is veilig, stabiel en onderhoudbaar. Je levert op, legt uit wat je gebouwd hebt en meet of het werkt. Je deelt werkwijzen, prompts en agent-workflows, zodat het hele team sneller en slimmer werkt. Wat je meebrengt Een technische basis: je begrijpt API’s, data en hoe systemen met elkaar praten. Je hebt al oplossingen gebouwd die echt gebruikt worden. Je werkt elke dag met Claude of vergelijkbare AI-agents en weet wanneer je ze vertrouwt en wanneer je zelf ingrijpt. Je voelt je thuis bij klanten en legt technische keuzes eenvoudig uit. Je denkt in resultaat en neemt ownership: een project is pas af als het werkt. Je spreekt en schrijft vlot Nederlands. Wat wij bieden Eigenaarschap vanaf dag één, zonder micromanagement, met een team van experts achter je. Ruimte en tijd om te experimenteren met de nieuwste AI-tools. Hybride werken: jij kiest de mix tussen kantoor en thuis. Een competitief loon op basis van ervaring, bedrijfswagen met laadpas en extralegale voordelen. Je eigen setup, qua software en hardware. Een team dat hard werkt en successen viert: van BBQ’s en ons visieweekend tot Rock Affligem. Interesse? Solliciteer via LinkedIn of in 60 seconden via onze website: https://www.conversal.be/vacature/ai-web-engineer/

items.desc: ¿Qué tipo de Data & AI techie eres? Data Analytics, Big Data, Inteligencia Artificial, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, Cloud Data Platforms… Si te interesa cómo los datos y la IA transforman los negocios y la sociedad, tenemos mucho en común. Accenture Data & AI es el área desde la que ayudamos a nuestros clientes a extraer valor real de sus datos, aplicando analítica avanzada, inteligencia artificial y soluciones de datos a gran escala para impulsar la toma de decisiones, la automatización y la innovación. En Accenture Data & AI trabajamos en programas de transformación empresarial y tecnológica de gran impacto para clientes globales, utilizando tecnologías punteras en entornos cloud y arquitecturas modernas de datos. Buscamos estudiantes universitarios con interés en iniciar su carrera en el área de Data & IA. No requerimos experiencia previa ni una tecnología concreta de entrada: recibirás formación al incorporarte y te asignaremos un proyecto en función de tu perfil, motivación y necesidades del negocio, trabajando con herramientas actuales y metodologías Agile. Aporta curiosidad, pensamiento analítico y ganas de aprender para ayudar a nuestros clientes a convertir los datos en conocimiento, innovación y crecimiento sostenible. ¡El cambio empieza por ti! Únete a Accenture Data & IA. Funciones Participar en el diseño, desarrollo y mantenimiento de soluciones de datos, colaborando en procesos de ingestión, transformación y explotación de información utilizando herramientas de analítica y plataformas de datos en entornos cloud. Apoyar en el análisis de datos estructurados y no estructurados para la elaboración de informes, dashboards y modelos analíticos que faciliten la toma de decisiones de negocio. Colaborar en proyectos de inteligencia artificial y analítica avanzada, participando en tareas de preparación de datos, entrenamiento, validación y evaluación de modelos de machine learning. Trabajar en equipos multidisciplinares bajo metodologías Agile (Scrum/Kanban), documentando desarrollos, participando en ceremonias y asegurando la calidad de los entregables. Responsabilidades Ejecutar las tareas asignadas cumpliendo los estándares técnicos, de calidad y de seguridad definidos en el proyecto. Documentar procesos de datos, análisis y modelos desarrollados, asegurando su correcta comprensión y reutilización. Aprender y aplicar nuevas herramientas, tecnologías y metodologías relacionadas con Data & IA según las necesidades del proyecto. Colaborar activamente con perfiles senior, data engineers, data scientists y consultores para la correcta entrega de soluciones de valor al cliente. ¿Qué ofrecemos? Formaciones diseñadas específicamente para tu desarrollo técnico y competencial en Data, Analytics e Inteligencia Artificial. Un programa de mentoring que te ayudará a explorar tus opciones en Accenture y a construir tu propio camino profesional con nosotros. Otros requisitos son: Formación universitaria en Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Estadística, Física u otras titulaciones STEM relacionadas. Nivel mínimo de inglés B2. Otros idiomas serán valorables. Curiosidad intelectual y mentalidad analítica. Capacidad de trabajo en equipo en entornos multidisciplinares. Pasión por la tecnología, los datos y la inteligencia artificial. Igualdad de Oportunidades en el Empleo Todas las decisiones de empleo se tomarán sin importar la edad, raza, credo, color, religión, sexo, origen nacional, ascendencia, grado de discapacidad, estado de veterano, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género, información genética, estado civil, estado de ciudadanía o cualquier otro motivo o circunstancias protegidas por las leyes federales, estatales o locales.

items.card: You will join the Technology team as a Software Engineer for the duration of the programme and take part in a structured onboarding covering KKR and alternative investments. You will work on real production initiatives across the Investment Lifecycle and asset-class platforms, attend educational and network-building programming, and have the opportunity to showcase your work to technology leaders across the firm.
items.desc: Company Overview KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries. THE PROGRAMME This is a full-time in-person graduate position based in Dublin, Ireland, offered as an 18-month fixed-term contract commencing on September 6, 2027. You will join the Technology team as a Software Engineer for the duration of the programme and take part in a structured onboarding covering KKR and alternative investments. You will work on real production initiatives across the Investment Lifecycle and asset-class platforms, attend educational and network-building programming, and have the opportunity to showcase your work to technology leaders across the firm. THE OPPORTUNITY As part of our continued investment in Ireland, KKR is launching a Technology & Engineering Centre of Excellence in Dublin. This new hub will play a central role in building the world’s first technology platform engineered to manage over one trillion dollars in alternative AUM (assets under management). Designed from the ground up for scale, security and speed, this is the infrastructure for the future of global finance. Areas of focus include investment technology, portfolio construction and management, liquidity solutions, risk analytics, and advanced data platforms THE TECHNOLOGY FUNCTION KKR's Technology organisation is a global group of passionate technologists and product managers, unified by a shared mission to deliver exceptional products and solutions that drive value for our stakeholders, clients, and investors. Our passion for technology and innovation fuels our commitment to creating high-quality, impactful solutions that address complex challenges and meet the evolving needs of our sophisticated businesses. items.desc: Job Description Role: ML/ Data Science Engineer Rate: £500 - £550 Inside IR35 Location: Central London, hybrid 3 days per week on-site Duration: 6 months initial contract About The Role We're looking for a hands-on ML / Data Science Engineer to design, build and optimise production ML models on AWS. You'll work across the full model lifecycle - from choosing the right algorithm through to tuning, deployment and monitoring - using classical ML techniques. This role will suit someone who can explain not just what they built, but why: which models they chose, the trade-offs, and how they measured success in production Key Responsibilities Design, build and validate classical ML models (e.g. regression, tree-based ensembles, clustering) to solve real business problems Select appropriate algorithms and clearly justify model choices to technical and non-technical stakeholders Develop clean, well-tested, production-ready Python code Build, train and deploy models on AWS using Amazon SageMaker and related services Tune model performance through hyperparameter optimisation, feature engineering and error analysis Instrument models in production, defining and tracking MLOps metrics such as accuracy, drift, latency and throughput Collaborate with data engineers, data scientists and product teams to take models from prototype to production Essential Skills And Experience Classical / traditional ML: Proven experience with models such as linear and logistic regression, decision trees, random forests, gradient boosting (XGBoost, LightGBM), SVMs and clustering. You can explain which models you've used, why you chose them and what alternatives you considered. Python: Strong proficiency in Python and its data/ML ecosystem (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn), writing maintainable, production-quality code. AWS: Hands-on experience building, training and deploying ML models on the AWS stack, ideally with experience in Amazon SageMaker Model tuning and MLOps: Practical experience in hyperparameter tuning and performance optimisation. You can articulate the metrics you'd track for MLOps (e.g. model accuracy, precision/recall, data and concept drift, latency, cost) and how you've instrumented models to monitor and improve performance in production. £500.00 - £550.00 / day Talent International UK and it's subsidiaries, Digital Gurus, Infinite Talent and Rethink act as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and employment business for the supply of temporary workers. items.desc: Job Description Breng data tot leven en maak zichtbaar impact binnen onze high tech vaccinomgeving als Vision Engineer Welkom in ons team De site Boxmeer maakt deel uit van ons Animal Health netwerk en produceert en verpakt diergeneesmiddelen voor de wereldwijde markt. De afdeling Live Vaccines bestaat uit CFFD, SFFD, Improvement en Maintenance & Reliability (M&R). Binnen de afdeling werken ongeveer 280 medewerkers gedurende 7 dagen per week aan het formuleren, vullen en vriesdrogen van levende (steriele) vaccins volgens GMP en EHS wet- en regelgeving. Het Visuele Inspectie/Vacuüm Testen (VI/VT) team bestaat uit ongeveer 50 medewerkers. Over de rol Als Vision Engineer rapporteer je aan de VI/VT Lead en speel je een belangrijke rol in het optimaliseren van het automatische visuele inspectie en vacuümtestproces binnen de VI/VT afdeling van SFFD. Je ontwikkelt en verfijnt vision algoritmes die machines in staat stellen visuele data te interpreteren en betrouwbare beslissingen te nemen. In deze functie combineer je operationele kennis met automatiseringsexpertise en fungeer je als verbindende schakel tussen proces en machine. Je werkt in multidisciplinaire teams aan de ontwikkeling en implementatie van een nieuwe standaard voor visuele inspectie, volledig in lijn met Annex 1, voor zowel vloeibare als gevriesdroogde producten op de site Boxmeer. Taken en verantwoordelijkheden omvatten Ontwikkelen, optimaliseren en onderhouden van vision algoritmes voor automatische visuele inspectie en vacuümtesten. Analyseren en interpreteren van visuele data om inspectieprestaties en procesbetrouwbaarheid te verbeteren. Actieve bijdrage aan troubleshooting op de productielijn en het uitvoeren van root cause analyses bij afwijkingen. Opleiden en ondersteunen van operators en technici in het gebruik en begrip van vision systemen. Meewerken binnen projectteams aan de ontwikkeling en implementatie van de nieuwe visuele inspectiestandaard conform Annex 1. Affiniteit met programmeren en een goed begrip van software‑engineeringprincipes; ervaring hiermee is een plus. Uitstekende beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als de Engelse taal, in woord en geschrift. Je krijgt alle ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en te laten zien wie jij bent. Verder kan je rekenen op aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals Competitief salaris afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring. 3% eindejaarsuitkering en een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van eigen en bedrijfsresultaten. Minimaal 35,5 verlofdagen. Reiskostenvergoeding en een solide pensioenregeling. Een hoogwaardig bedrijfsrestaurant met dagelijks verse en gezonde opties. Uitstekende bereikbaarheid het treinstation ligt direct bij onze hoofdingang en er is ruime parkeergelegenheid. Een bijdrage aan je persoonlijke sportabonnement ter ondersteuning van je vitaliteit. Toegang tot een aparte gebeds-/meditatieruimte. Uitgebreide doorgroeimogelijkheden dankzij de omvang van de site en de aanwezigheid van vele disciplines en global afdelingen die in Boxmeer vertegenwoordigd zijn. Wij zijn een wereldwijd team van professionals dat samenwerkt om een positieve impact te maken in de dierenzorg en de voedselvoorziening in de wereld, en we hebben een diep gevoel van verantwoordelijkheid naar onze klanten, consumenten, dieren, de samenleving en onze planeet. items.desc: Partout dans le monde, grâce aux solutions innovantes conçues et fabriquées par ses équipes, Sagemcom permet au plus grand nombre d'accéder au haut débit Internet, aux divertissements, et à une énergie maîtrisée. Entreprise à mission depuis 2022, Sagemcom est leader technologique dans le monde des télécoms et de l'énergie, et ses équipes s'engagent chaque jour à fournir des solutions sur mesure et responsables, adaptées aux besoins de leurs clients opérateurs télécom et utilities. Aujourd'hui, notre Groupe est : * Numéro 1 mondial des solutions haut débit (box internet et services logiciels associés) * Leader technologique des solutions audio-vidéo (hubs vidéo 4K et Video SoundBox™ ) * Leader européen des solutions smart-grid (comptage communicant, réseaux intelligents, électrification rurale, IoT) En 2024, Sagemcom a réalisé un chiffre d'affaires de 2.3 milliards d'euros, et s'appuie sur 6 500 collaborateurs répartis dans plus de 50 pays. Intégrer le groupe Sagemcom, c'est rejoindre un groupe de dimension internationale, où vous pourrez chaque jour relever de nouveaux défis. Si le travail en équipe, l'agilité, la créativité et les nouvelles technologies vous intéressent, rejoignez l'aventure ! » Vous rejoignez l'équipe BSP de notre R&D Broadband Solutions, en charge des couches basses logicielles de nos passerelles résidentielles : bootloader, noyau Linux, drivers et adaptation aux plateformes matérielles. Ces produits, déployés à grande échelle chez des opérateurs télécoms, intègrent des technologies d'accès avancées (GPON, DOCSIS, FTTH, 5G) et les dernières générations de Wi-Fi (Wi-Fi 8). L'équipe fournit aux équipes Software Suite (prplOS, 5G) une base logicielle fiable, performante et sécurisée. Nous engageons une évolution de nos pratiques avec une approche de développement AI-native, intégrant l'IA et les agents IA à chaque étape du cycle de développement. En tant que Développeur·se logiciel senior AI-native, vous développez et maintenez le BSP de nos passerelles (bootloader, noyau Linux et drivers), principalement en C. Vous intervenez directement sur la conception et le développement des solutions et contribuez aux choix techniques avec les architectes, les équipes hardware et les autres développeurs de l'équipe. Principales activités: Porter et maintenir le BSP sur de nouvelles plateformes : bring-up de cartes, bootloader (U-Boot), Device Tree, configuration du noyau. Développer, intégrer et maintenir des drivers Linux : interfaces réseau, Wi-Fi, stockage, GPIO, I2C, SPI, USB. Intégrer les SDK des fondeurs de SoC et suivre leurs évolutions ainsi que celles du noyau upstream. Mettre en oeuvre les mécanismes de sécurité bas niveau : secure boot, chaîne de confiance, mises à jour logicielles robustes. Analyser et résoudre les problèmes complexes sur cible : démarrage, stabilité, performance, consommation, crashs noyau. Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes hardware, les fournisseurs de chipsets et les équipes Software Suite. Garantir la qualité des développements par les tests automatisés, les revues de code et la validation sur cible. Utiliser de manière avancée les outils et agents IA tout au long du cycle de développement, tout en gardant la maîtrise du résultat. Contribuer au partage des bonnes pratiques techniques au sein de l'équipe, notamment sur l'usage de l'IA. Profil recherché: Vous disposez d'une solide expérience dans le développement de BSP et de drivers Linux, idéalement sur des équipements réseau ou télécoms. Vous maîtrisez particulièrement : - Le langage C et le développement dans le noyau Linux : drivers, Device Tree, gestion des interruptions, DMA, gestion mémoire. - Les bootloaders (U-Boot) et les phases de démarrage d'un SoC. - Les architectures ARM et les interfaces matérielles courantes (I2C, SPI, UART, USB, PCIe, Ethernet). - Les outils de build embarqué (Buildroot, Yocto ou OpenWrt), les chaînes de compilation croisée et le débogage bas niveau (JTAG, console série, analyse de crashs noyau). - L'utilisation avancée d'outils de développement assisté par IA tels que Claude Code, GitHub Copilot ou équivalents, incluant le pilotage d'agents IA, la décomposition des tâches, la revue du code généré et la validation des résultats. - Une expérience des SoC Broadband (Broadcom, Qualcomm, MediaTek…) ou des drivers Wi-Fi est appréciée. La connaissance du secure boot, des mises à jour sécurisées ou de la contribution au noyau upstream constitue un plus. Nous recherchons un profil très opérationnel et autonome, capable de prendre en charge un sujet de bout en bout, de challenger les solutions techniques proposées, y compris celles produites par l'IA, et de contribuer aux choix de conception. Une aptitude à lire des schémas électroniques et à travailler au contact du hardware est appréciée. Ce que vous trouverez chez Sagemcom : > Un cadre de travail stimulant dans une entreprise internationale et engagée > Des perspectives d’évolution et de formation régulière > Un management de proximité …

items.desc: À propos d'evoteo evoteo accompagne ses clients dans leurs projets de transformation digitale en mettant l'expertise, l'agilité et l'innovation au service de leurs enjeux métiers. Vous êtes force de proposition, capable de fédérer des interlocuteurs variés et suffisamment à l'aise pour faire avancer des projets dans des environnements complexes et comportant de nombreuses parties prenantes. Forte de 70 ans d’existence, Alpine s’impose comme un symbole de passion et d’innovation. Fidèles à notre ADN sportif, nous développons aujourd’hui une gamme complète de véhicules premium, innovants, performants et durables. En étroite collaboration avec l’ingénierie Renault et l’expertise technologique d’Alpine Racing, nous repoussons sans cesse les limites pour transférer le meilleur de la compétition à nos véhicules. Cette ambition se traduit par des véhicules à la fois exclusifs, raffinés et résolument sportifs, qui placent Alpine au cœur de l’univers premium de l’automobile. Avec des équipes engagées et passionnées, nous faisons vivre au quotidien l’esprit Alpine : agilité, esprit d’équipe et recherche permanente de perfection. Informations Pratiques Lieu : Technocentre Renault, Guyancourt Type de contrat : Stage Durée : 6 mois Vous serez rattaché(e) à la Direction Prestations et Validations, dont la mission est de décliner les exigences produits en termes de niveaux de prestations, sur tous les aspects du véhicule (comportement, acoustique, fiabilité,…) Cette direction contribue directement à la satisfaction des clients et l’image de marque. Vos Missions Au sein du pôle Data, UX & Profils de mesures, vous participerez au développement d'une plateforme de valorisation automatique des données véhicules. Le développement des futurs véhicules Alpine repose sur l'analyse de quantités croissantes de données issues des essais, de la simulation et du retour d'expérience terrain. Ces données constituent un levier majeur pour accélérer les phases de validation, améliorer la représentativité des simulations et capitaliser les connaissances acquises tout au long du développement des véhicules. Plusieurs briques méthodologiques et outils existent aujourd'hui. L'enjeu est désormais de les industrialiser et de les intégrer au sein d'une chaîne cohérente permettant d'automatiser l'exploitation des données véhicule depuis leur acquisition jusqu'à la génération d'indicateurs d'aide à la décision. Validation systématique des données d'essais Les plans de validation ont été standardisés pour les différents systèmes du véhicule. Votre Mission Consistera à développer les outils permettant d'appliquer automatiquement ces plans de tests à l'ensemble des données enregistrées sur les véhicules de développement ; détecter automatiquement les scénarios de validation réalisés lors des roulages ; calculer les critères de conformité associés ; générer des rapports de validation automatisés ; construire des indicateurs de couverture et de progression de la validation. L'objectif est de tendre vers une validation continue alimentée directement par les données d'essais. Comparaison entre véhicules clients et modèles de développement Les bases de données utilisées lors du développement sont construites plusieurs années avant la commercialisation des véhicules. Vous Participerez à l'exploitation des données issues de véhicules réels ; leur comparaison avec les référentiels historiques de développement ; l'identification des écarts de comportement ; la mise en place d'indicateurs permettant d'évaluer la représentativité des hypothèses utilisées lors de la conception. Cette approche permettra de renforcer la boucle de retour d'expérience entre les véhicules en circulation et les futurs programmes. Génération automatique de scénarios de simulation Les données GPS contiennent une description fidèle de l'utilisation réelle des véhicules, mais ne peuvent pas être enregistrées sur nos véhicules clients. Vous Développerez des outils de reconstruction automatique de profils de vitesse ; des scripts permettant de générer automatiquement des scénarios d'essais exploitables sous Scanner ou d'autres outils de simulation ; des métriques permettant d'évaluer la représentativité des scénarios générés. L'objectif est d'améliorer la continuité entre les essais terrain et la simulation. Automatisation de l'analyse de mesures Les campagnes d'essais produisent plusieurs centaines de fichiers de mesures. Vous Contribuerez à l'automatisation des traitements de données ; la gestion des versions et de la traçabilité des résultats ; l'extraction automatique d'indicateurs métier ; le développement de briques de traitement du signal ; l'identification automatique d'événements et d'anomalies. Cette démarche vise à réduire significativement le temps consacré aux activités de dépouillement et d'analyse. Votre Profil Étudiant(e) Bac+5 en école d'ingénieur ou master universitaire.es Dominante Data Science, Informatique, IA, Mathématiques appliquées ou Systèmes embarqués. Bonne maîtrise de Python. items.desc: BDO CFO Advisory søker operative prosjektledere som kombinerer økonomiforståelse med teknologi og praktisk gjennomføring. Du leder forbedringsprosjekter, men er også selv med på å få løsningene til å fungere hos kunden. Vi jobber tett på økonomifunksjonen i familieeide og børsnoterte selskaper, store og mellomstore private virksomheter, PE-eide selskaper og offentlig sektor. En stadig større del av oppdragene våre handler om å forenkle prosesser, redusere manuelt arbeid og bruke automatisering og AI der det gir konkret verdi. Vi opplever at økonomiavdelingen ofte har begrensede ressurser, og CFO-ens kapasitet er en flaskehals. Det er der du gjør en forskjell. Nå trenger vi flere som kan ta arbeidet fra behov til løsning i bruk. Du kartlegger prosesser sammen med kundens økonomiteam, finner ut hvor tid går tapt og hvor feil og risiko oppstår, og utvikler forbedringer sammen med spesialistene våre innen data, teknologi og AI. Dette er ikke en ren prosjektlederrolle. Du driver prosjektet fremover, men bidrar også selv med analyse, løsningsutforming, testing og implementering. Målet er forbedringer som merkes i økonomifunksjonens hverdag og kan dokumenteres, for eksempel i spart tid, færre feil eller raskere rapportering. Du trenger ikke være utvikler. Din styrke er å forstå økonomiprosessene, se hva som bør forenkles eller automatiseres, og sørge for at løsningene faktisk blir tatt i bruk. Stilling: Operativ prosjektleder, Manager eller Senior Manager avhengig av erfaring. Dette kommer du til å jobbe med Være rådgiver og sparringspartner for CFO-er og økonomimiljø i regionen Lede forbedrings-, automatiserings- og systemprosjekter fra kartlegging til løsning i bruk. Kartlegge og forbedre prosesser innen blant annet record-to-report, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash og FP&A. Prioritere tiltak sammen med kunden ut fra forventet effekt, enten løsningen er prosessforbedring, regelstyrt automatisering eller AI. Designe internkontroll, sporbarhet og retningslinjer for AI som også dekker revisors krav. Bidra operativt med prosesskartlegging, dataanalyse, krav, testing, rutiner og opplæring. Lede eller delta i implementering av økonomisystemer. Måle og dokumentere effekten av forbedringene. Bidra i kundedialog, tilbudsarbeid og utvikling av tjenestene våre. Vi ser etter deg som Har minst fem års relevant erfaring fra en økonomifunksjon, rådgivning, revisjon eller en kombinasjon. Har ledet eller hatt en sentral rolle i forbedrings-, automatiserings- eller systemprosjekter i økonomifunksjonen. Forstår regnskap, rapportering og internkontroll samt sentrale økonomiprosesser. Har praktisk erfaring med automatisering, dataanalyse eller AI, og tar i bruk nye verktøy selv. Kan omsette økonomifaglige behov til praktiske løsninger sammen med teknologer. Trives med både å ta ansvar for fremdrift og å gjøre en vesentlig del av arbeidet selv. Kommuniserer godt på norsk og engelsk. Vi er særlig interessert i hva du selv har bidratt til å gjennomføre, og hva som ble bedre som resultat. Erfaringen din kan for eksempel være fra automatisering av avstemminger eller fakturaflyt, et vellykket systembytte, generativ AI i rapportering og analyse, forbedring av prognoseprosesser, prosessmining eller innføring av ERP-, EPM- og analyseverktøy. Teknologimiljøet vårt bruker blant annet Databricks som dataplattform. Erfaring med Databricks eller tilsvarende plattformer er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det samme gjelder sertifisering innen prosjektledelse eller lean. Hvorfor BDO CFO Advisory? Du er med og bygger. Automatisering av økonomiprosesser er et prioritert område hos oss, og arbeidet er i gang. Du får påvirke hvordan vi utvikler tjenester, metodikk og team. Du jobber tett på både økonomi og teknologi. Du blir en del av CFO Advisory og samarbeider med spesialister innen AI, data og teknologi i BDO Consulting. Du får ansvar uten å miste det operative arbeidet. Du leder prosjektene og dialogen med kunden, samtidig som du er tett på leveransen og ser resultatene. Klar for å skape konkrete forbedringer? Send oss en søknad, eller ta kontakt for en uforpliktende prat. Har du erfaring med å bygge og lede et fagmiljø innen økonomisystemer og AI, vil vi også gjerne høre fra deg. Søknadsfrist: Snarest, aktuelle kandidater vurderes fortløpende, og alle henvendelser behandles konfidensielt.

items.desc: Google Analytics gebruikscijfers inzetten om accurate voorspellingen te doen. Daar draait deze opdracht om. Om vervolgens een kubernetes cluster af te scalen. Bij een van onze klanten hebben we een kubernetes cluster met daarin verschillende services die we draaiende houden. Deze services vragen bepaalde resources van virtual machines. Het kost geld om deze machines draaiende te houden. We betalen voor geheugen en CPU kracht. Ze draaien echter door de dag heen op dezelfde gereserveerde capaciteit, kan dit niet slimmer? We willen graag adaptieve kubernetes scaling op basis van Google Analytics gebruikscijfers. Door accurate voorspellingen te doen hopen we op de momenten dat het nodig is het cluster af te scalen en zo geld te besparen op resources. De opdracht Onderzoek de mogelijkheid om een kubernetes cluster en verschillende pods daarbinnen af te scalen op het moment dat ze minder nodig zijn. Gebruik hiervoor Google Analytics gebruikscijfers. Over Info Support Info Support is specialist in maatwerksoftware, data/AI solutions, beheer en trainingen en actief in de sectoren Finance, Industry, Agriculture, Food & Retail, Mobility & Public en Healthcare. Wij bieden solide en innovatieve oplossingen voor complexe en bedrijfkritische softwarevraagstukken. Onze hoofdkantoren zijn gevestigd in Veenendaal (NL) en Mechelen (BE). Op dit moment zijn er circa 500 medewerkers bij Info Support in dienst. De werkwijze van Info Support kenmerkt zich door een aantal kernwaarden: soliditeit, integriteit, vakmanschap en passie. Deze kernwaarden zijn verweven in ons werk en de manier waarop we met elkaar omgaan. Om te zorgen dat alle medewerkers altijd op de hoogte kunnen zijn van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen beschikt Info Support over een inhouse IT Academy waar graag wordt voldaan aan de honger naar meer of andere kennis en vaardigheden. Om deze opdracht te kunnen doen is B2-taalvaardigheid in het Nederlands vereist.

You Will Have a Passion For Teamwork, An Inquisitive Mind And a “can Do Attitude” As Well As a Strong Academic Background And a Keen Interest In One Or More Of The Following Areas Embedded Software Development PC Application Software Development Digital Signal Processing Communications Algorithm development and Simulation RF Engineering and RF Hardware Development Baseband Hardware Development Test System Development and ATE Systems What are we looking for? We are looking for a motivated, enthusiastic and highly capable graduate to work within either our DTC or DBS Engineering teams. Requirements We are looking for someone who can display many of the following attributes: Strong problem solving skills Adaptability Strong work ethic Excellent communication skills Qualifications Minimum of a 2:1 Bachelor’s degree (predicted) in Electronics, Software, Physics or a related discipline to Engineering The successful candidate must have the right to work in the UK and be eligible for UK Security Clearance. Anticipated start date: September 2027 Benefits And Culture At DTC we value our employees. Benefits Include A personal approach to training and development 25 days annual leave plus Bank holidays Competitive salary A generous pension plan, company match up to 9%. Company bonus scheme Flexible core working hours. Open plan, modern office environment Onsite subsidised café Social events Free onsite parking Enjoy working as part of a global organisation with teams in Whiteley, Hampshire; USA; Denmark, Singapore; Dubai and Australia. DTC is committed to promoting a culture that supports personal development and embraces a diverse mix of employees throughout all levels of the organisation. Interested in a career with us? Be a part of a growing organisation that drives innovation and excellence, values employees and takes a tailored approach to training and development - if you want to make a difference at DTC, we want to hear from you. Simply click on APPLY and we will be in contact. Applications will be open until 6th December 2026.

ModUlf er nå inn i sitt andre år hvor
items.desc: Om ModUlf UDI skal gjennom digitaliseringsenheten (DIGA) de neste 6 årene gjennomføre programmet Modernisert Utlendingsforvaltning (ModUlf). Programmet gjennomføres i samarbeide med UNE, Politiet og UD. Programmet skal erstatte våre fagsystemer og vår digitale grunnmur med nye, sikre og mer moderne løsninger, samtidig forbedre prosesser og samhandling på tvers av virksomhetene. ModUlf er nå inn i sitt andre år hvor de første leveranse er levert og en videre oppskalere er planlagt i 2027. Programmet har en økonomisk ramme på 2,4 milliarder og skal gjennomføres frem til 2031. Behovets formål: ModUlf ønsker å utforske hvordan kunstig intelligens (KI) kan bidra til økt kvalitet, effektivitet, lavere kostnader og gevinstrealisering av programmet. Programmet skal nå i gang med å utforske mulighetene for å bruke KI i gjennomføringen, som for eksempel i programgjennomføring, produktutvikling, innsiktsarbeid, planlegging, arkitektur, utvikling, innføring og styring. Erfaringene fra ulike proof-of-concepts skal inngå i re-estimeringen av programmet. For å akselerere dette arbeidet søker vi en erfaren konsulent som ta en ledende rolle i å etablere, strukturere og gjennomføre en portefølje av KI-initiativer. Om rollen Konsulenten skal være den utførende som hjelper ulike KI POCer teknisk i etablering og bygging. Identifisere aktuelle anvendelsesområder for bruk av KI for programmet. Etablere og gjennomføre piloter. Sørge for at programmet tar i bruk KI-kapabiliteter ut fra POCene. Konsulenten skal bidra til å skape en balansert tilnærming mellom innovasjon og kontroll, slik at programmet raskt kan teste verdiskapende løsninger innenfor tydelige rammer for risiko, personvern, informasjonssikkerhet og etterlevelse. Ettersom dette er et relativt nytt område, kan det like godt hende at den rette ressursen er en junior ressurs som en spesialist. Arbeidsoppgaver: Etablere og drive KI-piloter Arbeide med å etablere og gjennomføre piloter innen administrative og utviklingsrelaterte områder for programmet Sikre dokumentasjon av erfaringer, læring og anbefalinger for videre skalering. Sørge for at programmet gjennomføringsmodell tilpasses til de KI-verktøyene som gir reelle besparelser. Etablere nødvendige rammer Sørge for at programmet er påkoblet prosessene med å etablere en pragmatisk governance-modell for KI. Definere roller, ansvar, beslutningspunkter og prioriteringsmekanismer for KIinitiativ. Kompetansekrav: Ressursen må ha minimum 2 års utviklererfaring med KI-verktøy. Ressursen må ha dokumentert erfaring med etablering og gjennomføring av KI-piloter eller proof-of-concept-løp, herunder arbeid med hypotesetesting, gevinstvurdering og evaluering av resultater. Ressursen må ha erfaring med å ta initiativer fra idéfase til demonstrert verdi og beslutningsgrunnlag Ressursen må har erfaring med hypotesedrevet utvikling, eksperimentering og gevinstrealisering. Ressursen må ha god forståelse for moderne KI-teknologi, herunder generativ KI, språkmodeller og agentiske løsninger. Ressursen må ha grunnleggende forståelse for informasjonssikkerhet, personvern og regulatoriske krav knyttet til bruk av KI Ressursen bør ha erfaring fra offentlig sektor Ressursen bør har erfaring med bruk av Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI, OpenAI, Claude eller tilsvarende. Personlige egenskaper: Evne til å identifisere hvor KI kan skape størst verdi og omsette dette til konkrete initiativer Evner å omsette utydelige problemstillinger til konkrete aktiviteter og leveranser. Evner å samle ulike interessenter rundt felles mål Kommuniserer godt på med tekniske og ikke-tekniske miljøer. Holder seg oppdatert på utviklingen innen KI og tilgrensende teknologiområder. Søker aktivt ny kunnskap og deler erfaring med andre. Er komfortable med å teste, feile og justere kurs underveis. Oppstart: Så raskt som mulig Varighet: 31.03.2027 + opsjon Omfang: 50 % allokering tilsvarende 400 timer før utløsning av eventuelle opsjoner. Arbeidsstedet: Primært i UDI sine lokaler på Valle, men etter avtale kan noe hjemmekontor benyttes Ressursen må kunne stille til intervju i UDI sine lokaler Den valgte ressursen må kunne benytte egen PC i forbindelse med oppdraget Ta kontakt for kompetansematrise Frist for å melde interesse: 30 oktober kl 12

items.title: ingénieur informatique Développeur d’agents IA / Full Stack TypeScript Vue 3 (H/F) (IT) / Freelance
items.card: Vos missions : Concevoir et développer des agents IA, leurs skills et leurs tools à partir d’un framework d’orchestration interne en TypeScript. Développer et maintenir les interfaces utilisateurs des outils des agents en Vue 3.js. Intégrer les API de systèmes bancaires et assurer leur interopérabilité avec les agents. Exploiter les données métier dans Snowflake via des outils dédiés ou une couche sémantique.
items.desc: Nous recherchons un Ingénieur Développeur d’agents IA / Développeur Full Stack & IA pour rejoindre une équipe en charge d’une infrastructure de données et concevoir des agents autonomes dans un environnement Cloud AWS. Mission freelance à Gémenos : présence sur site 3 jours sur 5 et télétravail partiel. Démarrage dès que possible, fin prévue le 31 décembre 2026. TJM proposé : 308,55 € HT/jour maximum selon profil. Vos missions : Concevoir et développer des agents IA, leurs skills et leurs tools à partir d’un framework d’orchestration interne en TypeScript. Développer et maintenir les interfaces utilisateurs des outils des agents en Vue 3.js. Intégrer les API de systèmes bancaires et assurer leur interopérabilité avec les agents. Exploiter les données métier dans Snowflake via des outils dédiés ou une couche sémantique. Déployer les agents et leurs interfaces sur AWS, et assurer leur capacité à monter en charge dans le respect des standards de sécurité. Veiller au respect des contraintes PCI-DSS / PCI-CP dans les interactions entre les agents, les données et les API. Collaborer avec les architectes sécurité, Product Owners, ingénieurs DevOps et équipes de conformité. Profil candidat: Vous maîtrisez le développement Web et IA, avec une pratique avancée de TypeScript et de Vue 3.js. Vous avez une expérience du développement d’agents utilisant des frameworks d’orchestration et savez prendre en main un framework interne. Compétences attendues : Snowflake : SQL, Snowpark et modélisation de données pour l’IA. AWS : notamment Lambda, API Gateway et sécurité Cloud. Intégration d’API et conception d’outils pour les agents. Connaissance des enjeux PCI-DSS / PCI-CP dans un contexte d’IA. Bonne connaissance d’Agile/Scrum. Bonne communication orale et écrite en anglais, indispensable. Nous recherchons une personne rigoureuse, force de proposition, disposant d’excellentes capacités relationnelles et faisant preuve de ténacité pour résoudre des problèmes complexes. La capacité à intervenir à Gémenos 3 jours par semaine est nécessaire.

items.desc: Jsme DataBrothers, 27 kolegů, kteří se primárně zabývají daty v Power BI. Nevadí, jestli s reportingem teprve začínáš, nebo už máš pár projektů za sebou. Místo u nás je pro juniora i mediora. Na čem budeš pracovat: Zhruba 80 % času se budeš věnovat reportingu a 20 % AI . Poměr se ale může měnit podle toho, co tě baví a co zrovna potřebujeme. Reporty v Power BI na míru klientům z různých oborů. Časem se zaměříš na obory, které ti sednou nejvíc. Konzultační a implementační projekty postavené na Microsoft Data Platform (Power BI, Fabric, Azure). Řešení stavíme výhradně v cloudu. Klientům pomáháme technicky i procesně nastavit celou datovou platformu, od zpracování dat až po finální reporting. AI v praxi: AI funkce v reportingu, Microsoft Fabric a Microsoft Foundry. Interně i na projektech používáme také Clauda. Pracujeme hlavně pro střední a velké firmy a korporace. Co ti nabízíme: Zaučení a rozvoj: zkušené kolegy, kteří ti rádi pomůžou, a pravidelná interní školení ze světa Power BI a AI. Jasná a měřitelná KPI: podle nich si můžeš říct o vyšší plat, a to i několikrát do roka. 20 % z ročního zisku rozdělujeme mezi konzultanty. Bonusy za produkty, jejich prodej a buddy program. Firemní školení z komunikace, projektového řízení a dalších témat. Hodně dovolené a home office. Team buildingy: 2× ročně dvoudenní výjezd, 2× odpolední nebo večerní akce. K tomu vánoční oběd, hospody a další akce. Multisport karta a dobroty v kanceláři. Baví tě mluvit a prezentovat? Pořádáme 2 vlastní konference a organizujeme eventy v komunitních skupinách. Rádi tě podpoříme. Co od tebe čekáme: Chuť věci chápat a učit se. Nebojíš se nových technologií ani výzev. Budeš chápat business i technologii. Platí u nás jednoduché pravidlo: když nechápu, co reportuju, nemůžu to dělat dobře. Umíš naslouchat klientům , propojit jejich potřeby do souvislostí a všimnout si nových příležitostí. Otevřenost a transparentnost. Zpětnou vazbu umíš dávat, přijímat i si o ni říct. Nebojíš se přiznat, že se něco nedaří. Od toho je nás víc, abychom to vyřešili včas. Angličtinu na komunikační úrovni. Budeš s námi v kanceláři 3× týdně. Pokud jsi z větší dálky, po zaučení se můžeme domluvit i na 2 dny v kanclu. Bonusem pro nás bude: zkušenost s Microsoft technologiemi (Power BI, Fabric, Azure), zájem o AI nebo první zkušenosti s ní, ať už v reportingu, ve Fabricu, nebo v Microsoft Foundry, zkušenost s Claudem nebo jinými AI nástroji. Kdy a kde 📅 Nástup: co nejdřív, nejpozději v lednu 2027 📍 Kancelář: Praha 4 ⏱️ Úvazek: plný Zaujalo tě to? Pošli CV nebo odkaz na LinkedIn. Pokud máš nějaký vlastní report nebo projekt, budeme rádi, když ho přidáš. Ozveme se v týdnu od 2.11.2026

items.desc: Välkommen till Linnéuniversitetet! Här möter du 2 200 medarbetare och 40 000 studenter som tillsammans följer visionen att sätta kunskap i rörelse för en hållbar samhällsutveckling. Hos oss bedrivs forskning och utbildning med blicken mot framtiden. Vår närhet till näringsliv, både lokalt och globalt, ger oss lång räckvidd och möjlighet till förändring som skapar avtryck. Allt som behövs är en plats där idéer får utrymme att mötas och växa. Det är det vi skapat – och du är inbjuden. Change starts here! V ill du vara med och hitta nästa stora effektivisering innan någon ens hunnit formulera den som en beställning? Linnéuniversitetet gör en långsiktig satsning på AI, digitalisering och automatisering. Vi söker nu dig som vill arbeta nära universitetets verksamhet och tillsammans med våra medarbetare identifiera möjligheter att förenkla arbetssätt, frigöra tid och skapa bättre digitala lösningar. IT-avdelningen arbetar med att skapa moderna och digitala förutsättningar för studenter, medarbetare och forskare. Vår IT-miljö spänner över flera olika områden, från support, drift, förvaltning och utveckling. Just nu befinner vi oss i en intensiv utvecklingsfas där vi tillsammans med verksamheten accelererar arbetet med AI, digitalisering och nya arbetssätt. Arbetsuppgifter Det här är inte en roll där du väntar på färdiga beställningar. Som verksamhetsutvecklare inom AI och digitalisering arbetar du uppsökande och nära universitetets olika verksamheter. Din uppgift är att förstå hur arbetet faktiskt utförs, identifiera behov och hitta möjligheter där digitalisering kan förenkla arbetssätt, frigöra tid eller förbättra kvaliteten. Du fungerar som en brygga mellan verksamheten och IT. Du behöver kunna lyssna och förstå ett verksamhetsproblem, se vilka möjligheter som finns och tillsammans med verksamheten och andra kompetenser inom IT omsätta behovet till en konkret lösning. Ibland är lösningen AI. Ibland handlar den om automatisering, integration mellan system, bättre användning av data eller en förändrad process. Tekniken är ett medel, verksamhetsnyttan är målet. Du Kommer Bland Annat Att Aktivt söka upp och identifiera behov och effektiviseringsmöjligheter i universitetets verksamhet. Analysera processer, arbetsflöden och informationsflöden och identifiera manuella eller repetitiva arbetsmoment som kan förenklas. Tillsammans med verksamheten gå från ett upplevt problem eller en idé till ett tydligt utvecklingsbehov. Identifiera hur AI, automatisering, integrationer, data eller förändrade arbetssätt kan användas för att lösa behovet. Ta fram och prova enklare prototyper och lösningar självständigt eller tillsammans med andra specialister. Driva initiativ från identifierat behov till införd lösning. Samarbeta nära utvecklare, arkitekter, förvaltningsorganisation och andra kompetenser inom IT och universitetet. Identifiera lösningar och arbetssätt som kan återanvändas och skalas till fler delar av universitetet. Bidra till att utvecklade lösningar kan förvaltas och vidareutvecklas långsiktigt. Följa upp resultat och bidra till att synliggöra den verksamhetsnytta som utvecklingsarbetet skapar. Du kommer tillhöra sektionen Utveckling och förvaltning som redan idag arbetar med att omvandla behov till nya lösningar, vidareutveckla befintliga system och stödja verksamheten i dess digitalisering. Kvalifikationer Vi Söker Dig Som Har Relevant akademisk utbildning inom exempelvis IT, informatik, systemvetenskap, verksamhetsutveckling eller annan utbildning eller erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig. Erfarenhet av digitalisering, verksamhetsutveckling eller utveckling av digitala lösningar. God teknisk förståelse och förmåga att sätta dig in i hur system, data och integrationer hänger ihop. Erfarenhet av att analysera verksamhetsbehov och omsätta dem till konkreta förbättringar eller lösningar. God förståelse för möjligheterna med AI och automatisering. Förmåga att arbeta såväl självständigt som tillsammans med olika specialistkompetenser. God förmåga att kommunicera med både tekniska och icke-tekniska målgrupper. Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift. Meriterande Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av ett eller flera av följande områden: Utveckling eller införande av AI-lösningar generativ AI och AI-agenter. Automatisering av verksamhetsprocesser. Systemintegrationer, MCP:er och API:er. Processkartläggning och processutveckling Data och informationsflöden. Microsoft 365, Power Platform eller motsvarande plattformar. Förändringsledning och införande av nya digitala arbetssätt. Arbete inom universitet, offentlig verksamhet eller annan större och komplex organisation. Personliga egenskaper För att lyckas i rollen behöver du framför allt vara nyfiken på hur verksamheter fungerar och varför människor arbetar som de gör idag. Du är uppsökande och initiativtagande och tycker om att möta människor, ställa frågor och förstå deras vardag. Du har lätt för att skapa förtroende och kan föra dialog med …

items.desc: Are you passionate about making a difference, using your skills & experience to be a key enabler of AI-driven transformation? If so, we may have the role for you! We are excited to share an incredible opportunity for an AI Design Analyst to join our team in Data & AI. As our newest AI Design Analyst, you will be responsible for analysing business challenges, operational processes, data assets and system interaction to design AI-enabled solutions that deliver measurable value. This is a hybrid role with working from home plus some onsite presence in our Bradford & central Leeds offices. About the role Operating within the AI Centre of Enablement and AI Foundry delivery team, the role acts as the analytical and design bridges between business needs and the development of intelligent systems. This role will combine business analytics, data analysis, process design, and AI solution design to shape safe and effective AI capabilities. You will- Support the responsible adoption of artificial intelligence across internal operations and customer-facing services through structured analysis and stakeholder collaboration. Analyse business and operational challenges to identify opportunities where AI enabled solutions can enhance efficiency, decision making, or service delivery. Define AI solution designs by producing clear functional, logical, and interaction designs that describe how AI capabilities will operate within business processes and systems. Assess data readiness and AI feasibility by evaluating data availability, quality, and suitability for machine learning, large language models, and retrieval-based solutions. Support AI experimentation and prototyping by analysing results, evaluating model behaviour, and refining solution designs based on evidence and feedback. Engage and collaborate with stakeholders by facilitating workshops, translating technical concepts into business language, and ensuring shared understanding of AI solution outcomes. About you You will have- Strong experience in business, process, system and data analysis. Working knowledge of AI and machine learning concepts, including large language models and retrieval-based systems. Experience working with enterprise platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and Microsoft Graph . Familiarity with enterprise integration patterns using Microsoft Graph, Power Platform, and business applications. Working knowledge of MLOps, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and operational support of AI systems. The ability to translate complex problems into clear designs and requirements. Strong facilitation and stakeholder engagement skills. About us At YBS we don’t have shareholders, we have members. We care about people and that includes you. So here, you’ll be respected for who you are, you’ll be able to bring your whole self to work, and you’ll have everything you need to build a long and rewarding career. Flexibility. We offer a range of flexible working options without unsocial hours, which can help you find a healthy work-life balance. Whether it’s finishing early for an appointment or fitting your studies and hobbies in around your working hours, we can help make it work for you. We’re happy to talk flexible working and you can reach out to us anytime to discuss this during the recruitment process. Development. We want you to feel challenged here. Whatever your ambitions, we’re committed to helping you develop your skills and move ahead in your career journey. From day one, we’ll set you up for success with a brilliant induction and full training plan, all designed to get you up to speed quickly. Inclusivity. We’re passionate about creating an inclusive environment where everyone is welcome and able to be themselves. If you’ll go the extra mile to help our members, you’ll fit right in and feel you belong here. About our Benefits We offer lots of fantastic rewards that you can make the most of in and out of work, including: Holiday. You’ll get 28 days plus Bank Holidays, as well as the option to buy up to a further 5 days. Bonus. At YBS we work collaboratively and share in our success together, so when we reach our goals were all rewarded with an on target bonus of 7% of eligible pay (with the opportunity to earn up to a maximum 15%). Pension. We know how important it is to save towards the future, that’s why we’ll contribute up 11% into your YBS pension. Healthcare. Health and wellbeing are an important part of life at YBS, when you join us you’ll have access to a range of health benefits to suit your life including private medical insurance, dental and healthcare plans. My Benefits. When you join YBS you’ll have access to our self-service benefits portal, where you can access a range of retail, hospitality and health discounts. Ready to apply? If you’re excited about this role and want to be part of the YBS team, click apply now to send us your application. Want more information? If you have any questions about this role, please contact …

Din uppgift är att förstå hur arbetet faktiskt utförs, identifiera behov och hitta möjligheter där digitalisering kan förenkla arbetssätt, frigöra tid eller förbättra kvaliteten. Du fungerar som en brygga mellan verksamheten och IT. Du behöver kunna lyssna och förstå ett verksamhetsproblem, se vilka möjligheter som finns och tillsammans med verksamheten och andra kompetenser inom IT omsätta behovet till en konkret lösning. Ibland är lösningen AI. Ibland handlar den om automatisering, integration mellan system, bättre användning av data eller en förändrad process. Tekniken är ett medel, verksamhetsnyttan är målet. Du Kommer Bland Annat Att Aktivt söka upp och identifiera behov och effektiviseringsmöjligheter i universitetets verksamhet. Analysera processer, arbetsflöden och informationsflöden och identifiera manuella eller repetitiva arbetsmoment som kan förenklas. Tillsammans med verksamheten gå från ett upplevt problem eller en idé till ett tydligt utvecklingsbehov. Identifiera hur AI, automatisering, integrationer, data eller förändrade arbetssätt kan användas för att lösa behovet. Ta fram och prova enklare prototyper och lösningar självständigt eller tillsammans med andra specialister. Driva initiativ från identifierat behov till införd lösning. Samarbeta nära utvecklare, arkitekter, förvaltningsorganisation och andra kompetenser inom IT och universitetet. Identifiera lösningar och arbetssätt som kan återanvändas och skalas till fler delar av universitetet. Bidra till att utvecklade lösningar kan förvaltas och vidareutvecklas långsiktigt. Följa upp resultat och bidra till att synliggöra den verksamhetsnytta som utvecklingsarbetet skapar. Du kommer tillhöra sektionen Utveckling och förvaltning som redan idag arbetar med att omvandla behov till nya lösningar, vidareutveckla befintliga system och stödja verksamheten i dess digitalisering. Erfarenhet av digitalisering, verksamhetsutveckling eller utveckling av digitala lösningar. God teknisk förståelse och förmåga att sätta dig in i hur system, data och integrationer hänger ihop. Erfarenhet av att analysera verksamhetsbehov och omsätta dem till konkreta förbättringar eller lösningar. God förståelse för möjligheterna med AI och automatisering. Förmåga att arbeta såväl självständigt som tillsammans med olika specialistkompetenser. God förmåga att kommunicera med både tekniska och icke-tekniska målgrupper. Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift. Microsoft 365, Power Platform eller motsvarande plattformar. Förändringsledning och införande av nya digitala arbetssätt. Arbete inom universitet, offentlig verksamhet eller annan större och komplex organisation. Job Description Summary 
As AI Data Architect (f/m/d) in GE HealthCare's Advanced Imaging Solutions business, you will shape the global data architecture for AI development across ultrasound teams. You will align globally distributed teams on shared platform, tool, and infrastructure priorities, enabling secure, scalable, interoperable data foundations to develop, validate, and scale AI-enabled ultrasound solutions.
At GE HealthCare, our machines, our software, our solutions, our services, and our people make a genuine difference to medical professionals and patients all over the world. That’s because we never lose sight of what healthcare really needs—the human touch. 
 Job Description 
 As AI Data Architect (f/m/d) in GE HealthCare's Advanced Imaging Solutions business, you will shape the global data architecture for AI development across ultrasound teams. You will align globally distributed teams on shared platform, tool, and infrastructure priorities, enabling secure, scalable, interoperable data foundations to develop, validate, and scale AI-enabled ultrasound solutions.
 GE HealthCare develops medical technology, pharmaceutical diagnostics, and digital solutions that help clinicians make informed decisions and improve patient outcomes. With more than a century of healthcare experience, we pursue a world where healthcare has no limits and embrace respect, transparency, integrity, and diversity.
 Job Description 
 This role combines data architecture, AI development, platform strategy, and stakeholder leadership to align teams and provide secure, scalable, interoperable foundations for next-generation ultrasound products.
 In this role you will :
 Align global ultrasound teams on AI data needs, use cases, and shared business and technical priorities.
 Evaluate third-party platforms and lead build-versus-buy decisions, vendor assessments, due diligence, and proofs of concept.
 Define reference architectures and standards for scalable, secure, compliant, interoperable, usable, and cost-effective data platforms.
 Own the global AI data architecture roadmap, including priorities, investment proposals, capacity plans, and leadership reporting.
 Partner with infrastructure and cloud teams to standardize platforms, pipelines, metadata, lineage, data quality, observability, and governance.
 Enable compliant healthcare-data access, de-identification, retention, sharing, and lifecycle management.
 Coordinate platform onboarding, integration, migration, and retirement while promoting approved reference patterns.
 Lead architecture and incident reviews, document decisions, and communicate clearly with cross-functional stakeholders while monitoring relevant emerging technologies.
 Qualifications 
 Expected Qualification: 
 Master's degree in computer science, data engineering, software engineering, AI, or a related field.
 Progressive experience in data architecture, enterprise architecture, AI platforms, data engineering, or a related discipline.
 Strong understanding of modern data platforms, integration, metadata, lineage, quality, governance, and secure access.
 Experience across the AI data and model lifecycle, including curation, annotation, training, validation, deployment, and monitoring.
 Ability to assess vendors and technologies, including cloud platforms, APIs, distributed systems, and platform engineering concepts.
 Knowledge of privacy, cybersecurity, quality-system, and regulatory expectations for healthcare data and AI-enabled medical products.
 Proven ability to create roadmaps, influence across teams, and communicate effectively in English within a global organization.
 Desired Qualification: 
 Experience shaping enterprise data or AI architecture, preferably in medical imaging, healthcare, or another regulated environment.
 Familiarity with data catalogs, orchestration, quality and annotation tools, dataset stores, model registries, and AI platforms.
 Track record of defining reusable architecture standards and aligning separate initiatives around shared platforms and ways of working.
 Personal Attributes: 
 Collaborative and trusted across functions, countries, and disciplines.
 Comfortable with ambiguity and able to balance long-term architecture with near-term delivery.
 Curious, self-directed, and committed to learning, knowledge sharing, and better customer and patient outcomes.
 What we offer : 
 We offer a role specific compensation and a competitive salary and fringe benefit package reflecting your profile and experience.
 In Austria we are required to state the minimum pay. For this position, the annual compensation package starts at € 85.000. We will be pleased to discuss the appropriate effective salary based on your qualifications and experience.
 An exciting and diverse range of responsibilities in a growth-oriented company
 An interdisciplinary team and an international work environment
 Flextime and flexible working hours
 Free electric charging stations and ample parking …

Job Description: 
 An opportunity for a Junior Microwave Instrument Digital & Signal Processing Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid) .
 The selected candidate will join the Microwave Instrument Engineering Team , a cutting-edge multidisciplinary group delivering state-of-the-art payload solutions for space-based remote-sensing and Earth Observation missions. In this role, you will focus on the digital architecture, signal-processing pipeline, and data-flow algorithms that convert raw microwave radiometer measurements into calibrated satellite science data. As an early-career engineer, you will receive structured mentorship and practical training while contributing to both advanced feasibility studies and flight-model implementation phases.
 Responsibilities 
 The main tasks of the jobholder will be:
 Digital Architecture Design: Define on-board data-acquisition architectures and processing chains (digital down-conversion, filtering, radiometric calibration, and data compression), tailoring existing digital signal processors or proposing new building blocks.
 DSP Algorithm Development: Implement, optimize, and validate signal-processing algorithms (FFT, matched filtering, noise-reduction, error budgeting) in MATLAB/Python, preparing them for migration to embedded C/C++ or FPGA environments.
 System-Level Simulation & Modeling: Develop instrument performance simulators (MATLAB-Simulink, SystemVue, or equivalent) to evaluate data-rate budgets, dynamic range, latency, and system robustness through sensitivity and Monte-Carlo analyses.
 Prototyping & Laboratory Verification: Support FPGA/firmware prototyping, integrate digital processing units with RF front-ends, and execute hands-on laboratory testing (frequency response, BER, clock jitter, timing margins).
 Payload Interface Integration: Collaborate with RF engineers on ADC/DAC sampling interfaces and synchronize with flight software teams on telemetry packaging, data formats, and ground-processing requirements.
 Technical Documentation & Trade-Offs: Draft test plans, interface control documents, and verification reports, actively participating in multifunctional trade-offs (power, thermal, digital, RF) and future mission proposal efforts.
 Skills 
 Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to getting to know you:
 Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Applied Mathematics.
 Experience: Entry-level / Early-career (internships, academic research, final degree/master's thesis, or initial industry experience in DSP or embedded instrumentation).
 Technical Knowledge: Strong fundamentals in Digital Signal Processing theory (sampling, digital filtering, spectral analysis, calibration), coupled with proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink and Python or C/C++.
 Soft Skills: High learning agility, analytical problem-solving skills, proactive communication, and the motivation to work in a collaborative, multinational engineering environment.
 Languages: Advanced / Negotiation level in English (mandatory, written and spoken). Fluent Spanish is valuable; French or German is desirable.
 Valuable / Nice to Have: Familiarity with FPGA/HDL design (VHDL/Verilog) or embedded processor platforms (ARM, DSP).Hands-on laboratory experience with logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and data-acquisition testbenches.Understanding of ADC/DAC space constraints, radiation tolerance, or satellite payload development flows.Exposure to ESA program phases (ECSS standards) or requirement management methodologies.

Job Description: 
 An opportunity for a Junior RF Microwave Radiometer Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid) .
 The selected candidate will join the Microwave Instrument Engineering Team , a highly specialized and multidisciplinary group dedicated to cutting-edge microwave engineering for space-based Earth-observation missions. You will contribute directly to the definition, prototyping, validation, and integration of high-precision passive microwave payloads, participating across early feasibility studies, implementation phases, and payload delivery. As an early-career engineer, you will benefit from structured mentorship, technical training, and hands-on learning opportunities within an international space environment.
 Responsibilities 
 The main tasks of the jobholder will be:
 RF Architecture & Budget Analysis: Translate payload mission requirements into equipment specifications and build RF link/system budgets (noise figure, noise temperature, gain, dynamic range, and sensitivity).
 Detailed Design & Simulation: Develop schematic and electromagnetic models for RF front-ends (receivers, LNAs, mixers, filters, detectors, and antenna-coupling networks) using tools such as HFSS, ADS, or CST Studio.
 Prototyping & Laboratory Testing: Assemble breadboards and prototypes; conduct hands-on laboratory characterization (S-parameters, phase stability, noise figure, gain) using advanced RF test instrumentation.
 AIT & Verification Support: Collaborate in payload Assembly, Integration, and Testing (AIT) as well as Verification and Validation (V&V) campaigns, ensuring compliance with space flight margins.
 Multidisciplinary Engineering Alignment: Work closely with mechanical, thermal, power, and digital engineering teams in technical trade-offs, formal design reviews, and technology readiness milestones.
 Technical Reporting & Proposals: Author engineering memos, test plans, and verification reports, while assisting the team in technical proposals for future active and passive Earth Observation instruments.
 Skills 
 Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to getting to know you:
 Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering, RF/Microwave Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Physics.
 Experience: Entry-level / Early-career (internships, academic projects, master's thesis, or initial professional experience in RF/microwave design or test).
 Technical Knowledge: Solid theoretical foundations in microwave circuit design (impedance matching, S-parameters, noise theory) and proficiency with RF simulation suites (Keysight ADS, ANSYS HFSS, or CST Studio).
 Soft Skills: High learning agility, rigorous analytical mindset, strong teamwork capabilities, and the adaptability to work in a collaborative, multifunctional engineering ecosystem.
 Languages: Advanced / Negotiation level in English (mandatory, written and spoken). Fluent Spanish is valuable; French or German is a plus.

items.desc:
Join our Team
 About this opportunity : 
 We are looking for a Junior Digital Hardware Designer to join our Microwave & Digital Design team in Gothenburg. You will be part of the development of MINI-LINK, a key product within Ericsson’s wireless backhaul portfolio.MINI-LINK is a microwave network node delivering market-leading performance, driven by the rapid evolution of smartphones, IoT, and next-generation mobile networks. Our unit holds full design responsibility for MINI-LINK indoor units as well as outdoor mmWave products. This includes both the development of new hardware and the maintenance of released products. 
 What you will do: 
 As a junior digital hardware designer, you will work closely with experienced engineers and gradually take on more responsibility. 
 Your main tasks will include: 
 Contribute to schematic design and PCB development under the guidance of senior engineers. 
 Support pre- and post-layout simulations and participate in board and product verification. 
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as layout, power, mechanical, and thermal design to ensure optimal system performance. 
 Participate in hands-on troubleshooting and verification in the lab. 
 Use lab equipment such as power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes, and spectrum analyzers. 
 Bring new ideas and support continuous improvement in a collaborative team environment. 
 What you will learn and gain: 
 This role offers strong learning opportunities and hands-on experience in real product development: 
 Core digital hardware skills: CPUs, memories (DRAM/Flash), Ethernet switches, clock synthesizers, and related components. 
 Signal and power integrity fundamentals: exposure to simulation tools and methods used to identify and resolve SI/PI issues. 
 Schematic and PCB design basics: experience with industry-standard design tools and workflows. 
 Lab and measurement skills: soldering, measurements, and practical debugging of real hardware. 
 Professional growth: increased independence, communication skills, and a strong professional network. 
 Who we’re looking for: 
 A junior engineer or recent graduate with a degree in Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related field. 
 Strong interest in digital components, electronics design and practical, hands-on lab work.

 We are looking for curious and motivated engineers to join us in building the compute platform for AI at scale! 
 Job Description 
 Agentic AI is changing what CPU performance means in the cloud . As AI systems evolve from individual model calls towards complex, distributed workflows, performance increasingly depends on efficiently orchestrating models, data, tools and services across the whole system . 
 You will join a diverse, dedicated and inclusive group based in Arm's vibrant office at the heart of Manchester. Your work will help ensure the latest developments in AI take full advantage of Arm Neoverse platforms and pioneering cloud-server technologies like AGI-CPU, our CPU for next-generation AI data centers. Together with teams from across Arm, the open source community, and our partners, you will be accelerating AI and helping build the future of computing on Arm. 
 We work on the full stack, from applications and frameworks, to compilers, libraries, and assembly; we encourage everyone in the team to get involved in all parts. The team has a wide remit, but we are all aligned on a common goal. We trust and empower engineers with the autonomy to identify and solve problems without silos and with the support of their team mates. 
 Key skills 
 We're looking for people who are motivated to learn, we will support your growth. You don't need all of these to be successful! 
 Strong software engineering and programming skills, preferably C++ and Python 
 Eager to dive into unfamiliar software stacks and codebases , debug complex issues, and identify performance opportunities 
 Familiarity with Linux development environments , profiling, debugging and performance analysis 
 A degree in a computational or numerate subject , or equivalent experience 
 Nice-to-have skills and experience 
 We’d also be interested to hear about any experience you have in the following areas: 
 Experience with ML frameworks and LLM inference , such as PyTorch, vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp or similar 
 Experience using heterogeneous CPU + accelerator systems 
 Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks and protocols 
 An interest in understanding end-to-end application and system performance , from higher-level applications through runtimes and libraries to the underlying hardware 
 Understanding of CPU bottlenecks in agentic workloads 
 Understanding of databases, vector search and retrieval systems 
 Familiarity with containers and cloud/server infrastructure 
 Understanding of parallel programming, collective communications or distributed AI workloads 
 Experience engaging with the open-source community 
 Familiarity with SIMD technologies, such as Neon™, SVE and SME 
 Interpersonal strengths 
 Comfortable sharing ideas, asking questions, and collaborating with others. 
 Able to work independently, make pragmatic decisions and navigate ambiguity and change 
 Experience delivering technical work involving multiple contributors

 In Return

items.desc: About the role Linkup is the web search engine built for AI. Our infrastructure crawls, indexes and serves the live web to AI agents, and it’s scaling fast. We’re looking for a top‑tier Machine Learning Engineer to join Linkup and work hand‑in‑hand with our CTO, Denis Charrier, and the rest of the tech team. Your core responsibilities will be to: Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents Bring new ranking signals into the engine, beyond pure relevance Build the evaluation framework that tells us what really improves search quality Optimize model serving for latency and GPU cost Turn customer and benchmark feedback into ranking improvements, with clear before/after numbers Requirements You’re a great match if you: Are excited to help build Google for AI agents- and believe in Linkup’s mission Have strong hands-on experience in information retrieval, ranking or search in production. Build rigorous evals and check the data behind every number Care about latency, cost and reliability as much as model quality Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment Example Projects Ship a new ranking model to production and prove the gain on our eval sets Push our models to the next level: better answers, lower latency, lower cost per query Build and maintain the evaluations framework that measures every change to our search engine Our Stack Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, vLLM, Ray, Spark / Databricks, Vespa, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Terraform Details The ideal candidate will play a central role in our engineering team, partnering closely with the founders. The models you ship will decide what thousands of AI products read every day. We offer a flexible remote‑work policy- see the details here. Join us and leverage your expertise to push the boundaries of AI! About Linkup Our Vision We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web . These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information. AI agents need web search . To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off. Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs . Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space. Web 2.0 is sunsetting . The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home. Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up . We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone. Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup. Our Mission Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve. Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs. Our Culture Our culture is built on the following values: Mission . We believe we play a critical role in building the agentic web. We are 100% committed to our mission of bringing the reality of the world to AI agents. Speed . We build fast, we build to last. We get things done, well. Ownership . We empower every team member to take ownership of their projects, ensuring they see them through to successful completion. Teamwork . Our strength lies in our unity. We rely on one another and embrace our diversity as a core asset. Humility . We maintain low egos, showing respect for others and continuously learning from their insights and experiences. We expect all team member to take an active role in shaping our company culture. Our Team We are a small technical team, working shoulder to shoulder to build the web of agents. A bit more about our 3 co-founders: Philippe Mizrahi- Led the development of Lyft’s Autonomous Vehicles marketplace. Previously launched Amundsen, an open source search engine. Denis Charrier- Founding Engineer at Niland, an audio search company (acquired by Spotify), then Staff Engineer at Spotify. 15y of software development experience. Boris Toledano- Led robotics at Carrefour, after 3y at McKinsey & Co working on public affairs and digital transformation.

items.desc: Description Le Bureau des Talents est spécialisé dans la chasse, l'accompagnement et le coaching des talents pour les startups, les scale-ups et les entreprises à impact. Notre client est une startup française spécialisée en cybersécurité, qui développe une plateforme intégrant des technologies d'intelligence artificielle. Son équipe travaille sur des problématiques complexes à la croisée de l'IA appliquée, de la recherche et de la sécurité informatique. Dans cet environnement entrepreneurial, vous contribuerez à explorer de nouvelles approches, à expérimenter rapidement et à transformer des avancées en intelligence artificielle en solutions concrètes. L'équipe privilégie la curiosité scientifique, l'exigence technique et la capacité à produire des résultats mesurables. LE POSTE Nous recherchons un AI Researcher capable de faire progresser les capacités des agents IA à raisonner, planifier et prendre des décisions dans des environnements complexes. Vous travaillerez sur les mécanismes d'intelligence au coeur de ces agents : nouvelles approches de raisonnement, planification à plusieurs étapes, interaction avec des outils et évaluation des performances. Vous serez amené à concevoir des expériences, analyser leurs résultats et collaborer étroitement avec les ingénieurs et les spécialistes de la cybersécurité pour intégrer les approches les plus prometteuses au produit. L'objectif n'est pas de faire de la recherche théorique isolée, mais de faire émerger des avancées mesurables et de les transformer en systèmes capables de fonctionner dans des conditions réelles. Poste VOS MISSIONS Explorer de nouvelles approches en raisonnement, planification et prise de décision pour les agents IA. Concevoir des systèmes capables de réaliser des tâches complexes nécessitant plusieurs étapes d'exécution. Expérimenter différentes méthodes pour améliorer les capacités des modèles et des agents. Évaluer les performances des approches développées à partir de scénarios concrets et de résultats mesurables. Analyser les échecs, les limites et les comportements des modèles afin d'identifier des pistes d'amélioration. Étudier des techniques telles que l'utilisation d'outils, la planification à long horizon et l'interaction avec des environnements. Collaborer avec les ingénieurs et les chercheurs en cybersécurité pour intégrer les résultats de recherche aux systèmes en production. Itérer rapidement à partir des expérimentations et des retours issus des environnements réels. Profil PROFIL RECHERCHÉ Nous recherchons un profil en recherche IA doté d'excellents fondamentaux scientifiques et techniques, capable d'explorer de nouvelles approches, de concevoir des expériences rigoureuses et de transformer ses travaux en systèmes IA concrets.
