Formation de référence telle que l'École polytechnique, Télécom Paris, CentraleSupélec, l'ENS Paris-Saclay ou cursus comparable. Bon niveau d'anglais. Expérience Expérience ou pratique concrète en intelligence artificielle, machine learning, LLM, agents IA ou systèmes de reinforcement learning. Expérience dans la conception, la conduite et l'analyse d'expériences permettant d'évaluer et d'améliorer les performances des modèles. Capacité à transformer des hypothèses de recherche en approches testables et à tirer des conclusions à partir de résultats expérimentaux. Compétences techniques et scientifiques Bonne maîtrise de Python et des fondamentaux de la programmation. Solides connaissances en machine learning et compréhension du fonctionnement des modèles d'IA, de leurs capacités et de leurs limites. Capacité à explorer des problèmes ouverts, à comparer différentes approches et à analyser rigoureusement leurs résultats. Intérêt pour la recherche appliquée et la mise en oeuvre de solutions capables de fonctionner dans des environnements réels. items.desc: Graduate Site Engineer Start your career on site. Learn from experienced professionals. See the projects you work on take shape. Finished university or college and looking for your first real opportunity in construction or engineering? We’re looking for a Graduate Site Engineer who wants to build their career through hands-on experience. Rather than sitting behind a desk all day, you’ll be out on live project sites, learning how projects are delivered and developing practical engineering and surveying skills from experienced members of the team. This is a beginning-of-career opportunity , so we’re not expecting you to know everything on day one. We’re looking for someone with the right technical foundation, a willingness to learn and the confidence to get involved. What you’ll be getting involved in Working alongside our Project Managers, Site Agents and wider project teams, you'll develop experience across areas including: Setting out works accurately on live construction sites Using surveying equipment, including Total Stations and automatic levels Measuring cut, fill, stockpile volumes and project quantities Supporting site surveys and recording testing locations Keeping accurate project and site records Using surveying and GPS software Building and developing 3D models for use by our plant and site teams Working with colleagues, clients and other professionals involved in delivering projects Who are we looking for? You could be a great fit if you: Have recently graduated, or are about to graduate, in Surveying, Civil Engineering, Construction, Geotechnical Engineering or a related subject Have an HNC, degree or equivalent technical qualification Have some exposure to surveying equipment, setting out or 3D modelling through university, college, a placement or previous employment Enjoy solving problems and working practically Are organised and able to prioritise your workload Are comfortable communicating with different people Want to learn and take on increasing responsibility Have an interest in construction, earthworks and site engineering Any knowledge of health & safety, CDM 2015, geotechnical testing or contaminated land projects would be useful, but you don’t need to arrive as the finished article. Why this role? This is an opportunity to build genuine site experience, develop practical technical skills and learn how construction projects work in the real world. You’ll work with experienced people, develop relationships across the business and build the foundations for a long-term career in site engineering and construction. If you’re ambitious, practical and ready to turn what you’ve learned into a career, we’d like to hear from you.

items.desc: Your IMC journey as a Graduate Quantitative Researcher begins with a six-week Global Trainee Programme led by our seasoned engineers and traders alongside graduates from all three IMC regions: Europe, the United States, and Asia-Pacific. During this traineeship, you will deepen your knowledge about trading and financial markets, IMC’s trading strategies, and our proprietary trading systems. Your training will continue back at your local office, where you’ll receive support from your dedicated mentor, an experienced quant researcher at IMC. Following the programme, you will join a team of quantitative researchers, where you’ll play a key role in exploring and shaping strategies in global markets. You’ll receive recognition for your ideas and successes every step of the way. Your Core Responsibilities Collaborate with traders to evaluate existing models and suggest improvements Build customised analysis tools to explore new research ideas Apply rigorous quantitative techniques to solve complex problems Design mathematical models based on innovative trading ideas Implement these new models and put them into production Your Skills And Experience In your ultimate year of a MSc or PhD in mathematics, physics, astrophysics, or a related quantitative field, and are seeking to join IMC full-time in February or August 2027 Experience in a programming language (e.g. Python, Matlab or C++) First-class quantitative and analytical skills, with excellent attention to detail A genuine interest in financial markets (no prior knowledge or experience is required) Please note: If you have already applied for this position during the current recruitment season and were not selected, you may reapply when the next recruitment season begins in Summer 2027. We encourage you to focus on enhancing your skillset before reapplying. Due to current U.S. immigration and visa restrictions, some candidates may not be eligible to obtain the U.S. business visa required as part of our Global Traineeship Programme. As the programme includes mandatory training in the United States shortly after joining, we are unfortunately unable to proceed with applications from candidates who are unable to obtain the required visa within the programme timeline. If you are a dual passport holder of another nationality or a European citizen who wants to relocate back to Europe, you remain welcome to apply and should inform our campus recruitment team of your situation: CampusEU@imc.com. About Us IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.

items.desc: Would you like to work on the fundamental mechanisms of triboelectrification at the atomic and molecular scales using Density Functional Theory to elucidate the underlying triboelectric charge transfer mechanisms? Do you have experience in ab-initio electronic structure modelling using Density Functional Theory to understand and predict materials properties? Are you interested in working in a multidisciplinary team proactively tackling technical tasks in parallel? Electrostatic charge accumulation in powders and grains, due to collisional and sliding contacts of surfaces of solids, commonly known as triboelectrification, is a nuisance and source of hazards, and at the same time, it has great potential for exploitation, as in the fast-growing technology of Tribo-Electric Nano-Generators (TENG). The former adversely affects manufacturability, due to issues such as downtime, valuable product loss and negative environmental impact, whilst for the latter, the identification of durable and efficient functional materials is highly desirable. The capability to predict triboelectrification tendency of materials provides a great competitive edge in advanced manufacturing across a wide range of industries from food and pharmaceuticals to additive manufacturing, polymers and TENG. items.desc: Job Description Grade UE07: £41,885-£49,798 per annum School of Engineering, College of Science & Engineering Institute for Infrastructure and Environment Full Time: 35 hours per week Fixed Term: contract up to 12 months The Opportunity Together we can do great things. Be part of something bigger. This role sits at the critical intersection of climate adaptation, wildfire dynamics, and water security. The primary objective is to investigate how shifting climate patterns alter flood and drought hazard patterns and wildfire occurrence. Additionally it will explore how fire-modified landscapes drive changes in hydrology. You will develop an integrated modelling framework that connects climate change projections (e.g. CMIP6 or ISIMIP) to hydrological responses, specifically focusing on the cascading impacts of fire on water systems under future Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSPs). A core component of the work involves modelling future hazard occurrences at the global scale (spatially and temporally) – from floods to droughts and wildfire. The work will develop a probabilistic framework, handling uncertainty using a ensemble approach, to deliver a regional analysis of changing global hazards (floods (fluvial and pluvial), droughts (meterological and hydrological) and wildfire). Hotspots of increasing hazard magnitude/severity or duration will be identified and will feed into a wider project (led by the University of Bristol) exploring the global health burden of water supply under different SSPs. Floods and droughts will be detected using threshold metrics and events extracted from global climate projections (e.g. CMIP6/ISIMIP). Wildfire occurrence will be modelled not merely as a static hazard, but as a dynamic driver of landscape change. You will utilise large-scale climate ensembles (e.g., CMIP6 ISIMIP) and land-use projections to simulate future fire frequencies, severities, and spatial extents. This fire occurrence modelling will serve as the foundational input for assessing how vegetation loss and soil property changes—such as increased water repellency—alter the hydrological cycle. Working at a large scale, you will be responsible for the necessary data processing, synthesis, and downscaling required to bridge the gap between coarse global climate models and actionable local risk insights. You will employ probabilistic approaches to handle uncertainties in both climate projections, water jazards and fire behaviour, ensuring robust estimates of future water-related hazards. The outputs will directly feed the wider project consortium (University of Bristol and Newcastle – exploring the potential global health burden from SSPs). This position demands strong skills in geospatial analysis, climate model and data knowledge, and statistical programming to translate complex, multi-hazard interactions into outputs. items.desc: Quiénes somos Somos una de las entidades financieras de referencia de crédito al consumo en el mercado español. Con 35 años de historia en nuestro país, hemos acompañado a más de dos millones y medio de clientes para hacer realidad sus proyectos. Estamos respaldados por el grupo Crédit Mutuel, el cuarto banco más importante en Francia, que nos proporciona el soporte financiero y tecnológico necesario para diseñar, vender y gestionar una amplia gama de productos de crédito al consumo, préstamos personales, tarjetas, líneas de crédito, soluciones de pago y seguros. Estamos buscando para nuestras oficinas de Cornellà de Llobregat a un/a Data Scientist Tus misiones Identificar nuevas tendencias y oportunidades de análisis, colaborando con diferentes partes del negocio para impulsar la agenda de análisis y ciencias de datos. Transformar grandes conjuntos de datos complejos en ideas pragmáticas y factibles. Llevar a cabo actividades de investigación, desarrollo, exploración y descubrimiento de datos y desarrollar prototipos, algoritmos y pruebas de concepto, utilizando la ciencia de datos líder y soluciones innovadoras. Aplicar métodos analíticos, como el aprendizaje automático, el reconocimiento de patrones, los algoritmos de recomendación para resolver problemas comerciales y optimizar resultados. Trabajar en el descubrimiento de datos que aporte valor y ayude a la toma de decisiones. Colaborar con los equipos de ingeniería de datos para mejorar los datos como activo del negocio. Crear conocimientos sobre las tecnologías y técnicas existentes y emergentes, según corresponda a la ciencia de los datos, y mantener un espíritu de aprendizaje. Lo que experimentarás con nosotros Incorporarte a una multinacional del sector financiero en pleno proceso de Transformación. Integrarse en un equipo dinámico formando parte de proyectos transversales. Modelo de trabajo híbrido (2 días en remoto a la semana). Posibilidades de desarrollo profesional. Un completo paquete de compensación que incluye: contrato estable, salario fijo, variable, ticket restaurant y más beneficios sociales. Lo que nos gustará de ti Grado en Estadística, Matemáticas, Ingenierías, Física (o estudios comparables). Valoramos otras formaciones (ADE, Economía,…) si se complementa con un Máster en Data Science / Data Analytics. Experiencia mínima de 1 año como Data Scientist realizando modelos estadísticos / machine learning. Experiencia práctica con alguno de los paquetes estadísticos: SAS, Python (Sckit-Learning, Pandas, Numpy, VerticaPy) y/o R. Idiomas: valorable inglés o francés.

items.desc: Start date: 1st April 2027. A clinical research associate position is available working on a collaborative project to develop diagnostic and prognostic tools for coronary artery disease, as part of a multi-disciplinary team led by Professor Martin Bennett at the Department of Medicine, University of Cambridge, where the position will be based. Cardiovascular disease is the largest cause of death worldwide, and new diagnostics and treatments are needed, particularly in those at highest risk. In collaboration with the Department of Applied Mathematics and Theoretical Physics, Centre for Mathematics Sciences, Cambridge, we have developed an AI-based machine learning algorithm to analyse intracoronary images and identify high-risk patients and assess the efficacy of drugs to prevent or treat disease. The clinical research associate will work within a growing team of clinical and non-clinical scientists to further develop this and other tools for clinical use, focusing on image co-registration, segmentation, and post-processing to generate outputs suitable for clinical decision making. We are particularly looking for candidates with experience in invasive coronary image processing for real-world problems, and experience with relevant image analysis software would be very advantageous. Further information on the project from Professor Martin Bennett (mrb24@ cam.ac.uk). Duties include collaborative research objectives and defining individual project work streams. Working with the PI, the role holder will be expected to plan and manage their own research and administration, with guidance if required, and to assist in the preparation of proposals and applications to external bodies. You must be able to communicate material of a technical nature and be able to build internal and external contacts. Fixed-term: This post has funding for up to 2 years in the first instance, which may be extendable to 3 years. There may be the opportunity for the successful candidate to pursue a PhD during their employment, subject to approval. This appointment requires an Honorary Clinical Contract. Click the 'Apply' button below to register an account with our recruitment system (if you have not already) and apply online. This is an integrated appointment between the University and Cambridge University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust ("NHS Trust"). You will therefore also be issued with an Honorary Clinical Contract by the NHS Trust. You should be aware that if your contract with the NHS Trust is terminated your employment with the University will be terminated, and vice versa. Please ensure that you upload a covering letter, CV and a completed Additional Information for Clinical Researchers form in the Upload section of the online application. If you upload any additional documents which have not been requested, we will not be able to consider these as part of your application. Please include details of your referees, including email address and phone number, one of which must be your most recent line manager. Please quote reference RC51491 on your application and in any correspondence about this vacancy. The University actively supports equality, diversity and inclusion and encourages applications from all sections of society. The University has a responsibility to ensure that all employees are eligible to live and work in the UK.

items.desc: We are seeking outstanding scientists and engineers at an early stage in their academic careers to join the flagship Dalton Nuclear Research Fellowship Scheme. Fellows should show a high level of innovation and ambition in their ideas, and want to develop potentially transformative, high-impact research. Each Fellowship is for an initial four-year period and is an excellent stepping stone to establishing an academic career in nuclear science or engineering. You will be responsible for: Plan, develop and conduct world-leading research Win external funding for research Supervise postgraduate and postdoctoral researchers Engage with the nuclear sector and form positive working relationship between and across external academic, industrial and policy stakeholders Actively contribute to the Dalton nuclear community (e.g. engage in Dalton outreach activities, Dalton early career researcher development and networking, and/or contribute to the Dalton policy group) We welcome candidates who bring diverse perspectives, experiences, and approaches to their work. About You We encourage applications from individuals with a wide range of backgrounds and experiences. You should demonstrate: Essential Criteria A relevant PhD (or equivalent qualification/experience) awarded prior to commencing the appointment Ability to develop a coherent world-leading research programme Ability to plan and build a team and deliver outstanding results Strong understanding of the importance of the impact of your research programme on the nuclear sector – either industrial partners or government stakeholders Excellent communication and interpersonal skills We value transferable skills and real-world experience as much as formal qualifications. Our benefits include: Generous employer contribution pension 29 days annual leave plus bank holidays, along with Christmas closure Ride to work and EV car scheme available For more information, please see University of Manchester Benefits. You can also find information on our Flexible and Hybrid working here. We are an open place of enquiry and challenge. We embrace and celebrate difference, diversity and debate, and we pride ourselves on being a place of education, learning and community where we are able, within the law, to question and test received wisdom, express new ideas and explore controversial or unpopular topics and opinions. Find out more from our Freedom of Speech Policy. Applications should be submitted via the application form together with the following supporting documents noting the maximum page numbers for each document: Curriculum Vitae (2 pages) Please also upload your Research Proposal (2 pages), Academic Impact Statement (1 page) and Statement of Strategic Fit (1 page). These three documents must be combined into a single pdf (4 pages in total) Enquiries About The Role, Shortlisting And Interviews Names: Prof. Phil Edmondson and Prof. Clint Sharrad Email addresses: philip.edmondson@manchester.ac.uk; clint.a.sharrad@manchester.ac.uk General enquiries and administrative support recruitmentservices.people@manchester.ac.uk Technical and job portal support https://jobseekersupport.jobtrain.co.uk/support/home Applications close at midnight on the closing date. Entre tus funciones y responsabilidades: Identificar nuevas tendencias y oportunidades de análisis, colaborando con diferentes partes del negocio para impulsar la agenda de análisis y ciencias de datos. Transformar grandes conjuntos de datos complejos en ideas pragmáticas y factibles. Llevar a cabo actividades de investigación, desarrollo, exploración y descubrimiento de datos y desarrollar prototipos, algoritmos y pruebas de concepto, utilizando la ciencia de datos líder y soluciones innovadoras. Aplicar métodos analíticos, como el aprendizaje automático, el reconocimiento de patrones, los algoritmos de recomendación para resolver problemas comerciales y optimizar resultados. Trabajar en el descubrimiento de datos que aporte valor y ayude a la toma de decisiones. Colaborar con los equipos de ingeniería de datos para mejorar los datos como activo del negocio. Crear conocimientos sobre las tecnologías y técnicas existentes y emergentes, según corresponda a la ciencia de los datos, y mantener un espíritu de aprendizaje. ¿Qué esperamos de ti? Formación universitaria en Estadística, Matemáticas, Ingenierías, Física (o estudios comparables). Muy valorable Máster en Data Science / Data Analytics o similar. Nos comprometemos a considerar todas las candidaturas cualificadas sin distinción de origen, género, edad, orientación sexual o discapacidad. items.desc: 👋 Welcome to dexter health! At dexter health, we build AI-powered software for care teams. Our mission is to reduce administrative workload in healthcare so caregivers can spend more time with patients. We are looking for a high-agency AI Engineer to help us build new AI features faster and improve the quality, reliability, and speed of existing AI workflows. This is a hands-on engineering role. Not research. Not prompt-only. You will turn ambiguous product ideas into working, production-ready AI features. The role is mostly focused on shipping AI product features, with some AI systems and infrastructure work where needed. You will work closely with product and engineering, but we expect you to take real ownership. You should be comfortable moving fast, making technical decisions under ambiguity, and using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar every day. Tasks As our AI Engineer, you will: Build new AI-powered product features from idea to production Improve existing AI workflows for quality, reliability, latency, and user value Design and implement LLM-based workflows, structured outputs, validation logic, and fallback behavior Build evaluation loops, tests, and quality checks for AI-generated outputs Integrate AI capabilities into existing product and backend systems Work with commercial and open-source LLMs without being tied to one specific provider Support self-hosted model workflows where they make sense for quality, speed, cost, or control Debug AI feature failures across inputs, outputs, data, backend logic, and user flows Use AI development tools as a core part of your daily workflow Ship quickly while keeping production quality high Requirements We care less about formal seniority and more about speed, intelligence, ownership, and product impact. We like people who operate with founder-like urgency: they figure things out, make progress under ambiguity, and care about outcomes more than titles. Must-have Strong software engineering skills, especially in Python or a comparable backend language Experience building AI-powered product features or LLM-based workflows Ability to turn ambiguous product ideas into working software quickly Strong understanding of how to design, test, validate, and improve AI outputs Experience integrating AI workflows into production systems Strong debugging instincts across application logic, data, model outputs, and user-facing behavior Experience with evaluation, testing, validation, or quality checks for AI-generated outputs Serious experience using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar as part of your daily workflow High intelligence, fast learning speed, bias to action, and ownership mindset Comfortable with ambiguity, fast decisions, and a high-trust startup environment Clear written and spoken English Nice-to-have Experience with frontend or fullstack product development Experience with self-hosted LLMs, model serving, inference optimization, or similar systems Experience with open-source LLMs and related deployment workflows Experience improving latency, cost, quality, or reliability of AI systems Experience with healthcare software, healthcare data, or regulated environments Experience working with structured data extraction, documentation automation, voice workflows, or workflow automation German language skills Knowledge of nursing homes or elderly care workflows This role is probably not for you if You are mainly looking for an ML research role You are a prompt engineer without strong coding skills You need detailed specifications before making progress You prefer slow, highly structured corporate environments You are mainly looking for management, not hands-on building You want to use AI tools only occasionally instead of as part of your daily workflow You optimize for perfect process over fast, reliable execution Benefits Remote work Fair compensation based on skills, experience, and location Ownership of important backend systems Work on software used in real healthcare workflows Modern AI-native development workflow Room to grow with the company Why? Caregivers spend too much time on documentation, coordination, and administrative work. We build technology that reduces this burden. AI is core to our product. But useful AI features do not come from demos alone. They need strong engineering, fast iteration, evaluation, production thinking, and deep ownership of the user outcome. If you want to build AI product features that ship, improve real workflows, use AI tools every day, and take ownership in a fast-moving team, we would like to hear from you.

Présent commercialement dans 54 pays, il exerce ses activités sous deux marques Atos pour les services et Eviden pour les produits et systèmes. items.desc: Företagsbeskrivning AFRY erbjuder tjänster inom teknik, design, digitalisering och rådgivning. Vi är dedikerade experter inom industri, energi och infrastruktur och skapar värde för kommande generationer. AFRY har nordiska rötter med global räckvidd. Våra gemensamma principer – Result driven, Client centric, Empowering och Accountable – vägleder oss i hur vi arbetar, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans. Var med och accelerera övergången till ett hållbart samhälle. Vår Space Tech sektion inom Defense designar och utvecklar säkra och robusta kommunikationslösningar för både kommersiella verksamheter och samhällskritiska funktioner. Genom detta bidrar AFRY till Sveriges säkerhets- och försvarsförmåga. Robust kommunikation innebär kommunikation som kan motstå både avsiktliga och oavsiktliga störningar av olika slag. Det kan handla om motståndskraft mot tekniska fel, naturkatastrofer, signalstörningar eller cyberhot. Den önskade robustheten kan uppnås genom att bygga in redundans, skapa alternativa kommunikationsvägar, optimera prestanda, eliminera störningar eller använda intelligent beslutsstöd. Jobbeskrivning Ämne: AI för spektrumanalys, störningsdetektion och adaptiv spektrumaccess Framtida kommunikationssystem förväntas kunna analysera radiomiljön, identifiera störningar och automatiskt anpassa sin kommunikation. Genom att kombinera artificiell intelligens med Software Defined Radio (SDR) kan intelligenta radiosystem utvecklas för att utnyttja radiospektrum mer effektivt och robust. Målet med examensarbetet är att undersöka hur AI- och maskininlärningsmetoder kan användas för att analysera spektrumdata, identifiera interferens och jamming samt stödja beslut kring frekvensval och kommunikationsstrategier. Om examensarbetet Hur bygger man satellitkommunikationssystem som fortsätter fungera när omgivningen förändras, spektrumet blir trängre och störningar ökar? Detta examensarbete genomförs inom vårt Dual-Use-program, där det aktuella projektet finansieras av Rymdstyrelsen och drivs av Space Tech Systems på AFRY i Uppsala. Här utforskar vi framtidens robusta satellitkommunikation genom att kombinera AI, signalbehandling, Software Defined Radio (SDR) och intelligenta beslutsstödsfunktioner. Visionen är att utveckla intelligenta kommunikationssystem som kan uppfatta sin omgivning, förstå radiospektrumet och anpassa sig till förändrade förutsättningar. Tekniken har potential att skapa robustare lösningar för både civila och försvarsrelaterade tillämpningar. Som examensarbetare blir du en del av ett team som arbetar i teknikens framkant. Arbetet kan innehålla: Litteraturstudie inom AI, signalbehandling och kognitiv radio. Datainsamling och bearbetning av spektrumdata. Utveckling av maskininlärningsmodeller för signal- och störningsklassificering. Analys av jamming- och interferensdetektion. Utvärdering av adaptiv spektrumaccess. Visualisering och beslutsstöd för intelligenta radiosystem. Du får arbeta tillsammans med erfarna ingenjörer och specialister och bidra till ett nationellt rymdinitiativ där forskning, innovation och praktisk ingenjörskonst möts. För dig som vill kombinera rymdteknik, AI och avancerade kommunikationssystem i ett examensarbete med verklig teknisk höjd finns nog få möjligheter som är mer spännande än detta. Tidplan Uppstart efter överenskommelse, men förslagsvis mitten av januari 2027 och genomförande under våren (motsvarande 30 hp). Exjobbet utförs till största del på vårt lokalkontor i Uppsala, med viss möjlighet att arbeta på distans. Kvalifikationer Lämplig bakgrund är civilingenjörsutbildning inom elektroteknik, teknisk fysik, datateknik, informationsteknik eller motsvarande. Arbetet passar särskilt dig som har intresse för artificiell intelligens, maskininlärning, digital signalbehandling, trådlösa kommunikationssystem eller dataanalys. Erfarenhet av Python, AI/ML-ramverk, GNU Radio eller arbete med spektrum- och signaldata är meriterande men inget krav. Du kommer ha handledare inom AFRY. Detta examensarbete kommer att genomföras som ett individuellt arbete samtidigt som det integreras i ett pågående utvecklingsprojekt inom sektionen Har du en egen idé om ett examensarbete diskuterar vi gärna det och ser om det kan vara passande för vår verksamhet och identifierade behov framåt. Ytterligare information Exjobbet utgör en grund för en möjlig framtida anställning hos AFRY. Som anställd på AFRY erbjuder vi en modern arbetsplats i ett globalt sammanhang med framåtanda och trygghet i form av kollektivavtal och personalförmåner så som friskvårdsbidrag och en förmånsportal med en mängd rabatter. Vår personalklubb arrangerar sociala aktiviteter på och utanför kontoret. Allt från skidresor, sjunga i kör till att spela brädspel – det finns något för alla. Vårt arbete med mångfald är också ständigt pågående, en mix av personligheter och bakgrunder gör oss ännu starkare, mer kreativa och framgångsrika ute på marknaden. Dessutom finns det många sätt att vidareutveckla sig hos oss! Vi satsar på våra …

items.desc: Description du poste : L’intelligence artificielle (IA) et les systèmes agentiques révolutionnent de nombreux domaines, y compris la cybersécurité. Alors que les systèmes connectés et embarqués se généralisent, leur sécurisation devient un enjeu majeur. Les méthodes traditionnelles de recherche de vulnérabilités (scanning, fuzzing, reverse-engineering, analyse statique/dynamique) restent indispensables, mais leur automatisation intelligente est un défi clé pour faire face à la complexité croissante des systèmes modernes. Dans ce contexte, les modèles de langage (LLMs) et les agents autonomes offrent des opportunités inédites pour guider, optimiser et automatiser les tests de sécurité. Leur capacité à comprendre, générer et raisonner sur des données complexes permet d’envisager des approches innovantes pour identifier des vulnérabilités avant qu’elles ne soient exploitées. Objectifs: Ce stage vise à explorer les capacités agentiques des modèles de langage open-weight (comme Qwen3.8) et leur intégration dans des harness optimisés pour la recherche de vulnérabilités, le guidage intelligent des outils de sécurité et la réalisation de campagnes de caractérisation des systèmes embarqués. Rejoignez-nous en Stage ! CEA Tech Corporate from CEA Tech on Vimeo . En tant que stagiaire au CEA, vous aurez l'opportunité de travailler au sein d'un environnement de recherche de renommée mondiale. Nos équipes sont composées d'experts passionnés et dédiés, offrant un cadre propice à l'apprentissage et à la collaboration. Vous aurez accès à des équipements de pointe et à des ressources de recherche de premier ordre pour mener à bien vos missions. items.desc: Deine Aufgaben: Du entwickelst innovative KI-Lösungen von der ersten fachlichen Analyse bis zum produktiven Einsatz beim Kunden. Dabei hinterfragst Du bestehende Annahmen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden pragmatische Lösungsansätze. Dazu gehören unter anderem die Orchestrierung von KI-Modellen, Tool-Integrationen, strukturierte Ausgaben und die Anbindung an bestehende Systeme. Du entwickelst die notwendigen Backend-Services, APIs und Integrationen selbst – insbesondere mit Python. Dabei legst Du Wert auf sauberen, wartbaren und testbaren Code sowie auf eine zuverlässige Umsetzung. Du sorgst dafür, dass KI-Anwendungen auch im produktiven Betrieb überzeugen. Dazu gehören Themen wie Fehlerbehandlung, Fallbacks, Guardrails, Monitoring, Sicherheit, Performance und Kostenkontrolle. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Kunden zusammen, begleitest Workshops und technische Umsetzungssessions und stimmst Dich mit unseren Engineering- und Architekturteams ab. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die technische Integration und die erfolgreiche Einführung der Lösungen. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, bewertest neue Technologien und entwickelst unsere Ansätze für den Einsatz von KI kontinuierlich weiter. Dabei entscheidest Du fundiert, wann KI einen echten Mehrwert bietet und wann klassische Softwarelösungen die bessere Wahl sind. Du hast Freude daran, technische Lösungen gemeinsam mit Kunden zu entwickeln, komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich zu vermitteln und neue Themen aktiv voranzutreiben. items.desc: ¿Quiénes somos? EME STUDIOS nació en 2017 como una marca de streetwear española. ¿Qué buscamos? Queremos crear nuestro departamento de IA, y buscamos a la persona que lo ponga en marcha. Su misión será ayudar a todos los equipos de la compañía (Compras, Ventas, Logística, Planificación, Producto, Marketing, Atención al cliente…) a trabajar mejor, más rápido y con mejores datos. No buscamos a alguien que espere a que le digan qué hacer. Buscamos a alguien proactivo, curioso y con criterio , que se siente con cada departamento, entienda cómo trabaja y qué le frena, y sea capaz de convertir esas necesidades en soluciones reales : automatizaciones, herramientas, aplicaciones, análisis de datos… lo que haga falta en cada caso. ¿Qué harás? Conocer a fondo el negocio y a cada equipo para detectar dónde la IA y la automatización pueden aportar más. Priorizar los proyectos según su impacto y construir una hoja de ruta de IA para toda la compañía. Diseñar, desarrollar e implantar las soluciones, desde la idea hasta que el equipo las usa en su día a día. Ordenar y aprovechar los datos de la compañía para que todas las decisiones se tomen con información fiable. Formar y acompañar a los equipos para que la IA forme parte de su forma de trabajar. Estar al día de lo que pasa en el mundo de la IA y traerlo a EME cuando tenga sentido. Requisitos Titulación universitaria en Ingeniería Informática, Matemáticas, Estadística, Ciencia de Datos, Inteligencia Artificial o un área afín. Experiencia mínima de 2 años en puestos relacionados con datos, inteligencia artificial o automatización de procesos. Experiencia demostrable en el diseño e implantación de soluciones basadas en IA, automatización y análisis de datos. Soltura en el uso de herramientas y lenguajes habituales en el entorno de datos e IA. ¿Cómo eres? Entiendes el negocio antes que la tecnología. Sabes escuchar, hacer las preguntas adecuadas y traducir un problema en una solución. Tienes iniciativa y autonomía. Detectas oportunidades sin que nadie te las señale. Eres resolutivo: prefieres algo que funcione hoy a algo perfecto dentro de seis meses. Sabes comunicarte con cualquier perfil, desde dirección hasta los equipos operativos. Tienes experiencia demostrable construyendo soluciones con IA, automatización y datos, y te mueves con soltura entre herramientas. Te motiva construir algo desde cero y ver su impacto en toda la empresa. ¿Qué te ofrecemos? La oportunidad de crear y liderar el departamento de IA de una de las marcas de streetwear que más crece en España. Relación directa con dirección e impacto en todas las áreas de la compañía. Libertad para decidir cómo hacerlo y con qué herramientas. Descuento en producto y un equipo joven con ganas de hacer cosas.

Son équipe enseignante est fortement impliquée dans les pédagogies actives, notamment via des projets, l'utilisation des outils numériques et le développement de l'alternance en lien avec les entreprises du secteur. items.desc: All great stories start somewhere. Yours could start with an application. Carbon13 is looking for those ready to dedicate the next X years to building a climate tech startup that reshapes the baseline scenarios dragging us deeper into climate crisis. There’s no time for false starts. Join the programme, find your dream co-founder in just 8 weeks, define your problem space, and tap into the expertise of 400+ domain specialists, carbon experts, and their sharp-eyed entrepreneurs in residence. Show that your team is ready to transform entire industries and secure Carboon13's initial investment in just 5 months. Apply here. And learn more about Carbon13 here. Here you will find an overview of our upcoming Q&As. ---- We're looking for software developers, data scientists, and/or AI/ML specialists to become co-founders of startups that will adjust economies for a net zero future. Your specialisation and skills on data and code are the core factors to really move the needle. With us you will find the right cofounder, whose strong entrepreneurial background will help you get what you build off the ground. Our mission: Save the climate and aim big - before it's too late. Carbon13 is the Venture Builder for the Climate Emergency. We are laser-focused on supporting founders solving for the climate, and the climate only. To do that, we ask every new founder on our Venture Builder to aim big, to build a solution with the potential to reduce carbon dioxide (or equivalent greenhouse gases) by 10 million tonnes per year - and all our support is designed to help you reach that figure. You like solving problems, so come build with us and solve this one. “As a scientist on the Venture Builder, yes it was great to join a group which also had lots of other scientists and engineers, but I was also taken out of my comfort zone and challenged by amazing entrepreneurs and commercial founders. That's what took it from an idea to a business." Yubiao Niu , Co-Founder & CTO @Nium Why participating? We bring together a bunch of diverse people with many perspectives. There are about 75 people in our cohort with strong science, business or technical backgrounds. One of these bright minds is certainly a suitable co-founder for you. The climate doesn't have time for us to waste on false starts, tinkering at the edges, or greenwashing. When you join one of our cohorts, you'll be welcomed into a community with hundreds of other founders and experters all working on solutions to save the climate. Real transformation doesn’t come from a single individual but unencumbered communities with original thought. We care deeply about the success of those who choose to take giant steps. And of course carbon: “One of the unique things that we are doing at Carbon13 is we are not expecting our founders to outsource this knowledge, we are very much training all of our founders, so they have access to the latest tools and techniques, so that they can assess their carbon mitigation potential, understand how to communicate it and of course be transparent in how they measuring it.” Carbon13 Co-Founder and Chief Sustainability Officer Dr. Nicky Dee Flexible programme framework Apart from nine in-person days in Berlin/Cambridge, you can do the programme from anywhere in the world. The rest of the programme is delivered remotely. It is very important to us to make clear that you can also be a successful climatetech founder if you have children, care for elderly relatives, do voluntary work or have other obligations. We can't tackle the climate crisis if we don't involve multiple life circumstances on the entrepreneurial path. Our Venture Builder is desgined on that principle. “There was people from all over the place. All different walks of life, ages, backgrounds and I think this was one of the great things that Carbon13 was able to bring together for me.” Natalia Dorfman, CEO and co-founder of KITA from cohort 2 in Cambridge From Food to Construction to Energy to New Materials to Carbon Capture Carbon13 is sector agnostic so founders can explore ideas in any emitting industry. We tailor our support accordingly for science-based, deeptech or hardware ventures - whether it's support on team building, assessing carbon mitigation potential, go-to-market strategy, IP protection, fundraising, you'll be accessing a brains trust of hundreds of experts, peers, and partners. More than 150 ventures launched through the programme and 71 ventures received our pre-seed investment, a total of £9Mio since 2021. More than two-thirds of these have already secured follow-on funding. Our ventures are working on technologies with great emission-saving potential, such as carbon negative concrete, methane capture, bioplastics, precision fermentation, quantum computing for materials discovery, green ammonia, green hydrogen, biochar or direct air capture. You can view our portfolio of ventures here. Working on a climate tech idea already? The VC funding route is currently the faster …

items.desc: About Us Textron Specialized Vehicles are a global manufacturer of golf cars, utility and personal transportation vehicles, side-by-sides, all-terrain vehicles, professional turf-care equipment, and ground support equipment. At Ransomes Jacobsen Ltd, we design and manufacture professional turf-care equipment under the brands of Ransomes and Jacobsen. Our mission is to be the premier supplier of high-quality and environmentally conscious turf equipment, providing superior performance for our customers. From prestigious championship golf courses to the World Cup, for more than a century, the most important turf in the world has been manicured by our brand. We recognise that our success, and future success, is tied directly to our people. We are looking for an Autonomy Systems Engineer to join the Company in Ipswich, Suffolk. About The Role As an Autonomy Systems Engineer, you will develop and integrate the onboard autonomy stack for Jacobsen vehicles. This role focuses on vehicle-level system integration, safety-critical architecture, and embedded implementation, supporting the transition from prototype systems to production-ready autonomous platforms. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Lead integration of the autonomy stack (perception, localisation, planning, control) onto vehicle platforms; Design and implement safety systems, including safety controllers and safe stop functionality; Develop and integrate embedded software and vehicle control interfaces (CAN, drive-by-wire); Define and deliver sensor integration (LiDAR, radar, cameras, GPS/IMU); Execute vehicle-level testing and validation, including field trials; Support functional safety activities (HARA, safety case, certification readiness); Other duties as required. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics/Mechatronics or similar. A minimum of two years’ experience in autonomous or robotic systems integration, or similar roles. Required Skills: Strong understanding of functional safety (ISO 13849 / ISO 12100); Experience with embedded systems and real-time control; Knowledge of sensor systems and vehicle interfaces (CAN); Hands-on experience with system testing and validation; Self-motivating and able to work with low levels of supervision to defined objectives; Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills. Desirable Skills: ROS2 and robotics software stacks; Sensor fusion and perception systems; Safety-rated controllers / safety PLCs; Off-highway or automotive systems experience. What We Offer Work life balance promoted with every other Friday off; 30 days annual leave; Competitive rate of pay, reviewed annually; Enhanced Company pension; Life assurance of four times your annual salary; Comprehensive Employee Assistance Program for you and your immediate family; Access to Textron University’s self-service training platform; Eye care scheme; Discounts on gym memberships, shopping and travel through Perks at Work; Onsite golf course and football pitch; Winter flu vaccination voucher. Feedback & professionelles Arbeiten: Regelmäßige Code-Reviews, Pair-Programming-Sessions und strukturierte Feedbackrunden unterstützen dich dabei, sauberen, wartbaren Code zu schreiben und professionell im Team zu arbeiten. Wissen teilen & wachsen: In unseren Skill Factorys leitest du kurze Sessions für andere Trainees oder Kolleg:innen. So festigst du dein Wissen und entwickelst deine Präsentations- und Coaching-Skills weiter. Erweiterung deines Kompetenzprofils: Neben Python, SQL & Co. eignest du dir Kenntnisse in KI- und Cloud-Technologien an und lernst, wie moderne Softwareentwicklung in diesen Bereichen funktioniert. Was du mitbringst Du hast ein abgeschlossenes oder stehst kurz vor dem Abschluss eines Studiums im IT- oder datenbezogenen Umfeld und bringst erste praktische Erfahrung mit Python und/oder SQL mit (z. items.desc: ﻿ MyOrigines est un acteur historique de la parfumerie, aujourd'hui reconnu pour son modèle de distribution majoritairement digital. Maison de parfumerie française, MyOrigines est née du retail physique et a su, au fil des années, opérer une transformation digitale réussie, sans jamais renier ses racines. MyOrigines n'est pas une marque née sur internet. Elle est issue d'une histoire familiale de parfumeurs commencée il y a près de 80 ans. Cette filiation confère à l'entreprise une légitimité métier forte, une culture produit exigeante et une expertise pointue de la parfumerie, qui constituent aujourd'hui le cœur de son ADN. Si le digital est désormais le principal canal de distribution, il est le prolongement naturel d'un savoir-faire historique et d'une expertise métier reconnue, qui ont permis à MyOrigines de s'imposer comme le troisième acteur de la parfumerie sur le marché français du e-commerce. Cette performance repose sur une combinaison unique : une culture produit exigeante, une connaissance fine des marques et une capacité à innover en continu, sans jamais perdre de vue l'essence de notre métier. Rejoindre MyOrigines, c'est intégrer une entreprise qui conjugue héritage et modernité, passion du parfum et excellence opérationnelle, exigence métier et innovation digitale, dans un environnement en constante évolution. Dans un secteur e-commerce international en forte transformation, MyOrigines renforce son pôle Stratégie & Optimisation, cellule transverse rattachée à la direction générale. Ce poste offre : · Une forte exposition à la direction générale, aux arbitrages business et à l’impact opérationnel au quotidien ; · Une variété de sujets à fort enjeu stratégique (ex : politique de prix, stratégie catalogue, gestion de stock, développement européen…) ; · Une courbe d’apprentissage rapide et ambitieuse qui lie data, IA, business, allocation de ressources et complexité ; · Un cadre de travail dynamique et exigeant, basé à Ajaccio, dans un environnement de vie exceptionnel. Mission & responsabilités Rattaché(e) au pôle Stratégie & Optimisation, vous intervenez sur des sujets divers à fort enjeu stratégique en appui transverse, sans vous substituer aux équipes opérationnelles, avec une logique métier de conseil : · Cadrer les enjeux métiers, structurer les analyses et prioriser les leviers de performance ; · Collecter, fiabiliser et exploiter les données utiles à la décision, en mobilisant les outils IA lorsque pertinent ; · Mener des analyses et proposer des plans d’action exploitables pour éclairer les arbitrages business ; · Formaliser des recommandations hiérarchisées et des supports de synthèse permettant la prise de décision ; · Accompagner les équipes dans la mise en œuvre des plans d’action et mesurer l’impact des initiatives engagées. Profil recherché · Programme Grande Ecole de commerce ou école d’ingénieur de premier plan (top 5 uniquement)/ université sélective ou équivalent · Un stage ou une première expérience en conseil en stratégie / management, direction de la stratégie, business analysis, growth ou start-up · Très fortes capacités d’analyse, de structuration, de modélisation, de résolution de problèmes et de synthèse · Solide sens business, orientation impact et culture de la performance · Appétence marquée pour l’IA, les LLM et leurs usages au service de l’optimisation et de l’exécution · Rigueur, curiosité, autonomie, humilité, sens du collectif, communication claire et capacité à apprendre vite Informations complémentaires · Rattachement : Pôle Stratégie & Optimisation · Prise de poste souhaitée : dès que possible. · Lieu & organisation : poste basé au siège à Ajaccio en présentiel · Niveau de poste : Junior · Type de contrat : stage de fin d’étude ou CDI

items.desc: Sobre Alberto Palatchi Alberto Palatchi es una firma internacional de moda nupcial con una facturación aproximada de 8 millones de euros y el objetivo de crecer hasta los 50 millones. La clave: automatizar procesos, conectar sistemas y usar la inteligencia artificial en el día a día de todos los departamentos. Buscamos un perfil inquieto, con iniciativa y orientado a construir soluciones. Alguien a quien le apasione la IA, que disfrute resolviendo problemas técnicos y que vea en cada tarea repetitiva una oportunidad de automatizarla. No buscamos un perfil de IT tradicional ni un gestor de proyectos, sino a alguien que prefiera desarrollar una solución antes que preparar una presentación sobre ella. Tu misión Serás la persona de referencia en automatización e IA de la compañía. Tu trabajo será conectar sistemas, crear herramientas internas y eliminar tareas manuales en ventas, compras, producción, logística, finanzas y customer service. Durante la fase inicial trabajarás junto a nuestros especialistas externos en Odoo y directamente con el CEO, aprendiendo cómo funciona el negocio por dentro. El objetivo es que, en 3–6 meses, tengas autonomía técnica real sobre nuestro ecosistema y puedas liderar sus siguientes pasos. Qué harás IA y automatización Crear automatizaciones con Python, APIs, n8n o herramientas similares. Montar agentes y asistentes de IA que reduzcan la carga administrativa: seguimiento de pedidos, respuestas de customer service, reporting, comunicaciones. Integrar modelos de lenguaje (Claude, OpenAI, etc.) con los datos y sistemas de la empresa. Identificar de forma continua oportunidades de mejora de productividad mediante la tecnología. Integraciones y desarrollos internos Conectar Odoo con otras plataformas (e-commerce, logística, marketing, finanzas) mediante APIs y webhooks. Desarrollar aplicaciones internas que simplifiquen el trabajo de cada departamento. Construir de forma progresiva un panel central para la dirección con alertas, indicadores y accesos a las herramientas clave. Datos Contribuir a centralizar los datos de la compañía (por ejemplo, en Google BigQuery) y mantener pipelines automáticos. Crear dashboards en Looker Studio o similares con los KPIs de cada área. Garantizar la calidad, integridad y actualización de los datos. Odoo Aprender y asumir progresivamente la parte técnica de nuestro ERP Odoo junto al partner externo. Configurar flujos, automatizaciones y, con el tiempo, desarrollar módulos propios. Documentar lo que construyes para que el sistema sea mantenible y escalable. Qué buscamos Entre 1 y 3 años de experiencia en desarrollo, datos o automatización (incluyendo prácticas y proyectos propios). Buen nivel de Python y conocimientos de SQL. Experiencia con APIs REST: interpretación de documentación técnica, autenticación e integración de datos entre sistemas. Uso intensivo y práctico de herramientas de IA (LLMs, asistentes de código, agentes) en tu día a día. Nociones de Git y bases de datos relacionales. Inglés profesional, para la lectura de documentación técnica y la comunicación con proveedores. Portfolio, perfil de GitHub o proyectos propios que demuestren tu capacidad para resolver problemas reales. Se valorará Formación en Ingeniería Informática, Telecomunicaciones, Matemáticas, Data Science o similar, o un bootcamp con proyectos que lo demuestren. Experiencia con Odoo (configuración, Studio, módulos o su API). Experiencia con n8n, Make, Zapier o herramientas de orquestación de agentes de IA. Conocimientos de Google Cloud, BigQuery, Looker Studio o equivalentes. JavaScript, TypeScript o React para construir interfaces internas. Docker y nociones de despliegue. Interés por el negocio: ventas, logística, inventario, finanzas o comercio internacional. Experiencia en moda, retail, distribución o wholesale. Encajarás si… Te pasas el día probando nuevas herramientas de IA y piensas en cómo aplicarlas a un negocio real. Cuando algo se hace a mano tres veces, ya estás pensando cómo automatizarlo. Te gusta entender el porqué de los procesos, no solo el cómo. Eres autónomo/a: investigas, pruebas, te equivocas rápido y sacas cosas a producción. Te motiva más construir algo útil que tener un cargo bonito. Qué ofrecemos Salario de 28.000 a 33.000 € brutos anuales, según experiencia. Un proyecto con impacto directo y visible en toda la compañía desde el primer mes. Trabajo directo con el CEO y acompañamiento de especialistas en Odoo durante la fase inicial. Libertad para proponer y probar herramientas y tecnologías nuevas. Un plan de carrera con la posibilidad de evolucionar hacia un rol senior y de liderazgo tecnológico a medida que crezca la empresa.

items.desc: Chi siamo DeepAgent costruisce agenti AI vocali e WhatsApp che ogni giorno gestiscono migliaia di chiamate per aziende Enterprise e PMI (ad oggi siamo a 400k chiamata al mese). Da ottobre 2025 siamo cresciuti di oltre il 200% e puntiamo a un round Series A nel 2027. Il nostro modo di lavorare è semplice: la pratica viene prima della teoria, fatto è meglio che perfetto, il lavoro ripetitivo lo automatizziamo e ognuno è responsabile dei propri obiettivi. Il ruolo Lavorerai al fianco di Valeria Pagliarini, che segue tutta la Customer Base: onboarding, creazione e ottimizzazione degli agenti, messa in produzione e risultati per i clienti. È un ruolo a metà tra tecnica e cliente, e decide se un cliente resta con noi per anni o se ne va dopo qualche mese. Cosa farai Configurerai e testerai agenti vocali e WhatsApp: prompt, tool calling, variabili dinamiche Collegherai gli agenti ai software dei clienti, come CRM e calendari, tramite la nostra piattaforma (dalle subito un’occhiata) Userai Claude Code per scrivere script e automatizzare il lavoro ripetitivo. Analizzerai chiamate e trascrizioni per capire dove l'agente sbaglia, e lo correggerai con test ripetibili. Parlerai con i clienti per capire cosa gli serve e aiutarli a crescere nel tempo. Lavorerai a stretto contatto con il team Tech e Prodotto, portando i feedback dal campo per rendere la piattaforma sempre più solida e scalabile. Cosa ti serve Un background da developer: è fondamentale. Vivi e respiri AI: per te non è una moda passeggera ma uno strumento che usi ogni giorno. Uso pratico di Claude Code o di altri agenti di coding. Conoscenza degli agenti AI: prompt, tool calling, variabili dinamiche, test. Ti muovi a tuo agio con n8n, Make, Zapier o altri strumenti no-code/low-code, e ci costruisci soluzioni anche complesse. Basi di JavaScript e/o Python: sai scrivere e modificare script semplici, manipolare JSON e lavorare con le variabili. Esperienza di integrazione tra sistemi tramite API: protocollo HTTP, autenticazione OAuth e JWT, webhook. Basi di SQL. Italiano fluente e capacità di spiegare cose tecniche in modo semplice. È un plus se Hai già costruito un agente AI o un'automazione con un LLM, anche come progetto personale. Hai già lavorato a contatto con clienti. Chi cerchiamo Una persona curiosa, veloce e proattiva, che non si ferma al primo problema e ha voglia di costruire. Non è un semplice ruolo di supporto. Cosa offriamo Progetti AI tra i più innovativi in Italia: lavorerai con le tecnologie che stanno ridefinendo il modo in cui si lavora. Crescita esponenziale, professionale e personale: qui i limiti li decidi tu. Un team giovane e affamato di eccellenza, con persone brillanti che condividono la tua passione. Impatto concreto su brand che conosci: gli agenti e le automazioni che costruisci avranno un effetto diretto e misurabile. Un ambiente dove la tua voce conta, perché le buone idee non hanno gerarchie. Un headquarter da sogno a Roma: una splendida villa dove lavoro, innovazione e divertimento si incontrano. Aspettati brainstorming a bordo piscina dove condividiamo idee e obiettivi, in un ambiente che è tutto tranne che un ufficio tradizionale. Compenso e contratto Collaborazione a Partita IVA. Fisso da 1.500 a 2.000 € al mese, in base a seniority e track record. In bocca al lupo!

Här får du en central roll i att analysera och utveckla Sparaaffären genom att kombinera datamodellering, analys och tydlig kommunikation av insikter. Hos oss på Swedbank har du en möjlighet att: Arbeta end-to-end med data – från behovsidentifiering och datainsamling till modellering, analys och visualisering. Analysera och följa upp Sparaaffären ur ett produkt-, kund- och organisationsperspektiv. Identifiera mönster i data och omsätta dessa till konkreta, affärsnära rekommendationer. Ta fram beslutsunderlag och presentera insikter till management och andra seniora stakeholders. Bidra till och vidareutveckla datamodeller som möjliggör bättre uppföljning och styrning av affären. Utveckla och vidareutveckla dashboards och applikationer i Power BI och Qlik som stödjer analys och beslutsfattande. Samarbeta tvärfunktionellt med olika team för att driva datadrivna initiativ. I denna roll behöver du: Grundläggande krav: 2–4 års erfarenhet av att arbeta som Data Scientist, analytiker eller liknande, med fokus på att ta fram insikter från data. Stark erfarenhet av SQL och att arbeta med större datamängder. Erfarenhet av Python eller motsvarande verktyg för dataanalys, gärna med inslag av modellering. Erfarenhet av datamodellering och visualisering i BI-verktyg (t.ex. Power BI eller Qlik). Erfarenhet av att arbeta med hela analysprocessen – från data till insikt och presentation. God förmåga att kommunicera komplexa samband på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt. Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Bosatt i Sverige, med placering i Stockholm med omnejd. Relevant akademisk utbildning (t.ex. statistik, ekonomi, datavetenskap eller matematik. Meriterande kvalifikationer: Erfarenhet från arbete inom bank eller finansiella tjänster. Kunskap om sparande, pension eller försäkring. Förmåga att dela kunskap och bidra till teamets kompetensutveckling. Erfarenhet av att arbeta affärsnära och omsätta analys till konkreta rekommendationer. Hos oss kan du uppleva: Personlig och professionell utveckling genom självledarskap och kontinuerlig utveckling. Meningsfullt arbete som positivt påverkar vår arbetsplats, våra kunder och samhället. En öppen och samarbetsinriktad kultur som uppmuntrar tvärfunktionellt teamarbete och erbjuder nätverksmöjligheter. En stöttande och inkluderande miljö som främjar en balanserad och hållbar arbetslivssituation, med flexibla arbetsförhållanden när det passar rollen. Förmåner såsom vårt erbjudande för bankprodukter för anställda, tjänstepensionsplan, aktiebaserade belöningsprogram Eken, och friskvårdsbidraget. "Bli en del av vårt team och... Ta chansen att bli en del av vårt dynamiska och ambitiösa analysteam. Tillsammans hjälper vi Swedbank att bli mer datadrivna och stärker vår position inom Sparaområdet.'' Elias Jakobson, din framtida chef. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan senast den 2026-11-22. Placeringsort: Sundbyberg Rekryterande chef: Elias Jakobson Vi vill göra dig uppmärksam på att bakgrundskontroll och drogtest kan komma att genomföras för denna roll om du går vidare i processen. Vi har gjort vårt medieval för rekrytering och undanber oss därför kontakt med annonssäljare eller säljare av andra rekryteringstjänster. Swedbank är en inkluderande arbetsgivare och diskriminerar ingen utifrån kön, ålder, sexuell läggning eller sexuell identitet, etnicitet, religion eller funktionsnedsättning - alla är välkomna.

items.desc: Voor GewoonGers zijn wij per direct op zoek naar een AI Engineer Bouw jij met AI toepassingen die goed werk leveren? Bij GewoonGers krijg je de ruimte om software, integraties en nieuwe functionaliteiten te ontwikkelen die onze organisatie verder helpen. Onder andere voor ons e-commerceplatform en de systemen daarachter. Je gebruikt AI actief bij het ontwikkelen, testen en verbeteren van oplossingen. Je hoeft onze specifieke systemen of programmeertalen nog niet te beheersen. Wij vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je met concrete projecten kunt laten zien wat jij met AI kunt bouwen en hoe je zorgt dat het betrouwbaar werkt. Over de functie Als AI Engineer ben jij een belangrijke schakel binnen het IT-team. Je werkt nauw samen met de IT-manager en vertaalt wensen uit de organisatie naar werkende technische oplossingen. Je werkt zelfstandig aan projecten en stemt af met collega’s, interne developers en externe partijen. De nadruk ligt op het bouwen en doorontwikkelen van digitale toepassingen. Denk aan nieuwe functionaliteiten voor het e-commerceplatform, koppelingen tussen systemen en automatiseringen die handmatig werk verminderen. Je zet AI in om code te ontwikkelen, technische vraagstukken op te lossen en sneller van idee naar een bruikbare toepassing te komen. Je bent betrokken bij het hele proces: van het uitwerken van een oplossing en het maken van technische keuzes tot testen, implementeren en onderhouden. Daarbij beoordeel je kritisch wat AI oplevert en zorg je dat jouw oplossingen aansluiten op de bestaande omgeving. Wat ga je doen? Software bouwen en verbeteren: met behulp van AI nieuwe toepassingen en functionaliteiten ontwikkelen, onder meer voor het e-commerceplatform. Integraties realiseren: API-koppelingen bouwen en optimaliseren, zodat interne en externe systemen goed met elkaar communiceren. Systemen verbinden: gegevensstromen en processen verbeteren en terugkerende werkzaamheden automatiseren. Technische keuzes maken: samen met de IT-manager en developers nadenken over architectuur, onderhoudbaarheid en de beste aanpak. Kwaliteit bewaken: zelfgeschreven en door AI gegenereerde code beoordelen, testen en verbeteren, met aandacht voor performance, security en betrouwbaarheid. Samenwerken en afstemmen: werkzaamheden coördineren met interne collega’s en externe developers of freelancers. Verbeteringen doorvoeren: kansen signaleren, oplossingen bouwen en deze op basis van gebruik en feedback verder ontwikkelen. Wat breng jij mee? Jij bent een bouwer die graag onderzoekt, uitprobeert en doorpakt. Je maakt ideeën concreet en haalt voldoening uit toepassingen die daadwerkelijk worden gebruikt. Dit vinden wij belangrijk: Hbo-/wo-werk- en -denkniveau. Aantoonbare ervaring met het bouwen van software of digitale toepassingen met behulp van AI, vanuit werk of eigen projecten. Concrete voorbeelden van wat je hebt gerealiseerd, wat jouw bijdrage was en welk probleem je ermee hebt opgelost. Technisch inzicht om te begrijpen hoe toepassingen, gegevens en systemen met elkaar samenhangen. Een kritische blik op de kwaliteit van AI-output en het vermogen om oplossingen te testen en fouten te onderzoeken. Zelfstandigheid om een project van idee tot werkende toepassing te brengen. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden om technische keuzes met collega’s en externe partijen af te stemmen. Ervaring met specifieke systemen, programmeertalen of frameworks is geen harde eis. Jouw praktische ervaring met AI, leervermogen en aantoonbare resultaten zijn doorslaggevend. Ervaring met e-commerce, API-integraties, softwareontwikkeling of workflowautomatisering is mooi meegenomen. Wat bieden wij? Een uitdagende functie voor 32 tot 40 uur per week. Een marktconform salaris, passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring, conform de cao Metaal en Techniek. Veel ruimte om zelf toepassingen te bouwen en technische verbeteringen door te voeren. Directe invloed op de ontwikkeling van het e-commerceplatform en de achterliggende processen. Ruimte om nieuwe AI-mogelijkheden te onderzoeken en praktisch toe te passen. Een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23 per kilometer. De mogelijkheid om te trainen in onze eigen sportschool op kantoor. Een ondernemende werkomgeving met korte lijnen, waar je direct ziet wat jouw werk oplevert. Over GewoonGers GewoonGers is een Nederlands interieurmerk met Rotterdamse roots, gespecialiseerd in op maat gemaakte aluminium deuren, glazen wanden en akoestische wandpanelen. Sinds de oprichting in 2016 is de organisatie uitgegroeid tot een bedrijf met ruim 100 medewerkers. In Vlaardingen zitten kantoor, showroom en fabriek onder één dak. Klanten vinden hun weg naar GewoonGers via de webshop en showrooms in Vlaardingen en Amsterdam. Die combinatie van e-commerce, maatwerkproductie en dienstverlening biedt volop mogelijkheden om digitale oplossingen te bouwen die direct verschil maken. De mentaliteit is nuchter en ondernemend: korte lijnen, snel schakelen en veel aandacht voor de klant. Interesse? Solliciteer via LinkedIn of stuur …

items.desc: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact – on our colleagues, partners, customers and society. Together, we’re pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water and shipping. As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too. We are looking for a curious and analytically minded Global People Analytics and HR AI Specialist to join Alfa Laval’s People Analytics and Strategic Workforce Planning function. This is an opportunity for someone with a few years of experience in people analytics, HR systems, work technology, or a related field who wants to help shape how data and technology support better people decisions. You do not need extensive experience in every part of the role. What matters most is your analytical capability, technical curiosity, ability to work with people, and motivation to build something new. The role combines hands-on analysis with coordination, stakeholder management and project management. You will work closely with HR colleagues across the organization and help translate business and people questions into useful insights, practical solutions, and improved ways of working. The role is based in a hybrid working environment, with regular presence in the office in Lund and collaboration with colleagues across Alfa Laval. Your Responsibilities Coach and support HR colleagues in using data and analytics to answer business and people questions Support the establishment and day-to-day coordination of an HR AI CoE, helping colleagues explore use cases, share experiences and adopt AI responsibly. Co-design and deliver training and knowledge-sharing activities. Maintain and coordinate established employee survey processes and the Glint platform, ensuring reliable delivery and continuous improvements where needed. Coordinate data requests and analyses for annual and sustainability reporting, and ad hoc decision support Contribute to team-based deliveries as the scope of the function develops The role is primarily about analysis, coordination, and helping HR explore, evaluate and adopt new technologies, including automation and AI, with a focus on practical application, responsible use and creating value for the organization. It is not focused on operational HR reporting or building AI solutions. What You Bring A few years of experience in HR with analytics, business intelligence, and technology. Non technical HR experience is strongly meriting. Strong technical curiosity and the ability to learn new systems and tools quickly An interest and strong curiosity to figure out how to figure out how to make AI practically work in HR A strong analytical mindset and practical experience working with data. The ability to translate a business question into a meaningful analytical question including critically evaluate and challenge interpretations. An understanding or interest to learn of responsible technology use, including data privacy, acceptable use and ethical considerations. Strong communication skills and a highly collaborative approach A proactive mindset and a desire to make a practical impact Experience with tools such as Excel and usage of Power BI; experience with Workday, Glint, or Azure is meriting Project management or coordinator experience is meriting Experience with employee surveys, people analytics, change management, or AI adoption is an advantage, but extensive specialist experience is not required. Why join us? You will join a successful and collaborative team at a time when people analytics and AI are developing strongly. This role offers the opportunity to shape Alfa Laval’s employee listening approach, help build new HR AI practices, and develop your skills across analytics, technology, stakeholder management, and change leadership. Vi är inne i ett väldigt kul skede där data och AI gör livet lättare för både våra användare och oss på Unikum. Det gäller så klart också support - vill du leda resan? Om rollen Vi söker en tekniskt nyfiken supportspecialist till vårt Customer Success-team. Ditt uppdrag är att samla supporten i ett gemensamt system med gemensamma processer och att bygga en support där AI, kunskap och smarta flöden gör det enkelt att ge kunderna rätt hjälp snabbt. Samtidigt äger du tekniska ärenden från första analys till lösning eller eskalering. Så utvecklas rollen I början lägger du mest tid på ärendehantering och migrering till det gemensamma systemet. Där lär du känna kunderna, produkterna och utmaningarna. Det är grunden för nästa steg. Med tiden flyttas fokus till att bygga bort återkommande ärenden genom bättre processer, kunskap och AI-stöd. Ju bättre vi lyckas, desto mer av din tid går till utveckling. Det här kommer du att göra Utveckla AI-stöd för kunskapssökning, klassificering, prioritering och svarsförslag, och följa upp att det faktiskt fungerar Bidra till migrering till ett gemensamt supportsystem med nya ärendeflöden, kategorier, mallar och uppföljning Utreda tekniska ärenden kring behörigheter, konfigurationer, integrationer och dataflöden Ta fram reproducerbara steg och tekniskt underlag tillsammans med produkt- och utvecklingsteamen Förklara tekniska frågor begripligt för kunderna och hålla dem uppdaterade om nästa steg Använda ärendedata och AI för att hitta mönster, förbättra hjälpartiklar och föra kundinsikter vidare till rätt team Vi tror att du har god teknisk förståelse och är van att felsöka systematiskt är intresserad av hur system, databaser och integrationer hänger ihop är nyfiken på AI och vill bygga lösningar, inte bara använda dem tycker om kunddialog och kan förklara tekniska saker enkelt skriver och talar mycket god svenska och god engelska Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av SaaS, API, SSO, databaser, logganalys, systemigrering, automatisering eller kunskapshantering i support. Skolbakgrund är också ett plus. Bockar du inte av allt? Sök ändå! Vi värdesätter nyfikenhet och viljan att lära minst lika mycket som en komplett lista med erfarenheter. AI med omtanke Våra kunder är skolor, och våra användare är barn, elever och lärare. Därför bygger vi AI-stöd som hjälper människor, inte ersätter dem, och vi hanterar data tryggt och ansvarsfullt. items.desc: En BCNC Group buscamos un/a Data Scientist con orientación a negocio y experiencia en reporting y analítica financiera o comercial, capaz de transformar datos en recomendaciones que ayuden a mejorar los resultados de la compañía. ¿Cuáles serán tus funciones? Analizar datos financieros, comerciales y de ventas para identificar tendencias, desviaciones y oportunidades de mejora. Desarrollar y mantener dashboards e informes que faciliten la toma de decisiones. Elaborar y evaluar previsiones de negocio ( forecasts ), analizando las desviaciones entre las predicciones y los resultados reales. Definir, monitorizar y comunicar KPIs en colaboración con las áreas de negocio. Recoger requisitos y traducir las necesidades de los equipos en análisis e indicadores. Evaluar el impacto de estrategias de venta y acciones comerciales mediante comparativas A/B, análisis antes/después y otras técnicas. Comunicar conclusiones y recomendaciones a interlocutores técnicos y no técnicos. Proponer análisis de forma autónoma, cuestionando los datos y explorando patrones relevantes para el negocio. ¿Qué buscamos? Experiencia en reporting y analítica financiera o de ventas, en posiciones de Data Science, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, FP&A o similares. Dominio de SQL , incluyendo consultas complejas y optimización. Experiencia en visualización y reporting con Power BI, Tableau u otras herramientas de BI . Excel avanzado . Experiencia en elaboración y evaluación de forecasts, seguimiento y comunicación de KPIs. Comprensión de procesos ETL y modelado de datos . Experiencia en toma de requisitos e interlocución con stakeholders. Capacidad para convertir los resultados del análisis en recomendaciones concretas. Curiosidad, iniciativa y capacidad de comunicación. ¿Qué valoraremos? Experiencia en Controlling, Finanzas, Comercial o Ventas . Experiencia en análisis comparativos y evaluación del impacto de acciones comerciales. Conocimientos de Python y Pandas para análisis y automatización. Conocimientos de estadística y Data Science. Uso de Git para el control de versiones. Conocimientos de entornos cloud. Conocimiento del sector aéreo . ¿Te interesa? Si disfrutas analizando datos y ayudando a los equipos de negocio a tomar mejores decisiones, ¡queremos conocerte! Inscríbete y comparte tu CV con nosotros.

items.desc: About The Role What if your curiosity and creative thinking could make AI safer for millions of people? We're looking for AI Red Team Testers to do something genuinely unique: try to break AI systems on purpose. Your job is to think like an adversary — crafting clever prompts, unexpected scenarios, and edge cases that expose weaknesses in AI models before they reach the real world. The issues you find directly shape how AI systems are improved, making this one of the most impactful roles in AI development today. This is a fully remote, flexible contract role open to curious, analytical thinkers from any background. No cybersecurity or hacking experience required. Organization: Alignerr Type: Hourly Contract Location: Remote Commitment: 10–40 hours/week What You'll Do Design creative prompts, scenarios, and conversation flows to probe AI model weaknesses Attempt to elicit incorrect, unsafe, biased, or policy-violating outputs from AI systems Document every failure mode you discover with clear, reproducible steps Rate the severity and potential impact of identified issues Provide structured, detailed feedback using evaluation tools and rubrics Collaborate asynchronously with AI safety and research teams Work independently on your own schedule across varied and intellectually stimulating tasks Who You Are Naturally curious — you enjoy thinking around corners and finding unexpected solutions Comfortable with adversarial thinking and pushing systems to their limits Detail-oriented and systematic — you document findings clearly and thoroughly Strong written communication skills in English Able to assess and articulate the severity and context of issues you discover No prior AI, cybersecurity, or technical background required Nice to Have Experience in writing, journalism, research, or critical analysis Familiarity with AI tools or large language models as an end user Background in ethics, philosophy, psychology, or social science Prior experience in quality assurance, testing, or evaluation roles Why Join Us Work on real AI safety projects alongside leading research labs and top AI teams Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you Freelance autonomy with meaningful, intellectually engaging task-based work Contribute directly to making AI systems safer and more reliable for everyone Variety in every session — no two testing scenarios are the same Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch
