Le sens de l’adaptation et le goût de l’effort sont des qualités indispensables. Être officier, c’est être en situation de responsabilité, en particulier auprès du personnel placé sous ses ordres. Cela suppose d’avoir le sens de l’humain et une certaine forme d’exigence vis-à-vis de soi-même. ESIOC 62.430 Mont-de-Marsan Les missions de l’Escadron des systèmes d’information opérationnels et de cyberdéfense 62.430 s’articulent autour de 4 pôles : la réalisation de systèmes d’information opérationnels, y compris embarqués sur aéronef, le soutien de systèmes d’information opérationnels déployés sur les théâtres d’opération, la cyberdéfense, et la valorisation des données Air par une approche orientée Big Data. POSTE Vos missions au sein des équipes : Au sein du Département du Numérique et de la Donnée et plus précisément de la Division Valorisation de la Donnée, le scientifique de la donnée est chargé de développer des programmes permettant de s'appuyer sur la fouille de données, les statistiques, les méthodes de référencement, l’apprentissage automatique et la visualisation de données, dans le but d’aider à la prise de décision, ainsi que d’effectuer de la recherche fondamentale. Activités principales : Organiser et animer la section ; Piloter et organiser les phases de ses projets ; Mettre les données massives ("Big Data") et les données classiques des organismes du ministère au service de la compréhension des décideurs ; Elaborer des modèles prédictifs afin d’anticiper l’évolution des données et des tendances relatives à l’activité de l’organisme considéré ; Concevoir les modèles statistiques, bâtir les bases de données ou l'apprentissage statistique pour soutenir la prise de décision ; Modéliser des résultats d’analyse des données afin de les rendre lisibles et exploitables par les décideurs ; Recommander des stratégies en innovation et transformation numérique pour les états-majors ; Estimer la complexité et la charge, sur le volet IA, des besoins exprimés. CONDITIONS PARTICULIÈRES : Vous justifiez d’une expérience professionnelle dans le domaine scientifique de la donnée . DIPLÔME – FORMATION : Vous justifiez d’un bac+5 ou équivalent en génie mathématique; dans le domaine de l’informatique, des systèmes d’information ou de la donnée. COMPÉTENCES SPÉCIFIQUES REQUISES : Vous possédez plusieurs des compétences suivantes : Développement algorithme intelligence artificielle Evaluation de solutions intégrant l’IA Ingénierie et conduite de projet de SI Statistiques exploitation de données Intégration intelligence artificielle Proposition de solutions optimisées Veille technologique SIC QUALITÉS RECHERCHÉES : Vous êtes organisé·e, rigoureux·se et autonome ; Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et la collaboration transverse ; Vous faites preuve de curiosité, d’adaptabilité et d’esprit d’analyse RECRUTEMENT : Grade et échelon définis selon l’expérience et/ou les diplômes détenus.

items.desc:
Introduction to the job 
 Do you enjoy solving algorithm design problems for the semiconductor metrology industry, with demanding time, accuracy, and memory requirements? Do you like to use your creativity, your in-depth knowledge of physics principles, numerical math's and machine learning, and your hands-on experience with practical problem solving, being part of a highly talented group of algorithm experts?
 Role and responsibilities 
 In this role you will focus on scanner modeling and optical and mathematical models and methods required to infer physical model parameters from optical metrology data. Relevant new metrics, calibrations and algorithms as well as new measurement functions, with optimum performance characteristics, are identified, designed and implemented. The availability and development of fast and accurate machine learning models and metrology inference strategies is essential.
 As a Mathematics Machine Learning Engineer you will be doing the following:
 Development of models for scanners and optical metrology solutions with statistically correct parameter inference, deep learning and optimization algorithms, and system calibrations, to improve semiconductor high-volume fab control solutions.
 Implement machine learning and deep learning scanner models and metrology applications, with a mindset for scalable data-intensive and distributed software architectures, at the interface with colleague physics, data science, and software groups at ASML.
 Communicate crystal clearly on physical principles, mathematical solutions and design decisions to stakeholders, without omitting the essentials.
 Drive for data and code quality, and collaborate and help to implement along industry coding best practices.
 Work as a team with similar-minded people, benefitting from each other’s specific competences.
 Design and realize fully functional proof-of-concept subsystems on the edge of system specifications, costs and project planning, thereby contributing directly to products for B2B customers world-wide.
 Review technical analyses from the team, and structure team contributions keeping the overview.
 Consolidate technical-team identity in communication with other departments.
 Contribute to technical product roadmaps and generate intellectual property protecting ASML products, while developing the best metrology solutions and a well-founded vision on semiconductor metrology.
 Keywords: Mathematical optimization, optical modeling and calibration, mathematics, inverse problem, parameter inference, (non-)convex optimization, machine learning, deep learning, neural network, regression, information theory.
 Education and experience 
 Ph.D. in Applied Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, or Electrical Engineering.
 0-3 year of working experience.
 Skills 
 Excellence in numerically stable modeling and inference strategies, using sound physical-mathematical principles and insights
 Ability to explain physical principles and algorithmic solutions in a crisp way, without omitting the essentials
 Excellence in numerical mathematics, and affinity with machine learning methods, data-intensive and distributed software architecture (cloud) as environment for metrology applications
 Drive for structuring the scripting code base in the cluster, and be energized by helping colleagues in this
 Fluency in the languages Python, C++, MATLAB, or Julia, and awareness of compatibility with other software
 Sound understanding of the fundamentals such as optics, linear algebra, probability theory, robust optimization and (deep) learning methods
 Drive creative solutions within the bigger picture, with the product and customer in mind
 Initiating, self-propelling and decisive in an ambiguous environment
 Team worker, and ability to influence without power
 Pragmatic approach and pro-active attitude, with result focus and a ‘can do’ spirit
 Other 
 We would like to receive a letter of motivation in which it is clearly stated how you have applied your knowledge and experience in practice. 
 Please note that applications will only be reviewed starting in week 35 due to the holiday period

items.card: Job Description: Airbus Defence & Space recrute un(e) Artificial Intelligence & Image Processing Engineer for Space Systems (f/h) à Toulouse. Au sein de l'unité « Ground, Image & Navigation Solutions », le département « Image Engineering & Solutions » conçoit, développe et maintient les chaînes de traitement d’images pour les missions d'observation de la Terre, de surveillance de l’espace et d'exploration spatiale.
items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Airbus Defence & Space recrute un(e) Artificial Intelligence & Image Processing Engineer for Space Systems (f/h) à Toulouse.
 Au sein de l'unité « Ground, Image & Navigation Solutions », le département « Image Engineering & Solutions » conçoit, développe et maintient les chaînes de traitement d’images pour les missions d'observation de la Terre, de surveillance de l’espace et d'exploration spatiale.
 Vous rejoindrez l'équipe « Vision & Image Processing » , un collectif de plus de 25 ingénieurs et docteurs alliant expertise de pointe en traitement d'images, vision par ordinateur, architecture et développement logiciel. Notre périmètre couvre également l’architecture des systèmes et sous-systèmes imageurs spatiaux, répondant à de fortes exigences d'opérabilité, de volumétrie et de qualité métrique.
 Pionniers du déploiement industriel du deep learning en production spatiale depuis 2021 (notamment sur Pléiades Néo HD15), nous exploitons l'apprentissage automatique pour repousser les limites de la qualité géométrique et radiométrique. Votre rôle consistera à concevoir et intégrer ces technologies d'IA au cœur des performances des systèmes actuels et futurs d’Airbus Defence and Space.
 Votre environnement de travail : 
 Capitale mondiale de l'aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche dans le spatial, Toulouse est une ville dynamique du sud-ouest de la France desservie par un aéroport international. Idéalement située entre la mer Méditerranée et l' océan Atlantique et à proximité des Pyrénées, elle offre de nombreuses possibilités d'activités de plein air !
 Parce que nous prenons soin de vous : 
 Avantages financiers: Salaire attractif, accords d’intéressement et de participation, plan d'épargne salariale abondé par Airbus, plan d’actionnariat salarié sur la base du volontariat, avec attribution d'actions gratuites en fonction du nombre d’actions souscrites.
 Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle: Des jours de congés supplémentaires pour occasions spéciales et des options de transfert de congés, un comité d'entreprise proposant de nombreuses activités socio-culturelles et sportives et d’autres services.
 Bien-être / santé: couverture complémentaire des frais de santé et de prévoyance (incapacité, invalidité, décès). Selon le site : centre de services de santé, services de conciergerie, salle de sport, application de covoiturage.
 Développement individuel: des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, parcours expert, mobilité nationale et internationale).
 Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation.
 Vos missions principales : 
 Ingénierie système & cadrage : analyser les exigences client, contribuer à la définition architecturale des solutions et assurer l'interface technique avec les équipes système, instrumentation optique et segment sol.
 R&D & conception algorithmique : concevoir et prototyper des algorithmes avancés pour optimiser la qualité radiométrique et géométrique des instruments imageurs (projets opérationnels et R&D, du simulateur aux briques logicielles qualifiées).
 Industrialisation & qualification : définir les métriques de performance, piloter les campagnes d'évaluation (qualification, photo-interprétation) et fiabiliser le passage à l'échelle des modèles au sein des chaînes de traitement opérationnelles.
 Veille technologique : évaluer l'état de l'art algorithmique et adapter les innovations externes aux contraintes des systèmes spatiaux.
 Documentation technique : rédiger les dossiers de justification, spécifications fonctionnelles, plans de validation et rapports de performance.
 Développement transverse : contribuer progressivement au montage d'offres techniques et diffuser l'expertise en ingénierie guidée par la donnée sur l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur spatiale.
 Votre profil : 
 Formation supérieure (Bac+5 ou doctorat) en traitement d'images, vision par ordinateur, informatique ou mathématiques appliquées.
 Expérience confirmée en conception d'algorithmes de traitement d'images par apprentissage automatique ( deep learning appliqué aux problèmes inverses, super-résolution, débruitage, recalage), au-delà des seules tâches classiques de classification ou segmentation.
 Maîtrise avancée du développement sous Linux via l'écosystème Python scientifique ; la maîtrise du C++ et la pratique du calcul haute performance (HPC/GPU) constituent des atouts majeurs.
 Solide bagage mathématique (optimisation, estimation statistique, modélisation physique).
 Une expérience dans le domaine spatial (qualité image, systèmes imageurs, segment sol) ou dans des domaines proches à fortes …

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a
 Mission Systems Equipment Design Responsible (d/f/m) 
 Your Mission 
 As Equipment Design Responsible, you will be the technical authority for airborne equipment throughout its entire lifecycle, for various weapon systems. You will transform operational and system-level needs into robust, certifiable equipment solutions, working closely with international suppliers and multidisciplinary engineering teams. You will ensure that equipment designs meet demanding performance, qualification, and certification requirements while supporting integration, testing and in-service operations. This role offers a unique combination of design responsibility, technical depth and direct influence on the successful delivery of advanced airborne capabilities.
 Your location (Manching) 
 Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.
 Your benefits 
 Attractive salary and special payments
 30 days holidays and extra days-off for special occasions
 Excellent upskilling opportunities and great international, group wide development prospects
 Special benefits: employer-funded pension, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special conditions for insurances, subsidies for public transport, employee benefits at cooperating companies
 On-site-facilities: Medical officer for check-ups and other health-related services, canteen and cafeterias, kindergarten close to the site 
 Compatibility of family & work (part-time models, flexible working hours, individual timeout)
 Networking and connection: Employee events, groups and initiatives
 Working in a diverse environment, with more than 140 nationalities, where every voice is heard

 Own the technical responsibility of airborne mission systems equipment throughout the full development lifecycle, including in-service support activities.

items.desc:
WHY FACULTY? 


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here https://faculty.ai/impact.



We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.



Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.



AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

 


ABOUT THE TEAM 

 

Our Energy, Transition and Environment business unit is pioneering meaningful change in the clean energy revolution. Our vision is to accelerate the transition to net-zero emissions and drive efficiencies for a new era of utility companies.

 

We believe that the responsible, and intelligent, deployment of AI is critical to the success of this mission. We partner with a wide range of clients - from major energy operators, to GreenTech startups, and national infrastructure providers - to build solutions which return measurable impact and move us towards a smarter, cleaner, and more sustainable world.

 



ABOUT THE ROLE

 

As an Associate, you’ll be part of a close-knit team - scoping, building and delivering impactful AI projects for our clients in the industry. 

We’ll look to you to build trusted client relationships, analyse requirements and feedback, stay on top of workflows and help to ensure our bespoke AI tools are optimised for real-world operations.

This is an exciting, new role for an individual motivated to build their knowledge of AI transformation in the Energy value chain. 

 
 


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 

 - Managing individual work streams to support the successful delivery and implementation of bespoke AI solutions

 - Working side-by-side with Government stakeholders to understand critical mission challenges and user needs

 - Conducting open-source analysis to support the development of cutting-edge AI tools

 - Translating complex operational requirements into clear user stories for delivery and engineering teams.

 - Designing and testing workflows that support user-centric decision-making in high-stakes environments

 - Collaborating closely with technical teams to ensure projects run smoothly and solutions meet customer needs

 - Contributing to internal thought leadership, strategy, and capability development across the team
   
    


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 

 - You demonstrate analytical thinking, can clearly communicate ideas, and synthesise complex information

 - You have some experience working on AI/data intensive projects in the Energy sector

 - You have external client-facing experience and have built trusted relationships which have contributed to the overall success of projects/products

 - You’ve worked with technical teams

 - You understand Agile and related methodologies and the basis of iterative development and continuous delivery

 - You are thoughtful and proactive in ambiguous situations, with examples of when you’ve taken initiative and owned finding solutions to challenges

 - You’re excited and knowledgeable about the possibilities for innovation in  Government technology 

 
 


OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS



 1. Talent Team Screen (30 mins)

 2. Introduction Interview (60 mins)

 3. Case Study Interview (60 mins)








OUR RECRUITMENT ETHOS




We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.



If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours. 



A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

Job Description: 
 Your impact 
 Are you ready to launch your career and make an impact on real-world projects from day one? 
 At Leonardo, we’re looking for graduates who want to be part of something bigger—shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. 
 We are committed to developing our graduates into leading technical or business professionals, and as such we will also support you through your preferred route for professional development. 
 Our 18-month Graduate Programmes give you the opportunity to work on exciting and challenging projects alongside subject matter experts. 
 ​Systems Engineers are involved in all aspects of design and development; from initial product design through to in-service support. 
 They look at the big picture, determine how the system needs to operate and collaborate to produce the required overall operational behaviours. They also dive into the deepest level of detail – taking the system piece-by-piece and defining its design to the finest point. Our Systems Engineers can also actively engage in R&D, developing new concepts and conducting fundamental research into our future technologies. 
On joining, you will receive a starting salary of £34,000 per annum, plus a £1,000 welcome bonus. You’ll also be eligible for a £1,000 exit bonus upon successful completion of the programme. In addition, you may be eligible for a Temporary Accommodation Allowance (TAA), subject to specific criteria. 
 We encourage you to spend at least three days each week on site to integrate with your team and maximise your learning experience. 
 During the programme, you will: 
 Work on real engineering problems and have the opportunity to be involved in supporting a wide range of tasks across multiple projects/products, which covers Sea, Land, Air and space domains. 
 Be part of a dynamic and innovative team who will provide day-to-day guidance and on-the-job training, introducing you to systems engineering processes, methods, technology and tools. 
 Receive targeted training, developing the engineering skills and necessary domain knowledge required to achieve technical excellence and be a successful Systems Engineer. 
 What you’ll bring 
 All of our Graduate roles require (a) a minimum of an lower Second class Bachelors/Integrated Master’s degree, or (b) a higher degree, such as an MSc or PhD. In all cases the subject should be engineering, mathematics, physics or another STEM discipline. 
 In addition to this, we would be interested in hearing from you if you have experience in: 
 Coding/programming. 
 Relevant project work and/or placements in industry. 
 Solving problems as part of a team 
 Applying your science and technology knowledge to solve a real world problem 
 Security Clearance 
 Many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations. As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years. 
 For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV). As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment. 
 To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years. In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks. Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment. 
 For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting 
 Why join us 
 At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do, key contributors in shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. 
 We offer a comprehensive, company-funded benefits package that supports your wellbeing, career development, and work–life balance. Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive. 
 Time to recharge: Enjoy generous leave with the opportunity to accrue up to 12 additional flexi-days each year. 
 Secure your future: Benefit from our award-winning pension scheme with up to 15% employer contribution. 
 Your wellbeing matters: Free access to mental health support, financial advice, and employee-led networks championing inclusion and diversity (Enable, Pride, Equalise, Armed Forces, Carers, Wellbeing and Ethnicity). 
 Rewarding performance : All employees …

items.desc: Description The purpose of this role is to shape the public and political debate around data centre expansion and cloud sovereignty in Europe. The consultant will lead strategic communications across two connected areas: supporting campaigns challenging unsustainable data centre construction and building support for stronger sovereignty requirements in cloud procurement. A successful outcome would see a stronger European debate around sustainable and sovereign digital infrastructure, with campaign narratives focused on constructive policy solutions rather than polarising culture-war arguments. It would also build greater political and public support for reducing dependency on dominant hyperscalers and strengthening sovereignty requirements in cloud procurement. How you'll contribute Engage with and support organisations campaigning for democratic pacing and more stringent safeguards on data centre construction, helping to shape communications and campaign narratives towards constructive policy outcomes. Develop and deliver strategic communications to build public and political support for stronger democratic and sustainability requirements for data centre construction in Europe. Develop and deliver strategic communications to build public and political support for stronger sovereignty requirements in cloud procurement, challenging dependency in sensitive public and private sectors. Develop messaging, campaign framing and media strategies to support TBIP’s wider sustainable and sovereign data centres work, helping to build a compelling narrative around sustainable and sovereign digital infrastructure. Work closely with relevant TBIP and FOTI policy, advocacy and campaign colleagues, as well as external stakeholders, to ensure communications activity supports and strengthens wider policy and advocacy objectives. Our ideal candidate has Must haves: Demonstrable experience developing and delivering strategic communications and campaign strategies, ideally in a policy, advocacy or public affairs context. Strong understanding of the European political and policy landscape, with the ability to translate complex issues into clear, compelling public-facing narratives. Experience shaping campaign messaging, influencing public debate and identifying opportunities for media and political engagement. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical or policy issues to non-specialist audiences. Experience working collaboratively with campaigners, policy experts, advocacy organisations and external stakeholders. Ability to work independently, respond flexibly to emerging opportunities and manage competing priorities Fluency in written and spoken English, our working language; Nice to haves: Knowledge of European digital policy, particularly digital sovereignty, cloud infrastructure, data centres or competition in digital markets. Experience working on environmental sustainability, technology policy or corporate accountability campaigns. Established relationships with European media, policymakers, civil society organisations or relevant campaign networks. items.desc: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. The Engineering team In our engineering team, we build the infrastructure, interfaces, and applications to provide first-class service to our members, health professionals, and even ourselves! Being an engineer at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate engineers, with a lot of product interaction. We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems! Our process is very simple: those who make product decisions are the same ones who build them. Want to know more? Read this article if you want to discover how life as an Engineer at Alan and this article on our Engineering career pat The stack Python services on FastAPI, async SQLAlchemy and PydanticAI, Temporal for durable execution, PostgreSQL, MCP, Daytona sandboxes, various LLM model providers, Terraform on AWS, React with Vite. Our main backend is a Flask monolith. We deploy daily and believe in distributed ownership: you build it, you own it. The Agentic Platform area In 2027, we expect to run more AI agents than we have employees . Agents already do real work at Alan. They answer members' health questions, resolve support requests, read medical documents, detect fraud, automate operational tasks, and write a large share of our code. But every team building an agent ends up solving the same hard problems again: how to call models safely with health data, how to give an agent tools and the right permissions, how to know whether a prompt change made it better or worse, how to debug what it did. The result: several agent frameworks and evaluation stacks, each with its own security and compliance story. The Agentic Platform area was created to fix that. Our mission: make it cheap, fast and safe for every Alaner or crew to build, run and improve agentic products and workflows. We own the environment agents run in (infrastructure, runtime, evaluation, observability, skills lifecycle), with security, privacy and compliance by design, and the generalist products on top: Hopper and the Agent Studio. Product teams and all Alaners own their agents, skills, and their outcomes. We give them the paved road. Two crews, one team: Hopper is every Alaner's AI companion. Five months after it started, 80% of Alaners use it, 3k sessions are created each day, and about 30% of our pull requests are opened from it (watch how we built it). AI Product Platform builds the shared blocks every AI product at Alan runs on. For instance, our ops teams now build agents autonomously on our Ops AI Platform (read how, watch the talk). Problems you'll only find here Run agents at scale One runtime for every AI product. A shared agent framework, from a single model call to multi-agent workflows with live streaming, and one gateway to every model: routing, failover across providers, quotas and cost per use case built in. Agent sessions that last for hours. Durable sessions, started from the web, Slack, Linear or GitHub, that survive pod restarts and deploys, and pick up exactly where they left off. Sandboxes at scale. An isolated environment for every agent session and every evaluation, on an infrastructure compliant with sensitive data, with negligible boot overhead. Make agents trustworthy and proactive One tool gateway to the whole company. An MCP gateway that connects agents to internal tools and data, external services, computer use, managing identity and credentials. Agents safely acting on critical data. We give each agent no more than the access it needs. Every tool call goes through identity, permissions, confirmations and audit. No sensitive data leaks. Evals you can replay in time. Re-run an agent or skill against production as it was at a past point in time, on real data, safely isolated. Anyone can ship knowing their change is an improvement rather than a regression. Elle a engagé sa transformation AI. Des agents analysent déjà les anomalies et proposent des correctifs, que l'équipe évalue puis vérifie sur cible. L'objectif est d'étendre cette démarche à tout le cycle de développement, de la conception aux tests. Description de la mission Votre rôle Rattaché·e au responsable d’équipe logiciel, vous développez et maintenez le logiciel des compteurs d’eau Sagemcom. Vous savez décomposer un problème, structurer le contexte et écrire des spécifications claires : ce sont désormais vos premiers leviers de productivité. Vous jugez sur des preuves (tests, mesures sur cible), pas sur la vraisemblance du code généré. Curieux·se, adaptable et doté·e d’un bon relationnel, vous avez de réelles capacités d’analyse et de synthèse. Force de proposition, vous partagez volontiers vos pratiques pour faire progresser l’équipe. Sagemcom est une entreprise handi-accueillante. Labellisé « Cluster IA » dans le cadre de France 2030 avec un financement de 70 millions d'euros jusqu'en 2029, il développe une recherche interdisciplinaire de classe mondiale, soutient l'innovation et propose des formations en IA. En synergie avec le réseau national 3IA, l'UGA porte le projet EFELIA-MIAI ( École Française de l'IA ), visant la labellisation de formations, la mise en place de plateformes de calcul, ainsi que la création de cours pilotes et de contenus pédagogiques (MOOC/SPOC) partagés au niveau national. Dans ce cadre, l'UFR STAPS (Sciences et Techniques des Activités Physiques et Sportives) développe des actions de formation innovantes intégrant l'Intelligence Artificielle à l'analyse du mouvement humain et au sport-santé. Découvrez le MIAI : https://miai.univ-grenoble-alpes.fr/ Missions principales Sous l’autorité du Directeur de l’UFR STAPS et en coordination avec la cheffe de projet Pédagogies de MIAI Cluster, vous contribuerez à la conception, au déploiement et à la valorisation de dispositifs de formation innovants en IA appliquée aux domaines du sport, de la santé et de la performance. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les enseignants-chercheurs, les ingénieurs pédagogiques du réseau EFELIA et les partenaires académiques régionaux (USMB, UCA). Activités principales Concevoir et déployer des modules de formation en IA pour les parcours de Licence (ES, APAS) et Master (EOPS, APAS, Management Sportif), incluant la création de ressources pédagogiques no-code (reconnaissance de gestes, analyse vidéo, suivi GPS, visualisation 3D). Développer des travaux pratiques et dirigés (TP/TD sous Python et R, Jupyter Notebooks) axés sur le traitement des données du mouvement humain pour les étudiants de Master. Former et accompagner les enseignants de l'UFR STAPS pour garantir leur autonomie dans l'enseignement des outils d'IA. Produire, organiser et évaluer les ressources multimédias et supports pédagogiques (tutoriels vidéo, guides pratiques, jeux de données annotés, exercices interactifs). Animer des ateliers pratiques, séminaires et constituer une communauté de pratique au sein de l'UFR. Participer à la création de modules de formation continue pour les professionnels, en lien avec la Direction de la Formation Continue (UGA / Grenoble INP-UGA). Intervenir lors d'ateliers de sensibilisation (Summer Schools, grand public) et représenter MIAI Cluster lors de congrès et salons. Constituer, gérer et mener à jour l’inventaire des ressources éducatives du projet EFELIA-MIAI et alimenter la librairie en ligne du cluster. Assurer une veille scientifique et technologique continue sur les innovations en IA appliquée à l'analyse du mouvement. Contraintes liées au poste : Déplacements ponctuels à prévoir pour la représentation de MIAI Cluster sur des salons/congrès ou des interventions lors de Summer Schools. Compétences attendues Solides connaissances des outils et méthodes d'IA (traitement du signal, apprentissage profond / deep learning, préparation et annotation de jeux de données). Maîtrise avancée de la programmation en Python (la maîtrise de R et des notebooks Jupyter est vivement souhaitée). Ingénierie pédagogique : scénarisation d'activités multimédias et interactives pour publics spécialistes et non-spécialistes. Maîtrise ou appétence pour la configuration et le traitement des données issues de capteurs de mouvement (EMG, centrales inertielles, plateformes de force, GPS, caméras, drones) et logiciels d'analyse du mouvement. Maîtrise des techniques de conduite de projet et de travail collaboratif pluridisciplinaire. Aisance rédactionnelle et capacités de présentation orale (français et anglais technique courant). Rigueur scientifique, esprit d'analyse et sens de la synthèse. Aisance relationnelle, pédagogie et qualités d'écoute pour l'accompagnement des utilisateurs (enseignants, étudiants). Autonomie, proactivité et sens des initiatives. Esprit d'équipe, adaptabilité et goût pour la transmission des savoirs. Expérience professionnelle souhaitée : 2 à 5 ans. Formation / Diplôme : Diplôme d'Ingénieur ou Master 2 (Bac+5) en informatique, sciences de données, sciences de l'ingénieur ou bio-mécanique/STAPS avec forte composante numérique. items.desc: Sede di lavoro: Roma Sud – Casal Palocco / Axa Tipologia: Full-time – 40 ore settimanali Modalità: In presenza Esperienza: Junior, preferibilmente 1–3 anni Chi siamo Siamo una realtà imprenditoriale impegnata nella progettazione, nello sviluppo e nella commercializzazione di piattaforme software innovative destinate ad aziende e professionisti. L'intelligenza artificiale rappresenta una componente centrale del nostro metodo di lavoro: utilizziamo strumenti AI avanzati per accelerare lo sviluppo, migliorare la qualità del software e realizzare soluzioni tecnologiche evolute. Per ampliare la nostra struttura cerchiamo uno Sviluppatore Software Full Stack Junior, appassionato di programmazione, nuove tecnologie e intelligenza artificiale. Di cosa ti occuperai Entrerai a far parte di un ambiente dinamico, lavorando direttamente con la Direzione alla realizzazione di piattaforme digitali già progettate a livello di struttura, logica funzionale e interfaccia. Il tuo compito sarà trasformare i progetti esistenti in applicazioni software complete, funzionanti e affidabili. In particolare, ti occuperai di: Sviluppare applicazioni web e piattaforme gestionali. Utilizzare strumenti di programmazione assistita dall'intelligenza artificiale, come Google Antigravity, Claude Code, ChatGPT o soluzioni equivalenti. Trasformare mockup HTML e specifiche funzionali in applicazioni operative. Sviluppare e integrare frontend, backend e database. Realizzare collegamenti con API e servizi esterni. Implementare nuove funzionalità su piattaforme esistenti. Analizzare, verificare e correggere il codice generato anche attraverso strumenti AI. Individuare e risolvere anomalie tecniche. Eseguire test funzionali e controlli di qualità. Collaborare all'ottimizzazione, alla sicurezza e alla stabilità delle applicazioni. La progettazione grafica, la struttura delle piattaforme e i mockup sono già gestiti internamente. Competenze richieste Conoscenza di JavaScript e/o TypeScript. Familiarità con React, Next.js o framework equivalenti. Conoscenze di sviluppo backend e database SQL. Capacità di utilizzare Git e strumenti di sviluppo software. Esperienza o familiarità concreta con strumenti AI applicati alla programmazione. Capacità di comprendere, modificare e verificare codice sorgente. Conoscenza della lingua inglese almeno a livello B2, scritto e parlato. Attitudine al problem solving, precisione e autonomia operativa. Competenze preferenziali Saranno considerate positivamente conoscenze di: Node.js e PostgreSQL. Python. Docker e ambienti cloud. API e integrazioni con modelli di intelligenza artificiale. Playwright, Vitest e strumenti di testing automatizzato. Automazione dei processi di sviluppo software. Utilizzo di agenti AI per lo sviluppo e la manutenzione delle applicazioni. Non è indispensabile una laurea. Valutiamo anche diplomati informatici, diplomati ITS Academy e candidati che abbiano sviluppato competenze attraverso esperienze pratiche o progetti personali. Cosa offriamo Opportunità di lavorare su progetti software innovativi e concreti. Utilizzo quotidiano di strumenti avanzati di intelligenza artificiale. Collaborazione diretta con la Direzione aziendale. Possibilità di contribuire allo sviluppo di più piattaforme digitali. Ambiente tecnologico orientato all'innovazione e alla crescita professionale. Opportunità di apprendimento e specializzazione nelle tecnologie AI applicate allo sviluppo software. Chi cerchiamo Una persona curiosa, motivata e appassionata di tecnologia, che non si limiti a utilizzare l'intelligenza artificiale per generare codice, ma voglia comprenderlo, migliorarlo e utilizzarlo per sviluppare software di qualità. Cerchiamo soprattutto capacità pratiche, affidabilità, voglia di imparare e attitudine a risolvere problemi. Come candidarsi Invia il tuo curriculum vitae specificando: Linguaggi di programmazione e tecnologie conosciute. Strumenti di intelligenza artificiale utilizzati nello sviluppo software. Eventuali progetti realizzati, anche personali, con link GitHub o dimostrazioni. Livello di conoscenza della lingua inglese. Disponibilità a lavorare in presenza nella zona di Roma Casal Palocco. La selezione comprenderà un colloquio conoscitivo e una breve prova tecnica pratica, finalizzata a valutare le competenze effettive. Se ti appassiona sviluppare software utilizzando le nuove potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, inviaci la tua candidatura. items.desc: Data Scientist - Credit Risk Modelling At a glance We are looking for new medior colleagues to join our Non-Retail Credit Risk Modelling team within ABN AMRO's Risk Modelling department. Effectively managing risks is essential in banking. The importance of modelling in core banking processes, such as risk management, is growing rapidly. New technologies, data sources, and data-driven solutions bring countless opportunities. These opportunities drive competition and increasing regulatory demands on data and models. ABN AMRO is taking a proactive step by leveraging these opportunities to strengthen its competitive position. The Risk Modelling department aims to create risk models that enable risk-based decision-making and sustainable growth. Our models comply with regulations, accurately predict risks, and allow us to offer clients a sustainable price that aligns with their risk profile. Our team is committed to being at the forefront and cutting edge of these developments. Your job As a data scientist in the Non-Retail Credit Risk Modelling department, you play a key role in redeveloping credit risk models for various lending portfolios. You and your team are central to reshaping ABN AMRO’s credit risk model landscape, one of the major challenges in the bank’s risk management. In this role, you contribute to every phase of the model redevelopment cycle, from model initiation to internal validation and onsite inspections by DNB/ECB. You have advanced knowledge of statistics, coding, modelling decisions, and applicable regulations. You can clearly articulate your views and foster strong collaboration with stakeholders across the bank. Working environment ABN AMRO’s Risk Modelling department is a young and international team consisting of over 150 professionals from diverse backgrounds. As the bank’s centre of excellence for quantitative risk models, we play a crucial role in daily decision-making processes. Our models support activities like pricing deals, granting credits, and determining capital requirements. Our team thrives on intellectual challenges and has a hands-on mindset to deliver results. Collaboration is key to ensuring our work has maximum usability and a positive impact across the bank. Your profile You have a master's degree or PhD in a quantitative field; You have >2 years’ experience working in a credit risk modelling team e.g. IRB, IFRS9, Stress testing or related model development. You speak and write English fluently; You are an effective communicator, connecting easily with stakeholders on different levels of seniority; You are familiar with relevant coding languages, such as Spark, Python and SQL. Experience with Azure DevOps / git is a pre. You have thorough knowledge of banking and credit risk; You have thorough knowledge of rules and regulations and regulatory trends relevant for credit risk modelling (Basel, CRR, etc); Experience in working with DNB/ECB through communication and on-site inspections is a pre. Do you have what it takes to meet this challenge? Do you have experience with large projects with a strong quantitative character, and an eye for detail? Or are you a top talent in the field of quantitative risk management, and ready for the next step in your career? Look no further and apply to this role, we look forward to get to know you! An excellent pension scheme, ensuring that you are well prepared for the future. Flexibility in working: working from home is possible in consultation with your team and depending on your role. We will provide an ergonomic home office setup for you. Plenty of room for relaxation with five weeks of vacation per year, supplemented by two mandatory days off. You can also purchase up to four additional weeks of vacation annually. Five “Banking for better days”: extra days off that you can use for personal development or volunteer work. You work across the signals captured by our Radar, Radio, and Electronic Warfare modules, building the classification and
items.desc: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As Signal Processing Engineer within RF Processing & Analytics, you own the algorithms that turn raw electromagnetic intercepts into an actionable picture of the RF environment — detecting, characterizing, and identifying the emitters around our platforms in contested environments. You work across the signals captured by our Radar, Radio, and Electronic Warfare modules, building the classification and analytics layer that turns isolated detections into a real-time electronic order of battle for operators and downstream autonomy. Responsibilities Signal Detection & Characterization: Build algorithms to detect, deinterleave, and extract parameters (PRI, pulse width, frequency, modulation) from intercepted RF emissions. Emitter Classification & Identification: Develop classification pipelines — combining feature-based methods and machine learning — to identify emitter types and match them against threat libraries. Electronic Order of Battle: Design the analytics that turn individual detections into a coherent, real-time picture of emitters, tracks, and threat posture. AI-Assisted Analytics: Apply machine learning to modulation recognition, anomaly detection, and emitter fingerprinting where it improves classification confidence in dense, contested spectrum. Cross-Module Data Fusion: Work with signals captured by Radar, Radio, and Electronic Warfare to build a unified processing pipeline rather than siloed, single-sensor analysis. Real-Time Pipeline Engineering: Take algorithms from offline prototyping (MATLAB/Python) to real-time or near-real-time implementation, alongside software and embedded/FPGA engineers. Field Validation: Validate detection and classification performance against simulated and real-world RF datasets, in lab and field-test conditions. Candidate Requirements Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, Applied Mathematics, or a related field. 3-6 years of experience in RF/radar signal processing, ideally with exposure to ELINT, ESM, or SIGINT applications. Strong fundamentals in DSP: spectral analysis, filtering, multi-rate processing, statistical/adaptive signal processing. Proficiency in Python and/or MATLAB for algorithm prototyping; working knowledge of C/C++ for production-oriented implementation. Comfortable applying machine learning to signal classification problems. Clear communicator, able to work across RF hardware, software, and data science disciplines. Fluency in English required; French is a plus. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

items.desc: Het bedrijf Onze klant is een opkomende tech-startup in de data sector, gedreven door de missie om ongekende waarde uit ruwe informatie te halen. Zij bouwen slimme, schaalbare algoritmes die bedrijven helpen om razendsnel betere beslissingen te nemen. Zonder logge structuren of bureaucratie, maar met een platte organisatie waar jouw ideeën direct worden getest en uitgerold. De focus ligt hier volop op experimenteren, pionieren en het bouwen van innovatieve producten die de markt echt veranderen. Wat zij doen heeft directe impact op hoe organisaties hun toekomst vormgeven, omdat betrouwbare data de fundering van elke goede strategie vormt. Je komt terecht in een hecht en briljant team van tech-enthousiastelingen die graag kennis delen en wekelijks successen samen vieren. Jouw rol als AI Specialist in dit verhaal? De vertaalslag maken tussen complexe modellen en werkbare realiteit, waardoor je vanaf dag één je stempel drukt. Getriggerd? Lees dan snel verder! Takenpakket In deze rol neem jij als AI Specialist het voortouw bij het ontwikkelen van revolutionaire oplossingen vanaf de eerste brainstorm tot de livegang. Je analyseert enorme hoeveelheden informatie om patronen te ontdekken en vertaalt deze naar bruikbare inzichten die de kern van nieuwe producten vormen. Complexe bedrijfsvraagstukken zet jij om in werkbare datamodellen, waardoor klanten direct tijd besparen en hun foutmarges verkleinen. Door het trainen en finetunen van algoritmes verhoog je continu de nauwkeurigheid van de bestaande systemen. Interne teams neem je op sleeptouw tijdens interactieve sessies, zodat iedereen de nieuwste technologieën begrijpt en optimaal kan benutten. Strakke kaders rond dataveiligheid en privacy borg jij moeiteloos, waardoor alle innovaties niet alleen slim maar ook betrouwbaar blijven. Profiel Voor deze functie van AI Specialist kijken we vooral naar jouw innovatieve denkkracht en de drang om dingen te bouwen. Je beschikt over een masterdiploma in een relevante richting, gekoppeld aan aantoonbare bagage in machine learning of geavanceerde data-analyse. Ervaring met het ontwikkelen van modellen vanaf scratch stelt jou in staat om razendsnel waarde te leveren binnen een snelgroeiende omgeving. Vlotte communicatie behoort tot je natuurlijke sterktes; je kan ingewikkelde materie heel behapbaar overbrengen naar non-technische stakeholders. Collega’s omschrijven jou als een pragmatische bouwer die veel liever in concrete oplossingen denkt dan blijft hangen in eindeloze theorieën. Aanbod Jouw inzet als AI Specialist belonen we met een pakket dat net zo modern en flexibel is als de startup zelf. Een stevig brutosalaris, eerlijk en direct afgestemd op de kennis en absolute meerwaarde die jij binnenbrengt. Direct een gloednieuwe elektrische bedrijfswagen inclusief laadkaart, zodat je zorgeloos, comfortabel en groen de baan op kan. Optimale gemoedsrust via een uitgebreide groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering, perfect geregeld voor jou én je gezin. Dagelijks een fijn extraatje dankzij royale maaltijdcheques en een mooie, structurele netto onkostenvergoeding. Volledige vrijheid over jouw planning door de glijdende uren, waarmee je werk en privéleven naadloos in elkaar laat overvloeien. Meerdere dagen per week de optie om in alle rust via thuiswerk te knallen, met ergonomisch materiaal voor je thuiskantoor voorzien. Een riant opleidingsbudget dat je helemaal vrij mag inzetten voor conferenties, cursussen of boeken om je brein scherp te houden. Echte, tastbare inspraak in een platte structuur zonder hiërarchie, waar jouw technische beslissingen de richting van het bedrijf bepalen. Wekelijkse teamlunches, toffe hackathons en legendarische vrijdagmiddagborrels die de fantastische sfeer er extra goed in houden. Klaar voor deze nieuwe stap? Stuur vandaag nog je cv in en we bekijken samen de mogelijkheden.

items.desc: To strengthen and/or further develop its research competencies in educational technologies in distance learning settings, the research center for Learning and Instruction with Future Technologies (LIFT) is looking for a: Research Software Engineer in Educational Technologies (100 %) Place of work: Brig, partial remote working possible (within Switzerland) Start date: 1January 2027, or upon agreement Contract duration: 2 years (renewable) The research center for Learning and Instruction with Future Technologies (LIFT) is an interdisciplinary research center dedicated to research on learning and instruction in education. It bundles expertise on how students learn, how interest develops, how learners regulate their study behavior, and how digital and distance teaching can be designed based on evidence. The center investigates current and future challenges in high-quality education through theory-driven research that is applicable in everyday distance teaching. Its ambition is to advance rigorous, useful, and innovative research that helps evidence-based teaching practices become normal practice. To support researchers and implementation partners in prototyping or building educational technologies (including learning-management systems, Generative AI, AR/VR/XR and more), the LIFT is looking for a versatile software engineer. If you love trying out new technologies and building prototypes and tools at the forefront of what is possible, this opportunity is a good match! The position is based within the IT team and reports to the Head of IT for personnel and organizational matters. You will primarily support research at LIFT, working closely with its researchers and following the university’s IT standards. Your responsibilities Implement prototypes in alignment with project partners’ specifications and inputs Further develop prototypes into scalable products Take ownership of project development Scout and benchmark technology, including specification comparison Conduct user evaluation of prototypes Upon agreement, co-author research publications. Note: This position is strongly focused on the development of said prototypes and products. It does not, however, include system maintenance or helpdesk tasks. Your profile Master’s degree in Computer Science Experience in building websites including both front end and back end Experience in working with GenAI APIs, as well as recent trends such as Agentic AI Experience in working with continuous integration (CI) and testing methodologies Experience with at least one game engine, e.g. Unreal, Unity, or Godot, including AR or VR development Experience reviewing and improving code written by others Interest in human learning and interaction design Collaborative personality and ability to interact comfortably with others and working in a diverse team Enjoy learning new things and figuring things out Excellent command of English, knowledge of French and/or German is a plus We offer Academic visibility: You will be named as a co-author on work you contribute to, and you are encouraged to publish the tools and methods you develop as contributions in their own right. A research-intensive academic environment: You will be part of a dynamic university setting characterised by strong scientific expertise and a culture of interdisciplinary collaboration. Attractive employment conditions: modern working conditions, generous social benefits and a wide range of continuing education opportunities. A committed team: you will join a highly skilled and engaged team that embodies innovation, excellence, and a strong culture of collaboration. An inspiring working environment: our campus in Brig is located in immediate proximity to the historic old town, the Swiss Federal Railways (SBB) station and attractive natural and mountain regions. It offers a high quality of life and a vibrant academic exchange. Your Application Motivation letter describing why you have the necessary skills for this position (2 pages maximum). Resume (2 pages maximum). Portfolio of previous work (either as a PDF or a link). For further information, please contact Prof. Dr Julia Chatain: julia.chatain@unidistance.ch .

items.desc: Unbefristet in Vollzeit für unsere Abteilung Product Unit Electronic Warfare in Nürnberg Wir über uns – Keeping people and society safe Saab ist ein führendes Verteidigungs- und Sicherheitsunternehmen mit Hauptsitz in Stockholm, Schweden, und beschäftigt über 28.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit. Wir entwickeln, fertigen und warten Produkte, Dienstleistungen und Systeme in allen Bereichen der militärischen Verteidigung und der zivilen Sicherheit. Saab Deutschland ist an fünf Standorten (Berlin, Wilhelmshaven, Bremen, Nürnberg und Mülheim-Kärlich) in den Bereichen „Electromagnetic Warfare (EW), Land Systems und Naval Systems“ tätig. Hier werden in Deutschland die Grenzen der Technologie ständig vorangetrieben, mit dem Ziel: Eine sicherere und nachhaltigere Welt zu schaffen. In Nürnberg sind wir im Bereich EW auf Airborne Radar Electronic Support Measures (R-ESM), Electronic Countermeasure (ECM), Communications Intelligence (COMINT), Communications Electronic Support Measures (C-ESM) und auf die Fusion von Daten verschiedener Sensoren spezialisiert. items.desc: Data Scientist – Ökonometrie & Mikrodaten (m/w/d) · 100 % Festanstellung · BAK Economics AG · Basel · Eintritt nach Vereinbarung BAK Economics ist ein unabhängiges Wirtschaftsforschungs- und Beratungsinstitut in Basel mit rund 25 Mitarbeitenden aus Ökonomie, Entwicklung, Data und KI. Wir arbeiten für die öffentliche Hand, Verbände und Unternehmen und betreiben eigene Datenprodukte. Unsere Projekte basieren zunehmend auf grossen Mikrodatensätzen. Dazu zählen beispielsweise Steuerdaten natürlicher und juristischer Personen, auf deren Grundlage wir Prognosemodelle entwickeln, ebenso wie Erfolgsrechnungen und Bilanzen von Unternehmen sowie Patentdaten, die wir mit Unternehmen und Regionen verknüpfen. Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der nicht nur gerne mit Daten arbeitet, sondern auch methodisch etwas draufhat. Kennst du den Unterschied zwischen einer Pooled Regression und einer Fixed-Effects-Regression? Weisst du, was echtes Clustering von einer blossen Kategorisierung unterscheidet? Und siehst du in Datensätzen voller Tippfehler, unterschiedlicher Schreibweisen und Sonderfälle eine Herausforderung statt ein Ärgernis? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Deine Aufgabe Du verantwortest Modelle auf grossen Mikrodaten, von der Rohdatenlieferung bis zur ausgelieferten Zahl. Dabei bringst du Ordnung in komplexe Daten, verknüpfst unterschiedliche Quellen und erkennst Methodenwechsel und Brüche in Zeitreihen. Dabei willst du verstehen, wie Daten entstehen: welche Prozesse und Regeln hinter einer Steuerveranlagung oder einer Bilanz stehen und wie sie sich in den Daten niederschlagen. Wenn etwas nicht aufgeht, bleibst du dran, bis du die Ursache kennst. Auf dieser Grundlage entwickelst du statistische und ökonometrische Modelle, erstellst Prognosen und Simulationen und untersuchst beispielsweise, wie sich eine Steuerreform auf die Einnahmen eines Kantons auswirkt. Neben der Modellierung überlegst du dir, wie sich die Korrektheit von Daten und Resultaten überprüfen lässt, etwa mit Plausibilitätschecks, Abgleichen mit unabhängigen Quellen und Tests, die bei jeder neuen Datenlieferung laufen. Du hinterfragst Methoden, erkennst unplausible Zahlen und präsentierst unseren Auftraggebern die Ergebnisse verständlich und nachvollziehbar – inklusive ihrer Grundlagen und Grenzen. Viele unserer Modelle sind langfristig im Einsatz – etwa in unserer Patentanalyse, unseren Branchenprognosen, unserem Steuerrechner sowie unseren Benchmarking- und Regionen-Tools. Deshalb legen wir grossen Wert darauf, dass deine Arbeit nachhaltig nutzbar bleibt: sauber dokumentiert, versioniert und für andere nachvollziehbar und reproduzierbar. Dein Profil Du hast einen Master oder ein Doktorat in Volkswirtschaftslehre, Statistik, Data Science, Mathematik, Informatik oder einem verwandten Fach und 3-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung mit grossen, unordentlichen Datensätzen. Python beherrschst du sicher und arbeitest routiniert mit pandas, NumPy, statsmodels und scikit-learn. KI-Tools nutzt Du wo möglich und sinnvoll, behältst aber das Verständnis und die Verantwortung. Du kennst Panelökonometrie, weisst wie mit fehlenden Werten umzugehen ist und validierst Modellergebnisse of sample. Machine Learning setzt du dort ein, wo es etwas bringt. Du arbeitest selbständig und sorgfältig, auch mit vertraulichen Daten und zugleich gern im Team: Man kann sich auf dich verlassen, du fragst nach, wenn etwas unklar ist, statt Annahmen zu treffen, und du gibst und nimmst Feedback an. Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch. Gute Französischkenntnisse ist ein klares Plus. Besonders willkommen ist Erfahrung mit Steuer- oder Registerdaten, Mikrosimulationen, Verknüpfungen von Datensätzen (Record Linkage) und/oder Bilanzdaten von Unternehmen. Was dich erwartet Deine Modelle werden von Kantonen und Unternehmen genutzt, und du prägst mit, welche Methoden bei uns zum Standard werden. Datensätze, an die man ausserhalb von Verwaltung und Forschung selten herankommt. Ein interdisziplinäres Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen: Du siehst, was mit deinen Zahlen passiert. Freiraum bei Methoden, Werkzeugen und eigenen Ideen. Ein Arbeitsplatz mitten in Basel und gelegentliche Einsätze bei Kunden in der ganzen Schweiz. Rund drei Tage pro Woche arbeitest du bei uns im Büro oder beim Kunden, die übrigen Tage im Homeoffice. Dazu kommen flexible Arbeitszeiten. Bewerbung Du kannst dich über Linkedin bewerben oder schick uns deinen CV an jobs@bak-economics.com und zeig uns, wie du arbeitest: mit einem Code-Beispiel, einem GitHub-Projekt (gerne auch aus einem privaten oder Studienprojekt) oder einer halben Seite über ein Datenprojekt, bei dem etwas nicht stimmte. Was war falsch, wie hast du es erkannt und wie hast du das Problem gelöst? Neugierig geworden? Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

items.desc: €63.000 OTE · variabile uncapped · €22.000 di fisso garantito · Montichiari (BS), in sede Nati bootstrap. Da zero a €1,2 milioni di fatturato in tre anni, €10 milioni a fine 2026. L'AI è già dentro il nostro prodotto: Mentium trasforma ogni videolezione in riassunti, quiz, flashcard e schemi in pochi secondi. Ora vogliamo che diventi il nostro vantaggio più grande, e cerchiamo chi la costruisca. Chi siamo NowDiploma è una scaleup dell'educazione: una scuola online per il diploma, con titolo di Stato riconosciuto dal MIM, e Mentium, la piattaforma con AI su cui studiano tutti i nostri studenti, in tutti i percorsi. Lavoriamo in team piccoli, veloci e pieni di talento. Qui la crescita dell'azienda diventa crescita delle persone. Giorgio ha co-fondato NowDiploma a 22 anni: l'età non è un limite, conta quello che sai costruire. Cosa farai Costruirai le funzionalità AI di Mentium, dal prototipo alla produzione. Parlerai con studenti e tutor per capire dove si bloccano nello studio, trasformerai quei problemi in strumenti e misurerai se aiutano davvero. Se non aiutano, li migliori o li togli. Lavorerai su prompt, valutazione della qualità e affidabilità delle risposte, insieme a design, didattica e al resto del team tech. E terrai fermo il principio con cui è nata Mentium: l'AI propone, lo studente decide. Chi cerchiamo • Hai già costruito con l'AI. Prototipi, progetti personali o lavoro con modelli linguistici: mostraci cosa hai fatto. • Pensi da prodotto. Prima di chiederti come costruire qualcosa, ti chiedi se serve. • Rigore. Un'AI che sbaglia su una materia d'esame fa danni veri: per questo testi, misuri e migliori. • Drive. Vuoi crescere molto in fretta e prenderti responsabilità prima che qualcuno te le consegni. • Background STEM preferibile, non bloccante se la testa è quella giusta. • Mentalità da co-founder/cto , non timbri il cartellino. Cosa offriamo • €63.000 OTE, variabile uncapped. €22.000 di RAL fissa sono garantiti. Al raggiungimento del 100% dei tuoi obiettivi arrivi a €63.000; oltre il 100% guadagni di più, senza tetto. Sotto gli obiettivi guadagni meno: all'80% resti sotto i €63.000. • Pacchetto stock da €80.000. Partecipi al valore di un'azienda che sta crescendo adesso. • Un prodotto vero su cui lavorare. Ogni funzione che rilasci arriva a utenti reali, non resta in un notebook. • Mentorship diretta e responsabilità reali fin da subito. • Contratto a tempo indeterminato o determinato, tempo pieno. Prima di candidarti Crescere così significa costruire molte cose mentre si corre. Lavorerai su problemi aperti, senza specifiche pronte: a volte la risposta giusta sarà non usare l'AI. Si lavora in sede a Montichiari, tutti i giorni. Anche per questo ruolo circa due terzi dell'OTE sono variabili: valuta se è il modello giusto per te. Processo di selezione 1. Screening del profilo 2. Test tecnici 3. Colloqui Valutiamo capacità reali, non solo il CV. Se il ruolo ti piace, candidati anche se non ti ritrovi in ogni punto.

items.desc: Wil jij onderzoeken hoe AI en data de zorg slimmer en veiliger maken? Als Junior Onderzoeker Toegepaste AI en Data test je modellen en prototypes in de praktijk, samen met ziekenhuizen en zorgorganisaties. Je werkt onder begeleiding van ervaren onderzoekers. Sluit je aan bij het lectoraat ICT-innovaties in de Zorg. Jouw nieuwe baan begint bij hogeschool Windesheim in Zwolle. Aan deze baan geef jij invulling Zinvol werk begint met onderzoek dat er echt toe doet. Als Junior Onderzoeker werk je aan projecten van het lectoraat ICT-innovaties in de Zorg. Je analyseert data, bouwt en test prototypes en vertaalt technische resultaten naar bruikbare inzichten voor zorgprofessionals. Binnen een project krijg je een afgebakende taak. Je pakt onderdelen zelf op en begeleidt studenten. Ervaren onderzoekers staan naast je. Voorbeelden van projecten waar je aan meewerkt: het testen en monitoren van AI-modellen in ziekenhuizen het ontwikkelen en beoordelen van synthetische data AI-ondersteuning bij digitale triage en zorg op afstand veilige verwerking van data uit zorgsensoren Meer in detail ben jij als Junior Onderzoeker bezig met het: verzamelen, opschonen en analyseren van data ontwikkelen en testen van modellen, prototypes en demonstrators uitvoeren van literatuuronderzoek en technische verkenningen opzetten en uitvoeren van experimenten, en vastleggen van de resultaten bespreken van bevindingen met onderzoekers, ontwikkelaars en zorgprofessionals bijdragen aan rapportages, presentaties en andere vormen van kennisdeling begeleiden van studenten bij technische projectopdrachten Welkom bij Windesheim Een hogeschool waar iedereen zich gewaardeerd én thuis mag voelen. Gelijke kansen staan centraal en onze kracht ligt in samenwerking. We dragen bij aan een inclusieve en duurzame samenleving door relevant onderzoek en het opleiden van nieuwe professionals. Met persoonlijke leerroutes en actuele opleidingen bouwen we samen aan de toekomst. Onze campus in Zwolle is een energieke gemeenschap met alle voorzieningen: van een campuswinkel en restaurants tot sportschool en zwembad. Dit alles op een steenworp van het bruisende stadscentrum. Jij sluit je aan bij 15 collega’s van het lectoraat ICT-innovaties in de Zorg . Kenmerkend aan jouw team zijn de korte lijn met de zorgpraktijk en de mix van technische kennis en zorgkennis. Het team doet onderzoek dat direct raakt aan de praktijk, van ziekenhuizen tot zorgorganisaties in de regio. Een indruk krijgen? Bekijk de projecten AI-supported digital triage en remote patient monitoring en LokAI . Jouw bijdrage Wij geloven dat diversiteit onze resultaten versterkt. Voor de rol van Junior Onderzoeker zoeken we een nieuwsgierige professional die zorgvuldig werkt aan onderzoek naar AI en data in de zorg. Je hoeft nog niet op alle onderwerpen ervaring te hebben. Belangrijker is dat je nieuwe technologie wilt onderzoeken en uitproberen, en dat zorg en publieke gezondheid je aanspreken. Reageer dan gerust. Een informeel (telefoon)gesprek is ook een mooie eerste stap. Ontwikkeling binnen de functie Je krijgt begeleiding bij het verder ontwikkelen van je onderzoeksvaardigheden en technische kennis. The title of the project is Spectrally Efficient Low Cost Energy Efficient Communication for Transport using 3D Angular Modes (SELECT-3DAM). We are seeking a Research Fellow to join us for the remainder of the project (expected until March 2029) on a full-time basis. This work
items.desc: The University of Surrey is a global community of ideas and people, dedicated to life-changing education and research. We are ambitious and have a bold vision of what we want to achieve - shaping ourselves into one of the best universities in the world, which we are achieving through the talents and endeavour of every employee. Our culture empowers people to achieve this aim and to collectively, and individually, make a real difference. The role The University of Surrey has recently been awarded a three-year project by the Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council. The title of the project is Spectrally Efficient Low Cost Energy Efficient Communication for Transport using 3D Angular Modes (SELECT-3DAM). We are seeking a Research Fellow to join us for the remainder of the project (expected until March 2029) on a full-time basis. This work builds on recent seminal work carried out by the project investigators on Linear Angular Momentum Multiplexing (LAMM). The project is an exciting opportunity to undertake work on antenna synthesis and physical layer radio to underpin the science to enable practical implementation of an evolution of this concept, 3D Angular Momentum Multiplexing (3DAMM), for advanced infrastructure to train communications. Its application is to provide a low cost, energy efficient solution to deliver reliable gigabit connectivity to train carriages in tunnels. 3DAMM is a highly innovative wireless transmission architecture that has promise of revolutionising spectral efficiency in some wireless links. We are looking to attract the brightest and best to form an effective team to develop and investigate the concept further. Together with another researcher appointed to the role focused on RF and antennas, this will include designing and constructing a concept demonstrator. The postholder will undertake a range of research activities within a specified research area in infrastructure to train communications by means of 3D Angular Momentum Multiplexing, assuming responsibility for specific areas of projects and making use of new research techniques and methods, in consultation with the research award holder or supervisor. This will include computer-based simulations, library research, critical evaluation and interpretation as well as assisting other researchers with practical measurements. About You The post holder must hold a PhD degree (or equivalent) or close to completing a PhD degree in Electronic Engineering, Mathematics or other areas related to synthesis of antenna arrays and/or modulation and coding. Postdoctoral research or industrial experience would be an advantage. The post holder will have authority over some aspects of project work and must be capable of providing academic judgement, offering original and creative thoughts and be able to interpret and analyse results. How to apply To apply, please submit your application with a CV and cover letter online via the University of Surrey jobs portal.

About the Role We are looking for a Navigation & Perception Engineer (f-m-d) to make our robots move safely and reliably through indoor environments shared with people. You will work on autonomous service robots that deliver objects and guide people, and on semi-humanoid and humanoid robots that navigate and perform loco-manipulation tasks. The work covers how the robots understand their surroundings and move through them: localization and mapping, semantic scene understanding, motion planning, and execution on real hardware. Responsibilities Own and harden our multi-modal navigation stack (localization, mapping, planning, obstacle avoidance) for dynamic, unstructured indoor spaces with people. Build semantic maps (object-level, open-vocabulary 3D scene representations) that ground natural-language goals into navigation targets. Fuse 2D/3D lidar, RGB-D cameras, IMU, and wheel odometry into the perception pipeline that feeds navigation. Extend the behavior layer above navigation: task-level goals, docking and approach maneuvers, recovery behaviors, and human-aware navigation policies. Build simulation environments for rapid testing of navigation and perception, validate on real hardware, and iterate. Handle multi-floor operation and building infrastructure: elevators, automatic doors, charging stations. Deploy and test navigation in realistic use-case scenarios. Required Skills Strong background in mobile robot navigation and 3D perception, with hands-on experience on real hardware. Deep understanding of SLAM, path planning, obstacle avoidance, and motion control of mobile robots. Solid experience with perception for navigation: point cloud processing, object detection and segmentation. Hands-on experience with ROS2 and the Nav2 framework. Proficiency in C++ and Python. Proven ability to debug and tune robots in the field, where sensor noise, latency and messy environments are the norm. Nice to have Experience in any of the following is a plus. We do not expect one person to cover all of them: Open-vocabulary perception (CLIP, SAM, vision-language models) and 3D scene graphs for language-grounded navigation. Visual place recognition for relocalization, especially learned pipelines (NetVLAD, CosPlace, EigenPlaces, AnyLoc). Learning-based navigation (reinforcement or imitation learning). Deployment on embedded platforms (NVIDIA Jetson). Whole-body control or loco-manipulation for mobile manipulators. Fleet or multi-robot coordination. What we are looking for Engineers who bridge theory and real-world execution and are comfortable both reading research papers and diagnosing hardware issues on the bench. Strong debugging skills: able to isolate why a robot misbehaves, whether the cause is a sensor, the software or the mechanics. Comfort with the full navigation stack, from integrating new sensors to high-level behavior logic. Genuine interest in making robots that reliably understand and navigate spaces shared with people, rather than in delivering demos. Classification Target: Expected job level B2, corresponding to a statutory base minimum of € 33058,74 gross per year. Total Rewards Package: Final financial offers will exceed collective bargaining minimums to reflect individual expertise and prior achievement. The complete rewards proposal will include an individual merit allowance on top of the base minimum, a fixed production allowance, welfare benefits, performance bonuses, healthcare coverage (Metasalute), and pension options (Cometa). Applications are welcome from all individuals regardless of gender, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, background, or disability status.
