items.desc: TL;DR We help large enterprises cut energy costs and valorize flexibility in the age of AI. We're hiring a Applied AI Engineer to own the foundation under our agentic features: the architecture, the harnesses, the evals, the tool surface, the model choices and the guardrails that let AI workflows run reliably for large enterprise customers. About Companion.energy Companion.energy connects the financial side of energy management (contracts, markets, risk) with the operational side (assets, processes, sites). We model complex energy contracts and flexible assets, forecast demand and production, and translate predictions into automated, second-by-second control decisions that move megawatts and money. Our software is used by large B2B enterprises and energy players to lower OPEX, maximize revenue, increase renewable usage, and manage risk. Why Companion.energy ? Where this is going. Energy management today runs on spreadsheets, manual checks and consultants who bill by the hour. Reading a contract, checking a year of invoices line by line, comparing one site against another, writing the monthly report. Almost none of that work needs a person, and all of it has to be right. We believe agents do that work, inside the platform, on the customer's own data, and that this is what rebuilds the category rather than making it look nicer. Insight on demand instead of by project. When the platform can benchmark a portfolio of sites or explain a cost deviation itself, analysis stops being an annual consulting engagement and becomes something a customer asks for on a Tuesday afternoon. That changes what our customers are able to do, not just how quickly they click. It ends in the physical world. The same platform steers batteries, shifts industrial loads and bids into balancing markets. Insight here does not end in a report that gets filed. It ends in megawatts moving at a different moment, which is what makes an energy asset pay for itself and what makes a renewable grid workable. The repetitive work is a bottleneck we feel ourselves. A lot of the configuration and analysis behind our features is still done by hand on our side, and that is precisely what stops us rolling them out to more customers. Automating it is not an internal efficiency project. It is how the company scales. Real stakes. Large enterprises act on what our system tells them. A reconciliation that gets a number wrong becomes a claim against a supplier, not a bad chat reply. That constraint is what makes this interesting engineering rather than a demo problem. Room to decide. The agentic part of the product is early, already live with customers, and the place on our roadmap with the most room in it. You will be setting the direction rather than inheriting someone else's framework. What you'll work on The agentic architecture. How an agent is defined, how tools are exposed to it, how context gets assembled, how a run is traced, and how state and long-running work are handled. Today each of our AI workflows answers those questions its own way. You decide how we answer them once, so that building the next agentic feature is routine rather than a new invention. Evaluation. Deciding what "good" means for a feature whose output differs on every run, then building the harnesses and datasets that hold it to that standard and catch a regression before a customer does. This is the part most teams skip and the part that separates a demo from a product. The tool surface. We serve the platform to agents over MCP today, through an internal management server and a customer-facing analytics server. Designing tools to be used by models rather than people is real design work, and so is deciding which steps of a workflow should stay deterministic code instead. Multi-model. Which model runs which step, how we stay able to swap them as they change, and how that decision gets made on evaluation evidence rather than on release notes. Cost, latency and reliability as product constraints. A budget per feature, caching, retries and fallbacks, and the monitoring that tells us when a workflow has become slower or more expensive than the value it delivers. Guardrails our customers can accept. Permission-aware, tenant-isolated and auditable, with human-in-the-loop wherever a wrong number turns into a claim against a supplier. Our customers are large enterprises, and their data cannot leak across tenants or into the wrong hands. The workflows on top. You will build features as well as foundations, and the foundation gets judged by how fast the next feature ships. Contract and hedge position ingestion is next in line, following the pattern reconciliation established: take the document, parse it, propose the mapping, let a human confirm.; What we are looking for You've built agentic systems that survived contact with paying customers: tool design, context engineering, multi-step and long-running flows, structured output, retrieval where it earns its keep, and the judgement to keep a …

items.desc: Je bouwt voice-agents die gesprekken voeren, systemen bedienen en klantvragen zelfstandig afhandelen. Je experimenteert met de nieuwste modellen van Google, Anthropic en OpenAI en combineert taalmodellen, spraakherkenning, stemmen en tools tot iets dat echt werkt. Komt er een nieuw model uit? Dan wil je het proberen en horen of je agent er beter van wordt. Je verandert hoe Zonneplan werkt. Je ziet waar voice-agents meer kunnen betekenen voor sales, service en operations en neemt zelf het initiatief om dat te bouwen. Je kiest de technische aanpak, koppelt systemen en brengt nieuwe toepassingen na zorgvuldig testen live. Van het eerste idee tot de gesprekken waarin je hoort dat het werkt: jij pakt door. Hier wacht niemand af. Heb je een beter idee? Zeg het, en bouw het. We zijn gedreven optimisten die liever testen en soms falen dan blijven hangen in hoe het altijd ging. Je werkt samen met slimme mensen én slimme systemen, in een team vol verschillende achtergronden waar iedereen meepraat, meebouwt en meetelt. Jouw impact bij Zonneplan Jij bouwt nieuwe voice-agents en brengt ze live. Je ziet waar een agent werk kan overnemen en neemt zelf het initiatief. Je bepaalt de aanpak, koppelt de benodigde systemen en test totdat de agent in echte gesprekken zijn werk doet. Jij geeft agents meer mogelijkheden. Met API-koppelingen en toolcalling laat je agents orders afronden, afspraken maken en operationele taken uitvoeren. Je zorgt dat ze weten wanneer ze kunnen handelen en wanneer een collega moet overnemen. Jij bepaalt de technische koers. Je kiest de architectuur en tooling van de voice-stack en beslist welke verbeteringen je doorvoert. Daarbij weeg je gesprekskwaliteit, snelheid, betrouwbaarheid en kosten af. Jij maakt ieder gesprek beter. Je duikt in gesprekken en traces om te ontdekken waar timing, begrip of toolgebruik misgaat. Je bouwt evaluaties waarmee je verbeteringen toetst en fouten eerder vindt. Dit krijg je van ons Een salaris tussen €3.250 en €5.000 bruto per maand. 25 vakantiedagen (met de mogelijkheid om er meer bij te kopen) en reiskostenvergoeding. Een persoonlijk keuzebudget voor sport, boodschappen of iets anders dat bij je past. Een toegewijd team met veel ervaring in generatieve AI, dat elkaar elke dag uitdaagt om bestaande werkwijzen anders aan te pakken. Vrijheid in tooling, providers en modellen, inclusief een Claude Max-abonnement. Dit neem jij mee Je hebt een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding. Je hebt zelfstandig AI-toepassingen gebouwd en verbeterd, in eigen projecten of in je werk. Je hebt technisch inzicht en begrijpt hoe taalmodellen, spraakherkenning en koppelingen samenwerken. Ervaring met voice AI is een pré. Je doorgrondt processen, zoekt technische problemen uit en kunt beoordelen of een oplossing goed werkt. Je werkt zelf AI-first en hebt een sterke bouwdrang: je neemt initiatief, maakt zelfstandig keuzes en krijgt je ideeën werkend. Zo ziet het proces eruit 1. Solliciteer op deze vacature en vertel of laat zien wat je hebt gebouwd. 2. Kennismakingsgesprek met Samer (recruiter). 3. Eerste gesprek met Glenn (direct leidinggevende van de functie) en iemand van het team. 4. Persoonlijkheids- en capaciteitentest en een praktische casus waarin je een AI-toepassing bouwt of verbetert. 5. Is er een match? Dan doen we je snel een aanbod. Wat bouw jij voor Plan Zero? Bij Zonneplan werken we aan Plan Zero: een volledig duurzaam, kostenneutraal, frictieloos en betrouwbaar energiesysteem. Jij bouwt voice-agents die klanten helpen met hun vragen, bestellingen en afspraken. Solliciteer en laat zien wat je al hebt gemaakt. Wat is jouw plan? Heb je vragen? Bel of mail met Samer: 088 020 3012, samer.elmokdad@zonneplan.nl Please note: Proficiency in the Dutch language is required

items.desc: Du willst ein KI-Produkt nicht nur mitbauen, sondern verantworten? replient.ai beantwortet und moderiert Kommentare auf Instagram, Facebook, TikTok und YouTube mit KI, auch unter laufenden Ads. Die KI lernt die Tonalität jeder Marke aus bisherigen Antworten und der Website. Über 900 Marken, Creator und Agenturen nutzen replient.ai, darunter SNOCKS, HOLY, OCEANSAPART, Liebscher & Bracht, fonio.ai und mobile.de. Jetzt suchen wir die Person, die bei uns die komplette Technik in Oberösterreich übernimmt. Deine ersten 90 Tage Codebase übernehmen: Du übernimmst die bestehende Codebase und machst sie zu deiner. Du entscheidest, was bleibt, was umgebaut wird und was weg kann. Antwortqualität messbar machen: Du baust Evals für unsere LLM-Pipeline und machst die KI-Antworten nachweisbar besser: Tonalität der Marke, richtige Fakten, saubere Moderation. Integrationen skalieren: Meta, TikTok und YouTube liefern die Kommentare, auf denen alles aufbaut. Du machst die Anbindungen stabil, schnell und bereit für mehr Volumen. F&E-Projekt mit der FH OÖ: Ein gefördertes Forschungsprojekt (FFG / Land OÖ). Du verantwortest es technisch und bringst die Ergebnisse ins Produkt. Tech-Roadmap und später das Team: Du baust mit uns die Roadmap, legst fest, wen wir als Nächstes brauchen, und baust später das Tech-Team auf. Was du mitbringst Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung mit Software, die echte Nutzer verwenden. Die Rolle ist für erfahrene Engineers, nicht für den Berufseinstieg. Du hast LLMs schon in Produktion gebracht, nicht nur in Demos. Du bist in TypeScript, React, Next.js, Supabase/Postgres und Python schnell produktiv. Du willst die komplette Technik verantworten: Codebase, Infrastruktur, Roadmap. Du hast Lust auf Meta-, TikTok- und YouTube-APIs und verstehst Social Media. Du kannst ca. 2 Tage pro Woche zu uns ins Büro nach Lichtenberg bei Linz kommen. Was du bekommst 90.000 € brutto fix (14 × 6.429 €) plus 1 % vom ARR-Zuwachs: Wächst replient.ai, wächst dein Einkommen mit. Klare CTO-Perspektive: Du triffst die technischen Entscheidungen und sitzt bei Produkt und Roadmap mit am Tisch. AI-first Tool-Stack: Claude Pro, ChatGPT Pro, Cursor und was du sonst brauchst. Hybrid: ca. 2 Tage pro Woche im Büro in Lichtenberg mit Pöstlingberg-Blick und Outdoorspace, an den anderen Tagen remote. Ein kleines High-Performance-Team statt Konzern, geführt von Markus & Thomas Danninger. So läuft die Bewerbung Kein Anschreiben nötig: Bewirb dich direkt hier über LinkedIn. Wenn du richtig auffallen willst, schick uns zusätzlich kurze Antworten auf diese 4 Fragen an office@replient.ai (Betreff „Founding AI Engineer“). Ein paar Sätze pro Frage reichen. Zeig uns etwas, das du gebaut hast (GitHub, Live-Produkt, App oder Side Project), und sag kurz, was dein Anteil war. Was ist dein bestes KI- oder LLM-Projekt, und wie hast du gemessen, ob die Ergebnisse gut sind? Was reizt dich daran, bei uns die komplette Technik zu verantworten, und womit würdest du anfangen? Welches replient.ai-Feature würdest du als Erstes bauen oder verbessern, und warum? Tipp: replient.ai vorher 14 Tage gratis testen, ohne Kreditkarte. Danach folgen ein Kennenlerngespräch mit Markus & Thomas, eine kleine Testaufgabe und ein bezahltes Probearbeiten.

items.desc: Avrai completo controllo dei numeri con cui Jet HR prende ogni decisione, e ci costruirai sopra modelli predittivi e agenti AI per scalare. Cosa farai Il tuo obiettivo è possedere le metriche di Jet HR e trasformarle in modelli predittivi , dal dato grezzo alle decisioni di Sales, Growth e Ops. Nel concreto: Sei owner dei modelli dbt che sono la source of truth delle metriche di Jet per Ops, Growth, Sales, Finance e Product. Costruisci il semantic layer delle north star metrics: la base della self-service analytics e degli agenti AI che interrogano i dati. Costruisci MCP e agenti AI per l’analisi dati e per automatizzare i processi GTM (Sales, Marketing, Customer Success), misurandone l’impatto. Crei analisi che orientano le decisioni concrete di Growth e Ops. Porti la self-service su Metabase a tutta l’azienda, a partire dai domini ancora scoperti. Test, documentazione e monitoring inclusi. Sviluppi modelli predittivi end-to-end - lead scoring, attribution multi-touch, forecasting - dalla definizione del problema al deploy e al monitoraggio. Come lavoriamo Il team Data di Jet HR non è un semplice team di supporto. È la funzione che costruisce l’intera piattaforma dati su cui gira il prodotto e i prodotti AI che lo estendono. Data platform. Lavoriamo su una piattaforma scalabile e robusta: architettura, automazione, data products. Niente one-off, niente workaround. Self-service. Ogni team di Jet deve poter lavorare sui dati in autonomia. Dobbiamo essere un moltiplicatore, non un collo di bottiglia. Tech-first. Il team è composto da data engineers, analytics engineers, data scientists e AI engineers. Collaboriamo strettamente con prodotto, sales e operations per trasformare i dati in asset strategici. Niente task banali. Non esistono report manuali da tenere in vita. Automatizziamo, ottimizziamo, costruiamo soluzioni che durano. Tech stack DBT · Snowflake · Python · Metabase · DltHub · Apache Airflow · Docker · AWS Chi cerchiamo 3+ anni di esperienza in analytics engineering, data science o data engineering. Parli italiano. Per combattere la burocrazia bisogna prima capirla profondamente. Statistica applicata. Hai usato modellazione statistica e causal inference (A/B test, metodi quasi-sperimentali) su problemi di business reali. Data modelling. Hai lavorato con modelli dimensionali (star/snowflake schema) e/o Data Vault. Python solido. Lo usi ogni giorno per analisi, modelli e pipeline, con codice pulito e testabile. Cosa offriamo €45.000 – €60.000 di RAL. Full remote. Per davvero. Puoi lavorare da dove vuoi, basta che sia in una timezone compatibile con l’Italia. Se vuoi, il nostro ufficio a Milano è pronto ad accoglierti. Due volte l’anno abbiamo un meetup di 3 giorni, tutto pagato da Jet. Ownership di quello che fai. Non hai spec iper-dettagliate, non sei un mero esecutore. Sei tu responsabile dell’output finale. Impatto concreto. Siamo una start-up, ognuno dà un contributo essenziale allo sviluppo dei prodotti e alla crescita di Jet. Il tuo lavoro fa la differenza per migliaia di clienti. Start-up environment. Non è una startup qualsiasi, ma una ben finanziata e zeppa di talenti. In 6 mesi vedrai ed imparerai cose che altrove forse vedresti in anni, con un altissimo livello di responsabilità e coinvolgimento. Processo di selezione Prima interview con Talent Tech interview con Head of Data & AI Final interview con il team

items.title: Data Scientist, Featurespace
items.card: Job Description What it's it all about: At Featurespace, part of Visa, we build technology that helps financial institutions protect their customers from fraud and financial crime. We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join our team, developing and managing the analytical capabilities at the heart of our fraud and risk prevention products. The opportunity This isn’t a role where you build a model and hand it over.
items.desc: About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description What it's it all about: At Featurespace, part of Visa, we build technology that helps financial institutions protect their customers from fraud and financial crime. We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join our team, developing and managing the analytical capabilities at the heart of our fraud and risk prevention products. The opportunity This isn’t a role where you build a model and hand it over. You’ll work across the full lifecycle of analytical products, from understanding customer problems and exploring data through to developing, deploying, monitoring and improving models in production. You’ll combine strong data science with product thinking and operational ownership. You’ll see how your models perform with real customer data, understand the value they deliver, and help ensure they remain effective and well-managed as data, customer needs and fraud patterns change. You won’t be developing your expertise in isolation. You’ll join a group of other Data Scientists in Cambridge focused on fraud and risk, working alongside colleagues with significant experience in the field. It’s a close-knit and collaborative team, with lots of opportunities for informal learning, mentoring and exchanging ideas with people tackling similar problems. What You'll Do Develop ML models using rich and complex transactional datasets. Work with customers, product managers, engineers and delivery teams to turn real-world problems into effective fraud and risk prevention products. Take models from discovery and experimentation through to production. Monitor deployed models, investigate changes in performance and identify opportunities for improvement. Retrain, enhance and safely release models as data, customer needs and fraud patterns evolve. Measure and communicate the impact of our fraud and risk prevention products. Contribute to model governance, documentation and robust production processes. Share knowledge, mentor colleagues and help improve how the team works. This is a hybrid position. Hybrid employees can alternate time between both remote and office. Employees in hybrid roles are expected to work from the office 3 set days a week (Tuesday - Thursday), with a general guidepost of being in the office 50% or more of the time based on business needs. Qualifications What we'd like from you: Experience implementing machine-learning models or analytical algorithms in software. Experience using Python, Java or another major programming language for data analysis or machine learning. Experience using SQL to analyse data. Practical experience working with large, diverse datasets. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly for data-centric problems. The ability to pick up new technologies and concepts quickly. Experience collaborating with multiple stakeholders on technical projects. Clear and concise written and verbal communication. The ability to manage and prioritise your own work. A degree in a scientific or numerate discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Visa is an EEO Employer Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

This is an opportunity to join a growing team at a pivotal stage in its transformation, helping to build scalable machine learning solutions that drive real commercial outcomes. You'll work closely with senior stakeholders and play a key role in shaping how Data Science is embedded across the organisation. The Company They are a well-established consumer-focused organisation undergoing a significant data and AI transformation. With strong investment in technology, analytics, and customer insight capabilities, they are building a modern Data Science function focused on delivering measurable business value. The team is moving beyond ad hoc analytics towards scalable, production-ready machine learning solutions. Data is at the heart of strategic decision-making, creating an exciting environment for a commercially minded Data Scientist to make an impact. The Role As a Data Scientist, you will work closely with Data Science leadership, engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to develop and deploy machine learning solutions across a range of customer and commercial use cases. Responsibilities include: Building, validating, and deploying predictive and machine learning models Developing customer segmentation and customer lifetime value models Supporting forecasting initiatives to improve commercial planning Delivering targeted customer and personalisation use cases Working across the full Data Science lifecycle from problem definition through to production deployment Collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders to translate business challenges into analytical solutions Contributing to the development of a scalable Data Science platform and best practice framework Presenting insights and recommendations clearly to business audiences Your Skills & Experience Strong commercial experience in Data Science and machine learning Excellent Python skills, with SQL expertise Experience delivering end-to-end Data Science projects from development to deployment Knowledge of statistical modelling, forecasting, and predictive analytics techniques Experience communicating technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders Ability to work in a collaborative, business-focused environment Exposure to cloud technologies such as GCP or Azure is advantageous Experience with Vertex AI, Azure ML, or similar machine learning platforms is beneficial What They Offer Salary up to £55,000 Hybrid working with 3 days per week in Knowsley Opportunity to join a growing Data Science team at an early stage of its journey Exposure to high-profile customer and commercial projects Significant opportunity to influence tooling, processes, and best practice Ongoing professional development and career progression opportunities Inclusive and collaborative working environment How to Apply If you're a Data Scientist who enjoys solving real business problems with data and wants to help shape a growing machine learning capability, apply today to find out more.

items.card: In this role, you will be responsible for scoping, developing, validating, and documenting machine-learning-based solutions which will form the core of the products that INGA develops. You will collaborate closely with other scientists and analysts in evaluating model performance to ensure the best possible performance. We are looking for curious and empathetic individuals who are committed to developing themselves
items.desc: Discover ING Hubs Romania ING Hubs Romania offers 130 services in software development, data management, non-financial risk & compliance, audit, and retail operations to 24 ING units worldwide, with the help of over 2000 high-performing engineers, risk, and operations professionals. We started out in 2015 as ING’s software development hub, then steadily expanded our range to include more services and competencies. Now we provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities and operate from our office in Bucharest. Our tech capabilities remain the core of our business , with more than 1800 colleagues active in Data Management, Touchpoint Channels & Integration, Core Banking, and Global Products. We enjoy a flexible way of working and a highly collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged. For us, impact isn't a perk. It's the driver of our work. We are guided and rewarded by a shared desire to make the world a better place, one innovative solution at a time. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things and they love doing it in good company. Do you? The Mission Within ING, there is ING Analytics (INGA) - a major driving force in its digital transformation of the bank. By creating measurable value for ING and its customers through world-class analytics products and services, INGA helps ING to become a data-driven leader. Among others, INGA delivers call & speech analytics, generative AI in risk summarization, insights into portfolio performance, advanced ESG data insights (commercial purposes), data analytics platforms (cloud and on-premises), and many more. We are looking for a Data Scientist to join us in Bucharest. In this role, you will be responsible for scoping, developing, validating, and documenting machine-learning-based solutions which will form the core of the products that INGA develops. You will collaborate closely with other scientists and analysts in evaluating model performance to ensure the best possible performance. We are looking for curious and empathetic individuals who are committed to developing themselves and learning new skills. We hire people based on an evaluation of their potential and support them throughout their time in Bucharest. Come join us! Your day-to-day A typical day for a data scientist starts with coffee, catching up with colleagues, and drafting a plan for the coming day. After the standup, you will start developing machine learning solutions, adopting best practices and quality standards for fit-for-purpose model pipelines. As an effective team member of the model development & implementation team, you will challenge the status quo while addressing the requirements of the ING model governance. After lunch, you will prepare fraud advance models to be deployed to production. Finally, to wrap up the day, you will actively explore INGA’s domain and engage in creating a journey that makes our bank and our society safer. What You’ll Bring To The Team Bachelor's degree in computer science, mathematics, engineering, or econometrics. 3-5 years of work experience in the data science field. Good understanding of supervised and unsupervised machine learning methods. Strong Python programming skills, Apache Spark, SQL, Git. Excellent communication skills, capable of working collaboratively in a semi-remote, globally distributed team. Nice to have Broad experience with end-to-end machine learning projects; involvement in all modeling steps (from data extraction to production). Background in writing production-ready code and a solid understanding of object-oriented programming is a strong plus. Proactive and can-do attitude (self-steering). Curious mindset; you are collaborative and passionate about helping others to grow and improve. Able to embrace challenges in a fast-changing and complex environment. If you want to deep dive into the processing of personal data conducted by ING Hubs Romania during the recruitment process and your rights related to it, read the privacy notices on our website (make sure to scroll until you reach the Data Protection section/ Candidates tab).

items.card: In this role, you contribute to every phase of the model redevelopment cycle, from model initiation to internal validation and onsite inspections by DNB/ECB. You have advanced knowledge of statistics, coding, modelling decisions, and applicable regulations. You can clearly articulate your views and foster strong collaboration with stakeholders across the bank. Working environment ABN AMRO’s Risk Modelling department
items.desc: Data Scientist - Credit Risk Modelling At a glance We are looking for new medior colleagues to join our Non-Retail Credit Risk Modelling team within ABN AMRO's Risk Modelling department. Effectively managing risks is essential in banking. The importance of modelling in core banking processes, such as risk management, is growing rapidly. New technologies, data sources, and data-driven solutions bring countless opportunities. These opportunities drive competition and increasing regulatory demands on data and models. ABN AMRO is taking a proactive step by leveraging these opportunities to strengthen its competitive position. The Risk Modelling department aims to create risk models that enable risk-based decision-making and sustainable growth. Our models comply with regulations, accurately predict risks, and allow us to offer clients a sustainable price that aligns with their risk profile. Our team is committed to being at the forefront and cutting edge of these developments. Your job As a data scientist in the Non-Retail Credit Risk Modelling department, you play a key role in redeveloping credit risk models for various lending portfolios. You and your team are central to reshaping ABN AMRO’s credit risk model landscape, one of the major challenges in the bank’s risk management. In this role, you contribute to every phase of the model redevelopment cycle, from model initiation to internal validation and onsite inspections by DNB/ECB. You have advanced knowledge of statistics, coding, modelling decisions, and applicable regulations. You can clearly articulate your views and foster strong collaboration with stakeholders across the bank. Working environment ABN AMRO’s Risk Modelling department is a young and international team consisting of over 150 professionals from diverse backgrounds. As the bank’s centre of excellence for quantitative risk models, we play a crucial role in daily decision-making processes. Our models support activities like pricing deals, granting credits, and determining capital requirements. Our team thrives on intellectual challenges and has a hands-on mindset to deliver results. Collaboration is key to ensuring our work has maximum usability and a positive impact across the bank. Your profile You have a master's degree or PhD in a quantitative field; You have >2 years’ experience working in a credit risk modelling team e.g. IRB, IFRS9, Stress testing or related model development. You speak and write English fluently; You are an effective communicator, connecting easily with stakeholders on different levels of seniority; You are familiar with relevant coding languages, such as Spark, Python and SQL. Experience with Azure DevOps / git is a pre. You have thorough knowledge of banking and credit risk; You have thorough knowledge of rules and regulations and regulatory trends relevant for credit risk modelling (Basel, CRR, etc); Experience in working with DNB/ECB through communication and on-site inspections is a pre. Do you have what it takes to meet this challenge? Do you have experience with large projects with a strong quantitative character, and an eye for detail? Or are you a top talent in the field of quantitative risk management, and ready for the next step in your career? Look no further and apply to this role, we look forward to get to know you! We are offering We believe it is important to be a good employer. Joining us means stepping into a role with impact, supported by excellent employment conditions that foster your job satisfaction, development, and wellbeing. In addition, we offer: An attractive gross monthly salary based on a 36-hour work week, including holiday allowanceand a flexible benefit budget. An excellent pension scheme, ensuring that you are well prepared for the future. Flexibility in working: working from home is possible in consultation with your team and depending on your role. We will provide an ergonomic home office setup for you. Plenty of room for relaxation with five weeks of vacation per year, supplemented by two mandatory days off. You can also purchase up to four additional weeks of vacation annually. Five “Banking for better days”: extra days off that you can use for personal development or volunteer work. Personal development is key: you receive a development budget of €1,000 per year, which can accumulate up to €3,000. An annual public transport pass with free public transportation throughout the Netherlands for both business and private use. You can find more information about our employment conditions and salary scales in our Collective Labour Agreement (CLA), which applies to this vacancy. Interested? Interested in this position? Please send us your application! Your Future: Inclusive, Innovative, Sustainable At ABN AMRO, we believe in " Banking for better, for generations to come. " Equal opportunities for everyone are a crucial foundation, as we strive for an inclusive culture where all employees feel seen, heard, and valued. Our vision of being …

items.card: What You Will Do Strengthen our ML framework: Build and improve the framework our researchers use to build models and quantitative strategies. Build production-ready software: Design and develop reliable, scalable, and well-tested Python software that integrates machine learning into our internal trading platforms. items.desc: Join Copenhagen Energy Trading as our new Machine Learning Engineer Machine learning is becoming an increasingly important part of how we understand energy markets, improve forecasts, and make trading decisions. We are therefore looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to move our models from research to production, building robust, scalable pipelines that continuously improve our strategies. At Copenhagen Energy Trading (CET), we combine deep market expertise with machine learning, quantitative research, data, and engineering to automate and optimise how we trade power. We’re a small, highly ambitious team based in central Copenhagen, specialising in power trading and asset management across Europe and North America. Technology is at the core of how we operate, supported by one of Europe’s most advanced automated and analytical trading environments for power markets. The Opportunity Energy markets produce vast amounts of data and are continuously shaped by weather, power production, transmission constraints, and market behaviour. Using that data meaningfully requires accurate models and reliable software and infrastructure that allow those models to run in production. As our Machine Learning Engineer, you’ll work across machine learning and software development. Alongside quantitative researchers, software engineers and traders, you’ll build the production systems behind our ML pipelines, making our trading more performant, more reliable and more automated. You’ll own the full lifecycle around the model: from data management to the pipelines and frameworks that deploy and monitor our models, keeping them reliable and adaptive as markets evolve. The opportunity for impact is large, and so is what it asks of you: dedication, real talent and the willingness to grind through hard problems. This is a hands-on engineering role at the centre of how CET uses machine learning to trade. What You Will Do Strengthen our ML framework: Build and improve the framework our researchers use to build models and quantitative strategies. Build production-ready software: Design and develop reliable, scalable, and well-tested Python software that integrates machine learning into our internal trading platforms. Develop data infrastructure: Build and maintain data pipelines and storage solutions for ingesting, transforming, and serving diverse market and fundamental data. Ship and operate models: Take models from experiment to production, including deployment, serving, monitoring and experiment tracking Improve our ML and engineering practices: Help strengthen our approach to MLOps, testing, CI/CD, code reviews, and the wider model development lifecycle. Shape our technical solutions: Evaluate and introduce tools and technologies that improve how we develop, deploy, and operate machine learning solutions. Collaborate across disciplines: Work closely with quantitative researchers, traders, and software engineers to turn business and market needs into practical technical solutions. Build energy-market expertise: Develop a deep understanding of power markets and how machine learning, data, and software can improve trading decisions. What We're Looking For We value strong technical ability, sound judgement, curiosity, and motivation to learn. While we don't expect a perfect match, many of the following qualifications will help you succeed in the role: Strong software engineering skills: Experience building clean, scalable, tested, and production-ready software. Strong Python skills are essential, as Python is our primary development language. MLOps and development practices: Proficiency in Git, code reviews, CI/CD, experiment tracking, model deployment, and monitoring. Cloud computing: Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP, ideally including relevant data and machine learning services. Problem-solving and communication: The ability to structure complex problems, communicate clearly, and collaborate with colleagues across technical and commercial disciplines. Full professional proficiency in English is required. Ownership : The ability to work independently and deliver in a fast-paced environment. Interest in energy markets: Curiosity about power markets, trading, and energy systems. Previous experience in energy or trading is an advantage, but not a requirement. Education: A degree with a strong technical focus, e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, or other relevant fields. We welcome different educational backgrounds and levels of qualification. What We Offer Growth environment: Become part of a young, ambitious, and expanding tech-driven trading company where talented people are given responsibility and room to grow. Exceptional team: Work closely with experienced quantitative researchers, software engineers and power traders. Competitive compensation: Receive a competitive salary package and attractive benefits that reflect your skills and contributions. items.card: Job Description Do you thrive in designing and developing software solutions for modular robotics platforms? As a Software Engineer within vision and robotics, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining
items.desc: Job Description Do you thrive in designing and developing software solutions for modular robotics platforms? Are you motivated by taking responsibility for the entire software development process and ensuring compliance with quality and architectural standards? If so, we might have the right job for you! As a Software Engineer within vision and robotics, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining software solutions while ensuring compliance with quality and architectural standards. Moreover, you will contribute to the successful implementation of solutions by conducting training sessions for internal stakeholders and end users. You will support projects, collaborate closely with the Technical Product Owner (TPO), and ensure valuable feedback from projects and site integration is used for adjustments and further development. Responsibility for Vision and Robotics Responsibilities We are a global organization, but you will be working from our office in Aarhus and be part of a small team of highly skilled colleagues in logistics. You will join the Robot Product Team, which covers multiple disciplines – Electrical, Mechanical, Automation – with you as the software responsible. You will work in close collaboration with the TPO, who acts as Product Owner, and you will have sparring opportunities with software colleagues across the organization to support knowledge sharing and development. Here, your responsibilities will be: Improving new software products related to vision and robotic applications and supporting their use in projects. Maintaining and developing software applications according to our operating model and applicable standards. Ensuring code quality through reviews, documentation, and adherence to coding and architectural guidelines. Offering input to automation strategy and technical requirements and setting product requirements in collaboration with the business. Testing and validating functionalities on our local test loop or on sites. Collaborating with interdisciplinary teams on a common system and evaluating and selecting appropriate technologies for automation and system integration. Experienced Software Developer You are familiar with commonly used tools, frameworks, and libraries relevant to 3D vision, point cloud processing, and AI development, and can evaluate and apply them effectively based on product needs. Additionally, we imagine that: You hold a bachelor's or master's degree, or an equivalent qualification in computer science, engineering, or a related field. You have solid proficiency developing real-time applications in C# and Python. You possess solid expertise in classical computer vision and 3D geometry, with a strong focus on point cloud processing and object recognition. Experience or interest in machine learning and signal processing is highly relevant, as these fields play an increasing role in advancing vision and robotics applications. You have experience in developing and maintaining various software architectures such as Docker and Kubernetes. You possess strong knowledge of software design principles, design patterns, and effort estimation for development tasks, and have hands-on experience with version control systems (e.g., Git), as well as software prototyping and conceptualization. You bring a solid understanding of high-level integration with robotic systems and can design and implement interfaces that enable effective communication between software components and robotic controls. You can combine input from multiple sensors into valuable insights. This could be cameras, LiDAR's, encoders, safety sensors etc. Moreover, you demonstrate innovative thinking, analytical skills, and a strong problem-solving mindset. You bring excellent communication skills, team spirit, and a high willingness to learn. You enjoy working collaboratively across disciplines in a diverse and inclusive environment. Interested? If you find the description interesting, please do not hesitate to contact Henning Horn Lauritsen +45 8741 4674 with any question you might have or apply via the link. We look very much forward to hearing from you! BEUMER Group Conveying, loading, palletizing, packing, sortation, and distribution – BEUMER Group is a leader within the development and manufacture of high-technological intralogistics systems for global markets. Our employees stand out from others thanks to their ability to supply innovative solutions to our customers. They can do this because they know the industry and are passionate about continuously developing and expanding their knowledge. We support these high standards through teamwork, mutual respect and a working culture based on trust that fosters stability and security for all our employees. Our common goal is to implement outstanding and innovative projects worldwide.

Uni), vorzugsweise in Bildungswissenschaften, Hochschuldidaktik, Medienpädagogik, Sozialwissenschaften oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet Interesse an den Themen Künstliche Intelligenz, digitale Lehre und Hochschulentwicklung Erste Erfahrungen in der Organisation, Begleitung oder Durchführung von Projekten, Veranstaltungen oder Qualifizierungsangeboten sind wünschenswert Freude an der Zusammenarbeit und dem Austausch mit Studierenden, Lehrenden und weiteren Projektpartnern Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie sicherer Umgang mit gängigen digitalen Anwendungen Was wir Ihnen bieten Homeoffice Bis zu 30 Urlaubs- & 24 Gleittage Familienfreundlicher Arbeitgeber Flache Hierarchien, viele Fortbildungs- & Weiterbildungsangebote Innovatives Arbeitsumfeld & sicheres Arbeitsverhältnis beim Freistaat Bayern Gute Anbindung & zentrale Lage Es handelt sich um eine bis 31.12.2027 befristete Vollzeitstelle mit einem Beschäftigungsumfang von 40 Wochenstunden im Angestelltenverhältnis. items.desc: HQ Air Command, RAF High Wycombe, HP14 4UE Job Summary This role sits within the Deputy Director People pillar, placing the team at the heart of the Air People Directorate, supporting and influencing data and analysis across the different People areas. The role is part of the Digital and Analytics team, which is set up to: Provide the 2* directorate and wider RAF with the best digital solutions, people data, analytics and insights available. Support data driven decision making. Ensure quality data is maintained and reflected in our data and dashboard products. The People Analytics and Insight Data Scientist position is a new role which will play a critical part in driving the analytical outputs of the People Analytics and Insight team. The products and processes developed within this role will directly link to the quality and timeliness of decision making at senior levels. This is an exciting position with opportunities to develop advanced analytics outputs and structures which will be crucial to progressing the scope of and impact of the team. While the role does not require direct line management of others, part of its purpose will be to develop tools that can be utilised and maintained by existing members of the team, building greater resilience and contributing to their future development. The team has ambitions to deliver a 10-year analytics roadmap as part of the People Analytics Transformation (PATx). This is aimed at transitioning into the employment of more advanced analytics. This role will be pivotal in refining and facilitating delivery of this strategy. This position is advertised at 37 hours per week. Job Description The People Analytics and Insight Data Scientist will develop advanced analytical products that improve the quality and timeliness of senior decision-making. The post holder will develop and maintain data models, machine learning pipelines, forecasts, dashboards and supporting data processes. The post holder will work with stakeholders across Air to turn complex workforce questions into clear, evidence-based insights, while ensuring products are robust, assured and maintainable by the wider team. The post holder will work autonomously within agreed priorities, applying professional judgement when selecting analytical methods and escalating matters with wider policy or strategic implications. The post holder must have the ability to work in a fast-paced and evolving environment, where attention to detail is critical. The projects (military & civilian data) have considerable interest at all levels of the leadership and as a result the post has significant exposure to senior civilian and military staff. This is a positive, fast-moving team, at the forefront of the RAF in terms of modernising the way the Department captures and utilises data. The job holder is responsible to SO1 People Analytics and Insight for: Creating data models, machine learning pipelines, forecasts and other advanced analytical processes to support team outputs. Identifying and clearly explaining data-led solutions to business problems, including recommendations for non-technical and senior stakeholders. Developing data cleansing, transformation, validation and assurance processes that support accurate, timely and reliable analysis. Engaging stakeholders across Air to identify opportunities for advanced analytics, facilitating data discovery and applying RICE analysis where appropriate. Leading small teams of data analysts when required, setting the analytical approach and ensuring delivery to agreed quality standards and timescales. Refactoring existing products and processes where specialist expertise is not available within the analyst team, ensuring technical quality, resilience and maintainability. Working with SO1 People Analytics and Insight to identify skills gaps and recommend and prioritise technical upskilling for the wider team. Providing training and designing product maintenance arrangements that reflect the capability of the analysts who will sustain them. Deputising for SO1 People Analytics and Insight when required, including coordinating tasks, presenting technical matters and representing People Analytics at executive meetings within delegated authority. Managing and delivering higher-complexity Management Information requests received through the People Analytics Front Door, including integrating multiple data sources, resolving data-quality issues and providing evidence-based recommendations. Completing all required project documentation and complying with relevant security, assurance, diversity and inclusion, health and safety, and mandatory training requirements. The People Analytics and Insight Data Scientist will develop advanced analytical products that improve the quality and timeliness of senior decision-making. items.desc: Notre entreprise Infotel Conseil accompagne les directions Informatiques et Métiers des grandes entreprises depuis plus de 40 ans (Airbus, BNP Paribas, Banque de France, BPCE, Air France, Arkéa, Stellantis, etc.). C’est aujourd’hui plus de 3 100 Infotéliens qui ont rejoint le groupe en France (Paris, Toulouse, Lyon, Bordeaux, Lille, Rennes, Nantes, etc.) et à l’étranger (UK, Monaco, Allemagne, US, Canada, Inde, Maroc). Nous avons ainsi réalisé en 2025 un chiffre d’affaires de 294,5 M€. Infotel Conseil, spécialiste des projets IT, intervient pour ses clients sur la gestion et l’évolution de leur patrimoine informatique. Dans le cadre du développement de notre agence de Lille, nous recherchons un Lead Tech IA pour accompagner la conception et la mise en œuvre de solutions d’intelligence artificielle innovantes. Vos missions En tant que Tech Lead IA, vous êtes le référent technique sur les projets d’intelligence artificielle. Vous intervenez de la définition des architectures jusqu’à la mise en production des solutions, tout en accompagnant les équipes de développement dans leur montée en compétences. 1/ Concevoir et développer des architectures IA agentiques Définir les architectures cibles et les standards de développement IA dans un environnement multicloud : AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI et Azure Foundry. Concevoir le harness des agents : orchestration, intégration des outils et serveurs MCP, gestion du contexte et sécurité. Développer des composants réutilisables pour faciliter la création et l’industrialisation des solutions IA. Faire évoluer les cas d’usage à forte valeur ajoutée, du prototype à la mise en production. 2/ Évaluer les modèles et les agents IA Construire un dispositif commun d’évaluation des modèles et des agents, avec des jeux de test élaborés en collaboration avec les équipes métiers. Comparer les performances des différents LLM et fournisseurs sur des cas d’usage concrets. S’appuyer sur des résultats mesurables pour orienter les choix technologiques. 3/ Industrialiser les solutions et maîtriser les coûts Collaborer avec l’équipe DevOps pour mettre en place les pipelines CI/CD, l’observabilité et les mécanismes de contrôle et de sécurité (guardrails). Définir les critères de passage en production en intégrant les exigences de cybersécurité et les contraintes réglementaires. Piloter les coûts d’exploitation des solutions IA : suivi de la consommation de tokens et des ressources de calcul, optimisation et prévisions budgétaires. 4/ Accompagner les équipes sur les pratiques IA Partager les bonnes pratiques de développement agentique, notamment autour de Claude Code et des outils équivalents. Intervenir comme référent technique IA auprès des équipes Développement, Infrastructure, Data, Cybersécurité, Juridique et des métiers. Assurer une veille sur les évolutions des modèles, frameworks agentiques et méthodes d’évaluation pour faire évoluer les pratiques techniques. Votre profil Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une formation supérieure en informatique (Bac+5, école d’ingénieurs ou équivalent) et justifiez d’une expérience confirmée en développement logiciel, avec une expertise en intelligence artificielle. items.desc: ﻿Du möchtest Künstliche Intelligenz nicht nur kennenlernen, sondern in Anwendungen überführen, die wirklich eingesetzt werden? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung ! Die FERI AG mit Hauptsitz in Bad Homburg zählt zu den führenden bankenunabhängigen Asset Managern in der DACH-Region. Mit mehr als 280 Mitarbeitenden verbinden wir aktives Asset Management mit persönlicher Beratung, um Vermögen langfristig zu schützen und nachhaltig weiterzuentwickeln. Seit 1987 bietet FERI für institutionelle Investoren, Familienvermögen und Stiftungen maßgeschneiderte Investmentlösungen, die aktives Vermögensmanagement und wissenschaftlich fundierte Analysen verbinden. Gemeinsam mit MLP betreut FERI derzeit ein Vermögen von über 68 Milliarden Euro, davon mehr als 18 Milliarden Euro in alternativen Investments. Das IT Development der FERI AG ist ein kompetenter Lösungsanbieter für individuelle und leistungsfähige Softwareentwicklungen: Es ist maßgeblich verantwortlich für die Erstellung oder Anpassung individueller und leistungsfähiger Software-Lösungen sowie den professionellen Betrieb von Anwendungen. DEINE AUFGABEN Bringe KI von der Idee in den produktiven Einsatz Du möchtest Künstliche Intelligenz nicht nur kennenlernen, sondern in Anwendungen überführen, die wirklich eingesetzt werden? In der FERI IT entwickelst du gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen KI-Agenten, Softwarelösungen und Automatisierungen für konkrete Geschäftsprozesse. Dabei begleitest du Lösungen vom Prototyp bis zum sicheren und nachhaltigen Betrieb. Du entwickelst, erweiterst und betreibst KI-Agenten sowie agentenbasierte Anwendungen Du integrierst KI-Modelle, KI-Dienste, Datenquellen und externe Systeme über APIs und andere Schnittstellen Du untersuchst neue KI-Technologien anhand konkreter Anwendungsfälle und überführst geeignete Prototypen in produktive Lösungen Du entwickelst Anwendungen, Services und Automatisierungen für IT- und Geschäftsprozesse, unter anderem mit individueller Softwareentwicklung und Microsoft Power Automate Du berücksichtigst Anforderungen an Sicherheit, Datenschutz, Berechtigungen, Monitoring und technische Dokumentation Du arbeitest mit unseren Fachbereichen zusammen und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in technische Lösungen DEIN PROFIL Qualifikation: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium in Artificial Intelligence, Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang Erfahrung: Erste praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, KI-Entwicklung oder Automatisierung, beispielsweise durch Studienprojekte, Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeiten oder eigene Projekte Kompetenzen: Praktische Programmierkenntnisse in mindestens einer modernen Programmiersprache, vorzugsweise C# oder Python Grundkenntnisse: in Machine Learning, generativer KI, Large Language Models oder KI-Agenten Fähigkeiten: Analytisches und strukturiertes Denkvermögen, hohe Sorgfalt und Qualitätsorientierung Soft Skills: Teamfähigkeit, Eigeninitiative und ausgeprägte Lern- und Entwicklungsbereitschaft Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse Grundkenntnisse in: SQL, APIs, Cloud-Plattformen, Git, DevOps oder automatisierten Tests Von Vorteil: Erfahrungen mit Microsoft Power Automate oder vergleichbaren Automatisierungsplattformen Wichtig : Du musst noch nicht jede genannte Technologie beherrschen. Entscheidend sind eine solide technische Grundlage und die Bereitschaft, dich strukturiert in neue Themen einzuarbeiten. items.title: Data Scientist
items.card: Cosa farai Il tuo obiettivo è possedere le metriche di Jet HR e trasformarle in modelli predittivi , dal dato grezzo alle decisioni di Sales, Growth e Ops. Nel concreto: Sei owner dei modelli dbt che sono la source of truth delle metriche di Jet per Ops, Growth, Sales, Finance e Product. Costruisci il semantic layer delle north star metrics: la base della self-service analytics e degli agenti AI che interrogano i
items.desc: Avrai completo controllo dei numeri con cui Jet HR prende ogni decisione, e ci costruirai sopra modelli predittivi e agenti AI per scalare. Cosa farai Il tuo obiettivo è possedere le metriche di Jet HR e trasformarle in modelli predittivi , dal dato grezzo alle decisioni di Sales, Growth e Ops. Nel concreto: Sei owner dei modelli dbt che sono la source of truth delle metriche di Jet per Ops, Growth, Sales, Finance e Product. Costruisci il semantic layer delle north star metrics: la base della self-service analytics e degli agenti AI che interrogano i dati. Costruisci MCP e agenti AI per l’analisi dati e per automatizzare i processi GTM (Sales, Marketing, Customer Success), misurandone l’impatto. Crei analisi che orientano le decisioni concrete di Growth e Ops. Porti la self-service su Metabase a tutta l’azienda, a partire dai domini ancora scoperti. Test, documentazione e monitoring inclusi. Sviluppi modelli predittivi end-to-end - lead scoring, attribution multi-touch, forecasting - dalla definizione del problema al deploy e al monitoraggio. Come lavoriamo Il team Data di Jet HR non è un semplice team di supporto. È la funzione che costruisce l’intera piattaforma dati su cui gira il prodotto e i prodotti AI che lo estendono. Data platform. Lavoriamo su una piattaforma scalabile e robusta: architettura, automazione, data products. Niente one-off, niente workaround. Self-service. Ogni team di Jet deve poter lavorare sui dati in autonomia. Dobbiamo essere un moltiplicatore, non un collo di bottiglia. Tech-first. Il team è composto da data engineers, analytics engineers, data scientists e AI engineers. Collaboriamo strettamente con prodotto, sales e operations per trasformare i dati in asset strategici. Niente task banali. Non esistono report manuali da tenere in vita. Automatizziamo, ottimizziamo, costruiamo soluzioni che durano. Tech stack DBT · Snowflake · Python · Metabase · DltHub · Apache Airflow · Docker · AWS Chi cerchiamo 3+ anni di esperienza in analytics engineering, data science o data engineering. Parli italiano. Per combattere la burocrazia bisogna prima capirla profondamente. Statistica applicata. Hai usato modellazione statistica e causal inference (A/B test, metodi quasi-sperimentali) su problemi di business reali. Data modelling. Hai lavorato con modelli dimensionali (star/snowflake schema) e/o Data Vault. Python solido. Lo usi ogni giorno per analisi, modelli e pipeline, con codice pulito e testabile. Cosa offriamo €45.000 – €60.000 di RAL. Full remote. Per davvero. Puoi lavorare da dove vuoi, basta che sia in una timezone compatibile con l’Italia. Se vuoi, il nostro ufficio a Milano è pronto ad accoglierti. Due volte l’anno abbiamo un meetup di 3 giorni, tutto pagato da Jet. Ownership di quello che fai. Non hai spec iper-dettagliate, non sei un mero esecutore. Sei tu responsabile dell’output finale. Impatto concreto. Siamo una start-up, ognuno dà un contributo essenziale allo sviluppo dei prodotti e alla crescita di Jet. Il tuo lavoro fa la differenza per migliaia di clienti. Start-up environment. Non è una startup qualsiasi, ma una ben finanziata e zeppa di talenti. In 6 mesi vedrai ed imparerai cose che altrove forse vedresti in anni, con un altissimo livello di responsabilità e coinvolgimento. Processo di selezione Prima interview con Talent Tech interview con Head of Data & AI Final interview con il team

items.desc: Open Huis - Next Step in ICT in Amsterdam Ben je benieuwd naar onze cultuur, opdrachten en ontwikkelmogelijkheden? Bezoek op 11 november 2026 ons event Open Huis - Next Step in ICT in Amsterdam. Spar met onze consultants over actuele ontwikkelingen in IT, kom meer te weten over onze uitdagende opdrachten en krijg advies over jouw carrièremogelijkheden en de vaardigheden die de komende jaren het verschil maken. Meld je aan (hyperlink naar https://www.cimsolutions.nl/aanmelden-open-huis-next-step-in-ict-amsterdam/) Als Data Analytics Specialist / Data Analist / Data Scientist ben je verantwoordelijk voor het verzamelen, analyseren en interpreteren van data om inzichten te verkrijgen en te gebruiken voor datagedreven besluitvorming bij of voor onze gerenommerde klanten waaronder Belastingdienst, Gemeente Den Haag, diverse ministeries, Centraal Justitieel Incassobureau of VGZ. Afhankelijk van het ervaringsniveau ligt de focus op verschillende aspecten van data-analyse en data science. Waarom past deze vacature bij jou? Je bent analytisch, nieuwsgierig en gedreven om maatschappelijke impact te maken met data. Je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen techniek en beleid en weet abstracte analyses te vertalen naar concrete inzichten. Je draagt graag bij aan kennisdeling, continu verbeteren en datagedreven werken binnen onze klanten. Je vindt het leuk om kennis te delen met collega’s, klanten en vakgenoten. Je voelt je thuis in een informele, collegiale en professionele omgeving, waar de aandacht voor de klant en voor de medewerker centraal staan. Wat ga je doen? Verzamelen, opschonen, transformeren en valideren van data uit verschillende bronnen. Toepassen van statistische methoden en data-analyse technieken om patronen, trends en inzichten uit data te halen. Ontwikkelen van geavanceerde machine learning modellen. Resultaten van analyses visualiseren en presenteren in heldere dashboards, rapporten en presentaties. Adviseren over datagedreven besluitvorming aan management en stakeholders. Coachen en (bege)leiden van medior en junior Data Specialisten. Effectief samenwerken met Data Engineers, Data Stewards, business analisten en andere stakeholders. Wat kun jij van ons verwachten? Een vast dienstverband voor onbepaalde tijd, een max. salaris van € 8.000,- bonusregeling, leaseauto, pensioenregeling en maandelijkse onkostenvergoeding; Opdrachtkeuzevrijheid: Jij bepaalt in overleg waar je aan werkt, met de begeleiding van een personal coach; Per jaar € 5.000,- opleidingsbudget en daarnaast ook nog eens 5-10 dagen studietijd; Kennissessies met vakgenoten en inhoudelijke events; Minimaal 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen op te bouwen of te verkopen; Sociale events zoals sportdagen, weekend weg en gezellige borrels; Een vestiging bij jou in de buurt. Jouw ontwikkeling, onze prioriteit CIMSOLUTIONS biedt jou een omgeving waarin je kunt doorgroeien naar Data Architect / Data Consultant. Je krijgt ruimte, ondersteuning en middelen om je te specialiseren en te excelleren. We bieden toegang tot diverse opleidingen en ondersteunen je met ervaren collega's. Onze slogan "Learn, create and make it work" is niet zomaar een zin – het is de kern van hoe wij werken en ontwikkelen. CIMSOLUTIONS heeft een actief diversiteitsbeleid en streeft naar een evenwichtige verdeling van professionals naar o.a. leeftijd, gender, etnische achtergrond en cultuur, arbeidsvermogen, kennis en competenties. Hierbij benadrukken wij dat wij gelijke kansen belangrijk vinden in de selectie. Wat breng jij mee? Een afgeronde wo-opleiding in Data Science, AI, Informatiekunde, Business Analytics of vergelijkbaar; Minimaal drie jaar aantoonbare ervaring in een Agile omgeving met het analyseren en interpreteren van data en het vertalen van inzichten naar concrete adviezen; Vaardig in het ontwerpen van dashboards en visualisaties die inzichten helder presenteren; Diepgaande kennis van statistische methoden, machine learning technieken en algoritmen; Ervaring met het ontwikkelen en trainen van machine learning modellen; Kennis van actuele ontwikkelingen op het gebied van data-analyse, data-ethiek en relevante wet- en regelgeving; Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk; Voor senior functies ervaring met het leiden van data science projecten en kennisdeling; AI-affiniteit is een pré. Waarom CIMSOLUTIONS? 15 keer Top Employer! Uitstekend salaris; Vrije keuze leaseauto; € 5000,- opleidingsbudget; Aantrekkelijke bonussen; Veel sociale evenementen; Uitdagende projecten; Gevarieerde opdrachten; Gerenommeerde klanten. Heb je interesse? Wij vinden het leuk om op ons hoofdkantoor of één van onze lokale vestigingen of online kennis te maken. Solliciteer via onderstaande button of neem voor meer informatie contact op met ons recruitment team via: Mail: recruitment@cimsolutions.nl; Telefoon: 0499-366 000; of bezoek onze website: www.cimsolutions.nl/werken-bij/

Bezoek op 11 november 2026 ons event Open Huis - Next Step in ICT in Amsterdam. Spar met onze consultants over actuele ontwikkelingen in IT, kom meer te weten over onze uitdagende opdrachten en krijg advies over jouw carrièremogelijkheden en de vaardigheden die de komende jaren het verschil maken. Meld je aan (hyperlink naar https://www.cimsolutions.nl/aanmelden-open-huis-next-step-in-ict-amsterdam/) Als Data Scientist lever je inzichten uit gegevens door het analyseproces te optimaliseren en visuele gegevensrepresentaties te presenteren. Je zoekt, beheert en voegt meerdere gegevensbronnen samen en zorgt voor consistentie van gegevenssets. Je identificeert de wiskundige modellen, selecteert en optimaliseert de algoritmen om bedrijfswaarde te leveren door middel van inzichten. Je stelt patronen vast en beveelt manieren aan om gegevens toe te passen. Waarom past deze vacature bij jou? Jij wilt jezelf blijven ontwikkelen en dat zit in ons DNA! Met jouw inzicht in cijfers, data en techniek leg je elke complexiteit simpel uit aan de klant. Klanttevredenheid is belangrijk voor je, dus je luistert goed en geeft inzichtelijke antwoorden die de klant het vertrouwen geeft dat het probleem wordt opgelost. Aan de hand van de informatiebehoefte van jouw stakeholders ontwikkel, test en implementeer je data science-modellen en help je collega’s om de mogelijkheden die schuilen in de rijke data bij onze gerenommeerde klanten, optimaal te benutten. Natuurlijk houd je daarbij de ontwikkelingen in het vak goed in de gaten. Krijg jij energie van het ontdekken van nieuwe kansen met data science? Je voelt je thuis in een informele, collegiale en professionele sfeer waar de aandacht voor de klant en voor de medewerker centraal staan. Wat kun jij van ons verwachten? Naast een dienstverband voor onbepaalde tijd, een max. salaris van € 8.000, bonusregeling, leaseauto, pensioenregeling en maandelijkse onkostenvergoeding; € 5.000,- opleidingsbudget en daarnaast 5-10 dagen studietijd; Kennissessies met andere SIG Data Analytics en Competence Center Data Analyse, Big data en BI; 25 vakantiedagen en snel oplopend tot 28 vakantiedagen per jaar; Het aan- of verkopen van vakantiedagen; Regelmatig sociale uitjes zoals sportdagen, weekendjes weg en gezellige borrels. Jouw ontwikkeling, onze prioriteit We bieden jou persoonlijke ontwikkeling aan en zo werk je aan jouw carrière. Learn, create and make it work is niet alleen onze slogan, maar is ons DNA. Als Data Scientist kun je doorgroeien naar diverse rollen, zoals Data Science Consultant, Business Analist, Senior Consultant. CIMSOLUTIONS heeft een actief diversiteitsbeleid en streeft naar een evenwichtige verdeling van professionals naar o.a. leeftijd, gender, etnische achtergrond en cultuur, arbeidsvermogen, kennis en competenties. Hierbij benadrukken wij dat wij gelijke kansen belangrijk vinden in de selectie. Wat breng jij mee? Minimaal een afgeronde WO-Masters opleiding met een sterk ICT-component Ervaring met het structureren en analyseren van grote hoeveelheden data om daarin relevante inzichten te ontdekken; Kennis van artificial intelligence, predictive analysis of Deepen/of Machine learning (libraries zoals TensorFlow, Keras, sklearn, Caffe, Torch); Kennis van en ervaring met één of meerdere analytics tools zoals R, Spark, Storm, HIVE, QlikView, Power BI, Splunk, MatLab, of SAS Suite etc.; Kennis van en ervaring met databasetechnologieën (Hadoop, SQL NoSQL, NewSQL etc.); Ervaring met het visualiseren van data met behulp van de laatste state-of-the-art technologieën; Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels. Waarom CIMSOLUTIONS? 15 keer Top Employer! Uitstekend salaris; Vrije keuze leaseauto; € 5000,- opleidingsbudget; Aantrekkelijke bonussen; Veel sociale evenementen; Uitdagende projecten; Gevarieerde opdrachten; Gerenommeerde klanten. items.title: Temp AI Engineer
items.card: In this role, you will be responsible for designing and implementing AI solutions to ensure the quality and reliability of embedded software developments. You will work closely with software developers, system architects and product owners to provide them the best AI state of the art solutions. Have you ever wondered how smartphones, connected cars, smartwatches, and IoT devices securely connect to mobile networks?
items.desc: G+D makes the lives of billions of people around the world more secure. We shape trust in the digital age with built-in security tech in three segments: Digital Security, Financial Platforms and Currency Technology. We have been a reliable partner for our customers for over 170 years with our innovative solutions for SecurityTech! We are an international technology group and traditional family business with over 14,000 employees in 40 countries. Creating Confidence is our path to success. Trust is the basis of our collaboration within G+D. We are the reliable partner for all challenges resulting from the Internet of Things. We offer a complete connectivity portfolio for mobile network operators, automotive manufacturers, technology companies such as chip and module manufacturers as well as transport and logistics providers. Our portfolio includes highly secure solutions in the area of connectivity & IoT, from classic SIM, eSIM and iSIM, to the associated embedded operating systems and life cycle management, through to services for global connectivity and IoT solutions. Do you want to actively shape the digital transformation with us? At G+D Mobile Security, the global leader in SIM and eSIM technologies, we are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented AI Engineer to join our SW development team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing and implementing AI solutions to ensure the quality and reliability of embedded software developments. You will work closely with software developers, system architects and product owners to provide them the best AI state of the art solutions. Have you ever wondered how smartphones, connected cars, smartwatches, and IoT devices securely connect to mobile networks? Join us in Barcelona and help shape the future of secure digital connectivity. What We Do Our Barcelona R&D center develops innovative products that are shaping the future of communications worldwide. We work directly with leading smartphone manufacturers, automotive companies, and major IoT players. Your work will have a direct impact on the reliability, scalability, and security of next generation solutions. Duties & Responsibilities Contribute to the R&D AI strategy definition and operation. Design and implement useful AI use cases and agent orchestration for embedded software developments. Analyze AI solution results, identify root causes of failures, and work with development teams to promote and increase the value of the provided AI solutions. Contribute to continuous improvement of SW development process, tools, and methodologies. Maintain AI solution documentation and generate dynamic KPIs and reports for internal stakeholders. Qualifications & Skills Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related field. Proven experience in AI solutions and agent orchestration. items.desc: Open Huis - Next Step in ICT in Amsterdam Ben je benieuwd naar onze cultuur, opdrachten en ontwikkelmogelijkheden? Bezoek op 11 november 2026 ons event Open Huis - Next Step in ICT in Amsterdam. Spar met onze consultants over actuele ontwikkelingen in IT, kom meer te weten over onze uitdagende opdrachten en krijg advies over jouw carrièremogelijkheden en de vaardigheden die de komende jaren het verschil maken. Meld je aan (hyperlink naar https://www.cimsolutions.nl/aanmelden-open-huis-next-step-in-ict-amsterdam/) Als Data Scientist lever je inzichten uit gegevens door het analyseproces te optimaliseren en visuele gegevensrepresentaties te presenteren. Je zoekt, beheert en voegt meerdere gegevensbronnen samen en zorgt voor consistentie van gegevenssets. Je identificeert de wiskundige modellen, selecteert en optimaliseert de algoritmen om bedrijfswaarde te leveren door middel van inzichten. Je stelt patronen vast en beveelt manieren aan om gegevens toe te passen. Waarom past deze vacature bij jou? Jij wilt jezelf blijven ontwikkelen en dat zit in ons DNA! Met jouw inzicht in cijfers, data en techniek leg je elke complexiteit simpel uit aan de klant. Klanttevredenheid is belangrijk voor je, dus je luistert goed en geeft inzichtelijke antwoorden die de klant het vertrouwen geeft dat het probleem wordt opgelost. Aan de hand van de informatiebehoefte van jouw stakeholders ontwikkel, test en implementeer je data science-modellen en help je collega’s om de mogelijkheden die schuilen in de rijke data bij onze gerenommeerde klanten, optimaal te benutten. Natuurlijk houd je daarbij de ontwikkelingen in het vak goed in de gaten. Krijg jij energie van het ontdekken van nieuwe kansen met data science? Je voelt je thuis in een informele, collegiale en professionele sfeer waar de aandacht voor de klant en voor de medewerker centraal staan. Wat kun jij van ons verwachten? Naast een dienstverband voor onbepaalde tijd, een max. salaris van € 8.000, bonusregeling, leaseauto, pensioenregeling en maandelijkse onkostenvergoeding; € 5.000,- opleidingsbudget en daarnaast 5-10 dagen studietijd; Kennissessies met andere SIG Data Analytics en Competence Center Data Analyse, Big data en BI; 25 vakantiedagen en snel oplopend tot 28 vakantiedagen per jaar; Het aan- of verkopen van vakantiedagen; Regelmatig sociale uitjes zoals sportdagen, weekendjes weg en gezellige borrels. Jouw ontwikkeling, onze prioriteit We bieden jou persoonlijke ontwikkeling aan en zo werk je aan jouw carrière. Learn, create and make it work is niet alleen onze slogan, maar is ons DNA. Als Data Scientist kun je doorgroeien naar diverse rollen, zoals Data Science Consultant, Business Analist, Senior Consultant. CIMSOLUTIONS heeft een actief diversiteitsbeleid en streeft naar een evenwichtige verdeling van professionals naar o.a. leeftijd, gender, etnische achtergrond en cultuur, arbeidsvermogen, kennis en competenties. Hierbij benadrukken wij dat wij gelijke kansen belangrijk vinden in de selectie. Wat breng jij mee? Minimaal een afgeronde WO-Masters opleiding met een sterk ICT-component Ervaring met het structureren en analyseren van grote hoeveelheden data om daarin relevante inzichten te ontdekken; Kennis van artificial intelligence, predictive analysis of Deepen/of Machine learning (libraries zoals TensorFlow, Keras, sklearn, Caffe, Torch); Kennis van en ervaring met één of meerdere analytics tools zoals R, Spark, Storm, HIVE, QlikView, Power BI, Splunk, MatLab, of SAS Suite etc.; Kennis van en ervaring met databasetechnologieën (Hadoop, SQL NoSQL, NewSQL etc.); Ervaring met het visualiseren van data met behulp van de laatste state-of-the-art technologieën; Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels. Waarom CIMSOLUTIONS? 15 keer Top Employer! Uitstekend salaris; Vrije keuze leaseauto; € 5000,- opleidingsbudget; Aantrekkelijke bonussen; Veel sociale evenementen; Uitdagende projecten; Gevarieerde opdrachten; Gerenommeerde klanten. Ben je overtuigd? We willen graag kennis met je maken.
