items.desc: This role is ideal for candidates who are immediately available to interview and start a new role. The start date for this role is 7th December 2026! Junior AI Engineer Do you have an inquisitive mindset, enjoy problem solving, and have an interest in tech? Our Technology Academy provides you with the opportunity to learn everything you need to build a successful career in IT, across a range of roles, without any previous experience or a specific degree. In fact, if you don’t have a degree we definitely want to hear from you! Why choose CTA? We are an inclusive and diverse technology academy committed to creating equitable opportunities for those looking to work in tech. Our academy pays a competitive salary, above the National Living Wage from day one while you train, before finding the ideal client project for you to work on using the skills you've gained. About the role You’ll be joining us as an Associate Technology Consultant, working across AI Engineering and Software Quality Engineering . It all starts with our introductory training courses, covering everything you need to know to get started in the world of consulting. Our in-depth training is full time and is delivered on a hybrid learning basis (classroom & and remote). You'll learn a lot quite quickly – it will be fast-paced, but enjoyable and highly engaging! After the training period you’ll have the opportunity to gain industry experience by working with our clients on their projects. For this specific role you’ll be working as part of a global consultancy’s specialist team who are involved in the end-to-end design and implementation of solutions that the business and technology teams use to manage work, products and programmes! After a period of training you’ll have the opportunity to gain industry experience by working with one or more of our clients as an AI Engineer & Software Quality Engineer. While doing this you’ll get continued support from us and the client you work with. Our programme is designed as a two-year journey, giving you the opportunity to build meaningful industry experience, develop your technical and professional skills, and establish a strong foundation for your career. At the end of the programme, there may be opportunities to move into a permanent role with your client, depending on individual performance and opportunities available within the client organisation at the time. What does our Academy offer? A route into the tech industry as an Associate Technology Consultant, specialising in AI Engineering and Software Quality Engineering A structured career path and ongoing progression opportunities within the first years of employment. Training in a range of technologies and tools vital to the tech industry, including Agile and Scrum, databases, SQL, websites, Web Services and APIs, programming, software testing and test automation. You'll learn how these technologies work and how they're used in real-world projects. An introduction to data science, including how to prepare, analyse and interpret data, use statistics to understand patterns, and creating visualisations. Training in Python and tools such as NumPy and Pandas for working with data and PyTest for testing software. An introduction to AI and Machine Learning (ML), exploring how models learn from data, recognise patterns and work in practice, including large language models (LLMs), small language models (SLMs) and traditional ML models. Training in how AI systems are developed, trained, deployed and monitored to ensure they perform as expected. Specialist training in AI and Machine Learning testing, including checking data quality, evaluating model performance, testing AI tools and large language models (LLMs), and using test automation to improve reliability and efficiency. A role with one of our industry leading clients on one or more projects so you can explore where you want your career to go Ongoing learning and development opportunities, including on-the-job training and ongoing support from our experienced trainers and consultants. Access to a range of certifications covering various roles and technologies, including ISTQB, AWS, Azure, Scrum and more. About you - A passion for technology and a willingness to learn - A strong work ethic - you’re up for the challenge and ready to work hard for it - Loves working in teams - Strong communication skills - Good organisational skills, both personally and as part of a team - You have a degree, but it doesn’t have to be in CompSci or a STEM degree - You don’t have a degree, but you have some recent work experience or you’ve been doing some upskilling in technology recently What’s in it for you? - Earn a salary from day one of training, with structured career development, ongoing support and opportunities for salary progression throughout the programme - 25 days holidays , plus bank holidays. - 5% matched employer pension contributions. - Access to Mintago, our financial wellbeing partner – Connect with a personal …

items.desc: Hay proyectos donde un modelo no termina al entrenarse: empieza a aportar valor cuando llega a producción, se monitoriza y se mantiene estable. Aquí trabajarás con Python, MLOps, cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, MLflow y Stratio , en un entorno donde la industrialización de modelos tiene impacto real. Te incorporarás a un contexto técnico estable, con foco en analítica avanzada, operación de modelos en producción y calidad del ciclo de vida ML , con autonomía, continuidad y margen para seguir creciendo en prácticas modernas de datos, automatización y gobierno de modelos. Lo que hará que esta oportunidad te encaje ✅ Teletrabajo desde cualquier punto de España Podrás trabajar en remoto al 100%, con la flexibilidad de organizar tu vida sin depender de una ubicación concreta. ✅ Modelos que llegan a producción de verdad No te quedarás solo en notebooks: trabajarás en despliegue, operación, monitorización, retraining y control de drift. ✅ Stack técnico sólido y actual Python, Docker, Kubernetes, cloud, CI/CD, MLflow, pipelines de datos y herramientas MLOps formarán parte del entorno habitual. ✅ Especialización real en Stratio Podrás aplicar tu experiencia configurando, administrando y optimizando componentes clave de la plataforma. ✅ Horario pensado para organizar mejor tu semana Tres días de jornada intensiva y dos días de jornada partida, aportando equilibrio y previsibilidad. ✅ Salario claro desde el inicio SBA de 53.000 € . 🎯 Misión del rol Tu misión será desarrollar, desplegar, operar y mantener soluciones de machine learning en entornos productivos , asegurando que los modelos sean fiables, trazables, monitorizables y sostenibles en el tiempo. 💡 Cómo será tu día a día en este proyecto ▫️ Desarrollar soluciones en Python aplicadas a machine learning e ingeniería de datos. ▫️ Desplegar y operar modelos ML en entornos productivos . ▫️ Trabajar con Docker, Kubernetes y servicios cloud . ▫️ Diseñar y mantener pipelines de datos y automatizaciones CI/CD para ML . ▫️ Gestionar versionado de código y experimentos con Git, MLflow u otras herramientas equivalentes. ▫️ Monitorizar modelos, detectar drift y participar en procesos de retraining . ▫️ Configurar, administrar y optimizar componentes de Stratio . ▫️ Colaborar en prácticas de MLOps, gobernanza, explicabilidad y operación continua. 🌱 Qué te ayudará a tener éxito en esta posición Haber trabajado al menos 3 años en machine learning, ingeniería de datos o MLOps te permitirá entender bien el ciclo completo del modelo. Será clave que te muevas con comodidad en Python, cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD y herramientas de control de experimentos. También encajarás especialmente bien si tienes experiencia en monitorización de modelos, retraining, drift, Spark, Airflow, Kubeflow, APIs de inferencia, microservicios o proyectos de industrialización de modelos ML. 👉 Da el siguiente paso Si buscas un rol donde el machine learning no se queda en laboratorio, sino que se convierte en sistemas productivos estables, monitorizados y con recorrido técnico, esta posición puede darte continuidad, especialización y crecimiento real en MLOps.

items.desc: At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards. In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate. A few examples of your responsibilities Design and improve data pipelines. Contribute to the design and evolution of data systems—ensuring data is accurate, reliable, and efficiently processed across diverse tech stacks. Ensure data correctness and scalability. Work closely with software engineers to validate data, define metrics, and improve the robustness of reporting and analytics systems. Develop internal data products and tooling. Help build scalable solutions (e.g., reporting engines, forecasting tools) used by product teams across the company. Support platform-wide decision-making. Partner with multiple teams to provide the analytical and modeling backbone for business planning and performance tracking. Leverage AI to accelerate work and uncover insights. Use AI tools to move faster, surface ideas and opportunities, and study competing products and trends. What we look for Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter. Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar. Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent. Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English. What we offer Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field. An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too. All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work. Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity. Commitment & contract Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time. Location Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland). The selection process In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process. Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject. All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to …

items.desc: A Direção de Compliance pretende recrutar um Data Scientist para a área de Fraude. A Direção de Compliance tem como missão a gestão da Função Conformidade do Grupo Crédito Agrícola, garantindo o adequado cumprimento da legislação regulamentação aplicável e a Prevenção de Crime Financeiro. Principais responsabilidades: Investigar e analisar novos e emergentes modus operandi de fraude, acompanhando a evolução dos padrões e tendências no contexto bancário; Analisar grandes volumes de dados transacionais e comportamentais, recorrendo a SQL, Python e/ou R, com vista à identificação de padrões, anomalias e potenciais situações de fraude; Desenvolver, testar e otimizar modelos analíticos e de Machine Learning aplicados à prevenção e deteção de fraude; Traduzir os resultados das análises e investigações em insights acionáveis, contribuindo para a melhoria da eficácia e precisão dos mecanismos de deteção; Monitorizar e avaliar o desempenho dos modelos e mecanismos de deteção existentes, identificando eventuais lacunas, desvios e necessidades de ajustamento face à evolução dos padrões de fraude; Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos mecanismos de deteção, procurando assegurar um equilíbrio entre a identificação eficaz de situações de fraude e a redução de falsos positivos; Trabalhar em estreita articulação com as áreas de Fraude, Tecnologia, Risco, Compliance e outras áreas relevantes, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento e implementação de soluções de prevenção e deteção de fraude e para uma resposta integrada a novas ameaças; Documentar os resultados das análises, modelos e metodologias desenvolvidas, contribuindo para o reforço e partilha do conhecimento interno em matéria de fraude. Perfil pretendido: Formação superior em Data Science, Matemática, Estatística, Engenharia Informática, Engenharia ou área similar; Experiência profissional mínima de 4 anos em Data Science, Advanced Analytics ou Machine Learning, preferencialmente aplicada ao setor financeiro; Experiência sólida na utilização de SQL e na análise de grandes volumes de dados; Experiência na utilização de Python e/ou R; Conhecimentos de ferramentas de visualização e reporting, como Power BI, serão valorizados; Conhecimentos sólidos de análise estatística, Machine Learning e técnicas de deteção de anomalias; Forte capacidade analítica, de pensamento crítico e de resolução de problemas; Capacidade para trabalhar e interpretar grandes volumes de dados; Boas capacidades de comunicação e apresentação, incluindo experiência de contacto direto com clientes; Domínio da língua inglesa, oral e escrita; Será valorizada experiência nas áreas de fraude, pagamentos, cartões, serviços financeiros ou banca; Será valorizada experiência no desenvolvimento e aplicação de modelos de Machine Learning à deteção de fraude; Serão valorizados conhecimentos de AML, KYC e PSD2, bem como de outros referenciais relevantes no âmbito da prevenção e deteção de fraude. O que oferecemos: Integração numa instituição sólida, com forte presença no setor financeiro; Remuneração e benefícios de acordo com o ACT e práticas do setor bancário; Oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional numa equipa colaborativa e especializada; Perspetivas de evolução e crescimento na carreira. Se considera que o seu perfil se alinha com os nossos requisitos, este desafio é para si! O Grupo Crédito Agrícola destaca-se como uma entidade empregadora de referência, oferecendo um ambiente de trabalho que valoriza a segurança, a inovação, a sustentabilidade e o desenvolvimento profissional dos seus colaboradores. Com uma presença sólida no sector bancário e segurador, o Grupo proporciona oportunidades em diversas áreas, promovendo o crescimento contínuo e a formação especializada das suas equipas. Além disso, o Grupo está comprometido com práticas de responsabilidade social e ambiental, alinhando-se com políticas de sustentabilidade que reforçam o seu papel como agente de mudança positiva junto das comunidades locais. Integrar a equipa do Grupo Crédito Agrícola significa fazer parte de uma instituição que valoriza o talento, a diversidade, o compromisso com a excelência e a portugalidade, oferecendo um percurso profissional enriquecedor e alinhado com os desafios do mercado atual.

Lo que hará que esta oportunidad te encaje ✅ Teletrabajo desde cualquier punto de España Podrás trabajar en remoto al 100%, con la flexibilidad de organizar tu vida sin depender de una ubicación concreta. ✅ Modelos que llegan a producción de verdad No te quedarás solo en notebooks: trabajarás en despliegue, operación, monitorización, retraining y control de drift. ✅ Stack técnico sólido y actual Python, Docker, Kubernetes, cloud, CI/CD, MLflow, pipelines de datos y herramientas MLOps formarán parte del entorno habitual. ✅ Especialización real en Stratio Podrás aplicar tu experiencia configurando, administrando y optimizando componentes clave de la plataforma. ✅ Horario pensado para organizar mejor tu semana Tres días de jornada intensiva y dos días de jornada partida, aportando equilibrio y previsibilidad. ✅ Salario claro desde el inicio SBA de 53.000 € . 🎯 Misión del rol Tu misión será desarrollar, desplegar, operar y mantener soluciones de machine learning en entornos productivos , asegurando que los modelos sean fiables, trazables, monitorizables y sostenibles en el tiempo. 💡 Cómo será tu día a día en este proyecto ▫️ Desarrollar soluciones en Python aplicadas a machine learning e ingeniería de datos. ▫️ Desplegar y operar modelos ML en entornos productivos . ▫️ Trabajar con Docker, Kubernetes y servicios cloud . ▫️ Diseñar y mantener pipelines de datos y automatizaciones CI/CD para ML . ▫️ Gestionar versionado de código y experimentos con Git, MLflow u otras herramientas equivalentes. ▫️ Monitorizar modelos, detectar drift y participar en procesos de retraining . ▫️ Configurar, administrar y optimizar componentes de Stratio . ▫️ Colaborar en prácticas de MLOps, gobernanza, explicabilidad y operación continua. 🌱 Qué te ayudará a tener éxito en esta posición Haber trabajado al menos 3 años en machine learning, ingeniería de datos o MLOps te permitirá entender bien el ciclo completo del modelo. Será clave que te muevas con comodidad en Python, cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD y herramientas de control de experimentos. También encajarás especialmente bien si tienes experiencia en monitorización de modelos, retraining, drift, Spark, Airflow, Kubeflow, APIs de inferencia, microservicios o proyectos de industrialización de modelos ML. 👉 Da el siguiente paso Si buscas un rol donde el machine learning no se queda en laboratorio, sino que se convierte en sistemas productivos estables, monitorizados y con recorrido técnico, esta posición puede darte continuidad, especialización y crecimiento real en MLOps.

Si occuperà di analizzare i dati e supportare lo sviluppo di modelli e strumenti basati su Python, Machine Learning e Intelligenza Artificiale, utilizzando l’ambiente Google Cloud Platform. Attività Analizzare i dati per individuare anomalie e comportamenti potenzialmente fraudolenti. Supportare la preparazione e l’elaborazione dei dati con Python e SQL. Collaborare allo sviluppo e alla verifica di modelli di Machine Learning. Contribuire alla valutazione delle prestazioni dei modelli e dei risultati delle analisi. Utilizzare i servizi GCP e gli strumenti della suite Google. Collaborare con il team nella documentazione delle attività e nella condivisione dei risultati. Requisiti Esperienza in ambito Data Science, Machine Learning, AI o analisi dati. Conoscenza di Python. Interesse o esperienza in progetti di prevenzione delle frodi. Familiarità con Google Cloud Platform e con la suite Google. Capacità analitiche, precisione e attitudine al lavoro in team. Laurea in Scienze giuridiche Competenze preferenziali Conoscenza di SQL, BigQuery, pandas e NumPy. Familiarità con librerie di Machine Learning come scikit-learn. Conoscenza di Vertex AI o Cloud Storage. Esposizione a Pub/Sub o Dataflow, in particolare per l’elaborazione di dati in tempo reale. Le tecnologie indicate come preferenziali possono essere adattate in base allo stack effettivamente utilizzato dal team. Cosa offriamo? Formazione continua su hard e soft skills. Follow-up costante con HR e Business Manager. Un percorso di crescita chiaro e strutturato in un ambiente innovativo, dinamico e internazionale. La retribuzione annua lorda per questo ruolo è compresa tra 22.000 EUR e 29.000 EUR. La posizione è inquadrata nell’ambito del CCNL del Commercio e Terziario applicato dalla nostra società. Il posizionamento all'interno del range sarà definito in base alle competenze tecniche, all'esperienza specifica nel ruolo e agli esiti del processo di selezione, secondo criteri oggettivi e predefiniti. In presenza di profili con caratteristiche eccezionali rispetto al range indicato, una revisione potrà essere valutata previa approvazione interna The world needs you ADENTIS Italia è un equal opportunities employer: crediamo che tutte le forme di diversità siano fonte di arricchimento reciproco. Ci impegniamo a garantire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, nel quale ogni singola risorsa possa apportare un valore unico alla nostra realtà. Pertanto, accogliamo candidature senza distinzione di età, genere, nazionalità, disabilità, orientamento sessuale, religione o stato civile. Inoltre, teniamo fede ai nostri impegni prestando attenzione alle risorse appartenenti alle categorie protette ai sensi degli articoli 1 e 18 della Legge 68/99. I dati personali saranno trattati in conformità alle disposizioni contenute nel regolamento UE 2016/679.

items.desc: Pet Pawr Group AB är ett snabbväxande entreprenörsdrivet bolag med en omsättning på ca. 1 Mdkr. Vill du bygga AI-agenter som används på riktigt, i butik, lager och på kontor? Pet Pawr Group söker en specialist som tar egna AI-tjänster hela vägen från affärscase till drift och mätbar effekt. Om rollen Du äger de tjänster och agentbaserade flöden vi utvecklar inhouse och du bygger dem själv. Målet är mindre manuellt arbete, kortare ledtider och bättre beslutsunderlag i alla avdelningar. Du ansvarar för utveckling, drift och första support, och rapporterar till vår CTO. Rollen passar dig som i dag arbetar som AI Engineer, AI-utvecklare eller fullstackutvecklare med fokus på automation. Det här gör du Bygger och driftsätter agentbaserade flöden med tydliga gränser för vad agenten gör själv och när en människa godkänner Kartlägger manuella moment tillsammans med avdelningarna och prioriterar efter störst effekt Äger roadmap, backlog och acceptans för dina produkter Sätter vårt arbetssätt för AI-driven utveckling: specifikation, kod, granskning, test och produktion Mäter effekt i sparade timmar och följer kostnaden för modeller mot nyttan Utbildar kollegor och tar fram riktlinjer för ansvarsfull AI, informationssäkerhet och GDPR Du har Minst 3 års erfarenhet som fullstackutvecklare Byggt och driftsatt agentbaserade flöden själv Erfarenhet av automation i handel till exempel supply chain, prissättning, innehåll eller masterdata Vana att värdera initiativ i kronor och timmar och att föra dialog på ledningsnivå Gott omdöme kring säkerhet och personuppgifter Meriterande är erfarenhet från detaljhandel med både butik och e-handel. Så arbetar vi AI är ett medel, inte ett mål. Den enklaste lösningen som ger effekten vinner. En lösning som inte används räknas inte som levererad. Vi erbjuder Mandat över prioriteringar, verktyg och modeller inom givna ramar Avsatt tid varje kvartal för att utforska nya verktyg och modeller Hybridarbete från vårt kontor på Linnégatan i Stockholm Bra att veta Våra butiker har öppet kvällar och helger. Ibland kan ett akut fel i dina tjänster behöva åtgärdas utanför kontorstid, men det ska vara undantag och inte regel. Ansökan Skicka ditt CV och en kort beskrivning av något du byggt och vilken effekt det gav. Urval sker löpande. Hos Pet Pawr Group får du inte bara möjligheten att utvecklas i din roll, du får även vara en del av ett professionellt team som varje dag arbetar för att skapa den bästa upplevelsen för både kunder och deras djur! Välkommen att ta nästa steg i din karriär tillsammans med oss!

items.desc: Open Huis - Next Step in ICT in Amsterdam Ben je benieuwd naar onze cultuur, opdrachten en ontwikkelmogelijkheden? Bezoek op 11 november 2026 ons event Open Huis - Next Step in ICT in Amsterdam. Spar met onze consultants over actuele ontwikkelingen in IT, kom meer te weten over onze uitdagende opdrachten en krijg advies over jouw carrièremogelijkheden en de vaardigheden die de komende jaren het verschil maken. Meld je aan (hyperlink naar https://www.cimsolutions.nl/aanmelden-open-huis-next-step-in-ict-amsterdam/) Als Data Scientist lever je inzichten uit gegevens door het analyseproces te optimaliseren en visuele gegevensrepresentaties te presenteren. Je zoekt, beheert en voegt meerdere gegevensbronnen samen en zorgt voor consistentie van gegevenssets. Je identificeert de wiskundige modellen, selecteert en optimaliseert de algoritmen om bedrijfswaarde te leveren door middel van inzichten. Je stelt patronen vast en beveelt manieren aan om gegevens toe te passen. Waarom past deze vacature bij jou? Jij wilt jezelf blijven ontwikkelen en dat zit in ons DNA! Met jouw inzicht in cijfers, data en techniek leg je elke complexiteit simpel uit aan de klant. Klanttevredenheid is belangrijk voor je, dus je luistert goed en geeft inzichtelijke antwoorden die de klant het vertrouwen geeft dat het probleem wordt opgelost. Aan de hand van de informatiebehoefte van jouw stakeholders ontwikkel, test en implementeer je data science-modellen en help je collega’s om de mogelijkheden die schuilen in de rijke data bij onze gerenommeerde klanten, optimaal te benutten. Natuurlijk houd je daarbij de ontwikkelingen in het vak goed in de gaten. Krijg jij energie van het ontdekken van nieuwe kansen met data science? items.desc: Localisation : Paris 13e Démarrage : Asap Type de mission : Longue durée Contexte de la mission Dans le cadre de l’accélération de sa transformation Data et Intelligence Artificielle, une organisation recherche un ML Engineer spécialisé en industrialisation de solutions IA sur Dataiku . Vous interviendrez sur la transformation de modèles de Machine Learning développés par les Data Scientists en solutions robustes, performantes et exploitables en production, tout en contribuant à la mise en place des bonnes pratiques MLOps. Missions principales Industrialiser les modèles de Machine Learning et transformer les prototypes en solutions prêtes pour la production. Concevoir, développer et maintenir des workflows sur Dataiku : recettes, scénarios d’automatisation et API endpoints. Mettre en place des pipelines CI/CD pour automatiser le déploiement des modèles IA. Assurer le monitoring des modèles en production : performances, détection de dérive (model drift) et suivi de leur fiabilité. Garantir la scalabilité, la maintenabilité et la qualité des solutions déployées. Intégrer les modèles dans les systèmes d’information en collaboration avec les équipes Data, IT et métiers. Documenter les solutions et contribuer à la standardisation des pratiques MLOps. Compétences recherchées Expérience confirmée en Machine Learning Engineering et MLOps. Très bonne maîtrise de Dataiku DSS, notamment en conception de workflows, automatisation et déploiement. Maîtrise des pratiques CI/CD appliquées aux projets IA. Bonne connaissance des architectures Data et des flux ETL/ELT. Connaissance des environnements Cloud et des technologies de conteneurisation, notamment Docker et Kubernetes. Capacité à déployer et maintenir des modèles de Machine Learning en environnement de production. Profil candidat: Profil recherché Nous recherchons un profil opérationnel, rigoureux et autonome, capable de faire le lien entre la Data Science et la production, avec une expertise solide sur Dataiku et une approche orientée fiabilité, automatisation et industrialisation des solutions IA.

items.desc: Wil jij jouw analytische talent inzetten op het snijvlak van data, duurzaamheid en strategie? Werk je graag in een team dat midden in de complexe uitdagingen van de energiemarkt staat? Dan zoeken wij jou. Als Data Scientist versterk je het team Energie-Inkoop, Risicomanagement en Prijsbeleid. Dit team bepaalt de inkoopstrategie voor groene elektriciteit en gas en vertaalt deze naar scherpe en verantwoorde prijzen voor onze klanten. Want welke energieproducten we ook aanbieden, het begint altijd met het zo nauwkeurig mogelijk voorspellen van het verbruik, de onzekerheden en de kostprijs. Elke verbetering verlaagt de kosten voor onze klanten en helpt ons om de energietransitie te kunnen versnellen. De energiemarkt verandert snel. Door de energietransitie wordt het inkopen en prijzen van energie steeds complexer en minder voorspelbaar. Slimme analyses en toepassingen die steeds dichter bij real time komen, zijn daarom essentieel. En daar ga jij mee aan de slag! Jouw taken en verantwoordelijkheden Ontwikkelen en verbeteren van prijs- en voorspelmodellen voor energieverbruik en kostprijzen; Toepassen van AI om voorspelkracht te vergroten en verbeteringen breed te implementeren; Je benut de nieuwe mogelijkheden van machine learning en A.I. om de verbeterstappen sneller en over volle breedte te implementeren. Je ontwikkelt je tot expert in toepassing van A.I. bij deze modellen en processen; Signaleren van trends zoals slim laden, zon-curtailment en thuisbatterijen, en hun effect op onze portfolio; Vertalen van inzichten naar concrete verbeterkansen in pricing, sourcing en risicomanagement; Actief bijdragen aan kennisopbouw binnen het team en implementatie van innovaties. Je krijgt de ruimte om initiatief te nemen, je te ontwikkelen, verbeterkansen te ontdekken en deze te realiseren. Je rapporteert aan de Director Customer Value Optimization. Functie-eisen Wie ben jij? Je bent analytisch en verdiept je graag in bovenstaande materie om je te ontwikkelen tot een topspecialist. Je werkt accuraat en hebt een proactieve houding. Je werkt nauw samen met andere specialisten op het gebied van inkoop, forecasting, pricing en rapportage binnen de afdeling. Daarnaast werk je samen met specialisten op het gebied van data science, machine learning en data-engineers buiten de adeling. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen kritisch te bekijken en brengt nieuwe perspectieven in. Tegelijkertijd kun je jouw analyses en ideeën begrijpelijk overbrengen aan collega’s. Daarnaast Heb Je Een relevante universitaire studie afgerond, met sterke wiskundige, natuurkundige en/of econometrische componenten; Enige relevante werkervaring; Je beschikt over ruime en aantoonbare ervaring met Python (bv pandas, numpy, matplotlib, scipy, sklearn packages), en het werken met grote data sets; Ervaring met toepassing van machine learning technieken en A.I. en een sterke behoefte om frontrunner te blijven of worden op dit gebied; Goede communicatieve en schriftelijke vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels. Aanvullende informatie Wij bieden De Hoogte Van Jouw Salaris Wordt Gebaseerd Op Je Opleiding En Je Relevante Werkervaring. Het Salaris Voor Deze Functie Is €4862,- Tot €6077,- Bruto Per Maand, Exclusief Vakantiegeld, Op Basis Van Een 38-urige Werkweek. Naast Je Salaris Kennen We Een Goed Secundair Arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket Waarvan De Belangrijkste Onderdelen Zijn Op basis van je jaarsalaris ontvang je 8% vakantiegeld, een eindejaarsuitkering van 4,5% en een winstdeling tot 3,5% van je jaarsalaris op basis van de resultaten van Vattenfall Nederland (RDR) NS Business kaart voor woon/werk verkeer of reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,23 per km (max. 50 km enkele reis) en een thuiswerkvergoeding van €3,05 20 vakantiedagen, 5 bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen (onderdeel van Mijn Keuze Mijn Budget) 2 bovenwettelijke dagen ter compensatie voor overwerken (onderdeel van Mijn Keuze Mijn Budget) 3,5 vitaliteitsdagen en 13 ADV-dagen (bij 38-uur contract met 40-urige werkweek) Mijn Budget Mijn Keuze: extra vakantiedagen aan- en verkopen, een fiets aanschaffen of je kan je budget (maandelijks) laten uitbetalen Pensioen bij ABP: Vattenfall draagt 70% bij en jij 30%. items.desc: At Motia, we're at the forefront of fleet solutions, providing innovative services that power businesses across the UK. We're committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive. Our culture fosters collaboration, innovation, and growth, ensuring you can build a career, not just a job. With over 300 employees across five offices, we support over 55,000 customers nationwide. About the role Reporting to the Head of Business Intelligence, the Graduate Data Scientist will support the development of data-driven insights, predictive models, and analytical solutions that help improve business performance. This is an exciting opportunity for a recent postgraduate to apply advanced analytical techniques in a commercial environment while developing their skills alongside experienced data professionals. The successful candidate will contribute to projects across marketing, sales, pricing, and customer analytics, helping the business make informed decisions and identify opportunities for growth as we migrate to Microsoft Fabric. Please note that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role, applicants must already have the right to work in the UK. Duties & Responsibilities Support the development and enhancement of customer value, segmentation, and predictive models. Assist in analysing customer, sales, and operational data to identify trends and opportunities. Contribute to the design, build, testing, and deployment of machine learning and statistical models. Support pricing and commercial analysis through data exploration and modelling techniques. Work with stakeholders across the business to understand analytical requirements and business challenges. Help develop dashboards, visualisations, and reporting solutions that communicate insights effectively. Participate in test-and-learn initiatives to measure the effectiveness of business strategies and campaigns. Collaborate with the Business Intelligence team to improve data quality, reporting, and analytical capabilities. Present findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences. Stay up to date with developments in data science, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and analytics. What You'll Gain Structured development and mentoring from experienced data and analytics professionals. Exposure to real-world commercial data science projects. Opportunities to develop technical and business skills. A collaborative and innovative working environment. Clear career progression opportunities within Data Science and Analytics. Requirements Master's degree in Data Science (or closely related subject such as Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or Analytics). Strong understanding of statistical analysis, data modelling, and machine learning concepts. Experience using Python and/or R through academic projects, internships, or personal development. Knowledge of SQL and relational databases. Ability to work with large datasets and transform data into actionable insights. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly. Highly organised with strong attention to detail. Eagerness to learn, develop, and build a career within data science. Ability to work collaboratively within cross-functional teams Experience with data visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau. Knowledge of cloud analytics platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. Understanding of predictive modelling, customer analytics, or commercial analytics. Experience of applying machine learning techniques through university projects or internships. Familiarity with Git or other version control tools. Benefits Hybrid working - 2/3 days on site at our Leeds Head Office a week Basic Salary - £30,000 per annum Bonus - up to £2k per annum Annual leave - 25 days plus bank holidays An additional day annual leave for your birthday after 1 year service Holiday purchase Scheme - buy/sell up to 5 days annual leave after 2 years service Free breakfast Early Friday finish - 2:45pm Fun, supportive working environment Cycle to work scheme Dress down office Pension 4 x salary life assurance

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with a background in data, AI or automation who enjoys mentoring others, building strong relationships and making a meaningful impact on learner success. About the Role As an AI & Data Automation Coach, you'll work closely with apprentices, employers and internal teams to deliver a high-quality coaching experience. You'll support learners in developing the knowledge, skills and behaviours required by their apprenticeship standards while helping them apply their learning in the workplace. You'll play a vital role in learner engagement and achievement, conducting regular progress reviews, providing constructive feedback and guiding apprentices through key milestones, including gateway reviews and End Point Assessment preparation. What You'll Be Doing Coaching and supporting apprentices throughout their learning journey Delivering structured development plans that help learners achieve their full potential Conducting regular progress reviews with apprentices and line managers Providing feedback against apprenticeship knowledge, skills and behaviours Supporting learner engagement and programme participation Building strong working relationships with learners, employers and internal stakeholders Providing academic, professional and safeguarding support where required Supporting gateway reviews and preparing apprentices for End Point Assessment Contributing to programme improvements, systems and processes Working collaboratively with client services, apprenticeship support teams and employer stakeholders What We're Looking For We're keen to hear from candidates who have experience in areas such as: Data Analytics Data Operations Data Management Automation AI Technologies Business Intelligence Digital Transformation You'll ideally bring: Professional experience in a data-focused role Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills The ability to provide meaningful developmental feedback Experience holding coaching, review or performance conversations Excellent organisational and time-management skills A passion for supporting and developing others Desirable Experience The following would be advantageous: Experience working with apprenticeship programmes Coaching or assessment qualifications Experience within a corporate or commercial environment Relevant industry qualifications within data, AI or technology disciplines Why Join BPP? At BPP, you'll join a supportive and collaborative team dedicated to helping learners achieve their ambitions. You'll have the opportunity to make a genuine impact on apprentice success while developing your own coaching, learning and development expertise. We offer a range of professional development and career progression opportunities, allowing you to continue growing your skills and career within BPP. Please note: The successful candidate will be required to undergo a DBS check. If you're passionate about data, technology and helping others succeed, we'd love to hear from you. BPP is committed to promoting equality, diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified candidates. As a Disability Confident employer, BPP is committed to providing reasonable adjustments throughout the interview process. Candidates are encouraged to share any adjustment requirements ahead of interview so these can be considered and accommodated. BPP part of Lyceum Education Group actively promotes equality of opportunity for all with the right mix of talent, skills and potential, and welcomes applications from a wide range of candidates. BPP will select candidates for interview based on their skills, qualifications and experience. Please note that for those posts that are exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974, the successful candidate will be required to undertake a DBS check in addition to BPP undertaking any necessary online searches. This is deemed appropriate and necessary from a safeguarding perspective, and in line with BPP safer recruitment practices BPP part of Lyceum Education Group reserves the right to amend or withdraw this advertisement at any time prior to the closing date, should we receive a high volume of applications or if business needs change.

items.desc: Equal Plus Consulting has been engaged to search for a Translation & AI Ecosystem Analyst / Consultant to work hybrid for a client in Kontich Belgium. TITLE Translation & AI Ecosystem Analyst / Consultant LOCATION Kontich Belgium or Prague Czech REQUESTED START DATE 9 Nov 2026 END DATE 31 Jan 2027 MAX BUY-IN PRICE 0.00 LANGUAGES English DESCRIPTION Important: this role can be done from Belgium or Prague Role Summary We are seeking a Translation & AI Ecosystem Analyst / Consultant for a 3-month strategic assignment to conduct a comprehensive, helicopter-view assessment of our current translation landscape. We want to investigate the internal business expectations and the translation output from our department and our external partner (specifically regarding Machine Translation quality). To address this, we require a seasoned professional to independently evaluate our setup, investigate modern AI translation alternatives, and deliver a strategic roadmap across people, process, governance, resources, AI capabilities, and tools. This position is key to provide an objective, data-backed foundation to decide on future operating models, tool selections, and process enhancements. Key Objectives & Scope of Work Ecosystem Assessment: Analyze the end-to-end translation ecosystem from a high-level perspective to identify root causes behind stakeholder dissatisfaction. AI & Tool Investigation: Lead a targeted investigation into AI-powered translation tools to evaluate potential alternatives to or enhancements for the current provider. Process Analysis: Map the variance between business needs/expectations and the actual quality and efficiency delivered. Strategic Recommendations: Provide actionable recommendations in Tools & AI Capabilities: investigation into other AI-powered translation tools to evaluate potential alternatives to or enhancements for the current provider People & Training: Identifying training needs. Processes Governance & Vendor Management: Establishing SLAs, and vendor accountability. Key Responsibilities Collaborate closely with the internal lead to gather context, access existing workflows, and connect with key business stakeholders. Audit current Machine Translation (MT) quality, feedback loops, and supplier delivery mechanisms. Research, test, and benchmark alternative enterprise AI translation tools and engines. Synthesize findings into a clear, executive-ready assessment report and improvement roadmap. Candidate Profile & Requirements Must-Have Experience Seniority: Solid, demonstrable experience in a similar position within the translation/localization domain. Deep AI & MT Expertise: Strong hands-on knowledge of modern Machine Translation (MT), Neural Machine Translation (NMT), Large Language Model (LLM) translation workflows, and enterprise translation tools. Vendor & Ecosystem Knowledge: Familiarity with major TMS (Translation Management Systems) and translation vendors/partners. Consulting & Analytical Mindset: Proven ability to look beyond daily operations, perform root-cause analysis, and translate business frustration into structured, objective solutions. Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication skills to interface with internal stakeholders, translate technical gaps into business impacts, and present clear strategic choices to management.

items.desc: About Us Machnet Medical Robotics (MMR), founded in 2020, is on a mission to revolutionise medical robotics. Our guiding principle is simple: innovation must improve patient outcomes, support clinicians without disrupting workflows, and empower healthcare staff rather than adding burden. MMR is a well-funded company with long-term investors and a strong financial foundation. Our hardware and software teams have developed a fully functional medical robotic platform that has successfully completed animal trials. As we move into the next phase, we are refining the mechanical design for production with a focus on safety, reliability, manufacturability, and scalability, preparing our technology for deployment in hospitals worldwide. About the Role We are seeking an AI and Data Verification Engineer to lead the independent verification of machine learning, data and supporting software within our medical robotic platform. In this role, you will define and implement verification approaches for machine learning performance, datasets, data processing pipelines and supporting software. You will independently assess candidate models against defined requirements and acceptance criteria, verify the integrity and traceability of data used for evaluation, and ensure that model performance is supported by appropriate and reproducible evidence. You will work closely with AI, software and systems engineers while maintaining appropriate independence between model development and verification. This is a technical role combining machine learning evaluation, data analysis, statistical methods and software test automation. Key Responsibilities • Define verification protocols and test approaches based on software requirements and identified risks • Design and implement independent verification for machine learning models, datasets, data acquisition and supporting software • Manage independent test datasets and verify dataset integrity, provenance, traceability and separation between training, validation and test data • Independently assess model performance against defined requirements, including comparison with ground truth and previously released models • Verify annotation quality and consistency, including agreement between independent annotators • Develop Python based automated tests, test utilities and test harnesses, using BDD and other appropriate verification methods • Verify data acquisition and processing, including data integrity, completeness, provenance, traceability, metadata, timestamping and synchronisation. • Produce reproducible verification evidence and reports to support software and model release Who We’re Looking For • Experience in verification or testing of machine learning, computer vision or data driven software systems • Strong Python skills, including test automation and data analysis • Good understanding of machine learning evaluation, including datasets, ground truth, model performance metrics and relevant statistical methods • Solid understanding of how ML models fail, how deployment changes their behaviour, and how to measure performance with statistical confidence on truly independent data • Experience working with complex datasets, including data quality, traceability and integrity • Experience designing verification strategies and test methods from requirements • Comfortable working within Linux based development and test environments • Methodical and technically curious, with the ability to investigate complex problems and work independently • Comfortable collaborating with AI, software, systems and test engineers in a fast paced startup environment • Eligibility to work on site at our central London office Experience We Value • Experience with computer vision or medical image analysis • Experience with ML pipelines, model lifecycle tooling, dataset versioning and reproducibility • Experience testing software in regulated or safety critical environments • Experience with medical device software and familiarity with standards such as IEC 62304 and ISO 13485 Why Join Us? At MMR, you will work at the intersection of robotics, AI, and healthcare, building technology that directly impacts patient care and clinical outcomes. You will join a mission-driven, collaborative team where your technical expertise will meaningfully shape the future of medical robotics. We believe technology must serve people responsibly. Human-centred innovation, integrity, and long-term responsibility guide how we design products and how we support our team members’ growth and well-being. What We Offer An international, interdisciplinary team based in Central London and Zwolle, Netherlands A collaborative and supportive workplace culture within a growing medical device and robotics startup A central London office with a well-equipped prototyping and development space Ongoing professional development through training, workshops, and conferences Competitive salary package including pension contribution Employee wellbeing …

items.desc: Contexte de la mission En tant qu'Hôpital académique de l'UCLouvain, les Cliniques universitaires Saint-Luc ont pour pour mission d'offrir des soins de qualité aux patients, de former les meilleurs professionnels de santé et de mener des programmes de recherche clinique de pointe. Actuellement, dans le cadre de l’espace européen des données de santé (European Health Data Space), elles mettent en place une infrastructure et des outils nécessaires pour l’exploitation des données de santé dans des buts de recherche et d’amélioration continue des soins, avec une attention particulière à la sécurité des données, au respect de la règlementation général de la protection des données (RGPD) et à la réglementation concernant l’intelligence artificielle (AI Act). Pour ce faire, les Cliniques participent à des projets collaboratifs afin de rendre les systèmes d’exploitation de données interopérables entre institutions au niveau national, européen, voire international. En particulier, les établissements de santé génèrent quotidiennement un volume considérable de données textuelles non structurées (comptes-rendus médicaux, rapports d’examens, lettres de suivi, etc.) contenant des informations sensibles et identifiantes, difficilement exploitables pour la recherche. Description du rôle Vous travaillez sur un projet qui vise à développer un outil de validation automatisée de l'anonymisation basé sur l'intelligence artificielle qui permettra : () d'automatiser la vérification de l'anonymisation des données textuelles en langage naturel, () de garantir une validation exhaustive et systématique avant toute sortie de données, () de standardiser le processus de validation entre établissements. Vous travaillez sous la responsabilité du Manager Exploitation des eHealth Data, lui-même sous la responsabilité de la Chief Medical Information Officer (CMIO). Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les coordinateurs de projets, l’équipe IT infrastructure, les utilisateurs (chercheurs, médecins, paramédicaux, scientifiques, …). Conception · Développer une approche API-first et la conteneurisation permettant un déploiement flexible, que ce soit en mode cloud, on-premise, ou hybride. Cette versatilité technique facilitera l'adoption par des organisations ayant des contraintes d'infrastructure différentes. L'interface utilisateur pourra être facilement adaptée aux besoins spécifiques de chaque contexte d'utilisation. · Le caractère open-source du projet permettra à la communauté de développer des extensions spécifiques. De nouveaux modules pourront être ajoutés pour prendre en charge des langues supplémentaires, de nouveaux types de documents, ou des réglementations spécifiques à certains pays ou secteurs. · Conception des algorithmes d’extraction, transformation et chargement (ETL) afin de traiter les documents. · Entrainement du modèle d’IA. Mise en oeuvre et maintenance · Installer, configurer et maintenir, sur des serveurs, avec un système Docker · Conception du système de traduction automatique sur base d’un LLM open source · Traduction des notes avec échantillonnage · Génération de variations avec fausses données identifiantes · Itérations d’entrainement de plusieurs modèles et de tailles différentes · Evaluation de l’anonymisation de notes (anonymisées manuellement par des prestataires de soins) avec l’outil de screening et rédaction d’un rapport de performance · Développement des ETL pour assurer la gestion des données Sécurité des données · Mettre en place des mécanismes de sécurité robustes pour protéger les données sensibles. Documentation · Maintenir une documentation complète de l'outil, son architecture et son utilisation. Formation · Participer à la formation des utilisateurs et des membres de l'équipe sur l'utilisation des outils mis en place Qualifications · Diplôme de niveau master en informatique, avec un doctorat dans le domaine de l’intelligence artificielle · Diplôme de niveau master dans les soins de santé ; un diplôme en médecine (éventuellement sans pratique) serait un atout majeur · Profil hybride ML Engineer / MLOps, capable de développer, entrainer et déployer des modèles IA ainsi que d’administrer un serveur de GPUs qui fera tourner le modèle et l’application développée · Le ou la candidat.e devra également être capable de développer une interface graphique permettant à des utilisateurs non techniques d’utiliser l’outil de vérification Pour ce faire, le ou la candidat.e a besoin de: · Expérience en développement et entrainement de modèles LLM · Evaluation de modèles (précisions, F1, rappel, ...) · Connaissance de l’écosystème HuggingFace · Expérience avancée en Python et développement d’API · Expérience en maintenance de serveurs GPUs · Connaissance avancée de Linux et Docker ainsi que des outils de développement et de déploiement de logiciels (e.g. Git, CI/CD, Registry, ...) · Compréhension d’une architecture réseau d’une grande organisation · Très bonne maîtrise des données médicales, compréhension …

To apply, send us: A portfolio or AI image samples in fashion / luxury / jewelry style Your answer to the mandatory test question above Your availability, rates (per image or per batch), and preferred payment method No portfolio + no test answer = application not read.

items.desc: We believe talent is everywhere. The chance to live from it isn't. Millions of creators are talented and invisible at the same time. The value they create flows to middlemen, while the brands who want to reach them are stuck in a non-transparent, fragmented market. So we built the tools to fix both sides at once. Creators turn an account into an income: join a campaign in minutes, make something they're proud of, and get paid fairly for creativity, not follower count. Brands brief once, activate hundreds of creators, and see content live within 24 hours. Next year, 10,000 creators will make a living from WePush. When a creator earns, a brand grows. When a brand grows, more creators earn. WePush is the fastest-growing creator marketing platform in Europe, with over 150,000 creators and 500,000+ collaborations powering brands like L'Oréal, ABOUT YOU, Zalando, and Sony Music. Two numbers matter to us: how many people make a living through WePush, and how many millions of people brands reach through them. Technical Overview: We run on a real distributed system: Angular and React frontends, a native iOS app, a Node/TypeScript application server handling booking and matching logic, a fleet of independently deployable backend services on Kubernetes, a real-time layer, a ledger that moves actual money, and a small army of scrapers. We're looking for a Fullstack AI Product Engineer who is comfortable moving across all of those layers and who uses AI agent tools as genuine leverage. We use these tools daily to read unfamiliar services, ship changes, and move fast. Tasks What you'll actually work on: A native iOS app: SwiftUI, rewritten natively Web Frontend: our marketplace apps are built in Angular, and newer internal tooling is React. An application server layer: a Node/TypeScript service sitting between the frontend and the backend fleet, handling booking, scheduling/matching logic, invoicing, and PDF generation. A polyglot microservices fleet, with a shrinking Hack/HHVM legacy core and a growing set of services in Node.js and Go, each independently versioned, containerized, and deployed via Helm to Kubernetes A real CI/CD pipeline: GitLab CI building images with Kaniko, tag-based semver releases (nightly unstable builds, stable releases promoted through dev to test to a manually gated prod), and cross-service pipeline triggers when a shared dependency publishes Scheduled workloads at scale: a couple dozen CronJobs per environment (reminders, payout checks, stat rollups, token refreshes, media polling), each independently schedulable, tunable, and killable without redeploying the whole service Money movement: a ledger service backing real balances and payouts A scraper fleet: services that scrape platforms which actively fight back (rate limits, bot walls, reshaped responses), running on their own schedule with their own failure modes A newer AWS/serverless edge: internal tooling and some integrations are moving onto Lambda/API Gateway/DynamoDB. This is where a lot of new, greenfield work is happening What "AI-driven builder" means here: You use AI tools openly, as your default way of working, to read and understand an unfamiliar service fast, not just to generate new code. Half the job is "what does this cron job actually do and what breaks if I touch it," and AI is how you get that answer in minutes instead of a day You verify before you trust: you'd catch a plausible but wrong AI suggestion before it ships You can operate across languages and layers without needing to be a specialist in all of them, including ones you don't know yet You respect the promotion pipeline. You don't route around dev to test to prod because it's slower The stack you'll touch: Angular and React on the web frontend, native iOS in SwiftUI, a Node/TypeScript application server, Node.js and Go for newer backend services, a legacy Hack/HHVM core we're winding down, Kubernetes, Helm, GitLab CI, Docker, a Formance-based ledger, WebSockets, cron-driven scheduled workloads, and a growing AWS serverless layer (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3/CloudFront) Requirements You're a strong fit if.. You've operated real distributed systems, not just built a monolith and called it done. You're just as comfortable tracing a bug from a UI symptom (web or native) down through the application server into the backend that caused it as you are building the fix on either end You're comfortable being dropped into someone else's code, in a language you may not know, with real production traffic on it, and using AI tools plus your own judgment to figure out how it actually behaves You're honest about uncertainty. "I don't know, let me check the logs" beats a confident guess, from you or your AI tools Not expected: Any prior Hack (or R) experience. Nobody on the team learned either on purpose, and we're actively phasing both out A portfolio of AI-free work. We're not testing whether you can code without tools, we're testing whether you build good software, in a …

items.desc: Unikum är Sveriges största digitala verktyg för lärande och har redan passerat 1 miljon användarkonton i tusentals förskolor och skolor. Vår ide är enkel: Unikt lärande för unika barn! Vi är inne i ett väldigt kul skede där data och AI gör livet lättare för både våra användare och oss på Unikum. Det gäller så klart också support - vill du leda resan? Om rollen Vi söker en tekniskt nyfiken supportspecialist till vårt Customer Success-team. Ditt uppdrag är att samla supporten i ett gemensamt system med gemensamma processer och att bygga en support där AI, kunskap och smarta flöden gör det enkelt att ge kunderna rätt hjälp snabbt. Samtidigt äger du tekniska ärenden från första analys till lösning eller eskalering. Så utvecklas rollen I början lägger du mest tid på ärendehantering och migrering till det gemensamma systemet. Där lär du känna kunderna, produkterna och utmaningarna. Det är grunden för nästa steg. Med tiden flyttas fokus till att bygga bort återkommande ärenden genom bättre processer, kunskap och AI-stöd. Ju bättre vi lyckas, desto mer av din tid går till utveckling. Det här kommer du att göra Utveckla AI-stöd för kunskapssökning, klassificering, prioritering och svarsförslag, och följa upp att det faktiskt fungerar Bidra till migrering till ett gemensamt supportsystem med nya ärendeflöden, kategorier, mallar och uppföljning Utreda tekniska ärenden kring behörigheter, konfigurationer, integrationer och dataflöden Ta fram reproducerbara steg och tekniskt underlag tillsammans med produkt- och utvecklingsteamen Förklara tekniska frågor begripligt för kunderna och hålla dem uppdaterade om nästa steg Använda ärendedata och AI för att hitta mönster, förbättra hjälpartiklar och föra kundinsikter vidare till rätt team Vi tror att du har god teknisk förståelse och är van att felsöka systematiskt är intresserad av hur system, databaser och integrationer hänger ihop är nyfiken på AI och vill bygga lösningar, inte bara använda dem tycker om kunddialog och kan förklara tekniska saker enkelt skriver och talar mycket god svenska och god engelska Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av SaaS, API, SSO, databaser, logganalys, systemigrering, automatisering eller kunskapshantering i support. Skolbakgrund är också ett plus. Bockar du inte av allt? Sök ändå! Vi värdesätter nyfikenhet och viljan att lära minst lika mycket som en komplett lista med erfarenheter. AI med omtanke Våra kunder är skolor, och våra användare är barn, elever och lärare. Därför bygger vi AI-stöd som hjälper människor, inte ersätter dem, och vi hanterar data tryggt och ansvarsfullt. Du kommer arbeta tillsammans och ha stöd av vår AI channel transformation och kunniga kollegor. Bli en del av Unikum! Vi är 60 engagerade medarbetare i Sverige och Tyskland som tillsammans förbättrar lärandet för över 1 miljon användare – från förskola till vuxenutbildningen. Vi är på en spännande tillväxtresa och har nyligen välkomnat StudyBee och Tempus till vår företagsgrupp. Tillsammans stärker vi vår position på marknaden för att ge skolor ännu smartare och enklare verktyg för att se, förstå och förbättra lärandet. Våra digitala verktyg ger stöd i skolans viktigaste processer – från planering och bedömning till dialog och uppföljning, och skapar en trygg röd tråd genom hela lärresan. Hos oss präglas arbetet av samarbete, nyfikenhet och lekfullt allvar. Vi tror på frihet under ansvar och på att växa tillsammans, i en miljö där det är lätt att dela med sig, utvecklas och göra skillnad för barn och unga. Vi erbjuder stort utrymme att påverka hur supporten utvecklas distansarbete två dagar i veckan konkurrenskraftig lön och attraktiva förmåner friskvårdsbidrag, massage på jobbet och frukost varje vecka kollegor som värdesätter skratt och teamwork, och tårta i tid och otid Start så snart som möjligt. Vi går igenom ansökningarna löpande, så vänta inte med att söka. Ansvarig för rekryteringen är Karoline Börjel, teamledare för supporten. Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Eleni Joannou, eleni.joannou@unikum.net

items.desc: Doktorarbeit: Sichere KI für maritime Antriebe / Safe Artificial Intelligence for Maritime Engines Doktorarbeit: Sichere KI für maritime Antriebe / Safe Artificial Intelligence for Maritime Engines Job-ID: 13257 Standort: Augsburg, DE, 86153 Land: DE Das sollten Sie über uns wissen Everllence ebnet den Weg in eine klimaneutrale Weltwirtschaft. Ob Industrieproduktion, Energie- oder maritime Wirtschaft: Wir denken ganzheitlich und packen schon heute die Herausforderungen von morgen an – für eine nachhaltige Wertschöpfung unserer Kunden. In unserem Technologieportfolio steckt die Erfahrung aus über 250 Jahren Ingenieurstradition. Everllence hat seinen Hauptsitz in Deutschland und beschäftigt rund 15.000 Mitarbeiter an mehr als 120 Standorten weltweit. Unsere Kunden profitieren außerdem vom globalen Service-Center-Netzwerk unserer After-Sales Marke, Everllence PrimeServ. Folgende Aufgaben können wir Ihnen anbieten Die Doktorarbeit beschäftigt sich mit der Entwicklung sicherer KI-Methoden für maritime Antriebssysteme, die mit alternativen Kraftstoffen wie Methanol betrieben werden. Ziel ist es, die Betriebsflexibilität zu erhöhen und Emissionen zu reduzieren - ein wesentlicher Beitrag zur Dekarbonisierung der Schifffahrt im Einklang mit den Zielen der International Maritime Organization (IMO). Die zentralen Forschungsaspekte sind: Optimierung des Motorbetriebs durch KI: Analyse von Motorbetriebsdaten zur Anpassung von Verbrennungs- und Antriebsstrategien. Effiziente Nutzung alternativer Kraftstoffe: Dynamische Anpassung an variierende Eigenschaften von Methanol und anderen Kraftstoffen. Simulation und Bewertung von Betriebsszenarien: Einsatz von KI zur Modellierung und Analyse zahlreicher Szenarien für maximale Effizienz und Nachhaltigkeit. Sicherheitsaspekte: Gewährleistung des sicheren Betriebs innerhalb physikalischer und mechanischer Grenzen maritimer Antriebssysteme. Validierung der Methoden: Umsetzung und Tests sowohl in Simulationen als auch an realen Motoren in Zusammenarbeit mit einer Universität und einer Testeinrichtung. Mit diesen Qualifikationen helfen Sie uns weiter Sehr guter Masterabschluss (oder gleichwertig) in Informatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder verwandten Disziplinen (typischerweise Mathematik, Physik). Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind erforderlich. Fundierte Kenntnisse in Machine Learning, sowie mindestens einer Programmiersprache, z. B. Python, MATLAB oder C/C++. Hohe Motivation und Freude an der Arbeit in einem internationalen und interdisziplinären Team. Vorkenntnisse in den folgenden Bereichen sind von Vorteil: Regelungstechnik Verbrennungskraftmaschinen Unsere Benefits Für Sie Kantine, Essenszulage, Barrierefreiheit, betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement, Betriebsarzt, Fitnessraum, Parkplatz, gute Verkehrsanbindung, Mitarbeiterrabatte, Studentennetzwerk, Frauennetzwerk Gut zu wissen Bei Fragen können Sie sich gerne per E-Mail an Ihren Recruiter, Nicola Hasl, wenden. E-Mail: nicola.hasl@everllence.com. Bitte bewerben Sie sich nur über den Button "Jetzt bewerben". Bewerbungen via Email können leider nicht berücksichtigt werden. Hier sind Sie beruflich zuhause Am Hauptsitz von Everllence in Augsburg wurde einst der Dieselmotor erfunden, mit dem Rudolf Diesel der Dampfmaschine den Kampf ansagte. Heute ist die Bewältigung der Herausforderungen in den Bereichen Marine, Energie und Industrie zu unserer Hauptaufgabe geworden – nicht nur für den Erfolg unserer Kunden, sondern auch für den Erhalt unserer Umwelt. items.desc: We're building the technology that will change how consumers buy and sell furniture. Resale is one of the biggest shifts in consumer behaviour of our generation. Fashion has been transformed by it. Electronics too. But furniture, one of the largest, most valuable categories in every home, has been left behind. It's big, bulky, hard to photograph, hard to price, hard to trust and hard to move. Most of it still gets dumped, sold for nothing, or sent to landfill or the incinerator. That's not a furniture problem. It's a technology problem. And it's wide open. Sofalistic is a resale technology company. We started with the hardest category there is, and we're building the AI, platforms and experiences to make buying and selling pre-loved furniture online as easy as buying new. Trust, pricing, logistics, fraud prevention, payments, disputes: we've built the hard parts that others avoid. Now we're scaling fast, and building the next generation of AI-powered resale experiences. The ambition is simple: to become the technology that powers furniture resale, in the UK and beyond. The role We're looking for our first engineer: a builder with a founder's brain. Someone who will own our AI and technology from day one, and grow into leading our tech team. This isn't a job where you wait for tickets. You'll sit next to our CEO and co-founder, Marc, and help decide what we build, why, and how fast. Some days you'll ship three things before lunch. Other days you'll be the one saying "we're solving the wrong problem." Years of experience matter less to us than what you've built and how you think. How we build AI isn't a feature for us. It's how we build. Claude Code writes much of our code. We architect, direct, review, test and ship. An idea in the morning is a working prototype by the afternoon. Everything below is live, used by real people, and built this way by a tiny team: AI dispute resolution handling real buyer and seller disputes end to end Computer vision that reads contact details hidden in photos and shuts down organised fraud rings Intelligent seller automation: sold alerts, offer negotiation and listing refresh across email, SMS and push A logistics platform replacing spreadsheets and manual bookings Native iOS and Android apps Imagine what we'll build with you. What's next We're only scratching the surface of what AI can do for resale. How furniture is discovered, listed, priced, trusted and delivered is all still up for reinvention, and we intend to lead it. You'll help decide what we build next, and the experiences no one has imagined yet for this category. You might be the one if you Think like a founder. You see the business, not just the code. You spot opportunities, challenge ideas (including ours) and care whether something actually moves the needle. Build like a doer. You'd rather ship something today and improve it tomorrow than plan it for a month. Are AI-native. You're exceptional with Claude Code or similar, you direct AI with real skill, and you know when it's wrong. Are technically sharp. You're comfortable in PHP and JavaScript/TypeScript, with a solid grasp of APIs, databases, security and production systems. Take production seriously. We move real money. You test properly, ship safely and stay calm when something breaks. Can't stop thinking about it. The best ideas come in the shower, on a walk, at 10pm. You genuinely love building, and you want to build something that matters. Own it completely. No egos, no "that's not my job." Bonus if you Have started something of your own, a company, a product or a side project people actually use Have worked with Next.js, Flutter or Cloudflare Have built marketplace, payments, computer vision or fraud-prevention systems What you get £70,000 salary Share options, so you own a real piece of what you help build A genuine founding role, with real influence over product, technology and direction Top-spec kit and every AI tool you need A clear path to leading engineering as we grow The chance to define the technology for an entire category, and to look back and say "I built that" How we work We build together, not in silos. You'll be in our Bournemouth office most of the week, working alongside the founders, with one day a week from home. Flexibility grows as the team does. How to apply Skip the cover letter. Show us something you've built with AI: a repo, a live demo, a 2-minute Loom, or just a few paragraphs on what you built and how. If your best work is under NDA, tell us about it without the confidential bits. We want to know what the AI did and what you did. And tell us one thing you'd build or change at Sofalistic if you joined tomorrow. Not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway. What you've built matters more than your CV. Our process: a call to get to know each other, a build session with the founders for shortlisted candidates, then an offer. Fast.

items.desc: We know that the quality of a training dataset is an important indicator of model performance, but how well does a data quality framework developed on a simple machine learning task generalize to real-world ML scenarios? In this thesis, you’ll extend and test an existing framework on diverse datasets, models and tasks, including LLMs. You’ll explore new quality dimensions and benchmark generalizability, building towards a practical tool that helps teams evaluate and improve their data in complex AI pipelines The impact of data quality on machine learning performance is well established, yet most frameworks are tested only in limited, controlled environments. Previously, we developed an automatic data quality framework ( Automatic Assessment of Dataset Quality for ML ), which showed promising results by quantifying data quality across three core dimensions: completeness, consistency and accuracy using synthetic data and a small set of machine learning models. However, real-world systems operate in far more varied and complex contexts. Today’s AI models range from classical algorithms to advanced LLMs, and datasets span structured tables, text, sensor streams, and more. Without validating how such a framework performs across these environments, its insights remain confined to the lab. The question is not just does it work, but how well does it generalize? The Assignment This thesis explores the generalizability of the developed data quality assessment framework across a wide spectrum of machine learning use cases. You will: Extend dataset coverage using both real-world and synthetic data from diverse domains (e.g., healthcare, finance, social media, e-commerce, public benchmarks). Diversify task types, including classification, regression and clustering. Broaden algorithmic scope by comparing a range of machine learning models. Evaluate the role of LLMs in assessing data quality across different data domains. Compare model responses to varying data quality degradations across model sizes and architectures. Add quality dimensions such as uniqueness, timeliness, accessibility, believability and statistical measures. Benchmark generalizability by measuring the framework’s reliability across tasks, models, and datasets. The final deliverable is an empirically validated, modular extension of the original framework – capable of guiding users towards improving their datasets for machine learning. items.desc: Join our team and build the future of space technology We´re expanding our team at Alén Space, and are looking for a DSP Engineer; with passion in what you do , talented and experienced. You will be part of a multidisciplinary team of software, FPGA, and digital signal processing engineers and will support the implementation of DSP (Digital Signal Processing) algorithms in programmable devices (FPGAs). What you will be doing? Design digital communication systems using platforms including software defined radios (SDRs) and FPGAs. Functional modeling of DSP algorithms and their implementation in RTL (Verilog/VHDL) or high-level languages (C/C++). Support the evolution of our custom space-tailored radio platforms. Main languages/technologies used: Verilog/SystemVerilog. Yosys/Xilinx Vivado. Python. C/C++. GNURadio. Examples of existing applications already developed by Alén Space: DVB-S2 transmitter in Verilog. ADS-B receiver in Verilog. AIS receiver, hybrid between FPGA (VHF channelizer) and CPU (GNURadio/C++). Proprietary M2M modem implemented in C. What Do We Need In Our Team Bachelor or Master’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering. More than 3 years of experience in developing signal processing algorithms for communication systems in Python, C/C++ or Matlab using both floating point and fixed-point design techniques. Experience in migrating modeled algorithms to implementations in FPGAs or SDR frameworks. Understanding of RF concepts such as AGC, noise figure, power amplifiers, phase noise, PLL, oscillators/mixers. Valuable knowledge: Expertise with Software-Defined Radios (SDR) frameworks such as GNU Radio. Experience with Xilinx Zynq or Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ series FPGAs, Analog Devices AD9361, and other common RF chipsets. Some experience with Python or other scripting languages. Knowledge of coding theory and techniques: LDPC, Turbo codes… Candidate qualifications and skills Work remotely a percentage of the time to be defined with the manager Flexible start/finish times; reduced intensive working hours on Fridays and in summer Monday to Friday. Competitive compensation with ongoing reviews, flexible compensation . Wellbeing program: Health, dental, and accident insurance; free fruit and free lunch every friday and much more!
