Concurrently, you will champion platform adoption across the department,
items.desc:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed. 
 Therapeutic Modality (TMo) organization, accountable for translating disease biology into high-quality drug candidates across small molecules, large molecules, oligonucleotides, and genomic medicines. By integrating deep modality expertise with cross-disciplinary collaboration, TMo drives innovation within and across platforms to enable differentiated, sustainable therapeutic impact. 
 The Opportunity 
 We are looking for a highly versatile Scientist to serve as our primary operational and computational architect embedded in the wet-lab scientific community. In this role, you will bridge the gap between physical laboratory benches and advanced digital infrastructure. You will have the chance to shape how active learning loops could fundamentally rethink small molecule assay development for screening and profiling by building future ready agentic AI workflows from assay design to data delivery. Concurrently, you will champion platform adoption across the department, ensuring bench scientists are trained and supported on core tools. This profile requires a unique combination of biological literacy and data engineering acumen to successfully design closed-loop analytical systems, minimize operational bottlenecks, and transition raw screening readouts into predictive, FAIR-compliant data assets. 
 Lead the co-development, operational rollout, and continuous training for our end-to-end assay development and screening laboratory information management systems (LIMS), ensuring complete, traceable data trails and digital twins. 
 Design and integrate cutting-edge Agentic AI tools and Design of Experiments (DoE) frameworks. 
 Build and adjust pipelines that connect specialized raw instrument outputs directly with databases to achieve robust FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable) data standards. 
 Act as a change agent by coordinating user onboarding, training bench scientists, and championing platform adoption across the broader scientific community. 
 Make a direct impact by accelerating assay design and execution times, lowering processing error rates, and resolving operational bottlenecks for specialized teams. 
 Who You Are 
 You hold a Ph.D. or M.S. in Computational Biology, Scientific Informatics, Bioinformatics, Biology/Biochemistry with a strong computational focus, or a related quantitative scientific discipline. 
 You bring solid experience in cellular, biochemical, or biophysical systems and are familiar with FAIR data management standards. 
 You have proven experience working with laboratory informatics environments (such as LIMS or electronic lab notebooks) alongside wet-lab operations incl. Design of Experiments. 
 You demonstrate strong programming proficiency, including building or maintaining databases, automating data extraction, and working with ML/LLM API integration. 
 You are a collaborative communicator with a customer-centric mindset, ready to train cross-functional users and manage stakeholder relationships effectively. 
 At Roche, we aim high to deliver life-changing healthcare solutions. If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact on patients and healthcare systems worldwide, this is the place for you. 
 Who we are
 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
 Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.




THE ROLE

The Field CTO role is one of Mistral's senior external technical voices; a role for someone who has earned genuine credibility in the AI field and can engage enterprise boards, CIOs, and CTOs as a peer. You will shape how strategic accounts think about their AI strategy, represent Mistral at major industry events, and publish thought leadership that reflects a real point of view on where AI is going.

You will work closely with regional sales leadership across your territory and bring what you learn from executive conversations back into Mistral's product direction. This is an externally-facing, influence-driven role. The output is measured in relationships built, content published, and executive conversations that move.

 


WHAT YOU WILL DO

Executive engagement

Run Mistral's Executive Briefing Center with your regional VP; a selective program for C-level stakeholders at strategic accounts. Build and sustain trusted-advisor relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and VP Engineering across your territory.

Thought leadership

Publish regularly: articles, whitepapers, and analysis of where enterprise AI is heading. Brief Gartner and Forrester on Mistral's roadmap and market position. Track frontier research and bring it into customer conversations.

Conference and event presence

Represent Mistral at major industry events through keynotes, panels, and roundtables. Build a public presence that generates inbound interest from enterprise executives and the wider AI community.

Market feedback

Bring what you hear in executive conversations back into product direction. Patterns across accounts on governance requirements and deployment constraints should reach the people building the models.

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Demonstrable credibility in the AI field. A public track record in AI: published papers, articles, or talks that reflect a clear, defensible position. Your work should read as credible next to Mistral's technical brand.

 - A stated position on open-weight models and what they change for the enterprises adopting them. Your existing public positions should sit comfortable next to Mistral's.

 - You are fluent in European data sovereignty and on-premise deployment, at the level that holds up with a CTO or VP Engineering asking hard questions.

 - You are comfortable engaging C-level stakeholders across multiple verticals on technical architecture and business strategy, in the same conversation.

 - Cross-vertical fluency, you can credibly engage across financial services, manufacturing, defense, and energy without being a domain specialist in any one of them.

 - 10–25 years of experience in enterprise technology. You have held roles such as: Field CTO, Principal Architect, or VP Engineering at a major cloud or AI company, or a founder who built technical credibility and executive relationships through their own company.

 - Comfortable with 30-50% travel depending on your region.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Existing network of CTO and CIO relationships at enterprise accounts in your region

 - Prior Field CTO or equivalent externally facing technical role at a major cloud or AI company

 - Fluent in multiple languages spoken across your region




WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link.




PRIVACY POLICY

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.desc:
Location 
ESTEC, Noordwijk, Netherlands with a resident assignment to ESRIN in Frascati, Italy.
 The post is subject to rotation. At the end of the 4-year assignment, notwithstanding possible extension of the appointment, a further assignment in an ESA establishment will be considered.​
 Description 
 Vega and Space Rider Flight Dynamics Engineer, reporting to the Head of the GNC Systems Architecture Section (parent organisation unit), in the GNC, AOCS and Pointing Division, Electrical Department, Directorate of Technology, Engineering and Quality.
 For your first assignment, you will be located at ESRIN and provide support to the Vega and Space Rider Launch System and Engineering Division, Flight Programmes Department, Directorate of Space Transportation.
 Duties 
 This Division is responsible for managing engineering expertise in the Vega and Space Rider Integrated Project Team, supporting ESA and institutional missions, ensuring compatibility between launch systems, payloads and mission requirements. The Division is also responsible for maintaining technical consistency in the development and exploitation of the Vega-C, Vega-E and Space Rider systems, as well as for the implementation of the launch system industrial activities.
 Within this context, you will serve as the focal point for all aspects relating to the flight dynamics of the Vega launcher family and Space Rider, from early mission feasibility through final mission analysis and post flight assessment. You will conduct and oversee trajectory, separation and collision avoidance analyses, support development activities, contribute to post flight analyses and anomaly investigations, maintain mission registers and technical documentation, and develop and adapt in house flight dynamics tools to evolving launcher configurations and mission needs, in close coordination with internal ESA teams, ESTEC and industrial partners.
 Your tasks and responsibilities will include:
 serving as the focal point for all trajectory analyses to be performed as part the preparation of Vega missions;
 supporting the GNC system development with an emphasis on guidance definition through trajectory analysis and optimisation in closed-loop;
 supporting ESA and institutional customers, from the early development phases, on all aspects related to payload compatibility with the Vega launcher family, in close coordination with the experts from the Vega Integrated Project Team;
 participating in Vega-C mission analyses covering the full lifecycle from early feasibility studies and activities through to final mission analyses, ensuring the compliance of mission characteristics with the launcher’s qualified domain;
 conducting preliminary separation and collision-avoidance analyses, based on preliminary mission inputs, to support ESA and institutional missions;
 performing long-term trajectory propagation analyses, including critical reviews of industrial inputs related to no-collision and mid-term collision avoidance assessments, with particular emphasis on Vega-C dual-launch and multi-payload configurations;
 supporting Vega-C post-flight mission analyses related to trajectory and separation performance, including contributions to anomaly investigations within the relevant domain and the performance of independent cross-checks where required, for example to refine internal model uncertainties;
 maintaining the register of future missions and preparing bi-yearly internal reports highlighting key criticalities with respect to the launcher’s qualified perimeter;
 producing relevant technical documentation and presenting analysis results to ESA and institutional customers as well as to internal or external stakeholders;
 maintaining, adapting and further developing in-house flight dynamics tools to accommodate new launcher characteristics and evolving mission needs, including mathematical solvers and tools for concurrent optimisation of GNC-related aspects of the space vehicle and trajectory.
 Technical competencies 
 Flight dynamics and analysis of launchers and re-entry vehicles
 Launcher system engineering and launcher performance analysis
 Trajectory analysis and optimisation, including transient flight phases and separation dynamics
 Long-term trajectory propagation, collision avoidance and multi-payload mission analysis
 Development, validation and maintenance of launcher flight dynamics and mission analysis tools and numerical models
 Technical assessment and independent verification of industrial analyses and data
 Knowledge of launcher GNC and its interfaces with propulsion, structures, operations and other system disciplines
 Knowledge of the European launcher sector and the Vega launcher family
 Behavioural competencies 
 Result Orientation
Operational Efficiency
Fostering Cooperation
Relationship Management
Continuous Improvement
Forward Thinking
For more information, please refer to the ESA Core Behavioural Competencies guidebook.

 Tasks WHAT WE DO As the FinTech hub of Mercedes‑Benz, we connect the world of mobility with the world of payments. Our mission is simple: Transform transactions into the best possible customer experience — inside the car and beyond. 
 What does that mean in practice? We make our customers’ lives easier by allowing them to pay for Mercedes-Benz goods and services across the entire customer lifecycle: from the purchase phase (initial financing/leasing rate, online reservation payments or down payments to full vehicle payments) through the usage phase (car-related services like fueling, charging or Digital Extras or the e-Vignette from the Mercedes-Benz Store) all the way to the retention phase (early contract settlement). 
ABOUT MERCEDES PAY Mercedes pay as a platform was launched in 2018 and is now live in 45+ markets across the globe, playing a central role in the digital business model of Mercedes‑Benz. 
 We enable payments across all customer touchpoints, no matter where the customers are: via app, web, at the Point of Sale and even the car itself. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Stuttgart, Berlin and Singapore. 
Our solutions enable: 
 Digital Extras & subscriptions
 Mobility services like fueling and charging 
 e-Commerce (ATC)
 Online vehicle sales and full vehicle payment (in selected markets) 
 In-car payments 
 Loyalty 
 OUR VALUES & HOW WE WORK We are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than staying stuck because of unexpected roadblocks. 
 In short: How we work is strongly based on our values of collaboration: Trust, innovation, responsibility, team spirit and belonging. 
 Since we are still building new processes and products alongside our existing ones, everyone has the opportunity to shape our success – from day one! 
 Are you ready to rethink how the world pays for mobility? Join us and help shape the future of payments!
YOUR DAY AT GLANCE You will collaborate in a dynamic, innovation-driven environment where your experience and hands-on attitude are valued
 You will set up and maintain our AWS cloud infrastructure, align them with best-practice standards using infrastructure as code, and support the rollout of new payment products and services from an infrastructure perspective
 You will support releases and ensure the reliable operation of CI/CD pipelines, including up-to-date compliance and security checks for our builds and deployments
 You will further develop our data pipeline and integrate it with other systems
 You will leverage Datadog features to monitor changes to our infrastructure
 You will contribute to IT Operations activities during the rollout of products to new markets and use cases
 You will collaborate with Mercedes-Benz Group IT specialists and external providers to co-create innovative solutions and contribute to AI-based IT Operations solutions at Mercedes pay
 You will play a key role in ensuring the operational excellence of our global payment platform
 Qualifications WHAT WE EXPECT You have a strong passion for IT and bring an open-minded, highly motivated attitude
 You have strong solution-oriented, problem-solving, and analytical skills
 You are proficient in cloud service architecture best practices and have experience writing infrastructure as code
 You are proficient in Terraform, Kubernetes, and Helm, and have experience in software development (e.g. Java), Git SCM, and the Atlassian toolchain
 You have successfully completed a relevant degree in Computer Science or have equivalent professional experience
 You are willing to participate in an on-call rotation
 You have knowledge of IT security best practices and common standards
 You are fluent in business English and technical English
 WHAT WE OFFER

 Excellent infrastructure

items.desc: Salary Grade 6, £37,369 to 46,970 per annum Contractual hours 35 Basis Full time Region South Job category/type Academic and Research Date posted 27/10/2026 Job reference SRF54613 Fixed term contract, up to 3.5 years Closing date: 23:59 on 30th November 2026 Interview date: 8th December 2026 By reference to the applicable SOC code for this role, sponsorship may be possible under the Skilled Worker Route. Applicants wishing to consider the SWR must ensure that they are able to meet the points requirement before applying. There is further information about this on the UK Visas and Immigration Website UK Visas and Immigration Website. We are seeking a motivated research scientist to work as part of a team striving to improve both our representation of climate and extreme events over Europe, and the information provided about how extreme events may evolve in the coming decades. The post holder will be based in the National Centre for Atmospheric Science (NCAS) in the Department of Meteorology at the University of Reading. The Department of Meteorology is world-renowned for its pioneering research on weather, climate and earth observations with 100% of our research graded as world-leading or internationally excellent in REF2021. NCAS is a NERC research centre distributed across UK Universities. At Reading, it includes world-leading expertise on climate variability and change. The main duties of the role are to: Identify weather conditions leading up to high-impact extremes, and how they change with warming Perform a broad assessment of the atmospheric drivers of precipitation and air quality extremes, and probability distributions of temperature and precipitation, in project simulations Assess the degree to which qualitative conclusions about causes and consequences of specific extreme events depend on model resolution and complexity Contribute to the development of physical climate storylines, in collaboration with project partners and stakeholders, to be used to communicate how combinations of anthropogenic forcing and internal variability affect the development and intensity of extreme events. Use storylines to identify potential high-impact events as they develop in simulations, so that large ensembles of these events can be produced You will have : Strong scientific analytic ability and high capacity for problem solving Strong data-analytical skills and understanding of statistical methods Good programming and communication skills Experience of analysing output from climate models and similar datasets or shortly expect to receive, a PhD or equivalent research experience in physical or mathematical sciences We welcome applications from both external and internal candidates. As part of the University’s ongoing commitment to professional development, this role can be considered on a seconded basis for existing staff members. Internal candidates should discuss this with their line manager prior to applying. items.desc: Description We are looking for a full-stack developer to join a growing Insurtech business unit (based in Cambridge) building market-leading insurance software with a focus on the development of modern SaaS based solutions. You will join at a genuine inflection point: we are moving from AI-assisted coding toward an agentic software development lifecycle, where engineers increasingly describe intent, and orchestrate, review and govern the work that AI executes. The Role Today the role focuses on: Working with the Product Owner to define, refine and deliver the product backlog. Designing and building software solutions that meet functional and non-functional requirements, using AI coding tools to accelerate delivery. Writing and maintaining test-related code - unit tests, test frameworks and automated test cases. Reviewing and debugging code to identify defects, performance bottlenecks, and technical debt. Participating in Agile/scrum activities (planning, stand-ups, retrospectives) and continuously improving team velocity, process and engineering practice. Participating in incident response and continuously hardening the platform based on production learnings The role will evolve and we expect more focus on: Business outcomes - partnering closely with business stakeholders to understand underlying needs, challenge assumptions where appropriate, and measure success through tangible business and user outcomes. Design over implementation - spending more time defining system boundaries, integration patterns and architectural intent, using AI-assisted tools to explore solutions and validate design decisions before code is written. Specification as a first-class craft - writing clear, testable intent and acceptance criteria that agents and humans can both act on. Review and quality judgement - evaluating AI-generated work for correctness, security and design fit, rather than typing every line yourself. Orchestration - composing and supervising AI capabilities and agentic workflows inside governed pipelines with clear quality gates. Raising the team, not just yourself - turning good individual practice into shared, reusable capability so the whole team gets faster, not just one person. Learning and adaptation - staying current with emerging AI capabilities and engineering practices, helping the team identify, adopt and govern new ways of working that improve delivery and outcomes Qualifications What you’ll bring Core engineering Solid full-stack development experience across modern front-end and back-end technologies, with cloud/SaaS exposure. Strong grasp of software design, testing and quality fundamentals - you know what good looks like and can articulate why. Comfortable working in Agile/scrum teams and collaborating closely with Product. AI fluency Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants or agentic tools in real delivery - and, more importantly, good judgement about when to trust, correct or override them. Able to write clear specifications and prompts, and to critically review AI-generated code for correctness, security and maintainability. Curious and self-directed about emerging AI engineering practice - you actively experiment rather than wait to be trained. (Specific tools matter less than the fluency and judgement; the toolchain will keep changing.) Mindset Comfortable with ambiguity and change - you can do valuable work today while the operating model around you is still forming. Passion for complex problem solving, as well as statistics and algorithm development Paint drip-shaped: you have multiple deep areas of expertise and demonstrate ability to use various approaches and adapt as roles blur. Sees reviewing and specifying as real engineering and an opportunity to deliver even more value, not a step down from writing code. A growth mindset and a bias to improve the system, not just complete the ticket. General knowledge of the insurance industry and degree level education in a relevant discipline is highly desirable but not essential. What we offer Enjoy a benefits package designed to help you thrive, both professionally and personally. You'll receive 25 days of annual leave plus an extra WTW day to relax and recharge. Our comprehensive health and wellbeing offering includes private healthcare, life insurance, group income protection, and regular health assessments, all giving you peace of mind. Secure your future with our defined contribution pension scheme, featuring matched contributions up to 10% from the company. We support your growth and balance with hybrid working options, access to an employee assistance programme, and a fully paid volunteer day to make a difference in your community. On top of these, you can opt into a variety of additional perks including an electric vehicle car scheme, share scheme, cycle-to-work programme, dental and optical cover, critical illness protection, and much more. Aujourd’hui, Meilleurtaux est un acteur global du Crédit, de l’Assurance et du Placement , rassemble près de 2 000 collaborateurs , 240 agences franchisées et accompagne chaque année plus de 3 millions de Français. items.card: You will conduct individual and collaborative research projects in theoretical chemistry and computational simulation, continually update your own knowledge and understanding in the field and translate knowledge of advances in the subject area into research activity, write up research work for publication, contribute to preparing proposals and applications to external bodies, e.g. for funding and contractual
items.desc: The Faculty of Chemistry at the Georg-August-Universität Göttingen welcomes applications for a Research Assistant (f/m/d) at the Theoretical Chemistry group (Group of Prof. Reinhard Maurer). This is a full-time position with a regular working time of 39.8 hours per week and a fixed-term employment contract for two years. The position can be filled on or after 01.02.2027 (start date is flexible). Salary: Pay grade 13 TV-L (100%). Your duties You will conduct individual and collaborative research projects in theoretical chemistry and computational simulation, continually update your own knowledge and understanding in the field and translate knowledge of advances in the subject area into research activity, write up research work for publication, contribute to preparing proposals and applications to external bodies, e.g. for funding and contractual purposes, to support a developing research agenda, present information on research progress and outcomes to team members and collaboration partners, contribute positively to a collegiate research environment by supporting students and engaging in group activities such as meetings and seminars, contribute to teaching of courses as defined in Section 31 of the Higher Education Act of Lower Saxony (NHG) and administering of examinations (4 LVS). It is expected that teaching can be conducted in German after a maximum of two semesters of training. Your profile You hold a highly qualified PhD in a relevant scientific discipline (e.g. chemistry, physics, materials science), proven ability in research and evidence of high-quality research outputs in relevant field, excellent knowledge of range of theoretical and computational methods in electronic structure theory, molecular simulation, and/or condensed matter physics with relevance to the project, good programming skills, ability to communicate complex scientific results effectively, ability to work both independently and as part of a team on complex research programs, ability to work collaboratively and effectively within an interdisciplinary and diverse team, desirably prior experience in many-body dispersion methods, dispersion-corrected density-functional theory for extended systems, or machine-learning interatomic potentials. This post is designed to serve in fostering young researchers and scientists and give the successful applicant the opportunity to pursue post-doctoral research. The position is also suitable for part-time work. We are looking for a postdoctoral researcher to contribute to the development of novel dispersion-inclusive simulation methods for hybrid metal–organic interfaces. The project aims to establish a predictive and scalable methodology by (i) developing density-consistent treatments of van der Waals interactions within DFT, (ii) extending the many-body dispersion (MBD) framework and (iii) embedding the resulting physical response models into machine-learning force fields for large-scale simulations of realistic interface sizes. We are looking for an applicant with strong expertise in dispersion-corrected DFT, many-body methods for condensed-phase systems, or physics-informed machine-learning interatomic potentials. Who we are : In the Maurer group, we aim to develop computational simulation methodology to study quantum phenomena at surfaces with applications ranging from photocatalysis, to nanotechnology and electrochemistry. Our goal is to combine electronic structure theory, molecular and quantum dynamics methodology, and machine learning methods to achieve an accurate yet computationally feasible description of complex phenomena in materials and at solid/gas and solid/liquid interfaces. You will join a large, international and interdisciplinary research group that provides a collaborative and supportive environment. The University of Göttingen is an equal opportunities employer and places particular emphasis on fostering career opportunities for women. Qualified women are therefore strongly encouraged to apply in fields in which they are underrepresented. The university has committed itself to being a family-friendly institution and supports their employees in balancing work and family life. The mission of the University is to employ a greater number of severely disabled persons. Applications from severely disabled persons with equivalent qualifications will be given preference. The documents are to be submitted by electronic form (single PDF file) to the e-mail maurergroup@chemie.uni-goettingen.de . The deadline for submission is 20:00 (CET) on Wednesday November 18, 2026 . Please note: With submission of your application, you accept the processing of your applicant data in terms of data-protection law. Further information on the legal basis and data usage is provided in the Hinweisblatt zur Datenschutzgrundverordnung (DSGVO) https://www.uni-goettingen.de/hinweisdsgvo

items.desc: About the role: As a Learning Experience Architect at Quantum Systems, you will work with our Training & Demo Team to shape learning around our unmanned systems (UxS). You will help our international customers and employees understand complex technology and use it safely. You will define the instructional approach for our training portfolio and support its implementation. Working with trainers and subject matter experts, you will digitize and scale existing training and develop new offerings. You will combine digital learning with practical exercises and assess how well learners can apply what they have learned. You will have the freedom to take your ideas from concept to launch and put your own stamp on UxS training at Quantum Systems. Your work will improve the technical and instructional quality of our training and make its impact measurable. What is your Day to Day Mission: You will design modular learning paths that combine digital self-study with instructor-led training and simulator exercises. You will turn technical expertise into interactive learning modules and assessments and coordinate media production. You will build scalable offerings in learning management systems such as Moodle and define standards for quality and reusable content. You will test learning concepts with target users and improve them using feedback, usage data and learning results. You will evaluate learning outcomes and practical application and use the findings to improve our training portfolio. You will advise and support our trainers in using effective instructional methods for digital and blended learning. You will prioritize portfolio improvements and deliver learning projects with UxS experts, the Simulator Team and external providers. You will analyze learning needs and define measurable objectives for new and existing offerings with the Training & Demo Team. What you bring to the team: You have a degree in education, instructional design, media or e-learning, or a comparable qualification with relevant practical experience. You have solid experience in adult learning and modular, digital and blended learning, demonstrated through project examples or a portfolio. You can analyze learning needs, define measurable objectives and test learning concepts with target users. You are proficient in authoring tools and experienced in designing and publishing digital learning in learning management systems such as Moodle. You know how to evaluate learning outcomes and practical application and use feedback and learning data to drive improvements. You can understand complex technical topics, explain them clearly with subject matter experts and advise trainers on new learning formats. You work independently and methodically and coordinate learning projects with different stakeholders. You have excellent written and spoken German and English communication skills. Experience with AI in learning, media design (images, audio, video) or learning management system administration is a plus. items.desc: About Refine A spreadsheet error in one of the most influential economics papers of the decade helped justify austerity across Europe and the US. Millions lived with the consequences. The error was only found years later, by sheer luck, long after the damage was done. Flawed analysis shapes policy, investment and lending every day, costs billions every year, and mostly goes unnoticed. AI makes it worse: rigorous-looking work is now cheap to produce. Refine exists to catch these errors before anyone acts on them. We're building the infrastructure that verifies high-stakes work; think CI/CD for everything beyond code. It reviews a document like a team of experts, checking the maths, data, logic and argument, in minutes. The best AI review system. Refine 5 beats frontier models such as GPT-6 Astra in over 90% of blind head-to-heads across ten fields, from economics to biology. It combines the top frontier models at hundreds of times normal compute, so no one model's blind spots get through. We tune it on documents seeded with the errors frontier models miss. The de facto AI reviewer for economics. Econometrica and the AER run every paper they publish through Refine. It's used at 24 central banks and by researchers at Oxford, MIT, Stanford, Yale and Cambridge; Cambridge, UCLA and NYU provide it to theirs. Beyond academia. 29,000+ reviews sold at 1,000+ institutions, including litigation consultancies, hedge funds and companies bidding on public tenders. Enterprise-grade. ISO 27001 certified, SOC 2 Type 1 (Type 2 in progress). On the web and inside ChatGPT, Claude and Codex. The role You'll own growth end to end, from first visit to renewed subscription, building it from the ground up with room to build a team later. Priority: top of funnel and fast experimentation. You're measured on signups, active, paying and repeat users, and on revenue as we grow from $1M to $10M. You'll work directly with the founders, Yann Calvo Lopez (CEO) and Ben Golub (Chief Scientist, formerly a tenured economics professor at Harvard). Our advisors include OpenAI co-founder John Schulman. What you'll do Experiment constantly. Tests on pages, offers, onboarding and pricing. Open the AI channels. ChatGPT ads, and being the answer when someone asks an AI how to check a paper or verify a contract. Turn our ChatGPT, Claude and Codex integrations into distribution. Win search, classic and AI. Drive search traffic and get cited in AI answers. Make paid acquisition pay off. Grow the viral loop. Users share reviews with co-authors and colleagues, who sign up to read them; some become paying users. Build lifecycle email around the deadlines that drive usage: submissions, grant cycles, filings, tenders. Whatever else makes us grow. If it moves the numbers, it's in scope. Our data (yes, really) Everything is in PostHog and wired to AI: every product event captured server-side (uploads, reviews, purchases, credits); Stripe, Clerk, Customer.io, ad platforms and our app database in the same warehouse; plus model costs, logs, feature flags and experiments. Ad click to revenue is one query, per person or per organisation. Ask an AI for "signup-to-paid by campaign, last 60 days" and set up the next test in the same conversation. No begging engineers for data. Who you are A hands-on operator with about 4-7 years in growth at a self-serve (B2C or prosumer) or B2B SaaS company. Less is fine if you're great. In the data daily. You ideally don't wait for someone to build you a dashboard. AI-native. You use Claude, Claude Cowork, Codex or similar every day to research, analyse, build and test, and can show examples. An experimenter. Five small tests this week beat one big plan next month. Proven in paid acquisition (Google Ads at minimum), measured in revenue, not clicks. A clear writer. We use AI for almost everything except customer-facing copy: you write that, for PhDs, law firm partners and central bank economists. An owner. Idea to measured result, low ego, comfortable with ambiguity. Nice to have: PostHog or similar analytics; setting up lifecycle email (Customer.io or similar); coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) to build pages and automations yourself; LinkedIn Ads; range across B2C and B2B; Spanish or another European language. How we work AI-native throughout. We build with AI and expect marketing to as well: one person with the right setup does what used to take a team. Autonomy. You choose what to work on, by impact. Speed. Tracking fixes, pages and product tweaks usually ship the same day. Evidence over opinions. If we can't measure it, we don't claim it worked. Remote-first. Async by default, few meetings. Respect for users. They're sceptical experts; we win them with substance, not hype. Meritocracy. Talent, hard work and results are rewarded. Compensation: competitive. items.desc: Vall d'Hebron Research Institute (VHIR) is a public sector institution, located in Barcelona (Spain) that promotes and develops innovative biomedical research at the University Hospital Vall d'Hebron. The Cardiovascular Diseases Research Group generates knowledge on the mechanisms of heart diseases and proposes new diagnostic and therapeutic tools to be applied in patients with cardiomyopathies. The group is looking for candidates to apply to the next call of Ayudas para la Formación de Profesorado Universitario (FPU2026) and join its research team to undertake doctoral studies in cardiovascular research. You will undertake doctoral-level research under the supervision and mentorship of experienced researchers, while developing scientific, technical and transferable skills. You will be expected to contribute to high-quality research in line with the scientific objectives of the team, work towards the completion of your doctoral thesis and participate in the dissemination of research results through scientific publications, conferences and seminars. In addition, you will participate in training and professional development activities, contribute to outreach and collaborative research activities, and develop the skills and experience required for the next stage of your research career. Main responsibilities and duties: Develop and complete a doctoral research project and thesis focused on addressing an unmet clinical need in cardiology, in accordance with the agreed research and training plan. Conduct high-quality translational research under the supervision of senior researchers, including experimental work using appropriate in vitro and in vivo animal models, data collection and measurement, statistical analysis, interpretation of results, and literature review. Contribute to the design of experiments, development of research protocols, and implementation of appropriate methodologies. Collaborate with senior researchers and other members of the team in the development of research projects and contribute to scientific publications and communications. Present and discuss research findings within the group and participate in scientific conferences, seminars, and other research dissemination activities. Participate in doctoral training, scientific events, and continuous professional development activities. Actively contribute to scientific discussions and foster knowledge exchange within the research group. Education and qualifications: Required: Hold a university degree in Biology, Biochemistry, Pharmacy, Biomedicine, Veterinary Medicine, or a related discipline. Have a minimum average grade of 8 out of 10 in the Bachelor's degree . Hold a completed university degree and a Master's degree, with a minimum of 300 ECTS credits in official university studies at the time of application. Alternatively, hold an official university qualification from a country within the European Higher Education Area comprising at least 300 ECTS credits, including a minimum of 60 ECTS credits at Master's level, that provides access to doctoral studies. Meet the eligibility requirements for the FPU2026 call, including the following: Not have previously been awarded an FPU grant under any previous call. Not hold a doctoral degree from any Spanish or foreign university. Not have held a predoctoral contract for more than 12 months prior to submitting the application. Be enrolled in or admitted to a doctoral programme for the 2026–2027 academic year at the time of application. Candidates who are not yet enrolled or admitted may also apply if they will meet this requirement by the date the employment contract is formalised. Be admitted to the relevant doctoral programme and enrol in the corresponding doctoral studies at the beginning of the appointment. Have an English proficiency level of at least B2 or equivalent , according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). items.desc: Mission As a Data Scientist specializing in LLM you will be responsible for developing, implementing and optimizing advanced algorithms, models and capabilities that help our teams (e.g. Field Operations) automate their workloads, e.g. in the context of decision support, mission planning and situational awareness. You will work on a variety of projects that involve understanding, processing and generating human language to solve complex problems and create innovative solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in LLMs, machine learning and data science, with a proven track record of successful projects in these domains. What Will Be Your Responsibilities Algorithm Development: Design, develop and implement state-of-the-art algorithms and models, within the context of language models. Capability Development: Realize new AI-based capabilities in areas such as decision support, mission planning, workflow automation. Model Training and Optimization: Train and optimize large language models using vast amounts of textual data, ensuring high performance and accuracy. Data Preprocessing: Perform data preprocessing tasks such as tokenization, stemming, lemmatization and normalization to prepare datasets for training and evaluation. Research and Innovation: Stay current with the latest advancements in LLM and Natural Language Processing (NLP) and apply new techniques to improve existing models and develop new solutions. Collaboration: Work closely with data engineers, software developers, product managers and other stakeholders to understand project requirements and deliver effective solutions. Performance Evaluation: Evaluate the performance of models using appropriate metrics and techniques and iteratively improve their accuracy and efficiency. Deployment: Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy models into production environments and ensure their robustness and scalability. Documentation: Maintain comprehensive documentation of models, algorithms and processes for future reference and reproducibility. Profile And Requirements Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field. A Ph.D. is a plus. Experience: 3+ years of experience in data science, with a focus on large language models and NLP. Technical Skills Strong programming skills in Python, with experience using NLP and LLM libraries such as spaCy, Hugging Face (Transformers, Datasets, PEFT, TRL) and the major model families (e.g. GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, Qwen, Gemma) via both API and open weights. Proficiency in deep learning frameworks, primarily PyTorch (plus Keras/TensorFlow as needed), and familiarity with inference optimisation (quantisation, TensorRT-LLM). Experience with data preprocessing, curation and tokenisation for LLM workloads, including building and cleaning datasets for fine-tuning and retrieval (chunking, embeddings, deduplication, synthetic data generation). Solid understanding of transformer architectures and attention, with working knowledge of fine-tuning and alignment techniques (full fine-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA, instruction tuning, RLHF/DPO). Exposure to RNNs and CNNs is a plus rather than a core requirement. Experience training and fine-tuning LLMs and building RAG and agentic systems, including orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph), vector databases (e.g. Qdrant, Weaviate, pgvector) and tool/function calling. Experience with experimentation and tracking tooling: Jupyter notebooks plus experiment and prompt tracking (MLflow, Weights & Biases) and LLM evaluation (e.g. Ragas, LangSmith/Langfuse, custom eval harnesses). Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and their AI services, with a focus on Google Cloud (Vertex AI, model garden, managed endpoints). Experience deploying self-hosted and open-weight LLMs in production, using serving frameworks such as vLLM, TGI, Ollama or llama.cpp, with awareness of GPU sizing, quantisation formats (GGUF, AWQ, GPTQ) and on-prem or airgapped constraints. Working knowledge of MLOps/LLMOps and DevOps practices: Git, CI/CD, containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes), plus telemetry, monitoring and observability for model and inference performance. Analytical Skills: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to design innovative solutions to complex problems. AI Ethics and Bias Mitigation: Experience or awareness of AI ethics, fairness and bias mitigation strategies, in the context of NLP and LLMs. Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Collaboration: Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional team environment. Attention to Detail: High attention to detail and a commitment to ensuring the accuracy and quality of work. Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously. What We Have …

items.desc: Vil du være med til at skabe digitale værktøjer, der bruger AI til at understøtte journalisters daglige arbejde? I JP/Politikens Hus har vi arbejdet med udvikling af redaktionelle AI-værktøjer siden 2020 og blandt andet vundet internationale priser for Magna, der i dag bruges af de fleste journalister i JP/Politikens Hus. Vi er nu i gang med at etablere et nyt produktteam, der skal videreudvikle en nyetableret AI baseret platform til monitorering og filtrering af kilder til nyhedshistorier og versionering af nyhedshistorier i tekst, billede og lyd. En tidlig udgave af platformen er testet med stor succes og vi skal nu til at rulle platformen ud til flere medier i JP/Politikens Hus og videreudvikle den for at realisere dens fulde potentiale. Derfor søger vi blandt andet en ML Specialist, der skal udvikle platformens AI-funktioner og sikre, at de er præcise, pålidelige og nyttige for journalister fra bl.a. Ekstra Bladet, Politiken, Jyllands-Posten og erhvervsmedierne. Produktteamet er en del af AI-enheden i JP/Politikens Hus. Teamet er placeret tæt på redaktionerne, så produktudvikling og journalistiske behov kan mødes i det daglige arbejde. Som ML Specialist samarbejder du tæt med teamets Product Manager og Tech Lead. Du refererer til Data Science & AI Manager Tobias Tvarnø og bliver en del af AI-enhedens Data Science-team. Om rollen Som ML Specialist får du ansvar for at udvikle de modeller, prompts og datapipelines, der driver produktets AI-funktioner. Rollen kombinerer hands-on udvikling med eksperimenter, evaluering og løbende kommunikation med brugerne. Du Vil Blandt Andet Arbejde Med Udvikling af AI-løsninger i Python, fra prototype til produktionsklare services i teamets fælles kodebase Design og implementering af løsninger med sprogmodeller og andre AI-teknologier til monitorering og filtrering af kilder og versionering af nyhedshistorier Eksperimenter, prototyper og evaluering af potentielle løsninger sammen med teamets Product Manager Løbende dialog med brugere og indsamling af feedback, der omsættes til evalueringsdata og forbedringer af løsningerne Tæt samarbejde med teamets Product Manager og Tech Lead om at omsætte redaktionelle behov til sammenhængende produkt- og tekniske løsninger Systematisk evaluering samt sikring af kvalitet, faktuel korrekthed, ydeevne og vedligeholdelse i AI-løsningerne En vigtig del af rollen er at skabe løsninger, der er pålidelige og gennemskuelige, understøtter hurtige journalistiske arbejdsgange og lever op til krav om kvalitet, sikkerhed og ansvarlig brug af AI. Hvordan integrerer man sprogmodeller og andre AI-teknologier i arbejdsgangen uden at gå på kompromis med brugerens kontrol eller kvaliteten? Hvordan udvikler man evalueringsmetoder, der kan afgøre, om genereret indhold er korrekt og understøttet af kilderne, og som fungerer på tværs af mediebrands og redaktionelle behov? Hvordan bruger man kvalitative tilbagemeldinger og produktdata til løbende at forbedre produktets effekt og kvaliteten af AI-løsningerne? Onze dynamische wereld verandert continu, en jij verandert met ons mee. Vacatureomschrijving Als AI Developer werk je aan het ontwerpen en bouwen van AI-oplossingen binnen het Microsoft-ecosysteem. Je ontwikkelt AI-agents en slimme applicaties met Azure AI Foundry, Semantic Kernel en het Microsoft Agent Framework. items.desc: Meet the Team Cisco ThousandEyes is a Digital Assurance platform that empowers organizations to deliver flawless digital experiences across every network – even the ones they don’t own. Powered by AI and an unmatched set of cloud, internet and enterprise network telemetry data, ThousandEyes enables IT teams to proactively detect, diagnose, and remediate issues – before they impact end- user experiences. ThousandEyes is deeply integrated across the entire Cisco technology portfolio and beyond, helping customers deploy at scale while also delivering AI-powered assurance insights within Cisco’s leading Networking, Security, Collaboration, and Observability portfolios. Your Impact We are seeking a visionary Software Engineer to join our newly formed Autonomous Security team. This is not a traditional "monitor and patch" role. In this position, you will be at the forefront of the next evolution of cybersecurity: Autonomous (AI) Security Team. Your mission will be to design, build, and deploy AI agents that act as autonomous security researchers and first responders. You will move our security posture from "Human-in-the-loop" to "Human-on-the-loop," creating a self-healing infrastructure that identifies, tests, and mitigates vulnerabilities at machine speed. AI Agent Development: Build and fine-tune LLM-based agents to perform automated vulnerability research and code analysis. Autonomous Remediation: Develop "self-healing" pipelines that automatically generate, test, and deploy security patches and dependency updates via Kargo and ArgoCD. Threat Mitigation: Design AI-driven logic to detect anomalous traffic patterns and autonomously update WAF rules or service mesh configurations to neutralize external threats in real-time. Pipeline Integration: Integrate AI security tooling directly into our CI/CD lifecycle, ensuring that security is an automated, invisible, and frictionless part of the development process. Security Orchestration: Build the "nervous system" that connects security scanning tools (Snyk, Wiz, etc.) with AI agents to prioritize and resolve alerts without manual triage. Minimum Qualifications Programming & Automation: 3+ years developing production software, backend services, or automated tooling using Python or Go. Cloud-Native & CI/CD: Hands-on experience containerizing applications, managing Kubernetes deployments, and building automated CI/CD or GitOps pipelines (e.g., ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI). Application Security: Demonstrated experience implementing secure coding practices, applying OWASP Top 10 mitigation strategies, and remediating CVEs in cloud environments. Preferred Qualifications AI/LLM Engineering: Practical experience integrating Large Language Model (LLM) APIs, structured prompt workflows, or agentic frameworks into software applications. Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus) for security context retrieval. Familiarity with "Policy as Code" (OPA/Rego). Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

items.desc: What is Finary? We are on a mission to give power back to investors . Great financial guidance has always existed, it just came with a minimum net worth. We're changing that by building the AI-powered one-stop shop for investing, where you can track your assets, manage your budget, invest, and learn. One simple, ambitious idea drives us: put a private banker in everyone's pocket. Mounir launched Finary in 2021, and more than 1,000,000 people now trust us with their financial lives. We ship cutting-edge products with touches of delight, and we care deeply about experience, performance, and ease of use. Why now? A new generation of investors is emerging: ambitious, involved, done with taboos around money. We see a world where investing empowers everybody to live the life they've always dreamt of. To fuel that, we raised €40M from Hedosophia, Y Combinator, and Speedinvest, alongside founders and operators like Steve Anavi & Alexandre Prot (Qonto), Matthieu Rouif (Photoroom), Eric Demuth (Bitpanda), Axel Weber (former UBS Chairman), and Harsh Sinha (CTO at Wise). In July 2026, the AMF granted us our MiCA license, on top of our Investment Firm license: one of the very few French platforms holding both, offering stocks, ETFs and crypto on a single regulated platform, right as Europe consolidates around licensed players. There's never been a more exciting time to join. What we offer We're 70 builders who genuinely love what they do: real ownership from day one, tier-1 salary and equity, offices in the heart of Paris with hybrid remote, and quarterly gatherings we actually look forward to. We hire A-players who are as kind as they are demanding, people whose ideas transform not just our product but the way we work and think. Our culture is direct, transparent, and built on radical candor: we challenge each other openly, then commit. And we don't hedge on AI. It's the single most important skill of the next decade and a real bar here. Everyone at Finary has rebuilt how they work around it. If that's already second nature to you, you'll be surrounded by people pushing that frontier every day. Read more about our values here. The opportunity AI is not a side project at Finary: it's how we intend to run the company. Our teams already build their own automations, so this role is about the hard part: complex orchestrations, and intelligence inside the products our advisors and operations team rely on every day. You own what you build end to end, from understanding the need with the people who'll use it to running it in production. We move fast and need an AI product engineer to move with us. What You'll Do Advisory at scale: build the closing machine and the systems that accelerate our sales team Allocation engines: build the recommendation engine that captures our advisors' expertise Operating systems: build the agentic layer that lets our operations team orchestrate a fleet of AI agents, with minimal humans interactions End-to-end ownership: gather needs with the teams who use your products, then design, build, deploy and maintain them; define what a correct agent decision looks like, measure it, and catch drift before users do Enablement: help non-engineers build their own automations, step in when they need something more robust, and work with the rest of engineering on shared agentic infrastructure What we're looking for Production software experience: 3+ years shipping production grade software, including products you've owned end to end, from gathering needs to running them AI systems in production: you've built and run LLM integrations, agents and multi-step orchestrations in production. You can explain how they work and evaluate them. You know when a simple rule beats an agent, and AI coding tools are part of your daily work. Range across the stack: comfortable across several languages and codebases, and quick to pick up new ones. Our stack is TypeScript, Rust and Ruby, on Google Cloud and Kubernetes with infrastructure as code. You don't need to be an SRE, but you deploy and run what you build and keep data correct as systems evolve Product sense and UX: you start from the problem, not the technology, and you care about the people using what you build and how it feels to use High agency: you work across teams and switch context often, and you find the next problem worth solving and own it without waiting to be told French and English: fluent French to work with our advisory team and the rest of the company, and professional English Based in Western Europe: we expect quarterly presence for our onsite weeks in Paris We're particularly interested in: An agentic system you built that is in production and used today How you know it works, and what it saves the people using it A time you chose a simple script or rule over an agent, and why Nice to have Familiarity with fintech or a regulated industry Passion for personal finance and investing What we offer Competitive salary: €65k - €80k base depending on …

items.desc: Company Description FromNine is an international technology company helping governments and enterprises apply artificial intelligence, enterprise software, and cloud solutions at scale. With more than 2,400 professionals across Europe and Southeast Asia, the company focuses on modernizing core systems, unlocking data value, and integrating AI safely into daily operations. FromNine has delivered over 600 projects for public bodies in every EU member state and more than 400 projects for private companies. European operations are headquartered in Antwerp with innovation hubs in Ghent, Amsterdam, and Cyberjaya, supporting multilingual work across Europe and Asia. Trust and security underpin all engagements, supported by ISO/IEC 27001 certification and strategic partnerships with Salesforce, SAP, and Odoo. Role Description The Generative AI Engineer will design, build, and optimize generative AI solutions that support public institutions and enterprises in their digital transformation programs. Day-to-day responsibilities include developing and fine-tuning models, integrating them into cloud-based and on-premise systems, collaborating with data engineers and software developers, and translating client needs into robust technical architectures. The role involves experimenting with new AI techniques, ensuring responsible and secure use of AI, documenting solutions, and supporting deployment and maintenance in production environments. This is a full-time hybrid role based in Paris, with a mix of on-site collaboration and work-from-home flexibility. Qualifications Strong foundation in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, with experience in designing and implementing production-grade AI or machine learning systems. Hands-on experience with generative AI models (e.g., transformer-based LLMs, diffusion models), including fine-tuning, prompt engineering, evaluation, and optimization for latency, accuracy, and cost. Proficiency in programming and tooling for AI development (e.g., Python, relevant ML/AI frameworks, APIs, version control) and familiarity with modern software development practices. Understanding of cloud and enterprise environments, including CI/CD practices, containerization, integration with existing systems, and attention to security and data privacy. Ability to work in cross-functional teams, communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders, and translate business requirements into technical solutions. Experience or strong interest in working with public sector and enterprise clients on large-scale transformation projects is beneficial. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Comfort working in an international, multilingual environment; proficiency in English is required, and French or other European languages are an advantage.

items.desc: Är du redo för ett examensarbete där du får vara med och utveckla banbrytande lösningar inom högteknologiska system? Hos Combitech arbetar vi i framkant med allt från flygväderövervakning till autonoma maskiner, och vi söker nu dig som vill vara en del av en unik utvecklingsutmaning – att bygga stöd för automatisk troubleshooting i körande system. Uppdraget – Agentic troubleshooting I detta examensarbete får du chansen att utveckla en innovativ felhanteringslösning för vårt avancerade system för flygväderövervakning (AWOS). Målet är att komplettera de agenter som finns för utveckling av systemet med agenter för övervakning och felhantering av körande system. Uppgiften Dark Software Factory-metodik är idag en självklar väg att gå för greenfieldprojekt. Där kan man från början bygga systemet med hög tillgänglighet för agenter via MCP-servrar. För brownfieldprojekt däremot är det mer utmanande att i efterhand göra systemet tillgängligt för agenter. Din uppgift blir att träffa rätt med en design för att tillgängliggöra ett system med över 30 år på nacken för agenter i syfte att automatisera felsökning i både testsystem och driftsatta system. Har man det på plats är steget litet till ett självläkande system. Vem är du? Vi söker dig som har en stark drivkraft och passion för programmering och systemutveckling och som är civil- eller högskoleingenjör med inriktning mot data, IT eller liknande, och vill vara med och forma den nya vardagen med Agentic workflows. Du tycker AI-utvecklingen är spännande samtidigt som du är vass på det underliggande hantverket. Du kommer att arbeta tillsammans med våra erfarna utvecklare och få insikter i hur vi skapar framtidens högteknologiska lösningar. Hos Combitech får du stor frihet att forma examensarbetet tillsammans med oss. Vi söker en driven student (eller två) som vill utveckla lösningar som driver tekniken framåt. Detta är mer än bara ett examensarbete – det är din chans att utveckla något som gör en verklig skillnad och sätter en ny standard för hur vi mäter och visualiserar systemens robusthet. Då tjänsten innebär arbete som omfattas av försvarssekretess krävs det att du genomför och godkänns i en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll. Urval sker löpande. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Kom och gör skillnad Vi tror att man gör ett bättre jobb om man kan fokusera på rätt saker, därför gör vi det lätt att kombinera jobbet med vardagen. Vi satsar på våra medarbetare, de utgör kärnan, hjärnan och hjärtat i vår verksamhet. Dessutom står vi på en stadig grund av högteknologi, forskning och anställningstrygghet med försvars- och säkerhetskoncernen Saab som ägare. För oss handlar det om hållbarhet - vi vill bli branschens mest hållbara företag; och för att vara ett hållbart företag i en hållbar framtid behöver vi investera i våra medarbetare. För oss är din återhämtning, dina utvecklingsmöjligheter och din trygghet lika viktigt som företagets framgång - utan våra medarbetare står vi stilla. Vill du veta mer om hur det är att arbeta hos oss? Kolla in våra karriärsidor! Kontakt/rekryterande Chef Mattias Adelman mattias.adelman@combitech.com

items.desc: Join our Applied AI Engineering team, which designs and develops solutions across the entire data and AI spectrum, from data processing and AI and machine learning workflows to agentic AI. You will work directly with our clients’ business teams to identify high-value opportunities, frame business problems and translate them into clearly defined solutions that our engineering teams can build. This is a role for someone who moves confidently between business, data and technology and knows how to turn ambiguous needs into focused, actionable problems. EY.AI – in this role, you will work in an environment where AI agents are part of the team and everyday project delivery. You will use solutions tailored to specific business areas to analyse data, generate recommendations and design solutions. This will help you move more quickly from analysis to action and create a competitive advantage for our clients. Your scope of duties Working directly with clients’ business teams to identify, frame and prioritise high-value data and AI opportunities. Gathering and documenting business requirements and mapping the related business processes and data. Defining success measures and the business value case, while ensuring that prototypes remain focused on genuine business needs. Acting as a bridge between business stakeholders and forward-deployed engineers by translating business needs into clear technical requirements. Conducting light, hands-on data analysis, including data profiling and creating simple views or visualisations to assess feasibility and potential value. Shaping and prioritising the prototype backlog in cooperation with the Tech Lead. Supporting build, pivot or stop decisions based on business value and technical feasibility. Preparing clear, de-risked requirements, process maps and data definitions for handover to Solution Engineering teams. Supporting stakeholder communication, solution demonstrations and early adoption. Applying industry knowledge, particularly in financial services, to ensure that solutions are grounded in business and regulatory realities. Our Requirements A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field and approximately four or more years of business analysis experience in technology, data or AI projects, or a master’s degree and approximately three years of relevant experience. Proven experience in requirements elicitation, process mapping and translating business needs into technology delivery. The ability to work confidently with both business stakeholders and technical or data-focused teams. Strong problem-framing skills and the ability to turn vague or ambiguous needs into clearly defined, buildable problems. Data literacy and practical experience analysing and validating data using tools such as SQL, Excel and Power BI. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to engage effectively with both business and technical audiences. The ability to make progress in fast-moving environments, including situations where requirements are incomplete or ambiguous. A working understanding of data, AI and generative AI concepts, including the capabilities and limitations of these technologies. The ability to use AI safely and effectively in everyday work. Critical thinking, curiosity and openness to continuous development and new ways of working. Ideally, you will also have Experience in financial services or another regulated industry, particularly in areas such as AML/KYC or financial processes. Awareness of relevant governance and regulatory requirements, including the EU AI Act and GDPR. Experience working on AI, machine learning, generative AI or data projects. Experience as an Agile Business Analyst or Product Owner. Familiarity with tools such as Power BI, Jira and process-mapping solutions. A relevant business analysis, Agile or product management certification, such as CBAP. Previous consulting experience. What We Offer The opportunity to participate in projects combining business analysis, data, AI and generative AI. Direct collaboration with clients and engineering teams, giving you a meaningful influence on the solutions that are designed and developed. A variety of projects and opportunities to build experience in new business and technology areas. Access to leading AI tools as an integral part of your everyday work, helping you make the most of your potential and focus on the most interesting challenges. Professional and financial support in obtaining recognised qualifications and certificates. EY Badges – global certification of your competencies and the opportunity to earn an MBA from the prestigious Hult International School of Business. items.desc: About Teamwill Consulting Putting domain expertise and artificial intelligence at the heart of the decisions that finance millions of projects, vehicles, and equipment around the world is the core of what we do. For more than 20 years, Teamwill Consulting has been supporting leading players in banking, consumer finance, and mobility through their strategic and technological transformations. Operating in 11 countries and bringing together more than 800 professionals, the Group combines deep industry expertise, close client relationships, and the ability to deliver on a global scale. Artificial intelligence is a cornerstone of our growth strategy. To carry that ambition, we are strengthening our technology, engineering, and data teams. Role Summary Teamwill Consulting’s Data Migration & Quality practice moves clients from legacy data platforms to modern, target architectures without losing trust in the data along the way: mapping, transformation, reconciliation, and lineage. As an AI Data Engineer, you build the pipelines and tooling that make that move safe and auditable, and you apply artificial intelligence (AI) to the parts of a migration that are normally the slowest and most error-prone, including high-level mapping, anomaly detection, and planning. Key Responsibilities Design and build data pipelines that extract, transform, and load data from legacy sources into a target platform, including moving business logic that lives inside a database (for example stored procedures) into versioned, tested application code. Build and maintain the ingestion and monitoring scripts, with clear logging and traceability, so a data issue in production can be traced back to its source. Own and implement schema evolution and versioned database migrations, including moving from a shared database design to one schema, and one database, per service. Define accesses, rules, and controls for data, databases, schemas, and tables, applying the principle of least privilege, and work with Security and Infrastructure teams to enforce them. Design and run data reconciliation and dual-run cutover processes: running the legacy and target systems side by side against the same data, to prove the migration is correct before the legacy system is retired. Build and enforce data-quality controls (validation rules, anomaly detection, completeness and consistency checks) as an automated, repeatable part of every migration. Apply AI, including large language models (LLM), to migration-specific problems: proposing a high-level data mapping between source and target schemas, drafting a migration test plan, and flagging likely anomalies for human review. Build the data pipelines and retrieval layer an AI-assisted mapping tool needs to reason over a legacy schema well: turning table and column definitions, constraints, and business documentation into a form a model can retrieve from accurately, and keeping that data clean, consistent, and current as the migration itself changes it. Package data-processing components as containerized services with a documented application programming interface (API) and contribute them to Teamwill’s shared asset portfolio for reuse across engagements. Work closely with Business Analysts, Architects, Software Engineers, Platform Engineers, and client-side data owners to sequence a migration safely, including on live, regulated systems. What You’ll Work On You will work on data migration and modernization engagements for large-scale, regulated organizations in financial services. A representative engagement: a legacy system where part of business rules are embedded as stored procedures directly in the database, invoked from multiple call sites across dozens of services, which needs to move to a modern architecture without a single point of downtime and without losing an audit trail. You will also apply AI to accelerate the mapping, planning, and testing phases of this kind of work, in a production context where data residency, regulatory approval, and compute capacity shape solutions. The work is international: you will collaborate with teams and clients across Teamwill Consulting’s geographies. What We’re Looking For Master’s degree (or equivalent professional experience) in computer science, data engineering, or a related field. 3+ years of hands-on experience building production data pipelines, including at least one large-scale data migration or platform modernization project. Strong Python and Structured Query Language (SQL) skills; comfort writing tests for data pipelines (for example with PyTest) and treating data-quality checks as code. Practical experience with schema as code and versioning tooling (for example Liquibase or an equivalent) and with relational databases at production scale (for example PostgreSQL). Working knowledge of containerization (Docker) and container orchestration (Kubernetes), and of continuous integration / continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines. Comfort working with AI tools, …
