items.desc: Darktrace is a global leader in AI-driven cybersecurity, helping organizations stay ahead of evolving threats every day. Darktrace was built on a genuinely differentiated idea: that Adaptive AI could detect and respond to novel, real-time cyber threats. That approach matters more than ever in the era of AI. Today, our customers depend on us to stay ahead. At Darktrace, we are energized by that responsibility. We work across teams and rally around a shared goal. We own outcomes end to end - step in, step up and see things through without waiting to be asked. We make decisions with urgency, say the hard thing, and hold each other to high standards with care and directness. We move first and learn fast anticipating where our customers are going next, continuously challenging ourselves. We invest in the skills, learning and opportunities that help people deliver at the level their roles demand, and reward the aptitude and curiosity to grow beyond them. Our Values: Own It | Win as One | Raise Our Bar | Move First. Learn Fast Job D escription : At Darktrace, we're looking for a curious and driven Malware Researcher to join our Malware Team. This is an exciting opportunity for someone with a strong technical foundation and a passion for cyber threat research and data science. You'll investigate emerging threats, uncover insights from complex datasets, and help shape how we detect and respond to evolving attacker techniques. This position follows a hybrid working model, with a minimum of 2 days per week spent in either our Cambridge or London office. What will I be doing? Conducting in-depth analysis of cyber threats, malware, and adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs). Proactively hunting for emerging threats and identifying new attack trends. Producing high-quality threat intelligence reports, blogs, and research publications. Developing data-driven methodologies to support threat hunting and intelligence production. Presenting research findings internally and externally, including at conferences and industry events. Developing and refining threat detections based on research outcomes. Using data visualisation and analytical techniques to support investigations and communicate findings effectively. Collaborating with security researchers, analysts, and product teams to strengthen Darktrace's threat intelligence capabilities. What experience do I need? We're looking for someone who enjoys investigating complex cyber threats, turning data into actionable intelligence, and sharing their findings with others. You'll have a strong technical foundation, excellent analytical skills, and a genuine passion for understanding adversary behaviour and the evolving threat landscape. Key skills and experience include: A background in Cyber Security, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field. Malware analysis and reverse engineering. Understanding of operating systems, networking concepts, system internals, and security fundamentals. Experience with programming or scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or C/C++. Experience analysing structured and unstructured datasets to generate meaningful insights. Familiarity with malware analysis, threat intelligence, digital forensics, or reverse engineering techniques. Strong understanding of modern cyber threats, malware trends, and attacker methodologies. Desirable experience: Applying data science techniques to cybersecurity challenges. Threat intelligence, detection engineering, or security analytics. Knowledge of query languages and security tooling. Research publications, blog writing, conference presentations, or open-source contributions. Benefits: 23 days’ holiday + all public holidays, rising to 25 days after 2 years of service, Additional day off for your birthday, Private medical insurance which covers you, your cohabiting partner and children, Life insurance of 4 times your base salary, Salary sacrifice pension scheme, Enhanced family leave, Confidential Employee Assistance Program, Cycle to work scheme. As a growing business strengthening its governance and controls, this role plays a part in supporting high standards of integrity and accountability. Darktrace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. items.desc:
We are looking for a passionate, talented, and inventive Data Scientist with a strong machine learning and analytics background to help build industry-leading language technology powering Rufus, our AI-driven search and shopping assistant, helping customers with their shopping tasks at every step of their shopping journey.
This innovative role focuses on developing conversation-based, multimodal shopping experiences, utilizing data analysis, statistical modeling, machine learning (ML) technologies, and experimentation to drive product decisions and optimize customer experiences.
Our mission in conversational shopping is to make it easy for customers to find and discover the best products to meet their needs by helping with their product research, providing comparisons and recommendations, answering product questions, enabling shopping directly from images or videos, providing visual inspiration, and more. We do this by leveraging advanced analytics, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Machine Learning (ML), A/B testing, causal inference, and data-driven insights to continuously improve our systems.
Key job responsibilities
As a Data Scientist, you will be responsible for the analysis, modeling, and optimization of AI technologies that will shape the future of shopping experiences. You will play a critical role in measuring and improving multimodal conversational systems, in particular those based on large language models, information retrieval, recommender systems and knowledge graphs, to be tailored to customer needs. You will handle Amazon-scale use cases with significant impact on our customers' experiences. You will collaborate with scientists, engineers, and product partners locally and abroad. Your work will include designing experiments, analyzing results, and launching new features, products and systems.
A day in the life
You will:
- Perform hands-on analysis and modeling of enormous multimodal datasets to develop insights into how to best help customers throughout their shopping journeys. 
- Use statistical methods, machine learning, and data mining techniques to create scalable solutions for measuring and optimizing shopping assistant systems based on a rich set of structured and unstructured contextual signals. 
- Design and analyze A/B tests and experiments to evaluate new features and model improvements, ensuring statistical rigor and actionable insights. 
- Develop metrics, dashboards, and reporting frameworks to monitor system performance, customer engagement, and business impact. 
- Build predictive models and conduct deep-dive analyses to identify opportunities for improving customer experience, conversion, and satisfaction. 
- Collaborate with Applied Scientists and Engineers to translate analytical insights into production systems, working closely on model evaluation and deployment. 
- Establish automated processes for large-scale data analysis, ETL pipelines, metric generation, and experimentation frameworks. 
- Communicate results and insights to both technical and non-technical audiences, including through presentations, written reports, and data visualizations.
About the team
The Rufus Features Science team, based in London, works alongside ~150 engineers, designers and product managers, shaping the future of AI-driven shopping experiences at Amazon. The team works on every aspect of the Rufus AI, from making Rufus agentic, enabling customers to set price alerts or empower Rufus to act on their behalf and automatically purchase products when the price is right, to understanding multimodal user queries and generating answers that combine text, image, audio and video, including deep research reports that scour the web and the Amazon catalog to provide detailed and personalised shopping guidance. We utilize and advance state-of-art techniques in the fields of Natural Language Processing, gen AI, Information Retrieval, Machine/Deep Learning, and Data Mining. We validate our work by actively participating in the internal and external scientific communities.
- Experience with machine learning/statistical modeling data analysis tools and techniques, and parameters that affect their performance
- Experience in a ML or data scientist role with a large technology company
- Experience with data scripting languages (e.g. SQL, Python, R etc.) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, or Matlab)
- Experience effectively communicating complex concepts through written and verbal communication
- Master's degree or above in Math, Statistics, Computer Science, or related science field
- Experience with AWS services including S3, Redshift, Sagemaker, EMR, Kinesis, Lambda, and EC2
- Experience in defining and creating benchmarks for assessing GenAI model performance
- Experience working on multi-team, cross-disciplinary projects

The Solution Engineer - I will be the primary technical counterpart for internal Security teams that require capabilities offered by Security Platform Services. The Solution Engineer will be responsible for empowering Security teams to achieve their goals, while expediting the value realization of our platform offering. The Solution Engineer will do this by: Understanding our users’ needs and how our platform can contribute to their success. Delivering technical solutions to clients' needs using our platform components. Identifying opportunities to extend our platform to meet business critical, high impact use cases. Fostering a community of Security Platform Services users to facilitate long term success. The ideal Solutions Engineer leverages their imagination, relentless stakeholder service, customer lens, and their tenacity to enable our users to achieve their vision. This position is critical to the company’s security success and is a primary catalyst for achieving our users objectives. Key Job Responsibilities and Duties: Hold platform demonstrations/presentations and translate requirements into business outcomes while identifying the associated tasks to achieve defined business outcomes. Build up a thorough understanding of the technical systems of our users in order to identify, validate and develop opportunities to accelerate the adoption of our platform to empower teams to achieve their goals. Consult on and deliver custom technical solutions leveraging existing platform components. Actively engage with stakeholders to support their onboarding and usage of the platform, including diagnosing errors, troubleshooting unexpected behaviors, and optimizing existing usage of platform components. Contribute to the definition of SPS product solutions for our internal users and work together with product management to build a platform roadmap based on their needs. Define the needs of the user, architect a solution together with the user and development team and lead the realisation efforts. Contribute to documentation describing our product offering and usage. Foster a community of platform users in order to facilitate the awareness, usage, and reach of our platform across wide ranging security department capabilities. Role Qualifications and Requirements: BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Technology or related field experience required. 1 to 3 years experience with solution design. Experience within security or security companies is an advantage. 1 to 3 years experience in (internal) customer facing roles with a proven track record of effective collaborations across multiple internal organisations and interactions with partners. 1 to 3 years scripting experience. Python knowledge is an advantage. Experience supporting business cases for technical solutions using qualitative & quantitative data. Strong verbal and written communication skills are a must. Past experience writing and publishing technical documentation is desirable. Excellent organizational skills and ability to meet tight deadlines in an environment with competing priorities A self-starter with a proactive attitude, motivated by the end result. items.desc:
As a data science consultant at QuantumBlack, you will work in multi-disciplinary environments harnessing data to provide real-world impact for organizations globally. You will influence many of the recommendations our clients need to positively change their businesses and enhance performance.
 In this role, you will be responsible for working on complex and extremely varied data sets from some of the world’s largest organizations to solve real-world problems. You will develop high-quality data science products and solutions for clients as well as assets for our internal data teams, focusing on modeling and working alongside the Data Engineering team. Additionally, you will present findings, recommendations, and provide consultation to stakeholders, both internal and clients.
 Throughout your tenure, you will learn to work across various industries and sectors, gaining insights into diverse business challenges and applications of data science. You will build large-scale data and analytics solutions, handling complex problems and advanced client situations. You will also learn best practices in data and analytics development, including framework, responsibility model, high-quality code, data security, sustainability, and scalability. Working in collaborative teams with diverse skill sets, you will foster effective teamwork and learn from colleagues in a multicultural and creative environment. Staying up-to-date with the latest advancements in data science tools, techniques, and technologies, as well as participating in first-class learning programs, will be a key part of your development. You will also develop strong client-facing skills, including effective communication, problem-solving, and presentation abilities.
 You will work with other data scientists, data/ML engineers, designers, project managers, and business subject matter experts on interdisciplinary projects across various industry sectors to enable business ambitions with data and analytics.
 In terms of who you are, you are a highly collaborative individual who is capable of laying aside your own agenda, listening to and learning from colleagues, challenging thoughtfully, and prioritizing impact. You search for ways to improve things and work collaboratively with colleagues. You believe in iterative change, experimenting with new approaches, learning, and improving to move forward quickly.
 Our tech stack is diverse. While we advocate for using the right tools for the right task, we also take into account the client’s current landscape and preferences. Often, we use Python, PySpark, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Databricks, SQL, Docker, and Kubernetes. We also leverage our own proprietary tools such as Kedro, CausalNex, and MLRun. We work on a regular basis with cloud service providers such as AWS, GCP, and Azure.
 Degree in (business) maths, statistics, machine learning, data science, physics, computer science or engineering required
 Up to 2 years of professional hands-on experience in applying advanced data science methods and implementing technical data solutions (e.g. develop machine learning models), in order to solve business problems
 A strong grasp of various analytics landscape, including business intelligence, machine learning, AI, and generative AI, and how to apply them effectively in different scenarios
 Proficiency in Python, SQL (focus on data & analytics applications)
 Professional experience in cloud-based analytical tools from market-leading providers such as AWS, MS Azure, Google Cloud
 Effective communication and presentation skills, particularly the ability to explain complex analytical concepts in a comprehensible manner adapted to different groups of non-technical audiences e.g. business managers, heads of products, sales & marketing leads
 Master degree in data science, computer science, business informatics or equivalent is a plus
 Practical experience in Generative AI application development

 Proficient communication skills in German and English

items.desc: Freelance AI Learning Experience Designer As an AI Learning Experience Designer (ID/LED), you will be responsible for designing and contextualizing cutting-edge, instructor-led AI training programs for both technical and non-technical audiences. You will collaborate with subject matter experts (SMEs), instructional designers, and product managers to create engaging, outcome-driven learning experiences that help learners grasp, apply, and innovate with AI technologies. Terms and Details: ● This is a flexible, contractor position on a per-project basis ● We would expect someone to provide up to 30 hours per week when on a project ● This role will be 100% remote Key Responsibilities: Discovery ● Work with leading LED or as project manager to define key skills, competencies, learning objectives and pathways within the discipline. ● Support sales teams or product teams in identifying client and learner needs and goals and proposing learning solutions. Design & Development ● Follow our client's design and development standards, best practices, and processes for core and customized curriculum, materials, and assets. ● Design and develop AI-focused learning experiences that cater to learners at varying levels of expertise and technical proficiency. ● Create instructor-led training materials (slides, hands-on labs, case studies, assessments) aligned with best practices in AI education. ● Partner with AI subject matter experts (SMEs) to design practical, interactive exercises, such as coding challenges, AI model-building workshops, and ethical AI decision-making scenarios. ● Curate and contextualize existing AI content to align with emerging industry trends, ensuring materials are always relevant and up to date. ● Design structured learning pathways for AI skills development, from foundational AI literacy to advanced deep learning applications. ● Work with vendors, contractors and freelancers in content, assessment, and support material production. Delivery ● Develop instructor enablement materials to support live classroom training delivery (e.g., facilitator guides, learner workbooks, real-world case studies). ● Provide guidance to instructors on best practices for AI education, including effective strategies for live coding demonstrations, interactive discussions, and problem-solving activities. ● Work closely with instructors, learning facilitators, and client teams to tailor learning programs for diverse audiences, including enterprise clients, startups, and government organizations. ● Collect, synthesize and analyze data on learning impact for continuous improvement, refinement, and content updating. ● Where applicable, work with translation vendors in the localization of content. Productization ● Work with product management and learning teams to standardize patterns and components for base curricular products. ● Work with product management and learning teams to build out the library of product components, examples, and documentation. Requirements: ● Has created content for an instructor-led program that focuses on AI concepts. ● Background in a client-facing role, either supporting or managing, is highly desirable ● Experience collaborating with AI subject matter experts to translate complex concepts into structured, engaging learning experiences. ● 6+ years of instructional design or learning experience design with a focus on AI, data science, or emerging technologies. ● Demonstrated experience leading and managing a team, delegating responsibilities, and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality learning solutions. ● Knowledge of instructional design methodologies, including Bloom’s Taxonomy, ADDIE, and experiential learning models. ● Strong knowledge of AI concepts such as machine learning, large language models (LLMs), neural networks, and ethical AI considerations. ● Thrives working in fast-paced, dynamic environments. ● Familiarity with Google Suite, and LMS content management and authoring tools. ● Willingness to flex your schedule to join meetings in different time zones, particularly in the United States and Europe, Middle East, and Asia. Nice to Have: ● Technical proficiency in AI and coding (Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar AI frameworks). Including knowledge of GitHub. ● Familiarity with Virtual Machines (VM) ● Hands-on experience developing AI training labs, coding exercises, or real-world AI case studies. items.desc: Chi siamo Avantune è la piattaforma mid market di riferimento per centinaia di aziende in Europa da oltre trent'anni, e serve clienti nordamericani dal 2011. Sviluppiamo Genialcloud, una piattaforma integrata di Business Applications e Intelligence (ERP, CRM, gestione documentale e workflow, analytics, IoT e AI). Azienda familiare, profittevole, senza debiti. Stiamo investendo per costruire lo stesso tipo di business su scala in Nord America. Genialcloud 11, lanciato a luglio 2026, introduce Trinity AI come agente intelligente unificato sulla piattaforma, una nuova architettura API progettata per lo sviluppo agentico, e un framework di personalizzazione che consente lo sviluppo di soluzioni verticali. Il ruolo Cerchiamo uno sviluppatore o una sviluppatrice per il team della piattaforma Genialcloud, basato nel nostro ufficio di Spoleto. Il ruolo è costruire e orchestrare agenti AI che generano, integrano e mantengono codice nei flussi di prodotto reali, nel linguaggio che il contesto richiede: .NET sul core della piattaforma, Python e JavaScript altrove. Verrai assegnato a componenti specifiche della piattaforma nel tempo, secondo le esigenze del lavoro, e approfondirai qui le tue capacità agentiche, su prodotto reale, senza che ti sia richiesto di possederle già tutte all'ingresso. Non è ricerca teorica: è prodotto che va in produzione. Facciamo sul serio con la programmazione agentica: non scrivere ogni riga di codice a mano, ma istruire, guidare e supervisionare agenti AI che scrivono, testano e integrano codice, mantenendo tu il controllo su architettura, qualità e correttezza. Se hai basi solide e l'istinto da builder, questo è un ruolo in cui cresci. Cosa farai Progettazione e orchestrazione di agenti AI (inclusa integrazione con Trinity AI) per costruire, estendere e mantenere funzionalità della piattaforma Genialcloud. Lavoro nel linguaggio che il contesto richiede: .NET (C#, ASP.NET Core) sul core della piattaforma, Python e FastAPI per servizi e agenti, JavaScript e React per interfacce e integrazioni, con gran parte della copertura tra linguaggi ottenuta guidando gli agenti AI. Validazione, revisione e correzione del codice generato dagli agenti: la capacità di leggere e ragionare sul codice conta più della velocità di scriverlo a mano. Ownership nel tempo di componenti specifiche della piattaforma, approfondendo dove serve al prodotto. Partecipazione occasionale a conversazioni con prospect o clienti insieme al team commerciale, dove la profondità tecnica aggiunge valore. Chi cerchiamo Basi solide di programmazione e comprensione di .NET (C#, ASP.NET Core): sai leggere, ragionare e intervenire su codice di produzione, anche se non sei ancora un senior. Conoscenza e forte attitudine per la programmazione agentica: uso di AI, LLM e pattern di orchestrazione agenti come strumento di lavoro quotidiano. Esperienza agentica pregressa è un plus, ma ciò che conta è l'attitudine e la voglia di lavorare così: la profondità la sviluppiamo insieme. Buona conoscenza di JavaScript. Oltre a questo, curiosità e comodità nel muoverti tra più linguaggi e framework (Python, FastAPI, React) secondo quanto serve al problema, cosa che il modo di lavorare agentico rende molto più accessibile di un tempo. Inglese buono: lavoriamo in un contesto internazionale tra Italia, Canada e Stati Uniti e il ruolo prevede occasionalmente incontri con prospect e clienti. Mentalità da builder e attitudine di chi rende al meglio in un team piccolo e ad alta competenza, dove hai ownership reale e cresci verso di più. Disponibilità a lavorare in sede presso il nostro ufficio di Spoleto, con un giorno alla settimana di lavoro da casa. Politica di non negoziazione del compenso. La struttura di compenso indicata in questa pagina riflette quanto riconosciamo per questo ruolo, calibrata in modo equo su tutto il team. Non negoziamo RAL, variabile o OTE per questa posizione. Se la struttura ti convince, saremo felici di sentirti. In caso contrario capiamo, ma ti chiediamo di non candidarti aspettandoti un importo diverso.Compenso e benefit RAL indicativamente calibrata sulla tua esperienza e sulla capacità di guidare gli strumenti AI verso soluzioni solide, con eventuale quota variabile legata a obiettivi e tempi di sviluppo raggiunti. Lavoro in presenza presso il nostro ufficio di Spoleto, con un giorno alla settimana di lavoro da casa. Per la giornata in remoto è necessario disporre di una buona connessione internet e di un computer adeguato. Non è previsto supporto per il trasferimento. Buoni pasto e buoni Amazon; copertura sanitaria integrativa eventuale. Coinvolgimento diretto con un team piccolo e senior che costruisce prodotto in un'azienda mid market seria e profittevole: ownership reale, senza livelli intermedi. Un ambiente dove la tua opinione conta dal primo giorno. Le ore di lavoro sono dedicate esclusivamente ad Avantune. L'entreprise Wavestone recherche actuellement des profils : Dans un monde où savoir se transformer est la clé du succès, l'ambition de Wavestone est d'apporter à ses clients des réponses uniques sur le marché, en les éclairant et les guidant dans leurs décisions les plus stratégiques. Wavestone est un nouveau cabinet de conseil, issu du rapprochement début 2016 de Solucom et des activités européennes de Kurt Salmon (à l'exclusion de consumer goods & retail en dehors de France). Notre cabinet rassemble 2800 collaborateurs présents sur 4 continents, figure parmi les leaders indépendants du conseil en Europe, et constitue le 1er cabinet de conseil indépendant en France. Pour satisfaire nos clients, nous développons 18 terrains d’excellence, à la fois sectoriels, fonctionnels, et technologiques. Sur chacun d’eux, nous nous engageons à apporter à nos clients une profondeur d’expertise de premier plan. Mais surtout, et c’est là le cœur de notre proposition de valeur, nous combinons ces 18 terrains d’excellence sans couture et sans silos. Enfin, pour enrichir notre offre, nous investissons dans 5 assets à forte valeur ajoutée : le Research Knowledge Center, parce que pour prendre de bonnes décisions il faut de bonnes informations, le Creadesk, qui permet de stimuler la créativité et l’innovation, la Faktory, pour prototyper des idées en mode « test and learn », le Machine Learning et Data Lab, pour exploiter les gisements de valeur qui se cachent dans les données de nos clients et Shake Up', pour accompagner des start-ups dans leur croissance et leur développement. Nous recrutons des talents aux parcours diversifiés, de tous niveaux d'expérience. Des personnalités engagées, reconnues pour leur goût d'entreprendre et leur esprit d'équipe. Venez vivre une expérience unique au sein de Wavestone ! \n\n Description de l'entreprise Rejoignez un cabinet de conseil international qui accompagne les grandes transformations stratégiques. Nous sommes Wavestone : des expert·es passionné·es et orienté·es solutions, qui placent l’humain au cœur de la performance et de la croissance. Ambitieux·ses et en pleine expansion, nous développons sans cesse notre portefeuille de clients et de projets, avec une portée internationale et une réelle volonté de générer un impact positif. Êtes-vous un vrai team player, porté par des valeurs fortes ? Êtes-vous curieux·se et déterminé·e, avec l’envie d’apprendre chaque jour ? Êtes-vous du genre à relever les défis sans hésiter ? Alors vous êtes au bon endroit. Rejoignez Wavestone et exprimez votre potentiel dans un environnement stimulant et collaboratif, où l’on transforme les défis d’aujourd’hui en opportunités de demain. Description du poste La business unit CTO Advisory est composée d’un collectif multi-compétences, de plus de 600 consultant·es, qui combinent compréhension des enjeux business des clients et expertise technologique de premier plan. L’objectif de ces équipes est de contribuer à positionner Wavestone comme le partenaire conseil de confiance des Chiefs Technology Officer (CTO) dans leurs transformations technologiques et organisationnelles les plus ambitieuses. Les champs de recherche portent sur la recherche fondamentale en physique nucléaire et l’astrophysique nucléaire, les matériaux sous irradiation et la nanostructuration, les collisions moléculaires et le milieu interstellaire, la radiobiologie et les techniques innovantes pour la dosimétrie et la thérapie de certains cancers. Le GANIL (environ 350 personnes) se situe sur le futur site EPOPEA, parc de sciences et d’innovation de la communauté urbaine de Caen la Mer, à Caen en Normandie. Il est géré conjointement, au sein d’un Groupe d'Intérêt Économique (GIE), par le Commissariat à l'énergie atomique (CEA/DRF) et par le Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique (CNRS/IN2P3). En tant qu’infrastructure de recherche, le GANIL est au service d’une communauté scientifique nationale, européenne et internationale d’un millier d’utilisateurs. La personne recrutée sera affectée au GANIL, au sein du groupe DOSADO de la division DPHY. Ce groupe est intégré à la Division de la Physique également constituée des groupes DELPH (Détection et lasers pour la physique) et GTA (Groupe des Techniques d’Acquisition). Les agents de cette division ont pour mission l’accueil des expériences effectuées au GANIL portées par une communauté scientifique internationale. Ils mènent également un programme de R&D sur les techniques de détection, sur les techniques laser, sur les techniques d’acquisition des données produites dans les expériences et enfin sur la fabrication de cibles et couches minces. La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec l’équipe INTHERES à Toulouse dans le cadre du projet OPTADOM. Elle passera donc la majorité de son CDD dans l’équipe INTHERES, où l’analyse des acquisitions d’imagerie a déjà débuté. Elle viendra également régulièrement au GANIL sur des périodes de 2 à 3 semaines pour les expériences ainsi que l’intégration des biodistributions au processus dosimétrique. Avantages collaborateurs: 53 jours de congés par an (32 CA et 21 JRTT) - Participation complémentaire santé – Participation frais de restauration - Participation aux frais de transport collectif ou forfait mobilité - Comité Action Sociale Contraintes et risques Le GANIL étant classé comme installation nucléaire de base (INB), le poste est soumis à des contraintes de travail particulières liées à l'exposition potentielle aux rayonnements ionisants. La personne doit être autorisée par le service médical du GANIL à travailler dans une zone surveillée et contrôlée, conformément aux réglementations et procédures applicables en matière de sûreté et de sécurité nucléaires. Wavestone est un nouveau cabinet de conseil, issu du rapprochement début 2016 de Solucom et des activités européennes de Kurt Salmon (à l'exclusion de consumer goods & retail en dehors de France). Notre cabinet rassemble 2800 collaborateurs présents sur 4 continents, figure parmi les leaders indépendants du conseil en Europe, et constitue le 1er cabinet de conseil indépendant en France. Pour satisfaire nos clients, nous développons 18 terrains d’excellence, à la fois sectoriels, fonctionnels, et technologiques. items.desc: About AirDNA We built AirDNA to solve a problem: how do you make smart short-term rental decisions when there’s too much guesswork and not enough good data? What started in a garage in California in 2015 is now a global team helping thousands of people — from aspiring hosts to major real estate firms — make confident choices about where to invest, what to charge, and how to grow. Our mission is simple: give people the tools they need to build freedom through short-term rentals. Whether that means buying their first Airbnb or scaling a portfolio, we’re here to help unlock financial independence and growth. We track 10M+ listings in 120,000 markets, and our platform is trusted by users in over 100 countries. It’s big data, made useful. In 2024, AirDNA acquired Uplisting, a powerful property management software that helps hosts and operators manage listings across Airbnb, Vrbo, and other platforms. With features like channel management, automated messaging, dynamic pricing, task coordination, and financial reporting, Uplisting expands our mission to support every stage of the short-term rental journey — from investment to operations. The AirDNA team We’re a curious, driven, and kind group of humans who genuinely love what we do. Our values — Happy, Hungry, Honest — guide how we show up for our customers and for each other. Want to see what that looks like in action? You’ll get a feel once you meet us. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you don’t check every box . Passion, potential, and perspective matter here. Your role As a Data Quality Analyst, you will work with product, other data scientists and engineering to help bring innovative solutions to market. At AirDNA, models are at the heart of all of our products. The data quality analyst is responsible for helping set strategies to continuously improve our data accuracy to help our customers stay ahead in a fast-changing industry. We help people make smarter data-driven decisions based on our short-term rental data and we will continuously strive to expand and improve that data while looking to maximize the value it provides. We develop solutions to facilitate customers gaining access and value from our data. Here's what you'll get to do: Conduct exploratory data analysis on short-term rental pricing and occupancy datasets to identify patterns, trends, and outliers. Collaborate with domain experts to gain a deep understanding of factors influencing pricing and occupancy dynamics in the short-term rental market. Analyze predictive models to predict short-term rental markets behavior. Collaborate with data engineering teams to integrate new data sources and ensure data quality for modeling purposes. Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers, engineers, and business analysts, to implement pricing strategies based on data-driven insights. Clearly communicate findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Implement monitoring systems to track model performance over time and proactively identify issues or deviations. Regularly analyze models to adapt to changes in market conditions and business requirements. Here's what you'll need to be successful: 1+ years of professional experience working with data , with a focus on software development and advanced analytics. Full proficiency in English both verbal and written. Proficiency working with SQL and Python (pandas, datetime, numpy, dictionaries, packages). Experience working with large data sets in distributed systems such as Snowflake. Excellent communication skills, data driven, critical thinker and attention to detail. Flexibility, time management and a learning mindset . Data driven , critical thinker and hungry to learn. Comfortable working with data validation , models, and architecture. Bonus points: Exposure to designing, developing, and deploying successful software solutions powered by data science and analytics. Experience in programming languages such as Python, with proficiency in data manipulation and analysis libraries (e.g., Pandas, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch or TensorFlow) Here's what you can expect from us: Base salary of 30,000 - 33,000 EUR annually Indefinite contract Eligible for discretionary annual company bonus program 36 holidays per year Continuing education stipend 150 EUR to spend with Cobee card available monthly for public transport, daycare, pension plan, restaurants and health insurance Health insurance with Sanitas (Vision + Dental included) Language lessons with Preply (French-German-Italian-Spanish) Individual growth plan to progress in the role Standard working hours from 11 am to 7 pm A fun and sunny office with big terraces Talented international team and a vibrant work environment Bottom-up management: we listen to your ideas and implement them Team building events Dog friendly office! items.desc: Job description We are seeking a researcher to join the Lundeberg research group at the Department of Gene Technology, KTH. The position focuses on developing bioinformatic methods for the analysis of spatial molecular data and three-dimensional (3D) tissue reconstruction, with particular emphasis on image analysis, machine learning and computational pathology. You will independently develop, implement and evaluate methods for integrating tissue images with spatial molecular data. The work includes analysis of large-scale imaging and omics datasets and biological interpretation of the results. The work will be carried out in close collaboration with experimental and clinical researchers. The research group is international, and English is normally used for scientific communication. Qualifications Requirements A doctoral degree, or an equivalent foreign degree, in bioinformatics, computational biology, computer science, biotechnology or another relevant field, as well as documented research expertise relevant to the position. Documented experience in the analysis of tissue images and spatial molecular data, as well as experience with GPU-based analysis. Ability to independently develop, implement and evaluate analytical methods and analyse large-scale biological data. Ability to independently conduct research and method development, communicate research, and contribute to the utilisation of research results. As a person, you are proactive, self-driven and structured, with good collaborative skills. You should also have an awareness of diversity and equal opportunity issues, with particular focus on gender equality. Preferred qualifications Education or documented experience in machine learning, image analysis, spatial omics, computational pathology or related quantitative methods is advantageous. Experience in one or more of the following areas is considered advantageous: 3D reconstruction, image registration, machine learning or deep learning, multimodal data integration, foundation models in pathology, Python programming, and working in HPC environments. Teaching experience and experience in leading research activities or teams are considered advantageous. Great emphasis will be placed on personal skills. items.desc: Job description The Department of Applied Physics is seeking a researcher in theoretical and computational magnetism and spintronics. The position is placed in an internationally prominent research group at the AlbaNova University Center, studying magnetic materials and spin phenomena using advanced computational methods. You will conduct research on magnetic and spintronic phenomena in quantum materials and low-dimensional systems, for example spin and magnon transport, fundamental magnetic interactions, and topological spin textures in two-dimensional magnets, antiferromagnets and altermagnets. The work includes the development and application of first-principles calculations, atomistic spin dynamics and micromagnetic simulations, as well as the development of automated and AI-assisted computational workflows for large-scale materials studies. The duties also include supervising doctoral students and postdocs, collaborating with experimental and theoretical research groups in Sweden and internationally, actively seeking external research funding, and contributing to the scientific environment of the group and the department. Some teaching and pedagogical qualification may be included in the duties. Qualifications Requirements A doctoral degree or an equivalent foreign degree Documented research expertise in theoretical or computational condensed matter physics with a focus on magnetism and spintronics, demonstrated through publications in leading international scientific journals. Extensive experience of electronic structure calculations (first principles/DFT) and of simulating magnetic materials and their properties. Excellent command of English, spoken and written, as the work is carried out in an international research environment. As a person, you are independent and driven, and you have excellent collaborative abilities. Preferred qualifications Documented experience of research on fundamental magnetic interactions, for example the Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya interaction, magnetic anisotropy and exchange interactions, and their role in topological magnetism. Experience of studies of spin and magnon transport in two-dimensional magnets, van der Waals materials, antiferromagnets or altermagnets. Experience of atomistic spin dynamics and micromagnetic simulations. Experience of machine learning/AI and of developing automated workflows for large-scale calculations on high-performance computing resources. A documented ability to attract external research funding in competition, as well as scientific prizes and awards. Teaching ability and experience of supervising doctoral students or postdocs. The ability to work towards research results being utilised in practice and to inform about research and development work. Experience of developing and leading activities and staff. items.desc: DESCRIPTION AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset. items.desc: Join Artefact Belgium: Shape the Future of Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) Are you an early-career professional excited to harness the power of generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)? Artefact Belgium is seeking a Data Scientist - Gen AI to join our innovative team in Brussels. Our Belgian team specializes in LLM and GenAI projects, and this is your chance to work on cutting-edge solutions, collaborate with top-tier experts, and contribute to impactful projects in a dynamic, forward-thinking environment. Who You Are A recent graduate or professional with 1 to 3 years of experience, with hands-on experience working with LLMs and a passion for generative AI and NLP. Motivated to apply your technical expertise to real-world challenges in AI. Able to thrive in collaborative settings while independently driving your own workstreams. Eager to learn, grow, and push the boundaries of what's possible in AI innovation. Who We Are Artefact is a leading Data & AI consulting firm operating at the forefront of AI innovation. With a global presence, we help clients across industries—public health, manufacturing, etc. —leverage generative AI to achieve transformative outcomes. Our team in Belgium is specialized in LLM and GenAI projects, working on the most advanced applications of these technologies. At Artefact, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning, with a strong commitment to inclusivity and employee growth. What You Will Do Collaborate with the team to design, train, and fine-tune state-of-the-art models for client projects and internal tools. Develop and integrate agentic AI solutions using tool calling, and emerging protocols like Model Context Protocol (MCP) to create autonomous, context-aware applications. Research and implement innovative generative AI applications to solve complex business problems. Design and implement comprehensive evaluation frameworks to measure LLM performance, establishing quality metrics and benchmarks that guide development decisions and ensure reliable, production-ready solutions. Optimize the performance, scalability, and usability of LLM-powered products and tools. Contribute to the deployment and maintenance of AI systems, including models, APIs, and supporting infrastructure. Participate in technical discussions and brainstorming sessions to shape impactful solutions. What You Bring A degree in computer science, mathematics, engineering, physics, or a related field. Experience working with LLMs, generative AI, or advanced NLP applications (e.g., fine-tuning models, using frameworks like Hugging Face or OpenAI). Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with AI and NLP libraries. Analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with an ability to address real-world challenges through AI. Good communication skills in English, Dutch or French; additional languages are a plus. A growth mindset, adaptability, and eagerness to work in a fast-paced, cutting-edge environment. What We Offer A competitive salary with benefits tailored for early-career professionals. Hands-on experience with state-of-the-art LLM technologies in impactful projects. A dynamic and supportive work environment that fosters creativity and professional development. Resources for ongoing training, certification, and skill-building in generative AI and related fields. A collaborative, inclusive workplace with access to global expertise through Artefact's network. This position is based in Brussels. Don't worry if you don't meet every criterion! We value passion, potential, and a commitment to innovation. If you're excited about generative AI and ready to grow your career, we'd love to hear from you!

items.desc: AI Engineer 🏢 About Juryo At Juryo we are building the AI voice operating system for B2C law firms. Our agents qualify, sell, onboard, support clients and handle collections. They already work with more than 30 law firms in Spain and the UK, and in 7 months we have gone from 0 to €1M ARR. 💼 The role Our agents talk to thousands of people every week: someone who just had an accident, someone drowning in debt, someone trying to get their papers in order. Every conversation either moves a case forward or loses it. We are looking for AI Engineers to make our agents the best in the market at that. What is an AI Engineer at Juryo? You own how our agents think, talk and decide. Not demos, real production calls with real clients, where latency, tone and a single wrong tool call make the difference between a signed client and a hang up. We build AI native: you’ll direct coding agents to ship faster and spend your time where your judgement matters. If you’ve shipped LLM products that real users depend on, or you’re obsessed with getting there, this is for you. What you’ll do Design and improve our agent architecture: prompting, tool calling, memory, multi agent flows across voice and WhatsApp. Build the evals and testing that tell us if an agent is getting better or worse, before a client notices. Push latency down and naturalness up in voice: turn taking, interruptions, voices, speech recognition in Spanish and English. Turn what our Forward Deployed Engineers learn on the ground into reusable agent components, so every new firm starts from something better. Stay on top of models and providers, test what’s new and decide what goes into production. What we’re looking for You’ve built and shipped LLM based products in production, not just prototypes. You know how models fail: hallucinations, prompt injection, broken tool calls. And you know how to measure and fix it. You’re comfortable writing code: TypeScript or Python, APIs, webhooks. You’re AI native. You use coding agents daily and know when not to trust them. You’re hungry to work. We’re a team that wants to make its mark, and we put in the hours. You speak English fluently. Spanish is a big plus, since most of our agents speak it. You live in Barcelona or are willing to move here. We work from the office, 100% on site. Nice to have: multimodel AI experience What we work with TypeScript, Python, ElevenLabs, Retell, OpenAI, Anthropic, PostgreSQL, webhooks, Vercel. If you know some of them, great. If not, they can be learned: we care more about how fast you learn than about what your CV says. What we offer Joining a rocket ship as part of the founding team, with still a lot left to build A small, demanding team with a great vibe, where you’ll learn in one year what would take you five anywhere else. Freedom to do things your way, without layers of approval. Practically unlimited tokens to build with the best tools out there. Market salary + equity.

items.desc: Dans le cadre du développement de notre agence, nous recherchons un Ingénieur en IA Générative (H/F) Intégré(e) au sein des équipes clients, tes futures missions sont : Explorer les technologies d'IA Générative (LLM, réseaux neuronaux, etc.) et évaluer leur potentiel applicatif en environnement d'ingénierie Concevoir et déployer des projets pilotes autour de cas d'usage métiers en lien avec l'ingénierie (génération de code, modélisation, optimisation de processus) Développer des prototypes et des preuves de concept autour de modèles d'IA générative (GPT, diffusion, transformers) Participer à la mise en production (RUN) et à la montée en charge (scalabilité) des solutions d'IA retenues Apporter conseil, assistance et expertise auprès des utilisateurs métiers sur les usages et limites de l'IA Générative Contribuer à la stratégie IA et participer à l'évolution des référentiels et trajectoires technologiques (BUILD) Tes atouts pour le poste sont : Une maîtrise des technologies d'IA et des architectures GenAI : grands modèles de langage (LLM), réseaux de neurones, transformers ; Une solide expérience dans le développement logiciel (Python, APIs, frameworks IA/ML) et les environnements Cloud ; Une sensibilité aux bonnes pratiques MLOps (CI/CD, monitoring de modèles, mise à l'échelle de pipelines IA). De formation BAC+5 (école d'ingénieur ou université), tu disposes d'une première expérience significative dans le domaine de l'intelligence artificielle appliquée, avec une appétence pour l'innovation et les projets à fort impact technologique. items.desc: Bouw jij mee aan slimme AI-oplossingen die collega’s écht verder helpen? In deze rol vertaal je vernieuwende ideeën naar praktische toepassingen die dagelijks het verschil maken. Je krijgt de ruimte om te experimenteren, te bouwen en AI binnen Harvest House verder vorm te geven. Voor onze IT-afdeling zijn wij op zoek naar een: AI Engineer (38 uur) Wat ga je doen? Bij Harvest House verbinden we data, applicaties en AI om het werk slimmer en eenvoudiger te maken. Als AI Engineer vertaal je ideeën en vraagstukken uit de organisatie naar praktische AI-oplossingen die veilig, schaalbaar en beheersbaar zijn. Je werkt daarbij met onder andere Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft 365 en onze Enterprise Landing Zones. Je bent betrokken bij het hele traject: van het onderzoeken van een vraag en het bouwen van een prototype tot de implementatie, optimalisatie en het beheer. Denk aan slimme agents, zoekoplossingen, documentverwerking, procesautomatisering en koppelingen met bestaande applicaties en databronnen. Je kijkt verder dan een experiment en zorgt dat toepassingen betrouwbaar in de dagelijkse praktijk kunnen worden gebruikt. Je werkt samen met architecten, developers, data engineers, securityspecialisten, functioneel beheerders en collega’s uit de business. Je denkt mee over technische standaarden, architectuur en keuzes voor de lange termijn en bent een inhoudelijke sparringpartner voor IT en de organisatie. Zo help je Harvest House om AI professioneel en verantwoord in te zetten. Je rapporteert aan de IT Manager en werkt projectmatig aan verschillende AI-vraagstukken. Welke taken krijg je? Je ontwikkelt AI-apps en agents met onder andere Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service en Microsoft Copilot Studio. Je koppelt AI-toepassingen aan Microsoft 365, Teams, Power Platform en onze bedrijfsapplicaties. Je brengt prototypes naar productie en zorgt dat oplossingen schaalbaar, testbaar en onderhoudbaar zijn. Je test kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid en bewaakt privacy, autorisaties, informatiebeveiliging, prestaties en kosten. Je denkt met collega’s mee over waar AI waarde toevoegt en durft ook te adviseren om iets niet te bouwen. Wie ben jij? HBO/ WO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur binnen de IT Minimaal 1 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare rol Je bent nieuwsgierig, nuchter en kijkt verder dan de nieuwste hype. Je krijgt energie van oplossingen die niet alleen technisch werken, maar ook echt worden gebruikt. Je werkt zelfstandig, zoekt actief de samenwerking op en maakt technische keuzes begrijpelijk voor anderen. Je hebt ervaring met het ontwikkelen en implementeren van oplossingen binnen Microsoft Azure. Je hebt kennis van generatieve AI, taalmodellen, prompting en semantisch zoeken. Je hebt ervaring met Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Microsoft Copilot Studio of vergelijkbare onderdelen binnen het Microsoft ecosysteem. Je werkt met Microsoft technologieën zoals: MS Foundry, MS CoPilot Studio, M365 CoPilot, MS Powerplatform. Je hoeft niet al met alle Microsoft technologieën gewerkt te hebben. We vinden het belangrijker dat je een goede technische basis hebt en nieuwe onderdelen snel eigen kunt maken. Je kunt veilige koppelingen maken met API’s, applicaties en databronnen. Je begrijpt hoe identiteit, rollen en autorisaties met Microsoft Entra ID worden toegepast. Je weet hoe je oplossingen test, implementeert, monitort en beheersbaar houdt. Je begrijpt dat een goede AI toepassing meer vraagt dan alleen een werkende prompt. Je kunt technische mogelijkheden vertalen naar begrijpelijke keuzes voor collega’s en management. Wat krijg je? Een jaarcontract voor een fulltime dienstverband, met uitzicht op een vast contract. Een passend salaris en goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden. 26 vakantiedagen en een aantrekkelijke bonusregeling. Een eigen mobiele telefoon en laptop. Ruimte voor opleidingen, certificeringen en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Veel vrijheid om de inzet van AI en je eigen rol verder vorm te geven. items.desc: AI and Automation Developer Rochdale | £65,000 - £75,000 + 25% Bonus + Benefits | Hybrid - 3 Days Office-Based An exciting opportunity for an AI and Automation Developer to join a large, established organisation with a £180m turnover and 7,500 employees, as the first dedicated employee in a new AI team. This is a fantastic opportunity to help shape the organisation's approach to AI and automation, building the foundations, infrastructure and applications needed to transform business processes. The company is fully embracing AI, and this role offers the chance to make a real impact from day one, taking ownership of solutions from initial concept through to deployment. The Role Working closely with the Director of Data and Business Optimisation, you will design, build and deploy AI-powered applications, agents and integrations to improve efficiency across finance, billing, field operations and customer service. Key responsibilities will include: Establishing the infrastructure, development processes and deployment frameworks required to deliver AI applications securely and effectively. Developing AI-powered applications, agents, APIs and integrations using modern programming languages and large language models. Integrating AI solutions with Microsoft 365, finance, CRM, workforce management and other business systems. Building data pipelines and reporting services to provide reliable, consistent business information. Implementing effective AI governance, security, testing and monitoring to ensure solutions are reliable, compliant and fit for purpose. Working with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities for automation, challenge existing processes and turn business problems into practical technical solutions. Taking ownership of the full software development lifecycle, from design and development through to deployment, maintenance and ongoing improvement. Measuring the business benefits of AI solutions, including time saved, reduced errors and cost efficiencies. Supporting the development of the wider team as it grows, sharing best practice and advising on emerging AI technologies. About You You will be an experienced Software Engineer with hands-on experience developing and deploying production applications, alongside practical experience integrating AI and large language models into business solutions. You will ideally have: Strong commercial software development experience using TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, C# or a similar modern language. Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications, including prompt engineering, tool/function calling and evaluating AI outputs. A solid understanding of web applications, REST APIs, relational databases and cloud or serverless deployment. Experience with Git, automated testing and CI/CD pipelines. A good understanding of software security, data protection and the responsible use of AI. The ability to understand business processes, identify opportunities for improvement and explain technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders. A proactive, hands-on approach, with the confidence to take ownership and build solutions from the ground up. The Opportunity This is much more than a traditional software development role. As the first employee in a new team, you will have the opportunity to help establish the technical foundations, shape how AI is adopted across the organisation and deliver solutions that make a tangible difference to the way the business operates. Package: £65,000 - £75,000 + 25% bonus, private medical insurance and pension. Location: Rochdale, with three days per week in the office. If you are passionate about AI, software engineering and automation, and want the opportunity to build something from the ground up within a substantial, forward-thinking business, this could be an excellent next step. Coburg Banks Limited is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy. LNKD1_UKTJ

items.title: Software Engineer / AI Engineer
items.card: About The Role You'll work on Aleido's modular platform for product information, used by some of the world's leading industrial companies to create, manage and deliver technical content. You'll own work from specification to deployment, contribute to technical decisions and help shape how we engineer as a team. You'll join us in one of two directions: As a Software Engineer, you'll focus on building high-quality
items.desc: We're growing our engineering team and looking for both Software Engineers and AI Engineers to help build the next generation of Aleido's platform. Whether your strength is solid, scalable software or applying AI to real products, you'll join a team where AI isn't a side project. It's built into what we deliver and how we build it. About The Role You'll work on Aleido's modular platform for product information, used by some of the world's leading industrial companies to create, manage and deliver technical content. You'll own work from specification to deployment, contribute to technical decisions and help shape how we engineer as a team. You'll join us in one of two directions: As a Software Engineer, you'll focus on building high-quality features across the platform: APIs, cloud services and modular architecture on Azure and .NET. As an AI Engineer, you'll focus on bringing AI into the platform and our products: LLM-powered features, agent integrations, automation and tooling that turns AI capabilities into measurable customer value. Both directions share the same foundation and work closely together. What You'll Do Own development tasks from specification to deployment. Write high-quality, scalable and maintainable code, using AI-assisted development to work faster without compromising quality. Contribute to design and architecture discussions and propose technical solutions. Perform thorough code reviews and contrubute to overall code validation and quality practices. Collaborate closely with Product Owners and UX to refine requirements. Support platform operations, monitoring and troubleshooting. Improve workflows, documentation and engineering standards, including how we work with AI. Stay curious about new technologies and help keep our solutions ahead of the curve. Who You Are We believe that you have: A strong understanding of software engineering, cloud services and distributed systems. Good experience with Azure, .NET or an equivalent modern tech stack. An understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and observability. A clear grasp of API design, modular architecture and platform patterns. Hands-on experience using AI tools in your development work, and genuine interest in where this technology is heading. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, and a sense of ownership for what you deliver. Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Fluency in English, written and spoken. For the AI Engineer direction, we also expect experience building with LLMs, AI services or frameworks (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI or Azure AI services), and with integrating AI capabilities into .NET applications. Nice to have Experience with Azure cloud platform. Familiarity of AI/ML-enabled systems, including information flow, uncertainty and error propagation, common failure modes, and approaches to troubleshooting and debugging. Experience with agentic workflows, MCP or other AI integration patterns. Understanding of business process mapping and optimization techniques. Familiarity with content management, technical documentation or aftermarket information. Who We Are Aleido is a Swedish international company with a long heritage of driving the development of product information and learning solutions. Our customers develop complex products or systems, or seek knowledge and confidence to create lasting change, within a wide range of industries including automotive, telecom, advanced machinery, rail and medtech. We are almost a thousand colleagues in five countries. Together we bridge the gap between technology and the people who depend on it – by making the advanced simply understood. You'll be part of a tight-knit and innovative team where your work truly makes a difference. We believe in empowering people, embracing creativity and constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible with software and AI.

items.desc: Desarrolla tu carrera profesional con nosotros Somos un banco universal, cercano y abierto, que impulsa la rentabilidad de forma sostenida y construye capacidades que garanticen nuestro futuro con foco en la innovación, la transformación digital y el desarrollo sostenible. Con una sólida trayectoria en España y cerca de 8.000 profesionales, somos el sexto mayor banco del país por capitalización bursátil. Forma parte de nuestro proyecto Como parte de esta estrategia, hemos lanzado nuestro Hub de Inteligencia Artificial Generativa (IAG), un proyecto pionero en el sector bancario español. Apostamos por la especialización, el talento y la colaboración con los principales partners tecnológicos. Tu rol dentro de Unicaja Queremos sumar a nuestro Hub de IAG un/a Ingeniero/a de Datos IAG apasionado/a por la innovación y la transformación digital. Serás parte de un entorno multidisciplinar, innovador y con impacto real en el sector a través de la tecnología. Tendrás la misión de garantizar la viabilidad técnica y funcional de la estrategia de datos y test de validación de cada nuevo sistema IAG desde su análisis e incubación (en el Hub IAG) hasta la productivización y mantenimiento (en el Hub Desarrollo y Escalado), garantizando la fiabilidad y seguridad alineados con los marcos de trabajo establecidos. En aquello en lo que pondrás foco: Responsable de garantizar, que tanto en los MVPs (Hub IAG) como en los escalados de los sistemas IAG (Hub Desarrollo y Escalado), la identificación y disponibilidad de los datos necesarios, y con la calidad suficiente, para garantizar el correcto funcionamiento de la solución. Liderar la definición de la estructura de almacenamiento de los datos que genera la aplicación IAG para que sean explotables garantizando la gobernanza y calidad acorde a las políticas del banco. Liderar la definición de los KPIs a medir y monitorizar para cada aplicación IAG, (principalmente las métricas para evaluar las respuestas del modelo IAG). Liderar el diseño de los tests para validar la aplicación IAG que se realizarán de forma recurrente mientras la aplicación esté en producción y qué métricas se utilizarán para su evaluación. Tanto Test funcionales (validar integridad funcional) como Test Adversarios (validar integridad ética, responsable, segura y fiable del uso de la IAG). Supervisar el análisis y evaluación del resultado de los test y decidir qué acciones realizar para mejorar la aplicación IAG. Supervisar el análisis y evaluación las respuestas que genera la aplicación IAG durante su actividad en producción y decidir qué acciones realizar para mejorar la aplicación IAG. Liderar el diseño y definición sobre cómo estructurar la información a usar en la aplicación IAG para minimizar el uso de documentos desestructurados, con el objetivo de optimizar su desempeño (pudiendo requerir la definición de ontologías para reflejar las relaciones entre la información). Colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios para garantizar la integración adecuada de las soluciones en el entorno técnico. Soporte en el diseño de planes de escalado de las soluciones IAG. Supervisar y validar los diseños técnicos realizados por los proveedores y asegurar su alineación con los estándares y frameworks establecidos para el correcto uso y gobierno de los datos en la entidad. Lo que buscamos: Experiencia : 5-10 años de experiencia en la gestión de proyectos de Machine Learning. 3-5 años en programación ETLs en el ámbito de Big Data, Será valorable experiencia en proyectos IA Generativa desarrollando prompting de al menos 1 año. Formación académica en Ingeniería Informática, Ingeniería de Software, Ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones o áreas afines. Además, es necesario que seas: Proactivo, resolutivo y con orientación a resultados. Tengas experiencia en el desarrollo de MVPs y proyectos de IAG, priorización estratégica de actividades. Tengas conocimientos avanzados en estrategias de escalabilidad y continuidad operativa, gestión de proyectos en Agile y Waterfall. Tu Stack tecnológico imprescindible es el siguiente: Programación ETL. Gestión de entornos y sistemas Big Data. ChatGPT, Gemini. Microsoft Copilot. Evaluación IAG (Ej: DeepEval, MLflow, Opik, etc) . Guardarrailes IAG (Ej: Nemo Nvidia, Guardarils AI, etc). ¿Qué ofrecemos en Unicaja? Un entorno de trabajo dinámico donde podrás aprender y crecer profesionalmente. Oficinas ubicadas en Málaga. Flexibilidad y bienestar: jornada intensiva todo el año y horario y condiciones flexibles para que puedas equilibrar tu vida personal y profesional. Paquete retributivo competitivo, beneficios sociales y beneficios exclusivos por pertenecer a Unicaja. Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional en un entorno dinámico, con formación continua y acceso a las últimas tecnologías. Compromiso con la Igualdad, Diversidad e Inclusión en el entorno de trabajo. ¿Quieres formar parte de un proyecto que está redefiniendo el futuro de la banca? Únete a Unicaja y crece con nosotros.

Together, you will build our trading execution engine, data intelligence solutions, and client applications. Our tech stack mainly consists of C#/.NET, Python, React/TypeScript, and PostgreSQL. Our systems run on Microsoft Azure, and we use tools such as Docker, Azure DevOps, and Terraform for deployment and infrastructure. Your initial focus will be on developing data and machine learning solutions and bringing them reliably into production. You will also work on the services, APIs, and interfaces that integrate these solutions into our products. What will you do? Work closely with our data analyst to further develop analyses and models and translate them into maintainable Python software. Build data pipelines to collect, process, and validate market, blockchain, and portfolio data. Develop backend services, REST APIs, and integrations within our .NET and Python environment. Take a DevOps-minded approach to development, focusing on CI/CD, monitoring, quality, performance, and scalability. Make data and model outputs available in our React/TypeScript applications. Design and maintain data models using PostgreSQL. Ensure automated testing, reliable deployments, logging, and monitoring. Contribute to technical decisions and work with colleagues to bring features from development into production. What do you bring? At least 3 years of relevant experience in software development. Demonstrable experience in training and evaluating machine learning models, either professionally or through a substantial personal project. A strong foundation in backend development with C#/.NET and/or Python, along with practical experience in TypeScript and React. Experience with REST APIs, relational databases, Git, and automated testing. The ability to independently deliver a clearly defined solution and explain technical decisions effectively. A completed university degree (WO level) or demonstrably equivalent professional experience and capabilities. Nice to have: Experience deploying and monitoring data pipelines or models in production. Experience with Microsoft Azure, Docker, and CI/CD, for example using Azure DevOps. Knowledge of PostgreSQL, Entity Framework Core, Next.js, or Terraform. Experience working with financial time series or blockchain data. An interest in crypto and fintech. You use AI development tools effectively and critically review and test the code they generate. What do we offer you? A gross monthly salary between €4,500 and €6,000 (based on a 40-hour workweek). A full-time position of 40 hours per week (32 or 36 hours are negotiable). The prospect of a permanent contract. 25 vacation days (based on full-time employment). Travel reimbursement of €0.23 per kilometer or full reimbursement of public transport costs. A laptop or laptop allowance so you can get started right away. The opportunity to design and build innovative software in the fintech industry. Plenty of room for initiative: you will help shape how we build our technology. The opportunity to work with an ambitious and professional team. Primarily on-site work, with the possibility of hybrid working in the future, subject to certain conditions. Does this sound like your next career move? Visit our website and apply.

Wir bauen für mittelständische Unternehmen und PE-Portfoliogesellschaften die Infrastruktur, mit der Prozesse nicht nur analysiert, sondern von KI-Agenten übernommen werden – vom Process Mining über die Neustrukturierung bis zum laufenden Betrieb. Dafür entwickeln wir eigene Produkte (HYRO-Plattform: HYROSCALE, HYROCALL, HYROINSIDE) und arbeiten als Celonis-Partner für Process Mining. Zu unseren Kunden zählen Fujitsu, Bertrandt und Degussa; über 40 Projekte haben wir mit einem Team von acht Personen geliefert. Unser Vergütungsmodell gegenüber Kunden ist wirkungsbasiert: Features werden mit einem Anteil der realisierten Einsparung oder Umsatzsteigerung bezahlt. Das prägt, wie wir arbeiten – und wen wir suchen. Wir brauchen Menschen, die einen Prozess bis auf die Zahl durchdringen, daraus ein System bauen und den Kunden durch die Veränderung führen. Die Rolle Du verantwortest bei unseren Kunden den Weg vom Prozessbefund zum laufenden Agenten-System – fachlich, technisch und gegenüber der Geschäftsführung. Du leitest Engagements von der Ist-Aufnahme (Process Mining, Interviews, Customer Journeys) über Maßnahmenkataloge mit Business Case bis zur Umsetzung mit unserem Engineering-Team und der HYRO-Plattform. Du bist das Gesicht des Projekts im Strategiekreis des Kunden und trägst die Verantwortung dafür, dass die versprochene Wirkung eintritt – denn daran hängt unsere Vergütung. Die Position ist als Senior Consultant angelegt. Wer in den ersten 12–18 Monaten einen belastbaren Track Record aufbaut – abgeschlossene Engagements mit gemessener Wirkung, zufriedene Kunden, eigene Akquise – wechselt in den Partner-Track mit Erfolgsbeteiligung am Ergebnis der von ihm verantworteten Projekte und Kunden. Was du tust Analyse und Konzeption Prozesslandkarten und Customer Journeys beim Kunden aufnehmen – mit Process Mining (Celonis, Event-Logs aus ERP, CRM, Telefonie, Buchungssystemen) und mit Interviews vor Ort Bruchpunkte, Qualitätsmerkmale und Kostentreiber identifizieren; Baselines definieren, an denen später die Wirkung gemessen wird Maßnahmenkataloge mit Business Case je Maßnahme erarbeiten: Ergebniseffekt pro Jahr, Aufwand, Priorität, Bewertungseffekt für die Gesellschafter Mit der Geschäftsführung evaluieren, welche Maßnahmen sofort starten und welche in Beirat oder Aufsichtsrat gehen Agentic AI und Umsetzung Prozesse neu strukturieren und in Agenten-Systeme überführen: Entscheidungskorridore, Freigabeprozesse, Eskalationsregeln, Audit-Logs Drittanbieter-Tools anbinden, Daten extrahieren und bereinigen, Features auf der HYRO-Plattform spezifizieren und mit dem Engineering-Team umsetzen Agenten in Betrieb nehmen, Korridore mit dem Kunden schrittweise erweitern, Wirkung gegen die Baseline nachweisen Kunde und Geschäft Engagements eigenverantwortlich führen: Strategiekreis, Workshops, Entscheidungsvorlagen, Change bei den Teams Angebote und Business Cases schreiben, die ein PE-Partner ohne Rückfrage versteht Perspektivisch: eigene Kunden gewinnen und ein Themenfeld (z. B. items.desc: Title: Data Scientist, Delivery Location: Turin, Italy (hybrid) Reporting to: CTO Before you apply: Nebuly is where the bar is high and the vision is bold. We move fast, think deeply, and push each other to build the future of AI products. If you're ready to give your best, we'd love to hear from you. About Nebuly Nebuly is a fast-growing, VC-backed startup building the platform that proves the ROI of enterprise AI. Every enterprise function (sales, customer support, HR, finance) is deploying AI agents at scale, and budgets are following fast. But most companies can't answer a basic question: is this spend actually working? The signal that could answer it is already there, in the millions of conversations happening every day between employees, customers, and these agents. It's unstructured, high-volume, and invisible without the right infrastructure. Nebuly makes that signal visible. It sits on top of any enterprise AI deployment, turns those conversations into a clear answer on whether AI is working and where, and connects the dots back to ROI. Think of it as the accountability layer for enterprise AI: connect once, see the impact, prove the value, with no data ever leaving your environment. Our customers include Oura, CNH Industrial, Vodafone, and Moncler. Demand is accelerating fast, and we're building the team to match. The role Every new customer brings a different AI deployment, different users, and different questions they need answered. Most of them start with a Proof of Value (PoV) or Proof of Concept (PoC): a few intense weeks in which we have to show, on their own data, that Nebuly delivers insights they can't get anywhere else. Plugging in the product is only half the job: the other half is making sure that what Nebuly shows is exactly what that customer needs to see. As a Data Scientist in our Delivery team, you own that second half, and you are the person who makes a PoV/PoC succeed. You dive into each customer's data, find the trends that matter, and decide what is real signal and what is noise. You judge whether a metric, a topic, or an insight is actually useful for that specific customer, and you shape the product configuration accordingly. Throughout the PoV/PoC and the installation you work side by side with our revenue team and directly with the customer's own stakeholders: you agree on success criteria, you show them what their data is telling them, and you iterate until the product fits their needs perfectly and the value is clear enough to turn the pilot into a long-term deal. You sit at the intersection of data, product, and customers: you turn raw conversational data into insights a business leader can act on, and you bring back to product and engineering what you learn in the field. Examples of your daily responsibilities Work hands-on with customers during PoV/PoC phases: help define success criteria with them and the revenue team, and own the analytical side of the pilot from kickoff to final readout. Explore and analyse customer data during PoVs/PoCs and onboarding: write queries, slice the data, and identify the trends, patterns, and anomalies that matter. Assess whether a given data point, metric, or insight is relevant and valuable for the customer, and discard what isn't. Configure and fine-tune the product for each customer (topics, metrics, segments, dashboards) so that it answers their real business questions. Work closely with the revenue team before and during installation to understand customer goals and translate them into an analytics setup. Run regular sessions with customers' stakeholders during the PoV/PoC to present findings, validate hypotheses, and iterate on the configuration together. Prepare the final PoV/PoC readout with the revenue team: the insights uncovered, the value demonstrated, and the case for moving to production. Build Python scripts and notebooks to automate recurring analyses, data quality checks, and onboarding steps. Evaluate the quality of the insights our AI pipelines produce on customer data, and flag issues to the AI and engineering teams with clear evidence. Turn what works into repeatable playbooks, so that every new installation is faster and better than the last. Bring patterns you see across customers back to product and engineering to help shape the roadmap. What we look for 2 to 5 years of experience as a Data Scientist, Data Analyst, Analytics Engineer, or in a similar analytics role. Strong SQL. You write complex queries comfortably (joins, window functions, aggregations) and you know how to get answers out of a database efficiently. Strong Python. You are fluent with the data stack (pandas or polars, notebooks, plotting libraries) and you write clean, reusable code, not just one-off scripts. An analytics mindset. You know how to go from a vague business question to a precise analysis, and you can tell a meaningful trend from a statistical artefact. Business sense. You care about what the customer will do with an insight, not …
