items.desc: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Support Operations Specialist based in Ireland. Are you passionate about artificial intelligence, customer experience, and building smarter support solutions? This opportunity allows you to take ownership of an AI-powered customer support agent and continuously improve its performance, accuracy, and effectiveness. You will work at the intersection of AI operations, customer care, product development, and technical implementation in a fully remote, international environment. Your work will help deliver faster, more reliable, and more human customer interactions while ensuring seamless escalation to human support when needed. By analyzing performance data, refining workflows, and testing emerging technologies, you will directly influence how AI transforms customer service. This role is ideal for a curious, analytical, and proactive professional who enjoys experimenting, solving complex problems, and turning insights into measurable improvements. Accountabilities Optimize AI Support Performance: Take ownership of the AI support agent's effectiveness, identifying opportunities to improve resolution rates, answer accuracy, customer satisfaction, and escalation decisions. Maintain Accurate Knowledge: Collaborate with internal policy and product experts to ensure the AI agent has access to current, reliable information and provides consistent, accurate responses. Analyze Performance and Identify Root Causes: Review successful resolutions, escalations, and unsuccessful interactions to identify recurring issues, investigate underlying causes, and prioritize improvements. Test and Measure Enhancements: Design and conduct tests before and after implementing changes, document results, and evaluate their impact on the AI agent's performance. Configure AI Behavior and Workflows: Develop and refine AI guidance, response tone, procedures, and workflows within Intercom Fin to ensure interactions are clear, empathetic, accurate, and aligned with established service standards. Improve Human Handoffs: Ensure customers can reach a human support specialist smoothly whenever their requests require additional expertise, judgment, or personalized assistance. Expand AI Capabilities: Identify opportunities to introduce AI support across additional products, services, and more complex customer journeys. Monitor Emerging AI Technologies: Stay informed about new Intercom features and developments in AI-powered customer support, run targeted experiments, and recommend practical innovations based on their demonstrated value. Coordinate Cross-Functional Improvements: Work closely with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and internal knowledge owners to resolve issues, clarify data requirements, implement integrations, and improve the AI agent's capabilities. Communicate Results and Build Feedback Loops: Report performance insights and recommendations to Customer Care leadership, prioritize improvement requests, and establish a clear process for teams to flag issues and track their resolution. Requirements Hands-On Intercom Fin Experience: Demonstrated experience configuring and improving Intercom Fin, including its guidance, workflows, or procedures, with measurable results to show for your work. Excellent Communication and Writing Skills: The ability to produce clear, accurate, natural, and empathetic customer-facing responses, with strong judgment about when an answer is incomplete, misleading, or inappropriate. Analytical and Problem-Solving Abilities: Experience identifying patterns in performance data, investigating root causes, developing solutions, and measuring whether changes deliver the intended results. Technical Confidence: Comfort with technical configurations and the ability to discuss integrations, workflows, and implementation requirements effectively with engineering teams. AI Knowledge and Curiosity: A strong interest in AI-powered support technologies, a willingness to experiment with new tools, and the ability to distinguish practical innovations from unproven hype. Project and Stakeholder Management: The ability to translate findings into clear recommendations, coordinate cross-functional teams, prioritize improvements, and follow through on implementation. Adaptability and Initiative: A proactive, independent mindset, intellectual curiosity, creativity, integrity, and a willingness to test new approaches and learn from setbacks. Customer-Centric Approach: A genuine commitment to improving customer experiences through reliable, accessible, and thoughtful support. Preferred Industry Experience: Familiarity with data privacy, insurance, healthcare, or other regulated service environments is an advantage. Mission Alignment: An interest in building accessible, globally relevant services that help people work and live across geographical borders. Benefits Fully Remote Work: Work from …

Are you passionate about artificial intelligence, customer experience, and building smarter support solutions? This opportunity allows you to take ownership of an AI-powered customer support agent and continuously improve its performance, accuracy, and effectiveness. Sichere Qualität: Du übernimmst Verantwortung von der Implementierung bis zum Test und prüfst AI-generierten Code, bevor er ins Repository geht. Wachse im Team: Du arbeitest in interdisziplinären Teams, lernst im Pairing und im Review von erfahrenen adessi und bringst dich zunehmend eigenständig in Design-Entscheidungen ein. DEIN PROFIL Ausbildung: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine Ausbildung im IT-Bereich bildet deine fachliche Basis für diese Rolle. Java-Erfahrung: Du hast erste bis mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung webbasierter Anwendungen idealerweise im Spring-Stack. Arbeitsweise: Clean Code, Testing, CI/CD, Docker und Domain-driven Design sind dir vertraut, oder du arbeitest dich schnell in diese Themen ein. Lernfreude: Neue Frameworks und Themen erschließt du dir schnell, AI-gestützt umso schneller. AI Kompetenz: Du hast erste Erfahrung mit AI-Coding-Assistenten wie Claude Code und möchtest agentisches Entwickeln zu deinem Handwerk machen. items.desc: Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso. DEINE ROLLE Implementiere im Team: Du implementierst Java-Anwendungen im Team, mit erfahrenen adessi an deiner Seite bei komplexeren Entscheidungen. Entwickle agentisch von Anfang an: Du entwickelst Features mit Claude Code und vergleichbaren Agenten und lernst im Projektalltag einzuschätzen, wo sie tragen. Entwickle bestehende Systeme weiter: Du erweiterst vorhandene Anwendungen und passt sie an neue fachliche Anforderungen an. Sichere Qualität: Du übernimmst Verantwortung von der Implementierung bis zum Test und prüfst AI-generierten Code, bevor er ins Repository geht. Wachse im Team: Du arbeitest in interdisziplinären Teams, lernst im Pairing und im Review von erfahrenen adessi und bringst dich zunehmend eigenständig in Design-Entscheidungen ein. DEIN PROFIL Ausbildung: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine Ausbildung im IT-Bereich bildet deine fachliche Basis für diese Rolle. Java-Erfahrung: Du hast erste bis mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung webbasierter Anwendungen idealerweise im Spring-Stack. Arbeitsweise: Clean Code, Testing, CI/CD, Docker und Domain-driven Design sind dir vertraut, oder du arbeitest dich schnell in diese Themen ein. Lernfreude: Neue Frameworks und Themen erschließt du dir schnell, AI-gestützt umso schneller. AI Kompetenz: Du hast erste Erfahrung mit AI-Coding-Assistenten wie Claude Code und möchtest agentisches Entwickeln zu deinem Handwerk machen. Sprachkentnisse: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi. Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

items.desc: The Scientific Computing Center is the Information Technology Center of KIT. The National Research Data Infrastructure (NFDI) aims to systematically catalogue and make accessible the data holdings of science and research, ensure their long-term preservation, and make them accessible. It is being established as an interconnected structure of consortia that act on their own initiative. Within NFDI-MatWerk, a reliable digital platform for materials science and nanoscience is being developed, enabling the digital representation of materials data and specific metadata. Services for the easy storage, sharing, searching, and analysis of data and metadata are being developed and made available to researchers. Furthermore, data from scientific groups distributed throughout Germany should be accessible through a knowledge-graph-based infrastructure in such a way that fast and complex search queries and analyses become possible. Your Tasks In the “Data Exploitation Methods” department of the Scientific Computing Center (SCC), we develop innovative software solutions for the NFDI to make the handling of research data simple and user-friendly. Within the framework of NFDI-MatWerk, you will work on the following topics: You will develop a tool for automatic metadata extraction and mapping, optimally tailored to the needs of researchers in the field of materials science. You will use LLMs to support semantic extraction from unstructured or semi-structured texts. You will design new methods and workflows to improve the analysis and visualization of large data collections. You will participate in teaching activities (supervision of students). You will publish at least one scientific article per year in academic journals and present your results at conferences. Your Profile You Have A completed university degree (Diplom (University)/Master’s) in STEM subjects (mathematics, computer science, natural sciences, and technology). Ideally, a completed PhD. Experience in software development and LLMs. Preferably, experience in the field of technical data and metadata management. Strategic, creative, and goal-oriented thinking skills that support your proactive way of working, which you bring to a team that works in the same way. Very good communication, presentation, and publication skills in English (spoken and written). Curious about an exciting and versatile role in an agile team? Discover more about SCC as your professional place to be: https://www.scc.kit.edu/en/aboutus/working-at-scc.php We Offer Science for Impact : Engage with topics of societal relevance — in an excellent scientific environment that enables change. Flexible Working Hours : Take advantage of flexible‑hours schemes, remote‑work options, and a 30‑day annual leave entitlement to achieve an optimal work‑life balance. Career‑Building and Developmental Opportunities : We provide you with a structured onboarding program, a broad spectrum of continuing‑education options, and personalised support, thereby fostering your individual growth. Family-friendliness : The “KIT‑Family +” program assists you in reconciling work and family life by offering childcare services, holiday activities, a parent‑child office space, and assistance with caring for relatives. Stay Healthy : Under the motto “Fit at KIT – Body, Mind and Soul,” we promote your well‑being through fitness classes and mental‑health programmes. Individualised Extra Benefits : Enjoy a corporate pension (VBL), a €25 monthly contribution toward a JobTicket BW, plus a broad selection of cultural and recreational programmes. Job location Eggenstein-Leopoldshafen (and Karlsruhe) Salary Salary category 13 TV-L; classification is based on personal and professional qualifications. We therefore welcome applications from all candidates. Women are especially encouraged to apply. items.card: The role We are looking for a Computational Structural Biologist to help develop computational approaches for understanding and designing molecular glue-induced protein interactions. You will combine structural modelling and prediction with experimental data to develop and test hypotheses about protein complexes and binding. This is a hands-on coding role. You will develop and maintain scientific software, data
items.desc: Computational Structural Biologist Type: Full-time Location: Remote (UK time ± 2 hours; UK preferred) Compensation: Competitive, based on experience About us Bindbridge is advancing sustainable agriculture through AI-powered molecular glue discovery and design. Backed by Speedinvest and Nucleus Capital, we are building a computational platform to bring targeted protein degradation to agriculture. Our first goal is to discover herbicides that revolutionise crop protection while minimising environmental impact. The role We are looking for a Computational Structural Biologist to help develop computational approaches for understanding and designing molecular glue-induced protein interactions. You will combine structural modelling and prediction with experimental data to develop and test hypotheses about protein complexes and binding. This is a hands-on coding role. You will develop and maintain scientific software, data pipelines and structured datasets that connect predicted structures, experimental results and computational analyses. Working across our science, AI and software teams, you will turn research questions into clearly defined computational studies, evaluate the results and communicate their implications. Projects may draw on data from XL-MS, HDX-MS, SAXS, cryo-EM, X-ray crystallography and biophysical assays. You are not expected to know every method, but you should be willing to learn how unfamiliar data can constrain, validate or challenge structural models, with support from our scientists, collaborators and advisers. Key responsibilities Lead computational studies of protein structures, complexes and molecular glue-induced interactions using methods such as structure prediction, co-folding, docking, molecular dynamics and integrative modelling. Work with experimental scientists and advisers to incorporate structural and biophysical evidence into models, understand its limitations and identify useful follow-up experiments. Write, test and maintain reusable scientific software for structural modelling, analysis and evaluation, contributing directly to shared codebases and working with AI and software engineers to integrate, deploy and scale it. Design and build data pipelines that ingest, validate, harmonise and version structural, sequence, experimental and computational data. Develop and maintain data models and databases that connect proteins, structures, experiments, predictions and results, with clear quality controls, metadata and provenance. Design benchmarks and evaluations that show where computational approaches work, where they fail and how confidently their results can be used. Document methods, assumptions, limitations and results, then communicate their scientific implications across disciplines. What you will bring A strong foundation in computational structural biology, structural bioinformatics or a closely related field, including an understanding of protein structure, interactions and conformational behaviour, gained through postgraduate study or equivalent professional experience. Experience using computational methods to investigate protein structures or complexes and drawing conclusions from the results. Strong programming and software engineering skills with experience developing tested, maintainable scientific software. Experience building data pipelines and working with databases or structured scientific data systems, including validation, metadata, provenance and versioning. The ability to define a research question, select an appropriate computational approach and draw defensible conclusions from incomplete or uncertain evidence. Experience interpreting data from at least one structural or biophysical method, together with the ability to learn unfamiliar methods with support from specialists and advisers. Clear written and verbal communication, together with the independence to lead complex research while collaborating across scientific and technical disciplines. Nice to have Experience with molecular glues, targeted protein degradation, induced proximity or other protein-protein interaction problems. Experience combining multiple sources of sparse or uncertain evidence through integrative structural modelling. Familiarity with machine-learning approaches to protein structure prediction, complex modelling or molecular design. Experience running scientific workflows across large datasets or shared computing infrastructure. Experience in biotechnology, drug discovery, E3 ligase biology, chemoproteomics or plant biology. Experience using AI-assisted development tools while validating their outputs and applying scientific judgement. Why join us Apply computational structural biology to difficult and underexplored problems in molecular glue discovery. Shape the scientific methods, software and data foundations behind an emerging discovery platform. Collaborate closely with scientists, AI researchers, software engineers and experienced external advisers. Join an early team …

Les champs de recherche portent sur la recherche fondamentale en physique nucléaire et l’astrophysique nucléaire, les matériaux sous irradiation et la nanostructuration, les collisions moléculaires et le milieu interstellaire, la radiobiologie et les techniques innovantes pour la dosimétrie et la thérapie de certains cancers. Le GANIL (environ 350 personnes) se situe sur le futur site EPOPEA, parc de sciences et d’innovation de la communauté urbaine de Caen la Mer, à Caen en Normandie. Il est géré conjointement, au sein d’un Groupe d'Intérêt Économique (GIE), par le Commissariat à l'énergie atomique (CEA/DRF) et par le Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique (CNRS/IN2P3). En tant qu’infrastructure de recherche, le GANIL est au service d’une communauté scientifique nationale, européenne et internationale d’un millier d’utilisateurs. La personne recrutée sera affectée au GANIL, au sein du groupe DOSADO de la division DPHY. Ce groupe est intégré à la Division de la Physique également constituée des groupes DELPH (Détection et lasers pour la physique) et GTA (Groupe des Techniques d’Acquisition). Les agents de cette division ont pour mission l’accueil des expériences effectuées au GANIL portées par une communauté scientifique internationale. Ils mènent également un programme de R&D sur les techniques de détection, sur les techniques laser, sur les techniques d’acquisition des données produites dans les expériences et enfin sur la fabrication de cibles et couches minces. La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec l’équipe INTHERES à Toulouse dans le cadre du projet OPTADOM. Elle passera donc la majorité de son CDD dans l’équipe INTHERES, où l’analyse des acquisitions d’imagerie a déjà débuté. Elle viendra également régulièrement au GANIL sur des périodes de 2 à 3 semaines pour les expériences ainsi que l’intégration des biodistributions au processus dosimétrique. items.desc: Do you want to join us in creating a more competitive and sustainable future? Do you want to make a difference, in an organisation that makes a difference? Do you have a PhD in economics or a related field? Help us to help others! Your application is welcome! About Us Our mission at RISE is to promote sustainable growth in Sweden by strengthening the competitiveness and renewal of the private sector and contributing to the innovative development of society. The unit Sustainability Analytics belongs to the Department of Energy and Resource Transition in the Division of Digital Systems and Societal Transformation. Over the past ten years, team members have worked to build knowledge in circular business model innovation, circular business ecosystems and sustainability analysis at different system levels. We specialize in methods such as circularity measurement, life cycle assessment, choice modelling, techno-economic analysis and business model innovation and combine these methods to answer questions from multiple perspectives. We thrive at the intersection of the private sector, the public sector and civil society/citizens. From an organizational perspective, we help our partners envision, understand and create sustainable, circular business ecosystems that prioritize longevity, repair and reuse. From a consumer perspective, we help understand consumption patterns and develop underlying logics, rules and norms with the goal of changing behavior towards sufficient and circular consumption. Together, this results in longer product lifetimes, higher utilization rates and material recirculation. About The Role As a researcher with us, you will, together with colleagues and partners, work in projects where you drive forward research on sustainable and circular business drawing from large datasets and analysis that filters signal from noise, allowing for confident decisions in industry and the public sector. We welcome researchers with experience independently managing large datasets and applying quantitative-, qualitative- or mixed methods to generate rich explanations and justifications for circular business models. Applicants with training in diverse academic fields are welcome, however experience working across disciplines is necessary, and experience with economic data is highly encouraged. You will develop and deliver results that are directly applicable by companies, businesses and other organizations across industries, sectors and product types. The results aim to demonstrate how organizations can ensure a sustainable transformation of their business, operations and the system they operate in. Furthermore, you will work together with research colleagues within the unit and in the broader field of decision support methods and sustainability analysis of circular economy and resource efficiency. You will also have access to a broad network across RISE working in different ways with circular economy transitions, as well as with other technical and business-related experts. In collaboration with your colleagues, you are expected to contribute with experience and expertise in ongoing and newly started projects. In the long term, we see you becoming independent and formulating and conceptualizing the decision support elements of large research applications yourself. The goal for the unit is that we, together at RISE, will advance the position of decision support and analytics for circularity and become one of the most recognized research institutes in the field. Who are you? To thrive and succeed in this role, you are curious, humble and motivated to learn new things. You are able to build relationships and inspire confidence based on your competence and communication skills. You find it easy to cooperate in different constellations and enjoy the fact that the work is varied - e.g. in terms of industry, product and material - and sometimes unpredictable. It goes without saying that you deliver independent and impartial results. Requirements for the role are as follows: PhD in economics, business, or a related social science discipline At least three years of experience conceptualizing, executing, and publishing research Deep expertise in analysis of big data sets with quantitative, qualitative or mixed methodologies Speak and write English fluently It is an advantage for the role if you have: A good understanding of circular economy and circular business models Experience developing original and innovative ways to visualize data Experience with economic modelling Experience with research related to one or more of the following sectors: the built environment, furniture, textiles, consumer products, finance or energy Applied for- and led externally funded research projects A working proficiency in Swedish Are we right for each other? At RISE, we like different and we are convinced that diversity contributes to an innovative environment where we together challenge boundaries and develop new knowledge for the future. …

Experiment design and execution Analyze and interpret experimental results Write scientific articles for publication in peer-reviewed journals Present at international
items.desc:
Mission
 At the Laboratory for Quantum Magnetism (LQM) we perform fundamental research in magnetism and correlated electron materials. Our core activities span from synthesis of novel materials over in-house experimental techniques in combination with low temperature, high pressures and high magnetic fields, neutron and X-ray scattering to theory and modeling. The LQM is part of the École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL), a world-renowned research and education center, offering an ideal academic environment as well as an excellent connection to industry. 
 The available PhD position is centered around microwave spectroscopy of rare-earth quantum magnets, with a focus on entanglement between electronic and nuclear degrees of freedom, transitions between electro-nuclear states driven by external magnetic field, and how the occupancy of those states can be manipulated by external perturbations. Examples of published work can be found in Scientific Reports and Physical Review B . Alongside the above-mentioned experimental technique, our laboratory, and EPFL, offers state-of-the-art laboratories and equipment to facilitate the research. The project will be supervised by Prof. Henrik Rønnow and Dr. Ivica Živković. 
 Main duties and responsibilities
 As a PhD Student, you will be expected to: 
 Take responsibility for the development and completion of your doctoral research project 
 Make regular visits to large-scale facilities for Neutron, X-ray and Muon-based experiments. 
 Experiment design and execution 
 Analyze and interpret experimental results 
 Write scientific articles for publication in peer-reviewed journals 
 Present at international conferences 
 Supervise student projects and basic administrative support 
 Contribute to teaching 
 Profile
 We are looking for a highly motivated candidate with a Master’s degree in Physics or a related field. The successful candidate should have a strong background in solid-state physics and quantum mechanics, excellent communication skills in English (spoken and written), and a willingness to learn and engage in challenging research. 
 We offer
 A challenging and exciting PhD project in experimental quantum magnetism, supervised by Dr. Ivica Živković and Prof. Henrik M. Rønnow. 
 Access to state-of-the-art experimental facilities for microwave spectroscopy of rare-earth quantum magnets. 
 Opportunities to perform measurements under low-temperature and high-magnetic-field conditions. 
 A stimulating and collaborative research environment within the Laboratory for Quantum Magnetism and the broader EPFL community. 
 Opportunities to present your research at international conferences and develop collaborations within the quantum magnetism community. 
 Informations
 Applications should include grade transcript, CV, motivation letter and three contact persons for references. For any further information, please contact Dr. Ivica Živković ( ivica.zivkovic@epfl.ch ). We encourage applications from candidates of all genders and diverse cultural and personal backgrounds . 
 The selected PhD student will need to enroll in the physics program of the EPFL doctoral school. After one year of successful probation, the initial contract will be extended up to a total of four years. Doctoral school information and employment conditions at EPFL are described at: 
 https://www.epfl.ch/education/phd/programs/edpy-physics

items.desc:
Location 
ESTEC, Noordwijk, Netherlands 
 Description 
 End-to-End Navigation System Engineer in the Navigation Systems Implementation and Validation Section, End-to-End Systems Division, Systems Department, Directorate of Technology, Engineering and Quality.
 Our team and mission: 
 You will belong to the Navigation Systems Implementation & Validation Section (TEC-SEI). The Section provides expert technical support and consultancy to ESA projects, programmes, and general studies in the field of radio navigation systems and techniques (PNT, in particular GNSS). Our core mission focus lies in the critical project lifecycle Phases C and onwards, bridging the gap between detailed design, physical implementation, and operational deployment. To successfully deliver on this mandate, the Section requires strong expertise in system design and validation (engineering).
 Duties 
 As an End-to-End Navigation System Engineer specialising in SI&V, your primary responsibilities will focus on the end-to-end integration, testing, and validation of complex navigation architectures. You will support established programmes like Galileo, as well as new and emerging ESA PNT missions such as the Celeste LEO-PNT In-Orbit Demonstrator and OpStar. Your duties will include:
 defining, guiding, and executing comprehensive System Assembly, Integration and Validation (SI&V) strategies and test campaigns across Phase C, D, and E lifecycles for Galileo (G1 and G2), Celeste LEO-PNT, and OpStar;
 providing expert system design and validation engineering support to subsystem-level and system-level Assembly, Integration, and Testing (AIT) and AIV processes, ensuring correct flow-down of system requirements to the segment and payload levels;
 operating and exploiting ESTEC Navigation Laboratory facilities—including System Test Beds (e.g., G2STB), Radio Frequency Constellation Simulators (RFCS), and Test User Receivers (TURNs)—to conduct Signal-in-Space (SIS) compatibility testing and end-to-end performance verification;
 supporting commissioning and in-flight operations, including Launch and Early Orbit Phase (LEOP) and In-Orbit Testing (IOT) activities, actively investigating system anomalies, and managing the resolution of non-conformances;
 supporting the performance monitoring of Systems in operation, investigation of system anomalies and the design, development and validation of related tools;
 participating as a technical expert in formal project reviews (e.g., Critical Design Reviews [CDRs], Test Readiness Reviews [TRRs], and Acceptance Reviews [ARs]), evaluating industrial data packs to ensure integration readiness and system design maturity;
 defining test scenarios, coordinating data dissemination analysis, generating test vectors, and executing hardware-in-the-loop laboratory activities to evaluate and verify new PNT subsystems and equipment;
 contributing to the continuous improvement of SI&V engineering best practices, standards, and tools, actively capturing and sharing validation methodologies across the Agency.
 Technical competencies 
 Deep understanding of system design and verification processes for space missions (focusing on Phase C and onwards), specifically for GNSS and emerging PNT architectures (e.g., LEO-PNT)
 Proven hands-on experience defining test plans and executing hardware/software test campaigns in laboratory environments using system test beds, signal simulators, and advanced receivers
 Familiarity with the Galileo system architecture, signals (e.g., OS, HAS, PRS), and its specific SI&V operational processes
 Experience in preparation of procurement activities for technology development and innovation (statements of work, proposal evaluation)
 Experience in the management and technical monitoring of industrial activities, including resolving complex integration non-conformances and driving formal technical reviews
 Behavioural competencies 
 Result Orientation
Operational Efficiency
Fostering Cooperation
Relationship Management
Continuous Improvement
Forward Thinking
For more information, please refer to ESA Core Behavioural Competencies guidebook 
 Education and professional experience 
 A master's in telecommunication engineering or another relevant domain is required for this post, together with 4 years of relevant professional experience.
 Additional requirements 
 experience of working with satellite navigation in particular and PNT in general;
 knowledge of and proven experience in machine learning or data analysis applied to PNT, end-to-end navigations systems performance analysis, GNSS receiver signal processing, advanced positioning algorithms are all considered assets;
 strong technical, analytical, organisational and reporting skills, with a proactive attitude to solving problems;
 good interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to work in a multicultural environment, both independently and as part of a team;
 understanding of the ESA procurement process.

items.desc: We are seeking to appoint a Research Assistant (AI Scientist & Computational Cancer Biology) to join the Nuffield Department of Medicine, University of Oxford, working on an state of the art project funded by Advanced Research & Innovation Agency. Reporting to Dr Lennard Lee, Programme Director, you will serve as an AI Scientist & Computational Cancer Biology Research Assistant for the UK Cancer Vaccine AI Scientist & Supercomputing Project. The UK Cancer Vaccine AI Scientist & Supercomputing Project is a government-supported national flagship research initiative hosted by the University of Oxford. The project brings together sovereign AI supercomputing, AI Scientists, automated laboratories, and immunology to develop and manufacture safer, more precise and more effective personalised cancer vaccines. To accelerate the development of personalised cancer vaccines for NHS patients, we seek to create an AI scientist capable of reviewing scientific discovery, generating hypotheses, designing experiments, controlling laboratory workflows, and analysing results. By integrating advanced machine learning with robotic laboratory automation, experimental findings are rapidly fed back to the AI scientist, enabling increasingly accurate predictions and accelerating the pace at which new scientific discoveries can be translated towards patient benefit. The project has been recognised as one of the UK’s leading strategic research initiatives, having been referenced within both the Government’s AI for Science Strategy and the 10-Year National Cancer Plan. It is supported by major UK research funders and government organisations, including ARIA, the Medical Research Council, UK Research and Innovation, Cancer Research UK and the Department for Science, Innovation and Technology, alongside a consortium of more than 2,500 scientists, clinicians, engineers, patient representatives and technology experts. The successful candidate will join a highly collaborative multidisciplinary team working at the interface of artificial intelligence, computational biology, cancer immunology, robotics, software engineering and clinical research, contributing to research that aims to establish new approaches for the discovery and development of personalised cancer vaccines. You will provide computational research support within the programme, working with large-scale cancer, genomic and immunological datasets and applying established and emerging artificial intelligence approaches to cancer vaccine research. They will use frontier and open-source AI models and agentic coding tools, contribute to the development and evaluation of AI models and scientific agents, and support computational analyses alongside cancer biologists, immunologists and AI researchers. The post holder will manage their own research and administrative activities within agreed guidelines and contribute to project planning, data analysis, research outputs and collaborative research . It is essential that you hold a degree in computer science, computational biology, bioinformatics, genomics, cancer biology or a related discipline and possess sufficient specialist knowledge in computational biology, bioinformatics, artificial intelligence or data science to work within established research programmes. You will have experience analysing biological, genomic, biomedical or other large-scale research datasets using computational methods, practical experience using modern AI models or AI-assisted coding tools, with an ability to apply them appropriately to research tasks and some experience developing, adapting or evaluating computational models, machine-learning approaches, AI agents or reproducible computational workflows. Applications for this vacancy should be made online and you will need to upload a supporting statement and CV. Your supporting statement must explain how you meet each of the selection criteria for the post using examples of your skills and experience. Please restrict your documentation to your CV and supporting statement only. Any other documents will be requested at a later date. This position is offered full time on a fixed term contract until 30 September 2030 and is funded by ARIA. Only applications received before 12 midday on Monday, 9 November 2026 will be considered. Please quote 189247 on all correspondence.

items.desc: Engineering - Leuven | Just now We are looking for Process Engineers for bevel management who will be a member of the Chemical Mechanical Planarization team (CMP) within the R&D Unit Process and Modules organization (UPM), which is responsible for developing processes requested by the process integration departments running imec’s CORE and CMORE programs. What you will do Miniaturization of system size is a driving force in most electronics applications. The continuous scaling of integrated circuits, and the advent of more compact system integration technologies make this possible. Within its affiliation programs and bilateral initiatives, imec contributes to the state-of-the-art in a significant manner. Thanks to recent advances in 3D integration, wafer-level packaging and MEMS, novel types of components with small form factors and an increased number of functionalities are emerging. These novel components also require new and advanced packaging solutions. To support the growing interest in these activities, we are looking for a process Engineer for Bevel management. You are member of the Chemical Mechanical Planarization team (CMP) within the R&D Unit Process and Modules organization (UPM) which is responsible for developing processes requested by the process integration departments running imec’s CORE and CMORE programs. You work in a group of about 20 people with whom you interact daily. You will work in a dynamic multidisciplinary and multicultural environment in close cooperation with Researchers, Scientists, Hardware Engineers, Operations, Equipment Vendors, Industrial Assignees, Device and Process experts. You will be a member of a dedicated interdisciplinary team that is setting up a strategy for wafer bevel management. In this team the wafer edge or bevel is reshaped by trimming, deposition, etching or polishing techniques. For this, you work mainly in the cleanroom, and you are supported by experienced technical staff. Secondly, you are involved in research activities where precise control of the wafer bevel is required (3D integrated systems, 3D memory, image sensors, photonics, biomedical devices, quantum computing...). More specifically, you will: Start-up state-of-the-art semiconductor equipment with a key role in bevel management. Develop a training plan for mastering both equipment and process. items.desc: Chez IVIDATA Life Sciences , nous accompagnons les plus grands acteurs de l’industrie pharmaceutique et biotechnologique dans la valorisation de leurs données de recherche et de développement clinique. Nos consultants interviennent au cœur des laboratoires d'innovation pour accélérer la découverte thérapeutique grâce aux technologies data, bio-informatiques et IA les plus avancées. Le Contexte & Vos Missions Dans le cadre du renforcement de l’écosystème digital d'un acteur pharmaceutique de référence situé sur le plateau de Paris-Saclay, nous recherchons un(e) Consultant(e) en Chémo-informatique et Intelligence Artificielle . Intégré(e) au département Chimie Computationnelle et en collaboration directe avec l’Associate Director et les chimistes médicinaux, vous aurez pour mission de fiabiliser, moderniser et automatiser les flux de données chimiques et les outils d'IA prédictive et générative. Vos principales responsabilités : Workflows & Flux de données : Concevoir, optimiser, tester et maintenir des protocoles de traitement de flux de données chimiques Gestion de collections de composés : Assurer la connectivité, l'intégrité et la mise à jour des bases de données de structures chimiques et de données biologiques/physico-chimiques (ADME, Toxicologie), avec interfaçage vers des outils collaboratifs Plateforme de prédiction & Machine Learning : Développer et maintenir les modèles prédictifs de propriétés moléculaires, concevoir des études de référence et suivre la performance des algorithmes au fil du temps. IA Générative & Automatisation : Participer à la maintenance de la plateforme d'IA générative (conception moléculaire de novo , Reinvent, agents IA) et automatiser la réinjection des résultats vers les outils de visualisation des chimistes. Bonnes pratiques logicielles & Cloud : Restructurer et documenter les dépôts GitHub de l'équipe (qualité de code, tests, CI/CD) et accompagner le déploiement de services dans l’environnement Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Profil Recherché Formation : Bac+5 (Master 2, diplôme d’ingénieur) ou Doctorat (PhD) en Chémo-informatique , Bio-informatique ou informatique appliquée aux sciences du vivant. Compétences techniques : Maîtrise avancée de la manipulation de structures moléculaires et de descripteurs chimiques (SMILES, SDF, RDKit). Pratique courante du scripting Python (Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch) et des environnements Shell / Linux. Expérience solide dans la conception de flux de données scientifiques : Pipeline Pilot (un atout majeur) ou KNIME. Connaissance des méthodes de Machine Learning de pointe appliquées à l'ADME/Tox ou au criblage virtuel. Connaissance des plateformes de modélisation (LiveDesign / Schrödinger) et des technologies Cloud (GCP / Docker) appréciée. Bonnes pratiques logicielles indispensables : gestion de versions sous Git/GitHub, code modulaire, documentation et reproductibilité. Langues : Français : lu, écrit, parlé (niveau professionnel opérationnel). Anglais : lu, écrit, parlé (courant / indispensable pour le contexte international de recherche). Savoir-être : Rigueur scientifique, autonomie, sens de l'écoute et du service pour faire le lien entre la data science et la chimie de laboratoire. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? IVIDATA Life Sciences place l’expertise au cœur de nos actions. Aux côtés des grands acteurs du secteur (laboratoires pharmaceutiques, biotech, dispositifs médicaux, santé animale, cosmétique, nutrition…), nos consultants interviennent sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie des produits : de la recherche préclinique à l’industrialisation. Nos 140 consultants déploient leurs compétences dans 3 domaines clés : Biométrie & Data, Opérations & Développement cliniques, Affaires réglementaires & Vigilances. En rejoignant notre équipe, vous évoluerez dans un environnement stimulant, collaboratif et en constante évolution , où vos idées et votre expertise auront un impact réel.

items.desc: We’re looking for a Business Performance & Margin Analyst to join our team in Madrid and play a key role in shaping the future of neuro-contextual advertising at a global scale. Who We Are Seedtag is the leading Neuro-Contextual Advertising Company. We are redefining how advertising works in a privacy-first world by moving beyond keywords and cookies, towards understanding human emotion, intent, and context. Powered by advanced AI and neuroscience, our proprietary technology, Liz, delivers a deep, human-like understanding of content and attention. This enables brands to connect with audiences at the right moment, in the right mindset, with ads that are relevant, engaging, and respectful of the user experience. Founded in 2014 by two ex-Googlers, Seedtag has grown into a global company with 500+ Seedtaggers across 17 countries, backed by €250M in funding, and expanding rapidly across the open web and Connected TV. We’re not just building technology, we’re rewriting the rules of advertising. Your Challenge As Business Performance & Margin Analyst, you will: Client Intelligence (your biggest lever) Analyse our client portfolio end to end — revenue, margin contribution, delivery quality and growth trajectory — and turn that into a clear point of view on where we should invest more, where we should renegotiate, and where we're losing money. Build the recommendations that our commercial and operations teams act on: what to change per client, which accounts deserve more resources, which patterns separate our profitable relationships from our unprofitable ones. Use campaign and delivery data to produce concrete operating advice, not just reporting. Trading Deals & Agency Economics Own the analysis of all trading deals and the profitability of our agreements with agencies: what each deal costs us, what it returns, and whether the terms still make sense. Build the framework and the recurring review that keeps every deal honest, and flag renegotiation opportunities before renewal. Joint Deals, Partnerships & Added Value Quantify what we give away: joint business deals, partnerships, free impressions, over-delivery and other value-added commitments. Put a euro figure on each one, assess whether it bought what it was meant to buy, and set the guardrails for what we commit to going forward. Contracts, Platforms & Fees Review our contracts with platforms, technology vendors and partners: fee structures, revenue shares, minimum commitments and hidden cost leakage. Model the impact of alternatives and support renegotiations with clear, defensible analysis. Publisher & Supply Profitability Identify which publishers deliver the strongest economics for us: where our margin is highest, where volume and profitability align, and where we're paying more for inventory than the returns justify. Recommend where to deepen partnerships and where to rebalance, backed by numbers. Guarantees & Commitments Analyse our minimum revenue guarantees and similar commercial commitments, identify the ones that are structurally unprofitable, and design how we optimise or exit them. What You’ll Need to Succeed 2–3 years in strategy or operational consulting, with a track record of structuring ambiguous business problems and turning them into decisions leadership can act on. A strong analytical foundation, ideally a Master's in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Finance or similar. Genuinely data-driven. You're comfortable living in large datasets, you know the difference between a number and an insight, and you don't form an opinion before you've looked at the data. Strong command of AI tools. You understand how modern AI works, you already use it to multiply your own output, and you're excited about working somewhere that treats it as core infrastructure rather than a side experiment. Excellent business judgment and communication. You'll present to commercial leadership, finance and operations and be the person whose analysis settles the argument. Ownership mentality. This is a first-of-its-kind role here: you'll be defining the frameworks, not inheriting them. Fluent English and Spanish. No technical background required. You don't need to code. Why Join Seedtag? This is a defining moment to join Seedtag, a company that combines scale, ambition, and soul. Growth & Opportunity: Accelerated, hands-on development with real ownership, global projects, and internal mobility. Flexibility: We trust you to balance work and life with flexible schedules and a hybrid model; work from home, the office, or wherever you do your best work. Learning & Development: Access to online learning, continuous training, and optional English or Spanish group classes. Culture that Cares: Well-being is part of how we work, supported by initiatives like SeedDay, Digital Disconnection, and team-building moments. Connection & Fun: Global events, offsites, celebrations, and a strong sense of belonging across all Seedtag locations. Additional Perks Flexible benefits plan …

items.card: about the job Prof. Dr. Nicolas Martin Deputy Director Institute of Asian and Oriental Studies Working at UZH The University of Zurich offers a wide range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. items.desc: Institute of Asian and Oriental Studies Cultural History of India 100 % Start of employment 1 August 2028 The University of Zurich invites applications for a professorship in cultural history of India (open rank) starting on 1 August 2028. Candidates are expected to have produced excellent, internationally visible research in the cultural history of India and to bring teaching experience commensurate with their career stage. A source-based, cultural-historical research profile that engages with India's intellectual, religious, and artistic traditions and their reception, reinterpretation, and continuing impact is central to the position, whether based on textual, material, or both types of sources. Of particular importance is the demonstrated ability to connect historical and cultural-historical research with contemporary questions. Applications from Indology are as welcome as from related disciplines (e.g. Religious Studies, History, Economic History, Art History, Anthropology, Linguistics, or Legal History), provided the research is archivally and textually grounded and supported by demonstrated competence in Indian languages. Candidates must possess excellent linguistic and text-analytical competence in at least one Indian language, ideally a classical one alongside a modern Indian language (such as Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, or Urdu). In teaching, the chair is expected to cover the cultural history of India in a wide sense, including engagement with texts, images, and objects, supported by competence in at least one Indian language. The teaching portfolio will address religion, art and material culture, law and politics, society and gender, and ritual and everyday religious practice, with the rela- tive weight given to each shaped by the profile of the appointee. Beyond innovative contributions to the field, the chair is expected to collaborate in research and teaching with the social-science chair in Indian Studies as well as with other professorships at the Institute of Asian and Oriental Studies, at the Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences, and with national and international institutions, including the Museum Rietberg and the Ethnographic Museum of the University of Zurich. A doctorate in Indology or a related discipline, completed by the time of application, and further excellent scholarly publications are required. Depending on the qualifications of the appointee, the professorship will be filled as a full, associate, or assistant professorship with tenure track. Teaching may be carried out in English. Non-German speaking candidates are expected to acquire a working knowledge of German within the first three years of their appointment. The Institute of Asian and Oriental Studies, the University of Zurich, and Zurich as an academic location offer a stimulating research and teaching environment with rich opportunities for scholarly exchange and collaboration. The university of Zurich is committed to equality and to increasing diversity in research and teaching, and expressly invites applications that contribute to these goals. Applications must be submitted online by 7 December 2026. Access and information for the online application are available on the website of the Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences. items.desc: The role An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Research Support Assistant to join the multi-institutional PIONEER (Programmable In-Organellar Nucleic-acid Entry, Expression and Retention) programme, funded through the ARIA Precision Mitochondria scheme. The project brings together experts across disciplines to develop innovative approaches for engineering biological systems and organelles. Based in the School of Biochemistry and Biomedical Sciences, you will work closely with Prof. Ross Anderson, Prof. Mark Szczelkun, and a collaborative team of researchers. This position is ideal for a recent graduate or early-career researcher looking to build expertise at the interface of computational protein design and engineering biology. The role is designed to provide training, mentorship and research experience that will support future progression to Research Associate positions. What will you be doing? You will contribute to the delivery of key research objectives within the PIONEER programme by applying computational approaches to protein and peptide design and supporting the generation and analysis of research data. Key responsibilities include: Designing protein and peptide binders using state-of-the-art computational methods and AI-based design tools, including RFDiffusion3, proteinMPNN, Boltzgen and DiffDock. Using structure prediction platforms such as AF3, ESMFold2 and Boltz-2 on high performance computing clusters to develop and optimise computational design pipelines. Performing molecular dynamics simulations to evaluate protein structures and interactions. Working with research software engineers and specialist computational platforms to support project development on the UK’s most powerful supercomputer, Isambard-AI. Collaborating with laboratory-based researchers to experimentally characterise designed proteins and peptides. Analysing and presenting research findings at team meetings and contributing to scientific publications. Maintaining accurate research records and contributing to project reporting and milestone delivery. Supporting and occasionally training students or colleagues in computational methodologies. You should apply if You have a degree in a relevant scientific discipline and are enthusiastic about developing a research career in computational biology, protein engineering or related fields. We are looking for candidates who can demonstrate: Experience with computational protein design methods and associated data analysis. Experience of protein structure prediction tools such as AF3 and Boltz-2. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present scientific findings clearly. The ability to work independently while recognising when to seek guidance. Good organisational skills and the ability to manage workloads effectively. A collaborative approach and enthusiasm for working within a multidisciplinary research team. Experience of high-performance computing, gene editing systems, bacterial defence systems, or research laboratory environments would be advantageous but is not essential. This is an outstanding opportunity to contribute to a high-profile, cutting-edge research programme while developing valuable computational and research skills in a supportive and ambitious environment. Additional information Contract type: Fixed Term Contract (Specialist Skills) Work pattern: Full time / 35 hours per week Grade: H Salary: £36,320 - £40,704 per annum School/Unit: School of Biochemistry and Biomedical Sciences This advert will close at 23:59 UK time on Monday 2nd November 2026 Shortlisting will take place on Tuesday 3rd November 2026 Interviews will take place on Tuesday 10th November 2026 For informal queries please contact: Ross Anderson ( Professor of Biological Chemistry) - ross.anderson@bristol.ac.uk / 0117 455 8937 Our strategy and mission We recently launched our strategy to 2030 tying together our mission, vision and values.

items.desc: On the 1 August 2026, The University of Greenwich and the University of Kent formed a pioneering new multi-university group called London and South- East (LASE) University Group. Should you join us, you will be employed by LASE but will work as part of the University of Kent academic division, contributing to its distinct strengths, community and identity while also being part of a wider group that brings together the scale, resilience and shared ambition of both universities. Through LASE we aim to deliver outstanding education, impactful research, and meaningful regional and global impact. Kent and Medway Medical School (KMMS) is an exciting collaboration between Canterbury Christ Church University and LASE which builds on their existing high-quality clinical teaching and research strengths. Our mission is to widen participation, train excellent doctors, and improve health in Kent and Medway. Can you provide expert advice in ethical issues relating to research? If yes, then read on. The Kent and Medway Medical School (KMMS) is seeking a Research Ethics Officer to be responsible for all aspects of administration associated with research ethics and research integrity procedures. You will provide dedicated support to KMMS’ Research Ethics Advisory Group (REAG), facilitating the process via which researchers are required to apply for research ethics review for their research activity. As a Research Ethics Officer you can expect to be involved in: Providing administrative support to the internal research ethics review process, developing and implementing ethics templates, procedures, policies, systems and practices Delivering training in university ethics and governance procedures, providing inductions for new research active staff, members of the REAG and the wider KMMS community Coordinating the business of the KMMS REAG, being accountable for efficient and effective functioning of the REAG including initiating and preparing agendas, distribution of REAG papers, recording and preparing accurate minutes What will you bring to the role? Experience of acting as a source of expert advice and communicating complex or specialised information to colleagues with varying levels of knowledge or experience of the subject Appreciation of ethical issues in relation to research and the requirements of a process to review these issues An ability to rapidly assimilate new and complex information What we can offer in return: As a member of our team, you can expect a friendly, open and collaborative working environment and support in your development and wellbeing.  We are Siemens 
 Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.
 We offer a role with responsibility, independence, and the possibility to contribute proactively. We foster a teamwork culture with room for individual development. 
 About the Team
 The Simcenter ROM Team at Siemens is leveraging AI to reinvent the product design cycle. With a focus on customer impact and a strong culture of collaboration and innovation, we’re harnessing emerging technologies like geometric deep learning and generative AI to enable faster product design. 
 What you will be doing
 • Be part of a multidisciplinary team developing state-of-the-art AI-powered engineering solutions. 
 • Collaborate closely with product management, research, and user experience teams to bring innovative technologies to a fast-growing product. 
 • Contribute to software engineering initiatives, helping ensure high-quality solutions and timely delivery. 
 • Design, build, and optimize high-performance machine learning pipelines to efficiently harvest and process simulation and test data.
 What You Will Bring
 • A problem-solving mindset, eagerness to collaborate, and a passion for continuous learning
 • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field
 • Extensive experience in software engineering, with a demonstrated track record of delivering high-quality software solutions
 • Strong proficiency in Python and solid knowledge of C++
 • A strong understanding of data structures, design patterns, object-oriented programming, ORM, and databases
 • The ability to write clean, modular, and well-tested code
 • Comfort working across both Windows and Linux environments
 • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
 Additional/Nice to have
 • Familiarity with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX. 
 • Experience applying and implementing numerical methods and algorithms in real-world engineering contexts. 
 • Experience working with parallel and high-performance computing technologies, including multi-threading, MPI, or CUDA. 
 • Experience optimizing, debugging, and profiling high-performance applications to maximize efficiency and scalability. 
 • A proven track record of translating numerical methods from academic research into practical software solutions.
 Why Us?
 At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

items.desc: Finnair is a diverse community of professionals who work ambitiously, with a big heart and strong commitment. A strong safety culture is our priority and at the core of our everyday work — something we never take for granted. We are also committed to doing our share in solving the climate challenge by determinedly following our science-based pathway to decarbonize our operations. We find meaning in our purpose: With our heart in Finland, we make every journey better, today and tomorrow. Our values — Always Safe, Customer at Heart and Stronger Together — guide us in everything we do. Intelligent Operations is a new organization within Finnair Digital, focused on accelerating the digital transformation of airline operations. We bring together expertise in technology, data, architecture, integrations, and operational development to build reliable digital capabilities that support operational workflows and decision-making across the airline. We are now looking for a Data Scientist to join our Intelligent Operations team at Finnair. In this role, you will develop predictive models and optimization solutions that support operational decision-making across Finnair. You will apply advanced analytical methods, including time-series analysis, multivariate modelling, pattern recognition and anomaly detection, to complex operational data. Your work will help identify irregularities, recognize early indicators of potential technical issues, and support proactive maintenance and operational decision-making. The role combines strong data science expertise with an interest in software development. We aim to build reliable, production-ready solutions by applying modern software engineering practices, including code quality, testing, maintainability, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. You will work closely with operational stakeholders, Business Analysts, Data Engineers, Software Developers, architects and other Digital teams to understand business needs and develop reliable analytical and AI-driven solutions for an operationally critical environment. Main Responsibilities Work with operational stakeholders and Digital teams to understand operational challenges and translate them into predictive modelling and optimization solutions Design, develop, validate, and deploy predictive and optimization models that support operational planning, maintenance, and decision-making Apply statistical and machine learning techniques, including feature engineering, pattern recognition and anomaly detection, to complex operational data to develop reliable predictions Build scalable, maintainable and production-ready data science solutions, applying modern software engineering practices, including clean, tested and reusable code and test-driven development where appropriate Contribute to MLOps practices, including model deployment, monitoring, observability and continuous improvement of data science and optimization solutions Ensure high standards for data quality, model validation, governance, and responsible use of AI Communicate findings, model outcomes, risks and recommendations to technical and business stakeholders, and contribute to improving data science and engineering practices within Intelligent Operations. Our expectations Master's degree or higher in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Operations Research or another relevant quantitative field. Minimum 3–5 years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Operations Research or a similar analytical role Strong foundation in mathematics, statistics and machine learning, with practical experience in predictive modelling and familiarity with techniques such as multivariate time-series analysis, feature engineering, pattern recognition, and anomaly detection Strong Python programming skills and an interest in software engineering, including testing, version control, CI/CD and MLOps practices Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work with complex data and communicate findings to technical and business stakeholders Experience with AWS, predictive maintenance, sensor data, or aviation is considered an advantage Fluency in English is required; Finnish language skills are an advantage. Working at Finnair We offer you an exciting opportunity in the multifaceted and fast-changing aviation and travel industry, along with a great team and wide personal development opportunities. At Finnair, ambitious, competent, and motivated people can really make a difference. We are happy to enable our employees to enrich their lives and fulfill their travel dreams by offering a wide leisure travel benefit. We also support the health and wellbeing of our employees through our own Sickness Fund insurance benefits, Epassi benefits for sport, culture, wellbeing and commuting, gyms around the Finnair campus, and activities organized by our hobby clubs. items.title: Agentic AI Engineer
items.card: The role has two core parts. First , you’ll work alongside our behavioural science team to build AI systems that solve specific client problems. How might a population respond to an unfolding event? How could the behaviour of a group change when its environment changes? How can large volumes of social data be turned into useful behavioural intelligence? You’ll translate behavioural science into agentic workflows
items.desc: We’re a fast-growing social analytics AI scale-up combining network and behavioural science with modern AI to answer complex questions about how people and groups behave in the real world. Following our Series A, we’re looking for an Agentic AI Engineer to join our team in London. The role has two core parts. First , you’ll work alongside our behavioural science team to build AI systems that solve specific client problems. How might a population respond to an unfolding event? How could the behaviour of a group change when its environment changes? How can large volumes of social data be turned into useful behavioural intelligence? You’ll translate behavioural science into agentic workflows that can reason across data, test hypotheses and produce useful outputs for real users. Second , You will join us in building our own foundational AI capabilities that can be reused across multiple clients. Instead of solving every new problem from scratch, you’ll identify what can be generalised and turn it into robust capabilities within our core platform. That means: Building agentic systems around behavioural science and real-world problems Working closely with scientists to translate research and models into AI capabilities Designing multi-step reasoning and agent workflows Building reusable foundational AI components across client deployments Developing tool-use, retrieval, context and evaluation capabilities Taking experiments from rapid prototypes into reliable production systems We’re particularly interested in engineers who have built real LLM or agentic AI systems and enjoy working directly with domain experts rather than receiving perfectly defined specifications. You’ll be working at the intersection of AI engineering, behavioural science and real-world decision-making. What matters is engineering depth, curiosity, comfort with ambiguity and an AI-native way of working. If building AI that turns behavioural science into real-world capabilities sounds like your kind of problem, please apply here.

items.desc: Who we are Oliver Wyman is a global management consulting firm. We work with clients through their most defining moments, combining deep industry knowledge, specialized expertise, and the power of perspective to help them adapt, grow, and thrive. We believe diverse perspectives make the work stronger. Our consultants bring different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking to help solve complex problems and create lasting impact for clients, colleagues, and communities. At Oliver Wyman, we are proud of the values that we aspire to live by. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential. Quotient — AI by Oliver Wyman brings together deep industry insight, strategic advisory, and hands-on AI delivery to help organizations move from proof to production and from production to enterprise value. The role WAVE is a newly created team within Quotient. It exists to accelerate AI-enabled business development and help our teams move faster, think differently, and build with reuse in mind. As an AI Engineer, you will be one of the build engines of WAVE. You will turn briefs into working prototypes and production-ready solutions, with a focus on agent- and LLM-based work, and traditional ML where that is the right tool for the problem. This is a hands-on role for engineers who want to move quickly, make practical design decisions, and build solutions that are useful, reusable, and worth scaling. We are hiring sevaral AI Engineers across a deliberate spread of strengths, so the team covers the full range from software engineering to data science to modern AI and agent design. What you will do You will help WAVE turn ideas into usable technical solutions that support business development and project execution. You will: Build AI agent and LLM-based solutions that support Bunisess Development and project execution. Develop traditional ML and analytical models where they are the best fit for the problem. Prototype disruptive delivery formats, including agents, avatars, and visual formats that can reduce dependence on slides and meetings. Build with reuse and scale in mind, coordinating with Quotient Inside when a solution is ready to be productized. Work closely with the Technical Business Partner to translate business needs into technical execution. Collaborate with the Platform / Infrastructure Engineer to deploy solutions reliably and maintainably. Pair with the Front-end / AI Content Creator on client-facing outputs and presentation formats where needed. Join client discussions when technical credibility needs to be demonstrated or explained. Help the team move quickly from experiment to delivery while keeping quality high. Specialisation tracks We are hiring across a spread of strengths. You do not need to fit every track, but you should be strong in one and comfortable collaborating across all three. Software-engineering-leaning You bring strong software development fundamentals and take ownership of robustness, structure, and production quality. Data-science-leaning You bring strong ML and analytical grounding and are closest to the data science craft. Core AI / agents You bring depth in modern agent frameworks and LLM application patterns, with a practical understanding of what it takes to make them work in real settings. How you will be measured Our success is simple to state: demand for our work should outgrow our capacity. You’ll know you are succeeding when prototypes ship quickly, when partners keep coming back for more, and when more of what WAVE builds becomes reusable, scalable, and ready to deploy again. Why join us? You can be your best here. At Oliver Wyman, you will find meaningful work, talented people, and a culture built on trust, support, and growth. Create solutions that have impact Build AI-enabled work that helps our teams win work, sharpen proposals, and move faster on important opportunities. Turn promising ideas into working solutions that can support business development and project delivery. Be part of a team where success is measured not only by what is built, but by whether it can be reused, scaled, and sold again. Develop as a leader Take ownership from day one in a role that sits at the centre of WAVE’s delivery engine. Build credibility by making practical technical calls and helping others move quickly without losing quality. Develop the confidence to lead through technical judgement, collaboration, and clear communication. Learn without limits Build a rare mix of AI engineering, product thinking, and exposure to consulting-led delivery. Work closely with colleagues across Quotient and the wider firm, learning from both business and technical perspectives. Deepen your understanding of how to turn modern AI capabilities into solutions that are realistic, scalable, and reusable. Conception et paramétrage des agents IA spécialisés pour l'analyse et la structuration. Développement, tests et validation des résultats. Proposition d'une approche d’industrialisation du processus. Must Haves : Maîtrise des outils d’intelligence artificielle générative. Expérience en conception et paramétrage d'agents IA. Compétences en prompt engineering pour les documents normatifs. Capacité à gérer un corpus de documents volumineux. Nice to Haves : Connaissance des standards et référentiels de sécurité NIS et NIS 2. Expérience en automatisation de processus documentaires. Compétences en validation et contrôle de résultats pour garantir la conformité.

items.desc: S vyše 2,3 mil. zákazníkov patríme medzi lídrov v poskytovaní telekomunikačných služieb na slovenskom trhu. Ako prví prinášame prelomové inovácie na trhu, či už to bol prvý mobil za korunu alebo nová generácia siete 5G Standalone a stále ideme ďalej. Dnes poskytujeme komplexné telekomunikačné služby pre domácnosti aj podnikateľov vrátane mobilných služieb, pevného internetu, digitálnej televízie a moderných smart riešení. V prvom rade sme však starostlivý, zodpovedný a ľudský zamestnávateľ, a preto hľadáme rovnakých ľudí do nášho tímu. U nás budete od prvého dňa plnohodnotnou súčasťou firmy a našej komunity. Záleží nám na spoločnosti, v ktorej pôsobíme, vnímame svoju zodpovednosť voči nej, a preto sa angažujeme vo verejnoprospešných aktivitách. Pomáhame nášmu okoliu cez Nadáciu Orange, podporujeme mimovládne organizácie a tiež aktívnych jednotlivcov. Prostredníctvom týchto aktivít sa snažíme meniť svet na lepšie miesto pre všetkých. Záleží nám na tom, aby sa u nás každý cítil dobre. Veríme, že zamestnanie nie je len o hodnote, ktorú prinášate firme Vy, no i o tej, ktorú prináša firma Vám. Váš rozvoj je pre nás rovnako dôležitý ako pre Vás, preto Vás v ňom budeme podporovať. Sme hrdí na to, že sme starostlivý a zodpovedný zamestnávateľ. Pokiaľ Vás naša pozícia zaujala a zdieľate s nami rovnaké hodnoty, budeme sa tešiť na Váš životopis. Zaujíma ťa umelá inteligencia, machine learning a nové možnosti, ktoré prinášajú generatívne AI technológie? Budeš súčasťou tímu, ktorý navrhuje a nasadzuje moderné AI riešenia v prostredí veľkej technologickej spoločnosti. Získaš možnosť pracovať s najnovšími technológiami v oblasti umelej inteligencie, cloudových služieb a spracovania dát, pričom tvoje riešenia budú používať tisíce zákazníkov aj zamestnancov. Hľadáme človeka, ktorý má dobré základy v Data Science, rád experimentuje, neustále sa učí nové veci a chce sa rozvíjať v oblasti AI technológií.
