items.desc: ¿Te apasiona la IA Generativa y el Machine Learning? Desde LHH Buscamos un/a Senior Data Scientist para liderar proyectos estratégicos de Inteligencia Artificial con impacto real en negocio en una de las compañías más importantes del sector asegurador. RESPONSABILIDADES DEL PUESTO Colaborar con los responsables de su propia unidad y con el resto de las áreas de negocio y técnicas en la definición y desarrollo de proyectos analíticos, de Machine Learning y de IA, incluyendo IA generativa, asegurando el cumplimiento de plazos y expectativas, supervisando los entregables comprometidos e informando de avances, bloqueos y riesgos potenciales de forma proactiva. Trabajar de la mano con las distintas áreas del Grupo y la Red Agencial para entender en profundidad los problemas de negocio, aplicando escucha activa y teniendo en cuenta las particularidades de cada unidad en la definición de soluciones basadas en datos e IA. Analizar la información existente y proponer nuevas aproximaciones que permitan enriquecerla, incluyendo el uso de datos estructurados y no estructurados, con el objetivo de resolver retos de negocio mediante soluciones analíticas y de IA tradicional y generativa. Diseñar, evaluar y evolucionar soluciones basadas en Inteligencia Artificial aplicadas a casos de uso reales, asegurando su alineación con los objetivos de negocio y con los estándares técnicos del grupo. Definir cuándo utilizar modelos de IA generativa frente a modelos de machine learning tradicionales, reglas u otros enfoques analíticos, aplicando criterio técnico y de negocio. Diseñar y mantener soluciones de IA integradas con datos corporativos, así como definir diferentes métricas de utilidad para el negocio, y para el equipo de Data Science. Promover el uso responsable y controlado de los datos y de la IA dentro de la compañía, conforme a las políticas internas de seguridad, privacidad, cumplimiento y a los estándares de calidad y legalidad establecidos. Aportar capacidades de tratamiento y preparación del dato cuando sea necesario, como soporte a soluciones analíticas y de IA, garantizando la calidad de la información utilizada. Interpretar los resultados de modelos analíticos, de Machine Learning y de sistemas de IA generativa, identificar oportunidades de mejora y proponer estrategias alternativas, comunicando de forma clara los procesos y conclusiones tanto a perfiles técnicos como de negocio. Definir y supervisar KPIs para monitorizar modelos analíticos y soluciones de IA, incluyendo métricas de rendimiento, calidad, uso, costes, latencia, posibles drifts y métricas de gobierno. Liderar proyectos de Data Science y AI de manera individual o en colaboración con otros miembros del equipo y con equipos de consultoría externos, actuando como referente técnico. Mantener y mejorar soluciones analíticas y de IA ya existentes, asegurando su correcta evolución y operatividad en entornos productivos. Documentar las soluciones desarrolladas, justificando las decisiones técnicas adoptadas y definiendo los procesos operativos asociados. Colaborar en los procesos de identificación, evaluación y negociación con proveedores de soluciones analíticas y de IA tradicional y generativa, participando en la definición de los requerimientos técnicos y de control necesarios para el correcto desarrollo de los proyectos. EXPERIENCIA, CONOCIMIENTOS Y HABILIDADES REQUERIDAS Experiencia deseada: Experiencia profesional de al menos 4 años en departamentos de ciencia de datos, con participación en proyectos de analítica avanzada y soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial. Experiencia práctica en proyectos que incorporen modelos de IA generativa (LLMs), e IA agéntica aplicados a casos de negocio reales. Conocimiento de técnicas de prompting, y de evaluación de sistemas de Gen AI, así como de buenas prácticas para el aseguramiento de la calidad de los sistemas de Gen AI, como pueden ser el uso de guardarraíles. Se valorará positivamente haber participado en proyectos del sector del seguro y haber trabajado en otras compañías aseguradoras. Experiencia en trabajo en equipo. Experiencia en coordinación y liderazgo de proyectos analíticos y de IA. Conocimientos avanzados matemáticos y estadísticos, y en técnicas de preparación de datos en bruto (estructurados y no estructurados, incluyendo texto) y creación de modelos de Machine Learning de diferente tipología tales como series temporales, modelos de regresión y apoyo a soluciones de IA generativa. Experiencia en evaluación, monitorización y mejora de modelos y soluciones de IA generativa, incluyendo métricas de calidad, uso y control de resultados. Se valorará positivamente el doctorado. Conocimientos Requeridos: Conocimientos de Python y PySpark, aplicados al desarrollo de soluciones analíticas y de Inteligencia Artificial. items.desc: About Us Fuzzy Labs is a fast-growing, Manchester-based tech consultancy that helps a diverse range of clients productionise machine learning using Open Source MLOps. We exist to help our customers harness and channel the power of AI safely and effectively, to make positive change and use AI for good. Our work sits across the whole development lifecycle, from prototyping new machine learning models to building scalable and secure production ML systems, and everything in between. Our work spans disruptive startups, multi-national organisations, policing, and secure government sectors, providing you with the unique opportunity to make a tangible, real-world impact. We've had considerable growth over the last few years and we’re looking to continue with this momentum as we build on our reputation as Open Source MLOps experts, expand our role within the community, and continue to deliver high-quality solutions to our clients. What We’re Looking For The ideal candidate will be motivated to grow and progress in line with the company’s ambitions: we’re looking for passionate engineers with an appetite for keeping up with the cutting edge, an eye for detail, and a knack for creative problem solving. As well as being a great engineer, motivated by the chance to be at the forefront of MLOps adoption, you’ll also enjoy being part of a culture that values: Loving what we do: a real passion for Open Source, MLOps, and taking pride in our work. Just trying it: MLOps is an exciting new field. We love to develop new skills, solve new problems and thrive on a challenge. Being greater than the sum of parts: we are a team, one that isn’t just us but our customers and our community. Positive impact: AI is going to change the world. We choose to use it for good and leave a positive legacy. A typical day Our Engineers Collaborate Closely With Their Team Leads And The Customer To Design And Implement High Quality Solutions. We Encourage Our Engineers To Work With a High Degree Of Autonomy And Own Workstreams Across Every Stage Of The Project Delivery Lifecycle, Including Working closely with clients to understand their needs, build strong relationships, and bring them along on the journey. This includes presenting back our solutions in demos and participating in workshops and training sessions. Designing and implementing features to a high standard of engineering, including good documentation and automated testing. Contributing to sprint planning sessions, retrospectives and code reviews, working with your team lead to plan your project work. Ensuring our high engineering standards are maintained and our clients are delighted. Staying up-to-date with a fast-moving industry, embracing new tools and frameworks, and sharing our learnings with the team. As well as client work, we also set aside time to work on R&D projects and produce content in the form of blogs and videos. These projects are how we keep on top of a fast-moving technology landscape, in addition to being our greatest source of marketing. You’ll have the opportunity to craft your own voice in the MLOps community through R&D content. Skills And Experience Our team is made up of a mix of backgrounds. We are looking for smart, curious people who are always expanding their knowledge and exploring new and emerging technologies. If you get excited about keeping up with the newest machine learning research, or figuring out how to scale generative models in the cloud, then you’ll fit right in. Some of the skills and experience we look for include: An undergraduate degree in computer science, mathematics, or similar, or a relevant postgraduate degree. A passion for coding, machine learning, and open source technologies. Proven experience building production-grade ML software in Python - this could include training models from scratch, serving models as web services, or integrating data stores. Experience with cloud computing, for example AWS, Google Cloud or Azure, along with modern DevOps practices and infrastructure-as-code tools. Experience delivering software using an agile development methodology. Fluency in our core tooling: Git, Unix/Linux, Docker, and common open-source MLOps tools. Plus, a strong opinion on your IDE / editor of choice is welcome ;) You should be aware of the broad landscape of machine learning applications, tools, and technologies and willing to deepen your knowledge. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements. MLOps is an emerging field, which sits somewhere in the intersection of data science, machine learning engineering, and DevOps. We’re excited to speak to candidates from any of these backgrounds; you don’t need an explicit MLOps background to apply for this role, as you’ll learn as you go by immersing yourself in this exciting new field. Benefits By joining a growing company you’ll have the chance to make a real impact on its future. There’s plenty of room for growth and we’ll work with you to help you realise …

Das treibt dich an und bringt dich vorwärts. Du lernst täglich dazu und wächst daran. Zusammen mit uns. Agentic AI Engineer (all genders) 80 - 100 % Luzern Luzern Luzern, Luzern 6004 Schweiz Du bist begeistert von KI und möchtest mit deiner Expertise innovative KI-Lösungen in der Praxis voranbringen? Dann bist du bei uns richtig. Was du bewirkst Du entwickelst und optimierst die zentrale KI-Plattform der Suva und stellst deren zuverlässigen Betrieb sicher. Für Entwicklungs- und Produktteams schaffst du die technischen Voraussetzungen, damit sie KI-Services sicher und effizient nutzen können. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Architektur-, Security- und Plattformteams förderst du die Wiederverwendung gemeinsamer Plattform-Services und Self-Service-Angebote. Für KI-Agenten, Multi-Agent-Systeme und agentenbasierte Geschäftsprozesse definierst du Standards und Best Practices. Mit deinem Know-how gestaltest du den Aufbau und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der KI-Fähigkeiten der Suva aktiv mit. Was du mitbringst Du verfügst über einen Hochschulabschluss in Informatik (ETH, Universität oder Fachhochschule) oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung. Als Software Engineer, Platform Engineer, AI Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle hast du rund fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung gesammelt. Im Aufbau, Betrieb oder in der Weiterentwicklung von Cloud- und Plattformlösungen bringst du praktische Erfahrung mit. Mit Agent Harnesses, Agentic-AI-Frameworks sowie Foundation- und Frontier-LLMs hast du erste Erfahrungen gesammelt. Du interessierst dich für moderne KI-Technologien und deren sicheren, produktiven Einsatz im Unternehmensumfeld. Wie du bei uns wächst Ein Team, das dich begleitet: Lerne von anderen und entwickle dich fachlich und persönlich weiter. Ein Umfeld für Neues: Bring frische Ideen und Lösungen ein – für uns, unsere Versicherten und die Schweiz. Eine sinnvolle Aufgabe: Du weisst, was du tust und warum. Klingt gut? Sende uns deine Bewerbung. Du hast Fragen? Nico Joller, Talent Acquisition Manager, ist für dich da: 📞 041 419 5843

items.card: In this role, you will provide technical guidance to migration, engineering, and clinical teams, ensuring a shared understanding of algorithm behavior and expected output characteristics. If you are passionate about applying your expertise in data science to validate algorithms and support system transitions, this opportunity may be the right fit for you. Your tasks Providing technical guidance on signal processing
items.desc: We are looking for a Signal Processing & Data Analysis Specialist to join our Data Science team. In this role, you will provide technical guidance to migration, engineering, and clinical teams, ensuring a shared understanding of algorithm behavior and expected output characteristics. If you are passionate about applying your expertise in data science to validate algorithms and support system transitions, this opportunity may be the right fit for you. Your tasks Providing technical guidance on signal processing to migration, engineering, and clinical teams, ensuring a shared understanding of algorithm behavior and expected output characteristics Analyzing datasets to identify deviations, edge cases, and anomalies, applying appropriate statistical methods to assess the significance of discrepancies Deconstructing the logic of existing signal processing algorithms and producing clear, well-structured documentation to support validation efforts and enable knowledge transfer across teams Contributing to the design of validation frameworks and test cases, including defining tolerance thresholds and acceptance criteria for comparing algorithm outputs across environments Developing and executing CSV-based comparison workflows to verify the consistency of algorithmic output, identifying and quantifying discrepancies Collaborating with data migration specialists and engineers to resolve data-integrity issues, ensuring all deviations are properly quantified, documented, and traceable Requirements Minimum 5 years of experience with algorithm or software validation, developing data comparison or reconciliation workflows using large tabular or CSV datasets PhD in Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field Solid understanding of digital signal processing and time-series analysis Proficiency in Python, including familiarity with libraries like SciPy, NumPy, or pandas Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to stakeholders outside your specialty Advanced level of English and residency in Poland Nice to have Familiarity with database migrations or platform equivalency testing Experience with high-frequency sensor data Job no. JOB-X6HBA Sii ensures that all hiring decisions are made solely on the basis of qualifications and competence. We are committed to equal and fair treatment of all, regardless of legally protected characteristics. At Sii, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment, in full compliance with applicable anti-discrimination laws.

items.desc: ⚡️About Volter Volter is a top-tier climate VC-backed B2B energy tech platform building the products that make clean, renewable power simple for businesses everywhere. The energy transition is a huge and vital opportunity, but it's currently too difficult for commercial & industrial companies to achieve. Historically, the energy industry has been too opaque, complex and lacking in trust. We’re fixing that. Our aim is to be the “Octopus Energy for industry”: a modern tech platform providing new renewable energy products with radical transparency — accelerating deployment of renewables and helping customers cut cost and carbon without complexity. We’re excited to use technology to help our customers deploy & utilise more renewable energy and fast forward the energy transition - and we need your help! 💼 Role: Data Scientist You’ll lead our data science work, including owning forecasting and pricing optimisation: producing accurate half‑hourly demand and generation forecasts, shaping prices, quantifying uncertainty and translating it into simple decisions for customers and our supply portfolio. You’ll own the full model lifecycle—from problem framing and baselines to productionisation, monitoring and iterative improvement. You are a self-starter who excels both independently and in a team. You dislike corporate structure and bureaucracy, and believe in a "best idea wins" culture. This is why you prefer a growth-oriented, flat, startup environment. A desire to keep learning and having an impact is very important to you. You fear looking back in 10 years time and realising you never made a difference…that you were simply a tiny cog in a large machine that will churn on with or without you. 🛠️ Day-to-day Responsibilities Build, validate and deploy time‑series models (including probabilistic where useful) and matching optimisation algorithms for customer demand and generation and constantly improve model performance Understand customer profiles and develop relevant features from HHD, weather, calendar and price inputs; set up robust back‑tests and error attribution Develop, maintain and improve pricing and trading decision engines to maximise PnL Alongside engineering, create reliable feature/data ETL pipelines, and partner with product to surface insights in the platform Create risk and hedging analytics (e.g., shape/volume error distributions, scenario analysis, what‑if tools) Design monitoring for model/data drift; manage model registries and experiment tracking Be responsible for driving new initiatives to improve business outcomes from a data science perspective and be able to drive and own from idea to scoping, production and maintaining Communicate results clearly to non‑technical stakeholders; build explainability into outputs 🧩 What Experience You Bring 4–8+ years in Data Science/ML with a focus on time‑series forecasting and decision analytics Strong Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit‑learn, statsmodels; PyTorch/TF a plus) and SQL; rigorous evaluation (MAE/RMSE, MAPE, pinball loss) Experience productionising models (APIs/batch jobs), experiment tracking (e.g., MLflow) and basic MLOps Being able to evaluate the right tools for the job given business requirements & experiment with new ways of doing things to continuously improve Comfort combining statistical baselines with ML methods (gradient boosting, GLMs, probabilistic models) We need a hands‑on lead who can ship useful forecasts and iterate quickly without a big platform team. Energy experience accelerates you, but we’ll value evidence that you can master domain context fast and build pragmatic, explainable models that survive contact with production. 💥 Stand‑out Candidates Will Have Experience In… GB energy markets (half‑hourly settlement, weather‑driven load, network tariffs) and portfolio risk analytics Experience with AWS and infrastructure (eg Terraform) Experience and willingness to surface insights in relevant UIs/products Forecast explainability, uncertainty quantification and decision tooling for non‑technical users Optimisation (LP/MIP) for hedging or tariff design 🤘Who You Are Curious, pragmatic and outcome‑driven. You love shipping models that make decisions better today rather than making them better tomorrow. You are energised by early-stage businesses, are adaptable and thrive within startup environments. You have a strong bias toward action and having an impact quickly. You want to get sh*t done. You are a self-starter and autonomous in your way of working, but ultimately believe a team can get further together than any individual. You communicate clearly and keep things as simple as possible. 🌱 What You Can Expect From Us A dynamic and fast-changing environment with incredible responsibility and autonomy Working directly with and learning from experienced startup founders who’ve invested in and scaled businesses up to several billion dollars in valuation The ability to build and own something from the very beginning Working on …

items.desc: Data Engineer met AI-ambities? Zet de volgende stap bij ons! Dit bieden wij jou Een groeiende organisatie met uitdagende klanten en projecten in verschillende branches; Een leuke functie in een gezellige werkomgeving met veel autonomie; Uitstekend salaris, een leaseauto, een bonusregeling, een smartphone en een laptop; De mogelijkheid om parttime te werken (minimaal 24 uur), 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid meer dagen op te bouwen; Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals een premievrij pensioen en de optie om gunstig aandelen te kopen; De ruimte en de middelen om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je o.a. toegang tot de Vinci Academy en andere omgevingen waar een heel afwisselend aanbod aan trainingen en opleiding wordt aangeboden. Wil je meer weten of vrijblijvend eens koffie drinken? Leuk! Bel of app dan met Bert van Oort, 06 13 84 29 76, of mail [email protected] , of maak een connectie met jouw LinkedIn profiel. Bert van Oort neemt dan contact met je op. Hier krijg jij energie van Als Data & AI Engineer voeg jij daadwerkelijk slimme AI toe aan de data van onze klanten, zodat zij er direct meer waarde uit kunnen halen. Je werkt praktisch en hands-on: op het snijvlak van data science, data engineering, cloud engineering en softwareontwikkeling zorg je ervoor dat data tot leven komt met AI. Samen met je collega’s integreer je AI-oplossingen in bestaande processen, waardoor data niet alleen inzichtelijker wordt, maar ook direct bijdraagt aan betere besluitvorming en efficiënter werken. Betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid en concrete impact staan daarbij altijd voorop. Je richt je op het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en verfijnen van geavanceerde AI-oplossingen, zoals generatieve AI en LLM’s, waarbij de nadruk ligt op het benutten van de nieuwste AI-technieken. Je brengt deze modellen naar productie door gebruik te maken van moderne MLOps-methoden. Daarnaast bouw je robuuste AI-platformen in Azure en schakel je naar andere cloudomgevingen wanneer dat nodig is. Het integreren van AI in bedrijfsprocessen gebeurt bijvoorbeeld via API’s, SDK’s of copilots, waarbij je slimme methodieken en geavanceerde prompt engineering inzet om AI direct te koppelen aan de kenmerken van de organisatie. Je werkt nauw samen met jouw collega data engineers, architecten, specialisten en uiteraard met klanten. Je begeleidt implementaties en helpt medewerkers om AI-oplossingen te omarmen, zodat deze blijvende waarde opleveren. Ook draag je actief bij aan onze interne AI community en deel je jouw kennis tijdens kennissessies om gezamenlijk te groeien. Hier herken jij jezelf in In deze rol zoeken we iemand met een breed en veelzijdig profiel. We realiseren ons dat het volledige plaatje complex is en dat het goed mogelijk is dat je slechts een deel van het profiel beheerst. Dat is geen probleem. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je nieuwsgierig bent, wilt leren en energie krijgt van nieuwe uitdagingen. Deze functie raakt verschillende delen van ons vakgebied en sluit aan op nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen. Waar nodig helpen we je graag om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen, zodat je in deze rol kunt groeien. Je bent bekend met het ontwikkelen en implementeren van AI en ML-modellen en beschikt over solide kennis van Python, SQL en ETL-principes. Je hebt ervaring met Azure AI en Azure Machine Learning en vindt het geen probleem om ook met andere omgevingen te werken. Daarnaast weet je hoe je AI-oplossingen integreert via API’s of SDK’s. Je voelt je thuis in een multidisciplinaire omgeving waarin heldere communicatie essentieel is. Je schakelt gemakkelijk met klanten en collega’s en denkt actief mee over hoe AI waarde kan genereren binnen verschillende organisaties. Je bent nieuwsgierig, oplossingsgericht en altijd op zoek naar nieuwe technologieën en manieren om werk slimmer te maken. Je geniet van complexe vraagstukken en krijgt energie van het vinden van elegante en effectieve oplossingen. Je voelt je thuis in een dynamische werkomgeving waarin je de ruimte krijgt om jezelf te ontwikkelen en eventueel door te groeien richting rollen als bijvoorbeeld Senior, Lead Engineer of Architect. Dit is jouw team Bij Axians geloven we dat onze mensen het verschil maken. Binnen onze Business Analytics unit werk je met de nieuwste Microsoft en IBM-technologieën, waaronder met ons eigen dataplatform Maestro. Samen helpen we klanten om hun data écht te benutten en om te zetten in waardevolle inzichten en innovatieve toepassingen.

Operiamo su tutto il territorio nazionale e all’estero, con headquarter a Milano – in Piazza Duomo, nella storica Via Hoepli – e presenza a Brescia, Padova, Modena, Bologna, Torino. items.desc: Application Deadline: 8 November 2026 Department: GTM Adoption Location: London Compensation: £51,872.50 - £76,555.50 / year Description We're hiring an AI Learning Designer to write lessons for our AI masterclasses and lead the improvement of the AI-marked assignments that show whether learners actually change how they work. This isn’t a traditional instructional design role. You won’t build e-learning modules or storyboard compliance courses. Our masterclasses pair short video lessons with role-specific assignments, built with prompts and marked by AI with immediate feedback. You’ll lead how we review and improve those assignments across our curriculum: what we ask learners to do, how we mark it, and whether it leads to meaningful outcomes. You’ll also share ownership of our curriculum with our AI Learning Writer, split by AI provider, such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot. For your provider, you’ll write the scripts and lessons, and keep them current as new features ship. What you'll own Assignment quality: Develop clear quality standards with the Head of AI Learning, then review, test and redesign our prompts, tasks and marking criteria using learning science and sound prompt engineering. Your first big project is auditing assignments across our masterclasses and delivering the agreed redesigns. Your provider’s courses: Write scripts and demonstrations for new and refreshed courses. When your provider ships something that matters, test it yourself, decide what learners need to know, and update the course. Our content management system: Run day-to-day publishing and maintenance, fix problems as they come up, and improve the agentic tools we use to manage content. Learning objectives: Keep your provider’s objectives sharp, so what we teach, what we assess and what learners can do afterwards all line up. Learning what works: Use submission, feedback, completion and drop-off data to judge whether an assignment does its job. AI handles much of the analysis. We need your judgement on what it means for learners and the business. What we're looking for We hire for aptitude, hunger and a bias to action over years of experience. This role works best for someone who thinks in outcomes, cares how people learn, and opens a new AI tool the day it launches. You might come from consulting, product, research, teaching, edtech or learning design itself. You'll bring evidence of: Sustained, hands-on use of AI: prompts that do real work, comfort with agentic tools, and a feel for where models are reliable and where they need checking Thinking hard about how people learn, whether through teaching, tutoring, coaching or building training. You don’t need formal training in learning science, but you’ll want to go deep on it. Thinking in outcomes and working rigorously: you define success, measure what matters and act on what you find, moving quickly while catching the details others miss Clear writing that makes technical ideas simple without making them dull Learning fast and taking ownership of finished work, to deadlines Useful but not essential: Experience in learning design, assessment, learning science or edtech A background in consulting, product, research or similar analytical work Experience evaluating AI outputs or designing marking rubrics Experience with content management systems, automation or no-code tools We know great candidates don't always tick every box. If the scope excites you and you think your experience could translate, we'd love to hear from you. What you'll get A small, high-performing learning team, where everyone owns substantial work and what you build reaches hundreds of organisations in the UK and internationally. Equity: Everyone at PAIR is offered equity, because we want everyone to share in what we build together. Holiday: 25 days, plus bank holidays Learning: access to the best AI tools and PAIR’s own masterclasses A path to grow your career: we’re an early stage company that promotes from within. As we continue to scale, the opportunities to grow with us will only increase. Regular social events: to celebrate the wins, unwind and enjoy the journey together! The fine print This role is hybrid, with 2 days per week in our central London office We also come together for 7 company-wide Anchor Weeks each year (in person, Monday to Thursday). Inclusion and adjustments We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Every candidate for this role is assessed against the same published criteria, by interviewers using the same core questions. If you need any reasonable adjustments at any stage - a different format, more time, or flexible scheduling - just let us know.

items.desc: About This Role As an AI Business Operations Graduate, you will be part of Biogen's Customer Excellence & Operations (CE&O) team in Benelux, embarking on a dynamic 12-month paid program. This role offers a unique opportunity to explore the intersection of artificial intelligence and business operations within the pharmaceutical industry. You will contribute to the EU18 AI Accelerator, a collaborative hub where AI agents are designed, tested, and implemented to solve real business challenges across 18 European countries. You will work closely with the CE&O Omnichannel Manager, building AI agents using low-code tools like Microsoft Copilot Studio and transforming proven solutions into reusable blueprints. This program asks you to automate key processes, support various teams, and ensure compliance with Biogen's data privacy and responsible AI standards. By the end of the program, your contributions will help shape recommendations for scaling the AI accelerator across Europe. What You’ll Do You will be part of BioTrain, Biogen’s graduate program, combining hands-on experience with structured training, mentoring and exposure to different areas of the pharmaceutical industry. You will build practical skills, expand your professional network and gain valuable experience to support your future career. Map business processes, and identify ways that they can be redesigned, to maximally leverage AI Design and test AI agents for the EU18 AI Accelerator, transforming ideas into functional solutions. Collaborate with IT and business partners to ensure agents meet local needs and compliance standards. Support automation of Customer & Market Insights and Field Force Effectiveness processes. Leverage AI and automation to reduce manual effort in recurring insight generation, reporting, and field-force analytics. Provide operational assistance to Commercial, Medical, and Value & Access teams. Train and assist users in adopting AI agents, collecting feedback for continuous improvement. Document and report progress, tracking key performance indicators to measure success. Ensure all developments adhere to Biogen’s compliance, data privacy, and responsible AI guidelines. Engage with cross-functional teams to enhance workflow optimization and process improvement. Present your work and recommendations to senior leadership, showcasing your impact. Who You Are You are a recent graduate with a passion for exploring how AI can transform business operations. Your curiosity drives you to understand and leverage technology to achieve business goals. You possess a strong foundation in a relevant discipline, combined with a broad interest in business and data. Your analytical mindset allows you to solve problems methodically, while your communication skills help you convey ideas clearly and motivate others. You thrive both independently and collaboratively, eager to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment. Required Skills Recent Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Business Analytics, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Digital Marketing, or a related field. Hands-on experience with AI technologies, such as building custom GPTs or automation tools. Fluent in English, both written and spoken; Dutch and French are advantageous. Understanding of generative AI applications and their limitations. Awareness of data privacy (GDPR) and responsible AI practices. Structured working style with strong planning and documentation skills. Ability to collaborate with diverse teams across functions and countries. Valid permit or right to work in the Netherlands or Belgium. Preferred start date: January 2027, with flexibility for the right candidate. Preferred Skills Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, or Power Platform. Exposure to pharma, healthcare, or other regulated industries. Experience in training users or explaining digital tools to colleagues. Job Level: Internship Why Biogen? We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. As a mid-sized biotechnology company, we provide the stability and resources of a well-established business while fostering an environment where individual contributions make a significant impact. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills. Above all, we work together to deliver life-changing medicines, with every role playing a vital part in our mission. Caring Deeply. Achieving Excellence. Changing Lives. At Biogen, we are committed to building on our culture of inclusion and belonging that reflects the communities where we operate and the patients we serve. We know that diverse backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives make us a stronger and more innovative company, and we are focused on building teams where every employee feels empowered and inspired. items.desc: Job Description At Luminus, our ambition is to become the number one energy company in customer focus while continuously improving operational efficiency. Within Customer Experience & Care, our e-Care team plays a key role in delivering seamless digital customer experiences through omnichannel solutions, self-service and innovative AI technologies. As CX AI Solutions Specialist, you take ownership of bringing AI to life across our customer care channels. You bridge the gap between AI strategy, technology and business needs, developing solutions that enhance customer interactions and empower our customer-facing teams. From identifying opportunities to delivering and optimising AI solutions, you ensure that innovation translates into measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, operational efficiency and digital service quality. What You’ll Do Identifying and evaluating AI opportunities across our customer care ecosystem, including chatbots, virtual assistants, agent-assist solutions and emerging technologies, translating customer and business needs into impactful initiatives. Leading AI projects from concept to implementation and adoption, defining business requirements, assessing feasibility and building business cases to ensure successful delivery and measurable results. Driving the continuous improvement of AI-powered customer and employee interactions through performance monitoring, prompt engineering, conversational design and ongoing optimisation. Acting as the AI expert and business owner within e-Care, collaborating closely with IT, Data, Enterprise Architecture, the AI Impact Retail team and other stakeholders to align AI initiatives with business priorities. Measuring and optimising the impact of AI solutions on customer satisfaction, interaction quality, operational efficiency and cost savings, using data and insights to identify further improvement opportunities. Accelerating AI adoption across customer-facing teams by supporting change management, promoting new ways of working and ensuring solutions comply with data privacy, security and responsible AI principles. What You Bring You hold a master's degree or have at least 3 years of relevant professional experience, preferably at the intersection of customer experience, IT and AI. You have a strong understanding of AI technologies and their applications in customer care, including conversational AI, virtual assistants, automation and digital customer engagement. You have hands-on knowledge of prompt engineering and conversational design, combined with an understanding of enterprise customer experience platforms such as Salesforce, Genesys Cloud or equivalent solutions. You combine strong project management skills with a strategic and analytical mindset, translating business needs into concrete technical requirements and successfully delivering digital or AI initiatives. You are a proactive, curious and solution-oriented professional with excellent communication, stakeholder management and change management skills, capable of engaging both business and technical audiences. You are fluent in English and either Dutch or French, with a good working knowledge of the other national language, and are comfortable travelling between Luminus locations when needed. Benefits Of Working At Luminus The energy sector is one of the most rewarding industries in Belgium with a highly rewarding compensation and benefits package: Competitive compensation: Attractive salary with a performance-based bonus that can be optimized to your personal preferences, plus meal vouchers. Insurance & social benefits: Group insurance and hospitalization coverage for the entire family. Additional reimbursement for healthcare and pharmaceutical costs. Mobility: Full reimbursement for public transport, kilometer-based cycling reimbursement and flexible mobility choices such as a company car or mobility budget. Internet & communication: Home internet covered, reimbursement for a personal mobile device with a phone subscription. Home Office: A fully-equipped home office, including an ergonomical ICT set-up. Exclusive discounts: 30% off gas and electricity after six months, discounts on energy-saving services (e.g., solar panels, heat pumps) and reduced prices on top brands, amusement parks, festivals and more. You make a direct impact on Luminus’ EBITDA and strategic growth. You join a collaborative, forward-thinking team at the heart of the energy transition. You work and connect with your colleagues at a Luminus office or from home. Need some flexibility? Your manager is open to discuss what works. Luminus values e.v.e.r.y individual. items.desc:
Applied AI Engineer - Direct Acquisition
 We're planning this as a six-month secondment. There may be an opportunity to extend it or make it permanent.
 We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer to join the Direct Acquisition team. 
 You'll design and build AI agents that run whole business processes, from planning the work to learning from the results. What you find will steer how far iwoca takes agents across the business.
 The company 
 Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.
 That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.
 We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £5 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.
 The team 
 Direct Acquisition includes iwoca's Marketing, Sales, Brand and Acquisition Tech teams. Together, they reach UK businesses of all shapes and sizes through paid and organic marketing channels and direct sales.
 A new team in Direct Acquisition builds agents that automate and improve acquisition processes. That's its only focus, and it works closely with Acquisition Tech. It's small – a product owner and you – and everyone builds. You'll report to the Head of Direct Acquisition, who sets the commercial direction.
 The role 
 As the Applied AI Engineer, you'll build the agents and the systems around them. Most of the work is system design and backend engineering.
 You'll start with direct mail. The first goal is an agent that plans each monthly round, uses iwoca's existing predictive models to build the mailing file, and learns from the results as they come in. The pattern is simple to say and hard to get right: the agent orchestrates, deterministic code does the work, and a human in the loop approves the file before it goes to print. You'll work with the people who run each process to understand the edge cases, and with Core Systems and Compliance on access and controls.
 The agents don't exist yet, and much is still open: which processes the team takes on, and what the architecture looks like. You'll own those design decisions and write most of the code yourself, much of it with AI coding tools. Some of this won't work, and finding out why is one of the main outputs of the role.
 Architecture. You'll design what agents need to run reliably: memory that persists between runs, task management, access to tools, permissions, and a record of every decision and why. You'll build each piece so the next process can reuse it. 
 Guardrails. You'll decide where the agent uses judgement and where code enforces rules the agent can't change, like suppressions, compliance checks and budget limits. 
 Delivery. You'll own each agent end to end: connect it to iwoca's predictive models, data pipelines and channel tools, and run it alongside the current process until it has shown it works. 
 Measurement. You'll track how often agents need a person, where they fail, what they cost, and what they're worth. 
 The requirements 
 We're looking for the depth of someone who has solved hard problems, and the pace of someone who moves fast in areas that are new to them.
 Essential:
 System ownership. You've owned a complex system end to end, from design to running it in production, and lived with the consequences of your architecture choices. 
 Design judgement. You've made architecture decisions other people built on, and you can explain the trade-offs and what you'd change. When an idea won't work, you say so and offer a better one. 
 Pace. You've got things live quickly in unfamiliar areas and they kept working once people relied on them. 
 Agent engineering. You've built systems where LLMs take actions – more than chat or summaries – and you can explain what went wrong and how you fixed it. You know when a problem needs an agent and when it needs a for-loop. 
 Controls. You've built permissions, data access rules and audit trails into systems from the start. 
 Constructive challenge. You work well with commercial and product colleagues, and when an idea won't work, you say so and offer a better one. 
 AI leverage. You've used AI coding tools to produce engineering work you couldn't have delivered without them – a service, an integration, or an internal tool others use. You have opinions on how to get the most out of them, and you check their output before it reaches production. 
 Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

items.desc: AI verandert de manier waarop marketingteams werken. Van het ontwikkelen van content tot het automatiseren van processen en het persoonlijker maken van klantcommunicatie. Ook voor een organisatie als ENGIE, waar grote ambities op het gebied van digitalisering en klantgerichtheid samenkomen, biedt dat volop mogelijkheden. Maar hoe vertaal je die ontwikkelingen naar slimme toepassingen die niet alleen op papier interessant zijn, maar ook in de praktijk écht iets toevoegen? ENGIE Nederland is onderdeel van een van de grootste internationale energiebedrijven ter wereld. Met de kennis, slagkracht en ervaring van een wereldwijde organisatie speelt ENGIE ook in Nederland een belangrijke rol in de energietransitie. Onder andere met de recente opening van een van de grootste batterijparken van Nederland en een leidende positie in de zakelijke energiemarkt. In de consumentenmarkt is ENGIE juist een challenger met grote groeiambities, die de markt wil uitdagen met slimme, duurzame en klantgerichte energieoplossingen. Die ambitie vraagt om meer dan alleen duurzame energie. Ook de manier waarop ENGIE klanten bereikt, helpt en bedient, verandert. Klanten verwachten steeds persoonlijkere, relevantere en eenvoudigere digitale ervaringen. Tegelijkertijd bieden data, technologie en AI volop kansen om commerciële processen slimmer in te richten, de klantbeleving te verbeteren en verdere groei te realiseren. ENGIE investeert volop in deze ontwikkelingen. Er zijn al verschillende AI-tools, mogelijkheden en trainingen beschikbaar. De volgende stap? Die mogelijkheden vertalen naar concrete toepassingen die het dagelijkse werk verbeteren en daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor klanten en collega's. Daarom bouwen ze binnen Marketing & Sales aan een nieuwe manier van werken, waarin AI niet alleen wordt verkend, maar ook structureel wordt ingezet. Van AI-experiment naar dagelijkse praktijk Een salescollega die met behulp van AI sneller tot een passend klantadvies komt. Een slimme workflow die contentcreatie versnelt. Of een toepassing die klantdata gebruikt om communicatie persoonlijker te maken en de juiste vervolgstap richting een klant te bepalen. Als AI Marketing & Content Engineer onderzoek je hoe generatieve AI en automatisering dit soort verbeteringen mogelijk maken. Je beweegt op het snijvlak van AI, marketing, content en sales en vertaalt technologische mogelijkheden naar praktische oplossingen voor de commerciële organisatie. Soms ontdek je zelf een nieuwe toepassing, soms komt een team met een concreet vraagstuk. Jij onderzoekt wat mogelijk is, bouwt een eerste oplossing, test deze met gebruikers en verbetert haar totdat collega's er daadwerkelijk mee kunnen werken. Je zorgt ervoor dat goede ideeën niet blijven steken in losse experimenten, maar uitgroeien tot bruikbare en schaalbare toepassingen. Wat ga je doen? Je ontwikkelt en implementeert AI-toepassingen Je bouwt, implementeert en beheert AI-agents, GPT's en andere AI-assistenten voor commerciële processen. Je onderzoekt waar AI het verschil kan maken en vertaalt ideeën naar werkende oplossingen die aansluiten op de praktijk van ENGIE. Je automatiseert en verbetert commerciële processen Je ontwerpt slimme workflows die werkzaamheden versnellen, de kwaliteit verhogen en processen schaalbaarder maken. Denk aan toepassingen voor contentcreatie, salesondersteuning en klantcommunicatie, maar ook aan personalisatie, lead scoring, next-best-action en retentie. Je maakt AI toegankelijk voor collega's Je ontwikkelt prompt libraries, formats en praktische richtlijnen waarmee collega's AI effectief en verantwoord kunnen inzetten. Je inspireert, traint en begeleidt teams en helpt hen nieuwe toepassingen onderdeel te maken van hun dagelijkse werk. Je test, leert en verbetert continu Je werkt nauw samen met commerciële teams om kansen te identificeren, oplossingen te testen en feedback op te halen. Je volgt ontwikkelingen binnen generatieve AI, automation en conversational AI en bepaalt welke innovaties relevant zijn voor ENGIE. Kansrijke toepassingen verbeter je en schaal je waar mogelijk verder op. Je zorgt voor verantwoord gebruik van AI Je houdt bij het ontwikkelen en implementeren van toepassingen rekening met kwaliteit, privacy, veiligheid en verantwoord gebruik. Je bouwt AI-capabilities die de gehele commerciële organisatie kunnen ondersteunen. Het commerciële resultaat en het eigenaarschap van de processen blijven bij de betreffende domeinen. Dit is jouw speelveld Je wordt onderdeel van het team Marketing Automation & AI en werkt vanuit het ENGIE-kantoor in Zwolle. Je trekt samen op met collega's uit onder andere content, digitale marketing en klantbehoud om technologie praktisch toepasbaar te maken en klanten beter en persoonlijker te helpen. ENGIE is volop in beweging. Binnen Marketing & Sales worden nieuwe teams gevormd en nieuwe manieren van werken ontwikkeld. Omdat deze functie nieuw is, ligt nog niet alles vast. Je krijgt de ruimte om zelf kansen te signaleren, …

items.desc: Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso. DEINE ROLLE Agentic Low Code: Du entwickelst als Agentic Low Code Developer mit Copilot Studio und der Power Platform agentische Geschäftslösungen für die Fachbereiche unserer Kunden – von intelligenten Apps und Hyperautomation bis zu Multi-Agenten-Szenarien im Enterprise-Umfeld. Du verbindest Low Code, KI und Prozessautomatisierung zu produktiven Lösungen und unterstützt beim Aufbau skalierbarer Governance-Strukturen. Agentische Low-Code-Entwicklung mit Copilot Studio: Du entwickelst mit Copilot Studio maßgeschneiderte KI-Agenten und Copiloten – inkl. Anbindung an Microsoft 365, Dataverse und branchenspezifische Datenquellen – und etablierst agentische Low-Code-Entwicklungsprozesse als gelebte Praxis: von der Orchestrierung mehrerer Agenten über Qualitätskriterien und Evaluierung bis zur Überwachung im Produktivbetrieb. Intelligente Applikationen entwickeln: Du konzipierst und entwickelst Geschäftsanwendungen mit Power Apps und setzt dabei konsequent auf KI-gestützte Funktionen wie AI Builder und Copilot-Integration auf Basis unternehmensinterner Datenquellen. Prozessautomatisierung und Hyperautomation: Du entwirfst und implementierst intelligente Workflows mit Power Automate – von klassischen Geschäftsprozessen über RPA bis hin zu KI-gestützten Automatisierungen, die Daten analysieren, klassifizieren und Entscheidungen vorbereiten. Architektur und Integration: Du entwirfst Lösungsarchitekturen, die Power Platform und Copilot Studio mit Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, Azure-Diensten und Drittsystemen nahtlos verbinden. Beratung und Governance: Du führst Envisioning- und Discovery-Workshops durch, priorisierst Automatisierungs- und Agenten-Kandidaten und unterstützt beim Aufbau von Center-of-Excellence-Strukturen sowie Governance-Frameworks für den skalierbaren und sicheren Einsatz der Power Platform im Enterprise-Umfeld. DEIN PROFIL Berufserfahrung: Du hast mindestens drei Jahre im Power Platform-Umfeld und technischen Beratung gearbeitet, davon mindestens ein Jahre mit konkretem Fokus auf Microsoft Copilot Studio im produktiven Einsatz. Fundierte Ausbildung: Ein Studienabschluss in Informatik, Mathematik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem verwandten Bereich bildet die theoretische Basis. Power-Platform-Erfahrung: Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio und Dataverse mit. Agentische und AI-Kompetenz: Du bist begeistert von Copilot Studio und den Möglichkeiten, die agentische KI in der Low-Code-Entwicklung eröffnet, und bringst Interesse oder erste Erfahrung in der Orchestrierung von KI-Agenten und Multi-Agenten-Szenarien im Low-Code-Umfeld mit. Integrations- und Architekturkompetenz: Du hast Erfahrungen mit Konnektoren, APIs und der Anbindung von Azure-Diensten oder Drittsystemen sowie die Fähigkeit, übergreifende Lösungen zu entwerfen, die Power Platform sinnvoll in bestehende IT-Landschaften einbetten. Beratungs- und KI-Kompetenz: Du überzeugst Fachbereiche und IT-Entscheider gleichermaßen, übersetzt technische Sachverhalte in Business-Sprache und nutzt KI-Tools souverän im Fachgebiet – inklusive kritischer Bewertung der Ergebnisse und Enablement von Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Kunden. Sprachkenntnisse: Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi. Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

items.desc: Ready to turn business problems into practical AI and automation solutions — and to say so when AI is not the right answer? Interested in owning a use case from the first workshop through to enterprise deployment, rather than picking it up after someone else has scoped it? Practical Information Location: Sofia, Bulgaria | Reports to: Service Delivery Lead - Azure & DWP | Work Arrangement: Hybrid | Language Requirements: Fluent/professional English, written and verbal | Learn more: softwareone.com As our new Microsoft AI & Automation Engineer , you work directly with customers to identify valuable use cases, recommend the right solution and take it through to enterprise deployment. Sometimes that means an agent built in Microsoft Copilot Studio or Microsoft Foundry. Sometimes it means Power Platform automation, classic search or another deterministic approach. This is a customer-facing delivery role on enterprise AI enablement engagements, working alongside the architect who owns the platform decision and alongside the strategy, security and adoption workstreams. Alongside hands-on delivery, you will help ensure that Responsible AI and governance principles are designed into solutions from the beginning rather than added at the end. We care more about solving the problem than using the most powerful technology. Key Responsibilities A dvise and implement governance guardrails with in the customer's Power Platform — managed environments, DLP connector policies, the custom connector approval route, capacity and license consumption, and the Center of Excellence tooling that keeps the estate visible Use agile and design-thinking methods to uncover, challenge and prioritise valuable AI and automation use cases B uild and customize agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio or Microsoft Foundry — instructions, knowledge grounding, connectors, actions and the enterprise AI workflows behind them Support the Solution A rchitect on the platform decision for each enterprise AI use case — Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry or the Power Platform — working from the business outcome rather than the product, choosing the least powerful option that meets the requirement, and defending that trade-off in design review Say so when the answer is not an agent at all: structured, predictable work belongs in deterministic automation, and static retrieval in classic search. Recommending that is part of the job Build and manage enterprise integrations — REST APIs, authentication, permissions, and connections into Dataverse, SharePoint and third-party systems Develop and maintain solutions across Power Apps and Power Automate Support enterprise AI rollout by embedding security, governance and Responsible AI principles across the solution lifecycle For everything you build, ensure the following : a first-class agent identity with least-privilege scope, registration in the agent inventory, human approval gates on anything that writes, data-protection checks across grounding and action paths, and audit-mode monitoring from day one Stay current on Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform and MCP developments, and share what you learn across the team Job Requirements Hands-on Copilot Studio agent building. You have built and customized agents in production — instructions, knowledge grounding, topics, connectors and actions — and you have extended them with tools Power Platform and Microsoft 365 depth, with real integration experience. Around five years across Power Apps, Power Automate and SharePoint Online, and the integration work that comes with it — REST APIs, authentication, permissions, and Dataverse and SharePoint connections Governance literacy. You understand environment strategy, ALM and deployment across dev, test and production, plus tenant and connector policy — and you understand that an agent inherits whatever those policies allow. You do not need to have run a tenant; you do need to know what to ask for and why Alongside those three, we look for how you work: agile, open-minded, strong design-thinking skills, and the judgement to challenge assumptions rather than accept the first use case offered Consulting presence: you run workshops, write documents customers sign, and handle estimation and scope conversations without escalation Fluency in English (both verbal and written) Considered a strong advantage None of the following is required , and nothing here will cost you the role. But each one is a genuine advantage, and if you bring it, you will be building on it from your first week: Microsoft Foundry — agent projects, model deployment and the Microsoft Agent Framework pro-code path . Semantic Kernel or AutoGen counts . The single strongest differentiator on this list Agent identity and lifecycle — Microsoft Entra Agent ID and Microsoft Agent 365 : registration, least-privilege scoping and retirement. Rare experience, and increasingly the difference between a pilot and a production rollout Microsoft Fabric — OneLake , lakehouse or …

items.desc: Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso. DEINE ROLLE Agentic Low Code: Du entwickelst als Agentic Low Code Developer mit Copilot Studio und der Power Platform agentische Geschäftslösungen für die Fachbereiche unserer Kunden – von intelligenten Apps und Hyperautomation bis zu Multi-Agenten-Szenarien im Enterprise-Umfeld. Du verbindest Low Code, KI und Prozessautomatisierung zu produktiven Lösungen und unterstützt beim Aufbau skalierbarer Governance-Strukturen. Agentische Low-Code-Entwicklung mit Copilot Studio: Du entwickelst mit Copilot Studio maßgeschneiderte KI-Agenten und Copiloten – inkl. Anbindung an Microsoft 365, Dataverse und branchenspezifische Datenquellen – und etablierst agentische Low-Code-Entwicklungsprozesse als gelebte Praxis: von der Orchestrierung mehrerer Agenten über Qualitätskriterien und Evaluierung bis zur Überwachung im Produktivbetrieb. Intelligente Applikationen entwickeln: Du konzipierst und entwickelst Geschäftsanwendungen mit Power Apps und setzt dabei konsequent auf KI-gestützte Funktionen wie AI Builder und Copilot-Integration auf Basis unternehmensinterner Datenquellen. Prozessautomatisierung und Hyperautomation: Du entwirfst und implementierst intelligente Workflows mit Power Automate – von klassischen Geschäftsprozessen über RPA bis hin zu KI-gestützten Automatisierungen, die Daten analysieren, klassifizieren und Entscheidungen vorbereiten. Architektur und Integration: Du entwirfst Lösungsarchitekturen, die Power Platform und Copilot Studio mit Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, Azure-Diensten und Drittsystemen nahtlos verbinden. Beratung und Governance: Du führst Envisioning- und Discovery-Workshops durch, priorisierst Automatisierungs- und Agenten-Kandidaten und unterstützt beim Aufbau von Center-of-Excellence-Strukturen sowie Governance-Frameworks für den skalierbaren und sicheren Einsatz der Power Platform im Enterprise-Umfeld. DEIN PROFIL Berufserfahrung: Du hast mindestens drei Jahre im Power Platform-Umfeld und technischen Beratung gearbeitet, davon mindestens ein Jahre mit konkretem Fokus auf Microsoft Copilot Studio im produktiven Einsatz. Fundierte Ausbildung: Ein Studienabschluss in Informatik, Mathematik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem verwandten Bereich bildet die theoretische Basis. Power-Platform-Erfahrung: Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio und Dataverse mit. Agentische und AI-Kompetenz: Du bist begeistert von Copilot Studio und den Möglichkeiten, die agentische KI in der Low-Code-Entwicklung eröffnet, und bringst Interesse oder erste Erfahrung in der Orchestrierung von KI-Agenten und Multi-Agenten-Szenarien im Low-Code-Umfeld mit. Integrations- und Architekturkompetenz: Du hast Erfahrungen mit Konnektoren, APIs und der Anbindung von Azure-Diensten oder Drittsystemen sowie die Fähigkeit, übergreifende Lösungen zu entwerfen, die Power Platform sinnvoll in bestehende IT-Landschaften einbetten. Beratungs- und KI-Kompetenz: Du überzeugst Fachbereiche und IT-Entscheider gleichermaßen, übersetzt technische Sachverhalte in Business-Sprache und nutzt KI-Tools souverän im Fachgebiet – inklusive kritischer Bewertung der Ergebnisse und Enablement von Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Kunden. Sprachkenntnisse: Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi. Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

items.desc: At Sysdig, we believe cloud security isn't a compromise - it's a promise. From the start, our mission has been clear: to help organizations secure innovation in the cloud, the right way. We created Falco, the open standard for cloud threat detection, and continue to lead the cloud security market with runtime insights, open innovation, and agentic Al. Creators of technology trusted by over 60% of the Fortune 500, Sysdig gives teams the real-time clarity to move fast and defend what matters most. Culture matters here. We believe diversity fuels stronger ideas, and open dialogue drives sharper decisions. Recognized as a Best Place to Work and one of Deloitte's fastest-growing companies for the past 5 years, we're here to raise the standard for what cloud security and workplace culture should be. If you have the passion to dig deeper, the desire to challenge convention, and the curiosity to build something better, Sysdig is the right place for you. What You Will Do Build and maintain hands-on lab scenarios and technical content (YAML- and Markdown-based) that reflect real-world use cases, with support from senior team members. Script and automate parts of the training environment (Bash/Python), and help troubleshoot the delivery platform (e.g. Instruqt, LMS) when issues come up. Help design and deliver training sessions, demos and workshops, starting alongside senior instructors and taking ownership of smaller sessions over time. Write clear, concise courseware and technical instructions, and apply the basics of instructional design to align material with clear learning outcomes. Use AI coding/agent clients (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, or equivalents) to help build labs, write scripts and draft content faster, learning when to trust and when to verify their output. Collaborate with peers and cross-functional teams, ask for feedback often, and steadily build both technical depth and presentation confidence. What You Will Bring With You A working understanding of core DevOps and cloud-native concepts (containers, orchestration, CI/CD, Linux, cloud fundamentals), and eagerness to go deeper. Hands-on comfort scripting in at least one language (Bash or Python) and working with YAML/Markdown. Clear written and verbal communication and genuine enthusiasm for teaching and presenting to technical audiences, with room to grow. Comfort experimenting with AI coding/agent CLI clients (Claude Code, Codex, or similar). Curiosity, reliability, and a habit of asking for and integrating feedback. Professional English, written and spoken (an additional language is a plus). What We Look For Someone who applies newly acquired skills to deliver small components of training independently and connects technical topics to customer use cases. A dependable, collaborative team member who follows best practices, seeks feedback, and shows initiative in improving content and delivery. Growth potential toward a well-rounded enablement professional who can both build and teach. items.desc: About the Role: Join Ferrero’s global eCommerce team and help shape how consumers discover, understand and choose our products online. In this role, you will contribute to the growth of Digital Shelf and Agentic Commerce capabilities, helping create better shopping experiences across markets. Your work will have a direct impact on product visibility, content quality, and online conversion, while giving you the opportunity to learn, grow, and discover how digital commerce is evolving around the world. Main Responsibilities: You will support key global initiatives that strengthen Ferrero’s online presence and help consumers find the information they need when shopping online. You support Digital Shelf execution across markets, helping improve product visibility, availability, content quality, and conversion. You contribute to tracking, audits, and business reviews, working with technology partners, and identifying opportunities to improve online performance. You help develop best practices and content recommendations while supporting Agentic Commerce projects and coordinating actions across markets and functions. About You: You enjoy using data to understand consumer behavior and are curious about how people discover and shop for products online. You bring a thoughtful approach to your work and are ready to contribute to meaningful projects while building new skills. You bring 1-3 years of experience in eCommerce, digital, marketing, analytics, or a related field. You can work confidently with Excel, PowerPoint, and data-driven tools to create insights and support decision-making. You communicate clearly, collaborate effectively across teams and markets, and are eager to learn about Digital Shelf and Agentic Commerce. Are you ready for this great challenge? Don’t miss the chance to apply! What We Offer: Careers with caring built in - discover our benefits here. About Ferrero: Ferrero began its journey in the small town of Alba in Piedmont, Italy, in 1946. Today, it is one of the world’s largest sweet-packaged food companies, with many iconic brands sold in countries all over the world. Find out more about Ferrero at ferrero.com. DE&I at Ferrero: Ferrero is committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture in which all employees feel welcomed and appreciated and have the same opportunities. We believe all our people are equally talented in their own way. In nurturing the curiosity and natural abilities of our employees, we provide them, generation after generation, the means to succeed personally and professionally, enabling them to craft their journey at Ferrero. The diversity of our talents is what makes our work environment multicultural, innovative, and highly rewarding. Find out more here.

items.desc: Location(s): UK, Europe & Africa : UK : Gloucester BAE Systems Digital Intelligence is home to 4,500 digital, cyber and intelligence experts. We work collaboratively across 10 countries to collect, connect and understand complex data, so that governments, nation states, armed forces and commercial businesses can unlock digital advantage in the most demanding environments. Job Title: Operational Cyber Researcher Job City: Gloucester (5 days/ week on site) Operational Cyber Group is a team of industry-leading experts in high-assurance development, research, reverse engineering, and vulnerability research. With a focus on National Security, we work on some of the country’s toughest challenges. Our people provide mission-changing capability for our customers across a wide variety of platforms and technologies. We are looking for experienced Researchers that can investigate a wide range of systems and technologies with a focus on discovering and exploiting weaknesses in their design or implementation, and who want to have a meaningful impact on National Security. Role Description Technical delivery: be able to systematically deconstruct a wide range of technologies and protocols to perform exploratory research and assessment, as well as experimental development (this includes creating prototypes and simulations). Mentorship, team-leadership, and collaboration: work in teams to deliver high-quality reports, whilst developing junior team-members. Adaptability: be able to quickly assess new domains and technologies, knowing which tools and methodologies are best suited to the task at hand. Security mindset: be capable of identifying vulnerabilities and prioritise avenues of research that will deliver the most value to our customers. Have a working knowledge of vulnerability assessment or penetration-testing techniques. What We Are Looking For Familiarity with a variety of tools (e.g. IDEs, debuggers, source control, Ghidra, FRIDA, Wireshark, VMs) and techniques (e.g. fuzzing, scripting, code injection). Intermediate to advanced understanding of computing principles (e.g. stack/heap distinction, compiled/interpreted languages). Proficiency with at least one programming language and the ability to perform scripting or rapid prototype development. Ability to use and configure more than one major operating system. Ability to pick up new languages and technologies easily. Ability to communicate regarding technical topics to a variety of audiences, including non-technical, through presentations and technical reports. Experience working with teams and leading technical tasks. Other desirable skills include: experience performing network traffic analysis, reverse engineering, vulnerability analysis, exploit development, working knowledge of modern cryptography. Why join us? You will receive a dedicated training budget to use during your first year with us. This can cover major cybersecurity conferences such as Black Hat, specialist training, and more. By joining the Operational Cyber Group, you will be addressing the most critical cyber needs of governments and businesses across the globe, with a meaningful and tangible impact on UK National Security. Work-life balance is important to us: we can offer a variety of hours to suit individual needs, such as part-time or flexible working, along with a minimum of 25 days of holiday per year. We offer additional leave to cover Reservist and Cadet Force Adult Volunteer duties. Our flexible benefits package includes private medical and dental insurance, a competitive pension scheme, cycle to work scheme, childcare vouchers, discount cards and more. We are a supportive, inclusive and friendly team, committed to helping each other learn and succeed. We have a number of Diversity and Support groups which cover everything from gender diversity to mental health and wellbeing. With clear career progression pathways, mentorship, as well as ongoing training throughout your career, you can feel confident that your aptitude will be rewarded. Please be aware that this role is subject to security restrictions. We do not expect you to have a security clearance before applying, but you will need to be eligible to work in the UK and be able to successfully achieve an eDV UK security clearance. For more details see https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/edv-guidance-pack-for-applicants. Our recruiters are happy to explain the process. items.desc: Company Overview At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Our products support people working in complex, high-stakes environments — from public safety and emergency communications to enterprise security. Understanding the people who use these technologies, the environments they work within and the challenges they face is fundamental to building products that are useful, trustworthy and effective. Job Description About the role We are looking for a curious and thoughtful UX Researcher with strong foundations in social or behavioural science. This role is well suited to someone who wants to apply rigorous research to complex, real-world problems and grow their career in applied UX research. You may already have some experience in UX or product research. Equally, you may be completing a PhD, working in academia, government, policy, behavioural research or another applied research environment and looking to move into industry. What matters most is how you think: asking good questions, challenging assumptions, evaluating evidence critically, designing thoughtful research and turning complex findings into a clear point of view. What You'll Do Frame complex problems Work with stakeholders to turn broad product or business questions into clear, answerable research questions. Identify assumptions, gaps in knowledge and areas of uncertainty before recommending new research. Review existing evidence and understand user behaviour within its wider social, organisational and technological context. Look beyond individual features to understand workflows, systems and broader patterns. Design and conduct rigorous research Select research methods that fit the question and the decision being made. Plan and conduct qualitative research such as interviews, contextual inquiry, observation, field research and usability studies. Design studies that consider bias, validity, ethics and the limitations of the available evidence. Adapt research approaches to complex environments and populations that may be difficult to access. Use quantitative approaches where appropriate, including surveys, structured studies and analysis of behavioural or product data to help answer research questions and measure user outcomes. Partner with other researchers and specialists when a project requires different methodological expertise. Make sense of evidence Analyse qualitative data systematically and identify meaningful patterns. Analyse and interpret quantitative data alongside qualitative findings, identifying patterns and relationships while being clear about sample size, uncertainty and the limitations of the evidence. Distinguish between evidence, interpretation and assumption. Connect individual findings to broader product, user and strategic questions. Influence decisions Translate research findings into clear implications and recommendations. Communicate complex ideas in simple, accessible ways for multidisciplinary and senior audiences. Help Product and Design teams understand how evidence should influence priorities and decisions. Work collaboratively with stakeholders while maintaining an independent research perspective. Contribute to the research community Share methods, learning and evidence with other researchers. Contribute to reusable research knowledge rather than treating every project as an isolated study. Participate in critique, peer review and research planning. Develop your own methodological expertise through coaching, collaboration and practice. Basic Requirements What We're Looking For We are particularly interested in candidates with a background in social or behavioural science and strong evidence of critical thinking. You should be able to demonstrate: Strong research and analytical skills. Experience designing and conducting empirical research. The ability to take an ambiguous problem and break it into answerable questions. Strong critical-thinking skills and a willingness to question assumptions. The ability to evaluate the quality, strength and limitations of evidence. Experience analysing qualitative research systematically. The ability to identify patterns across complex or sometimes contradictory information. Strong written and verbal communication skills. The ability to explain research clearly to people without a research background. Intellectual curiosity and a genuine interest in understanding human behaviour. Comfort working independently while …
