items.desc: About Nadifor Nadifor is building an AI-native learning platform for modern teams. We help companies create, deliver, and improve learning experiences that are more personalized, measurable, and connected to real business outcomes. We are an early-stage company, which means the product, engineering culture, and operating model are still being shaped. We are looking for people who want to do more than write code. We want engineers who care deeply about the product, the customer, the craft, and the company we are building. Our engineering culture is inspired by strong product engineering teams: small teams, high ownership, direct customer context, fast iteration, and engineers who are expected to make thoughtful product and technical decisions. The role We are looking for a Product Engineer who can operate across the stack, with particular strength in user-facing product experiences. You will help define and build the core user experience of Nadifor. This includes customer-facing workflows, learning journeys, AI-powered interactions, admin experiences, dashboards, content creation flows, and the overall quality of how the product feels. You should be comfortable taking an ambiguous customer problem, shaping the solution, making product and technical tradeoffs, and shipping the feature end to end. Your strongest contribution will likely be around frontend execution, product quality, interaction design, UX judgment, and the craft of how the product feels. This is not a narrow frontend role. We are looking for someone who can take an ambiguous customer problem, shape the solution, make product tradeoffs, build across the stack, and ship something polished. Experience and scope We’re looking for someone who can independently take a customer problem through to a reliable production feature. You’ll join our four-person engineering team, working directly with the CTO to shape the product and our technical decisions. What you’ll do Own customer-facing product areas from problem discovery to production delivery. Turn rough ideas, customer feedback, and prototypes into high-quality product experiences. Build full-stack features, with a strong focus on frontend quality, UX, interaction design, and product polish. Make product decisions around scope, flows, edge cases, usability, and tradeoffs. Work directly with founders, customers, and other engineers to understand real user needs. Improve the quality bar of our product and engineering practices. Help evolve our design system, frontend architecture, and product development process. Mentor and raise the bar for other engineers on product thinking, frontend execution, and ownership. Contribute to the culture of a small, high-agency engineering team. What we’re looking for Strong experience building and shipping production software. Excellent frontend and product craft, ideally with React and TypeScript. Ability to work full-stack, even if your strongest spike is frontend/product experience. Strong product judgment: you can reason from customer problems, not just tickets. Comfort with ambiguity and early-stage startup pace. Ability to make good tradeoffs between speed, quality, scope, and long-term maintainability. Strong communication skills, especially in writing. A high ownership mindset: you do not wait to be told exactly what to do. Taste for simple, useful, well-crafted products. Interest in AI-native product experiences and how AI changes learning, coaching, and workplace enablement. Nice to have Experience in early-stage startups. Experience building B2B SaaS products. Experience with AI-powered product interfaces. Experience with design systems, component libraries, or complex workflow products. What success looks like In your first months, you will have taken ownership of meaningful product areas, shipped high-quality features used by customers, improved the frontend/product quality bar, and helped the team work with more clarity and autonomy. Longer term, you will be one of the people who defines how product engineering works at Nadifor. Let’s build something that matters. Send your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note about something you’ve built to careers@nadifor.ai. Include the role title in your subject line. Skip the cover letter.

A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards. In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate. A few examples of your responsibilities Shape high-leverage product experiences. Design exceptional UI and UX—from early concepts to polished delivery—using the best available tools to explore more directions, move faster, and raise the quality bar. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter. Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar. Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent. Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English. What we offer Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field. An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too. All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work. Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity. The selection process In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. items.desc: ZEISS is technology and innovation. Founded in Germany in 1846, ZEISS is an internationally leading technology enterprise operating in the optics and optoelectronics industries across 50 countries. As a company wholly owned by a foundation, ZEISS is committed to responsibility in all its activities. As a pioneer in scientific optics, its employees across the globe continue to push the boundaries of what is possible. With a strong focus on quality and innovation, ZEISS creates value for its customers and helps shape new ways of seeing the world. We’re looking for a UX Researcher to join us in Castiglione Olona, Italy. At ZEISS Vision Care Italy, our dedicated Omnichannel Customer Experience team plays a key role in understanding customer needs, measuring satisfaction and continuously improving the experience we deliver to our customers, including eye care professionals. Working collaboratively across the business, the team combines customer insights, research and a human-centred approach to drive meaningful improvements across both digital and traditional customer touchpoints. Your Role As a UX Researcher, you will play an important role in shaping and enhancing the customer experience by understanding customer behaviour, analysing feedback and translating research findings into actionable business insights. Working closely with the Head of Omnichannel Customer Experience and colleagues across the organisation, you will help develop our Voice of the Customer programme, measure customer satisfaction and support the continuous improvement of our customer journeys. The role of UX Researcher will involve: Leading UX research activities , designing and conducting qualitative and quantitative research, including customer surveys, interviews, usability testing, focus groups and workshops to better understand customer needs and behaviours. Measuring and analysing customer satisfaction , monitoring key metrics including NPS, CES and CSI, applying statistical techniques and using tools such as Power BI to identify trends, evaluate feedback and uncover opportunities for improvement. Translating research into actionable insights , developing clear reports, presenting findings and working with stakeholders across Marketing, Sales, Customer Care, IT and Digital to turn customer feedback into meaningful improvements. Supporting customer journey optimisation , developing customer personas, mapping customer journeys and identifying opportunities to enhance the omnichannel experience, including digital platforms and customer self-service solutions. Championing human-centred thinking , collaborating across functions to promote Design Thinking methodologies, facilitate workshops and ensure customer needs remain central to business decisions and digital development projects. Your Experience A degree in Psychology, Sociology, Statistics, Communication Sciences or a related discipline, combined with approximately 1–2 years of experience in UX Research, customer insights, market research or a similar analytical role. A strong understanding of qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, including survey design, sampling techniques, statistical analysis and the interpretation of customer feedback. Experience analysing data and translating research findings into meaningful recommendations, with knowledge of customer satisfaction metrics and tools such as Power BI. An understanding of customer journey mapping, personas, user behaviour and human-centred design principles, ideally gained within a B2C, B2B or B2B2C environment. Excellent communication, interpersonal and organisational skills, with the ability to collaborate across departments, manage priorities and communicate complex findings clearly. Fluency in both Italian and English is essential. It would be desirable if you had: Experience with Voice of the Customer platforms or survey tools such as Qualtrics or Medallia, alongside knowledge of statistical analysis tools such as R. Familiarity with Design Thinking methodologies and collaborative tools such as Miro, together with basic knowledge of Figma for making simple changes to existing prototypes or mock-ups. Previous involvement in digital customer experience, omnichannel initiatives, usability research or projects focused on improving customer self-service solutions. Your Benefits If you join ZEISS, you will have access to a range of benefits, including: A hybrid working model offering flexibility between office-based and remote working. Subsidized canteen Bonus based on performance, production and attendance Welfare benefits Role Details Location: Castiglione Olona, Italy. Working model: The role will initially require an on-site induction period of approximately 1–2 months to support onboarding, training and integration into the team. Following this, you will benefit from a hybrid working arrangement of three days on-site and two days working remotely. Salary: €30,000 - £35,000 gross per annum (RAL), dependent on …

items.desc: About this position Working as a Cloud Engineer at TNO means contributing to research and innovative applications that matter. From the energy transition and the application of secure AI in healthcare to the future of digital identity and our safety. What will be your role? As a Cloud Engineer, you will have the opportunity to further shapen and define our cloud technology together with your colleagues. This includes developing the Azure Platform, creating standards for Infrastructure as Code (IaC), developing the necessary automation for self-service in the Azure cloud, and supporting the setup of IaC and CI/CD for cloud applications. As a Cloud Engineer at TNO, you will work with a diverse range of internal clients. These can be scientists conducting advanced research on cloud technology or colleagues with no knowledge of cloud technology. The development requests are therefore diverse, making it challenging as it is not a standard package that needs to be developed and managed. So this is a role where you have a lot of space to contribute to the direction and implementation of the cloud transition within a very diverse environment and where you directly contribute to societal importance. What we expect from you We are looking for a Cloud Engineer with experience in: Azure (Enterprise Scale Landing Zone Architecture) Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), CI/CD (Azure DevOps, YAML, GitLab), PowerShell, Azure CLI Azure Policy and Policy-as-Code Azure PaaS services (networking, compute, storage, database) DevOps way of working, Agile, Scrum Additionally, you are attracted to the idea of not entering an already standardized environment but rather being able to shape and define the transition to the cloud. If you also enjoy coaching colleagues in this transition, that is certainly possible. What you'll get in return Challenging and varied work with real impact. At TNO, you have considerable freedom to shape your own career and development. In addition to a gross monthly salary between € 4,000 and € 5,700 (based on full-time employment and depending on your knowledge and experience), you will receive a 13th-month payment of 8.33% and a flexible benefits budget of 5.58%. This brings your potential monthly compensation to between approximately € 4,600 and € 6,600. On top of that, you will receive 8% holiday allowance. We also invest heavily in your professional growth, offering opportunities to attend training courses, pursue further education and obtain relevant certifications. TNO offers optional employee benefits, enabling you to tailor your benefits package to match your personal situation. You may also expect: An extremely professional, innovative working environment where colleagues are leading experts in their field. The opportunity to attend courses, workshops and conferences, and to receive training and coaching based on your needs. 33 days annual leave plus a flexible holiday that can be used on a cultural, religious, or otherwise important day of your choosing (on a full-time basis). An employer working towards a respectful, inclusive, and equitable work environment where every employee can flourish, with various initiatives such as Jong TNO, numerous expertise based guilds, Rainbow Community and Round Tables on diverse inclusion topics. We offer a comprehensive and flexible mobility plan that also includes full compensation for public transportation for commuting and business travel. items.desc: About Stream Stream powers real-time Chat, Video, Activity Feeds, and AI Moderation for more than 1 billion end users across 4,000+ apps, from Strava and Bumble to eBay and Patreon. Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low-latency services and a great developer experience. The role We're looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to join Stream on our mission of elevating the quality of apps for billions of users globally. You'll own the technical direction of Stream Video's media plane and the infrastructure it runs on. This is a full-time role, hybrid with 3 days a week in our Amsterdam office, or remote from anywhere in the EU. What you'll work on Stream Video runs on an SFU we built in Go on top of Pion, plus ingest and recording fleets, all on a global edge network we own across more than one cloud. Nobody at Stream has owned this media plane end to end before. Our central infrastructure team is tuned for request-based services, and video breaks in different ways: live sessions can't be dropped, bandwidth is the biggest cost, and placement is the main lever. That's why this is a Staff role. You'll set the direction for the video backend and its infrastructure with your own roadmap, reporting to our Director of Engineering with a direct line to our CTO. The Video SDK teams own the client side, and you'll work closely with them and with infrastructure. Part of the fleet is mid-move to Kubernetes. Job responsibilities: Architecture: write the architecture and roadmap for Stream Video's backend and media infrastructure, and decide what ships. Scale livestreaming: architect the SFU and media pipeline (WHIP, WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, SVC), including the path from WebRTC to CDN-backed HLS for very large audiences. Own the fleet: reliability, autoscaling, placement, rollouts, observability and cost for long-lived sessions across clouds, with cost per gigabyte as a first-class metric. Gate production changes: define the validation that decides which changes, including AI-generated ones, reach live media, using behaviour tests on realistic networks, nightly telemetry scans and a public quality benchmark. Take the final escalation: handle the hardest quality, latency and production incidents, and work with enterprise customers on advanced integrations. Raise the bar: mentor senior engineers through design review, code review and hiring. About you You've owned systems where a dropped session or a bad rollout is visible to users within seconds, and you think about cost and reliability as much as features. You'd rather write the hard design doc than wait for one. A founder background is an asset here. The team is small, so you'll still write and review plenty of code. If you're looking for a large organisation with a platform team to hand problems to, or a management track, this role won't suit you. You have: Extensive backend engineering experience, including significant time owning architecture for high-scale production systems Expert proficiency in Go or an equivalent systems language (Rust, C++, Java) A track record owning real-time, stateful or latency-sensitive systems at very high scale Deep knowledge of distributed systems and networking: failure modes, placement, capacity planning and cost Strong experience with real-time media or streaming: WebRTC, SFU/MCU concepts, RTP/RTCP, DTLS, or RTMP, SRT and HLS Clear written communication: design docs and RFCs that others can act on Hands-on experience adopting AI coding and agent tools, and judgement on how to make them safe in production Bonus points: Built or operated an SFU, or contributed to Pion or another WebRTC stack Moved a stateful fleet to Kubernetes, or ran media workloads across more than one cloud Knowledge of bandwidth estimation, congestion control, simulcast, SVC and codecs (Opus, VP8/VP9, AV1) CockroachDB/PostgreSQL, RocksDB, Raft and Redis at scale Experience at developer tooling, API or SDK companies Founder or early-stage startup experience building real-time products Python or Rust alongside Go Conference talks, technical writing or notable open-source work in real-time media What makes this role exciting Scope: the infrastructure direction for video is yours to run as a product, with the authority to decide what ships. Impact: Video is Stream's most complex product, and many customers run it alongside Chat, Feeds and Moderation, so this work matters across the company. Stack: Go, Pion, WebRTC, WHIP/WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, Protobuf, CockroachDB/Postgres, RocksDB, Raft and Redis, with Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT Codex in daily use. Starting point: a concrete first 90 days. Ship a validation gate on every infrastructure change that reaches production media, and move part of the fleet to Kubernetes with a cost-per-gigabyte number attached. Why join Stream? items.desc: Ubiq Aerospace AS Krambugata 2, 7011 Trondheim Om jobben Lagre favoritt Stillingstittel Electronics Design Engineer Type ansettelse Fast, heltid 100% Antall stillinger 2 Arbeidsspråk Engelsk Søk senest søndag 15. november Design, build and validate the electronics at the heart of the next generation of autonomous aircraft. Ubiq Aerospace is a Trondheim-based deep tech company on an ambitious growth journey. We develop next-generation ice protection systems, smart aerostructures and sensing systems for aircraft operating in the world's harshest environments. We are looking for a creative, open-minded and technically strong Electronics Design Engineer to join our team. Electronic hardware for power and signals is a crucial part of our solutions, and in this role you will take ownership of electronics development from early concepts and requirements through to working, tested hardware. This posting is for an experienced candidate, but we also have an open position for an early career candidate on our website. You will work hands-on across the entire electronics design process, including system and circuit design, component selection, schematic capture, PCB layout, prototyping, bring-up, debugging and validation. We are looking for someone who is comfortable designing a PCB from scratch and taking it all the way through to functioning hardware. You'll combine individual technical ownership with close collaboration across Ubiq's multidisciplinary engineering teams. You'll contribute to decisions about future hardware needs and architectures and work alongside colleagues across different engineering disciplines to develop robust solutions to challenging problems. We're open to what your background specifically might look like. What matters to us is that you're comfortable taking responsibility, are self-motivated and have a learning mindset. We're a small team, so we also value people who are adaptable, pragmatic and enjoy working closely with others. What you'll do End-to-end electronics design: Take ownership of electronic hardware from requirements and architecture through circuit design, component selection, schematic capture and complete PCB layout. Prototyping and bring-up: Take new hardware from design files to physical prototypes, including board bring-up, debugging and iteration. Design for manufacturing: Consider manufacturability, assembly and test from the outset, and work with manufacturing partners and colleagues to take designs smoothly from prototypes towards reliable production. Assembly and integration: Assemble and integrate electronics & wiring into higher-level subsystems. Testing and validation: Develop and perform testing to verify that designs meet their requirements and perform reliably in their intended environment. Hardware architecture: Analyse future hardware needs and contribute to system architecture and technical trade-offs. Cross-disciplinary development: Work closely with other engineering disciplines to ensure electronics are well integrated into the overall system. Documentation: Document hardware designs, design choices, test procedures and results to support effective collaboration and future development. Your background, knowledge and skills Relevant education within electronics, power electronics, electrical engineering or a related field. Practical experience and demonstrated ability are just as important to us as the specific educational path you have taken. Hands-on experience designing electronic hardware and taking PCB designs from an initial idea through to working hardware. Experience with schematic capture and complete PCB layout, including component placement and routing. Strong understanding of electronic design principles and good knowledge of analogue and digital circuits. Ability to select components and make sound engineering trade-offs based on electrical performance, reliability, availability and other design constraints. Comfortable bringing up and debugging newly manufactured PCBs and systematically finding and solving hardware problems. Experience using standard electronics lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies and signal generators. Understanding of design for manufacturing (DFM) principles and how PCB design choices influence fabrication, assembly, testability and production reliability. Proficient in fine-pitch SMD soldering, wire crimping, and PCB modification to support rapid iteration. Strong analytical problem-solving skills combined with a pragmatic and solution-oriented approach. Enjoy taking technical ownership while collaborating closely with others. Why join Ubiq Aerospace? At Ubiq, you'll be trusted with real engineering responsibility from day one. You'll join us at a particularly exciting stage: our technologies are moving from R&D and low-rate production towards products that need to be manufactured reliably at greater scale. items.desc: Fast stilling Heltid Stavanger Søknadsfrist 20.11.2026 Mulighet for hjemmekontor Ingen hjemmekontor Arbeidsspråk Engelsk, Norsk Sektor Privat Vil du være med og videreutvikle hvordan Skretting planlegger og optimerer vareflyten? Skretting Norge søker en ny kollega til en rolle som kombinerer operativt ansvar for daglig reseptoptimering med utvikling av nye og mer effektive metoder for planlegging av vareflyten. Det operative ansvaret gir praktisk kjennskap til dagens prosesser og behov, og et godt grunnlag for å utvikle og teste løsninger som kan effektivisere optimeringen og styrke beslutningsgrunnlaget på tvers av avdelinger. Rollen som Fagspesialist råvareoptimering gir bred innsikt i sentrale forretningsprosesser i Skretting, blant annet råvareinnkjøp, innlogistikk, produksjon og kvalitet, og du får erfarne kolleger og støttespillere rundt deg. Stillingen hører til Skretting Norge, med arbeidssted ved kontoret vårt i Stavanger eller på Averøy. Dine viktigste oppgaver Du får ansvar for å optimere fôrresepter før de går i produksjon, og bidra til å sikre at nødvendige råvarer er tilgjengelige når de trengs. I det daglige samarbeider du med produksjon, innlogistikk og kvalitet, både lokalt og på tvers av fabrikkene. Du har også tett kontakt med innkjøp, sentral reseptoptimering og produksjonsplanlegging. I utviklingsarbeidet skal du hente ut og bearbeide produksjonsdata, identifisere forbedringsmuligheter og omsette dem i praktiske løsninger. Målet er å skape bedre overblikk og dataflyt mellom systemer og gi raskere beslutningsstøtte for logistikk, produksjon og innkjøp. Hvem ser vi etter? Vi ser etter deg som tar initiativ, ser forbedringsmuligheter og motiveres av å skape konkrete resultater. Du er analytisk og løsningsorientert, og evner å omsette data og innsikt til praktiske beslutninger i samarbeid med ulike fagmiljøer. Du har gjerne relevant utdanning på masternivå, for eksempel innen data science, industriell økonomi, logistikk eller beslektede fagområder. En faglig profil med vekt på dataanalyse, maskinlæring, optimering eller operasjonsanalyse er særlig relevant. Vi oppfordrer også nyutdannede og deg som avslutter studiene våren 2027 til å søke. Du er komfortabel med å hente, strukturere og analysere data og har gjerne erfaring med programmering og bruk av API-er. Du har tilstrekkelig teknisk forståelse til å utvikle konkrete løsninger ved hjelp av AI-verktøy og/eller i samarbeid med spesialister Relevant arbeidserfaring og dokumentert kompetanse kan kompensere for manglende mastergrad. Kjennskap til biologi, kjemi, akvakultur, næringsmiddelfag eller industriell produksjon er en fordel, men ikke en forutsetning. Du behersker norsk og engelsk både muntlig og skriftlig. Hva kan vi tilby deg? Du får en sentral rolle med stor påvirkningskraft og mulighet til å skape positive, synlige forbedringer innen reseptoptimering, produksjon og råvareflyt. Du blir en del av et erfarent fagmiljø som samarbeider tett og deler kunnskap. Vi er opptatt av å gi medarbeiderne våre gode utviklingsmuligheter, både gjennom utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver, læring i det daglige og muligheter for videre karriereutvikling i organisasjonen. Har du spørsmål om stillingen, kan du kontakte David Lausten Knudsen, direktør for forretningsutviklingsprosjekter i Skretting Norge, på david.knudsen@skretting.com, eller Elselill Sunde, Talent Acquisition Business Partner, på elselill.sunde@skretting.com Om Skretting Skretting er en verdensledende leverandør av innovative og bærekraftige ernæringsløsninger til havbruksnæringen, med produksjon i 18 land og en årlig fôrproduksjon på over 3 millioner tonn. Skretting Norge har rundt 300 ansatte og produserer cirka 700 000 tonn fôr årlig ved anleggene i Stavanger, Averøy og Stokmarknes. Det norske og globale hovedkontoret ligger i Stavanger. Vår visjon er «Feeding the Future». items.desc: Fast stilling Heltid Oslo Søknadsfrist 16.11.2026 Arbeidsspråk Engelsk Sektor Privat CFO Bon Dep A Norwegian brand adventure in more than 40 countries – and we’re looking for the CFO to shape our next chapter of growth Bon Dep started at a kitchen table in Oslo in 2012. Since then, we’ve built KKNEKKI into one of Europe’s most recognisable hair accessory brands – loved by millions, worn by Erling Braut Haaland and sold in around 6,000 stores across more than 40 countries. We’re growing fast and profitably, with most of our sales outside Norway. We recently entered the US through retail partners, and we have ambitions to expand further into Asia. Our next phase of growth raises the bar for our finance function. That’s why we’re creating the role of CFO: someone who will lead this development and use financial insight to drive better commercial decisions. About the role As CFO, you’ll join the management team, report to the CEO and hold overall responsibility for the company’s finances. Today, the finance function is a team of two, and you’ll work closely with experienced colleagues who handle accounting, consolidation, reporting and control day to day. Your focus will be on taking our financial management to the next level and acting as a commercial thought partner to the management team – shaping how we finance, structure and prioritise our growth, and understanding where we actually make money. You’ll thrive here if you enjoy switching between strategy and hands-on execution. You build models, lead bank meetings and find solutions when new markets bring new challenges. You work closely with colleagues and external advisers, and you keep things moving even when there’s no playbook to follow. What you’ll be responsible for Strategy and decision support Acting as a commercial thought partner to the CEO and COO on strategic choices such as new markets, sourcing and pricing Commercial assessments and analysis across the business Budgeting, forecasting and board reporting, built on a single source of truth for management, the board and owners International growth and financing Financial and corporate structuring to support growth in both existing and new markets Overall responsibility for payment solutions, VAT and tax in new markets – including a future direct-to-consumer offering through our website – working with external advisers where needed Banking relationships, financing and covenants, as well as credit and factoring in new markets Transfer pricing and intercompany matters, in collaboration with external tax advisers Risk and capital Managing currency, interest rate, credit and liquidity risk Working with the COO to make sure product flow, purchasing and financing keep pace with growth, so we can always deliver to our customers Building a finance function that scales Developing the processes, systems and division of responsibilities that allow finance to handle higher volumes and greater complexity – with solutions that are commercially grounded and work for our customers Advancing systems and automation, including AI, with a focus on business needs, control and quality Making sure the team has the right skills and capacity – identifying gaps and new needs, and addressing them through development, recruitment or external support Your first year In your first year, your key priorities will be to: Lay the foundation for continued profitable growth. Ensure that our financing, financial management and corporate structure support our ambitions in existing and new markets. Make the finance function more scalable. Challenge how we work today and drive the changes needed to handle higher volumes and greater complexity – even if that means fundamental changes. Together with the team, you’ll build solutions that deliver stronger control, efficient operations and better support for the rest of the business. Strengthen commercial decision support, with forecasts and analysis that give management a clear basis for setting priorities. Who we’re looking for You’ve led finance in a company before, and you care as much about customers and products as you do about the numbers. You: Have experience as a CFO or in a similar senior finance role, ideally in a growth company Are used to rolling up your sleeves in an organisation with lean support functions Understand the flow of goods – from purchasing and warehousing to retailers and consumers – and what it means for growth, profitability and capital needs Have a solid grasp of financing and international corporate structures Understand the key tax and VAT issues in international business and e-commerce, and know when to bring in specialist expertise Build your own models and have a strong understanding of technology, particularly automation and AI Hold a master’s degree in economics or finance, or equivalent Speak and write fluent English Experience from small or mid-sized companies with international operations is an advantage, ideally within brands, retail or e-commerce. …

Familiarity with cloud migration approaches and DevOps practices; preference for open-source , portable solutions. Strong communication, problem-solving mindset and willingness to learn in a team. Private medical care, life insurance. Access to the MyBenefit platform (possibility of using a wide range of products and services, including the Multisport card). items.desc: The Role: We're hiring a Spanish-speaking Solutions Engineer to help prospects and customers evaluate, test and implement Apryse's document SDKs inside their own products and infrastructure. You'll be the technical voice in the sales cycle: running demos, scoping requirements, debugging customer code and feeding what you learn back to our product engineering team. You'll work across both client-side and server-side use cases, helping customers understand how Apryse technology fits into their applications, services and document-processing workflows. While the role is primarily remote, you'll also occasionally work with customers on-site where this helps with technical evaluations, implementation workshops or key customer engagements. This suits a developer who enjoys deep, varied customer conversations and wants to use their technical background to solve real customer problems. What you'll do: Run product demos and support trial installs and beta implementations of the Apryse SDKs. Work with prospects by email and on calls to uncover their technical pain points and scope requirements: features, platforms, deployment environments, document-processing workflows and file formats. Help customers evaluate client-side and server-side SDK architectures, including how document processing fits into their applications, APIs and backend services. Occasionally travel to customer sites to support technical workshops, evaluations and implementation discussions. Partner with sales and product engineering to propose solutions that fit the customer and make sense commercially. Debug customer application code and guide implementations. Own technical support tickets through the pre-sales process and flag risks to the sales team early. Share customer feedback with product engineering to shape the roadmap, and keep up with competitors and document standards. What you'll bring: Fluent Spanish (C1 or native) and professional English, written and spoken. Hands-on development experience in modern web technologies: JavaScript or TypeScript, React or Angular, REST APIs and JSON. Experience with mobile (Android or iOS) or .NET is a plus. Comfort working with server-side applications, APIs and deployment environments. Experience with .NET, Java, Linux, Docker or cloud infrastructure would be particularly useful. Experience working directly with customers on technical issues: solutions engineering, integration, support engineering or consulting. Comfort working directly with customers both remotely and, when required, on-site. A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. A GitHub profile, technical writing or similar evidence of building and debugging complex systems. Clear communication, strong problem-solving and the discipline to prioritise in a fast-paced environment. You don't need to tick every box. We welcome non-traditional backgrounds. Nice to have: Knowledge of document formats and processing, especially PDF, plus interest in computer graphics, image compression or AI. Experience with server-side document workflows such as conversion, content extraction, OCR, rendering or automated document processing. Experience with containers, cloud deployments or backend application architectures. Experience supporting a Spanish-speaking customer base, in Spain or Latin America. Italian at B2 level or above would be particularly valuable, enabling you to support technical customer conversations in the Italian market. Benefits: Competitive salary commensurate with experience & qualifications. A comprehensive extended benefits package. A great team environment and resources, supporting you to do the best work of your life and providing unlimited career growth potential. Highly autonomous and entrepreneurial environment. Work with the hardware you're most comfortable with (Windows or Mac) Diverse and inclusive workplace where we all learn from each other. Excellent work-life balance with a flexible remote work environment. items.desc: About Pillar Pillar was founded in 2025. Today, we are 80+ people, serve 900+ customers, raised €12 million in 2026, and are expanding internationally. We are building the financial operating system for construction: bringing AI, automation, and modern software to an enormous industry still full of slow, fragmented processes. We are looking for a product-minded Full Stack Engineer who leans backend, moves fast, and wants to build. The Mission Build product end to end, with particular strength on backend architecture and execution. Our frontend capability is already strong; we now want someone who can deepen the team on backend while still owning the full product picture. What You'll Do Own features end to end, from product problem to production. Build across our TypeScript codebase using Next.js, React, Supabase, Node/Deno, Postgres, and Mastra. Take strong ownership of backend logic, data models, APIs, integrations, and product architecture. Work hands-on on the frontend when needed, with a strong preference for engineers comfortable with Next.js. Use AI as a native part of your engineering workflow - not only as a feature you build. Work in small squads with high autonomy and bottom-up initiatives. Move quickly from ambiguity to working product, making pragmatic technical decisions along the way. Raise the engineering bar through collaboration, judgment, and execution. Our stack Product: Next.js · React · TypeScript Backend & data : Supabase · Node/Deno · Postgres AI : Mastra · AI-native workflows Who You Are A Product engineer with backend depth and high agency You are a product engineer: you build outcomes, not just code. You are stronger on backend or genuinely full stack. Pure frontend profiles are not our priority for this hire. You are comfortable with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and modern backend/data patterns. Supabase experience is a strong plus. You have worked in a startup or scaleup environment and understand the pace, ambiguity, and ownership it requires. You take initiative, get your hands dirty, and get things done without waiting for perfect instructions. You are AI-native: AI is already part of how you think, build, debug, learn, and move faster. You can zoom out to understand the full picture and zoom in when details matter. You learn from failure, communicate openly, and collaborate without ego. Native Italian or Spanish is mandatory, together with professional working English. The Profile that Will Succeed Backend-leaning · Product-minded · Startup DNA The sweet spot: a hands-on product engineer from a startup/scaleup journey, ideally around the €3M-€30M growth stage, with backend depth and enough frontend fluency to own features end to end. How we work Agile and squad-based: small teams own their domains, with no unnecessary layers. AI-first: we build and work in the age of AI. Full-stack ownership: engineers are hands-on and accountable for delivered value. Bottom-up: initiative is expected, not delegated. What we offer Gross salary 55,000-75,000 € The opportunity to build core parts of Pillar’s product and engineering foundations as we scale End-to-end ownership : from product decisions and architecture to shipping features used by real customers. The chance to work in an AI-native engineering team , where AI is part of both the product and the way we build it. Close collaboration with Product, AI, and Engineering , with direct exposure to the problems we are solving for customers. Real autonomy, responsibility, and room to grow as Pillar and the engineering team scale. Location & languages Milan or Barcelona; native Italian or Spanish (mandatory) plus professional English. Hiring process CV screening. 30-min Talent Call - motivation, Pillar knowledge, mindset, languages, and startup fit. Two 30-min Technical Interviews - one backend-focused touchpoint and one frontend/product-focused touchpoint with engineers from the team. Final Interview with our CTO. One last thing Pillar is hiring this person while all of that is still taking shape. Build the system behind the scale. Compensation Range: €55K - €75K

items.desc: Description Diversity matters We are building a brand that represents the people of the world. It’s what you do that counts, and we are always looking to expand perspectives and voices to shape our future. We see you, we celebrate you, we want you! Who we are You might know us as the inventors of the bath bomb, but there’s more to this great-smelling, partly employee-owned, family-run company than pioneering cosmetics. We believe our business should put more back into the world than it takes and demonstrate that capitalism can be a force for good. The Living Wage Foundation’s statement 'a hard day's work deserves a fair day's pay' is one that we are proud to commit to in the UK. As an accredited Living Wage employer, we put our people first and fight cruel practices like animal testing, promote regeneration, and show that it is what’s inside that counts - whether that’s an ingredient in a product, or the minerals in a smartphone. Role Overview Cosmetic Warriors is the central research, formulation, and IP entity behind the Lush brand. It pioneers product invention, upholds our strict non-animal testing standards, and ensures every ingredient and formula is safe and viable for global distribution. We have always campaigned fiercely against animal testing and are committed to innovation without animal testing. Alongside our human volunteer testing, we commission and lead our own human cell culture ( in vitro ) testing programs for both raw materials and finished products. We are looking for an experienced Research & Development Toxicology Support to join our team to support product safety sign-offs, manage ingredient data, and champion non-animal safety science alongside our R&D and Regulatory Affairs teams. As part of the Cosmetic Warriors Scientific Safety function, this role bridges creative R&D, fragrance invention, and global regulatory compliance. You will work directly at the source of product creation, providing the toxicological data and scientific backing needed to prove that Lush products are safe, innovative, and ethically sound. As part of the broader Cosmetic Warriors function, you will play a key hands-on role in ensuring all products created for the Lush Brand are safe, viable, and compliant. You will advise in-house formulation teams, manage raw material data, and liaise directly with external testing partners, such as XCellR8, to interpret and act on non-animal test results. Want to see where a career at Lush could take you? Head over here to explore real stories of growth and development across the business. Please note: We may close this vacancy early if we receive an overwhelming response or our business requirements change. Key Responsibilities Formulation Advisory & R&D Support Advise in-house Research & Development (R&D), fragrance development, and product inventing teams on the safety profiles of fragrance materials, essential oils, and raw cosmetic ingredients. Provide clear guidance on safe usage levels, exposure limits, and concentration thresholds for new formulations to ensure products are both effective and safe for consumers. Act as a core member of the Cosmetic Warriors safety function, contributing to wider risk assessments and safety studies required to prove product viability for the Lush brand. In-Vitro Testing & Partner Liaison (XCellR8) Act as a primary technical contact for XCellR8 (and other animal-free testing partners), managing sample pipelines and test schedules. Analyse, interpret, and feed back on in vitro test results received from XCellR8 to inform formulation adjustments and internal safety records. Conduct bibliographic literature searches and systematic reviews on raw materials, botanicals, and new cosmetic ingredients to build robust, human-relevant safety profiles. Act as the primary technical R&D contact. Safety Assessments & Product Compliance Assist in conducting human health safety assessments for raw materials, fresh ingredients, essential oils, and finished cosmetic formulations. Support the preparation, reviewing, and maintenance of documentation for Cosmetic Product Safety Reports (CPSRs) and global compliance dossiers. Perform toxicological calculations, including Systemic Exposure Doses (SED), Margin of Safety (MoS), and Natural Origin Content calculations. Generate and maintain Safety Data Sheets (SDS) across global business markets (UK, Australia, EU). Supplier & Raw Material Data Management Gather, audit, and analyse technical data provided by raw material and fragrance suppliers (e.g., IFRA certificates, allergen breakdowns, impurity profiles, heavy metals). Classify raw materials based on chemical hazard profiles and determine requirements for internal routine or ad-hoc testing. Maintain internal chemical, biological, and toxicology databases to ensure accurate data management across the business. items.desc: Job Overview We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Junior Data Engineer to join our dynamic data team. In this role, you will play a crucial part in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and data warehouses that support business analytics and decision-making processes. You will work closely with data analysts, data scientists, and other stakeholders to ensure the integrity, availability, and security of our data assets. This position offers an exciting opportunity to grow your technical skills in a fast-paced environment while contributing to innovative data solutions that drive strategic insights. Responsibilities Assist in designing and implementing robust data pipelines using tools such as Apache Spark, Hadoop, and Informatica to process large volumes of Big Data efficiently. Develop and maintain data warehouses utilizing SQL-based technologies like Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, and Apache Hive to support reporting and analysis needs. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable database designs and ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes. Write optimized SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and analysis to support business intelligence activities. Support the deployment of cloud-based solutions on AWS for scalable storage and computing resources. Automate routine tasks using Bash shell scripting, VBA macros, or Python scripts to improve workflow efficiency. Conduct analysis of data flows and troubleshoot issues related to database performance or pipeline failures. Document technical specifications, workflows, and best practices for ongoing maintenance and knowledge sharing. Experience Proven experience working with relational databases such as Oracle or Microsoft SQL Server. Familiarity with Big Data technologies including Hadoop ecosystem components like HDFS, Hive, Spark, and related tools such as Apache Hive or Informatica. Hands-on experience with cloud platforms like AWS is highly desirable. Strong programming skills in Java or Python for data processing tasks. Knowledge of database design principles including normalization, indexing, and schema development. Experience with Shell scripting (Bash) or VBA for automation purposes is a plus. Understanding of Data Warehouse concepts and architecture to support large-scale analytics projects. Excellent analysis skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets accurately and efficiently. Join us as a Junior Data Engineer if you’re eager to develop your expertise in cutting-edge data technologies while contributing to impactful projects! We value energetic problem-solvers who thrive on learning new skills and making a difference through innovative data solutions. Pay: £14.00-£55.07 per hour Work Location: Hybrid remote in Sevenoaks TN15

Excellent skills working with continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipeline tools such as GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps. The role requires continuous learning and application of new technologies and trends. Engineers at entry-level work on coding, debugging, and learning new software technologies. With progression in this track, the responsibilities expand to include leading teams, designing complex software systems, providing mentorship, and managing cross-functional integration. The more senior roles are responsible for defining the company's technological vision, making strategic decisions, driving innovation, and setting new industry standards. Across all levels, a successful software development engineer will demonstrate strong problem-solving skills, clear communication, excellent coding abilities, a keen understanding of the software ecosystem, and a cooperative team player attitude. Responsibilities: Design, build, deploy, and maintain quality code that is simple, well-structured, clear, and well-tested. Effectively break down and solve complex problems that require research or collaboration. Communicate effectively, regardless of medium, audience, or timing. Strong command of multiple levels of automated testing (e.g., unit, integration, contract, end-to-end, etc.). Mentor new and less-experienced team members. Initiate design and feature discussions, advocating for improvements in software performance, scalability, reliability, and security. Coordinate with other teams to ensure the successful integration of software applications. Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents quickly and effectively. Understand, respond to, and address customer needs and issues with empathy and timeliness. Any other reasonable activity required by management. Required Skills: Proficiency in a typed, object-oriented programming language. Deep knowledge of software methodologies, tools, and typical architectural patterns. Enthusiasm for software work in a software-as-a-service company. Driven by client satisfaction. Strong teamwork skills. Ability to manage own time and deliver expected results on time. Commitment to continuous learning and improvement. Exceptional analytical skills. Strong computer skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office. Excellent attention to detail and strong documentation skills. Outstanding verbal and written communication skills. Strong organizational and interpersonal skills. Exceptional problem-solving abilities. Education and Experience: Degree in Computer Science or related field. 4+ years of software development experience. items.desc: We are seeking a highly motivated ST3+ Trust Grade Doctor (SPR Level) to join the UCLH Comprehensive Stroke Service. Based at the National Hospital for Neurology and Neurosurgery (NHNN) in Queen Square and UCH on Euston Road, London, this role offers a unique opportunity to gain extensive experience in one of the UK’s largest stroke services. As a Stroke Fellow, you will rotate through core and specialist stroke roles, participate in governance and teaching programs, and work within a 24/7 mechanical thrombectomy service and hyperacute stroke unit. You will also engage in a variety of multidisciplinary teams and contribute to pre-hospital stroke video triage. This position provides excellent training in the management of stroke across all stages of care, with ample opportunities for service development and clinical research. You will receive the same educational supervision as other stroke SpRs with NTNs and have the chance to observe and learn from a broad range of specialist neurological clinics. NHNN is internationally recognized for its clinical care and research, offering comprehensive care for a wide range of neurological conditions. The role includes daily teaching opportunities and the chance to work closely with experts in various neurological fields. Clinical Rotations: Engage in core and specialist stroke roles, including hyperacute and acute stroke units, general and specialist stroke clinics, and the 24/7 mechanical thrombectomy service. Participate in pre-hospital video triage and assessment for potential stroke cases in north London. Patient Care: Deliver comprehensive care at all stages of stroke management, from pre-hospital to post-hospital. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams such as cardiology, neurosurgery, and haematology for integrated stroke care. Governance and Quality Improvement: Involve in clinical governance activities like audits, case reviews, and quality improvement projects to enhance stroke care services. Teaching and Education: Engage in the teaching program, including grand rounds, bedside teaching, and tutorials. Participate in weekly protected teaching sessions related to the stroke curriculum. Research and Development: Support clinical research at the NIHR-designated hyperacute stroke research center. Contribute to service development initiatives to improve stroke care delivery. Supervision and Mentorship: Receive supervision and mentoring similar to stroke SpRs with NTNs. Mentor junior doctors and medical students within the stroke service. University College London Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust (UCLH) is one of the most complex NHS trusts in the UK, serving a large and diverse population. We provide academically led acute and specialist services, to people from the local area, from throughout the United Kingdom and overseas. Our vision is to deliver top-quality patient care, excellent education, and world-class research. We provide first-class acute and specialist services across eight sites: University College Hospital (incorporating the Elizabeth Garrett Anderson Wing) National Hospital for Neurology and Neurosurgery Royal National ENT and Eastman Dental Hospitals University College Hospital Grafton Way Building Royal London Hospital for Integrated Medicine University College Hospital Macmillan Cancer Centre The Hospital for Tropical Diseases University College Hospital at Westmoreland Street We are dedicated to the diagnosis and treatment of many complex illnesses. UCLH specialises in women’s health and the treatment of cancer, infection, neurological, gastrointestinal and oral disease. It has world class support services including critical care, imaging, nuclear medicine and pathology. We are committed to sustainability and have pledged to become a carbon net zero health service, embedding sustainable practice throughout UCLH. We have set an ambitious target of net zero for our direct emissions by 2031 and indirect emissions by 2040. For the full Person Specification and more information regarding the main responsibilities of this role, please refer to the attached Job Description. Collaboration with Neurology Services: Collaborate with the neurology team at NHNN, gaining experience in specialist neurological clinics and the Neuro-SDEC model. This overview highlights the Stroke Fellow role's clinical, educational, and research responsibilities within a leading stroke service. Liaison and Diversion is a process of supporting people coming through the criminal justice system, and diverting people from this pathway where possible through engagement with service users with vulnerabilities. RECONNECT is a care after custody service that seeks to improve the continuity of care of people leaving prison or an immigration removal centre (IRC) with an identified health need. The 24/7 Urgent Care hub provides mental health assessment, intensive community interventions, advice, support and guidance twenty four hours, seven days a week across several access points for individuals presenting in crisis. This service has brought all urgent care teams together to create one central hub and thus diverts service users away from blue light services and affords them the right access to the right care at the right time in the most appropriate environment. Mersey Care is one of only three trusts in the UK that offer high secure mental health facilities. At the heart of all we do is our commitment to ‘perfect care’ – care that is safe, effective, positively experienced, timely, equitable and efficient. We support our staff to do the best job they can and work alongside service users, their families, and carers to design and develop future services together. A minimum of five years’ experience in systems testing and validation (automotive, robotics), or similar roles. Desirable Skills: Autonomous systems / ROS2 experience; Sensor systems (LiDAR, GPS/RTK, cameras, radar); CAN bus and vehicle systems; Functional safety validation (ISO 13849 / ISO 12100); Data logging and telemetry tools.  A Siemens Mobility Kft. K+F központjában, a XI. kerületi Infoparkban olyan projekteken dolgozunk, melyek biztosítják a zavartalan, fenntartható, megbízható és biztonságos közlekedést. 
 Tudj meg többet a cégünkről: www.siemens.hu/mobility 
 A projektről: Az elektronikus biztosítóberendezések a mai modern vasúti hálózatok elengedhetetlen tartozékai, amelyek biztosítják a vonatok számára a megfelelő vágányutakat és menetengedélyeket, a vágányok mentén telepített terepi objektumok és az ETCS L2 központok segítségével. Az EU platform a Siemens Mobility egy új generációs, generikus terméke, amely lehetővé teszi külsőtéri vasúti objektumok (jelzők, váltók, foglaltság érzékelők) redundáns ethernet hálózaton keresztül történő biztonságos üzemeltetését. Az új platformra épülő Smart Object Controller termékcsalád az infrastruktúra üzemeltetők számára belépést biztosít a biztosítóberendezések ötödik korszakába (DSTW), a nagy fokú decentralizáltság, az egységes architektúra és a könnyű karbantarthatóság által.
 A csapat tagjaként az alábbi feladatok várnak rád: 
 Szoftverfejlesztési feladatok végzése az EU platform nevű projektben.
 Szoros együttműködés a nemzetközi projekt többi tagjával.
 Kernel közeli biztonságkritikus C++ modulok fejlesztése és tesztelése.
 Dokumentációkészítés angol nyelven.
 Te vagy az ideális jelölt, ha: 
 Rendelkezel szakirányú felsőfokú végzettséggel.
 Erős C++ tudással, min. 3 év tapasztalattal rendelkezel.
 Mélyebb ismereteid vannak 32 bites ARM (Cortex-M, Cortex-R) processzorok terén.
 Szeretsz hardver közeli, beágyazott rendszereken és alacsony absztrakciós szinteken dolgozni.
 Proaktivitás, problémamegoldó hozzáállás, mérnöki szemléletmód és jó csapatmunka jellemez.
 Aktív, erős angol nyelvtudással rendelkezel, írásban és szóban is.
 Betanulási idő alatt hetente 3-4, hosszútávon pedig 2-3 napot tudsz az irodából dolgozni.
 A pályázásod során előnyt jelenthet, amennyiben: 
 Jártas vagy az alábbiakban: EULYNX, Sahara/RaSTA, ARMv7 assembly, CMake, LLVM toolchain, Lua.
 Linux felhasználói szintű ismeretével rendelkezel.
 Érdekel a vasút és a vasúti infrastruktúra.
 Aktív német nyelvtudással rendelkezel.
 Mi az, amit mi biztosítunk? 
 Családbarát munkahelyet, kötetlen munkaidővel, rugalmas hozzáállással.
 Stresszmentes környezetet, ahol nagy hangsúlyt kap a work-life balance.
 Fejlődési lehetőségeket, egyéni tréning kerettel, kidolgozott karrierúttal.
 Fontos számunkra az egészséged, többek közt élet- és egészségbiztosítással óvunk.
 Ergonomikus munkakörnyezetet biztosítunk számodra, ezzel is kényelmessé téve az irodai munkavégzést.
 A felsoroltak mellett egy több mint 20 elemből álló béren kívüli juttatási csomaggal várunk.

 Schimbă lumea de mâine împreună cu noi. 
 Unitatea noastră de afaceri Siemens Motion Control (DI MC) este unul dintre liderii mondiali în furnizarea de produse, sisteme, soluții și servicii în domeniul controlului mișcării. Aceasta include aproximativ 20.000 de angajați și patru segmente de business. Cu locații globale de producție, cercetare și dezvoltare (R&D) și servicii, MC este aproape de clienții săi și activă într-o gamă largă de industrii. 
 În rețeaua noastră de fabrici, Siemens AG dezvoltă și produce motoare electrice pentru piața globală. Clienții noștri țintă activează în domeniul tehnologiei de automatizare, în industria auto și în domeniul intra-logisticii. Pentru a susține creșterea noastră de succes, vom extinde locațiile noastre într-un mod direcționat în următorii ani. Digitalizarea și simulările ne sprijină în planificarea viitorului și în implementare. 
 In prezent cautam noi colegi pe rolul de Failure Room Analysis Technician care sa se alature echipei de Calitate. Vei fi responsabil pentru investigarea și analiza produselor neconforme provenite din producție, reclamații clienți (RMA) sau audituri interne, în vederea identificării modurilor de defectare și a cauzelor rădăcină. Acesta oferă suport tehnic echipelor de Calitate, Producție și Inginerie pentru implementarea acțiunilor corective și preventive. 
 Responsabilități principale: 
 - Recepționează și înregistrează probele trimise pentru analiză. 
 - Efectuează inspecții vizuale, măsurători și teste funcționale asupra produselor neconforme. 
 - Realizează analize de defect folosind echipamente și metode specifice laboratorului. 
 - Identifică și clasifică modurile de defectare. 
 - Colectează și documentează dovezi tehnice (fotografii, măsurători, rapoarte de testare). 
 - Întocmește rapoarte de analiză și concluzii tehnice. 
 - Participă la investigații de tip 8D, 5 Why și Ishikawa. 
 - Colaborează cu departamentele de Calitate, Producție, Inginerie Proces și Logistică pentru identificarea cauzelor rădăcină. 
 - Menține trasabilitatea probelor și arhivarea documentației aferente. 
 - Respectă procedurile de siguranță, calitate și mediu aplicabile în laborator. 
 - Asigură ordinea și buna funcționare a echipamentelor din Failure Analysis Room. 
 Cerințe 
 - Studii medii tehnice sau studii superioare în domeniul tehnic 
 - Experiență în domeniul calității, producției sau analizelor tehnice constituie avantaj. 
 - Experiență în utilizarea echipamentelor de măsurare și testare. 
 Cunoștințe și competențe: 
 - Interpretarea desenelor tehnice și a specificațiilor produselor. 
 - Utilizarea instrumentelor de măsură (șubler, micrometru, comparatoare, multimetru etc.). 
 - Cunoștințe de bază privind metodologiile de rezolvare a problemelor (8D, 5 Why). 
 - Cunoștințe Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). 
 - Atenție la detalii și gândire analitică. 
 - Abilități de comunicare și lucru în echipă. 
 - Cunoștințe de limba engleză la nivel tehnic.

Tu intégreras l'équipe de 35 AI Engineers, dont la mission est de concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions IA sur mesure pour nos clients : systèmes d'IA générative, modèles de vision, agents, moteurs de traitement
items.desc: Notre équipe Plus de 90 ingénieurs issus des meilleures écoles d'ingénieurs et d'informatique (CentraleSupélec, 42, Télécom Paris, Polytechnique, Mines, etc.) composent notre équipe technique. Tu intégreras l'équipe de 35 AI Engineers, dont la mission est de concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions IA sur mesure pour nos clients : systèmes d'IA générative, modèles de vision, agents, moteurs de traitement documentaire. Plus de 100 projets IA sont aujourd'hui en production et utilisés quotidiennement. Nos AI Engineers travaillent en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes produit, sales et fullstack afin de comprendre les enjeux métiers et de construire des systèmes fiables, évaluables et maintenables. De la phase de cadrage technique à la mise en production , ils s'appuient sur des pratiques d'ingénierie solides (revues de code, évaluation systématique des modèles, tests automatisés, CI/CD) et participent activement aux choix techniques et à l'amélioration continue des projets. Chez Galadrim, nous cherchons à faire évoluer le métier d'AI Engineer , en tenant les deux bouts : la maîtrise scientifique des modèles et la capacité à les intégrer dans un produit réellement utilisé. Nous formons des ingénieurs capables d'intervenir au croisement de la tech, du produit et du business. Dans un contexte de forte croissance (+50 % par an depuis sa création) , Galadrim renforce son pôle Data & IA et cherche ses futurs AI Engineers. Tes missions Concevoir et livrer des systèmes IA en production : de la conception technique jusqu'au monitoring, pas seulement jusqu'à la démo Construire des applications GenAI (RAG, agents, pipelines LLM) et des modèles plus classiques (vision, prévision, NLP) selon ce que le problème exige réellement Mesurer ce que tu construis : mettre en place les jeux d'évaluation et les métriques qui permettent de dire si le système est bon, et de le prouver au client Développer en full-stack pour intégrer l'IA dans le produit : un modèle qui n'est pas branché ne sert à personne Arbitrer les choix structurants de modèle et d'infrastructure, et les expliquer au client en termes de valeur business Challenger le besoin : évaluer la pertinence d'une approche IA au regard du problème posé, et recommander une alternative quand elle est plus adaptée Quelques exemples de problématiques de nos clients L'AS Saint-Étienne , l'un des clubs historiques du football français, nous a confié la refonte complète de son écosystème data. Le club dispose de 515 000 contacts répartis sur neuf sources qui ne communiquent pas entre elles : un même supporter qui achète un billet, commande un maillot et participe à un jeu concours existe sous trois identités distinctes. L'enjeu est de reconstituer un profil unique par supporter . Le projet couvre une couche d'ingestion Azure (temps réel et batch), un Data Lake en architecture medallion , la réconciliation des 515 000 profils sur trois clés de matching et la migration de 20 Go depuis une base MySQL historique. Nous avons développé un système de détection automatique des situations à risque sur les murs de grimpe pour Hapik , réseau international de salles d'escalade ludique. Nous avons créé une solution de computer vision branchée sur les flux de vidéosurveillance existants , qui identifie en temps réel les anomalies et déclenche une alerte auprès du personnel. Techniquement, le projet couvre l'acquisition des flux caméras (RTSP/ONVIF), la segmentation fine des équipements de sécurité via des modèles type SAM3, le tracking des personnes par zone, une classification d'état en temps réel, ainsi qu'un back-office de paramétrage et de supervision. Pour Eiffage Énergie Systèmes , filiale d'un grand groupe du BTP et de l'énergie, nous automatisons une chaîne de facturation de contrats de fourniture d'énergie. Ces contrats reposent sur des formules de révision complexes et des clauses de performance dont les calculs étaient jusqu'ici produits manuellement. Le projet s'appuie sur un pipeline OCR d'extraction depuis des documents hétérogènes (factures fournisseurs, exports métier, tableurs), une structuration des données par LLM , un moteur de règles métier reproduisant les formules contractuelles, et une interface de validation humaine avant génération des documents financiers. Dans le cadre de ce poste, tu seras amené(e) à travailler de temps en temps chez nos clients, pour comprendre leurs enjeux et leurs métiers, afin de mieux les accompagner Nos technos Chez Galadrim, nous considérons que la technologie est un moyen, pas une fin. Nous choisissons les outils les plus adaptés aux enjeux de chaque projet plutôt que d'imposer une stack unique. IA : API OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, Python/PyTorch, Hugging Face Outils d'IA au quotidien : Claude Code, Codex, Cursor Backend & infra : Typescript/Node.js, .NET/C#, PostgreSQL, AWS/GCP/Azure/Kubernetes, Terraform Frontend : TypeScript, React/React Native Ta progression Tu seras suivi(e) par un(e) mentor technique, avec du …

items.desc: Job Description Summary GE Vernova est une entreprise mondiale du secteur de l’énergie, organisée en trois segments : Power, Wind et Electrification. Fort de plus de 130 ans d'expérience dans la résolution des défis mondiaux, GE Vernova est idéalement positionnée pour jouer un rôle de leader dans la transition énergétique, en continuant à électrifier le monde tout en travaillant à sa décarbonation, avec plus de 70 000 employés répartis dans plus de 100 pays. Le segment Electrification de GE Vernova fournit des technologies et systèmes de réseau avancés, permettant la transmission et la distribution d'énergie depuis le point de génération jusqu'au point de consommation, et soutient une transition énergétique décarbonisée et sécurisée. Sur son site industriel situé à Villeurbanne (France), conçoit, teste et fabrique des disjoncteurs haute tension destinés aux opérateurs de réseaux et industriels nationaux et internationaux. Job Description Présentation du poste Le stage se déroulera au sein du C entre de R echerche de T echnologie H aute T ension ( HVTRC ), sur le site industriel de Villeurbanne , dans le cadre d'un projet visant à renforcer la capacité de diagnostic de l'état diélectrique des appareillages sous enveloppe métallique (GIS/GIL), dans un contexte de transition énergétique marqué par la croissance de l'électrification des réseaux et le remplacement progressif du SF₆ par des gaz alternatifs. Dans l’appareillage de type GIS, la présence de décharges partielles (DP) constitue un indicateur précoce de dégradation de l'isolation. La capacité à les détecter représente un enjeu majeur de fiabilité et de maintenance prédictive. La difficulté principale réside dans l’identification du phénomène étant à son origine. Les activités du stage seront axées autour de l’optimisation et fiabilisation de l’analyse des données mesurées. L’objectif final étant d’améliorer les systèmes de monitoring de poste client. L'approche envisagée s'appuiera sur des méthodes de Machine Learning (ML), afin d'automatiser et de fiabiliser l'extraction d'informations difficilement accessibles par les méthodes de traitement de données classique. Missions Le Stage S’articulera Autour Des Missions Suivantes Développement de techniques d’identification des décharges partielles Participation aux campagnes d’essai de caractérisation des différents types de défauts rencontré, en collaboration avec l’ingénieur en charge du projet Présentation des résultats lors des revues périodiques. Formation École d’ingénieur (généraliste ou spécialisée) ou université, niveau Bac+4 / Bac+5, avec une forte composante en data science (ou IA). Connaissances / Compétence requises Bonnes bases en Python Connaissances solides en Traitement du signal et Machine Learning Rigueur en développement de code Curiosité, esprit d’innovation, adaptabilité et autonomie, persévérance et esprit d’équipe Langues : Français / Anglais, parlé et écrit Des notions en électromagnétisme HF est appréciée Date de début du stage/alternance et durée Début : janvier 2027 Durée : 6 mois

items.desc: Environnement de travail : Au sein du Groupe Actifs Réseau et Maintenance de la DSI d'Enedis, une équipe d'une dizaine de data scientists et data engineers réalise des études innovantes sur des sujets tels que la maintenance prédictive des réseaux, la mobilité électrique ou encore l'anticipation des charges sur le réseau. Nous développons des modèles permettant d'anticiper les besoins futurs de recharge sur le territoire et en particulier autour des autoroutes. Ces travaux contribuent aux études de dimensionnement du réseau électrique, un enjeu majeur pour accompagner la transition énergétique et garantir la qualité d'alimentation des clients dans les années à venir. Missions confiées : Vous rejoindrez le projet Mobilité Électrique et contribuerez à l'amélioration de modèles de recharge des véhicules électriques sur autoroute à horizon 2035. L'arrivée de nouvelles données fournies par nos partenaires ouvre de nouvelles perspectives d'analyse et d'amélioration des modèles existants. Explorer, analyser et valoriser de nouvelles sources de données partenaires Retravailler les modèles existants de recharge des véhicules électriques Intégrer et caractériser les stations de recharge situées à proximité des échangeurs autoroutiers Produire des restitutions cartographiques et des visualisations facilitant l’analyse des résultats Votre profil Niveau de diplôme préparé : Étudiant(e) en Master 2 ou dernière année d'école d'ingénieur Spécialisation du diplôme préparé : Analyse de données, programmation Python/SQL, Machine Learning en option Intérêt pour les problématiques liées à l'énergie, aux transports ou à la mobilité Esprit d’analyse, rigueur scientifique et capacité à travailler en équipe Durée du stage : 6 mois Ce que nous recherchons : Compétences dans les domaines suivants : Python (Pandas, Polars) Simulation de déplacements Graphes Cartographie (QGIS, Folium) Tout en étant soumise au principe de neutralité religieuse et politique, Enedis ouvre ses postes à toutes les compétences, toutes les énergies et toutes les personnalités sans exclusion. Conformément aux engagements pris par Enedis en faveur de l'accueil et de l'intégration des personnes en situation de handicap, cet emploi est ouvert à toutes et à tous sous réserve de l'aptitude médicale délivrée par la médecine du travail. L'emploi est tenu de respecter les principes et engagements définis par le Code de Bonne Conduite d'ENEDIS. Engagés dans le respect de la santé-sécurité, nos salariés relèvent des défis technologiques, écologiques et sociétaux. Soumise au principe de neutralité et engagée pour l'inclusion, Enedis ouvre ses opportunités à tous les talents.
