items.desc: Contexte de la missionDans le cadre de l?intégration des données Amazon au sein de la plateforme SDDS, nous recherchons un Business Data Analyst pour faire le lien entre les besoins métiers et les équipes techniques. La priorité porte sur les données de performance commerciale (Sales Performance), puis sur les données Media. MissionsRéaliser et maintenir l?inventaire des données Amazon disponibles : jeux de données, API, tables, champs et sources. Effectuer le mapping source-cible entre les données Amazon et les modèles SDDS, en précisant les transformations nécessaires. Documenter les KPI métiers : données sources, règles de calcul, granularité et dépendances. Identifier les données, attributs et transformations manquants pour répondre aux besoins métiers. Réconcilier les données Amazon avec les sources existantes : analyser les incohérences, doublons et différences de définition. Réaliser la recette fonctionnelle des données, documenter les anomalies et suivre leur résolution. Rédiger et maintenir les spécifications fonctionnelles, les documents de mapping et les dictionnaires de données et de KPI. Participer aux ateliers métiers et coordonner les échanges avec les équipes techniques. Profil candidat: Vous disposez d?une expérience confirmée en Business Analysis Data, BI ou analyse de données e-commerce, avec une forte dimension fonctionnelle. Compétences attendues : Expérience des données e-commerce, marketplace ou retail : ventes, sell-out, stocks, performance commerciale. Inventaire de données et mapping source-cible, notamment à partir d?API externes. Définition et documentation de KPI métiers. Analyse des écarts, qualité et réconciliation des données. Rédaction de spécifications fonctionnelles et de dictionnaires de données. Recette fonctionnelle et échanges directs avec les métiers. Français et anglais courants. Expériences appréciéesDonnées Amazon : Vendor Central, Seller Central, SP-API, Amazon Ads. Connaissance de SDDS et de ses modèles de données. Pratique de SQL pour l?analyse et le contrôle des données. Connaissance de GCP / BigQuery. Une expérience solide sur d?autres environnements e-commerce, marketplace ou retail pourra être étudiée en l?absence d?expérience directe sur Amazon.

items.desc: Job Description: Skywise is a leading digital services company, wholly owned by Airbus. We deliver a first-of-its-kind offer that seamlessly integrates Planning & Operations Control, Flight, Technical, and Ground Operations. By providing interoperable digital solutions for end-to-end operations, Skywise combines aircraft manufacturer expertise and digital know-how to transform operational complexity into predictable and profitable performance, ensuring resilient and more sustainable operations. Role Summary: The Security Operations Specialist is a key position in the Security team, responsible for focusing on the day-to-day protection and monitoring of security systems to enable the business to comply with SKYWISE’s security policy and certifications (ISO27001 & EASA Part IS). This position will ensure that all security issues are managed in an effective manner in accordance with Policy and certifications (ISO27001 & EASA Part IS). They will propose amendments and improvements to existing Security structures and policies, based on changes in the industry and best practices. This includes supporting and implementing Security initiatives across the organization, helping to develop support of the Security function, and ensuring that all procedures are detailed within the appropriate documents. This position partners with the internal IT and M&T teams to ensure global security across the organization. Main Responsibilities: Internal Security Monitoring: Continuously monitor internal network traffic, firewalls, routers switches, VPN gateways and local servers for suspicious activity and unauthorized access. Analyze alerts, internal flow logs, domain controller activity and endpoint detection and response (EDR/XDR) telemetry. Defne, manage and improve Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) correlation rules, detection logic and alters to reduce false positives and catch internal threat vectors. Incident Response & Forensic: Act as the primary responder for internal security incidents (e.g. malware outbreaks, unauthorized device connections, compromised internal user accounts, phishing containment). Collaborate with the Airbus Security Operations Center in case of a security event. Ensure evidence collection and event tracking and follow up. Vulnerability Management & System Hardening: Perform regular internal security vulnerability scans across our internal networks and assets. Manage the security tools for regular scanning by ensuring security requirements are met, and propose improvements. Assess the identified vulnerabilities and partner with the SKYWISE IT and M&T teams to prioritize and verify patches for critical internal vulnerabilities. Internal Access & Identity Management: Monitor the active directory for abnormal administrative privileges escalation, dormant account reactivation, or other suspicious activity. Monitor internal network to ensure non-compliant or rogue hardware cannot connect to corporate LANs or Wi-Fi. Qualified Experience / Skills / Training: Experience & Capabilities: 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience in a Security Operations Center, system administration with a security focus or internal network defense. Strong networking experience, Windows/Linux OS internals and AD architecture Expertise in configuring and deploying Enterprise EDR/XDR solutions Proficiency in analyzing the logs from firewalls, systems and network access control. Experience with AD threat vectors Knowledge, Skills, Demonstrated Capabilities & Competencies: Knowledge required on security tools for scanning, EDR/XDR, SIEM and firewalls Ability to break down complex issues Ability to work efficiently with others in a team environment Project management skills and highly organized Ability to work in an international environment spanning multiple jurisdiction with potentially different impacts on security. What we Offer: Work-Life Balance & Flexibility Flexible working hours with a hybrid model (3 days per week in our Blagnac office). 25 annual paid leave days + Collective and individual JRTT (proportional to working time). A 6th week of paid leave (proportional to working time). Generous 12-day "family reason absence package." Family & Health Support 5 additional full-pay days for maternity, paternity, and adoption leave. Comprehensive Health Insurance plan. 3 extra paid annual leave days for employees with RQTH status. Financial Wellbeing & Savings Success sharing (intéressement) and profit sharing (participation) schemes. Monthly seniority bonus for all employees with 3+ years of service. Access to Airbus Group saving plans (PEG) including investment in Airbus shares after 3+ months of service. Access to a TSA (Time Saving Account) Collective and Mandatory Retirement Savings Plans (PERCOL and PERO). On-site & Other Perks Several catering options for lunch (canteens, food trucks, bakeries, etc.). Staff councils (CSE) offer various social, cultural, and sports activities/services. Navette (shuttle) service. …

items.desc: The Investment Data Area (IDA) is AllianzGI’s home for investment-management-related data products. Today IDA owns ten established data products (incl. Positions Transactions, Issuer Security Information, Benchmark Market Index Data, Investment Key Figures, and Performance Attribution, among others), which share dependencies and largely leverage IDS, AllianzGI’s strategic partner for investment data services. Vendor Market Data (VMD) will be IDA’s eleventh data product. As the Data Product Owner (f/m/d) for Vendor Market Data, you will report to the Investment Data Area Business Lead and be responsible for delivering AI-ready, quality-assessed, lineage-tracked vendor and research data to business stakeholders. To reach your goals, you will be supported by your Squad, part of AllianzGI’s Investment Data Area Tech, and work alongside Data Stewards, Business / Data Analysts and Engineers within the Squad. In this role, you serve as the functional lead, responsible for driving the Squad’s work through a clear Product Vision and Strategy. Your mission is to grow VMD from its current scope into the single governed raw-data layer for all vendor and research data consumed by investment teams and beyond – owning ingestion (native, API, SFTP), data quality, access management, lineage and cataloguing in Unity Catalog, while consuming teams build their own models and analytics on top. You will manage the Squad’s Backlog, set priorities across onboarding waves, and define requirements to ensure alignment with strategic objectives. Balancing business and technical priorities, you will guide the Squad to deliver data solutions that meet organizational goals, focusing on maximizing customer value through effective product management. This position will be based in Frankfurt, Munich, Hong Kong or Singapore. What you will do Product Ownership Agile Delivery Define and communicate the vision, mission, and roadmap for the Vendor Market Data Product. Own and manage the product backlog in JIRA, translating documented data demands from Risklab, Equity, Fixed Income, Multi Asset, and Investment Research into actionable epics and user stories. Lead backlog grooming, sprint planning, and review ceremonies in collaboration with the Agile Master. Prioritize onboarding of vendors and datasets (native delta-sharing, API, SFTP) according to business value and squad capacity. Develop and own the global VMD operating model, data domains and ingestion patterns, ensuring every dataset is catalogued and lineage-tracked in Unity Catalog. Manage the research and resolution of data discrepancies and quality issues, involving appropriate resources within the squad. Collaborate with Market Data Services (MDS) on license management and ensure appropriate data access management. Identify and drive migration of existing, duplicated data flows into the governed VMD platform. Stakeholder Engagement Act as the primary liaison between consuming Investment stakeholders, investment tech products and the VMD Squad, ensuring raw data ownership stays with IDA while consuming teams refine their own models and analytics on top. Facilitate requirement-gathering workshops with investment teams and beyond to document and prioritize data needs, including scoping not-yet-documented requirements (e.g. Research Team). Coordinate with other Data Product Owners within IDA as well as with DPA to ensure alignment on data architecture, governance and shared platform usage. Organize and lead stand-ups, retrospectives, and review sessions with impacted stakeholders. Create firmwide transparency on vendor data sourcing, licensing terms, lineage and quality, ensuring consumers understand and trust the data. Partner with MDS / Procurement on vendor contract and licensing terms (incl. AI usage), and with the ODP Platform team on infrastructure and streaming architecture decisions. Serve as business partner for ITA leadership and investment teams on all matters relating to vendor and market / research data. Strategic Alignment Communication Maximize business value while protecting the squad’s autonomy and delivery flexibility. Ensure transparent communication of timelines, dependencies, open decisions and risks (e.g. vendor contracts, streaming architecture) to all stakeholders. Promote a culture of continuous improvement, excellence, collaboration, and agile maturity. Work closely together with Chapter Leads by defining the set of necessary competences in the Squad. Share fair and transparent feedback on the Squad members with their respective Chapter Lead. What you bring Academic background in Data Technology, Finance, Business Administration, Economics or a related field, with a strong understanding of data-driven business strategies. Several years of relevant experience in market / vendor data management, data product ownership or asset management. items.title: Expert Site Reliability Engineer - Edge Infrastructure (f/m/d)
items.card: Your Role Orbem’s AI-powered MRI systems run on edge infrastructure deployed directly at customer sites, such as hatcheries and food processing plants. As an Expert Site Reliability Engineer, you will own the reliability, availability, and performance of this growing global fleet. You are the team’s deepest technical authority on the on-premise platform, setting architecture and standards through hands-on expertise.
items.desc: We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you. Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future. Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter. Help us see what's possible. Join us. Your Role Orbem’s AI-powered MRI systems run on edge infrastructure deployed directly at customer sites, such as hatcheries and food processing plants. As an Expert Site Reliability Engineer, you will own the reliability, availability, and performance of this growing global fleet. You are the team’s deepest technical authority on the on-premise platform, setting architecture and standards through hands-on expertise. You will own the hardware, network, operating system, and Kubernetes layers that power teams like Data, Machine Learning, and Software. Your Day-to-Day As an Individual Contributor on the expert track, your responsibilities center entirely on deep technical ownership and execution: Edge Infrastructure Ownership Own the reliability and lifecycle of our edge racks: server hardware, network equipment, custom Linux-based OS, and the GPU-enabled Kubernetes layer running our AI classification services. Design and improve automation for provisioning our growing fleet (50+ edge clusters and counting) using tools like Terraform, BMC/IPMI, and router APIs. Maintain the secure network connecting edge deployments to our central cloud, and the tooling that enables safe software delivery to the fleet. Reliability & Incident Management Participate in the rotation of support on weekdays and own triage and resolution for escalated production issues. Lead post-incident reviews and turn findings into lasting, automated fixes. Define and monitor SLOs/SLIs/SLAs for physical edge systems running unattended in the field. Extend our observability stack (Prometheus, custom hardware exporters, Grafana, Datadog) to catch issues proactively, often before customers notice. Architecture, Collaboration & Craft Set technical direction for edge infrastructure projects and contribute to technical planning and ticket writing. Mentor fellow engineers through pairing, design/code reviews, and knowledge sharing, raising the technical bar without formal management authority. Act as the top-level technical escalation point, personally helping resolve the most complex support and production issues. Collaborate with stakeholders (with the eventual support of a Product Manager) to gather requirements and manage technical alignment. Automate away repetitive manual work, applying the same rigor to internal tooling as to a customer-facing product. Your Experience and Skills Container Orchestration: Super proficient in maintaining Kubernetes on edge machines. Programming: Fluency in at least one modern language, such as Golang or Python . Monitoring : Deep understanding of concepts and tools such as Prometheus and Grafana. Terraform is a native language to you. Linux & Server Expertise: Deep proficiency in Linux-based systems and experience with server hardware , including components like RAID controllers BIOS, and Booting . DevOps: Good understanding of release systems and proficiency with GitOps tools like Argo CD. Security Management: Proficient in security concepts like certificate management (issuing, lifecycles, etc.) and secure network tunnels (e.g., IPSec/VPN). What Makes You Stand Out Holistic Data Center Engineering Expertise : Deep understanding of how to deal with low-level hardware like routers, switches, servers, BIOS, and TPM modules . Bare-Metal Automation : Proven experience designing and implementing automation for bare-metal infrastructure provisioning. Modern Kubernetes & CI/CD Architect : Moves beyond basic deployments to architecting sophisticated, automated, and resilient delivery pipelines using cutting-edge GitOps and Kubernetes-native tooling. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Mastery : Expert-level proficiency with Terraform to build version-controlled, repeatable, and scalable environments. Behavioral competencies Strategic Thinker: You develop a clear vision and roadmap for the edge platform, considering its long-term health, scalability, and usability. Strong Communicator: You build strong relationships with development teams and other stakeholders, communicate changes clearly, and secure buy-in. High Ownership: You take end-to-end ownership of your technical output, including reliability, documentation, and continuous improvement. items.desc: Location Am Brauhaus 12 01099 Dresden Employment Area IT - Cloud Services Level Experienced professional Working Model Full-time Reference ID 5085 Schwarz Digits creates the technological foundation for digital sovereignty in Europe. As the IT and digital division of the Schwarz Group, we develop and manage the IT infrastructures for the retail divisions Lidl and Kaufland, as well as Schwarz Production and PreZero. At the same time, we operate as an independent provider in the external market to support companies across Europe in their digital transformation. We bundle our core services in the areas of Cloud, Cyber Security, Data & AI, Communication, and Workspace. Join us and contribute to digital sovereignty in Europe. With us, you will work at the intersection of agility and security: You will benefit from fast decision-making processes, enjoy genuine creative freedom in your projects, and be able to build upon the stable foundation of the Schwarz Group. Join our engineering team in Dresden to drive digital sovereignty and build next-generation cloud infrastructure at scale. As a Software Development Engineer, you will operate at the intersection of software engineering, cloud architecture, and infrastructure automation: Your Tasks Next Generation Cloud Architecture: Design and develop the next generation of our cloud and virtualization technology. Cloud System Architecture: Design, build, and operate resilient, highly scalable cloud services and underlying IaaS/PaaS components. Automation & Infrastructure as Code: Implement and maintain infrastructure provisioning using code-driven workflows (IaC). Control Plane & Microservices: Develop custom Kubernetes operators, controllers, and RESTful/gRPC APIs to control cloud resource lifecycles. CI/CD & Observability: Build automated testing/deployment pipelines and implement continuous monitoring, logging, and tracing across distributed cloud environments. Site Reliability Engineering (SRE): Participate in performance optimization, capacity planning, fault recovery, and incident management to maintain high availability guarantees. Agile Collaboration: Work closely in cross-functional DevOps/DevSecOps teams with Cloud Architects, Security Engineers, and Product Owners. Your Profile Must have Educational Background: Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or equivalent practical experience. Software Development: 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong proficiency in C, C++, Go (Golang), Python, or Rust for infrastructure-level programming. Cloud Architecture & Networking: Solid understanding of core networking protocols (TCP/IP, BGP, DNS, HTTP/2), Load Balancing, Ingress Controllers, and Service Meshes (e.g., Istio, Cilium). DevOps & CI/CD: Mastery of modern CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD) and GitOps principles. Language Skills: Business fluent in English (oral and written); German skills are a plus. Nice to have Experience with open-source cloud management platforms such as OpenStack (Nova, Neutron, Cinder) or Ceph distributed storage. Cloud security fundamentals (IAM, zero-trust network design, encryption at rest and in transit). Active contributions to open-source cloud-native projects (e.g., CNCF ecosystem). items.desc: At Endress+Hauser, progress happens by working together. As the global leader in measurement instrumentation, our more than 18,000 employees shape the future in the field of process automation. Whether developing and realizing new technology as a team, collaborating to build instrumentation, or strengthening vital relationships with countless global industries, we work to create trusted relationships that help everyone thrive. As a family-owned company, we look beyond short-term moves and work to create a vision that is forward-thinking for our people, our clients, and the world at large. With innovative solutions, our global IT team, Endress+Hauser InfoServe, ensures that our corporate group can rely on seamlessly functioning IT. To strengthen our Business Analytics team, we are looking for an Inhouse Consultant SAP Business Analytics to shape the future of our global data, analytics, and AI landscape. This position is based in Freiburg im Breisgau. What is the role about? In this role, you will help shape the future of SAP Business Analytics at Endress+Hauser. Working closely with colleagues across IT and the business, you will combine project leadership, consulting, and hands-on solution development to deliver data-driven solutions that support decision-making across our global organization. As part of our Data Engineering team, you will contribute to strategic initiatives around SAP S/4HANA, Business Analytics, and modern data platforms while helping build the foundation for future analytics and AI use cases across the Endress+Hauser Group. Which tasks will you perform? You will: Lead and contribute to global IT projects with responsibility for planning, coordinating, aligning stakeholders, and ensuring the successful delivery within our SAP Business Analytics landscape Contribute to IT projects as a Data Engineer or Business Intelligence (BI) consultant, designing, developing, and maintaining scalable business analytics applications As part of the Data Engineering team, you will primarily work in a BW/4HANA PCE environment, integrating data from various SAP (S/4HANA and ECC) and non-SAP systems and making it available for enterprise-wide reporting Manage the transition from SAP ECC to S/4HANA from an analytical perspective, assessing the impact on existing data models and analytical applications Play an active role in implementing our data lakehouse strategy based on SAP Business Data Cloud and advise business teams on building data products and self-service analytics solutions using SAP Datasphere and SAP Business Data Cloud Apply your experience with front-end analytics tools such as SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP BusinessObjects Lumira Designer, and SAP BusinessObjects Analysis for Office as part of your broader responsibilities Drive solution design, implementation, and continuous improvement in close collaboration with internal experts and external partners Contribute to the foundation for future analytics and AI initiatives across the Endress+Hauser Group What do we expect from you? You: Have several years of experience in SAP Business Intelligence, combined with a strong technical understanding of the SAP BW/BI stack, from system administration and data extraction to data modelling and reporting Have experience working with SAP BW/4HANA and an interest in shaping modern analytics solutions in an international environment Have proven project management skills and the ability to coordinate stakeholders, structure initiatives, and successfully drive implementation topics forward Have experience in designing and implementing data models in SAP Datasphere, combined with the motivation to contribute to modern, scalable analytics architectures Have an understanding of modern data architectures and cloud-based analytics concepts; experience with SAP Business Data Cloud, Snowflake, or data lakehouse architectures is an advantage Have good knowledge of the SAP FI/CO processes and data structure in both S/4HANA and ECC is beneficial Have good communication skills in English and German complete your profile What can you expect from us? items.desc: Location Am Brauhaus 12 01099 Dresden Employment Area IT - Cloud Services Level Entry-level professional Working Model Full-time Reference ID 5114 Schwarz Digits creates the technological foundation for digital sovereignty in Europe. As the IT and digital division of the Schwarz Group, we develop and manage the IT infrastructures for the retail divisions Lidl and Kaufland, as well as Schwarz Production and PreZero. At the same time, we operate as an independent provider in the external market to support companies across Europe in their digital transformation. We bundle our core services in the areas of Cloud, Cyber Security, Data & AI, Communication, and Workspace. Join us and contribute to digital sovereignty in Europe. With us, you will work at the intersection of agility and security: You will benefit from fast decision-making processes, enjoy genuine creative freedom in your projects, and be able to build upon the stable foundation of the Schwarz Group. Join our engineering team in Dresden to drive digital sovereignty and build next-generation cloud infrastructure at scale. As a Software Development Engineer, you will operate at the intersection of software engineering, cloud architecture, and infrastructure automation: Your Tasks Next Generation Cloud Software: Develop the next generation of our cloud and virtualization technology. Cloud System Architecture: Build and operate resilient, highly scalable cloud services and underlying IaaS/PaaS components. Automation & Infrastructure as Code: Implement and maintain infrastructure provisioning using code-driven workflows (IaC). Control Plane & Microservices: Develop custom Kubernetes operators, controllers, and RESTful/gRPC APIs to control cloud resource lifecycles. CI/CD & Observability: Build automated testing/deployment pipelines and implement continuous monitoring, logging, and tracing across distributed cloud environments. Site Reliability Engineering (SRE): Participate in performance optimization, capacity planning, fault recovery, and incident management to maintain high availability guarantees. Agile Collaboration: Work closely in cross-functional DevOps/DevSecOps teams with Cloud Architects, Security Engineers, and Product Owners. Your Profile Must have Educational Background: Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or equivalent practical experience. Software Development: software engineering experience, with proficiency in C, C++, Go (Golang), Python, or Rust for infrastructure-level programming. Cloud Architecture & Networking: Basic understanding of core networking protocols (TCP/IP, BGP, DNS, HTTP/2), Load Balancing, Ingress Controllers, and Service Meshes (e.g., Istio, Cilium). DevOps & CI/CD: Mastery of modern CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD) and GitOps principles. Language Skills: Business fluent in English (oral and written); German skills are a plus. Nice to have Experience with open-source cloud management platforms such as OpenStack (Nova, Neutron, Cinder) or Ceph distributed storage. Cloud security fundamentals (IAM, zero-trust network design, encryption at rest and in transit). Active contributions to open-source cloud-native projects (e.g., CNCF ecosystem). items.desc: DEINE AUFGABEN Du verbindest Engineering und Beratung: Du findest heraus, was Kund:innen in der Cybersecurity wirklich brauchen, und setzt es mit KI-Unterstützung selbst um. Unsere Projekte reichen von Security Operations über Identity & Access Management bis zur Absicherung von KI, vor allem bei Banken und Versicherungen. Du analysierst gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen Prozesse, Systeme und Sicherheitsanforderungen und leitest daraus konkrete Lösungen ab. Zusätzlich im Senior Level: Du verantwortest Teilprojekte und bist Ansprechperson für Fach- und Managementseite. Du entwickelst Prototypen, Automatisierungen und Anwendungen rund um Cybersecurity und KI und bringst sie bis in den Betrieb. Zusätzlich im Senior Level: Du gestaltest Architekturen und triffst technische Grundsatzentscheidungen. Du vergleichst Security-Produkte und neue Anbieter, machst ihre Stärken und Grenzen transparent und bindest bestehende Lösungen sinnvoll ein. Du setzt KI-Agenten und Coding-Tools gezielt ein und prüfst ihre Ergebnisse, bevor sie bei Kund:innen landen. Du konzipierst und moderierst Workshops und Trainings, etwa zur sicheren Nutzung von KI. Du erkennst neue Anwendungsfelder bei Kund:innen und arbeitest an Angeboten und Demos mit. Zusätzlich im Senior Level: Du gewinnst Folgeaufträge und entwickelst unser Leistungsportfolio im Cyber-Bereich weiter. Du teilst Dein Wissen im Team und machst gute Lösungen wiederverwendbar. Was dir an Security-Wissen noch fehlt, lernst Du bei uns im Projekt und von unserem Cyber-Team. Pentest- oder SOC-Erfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung. DEIN PROFIL Du willst Dich nicht zwischen Technik und Beratung entscheiden? Musst Du bei uns nicht. Wir ersetzen keine Security-Hersteller, sondern prüfen, was sie taugen, und bauen, was fehlt. Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die beides können: Du hast ein Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, einer Ingenieur- oder Naturwissenschaft oder einem anderen technisch geprägten Fach abgeschlossen, oder du bringst vergleichbare Praxis mit. Du hast bereits programmiert und etwas gebaut, das im Einsatz ist: im Job, als Werkstudent:in, in eigenen Projekten oder in einem Startup. Du kannst direkt nach dem Studium einsteigen; für das Senior Level bringst Du mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung mit. Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit KI, verstehst ihre Ergebnisse und sprichst es an, wenn etwas nicht stimmt. Du erklärst komplexe Themen verständlich und hast Freude daran, mit Kund:innen Lösungen zu entwickeln und Angebote mitzugestalten. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1 in beiden Sprachen) und bist für Termine bei Kund:innen reisebereit. Ein Plus, aber kein Muss: Erfahrung mit Cloud, Containern oder Identity-Systemen wie Entra ID Praxis mit KI-Agenten, MCP oder anderen LLM-Anwendungen Erste Berührungspunkte mit Security Operations, IAM oder Zero Trust Beratungserfahrung oder Kenntnisse einer regulierten Branche Nicht jeder Punkt passt? Bewirb Dich gerne trotzdem. DEINE BENEFITS Unterstützende Teamkultur: Teamzusammenhalt ist uns wichtig - wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig und pflegen eine gesunde Officekultur. Unser Eventteam plant regelmäßige Afterworks und sorgt für einen Austausch außerhalb des Arbeitsplatzes. Schnelle Verantwortungsübernahme: Du übernimmst ab Tag 1 spannende Aufgaben mit eigener Verantwortung - egal ob auf deinem Projekt oder bei der Einbringung in interne Aufgabe - du gestaltest mit! Klare Karrieremöglichkeiten: Bei uns findest du ein Umfeld, das dich fördert, fordert und weiterbringt. Wir haben klar definierte Karrieremöglichkeiten und ein transparentes Anforderungsmanagement and jedes Level. Kreativer Arbeitsplatz: Wir geben dir die Freiheit und Zeit, kreative Lösungen zu entwickeln und bieten dir dafür die beste und modernste Hardware an (Apple oder Windows). Mitarbeiterbenefits: Flexible Arbeitsmodelle, BahnCard, JobRad, Spendit-Card, Wellpass und betriebliche Altersvorsorge sorgen für dein Wohlbefinden. Außerdem gibt es bei uns im Office immer einen gefüllten Soft-Getränkekühlschrank. Attraktive Urlaubsregelung: Du genießt 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr und kannst flexibel von daheim arbeiten. Wir unterstützen führende Unternehmen in den Bereichen Cybersecurity, Data Analytics, Cloud, AI und Technology Transformation & Data. Bei uns erwarten Dich flache Hierarchien, eine herausragende Teamkultur und Raum für Deine persönliche und berufliche Weiterentwicklung. An unseren Standorten in München, Köln und Zagreb kannst Du gemeinsam mit einem kreativen, interdisziplinären Team innovative Lösungen gestalten und die Zukunft aktiv mitprägen. Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil von TRUSTEQ!

items.desc: embecta is a global medical device company with a 100-year legacy in insulin delivery and diabetes care. Driven by innovation, purpose, and a commitment to improving lives, we are expanding our portfolio of solutions to serve even more patients, healthcare providers, and communities around the world. embecta, formerly part of BD, is one of the largest pure-play diabetes care companies in the world, leveraging its nearly 100-year legacy in insulin delivery to empower people with diabetes to live their best life through innovative solutions, partnerships and the passion of more than 2,000 employees around the globe. We are seeking a technically skilled Engineering Technician – Days to be the subject matter expert for our highly automated packaging equipment. This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of critical manufacturing assets, driving machine performance, reliability, efficiency, and continuous improvement within a fast-paced medical device manufacturing environment. Working closely with Production, Engineering, Quality, and Maintenance teams, you will play a key role in ensuring our operations consistently deliver world-class levels of safety, quality, and performance. What You'll Do Serve as the technical subject matter expert (SME) for high-speed, fully automated process equipment. Monitor equipment performance and proactively identify opportunities to improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), reliability, and waste reduction. Provide hands-on technical support to Production and Maintenance teams, troubleshooting issues and driving timely resolution of equipment challenges. Lead investigations into recurring faults and performance losses, implementing sustainable corrective and preventative actions. Apply learnings from breakdowns, stoppages, and quality issues to continuously improve maintenance strategies and machine performance. Plan and coordinate repairs, upgrades, overhauls, and equipment improvement projects, including spare parts management. Partner with suppliers, contractors, and equipment manufacturers to support equipment optimisation and technical problem-solving. Support investigations relating to quality events, customer complaints, and manufacturing defects, implementing improvement actions to prevent recurrence. Contribute to the development and coaching of engineering technicians, apprentices, and new team members. Participate in Continuous Improvement, Lean Manufacturing, TPM, and equipment optimisation initiatives across the site. Maintain accurate technical documentation, maintenance records, performance reports, and engineering metrics. Champion a strong safety culture by ensuring equipment and work areas are maintained to the highest safety and housekeeping standards. About You You are a technically curious and solutions-focused engineering professional who enjoys understanding how equipment works, improving performance, and solving complex technical problems. You take ownership of issues from identification through to resolution and thrive in a collaborative manufacturing environment where reliability, quality, and efficiency are critical. Essential Qualifications & Experience National Craft Certificate, Engineering Technician qualification, or a third-level qualification in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronic, Mechatronic, or related Engineering discipline. Experience working within a high-volume manufacturing environment. Strong knowledge of mechanical and electrical systems associated with automated manufacturing equipment. Practical troubleshooting and fault-finding experience. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate root causes and implement sustainable solutions. Ability to work independently and collaboratively across multiple functions. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Good computer literacy and experience using engineering or maintenance systems. Preferred Experience Exposure to automation, PLC-controlled equipment, sensors, robotics, vision systems, or industrial control systems. Experience in Medical Device, Pharmaceutical, Food Manufacturing, or other regulated manufacturing industries. Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, TPM, Six Sigma, or Continuous Improvement tools. embecta is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We do not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, marital or domestic or civil union status, familial status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetics, disability, military eligibility or veteran status, or any other protected status.

items.desc: The Role Vanguard Ireland is a leading investment company / fund manager providing a wide range of UCITS funds and ancillary services throughout Europe and across the globe. As a market leader, the talent and passion of our crew is critical to our success. Together, we share a common set of values rooted in integrity, excellence, and a strong investor first ethic. Vanguard Ireland provides a superior foundation for building a professional career – a place for people to learn, to achieve and grow. Our philosophy aims to balance personal lifestyles, perspectives and crew/client needs as an important part of our culture. The Compliance team in Ireland forms a critical part of European compliance and supports Vanguard’s activities in Ireland and continental Europe. The compliance team based in Ireland includes a range of activities such as compliance advisory, monitoring and testing, central compliance, enterprise compliance, regulatory affairs and anti-financial crime. The Compliance Specialist will join European Compliance based in Dublin and report to senior Compliance leadership in Ireland. The role provides independent second-line advice, oversight and constructive challenge in support of Vanguard’s regulated activities and wider European business. This is a substantive individual-contributor role for a Compliance professional who can take ownership of assigned matters, interpret regulatory requirements, assess risk and deliver high-quality work with an appropriate degree of independence. In this role you will The role involves a broad range of Compliance responsibilities, including: Provide clear, practical and risk-based Compliance advice to business stakeholders on the application of Irish and EU regulatory requirements, internal policies and regulatory expectations Exercise independent judgement and provide constructive challenges to first-line proposals, activities and controls, documenting conclusions and escalating where appropriate Support oversight of the Vanguard’s Irish regulated activities, including relevant product, distribution, delegation, outsourcing and European branch activities Interpret regulatory developments and contribute to impact assessments, implementation plans, policies, procedures, training and communications that translate requirements into practical actions Interpret regulatory developments and contribute to impact assessments, implementation plans, policies, procedures, training and communications that translate requirements into practical business actions Support senior Compliance leaders in responding to information requests, supervisory engagements, inspections and other interactions with the Central Bank of Ireland and, where relevant, other European regulators Contribute to a strong Compliance culture by sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues and helping improve the effectiveness and efficiency of Compliance processes Participates in special projects and engages with colleagues in European Compliance, Legal, Risk and other functions as required What it takes Experience in asset management, a UCITS management company, MiFID investment firm, fund governance, distribution or related regulated activities Knowledge of Central Bank of Ireland requirements and supervisory expectations, including the relevant governance, conduct and fitness and probity requirements Familiarity with UCITS, MiFID II, cross-border distribution, marketing compliance or investment-related compliance matters Experience contributing to regulatory change, compliance risk assessments, monitoring or thematic review activity, remediation oversight, senior-management reporting or regulatory engagement A relevant professional qualification in Compliance, law, risk, accountancy or financial services Special Factors Vanguard is not offering visa sponsorship for this position This is a hybrid position and would require you to work in the office 3 days per week (Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday) Please note that we review applications on a rolling basis and may close this role early if there is a high level of interest. To avoid missing out, we recommend applying as soon as possible Why Vanguard? Vanguard is a different kind of investment company. It was founded in the United States in 1975 on a simple but revolutionary idea: that an investment company should manage its funds solely in the interests of its clients. This is a philosophy that has helped millions of people around the world to achieve their goals with low-cost, uncomplicated investments. It's what we stand for: value to investors. How We Work Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for the majority of our crew members, designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

items.desc: Fides è una Tech Company che affianca le aziende nei loro percorsi di Digital Transformation . Sviluppiamo soluzioni tecnologiche custom e offriamo servizi IT tailor-made , progettati per rispondere alle esigenze di business dei nostri Clienti e Partner. Accompagniamo l’evoluzione digitale attraverso percorsi di modernizzazione infrastrutturale e applicativa . Ci occupiamo della migrazione verso le principali piattaforme Cloud di mercato e dello sviluppo di soluzioni cloud-native, scalabili e integrate . Lavorare con noi significa avere l’opportunità di confrontarsi con settori, tecnologie e progetti diversi , sviluppando nuove competenze e costruendo un percorso professionale ricco di esperienze. Operiamo in ambiti che spaziano dal Banking & Finance al Digital Retail , dal Telco al Pharma e all’ Automotive , fino ai Servizi e alle Soluzioni ICT per l’ Industry 4.0 . Affianchiamo inoltre le aziende nei loro percorsi di trasformazione digitale , dall’e-commerce alla logistica, contribuendo a innovare processi, servizi e modelli di business . Un contesto dinamico e trasversale , in cui competenze, curiosità e voglia di innovare possono trasformarsi in nuove opportunità di crescita. Grazie a oltre 20 anni di esperienza e a più di 300 risorse distribuite tra le sedi di Milano, Napoli, Roma, Torino e Verona, Fides si posiziona tra le principali aziende italiane Hi-Tech. Ci distinguono affidabilità e competenza , che mettiamo al servizio dei nostri Clienti attraverso progetti e servizi innovativi, efficienti e altamente flessibili . Posizione: Siamo alla ricerca di un/una Cloud Engineer , da inserire all'interno del team Fides per progetti di Cloud Transformation e modernizzazione infrastrutturale presso importanti clienti Cross Industry . La figura sarà coinvolta nelle attività di progettazione, implementazione, gestione e ottimizzazione di infrastrutture e servizi Cloud , contribuendo alla realizzazione di soluzioni tecnologiche scalabili, sicure e ad alte prestazioni. Cerchiamo un profilo con esperienza nell'utilizzo delle principali piattaforme Cloud, quali AWS, Microsoft Azure o Google Cloud Platform (GCP) , capace di supportare i processi di migrazione, configurazione e gestione di ambienti infrastrutturali complessi. La risorsa contribuirà inoltre alle attività di automazione infrastrutturale, monitoraggio dei servizi e miglioramento continuo delle performance , collaborando con team tecnici multidisciplinari e supportando l'adozione delle principali best practice Cloud. La modalità di lavoro prevista è ibrida , con possibilità di inserimento presso le nostre principali sedi di Napoli, Milano, Roma, Torino e Verona . Requisiti: Competenze tecniche Esperienza nella progettazione, configurazione e gestione di infrastrutture e servizi Cloud. Buona conoscenza di almeno una delle principali piattaforme Cloud: AWS, Microsoft Azure o Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Conoscenza dei principali servizi Cloud, con particolare riferimento a risorse computazionali, storage, networking e gestione delle identità. Esperienza nella gestione di ambienti infrastrutturali Cloud e Hybrid Cloud. Conoscenza dei principi di Infrastructure as Code (IaC) e dei principali strumenti di automazione infrastrutturale. Familiarità con sistemi operativi Linux e Windows Server. Conoscenza delle tecnologie di containerizzazione, con particolare riferimento a Docker e Kubernetes. Esperienza nelle attività di monitoraggio, troubleshooting e ottimizzazione delle performance infrastrutturali. Conoscenza dei principi di Cloud Security, gestione degli accessi e protezione delle risorse. Familiarità con le principali metodologie di backup, disaster recovery e business continuity. Conoscenza delle principali best practice di gestione, manutenzione e ottimizzazione degli ambienti Cloud. Costituiscono requisiti preferenziali: Esperienza in progetti di migrazione e modernizzazione di infrastrutture On-Premise verso ambienti Cloud. Conoscenza di strumenti di Infrastructure as Code, quali Terraform, Ansible o CloudFormation. Familiarità con processi e strumenti di Continuous Integration e Continuous Delivery (CI/CD). Esperienza nella gestione di architetture a Microservizi e ambienti containerizzati. Conoscenza di strumenti di monitoraggio e osservabilità delle infrastrutture. Possesso di certificazioni Cloud, quali AWS Certified, Microsoft Azure o Google Cloud. Esperienza in progetti tecnologici presso clienti appartenenti a differenti settori di mercato. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Competenze trasversali Buone capacità di analisi e problem solving. Autonomia nella gestione delle attività assegnate. Attitudine al lavoro in team. Capacità di gestione delle priorità e delle scadenze. Precisione e attenzione alla qualità delle soluzioni implementate. Buone capacità comunicative e relazionali. Predisposizione all'apprendimento continuo e alla condivisione delle competenze. Altre informazioni: Cosa offriamo Retribuzione annua lorda (RAL) compresa …

items.desc: La risorsa entrerà a far parte di un team specializzato e in crescita, determinato a ottimizzare e razionalizzare i flussi e i processi di fraud detection della Compagnia, in un ambiente complesso, caratterizzato da elevati volumi di transazioni, schemi fraudolenti in evoluzione e interazioni costanti con tutte le aree di business. Si tratta di un ruolo strategico e operativo, che combina spiccate capacità analitiche e competenze antifrode con un approccio hands-on sull’analisi dei dati. All’interno del team di Data-Driven Fraud & Anomalies Detection Office, ricerchiamo una figura che supporti Groupama Assicurazioni nella gestione end-to-end della progettazione, implementazione e aggiornamento dei sistemi di fraud detection, per l’individuazione delle aree a maggiore rischio e delle relative azioni migliorative. Attività principali: Sviluppare, validare e monitorare modelli avanzati di Fraud Detection e Anomaly Detection, supervisionati e non supervisionati; Applicare tecniche statistiche, algoritmi di Machine Learning e metodologie di behavioural analytics per identificare pattern sospetti, anomalie e potenziali comportamenti fraudolenti; Definire, monitorare e ottimizzare indicatori antifrode e KPI di detection, minimizzando i falsi positivi e massimizzando l’efficacia operativa; Progettare e implementare pipeline dati e soluzioni scalabili per l’elaborazione di grandi volumi di dati; Collaborare con i team IT, Data Engineering e Business per l’industrializzazione di modelli ML e l’integrazione nei processi operativi antifrode; Garantire il monitoraggio continuo delle performance dei modelli, identificando fenomeni di model drift e definendo strategie di retraining; Contribuire all’evoluzione delle piattaforme antifrode, dei motori a regole e delle architetture data-driven; Produrre analisi, dashboard e reporting evoluti a supporto delle attività investigative e decisionali. Competenze e skill richiesti per il ruolo Solida conoscenza di Machine Learning, statistica applicata e metodologie analitiche; Esperienza pratica nello sviluppo e manutenzione di modelli predittivi e sistemi di anomaly detection; Ottima conoscenza di Python e delle principali librerie analitiche e ML (Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PySpark); Esperienza hands-on con SQL e scripting per attività di analisi dati, reporting e data preparation; Familiarità con strumenti di Business Intelligence e Data Visualization; Esperienza nella progettazione, sviluppo e messa in produzione di soluzioni data-driven e modelli ML in ambiente cloud; Conoscenza dei principali servizi cloud in ambito Data & AI (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform), la conoscenza dell’ecosistema Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Vertex AI, Cloud Storage o servizi equivalenti) costituisce un plus; Capacità di progettare soluzioni analitiche spiegabili, riproducibili e scalabili. Proattività, curiosità e capacità di anticipare l’evoluzione delle frodi; Attitudine al lavoro di squadra e comprovata capacità di collaborazione in contesti cross-funzionali; Ottime capacità comunicative, con attitudine a tradurre risultati analitici in insight rilevanti per il business; Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese La conoscenza della lingua francese preferenziale costituisce un plus. Formazione Laurea magistrale in: Informatica, Ingegneria, Statistica, Matematica o equivalenti; Almeno 3 anni di esperienza in un ruolo analitico simile (esperienza maturata in ambito assicurativo, preferenziale); Preferibili percorsi specialistici in Data Science, Big Data, Data Mining, IOT. Sede di Lavoro: Roma Inquadramento contrattuale CCNL applicato: ANIA Tipologia contrattuale: Tempo indeterminato. Trattamento economico: Per la posizione in oggetto la retribuzione annua lorda (RAL) iniziale sarà non inferiore a € 40.000. La RAL sarà comunque commisurata all’effettiva esperienza maturata, al livello delle competenze acquisite e alla corrispondenza del profilo ricercato col profilo della risorsa. Il trattamento economico è integrato da: il Premio Aziendale di Produttività Variabile (PAV) previsto dal Contratto Integrativo Aziendale Il pacchetto retributivo prevede, inoltre, benefit aziendali disciplinati dal CCNL delle Assicurazioni e dal Contratto Integrativo Aziendale, tra cui: smart working welfare aziendale, previdenza integrativa, polizza salute, polizza infortuni, polizza vita, ecc. items.desc: At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards. In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate. A few examples of your responsibilities Create exceptional visual assets across every touchpoint. From paid and organic social content to product visuals, brand assets, and presentation decks, create work that's effective, visually compelling, and delivered fast. Own the quality of every deliverable from brief to final output. Master your craft and raise the bar. Develop deep expertise in your primary discipline: motion, graphic design, illustration, or others. Build skills across adjacent ones to increase the range of work you can own. Stay ahead of what is possible, with AI. Use AI tools to push your creative output further and faster—from generating concepts and exploring visual directions quickly, to accelerating production workflows. Stay ahead of what's possible and apply new techniques where they matter. Deliver at pace, without sacrificing quality. Handle a high volume of work across multiple projects and priorities without dropping below excellent. Make smart trade-offs between craft and urgency. Execute with business awareness. Understand why something is being made, who it's for, and what success looks like. Use that context to make better craft decisions—not just aesthetically stronger ones, but strategically purposeful ones. Spot opportunities and take initiative. Don't wait for a fully formed brief. Flag gaps, propose ideas, and identify moments where proactive creative work can have a real impact—then act on them. What we look for Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter. Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar. Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent. Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English. What we offer Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field. An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too. All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work. Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £56,345 to £85,797 in London and from €54,346 to €82,557 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £196,764 in London or €188,848 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity. The selection process In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process. Some …

environment Very organized, rigorous and reliable Computer skills to include operation of retail point of sale system, Word, Excel and email An entrepreneur with the ability to drive results A positive, outgoing, high-energy personality able to thrive within a high paced environment and ability to multi-task with ease while maintaining a balance of daily responsibilities Great communication skills, ability to work with sales teams and liaise with corporate Service-oriented, proactive to propose improvements and support other team members RAL : 25.000 - 30.000 #LI-MP1 Joining our Company The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth. Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. items.desc: Il Gruppo IRSAP è uno dei maggiori gruppi italiani protagonista nel settore del riscaldamento e del condizionamento in Europa. Azienda italiana con oltre 60 anni di storia, rappresenta il made in Italy esportando in oltre 30 Paesi nel mondo. Innoviamo il Benessere Climatico con Tecnologia, Design e Sostenibilità. Continua ricerca e design sono gli elementi del nostro successo: un gruppo di oltre 1100 persone in Europa impegnate a tradurre il ricco patrimonio di conoscenze in prodotti innovativi, destinati alla realizzazione di impianti per la climatizzazione. Il Gruppo è composto da un insieme di aziende e marchi che opera da anni in tutta Europa, con stabilimenti produttivi in Italia, Romania e filiali commerciali in Francia, Spagna, Gran Bretagna e Germania. Per la nostra sede di Arquà Polesine (Rovigo) cerchiamo una figura di: Process Engineering Specialist La persona entrerà nella funzione Engineering di Gruppo e contribuirà a garantire l'efficienza operativa e il miglioramento continuo del processo produttivo, attraverso l'analisi tecnica dei processi esistenti, l'implementazione di soluzioni innovative e il supporto tecnico specialistico allo stabilimento.Il ruolo prevede una stretta collaborazione con le diverse funzioni aziendali e con i fornitori esterni, con l'obiettivo di garantire soluzioni produttive efficienti, affidabili e coerenti con le esigenze industriali. In particolare, si occuperà di: Implementazione di nuovi impianti: contribuire all'analisi delle soluzioni tecnologiche e gestire le diverse fasi dei progetti, dalla selezione dei fornitori all'installazione, fino alla predisposizione della documentazione tecnica e alla formazione del personale. Aggiornamento tecnologico degli impianti: sviluppare e coordinare interventi di innovazione e miglioramento degli impianti esistenti, individuando soluzioni tecnologiche e seguendone l'implementazione. Problem solving e miglioramento continuo: analizzare le criticità dei processi produttivi, individuarne le cause e definire soluzioni efficaci, pianificandone e monitorandone l'attuazione. Sviluppo di nuovi prodotti: collaborare con l’R&D e le altre funzioni coinvolte nello sviluppo prodotto, effettuando studi di fattibilità produttiva e valutando le soluzioni tecniche più appropriate per l'industrializzazione di nuovi prodotti. Progettazione di componenti: analizzare le esigenze tecniche, progettare e seguire la realizzazione di componenti destinati ai processi produttivi, supportandone la messa in funzione. Requisiti Diploma Tecnico Meccanico o Meccatronico, Diploma ITS o Laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica; Esperienza di 2-3 anni maturata in ruoli analoghi, preferibilmente in contesti industriali strutturati di medio/grandi dimensioni; Forte orientamento alla produzione e interesse per i processi di industrializzazione e miglioramento continuo; Conoscenza della lingua inglese (B1); Buona conoscenza dei software di progettazione Solid Edge (3D) e AutoCAD (2D); Conoscenza della Direttiva Macchine; Conoscenza degli strumenti e delle metodologie di Lean Production; Ottima conoscenza del pacchetto Microsoft Office; Disponibilità a brevi trasferte in Italia e Estero . Completano il profilo Attitudine alla collaborazione e capacità di interfacciarsi efficacemente con interlocutori interni ed esterni; Proattività, autonomia operativa e capacità organizzative; Approccio analitico e orientamento alla risoluzione dei problemi; Propensione al miglioramento continuo e alla ricerca di soluzioni innovative. Offerta Contratto a Tempo Indeterminato; RAL compresa tra €30.000 e €35.000; Welfare aziendale; Mensa aziendale. items.desc: We are hiring: Investment Analyst, Amsterdam Dynamic Credit is looking for an Investment Analyst for the Amsterdam office to join our Portfolio Management Team. The team currently manages over EUR 10 billion in both residential and buy-to-let mortgages as well as a portfolio of consumer loans. We offer a steep learning curve and the opportunity to work closely with the other analysts and portfolio managers as a full member of the team. You will be involved in a variety of projects, ranging from valuation of mortgage portfolios and performance reporting to running models and preparing client pitch presentations. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to be the point of contact for large institutional investors and manage investor queries. Please note that even though our company is international, for this position we are looking exclusively for people fluent in Dutch , due to the nature of the investment product and markets relevant to the role. How your skills will be challenged: Supporting portfolio managers and analysts in daily tasks Creating detailed portfolio performance reports for clients Researching market developments and contributing to quarterly updates Assisting in the sales process and the setup of asset management mandates Pricing of mortgage products Maintaining and enhancing valuation models Managing operational investment processes Having the opportunity to initiate projects and improvements What the ideal candidate looks like: Fluent in Dutch and English (both a must for this role) Valid resident permit for the Netherlands Quantitative orientation Master’s degree in finance, economics, econometrics or equivalent Excellent oral and written communication skills Strong analytical skills to understand the complexities of our business Independent thinker, able to challenge viewpoints Experience with Excel Knowledge of VBA / SQL / R / Python is a plus Hands-on experience with AI tools (e.g. large language models) and an interest in using them to improve and automate processes What do we offer? A full-time position Competitive compensation, perks, and benefits: pension scheme, NS Business Card, training and education, fun team events throughout the year Working in an area of great importance to the strategy of Dynamic Credit A steep learning curve The opportunity to be part of an entrepreneurial company and to work closely with analysts, portfolio managers, and partners in a pivotal position within the teams Access to the latest tools and technology Great colleagues and an informal, international, and fun atmosphere, with frequent events and drinks. Dynamic Credit Dynamic Credit is a fixed income asset management and direct lending firm. Founded in 2003, Dynamic Credit has over 69,000 clients, EUR 10 billion in mandates and funds and is headquartered in Amsterdam. Dynamic Credit manages (securities of) loans of others and its own proprietary direct lending. Our mission is to create a better match between savings and credit for a more prosperous and sustainable society. Dynamic Credit is innovative and makes complexity easier to understand through transparency. Our partners choose Dynamic Credit because we provide deep insight and reveal opportunities in alternative fixed income. We offer employees a steep learning curve and the opportunity to work closely with all teams at Dynamic Credit. We stand for a diverse and inclusive workplace where everybody can be themselves: an informal and open working environment with a wide variety of backgrounds, both locally and internationally, where a flexible and hybrid way of working is the standard. Dynamic Credit respects your privacy and does everything it can to protect your personal data. Please read our privacy statement at www.dynamiccredit.com/privacy before sharing any personal information with us. We do not accept unsolicited applications or CVs from recruitment agencies for this vacancy. Please note that without fluency in both English and Dutch and a valid working permit for the Netherlands, we are unable to process or respond on your application

items.desc: Laboratory Technician IEPG Group Join the IEPG group and help build the next generation power system research infrastructure by integrating real-world grid hardware with advanced real-time simulation and digital substation technology. Job description UTOPYS (Understanding Large, Complex Power Systems) is a ten-year programme to build a new theory of large, complex power systems, enabled by the a state-of-the-art real-time power system simulator. As Laboratory Technician, you will help build, operate, and maintain this large-scale real-time simulation environment and its laboratory in. The technician will contribute to the deployment and operation of a large-scale real-time simulation environment for future power systems, supporting researchers in developing, validating, and operating simulation models and associated laboratory infrastructure. Key Responsibilities: UTOPYS Research Infrastructure Support the installation, operation, maintenance, and expansion of the UTOPYS simulation platform and associated laboratory infrastructure. Power System Models and Simulation Support researchers in configuring, validating, and operating real-time power system simulations and experimental environments. Substation and Grid Technologies Contribute practical expertise on power system operation, substation equipment (relays, IEDs, merging units), protection schemes, and grid automation to support realistic modelling and experimental validation. Simulation Platform Integration Build and configure hardware-in-the-loop setups, connecting simulators to physical equipment through I/O interfaces, cables, communication networks, measurement systems, and other related software and hardware components. Technical Support for Research Teams Assist researchers, PhD candidates, students, and industrial partners in preparing and operating experimental setups and simulation studies. Laboratory Operations and Safety Ensure safe operation of laboratory facilities and compliance with laboratory procedures. You will become a member of the ESP Lab team, headed by Lab Manager Sandra Dordevic. The ESP Lab team is responsible for the operation, maintenance, and development of the department’s research infrastructure and experimental facilities supporting research and education activities. Your work will primarily focus on supporting the Intelligent Electrical Power Grids (IEPG) section, headed by Professor Peter Palensky, with a particular emphasis on the UTOPYS programme. This position offers an excellent opportunity to work in a multidisciplinary environment together with researchers, students, utilities, manufacturers, and industrial partners, contributing to the development of future sustainable and resilient power systems. About the Department The Department of Electrical Sustainable Energy addresses the technical, scientific, and societal challenges of the energy transition through research in: DC Systems, Energy Conversion and Storage (DCE&S) Photovoltaic Materials and Devices (PVMD) Intelligent Electrical Power Grids (IEPG) High Voltage Technologies (HVT) The department provides expertise across the entire electrical energy system chain, from generation and conversion to transmission, distribution, and end-use applications. The department operates the Electrical Sustainable Power (ESP) Lab, one of Europe's largest academic power systems laboratories. The ESP Lab hosts advanced facilities for high-voltage testing, DC grids research, power electronics, protection and control, digital substations, and real-time power system simulation, supporting research and education in future energy systems. The Intelligent Electrical Power Grids (IEPG) section conducts research on the operation, control, digitalisation, and resilience of future power systems, with a strong focus on real-time simulation, digital twins, cyber-physical energy systems, protection and control, and grid automation. UTOPYS is one of its initiatives, providing a unique large-scale platform for power system simulation and experimentation. Job requirements MBO/HBO degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Technology, Power Systems, or a related field. Practical experience with electrical power systems, substations, or transmission and distribution networks. Understanding of power system protection, control, and automation principles. Experience with power system simulation platforms, SCADA systems, RTDS, OPAL-RT, or similar technologies is an advantage. Familiarity with communication protocols and digital substation concepts (e.g. IEC 61850) is desirable. Hands-on, analytical, and solution-oriented, with strong troubleshooting skills. Comfortable working in a multidisciplinary research environment with researchers, students, and industrial partners. Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken. items.desc: WHO WE ARE: Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services. We offer solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology , Operations, Industry X and Accenture Song. IO Poland is a Warsaw-based Accenture delivery center providing information technology enterprise solutions and customizable products. We specialize in Data Center & Cloud architecture, remote management services and DevOps support across different stages of software development. For more information about Accenture Technology Poland please visit our website. THE WORK: Plan and deliver on-premises migrations from VMware, Hyper-V and physical servers to AWS, using 7 Rs strategies while continuously expanding your cloud migration expertise . Assess environments with AWS Application Discovery Service and Migration Hub, and develop your skills in server inventory and application dependency mapping. Migrate and modernize Windows Server workloads, including Active Directory-integrated applications, IIS, SQL Server and file services, while embracing opportunities to deepen your AWS knowledge . Automate infrastructure and migrations with Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Ansible, PowerShell and AWS Systems Manager, applying a proactive approach to skill enhancement . Secure and troubleshoot migrated workloads using IAM, encryption, patching, AWS Backup and compliance monitoring while collaborating with application, security, network, database, vendor and architecture teams. Flexible: The work location for this role may include a mix of working remotely (most of the time), onsite at a client or in an Accenture office - depending on specific project circumstances. With all our roles, there is some in-person time for collaboration, learning and building relationships with clients, peers, leaders, and communities. As an employer, we will be as flexible as possible to support your specific work/life needs. WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU: Grow your AWS migration expertise through hands-on work with enterprise environments, including discovery, migration, modernization, automation and cloud operations. Build skills across a broad AWS and automation stack , including EC2, EBS, S3, VPC, IAM, RDS, CloudWatch, Systems Manager, MGN, DMS, DataSync, Terraform and CloudFormation. Work with international teams and clients, using English and Polish while continuing your professional development through technology-focused projects. HERE’S WHAT YOU’LL NEED: Minimum 2 years of practical AWS experience, including hands-on participation in on-premises to AWS migration projects. Hands-on knowledge of AWS services and migration technologies, including EC2, EBS, S3, VPC, IAM, RDS, CloudWatch, Systems Manager, MGN, DMS, DataSync and/or Migration Hub. Windows Server administration experience (2012 R2–2025), including Active Directory, DNS, GPO, file services and troubleshooting, combined with virtualization experience in VMware vSphere and/or Microsoft Hyper-V. PowerShell scripting and Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation, plus a good understanding of TCP/IP, routing, DNS, firewalls, VPNs, load balancers and hybrid cloud connectivity. English and Polish at B2 level or above, with the ability to discuss technical topics with client stakeholders and application or server owners. Availability to support migration cutovers outside regular business hours or in a 24/7 model when required. BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE: Linux administration knowledge. Broader hands-on experience with migration assessment, dependency mapping or cloud security and compliance monitoring. Research indicates that some candidates, especially the most diverse ones, may hesitate to apply for positions if they don't meet all requirements. If you believe you possess the necessary skills, even if not meeting every requirement, we wholeheartedly encourage you to submit your application. WHAT WE OFFER: Individual support of a People Lead and a specific path of professional development, as well as the possibility of a session with a Coach. A wide training package, including soft, technical and language training, access to e-learning platforms, Gallup test, GenAI training, and the possibility of co-financing courses and certifications. Employee Assistance Program with legal, financial and psychological consultations. Accenture employees eligible for the Employee Share Purchase Plan automatically become eligible for quarterly dividends if they own company shares. Paid employee referral program. Private medical care and life insurance. Access to the WorkSmile platform, including the possibility of using products and services such as the Multisport card. items.title: AWS DevOps Engineer
items.card: WHO WE ARE: Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services. We offer solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology , Operations, Industry X and Accenture Song. For more information about Accenture
items.desc: WHO WE ARE: Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services. We offer solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology , Operations, Industry X and Accenture Song. For more information about Accenture Technology Poland please visit our website: Poland | Let There Be Change | Accenture. THE WORK: Support and maintain AWS infrastructure (EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, Route 53, CloudWatch), ensuring stability and performance. Write and maintain IaC with Terraform and Ansible to provision and configure Linux and Windows servers in a repeatable way, scripting in Bash/Python. Build and improve CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) with automated validation and deployment, working with Git. Take part in on-premises-to-AWS migrations and run workloads on Docker and Kubernetes , using open-source tools (Prometheus, Grafana). Learn and grow alongside senior engineers: troubleshoot issues, document solutions and suggest improvements. Flexible: The work location for this role may include a mix of working remotely, onsite at a client or in an Accenture office - depending on specific project circumstances. With all our roles, there is some in-person time for collaboration, learning and building relationships with clients, peers, leaders, and communities. As an employer, we will be as flexible as possible to support your specific work/life needs WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU: Work on cloud projects for international clients, building your expertise in AWS, IaC and migrations. Learn from experienced engineers and grow in open-source DevOps tooling and automation. HERE’S WHAT YOU’LL NEED Hands-on experience with AWS and core services (EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, CloudWatch), including troubleshooting. Practical experience with Terraform and Ansible , Git and CI/CD pipelines. Good Linux skills, Bash or Python scripting, and Docker basics. Familiarity with cloud migration approaches and DevOps practices; preference for open-source , portable solutions. Strong communication, problem-solving mindset and willingness to learn in a team. BONUS POINTS Basic knowledge of sovereign cloud concepts: data residency, GDPR, European cloud providers. Kubernetes, OpenStack or OpenTofu experience. Windows automation with Ansible (WinRM, PowerShell). Research indicates that some candidates, especially the most diverse ones, may hesitate to apply for positions if they don't meet all requirements. If you believe you possess the necessary skills, even if not meeting every requirement, we wholeheartedly encourage you to submit your application. WHAT WE OFFER: Permanent employment contract. Individual support of a People Lead and a specific path of professional development, as well as the possibility of a session with a Coach. A wide training package (soft, technical, and language training offer, access to the e-learning platforms, Gallup test, GenAI training, possibility of co-financing courses, and certification). Employee Assistance Program - legal, financial, and psychological consultations. Accenture employees eligible for the Employee share purchase plan automatically become eligible for quarterly dividends if they own company shares. Paid employee referral program. Private medical care, life insurance. Access to the MyBenefit platform (possibility of using a wide range of products and services, including the Multisport card). WHAT WE BELIEVE: Accenture does not discriminate against employment candidates based on race, religion, color, sex, age, disability, national origin, political beliefs, trade union membership, ethnicity, denomination, sexual orientation, or any other basis impermissible under Polish law. All our leaders are committed to building a better, stronger, and more durable company for future generations to create positive, long-lasting change. Inclusion and diversity are fundamental to our culture and core values. Our rich diversity makes us more innovative and creative, which helps us better serve our clients and our communities.
