items.desc: We are looking for enthusiastic colleagues to join the critical care team at Imperial College Healthcare. You will be working as part of the wider critical care directorate at Imperial College Healthcare NHS Trust, which provides 94 Adult ICU beds across three hospitals. All units were rated “Good” by the CQC in 2019, and achieved very positive feedback in peer reviews in 2023. Each unit admits both elective and emergency Level 2 and 3 patients, but has a distinct character. St Mary’s is a quaternary vascular centre and Major Trauma Centre, Charing Cross is a regional stroke and neurosurgical centre, and Hammersmith is a regional centre for cardiac, renal and haematology. As a result, we care for a hugely varied clinical case mix and are pioneers in multi-disciplinary and collaborative care. As one of the largest acute teaching Trusts in the UK, we offer a wide range of opportunities to help you achieve the career you aspire to. Academic clinicians are welcome and will be encouraged to become local principal investigators for multicentre studies in collaboration with our internationally acclaimed academic department led by Prof A Gordon. This will be a split-site post, working across St Mary's and Charing Cross Hospitals. The posts will attract 10PAs including a minimum of 2SPAs, but we also welcome applications from individuals who wish to work less than full time. Our philosophy is to formulate an individualised job plan with successful candidates, with an emphasis on enabling professional development and pursuit of specific interests. We strongly believe that the job plan needs to be sustainable and should enable the successful candidate to maintain a good work-life balance. Main duties contained within the job plan are assessing and managing critically unwell patients as part of the ICU MDT team. This will involve twice daily ward rounds as a minimum with targeted assessment and interventions as required. Outreach duties are also contained within the job plans and there are outreach clinics which can be job planned for interested candidates. SPA duties will vary but all consultants are expected to support and supervise trainees. All appointments are to the Trust, but this post will be based across our St Mary's and Charing Cross sites. There may also be opportunities for consultants to move sites during their career if they wish to, in order to gain new clinical or leadership experience. At Imperial College Healthcare you can achieve extraordinary things with extraordinary people, working with leading clinicians pushing boundaries in patient care. Become part of a vibrant team living our values - expert, kind, collaborative and aspirational. You’ll get an experience like no other and will fast forward your career. Benefits include career development, flexible working and wellbeing, staff recognition scheme. Make use of optional benefits including Cycle to Work, car lease schemes, season ticket loan or membership options for onsite leisure facilities. We are committed to equal opportunities and improving the working lives of our staff and will consider applications to work flexibly, part time or job share. Please talk to us at interview. Main Responsibilities Provide High Quality Care to Patients presenting as an Emergency or who require Critical Care Research, Teaching & Training Collaborate with academic and clinical colleagues to enhance the translational research portfolio, whilst meeting the full requirements of Research Governance Provide high quality teaching to medical undergraduates, foundation doctors, specialty trainees and members of other health care professions as required Performance Management Work with medical, nursing and managerial colleagues to ensure high performance in clinical efficiency, patient safety, quality of outcomes and financial management Medical Staff Management Participate in team objective setting as part of the annual job planning cycle Be responsible for the annual appraisal of doctors in training, Trust doctors and non-consultant grades as delegated Governance Participate in clinical audit, incident reporting and ensure resulting actions are implemented Keep fully informed about best practice in the speciality areas and ensure implications for practice changes are discussed with Specialty Leads Role model good practice for infection control to all members of the multidisciplinary team Leadership and Team Working Demonstrate excellent leadership skills with regard to individual performance, clinical teams, the Trust and when participating in national initiatives Work collaboratively with all members of the multi-disciplinary team and Imperial College as required

items.desc: Consultant in General Internal Medicine with specialist interest, for University Hospitals of Derby & Burton NHS Foundation Trust. To provide, with colleagues, General Medical Services as part of a fully integrated Assessment & Diagnostics service for Derbyshire, Staffordshire, and surrounding areas. Duties will primarily be in the General Medical wards. This post will provide an excellent opportunity to become involved in the development and delivery of general medical services in a large teaching hospital. Audit, research interests and management involvement will be actively encouraged. Candidates are encouraged to discuss flexible working requirements, although our preference is initially for a full job plan in general medicine. There is capacity to accommodate specialty interests by arrangement. There is a strong emphasis on provision of high quality SIFT teaching, and those with an interest in teaching are encouraged to apply. Please note, a Recruitment and Retention incentive is available for this post. The appointee will be responsible for the care of: - Management of patients on the General Medical Wards at University Hospitals of Derby & Burton NHS Foundation Trust. Responsibility for personal performance of clinical duties as agreed in their job plan, allowing for all proper delegation to, and training of staff. Responsibility for the professional supervision of junior medical staff. We are also open to considering any specialist interests alongside this role. Please approach us to discuss this further. Provision of regular high Quality SIFT teaching to medical students. Relevant participation in management Participate in the development of the new General Medicine service model and pathways. Responsible for maintaining awareness of professional guidelines such as “Duties of a Doctor” and of the “GMC Performance Procedures” and acting in accordance with them. An exceptional requirement to undertake additional duties for limited periods within the geographical area specified above or to undertake duties at other hospitals in the event of a major disaster or incident. Responsibility for implementing the Infection Control Policies as determined by University Hospitals of Derby & Burton NHS Foundation Trust. As a trusted organisation at the heart of our communities, we recognise the important role we can play in supporting the public, patients, our own people and local partners in achieving the best of health for the local population and the communities in which they live by providing Exceptional Care Together Our fundamental Values of Compassion, Openness and Excellence underpin how we intend to work as a Trust and the associated behaviours are becoming embedded in all aspects of how we work. In return we will offer: Development opportunities, including both professional and leadership development On-going support through every step of the way from recruitment to when you join our team and beyond. A variety of other staff benefits including employee assistance programme, discounted gym membership, onsite fitness classes, car schemes Key Facts about our Trust: We see on average 4810 OP appointments per day. We are the 4th busiest Trauma & Orthopaedic outpatients department in England – an average of 2077 per week. An average of 1115 patients are seen in A&Es across our network every day – 3rd largest in the country. Our hospitals admit an average of 195 emergency patients daily. Last year we undertook almost 33,700 planned surgical operations in our 57 operating theatres. We are one of only 7 Trusts nationally with more than 50 operating theatres. We carry out more than 140 elective procedures each working day. It is expected that the appointee will work: Monday to Friday. General Medical wards. A standard day on a General Medical ward involves leading a daily MDT board round at 09:00 -09:30, followed by a full ward round, from 09:30-12:00 (13h00 on Monday). Afternoon board round and review of results and new/unstable patients from approximately 15:30 - 16:30. One clinic per week. This may be flexed with other clinical activities such as the review of general medicine outliers, depending on need. The candidate will work an annualised total of 8 weekends per year, on the General Medical wards, (09:00-15:00, Saturday and Sunday) and 1 Bank Holiday per year (09:00 - 15:00). Together with Consultant colleagues, be responsible for teaching and training of undergraduate medical students and junior medical staff. There is no on-call commitment currently. If appointed and agreed to have a specialist interest alongside the General Medicine role, job plans will be different to the example above and below. However, morning General Medicine work will remain the same.

Nursing and AHP vacancies are also open to Student Nurses and Newly Qualified Nurses/AHPs. The community chronic pain service supports people with chronic pain to achieve long-term self-management, empowering them to live well. The post holder will take a lead role within the service , demonstrating highly specialised clinical practice across the 4 pillars of advance practice and leading the delivery of clinical care within Kent Prisons. This patient facing clinical role includes direct patient care in community clinics and secure settings and supporting others within the service. In liaison with the clinical lead and clinical service managers they will be expected to initiate, develop and implement community policies and clinical guidelines to achieve the service key objectives. The post holder provides clinical leadership to the Integrated Musculoskeletal service team working within the secure environment. Due to the need to work across multiple localities on the same day the post holder must be a driver with access to a car. If you are unable to drive due to a disability, please contact the Recruitment Team via kentchft.recruitment@nhs.net, quoting the vacancy reference number, so we can support you further. items.title: Behaviour Support Practitioner
items.card: You will be expected to work directly and indirectly with people with learning disabilities, families, and carers providing person-centred specialist behavioural assessments and interventions, using a Positive Behavioural Support approach. You will be part of a well established community-based MDT and wider staff group of Psychologists and Behavioural Support Practitioners across the MHLD service. You will provide
items.desc: We are exciting to advertise for a Behaviour Support Practitioner to work in the Mental Health & Learning Disabilities Service (MHLD) in Lambeth. You will be expected to work directly and indirectly with people with learning disabilities, families, and carers providing person-centred specialist behavioural assessments and interventions, using a Positive Behavioural Support approach. You will be part of a well established community-based MDT and wider staff group of Psychologists and Behavioural Support Practitioners across the MHLD service. You will provide clinical interventions that are focused on the person and the whole network. You will deliver support within the person’s home and community as required. As a Specialist Practitioner Behaviour Support Practitioner within Lambeth Mental Health & Learning Disability Service (MHLD), you will be a member of a multi-disciplinary community team working together primarily to: To provide applied behavioural assessment and intervention for clients who present behaviour that challenges services and poses risks to their well-being, including specialist assessment, treatment, planning, implementation and monitoring of outcomes. To employ the principles of Positive Behavioural Support in all aspects of clinical work. To participate in strengthening local services and developing capable environments though training, consultation and modelling. The teams do this through the early management of identified complex situations. This will include detailed risk assessment and management underpinned by a positive behaviour support model. As a Behaviour Support Practitioner in our team, you will be part of a well-established group of around 20 Psychologists and Behavioural Support Practitioners, working across the MHLD services, led by the Borough Consultant Clinical Psychologist, providing a range of psychological assessments and interventions for people with learning disabilities and their networks. You will receive supervision from a qualified psychologist, and have opportunities to work jointly with psychologists and colleagues. You will be expected to make use of regular CPD sessions within the Trust, and to contribute to teaching, training and/or supervision initiatives aimed at developing PBS approach across and outside the Trust. This is a permanent full time post in Lambeth MHLD, based at Maudsley Hospital. Flexible working requests and job share requests are welcomed. We are part of a Clinical Academic Group within Kings Partners Academic Health Sciences Centre, and research interests and joint initiatives aimed at improving the physical and mental health care for people with learning disabilities are encouraged. There are opportunities to help develop and deliver training and consultation to provider services as part of your work. Job Purpose: To provide applied behavioural assessment and intervention for clients who present behaviour that challenges services and poses risks to their well-being, including specialist assessment, treatment, planning, implementation and monitoring of outcomes. To employ the principles of Positive Behavioural Support in all aspects of clinical work alongside MDT colleagues. To participate in strengthening local services and developing capable environments though training, consultation and modelling. To contribute to enabling other staff, service users and carers from diverse backgrounds to flourish by working to create a psychologically safe environment. To provide clinical supervision and consultation as appropriate. To participate in service evaluation, audit and research. To work as an autonomous professional within professional and Trust guidelines and codes of conduct, and guided by the policies and procedures of the service, taking responsibility for own work including treatment and discharge decisions with support of clinical supervisor. To plan and facilitate staff training and teaching, and presentations as appropriate

items.desc: This is an NHSE funded training post as part of the CYP Psychological Trainings (formerly CYP-IAPT) which involves some time working as a Practitioner in Harrow CAMHS and some time studying with King’s College London undertaking a programme of training in CBT This intensive training post will equip the post-holder to provide interventions for children, young people or families using the core principles of the CYP Psychological Training Programme and consistent with the evidence base in the area of mood and anxiety disorders. The post-holder will work in the service, for at least 2.5 days of the week using the newly developed skills whilst attending the training programme or undertaking self-study days for the remaining days, as required by the education provider. The post holder will hold an appropriate training case load and complete the necessary assignments to meet the course requirements. With the assistance of their clinical supervisor accept appropriate referrals. Assess clients for suitability for the treatment for which modality specific training is provided; Make decisions on suitability of new referrals, adhering to the department’s referral protocols, and refer unsuitable clients on to the relevant service or back to the referral agent as necessary; Formulate, implement and evaluate therapeutic intervention for clients in line with their training modality and experience; Involve the system around the child in treatment as appropriate, e.g. parent/carer, school, conveying therapy formulations with sensitivity in easily understood language; Attend multi-disciplinary meetings relating to referrals or clients in treatment, where appropriate; Complete all requirements relating to data collection within the service; Keep coherent records of all clinical activity in line with service protocols; Work closely with other members of the team ensuring appropriate step-up and step-down arrangements are in place to maintain a stepped care approach. CNWL have a pioneering history of improving health outcomes in people’s lives, by providing physical and mental health services at GPs, clinics, hospitals, and in the community. To find out more about CAMHS please CLICK HERE . Staff are the heartbeat of our organisation! You’ll have direct liaison with your Service Manager and Head of Service to develop your career. You'll receive monthly supervision to support bespoke training, development offers, and our leadership and development programme, see the “Staff rewards and wellbeing handbook” for more details. We take flexible working seriously, and will always be open to discussion to meet our workforce's competing work-life demands #TalkAboutFlex Ensure the maintenance of standards of practice according to the employer and any regulating, professional and accrediting bodies (e.g., BPS, HCPC, BABCP, AFT), and keep up to date on new recommendations/guidelines set by the department of health; Ensure that client confidentiality is protected at all times and comply with data management systems and processes including submissions to the training provider; Be aware of, and keep up to date with advances in the spheres of care pathway; Ensure clear professional objectives are identified, discussed and reviewed with senior therapists on a regular basis as part of continuing professional development; Attend clinical/managerial supervision on a regular basis as agreed with Manager; Participate in individual performance review and respond to agreed objectives; Keep up to date all records in relation to Continuous Professional Development and ensure personal development plan maintains up to date specialist knowledge of latest theoretical and service delivery models/developments; Attend relevant conferences / workshops in line with identified professional objectives.

Our Multi-Academy Trust educates more than 4300 children and young people and employs over 450 professionals. Each of our four good and outstanding academies operates at the heart of their local community. Our mission is to enhance students’ lives through the highest standards of education underpinned by our Trust values of Excellence, Belonging and Partnership. The Multi-Academy Trust incorporates: The County High School, Leftwich. Middlewich High School. Sir John Deane’s Sixth Form College. Macclesfield Academy. The Sir John Brunner Foundation has a proud legacy of educational excellence dating back to 1557. We remain firmly focused on children, providing a first-class experience that nurtures curiosity, confidence, and joy in learning. In working with our communities, we create an environment where every child feels valued, safe, and supported to reach their potential. The Foundation’s Head Office is based at the Sir John Deane’s College campus in Northwich. This role is based at Middlewich High School where we believe that every child deserves to attend an excellent school, one that enables all students to flourish and be happy. We do this by providing all students with inspiring teaching, a supportive and caring environment and an enriching educational experience in and beyond the classroom. Our objective is to support all students to achieve ‘Excellence in Learning’ , taking pride in their personal achievements whilst making a positive contribution to society. About the Role To play a key role in enabling students to access learning, overcome barriers and achieve their potential through skilled classroom support and the delivery of targeted interventions. Working collaboratively with teaching staff and the SENDCo, the Learning Practitioner will contribute to the planning, delivery and evaluation of inclusive provision, with a particular focus on students with special educational needs and disabilities. The postholder will model effective practice, share expertise and support colleagues to strengthen the quality and consistency of support across the academy. The role will champion high expectations and promote students’ independence, confidence and wellbeing, ensuring they are supported to participate fully in academy life and make meaningful progress. We’d love to hear from you! The school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare and safety of children and young people and expects all staff to share this commitment. The successful applicant must have enhanced DBS disclosure and satisfactory references. The school is an equal opportunities employer.

items.desc: Description Join WTW and contribute to our global Cyber Acceleration Program (CAP). WTW is one year into a three-year global initiative focused on delivering the Cyber Acceleration Program (CAP). The program encompasses a number of projects across Cyber Security and wider technology domains, including Networks, Cloud, Identity and Data, supported by several workstreams and an established roadmap of projects. You’ll be part of a talented, energetic and globally located team, working in a dynamic environment alongside both internal teams and external suppliers, all with a shared motivation to succeed. Provide Architectural & hands-on technical delivery of the Illumio Segmentation platform within the Cyber Acceleration Programme (CAP), ensuring the effective deployment, configuration, and optimisation of controls across hybrid Azure and multi-cloud environments. The role focuses on implementing the Illumio Segmentation solution for in-scope critical applications/across the wider cloud environment, ensuring adherence to best practice & security principles. The role is responsible for design & implementation of the solution and creation of documentation prior to operational handover. Working closely with application, architecture, cloud engineering, and cyber security teams, the role ensures cloud networks are secure and effectively segmented. The Role Serve as a hands-on engineering resource with deep Subject Matter Expertise (SME) in Illumio, including proven experience designing and deploying solutions within Azure using cloud native constructs (e.g not agents) at enterprise scale. Ability to utilise the Illumio platform for application dependency mapping and traffic flow analysis to prepare and provision network segmentation policies to secure critical applications. Demonstrate the ability to proactively identify and resolve technical blockers as they arise, driving issues through to resolution with minimal escalation. Work collaboratively as part of the internal Illumio deployment team, contributing to design decisions, implementation, and knowledge sharing. Possess strong experience in documenting and defining operational processes, procedures, and workflows, ensuring repeatability and alignment with enterprise standards. Operate in the capacity of a Lead Engineer, providing technical direction, oversight, and guidance across the deployment lifecycle. Maintain flexibility in working hours where required to support project milestones and global stakeholder engagement. Qualifications What you’ll bring Relevant years of hands-on experience implementing the Illumio Segmentation platform within Azure using cloud native controls. Hold a strong cloud engineering and cloud networking foundation independent of Illumio, with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex networking issues across Azure environments. Relevant years of experience working with native Azure networking constructs (e.g., VNets, NSGs, UDRs, Azure Firewall, Private Endpoints, Load Balancers) and integrating these effectively alongside Illumio. Ability to design and implement solutions leveraging cloud-native controls and architectures (such as NSGs), ensuring tight integration with Azure networking and security capabilities. Capable of extending beyond simple deployment of an Illumio VEN agent on IaaS. Experience with integrating automated application deployments with Illumio preferred. Confidently challenge and refine deployment approaches to ensure alignment with enterprise-scale cloud architecture principles, rather than relying on vendor-default or agent-centric models. Strong collaboration skills, working with AppDev, Cloud Engineering, and Security teams to enforce controls without blocking delivery Strong communication skills with a collaborative, team-oriented approach. Proven technical leadership capability, including guiding teams in the development of robust solutions. Outcome-focused, adaptable, and able to respond effectively to changing priorities. Builds strong relationships by understanding and anticipating stakeholder needs, providing insightful and innovative solutions. Works effectively and inclusively across teams, valuing diverse perspectives. Demonstrates a growth mindset, maintaining a positive approach, focusing on results, and actively seeking and learning from feedback. What we offer Enjoy a benefits package designed to help you thrive, both professionally and personally. You'll receive 25 days of annual leave plus an extra WTW day to relax and recharge. Our comprehensive health and wellbeing offering includes private healthcare, life insurance, group income protection, and regular health assessments, all giving you peace of mind. Secure your future with our defined contribution pension scheme, featuring matched contributions up to 10% from the company. Your work will help us release reliable products that perform in the real world—even when the power drops, the network disappears or a device needs to recover on its own. What you’ll get stuck into You’ll take ownership of manual and system-level testing, setting up equipment, installing software builds and creating reliable, repeatable test environments. From checking everyday functionality to exploring awkward edge cases, you’ll put our products through their paces and provide clear evidence of what’s ready for release. Some days, you’ll be working through Linux logs, checking application behaviour or investigating communication between devices and supporting services. On others, you’ll be tracing a wiring fault, making a test cable or reaching for a multimeter. You’ll need to feel equally comfortable at the command line and the test bench. You’ll explore how equipment behaves during startup, shutdown, reboots, power loss and network interruptions. When something fails, you’ll reproduce the problem, work out where it originates and give developers the detail they need to resolve it. Along the way, you’ll keep test plans, defect reports, release versions and device configurations accurate and easy to follow. You’ll also run existing automated tests, investigate failures and help identify where additional coverage would make a difference. Sharing discoveries and supporting junior colleagues will be part of the job too. Requirements What you’ll bring We’re interested in people who combine strong testing instincts with practical technical skills. You should have: Experience testing software on embedded hardware, with strong manual, exploratory and integration testing skills. Confidence troubleshooting embedded Linux using command-line tools, SSH, logs, process checks and configuration files. Practical networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, ports, static IP addresses, gateways and DNS. Hands-on electronics skills: making and repairing cables, soldering and crimping connections, reading wiring diagrams and schematics, and using multimeters and oscilloscopes to investigate faults. A clear, methodical approach to test documentation, release records and defect reporting, with experience using tools such as Git and Jira. You’ll be comfortable investigating across software, operating systems, networking, power and hardware, including unfamiliar or legacy platforms. You don’t need advanced circuit design experience, but you should be able to set up equipment safely and investigate hardware-related failures independently. A few useful extras Experience with Robot Framework, scripting in Python or Bash, MQTT, serial communications, GPIO or watchdogs would be welcome. Familiarity with Windows CE, .NET Compact Framework, Docker, simulators or device connections to cloud and back-office services would also come in handy. We’re open to thoughtful use of approved AI tools to help develop test scenarios, analyse findings and improve documentation. You’ll remain responsible for checking the results and protecting confidential information. Sound like your kind of challenge? You’re curious, persistent and organised. You can work through incomplete documentation, explain a tricky fault clearly and keep investigating when a problem only appears once every twenty reboots. If you enjoy understanding how the whole system works—and helping make it more reliable—we’d love to hear from you. items.desc: Robotics Engineer Description About Us Textron Specialized Vehicles are a global manufacturer of golf cars, utility and personal transportation vehicles, side-by-sides, all-terrain vehicles, professional turf-care equipment, and ground support equipment. At Ransomes Jacobsen Ltd, we design and manufacture professional turf-care equipment under the brands of Ransomes and Jacobsen. Our mission is to be the premier supplier of high-quality and environmentally conscious turf equipment, providing superior performance for our customers. From prestigious championship golf courses to the World Cup, for more than a century, the most important turf in the world has been manicured by our brand. We recognise that our success, and future success, is tied directly to our people. We are looking for a Robotics Engineer to join the Company in Ipswich, Suffolk. About the Role As a Robotics Engineer, you will develop and optimise the core autonomy algorithms for Jacobsen vehicles, with a focus on localisation, navigation and motion planning. This role focuses on algorithm development, system performance and real-world behaviour, supporting the transition from prototype systems to field-ready, production-ready autonomous capability. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Develop and improve localisation algorithms, including sensor fusion (RTK GPS, IMU, LiDAR, camera) and fallback strategies; Design and implement navigation and path planning algorithms, including coverage planning and route optimization; Develop and optimise motion planning and trajectory generation, improving turn performance, smoothness, and transitions; Implement and tune algorithms such as A, Hybrid A, DWA, MPC, or similar; Integrate algorithms into the autonomy stack (ROS2 or equivalent); Work with Test & Validation teams to analyse field data, debug issues, and improve system performance; Support development and validation using simulation and digital twin environments; Other duties as required. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics/Mechatronics or similar. A minimum of five years’ experience in robotics, autonomy, or control systems, or similar roles. Required Skills: Experience with localisation, navigation, and motion planning algorithms; Proficiency in C and/or Python; Experience with ROS/ROS2 or similar frameworks; Understanding of sensor fusion techniques; ExperienCe with real-time systems and algorithm optimization; Self-motivating and able to work with low levels of supervision to defined objectives; Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills. Desirable Skills: Experience with outdoor or off-road autonomous systems; Knowledge of RTK GPS, IMU integration, and LiDAR-based localisation; Familiarity with coverage planning and path optimisation problems; Experience with simulation tools (e.g. Isaac Sim, Gazebo); Exposure to AI/ML approaches in perception or planning. What we Offer Work life balance promoted with every other Friday off; 30 days annual leave; Competitive rate of pay, reviewed annually; Enhanced Company pension; Life assurance of four times your annual salary; Comprehensive Employee Assistance Program for you and your immediate family; Access to Textron University’s self-service training platform; Eye care scheme; Discounts on gym memberships, shopping and travel through Perks at Work; Onsite golf course and football pitch; Winter flu vaccination voucher. items.desc: We’re the world’s leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know-how and technology to boost their business. Job Description ABOUT US: Sportradar is a sports data and technology company. As Forward Deployed AI Engineer, you work like an internal consultant: you are placed in a department or business unit, talk with the people there, find the real problems, cut through complexity, simplify how work is done, and then build and ship LLM and agent-based solutions. You work largely independently with little day-to-day supervision, find your way through organisational complexity and competing priorities to get things done, and learn fast. Senior engineers are available for guidance. THE CHALLENGE: Talk with colleagues in your department to understand workflows, pain points and data. Identify problems worth solving and break unclear or cluttered situations into clear, manageable steps. Streamline and simplify processes, and propose where an AI solution makes sense and where it does not. Work with several stakeholders and competing priorities, and keep your work moving pragmatically. Build, test and deploy LLM-powered applications and agents, from prototype to production. Implement retrieval (RAG), tool integrations, prompts and context handling. Build and run evaluations (test sets, automated checks, quality dashboards) and use the results to improve solutions. Build and maintain data pipelines that feed these systems. Plan your own work, give regular updates and document solutions. ABOUT YOU: Around 2+ years of software engineering or applied ML experience, or equivalent project experience. Clear communication with non-technical colleagues; able to explain technical topics simply. Self-motivation and the ability to work independently with little supervision. Pragmatic approach to organisational complexity and competing priorities. Structured approach to finding problems and simplifying complexity. Solid Python and software engineering fundamentals (testing, version control, APIs). Hands-on experience with LLM APIs and a project using RAG or agents, including some evaluation. Familiarity with SQL or data pipelines and with a cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP). Nice to have Consulting, internship or stakeholder-facing project experience. Working model Based in Leipzig. Some travel between Sportradar offices may be required. OUR OFFER: A collaborative environment with colleagues from all over the world (Engineering offices in Europe, Asia and the US) including various social events and teambuilding. Ability to shape your own workday and career via a clearly defined professional and personal development plan. Opportunity to develop yourself within an inspiring and fast-growing company with our Career framework possibilities. Vibrant and inclusive community, including Women in Tech and Pride groups which welcome all participants. Global Employee Assistance Programme. Calm and Reulay app (managing stress, maintaining focus, improving sleep, building resilience). Online training videos. Flexible working hours. While we appreciate the flexibility and benefits of working from home, we strongly believe that coming together in person fosters stronger connections, encourages collaboration, and drives innovation—both as individuals and as a company. The energy, shared ideas, and team support we experience in the office strengthen the foundation of our success and culture. For this reason, we are an office-first business operating on a fully on-site model, with team members working in the office five days a week to build relationships, exchange ideas, and grow together. Certain exemptions may apply depending on location — your local point of contact can provide further details. OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS: Initial Screening: A quick chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to understand your background and expectations. Technical Assessment: A short (home) task to showcase your technical skills. Two Technical Interviews: Meet with the Technical team and later with the Hiring Manager to dive into your solution, and also discuss team fit. Final Step: Receive feedback and, if successful, an offer! Additional Information At Sportradar, we celebrate our diverse group of hardworking employees. Sportradar is committed to ensuring equal access to its programs, facilities, and employment opportunities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. We encourage you to apply even if you only meet most of the requirements (but not 100% of the listed criteria) – we believe skills evolve over time. items.card: Job Description ABOUT US: Sportradar is a sports data and technology company. As Forward Deployed AI Engineer, you work like an internal consultant: you are placed in a department or business unit, talk with the people there, find the real problems, cut through complexity, simplify how work is done, and then build and ship LLM and agent-based solutions. You work largely independently with little day-to-day
items.desc: We’re the world’s leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know-how and technology to boost their business. Job Description ABOUT US: Sportradar is a sports data and technology company. As Forward Deployed AI Engineer, you work like an internal consultant: you are placed in a department or business unit, talk with the people there, find the real problems, cut through complexity, simplify how work is done, and then build and ship LLM and agent-based solutions. You work largely independently with little day-to-day supervision, find your way through organisational complexity and competing priorities to get things done, and learn fast. Senior engineers are available for guidance. THE CHALLENGE: Talk with colleagues in your department to understand workflows, pain points and data. Identify problems worth solving and break unclear or cluttered situations into clear, manageable steps. Streamline and simplify processes, and propose where an AI solution makes sense and where it does not. Work with several stakeholders and competing priorities, and keep your work moving pragmatically. Build, test and deploy LLM-powered applications and agents, from prototype to production. Implement retrieval (RAG), tool integrations, prompts and context handling. Build and run evaluations (test sets, automated checks, quality dashboards) and use the results to improve solutions. Build and maintain data pipelines that feed these systems. Plan your own work, give regular updates and document solutions. ABOUT YOU: Around 2+ years of software engineering or applied ML experience, or equivalent project experience. Clear communication with non-technical colleagues; able to explain technical topics simply. Self-motivation and the ability to work independently with little supervision. Pragmatic approach to organisational complexity and competing priorities. Structured approach to finding problems and simplifying complexity. Solid Python and software engineering fundamentals (testing, version control, APIs). Hands-on experience with LLM APIs and a project using RAG or agents, including some evaluation. Familiarity with SQL or data pipelines and with a cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP). Nice to have Consulting, internship or stakeholder-facing project experience. Working model Based in Warsaw. Some travel between Sportradar offices may be required. OUR OFFER: A collaborative environment with colleagues from all over the world (Engineering offices in Europe, Asia and the US) including various social events and teambuilding. Ability to shape your own workday and career via a clearly defined professional and personal development plan. Opportunity to develop yourself within an inspiring and fast-growing company with our Career framework possibilities. Vibrant and inclusive community, including Women in Tech and Pride groups which welcome all participants. Global Employee Assistance Programme. Calm and Reulay app (managing stress, maintaining focus, improving sleep, building resilience). Online training videos. Flexible working hours. While we appreciate the flexibility and benefits of working from home, we strongly believe that coming together in person fosters stronger connections, encourages collaboration, and drives innovation—both as individuals and as a company. The energy, shared ideas, and team support we experience in the office strengthen the foundation of our success and culture. For this reason, we are an office-first business operating on a fully on-site model, with team members working in the office five days a week to build relationships, exchange ideas, and grow together. Certain exemptions may apply depending on location — your local point of contact can provide further details. OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS: Initial Screening: A quick chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to understand your background and expectations. Technical Assessment: A short (home) task to showcase your technical skills. Two Technical Interviews: Meet with the Technical team and later with the Hiring Manager to dive into your solution, and also discuss team fit. Final Step: Receive feedback and, if successful, an offer! Additional Information At Sportradar, we celebrate our diverse group of hardworking employees. Sportradar is committed to ensuring equal access to its programs, facilities, and employment opportunities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. We encourage you to apply even if you only meet most of the requirements (but not 100% of the listed criteria) – we believe skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and grow with us, we invite you to join our team!

items.desc: At AIB, our values guide how we work and how we support each other. We’re looking for someone who puts Customer First , takes initiative and Owns the Outcome , and is always looking for ways to Eliminate Complexity . You’ll treat colleagues and customers with fairness and Show Respect , and you’ll thrive in a culture built on collaboration where we Be One Team to deliver meaningful impact. Location/Office Policy: Central Park, Dublin 18 - 3 days per week in office Would you like to play a leading role in a team whose ambition is to become a world class fraud function, exceptional at developing talent and turning information into insights? Do you enjoy collaborating with cross functional teams and influencing business direction with data-backed evidence? Do you actively seek opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement? What Is The Role We are looking for a technically strong Fraud Data Scientist to join the fraud decisioning capability within AIB. This role will focus on applying data science techniques to fraud detection and prevention in financial transactions, including payments and transfers, while also supporting forward-looking analytical insight across the fraud environment Key Accountabilities Apply domain knowledge in financial fraud to review and enhance existing anomaly detection in payment systems, including business rules and machine learning models. Support the transformation of new data streams into fraud risk signals to be used by rules and models. Develop a thorough understanding of the data science lifecycle including data exploration, preprocessing, feature engineering, modelling, validation, and deployment. Design, build, and maintain predictive models, including decision trees, random forests, and gradient-boosted trees, with a low-level understanding of their algorithms and functioning. Exposure to fraud platforms such as Featurespace, TSYS, or similar detection systems is desirable; familiarity with graph database technologies such as Neo4j or TigerGraph is a plus. Ability to translate data into clear, business-focused insights and work effectively with a wide range of stakeholders. We create great experiences for the millions of people who use our payments, software, and tax-free solutions every minute of every day. Planet empowers its customers to deliver great customer experiences by combining payments and software in ways that drive greater loyalty, increase revenue and save time. Founded over 35 years ago and with our headquarters in London, today we have more than 2,500 employees located across six continents serving our customers in more than 120 markets. Role Overview We're hiring a Data Scientist to join Planet's AI team and lead our commercial data science work. You'll partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to turn customer and revenue data into models and insights that directly move the top line — reducing churn, surfacing cross-sell opportunities, and giving the business a clear view of what's driving revenue. Cross-sell & upsell — Develop propensity models and next-best-action recommendations to help commercial teams prioritise accounts and product conversations. Revenue attribution & tracking — Design attribution frameworks across marketing channels, sales motions, and product touchpoints. Build the data products that let leadership see what's actually driving revenue. Experimentation — Design and analyse A/B tests and quasi-experiments for commercial initiatives. Bring statistical rigour to business decisions. Productionisation — Take models from notebook to production. Own the full lifecycle: feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring, retraining. Stakeholder partnership — Translate ambiguous commercial questions into well-scoped analytical problems. Communicate findings clearly to non-technical audiences. Solid grounding in statistics, experimentation, and causal inference — you know when a correlation isn't enough. Track record of shipping models that are actually used by the business, not just built. Excellent communication — you can explain a model to a CFO and debug a feature pipeline with an engineer in the same afternoon. Nice-to-have Experience with n8n or other workflow automation tools (Airflow, Prefect, Dagster). Exposure to payments, fintech, SaaS, or other recurring-revenue businesses. DBT experience for analytics engineering. Experience integrating LLMs or GenAI into commercial workflows. Reasonable accommodations may be made in order to allow for an individual to perform the essential functions of this role successfully.

items.desc: A propos de TechTown TechTown est un cabinet d’expertise spécialisé dans le Cloud et l’IA. Nous intervenons sur des missions de conseil et d’expertise, des projets de réalisation, et en tant que formateurs auprès de nos clients. Partenaire Google Cloud depuis la première année, nous avons récemment intégré le Partner Program de Anthropic. Nous sommes aussi l’organisateur de l’événement TechReady, qui a réuni récemment plus de 500 personnes de l’écosystème Cloud et IA de Nantes et sa région. Le Poste Nous recherchons un·e Forward Deployed Engineer : un·e développeur·euse qui ne se contente pas de livrer du code, mais qui s’immerge dans le contexte de nos clients pour comprendre leurs vrais problèmes et construire, avec eux, les solutions IA qui y répondent. Concrètement, tu es déployé·e au plus près des clients — sur leur site ou embarqué·e à distance dans leurs équipes selon les missions. Ton cœur de métier : intégrer l’IA de façon sur mesure dans leurs applications et leurs systèmes, et faire en sorte qu’à la fin de la mission, leurs équipes soient autonomes sur ces sujets. Tu es à la fois l’ingénieur·e qui construit la solution et l’interlocuteur·rice de confiance qui transmet et fait monter en compétence. C’est un rôle pour quelqu’un qui aime le contact terrain, la satisfaction de voir une idée passer du tableau blanc à un usage concret en production, et le plaisir de rendre les autres meilleurs et plus confiants. Le rôle Intégrer l’IA sur mesure. Concevoir et développer des applications web et backend intégrant des modèles d’IA, au plus près du contexte métier et technique du client. Travailler avec des APIs et SDK IA (LLM, vision, NLP…), mettre en place et exploiter des serveurs MCP pour structurer les interactions entre les LLM et les données de l’entreprise cliente. Passer du POC à une solution robuste et maintenable, en itérant rapidement avec le client. Faire monter le client en compétence . Conseiller sur les bons choix d’outils IA pour les développeurs (Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, Copilot…). Transmettre les pratiques, animer ateliers et formations, accompagner les équipes clientes jusqu’à leur autonomie réelle sur ces sujets. Pratiquer et diffuser le vibe coding. Pratiquer et promouvoir le vibe coding auprès des équipes IT des clients pour booster la qualité, la créativité et la productivité. Cadrer le besoin . Aller sur le terrain, comprendre le métier du client, transformer un problème souvent mal défini en périmètre technique clair et atteignable. Rayonner . Être l’ambassadeur·rice de TechTown : conférences, articles, partage d’expérience, veille technologique IA. Profil recherché Tu es à l’aise dans les sujets innovants et tu sais avancer sans cahier des charges parfait. Tu aimes le contact client et tu sais expliquer un sujet technique à un public non technique. Tu as un excellent esprit d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes. Tu es autonome, curieux·se, en veille active, et tu as envie de contribuer à la construction d’une jeune entreprise. Diplôme en informatique , ingénierie logicielle ou équivalent. Minimum 5 ans d’expérience en développement, idéalement avec une exposition au conseil, au delivery client ou aux missions en environnement varié. Expérience sur des projets intégrant de l’IA — ou une très grande envie d’en faire. Tu as une bonne compréhension des concepts de l’IA d’aujourd’hui. Une expérience en mentorat, animation de formation ou d’ateliers est un vrai plus. Tu maîtrises au moins un framework backend (Spring ou Node.js) et d’une solution frontend parmi React, Vue ou Angular. Tu possèdes une expérience avec des APIs et SDK IA (OpenAI, HuggingFace, Vertex AI…). Tu as une bonne connaissance des architectures cloud (GCP, AWS ou Azure) et des principes DevOps en application des pratiques craft. Tu es à l’aise avec les outils d’assistance au code et le prototypage rapide. On offre Une rémunération attractive selon profil et expérience (entre 45K et 65K). Une politique remote de 3 jours par semaine en moyenne, adaptée au rythme des missions client. Les licences adéquates pour bien faire ton travail (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini…). Les certifications en lien avec tes souhaits. Un accès aux conférences locales, nationales et internationales. Notre process 📥 Envoi d’un CV ou d’un lien LinkedIn (ajoute tes liens pertinents : GitHub, YouTube). 👋 Échange avec Antoine : 1 heure avec le CEO, partage de la vision et des attentes — visio ou présentiel. 💬 Rencontre de l’équipe TechTown avec Nicolas et Benjamin : 1h avec ton ou ta futur·e mentor — visio ou présentiel. 💻 Échange avec Julien : 1h30 avec le CTO. Échange sur l’expérience, la compétence technique et le vibe coding — visio ou présentiel. 🎉 Décision sous 48h pour devenir un·e Tech Citizen. ℹ️ TechTown promeut la diversité et l’inclusion. Nous étudions toutes les candidatures sans discrimination. 🚀 Rejoins TechTown et participe à la transformation numérique des entreprises !

items.desc: Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity. Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science. Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture. The AI & Automation Analyst accelerates the Europe W&D transformation by removing manual workload and turning fragmented operational data into scalable, decision-ready insight. The role identifies high-value opportunities, develops and implements pragmatic AI and automation solutions, and creates reliable analytics that improve productivity, visibility and decision making across warehousing and distribution. Key Responsibilities Own the Europe W&D AI and automation opportunity pipeline: identify repetitive, manual and data-intensive activities; quantify value; prioritize use cases; and maintain a clear delivery roadmap. Supports W&D tenders – Fusion project with automation of data collection; Design, build, test and deploy workflow automations that reduce manual reporting, data collection, consolidation and recurring administrative work across W&D. Develop scalable analytics and digital solutions that provide granular visibility of W&D performance, spend, service and operational drivers. Lead automation of Cost to Serve data flows, with the ambition to consolidate logistics supplier invoice detail at European level with minimal manual intervention and enable analysis at the lowest useful level of granularity, such as order, customer and picking unit/case level. Partner with W&D, QSC Technology, Finance, Procurement, CVC and other relevant functions to translate business needs into robust data and automation solutions. Build repeatable data models, dashboards and self-service tools; establish data quality checks, documentation and clear ownership so solutions remain sustainable after deployment. Assess AI use cases responsibly, ensuring solutions have a clear business case, operational fit, appropriate controls and business-continuity considerations rather than using automation for its own sake. Support harmonization and standardization of W&D processes and data inputs so automation can scale across markets, warehouses and logistics service providers. Measure realized benefits from deployed solutions, including hours of manual work removed, productivity, improved visibility, cycle-time reduction and decision quality. Build digital capability across the Europe W&D organization through practical coaching, reusable templates and simple guidance that enables teams to adopt and sustain new tools. Provide analytical support to Europe W&D leadership and country teams, translating complex operational, service and cost data into clear insights, trends and recommendations to support business decisions Perform ad hoc and structured analysis to support strategic initiatives, tenders, business cases, performance reviews and operational improvement opportunities across Europe W&D Requirements Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Analytics, Supply Chain Management, Mathematics or another relevant analytical, digital or technology-related field 3–5+ years of relevant experience in data analytics. Experience developing automation, reporting, and data solutions using Microsoft technologies and analytical tools. Ability to translate business needs into practical digital solutions, collaborate with stakeholders across functions, and apply data quality, governance, and responsible AI practices. Why Haleon? Career at one of the leading global healthcare companies. Hybrid work. Attractive reward package (annual bonus & awards for outstanding performance, recognition awards for additional achievements and engagement). Extensive support of work life balance (flexible working solutions including working from home possibilities, health & wellbeing activities). Private medical care - the cost of the basic package is financed by Haleon. In addition, candidates can extend the selected package to family members and/or partner and purchase the Senior package. P4P Partnership for Prevention. Family benefits (extra parental leave, caregiver’s policy). Life insurance and pension plan. Multisport card or points on the Multicafeteria Benefits account. Personalized learning approach. Supportive community …

items.desc: We are knowmad mood! Somos una compañía líder en transformación digital, en constante evolución y a la vanguardia de la tecnología. Nacimos para provocar un cambio real a través de la innovación y el desarrollo sostenible, con la misión de aportar valor a los clientes e impulsar nuestro talento. Formado por más de 3.000 personas creativas, digitales e innovadoras conectadas a un propósito y capaces de generar conexiones con personas de todo el mundo. Un equipo responsable, flexible y con alta capacidad de adaptación a las necesidades de nuestros clientes y del mercado, a la vez que proporciona valor, visión, creatividad, expertise, profesionalidad y pasión por la tecnología en cada proyecto. Los valores que marcan nuestro rumbo y nos guían hacia la excelencia son la colaboración, la innovación, el compromiso, la diversión y la conﬁanza. ¿Qué es lo que valoramos? Experiencia de al menos 5 años en roles de Arquitectura Técnica, Platform Engineering o Arquitectura de IA , participando en el diseño e implantación de plataformas corporativas de inteligencia artificial. Experiencia sólida en entornos híbridos, tanto Cloud (Azure, AWS o GCP) como On-Premise (Kubernetes, VMware), con visión de arquitecturas empresariales complejas. Experiencia en el diseño e implantación de plataformas de IA de autoservicio, incluyendo AI Gateway, gestión de credenciales, enrutado de modelos, control de cuotas y optimización de costes. Conocimientos avanzados en arquitecturas agénticas, incluyendo orquestación de agentes, gestión de contexto, integración de herramientas (MCP, Function Calling) y patrones RAG. Experiencia en Harness Engineering, diseñando entornos de ejecución seguros, trazables y reproducibles para agentes de IA. Conocimiento de gobierno y ciclo de vida de modelos de IA, evaluación de calidad, trazabilidad y control del uso de modelos aprobados. Experiencia en seguridad aplicada a IA: prompt injection, protección frente a fugas de datos, aislamiento de ejecución y gestión de riesgos asociados. Conocimientos de observabilidad, monitorización y control económico del consumo de modelos y agentes. Experiencia integrando capacidades de IA dentro del ciclo de desarrollo software mediante CI/CD, IaC y Kubernetes. Capacidad de trabajo en equipo y comunicación efectiva con equipos de arquitectura, plataforma, desarrollo, seguridad y negocio. Valoraremos especialmente experiencia previa en entornos bancarios o sectores altamente regulados. ¿Cuáles serían tus funciones? Diseño y evolución de la Plataforma Corporativa de IA: Definir, construir y evolucionar una plataforma que permita a los equipos desarrollar, desplegar y operar sistemas de IA y agentes de forma autónoma, segura y trazable. Arquitectura de Plataformas de IA: Diseñar los componentes de acceso y mediación a modelos, gobierno de uso, control de costes y capacidades de observabilidad sobre el ecosistema tecnológico de la organización. Diseño de Sistemas Agénticos: Definir arquitecturas de agentes basadas en orquestación avanzada, gestión de contexto, integración de herramientas y patrones RAG para distintos casos de uso corporativos. Harness Engineering: Diseñar y construir entornos de ejecución para agentes de IA garantizando aislamiento, permisos adecuados, verificabilidad y reproducibilidad de resultados. Gobierno y Seguridad de IA: Definir controles técnicos y mecanismos de supervisión que aseguren el cumplimiento normativo, la trazabilidad y la gestión de riesgos en el uso de modelos generativos y agentes. Integración de IA en el SSDLC: Incorporar capacidades de IA dentro del ciclo de vida del desarrollo mediante buenas prácticas DevOps, CI/CD, Kubernetes e Infraestructura como Código. Arquitectura y Construcción: Participar activamente tanto en la definición arquitectónica como en la implementación de la solución, garantizando la coherencia entre diseño y ejecución. Colaboración Multidisciplinar: Trabajar conjuntamente con equipos de arquitectura, ingeniería, seguridad, plataforma y desarrollo para impulsar la adopción de capacidades de IA a escala empresarial. Orientación a Producto: Gestionar la plataforma como un producto interno, entendiendo las necesidades de sus usuarios y evolucionándola continuamente para maximizar su adopción y valor de negocio. Además, valoraremos muy positivamente si tienes experiencia y/o conocimientos en: Conocimiento del marco regulatorio relacionado con IA y sector financiero: EU AI Act, DORA, gestión del riesgo de terceros y proveedores de modelos. Experiencia en MLOps o LLMOps, incluyendo despliegue de modelos propios o autoalojados, fine-tuning y gestión de artefactos. Experiencia en múltiples entornos tecnológicos del ecosistema corporativo (Cloud, On-Premise y Mainframe). Conocimientos de integración de capacidades de IA sobre entornos Mainframe y sistemas legacy. Experiencia impulsando la adopción de herramientas de IA para desarrolladores a nivel organizativo. Conocimientos avanzados en Kubernetes, observabilidad, …

items.desc: Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity. Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science. Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture. The AI & Automation Analyst accelerates the Europe W&D transformation by removing manual workload and turning fragmented operational data into scalable, decision-ready insight. The role identifies high-value opportunities, develops and implements pragmatic AI and automation solutions, and creates reliable analytics that improve productivity, visibility and decision making across warehousing and distribution. Key Responsibilities Own the Europe W&D AI and automation opportunity pipeline: identify repetitive, manual and data-intensive activities; quantify value; prioritize use cases; and maintain a clear delivery roadmap. Supports W&D tenders – Fusion project with automation of data collection; Design, build, test and deploy workflow automations that reduce manual reporting, data collection, consolidation and recurring administrative work across W&D. Develop scalable analytics and digital solutions that provide granular visibility of W&D performance, spend, service and operational drivers. Lead automation of Cost to Serve data flows, with the ambition to consolidate logistics supplier invoice detail at European level with minimal manual intervention and enable analysis at the lowest useful level of granularity, such as order, customer and picking unit/case level. Partner with W&D, QSC Technology, Finance, Procurement, CVC and other relevant functions to translate business needs into robust data and automation solutions. Build repeatable data models, dashboards and self-service tools; establish data quality checks, documentation and clear ownership so solutions remain sustainable after deployment. Assess AI use cases responsibly, ensuring solutions have a clear business case, operational fit, appropriate controls and business-continuity considerations rather than using automation for its own sake. Support harmonization and standardization of W&D processes and data inputs so automation can scale across markets, warehouses and logistics service providers. Measure realized benefits from deployed solutions, including hours of manual work removed, productivity, improved visibility, cycle-time reduction and decision quality. Build digital capability across the Europe W&D organization through practical coaching, reusable templates and simple guidance that enables teams to adopt and sustain new tools. Provide analytical support to Europe W&D leadership and country teams, translating complex operational, service and cost data into clear insights, trends and recommendations to support business decisions Perform ad hoc and structured analysis to support strategic initiatives, tenders, business cases, performance reviews and operational improvement opportunities across Europe W&D Requirements Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Analytics, Supply Chain Management, Mathematics or another relevant analytical, digital or technology-related field 3–5+ years of relevant experience in data analytics. Experience developing automation, reporting, and data solutions using Microsoft technologies and analytical tools. Ability to translate business needs into practical digital solutions, collaborate with stakeholders across functions, and apply data quality, governance, and responsible AI practices. Why Haleon? Career at one of the leading global healthcare companies. Hybrid work. Attractive reward package (annual bonus & awards for outstanding performance, recognition awards for additional achievements and engagement). Extensive support of work life balance (flexible working solutions including working from home possibilities, health & wellbeing activities). Private medical care - the cost of the basic package is financed by Haleon. In addition, candidates can extend the selected package to family members and/or partner and purchase the Senior package. items.desc: At ICON Strategic Solutions, you will work in a sponsor-dedicated model, supported by ICON’s global expertise. As the world’s largest FSP organisation, with over 90 sponsor partnerships, we offer stability, career development and a collaborative environment where your work contributes to the development of treatments that benefit patients worldwide. We are seeking a highly skilled Clinical Data Scientist/Senior Statistical Programmer with extensive experience in R Shiny application development and a strong background in clinical trial data standards. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building user‑centric analytical tools, transforming complex datasets into intuitive interactive dashboards, and driving high‑quality statistical outputs in accordance with industry standards. You will collaborate closely with statisticians, data managers, clinical programmers, and project leads to design, develop, and maintain innovative R‑based solutions that support study monitoring, data review, and analytical insight generation across clinical development programmes. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain R Shiny applications for clinical study monitoring, data visualization, safety review, and exploratory analysis. Develop modular, scalable, and well‑documented R code following best practices. Create interactive dashboards, visualizations, and bespoke analytical tools for cross‑functional teams. Optimize Shiny app performance, security, and usability for deployment in regulated environments. Ensure all deliverables comply with CDISC standards, regulatory guidance, and internal SOPs. Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for R and R Shiny within the team. Mentor junior programmers and contribute to knowledge‑sharing initiatives. Participate in study meetings, providing technical insights and programming expertise. Influence best practices, pipelines, and automation strategies for modernizing statistical workflows. Essential Requirements 5+ years of experience as a Statistical Programmer within the pharmaceutical/biotech/CRO industry. Strong clinical data experience, including CDISC (SDTM & ADaM) and TLF production. R Shiny experience, including: end-to-end app development, UI/UX design, dashboard visualizations (ggplot2/plotly), performance optimization and debugging. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field. Desirable Skills Experience with Python, SAS, or other analytical tools. Familiarity with pharmacovigilance or safety review workflows. Experience with Real World Evidence data. Experience deploying R Shiny apps (Shiny Server, Posit Connect, etc.). Exposure to automation, data engineering, or cloud environments. What We Offer Opportunity to lead innovation in R‑based analytics. Collaborative and forward‑thinking team environment. Competitive salary and benefits package. Career development and access to modern tools and training. Ability to influence strategy around R Shiny and data visualization initiatives. In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family. Avec plus de 6000 collaborateurs sur 5 continents, nous accélérons les transformations de nos clients à travers des partenariats de long terme, en créant un impact mesurable et durable. items.desc: FICHE DE POSTE – SCIENTIFIQUE EN CHIMIE COMPUTATIONNELLE Contexte de la mission Dans le cadre de ses activités de recherche thérapeutique, un laboratoire pharmaceutique recherche un scientifique en chimie computationnelle pour accompagner ses équipes dans l’identification et l’optimisation de nouvelles molécules. Le consultant utilisera des méthodes avancées de modélisation moléculaire, de simulation et d’intelligence artificielle pour contribuer à la découverte de candidats médicaments. Analyser les séquences et construire ou valider des structures protéiques 3D. Utiliser des méthodes de modélisation par homologie et des techniques récentes de co-repliement fondées sur les modèles de langage. Listes de touches chimiques issues des campagnes de recherche et de criblage. Calculs d’affinité et analyses des profils ADMET. Structures de molécules conçues à l’aide de l’IA générative. Modèles optimisés de protéines et d’anticorps. Profil recherché Formation et expérience Doctorat en chimie computationnelle, chémo-informatique ou dans un domaine connexe. Une expérience dans la conception rationnelle de médicaments, en environnement pharmaceutique, biotech ou CRO , est un atout. Connaissance de la chimie médicinale et des concepts pharmacologiques. Maîtrise de l’environnement Linux . Première expérience du cloud computing et des technologies fondées sur l’intelligence artificielle. Langues Anglais obligatoire. Français : lu, écrit et parlé, à un niveau minimum permettant de travailler avec les équipes. Qualités attendues Rigueur scientifique et esprit critique. Curiosité et sens de la collaboration. Autonomie et sens des responsabilités. Qualités relationnelles et adaptabilité. .

items.desc: GROUPE CALCUL Le groupe Présentation Le Réseau métier Le RT Paysage du calcul Actions RT Actions réseau Nos cafés Offres d'emploi Suivez-nous Offres d'emploi Modeling and development of a code for numerical simulation of CO₂ storage reservoirs containing impurities Proposée par Amaziane, le 21 octobre 2026 Post-doctorat Pau Université de Pau et des Pays de l'Adour 2 ans Email Web Fichier Suivez la liste Post Doc Research Project The research will focus on the development, implementation, and validation of advanced numerical models for coupled Thermo-Hydro-Mechanical-Chemical (THMC) processes in geological CO₂ storage systems containing impurities. Particular attention will be paid to the impact of impurities on fluid thermodynamic properties, multiphase flow, heat and mass transfer, and geochemical reactions. The study will investigate the complex interactions between these processes and their influence on the behavior and long-term performance of CO₂ storage reservoirs. The research will involve the development and analysis of numerical methods, their implementation within the DuMuX simulation platform, and the execution of large-scale numerical simulations using high-performance computing (HPC). Benchmarking and validation activities will be conducted to assess the accuracy, robustness, and computational efficiency of the developed models. reservoir scale. Qualifications PhD or equivalent in applied mathematics, Fluid Physics/Mechanics or computational engineering and a strong background in numerical modeling, discretization methods, and scientific computing. Computer and programming skills in C++ and experience with the DuMuX simulation platform. Knowledges in numerical simulation of flow and transport in porous media and interest in interdisciplinary cooperation will be appreciated.
