items.desc: Functieomschrijving Ben jij die gemotiveerde engineer die uitgedaagd wordt om je kennis over satellietnavigatie verder te ontwikkelen en in te zetten voor zowel civiele als militaire doeleinden? En wil je meehelpen de wereld efficiënter, slimmer en veiliger te maken? Lees dan verder! Wat ga je doen? Als R&D Engineer GNSS werk je met een team aan het onderzoeken, ontwikkelen en testen van positie, navigatie en tijd (PNT) oplossingen. Je werk focust zich op het verwerken van GNSS signalen, en de impact van GNSS jamming en spoofing. Je gaat aan de slag met Software Defined Radios om inzicht te krijgen in GNSS receiver processing, en je kijkt naar technieken voor detectie en mitigatie van stoor signalen. Samen met collega’s zet je testen op voor het evalueren van PNT apparatuur in relevante GNSS jamming en spoofing scenario’s. Onze werkzaamheden zijn zeer divers en omvatten zowel kennisopbouw als kennisgebruik. Hieronder volgen een aantal voorbeelden: onderzoeken van GNSS receiver technieken en om onze kennisbasis te versterken; verwerken van radionavigatie signalen, waaronder die van satellietconstellaties; inzichten ontwikkelen in kwetsbaarheden voor GNSS verstoringen; testen van PNT oplossingen, o.a. met een GNSS simulator en bij het NLR Drone Center; ontwikkelen van robuuste PNT systemen, met interferentie detectie en lokalisatie; presenteren van onderzoeksresultaten aan collega’s, klanten en stakeholders. Het team heeft regelmatig contact met de klanten en geeft graag goed onderbouwde adviezen. We werken voor en met de overheid (met name defensie), nationale, Europese en internationale industriële sector, andere instituten en universiteiten. Wat breng je mee? Gestructureerd Werkend En Leergierig Weet Jij Tot Inventieve Oplossingsrichtingen Te Komen. Je Werkt Het Liefste In Teamverband. Je Herkent Jezelf Verder In Het Volgende academisch denk- en werkniveau met een afgeronde masteropleiding Elektrotechniek, Natuurkunde, Lucht- en Ruimtevaarttechniek, of andere technische studie met vergelijkbare achtergrond; relevante programmeerervaring, zoals Matlab, Python of C++; relevante ervaring met de onderwerpen satellietnavigatie, RF engineering, receiver technologieën en SDR’s; ambitie om te werken aan innovatieve state-of-the-art oplossingen; bereid om aan Defensie-gerelateerde projecten te werken; sterke communicatievaardigheden en beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal ( tenminste C1-niveau). Wat bieden wij jou? Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? Ook dat kan bij NLR als lerende organisatie, met daarnaast een opleidingsbudget, een mentor, interne coaches en goede contacten met mbo’s, hbo’s en universiteiten. Naast Dit Alles Bieden Wij Jou De kans om bij te dragen aan complexe en maatschappelijk relevante vraagstukken; Voldoende vakantie- en ATV-dagen (in totaal 45 bij fulltime dienstverband) voor een goede werk-privébalans; Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8%; Een tegemoetkoming in jouw zorgkosten; Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof; De mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen met opleidingen en cursussen die passen bij jouw ambities. Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving Je gaat werken in de afdeling Intel and Space Capabilities binnen de divisie Aerospace Systems. Deze afdeling richt zich o.a. op de Nederlandse overheid en industrie rondom de thema’s “ruimtevaart”, "defensie en veiligheid" en “vitale infrastructuur”. Dat doen we met focus op betrouwbare en effectieve informatie voorziening, ondersteuning bij besluitvorming, commandovoering, missieondersteuning en veiligheid in en vanuit de ruimte. We zijn klantgericht en georganiseerd in drie samenwerkende teams. Binnen deze afdeling wordt je onderdeel van het Space Information Utilisation team, dat de focus heeft op PNT (Positioning, Navigation and Timing) en op ISR (Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance). Wij streven naar een fijne werkomgeving; waarin iedereen zich thuis kan voelt en ruimte is voor (persoonlijke en inhoudelijke) ontwikkeling. Er is een informele sfeer waarin het team centraal staat. Wij werken over het algemeen op de afdeling, maar ook deels vanuit huis. Wat betekent werken bij NLR? Koninklijke NLR is al ruim 100 jaar een kennisorganisatie met de wil en ambitie om te vernieuwen. Vanuit die drijfveer maken wij de wereld van lucht- en ruimtevaart veiliger, duurzamer, efficiënter en effectiever en staan wij voor baanbrekende innovaties. Bij ons werken meer dan 1000 gedreven professionals, van vliegtuigbouwkundigen tot psychologen en van wiskundigen tot applicatiedeskundigen. NLR staat voor een inclusieve en diverse organisatie waar iedereen zich welkom, veilig, gewaardeerd en gerespecteerd voelt. Wil jij meer weten? Voor meer informatie kan je contact …

items.desc: Meet Arago and the Aragonians Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles. The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance. Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders. Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work. What you’ll do As Architecture Modeling Engineer you will own performance modeling and workload analysis for Arago's optical AI accelerator, working across hardware and software teams to evaluate design choices, shape the programming model, and optimize key compute kernels. This role turns workload requirements into architecture decisions and, ultimately, high-performance software on silicon. Required Skills and Experience Strong mathematical background, particularly in linear algebra, probability, numerical methods, and quantitative performance analysis. Strong knowledge of computer architecture, including compute pipelines, memory hierarchies, interconnects, and parallel execution. Strong C/C++ and Python programming skills. Experience analyzing and optimizing performance-critical kernels or low-level compute workloads. Good understanding of AI/ML workloads, tensor operations, data movement, and common execution patterns. Ability to work across hardware and software teams and translate workload behavior into architecture and software requirements. Language: English at a proficient level. Responsibilities Develop fast, flexible performance models to evaluate AI accelerator architecture choices and guide early design decisions. Work closely with the software team to characterize key AI workloads, kernels, dataflows, and system bottlenecks. Work closely with hardware architects to model compute, memory, interconnect, and scheduling behavior across proposed architectures. Drive rapid performance studies and trade-off analyses across throughput, latency, utilization, bandwidth, and efficiency. Help define and validate the programming model and workload mapping strategy for the accelerator. Following architecture definition, work hands-on with the software team to optimize compute kernels and key workloads for the target hardware. Build lightweight simulation, profiling, and analysis tools that support fast iteration from architecture exploration through software optimization. Nice to have Strong industry knowledge about AI hardware, GPUs, memory generations, rack-scale computing. Experience building performance models, simulators, or analytical models for CPUs, GPUs, NPUs, or other accelerators. Experience with profiling, benchmarking, and identifying hardware or software performance bottlenecks. Experience in novel computing architectures: analog computing, in-memory computing, heterogeneous systems. Pay and benefits Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions. Meaningful stock option plan offered (included in the majority of full time offers). Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays. Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

items.desc: Researcher Advanced Contacts Role Overview One of the central challenges in beyond‑2 nm chip technologies is the scaling of electrical contacts. To address this, imec seeks to strengthen its research by hiring a Thin Film Deposition Expert on Scaled Contacts . In this role, you will be responsible for designing and optimising thin film deposition processes, conducting experimental studies to evaluate emerging materials, and collaborating closely with integration teams to ensure solutions are compatible with advanced device architectures. You will join the Materials & Interfaces, Deposition & Analysis department as a Researcher . Working within a cross-functional team of around 10 people, you will collaborate with unit process, integration and device experts from imec and partner companies. What you will do Process Development and Optimisation Lead the optimisation of thin film contact deposition processes , with emphasis on ALD and CVD , to improve performance, control, robustness and repeatability. Go beyond standard supplier recipes by leveraging deep understanding of process chemistry, reaction mechanisms and materials behaviours to tune and troubleshoot processes. Process Ownership and Delivery Play a leading role in delivering service lots, including partner-driven requests, while ensuring continuity, quality and timely execution. Support the execution and improvement of (C)TLM lots and flows within Joint Learning Programmes and guide users in implementing and owning their own flow. Materials and Characterisation Integration Coordinate intensive materials characterisation with partner teams and use results to guide process development. Integrate literature surveys and characterisation insights into actionable process and materials improvements. Collaboration and Ecosystem Integration Act as a versatile material and process expert, bridging chemistry, deposition, and characterisation across internal and external stakeholders. Collaborate closely on PVD, ALD and CVD-related activities and with epitaxy experts , focusing on non-epitaxial thin film deposition chemistries and materials engineering. What we do for you We offer you the opportunity to join one of the world’s premier research centers in nanotechnology at its headquarters in Leuven, Belgium. With your talent, passion and expertise, you’ll become part of a team that makes the impossible possible. Together, we shape the technology that will determine the society of tomorrow. We are committed to being an inclusive employer and proud of our open, multicultural, and informal working environment with ample possibilities to take initiative and show responsibility. We commit to supporting and guiding you in this process; not only with words but also with tangible actions. Through imec.academy, 'our corporate university', we actively invest in your development to further your technical and personal growth. We are aware that your valuable contribution makes imec a top player in its field. Your energy and commitment are therefore appreciated by means of a market appropriate salary with many fringe benefits. Who you are Technical Background PhD in Materials Science , Chemistry , Physics , or a related field. Strong expertise in thin film deposition, especially ALD and CVD , with broad understanding of thin film properties, interfaces, and structure-property relationships. Solid understanding of the links between process, material properties, and characterisation techniques. Experience and Skills Proven experience in process development and optimisation in an R&D or advanced manufacturing environment. Ability to address chemistry-driven process challenges thanks to the use of advanced characterisations and translate insights into improvements. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills, with the ability to handle parallel activities. Personal Competencies Collaborative and versatile team player, able to work effectively across disciplines. Scientifically curious, pragmatic, and delivery-oriented, with strong communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences. Comfortable working in a multi-projects, international research environment. IMEC and its affiliates will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate. IMEC will consider unsolicited referrals and/or resumes submitted by vendors such as search firms, staffing agencies, professional recruiters, fee-based referral services and recruiting agencies (hereafter “Agency”) to have been referred by the Agency free of charge. items.desc: Vacature AI verandert razendsnel. Bij HVC willen en kunnen we daarom niet vooraf bepalen hoe AI over een paar jaar wordt ingezet, maar wel stap voor stap ontdekken waar het ons kan helpen. Als AI Engineer krijg je de ruimte om nieuwe mogelijkheden direct in de praktijk te brengen. Je onderzoekt samen met collega’s waar AI waarde toevoegt, bouwt toepassingen en leert van wat wel en niet werkt. Een vraag van een collega is vaak het begin. Hoe ziet het werk eruit, waar zit een knelpunt en kan AI daarbij helpen? Vanuit die praktijk ga je experimenteren, bouwen, testen en verbeteren. Daarvoor hoef je nog geen jarenlange ervaring mee te brengen. Belangrijker is dat je de technische basis hebt om oplossingen te doorgronden en nieuwsgierig genoeg bent om nieuwe technologie snel eigen te maken. Zo groeit niet alleen jouw kennis, maar ontdekken we tegelijkertijd welke rol AI binnen HVC kan spelen. “Ik vind juist die onbevangenheid interessant. Misschien heb je tijdens je studie de nieuwste ontwikkelingen al uitgeprobeerd. Die kennis neem je mee naar HVC. Hier ontdek je hoe je AI in de praktijk toepast: door naast collega’s te gaan zitten, samen oplossingen te maken en vooral ook aan de slag te gaan.” — Martin Haubrich, Manager Digitalisering Verantwoordelijkheden Samen met gebruikers kansen voor AI herkennen en vertalen naar praktische toepassingen. AI-toepassingen en agents ontwikkelen, onder andere binnen Microsoft Copilot, en deze testen en verbeteren. Nieuwe AI-mogelijkheden verkennen en beoordelen wat daarvan bruikbaar is voor HVC. Meedenken over veiligheid, betrouwbaarheid, onderhoudbaarheid en verantwoord gebruik. Je werkt vanuit Alkmaar en werkt veel samen met collega’s uit Digitalisering, technische teams en verschillende onderdelen van HVC. Juist het contact met gebruikers is belangrijk: begrijpen wat iemand nodig heeft en vervolgens samen iets maken dat in de praktijk werkt. Binnen de organisatie zijn ervaren collega’s beschikbaar om inhoudelijk mee te sparren. Thuiswerken is deels mogelijk, maar zeker in deze fase speelt samenwerken op kantoor een belangrijke rol. wat bieden wij? € 3.436 - € 4.674 o.b.v. 38 uur 36 - 40 urige werkweek Diverse opleidingsmogelijkheden Genoeg verlofdagen. Deze zijn ook extra te kopen Persoonlijk Arbeidsvoorwaarden Budget van 13,7% Goede werk en privébalans vinden we belangrijk Wij zijn goed voor het klimaat én voor jou Samenwerken aan onze missie wat is vereist? Hbo+ werk- en denkniveau, in bijvoorbeeld IT, Computer Science, programmeren of toegepaste AI. Een technische basis waarmee je code en de werking van oplossingen kunt doorgronden, opgedaan tijdens opleiding, stage, projecten of werk. Nieuwsgierigheid naar AI en de motivatie om nieuwe ontwikkelingen zelf te volgen en uit te proberen. Makkelijk contact maken met collega’s en technische mogelijkheden begrijpelijk en praktisch maken. Kennis van Python en actuele AI-concepten zoals MCP is een pré, geen vereiste.

items.desc: Over deze vacature Bij de afdeling Modelling of Tactical Operations ga je meedraaien in technisch-wetenschappelijke onderzoeksprojecten met als doel om Defensie te ondersteunen bij het nemen van betere beslissingen. Dat kan op tal van fronten. Van de aanschaf en instandhouding van apparatuur aan boord van schepen, tot de voorbereiding en uitvoering van operaties. Samen met je collega’s analyseer je de data uit zelf uitgevoerde simulaties, bedenk je concepten en algoritmes en breng je adviezen uit die impact hebben op het werk van militaire eenheden, beleidsmakers en politici, zowel nationaal als internationaal. Wat ga je doen? Je komt werken in het JROADS team waar je mee helpt met het doorontwikkelen van een bestaande software simulatie applicatie in Java. In projectteams werk je samen met experts van andere TNO-afdelingen aan het modelleren van systemen op land, zee en lucht en dreiging, en dat in het Defensiedomein. Samen met analisten en gebruikers denk je na over nieuwe concepten en zet je deze om in nieuwe deelmodellen/werkende software, waarmee je analyses, oefeningen en experimenten ondersteunt. Defensie en andere veiligheidsorganisaties schakelen onze expertise bijvoorbeeld in bij het opzetten van een simulatieomgeving om operators nieuwe concepten te laten testen of om de meest effectieve inzet van wapen- of radarsystemen te bepalen. Om ervoor te zorgen dat je snel als volwaardig teamlid kunt meedraaien in projecten voor Defensie, volg je eerst een algemeen (intern) opleidingstraject gericht op jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling en het opdoen van vaardigheden die belangrijk zijn voor het werken bij TNO. Geleidelijk aan ga je steeds zelfstandiger werken, krijg je meer verantwoordelijkheid en krijg je meer contact met klanten. Een werkdag kan zomaar bestaan uit een bezoek aan militaire eenheden om informatie op te halen of om testen uit te voeren. Wat wij van jou verwachten Heb jij een passie voor technologie en innovatie, hou je van modelleren en wil je bijdragen aan maatschappelijke doelen? Dan past deze functie bij jou. Ervaring of affiniteit met het domein Defensie en Veiligheid is een pré, maar het is ook geen punt als dat nog niet zo is, want je ontdekt bij ons snel genoeg hoe boeiend en veelzijdig deze wereld is. Omdat je gaat werken in een innovatieve R&D-omgeving is het verder belangrijk dat je analytisch sterk bent, een groot abstract denkvermogen hebt en mee kunt denken over het vertalen van wetenschap naar praktijk. Verder beschik je over een technisch-wetenschappelijke wo-master, zoals lucht- en ruimtevaarttechniek, werktuigbouwkunde, technische wiskunde, informatica of natuurkunde met een relevante afstudeerrichting (bv. control & simulation of modellering); een brede technische interesse en hebt aantoonbare affiniteit voor het ontwikkelen van modellen en simulaties. Je combineert nieuwsgierigheid en aandacht voor details met een vermogen tot het overzien van complexe vraagstukken; ervaring met Java (of back-up C++ of C#). Ervaring in Python een pré; goede beheersing van de Nederlandse én de Engelse taal in woord en geschrift. Wat wij jou bieden Uitdagend én afwisselend werk met serieuze impact. En volop kansen, want bij TNO heb je grotendeels zelf de regie over je carrière. Naast een bruto (fulltime) maandsalaris tussen € 3.533,- en € 8.072,- (afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring), vakantiegeld (8%), een 13de maand (8,33%) en een flexbudget (5,58% + € 180), krijg je alle mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Daarnaast kun je bij TNO een ‘menu’ aan arbeidsvoorwaarden samenstellen dat bij jouw persoonlijke situatie past. Wat je ook mag verwachten Een uiterst professionele, innovatieve werkomgeving, met topexperts als collega’s. Mogelijkheid om cursussen, opleidingen en workshops te volgen en congressen te bezoeken, en coaching als je daar behoefte aan hebt. 33 vakantiedagen plus een flexibele feestdag, die in te zetten is op een culturele, religieuze of anderszins belangrijke dag naar keuze (bij een fulltime dienstverband). Een werkgever die divers talent waardeert en stimuleert, met initiatieven als Jong TNO, verschillende expertise gildes, onze Rainbow Community en Round Tables over inclusiethema’s. Een uitgebreide en flexibele mobiliteitsregeling, inclusief volledige vergoeding van openbaar vervoer voor woon-werk en zakelijke reizen. Gezellige activiteiten met je team en andere TNO'ers. Zo leer je snel veel mensen kennen. Flexibele werktijden, de mogelijkheid om parttime (32 of 36 uur) te werken en de mogelijkheid om thuis te werken. Een goede pensioenregeling. Lees hier uit welke arbeidsvoorwaarden je verder kunt kiezen. TNO als werkgever Onze mensen vormen het hart van TNO. Hun nieuwsgierigheid, expertise en ondernemerschap maken het mogelijk om impactvolle onderzoeken en innovaties te creëren voor duurzaam welzijn en welvaart van de samenleving. items.desc: CONSULTANT CHÉMO-INFORMATIQUE & IA H/F Contexte de la mission Dans le cadre de ses activités de recherche thérapeutique, un laboratoire pharmaceutique recherche un consultant junior en chémo-informatique et intelligence artificielle pour rejoindre son équipe de chimie computationnelle basée à Paris-Saclay. La mission consiste à gérer des données et des collections de composés chimiques, à optimiser les flux de données et à participer à l’évolution des plateformes de prédiction et d’IA générative utilisées par les équipes de recherche. Informations générales Localisation : Gif-sur-Yvette, Paris-Saclay (91) Télétravail : 2 à 3 jours par semaine maximum, dans la limite de 8 jours par mois, selon les contraintes des activités Niveau recherché : junior Département : Computational Chemistry – Recherche Missions principales Gestion des données et des workflows Gérer les collections de composés et les bases de données chimiques. Veiller à l’intégrité et à la connectivité des données pharmacologiques, physico-chimiques, ADME et toxicologiques. Concevoir, mettre à jour, optimiser et tester les workflows de données sous Pipeline Pilot . Assurer les échanges de données avec les applications utilisées par les équipes, notamment LiveDesign . Plateforme de prédiction et Machine Learning Développer et maintenir la plateforme de prédiction des propriétés moléculaires. Réaliser des études comparatives pour évaluer les modèles et suivre leur performance dans le temps. Intégrer les modèles les plus pertinents aux applications utilisées par les chercheurs, notamment GTD, REINVENT et LiveDesign . Intelligence artificielle générative Développer et maintenir la plateforme d’IA générative du département. Automatiser l’intégration des résultats dans LiveDesign pour leur analyse par les chimistes médicinaux. Étudier les possibilités d’automatisation à l’aide d’agents IA. Code et environnement cloud Restructurer et maintenir le dépôt GitHub de l’équipe. Documenter le code et veiller à sa qualité et à son accessibilité. Participer à la migration et au déploiement d’outils sur Google Cloud Platform (GCP) . Livrables attendus Rapports d’activité mensuels et présentations scientifiques. Protocoles et workflows de données conçus sous Pipeline Pilot . Modèles de Machine Learning entraînés et intégrés aux outils de l’équipe. Code source documenté et mis à jour sur GitHub . Flux d’automatisation et maintenance de la plateforme d’IA générative. Scripts de déploiement et documentation de l’infrastructure GCP . Profil recherché Formation et expérience Master 2 ou diplôme supérieur en chémo-informatique, bio-informatique ou informatique avec une spécialisation en sciences de la vie. Profil junior . Une expérience dans la gestion d’écosystèmes de chémo-informatique, d’IA et d’IT en environnement de recherche constitue un atout. Compétences techniques Expertise de Pipeline Pilot pour la conception de workflows de données. Maîtrise avancée de Python et de GitHub . Connaissance de l’analyse statistique multivariée et des méthodes de Machine Learning . Capacité à concevoir de manière autonome des études comparatives de modèles. Connaissance de GCP et du déploiement de solutions d’IA et de Machine Learning. Connaissance de la gestion de bases de données chimiques et de LiveDesign . Langues Anglais obligatoire : lu, écrit et parlé. Français : lu, écrit et parlé, au niveau minimum requis pour travailler avec les équipes. Qualités attendues Autonomie et méthode. Capacité à résoudre les problèmes et réactivité. Sens du service et goût pour la transmission des connaissances. Rigueur et souci du détail.

items.desc: Job Description Your Impact Leonardo UK Engineering is building internal AI Engineering Capability with engineers who deploy into Integrated Project Teams for short, scoped engagements. The role uses AI-enabled tooling to improve how a programme handles requirements, architecture, modelling, design, implementation and related engineering work. You will work within a small multi-disciplinary team in deep collaboration with our AI platform development team. Where this vacancy is being recruited across more than one grade, the successful candidate will be appointed to a specific assessed grade, and the applicable salary range will be that associated with the grade of appointment. What You’ll Do Deploy into a project – help to discover, scope and solve high value engineering problems with the platform’s tooling. Collaborate with the AI platform team to make architecture and design decisions and with company process owners to change how we engineer Build custom applications, workflows and templates to enable development, improvement of engineering products – from specifications to product implementation to supporting engineering modelling & simulation tooling. Become an expert user: know the tooling’s opportunities and failure modes better than anyone else in the company. Skill up the IPT’s engineers as you go — the team should be more capable after you leave than it was while you were there. What We’re Looking For High agency. You are curious, purposeful and proactive – you learn quickly and find ways to navigate complex organisational structures. Outcome oriented and data driven – you care about effecting real change for our engineers and our end customers. Write well enough that anything you leave behind is usable by a stranger six months later. Comfortable being measured on whether other people adopted something. Able to enter an unfamiliar programme, earn trust with a variety of stakeholders quickly, and leave without having become indispensable. What You’ll Bring Familiarity with LLMs, SLMs and Agentic AI as a user Programming and scripting, such as MATLAB, Simulink, Python, Bash Product and systems thinking Why this is interesting You work across several programmes a year instead of one, and see how the business really engineers. You become the company’s expert user of tooling that will be everywhere in three years. The process change your project exposes becomes the new company standard — you change the method, not just the output. Your output is measured in other people’s capability, which is a rarer and more portable thing to have done. Security Clearance You must be eligible for full security clearance. For more information and guidance please visit: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vettingclearance-levels Why join us At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We offer a comprehensive, company-funded benefits package that supports your wellbeing, career development, and work–life balance. Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive. Time to Recharge: Enjoy generous leave with the opportunity to accrue up to 12 additional flexi-days each year. Secure your Future: Benefit from our award-winning pension scheme with up to 15% employer contribution. Your Wellbeing Matters: Free access to mental health support, financial advice, and employee-led networks championing inclusion and diversity (Enable, Pride, Equalise, Armed Forces, Carers, Wellbeing and Ethnicity). Rewarding Performance: All employees at management level and below are eligible for our bonus scheme. Never Stop Learning: Free access to 4,000+ online courses via Coursera and LinkedIn Learning. Refer a friend: Receive a financial reward through our referral programme. Tailored Perks: Spend up to £500 annually on flexible benefits including private healthcare, dental, family cover, tech & lifestyle discounts, gym memberships and more. Flexible working: Flexible hours with hybrid working options. For part time opportunities, please talk to us about what might be possible for this role. For a full list of our company benefits please visit our website. Leonardo is a global leader in Aerospace, Defence, and Security. Headquartered in Italy, we employ over 53,000 people worldwide including 8,500 across 9 sites in the UK. Our employees are not just part of a team—they are key contributors to shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. At Leonardo we are committed to building an inclusive, accessible, and welcoming workplace. We believe that a diverse workforce sparks creativity, drives innovation, and leads to better outcomes for our people and our customers. Te buscamos, independientemente de tu género, capacidades diferentes, orientación sexual, origen étnico o cualquier característica que te haga único/a. ✨ Qué esperamos de ti ✨ Formación en Ingeniería Informática, Tecnologías de la Información, Ciencia de Datos o áreas afines. Conocimientos de programación y fundamentos de Big Data y Business Intelligence . Conocimientos de lenguajes como Python, SQL y PySpark / Apache Spark . Familiaridad con ecosistemas Big Data y tecnologías como HDFS y Parquet . Conocimientos de herramientas de Business Intelligence y visualización de datos, como Amazon QuickSight o MicroStrategy . Familiaridad con entornos Cloud, especialmente AWS (SageMaker, Athena, S3, etc.). Conocimientos de procesos de integración y despliegue continuo ( CI/CD ), incluyendo versionado de código, desarrollo y despliegues en entornos productivos. Capacidad analítica, orientación a la resolución de problemas y atención al detalle. Actitud proactiva, curiosidad tecnológica, capacidad de adaptación y ganas de seguir aprendiendo. Buenas habilidades de comunicación, colaboración y trabajo en equipo. ✨ Funciones ✨ Desarrollar y mantener procesos Big Data que den soporte a las actividades de Financial Crime Prevention, especialmente en los ámbitos de prevención del fraude y del blanqueo de capitales. Diseñar, desarrollar e implementar cuadros de mando y dashboards que faciliten el seguimiento, análisis y explotación de la información del departamento. Realizar tareas de extracción, tratamiento y análisis de datos para dar respuesta a necesidades del negocio y apoyar la investigación de incidentes relacionados con FCP. Participar en la mejora continua y automatización de procesos de datos , contribuyendo a incrementar su eficiencia, calidad y fiabilidad. Trabajar de forma coordinada con equipos técnicos y de negocio para identificar necesidades, proponer soluciones y facilitar la toma de decisiones basada en datos. items.desc: Descrizione azienda Vuoi un mini spoiler su CPM? Ci prendiamo cura dei maggiori brand mondiali da oltre 80 anni attraverso diverse attività, dal merchandising alle vendite, dalla consumer activation al supporto clienti fino alla formazione sul prodotto. Questa è CPM, una realtà internazionale forte e dinamica, come le persone che ne fanno parte. Per te, rappresenta la grande opportunità di entrare a far parte di una solida multinazionale dove formarti e sviluppare la tua carriera in un settore in crescita e in un ambiente giovane, innovativo e super stimolante. Un’esperienza che ti metterà a contatto con i brand e le aziende più importanti in Italia. Candidati e… magari ci vediamo a bordo! Posizione Ti offriamo di diventare il guru dei nostri dati. Per te abbiamo una posizione come Data Scientist in un settore, il Field Marketing, dove la tua competenza può davvero fare la differenza. Potrai mettere in luce le tue capacità di analisi e interpretazione del dato al servizio di tanti brand diversi. Annoiarsi? Impossibile. Lavorerai nella nostra sede di Milano in spazi di nuova generazione e potrai operare anche da casa e ovunque grazie alle nuove politiche di smart working. Perché in CPM Italy siamo convinti che i tuoi risultati passino anche attraverso la qualità della tua vita. Ok, ma cosa farai di preciso? Il tuo ruolo riguarderà il supporto ai progetti di vendita attraverso l’analisi dei dati, la realizzazione di report e modelli analitici, e la produzione di insight utili a supportare le decisioni di business. Come? realizzando report, dashboard e modelli analitici; sviluppando e affinando modelli di analisi predittiva per supportare i progetti; traducendo i dati in insight utili a supporto delle decisioni di business; utilizzando tool e sistemi di Business Intelligence; supportando l'identificazione di trend, pattern e opportunità attraverso tecniche di analisi quantitativa. Requisiti Sei tu la persona giusta? Per entrare nel nostro reparto di Data Scientist è richiesta un’esperienza di almeno 1 anno in questo ruolo, oltre a un solido background in discipline quantitative come Statistica, Matematica e Data Science. Essere positivi, proattivi e precisi è un ottimo requisito ma i veri must sono la passione per i numeri e la voglia di partecipare sempre a nuove sfide. In più è fantastico se… ti piace trasformare dati in informazioni; possiedi competenze di programmazione in Python e/o R; hai esperienza nella costruzione e validazione di modelli predittivi o di machine learning; conosci metodologie statistiche per l'analisi e l'interpretazione dei dati; Excel è il tuo pane quotidiano; hai una conoscenza base di PowerBI ed SQL; ti entusiasma lavorare in team. Altre informazioni Ai sensi della legge 12 Marzo 1999 n.68, Inventa CPM promuove l'inserimento e l'integrazione delle persone disabili nel mondo del lavoro, per questo motivo verranno tenute in particolare considerazione le candidature di tutti i soggetti indicati al comma 1 art.1 della succitata legge.

items.desc: Meer dan alleen techniek! Bij ilionx combineer je data, AI en consultancy. Adviseer klanten, ontwikkel innovatieve oplossingen en krijg de vrijheid om écht impact te maken. Heb jij al je eerste werkervaring opgedaan in Data & Cloud en wil je jezelf verder ontwikkelen binnen moderne dataplatformen? Ben je daarnaast communicatief sterk en vind je het leuk om samen met collega's én klanten tot slimme oplossingen te komen? Bij ilionx in Zwolle krijg je de kans om jouw technische en consultancyvaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen. Jouw functie als Junior Data & AI Consultant De wereld van Data & AI ontwikkelt zich razendsnel. Organisaties willen steeds meer waarde halen uit hun data en daarvoor zijn slimme, betrouwbare en toekomstbestendige oplossingen nodig. Als Junior Data & Consultant bij ilionx in Zwolle werk je mee aan het realiseren van die oplossingen. Je hebt al enige praktijkervaring met data en cloudtechnologie en wilt je verder ontwikkelen tot een veelzijdige dataspecialist. Je werkt aan het volledige dataproces: van het ontsluiten, transformeren en modelleren van data aan de backend tot het ontwikkelen van dashboards en rapportages aan de frontend. Zo zorg je ervoor dat data niet alleen technisch goed wordt verwerkt, maar ook daadwerkelijk waarde oplevert voor organisaties. Bij ilionx geloven we in de kracht van de veelzijdige consultant. Iemand die technisch sterk is, maar ook goed kan communiceren, samenwerken en de vraag achter de vraag begrijpt. Je vindt het leuk om met collega's te sparren, technische keuzes uit te leggen en mee te denken met klanten. Want een goede dataoplossing draait niet alleen om technologie, maar ook om het begrijpen van de mensen en organisaties waarvoor je deze ontwikkelt. Je hoeft nog niet overal expert in te zijn. We zoeken iemand die al een goede technische basis heeft, zelfstandig onderdelen kan oppakken en de ambitie heeft om zowel technisch als communicatief verder te groeien. In deze rol houd je je onder andere bezig met: Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van datapipelines en datamodellen met daarbij datamanagement Werken met moderne cloudplatformen zoals Databricks, Microsoft Fabric en/of Snowflake Ontsluiten, transformeren en structureren van data uit verschillende bronnen Ontwikkelen van dashboards, rapportages en visualisaties, bijvoorbeeld met Power BI Meedenken met klanten over hun datavraagstukken en deze vertalen naar praktische oplossingen Samenwerken met ervaren Data Engineers, BI specialisten en Data Consultants en jouw ideeën en inzichten actief delen Jezelf verder ontwikkelen op het gebied van Data Engineering, Analytics, Cloud en consultancy Wat bieden wij jou? Bij ilionx geloven we dat je het meeste leert door uitdagend werk te combineren met goede begeleiding, kennisdeling en ruimte om te experimenteren. Je komt terecht in een omgeving waar ervaren dataspecialisten graag hun kennis delen en waar je de mogelijkheid krijgt om steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Niet alleen technisch, maar ook in het contact met klanten en het adviseren over oplossingen. items.desc: Seksjon for mikrodata tilrettelegger data for utarbeiding av statistiske resultater, analyser og til bruk i forskningsprosjekter hos kunder og til microdata.no. Vi søker inntil tre nye medarbeidere. Er du vår nye kollega? I Seksjon for mikrodata vil du få ansvar for en portefølje av prosjekter. Dette krever selvstendig arbeid, i tillegg til samhandling på tvers i egen seksjon og andre seksjoner i SSB. En del av jobbhverdagen er dialog med våre kunder om datagrunnlaget de ønsker til sine prosjekter. Videre vil du utarbeide tilbud og tilrettelegge data for levering. Du vil også kunne få oppgaver innen kommunikasjon, rådgiving, presentasjoner og markedsføring av våre tjenester. Du som søker har relevant utdanning og/eller erfaring som har overføringsverdi til å jobbe med kunder gjennom hele prosessen, fra bestilling til leveranse av datagrunnlag. Du kan være nyutdannet, eller ha jobbet en stund og ha kompetanse fra tidligere arbeidsforhold som kan være relevant i arbeidet hos oss. Kundene våre er forskningsmiljøene i Norge og offentlig forvaltning. Seksjonen har også ansvar for microdata.no-løsningen i samarbeid med Sikt - Kunnskapssektorens tjenesteleverandør. Seksjonen består av 26 medarbeidere med variert bakgrunn. Vi har et hyggelig og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø! Hvilken kompetanse har du? Høyere utdanning på minimum bachelornivå, relevant erfaring kan kompensere for utdanningskravet Erfaring med og/eller interesse for koding- og programmeringsverktøy - fortrinnsvis Python God fremstillingsevne på norsk, skriftlig og muntlig Ønskelig med erfaring med å tilrettelegge data og sammenstille disse Ønskelig med erfaring innen team-/prosjektarbeid og bruk av ulike samhandlingsverktøy i oppgaveløsing Det er en fordel med forståelse for forskningsmetodikk I tillegg ønsker vi at du Har gode samarbeidsevner Har evne til å jobbe strukturert og nøyaktig Er analytisk og har evne til nytenkning Er serviceinnstilt og har forståelse for kundeoppfølging Har evne til å håndtere stort arbeidspress og mange oppgaver Opptatt av å tilegne deg kunnskap og kompetanse Hos oss får du Jobb i en virksomhet med et viktig samfunnsoppdrag. Vi har stor tillit hos befolkningen og blant beslutningstakere, og som medarbeider i SSB blir du del av et stort fagmiljø Gode muligheter for utvikling, samarbeid og nettverksbygging. Vi har nyansattprogram, årlig hackathon og arenaer for faglig deling på tvers Stilling som førstekonsulent/rådgiver i lønnsspenn kr 600 000 - 700 000. Stillingskode og lønn fastsettes ut fra dine kvalifikasjoner. Høyere lønn og eventuelt stillingskode kan vurderes for søkere som er særlig godt kvalifiserte Fleksitid, betalt overtid og sommertid i perioden 15. mai til og med 14. september Godt miljø også utenom arbeidstid, med idrettstilbud og ulike sosiale aktiviteter. Du kan trene én time i uken i arbeidstid, med treningsrom i kontorlokalene Medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse, som betyr at du får en av Norges beste pensjonsordninger og mulighet til å søke om boliglån med gunstige betingelser Nytt og trivelig kontorbygg sentralt i Kongsvinger Verdt å merke seg før du søker: For at vi skal best mulig skal kunne vurdere din søknad, trenger vi at du innen søknadsfristen registrerer relevant dokumentasjon i den elektroniske søkeportalen (attester, vitnemål osv.). For kandidater som vi vurderer å ansette kan vi utføre bakgrunnssjekk og kontroll av dokumentasjon. Når du søker jobb hos oss, vil navnet ditt stå på en offentlig søkerliste. Det er mulig å bli unntatt denne søkerlisten. Da må du i så fall begrunne hvorfor du ønsker å bli unntatt. Vi tar deretter stilling til om vi kan innvilge ønsket ditt. Kan vi ikke det, hører du selvsagt fra oss. SSB skal være et godt sted å jobbe for alle, og vi ønsker medarbeidere med ulike kompetanser, fagkombinasjoner, livserfaring og perspektiver for å løse fremtidens oppgaver. Har du funksjonsnedsettelse, innvandrerbakgrunn, eller hatt lengre fravær fra arbeid, utdanning eller opplæring de siste årene, vil vi oppfordre deg til å krysse av for dette når du søker på stillingen. Det gir deg mulighet for å få positiv særbehandling. Vi inviterer minst én kvalifisert søker fra hver av disse gruppe til intervju. Dersom du har behov for tilrettelegging vil vi strekke oss langt for å imøtekomme ditt behov.

items.title: (Junior) Consultant Digital Audit Technology (w/m/d)
items.card: Deine Aufgaben Du unterstützt bei der Anwendung und kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung von KI-gestützten sowie datenbasierten Prüfungsansätzen und trägst dazu bei, innovative Technologien in die Abschlussprüfung zu integrieren. items.desc: Begleite KPMG bei den zukünftigen Herausforderungen unserer Kunden und Kundinnen. Begeistere auch Du Dich für die Vielfalt unserer Fragestellungen - und mach gemeinsam mit uns den Unterschied. Du begeisterst dich für KI und Datenanalysen? Und du möchtest deine Erfahrungen in der Wirtschaftsprüfung in einem innovativen Umfeld einbringen? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams im Bereich Digital Audit Technology und unterstütze uns dabei, Prüfungsprozesse durch Einsatz modernster Technologie effizienter und smarter zu gestalten. Deine Aufgaben Du unterstützt bei der Anwendung und kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung von KI-gestützten sowie datenbasierten Prüfungsansätzen und trägst dazu bei, innovative Technologien in die Abschlussprüfung zu integrieren. Als Ansprechpartner:in begleitest Du Prüfungsteams bei der Einführung, Umsetzung und Optimierung digitaler Prüfungsprozesse und sorgst für einen effizienten Einsatz moderner Prüfungsmethoden. Das Setup unserer digitalen Prüfungstools gehört zu Deinem Verantwortungsbereich, wobei Du Aufgaben im Data Engineering sowie im Account Mapping übernimmst. Gemeinsam mit Fachkolleg:innen entwickelst Du datengetriebene Lösungen und unterstützt dabei, Prüfungsprozesse durch den gezielten Einsatz moderner Technologien weiter zu automatisieren. Deine Ideen bringst Du aktiv in interdisziplinäre Projekte ein und arbeitest daran mit, innovative Lösungsansätze für anspruchsvolle Mandantenanforderungen zu entwickeln. Im Austausch mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern wirkst Du an der Weiterentwicklung digitaler Prüfungsstandards mit und unterstützt die digitale Transformation der Wirtschaftsprüfung. Dein Profil Dein Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung hast Du erfolgreich abgeschlossen. Erste Berufserfahrung in der Wirtschaftsprüfung oder im Umfeld von Audit Technology ermöglicht es Dir, fachliche Zusammenhänge schnell zu erfassen und praxisnah einzubringen. Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Datenanalyse- und Visualisierungslösungen, idealerweise ergänzt durch erste Erfahrungen mit Structured Query Language, Power BI oder vergleichbaren Technologien, zeichnen Dich aus. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau erleichtern Dir die Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern im nationalen und internationalen Umfeld. Eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Eigeninitiative sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team runden Dein Profil ab. Deine Benefits Willkommen im Team Damit Du von Beginn an voll bei uns durchstarten kannst, begleiten wir Dich mit strukturierten Onboarding-Maßnahmen während der gesamten Orientierungsphase. Zudem fördert Deine Führungskraft gezielt Deine fachliche und persönliche Integration ins Team. Systematische und regelmäßige Feedback-Gespräche unterstützen Dich beim Erreichen dieser Ziele. Als Teil des weltweiten KPMG-.Netzwerks bieten wir Dir interessante Karrieremöglichkeiten im In- und Ausland und somit wertvolle Einblicke in die Vielfalt unserer Tätigkeitsbereiche. Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben Wir sind überzeugt, dass es vor allem Vielfalt und Flexibilität braucht, um Innovationen zu fördern und langfristige Erfolge zu sichern. Nur so können wir die besten Ideen entwickeln und wirklich innovative Lösungen finden. Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, Homeoffice-Option, Zeitkonten und Auszeiten schaffen wir Räume, um Privat- und Berufsleben miteinander zu vereinbaren. Fort- & Weiterbildung Durch regelmäßige Trainings, Workshops und Weiterbildungen entwickelst Du Dich stetig weiter. Zudem fördern wir Berufsexamina sowie berufsbegleitende Master-Studiengänge. Mit unseren Rotationsprogrammen ermöglichen wir Deinen fachübergreifenden Einsatz. Diese Einblicke in die vielfältigen Aufgabenfelder bei KPMG erweitern Deinen Horizont und fördern Synergien in der Zusammenarbeit. Die abgebildeten Leistungen können je nach Position und Standort leicht variieren.

items.title: Data Quality Specialist - Turkish, AGI Data Services - G T Quality
items.card: responsibilities * Define and implement quality metrics for established workflows * Create prescriptive actions for quality issues * Partner with customers, operations and internal support teams to optimize workflow quality * Conduct side-by-sides to identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements * Analyze data trends and develop solutions * Monitor quality performance and coach operations
items.desc:
Quality Specialists play a vital role in establishing and maintaining comprehensive quality frameworks across our operations. Their primary responsibility begins with developing robust quality strategies in collaboration with customers and CPMs, encompassing metrics, audit approaches, and specific targets for each workflow. When quality issues arise, these specialists create prescriptive actions, examining data patterns to formulate effective solutions. They maintain a continuous improvement cycle by managing a critical feedback loop between operations and customers, drawing insights from multiple sources including quality auditors, side-by-side observations, and metric analysis. Through regular side-by-side sessions, they identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements. items.desc:
People at Apple don’t just build products — they craft the kind of experience that have revolutionized entire industries. The diverse collection of our people and their ideas inspire innovation in everything we do. Imagine what you could do here! Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.
The Apple Services Engineering (ASE) team builds and provides systems and infrastructure that fuel Apple’s services (such as iCloud, iTunes, Siri, and Maps). We are the foundation on which Apple’s software developers build the products that our customers love. We are looking for passionate and talented Site Reliability Engineers to continue our focus in providing our customers the highest quality Apple Services experience. Our services have to scale globally, stay highly available, and "just work.” If you love designing, engineering and running systems and infrastructure that will help millions of customers, then this is the place for you!
FoundationDB infrastructure is BIG. Operating at our scale, across multiple geographically dispersed data centers and servicing hundreds of millions of users presents unique challenges. As an SRE at Apple, you'll need to solve these problems using data, teamwork, and your own expertise. SREs at Apple own the full infrastructure stack; from device driver performance debugging to content delivery network traffic management — our responsibilities are both broad and deep.
FoundationDB runs its systems on Linux. We run a mix of open source, vendor licensed, and internally developed tools to perform functions such as system configuration management, provisioning, software deployment, logging, and monitoring. You'll learn these tools and have opportunities to improve them. Our team is collaborative; we work closely with the development teams we support to deliver the best results for Apple. We think critically and strive to balance the best solution with the need to get things done for each engineering challenge we face. Good ideas are heard and results are rewarded.
FoundationDB SRE is a small team with huge scale. We serve as the database for much of CloudKit's use cases, including Mail, Contacts, and Keychain. We serve hundreds of millions of customers every day and are a fundamental piece of the Apple device experience.

 SECURITY CLEARANCE: You will be subject to BPSS and Export Control checks (including a criminal record check) 
 TRAVEL REQUIRED: Some travel within UK and international 
 LOCATION: Belfast 
 GRADE: B07 
 TYPE: Full time 
 WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU 
 Financial Reward: Competitive salary, annual profit share, contributory pension, share options 
 Work / Life Balance: 36 hour week, flexible working around core hours and Friday afternoons off, flexible working 
 We are seeking an individual who can demonstrate appropriate experience of delivering IT services in a fast moving industrial environment. A position is available at the Belfast site for an IT in OT Specialist. You will plan and carry out activities to ensure the information systems inside production assets are well serviced, taking responsibility for IT deployment, machine software configuration, validation, scheduled maintenance and IT reactive maintenance - as well as the upgrade and disposal of IT business owned software, business owned information systems hardware, business owned IT network devices as well as business owned operating systems. The IT in OT Specialist will play a key role in ensuring the Cyber Security of the Belfast site industrial assets.
 The Belfast IT in OT Specialist will work a normal day shift flexible work pattern and will be required to perform on-call duty. This job is fully on-site and not eligible for regular hybrid working. 
 HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE TEAM 
 Ensure and carry out enterprise class service level, availability and integrity of information systems inside production machinery.
 Plan and carry out the activities necessary and within scope to ensure the information systems inside production machines are well serviced.
 The ability to communicate effectively to both IT professionals and end users.
 Take responsibility for deployment, machine software configuration, validation, scheduled maintenance, reactive maintenance, upgrade and disposal of business owned software, business owned information systems hardware (computer), business owned IT network devices, and business owned operating systems.
 Take accountability and responsibility for implementation, scheduled maintenance, reactive maintenance, upgrades and disposal of IT softwares, reporting to industrial Maintenance.
 Actions on information systems to reach main mission goal.
 Maintenance plan for IT relevant systems.
 Technical inventory and documentation of relevant systems.
 Change management and coordination of relevant systems.
 Incident resolution (when the profile is able to) and escalation/handling support if the topic requires upper supports levels.
 Demand management on new IT/OT implementations.
 ABOUT YOU: 
 It is the responsibility of the applicant to ensure that sufficient detail is provided to demonstrate how they meet essential job criteria, as this alone will be used for vetting purposes. 
 Essential 
 A BSc Degree in Cyber Security, Computer Science, or Engineering (Electrical/Electronic or Automation) OR A Foundation Degree (FdSc) or HND (Level 5) in Cyber Security, Cloud & Network Infrastructure, or Systems Engineering 
 Knowledge of Cyber Security practices ideally within an industrial context, being able to critically assess at 1st level the physical and digital security of assets 
 Experience in performing Installations of Security software & system patches, ideally in an industrial context
 Desirable 
 The ability to communicate effectively to both IT professionals and end users 
 Previous experience working within a Industrial environment supporting/maintaining Information Technology/Systems e.g. Numerical Control, SCADA, HMI
 Experience of performing & maintaining software and database backups is desirable. Including restoring those backups within the Industrial Assets
 An understanding of Networking infrastructure 
 Leadership or Participation in IT projects with a basic understanding of project management
 Closing date: 3rd of November, 2026. 
 Please note that meeting the mandatory criteria listed above guarantees consideration for the role, but does not ensure progression to the interview stage. In the event of a high volume of qualified applications, the selection panel reserves the right to shortlist and progress candidates who additionally meet one or more of the preferential (desirable) criteria. 
 We employ people from all sections of the community and are committed to the appointment of the best candidate based upon the merit principle alone. In pursuit of our equal opportunities programme, we would particularly welcome more applications from Catholics and females, as these groups are currently under-represented in our workforce.
 HOW WE CAN SUPPORT YOU 
 Many of our staff work flexibly in many different ways, including part-time. Please talk to us at interview about the flexibility you need and we’ll always do our best to accommodate your request.

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Airbus Defence and Space sucht einen
 IT Systems Engineer (d/m/w) 
 Du wirst im Bereich „Flight and Service Operations“ am Standort Ottobrunn arbeiten.
 Die Abteilung Flight and Service Operations ist an verschiedenen Projekten beteiligt, die von IT-Infrastrukturen und sicheren Kommunikationsnetzen bis hin zum Betrieb von Bodenstationen und der Wartung von Satelliten in der Umlaufbahn reichen. Das Team der Abteilung Flight and Services Operations setzt sich aus multidisziplinären und hochqualifizierten Experten zusammen, die die Kontinuität der Dienste sowie den sicheren Betrieb auf höchstem Niveau für unsere Kunden weltweit gewährleisten. Dieses einzigartige und abwechslungsreiche Arbeitsumfeld bietet ein vielseitiges Aufgabengebiet mit einer breiten Palette von Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
 Dein Standort 
 Unser Standort ist nur einen Katzensprung von München, der schönen Hauptstadt von Bayern, entfernt. Du magst Sport und andere Outdoor-Aktivitäten? Die Alpen und der Starnberger See sind in einer Stunde zu erreichen und bieten eine Vielzahl von Freizeitaktivitäten. 
 Deine Vorteile 
 Attraktive Vergütung und Sonderzahlungen 
 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub und zusätzliche freie Tage für besondere Anlässe 
 Hervorragende Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und tolle internationale, konzernweite Entwicklungsperspektiven 
 Sonderleistungen: arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersvorsorge, Mitarbeiteraktienoptionen, vergünstigtes Auto Leasing, Sonderkonditionen bei Versicherungen, Bezuschussung im öffentlichen Personennahverkehr, Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen 
 Vor-Ort-Einrichtungen: standortnaher Kindergarten, Arzt für Check-ups und andere gesundheitsbezogene Dienstleistungen, Kantine und Cafeteria, Fitness Studio 
 Vereinbarkeit von Familie & Beruf (Jobsharing, Teilzeitmodelle, flexible Arbeitszeiten, individuelle Auszeit) 
 Arbeiten in einem diversen Umfeld, mit mehr als 140 Nationalitäten, in dem jede Stimme gehört wird 
 Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten 
 Betrieb moderner IT-Systeme, Troubleshooting und Beseitigung von Störungen, Identity Management (inkl. manueller und automatischer Updates)
 Analyse und Behebung von Systemfehlern im Betrieb (L1 & L2 Support), Weiterentwicklung und Implementierung der IT-Infrastruktur, Monitoring der IT-Infrastruktur
 Design und Konzeptionierung von IT Systemen sowie für den Betrieb benötigte Tools (inkl. Planung, Umsetzung, Validierung)
 Installation, Konfiguration und selbstständige Inbetriebnahme von Infrastruktursystemen sowie deren (Prozess-)Dokumentation und Vorbereitung für den Betrieb
 Weiterentwicklung und ständige Optimierung, sowie Automatisierung des Gesamtsystems
 Überwachung und Automatisierung des Asset- und Infrastruktur-Management (Hardware, Software, Lizenzen und Wartungsverträge)
 Kommunikation mit Kunden und Unterauftragnehmern zu betrieblichen Service Aspekten, Reporting und dem Incident Management
 Gewünschte Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen 
 Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Fachinformatiker oder Studium im Bereich Informationssicherheit, Informatik oder vergleichbar
 Sehr gute Kenntnisse im Bereich IT System Engineering, z.B. im Bereich Virtualisierung (VMware, HyperV), Windows/Linux Infrastruktur, Netzwerktechnik (Cisco, Fortigate, MikroTik), Storage Systeme
 Erfahrung in der konzeptionellen Weiterentwicklung sowie der Betreuung komplexer IT-Systeme
 Sehr gute Kenntnisse in der Automatisierung (z.B. Powershell Scripting, Ansible, Terraform etc.)
 Verhandlungssicher in der deutschen und englischen Sprache

Job Description: 
 We are hiring a Cost Engineer for Airbus Aerostructures to join our GBS!

 Requirements - our ideal candidate will have 
 Diploma/Master’s degree in engineering, materials science, technical business administration, economics or a comparable qualification acquired in another way

 In-depth knowledge of production processes and manufacturing processes
 Experience in project management
 Ability to analyze and process technical information
 Strong analytical skills and structured way of working
 Confident communication skills and assertiveness
 Excellent strong presentation skills
 Business fluent in English, German desirable
 Experience in MS Office, Google Suite, SAP, Business Warehouse, PLM, Catia, FactonD

 Diverse career opportunities within Airbus European core countries or in other regions around the world.

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Ready to join one of our Graduate Programs in Spain? 
 We are looking for recent graduates from different disciplines interested in developing their professional career in the aeronautical sector. The current context demands different ways of looking, thinking and relating. 
 - Starting date February 1st 2027 until January 31st 2027. 
 - The selection process will take place from November 2026 to December 2026. 
 What does this internship consist of? 
 Together with Nebrija University, Airbus has developed an exclusive program designed for those interested in the best training in new areas of knowledge considered to be essential in order to grow into professionals of the future. 
 You will have the opportunity to study a training program, that will allow you to discover the skills most in demand today. It will be combined with an 11 month internship at Airbus in an area related to your degree, where you can learn and complete your academic background. 
 The start of the internship will be in early February 2027, and will last 11 months (August disabled for all purposes). It is a full-time experience (40h/week), in which you will receive an attractive study grant. 
 Challenges and Responsibilities: 
 Help with the optimization of existing web services at AHE (implementing improvements, new features, and bug fixes).
 Support the execution of test suites defined for each development. (o bien: Assist in executing test suites... ) 
 Assist data security and integrity management (o bien: Support the management of data security and integrity ) .
 Support the continuous implementation of improvements, updates, etc., across development processes. 
 Skills: 
 Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to know you: 
 - Degree in Computer Engineering
 - English negotiation level.
 - Demonstrated skills and a keen interest in software development
 - Advanced knowledge of .NET web development technologies: MVC / ASP.NET Core / Microservices. Experience with other technologies and frameworks (e.g., Syncfusion) is a plus
 - Proficiency in HTML / CSS / JavaScript / JSON
 - Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases, and Entity Framework
 - Web design skills will be considered a plus
 WHY SHOULD YOU APPLY? 
 📍 LIFE IN ALBACETE: QUALITY & CONVENIENCE - Forget long commutes. Albacete offers you the great advantage of a “15-minute city": safe, accessible, comfortable and perfectly connected. Enjoy a premium standard of living at a competitive cost, ensuring you have the perfect balance between your career and your personal life. 
 🚁 AIRBUS HELICOPTERS: GROW WITH US - We offer more than a job; we offer a community. Immerse yourself in a young, collaborative environment that feels like family. As a strategic Center of Excellence, we are a global leader in helicopter production, offering you endless potential to grow alongside our major projects. 
 Bring your ideas to a dynamic, modern ecosystem and help us build the next generation of aerospace solutions. 
 WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE? 
 - Foster your professional development with a strong academic background and an in-depth collaboration in AIRBUS projects. 
 - Expand your network within the aeronautical industry. 
 - Meet our people working with passion and determination to make the world a more connected, safer and smarter place. 
 - Be part of our diversity and teamwork culture that propel us to accomplish the extraordinary - on the ground, in the sky and in space. 
 ARE YOU INTERESTED? APPLY AND MAKE IT FLY! 🚁

items.desc:
Lieu : Aix-en-Provence, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée
 Un package de rémunération attractif
 Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes
 Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu
 Votre quotidien 
En nous rejoignant à Aix-en-Provence, vous intégrez un site dynamique regroupant nos activités de services numériques permettant d’opérer les systèmes d’informations critiques de nos clients et de les accompagner dans leur transformation numérique sécurisée. 
 Votre Quotidien 
 Basé sur notre site d’Aix-en-Provence et, en tant qu’ingénieur Cloud AWS, vous serez responsable de la conception, de l'implémentation et de l'optimisation de nos solutions cloud sur la plateforme AWS. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la définition de notre stratégie cloud et accompagnerez nos équipes dans leur adoption des meilleures pratiques.
 Votre Profil 
 Profil expérimenté avec une formation supérieure en informatique de niveau Bac+5, vous justifiez d'une expérience significative d'au moins 4 ans ingénierie Cloud, dont 2 années minimum dédiées à AWS. 
 Vous êtes certifié AWS de niveau Associate minimum avec les compétences suivantes : 
 Expertise approfondie de AWS et de ses mécanismes de sécurité
 Maîtrise des services AWS : EC2, Lambda, S3, IAM, VPC…
 Expérience significative en sécurité des systèmes d'information
 Expertise en architecture Zero Trust et en solutions de chiffrement
 Maîtrise des conteneurs sécurisés et de Kubernetes (EKS, Kyverno)
 Compétences en Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) et en automatisation sécurisée
 Maitrise des outils de CI/CD comme GitlabCI
 Excellentes capacités d'analyse et de gestion des risques
 Leadership et capacité à porter la transformation
 Force de proposition et d'innovation
 Une connaissance de Datadog est un plus
 Excellentes qualités relationnelles et capacité à travailler avec des équipes multiculturelles
 De plus, une bonne maîtrise de l'anglais est indispensable pour interagir efficacement avec nos équipes internationales et nos partenaires. 
 Une Certification CKA ou CKS serait un plus. 
 Le mot du manager 
 Au sein de la direction APC (Automation Platforms & Cloud), nous vivons une période passionnante de transformation technologique. Notre équipe cloud est composée d'experts talentueux et passionnés qui partagent une vision commune : construire les infrastructures de demain tout en garantissant le plus haut niveau de sécurité. Nous recherchons avant tout une personnalité qui saura apporter sa pierre à l'édifice, partager ses connaissances et grandir avec l'équipe. L'environnement technique est exigeant, mais nous accordons une grande importance à l'accompagnement et au développement de chacun. 
 Vous êtes passionné(e) par les défis techniques et souhaitez travailler dans un monde en mouvement sans jamais vous ennuyer ? Ce poste est pour vous ! 
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous ! 
Le poste pouvant nécessiter d'accéder à des informations relevant du secret de la défense nationale, la personne retenue fera l'objet d'une procédure d’habilitation, conformément aux dispositions des articles R.2311-1 et suivants du Code de la défense et de l’IGI 1300 SGDSN/PSE du 09 août 2021.

items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and share. The team is small, agent-first and sits apart from the main org, with very fast CI, so ideas often ship the same or next day. Today, one engineer runs the whole iOS app alone.

We’re looking for a Mobile Engineer to own ElevenMusic across iOS and Android, and to make mobile a driver of the product rather than a downstream port of web features. You’ll build for musicians and creatives, think in systems as well as screens, and work with high autonomy and a high bar for taste.

Requirements

 - Shipped a well-designed, production mobile app that real users love, and can show us what you owned.

 - Strong systems thinking across mobile and backend. We’re framework-agnostic (Swift UI or Kotlin Jetpack Compose), but expect you to work across iOS and Android.

 - Exceptional product taste and a clear view on what makes a mobile experience great.

 - Highly self-directed: you turn loose directions into shipped work and own the outcome.

Bonus: musical interest or intuition. Open-source or GitHub contributions.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Warsaw, and Amsterdam.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

With more than 60,000 employees worldwide, the company has a strong industrial presence in Italy, the United Kingdom, Poland and the United States, and operates in 150 countries through subsidiaries, joint ventures and strategic partnerships. A key player in major global strategic programmes, Leonardo is a trusted technological and industrial partner to governments, defence administrations, institutions and commercial customers.
 Within the Aircraft Systems Integration area, Flight Control Systems (FCS) department, we are looking for a Flight Control Systems - Systems Engineer/Aircraft Integration for our Cascina Costa site.
 The successful candidate will contribute to Systems Engineering and System Integration activities related to Flight Control Systems development, supporting the definition and integration of FCS solutions within the overall aircraft architecture .
 The role combines system architecture, requirements management and technical coordination, with a strong focus on cross-functional collaboration across engineering disciplines , ensuring alignment between system design, safety objectives and aircraft-level requirements.
 Main Activities 
 The successful candidate will:
 Act as engineering focal point for cross-functional activities involving Flight Control Systems, facilitating coordination between engineering teams and stakeholders. Definition of ConOps and Mission Engineering;
 Definition of Aircraft functions and requirements, including qualification and airworthiness requirements impacting the FCS development;
 Collaborate with Aircraft Safety, Avionics, Structures, …, and other engineering functions to ensure consistent management of interfaces, assumptions and architectural decisions.
 Support the identification, assessment and resolution of architectural trade-offs and system integration challenges.
 Support the decomposition and allocation of aircraft-level functions and requirements to systems and subsystems within the FCS domain.
 Support the definition, analysis and validation of aircraft and system requirements allocated to Flight Control Systems.
 Contribute to the development, maintenance and validation of Flight Control System architectures and functional designs.
 Contribute to the preparation and execution of technical reviews at system and aircraft level.
 Participate in integration, verification and validation activities on simulation environments, integration benches and aircraft platforms.
 Support certification and airworthiness activities by contributing to compliance demonstration and technical assessments.
 Contribute to the continuous improvement and digitalization of Systems Engineering processes, methods and tools, including Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) approaches.
 Requirements (qualifications, level of experience, technical skills, languages, IT skills, Soft skills, other) 
 Education 
 BSc or MSc Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Automation Engineering, Control Systems Engineering or equivalent disciplines.
 Experience 
 2 to 5 years of experience in Systems Engineering, System Integration or Aircraft Systems Engineering activities.
 Experience gained within Aerospace, Defence, Space, Railway, Automotive or other highly regulated industries.
 Technical Skills 
 Essential:
 Understanding of Systems Engineering principles and lifecycle processes.
 Ability to coordinate technical activities involving multiple stakeholders and engineering disciplines.
 Experience working with complex and safety-critical systems.
 Knowledge of requirements management, system architecture and interface management activities.
 Experience in preparing and maintaining systems engineering documentation.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 Desirable:
 Experience in aircraft systems development and integration.
 Knowledge of Flight Control Systems, Vehicle Management Systems or Avionics architectures.
 Experience in system integration, testing and troubleshooting activities.
 Familiarity with requirements management tools (e.g. IBM DOORS, Polarion or equivalent).
 Familiarity with MBSE methodologies and architecture modelling tools (e.g. Cameo MagicDraw, Rhapsody, Capella or equivalent).
 Knowledge of Systems Engineering standards and practices, including ARP4754A, ARP4761A and IEEE 15288.
 Familiarity with aerospace development standards such as DO-160, DO-178C and DO-254.
 Experience supporting certification and airworthiness activities.

 Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
 Effective communication skills.
 Proactive and self-driven approach.
 Ability to work within multidisciplinary teams.
