Job Description Summary 
In the 12-month Quality Placement, you'll gain invaluable skills and experience in covering all aspects of quality from product & process design & definition, supplier quality, issue resolution and elimination through structured problem solving. 
 Job Description 
 About GE Aerospace 
 Are you ready to see your future take flight? At GE Aerospace, we are advancing aviation technologies for today and tomorrow. Your work will contribute to the production of advanced jet engines, components, and integrated systems that power commercial and military aircraft . You’ll be part of a team that embraces your drive, your curiosity, and your unique ideas and perspectives . Most importantly, you’ll share in our pride and purpose that affects the lives of millions around the world! 
 Roles and Responsibilities 
 In the 12-month Quality Placement , you'll gain hands-on experience across various aspects of quality, including product and process design, issue resolution, and risk management. 
 Responsibilities will vary depending on the location and role, as each site has unique projects, production processes, and priorities . You could be involved in investigating quality issues, auditing products and suppliers, reviewing materials, analysing data or driving process improvements. 
 We have different types of roles in this area; here is a brief snapshot into each: 
 Supplier Quality (Chelte nham) - this role will identify improvement opportunities for the team, which will improve efficiency and productivity through already identified improvement projects and to help identify new opportunities for improvement. With support from the wider team, in this role you will have the opportunity to take on responsibility for the management of a small portfolio of suppliers from a supplier quality perspective to gain experience in supplier management in a business environment. 
 Product Quality Placement (Caledonian) - support the business in delivering defect-free aerospace engines to customers by participating in quality investigations, driving product safety risk reduction, and providing day-to-day quality support to operations. You help run proactive quality activities such as PFMEA, reduce quality escapes through improved defect detection and elimination, and contribute to the continuous improvement of the Quality Management System. You also work on improving quality communications and awareness across the facility, participate in staff and management quality forums, and perform trend analysis and action planning to address recurring issues and strengthen overall quality performance. 
 This opportunity is offered in our Caledonian (Prestwick, Scotland) and Cheltenham sites , during the process we will ask you to share your location and role preferences. 
 GE Aerospace Caledonian is a purpose-built aircraft engine overhaul facility, adjacent to Glasgow Prestwick International Airport. The Caledonian site was officially opened in 1980 and has since grown into a centre of excellence for Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul (MRO) of CF6 & GEnx engine types. After each overhaul, the engines undergo intensive performance testing on site in our bespoke test cell, before returning to our global customer base ready for service. 
 Our vastly experienced and innovative workforce are passionate in the contribution towards the training of future engineers, leaders and surrounding talent in our organisation. At GE Caledonian, our Apprentices (Foundation, Modern & Graduate), XLP, OMLP and interns are key members of our team helping achieve the challenges of tomorrow. They continuously develop new skills to keep up with the pace of change in the Aviation Industry and become comfortable working in this ever-challenging environment which thrives on embracing change. 
 Our diverse team have a strong foothold in the local community, proactively seeking new volunteering opportunities to give back and deliver on our corporate responsibility. We have a dedicated affinity group on site who facilitate opportunities to the wider team, creating an inclusive culture we can all be proud of. 
 With over 1,700 employees, GE Aerospace based in Cheltenham is one of the largest sites outside the USA and a major contributor to the local economy. 
 Our heritage dates back to 1940 yet our technology is cutting-edge . Located in the heart of Gloucestershire, the Power Distribution & Controls (PD&C) site focuses on the design, development and manufacture of state-of-the-art aircraft power distribution and avionics systems for the global aviation industry. Our customers include all major aerospace manufacturers - covering commercial, business jet and military applications. The scale and complexity of engineering projects offer our employees unique opportunities to work on major international projects, developing critical aircraft systems that will be relied on by many people for decades to come.

items.desc:
Overview 
 Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a Critical Environment Technician Shift (CET), you will play a vital role in safeguarding datacenter uptime through the 24/7 monitoring via EPMS/BAS and operation of our critical environment systems.
Working from the control room, you will take operational ownership of these systems, monitor their performance, and respond promptly to incoming alarms. When an incident occurs, you will assess its severity and potential impact, coordinate the appropriate response, and ensure it is followed through to resolution. This includes engaging the right expertise, whether that means involving internal Electrical Engineers (EEs) or Mechanical Engineers (MEs), or arranging on-site support from external vendors.
Clear and timely communication is essential. Throughout an incident, you will keep management informed of the operational impact, actions taken, and progress towards resolution. Maintaining uptime and ensuring a safe, effective response are at the heart of this role. 
Shift pattern: You will be part of a shift organisation comprising four teams of seven people, providing 24/7 coverage through rotating 12-hour day and night shifts: 07:00–19:00 and 19:00–07:00. 
 Responsibilities 
 Serve as an operations specialist in one major area of CE operations (e.g., electrical, mechanical, controls, generators) and works on advanced tasks independently.
 Inspect and supervise critical environment-related facility equipment (e.g., controls, heating, ventilation, and air conditioning [HVAC], mechanical systems), building, and grounds regularly for unsafe or abnormal conditions and escalate per applicable policies and standards. 
 Utilize internal computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) to track all equipment assets and to complete work order requests for maintenance work.
 Safely and quickly respond to and lead onsite incident response teams for all abnormal conditions that impact operations, and coordinates with other critical facilities professionals to perform corrective repairs, without supervision.
 Enhance, develop new or follow preexisting emergency operating procedures (EOPs), methods of procedure (MOPs), and standard operating procedures (SOPs) in relation to CE operations and incidents.
 Under minimal oversight, perform various types of maintenance (e.g., planned, predictive, corrective) and repairs following methods of procedure (MOPs), and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for one or more types of equipment (e.g., electrical, mechanical, cooling systems), correct procedures.

items.desc:
Where do people love what they do, and being great at what they do? 
 At Swisslog, that’s where! Our teams are the heart of a world-leading Robotics company that’s harnessing the power of technology to shape the future of intralogistics. The result? We’re transforming performance and efficiency for customers across the globe, giving them the vital edge in their markets.
 Esprimi il tuo potenziale 
 As a Solution Designer, you will be responsible for developing innovative intralogistics and warehouse automation solutions for medium to complex customer projects. You will work closely with customers, Sales, Engineering, Controls, and Software teams to understand operational requirements, evaluate technical feasibility, and design solutions that deliver business value. You will also play a key role in customer discussions, workshops, and pre-sales activities, providing technical guidance throughout the solution development process
 The role combines technical expertise, customer engagement, and commercial awareness throughout the sales and solution development process.
 Analyze customer operations, business processes, and material flows to develop optimized automation and intralogistics solutions.
 Design technical concepts, material flow diagrams, system layouts, and subsystem configurations for medium to complex projects.
 Conduct technical feasibility assessments and support Go/No-Go decision-making processes.
 Create solution layouts using AutoCAD and/or Revit and prepare supporting design documentation.
 Develop budgetary cost estimates, ROI calculations, and business case evaluations.
 Collaborate with Sales Project Managers to prepare proposals, contracts, and customer presentations.
 Act as the technical lead during customer meetings, workshops, and pre-sales activities.
 Work closely with software, controls, system engineering, and purchasing teams to develop integrated solutions.
 Support concept reviews, design reviews, and the preparation of technical specifications and RFQs.
 Requisiti per il successo 
 Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Logistics, Automation, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
 Minimum 3-5 years of experience in solution design, material handling, warehouse automation, or intralogistics.
 Strong understanding of material handling systems, automation technologies, and solution design methodologies.
 Experience creating technical concepts, layouts, and 2D/3D drawings using AutoCAD and/or Revit.
 Strong analytical, problem-solving, and customer-facing skills.
 Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and perform effectively under deadlines.
 Proficiency with Microsoft Office and ERP/CRM systems.
 Fluency in English; additional language skills such as German, French, or Italian are an advantage.
 Experience with data analysis tools such as Power BI or SQL is considered a plus.
 Our promise to you 
 Swisslog is a world of opportunity for people who can deliver a game changing mission: driving the future of intralogistics, by shaping an era of robotic and data-driven automated solutions that create exceptional customer value.
 Join us on this journey and you’ll be part of a global enterprise that’s proud of its Swiss roots - and hugely excited by the worldwide opportunities open to everyone in the Swisslog family. So come and realize your potential, in a team that’s united by passion and driven by the OneSwisslog team spirit.
 Join the journey! 
 We´re looking forward to receiving your application!
 Talent Acquisition Manager: Denise McGarrigle

items.desc:
¿Quiénes somos? 
 Telefónica Servicios Audiovisuales (TSA) es la compañía del Grupo Telefónica creadora de soluciones audiovisuales broadcast desde 1993. 
 Con sede central en España y oficina en Latinoamérica, TSA destaca por su carácter internacional ofreciendo servicios y soluciones broadcast y multimedia en cualquier parte del mundo. Ofrecemos soluciones de consultoría, diseño e integración de proyectos audiovisuales broadcast end-to-end, soluciones integrales para la producción de televisión, proyectos de innovación como los basados en IA y servicios de plataformas de video DTH, IPTV, OTT, emisión de canales, etc. Nuestros proyectos y servicios se complementan además con formación, coaching y soporte con diferentes niveles de servicio. 
 También gestionamos el mayor telepuerto totalmente privado de España, mediante el cual se distribuyen más de 700 canales de televisión y radio, además de ofrecer accesos a Internet, Starlink, LAN, Voz IP y datos. 
 Nuestra experiencia se ha forjado a lo largo de los años a través del diseño, ejecución y soporte de numerosos proyectos y servicios, tanto propios como de nuestros clientes. 
 Creemos en la orientación al cliente, la innovación y la flexibilidad, y nuestro compromiso es promover soluciones tecnológicas para nuestros clientes, que se ajusten a las necesidades cambiantes de un mundo audiovisual en constante evolución. 
 Área de la Vacante 
 Desde el área de Ingeniería y Soporte Externo de Telefónica Servicios Audiovisuales se integran los proyectos y sistemas que habilitan todo tipo de servicios de producción broadcast para entornos Broadcast de Televisión y Radio, Productoras, y también en clientes diversos como instituciones, o del entorno del entretenimiento, que llevan asociados elementos de producción, sistemas de gestión de media almacenamiento, controles de TV, platós, emisión, archivo entre otros. 
 Nuestras soluciones de ingeniería se apoyan en productos y soluciones de proveedores de alto nivel y reconocimiento mundial, buscando siempre lo que mejor se adapta a la necesidad de nuestros clientes. 
 ¿Qué necesitamos de ti? 
 Formación: 
 Se valorará titulación o formación de Ingeniería de Telecomunicación o Informática o Técnico Superior en Administración de Sistemas Informáticos en Red o experiencia equivalente. 
 Idiomas: 
 Valorable inglés nivel alto, escrito y hablado. 
 Experiencia:

 Experiencia demostrable superior a 1 año en los conocimientos técnicos descritos en esta convocatoria, especialmente en el sector Broadcast. 
 Familiarización con la interpretación de esquemas de infraestructuras de red y esquemas funcionales de soluciones audiovisuales e informáticas, manuales de usuario, y guías de configuración y utilización de equipamiento audiovisual. 
 Habilidad para aportar soluciones. 
 Familiarización con metodologías de gestión de soporte, con herramientas de seguimiento de incidencias u otras plataformas para ticketing y gestión. 
 Experiencia en trato con proveedores para apertura de incidencias y seguimiento. 
 Capacidad de análisis para la anticipación de problemas y autonomía y decisión para la valoración de alternativas y soluciones. 
 Orientación al cliente en cuanto a la atención y recogida de sus especificaciones e incidencias, priorización de sus necesidades y presentación de los avances y resultados asociados a la implementación de proyectos y mantenimiento. 
 Conocimientos Técnicos: 
 Valorables conocimientos: 
 Conocimiento y experiencia en administración de sistemas Windows/Windows Server y Linux, incluyendo diagnóstico de incidencias, análisis de logs, gestión de servicios, usuarios, permisos y conectividad. 
 Conocimientos de redes IP y protocolos de comunicaciones, incluyendo TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, SSH, NTP, FTP/SFTP y otros protocolos habituales en entornos cliente/servidor. 
 Conocimientos de redes Ethernet y switching: direccionamiento IP y subredes, VLAN, routing básico, multicast, IGMP y diagnóstico de conectividad. Se valorará experiencia con electrónica de red Cisco, Dell u otros fabricantes. 
 Se valorará conocimiento en las tecnologías de AV sobre infraestructura IP/SMPTE 2110, SMPTE 2022 , AES67… 
 Conocimiento de las tecnologías específicas de los sistemas de almacenamiento, NAS, SAN, librerías de cintas… 
 Conocimiento o experiencia en software de entornos virtualizados, Vmware, Hyper-V, entre otros. 
 Se valorará el conocimiento del diseño, configuración y administración de Sistemas de Producción y Realización de TV basados en plataformas IT, producción, realización, ingestión, edición, playout, MAM. 
 Se valorará conocimiento de otras tecnologías de transporte audiovisual sobre IP como Dante, NDI o Ravenna 
 Se valorará el conocimiento y experiencia de equipamiento audiovisual, cámaras, mezcladores… 
 Ventajas de formar parte de nuestro equipo: 
 Contrato indefinido. 
 Cuidamos la flexibilidad , posicionándonos como referente en nuevas formas de trabajo , horarios, jornadas y medidas de …

 Definición y evolución tecnológica: Definir los requisitos técnicos y funcionales de los equipos y sistemas de radioenlaces, asegurando su alineamiento con las necesidades de la red, la operación y la evolución tecnológica del negocio.

 Innovación y prospección tecnológica: Analizar la evolución de las tecnologías de radioenlaces e identificar oportunidades de innovación que aporten mejoras en capacidad, automatización, eficiencia operativa y calidad de servicio. 
 Pilotos y evaluación de soluciones: Coordinar pilotos, pruebas de campo y procesos de evaluación técnica de nuevas soluciones y suministradores, contribuyendo a la selección de tecnologías y a la toma de decisiones para la evolución de la red.

 Arquitecturas de automatización y gestión de red. 
 Metodologías de validación y certificación tecnológica.

 Procesos de soporte y operación de red. 
 Protocolos de red y switching. 
 Procesos de evaluación tecnológica y selección de suministradores. 
 Inglés profesional, hablado y escrito.

 Más de cinco años de experiencia en tecnologías de radioenlaces.

items.desc:
Fort de son savoir-faire unique, BBGR conçoit et fabrique des verres correcteurs depuis 170 ans. 
 Eprouvée et testée, la qualité des verres BBGR garantit une précision de vision et un confort visuel optimales. 
 Grâce à son savoir-faire humain - 900 collaborateurs en France - et technique accumulé depuis la création du site en 1846, BBGR Provins est aujourd’hui le plus grand centre de développement et de production de verres en France. 
 La gamme de produits BBGR offre un large choix de verres, de très haute technologie, pour tous les besoins visuels et toutes les montures. D’innovation en invention, BBGR compte plus de 34 millions de regards satisfaits. 
 Votre poste 
 Rattaché(e) au Responsable Industriel, le/la Responsable Maintenance a pour principales missions de piloter le service maintenance en vue d’assurer la disponibilité des équipements, fiabiliser l’outil de production, développer les compétences de son équipe de Techniciens et contribuer aux performances industrielles du Laboratoire Rx (qualité, service, coûts, …) aux côtés des managers de production.
 Missions principales 
 Piloter les plannings d’intervention de maintenance (préventives, curatives et amélioratives) en concertation avec les Responsables d’Atelier et les différents acteurs concernés. Veiller à la bonne application et au bon déploiement des plans de maintenance.
 Garantir la remise en état de marche des équipements défaillants en toute sécurité et dans les meilleurs délais afin de contribuer à atteindre les objectifs du Laboratoire Rx.
 Manager une équipe de Techniciens Maintenance-Process (développement, formation, évaluation, …) en veillant à une bonne qualité de vie au travail (ambiance, climat, communication, partages, …) tout en s’assurant de la bonne application des règles de l’entreprise.
 Assurer la bonne coordination des divers intervenants techniques externes/internes (prestataires, fournisseurs, services support du Groupe, …).
 Mettre en place et suivre les différents indicateurs de performance liés à la maintenance industrielle (ex : taux de disponibilité machine, gestion des pièces détachées, etc…).
 Participer aux projets d’installation et/ou d’adaptation des équipements ainsi qu’aux travaux associés.
 Contribuer à la construction et au respect du budget maintenance.
 Animer une démarche d’amélioration continue du service maintenance (proposer des actions d’amélioration/optimisation, partager les bonnes pratiques au sein du Groupe, assurer une veille technologique, …)
 Contribuer à développer la capacité des équipes opérationnelles à se développer sur de la maintenance 1er niveau.
 Appliquer et faire appliquer les standards règlementaires du Groupe, notamment sur les registres QHSE (contrôle des biens et des personnes lors des maintenances, veiller au suivi des habilitations techniques diverses, notamment électriques, intégrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les ambitions RSE, …).
 Votre profil 
 Vous êtes issu(e) d'une formation BAC+2/3 minimum à BAC +5 (ou expérience significative équivalente) en maintenance industrielle / electrotechnique / automatisme / informatique industrielle, …), idéalement enrichie d’une première expérience managériale dans un environnement opérationnel.
 Rigueur, autonomie, capacité d’analyse, esprit de synthèse, sens du relationnel (travail en équipe), sens client et disponibilité sont des marqueurs indispensables à la bonne tenue de cet emploi.
 Par ailleurs, sont également nécessaires le goût du terrain dans un environnement très opérationnel, la maîtrise de l’anglais ainsi que des outils informatiques.

Ponúkame flexibilný spôsob práce – kde to povaha pozície umožňuje, zamestnanci si sami volia, kedy pracujú z domu a kedy z kancelárie. Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu. U nás robíme maximum pre to, aby sme vytvárali zdravé, moderné a spokojné pracovné prostredie. Ak chcete byť našou súčasťou, určite sa nám ozvite. 
 Platové podmienky 
 1 500 EUR/mesiac
 Štartovacia základná mzda je 1 300 EUR + mesačné provízie a kvartálne odmeny. Priemerná mesačná provízia po úspešnom adapte sa pohybuje vo výške 200 EUR a závisí od Tvojej šikovnosti, či to bude viac. Kvartálne odmeny sa priemerne pohybujú vo výške 700 EUR v závislosti od plnenia individuálnych aj pobočkových cieľov. Za prácu v obchodnom centre Ťa navyše odmeníme mesačným príspevkom vo výške 150 EUR. Po 6 mesiacoch Ťa čaká jednorázový adaptačný bonus vo výške 50% Tvojej nástupnej základnej mzdy.
 Účel a náplň práce 
 Čo od vás očakávame 
 Ak Ťa zaujíma svet bankovníctva, si komunikatívny/komunikatívna a máš prax v práci s hotovosťou, si skvelý typ na bankára/bankárku vo VÚB!
 Čakajú Ťa u nás možnosti kariérneho rastu aj zaujímavé finančné ohodnotenie.
 Okrem iného, máme pre Teba pripravených množstvo benefitov a ak o nich chceš vedieť viac, scrolluj ďalej.
 Vítame u nás skúsených bankárov, ale ak ešte bankovú prax nemáš, nevadí. U nás vo VÚB Ťa na to pripravíme celkom od začiatku.
 ČO TI DÁME NA ÚVOD?
Vďaka silnej podpore manažérov pobočky, nápomocným kolegom a priateľskému prístupu našich lektorov sa:
 postupne začneš orientovať vo VUB bankových produktoch a službách,
 naučíš pracovať s klientom a zlepšíš svoju komunikáciu a schopnosť argumentovať, čo sa Ti zíde aj v osobnom živote.
 PREČO SA TI PRÁCA VO VÚBKE BUDE PÁČIŤ?
 Budeš pracovať v jednej z najväčších a najvýznamnejších bánk na Slovensku.
 Na pobočke ste jeden tím – obchodné plány plníte spoločne a vzájomne sa podporujete.
 Rozširuješ si odbornosť a získavaš skúsenosti, ktoré využiješ v Tvojej kariére.
 Pri práci s klientom sa zlepšuješ v mnohých oblastiach, ktoré oceníš aj v osobnom živote.
 TVOJOU ÚLOHOU AKO PORADCU KLIENTA BUDE:
 podieľať sa na podpore predaja a spolupracovať s tímom,
 hľadať príležitosti pre predaj všetkých bankových produktov a služieb,
 poskytovať informácie a odborné poradenstvo klientom,
 vykonávať pokladničné a zmenárenské operácie,
 vykonávať servisné klientske operácie, zodpovedne pracovať s hotovosťou,
 podieľať sa na administratívnych činnostiach,

 SOLICITUD BECA 2026 En Endesa tenemos un firme compromiso con la formación y captación del talento. Por eso ofrecemos un Plan de Becas a recién titulados/as universitarios que quieran formar parte de un modelo de aprendizaje colaborativo orientado a adquirir competencias profesionales.

 ¿Qué hace la Unidad ?
 Departamento de gestión administrativa de la CENTRAL TÉRMICA DE MAHÓN y colaboraría en las tareas administrativas, entre otras, procesos de RRHH,Comunicación, Aprovisionamientos, Patrimonio, Servicios Generales, etc...
 ¿En qué colaborarás? 
 Participación en la gestión de nominas y dietas, de compras, proveedores y facturación, de Endesa Acredita, de almacenes, de control económico, de gestióndocumental y archivo y de control de accesos, etc..
 Lo que aprenderás 
 Conocerás el funcionamiento integral de un departamento de gestión administrativa, adquiriendo experiencia práctica en procesos de compras y aprovisionamientos, gestión económica, facturación, documentación, almacenes y servicios generales. Además, desarrollarás competencias organizativas y una visión transversal de la actividad de la Central Térmica de Mahón y de sus procesos de soporte al negocio.
 ¿Qué formación y conocimientos van a ser considerados? 
 La beca está orientada a perfiles de Administración o Dirección de Empresas o similares.

 Paquete Office. 
 Excel avanzado.
 Power Point y Outlook
 Inglés: C1

 Prácticas en ENDESA, Programa SWING:

 ● Centro de trabajo en España: Av. Ribera del Loira 60, Madrid
 Las becas de Endesa tienen una duración de 9 meses. Constan de dos partes, una Formación Práctica en la Empresa y una Formación Académica.

items.title: Package Design Engineer
items.card: Responsibilities Responsible for all aspects of package design from concept through best in class solution with optimal cost, manufacturability, performance and reliability. Utilize various industry standard die / package co-design and layout tools for design. Participate in die/package/PCB codesign activities, supporting critical signal paths, package architecture, floorplanning, bump maps, stackups, and routing
items.desc:
The Package Innovation (PI) department is an organization within NXP's Corporate Technology Office that develops advanced semiconductor packaging solutions and next-generation packaging technologies across all NXP product lines. The Package Design team is a centralized global function responsible for package development and package design execution across NXP. This position primarily supports the Networking & Radar (NR) and Automotive Processing & Systems business lines developing advanced driver assistance, radar, Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X), wireless high-frequency connectivity, and infotainment solutions for a full spectrum of radio and amplifiers.
 Position Summary 
 Responsible for all aspects of advanced semiconductor package design for mixed signal, RF, microwave, and mmWave products, including package architecture development, die-package codesign, package layout, design rule compliance, manufacturability and reliability optimization, and technical documentation.
 The successful candidate will work closely with BL partners, SoC designers, package engineers, project managers, simulation specialists, assembly sites including OSATs and substrate suppliers to develop package solutions that meet electrical, thermal, mechanical, reliability, manufacturability, and cost objectives.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Responsible for all aspects of package design from concept through best in class solution with optimal cost, manufacturability, performance and reliability.
 Utilize various industry standard die / package co-design and layout tools for design.
 Participate in die/package/PCB codesign activities, supporting critical signal paths, package architecture, floorplanning, bump maps, stackups, and routing implementation.
 Design and optimize package structures for RF and mmWave applications, including controlled-impedance routing, grounding, shielding, and signal-launch structures.
 Collaborate with simulation engineers to evaluate electrical performance, SI/PI, EM behavior, and implement design improvements.
 Support package design reviews, manufacturability assessments, design-rule compliance, and release documentation.
 Partner with assembly sites, OSATs, substrate suppliers, and cross-functional teams to deliver robust, manufacturable package solutions.
 Provide technical guidance on package architecture, substrate technologies, assembly processes, and RF package implementation.
 Qualifications 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Materials Engineering, or equivalent.
 Technical experience in the following areas:
 Five plus years direct experience designing flip chip and wire-bond substrate-based and WLCSP/FOWLP semiconductor packages.
 Expert proficiency with Cadence Allegro Package Designer (APD) and AutoCAD required.
 Experience with die-package-PCB codesign methodologies desired.
 Knowledge of Power Integrity and Signal Integrity (PISI) and high-speed signal routing, differential pair implementation, return-path management, and impedance-controlled interconnect design a plus.
 Strong understanding of substrate technologies including design rules as well as Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing.
 Experience with or extensive exposure to primarily analog SoC design prefrred.
 Personal Attributes 
 Effective written, verbal and presentation communication skills.
 Strong technical leadership and problem-solving skills.
 Demonstrated ownership and accountability for technical deliverables.
 Self-motivated and capable of driving technical execution with minimal supervision.
 Strong collaboration and teamwork skills in a global engineering environment.

items.desc:
Your mission at Voi 
 For the position as a Fleet Specialist , you’ll have the opportunity to work across two different areas depending on workload and suitability.
 You’ll be part of our Mechanical team , where you’ll focus on the maintenance and repair of our vehicles making sure our scooters and e-bikes are safe, reliable, and ready for customers. You may also support our In-Field team , using our vans to complete operational tasks across the Northampton area, helping ensure our operations run as efficiently as possible.
 Here are some exciting tasks awaiting you as a Fleet Specialist:
 Diagnosing and repairing broken vehicles 🔧
 Performing quality checks and identifying damaged vehicles 🔍
 Battery replacement 🔋
 Performing quick on-site repairs when needed 🛴
 Recycling and dismantling vehicles that cannot be repaired ♻️
 Assisting with the acceptance, packaging, and provision of new vehicles and batteries arriving at the warehouse 📦
 Supporting in-field operations as needed, including collecting damaged vehicles, clearing parking spaces, and setting up fallen vehicles 🤝
 Ensuring smooth logistics for collecting and returning vehicles ⚙️
 What you'll need to embark 
 Full UK Driving License with a maximum of 6 points for minor offenses and no major offences and meet the requirements for our e-Van insurance. The reason for this is you may be required to drive one of our e-Van's occasionally
 In-depth knowledge of your city and you’re used to driving in your city
 Responsible team player that can manage tasks alone and also work well together in a group
 Ability to motivate others and to share knowledge within the team
 Pragmatic problem-solving mentality that executes tasks, finds solutions and works hard to reach the team targets and OKR’s
 Ready to navigate your city in a van under any weather and traffic conditions
 Has the ability to react calmly to stressful situations (poor parking, traffic…)
 You have a physical condition that allows you to carry heavy loads
 PLEASE NOTE: You may be required to go through a DBS Check for this role.
 Job conditions 
 NOTE: our Talent Acquisition is based in Spain; you will receive a phone call from a Spanish number (+ 34 )!
 Working shifts: 5 out of 7 (Fixed shift pattern)
 Working hours: Early Shift (8:30-4:30 pm). Flexibility to work some weekends.
 Contract type: 3-month fixed-term contract/ Temp contract 
 Why Voi? 
 Working at Voi is more than just a job; it's a personal Voiage where you'll grow as a professional and be part of a diverse team and culture that's committed to making a positive impact on society. In addition to this, you'll have the opportunity to : 
 Join Europe's leading micromobility company and one of the fastest-growing scale-ups
 Make a direct impact on our ongoing success and contribute to the development of the micromobility industry in Northampton 
 Collaborate with inspiring, motivated, and diverse colleagues who share a common goal
 Be a part of the micromobility revolution and help create sustainable cities that are clean, quiet, and free from pollution
 At Voi, we are committed to responsible and ethical recruitment practices, ensuring that all recruitment processes are fair, transparent, and free from exploitation. We operate under the principle that we cover the associated recruitment costs, meaning that no recruitment fees or related costs are charged to workers at any stage of the hiring process. All such costs are borne by Voi, and we require the same standards to be upheld across the agencies we partner with. We work only with recruitment partners who share our commitment to ethical practices and regularly review our processes to ensure compliance, protect workers’ rights, and promote a safe and respectful hiring experience for all our candidates.
 Are you ready to embark on the Voiage with us?

items.desc: Where HR meets the future of work — and you help build it. xFarm Technologies is an independent tech company, created by farmers for farmers. Our mission is to digitalize the agri-food sector through a comprehensive platform accessible from computers, tablets, and smartphones. The xFarm platform is built around five pillars: Farm Management, Agronomy, Precision Farming, Connectivity, and Sustainability. Today, we support the work of 600,000+ farms across 24 million hectares in more than 100 countries. We are looking for a People AI & Operations Specialist to join our People & Organization team in Milan. This role covers two of the most exciting and high-impact domains of our Full-stack People model: People Operations and AI & People Innovation. You will operate at an international level, supporting our EMEA and LATAM geographies, and work in close collaboration with a small, highly skilled, and genuinely international team. This is a temporary contract to cover a maternity leave, with a possibility of a full-time permanent hiring. What you will do You will own two complementary Specialist Champion domains within the People team, combining the rigor of People Operations with the forward-looking energy of AI & People Innovation. People Operations Manage payroll and HR administration, in collaboration with payroll and labour consultants across different European countries (main focus — Italy) Manage and continuously improve the HRIS (HR Information System), ensuring data quality, accuracy, and compliance across all geographies Own employee lifecycle processes end-to-end: onboarding, contract management, changes, and offboarding workflows across EMEA and LATAM Draft, update, and communicate People policies adapted to different countries and legal frameworks Manage employee requests related to contracts, payroll, and HR administration, ensuring a timely and high-quality response Maintain and improve the People policies handbook, keeping it current and accessible for all employees and managers Ensure process compliance across all countries in scope, partnering with legal and finance where needed Deliver people data reporting and operational KPIs to the leadership team AI & People Innovation Evaluate, test, and drive the adoption of AI tools within the People function — from AI-assisted workflows to automation of repetitive tasks Identify friction points in existing People processes and redesign them before applying automation — understanding the work before changing it Build and maintain automations that reduce manual effort and improve the employee experience (e.g., onboarding communications, contract generation, HR reminders) Own and evolve the People tech stack roadmap in collaboration with IT and the People team Partner with the Talent Acquisition team to design, evaluate, select, and implement tools and platforms for recruitment and hiring — from ATS configuration to AI-powered sourcing and screening solutions Monitor the market for emerging People technology solutions and bring informed recommendations to the team Support the broader organization's AI transformation agenda from the People function perspective, acting as an internal champion for innovation Contribute to the future of work agenda, helping xFarm stay ahead of the curve on how AI is reshaping HR roles and practices Who you are You have solid experience in HR Operations — and you are genuinely excited about the intersection of people processes and technology. You do not just manage workflows: you ask why they exist, how they could be simpler, and what a better version would look like. What really matters to us: 2–5+ years of experience in People Operations, HR Systems, or a combined HR generalist/specialist role with a strong operational component Solid experience and knowledge of payroll and HR administration in Italy Hands-on experience with HRIS platforms (e.g., Factorial, Personio, BambooHR, HiBob, or similar) — you are comfortable being the internal expert and administrator A genuine passion for AI tools and process automation — you experiment, you learn fast, and you are not afraid to build something new Ability to manage multiple processes and priorities in parallel, with precision and attention to detail Strong communication skills — you can explain a complex compliance topic to a manager in plain language and a process change to an entire team without friction Fluency in Italian — required for managing local operations and employee relations in Italy Fluency in English — our working language is English, and you will operate daily in an international context It would be a bonus if you: Have experience supporting multi-country or international HR operations (EMEA scope particularly valued) Have experience with low-code/no-code automation tools (e.g., Make.com, Zappier, Notion AI, or similar) Have worked in a tech company, scale-up, or fast-growth international environment Have familiarity with people analytics tools or data dashboards …

The site develops and manufactures PVB interlayers used in laminated-glass applications for the automotive and architectural industries. The Application Development team combines materials science, processing expertise, and application knowledge to develop next-generation products and customer-focused solutions. Application Development Scientist We are seeking an Application Development Scientist – Formulation, Extrusion & Performance to join the AMI Application Development team in Ghent South. The scientist will help develop the next generation of PVB interlayer technologies, supporting both near-term business opportunities and longer-term innovation platforms for automotive and architectural glazing applications. This role sits at the intersection of materials, processing, and applications. The successful candidate will act as the technical translator between customer requirements, sheet performance, extrusion processing, formulation design, and raw-material characteristics. The ideal candidate combines a strong foundation in polymer science with practical experience in formulation and extrusion technology and is equally comfortable discussing rheology with process engineers, material properties with suppliers, and application requirements with customers. A key focus is to develop a fundamental, mechanistic understanding of how resin characteristics, additives, and formulation changes influence rheological and visco-elastic behavior during extrusion. This understanding will be used to explain and optimize critical sheet properties such as thickness and gauge uniformity, dimensional stability, shrink behavior, optical quality, and lamination performance, and to connect these properties to acoustic, impact, and other customer-relevant performance requirements. The role also works in the opposite direction: engaging with customers to identify unmet needs and translating customer and market requirements into application CTQs, sheet specifications, process conditions, formulation targets, and raw-material requirements. Key Responsibilities Develop and document fundamental mechanistic understanding of the relationships between material properties, formulation composition, rheology, extrusion behavior, sheet properties, lamination processes, and final application performance. Evaluate the impact of raw-material and formulation changes on rheology, visco-elastic behavior, processability, sheet quality, and customer performance. Translate customer and market requirements into measurable application CTQs and material, formulation, process, and product specifications. Engage directly with customers and partner with Marketing and Sales to understand application and market requirements, identify unmet needs, and translate them into new-product definitions and technology-development programs. Design, execute, and interpret laboratory studies, pilot trials, and manufacturing-scale development programs. Drive technology development from concept generation through laboratory validation, pilot testing, manufacturing implementation, and commercial deployment. Identify and develop intellectual property arising from technology programs, document inventions, and collaborate with internal experts to assess and pursue appropriate patent protection. Collaborate with manufacturing, process engineering, research, commercial teams, suppliers, and customers to develop robust, differentiated technical solutions. Communicate technical findings, recommendations, and project progress through clear written documentation and presentations. What we are looking for Technical competencies Strong foundation in polymer science, materials science, chemical engineering, chemistry, or a related discipline. Strong understanding of polymer rheology, visco-elastic behavior, and structure-process-property-performance relationships. Knowledge of formulation development, additive interactions, polymer extrusion, and process optimization. Ability to connect material behavior during processing with sheet properties, customer processing, and final application performance. Experience with experimental design, statistical analysis, data interpretation, scale-up, …

items.desc: Wat ga je doen? Bij iDocta trekken we volop de kaart van AI. Niet omdat het hip is, maar omdat we geloven dat AI bedrijven fundamenteel slimmer kan laten werken. Van onze eigen organisatie tot de print- en IT-wereld en de dagelijkse werking van onze klanten. Minder manueel werk, slimmere processen en technologie die écht het verschil maakt. We hebben de ambitie, de ideeën én een stevige lijst aan concrete businesscases. Wat we nog missen? Iemand die er werk van maakt! Jouw eerste testcase? iDocta zelf. Je krijgt de vrijheid om AI te integreren in onze dagelijkse werking. En daarna? Dan trek je met jouw expertise naar onze klanten, vanuit Entrypoint, onze eigen IT-firma. Een gloednieuwe functie waarin we rotsvast geloven. We willen gas geven, maar vooral ook iets bouwen dat écht werkt. Copilot is jouw speeltuin. Je tilt ons gebruik van Microsoft Copilot naar een hoger niveau. Laat onze systemen praten. Je verbindt AI met ons ERP, CRM en andere bedrijfsapplicaties. Van idee naar automatisering. Je zet concrete businesscases om in slimme workflows en AI-agents. Zie kansen waar anderen ze missen. Je analyseert bedrijfsprocessen en ontdekt waar AI écht het verschil kan maken. Eerst iDocta, daarna onze klanten. Vanuit Entrypoint adviseer je klanten, bouw je AI-oplossingen en geef je opleidingen om hen helemaal mee te krijgen in het AI-verhaal. Wie ben jij? Een doener met AI-feeling. Je heeft een sterke affiniteit met technologie en AI. Een IT-diploma is mooi meegenomen, maar wat je écht kunt, vinden we belangrijker. Technisch helemaal mee. Copilot Studio, Power Automate, API's en integraties? Daar weet jij raad mee. Een slimme procesdenker. Je begrijpt hoe bedrijven werken en ziet waar technologie het verschil maakt. Zelfstandig en ondernemend. Je neemt initiatief, stelt prioriteiten en houdt ook veiligheid en kwaliteit in het oog. Technisch sterk én communicatief. Je legt complexe zaken helder uit, geeft graag opleidingen en voelt je thuis in een adviserende rol bij klanten. Wat krijg je van ons? Je loon. Een marktconform brutoloon, maaltijdcheques van € 6 per gewerkte dag, een DKV-hospitalisatieverzekering én leuke kortingen via Benefits at Work. Je mobiliteit. Een salariswagen die je brengt waar je moet zijn. Liever op twee wielen? Ook fietslease behoort tot de mogelijkheden! Je vrije tijd. 26 verlofdagen om de batterijen weer helemaal op te laden. Je groei. Een gloednieuwe functie, bakken verantwoordelijkheid en een omgeving die vooruit wil. Geen eindeloos overleg, maar ideeën omzetten in actie. Yihaaa! Je collega's. Hard werken? Absoluut. Maar ook tijd voor plezier, met een wekelijkse teamlunch, afterworks en collega's die graag samen de bloemetjes buitenzetten. Freelance of vast? Jij mag mee kiezen! Van een freelanceopdracht van één dag per week tot een voltijdse job in loondienst: we staan voor beide open! We willen snel schakelen, maar op lange termijn halen we deze expertise het liefst vast in huis.

items.desc: Category: Research Location: Måløv, Capital Region of Denmark, DK Department: Research Bioanalysis Location: Måløv Your impact begins here As Laboratory Technician in Research Bioanalysis, you will help early-stage research projects get the answers they need. You will develop and run immunoassays that measure proteins and peptides in biological samples, giving project teams data to predict how long new compounds stay in circulation and how they work in the body. Your work supports early research in diabetes, obesity and cardiovascular diseases. What you’ll bring A relevant education in laboratory technology or equivalent. Proficiency in general biological research laboratory techniques and workflows. Practical experience analysing biological samples. A keen interest in data analysis and a drive to keep data quality high. A flair for IT and laboratory instruments, with the willingness to learn and adapt. A proactive attitude towards building your analytical technical skills, with an open mindset. An energetic, self-driven and organised way of working, and a team-player mindset. Hands-on experience with immunoassays such as ELISA, MSD or AlphaLISA. What you’ll do New projects often call for new ways of measuring different proteins and peptides. You will spend a significant part of your time developing tailored methods, alongside analysing samples with established ones. Develop and implement new immunoassays for the proteins and peptides your collaborators need to measure. Analyse samples from in vivo and in vitro studies using immunoassays Plan and carry out sample analyses, using robotics and IT systems to handle samples efficiently and track data. Analyse data and safeguard data integrity, so project teams can rely on the results. Proactively improve laboratory workflows and integrate new digital tools and AI Help strengthen the culture of the department. Who you’ll work with You will join Research Bioanalysis, part of Therapeutic Discovery within Research & Development, in Måløv, Denmark. In Research & Development, colleagues explore scientific ideas and advance them towards clinical testing. Curiosity, data, technology and collaboration come together to help meet future health needs. Your team is high-achieving, multidisciplinary and international: seven laboratory technicians, one tech trainee, four associate scientists and eight scientists. You will also work with collaborators who provide the samples and rely on your data, and with colleagues in other departments as workflows are refined across the research process. What you can expect here You will work in a department that is putting automation, digital tools and AI to use in everyday analytical work. You will have room to build new technical skills, take ownership of method development and make your voice heard on how the work is done. You will be supported to perform at your best by colleagues who share their expertise. Salary and Benefits: The Annual Base Salary ranges from 437,600.00 to 643,200.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience. A competitive benefits package is offered, including a pension scheme (currently 13% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution) in accordance with the applicable Collective Agreement for Salaried Employees (Industriens Funktionæroverenskomst or “IFO”). Benefits also include a free choice account of currently 10% and 4% holiday allowance. Start now Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn immunoassay expertise into data that helps move early research forward, apply for the Laboratory Technician role by 15 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

items.desc: En tant qu'organisateur de forums de recrutement, Talents Handicap accompagne de très nombreuses entreprises & organisations en France dans leurs recrutements de collaborateurs en situation de handicap. Participant actuellement à l'un de nos forums. L'entreprise Wavestone recherche actuellement des profils : Dans un monde où savoir se transformer est la clé du succès, l'ambition de Wavestone est d'apporter à ses clients des réponses uniques sur le marché, en les éclairant et les guidant dans leurs décisions les plus stratégiques. Wavestone est un nouveau cabinet de conseil, issu du rapprochement début 2016 de Solucom et des activités européennes de Kurt Salmon (à l'exclusion de consumer goods & retail en dehors de France). Notre cabinet rassemble 2800 collaborateurs présents sur 4 continents, figure parmi les leaders indépendants du conseil en Europe, et constitue le 1er cabinet de conseil indépendant en France. Pour satisfaire nos clients, nous développons 18 terrains d’excellence, à la fois sectoriels, fonctionnels, et technologiques. Sur chacun d’eux, nous nous engageons à apporter à nos clients une profondeur d’expertise de premier plan. Mais surtout, et c’est là le cœur de notre proposition de valeur, nous combinons ces 18 terrains d’excellence sans couture et sans silos. Enfin, pour enrichir notre offre, nous investissons dans 5 assets à forte valeur ajoutée : le Research Knowledge Center, parce que pour prendre de bonnes décisions il faut de bonnes informations, le Creadesk, qui permet de stimuler la créativité et l’innovation, la Faktory, pour prototyper des idées en mode « test and learn », le Machine Learning et Data Lab, pour exploiter les gisements de valeur qui se cachent dans les données de nos clients et Shake Up', pour accompagner des start-ups dans leur croissance et leur développement. Nous recrutons des talents aux parcours diversifiés, de tous niveaux d'expérience. Des personnalités engagées, reconnues pour leur goût d'entreprendre et leur esprit d'équipe. Venez vivre une expérience unique au sein de Wavestone ! \n\n Description de l'entreprise Rejoignez un cabinet de conseil international qui accompagne les grandes transformations stratégiques. Nous sommes Wavestone : des expert·es passionné·es et orienté·es solutions, qui placent l’humain au cœur de la performance et de la croissance. Ambitieux·ses et en pleine expansion, nous développons sans cesse notre portefeuille de clients et de projets, avec une portée internationale et une réelle volonté de générer un impact positif. Êtes-vous un vrai team player, porté par des valeurs fortes ? Êtes-vous curieux·se et déterminé·e, avec l’envie d’apprendre chaque jour ? Êtes-vous du genre à relever les défis sans hésiter ? Alors vous êtes au bon endroit. Rejoignez Wavestone et exprimez votre potentiel dans un environnement stimulant et collaboratif, où l’on transforme les défis d’aujourd’hui en opportunités de demain. Description du poste La business unit CTO Advisory est composée d’un collectif multi-compétences, de plus de 600 consultant·es, qui combinent compréhension des enjeux business des clients et expertise technologique de premier plan. L’objectif de ces équipes est de contribuer à positionner Wavestone comme le partenaire conseil de confiance des Chiefs Technology Officer (CTO) à lère de l'IA dans leurs transformations technologiques et organisationnelles les plus ambitieuses. Une mission qui adresse des clients grands comptes français et internationaux de tous secteurs d’activité : banque, énergie, transport, luxe, services, secteur public…en collaboration avec les autres business units du cabinet. Votre rôle au sein de la practice : Intégré(e) dans une équipe projet et au contact du client, vous serez amené(e) à : / Analyser et comparer nos clients du marché avec un delivery orienté : Etude d’opportunités, benchmark ou encore veille technologique / Apporter une vision en stratégie et organisation : Construire un schéma directeur, une roadmap d’évolution, ou encore travailler sur un modèle opérationnel cible / Concevoir les produits tech : Travailler sur le design d’architectures et de plateformes, accompagner les équipes IT à l’implémentation des socles / Concevoir les stratégies de transformations et les piloter : Cadrer et piloter un programme (comitologie, gouvernance, change management...), construire un Business Case, accompagner nos clients dans la transition vers le RUN / Optimiser les performances des services : Réaliser des audits (technique, organisationnel), travailler sur un plan de remédiation, créer un dashboard de pilotage... Des missions variées qui couvrent l’ensemble de nos offres : Grand compte de la pharmaceutique : Définir les nouveaux modes de collaboration digitale, moderniser les outils et l’expérience numérique de travail, booster l’adoption des nouveaux outils digitaux (ex : Copilot M365). Leader mondial de l’énergie : Définir la stratégie de transformation du SI vers le Cloud, cadrer cette transformation …

Nos équipes accompagnent les clients grands comptes de la région Rennaise, notamment dans les secteurs de la finance, de l’industrie, du secteur public, des télécommunications ou encore de l’énergie, dans leurs projets de transformation offrant ainsi des perspectives d’évolution dans les métiers du conseil, de l’expertise technique et de la gestion de projet sur les technologies phares du marché. Fonctions et responsabilités Concevoir, développer, déployer et maintenir des outils d'automatisation et les chaînes d’intégration et de déploiement continu (CI/CD). Automatiser les déploiements applicatifs, le provisioning et la gestion des infrastructures à l’aide d’outils d’Infrastructure as Code. Contribuer à la conception, à l'évolution et à l'optimisation des plateformes applicatives Cloud Native, notamment sur Kubernetes. Collaborer avec les équipes de développement pour améliorer la qualité, la fiabilité, la performance et la sécurité des applications. Participer à la mise en place des bonnes pratiques DevOps, de l’observabilité et de l’automatisation des processus. Contribuer à la résolution des incidents, à l'automatisation des diagnostics et des remédiations, et à l’amélioration continue des plateformes techniques. Qualités requises pour réussir dans ce rôle De formation Bac+5 (école d’Ingénieurs ou Université), vous avez une expérience d’au moins 3 ans dans des environnements DevOps. Vous disposez de compétences parmi les technologies suivantes : Développement et scripting : Java, Python ou Go Contexte Cloud Native : Kubernetes et connaissance de l'écosystème d'un des hyperscalers du marché (GCP, AWS, Azure) Intégration DevOps & monitoring : GitLab CI/CD, Ansible, Terraform, Helm, Kustomize, Crossplane, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry... La maîtrise des chaînes CI/CD, du développement d'outillage et de l'automatisation des déploiements est particulièrement recherchée. Une expérience des Kubernetes Operators et des pratiques de Platform Engineering constitue un plus. Le poste requiert aussi : Autonomie, Rigueur, Esprit d’équipe. Chez CGI, nous cultivons un environnement de travail respectueux, où chacun peut trouver sa place et développer son potentiel. Nous sommes engagés en faveur d’un recrutement inclusif, fondé sur l’égalité des chances et la non-discrimination. Cet engagement est reconnu par le Label Recrutement Inclusif, décerné par JobinLive. Ensemble, en tant que propriétaires, mettons notre savoir-faire à l’œuvre. La vie chez CGI est ancrée dans l’actionnariat, le travail d’équipe, le respect et un sentiment d’appartenance. Chez nous, vous pourrez exploiter votre plein potentiel parce que… Nous vous invitons à devenir propriétaire dès le jour 1 alors que nous travaillons ensemble à faire de notre rêve une réalité. C’est pourquoi nous nous désignons comme associés de CGI, plutôt que comme employés. Nous tirons profit des retombées de notre succès collectif et contribuons activement à l’orientation et à la stratégie de notre entreprise. Votre travail crée de la valeur. Vous élaborerez des solutions novatrices et développerez des relations durables avec vos collègues et clients, tout en ayant accès à des capacités mondiales pour concrétiser vos idées, saisir de nouvelles opportunités, et bénéficier d’une expertise sectorielle et technologique de pointe. Vous ferez évoluer votre carrière en vous joignant à une entreprise bâtie pour croître et durer. Vous serez soutenus par des leaders qui ont votre santé et bien-être à cœur et qui vous permettront de saisir des occasions afin de parfaire vos compétences et élargir les horizons. Ce même engagement envers l’équité s’étend à notre utilisation des technologies. Afin de soutenir notre équipe de recrutement, des outils d’IA peuvent être utilisés pour aider à l’évaluation des candidatures, sans jamais remplacer le jugement humain. Toutes les décisions d’embauche demeurent entièrement entre les mains de nos professionnels du recrutement. Joignez-vous à nous, l’une des plus importantes entreprises de conseil en technologie de l’information (TI) et en management au monde.

items.desc: En tant qu'organisateur de forums de recrutement, Talents Handicap accompagne de très nombreuses entreprises & organisations en France dans leurs recrutements de collaborateurs en situation de handicap. Participant actuellement à l'un de nos forums. L'entreprise Wavestone recherche actuellement des profils : Dans un monde où savoir se transformer est la clé du succès, l'ambition de Wavestone est d'apporter à ses clients des réponses uniques sur le marché, en les éclairant et les guidant dans leurs décisions les plus stratégiques. Wavestone est un nouveau cabinet de conseil, issu du rapprochement début 2016 de Solucom et des activités européennes de Kurt Salmon (à l'exclusion de consumer goods & retail en dehors de France). Notre cabinet rassemble 2800 collaborateurs présents sur 4 continents, figure parmi les leaders indépendants du conseil en Europe, et constitue le 1er cabinet de conseil indépendant en France. Pour satisfaire nos clients, nous développons 18 terrains d’excellence, à la fois sectoriels, fonctionnels, et technologiques. Sur chacun d’eux, nous nous engageons à apporter à nos clients une profondeur d’expertise de premier plan. Mais surtout, et c’est là le cœur de notre proposition de valeur, nous combinons ces 18 terrains d’excellence sans couture et sans silos. Enfin, pour enrichir notre offre, nous investissons dans 5 assets à forte valeur ajoutée : le Research Knowledge Center, parce que pour prendre de bonnes décisions il faut de bonnes informations, le Creadesk, qui permet de stimuler la créativité et l’innovation, la Faktory, pour prototyper des idées en mode « test and learn », le Machine Learning et Data Lab, pour exploiter les gisements de valeur qui se cachent dans les données de nos clients et Shake Up', pour accompagner des start-ups dans leur croissance et leur développement. Nous recrutons des talents aux parcours diversifiés, de tous niveaux d'expérience. Des personnalités engagées, reconnues pour leur goût d'entreprendre et leur esprit d'équipe. Venez vivre une expérience unique au sein de Wavestone ! \n\n Description de l'entreprise Rejoignez un cabinet de conseil international qui accompagne les grandes transformations stratégiques. Nous sommes Wavestone : des expert·es passionné·es et orienté·es solutions, qui placent l’humain au cœur de la performance et de la croissance. Ambitieux·ses et en pleine expansion, nous développons sans cesse notre portefeuille de clients et de projets, avec une portée internationale et une réelle volonté de générer un impact positif. Êtes-vous un vrai team player, porté par des valeurs fortes ? Êtes-vous curieux·se et déterminé·e, avec l’envie d’apprendre chaque jour ? Êtes-vous du genre à relever les défis sans hésiter ? Alors vous êtes au bon endroit. Rejoignez Wavestone et exprimez votre potentiel dans un environnement stimulant et collaboratif, où l’on transforme les défis d’aujourd’hui en opportunités de demain. Description du poste La business unit CTO Advisory est composée d’un collectif multi-compétences, de plus de 600 collaborateurs, qui combinent compréhension des enjeux business des clients et expertise technologique de premier plan. L’objectif de ces équipes est de contribuer à positionner Wavestone comme le partenaire conseil de confiance des Chiefs Technology Officer (CTO) dans leurs transformations technologiques et organisationnelles les plus ambitieuses. Une mission qui adresse des clients grands comptes français et internationaux de tous secteurs d’activité : banque, énergie, transport, luxe, services, secteur public…en collaboration avec les autres business units du cabinet. Au sein de cette BU, l’équipe CTO.ai se distingue par sa maîtrise des technologies Data & IA, et plus particulièrement des usages de l’intelligence artificielle générative, des agents IA et des solutions comme Microsoft Copilot Studio. Notre mission est d’aider nos clients à exploiter pleinement le potentiel de ces technologies : socle IA ("AI Ready") , cas d'usage et agents IA , puis transformation du SI pour supporter l'IA à l'échelle. Nos interventions couvrent tout le cycle de transformation IA : 1. Plateformes IA Ready & gouvernance des fondations IA Définition de la stratégie plateforme et de la trajectoire IA de l'entreprise Mise en place des fondations technologiques nécessaires à l'industrialisation de l'IA (data, cloud, sécurité, gouvernance) Conception de plateformes IA sécurisées, évolutives et conformes (RGPD, AI Act, gestion des accès, observabilité) 2. Modernisation des architectures SI pour l’IA Évolution des architectures applicatives et data pour tirer parti des technologies IA et génératives Modernisation des plateformes, APIs et …

Livrables attendus : dossiers d'architecture de référence, modules Terraform versionnés, pipelines MLOps automatisés, audits FinOps IA, documentation d'exploitation et fiches de transfert vers le Run. Cloud IA multi-cloud (Avancé AWS & Azure) : services AWS (Lambda, S3, Glue, SageMaker, Bedrock) ET Azure (Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Cognitive Services). Data, réseau & observabilité (Confirmé) : ELK, BigQuery, monitoring de production (Azure Monitor, Datadog, CloudWatch), réseau cloud (VPC, souscriptions, NACL/RTB/SG, NLB/ALB/AG), sécurité (Private Endpoints, RBAC, KMS) et FinOps IA. Compétences et certifications appréciées : Microsoft Fabric (enjeu fort) ; écosystème complémentaire : GCP / Vertex AI (niveau notions), Computer Vision, architectures Serverless. Niveaux de maîtrise attendus : Terraform confirmé à avancé · AWS AI avancé · Azure AI avancé · GCP ML notions. Certifications appréciées : HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Certified ML Engineer / Specialty, AWS Solutions Architect Associate, Azure AI Engineer Associate, Fabric Data Engineer Associate.

items.desc: About OceanWings OceanWings' mission is to provide the Shipping Industry with the most efficient Wind Assisted Propulsion Systems, enabling them to reduce emissions, lower operational costs, and protect the long-term value of their investments. By making innovative technology accessible,OceanWings aims to become a global leader in the decarbonization of shipping, helping steer the industry towards wind energy as the most scalable and ready solution for a sustainable future. Context Reporting to the IT Manager, you will administer and secure OceanWings' Microsoft 365, systems and multi-site network environment across offices, industrial facilities and connected vessels. This hands-on role combines infrastructure ownership, level 2/3 support and routine IT operations. Main Missions Administer Microsoft 365, Entra ID, users, groups, licences, MFA and Conditional Access. Manage Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams and Teams Rooms. Administer Intune, Windows 10/11 endpoints, compliance policies and application deployment. Operate LAN/WAN networks, switches, routers, VLANs, trunks, STP and LACP across multiple sites. Administer firewalls, VPNs, professional Wi-Fi and core DNS, DHCP and NTP services. Monitor infrastructure, investigate anomalies and resolve complex level 2/3 incidents using Wireshark or equivalent tools. Develop PowerShell scripts to automate administration, network configuration, backup and restoration tasks. Provide user support, manage tickets and troubleshoot hardware, software, Outlook and network issues. Prepare onboarding and offboarding equipment, maintain IT assets, stock and equipment orders. Document network diagrams, configurations, procedures and recurring administration tasks. Contribute to cybersecurity, redundancy, high availability and business continuity for shore-based and onboard environments. In the IT Manager's absence, ensure operational continuity and carry out the full range of missions assigned to the IT service. Profile & Required Skills You hold a minimum Bachelor's degree (Licence/Bac+3) in IT, systems and networks or a related field. You have a minimum of five years of relevant professional experience, with strong practical experience in Microsoft 365, systems and enterprise networking. The following three capabilities are essential: Hands-on administration of Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Exchange Online and endpoint environments. Practical enterprise networking experience, including firewalls, VPNs and production troubleshooting. Autonomous diagnosis and resolution of complex systems, software, hardware and network incidents. Ways of Working Act in line with our Operating Principles: Be Humble; Keep It Simple; Honor Every Commitment; Succeed Together; Move Fast & Adapt. Demonstrate a strong service mindset and the ability to set clear priorities. Organize your workload and working time autonomously while delivering reliably on commitments. Make day-to-day decisions within the delegated scope and escalate decisions that may affect the wider company. Respect reporting lines, seek alignment and work collaboratively rather than operating in isolation. Embrace the start-up environment by handling both confirmed-level responsibilities and junior or routine IT tasks. Desired Skills & Certifications Experience with OSPF/BGP, Azure or AWS networking, high availability, Exchange Hybrid, Microsoft Defender, Purview, Microsoft 365 migrations or IT projects is appreciated. Relevant certifications include Cisco CCNA/CCNP, Fortinet NSE/FCA/FCP, Aruba Certified Professional, Juniper JNCIA/JNCIS, Microsoft AZ-700, AZ-800/AZ-801, UniFi and Microsoft Administrator Associate or above. Certifications are desired but not mandatory. Professional English and French are required. Working at OceanWings means... Building IT solutions that support the decarbonization of the maritime industry. Working with a committed start-up team on worldwide and onboard infrastructure challenges. Conditions Permanent contract (CDI) - Cadre status. Position based in Paris, with travel to other sites in France up to once per week and no international travel planned. Remote working arrangements to be determined. Availability: as soon as possible. Recruitment Process 1. Initial telephone call. 2. HR interview. 3. Technical interview. 4. Final validation by the N+2 managee. Rémunération : 40 000,00€ à 50 000,00€ par an Lieu du poste : En présentiel

items.desc: Position: Software Engineer III – Cheminformatics Company: Elsevier Location: Frankfurt, Germany or Oxford, United Kingdom | Hybrid About Reaxys Reaxys is a comprehensive and powerful cloud hosted and deep-tech data searching tool that is used by thousands of chemists, researchers and students throughout the world to retrieve chemistry patents, chemical reactions, substance data and other related chemistry information using a highly performant chemical structure search engine. Supported by continuous updates and robust taxonomies, Reaxys can be searched using natural language, drawn chemical structures, formulas, physical property parameters, and more. Trusted for over 30 years by large pharma, innovative startups, large tech, private and public sector research hubs and universities alike, Reaxys is a partner to the pharma, medicinal chemistry and chemical industries. About the Role The Reaxys team is seeking a Cheminformatician to help develop solutions at the intersection of chemistry and technology. Working closely with the Product team, you’ll translate scientific questions into software features and workflows, using AI Assistants to support and accelerate development. The role calls for technical creativity and familiarity with AI-assisted software engineering paradigms. You will work in a global environment, collaborating with colleagues across continents, and leveraging the latest AI-powered development tools. Key Responsibilities: Bridge chemistry, cheminformatics and software engineering , translating scientific questions into molecular data representations, software features and computational workflows. Design and develop scalable, maintainable and production-quality software. Apply cheminformatics methods to molecular data, including molecular representations and chemical data validation. Collaborate with chemists, data scientists, Product and engineering teams to define requirements and evaluate computational results. Architect and develop distributed software systems. Work with cheminformatics tools and libraries such as RDKit or ChemAxon . Use modern AI-assisted development tools to support and accelerate software engineering. Required Qualifications: Academic background in Cheminformatics, Chemistry, Computational Chemistry, Biochemistry or a related scientific discipline. Relevant professional experience combining cheminformatics with software or technology development. Experience working with molecular data, chemical representations and data validation. Strong programming skills in Java and/or Python . Experience developing maintainable, production-quality software and an understanding of distributed systems. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate scientific requirements into technical solutions. Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in an international, multidisciplinary environment. Benefits: Hybrid working with flexibility between office and home Work in an international and collaborative environment Opportunity to work on products with real impact on scientific research and discovery Access to modern technologies and AI-assisted development tools Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development Collaboration with experts across chemistry, data science, product and software engineering Be part of Elsevier , a global organization supporting researchers and healthcare professionals worldwide Why Join Us? This is an opportunity to combine software engineering with real scientific impact . You’ll help develop technology that enables researchers and scientists to access, understand and work with complex chemical information. If you enjoy turning complex scientific challenges into scalable technology and want to contribute to tools that support research and discovery worldwide, we’d love to hear from you. About Elsevier Elsevier is a global leader in information and analytics, helping researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes. Through trusted content, data and digital solutions, we support our customers in making better decisions, driving innovation and tackling some of the world’s most complex challenges. At Elsevier, you’ll be part of an international and collaborative environment where technology and scientific expertise come together to make a meaningful impact. Primary Location Base Pay Range: Germany - Frankfurt (Baseler Platz) €56,400 - €94,200. We know your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. items.desc: Are you ready to combine your passion for IT and logistics in the dynamic role of Business Analyst? As an international extension of our central IT department, which is located in Belgium, we are looking for a Business Analyst in Germany to join the team. Discover below the challenges and rewards that come with this role at H.Essers. YOUR CHALLENGES You will play a unique role in the team, as you will work from Germany and interact closely with the Belgian IT department of H.Essers. Your focus as a Business Analyst will be in Germany and occasionally you will engage in other projects in the broader European area. In this interesting key position you will become the main point of contact for all questions and issues regarding the local warehouse management systems. Monitoring and supporting the existing systems but also providing training and troubleshooting assistance – as needed – will be part of your responsibility. What makes your job interesting is the great variety on the one hand but also the fact that you are a liason between different stakeholders. After all, you are the bridge between the customer, the operational teams within H.Essers and the technical support team to build solutions in the in-house developed warehouse/transport management systems. In addition, you can use your creativity and analytical mind to contribute to discussions on the future direction of these applications. More specifically, what can you expect from this opportunity? Close collaboration with your Belgian colleagues from the IT department to analyze and improve the H.Essers warehousing and transportation systems. Engaging and working together with several internal and external stakeholders to identify business requirements and develop solutions that meet their needs. Lead or support the implementation of improvement projects to optimize warehousing and transportation processes. Monitoring and troubleshooting IT systems related to warehousing and transportation will also be an important aspect of your job. As a change of pace, you will team up with the IT department to provide basic infrastructure support, such as setting up new hardware and troubleshooting network issues, and provide technical support and training to end-users. Coordinating projects in collaboration with external parties is one of your strengths. YOUR TALENTS You have a Master's degree (or equivalent by experience) in Management, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field. In addition you have minimum 2 years of experience in IT support or a related field. Thanks to your analytical insights, strong problem-solving mindset and outstanding communication and collaboration skills you make the difference. Working independently and managing multiple tasks simultaneously offers you the variety you need. If you already have knowledge of warehousing or transportation systems and you are familiar with basic infrastructure tasks, then this will be a great asset. Experience in the logistics or supply chain management area is an added benefit. You excel in stakeholder management, effectively engaging and communicating with various stakeholders to ensure project success. YOUR REWARDS Off course you have an attractive salary package. You can also count on a very extensive leave scheme. Supported by our vision of ‘Lifelong Learning’, the H.Essers Academy offers you a free choice of various training courses that contribute to your personal development. Your physical and mental health are strengthened through H.Essers’ Fit2Grow health program. Your greatest asset is undoubtedly your place within the close-knit H.Essers family. 7500 REASONS TO CHOOSE H.ESSERS Family values: have provided a strong foundation of trust and commitment for both employees and customers since 1928 Job security: in a rapidly changing world Ambitious team: with 7500 dedicated colleagues, we strive for excellence and have an abundance of ambition and opportunity Innovation: in our processes and services, enabling us to serve our customers ever more efficiently and sustainably Sustainable international growth: recognizing our social, economic, and environmental responsibilities as an organization to have a positive impact on society as a whole Diversity and inclusion: are crucial to a healthy and productive work environment and are actively embraced within H.Essers These are just a few reasons why H.Essers is an attractive choice, we are eager to discover your reason(s).
