items.desc: About the Team We are Quadcode, a fintech company excelling in financial brokerage activities and delivering advanced financial products to our global clientele. Our flagship product, an internal trading platform, is offered as a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solution to other brokers. We are looking for a Mobile QA Engineer for our iOS team . We are currently undertaking a major redesign of our flagship trading platform, used by millions of users worldwide, with three key goals: delivering an adaptive UI across different screen sizes and device families, expanding automated regression coverage, and transitioning to native Swift-based test automation. We follow an AI-first approach, actively integrating AI tools into our daily engineering workflows, including test design, automation development, code reviews, and debugging. We work in 2-week Scrum sprints, with daily meetings at 11:00 EET/EEST. Your role will involve owning the testing process end to end, from reviewing requirements and identifying potential risks to designing test cases, executing manual tests, and automating them where appropriate. Our ideal candidate has a strong product mindset, takes ownership of features, proactively identifies issues and opportunities for improvement, collaborates with different teams, and drives features through testing to a successful release. Tasks Manual Testing: Perform functional, regression, smoke, end-to-end and integration testing of new and existing iOS functionality. Review specifications, identify risks and edge cases, prepare test cases and checklists, and validate the redesigned UI across different screen sizes, device families, and iOS versions. Test Automation: Develop and maintain automated tests to expand regression coverage across product domains. Contribute automated tests for new functionality, including end-to-end tests, and add coverage for features that are not yet covered by developer-written tests. Automation Migration: Help migrate the existing test automation framework to Swift-based automation, improving maintainability, reliability, and regression coverage. API Testing and Debugging: Test REST APIs and JSON responses, validate integrations and real-time data flows, analyze network traffic using Charles Proxy or Proxyman, and investigate issues using device logs and debugging tools. items.desc: Chi stiamo cercando Per rafforzare il nostro team IT e Security siamo alla ricerca di un/a Cybersecurity Specialist , una figura che contribuirà alla protezione degli asset digitali aziendali, garantendo la sicurezza di infrastrutture, applicazioni, dati e processi. La risorsa collaborerà con i team IT per identificare e mitigare i rischi cyber, supportare l'implementazione delle misure di sicurezza e monitorare costantemente il livello di protezione dei sistemi informatici aziendali. Sarà inoltre coinvolta nelle attività di prevenzione, rilevamento e gestione degli incidenti di sicurezza, contribuendo alla diffusione di una solida cultura della cybersecurity all'interno dell'organizzazione. Requisiti fondamentali Titolo di studio Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica, Ingegneria delle Telecomunicazioni, Cybersecurity o discipline affini. Competenze tecniche Conoscenza dei principali framework e standard di sicurezza informatica (ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Controls). Conoscenza delle tecnologie di sicurezza per reti, endpoint e infrastrutture IT. Conoscenza delle principali tecniche di vulnerability assessment e remediation. Conoscenza delle architetture di rete, protocolli TCP/IP e tecnologie firewall. Familiarità con strumenti di Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR/XDR). Conoscenza delle principali soluzioni di sicurezza cloud (Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, AWS o Google Cloud). Capacità di analizzare log, eventi e anomalie di sicurezza. Competenze nella gestione degli incidenti cyber e nelle attività di incident response. Conoscenza dei principi di Identity & Access Management (IAM) e gestione degli accessi privilegiati. Familiarità con attività di penetration testing, vulnerability management e security assessment. Conoscenza delle normative in materia di protezione dei dati e sicurezza delle informazioni (GDPR e Direttiva NIS2). Competenze linguistiche Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese, scritta e parlata. Capacità di utilizzare documentazione tecnica e interfacciarsi con fornitori e partner internazionali Altri requisiti Disponibilità ad aggiornamento professionale continuo su minacce, vulnerabilità e tecnologie emergenti. Gradite certificazioni di settore quali CompTIA Security+, ISC2 CC, CISSP, CISM, CEH, Microsoft Security Operations Analyst o equivalenti. Disponibilità ad approfondire nuove tecnologie e modelli di sicurezza in ambienti on-premise e cloud. Di cosa ti occuperai Monitorare e analizzare eventi di sicurezza per identificare potenziali minacce e vulnerabilità. Supportare l'implementazione e la gestione delle misure di cybersecurity aziendali. Collaborare all'esecuzione di vulnerability assessment e attività di remediation. Partecipare alla gestione degli incidenti di sicurezza e alle attività di investigazione. Supportare l'adozione di policy, procedure e standard di sicurezza. Collaborare con i team IT nella progettazione e messa in sicurezza delle infrastrutture tecnologiche. Effettuare attività di risk assessment e analisi delle vulnerabilità. Garantire il corretto funzionamento degli strumenti di monitoraggio e difesa cyber. Contribuire alle attività di awareness e formazione degli utenti sui temi della sicurezza informatica. Supportare gli audit interni ed esterni relativi alla sicurezza delle informazioni e alla conformità normativa. Collaborare con fornitori e partner tecnologici per l'implementazione di nuove soluzioni di sicurezza. Cosa cerchiamo in te Forte orientamento all'analisi e alla risoluzione dei problemi. Approccio metodico e attenzione al dettaglio. Capacità di gestione delle priorità in contesti complessi e dinamici. Attitudine alla collaborazione con team multidisciplinari. Curiosità e interesse verso l'evoluzione delle minacce informatiche e delle tecnologie di difesa. Proattività nell'identificazione di rischi e opportunità di miglioramento. Ottime capacità comunicative per interfacciarsi efficacemente con interlocutori tecnici e non tecnici. Elevato senso di responsabilità e attenzione alla riservatezza delle informazioni. The role ensures that architectural guidelines are correctly applied, manages daily cloud operations, and contributes to secure, reliable, and optimized cloud services. CLOUD ARCHITECTURE DESIGN: Support in the design and implement cloud-based solutions, including infrastructure, applications, and services, that meet business needs and objectives. Support in the development of cloud architecture strategies and roadmaps to align with the organization’s digital transformation and IT goals. CLOUD PLATFORM SELECTION AND INTEGRATION Configure, deploy, and maintain services and resources on cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud). CLOUD SECURITY AND COMPLIANCE Ensure that cloud environments are secure and compliant with industry regulations (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2) and organizational security standards. CLOUD COST MANAGEMENT AND OPTIMIZATION Monitor cloud usage and identify cost-saving opportunities using cost management tools. DOCUMENTATION AND REPORTING Support in managing comprehensive documentation for cloud architectures, design patterns, security protocols, and operational procedures. Support in creating reports on the status of cloud projects, performance metrics, and cost analyses. Technical Skills: Cloud Platforms: knowledge of major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), including their services and capabilities. Cloud Architecture Design: Knowledge in designing cloud architectures for scalability, reliability, performance, and security. Security and Compliance: knowledge of cloud security best practices, including identity and access management (IAM), encryption, firewalls, and data protection. Cost Management: Ability to use cloud cost management and optimization tools, such as AWS Cost Explorer, Azure Cost Management, and Google Cloud Cost Management. DevOps and CI/CD: Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native tools. Performance Monitoring: Knowledge of cloud monitoring tools (e.g., AWS CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Monitoring) to track and optimize cloud performance. English proficiency written and spoken Soft Skills: Time-management skills. Proven problem-solving skills, ability to consider complex multi-disciplinary aspects of problem. Adaptability and Flexability Professional Experience: 2–4 years of hands-on experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. items.desc: Come parte del team di Information & Digital Office di Zurich Italia , la persona che stiamo cercando opererà all'interno dell'ufficio Non Motor Applications , responsabile della gestione e dell'evoluzione dei software a supporto del ramo Danni – Rami Elementari. Il ruolo prevede di affiancare il Business nella traduzione dei propri desiderata in requisiti IT da trasferire verso la factory di sviluppo, gestendo poi tutte le fasi successive del software lifecycle con i diversi fornitori coinvolti, con un focus particolare sulle piattaforme che implementano la gestione dei prodotti assicurativi e delle polizze Non Motor. Compiti principali Raccolta dei requisiti di Business e trasformazione in requisiti IT, identificando soluzioni funzionali e tecniche adeguate Guida tecnico-funzionale nei confronti del Business e dei team di sviluppo, agendo come punto di riferimento per l'ufficio Supporto allo sviluppo, al testing e alle attività di implementazione Gestione dei Fornitori (verifica delle soluzioni tecniche proposte, qualità del delivery, monitoraggio delle segnalazioni, …) Supporto alle attività di Produzione e gestione di Incident, Ticket e Problem Identificazione di soluzioni volte al miglioramento della User Experience e dell'efficienza dei processi di sottoscrizione e gestione polizze Requisiti richiesti Background in ambito IT Esperienza di almeno 4-6 anni in un ruolo di Business Analyst, preferibilmente in ambito assicurativo Solida esperienza nel settore assicurativo, con conoscenza: dei prodotti assicurativi (logiche di configurazione) del ciclo di vita della polizza (emissione, rinnovi e post vendita) Buona confidenza con database relazionali – in particolare Oracle e PostgreSQL : capacità di scrivere query SQL complesse (join, aggregazioni, subquery, analisi performance) e di contribuire al disegno di nuove strutture dati (modellazione logica/fisica, chiavi, relazioni, indici) Comprensione dell'architettura applicativa moderna basata su microservizi , con familiarità rispetto allo stack: Backend : Java e/o Node.js Frontend : Angular Cloud : AWS (concetti base dei principali servizi) Conoscenza delle logiche di integrazione via API REST e dei principali pattern architetturali Capacità di leggere e interpretare documentazione tecnica (specifiche di interfaccia, data model, flussi applicativi) Buon livello di inglese (scritto e parlato) Requisiti preferenziali Esperienza con strumenti di ticketing e ALM (es. Jira, ServiceNow) Esperienza nel coordinamento di fornitori e nella gestione di delivery complessi Capacità di lavorare in team e in contesti multi-fornitore Buona gestione dello stress e capacità di lavorare per obiettivi Attitudine propositiva nell'identificare soluzioni Ottime capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale Ottime capacità analitiche e di problem-solving Retribuzione La posizione prevede un range da € 40.000 a € 45.000 +6% di incentivazione variabile sui risultati; beneficerai inoltre di un pacchetto di Compensi Integrativi Aziendali (CIA) e di un sistema di benefit pensato per supportare il benessere e l'equilibrio tra vita professionale e personale. Con circa 53'000 collaboratori al servizio dei clienti in tutto il mondo, aspiriamo a diventare la migliore società assicurativa secondo i parametri dei nostri azionisti, clienti e collaboratori. Noi aiutiamo i clienti privati, le piccole e medie imprese e le società globali in tutto il mondo a comprendere i rischi e a tutelarsi dagli stessi offrendo un ampio ventaglio di prodotti assicurativi, soluzioni e servizi di consulenza.In Zurich promuoviamo la cultura della diversità e dell'inclusione. Il nostro scopo e i nostri valori sono concepiti per proteggere, ispirare fiducia e aiutare i nostri dipendenti a raggiungere il loro pieno potenziale. Diamo importanza e difendiamo ciò che è giusto promuovendo l’uguaglianza tra i nostri professionisti, indipendentemente da sesso, disabilità, orientamento sessuale, etnia, generazione, convinzioni, ecc. I nostri processi d’acquisizione ed assunzione di talenti rispettano questo impegno quotidianamente. Unisciti alla Zurich e diventa parte di questa cultura! items.desc: At Metlen Energy & Metals , we are catalysts for a sustainable future, leading the green energy transition with innovative solutions while being a reference point for competitive green metallurgy. Our global presence covers two business Sectors: Energy and Metallurgy. With a consolidated yearly turnover of €6.3 billion and a workforce of over 5,500 dedicated individuals, we fuel success through cutting-edge technology and diverse talent. We are committed to embracing new state-of-the-art technologies and advancements, propelling us towards a cleaner, brighter tomorrow. Our positive footprint extends across five continents, leaving a lasting impact. We foster a culture of resilience, challenge, respect, excellence, and change , empowering our diverse workforce to achieve remarkable outcomes. We are looking for an O&M Technician to join our M Renewables team in Italy , part of our subsidiary METKA EGN . The role is focused on day-to-day technical activities to ensure proper operation, maintenance, and reliability of our solar PV plants. Your role will encompass: Execute scheduled preventive maintenance and support corrective maintenance activities on solar PV plants. Assist in troubleshooting electrical and mechanical issues, escalating complex faults when needed. Monitor basic plant performance indicators and ensure compliance with internal procedures and safety standards. Maintain accurate documentation, including maintenance logs and technical reports; support the update of server files and backups. Support spare parts handling and assist external contractors during onsite interventions. Use and update the CMMS and other internal tools according to company procedures. Work remotely as required and travel regularly to various solar plant locations. What you bring to the role: 1–2 years of experience in maintenance or troubleshooting of solar PV plants or relevant electrical/industrial experience. Basic understanding of PV systems, including string inverters, trackers, MV/LV equipment, and monitoring systems. Hands-on experience in general electrical works. Technical Diploma or Degree in Electrical Engineering (or related field). Knowledge of Italian HSE legislation and willingness to follow company safety procedures. Fluent Italian and basic English. Valid driver’s license and availability to travel. Compensation & Contractual Framework The starting gross annual salary (RAL) for this position is 27.500€, based on objective and gender-neutral criteria. Applicable CCNL: MetalmeccanicoCNA Level / Inquadramento: B1 The final compensation may reflect the candidate’s relevant experience and competencies, in line with the Company’s remuneration framework. items.desc: REQ-10121524 26/10/2026 Data Analysis Amsterdam, Netherlands €4.757 - €7.721 ING Bank Do you love to operate in an operational environment? Help to make COO a truly customer focused, people and data organisation! As the data driven mindset is increasingly embedded within ING, there is more need for strong quants to ‘do their thing’ and provide our stakeholders with the right insights and predictions. Will you be our new colleague? The organisation: COO Netherlands Within the Operational Performance Team, we model and perform analyses on multiple domains within COO. This includes the Retail and Business Clients Contact Centres, Consumer Loans, Daily Banking, Mortgages, Business Clients Operations, Business Lending, Complaints and Business Incident Management. Yearly, these departments handle hundreds of thousands of client applications and contacts. We thrive for an excellent service for our customers within a perfectly streamlined operational organisation. Our team creates targeted analyses, providing continuous insight to support operational teams to drive customer orientated improvements. A happy customer is our highest priority! Via this vacancy we are looking for a medior Data Analyst to strengthen the Operational Performance Team. Roles and respondibilities As a Data Analyst within the Operational Performance Team, you will be responsible for strengthening the data driven way of working within the COO domain. You will develop strong knowledge on the day-to-day processes, build data models and conduct data analysis. You ensure timely and adequate reporting towards the ING Group, Executive Committee ING Domestic Bank Netherlands, COO NL management and other senior stakeholders. Provide management with a single source of truth to steer on our organisational ambitions and key performance indicators. Within your role, you are the driver to build data-based insights that support our stakeholders. For example, conduct an analysis on how to increase the productivity of our contact centres, or provide upper management with insights on how to improve our key performance indicators. We are looking for someone who can set priorities between different case studies, create visualisations as support of your analysis and translate the data to qualitative colleagues. Your key responsibilities will mostly consist of: Designing and developing (statistical) deep dive analysis on our operational processes; Providing strong visualisations and numerical insights for both periodical projects and day-to-day operations; Support with all ING group, Executive Committee ING Domestic Bank Netherlands and COO NL management reporting; Supporting junior data analysts in their data models; Identifying functional and non-functional requirements from stakeholders focused on delivering high quality automated data solutions for operations; Maintaining day-to-day dashboards and providing answers to ad-hoc data requests; Providing analytical support for yearly budgeting of the domains; Supporting the development and implementation of sustainable and maintainable data solutions; Challenging the current way-of-working and finding opportunities to make real impact; You take it on and make it happen! You decide based on facts, data driven analysis and the results they provide. How to succeed We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself. An HBO/WO (Bachelor/Master) education in a quantitative field and/or have proven yourself in this working field; 3-5 years of experience with statistical data analysis and data frameworks; Familiar with operational bank processes, IT-tooling and service concepts; Broad practical experience with techniques on data preparation and analysis (SAS, SQL etc.); Experience with dashboard tooling (Cognos, etc.); Experience with stakeholder management; You pro-actively search for improvements and implement them where possible; Strong analytical skills and numerical insight, result-oriented with an eye for improvement potential; Rewards and benefits We want to make sure that it’s possible for you to strike the right balance between your career and your private life. items.desc: About the Team We are Quadcode, a fintech company excelling in financial brokerage activities and delivering advanced financial products to our global clientele. Our flagship product, an internal trading platform, is offered as a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solution to other brokers. We are looking for a Mobile QA Engineer for our iOS team . We are currently undertaking a major redesign of our flagship trading platform, used by millions of users worldwide, with three key goals: delivering an adaptive UI across different screen sizes and device families, expanding automated regression coverage, and transitioning to native Swift-based test automation. We follow an AI-first approach, actively integrating AI tools into our daily engineering workflows, including test design, automation development, code reviews, and debugging. We work in 2-week Scrum sprints, with daily meetings at 11:00 EET/EEST. Your role will involve owning the testing process end to end, from reviewing requirements and identifying potential risks to designing test cases, executing manual tests, and automating them where appropriate. Our ideal candidate has a strong product mindset, takes ownership of features, proactively identifies issues and opportunities for improvement, collaborates with different teams, and drives features through testing to a successful release. Tasks Manual Testing: Perform functional, regression, smoke, end-to-end and integration testing of new and existing iOS functionality. Review specifications, identify risks and edge cases, prepare test cases and checklists, and validate the redesigned UI across different screen sizes, device families, and iOS versions. Test Automation: Develop and maintain automated tests to expand regression coverage across product domains. Contribute automated tests for new functionality, including end-to-end tests, and add coverage for features that are not yet covered by developer-written tests. Automation Migration: Help migrate the existing test automation framework to Swift-based automation, improving maintainability, reliability, and regression coverage. API Testing and Debugging: Test REST APIs and JSON responses, validate integrations and real-time data flows, analyze network traffic using Charles Proxy or Proxyman, and investigate issues using device logs and debugging tools. Cross-Platform Testing: Collaborate with the Android team to verify cross-platform functionality and identify inconsistencies between iOS and Android implementations. CI/CD: Integrate and maintain automated tests in CI/CD pipelines, helping ensure reliable execution and timely feedback on product changes. AI-Assisted Workflows: Use AI tools in day-to-day QA activities, including test design, test automation, code reviews, and debugging. Requirements Mobile Testing Experience: 3+ years of experience testing native mobile applications, with a focus on iOS. Understanding of platform-specific features, guidelines, and limitations (Apple Human Interface Guidelines, Material Design). Test Automation: Hands-on experience building and maintaining mobile automated tests using Appium, XCUITest, and/or Espresso. Ability to design a scalable test automation framework from scratch using patterns such as Page Object or Screenplay. Programming Skills: Proficiency in at least one programming language used for test automation: Kotlin, Java, Swift, Python, or TypeScript. Ability to write clean, readable, and maintainable test code. Testing Theory and Test Design: Solid understanding of functional, regression, smoke, integration, and end-to-end testing. Experience with test design techniques, including equivalence partitioning, boundary value analysis, decision tables, and pairwise testing. Ability to write clear test cases, checklists, and bug reports. API Testing: Experience testing REST APIs and working with JSON. Familiarity with Postman, Swagger, API automation tools such as REST Assured, Retrofit, or requests, etc.). Basic understanding of WebSockets and real-time data testing. Debugging and Traffic Analysis: Experience using Charles Proxy, Proxyman, or Fiddler for traffic interception and mocking. Ability to inspect logs using Xcode Console, Android Studio Logcat, and adb. CI/CD and Test Infrastructure: Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Bitrise. AI Tools: Willingness to use AI-assisted tools in everyday engineering workflows, including test design, test automation development, and debugging. Languages: English at B1 level or above and Russian at C2 level. Nice to have Experience writing mobile automated tests in Swift using XCUITest. Experience migrating legacy automation frameworks or transitioning between programming languages and testing technologies. We are looking for ✈ Flight Engineer in Customer Experience Your tasks: Build long-term relationships with airline clients around the world and be their go-to person
items.desc: Ready to elevate your aviation career? We are a close-knit team fascinated by innovation, crafting AI-driven solutions for the aviation industry. Airlines around the world use our software to analyze flight data, cut fuel consumption and reduce CO2 emissions on thousands of flights every day. Your work has a real impact on the daily operations of the skies and on the air we all breathe. In this role you bring understanding of how airlines work, speak the language of fuel and aircraft performance, and turn that knowledge into real value for our clients. You own your client accounts and have a real influence on how our product develops. We are looking for ✈ Flight Engineer in Customer Experience Your tasks: Build long-term relationships with airline clients around the world and be their go-to person for our solutions. Run project meetings and training sessions with clients, discussing fuel efficiency results, performance metrics and goals. Handle client requests and issues reported by airline fuel teams, from first contact to resolution. Analyze airline operational data and turn it into practical recommendations. Support airlines in monitoring their fuel efficiency initiatives and policies. Bring the client’s voice to the product team and define the scope of new features together with Product Owners, developers, UX and QA. Support clients in implementing new features and maintain product documentation. Our requirements: Aviation background: education and/or a few years of experience in airline operations, flight dispatch, aircraft performance, fuel management, flight safety or another area of the aviation industry (e.g. air traffic management, aircraft manufacturing). items.desc: At GE Vernova, we are tackling some of the world's most challenging energy problems. Joining our team means you will work on technology that powers the world, surrounded by people who are committed to safety, innovation, and sustainability. We believe that diverse perspectives drive the best solutions; that is why we foster an inclusive environment where your voice is heard, your curiosity is encouraged, and your professional development is a priority. We offer the opportunity to take true technical ownership of complex hardware while working alongside world-class experts who are dedicated to mentoring the next generation of engineering leaders. As a Mechanical Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in the design, analysis, and optimization of components across our gas power portfolio. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to deliver high-quality solutions, drive product upgrades, and ensure our designs meet rigorous performance and safety standards. This role requires a balance of technical ownership, innovative problem-solving, and a commitment to continuous improvement. Job Description Key Responsibilities: Design & Analysis: Execute mechanical design and analysis (stress, modal, lifing) for assigned components in gas turbines. Technical Stewardship: Take ownership of mechanical hardware; perform validation testing; and evaluate designs for factors like thermal growth, manufacturing variation, and assembly stack-up to ensure optimal product behavior. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering experts, manufacturing, and sourcing teams to optimize sub-systems and components. Continuous Improvement: Support root cause analyses (RCA) to improve reliability, quality and yield. Apply Lean principles to streamline processes and drive innovation. Project Delivery: Manage milestones through formal/informal technical reviews, ensuring compliance with NPI processes and design practices. Mentorship: Foster a collaborative environment by building strong relationships with key stakeholders, including Principal and Chief Engineers. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related STEM field from an accredited institution. Technical proficiency in engineering software (ANSYS, NX) and programming languages (Python, Excel VBA) for data analysis. A "Lean" mindset, familiarity with AI-driven tools, and a passion for innovative design. Demonstrated ability to thrive in a collaborative, inclusive, and fast-paced environment. Strong communication skills, with a transparent approach to project management and problem-solving. Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: No

You will ensure accurate processing of HR transactions, maintain high-quality employee data, support payroll-related activities, and serve as a trusted partner for employees, managers, and HR stakeholders. Working as part of our People Services team, you will contribute to a modern HR service delivery model focused on operational excellence, continuous improvement, data quality, and an outstanding customer experience. This role offers an exciting opportunity to develop expertise in HR Operations, collaborate with stakeholders across the business, and actively contribute to process improvement and standardization initiatives. Key Responsibilities: Employee Lifecycle & HR Operations Deliver end-to-end HR administration support across the employee lifecycle, including hiring, contractual changes, leave management, and offboarding activities. Process HR transactions accurately and within agreed service levels while ensuring compliance with company policies and local German regulations. Prepare and maintain employee documentation and HR records in accordance with legal and regulatory requirements. Execute payroll-impacting transactions accurately and on time, recognizing the critical impact of HR data quality on employee pay. Employee & Stakeholder Support Act as a primary point of contact for employees, managers, and HR stakeholders through our case management and digital support channels. Provide guidance on routine HR policies, processes, and lifecycle transactions. Resolve inquiries efficiently while delivering a high-quality customer experience. Partner closely with HR Business Partners, Centres of Excellence, Payroll teams, and other stakeholders to ensure seamless service delivery. Data Quality & Systems Management Maintain accurate employee data within HR systems, ensuring completeness, consistency, and compliance. Identify and resolve data discrepancies and proactively support data quality initiatives. Utilize HR systems such as Workday, SAP, and ServiceNow to manage transactions and employee records. Support reporting activities and contribute to data-driven decision making through accurate system management. Payroll Support & Operational Excellence Support payroll processes through timely and accurate execution of payroll-relevant transactions. Perform validations, audits, and controls to ensure payroll-impacting data is correct before payroll processing. Collaborate with payroll teams and vendors to investigate and resolve data-related issues. Continuous Improvement & Standardization Identify opportunities to simplify, improve, and standardize HR processes. Participate in process improvement projects, knowledge transfers, and operational excellence initiatives. Contribute ideas that improve efficiency, quality, employee experience, and service delivery performance. Support the team's journey toward greater standardization, digitalization, and automation. Compliance & Confidentiality Handle sensitive personal and employment data with the highest level of confidentiality. Ensure compliance with data privacy requirements, local legislation, internal controls, and company policies. Follow established governance, documentation, and process standards. Basic Qualifications: Fluent German and English language skills, both written and spoken. Experience in HR Operations, HR Administration, Shared Services, People Services, Payroll Administration, Time & Attendance, or a related field. Experience managing employee lifecycle transactions and HR data within HR systems. Strong attention to detail with a demonstrated commitment to accuracy and quality. Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment. Strong customer service and stakeholder communication skills. Ability to work confidently with confidential employee information. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel. Willingness to work in a hybrid model from Poznan Preferred Qualifications: Experience supporting employees within the German market. Knowledge of German HR administration and payroll processes. Previous experience in a Shared Services, Global Business Services, or HR Operations environment. Experience with Workday, ServiceNow, and/or SAP HR. Exposure to process improvement, standardization, Lean, Continuous Improvement, or automation initiatives. Experience working with payroll vendors or payroll-impacting HR processes. Curiosity, learning agility, and a continuous improvement mindset. items.desc: About AkzoNobel Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux, International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance the fabric of everyday life. Because we believe every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together. For more information please visit www.akzonobel.com © 2026 Akzo Nobel N.V. All rights reserved. About the role Join our dynamic Invoice to Cash (I2C) team, where you'll contribute to efficient receivables management, process improvement, and risk assessment. If you're passionate about learning, problem-solving, and working in a collaborative environment, this role is for you! Key responsibilities Manage the collection of trade receivables for assigned companies within the market. Actively participate in "Invoice to Cash" process improvement projects, driving efficiency and effectiveness. Set and review credit limits for customers, collaborating closely with Sales Management, Credit Control, and senior stakeholders. Monitor and support the improvement of overdue debts, ensuring collection effectiveness. Provide well-documented risk advice to senior management and the sales department, assessing internal and external factors. Produce monthly reports for the analysis of aged debt and overdue payments. What makes you a great fit Fluency in English and Turkish. SAP, Excel and knowledge of Microsoft D365 or AX is a nice to have. Strong communication skills to handle frequent interactions with customers. Analytical mindset with excellent organizational skills to manage a portfolio and prioritize tasks efficiently. A proactive, flexible team player who thrives in a multicultural environment. What we offer Full-time position in our dynamic Invoice to Cash team. Attractive salary. Yearly bonus. Extended Lux Med medical package, including dental coverage. Modern work tools and a comfortable office environment. Access to Learning Cafeteria (incl. LinkedIn Learning), with opportunities for professional certifications (e.g., Lean Six Sigma). Flexible hybrid work model offering work-life balance. Opportunities for personal and professional growth in a dynamic, multicultural team. items.desc: Global Operations Safety Model Data Quality Assurance Analyst - Arabic Speaking (Third-Party Associate) Location : Bucharest Employment Type : Third-party Associate Job Code : A181982B Responsibilities About the team The Platform Responsibility team is responsible for building, optimizing, and maintaining machine learning models and operational processes that support TikTok's Trust & Safety systems. We ensure that automated safety models perform effectively in identifying harmful content, mitigating risks, and maintaining a safe user environment across regions. The Platform Responsibility team is bringing disruptive innovation to content safety through the deep application of AI. We are building next-generation infrastructure that leverages advanced LLMs to reshape risk detection and governance. By engineering high-quality data pipelines and integrating AI into core decision-making, we drive exponential efficiency gains and precision. Working at the intersection of scalable engineering and technology, we empower global business growth while serving as the foundation of user trust. To eliminate any doubt, this role involves reading, viewing, listening and examining user-generated content to ensure they comply with community guidelines. Content includes images, video, text related to every day life, but they can also include (but are not limited to) bullying; hate speech; child abuse; sexual assault; torture; bestiality; self-harm; suicide; murder. It is possible that this role will be exposed to harmful content on a daily basis. Responsibilities • Perform daily operational tasks such as quality inspection, guidelines and process optimization, queue assignment, and handling escalations for the evaluation project. • Work closely with stakeholders to stay updated on guideline developments and provide feedback on implementation and execution. • Conduct daily audits on an internal system and provide error analysis and feedback to stakeholders (R&D & Product Manager). • Monitor the quality scores of evaluators and conduct root cause analysis with the management team. • Monitor project data, record daily output and quality scores, prepare data analysis/reports for projects, and validate reports and data provided to stakeholders/partners. • Localize the guidelines and design training schedules and coordinate and liaise with key stakeholders to ensure the successful go-live within the targeted timeframe. • Deliver process/product/guideline training to new joiners. • Play a role in setting up product knowledge tests, sharing result analysis, and working with key stakeholders to improve the product knowledge of the team. • Able to work with sensitive content including but not limited to child exploitation, diverse religious and political perspectives, violence, and adult/sexual content. (Not frequent) • Perform any other duties as reasonably required to support the role. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent education/experience. • Fluency in Arabic is required as the role requires communication with Arabic markets, fluent in English is also required as it is the working language. • Work experience in search engines and social media platforms; Former experience in Search relevant business. • Experience in cross functional work and stakeholder management. • Experience in analysis and communication skills with a good sense of flexibility. Preferred Qualifications • Experience in project management, project operation, or familiarity with users' Internet usage habits. Important Note: Please be advised that the job posting is on behalf of a third-party agency. This is a 12-month temporary assignment managed by a third-party agency who will be your employer. While you may assigned to work at TikTok, you will not be a TikTok employee. All contractual terms, including payroll and benefits, will be handled by a third-party agency. By applying, you agree that the information provided in your application may be processed and retained by TikTok for recruitment purposes and shared with a third-party agency in accordance with TikTok's Applicant Privacy Notice https://lifeattiktok.com/legal/privacy Job Information About TikTok TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo. ​ Why Join Us Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. By embracing an innovative culture of excellence, we pride ourselves on designing, manufacturing and servicing some of the world’s most transformative products. From life-saving medical technology and mission-critical defense solutions to sophisticated industrial automation, we’re proud to partner with our customers to bring their complex ideas to market. Visit Plexus.com to learn more about our unwavering commitment to our vision. Living Our Values With a vision rooted in the wellbeing and inclusive engagement of our team members, our customers, their end users and our communities, people are the heart of what we do and who we are. Our values unite and guide us in everything that we do. Our values include: Growing our People, Building Belonging, Innovating Responsibly, Delivering Excellence and Creating Customer Success. As part of our team, you’ll do impactful work within an inclusive environment where everyone works together to achieve extraordinary outcomes. You’ll be empowered to reach your full potential through managing your own personalised development plan and access to our learning and development programs. Purpose Statement: The Systems Administrator will use and demonstrate the Plexus core values to provide service excellence for our internal customers as well as management of site computing equipment. This role will provide technical and customer support to the site user community ensuring that applications, systems, network and technologies are available to support and advance business needs. The Systems Administrator will collaborate with other IT personnel, vendors and business partners in order to deliver and maintain secure, reliable and sustainable technology solutions. The Systems Administrator will also follow all policies and governance that promote and support Plexus philosophy and business objectives. Installs or removes hardware and/or software, using supplied installation instructions and tools, including handover to the client. Assists users and follows agreed procedures for further help or escalation. Follows agreed procedures to identify and resolve issues with applications. Uses application management software and tools to collect agreed performance statistics. Carries out agreed applications maintenance tasks. Assesses, analyses, develops, documents and implements changes based on requests for change. Identifies problems and issues and recommend corrective actions. Develops and adapts innovation tools, processes and infrastructures to drive the process of innovation. Identifies resources and capabilities needed to support innovation. items.desc: Company Description AECOM’s Enterprise Capabilities team is looking for a Junior Water Science Specialist to join our team in Bucharest. About Enterprise Capabilities Fundamental to our Think and Act Globally strategy and digital adoption, Enterprise Capabilities (EC) is AECOM’s primary vehicle for workshare. Operating across geographic boundaries and time-zones, EC partners with regional and Global Business Line project teams to provide technical expertise, accelerate delivery and keep AECOM competitive in the industry. With a team of over 3000 technical professionals located across nine countries and remote technical anchors, EC teams are trusted to deliver high-quality, specialist services that help to fill capability gaps, resourcing needs and technical constraints on projects of all scopes and sizes. Start here. Grow here Job Description Here’s what you’ll do: As a Graduate Ecologist, you will contribute to a diverse range of ecological assessments and environmental projects by: Conducting desk-based freshwater and marine aquatic ecological studies, including researching designated sites, habitats, and protected species records. Analyzing ecological survey data, including water quality monitoring, macroinvertebrate, macrophyte, and fish data. Managing and collating large-scale datasets for the delivery of monitoring data to our clients. Supporting Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG) assessments and biodiversity offsetting calculations using the Defra Watercourses Metric Assisting in the preparation of Ecological Impact Assessments (EcIA), Habitats Regulations Assessments (HRA) and protected species reports. Helping coordinate ecological field surveys and supporting project delivery teams across the UK. Collaborating with multidisciplinary specialists in GIS, landscape architecture, environmental planning, water and engineering. Qualifications Here’s what we’re looking for: Mandatory Bachelor degree in a related discipline such as: Aquatic Ecology Freshwater [or Marine] Biology Monitoring of the Water Environment Conservation Biology, Wildlife Conservation, Environmental Science Or a related subject Passion for ecology and environmental conservation. Good understanding of core ecological principles, including: The Water Framework Directive and other freshwater/marine legislation The scientific method Mitigation hierarchy Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG) Biodiversity offsetting Strong technical writing and report preparation skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment. Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage priorities and work within project budgets. Additional Information At AECOM, you will have freedom to grow in a world of opportunity Our Freedom to Grow hybrid working philosophy is the cornerstone of our success as a business – supporting a culture of flexibility, trust and performance at AECOM. #LI-IP1 At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment. About AECOM AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. items.desc: ABOUT SYLUX SYLUX is an innovative company bringing lifesaving systems to the transportation market. We specialize in infrared sensing and AI-driven perception technologies for automotive safety. The company is committed to improving vehicle awareness and recognition capabilities in darkness, fog, glare, and other low-visibility environments. By combining infrared cameras, AI algorithms, and advanced perception platforms, SYLUX helps next-generation ADAS and intelligent vehicles go beyond the limits of conventional sensors, enabling more consistent and reliable detection of pedestrians, cyclists, and other vulnerable road users, while setting a higher benchmark for future road safety. This infrared heritage also serves as the foundation for SYLUX’s expansion into broader ADAS perception and intelligent sensing solutions. As a company empowered by COMPAL, SYLUX benefits from Compal’s world-class manufacturing excellence, and global supply chain capabilities. Backed by Compal’s extensive experience in technology innovation and cross-industry integration, SYLUX is able to accelerate the commercialization of advanced sensing technologies and deliver practical solutions for the future of intelligent mobility and automotive safety. OUR CULTURE We believe innovation happens when people do what they love and have the opportunity to grow. SYLUX is powered by some of the brightest talent from around the world, working together to push creative and technical boundaries on behalf of our clients and their products. We strive to create an environment where people can grow and learn from each other, receiving the support to do your best while working on what you love. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Systems Network Engineer, you will help keep Sylux’s global IT environment secure, available, and ready to scale. You will take hands-on responsibility across networking, servers, cloud services, Microsoft 365, Azure, identity, security, and core infrastructure. You will monitor and troubleshoot systems and networks, resolve incidents, support infrastructure projects, and identify opportunities to improve reliability and reduce manual work. You will partner with Global IT colleagues and internal stakeholders to implement technology that supports day-to-day operations and future growth. The environment is dynamic, so you should be comfortable moving between planned projects and emerging technical issues. Success in this role means balancing strong troubleshooting skills with thoughtful infrastructure improvements that make the environment more stable, secure, and manageable over time. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Administer, maintain, and troubleshoot network infrastructure, including switches, routers, firewalls, VPN connectivity, wireless networks, and related services. Manage Windows, Apple and Linux server/workstation environments and associated infrastructure services. Administer and support Microsoft 365, including user access, configuration, troubleshooting, and service administration. Support and maintain Microsoft Azure infrastructure, cloud services, identity, and related integrations. Manage identity and access systems, permissions, authentication, and user lifecycle activities. Monitor network, server, and cloud environments for availability, performance, capacity, and security issues. Diagnose infrastructure incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable corrective actions. Support backups, recovery processes, system updates, patching, and infrastructure maintenance. Participate in infrastructure upgrades, migrations, security initiatives, and technology deployments. Document configurations, procedures, technical standards, and troubleshooting knowledge. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive administration and improve operational efficiency. Collaborate with IT colleagues and business stakeholders to prioritize and resolve technical needs. DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS Mid to senior-level experience in systems and network engineering. Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft 365, Microsoft Azure, Windows/Linux systems, and enterprise networking. Solid knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, VPNs, wireless networking, and firewalls. Experience with identity and access management, backups, monitoring, patching, virtualization, and infrastructure security. Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills, with the ability to independently own issues through resolution. Experience supporting infrastructure upgrades, migrations, automation, and technical projects. Strong communication, documentation, and collaboration skills with technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Comfortable working in a dynamic, startup-style environment with changing priorities. Relevant Microsoft, Cisco, or CompTIA certifications are a plus but not required. TRAVEL Occasionally

items.desc: Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape. For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments. Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected. By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe. This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead. Wood Mackenzie Intelligence Connected WoodMac.com Wood Mackenzie Brand Video Wood Mackenzie Values Inclusive – we succeed together Trusting – we choose to trust each other Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions Future Focused – we accelerate change Curious – we turn knowledge into action The Role We are seeking a full-time Power Market Analyst to join Wood Mackenzie’s Power & Renewables team, focusing on the development and application of advanced power market models across European electricity markets. As a Power Market Analyst, you will play a key role in building, maintaining, and enhancing market optimization models used to analyse power systems, generation economics, transmission constraints, and market outcomes. You will apply linear programming (LP) and other optimization techniques to simulate market behaviour, assess investment and operational decisions, and provide actionable insights on power market dynamics, decarbonization pathways, and energy transition challenges. Key Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and enhance optimization-based power market models for European electricity markets. Design and implement LP and mixed-integer optimization models to simulate generation dispatch, storage operation, cross-border trading, and market-clearing mechanisms. Analyse power market fundamentals, including supply-demand dynamics, renewable integration, fuel markets, emissions costs, and transmission constraints. Conduct scenario analysis to evaluate market outcomes, asset profitability, policy impacts, and energy transition pathways. Translate complex model outputs into clear market insights and recommendations for internal stakeholders and clients. Improve model methodologies, assumptions, and analytical frameworks to enhance model accuracy, transparency, and performance. Work with large datasets and develop efficient data workflows to support model development and analysis. Collaborate with experts across power markets, renewable energy, economics, and policy to deliver high-quality research and market intelligence. Monitor developments in European energy markets, regulatory frameworks, and market design, assessing their impact on market participants and investment decisions. Support client engagements through presentations, bespoke analyses, technical discussions, and thought leadership. About You We are looking for a highly analytical and intellectually curious individual with a strong foundation in optimization, quantitative modelling, and power market analysis. You enjoy solving complex problems, building robust models, and generating insights that support strategic decision-making. Essential Skills and Qualifications A degree in Operations Research, Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Economics, Energy Systems, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline. Experience in electricity market analysis, power system modeling, or energy economics. Strong knowledge of optimization techniques, particularly linear programming (LP) and mixed-integer programming (MIP). Experience developing and implementing mathematical models for power systems, generation portfolios, storage assets, or electricity markets. Proficiency in Python and/or other programming languages used for optimization and quantitative analysis. Experience with optimization frameworks and solvers such as Gurobi, CPLEX, Xpress, Pyomo, or similar tools. Strong understanding of European power market fundamentals, market design, and price formation mechanisms. Ability to analyze complex datasets and communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and commercial audiences. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Why Join Us? Löpande kunskapsöverföring och samarbete är också viktiga delar av uppdraget. Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter Utveckla och vidareutveckla backend-tjänster med Java och Spring. Utveckla och underhålla frontendlösningar med Angular. Arbeta med automatiserad testning för att säkerställa kodkvalitet och systemstabilitet. Arbeta med system som använder relationsdatabaser. Bidra till kontinuerliga förbättringar av kod, testprocesser och utvecklingsmetoder. Vi arbetar med automatiska tester och systemverifikation, i form av enhetstester och Gherkin, för att säkerställa att våra IT-system kan uppdateras utan manuella ingrepp och med hög tillgänglighet. Vi siktar på en applikationsmiljö med containerteknik och Kubernetes i grunden. Vi söker systemutvecklare med ett skarpt systemtänk och en förståelse för skillnaden mellan det komplicerade och det komplexa. Du är nyfiken på både teknik och människorna som använder den - och drivs av att skapa lösningar som gör verklig skillnad. I den här rollen blir du en viktig spelare i vårt team och en central del av vår leverans. Du trivs både med hög abstraktions- och konkretiseringsgrad, ser värdet i teknisk innovation och kvalitet och uppskattar dialog med användare för att säkerställa att vi bygger rätt lösningar. Du kommer ingå i ett utvecklingsteam som ansvarar för våra operativa och kritiska järnvägssystem. Teamet arbetar i hela kedjan från krav, design till utveckling, förvaltning och drift. Tillsammans med teamet kommer du upprätthålla en hög leveransförmåga och kontinuerligt leverera nytta till användare och tågresenärer. Din huvudsakliga uppgift som systemutvecklare blir att utveckla och förvalta våra operativa järnvägssystem, så att de som leder tågen får relevant och pålitlig information - både idag och i framtiden. Vi arbetar utifrån en product roadmap i kombination med sprintar, ett arbetssätt där innovation är en självklar del av vardagen. Vi är ett prestigelöst gäng som hjälper varandra, och vi tror att trygga, glada och motiverade människor bygger de bästa produkterna. Hos oss blir du en del av resan att bygga ett internationellt mjukvarubolag med ambitionen att bli global marknadsledare. Tjänsten är placerad på vårt kontor centralt i Skellefteå, som också är vår sociala mötesplats med morgonfrukost, uppskattade fikapauser och gemensam torsdagslunch. items.desc: SIX drives the transformation of financial markets. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. DevOps Engineer Zurich | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8333 Are you excited by the opportunity to shape reliable, high-performing application platforms in a modern DevOps environment? Do you enjoy combining automation, operations, and innovation to build resilient services that are ready for production at scale? We are looking for an Application DevOps Engineer to help drive automated deployments, GitOps-based delivery, and infrastructure-as-code across cloud and on-premise environments. In this role, you will work closely with application development teams to ensure stable, low-latency, and secure operations while continuously improving deployment workflows, monitoring, and platform resilience. What You Will Do Design, implement, and maintain automated deployment workflows using Ansible and GitLab CI/CD. Define and continuously improve monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and runbooks to strengthen operational stability and incident response. Develop automation and integration scripts in PowerShell, Python, Perl, Bash, and CMD, and work with structured formats such as XML, JSON, and XSL where required. Operate and support monitoring and job scheduling platforms such as Patrol, Elastic, Grafana, and Airflow. Take operational ownership of production services throughout their lifecycle, including deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, maintenance, recovery, and continuous improvement. Participate in a regular on-call rotation for business-critical production systems, responding to incidents outside regular business hours when required, and taking ownership of troubleshooting, mitigation, escalation, and service restoration. Lead or actively contribute to incident response, root-cause analysis and post-incident reviews, turning lessons learned into monitoring, automation and reliability improvements. What You Bring Strong DevOps mindset with experience across the software delivery lifecycle and operating production systems. Strong scripting skills in Python and shell, along with practical experience using GitLab CI/CD; experience with Ansible and infrastructure-as-code is highly valued. Solid understanding of Linux, networking fundamentals Hands-on experience operating production systems and containerized application platforms such as Kubernetes or OpenShift, including deployment, monitoring and troubleshooting. Experience with monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Splunk, or similar tools in containerized environments. Clear communication skills with the ability to explain technical topics to both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong hands-on troubleshooting skills across applications, Linux/Windows, TCP/IP networking, DNS, firewalls, TLS and containerized platforms. Fluent English; German and/or Spanish are an advantage. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko at +34 917095993. For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. What We Offer Flexible Work Models We trust our employees and offer a work environment that is well-balanced, productive and fosters success. Personal Development You will benefit from a culture of continuous learning and feedback. Your personal growth is supported through an extensive learning offering. Agile Working Methods Whether through scrum or design thinking, we solve exciting tasks together in teams.

Work at KPMG Additional Benefits Successful employees need top-tier IT infrastructure and excellent mobility-not only at work but also in their private lives. Our lunch allowance supports your daily meals, and you benefit from additional discounts across various areas. Generous Parental Leave We offer generous parental leave: 18 weeks of maternity leave and 4 weeks of paternity leave, which can be taken within the first year after the birth or adoption of your child. Fathers may also apply for up to two additional months of unpaid leave. To further support families, we offer places in holiday camps for children aged 6 to 15 during school holidays in cooperation with MS Sports. In our inspiring environment, clear thinking and strong perspectives matter more than hierarchies-because good ideas always come first. In our various communities (KNOW, KNOW Young, Pride, and Internationals at KPMG), you can connect with like-minded colleagues. Values & Culture Health & Wellbeing We promote employee wellbeing with a strong focus on mental health. Our offerings range from practical self-care webinars to leadership training. items.desc: Developers at Conferma build and maintain the systems that enable billions of pounds of B2B payments each year. They have engineered connectivity to over 70 of the world's best commercial card partners, over 700 travel management companies and over 150 travel technology partners. They build the mobile, web and backend platforms that streamline payment processes, reduce admin and improve cashflow for our customers. You will form part of one of our development teams, working in an Agile environment to deliver innovative and robust solutions. We have ambitious plans and you will be delivering the software that will allow us to deliver upon these. We partner with some of the biggest names in finance and banking and this requires high standards. You will work with our product teams to deliver exciting new features and help us reach new markets worldwide. You will ensure our software is extensible, robust, performant and secure. A Software Developer at Conferma is responsible for: Collaborating within a multi-disciplined scrum team to deliver high-quality software. Translating product and architecture requirements into code, providing accurate time scales and delivery estimates. Ensuring the highest quality of code, adhering to industry best practices and coding standards. Maintaining a wide range of applications and services to support the Conferma platform. Delivering the highest quality code, adhering to company and industry best practices and meet coding standards. Maintaining a high proficiency in multiple development technologies, coding languages and disciplines. You have: Proven commercial experience and expertise delivering complex solutions in C#, SQL Server, ASP.Net, and RESTful APIs. Skills in other languages and technologies such as HTML, CSS, Angular, Bootstrap, jQuery, JavaScript, TypeScript, WCF, MVC, SOAP and VB.Net. A strong development background, with exposure to Microsoft .Net technologies and web application frameworks. Demonstrable knowledge of industry best practices, development processes and methodologies and experience applying these in a team environment. Experience in creating and cloud native applications using Azure, AWS or GCP. Proven experience contributing to the successful delivery of secure, scalable, and reliable solutions. Skills in using AI tools to solve problems, increase productivity and improve quality. You are: Passionate about software design and development. Focused on outcomes and collaborating with your team to deliver your objectives. A problem solver. You think clearly and quickly about issues. You have an eye for detail and identify critical information within complex scenarios. You use the relevant information to make a balanced judgment and follows through to action. Always learning. You maintain good communication in your team and with your stakeholders. You understand when to consult or involve others. You remain aware of the bigger picture and identify what is important. We have set out to provide a comprehensive benefits package that includes everything you would expect as well as providing flexibility for you and your family. Flexible Paid Time Off 33 days paid annual leave (including bank holidays) and the ability to purchase up to 10 more days holiday each year. Time off for life events such as moving house or getting married. An additional days' leave on or around your birthday. A confidential Employee Assistance program (EAP) available to all 24/7. Access a range of fantastic rewards (such as Cycle2Work, Gym Membership, Tech Scheme and discounted shopping and Cinema) via Conferma Rewards. Diversity Equity and Inclusion We are committed to ensuring equal opportunity for all. We intend that no job applicant or employee shall receive less favorable treatment, nor be disadvantaged by any conditions or requirements which are irrelevant.

items.card: Job Description ELUTIONS is a global provider of Operational Business Intelligence and AI-driven solutions that optimize a broad range of operational performance and business practices—including, but not limited to, resource efficiency and energy consumption, production, asset health and performance, and commercial and logistics operations—across asset-intensive industries, such as chemical, LNG, refining,
items.desc: Job Description ELUTIONS is a global provider of Operational Business Intelligence and AI-driven solutions that optimize a broad range of operational performance and business practices—including, but not limited to, resource efficiency and energy consumption, production, asset health and performance, and commercial and logistics operations—across asset-intensive industries, such as chemical, LNG, refining, manufacturing, and logistics sectors. With over 30 years of experience evolving from industrial automation and controls into advanced AI analytics, Elutions enables organizations to convert operational data into actionable insights that drive measurable business outcomes. At Elutions, engineers work closely with real operational systems and data, gaining hands-on experience in applying analytics to complex, asset-intensive environments. Team members are encouraged to continuously develop their technical and domain expertise while contributing to solutions that deliver measurable operational and business impact. The Engineering Team is seeking a motivated Domain Engineer with the ability to integrate optimization strategies into real-world applications through commissioning data analytics and implementation. This position is primarily in-person with intermittent travel. Both entry- and mid-level applicants are encouraged to apply, as on-the-job training and mentorship are provided to support professional growth and technical development. ** Entry Level Candidates are Encouraged to Apply!!!** General Responsibilities: Conduct research, data analytics, and prepare technical and performance reports. Develop an understanding of industrial process systems and operations, including (but not limited to) fluid mechanics, pumping systems, energy systems, wastewater treatment, desalination, and process operations across chemical, petroleum, LNG, and refinery sites. Analyze large operational datasets and apply data analytics and data-mining concepts to identify patterns, anomalies, and optimization opportunities. Read and understand asset performance curves and equipment specifications. Learn and implement technical hardware/software solutions for monitoring, analytics, and optimization. Apply data pattern recognition techniques and energy optimization methodologies to support operational improvement initiatives. Visualize data findings through dashboards including UI/UX design Provide second-tier customer support for deployed analytics and optimization solutions. Support customer engagement activities, including training sessions, software demonstrations, technical presentations, and any additional support. Have effective interpersonal skills, organization/prioritization and administrative skills Field travel as needed to perform site surveys, equipment installation/commissioning, and field support activities. Requirements: Master’s degree or Bachelor’s degree in either Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Industrial Engineering disciplines. Other high-level science or mathematics-based degrees will also be considered. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis (formulas, pivot tables, charts). Working knowledge of Python or a similar scripting language for data analysis. Basic understanding of data analytics and statistics, including trend analysis and anomaly detection. Ability to interpret process diagrams and technical documentation (PFDs, P&IDs, equipment data). Exposure to industrial or operational data systems (e.g., historians, DCS/SCADA) is preferred. Motivational Fit: The successful candidate will have the following attributes: Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly when collaborating with distributed or cross-functional teams. Ability to plan, organize, and prioritize work effectively across multiple tasks and timelines. Analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with a willingness to investigate complex technical challenges. Proactive mindset with the ability to take initiative and follow through on assignments. Flexibility and adaptability when working in dynamic technical and operational environments. Collaborative, team-oriented approach with a strong sense of accountability. High level of motivation and interest in continuous learning and professional development.

items.desc: We’re on a mission to make banking 10x better. At 10x Banking ("ten- ex banking") we’re transforming the financial industry with our cloud-native core banking platform. 10x's platform powers global banks and financial institutions including Chase UK, Old Mutual and Westpac. We offer a diverse, global community that thrives on innovation and collaboration. Tackling exciting challenges with the utmost integrity, we aim to make a positive impact through our work for our clients, their customers and the communities we work in. Be part of something bigger – join us and transform and industry. About the role As a Software Engineer at 10x, you are passionate about working with cutting-edge technologies, and bring deep technical knowledge and proven experience with data systems to deliver scalable solutions. This role offers deep design and implementation work on complex distributed systems, with exposure to all parts of the banking backend. In addition to the technical side of the role, you bring experience proven experience in the challenges of delivery of high-quality software in a high-performance and fast paced development environment. About you You will be keen to solve problems beyond the borders of your immediate team and demonstrate that you can think on multiple levels; from strategic and tactical to driving operational excellence and system availability. You are adept at reading code and designing and delivering systems that can exceed the exacting demands of our clients. Our tech stack: Java / Spring Boot ecosystem (and some Kotlin) Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, Terraform, AWS Kafka, Redis, PostgresSQL , Spring reactive, Quarkus Gradle, Jenkins, SonarQube, Checkmarx Requirements Ideally you will have... Solid Java software development skillset, ideally utilising Java 21 or higher and the Spring framework, in particular Spring Boot 3.x.x. A demonstrable Test-driven-development mindset, with good experience in writing unit, integration, and functional tests specifically for web services. Experience with Kafka and event-driven architecture. Prior experience working with SQL databases, strong knowledge around PostgreSQL A keen interest in Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment, experience with build tools such as Gradle / Maven. A keen interest on development lifecycle process, best practices and operating distributed cloud-based microservices. Strong knowledge of designing and building RESTful APIs. Experience building and deploying production level Microservices using Docker / Kubernetes / Helm. Proven experience developing JVM-based microservices running in Kubernetes, and taking them through all stages of the development life cycle. Proven experience building cloud-based solutions using AWS. Applicable knowledge of event streaming technologies (e.g. Kafka). Excellent communication skills, solid work ethic, and a strong desire to write production-quality code Good experience of delivering software in an Agile manner, working as part of a Scrum team. You write high quality, clean code that’s reliable, maintainable and performant. You can assess the technical trade-offs and deliverables needed to create optimal solutions. Benefits At 10x Banking, we believe in empowering you to get the job done! Our benefits are here to support you be the best you can be. 25 days of holiday in addition to Bank/Public Holidays (with the option to swap some public holidays for alternative dates such as Diwali or Eid) 1 day off on or around your birthday 4 wellbeing days (1 additional paid day off per quarter, aimed at supporting you to maintain your personal wellbeing) Remote enabled working: scroll down to see the office requirements for this role Enhanced parental policies, including time off for fertility treatment Regular social gatherings and affinity groups Work from anywhere outside your typical working location – up to 4 weeks a year Career progression and learning pathways 1 paid volunteering day a year Sabbatical leave Options pool Private health insurance, with the option to add your family Pension scheme Enhanced company sick pay Life Assurance Income Protection Subscription to Headspace wellbeing app Flexible benefits via salary sacrifice More about 10x We are driven by the belief that whatever we do as a business has to be done in the right way. Our three core values of: Transformation, Integrity and Impact support this. Discover what life is like at 10x over on Instagram and find out what the company is up to on LinkedIn. 10x Ways of Working We recognise that a better work/life balance can improve people’s motivation, performance and overall wellbeing. That’s why if there’s scope in the working day, we have flexibility around our core hours to do the things that matter to you. We also know some work is done better at home and some is done better in the office, and that a one-size-fits-all approach doesn’t enable high performance. That’s why 10x is a remote-enabled organisation and supports agile working. …
