items.desc: About the role Applications are invited for a Research Assistant in Chemistry to work under the supervision of Professor Justin Benesch for a period of up to 10 months. The project involves assisting in key research of the Benesch research group and is funded by the BBSRC. About you Applicants must hold an undergraduate science degree, prior to taking up your appointment. The research requires experience in optical microscopy, mass photometry and extensive knowledge of python as well as machine learning based data analysis to support our project. The post will be based in the Department of Chemistry, and Kavli Institute for Nanoscience Discovery, and is available from 1st of January 2027. The position is for 0,6FTE. Application process Applications for this vacancy are to be made online, and you will be required to upload a supporting statement and CV as part of your application. Your supporting statement must explain how you meet each of the selection criteria for the post using examples of your skills and experience. Certificates, references and research papers should not be provided at this stage. To apply for this role and for further details, including a job description and selection criteria, please click on the link below. The closing date for applications is 12.00 midday, Tuesday 10 November 2026. Interviews will be held as soon as possible thereafter. The University of Oxford and The Department of Chemistry are Silver Athena SWAN holders. Applications are particularly welcome from women and black and ethnic minority candidates, who are under-represented in Chemistry research posts in Oxford.

items.title: Software Engineer II - Java - Engine by Starling
items.card: you will: Contribute to our award winning platform and internal tooling Build new features and products from scratch in a configurable way Share your knowledge with those around you, contributing to our learning culture Own your projects, working in small teams across the bank to collaboratively deliver Aim for greatness in everything you do, staying curious and inquisitive Be part of a scaling team and organisation
items.desc: At Engine by Starling, we are on a mission to find and work with leading banks all around the world who have the ambition to build rapid growth businesses, on our technology. Engine is Starling's software-as-a-service (SaaS) business, the technology that was built to power Starling, and two years ago we split out as a separate business. Starling has seen exceptional growth and success, and a large part of that is down to the fact that we have built our own modern technology from the ground up. This SaaS technology platform is now available to banks and financial institutions all around the world, enabling them to benefit from the innovative digital features, and efficient back-office processes that has helped achieve Starling's success. As a company, everyone is expected to roll up their sleeves to help deliver great outcomes for our clients. We are an engineering led company and we’re looking for people who are will be excited by the potential for Engine’s technology to transform banking in different markets around the world. Our purpose is underpinned by five values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness. Hybrid Working We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Engine - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of our offices so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person. About Engineering at Engine by Starling - https://www.enginebystarling.com/ We’re looking for Backend Software Engineers to work on the Engine Platform and make our existing features work for banks all over the world as well as building new features from scratch that Starling hasn’t released in the UK market. Engine by Starling engineers are excited about helping us deliver new features, regardless of what their primary tech stack may be. Hear more from the team in some case studies, below, and our work with Women In Tech. Day in the Life of a Software Engineer Running a Backend Team Check out our shiny new Engineering careers page We are looking for engineers at all levels to join the team. We value people being engaged and caring about customers, caring about the code they write and the contribution they can make to banking around the world. People with a broad ability to apply themselves to a multitude of problems and challenges, who can work across teams do great things here at Engine, to continue changing banking for good. As an Engineer you will: Contribute to our award winning platform and internal tooling Build new features and products from scratch in a configurable way Share your knowledge with those around you, contributing to our learning culture Own your projects, working in small teams across the bank to collaboratively deliver Aim for greatness in everything you do, staying curious and inquisitive Be part of a scaling team and organisation as we change banking for good Requirements We’re open-minded when it comes to hiring and we care more about aptitude and attitude than specific experience or qualifications. We are very open about how we deliver software. For the most part we code in Java, but you need not be an expert when you join us! We believe in clean coding, simple solutions, automated testing and continuous deployment. If you care enough to find elegant solutions to difficult technical problems, we’d love to hear from you. We have built our entire banking platform in house and mostly in Java. We are looking for people who want to work on building the tooling that is used by our engineers on a daily basis. The main part of our Backend Tech Stack is listed below, we don't ask that you have experience in all of this, but if you do, that's great! Java, which makes up the majority of our backend codebase AWS & GCP - we're cloud-native Microservice based architecture Kubernetes (EKS) TeamCity for CI / CD (with multiple production releases per day) Terraform and Grafana Our Interview process Interviewing is a two way process and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational and we want to get the best from you, so come with questions and be curious. In general you can expect the below, following a chat with one of our Talent Team: Initial interview with an Engineer - ~45 minutes Take home technical test to be discussed in the next interview Technical interview with some Engineers - ~1.5 hours Final interview with our CTO / deputy CTO ~45 minutes Benefits 33 days holiday (including public holidays, which you can take when it works best for you) An extra day’s holiday for your birthday Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off 16 hours paid volunteering time a year Salary sacrifice, company enhanced pension scheme Life insurance at 4x your salary & group income protection Private Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include …

items.card: Associate Specialist – Data Solutions Supervision (Insurance, Funds and Corporate Authorisations) Department The Bermuda Monetary Authority (Authority or BMA) is seeking the services of a skilled and capable individual to work as an Associate Specialist in our Supervision (Insurance, Funds and Corporate Authorisations) Department within our Property and Casualty (P&C) Supervision Team. Reporting to the Deputy
items.desc: Associate Specialist – Data Solutions Supervision (Insurance, Funds and Corporate Authorisations) Department The Bermuda Monetary Authority (Authority or BMA) is seeking the services of a skilled and capable individual to work as an Associate Specialist in our Supervision (Insurance, Funds and Corporate Authorisations) Department within our Property and Casualty (P&C) Supervision Team. Reporting to the Deputy Director, the successful candidate will play a key role in enhancing supervisory effectiveness through advanced analytics, AI-driven insights and automation. This role focuses on transforming data into actionable intelligence to support risk-based supervision of insurance and reinsurance entities, with particular emphasis on innovation in analytical methodologies and decision support. This is a key role for the Authority and the post-holder will be responsible for, but not limited to: Designing and delivering advanced risk analytics frameworks to support supervisory decision-making across insurance sectors, mainly P&C Applying Machine Learning (ML), AI techniques, and predictive analytics to identify emerging risks, anomalies and market trends Developing decision intelligence tools, including interactive dashboards, risk indicators, and early warning systems Leading the design and delivery of high-quality data visualisations and dashboards (e.g., executive dashboards, supervisory monitoring tools) to communicate complex insights clearly and effectively Translating analytical outputs into intuitive visual narratives that support Senior Management and regulatory decisions Establishing and enhancing robust data validation and quality assurance processes, including automated validation checks, reconciliation routines and anomaly detection Ensuring the integrity, consistency and reliability of data used in supervisory analytics through data governance best practices Designing, building and maintaining automated data pipelines and reporting workflows, improving efficiency, scalability and auditability Developing and maintaining scalable analytical models for solvency, liquidity and capital adequacy assessment Leveraging AI-assisted analytics to streamline data processing, validation and interpretation of regulatory filings Supporting thematic and cross-sector risk reviews through data-driven insights, scenario analysis and visual reporting outputs Integrating structured and unstructured data into centralised dashboards and analytical platforms Collaborating with internal stakeholders to embed data visualisation standards and best practices across the department Preparing high-impact reports, presentations, and interactive dashboards to communicate findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. If required, supporting the Supervision Department in all supervisory processes, such as colleges, risk assessment and onsite visits Performing other related work and special projects as assigned by the Deputy Director, Director or Deputy Managing Director in accordance with competencies normally associated with the post This position requires a proven technical and business background; therefore, the post-holder must have: A master’s degree in actuarial science, data science, computer science, artificial intelligence, or a related quantitative field or a bachelor’s degree in actuarial science, data science, computer science, artificial intelligence and related quantitative field, plus qualifications, such as actuarial degrees or memberships, along with substantial relevant professional experience A minimum of seven (7) years relevant experience in advanced analytics, risk modelling, supervision or data science within financial services or a regulated environment Experience applying AI/ML techniques in real-world analytical or risk contexts Strong proficiency in Python, structured query language (SQL), and modern data/AI tooling (e.g., cloud analytics platforms, ML libraries) Experience with data automation, workflow orchestration, or analytics engineering Knowledge and demonstrated experience of insurance and insurance supervision (P&C) is essential Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills Ability to translate complex analytical outputs into clear, decision-oriented insights The Bermuda Monetary Authority is the integrated regulator of Bermuda’s financial services sector. We offer the opportunity for broad exposure to international regulatory issues, special projects and a variety of work experiences. If you are looking for a challenging opportunity in a team environment, we invite you to submit your application online via our ‘Careers at BMA’ page on www.bma.bm/vacancies. Applications for this position must be received no later than 06 November 2026. Bermuda Monetary Authority is an Equal Opportunity Employer BMA House | 43 Victoria Street, Hamilton HM 12 | careers@bma.bm | (441) 295 5278 Professionalism, Integrity, Accountability, Adaptability, Collaboration

items.desc: Job Description - Summary Royal London is a Financial Services company with a difference. As the UK’s largest mutual life, pensions and investment company, we’re owned by our members and work for their benefit, not for shareholder profits. We’ve grown rapidly and have been recognised as one of the UK’s top rated places to work. Today, Royal London has over £170 billion of assets under management, and around 4,000 employees working in five offices across the UK and Ireland. As an organisation, they have worked hard to become experts in specialist markets, building a trusted brand, with plenty of awards to show for it. We’ve worked hard to become experts in our specialist markets, building a trusted brand – and our teams have plenty of awards to show for it. Whatever team you’re interested in joining and whatever role you play, we’ll help you to make a difference. AMS is a global workforce solutions partner committed to creating inclusive, dynamic, and future-ready workplaces. We help organisations adapt, grow, and thrive in an ever-evolving world by building, shaping, and optimising diverse talent strategies. items.desc: ABOUT SPHERE Every breakthrough in trade infrastructure has followed the same pattern: reduce a transaction cost, expand the market. Containerization for goods. SWIFT for money. Stripe for payments. Compliance is one of the last and largest — and the hardest, because trade rules aren't data to be looked up. They're a complex adaptive system with 190+ sovereign jurisdictions, in different languages, changing constantly, reacting to each other. Sphere built the system that solves it. Our AI (TRAM) ingests global trade law, interprets it, resolves conflicts across jurisdictions, and produces compliance determinations more reliable than human experts. We handle the entire lifecycle — calculation, registration, filing, remittance — at millisecond latency with zero downtime. Backed by a16z and YC. $21M Series A, 30%+ month-over-month growth, customers include ElevenLabs, Replit, Deel, Runway, and Lovable. Small team, global surface area. Everyone owns a domain that would be a full team at a larger company. San Francisco, five days in office. The problem keeps compounding. Expanding into input tax, withholding, e-invoicing, tariffs — each multiplies the complexity. Tens of millions of transactions today, billions ahead. THE ROLE We are seeking an experienced indirect tax professional to train and continuously improve TRAM, our AI-driven tax engine. You will be the human check on the machine — reviewing TRAM's determinations and monitoring results at speed and volume, catching errors before they reach customers, and feeding structured findings back into the system so it gets smarter over time. This is a hands-on review role, not an advisory one: you'll spend most of your time working through TRAM's output, one determination at a time, with sharp accuracy and fast turnaround. Over time, you'll also help shape the tax taxonomy underpinning the system and support deeper research where TRAM's findings need a second opinion. WHAT YOU'LL DO Review and validate TRAM-generated determinations at high volume, with speed and precision Flag errors, edge cases, and recurring patterns, and translate them into clear, actionable feedback for TRAM to learn from Serve as the internal subject matter expert across indirect taxes (sales tax, VAT, GST) Conduct tax research when a determination needs deeper investigation or a judgment call Contribute to taxonomy design and definitions REQUIREMENTS 4+ years of experience in indirect taxation (sales tax, VAT, and/or GST) Strong understanding of indirect tax systems in the US and/or internationally, with willingness to expand into whichever you know less Proven ability to work quickly and accurately through high volumes of tax content without sacrificing attention to detail Global mindset - Sphere was never built as a US-centric product; we think internationally, and we want people who join us to do the same High attention to detail - one of our key values is ‘Sweating the details’ and it is essential in our business Strong communication skills - we work at an extremely fast pace and so clear, concise communication is essential Multitasking capabilities - a lot will be thrown at you and you’ll need to manage your time wisely Fluency in another widely spoken language, such as Spanish, French, Arabic, Portuguese, etc. NICE TO HAVE Hands-on experience with tax automation or compliance platforms WHO YOU ARE You'll thrive here if: You're a Dog. You've been underestimated, gone through struggle, and never stopped running. You have a chip on your shoulder and enormous drive. You look at Stripe, Deel, and Flexport all punting on compliance and think: good, that means the opportunity is ours. Hunger beats pedigree. Early stage is in your bones. You've built things where there's no playbook and nobody handing you the answer. You define the problem instead of waiting for instructions. You own it end to end. Give you a goal and you figure out your own path. Small team, global surface area — everyone owns a domain that would be a full team at a larger company. No one tells you how. You believe speed and accuracy are both possible. We're building a complex product that requires robustness and 100% uptime, and we have to build at our customers' pace. Move fast. Don't break things. Both. This won't be a fit if: You need structure handed to you or ambiguity feels draining rather than motivating You want to manage people more than own hard problems (we're a flat, experienced team — everyone builds) You're used to "good enough" shipping (small errors have outsized impact here)

items.desc: About the Organisation: Public Health Scotland launched 1st April 2020 as a national health board, employing around 1200 people, and with an annual budget of around £101 million. Public Health Scotland wants to see a Scotland where everybody thrives, a Scotland where life expectancy improves and the difference in life expectancy between our poorest and wealthiest areas gets smaller. The Post: Do you want to help shape how people access and understand public health information? At Public Health Scotland, we're dedicated to improving the health and wellbeing of our communities, and we're looking for a Content Designer to help us achieve that mission. As a Content Designer, you'll play a key role in creating, improving and managing content across our digital channels. Working as part of a scrum team, you'll use evidence, user needs and content design best practice to ensure our content is clear, accessible and easy to use. You'll collaborate with subject matter experts, designers, researchers and stakeholders across the organisation to help people find and understand the information they need. As a Content Designer, you will: Create, edit and improve content that meets user needs and supports Public Health Scotland's objectives. Apply user-centred design principles, evidence and insight to develop accessible and inclusive content. Work with colleagues across disciplines to design and continuously improve digital services and information. Help ensure content meets accessibility, plain language and quality standards. Use data, user research and feedback to identify opportunities for content improvement and measure impact. Contribute to content governance processes and support good content practices across the organisation. The Candidate: You will work across a range of Public Health Scotland’s digital services to design user-focused digital content, including the further development of our website (https://publichealthscotland.scot) and our intranet. Educated to degree level or equivalent, you will have demonstrable experience and skills in: Designing and delivering usable and accessible digital content and using content management systems (CMS). Using and interpreting web analytics and user feedback to review and improve digital content. Supporting the delivery of digital projects with excellent personal organisation skills including effective work planning. You will also have strong communication skills and ability to manage relationships with colleagues, service teams and partners. By submitting your application, you confirm that all answers are your own work, reflect your personal knowledge, skills and experience, and have not been solely produced by AI or similar technologies. Location and Working Pattern: The post is based in either Gyle Square, Edinburgh or Bothwell Street, Glasgow. We are currently hybrid working; therefore, you will be expected to spend time in both PHS offices as well as the option to work at home. The work pattern is Monday to Friday, 36 hours per week. PHS is a flexible employer, and we are happy to discuss requests for alternative working patterns. During times of public health emergency, or other urgent business need, you may be required on a temporary basis to work your normal contracted working hours over 7 days including weekends, in order to meet the needs of the service. It is a condition of this employment that you must live and remain a resident within the UK for the post in which you will be employed with PHS.  A Siemens Mobility Kft. K+F központjában, a XI. kerületi Infoparkban olyan projekteken dolgozunk, melyek biztosítják a zavartalan, fenntartható, megbízható és biztonságos közlekedést. 
 Tudj meg többet a cégünkről: www.siemens.hu/mobility 
 A projektről: a projekt célja, hogy nemzetközi ügyfeleink számára biztosítsuk az ország-specifikus biztonsági és engedélyezési követelmények teljesülését a vasúti járművek esetében. Munkád során korszerű mozdonyvezérlő, fék- és vonatvédelmi rendszerek funkcionális biztonságának elemzésével és igazolásával járulsz hozzá jövőnk fenntartható és biztonságos közlekedéséhez.
 A csapat tagjaként az alábbi feladatok várnak rád: 
 A mozdonyvezérlő rendszer, a fékrendszer és a vonatvédelmi rendszer működésének biztonsági szempontú értékelése.
 Szoros együttműködés rendszertervező, szoftverfejlesztő és egyéb mérnök kollégákkal a funkciók és műszaki megoldások megértése, elemzése, valamint a biztonsági követelményeknek megfelelő architektúrák kialakítása érdekében.
 Biztonsági elemzések készítése szoftver- és hardverkomponensekre, illetve teljes rendszerekre.
 FMEA, FMEDA, FTA és egyéb hazard elemzések végrehajtása.
 Safety Case dokumentációk elkészítése, amelyek a járművek tanúsításának alapvető előfeltételei.
 Részvétel a funkcionális biztonsági követelmények definiálásában, nyomon követésében és igazolásában.
 Kapcsolattartás nemzetközi projektszereplőkkel és szakmai partnerekkel.
 Te vagy az ideális jelölt, ha: 
 Műszaki vagy informatikai végzettséggel rendelkezel, vagy ezzel egyenértékű szakmai tapasztalatot szereztél.
 Legalább 3 év tapasztalatod van Functional Safety területen.
 Magabiztos, legalább B2 szintű angol nyelvtudással rendelkezel.
 Dolgoztál már szabványok által meghatározott környezetben, és ismered a funkcionális biztonsági folyamatokat.
 Magabiztosan alkalmazod a különböző biztonsági elemzési módszereket, például az FMEA/FMEDA, FTA és Hazard Analysis technikákat.
 Rendszerszintű gondolkodásmód jellemez, és könnyen átlátod az összetett funkcionális és architekturális összefüggéseket.
 Jó kommunikációs készséged van, és hatékonyan tudsz együttműködni különböző szakterületek szakértőivel.
 Egyaránt jól érzed magad önálló és csapatmunkát igénylő feladatokban.
 A pályázásod során előnyt jelenthet, ha: 
 Legalább B2 szintű német nyelvtudással rendelkezel szóban és írásban.
 Ismered a vasútiparban alkalmazott EN50126, EN50128, EN50129 és EN50657 szabványokat, vagy más releváns iparági szabványokat.
 Erős problémamegoldó és analitikus gondolkodásmód jellemez.
 Van tapasztalatod SAP, DOORS vagy Polarion rendszerek használatában.
 Dolgoztál már Isograph Reliability Workbench (Fault Tree Plus) eszközzel.
 Korábban részt vettél biztonságkritikus rendszerek fejlesztésében vagy tanúsításában.
 Mi az, amit mi biztosítunk? 
 Lehetőséget a projekttel kapcsolatos nemzetközi utazáson való részvételre.
 Családbarát munkahelyet, kötetlen munkaidővel, rugalmas hozzáállással.
 Stresszmentes környezetet, ahol nagy hangsúlyt kap a work-life balance.
 Fejlődési lehetőségeket, egyéni tréning kerettel, kidolgozott karrierúttal.
 Fontos számunkra az egészséged, többek közt élet- és egészségbiztosítással óvunk.
 Ergonomikus munkakörnyezetet biztosítunk számodra, ezzel is kényelmessé téve az irodai munkavégzést.
 A felsoroltak mellett egy több mint 20 elemből álló béren kívüli juttatási csomaggal várunk.

 About the Role 
 As a Mechanical Design Engineer, you will contribute directly to the development and lifecycle support of electric motors for demanding industrial applications. At our motor factory in Oradea, you will help shape platform architectures, improve product quality, and industrialize robust, scalable mechanical solutions. The role provides a high level of ownership and close collaboration within a global R&D network. 
 Your Responsibilities 
 Develop mechanical components and assemblies for electric motors; add platform elements and modular building blocks where required by the assignment, while meeting performance, cost, and manufacturability targets. 
 Lead improvements in product and component quality , conducting structured analyses (e.g., root cause, design reviews) and driving corrective actions. 
 Identify and implement cost‑reduction opportunities , ensuring an optimal balance between technical performance, manufacturability, and reliability. 
 Ensure Design for Manufacturing (DfM) and Design for Automation (DfA) in close cooperation with Manufacturing Technology and industrialization engineers. 
 Act as a key technical interface for suppliers, Sales, Product Management, and customer engineering teams, supporting technically demanding customer requirements. 
 Collaborate closely with Quality, Logistics, Manufacturing Technology, Manufacturing, Procurement, and Controlling throughout the product lifecycle. 
 Ensure complete documentation, validation, and release of mechanical designs in accordance with internal standards and industrial development processes. 
 Contribute to the platformization and standardization of mechanical solutions , ensuring reuse and scalability across the motor portfolio. 
 What You Bring 
 Education & Experience 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or Mechatronics (required). 
 Experience in motor design, rotating machinery, or precision mechanics (preferred). 
 Proven experience with mechanical CAD tools (mandatory); Siemens NX preferred. 
 Technical Skills 
 Strong knowledge of materials, thermal behavior and cooling, ISO GPS tolerancing, and mechanical design principles , plus a basic understanding of FEM. 
 Mandatory exposure to platform architectures and industrial product development standards (e.g., requirements engineering, validation processes, release cycles). 
 Familiarity with the following tools / environments: 
 NX for mechanical design
 Teamcenter for Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) 
 Polarion for requirements and process management
 Simcenter or comparable simulation tools 
 Languages 
 Romanian and English — fluent
 German — considered a plus
 Soft Skills 
 Strong ownership & accountability for product quality and deliverables. 
 Effective cross-functional communication with factory functions and global R&D teams. 
 Structured problem-solving mindset and hands-on approach. 
 Travel 
 10-20% travel expected after the initial onboarding and training phase (e.g., to Germany or suppliers). 
 What We Offer 
 Work directly in the motor factory , enabling fast feedback loops between design and manufacturing. 
 High customer involvement and exposure to demanding technical requirements. 
 Collaboration within international R&D and engineering networks . 
 Opportunity to take end-to-end ownership of mechanical components and assemblies throughout the product lifecycle.

You will work in a factory‑embedded R&D environment, combining electromagnetic design, simulation, data evaluation, and hands‑on collaboration with testing, production, and mechanical engineering. 
 The role requires strong physics understanding, data‑driven thinking, and motivation to deepen expertise in industrial motor development. It is ideal for an engineer with several years of experience who wants to strengthen both technical depth and cross‑functional collaboration skills. 
 Your Responsibilities
 Motor Design & Simulation
 Contribute to the electromagnetic and electrical design of servo, linear, and torque motors 
 Perform and interpret simulations (electromagnetic, thermal, loss, behavior under load) using internal or commercial tools 
 Support parameter sensitivity studies, robustness evaluations, and component trade‑offs 
 Data Analysis & Product Performance
 Analyze test data, measurement results, and production feedback to identify improvement potentials 
 Participate in root-cause analysis for electrical performance deviations or robustness issues 
 Support continuous improvement of motor characteristics, efficiency, and stability 
 Development Process & Cross-Functional Work 
 Contribute to requirements definition, documentation, and validation according to industrial development standards 
 Collaborate closely with mechanical engineering, manufacturing technology, production, and quality to ensure DfM/DfA alignment 
 Assist in the introduction of platform elements, variant development, and lifecycle enhancements 
 What You Bring
 Education & Experience
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, Mechatronics, or similar (mandatory) 
 Experience in electric motor design (practical project or industry exposure required) 
 Several years of engineering experience — mid-level—suitable for handling independent tasks with support available when needed 
 Technical Skills
 Solid understanding of electromagnetic principles, motor physics, materials, and losses 
 Experience with electromagnetic and thermal simulations (Simcenter, Ansys, JMAG, MotorSolve or similar tools) 
 Strong data affinity: ability to evaluate measurements, trends, and physical correlations 
 Familiarity with:
 Teamcenter (PLM)
 Polarion (requirements/processes)
 Simcenter environments
 Understanding of motor testing and interpretation of characteristic curves 
 Soft Skills
 Analytical, physics‑driven problem solver 
 Collaborative and comfortable working in a factory + R&D hybrid setup 
 Clear communicator with an interest in learning and deepening expertise over time 
 Structured, reliable, and proactive
 Languages
 Romanian & English — fluent
 German — an advantage
 What We Offer
 A role embedded directly in the motor factory, enabling rapid learning and fast feedback cycles 
 Exposure to electric motor technologies 
 Opportunity to develop strong simulation and data analysis skills 
 Collaboration with global R&D teams and visibility across international projects 
 A supportive environment for technical growth and long-term career development

items.desc: Job description Want to improve one of Client's most strategic AI platforms through data-driven experimentation and measurable model improvements? You & your role As an AI Engineer - RAG Platform, you are responsible for continuously improving the quality, accuracy and effectiveness of Client's internal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) platform. You work at the intersection of Information Retrieval, Data Science and Software Engineering. Rather than building AI applications or platform infrastructure, your primary responsibility is improving the performance of the RAG system itself. The RAG platform serves thousands of users across Client and acts as a foundation for multiple AI-powered products. Your focus is understanding where and why the system underperforms, designing experiments to validate improvements and translating insights into measurable production outcomes. You contribute across the entire improvement lifecycle, from failure analysis and hypothesis generation to evaluation, implementation and monitoring. You leverage user feedback, retrieval metrics, evaluation datasets and production telemetry to continuously increase answer quality and user trust. This role is designed for a highly analytical and hands-on specialist who wants to deepen their expertise in retrieval systems, evaluation methodologies and applied AI rather than moving towards people management or generic product development. You will work closely with Software Engineers, Platform Engineers, Data Scientists and Product Managers, while acting as the driving force behind the continuous improvement of Client's RAG capabilities. Key responsibilities Drive continuous RAG model improvement Improve retrieval performance, answer quality and overall user experience through experimentation, analysis and optimization. Build evaluation and measurement capabilities Develop automated frameworks that measure RAG quality, identify regressions and provide actionable insights for future improvements. Turn insights into production outcomes Translate data analysis and experimentation results into scalable, maintainable engineering solutions that deliver measurable business value. Together we achieve more than alone The RAG platform is not a research project. It is a production product that must continuously improve. You will join a team of experienced engineers who are building and operating critical AI capabilities within Client. Success in this role comes from combining scientific rigor with engineering excellence. We value people who challenge assumptions, validate ideas through data and continuously raise the quality bar. You & your talent We are looking for someone who enjoys solving hard problems and is driven by measurable outcomes. Someone who is equally comfortable discussing statistical significance, retrieval metrics and system architecture. You take ownership of results rather than activities. You are naturally curious, analytical and passionate about improving complex systems. Mandatory skills Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG); Large Language Models (LLMs); Python; Databricks; Evaluation frameworks for GenAI systems; Embedding models; Prompt optimization; Data pipelines and workflow automation; CI/CD practices; Azure. Nice to have Experience with fine-tuning language models; Experience with ranking and retrieval systems; Experience with AI observability and monitoring; Experience working with large-scale production AI platforms; Knowledge of synthetic evaluation datasets and benchmark creation. Knowledge and experience Master's degree or equivalent academic level in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a related field; At least 3 years of relevant experience in machine learning, applied AI or data science; Demonstrable experience improving production-grade RAG systems or advanced retrieval-based AI solutions; Experience designing evaluation methodologies and quality metrics; Strong track record of converting analyses into automated production solutions; Experience working with large datasets and complex distributed environments; Ability to communicate findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders; Proficiency in English, both written and spoken

items.desc: About The Company Royal Mail is one of the United Kingdom’s most recognised and complex organisations, connecting people and businesses across the country. The company is investing in data, advanced analytics and artificial intelligence to transform its operations, improve customer experiences and identify new opportunities for growth. Its Data Insights team works across the business to turn information into practical insights and measurable outcomes. By bringing together data scientists, analysts, engineers and business leaders, Royal Mail is building stronger data-driven decision-making capabilities at national scale. About The Role Royal Mail is seeking a Senior Data Scientist to join its Data Insights team in Farringdon on a permanent, full-time basis. In this influential role, you will lead the development and delivery of data science solutions that address significant business challenges. You will work with large and complex datasets, applying machine learning, statistics, optimisation and AI to support better decisions across the organisation. You will guide projects from initial exploration and experimentation through proof of concept, evaluation and handover to production or operational teams. Working with stakeholders across technical and business functions, you will ensure that analytical work is relevant, robust and connected to clear business objectives. This is an opportunity to contribute to Royal Mail’s transformation while working on varied, real-world problems and modern data technologies. Qualifications You will have a Master’s degree, or equivalent practical experience, in a quantitative discipline such as data science, statistics, mathematics, computer science, physics or engineering. You should bring experience delivering end-to-end data science solutions, from data exploration and modelling through to deployment and monitoring. Strong knowledge of statistical modelling, machine learning and optimisation is essential, along with experience applying AI technologies and modern foundation models to business problems or workflow improvements. You will have expertise in Python and commonly used data science and machine learning libraries, as well as strong SQL skills. Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS or Google Cloud is required. Familiarity with software engineering and reproducible data science practices—including version control, testing and experiment tracking—is also important. You will communicate technical concepts clearly and translate findings into useful business recommendations. Responsibilities Lead the design, development and delivery of data science solutions that generate measurable business value. Analyse complex datasets to uncover patterns, identify opportunities and inform strategic decisions. Select and apply suitable machine learning, statistical, optimisation and AI approaches to address business needs. Design experiments, test hypotheses and develop evidence-based recommendations. Build and assess proof-of-concepts, supporting effective transition into production and operational environments. Present findings to technical and non-technical audiences, explaining methods, limitations and implications clearly. Contribute to data science standards, innovation and continuous improvement, and represent Royal Mail’s capabilities through presentations, reports and knowledge sharing. Benefits The role offers a competitive salary, car allowance, healthcare and the potential to earn an annual bonus of up to 18%. You will receive 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays, with entitlement increasing with service. Royal Mail provides access to the UK’s Collective Defined Contribution pension scheme, with employer contributions of over 12%, flexible options to increase savings and a guaranteed retirement lump sum. Pension eligibility and enrolment are subject to the applicable service requirements. Additional benefits include family-friendly support, enhanced parental leave options, company sick pay, funded dental insurance and periodic health assessments for eligible permanent employees. A benefits account offers access to more than 800 retail offers and other employer-provided or voluntary benefits. You and your family can also access wellbeing services and tools covering physical and mental health, financial guidance and social support. Equal Opportunity Royal Mail values different backgrounds and experiences. You are encouraged to apply even if your experience does not match every listed criterion, provided you can demonstrate relevant skills. The selection process includes a face-to-face or virtual interview. Applications may close early if sufficient candidates apply, so submit your application promptly.

Ensure production reliability (latency, failure modes, fallbacks). Work directly with product and founders on what to build and why. What This Role Is Really About Most teams fail because they don’t know what “good output” means, lack proper evals, iterate randomly, or overuse agents. Your job is to fix that. You will turn vague user problems into structured AI systems with measurable performance that improve every week. What You Need to Be Excellent At Shipping Real LLM Systems Evaluation-Driven Development Debugging Complex Failures Speed of Iteration Strong Technical Judgment What We Don’t Care About Number of years of experience. Whether you’ve used a specific framework. Fancy research credentials. If you can build, debug, and improve real systems, you’re a fit. What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days) A clear evaluation framework established for core use cases. Measurable, quantitative improvement in output quality. Faster iteration cycles across the team. Significantly reduced hallucinations and failure modes. Robust, scalable system architecture decisions. Tech Stack (Context, Not Strict Requirements) Language/Backend: Python (FastAPI) Database: Postgres Cloud: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Orchestration: LangGraph / LangChain (evolving) Observability: PostHog (analytics), Langfuse (LLM tracing) LLM Infrastructure: Azure OpenAI / Multi-provider APIs

items.desc: About RWS RWS is a global leader in content, translation, and intellectual property services. With more than 60 years of experience, RWS helps the world’s top brands grow by ensuring they are understood anywhere, in any language. The company combines proprietary technology with deep human expertise to deliver high-quality, compliant, and scalable solutions across industries such as life sciences, technology, finance, and legal. About Train AI Training or fine-tuning artificial intelligence (AI) requires data. LOTS of data. However, not just any data will do – our clients need responsible AI data that’s targeted, accurate and reliable to ensure machine learning (ML) success. But preparing AI training data is a monumental task that can take up the vast majority of AI project time, leaving AI teams with precious little time to focus on developing, deploying and evaluating ML models. TrainAI by RWS helps our clients address this challenge head-on. With a seamless blend of technological understanding and human intelligence, TrainAI provides complete, end-to-end data collection and content generation, data annotation or labelling, human-in-the-loop data validation and generative AI data services for all types of AI, in any language, at any scale, based on the principles of responsible AI. Today, TrainAI supports four of the world’s top five technology companies, enhancing the performance of their generative AI by providing services such as prompt engineering, response refinement and red teaming with locale-specific domain experts across a broad range of topic areas and educational levels. Job Purpose We’re looking for a mid-level product focused engineer to join our team. You'll own features and small products end-to-end—design, build, ship, iterate—using AI tools as your primary means of execution. You’ll be working with AI agents but bringing your own product judgment to every decision. We move fast because AI multiplies what one engineer can do, and this role is built for that. items.desc: Role: Data Scientist Location: Utrecht, Netherlands (Hybrid) Project Type: Contract Experience: Strong hands-on experience with GenAI, LLM-based applications, and RAG systems Working Arrangement: Hybrid, with Thursday as a mandatory office day Language: English We are looking for a Data Scientist specialising in GenAI and Chatbot optimization . In this role, you will work at the intersection of data science, engineering, and product development to improve the quality, accuracy, and effectiveness of AI-powered chatbot systems. Rather than developing foundation models, your primary focus will be on understanding chatbot behaviour, identifying performance gaps, and translating your findings into practical improvements. You will investigate questions such as: Why is the chatbot not delivering the expected results? Is the issue related to missing context, retrieval quality, prompt design, or data structure? You will assess existing solutions against state-of-the-art GenAI approaches and drive improvements across retrieval, generation, reasoning loops, tool calling, and other relevant GenAI capabilities. This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong, analytical professional who enjoys debugging AI behaviour and making AI applications work more effectively in real-world scenarios. items.desc: Arbetsuppgifter Institutionen för tillämpad fysik söker en forskare inom teoretisk och beräkningsbaserad magnetism och spinntronik. Anställningen är placerad i en internationellt framstående forskargrupp vid AlbaNova universitetscentrum som studerar magnetiska material och spinnfenomen med avancerade beräkningsmetoder. Du kommer att bedriva forskning om magnetiska och spinntroniska fenomen i kvantmaterial och lågdimensionella system, exempelvis spinn- och magnontransport, fundamentala magnetiska växelverkningar och topologiska spinntexturer i tvådimensionella magneter, antiferromagneter och altermagneter. Arbetet omfattar utveckling och tillämpning av first principles-beräkningar, atomistisk spinndynamik och mikromagnetiska simuleringar, liksom utveckling av automatiserade och AI-stödda beräkningsflöden för storskaliga materialstudier. I arbetsuppgifterna ingår även att handleda doktorander och postdoktorer, samverka med experimentella och teoretiska forskargrupper i Sverige och internationellt, aktivt söka extern forskningsfinansiering samt bidra till gruppens och institutionens vetenskapliga miljö. Viss undervisning och pedagogisk meritering kan ingå i arbetsuppgifterna. Kvalifikationer Krav Avlagd doktorsexamen eller utländsk examen som bedöms motsvara en doktorsexamen. Dokumenterad vetenskaplig skicklighet inom teoretisk eller beräkningsbaserad kondenserade materiens fysik med inriktning mot magnetism och spinntronik, visad genom publikationer i internationellt ledande vetenskapliga tidskrifter. Mycket god erfarenhet av elektronstrukturberäkningar (first principles/DFT) samt av simulering av magnetiska material och deras egenskaper. Mycket goda kunskaper i engelska i tal och skrift, då arbetet bedrivs i en internationell forskningsmiljö. Som person är du självständig och drivande och har mycket god samarbetsförmåga. Meriterande Dokumenterad erfarenhet av forskning om fundamentala magnetiska växelverkningar, exempelvis Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya-växelverkan, magnetisk anisotropi och utbytesväxelverkan, samt deras betydelse för topologisk magnetism. Erfarenhet av studier av spinn- och magnontransport i tvådimensionella magneter, van der Waals-material, antiferromagneter eller altermagneter. Erfarenhet av atomistisk spinndynamik och mikromagnetiska simuleringar. Erfarenhet av maskininlärning/AI och av att utveckla automatiserade arbetsflöden för storskaliga beräkningar på högpresterande datorresurser. Dokumenterad förmåga att attrahera extern forskningsfinansiering i konkurrens samt vetenskapliga priser och utmärkelser. Pedagogisk förmåga samt erfarenhet av handledning av doktorander eller postdoktorer. Förmåga att verka för att forskningsresultat kommer till nytta samt att informera om forskning och utvecklingsarbete. Erfarenhet av att utveckla och leda verksamhet och personal. Kunskap om mångfalds- och likabehandlingsfrågor med särskilt fokus på jämställdhet. Vi kommer lägga stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper. Bli en del av KTH KTH formar framtiden genom utbildning, forskning och innovation. Som ett ledande internationellt tekniskt universitet spelar vi en aktiv roll i att driva och medverka i omställningen till ett hållbart samhälle. Här erbjuds du möjligheten att växa och utvecklas på en kreativ och dynamisk arbetsplats med goda arbetsvillkor och förmåner. Jämställdhet, mångfald och lika villkor är en kvalitetsfråga och en självklar del av KTH:s värdegrund som universitet och statlig myndighet. Läs mer om våra förmåner och hur det är att arbeta och utvecklas på KTH. Fackliga representanter Kontaktuppgifter till fackliga representanter. Ansökan Du ansöker via KTH:s rekryteringssystem. Du som sökande har huvudansvaret för att din ansökan är komplett när den skickas in. Ansökan ska innehålla: CV inklusive relevant yrkeserfarenhet och kunskap. Kopia av examensbevis och betyg från dina tidigare universitetsstudier. Översättningar till engelska eller svenska om de ursprungliga dokumenten inte utfärdas på något av dessa språk. Kortfattad redogörelse för varför du vill bedriva forskning, dina akademiska intressen och hur de relaterar till dina tidigare studier och framtida mål. max 2 sidor lång. Ansökan ska vara KTH tillhanda senast sista ansökningsdagen vid midnatt, CET/CEST (CentralEuropean Time/Central European Summer Time). Om anställningen Anställningen gäller tillsvidare enligt avtal. Anställningen inleds med sex månaders provanställning. Övrigt För information om behandling av personuppgifter i samband med rekrytering. Det kan förekomma att en anställning hos KTH är placerad i säkerhetsklass. Om så är fallet för just denna anställning görs en säkerhetsprövning av sökande i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) efter samtycke. I dessa fall är en förutsättning för anställning att sökande blir godkänd efter säkerhetsprövning. Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av platsannonser.

items.desc: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About The Role As a Multi-Agents Mission Planning Engineer, you’ll design and implement the Guidance, Navigation, and Control algorithms that translate high-level mission goals into actionable guidance for autonomous robots and multi-agent systems. You’ll bridge cutting-edge research and field-ready autonomy, ensuring our systems are both intelligent and predictable in live operations. Responsibilities Design algorithms that decompose high-level missions into structured, solvable guidance tasks for autonomous robots. Develop and optimize mission and path-planning frameworks for autonomous systems. Build scalable backend integrations for mission guidance and execution. Run simulations and validation campaigns to assess autonomy consistency across diverse mission types. Partner with AI/ML, backend, and product teams to ensure algorithms are efficient, testable, and deployable in real-time environment Candidate Requirements Education: Ph.D. or M.S. in Aerospace Engineering, Robotics, Applied Math, AI, or related field. A PhD in the field of multi-agent systems or reinforcement learning is a huge plus. Experience designing and deploying mission- or path-planning algorithms in aerospace, defense, or robotics is a huge plus Technical Skills: Strong coding in Python and C++ . Deep understanding of autonomous decision-making, multi-agent coordination, and simulation frameworks. Mindset: Ability to move from research prototype to production-grade system Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

items.desc: Join us at EIT: At the Ellison Institute of Technology (EIT), we're on a mission to translate scientific discovery into real world impact. We bring together visionary scientists, technologists, engineers, researchers, educators and innovators to tackle humanity's greatest challenges in four transformative areas: Health, Medical Science & Generative Biology Food Security & Sustainable Agriculture Climate Change & Managing CO₂ Artificial Intelligence & Robotics This is ambitious work - work that demands curiosity, courage, and a relentless drive to make a difference. At EIT, you'll join a community built on excellence, innovation, tenacity, trust, and collaboration, where bold ideas become real-world breakthroughs. Together, we push boundaries, embrace complexity, and create solutions to scale ideas from lab to society. Explore more at www.eit.org. Welcome to the Plant Biology Institute: The Plant Biology Institute, headed by Professor Steve Kelly, is a key part of the Ellison Institute of Technology (EIT) Oxford. The institute aims to develop impactful and commercially sustainable solutions for improving global food production and planetary health through pioneering plant science research. The Plant Biology Institute will unite world-class researchers who are focused on expanding the frontiers of plant science. Our research is focused on enhancing our ability to feed the planet while simultaneously improving the climate and ecosystem outcomes of food production. By embedding cutting-edge plant science research within an organisation that is focused on solving global challenges at scale, we aim to accelerate the timeline from discovery to global impact. Areas of exploration include: Improved plant productivity, both indoors and outside Reduced reliance on inputs including water, fertilisers, pesticides, and herbicides. Novel decarbonised plant-based production platforms for food and medicines Advanced technologies that speed up discovery and deployment in plants. Researchers will have access to state-of-the-art laboratory and plant growth facilities and have opportunities to collaborate with experts at the forefront of research on AI, automation, and generative biology across the EIT ecosystem. They will also work with global leaders in market development, commercialisation, and impact creation. The Plant Biology Institute has long-term substantial funding to support the unique scale and ambition of its vision. Your Role: We are seeking a highly motivated Computational Biologist to join the Bioinformatics platform team, which builds computational tools for plant biology in close collaboration with the phenotyping platform and research teams. The successful candidate will work at the intersection of multi-omic analysis and software development, to accelerate plant science research. By developing and implementing robust data analysis pipelines, interactive visualisation tools, and preparing inputs for agentic workflows, your work will directly shape how we make data driven decisions to accelerate plant science research. The role will require working closely with bioinformaticians, research scientists and AI engineers, to design and deliver enterprise-level analytical approaches that meet the evolving needs of the institute. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in statistics, data analysis and visualization and the ability to translate complex, multi-omic datasets into clear, actionable insights that inform research and decision-making across the institute. Your Responsibilities: Collaborate closely with scientific teams to translate biological questions into computational approaches and develop experimentally testable hypotheses that guide experimental design Prepare multi-omics and imaging datasets for model ingestions, ensuring data quality and consistent annotation across modalities. Analyse and integrate omics data sets, including transcriptomics, metabolomics, and proteomics, to inform plant trait engineering strategies Develop computational pipelines for image segmentation, feature extraction and phenotyping across biological scales, including microscopy, growth chamber or in-field data Integrate image-derived phenotypes with omics data to link plant traits with molecular signatures and generate biological insights. items.desc: We are looking for a highly motivated R&D Wafer-to-Wafer (W2W) Bonding Engineer to strengthen the High Precision Bonding team. What you will do In this role, you will help develop the next generation of wafer bonding technologies that enable future logic, memory, photonic, RF and heterogeneous integration applications. The position combines fundamental process understanding, advanced data analysis, hands-on experimentation in the cleanroom, and close collaboration with equipment suppliers. Wafer-to-wafer bonding is becoming a key enabling technology for future semiconductor devices. Advanced integration schemes such as CFETs, backside power delivery networks, advanced memory architectures, photonic integration and 3D system integration require bonding solutions that push overlay accuracy, wafer distortion control and process stability beyond today's manufacturing capabilities. These challenges demand not only innovative process development but also a deep understanding of the bonding equipment and the physics governing the bonding process. As a member of the High Precision Bonding team, you will develop, optimize and understand advanced dielectric, metallic and hybrid bonding processes. You will combine hands-on process development with detailed metrology and data analysis to understand the interaction between process conditions, wafer characteristics and equipment behaviour. A significant part of your work will take place in imec's cleanroom, where you will execute experiments, operate advanced bonding tools and characterize bonding performance. You will work closely with equipment suppliers to understand tool limitations, evaluate new functionalities, troubleshoot complex issues and help define future generations of bonding equipment. You will collaborate with integration engineers, operations teams, hardware experts, suppliers and industrial partners in a multidisciplinary and international environment. As an R&D Wafer-to-Wafer Bonding Engineer, you will: Develop and optimize advanced wafer-to-wafer bonding processes. Design, execute and analyse experiments to understand process sensitivities, bonding mechanisms and equipment behaviour. Analyse large datasets from bonding and metrology tools, including overlay measurements, wafer distortion maps, bond-wave data, void inspection results and bond quality metrics. Develop data-driven methodologies to improve bonding performance, process robustness and manufacturability. Build a deep understanding of the bonding equipment, including alignment systems, wafer handling, chucking concepts, bonding environments and process monitoring capabilities. Work closely with equipment suppliers to investigate technical challenges, improve tool performance and define future equipment capabilities. Translate process and equipment insights into practical solutions that improve overlay performance, wafer distortion control, throughput and process stability. Drive process maturity from exploratory research towards robust pilot-line implementation. You will be expected to take a significant hands-on role within the cleanroom. You will share the ownership of the bonding process with your direct colleagues, and you will have to improve the maturity level of the bonding process. You will report progress, results, and opportunities to various organizational levels both internally as well as to customers, suppliers and partners. Collaborate closely with integration engineers, process and hardware engineering teams to enable successful technology development. What we do for you We offer you the opportunity to join one of the world’s premier research centers in nanotechnology at its headquarters in Leuven, Belgium. With your talent, passion and expertise, you’ll become part of a team that makes the impossible possible. Together, we shape the technology that will determine the society of tomorrow. We are committed to being an inclusive employer and proud of our open, multicultural, and informal working environment with ample possibilities to take initiative and show responsibility. We commit to supporting and guiding you in this process; not only with words but also with tangible actions. Through imec.academy, 'our corporate university', we actively invest in your development to further your technical and personal growth. We are aware that your valuable contribution makes imec a top player in its field. Your energy and commitment are therefore appreciated by means of a market appropriate salary with many fringe benefits. Who you are You hold a PhD in Physics, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or a related field. You combine strong scientific curiosity with a practical engineering mindset and are motivated to develop a fundamental understanding of advanced bonding processes and equipment behaviour. You enjoy translating scientific insights into process improvements and technology innovations. You are eager to work hands-on in a semiconductor …

items.desc: Das Institut für angewandte Künstliche Intelligenz und Robotik (IKR) der Hochschule für angewandte Wissenschaften Kempten sucht zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt nach einer engagierten Person für die Position als Wissenschaftliche Mitarbeiterin oder Wissenschaftlicher Mitarbeiter (w/m/d) Robotik – Steuerungssoftware und Konstruktion Arbeitsort: Marktoberdorf Das Forschungsinstitut IKR ist ein von der bayerischen Staatsregierung gefördertes Technologietransferzentrum und beschäftigt sich mit innovativen Lösungen für die Automatisierung auf Basis von Künstlicher Intelligenz und Robotik. Neben Anwendungen in der Produktion entwickelt das IKR roboterbasierte Lösungen in den Feldern Service und Agrartechnik. Im Verbundprojekt DraAuf – Drohnengestützte automatisierte Aufforstung , gefördert im Rahmen der KI-Leuchttürme für den Natürlichen Klimaschutz, entwickelt das IKR gemeinsam mit der Hochschule München und WOOD.IN.VISION ein System zur Pflanzung von Containersetzlingen in schwer zugänglichen Hanglagen. Eine Schwerlastdrohne trägt einen Leichtbaupflanzroboter am Seil zu Pflanzstellen. Dort bereitet der Roboter den Boden vor, bohrt ein Pflanzloch und setzt den Setzling autonom ein. Ihre Aufgaben Sie entwickeln gemeinsam die Steuerungssoftware des Pflanzroboters von der Hardwareansteuerung über Kommunikationsschnittstellen bis zur Integration von KI-Bildsegmentierungen und Sicherheitslogik. Sie optimieren die Bauteile des Pflanzroboters im CAD und entwickeln sie mit Fokus auf Leichtbau und Robustheit weiter, u. a. mit Faserverbundwerkstoffen und additiver Fertigung. Sie helfen beim Aufbau des Prototyps und bei Feldtests. Sie erfassen, protokollieren und werten Prozessdaten aus und schaffen damit die Grundlage für Dokumentation und Optimierung. Sie veröffentlichen Forschungsergebnisse auf Konferenzen und in Fachmagazinen. Die Hochschule Kempten setzt sich aktiv für Gleichstellung, Diversität und die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie ein. Seit 2020 sind wir zudem stolzes Mitglied der Charta der Vielfalt. Im Rahmen des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses besteht Gelegenheit zur Erbringung zusätzlicher wissenschaftlicher Leistungen durch selbständige Forschung sowie zum Erwerb von Erfahrungen in der Lehre. Im Rahmen der Dienstaufgaben wird daher ein Zeitanteil von mindestens einem Drittel der vertraglich vereinbarten Arbeitszeit zur eigenen wissenschaftlichen Arbeit gewährt. Das Aufgabengebiet umfasst Forschung im Bereich kausales maschinelles Lernen, Deep Learning und Softwareentwicklung. Auch wird eine Beteiligung an den Forschungsprojekten der Professur erwartet. Darüber hinaus sind in der ersten Phase Lehrveranstaltungen im Umfang von 4 LVS zu erbringen. Ihr Profil Abschluss eines den Aufgaben entsprechenden Hochschulstudiums, Promotion. Eine exzellent abgeschlossene Promotion im Bereich Statistik, Ökonometrie oder Maschinelles Lernen wird erwartet. Insbesondere sollen vertiefte Kenntnisse im Bereich Double Machine Learning, Deep Learning und Programmierung vorliegen. Auch sollen erste Publikationen und Working Paper vorliegen, die das Potenzial zur Veröffentlichung in referierten Fachzeitschriften haben. Darüber hinaus sind exzellente Kenntnisse in statistischer Programmierung (R oder Python) Einstellungsvoraussetzung. Auch sollte einschlägige Lehrerfahrung vorhanden sein. Durch Forschung und Lehre, Bildung und Wissenstransfer auf höchstem Niveau fördern wir die Entwicklung einer neuen Generation verantwortungsbewusster Weltbürger:innen, die den globalen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit gewachsen ist. Mit unserem Leitmotiv „Innovating and Cooperating for a Sustainable Future in a Digital Age“ gestalten wir die Zusammenarbeit mit wissenschaftlichen und außerwissenschaftlichen Partnerinstitutionen in der Metropolregion Hamburg und weltweit. Wir laden Sie ein, Teil unserer Gemeinschaft zu werden, um gemeinsam mit uns einen nachhaltigen und digitalen Wandel für eine dynamische und pluralistische Gesellschaft zu gestalten. Die Universität Hamburg engagiert sich für Chancengerechtigkeit. Vielfalt bereichert unser universitäres Leben in Studium, Forschung, Lehre, Bildung und am Arbeitsplatz. Wir begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, geschlechtlicher Identität, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Alter, Religion oder Weltanschauung sowie Behinderung oder Erkrankung. Die Universität Hamburg strebt eine Erhöhung des Frauenanteils an und bittet qualifizierte Wissenschaftlerinnen ausdrücklich um ihre Bewerbung. Schwerbehinderte und ihnen gleichgestellte behinderte Menschen haben Vorrang vor gesetzlich nicht bevorrechtigten bewerbenden Personen gleicher Eignung, Befähigung und fachlicher Leistung. Hinweis zur Regelanfrage nach 34a Hamburgisches Sicherheitsüberprüfungsgesetz: Die Dienststelle stellt für die im Auswahlverfahren ausgewählte Person eine Anfrage beim Landesamt für Verfassungsschutz über dort vorliegende Erkenntnisse, wenn dafür die gesetzlichen Voraussetzungen vorliegen (Informationen zur Regelanfrage und Datenschutzhinweise).

items.desc: Die Technische Universität Clausthal ist eine forschungsstarke Universität mit hoher nationaler und internationaler Vernetzung. Die rund 80 Professor:innen, 1.100 Beschäftigten sowie 3.000 Studierenden genießen kurze Wege, einen persönlichen Umgang und die faszinierende Landschaft inmitten des UNESCO-Welterbes Harz. Die TU Clausthal ist als größte Arbeitgeberin der Region der wichtigste Wirtschaftsfaktor und bietet kulturelle Vielfalt und Internationalität. Die TU Clausthal hat sich gesamtuniversitär dem Leitthema der „Circular Economy“ verpflichtet und verfolgt das Ziel, in Forschung, Lehre und Verwaltung am Aufbau einer nachhaltigen Gesellschaft im digitalen Zeitalter mitzuwirken. Die Abteilung für Energieinformatik am Institut für Informatik der Technischen Universität Clausthal sucht zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine:n Wissenschaftliche:r Mitarbeiter:in (m/w/d) zur Mitarbeit an einem Forschungsprojekt. Die Stelle ist zunächst bis zum 31.12.2028 befristet und mit 100% der regelmäßigen wöchentlichen Arbeitszeit zu besetzen. Die Bereitschaft zur akademischen Qualifikation (Promotion) wird vorausgesetzt. Die Stelle ist grundsätzlich teilzeitgeeignet. Beschreibung des Forschungsprojekts Die Stelle ist Teil des Projekts „Innovative integrierte Energiekonzepte für den ländlichen Raum“ (INITIAL), in dem sieben Fachbereiche an vier Hochschulen gemeinsam daran forschen, Simulationsmodelle für Erzeuger und Verbraucher in integrierten Energieparks (bestehend aus mit Erzeugern, Verbrauchern und Speichern – für Strom, Wasserstoff und/oder Wärme) zu integrieren. Das übergeordnete Ziel besteht darin, für eine gegebene Kombination integrierter Komponenten die netzdienlichste Betriebsweise zu ermitteln und gleichzeitig für Akzeptanz in der Öffentlichkeit zu sorgen. Der von der ausgeschriebenen Position zu erbringende wissenschaftliche Beitrag besteht primär in der digitalen Integration von Modellen und der datengestützten Optimierung ihrer Betriebsmodi. items.desc: Job Description As a Research and Development Engineer – Control Systems, you contribute to the development and validation of advanced control solutions for complex high-tech mechatronic systems. You work at the intersection of control engineering, system modelling, software and physical hardware, ensuring that innovative machine concepts can be translated into reliable system performance. A key part of your role is connecting simulation models, control software and physical test environments. Using MATLAB/Simulink and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing, you help establish a consistent engineering environment in which models, requirements and test results are aligned through a single source of truth. What will you do? Develop and optimize control systems for advanced mechatronic machines and modules Build dynamic system models and control algorithms using MATLAB/Simulink Translate system requirements into control strategies and simulation models Develop and execute Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) tests to validate control functionality Analyze differences between simulated and actual system behavior Integrate control software with sensors, actuators and physical hardware Establish consistency and traceability between requirements, models, software and validation results Improve model accuracy, system performance and control robustness Investigate complex technical issues through simulation, testing and data analysis Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, software and system engineers throughout the R&D process Your Profile Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechatronics, Control Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related technical field Experience in developing or validating control systems for mechatronic applications Strong knowledge of MATLAB/Simulink and model-based development Experience with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing Understanding of dynamic system modelling, control algorithms and system behavior Experience with integrating software and physical hardware Ability to work with structured engineering data, requirements and model traceability Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with the ability to work in multidisciplinary engineering teams Interested? items.desc: Reference: AIPRECCGSO3 Start date: 27/10/2026 0:00:00 Expiration Date: 05/11/2026 23:59:00 The Computational Cancer Genomics Lab adopts an integrated methodology to unravel disrupted protein-protein interaction networks in cancer. By analyzing extensive cancer genomics and multi-omics datasets, we build statistical and computational models to comprehend condition-specific interaction dynamics. Our primary objective is to map the context-specific cancer fitness landscape by examining position-specific interaction networks, supported by joint international collaborations. Key Focus Areas Genomics & multi-omics analysis: Process and integrate large-scale genomic and clinical cohort data from cancer patients. Computational & AI modeling: Develop statistical models and machine learning approaches to investigate condition-specific driver gene mechanisms and fitness landscapes. Interaction networks & emerging themes: Explore position-specific interaction networks, incorporating proteomics-based co-abundance network analyses and investigating subtle cross-talks in aging-cancer bifurcation dynamics. Methodological expansion & multi-omics integration: Unraveling complex position-specific interaction networks and mapping cancer fitness landscapes requires dedicated expertise capable of bridging genomic big data with emerging proteomics-based co-abundance network analyses. Complex biological frontiers: Investigating sophisticated biological transitions—such as the interplay between aging-cancer bifurcation dynamics and mutational contexts—demands tailored statistical modeling and AI/machine learning capabilities. Roles And Responsibilities Of Proposed Position Conduct research and exploratory data analysis using genomic big data derived from cancer patients and clinical cohorts. Develop and apply statistical models and machine learning/AI techniques to decipher complex biological mechanisms and driver gene interactions from big data. Implement and adapt scalable computational pipelines to streamline the analysis of high-throughput sequencing datasets. Selection Criteria Master’s degree (or equivalent experience) in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Statistics, Computer Science, Genomics, or a related quantitative field. Familiarity or hands-on experience with handling genomic big data, particularly from cancer patients or clinical/genomic cohorts (e.g., WGS, WES, RNA-seq, or single-cell data). Interest or basic background in applying statistical or computational modeling to interpret biological systems and disease mechanisms. Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in bioinformatics, such as R, Python, or equivalent languages. Hands-on experience in processing and analyzing big data. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English are required. All application materials, including a detailed CV, must be submitted in English. The CNIO Offers Joining a research centre of international relevance. Gross annual salary between €19,475 and €25,615. Social benefits. Flexible compensation (Health insurance, meals, transportation, childcare). Estos contratos están vinculados a la acreditación del CNIO como Centro de Excelencia Severo Ochoa CEX2024-001442-S, financiado por el Ministerio de Ciencia, Innovación y Universidades, Agencia Estatal de Investigación (MICIU/AEI/10.13039/501100011033).

items.desc: You will work collaboratively with Lloyds Banking Group General Insurance Limited and the University of Leeds’ School of Earth, Environment and Sustainability. This role is located at 11 - 12 Wellington Place, Leeds LS1 4AP Do you hold a PhD in Atmospheric Science, Climate Science, Fluid Dynamics, or a related field? Are you interested in the translation of hazard modelling research into commercial operations? This is an exciting opportunity to lead the transformation of how Lloyds Banking Group understands and manages UK windstorm risk by embedding cutting-edge climate science, machine learning, and advanced hazard modelling into its insurance operations. The vision of this project is to advance the science of climate and weather risk through next-generation approaches to UK windstorm assessment, generating insights that extend beyond academia to deliver tangible benefits for customers, insurers, and society. In doing so, the project will help strengthen the Lloyds Banking Group General Insurance’s ability to respond to increasingly severe weather and climate risks, supporting long-term resilience and a more sustainable future. The University of Leeds is offering a unique opportunity to accelerate your career through a Knowledge Transfer Partnership (KTP). You will work collaboratively with Lloyds Banking Group General Insurance Limited and the University of Leeds’ School of Earth, Environment and Sustainability, gaining experience at the interface of world-leading academic research and real-world commercial application within one of the UK’s leading research-intensive universities. As extreme weather events become more frequent and severe, the need to understand and manage climate-related risk has never been greater. By protecting more than 2.5 million UK households, Lloyds Banking Group plays a critical role in helping society withstand and recover from these events. This project provides an opportunity to contribute to that mission, advancing scientific understanding while helping ensure insurance remains a cornerstone of resilience in a changing climate. As the KTP Associate, you will play a central role in delivering this strategically important project. Working closely with industry specialists and leading academics, you will lead the development and implementation of innovative climate risk and hazard modelling approaches, integrating advanced scientific and machine learning methodologies into operational insurance decision-making. You will be primarily based within Lloyds Banking Group’s Leeds offices, fully embedded within the organisation, while also benefiting from access to the University of Leeds’ world-class facilities, resources, and academic expertise, located only 1 mile away. Please note that this post may be suitable for sponsorship under the Skilled Worker visa route but first-time applicants might need to qualify for salary concessions. For more information please visit: www.gov.uk/skilled-worker-visa. For research and academic posts, we will consider eligibility under the Global Talent visa.
