items.desc: Modelling Engineer Location: Bristol / London About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world's most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. The Role About The Software Organisation At Fractile PerfSim sits within the Software organisation at Fractile, which is responsible for developing a full software stack for our groundbreaking AI inference systems. That's everything from ML compilers, device drivers and systems firmware, application level runtime and ecosystem integrations, ML and compute libraries, great developer tooling and a full portfolio of simulators, through to datacenter scale workload deployment solutions. At Fractile, we know that a fantastic software stack is a critical and central part of any AI inference solution and it sits at the heart of everything we're doing. About The Team And Role To build hardware that doesn't yet exist, you first have to model it — with precision, depth, and an eye for the trade-offs that matter. At Fractile, high-fidelity pre-silicon models shape our architecture, performance, and product design long before hardware exists. The Simulation team includes C++ and SystemC specialists, verification and validation engineers, system architects, and embedded engineers. This is not a support function — it is the group that defines how Fractile's hardware behaves. As a Modelling Engineer you will develop the pre-silicon models of Fractile's AI acceleration hardware, enabling architectural exploration and definition, functional modelling, performance modelling and bottleneck analysis, and early software development on virtual platforms. You will work closely with hardware, software, and ML teams in a true hardware–software co-design loop. About You You have a genuine curiosity for hard problems and the depth to operate across architecture, performance, and functional correctness. You understand that the models you build will shape the architecture of Fractile's accelerator, determine performance trade-offs, enable early runtime and compiler development, unblock software teams months before silicon exists, and reduce risk across the entire product lifecycle. You take that responsibility seriously and bring the rigour it demands. Key Requirements Experience in pre-silicon modelling of complex semiconductor IP SystemC or equivalent modelling frameworks C++ for high-performance simulation Performance modelling and architectural analysis Verification and functional modelling Nice to Have Experience with ML workloads or ML accelerator architectures Prior startup or small-team experience What We Offer Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. Sie wird als vernetzte Struktur eigeninitiativ agierender Konsortien aufgebaut. In NFDI-MatWerk wird eine zuverlässige digitale Plattform für die Material- und Nanowissenschaften aufgebaut, welche die digitale Repräsentation von Werkstoffdaten und spezifischer Metadaten ermöglicht. Für die Forschenden werden Dienste zur einfachen Speicherung, gemeinsamen Nutzung, Suche und Analyse von Daten und Metadaten entwickelt und zur Verfügung gestellt. Weiterhin sollen über Deutschland verteilte Daten aus den wissenschaftlichen Gruppen über eine wissensgraphbasierte Infrastruktur so angesprochen werden können, dass schnelle und komplexe Suchanfragen und Auswertungen möglich werden. In der Abteilung „Data Exploitation Methods“ des Scientific Computing Center (SCC) entwickeln wir für die NFDI innovative Softwarelösungen zur einfachen und benutzerfreundlichen Handhabung von Forschungsdaten. Neugierig auf eine aufregende und vielseitige Rolle in einem agilen Team? Entdecken Sie mehr über SCC als Ihren beruflichen Place to be: KIT - SCC - Über uns - Arbeiten am SCC Ihre Aufgaben Im Rahmen von NFDI-MatWerk arbeiten Sie an folgenden den Themen: Sie entwickeln ein Tool zur automatischen Metadatenextraktion und zum Mapping, das optimal auf die Bedürfnisse der Forschenden im Bereich der Materialwissenschaften abgestimmt ist. items.desc: HAWK Biosystems is a deep-tech biotechnology company spun off from the Francis Crick Institute and based in the Science and Technology Park of Bizkaia. Our proprietary QF-Pro® Technology is an in situ quantitative interactomics analysis technology. It measures functional protein–protein interactions and activation states directly in fixed cells and FFPE tissue. This is biological information that expression, proximity, or co-localization analysis cannot provide. We partner with pharma, biotech, academic, and clinical teams worldwide to answer translational research questions and to support the development of more personalized therapies for patients. We are growing our team and are looking for an Application Scientist to work at the interface between our Life Science Business Unit and our Product team. The role combines leading the scientific side of our client projects with driving the scientific development of our products. Role Overview As Application Scientist, you will be the scientific owner of our client projects. During the pre-sales phase, you will support the Business Development team: you will understand each client’s scientific question, assess feasibility, and design the right study. You will then run the project in our laboratory through to the final report and the results discussion with the client. This role is built for a fully independent scientist . You will own every project from start to finish. That means making scientific decisions, anticipating and troubleshooting technical issues, critically interpreting the data, and clearly presenting results that both internal and external clients can rely on. We are looking for someone with sound scientific judgment, a rigorous and critical mindset, and the confidence to discuss science with senior pharma and academic stakeholders. Alongside client projects, you will lead R&D on our QF-Pro® reagent kit and contribute both to the scientific improvement of our current products as well as leading the design of new reagent products. You will turn what you learn in the laboratory and from clients into better reagents, protocols, and workflows. Key Responsibilities Act as the scientific point of contact for prospective clients during the pre-sales phase. Join Business Development calls and meetings, understand each client’s research question, assess feasibility, and design tailored studies, including biomarker selection, antibody strategy, sample requirements, controls, and readouts. Provide technical input for quotes and proposals (scope, timelines, and deliverables), and deliver scientific presentations on QF-Pro® Technology to clients and partners, and at scientific events. Lead client service and Proof-of-Concept (PoC) projects end to end on cell and FFPE tissue samples, from sample reception and quality assessment, assay setup, and immunofluorescence staining to image acquisition and quantitative data analysis. Manage timelines and priorities across several projects in parallel. Critically interpret results in their biological context, prepare client-ready technical reports, and present them to clients, working with the Business Development team to identify follow-up opportunities. Lead R&D on the QF-Pro® reagent kit: develop and optimize new reagents, formulations, and protocols, and improve kit performance, robustness, and reproducibility, including stability, lot-to-lot consistency, and compatibility with new sample types and biomarkers. Work with the Product team on the scientific improvement of the product. Define scientific requirements, test new features of the platform workflow and data analysis, and turn feedback from clients, distributors, and users into improvement proposals and new applications for QF-Pro® Technology. Ensure that all work follows HAWK’s ISO 13485 quality management system and good laboratory practices, including design and development documentation, verification, and validation activities, with full traceability. Provide on-site and remote technical training and support to distributors and clients, and support scientific communication with the Marketing team through application notes, case studies, webinars, and congress materials. Qualifications One of the following: PhD in Life Sciences (Biology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Biomedicine, or a related field). University degree in Life Sciences plus at least 4 years of hands-on laboratory experience in a related field (academic research, biotech/pharma, diagnostics, or CRO). Professional working proficiency in English, written and spoken. Spanish is a plus. Proven ability to run scientific projects independently, from experimental design to final results. Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills. You should have the rigor to question data and the judgment to make sound scientific decisions. items.desc: The Met Office is delighted to open our advertising for Industrial Placements 2027. This is an exciting opportunity to join the Met Office on a 12-month Year in Industry placement, commencing at the start of July 2027, developing your skills and knowledge and ensuring you gain the most value possible from your experience with us. You will have the opportunity to network with our cohort of Industrial Placements all over the Met Office and understand what career opportunities are on offer at the Met Office after you graduate. We’re looking for an AI for Ocean Climate Modelling Industrial Placement to help us make a difference to our planet. As our AI for Ocean Climate Modelling Industrial Placement, the job may be suitable for hybrid working, which is where an employee works part of the week in the office and part of the week from home. This is a voluntary, non-contractual arrangement and the location advertised will be your contractual place of work. As an Industrial Placement, we would expect you to attend the office once a week as a minimum. Our opportunity is full time, 37 hours per week. Our people are at the heart of what we do and we'll do our best to agree a working pattern that works for everyone. World changing work From science to technology, from meteorology to management, and from planning to communication, our expertise helps us stand out as the authority on weather accuracy and climate prediction. We help individuals, industries and government to make better decisions to stay safe and thrive. This is the Met Office. This is who we are. We’re a force for good - focusing on our environmental and social impact We’re experts by nature - always learning and developing to do things better We live and breathe it - putting our purpose at the heart of decision-making We’re better together - understanding partnerships and inclusivity make us greater We keep evolving - pushing boundaries to make tomorrow better for our customers Your world of expertise Our Industrial Placement scheme offers ambitious and capable undergraduates the opportunity to gain valuable experience working alongside diverse and highly skilled experts in their field. You’ll be working on projects that really matter and will make a difference. Our Industrial Placement scheme gives undergraduates valuable experience working with experts in their field. You will join the Ocean Modelling team within the Ocean, Cryosphere and Climate (OCC) group at the Met Office Hadley Centre. The team delivers ocean modelling capability that underpins the Met Office's coupled weather and climate prediction systems and advances understanding of the ocean's role in climate variability. The group's work spans global, regional and polar marine environments and involves collaboration with national and international partners. The team works with the National Oceanography Centre (NOC) through the Joint Marine Modelling Programme and contributes to the NEMO community ocean model. This placement offers an opportunity to explore how data-driven approaches could improve the representation of ocean vertical mixing. Vertical mixing influences ocean stratification and circulation, both of which are important for reliable climate projections, but it is often represented using simplified parametrisations. While machine learning has been applied successfully to the parametrisation of mesoscale eddies, its use for vertical mixing remains limited. You will develop skills in ocean science and machine learning while contributing to improvements in ocean model accuracy and reliability. Your key duties Review literature on recent developments in machine-learning approaches to ocean vertical mixing to understand current limitations. Select and process suitable training datasets for use in ML. Develop and evaluate a data-driven approach to represent or improve aspects of ocean vertical mixing. Assess the performance and validity of the approach using independent data and/or simplified numerical experiments. Analyse, document and communicate the results, including limitations and recommendations for future research. Why join us Our work is life-changing, often life-saving and always life-enhancing. The Met Office is Great Place to Work UK certified. We are also featured on their ‘Best Workplaces in Tech’ 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026 lists, as well as their ’54 Best Workplaces for Women’ 2023 list. På Saab tror vi att innovationer växer på nya idéer, och ditt examensarbete kan vara gnistan som tänder vårt nästa tekniska genombrott. Din akademiska precision, i kombination med din entusiasm för avancerad teknik, gör att du kan närma dig problem med en unik och insiktsfull lins. På Saab får du möjlighet att samarbeta med erfarna ingenjörer och specialister, få ovärderlig praktisk erfarenhet och samtidigt bidra till vår tillväxt och utveckling. Bakgrund Unmanned Systems utvecklar autonoma system inom Saab Dynamics. Flera av våra plattformar opererar över långa avstånd och i höga hastigheter, medan andra är mindre system som ofta benämns som drönare. Gemensamt för våra lösningar är behovet av avancerade funktioner för navigation, objektdetektering, omvärldsförståelse, optimal styrning av plattformar samt beslutsfattande baserat på tillgänglig information. Beskrivning till examensarbetet Vi söker en exjobbare med intresse för systemidentifiering och maskininlärning. Examensarbetet fokuserar på datadrivna metoder för att identifiera drönardynamik. Examensarbetet syftar till att undersöka hur Physics-Informed Machine Learning (PIML) kan användas för systemidentifiering av drönardynamik. Målet är att utveckla och utvärdera modeller som kombinerar fysikaliska samband med datadrivna metoder för att beskriva flygande systems dynamik under varierande flygtillstånd och lastkonfigurationer. Arbetet ger möjlighet att kombinera reglerteknik, fysikbaserad modellering och maskininlärning för att förbättra modellnoggrannhet och generaliseringsförmåga. En viktig del av arbetet kommer även att vara att analysera hur införandet av fysikaliska begränsningar påverkar modellernas prestanda jämfört med konventionella maskininlärningsmetoder. Arbetet kan innefatta Litteraturstudie inom systemidentifiering och PIML. Framtagning av relevanta tränings- och testdata. Utveckling av fysikinformerade modeller. Jämförelse mot klassiska identifieringsmetoder. Analys av modellernas robusthet och generalisering. Presentation av resultat och slutsatser. Ditt examensarbete kommer att genomföras i vårt team, där det finns djup kompetens och lång erfarenhet inom samtliga dessa områden. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta nära specialister och bidra till utvecklingen av framtidens autonoma system. Din profil Arbetet är lämpligt för 1–2 studenter i slutet av teknisk fysik-, elektroteknik-, datateknik-, maskinteknik- eller motsvarande utbildning som ska påbörja ett 30 hp examensarbete. Kunskap inom systemidentifiering, reglerteknik och maskininlärning är meriterande. Du kommer arbeta i vår nystartade verksamhet i Solna. Här fokuserar vi på obemannade system, vilket innebär ett fokus på teknikområden som krävs för att leda, navigera och styra obemannade system — främst flygande sådana. Vi ger dig det stöd och den vägledning du behöver för att omsätta dina teoretiska kunskaper i praktiska lösningar. Bli en drivande kraft bakom Saabs tekniska framsteg! Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. items.desc: En TECNALIA queremos reforzar nuestro equipo del Área de Negocio de “Next Generation Factories” cuya misión es generar nuevas oportunidades de negocio derivadas de los nuevos retos que debe afrontar el sector Industrial para abordar la transición hacia la nueva Proactive Factory, una fábrica consciente, flexible y conectada donde la trasformación digital juega un papel clave. Para ello buscamos un/a Ingeniero/a con ganas de crecer, con base en entornos industriales, automatización y robótica. El objetivo de esta posición es integrar el mundo de la ingeniería de control tradicional con las nuevas tecnologías de Inteligencia Artificial. Buscamos a alguien con un perfil junior, pero con capacidad de aprendizaje, curiosidad técnica y potencial para convertirse en una persona de referencia en la convergencia OT/IT de la organización. Qué harás Tus funciones principales estarán orientadas al diseño y despliegue de sistemas inteligentes en entorno industrial en evolución hacia fábricas que sean capaces de anticiparse: Desarrollo de IA Industrial: Implementación de agentes de IA (visión, series temporales, optimización) para cerrar el bucle de control de equipamientos en las fábricas (prensas, soldadura, robots,etc. ) y optimización de procesos operativos (SPC inteligente). Coordinación de sistemas ciberfísicos y multi-robot. Gestión de Logística Avanzada: Diseño e integración de flujos logísticos inteligentes (AGVs/AMRs, cobots y humanoides) integrados con los sistemas de gestión de planta. Ingeniería de Automatización: Conversión de tareas manuales en secuencias automáticas y diseño de estaciones de trabajo robotizadas. Sistemas de Visión y Digitalización: Integración de visión artificial y estrategias de IA para el control de calidad y mantenimiento predictivo. Colaborar en proyectos de investigación complejos que integren (robots + humanoides + AGVs + gruas + + visión + PLCs + AI + IIoT) y automaticen flujos de producción completos junto con sus controles de mantenimiento y calidad. Qué te ofrecemos Plan de formación continua en IA aplicada a la industria y nuevas tecnologías. Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar en un equipo con proyección en la temática, en un ambiente de trabajo dinámico y flexible. Oportunidad de trabajar en proyectos reales de vanguardia tecnológica (Industria 4.0). Dispondrás de medidas de conciliación de tu vida personal y profesional. Requisitos: Formación: Grado y/o Máster en Ingeniería Industrial, Automatización, Control, Robótica o titulación técnica afín. Se valorará positivamente Máster en industria 4.0, IA, robótica o transformación digital. Experiencia:- Haber realizado proyectos académicos, TFG/TFM o prácticas profesionales relacionados con la programación e integración de robótica industrial o colaborativa. Interés y primera aproximación al despliegue de sistemas autónomos (AGVs, AMRs) o automatización de procesos. Habilidades demostradas en la resolución de problemas técnicos mediante la integración de hardware y software (ej. uso de PLCs, sensores o microcontroladores en entorno educativo o profesional). Conocimientos Técnicos:- Robótica y Automatización: conocimientos en el funcionamiento de robots industriales y cobots. Comunicaciones Industriales: Conocimientos teóricos o prácticos de protocolos de red (como OPC-UA, MQTT, Profinet o Modbus TCP). IA e IIoT: Nociones sobre la aplicación de Inteligencia Artificial en la industria y conceptos básicos de captura de datos en tiempo real (IoT). Sistemas e Infraestructura: Familiaridad con la arquitectura de sistemas industriales (PLCs, SCADA) y conceptos básicos de virtualización o servicios en la nube (Cloud) o Edge. Ciberseguridad: Interés o conocimientos básicos en seguridad de la información aplicada a entornos industriales. Se valorarán positivamente conocimientos de ensamblado, soldadura y estampación. Idiomas:- Dominio de inglés hablado y escrito. Se valorará conocimientos de alemán. Habilidades: Visión global y capacidad analítica y de resolución de problemas. Actitud proactiva y capacidad de aprendizaje. Trabajo en equipo, actitud colaborativa y comunicación efectiva. Espíritu innovador y orientación a la consecución de objetivos y resultados. Valoramos positivamente las solicitudes de personas con certificado de discapacidad igual o mayor al 33%, en cumplimiento de la legislación vigente, Ley General de Derechos de las Personas con Discapacidad y de su inclusión social (LGD).

items.desc: En TECNALIA queremos potenciar nuestro equipo Innovative Air Mobility Lab, cuya misión es resolver problemas reales de la Low Altitude Economy mediante el desarrollo de vehículos aéreos avanzados e infraestructura tierra-aire. Dentro de este equipo ideamos y desarrollamos nuevas arquitecturas de aeronaves, sistemas de robótica aérea e infraestructura tierra-aire, abordando la conceptualización, dimensionamiento, diseño y cálculo mecánico, fabricación, integración y el desarrollo de las capas software: control, autonomía, percepción y coordinación, yendo del vehículo individual a la flota y al espacio aéreo. TECNALIA es un centro de investigación aplicada: investigamos, analizamos y expandimos el estado del arte, pero todo lo que desarrollamos debe llegar al mercado mediante transferencia tecnológica, prototipos y productos reales que generen impacto en empresas y en la sociedad. Para ello, buscamos una persona orientada al desarrollo de productos innovadores y proyectos de I+D en el campo del control de vuelo, aplicando dichas leyes a plataformas aéreas con capacidades de interacción física con el entorno, la navegación autónoma y la coordinación entre vehículos (swarming, gestión del espacio aéreo). Si eres una persona proactiva, responsable y resolutiva, con capacidad de adaptación a nuevos proyectos y te gusta el trabajo en equipo. Si sientes interés por la investigación aplicada y por transferir la tecnología que tú misma desarrollas a las empresas... ¡Sigue leyendo...! Qué harás El puesto vacante a cubrir pertenece al área de negocio de Movilidad de Tecnalia, que desarrolla soluciones de planificación y coordinación multiplataforma, algoritmos de autonomía, percepción y toma de decisión, así como hardware (autopilotos, electrónica de potencia, etc.) para plataformas móviles de tierra, mar y aire. Este puesto se centra en el ámbito aeronáutico, la persona seleccionada colaborará en proyectos aeroespaciales e industrialmente relevantes en el límite de la tecnología actual. Se busca un perfil flexible, sin miedo a capacitarse en diversas temáticas y colaborar en el desarrollo e implementación de algoritmos avanzados en: dinámica y control de vuelo, estimación y percepción, navegación autónoma (incl. GNSS degradado), interacción física con el entorno, robótica aérea, y coordinación multiplataforma (centros de comando y control). Responsabilidades: Contribución a la ideación de aeronaves, robots aéreos y soluciones sistémicas (vehículo + flota + infraestructura tierra-aire). Control de vuelo y estimación: modelado de planta, leyes de control, ajuste de ganancia, estabilidad y prestaciones; implementación en vehículos autónomos y pilotados. Navegación autónoma, estimación multi-sensor (fusión, incertidumbre, continuidad de misión), incluidos escenarios GNSS-denied o degradados. Coordinación inter-vehículo: algoritmos de formación / swarming, posicionamiento relativo y apoyo a la gestión del espacio aéreo y mando y control (C2). Robótica aérea e interacción con el entorno (inspección activa, contacto, manipulación aérea u otras formas de interacción física). Validación software SiL, HiL, evaluación de código en plataforma embebida. Validación de algoritmos en simulación, integración en prototipos de laboratorio y campañas experimentales de vuelo outdoor. Documentación científica y técnica: contribuir a publicaciones, informes y entregables, manteniendo siempre el foco en que los resultados sean transferibles a partners industriales y a producto final. Comunicación de resultados técnicos y científicos en reuniones de proyecto con socios de consorcio y clientes; presentación de avances, análisis de problemas y propuesta de soluciones en entornos colaborativos nacionales e internacionales. Qué te ofrecemos Participarás en proyectos de alto nivel tecnológico en un entorno de investigación aplicada con foco en la transferencia tecnológica y el impacto real. Trabajarás en estrecha relación con expertos multidisciplinares (estructuras, propulsión, percepción, sistemas, IA, coordinación) para crear nuevas soluciones. Acceso a laboratorios e infraestructuras de vuelo e integración (entornos indoor/outdoor, bancos de prueba, centros de control) para pasar de la simulación a la realidad. Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar en un equipo con gran proyección y líder a nivel nacional en la temática, en un ambiente multicultural, dinámico y enriquecedor. Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional en proyectos referentes que responden a retos del futuro (movilidad aérea, autonomía). Potenciar una carrera profesional sólida. Colaborar con grupos de investigación de alto nivel regionales, nacionales e internacionales, sobre todo europeos, y con empresas del ecosistema IAM. Dispondrás de medidas de conciliación de tu vida personal y profesional. Requisitos: Titulación: Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería Informática, Ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones, Ingeniería Electrónica, Ingeniería Aeronáutica, Físicas, Matemática o afín con …

El objetivo de esta posición es liderar la simulación de procesos y evolucionar las capacidades de “virtual commissioning” de células de fabricación, integrando funcionalidades avanzadas como la iteración con AGVs y el sistema digital de gobierno de las fábricas que permitan anticiparse a lo que va a suceder en las células de fabricación. Buscamos un perfil con rigor técnico, capacidad de estandarización y aptitud para liderar la transformación digital y la cultura del cambio tecnológico dentro de la organización. Qué harás Tus funciones principales estarán centradas en la creación, optimización y validación de entornos virtuales de producción: Investigar y desarrollar tecnología capaz de implementar modelos detallados de “virtual commissioning” para procesos de ensamblado. Definir, desarrollar y actualizar junto con nuestros clientes estándares para la implantación de virtual commissioning. Detectar, analizar y resolver incidencias técnicas complejas durante las fases de simulación de la mano de empresas del sector de fabricación para la solución de problemas del sector. Ayudar y fomentar, junto con los clientes, la adopción de metodologías de virtualización. Qué te ofrecemos Plan de formación continua en virtual commissioning aplicada a la industria y nuevas tecnologías. Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar en un equipo con proyección en la temática, en un ambiente de trabajo dinámico y flexible. Oportunidad de trabajar en proyectos reales de vanguardia tecnológica (Industria 4.0). Dispondrás de medidas de conciliación de tu vida personal y profesional. Requisitos: Formación: Grado y/o Máster en Ingeniería (Industrial, Electrónica, Robótica o similar) o titulación técnica afín. Experiencia:- Experiencia en “virtual commissioning” de procesos de ensamblado y proyectos de industrialización. Capacidad en la elaboración de documentación técnica y creación de estándares de trabajo. Conocimientos Técnicos:- Conocimiento de robótica, especialmente KUKA o ABB, incluyendo programación offline y depuración de programas. Manejo de TIA-Portal y protocolos de comunicaciones industriales. Competencias en programación básica. Capacidad para diseñar métodos de trabajo y protocolos de validación técnica. Capacidad analítica para el estudio de publicaciones científicas, patentes y documentación técnica. Se valorará contar con conocimientos de Process Simulate aplicado a procesos de ensamblado en el sector de automoción y preferiblemente de componentes metálicos). Se valorará tener conocimientos en Process Simulate aplicado a procesos de ensamblado en el sector de automoción y preferiblemente de componentes metálicos. Se valorará positivamente conocimientos de ensamblado, soldadura y estampación y de ”virtual commissioning” en procesos de ensamblado así como experiencia en proyectos de industrialización y colaboración con equipos de ingeniería. Idiomas: Dominio de inglés hablado y escrito. Se valorará conocimientos de alemán. Habilidades y Competencias: Habilidades de liderazgo, gestión de proveedores y comunicación interpersonal efectiva. Autonomía, capacidad resolutiva y espíritu innovador. Habilidad para el trabajo colaborativo y con clientes finales. Flexibilidad y adaptabilidad a entornos dinámicos. Valoramos positivamente las solicitudes de personas con certificado de discapacidad igual o mayor al 33%, en cumplimiento de la legislación vigente, Ley General de Derechos de las Personas con Discapacidad y de su inclusión social (LGD).

About the job Join our global team for a career filled with opportunities to solve challenges both small and large, local and global, simple and complex. Are you a graduate who is passionate about technology, maritime logistics, and environment? Join us in shaping the future of the maritime industry with Wilhelmsen! Wilhelmsen is a leading company in the maritime industry, known for our innovation, sustainability, and commitment to excellence. As we continue to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we're on a mission to redefine the maritime industry's future through cutting-edge technology and sustainable practices. Now, we’re expanding our horizons and inviting passionate graduates and young professionals to join us as we strive towards shaping the future of the maritime industry! About our graduate programme: As a participant in our 24-month graduate programme starting in August 2027, you will play a crucial role in driving innovation and change. You will collaborate with our diverse teams across the globe, taking ownership of projects that propel the industry towards a sustainable and prosperous future. Your journey You'll experience four dynamic six-month rotations across our business units, and, during one of these rotations, you'll embark on an international adventure, gaining valuable global insights. As a graduate at Wilhelmsen you’ll contribute to various areas, including: Data analytics, data science, and AI: Leverage the power of data-driven insights through maritime and logistics operations at sea and onshore. Software development: Shape the digital future of maritime solutions. Business development: Drive growth and expansion strategies. Vessel management: Optimise maritime operations. Ventures: Develop and support scaling ventures across the group. Sustainability and ESG: Tackle key environmental, social, and governance challenges. Who we are looking for To thrive in our graduate programme, you should possess: A master’s degree in engineering, data science, business, or IT. Either fresh out of school or with 1-2 years of professional experience. An insatiable curiosity and a passion for embracing new technology. A problem-solving mindset with a knack for innovation and fresh approaches. Excellent communication skills to engage and influence stakeholders and foster inclusivity. What we offer In addition to an exciting 24-month journey, including preferrable one rotation abroad, you can expect: Challenging and existing projects where you will grow professionally and personally More than 20,000 supportive colleagues A very good pension scheme. Premium life and health care insurance, including access to online medical services. Sports club membership including sporting and cultural activities (e.g., group training in our gymnasium, running, sailing, kayak rental, Pilates, football, theatre and concert tickets etc.) Company cabins in e.g., the Norwegian mountains, Swedish coast, Barcelona, Copenhagen, Berlin and Lisbon. Social events year-round (e.g., wine tastings, cooking classes, yoga, dance, and rock-climbing lessons etc.) Flexible working hours and a hybrid arrangement (work from home and Lysaker office). We look forward to reading more about you. Please upload your resume, cover letter, transcripts and any letters of recommendation here. Application will close 4 November 2026.

Reply’s services include Consulting, System Integration, and Digital Services. Role Overview: As a Graduate Cloud Consultant at Go Reply, you will step into a versatile role that bridges the gap between high-level business strategy and cutting-edge cloud innovation. You will be instrumental in supporting our clients to stay at the forefront of technology by optimising their digital strategies and solving complex business challenges. You will work alongside a diverse team of specialists across data science, security, and platform engineering to build highly resilient and scalable solutions based on Google Cloud Platform. items.card: The Role If you enjoy untangling difficult questions, finding the insight that changes the conversation and turning strategy into practical action, this role offers broad exposure and the opportunity to accelerate your development. You will join Shell’s internal Technology, Data & AI Strategy practice and work on technology, digital, data and AI questions from across the organisation. Depending on your experience,
items.desc: What’s The Role If you enjoy untangling difficult questions, finding the insight that changes the conversation and turning strategy into practical action, this role offers broad exposure and the opportunity to accelerate your development. You will join Shell’s internal Technology, Data & AI Strategy practice and work on technology, digital, data and AI questions from across the organisation. Depending on your experience, you may deliver a defined analytical module or own a substantial workstream. In every case, you will work with experienced consultants, senior stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams on problems with genuine enterprise relevance. You will also help shape how the team uses AI in its own work: we reimagine our own ways of working before we advise others on theirs, and fresh thinking from every level counts. What You’ll Be Doing Structure ambiguous business and technology questions using hypothesis-led problem solving. Gather and analyse business, technology, market, cost and value evidence to uncover actionable insight. Use AI tools every day to accelerate research, analysis, synthesis and drafting, check the quality of what they produce and share what works with the team. Develop strategic options, opportunity assessments, business cases and recommendations. Contribute to IT strategies, operating models, capability assessments, portfolio choices and digital, data and AI roadmaps. Plan and support interviews, working sessions and workshops that build alignment. Communicate findings through clear, concise and visually compelling stories and decision materials. Manage assigned activities, stakeholders, risks, issues and dependencies. Work across Shell’s Businesses, Functions and technology domains, building a broad enterprise perspective. Contribute ideas, knowledge, external insight and new AI-enabled ways of working to the consulting community. What You Bring Relevant experience in technology, digital, data, AI or business strategy, gained in a consultancy, enterprise strategy team or comparable environment. Strong structured problem-solving, business analysis and quantitative analytical skills. Hands-on curiosity about AI, with experience using AI tools to improve your own work and the judgement to check their outputs critically. The ability to synthesise evidence, identify what matters and communicate a clear point of view. Good written, visual and verbal communication and the confidence to work directly with stakeholders and subject-matter experts. An interest in relevant disciplines such as IT strategy, operating models, capability assessment, digital transformation, data and AI, emerging technology, portfolio management or business case development. Sound delivery discipline, curiosity, high standards and a willingness to learn and contribute to the wider team. How The Scope Flexes Responsibilities will increase with experience, from contributing to analysis and workstreams to independently owning substantial workstreams, engaging stakeholders directly and supporting colleagues. Appointment level will reflect relevant experience, autonomy and demonstrated impact. A note on grading We welcome candidates with a range of relevant experience. Appointments will be determined through the selection process based on the quality and relevance of experience, analytical depth, autonomy and impact demonstrated. Why join us? Varied, high-impact assignments across a broad range of enterprise challenges. Exposure to senior leaders and important enterprise decisions throughout your journey with the team. The chance to combine analytical depth with facilitation, influencing and strategy-to-execution experience. A supportive consulting community where you can learn from experienced colleagues and progressively take on broader accountability. Learn to use AI in strategy work from the start, in a team that aims to set the standard for AI-enabled consulting at Shell. Work that allows you to see how your analysis and recommendations influence real decisions and outcomes. How Success Will Be Recognised You will turn complex questions into clear analysis and practical recommendations, deliver high-quality work, help improve how the team works with AI and progressively take on broader ownership as your experience grows. After you submit your application, you will receive an email from Shell providing a link to an online assessment (HireVue) that is a mandatory part of the process and has a validity period – please check your spam/junk mailbox if you do not see the email. Once completed, your application will be reviewed to determine next steps. Thank you for your interest in Shell. What we offer You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. …

ABOUT THE TEAM Appian Customer Success is obsessed with creating exceptional customer outcomes and driving high-velocity, mission-critical business impact. Technical Aptitude: Proven capacity and willingness to rapidly learn and apply new technical platforms, tools, and methodologies. Prior experience in a professional, academic, or technical setting (internships, research, capstones, or consistent part-time/full-time employment) is valued but not required. Proven fluency in AI and LLMs, encompassing both the strategic development of AI-powered platform capabilities and the hands-on application of AI tools to accelerate daily workflows. items.desc: Quel sera votre rôle dans la #TeamDeloitte ? Poste à pourvoir dès que possible Vous integrerez l'équipe Financial & Sustainability Risks. Les spécialistes de ce département interviennent pour conseiller ces entreprises dans leurs projets d’évolution de leurs processus de valorisation, de traitement des instruments financiers et de modélisation des risques. Ils les accompagnent sur l'ensemble de leurs projets : conception et implémentation de modèles financiers et / ou climatiques, implémentation et production des reportings réglementaires, implémentation de nouvelles réglementations, analyse des impacts risques et réglementaires dans le cadre d'opérations de cession ou d'acquisition (due diligence), audits et contre-valorisations d'instruments financiers complexes, mise en place de solutions de gestion du risque de liquidité, ... Vos missions : En tant que consultant(e) junior, vous interviendrez au sein des Directions Financières / des Risques / de la Stratégie / Développement Durable sur des sujets relatifs : au développement de modèles de valorisation d'instruments financiers vanilles et exotiques pour l'ensemble des sous-jacents (action, change, taux d'intérêt, crédit, matière première) et au calcul des risques associés ; au développement de modèles relatifs au risque climatique (risque de transition, risque physique, ...) ; au développement de modèles ALM (projection de marge d’intérêt, modélisation des dépôts à vue, stress test) ; à des audits et contre valorisations d'instruments financiers complexes ; au développements d’outils de pricing ou de mesure du risque climatique ; à la conduite de projets réglementaires relatifs aux risques de marché, de crédit, de liquidité ou de contrepartie ; à l'application des techniques de Machine Learning aux problématiques de modélisation ; à la revue ou à la mise en place de processus de valorisation (pricing, XVA, prudent valuation, transition IBOR) ou de contrôle des valorisations (contrôle des données de marché / consensus, product control, IPV, …) ; à la revue ou refonte des processus FO/MO ou Risques sur activités de marché (collateral management, appel de marge, booking des opérations, contrôles MIFID,…). Exemples de missions : mesure de l'impact du risque climatique sur les portefeuilles d'actifs, assistance à la réalisation des stress tests financiers et climatiques, support à l'audit d'instruments financiers complexes, pricing d’autocalls à partir de techniques de machine learning, modélisation des dépôts à vue, définition de stratégies de couverture ALM, mise en place d'outil de gestion du risque de taux et liquidité, mise en place de dispositifs de collateral management (optimisation cash/titres, mise en place de l’initial margin dans le cadre d’Emir,…), refonte du dispositif de contrôle sur les valorisations. Et si c’était vous ? Vous êtes récemment diplômé(e) d'une grande école d'ingénieurs ou titulaire d'un Master issu d'une université reconnue avec une spécialisation en finance de marché quantitative. Vous avez une sensibilité financière (connaissance de la structure d'un bilan bancaire, enjeux réglementaires et ESG relatifs aux établissements financiers, gestion du capital, ...). Vous êtes pragmatique, rigoureux(se), proactif(ve) et souhaitez travailler au sein d'une équipe à taille humaine et avec une ambiance stimulante dans un environnement international pour proposer des solutions efficaces et opérationnelles à nos clients. Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et en mode projet. Votre maîtrise de la programmation (Python, Java, VBA, Matlab) est un plus. Vous avez une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais à l’oral et l’écrit. #ALLIN : tous les candidats ont leur place chez Deloitte sans aucune distinction, nous croyons en un environnement inclusif.

items.desc: Job Description Skretting Norge søker en ny kollega til en rolle som kombinerer operativt ansvar for daglig reseptoptimering med utvikling av nye og mer effektive metoder for planlegging av vareflyten. Det operative ansvaret gir praktisk kjennskap til dagens prosesser og behov, og et godt grunnlag for å utvikle og teste løsninger som kan effektivisere optimeringen og styrke beslutningsgrunnlaget på tvers av avdelinger. Rollen som Fagspesialist råvareoptimering gir bred innsikt i sentrale forretningsprosesser i Skretting, blant annet råvareinnkjøp, innlogistikk, produksjon og kvalitet, og du får erfarne kolleger og støttespillere rundt deg. Stillingen hører til Skretting Norge, med arbeidssted ved kontoret vårt i Stavanger eller på Averøy. Dine viktigste oppgaver Du får ansvar for å optimere fôrresepter før de går i produksjon, og bidra til å sikre at nødvendige råvarer er tilgjengelige når de trengs. I det daglige samarbeider du med produksjon, innlogistikk og kvalitet, både lokalt og på tvers av fabrikkene. Du har også tett kontakt med innkjøp, sentral reseptoptimering og produksjonsplanlegging. I utviklingsarbeidet skal du hente ut og bearbeide produksjonsdata, identifisere forbedringsmuligheter og omsette dem i praktiske løsninger. Målet er å skape bedre overblikk og dataflyt mellom systemer og gi raskere beslutningsstøtte for logistikk, produksjon og innkjøp. Hvem ser vi etter? Vi ser etter deg som tar initiativ, ser forbedringsmuligheter og motiveres av å skape konkrete resultater. Du er analytisk og løsningsorientert, og evner å omsette data og innsikt til praktiske beslutninger i samarbeid med ulike fagmiljøer. Du har gjerne relevant utdanning på masternivå, for eksempel innen data science, industriell økonomi, logistikk eller beslektede fagområder. En faglig profil med vekt på dataanalyse, maskinlæring, optimering eller operasjonsanalyse er særlig relevant. Vi oppfordrer også nyutdannede og deg som avslutter studiene våren 2027 til å søke. Du er komfortabel med å hente, strukturere og analysere data og har gjerne erfaring med programmering og bruk av API-er. Du har tilstrekkelig teknisk forståelse til å utvikle konkrete løsninger ved hjelp av AI-verktøy og/eller i samarbeid med spesialister Relevant arbeidserfaring og dokumentert kompetanse kan kompensere for manglende mastergrad. Kjennskap til biologi, kjemi, akvakultur, næringsmiddelfag eller industriell produksjon er en fordel, men ikke en forutsetning. Du behersker norsk og engelsk både muntlig og skriftlig. Hva kan vi tilby deg? Du får en sentral rolle med stor påvirkningskraft og mulighet til å skape positive, synlige forbedringer innen reseptoptimering, produksjon og råvareflyt. Du blir en del av et erfarent fagmiljø som samarbeider tett og deler kunnskap. Vi er opptatt av å gi medarbeiderne våre gode utviklingsmuligheter, både gjennom utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver, læring i det daglige og muligheter for videre karriereutvikling i organisasjonen. Har du spørsmål om stillingen, kan du kontakte David Lausten Knudsen, direktør for forretningsutviklingsprosjekter i Skretting Norge, på david.knudsen@skretting.com, eller Elselill Sunde, Talent Acquisition Business Partner, på elselill.sunde@skretting.com Om Skretting Skretting er en verdensledende leverandør av innovative og bærekraftige ernæringsløsninger til havbruksnæringen, med produksjon i 18 land og en årlig fôrproduksjon på over 3 millioner tonn. Skretting Norge har rundt 300 ansatte og produserer cirka 700 000 tonn fôr årlig ved anleggene i Stavanger, Averøy og Stokmarknes. Det norske og globale hovedkontoret ligger i Stavanger. Vår visjon er «Feeding the Future». Søknadsfrist: 20.11.2026 #Ownit #Skretting #Feedingthefuture

items.desc: Är du en student som är ivrig att tillämpa dina teoretiska kunskaper och nya perspektiv på verkliga utmaningar? På Saab tror vi att innovationer växer på nya idéer, och ditt examensarbete kan vara gnistan som tänder vårt nästa tekniska genombrott. Din roll Vi ser det enorma värdet som studenter tillför vårt företag. Din akademiska precision, i kombination med din entusiasm för avancerad teknik, gör att du kan närma dig problem med en unik och insiktsfull lins. På Saab får du möjlighet att samarbeta med erfarna ingenjörer och specialister, få ovärderlig praktisk erfarenhet och samtidigt bidra till vår tillväxt och utveckling. Bakgrund Saab utvecklar idag nya produkter där systemidentifiering är en viktig del av processen. Varje produkt är annorlunda och vi letar efter nya metoder som kan underlätta systemidentifieringen genom att använda nya data-drivna metoder. En noggrann dynamisk modell av systemet är en förutsättning till en bra regulator då det ofta används modellbaserade lösningar för att reglera flygande farkoster. Med erfarenhet och förundersökning kan rimliga grey-box modeller tas fram för att via en optimeringsmetod estimera ett dynamiskt system från provdata, men med utvecklingen av djupare maskininlärning skulle detta kunna underlättas genom att använda flexibla black-box modeller som minskar handpåläggning vid systemidentifieringsarbetet av nya produkter. Detta behöver åstadkommas på ett sätt som ger användaren tolkningsbar och tydlig information om dynamiken så att denna kan utvärderas, i kontrast till t.ex. ett tränat neuronnät där informationen kan bli låst i modellen utan någon form av efterprocess för att extrahera informationen. Beskrivning av examensarbetet Detta examensarbete har som mål att utforska alternativ för systemidentifiering av en flygande farkost där estimeringsmetoden har relaxerade krav på en befintlig grey-box modell genom användning av data-drivna metoder med underliggande estimeringsmodeller av hög flexibilitet. Exempel på dessa kan vara Sparse Symbolic Regression eller taylorisering av neuronnät. Exjobbet utförs på Missile Systems under Saab Dynamics, specifikt under sektionen för Guidance, Navigation & Control. Vi ansvarar för styr- och navigeringssystem för Saabs portfölj av missilsystem. Med detta exjobb så kommer du bidra med insikter till metoder som är relevanta för oss och vårt arbete. Din profil Arbetet är lämpligt för 1-2 studenter med intresse för identifiering av dynamiska system eller maskininlärning. Du/ni är i slutet av en civilingenjörsutbildning med inriktning kring mekatronik, datadrivna metoder eller motsvarande och ska påbörja ett examensarbete om 30hp. Vi ger dig det stöd och den vägledning du behöver för att omsätta dina teoretiska kunskaper i praktiska lösningar. Bli en drivande kraft bakom Saabs tekniska framsteg! Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap. Vänligen observera att vi arbetar med löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum har gått ut. Kontaktpersoner Torbjörn Crona, Chef torbjorn.crona@saabgroup.com 073-418 66 42 Marcus Lourié, kontaktperson/handledare marcus.lourie2@saabgroup.com 072-544 07 66 Vad du blir en del av Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas. Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld. Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här

items.card: responsibilities * Define and implement quality metrics for established workflows * Create prescriptive actions for quality issues * Partner with customers, operations and internal support teams to optimize workflow quality * Conduct side-by-sides to identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements * Analyze data trends and develop solutions * Monitor quality performance and coach operations
items.desc:
Quality Specialists play a vital role in establishing and maintaining comprehensive quality frameworks across our operations. Their primary responsibility begins with developing robust quality strategies in collaboration with customers and CPMs, encompassing metrics, audit approaches, and specific targets for each workflow. When quality issues arise, these specialists create prescriptive actions, examining data patterns to formulate effective solutions. They maintain a continuous improvement cycle by managing a critical feedback loop between operations and customers, drawing insights from multiple sources including quality auditors, side-by-side observations, and metric analysis. Through regular side-by-side sessions, they identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements. The specialists serve as key escalation points for customer concerns, providing strategic recommendations based on their deep understanding of processes. They consistently evaluate quality tools, suggesting refinements to enhance effectiveness, while simultaneously maintaining and updating process documentation to ensure standardization and clarity across all workflows. This comprehensive approach ensures quality remains at the forefront of our operational excellence.
Key job responsibilities
* Define and implement quality metrics for established workflows 
* Create prescriptive actions for quality issues 
* Partner with customers, operations and internal support teams to optimize workflow quality 
* Conduct side-by-sides to identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements
* Analyze data trends and develop solutions 
* Monitor quality performance and coach operations teams 
* Create and maintain quality metrics reports 
* Handle customer escalations and recommendations 
* Evaluate and suggest improvements for quality tools 
* Support process documentation and implementation
A day in the life
Your day starts by checking quality dashboards for your assigned workflows — reviewing audit scores, appeal rates, SLA status, and any overnight escalations. You will spend approximately 30% of your time on analysis: reviewing data trends, investigating root causes of quality dips, and creating prescriptive actions for operations teams. 
Another 30% goes to stakeholder communication: leading weekly customer meetings, preparing quality reports, and handling escalations. The remaining time is split between process work (updating SOPs, refining audit rubrics, conducting side-by-sides) and calibration activities (aligning audit standards with Senior Quality Auditors and operations teams). 
You are measured on: SLA metrics (appeals and batch completion), customer satisfaction, quality improvement trends for your workflows, and documentation quality. 
About the team
The Quality Operations team within FAI Data Services ensures that labeled training data meets accuracy and consistency standards before it is used to train Amazon's AI models. Quality Specialists own the quality strategy for assigned workflows, bridging the gap between operations execution and customer expectations.

items.desc:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. 
 The Position
 A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. 
 Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new computational sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide. 
 Within the CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst organisation drives the modernisation of our computational and data ecosystems and integration of digital technologies across Research and Early Development to enable our stakeholders, power data-driven science and accelerate decision-making. 
 Join the newly formed Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) as a Data Modeling Expert, a key role within our Data Connectivity team. You will serve as a key contributor in the data modeling, semantics, ontologies, and standards space, ensuring our data are FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable), high-quality, and trustable; enabling scientists, computational tools, and AI algorithms from across our Research and Early Development (REDs) organizations to effectively leverage and utilize these data assets. 
 As our Data Modeling Expert, you will: 
 Act as a key subject matter expert on data modeling, ontologies, semantics, and standards efforts, interfacing closely with business/scientific stakeholders and informatics/engineering colleagues. 
 Translate complex scientific requirements from various parts of R&D into clear draft data models that can be leveraged by the wider FAIR data modeling team. 
 Independently contribute to and on occasion drive the development of data models and standards and/or information architecture solutions potentially leading function-level efforts related to FAIR data processes relating to data modeling, standards development and/or information architecture. 
 Independently contribute to and on occasion drive strategies that ensure pan-RED Roche data is ready for AI/ML (AI data readiness), potentially leading tactical efforts around AI/data policies in partnership with other colleagues in the broader team. 
 Independently contributes to and on occasion drive efforts that enable data quality tracking, potentially leading strategies that allow us to track and measure data quality (e.g. tracking how well annotated xRED data is). 
 Foster a OneRoche data-centric mindset within the team, advocating for data standards, governance, and FAIR principles. 
 Contribute to the development, implementation and improvement of Data Governance strategies as it relates to data standards. 
 Who You Are: 
 You hold a Master's degree or higher in a scientific or technical field. 
 Experienced in Data Governance, Data Standards, Data Modeling, Ontology Development, or related fields. 
 You are proficient in one or more critical relevant scientific or data domains, and are able to provide leadership to initiatives based on that knowledge. 
 You are an exceptional communicator with strong networking capabilities, able to build relationships and lead effectively in a matrixed organization. 
 You have experience working within a Research & Development organization and have a deep understanding of its processes and data handling activities. 
 This role is based onsite at our Welwyn office.

items.desc:
Job Description Summary 
Au sein de GE HealthCare et de la division Hardware Engineering MICT ISS XRAY GENERATION, le/la technicien(ne) de Laboratoire – Câblage, Installation Bancs de Tests et Essais – accompagne les équipes R&D dans les projets de conception et de maintenance des générateurs Haute Tension et Tubes à Rayons X. Pour ce faire, il/elle réalise les câblages de cartes et des composants, met en place des bancs de tests, installe des configurations logicielles et est amené à réaliser des tests unitaires et des tests de performances. 
 Job Description 
 Câblage 
 Câblage de cartes électroniques (numérique et puissance) et d’éléments électrotechniques (soudure de composants sur carte, convertisseurs de puissance, blocs haute tension…)
 Câblage des bancs de tests et de composants tels que des power units et coolers
 Routage et installation de câbles dans les laboratoires engineering.
 Gestion des flux de pièces pour la construction des prototypes : 
 Organiser et gérer le stock des cartes électroniques en vue de suivre les évolutions de design, de préparer les kits de matériel, et de tracer les mises à jour avec les fournisseurs de cartes
 Gérer les flux entrants et sortants des étapes de tests des cartes
 Assure la traçabilité des révisions des composants et des configurations
 Installation de bancs de tests 
 Mettre en place les bancs de tests fonctionnels selon les besoins des différents projets.
 Assembler et installer les différents modules (charges, tubes RX, caissons, inverters, blocs haute tension, ordinateurs, câbles, circuits de refroidissement,…)
 Proposer des optimisations concernant les installations des manipulations (ergonomie, sécurité électrique, ..)
 Organiser et gérer le parc informatique composé de 60 ordinateurs engineering de laboratoires, en assurant leur maintenance et le suivi de leur configuration.
 Assurer la migration IT GEHealthCare des ordinateurs du laboratoire engineering.
 Exécuter les tests unitaires et tests de performances 
 Exécuter les tests prédéfinis par l’équipe de conception (test unitaires des circuits électroniques, chargement de logiciel, déroulement de tests automatiques, mesures au voltmètre, à l’oscilloscope etc .. )
 Documenter les résultats de tests, les défauts et les pannes, et les résultats d’investigations. Proposer des solutions techniques.
 Maintenance 
 Apporter du support aux équipes engineering et de production en assurer la maintenance des installations de certains composants et outillages.
 Qualifications requises 
 BAC+2 minimum – Niveau Technicien supérieur en Electronique/ Electrotechnique
 Aisance avec travail sur ordinateur
 Maitrise du Pack Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
 Habilitation risques électriques plateformes d’essais HE/BE essai
 Formations Rayonnements ionisants
 Formations LOTO (Lockout/Tagout)
 Qualifications souhaitées 
 Polyvalence, Curiosité, Rigueur et Autonomie
 Travail d’équipe
 La connaissance du secteur de l’imagerie médicale, des contraintes de routage de cartes et de câbles, de l’electronique de puissance, et de la compatibilité électromagnétique serait un plus.
 Inclusion et diversité : 
 GE HealthCare est un employeur offrant l'égalité des chances où l'inclusion compte. Les décisions relatives à l'emploi sont prises sans tenir compte de l’origine nationale ou ethnique, de la religion, du sexe, de l'orientation sexuelle, de l'identité ou de l'expression de genre, de l'âge, du handicap, du statut d'ancien combattant protégé ou d'autres caractéristiques protégées par la loi.
 Nos rémunérations totales sont conçues pour libérer votre ambition en vous donnant la motivation et la flexibilité dont vous avez besoin pour transformer vos idées en réalités qui changent le monde. Nos salaires et nos avantages sociaux correspondent à tout ce que vous attendez d’une organisation ayant une dimension internationale, avec des possibilités de développement de carrière, dans une culture qui favorise la collaboration et le soutien.
 A propos de nous : 
 GE HealthCare est l'un des leaders mondiaux dans le domaine des technologies médicales et des solutions numériques. Il permet aux cliniciens de prendre des décisions plus rapides et plus pertinentes à travers des équipements intelligents, des analyses de données, des applications et des services. Avec plus de 100 ans d'expérience dans le secteur de la santé et environ 47 000 employés dans le monde, la société est au centre d'un écosystème qui travaille pour une médecine de précision. Présent en France depuis 1987 avec aujourd’hui 2 800 collaborateurs, c’est un acteur solidement ancré dans l’hexagone à travers son empreinte industrielle, son centre de R&D et de production à Buc dans les Yvelines et des partenariats de recherche avec des entreprises et des centres de recherche français. www.gehealthcare.com

Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G.  Nos engagements, vos avantages

 Votre quotidien

 Vous êtes à l’aise dans des organisations matricielles, internationales et multi-parties prenantes.
 Vous savez travailler dans des environnements où l’accès à l’information est strictement encadré, avec application rigoureuse du droit d’en connaitre et des règles de cloisonnement entre pays, programmes, clients et niveaux d’habilitation.
 Vous faites preuve d’excellentes capacités de discernement pour arbitrer entre partage utile, protection des informations sensibles, souveraineté nationale et cohérence globale des solutions.
 Vous êtes reconnu pour votre rigueur, votre capacité d’analyse, votre sens des responsabilités et votre aptitude à alerter au bon niveau lorsqu’un risque technique, réglementaire, sécurité ou de conformité est susceptible de compromettre la réussite d’une solution.
 Vous avez à cœur de promouvoir des pratiques d’ingénierie exigeantes : documentation claire, validation structurée, maîtrise des interfaces, gestion des risques et capitalisation. Vous êtes passionné par l’ingénierie des systèmes complexes qui nécessite l’innovation et la mise en œuvre des technologies selon des pratiques en constante évolution.
 Vos compétences :

 Vous maitrisez les architectures basées sur des services cloud managées, sur des services IaaS ou sur des conteneurs …

items.desc:
Location: Hengelo, Netherlands 
 C/C++ RADAR SOFTWARE ENGINEER 
 For the SMU Team (sensor management unit) we are looking for a software engineer (C/C++) with strong analytical skills and effective communication abilities. You will not only be a developer writing software but also be involved in integrations and troubleshooting, primarily ensuring the software operates correctly across various radar systems. In this role, you will act as a connector across disciplines and work within a close-knit team.
 About Thales 
 Thales designs highly advanced radar systems and optical sensors that are part of a complete and integrated defense system. The product portfolio ranges from small portable radars for applications such as border or object surveillance to complex four-dimensional radars capable of detecting small objects at distances from hundreds up to thousands of kilometers.
 Within the software department, the Sensor Processing group is responsible for software development of the optimal control and digital processing functions within the sensors. This work is carried out in multidisciplinary teams collaborating with specialists in system engineering, functional sensor design, and the design and implementation of real-time systems.
 About the job 
 Within this Sensor Processing group, the complete radar software is developed. This includes various domains such as controlling the radar systems, organizing radar transmissions, and processing the digital information stream. The ultimate goal is to detect and classify specific objects, such as aircraft and drones, track them, and display them on an operator console.
 The software architecture is designed to be highly modular and supports the development of robust and evolutionary systems. Development takes place in Agile teams supported by a modern development toolchain. The teams themselves are responsible for the ongoing development and maintenance of the architecture, the toolchain, and the Agile process.
 About you 
 Do you have a passion for technology and enjoy working on radar controls or complex algorithms? Then you might be the person we are looking for. We would like to offer you the opportunity to build a career in the international high-tech environment at Thales.
 The requirement is a completed Master’s degree in (technical) computer science or a related field. We expect substantial experience (minimum 2 years or more) with the programming languages C and C++ and with developing real-time software. Experience with other programming languages such as Java is a plus. 
 You are creative, open-minded, and flexible, and you can operate effectively as a team player. Additionally, you are results-oriented, show initiative, and communicate clearly. A good command of both Dutch and English is necessary for successful function fulfillment.
 Screening Criteria 
 Minimum of 2+ years of experience in C++ software development
 Experience with Real-Time Software development
 Proficiency with Linux operating systems
 Experience working as part of a large software development organization
 Effective team player 
 Familiarity with build and deployment tools such as Jenkins, Artifactory, Maven 
 Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent 
 Reskilling is possible, but only if the candidate has prior real-time software experience
 Eligibility for VGB-B clearance and eligibility for Dutch Eyes Only classification
 Language: Native or near-native Dutch (C1/C2), combined with professional English 
 What's in it for you 
 A challenging job in a great team within our high-tech, innovative work environment. Includes the freedom for initiative and good ideas.
 Room for personal and professional growth within our organization, for example in regards to technical, commercial or international skills.
 A comfortable work space in a modern environment, with a focus on flexibility and the right work/life balance.
 You can usually work where and when you want, to be able to do your work as well and efficiently as possible. Within Thales we implement hybrid working, where you can, for example, work from home two days a week if your role allows it.
 A good salary, fitting travel allowance, and the ability to personalize your employment conditions. For instance, you can trade days off for our bicycle plan or company fitness.
 40 days paid-time-off per year.
 Interested?
 Apply now! Click on the button below to upload your profile and show your interest.
 To ensure that we are a good match, we may ask you to participate in an assessment.
 A government clearance will be requested as part of standard Thales procedures.
 Diversity Statement 
 We actively support a working pattern that suits your lifestyle and helps you reach your ambitions. That means that equal opportunities, inclusion and an informal culture are integral to our success. It also means that your well-being and happiness matter to us! items.title: Flight Dynamics Modelling Engineer
items.card: The role You will build and validate flight dynamics models for Helsing's aerial platforms. The work runs from first principles, through numerical simulation and test campaigns, to validation against flight-test data. These models feed directly into control law design, simulation environments and autonomy development, so their accuracy sets how quickly and safely new capabilities reach the air. You will work in a
items.desc:
Who we are 
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams, and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.
 The role 
 You will build and validate flight dynamics models for Helsing's aerial platforms. The work runs from first principles, through numerical simulation and test campaigns, to validation against flight-test data. These models feed directly into control law design, simulation environments and autonomy development, so their accuracy sets how quickly and safely new capabilities reach the air. You will work in a small team alongside control, aerodynamics and test engineers, specify the experiments needed to verify each model, and report the results to internal teams and external partners.
 The day-to-day 
 Develop flight dynamics models for aerial platforms end to end, from model architecture and specification through to validation against flight-test data
 Specify and run numerical and experimental campaigns, and set the acceptance criteria that decide when a model is fit for use in simulation and control design
 Work with the control, aerodynamics and test teams so that models feed directly into control law design, simulation environments and autonomy development
 Attend and analyse flight tests, turning telemetry and anomalies into measurable gains in model fidelity
 Document and present model assumptions, limitations and validation results so that programme decisions rest on evidence
 You should apply if you 
 Have built and validated flight dynamics models from first principles, and tested them against real flight or experimental data
 Bring a thorough grounding in aerodynamics, stability and control, and systems modelling, gained through an engineering degree or equivalent practice
 Work fluently in Matlab and Simulink
 Write clean, well-structured code in Matlab and at least one of Python, Rust, Java or modern C++
 Report findings clearly, in writing and in person, to technical and non-technical audiences
 Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. 
 Nice to have 
 Have applied system identification, control systems design or applied aerodynamics in a flight programme
 Have deployed dynamics models onto real-time test rigs, such as hardware-in-the-loop setups
 What we offer 
 Competitive salary and VSOP options
 Relocation support: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation
 Learning: €500/£450 yearly allowance
 Health & wellness: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health)
 Social: regular company events and monthly social allowances
 Enhanced parental leave: 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers
 Family support: 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work
 These are the core benefits across all locations; there may be additional benefits in specific sites.
 Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.
