items.desc:
Si vous avez déjà porté des lunettes, nous nous sommes déjà rencontrés. 
 Nous sommes un leader mondial dans la conception, la fabrication et la distribution de verres ophtalmiques, de montures et de lunettes de soleil. Nous offrons à nos partenaires de l’industrie dans plus de 150 pays l’accès à une plateforme mondiale de produits de soins de la vue de haute qualité (tels que la marque Essilor, avec Varilux, Crizal, Eyezen, Stellest et Transitions), des marques emblématiques que les consommateurs adorent (telles que Ray-Ban, Oakley, Persol, Oliver Peoples, Vogue Eyewear et Costa), ainsi qu’un réseau qui offre aux consommateurs des soins de la vue de haute qualité et des expériences d’achat de premier ordre (tels que Sunglass Hut, LensCrafters, Salmoiraghi & Viganò et le réseau GrandVision), et des plateformes de e-commerce de premier plan.
 Rejoignez notre communauté mondiale de plus de 190 000 employés dévoués à travers le monde pour conduire la transformation de l’industrie des lunettes et des soins de la vue. Découvrez-en plus en nous suivant sur LinkedIn ! 
 Votre #FutureInSight avec EssilorLuxottica 
 Êtes-vous prêt à explorer de nouveaux horizons, à favoriser l’inclusivité et la collaboration, l’agilité, à éveiller la passion et à avoir un impact positif sur le monde ?
 Rejoignez-nous pour redéfinir les limites de ce qui est possible !
 Ce que vous ferez : 
 L’Attaché Technico-Commercial (ATC) est un acteur clé de la satisfaction client et du développement de l’activité Instruments chez Essilor Solutions. Il intervient en binôme avec le Responsable Support Instruments (RSI) pour : 
 Installation et mise en service des équipements 
 Réaliser les installations de la gamme d’équipements Essilor chez les opticiens, ophtalmologistes ou en atelier. 
 Vérifier la conformité technique de l’installation avec les normes et signaler toute non-conformité. 
 Effectuer les réglages et tests nécessaires pour garantir un fonctionnement optimal. 
 Assurer la mise en main complète des appareils : formation théorique et pratique des utilisateurs. 
 Valider l’installation avec le client, établir le PV d’installation et mettre à jour les systèmes internes. 
 Interventions SAV et maintenance de premier niveau 
 Diagnostiquer les pannes à l’aide des outils méthodologiques (essais, historique de maintenance...). 
 Préparer les interventions en consultant les dossiers clients, planifier les rendez-vous, organiser le matériel et les pièces nécessaires. 
 Réaliser l’intervention technique, établir un devis si nécessaire, et effectuer les réparations de niveau 1. 
 En cas de besoin, coordonner avec le RSI ou un référent régional pour les escalades. 
 Former les clients à une bonne utilisation des machines et vérifier l'impact global sur leur environnement technique. 
 Conseil client et développement commercial 
 Promouvoir les nouveaux produits, services et contrats de maintenance. 
 Identifier les besoins additionnels chez le client (petit matériel, consommables, services) et conclure des ventes associées. 
 Conseiller sur l’entretien, la maintenance et l’optimisation des équipements. 
 Être force de proposition dans l’organisation des solutions en magasin. 
 Communication interne et collaboration 
 Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes internes : commerce, marketing, service client, logistique, expertise technique. 
 Participer aux réunions techniques pour partager les bonnes pratiques et remonter les informations terrain. 
 Être un appui auprès des autres ATC : accompagnement, partage de compétences, tutorat. 
 Gestion administrative et logistique 
 Mettre à jour quotidiennement son planning et l’outil de prise de rendez-vous. 
 Rédiger les rapports d’intervention, assurer le suivi du parc client et clôturer les dossiers. 
 Gérer son stock personnel (pièces, consommables, outils) et assurer la cohérence entre les flux physiques et informatiques. 
 Ce qui vous différencie : 
 Ce poste nécessite une polyvalence technique, un excellent sens du service client et une capacité à intervenir en autonomie sur le terrain. 
 Formation et expérience 
 Niveau Bac +2 minimum dans un domaine technique : 
 Électrotechnique , microtechnique , maintenance , ou optique instrumentale 
 Expérience dans le SAV itinérant ou l’installation de matériel technique requise. 
 Une formation ou une expérience dans le domaine optique ou biomédical est un plus. 
 Compétences 
 Maîtrise des outils informatiques, avec de solides notions en réseau . 
 Capacité à diagnostiquer des pannes, à s’organiser de manière autonome, et à anticiper les besoins techniques. 
 Aisance dans la communication client : pédagogie, écoute active, force de proposition. 
 Capacité à travailler en équipe et à partager les bonnes pratiques. 
 Conditions spécifiques 
 Permis B indispensable (poste itinérant). 
 Mobilité sur une zone géographique régionale : Bretagne

VÚB banka je druhá najväčšia banka na Slovensku a súčasť medzinárodnej skupiny Intesa Sanpaolo – jednej z popredných bankových skupín v Európe. V prvom rade sme komunita zanietených ľudí, ktorí veria v prostredie, kde má každý priestor rásť a rozvíjať svoj potenciál. Našou najväčšou hodnotou sú práve naši ľudia. Firemnú kultúru staviame na rešpekte, empatii a dôvere – vďaka čomu sa naši zamestnanci cítia oceňovaní a podporovaní. Ako prvá banka na Slovensku, ktorá získala medzinárodný titul TOP Employer, sme nastavili nový štandard pracovného prostredia. Ponúkame flexibilný spôsob práce – kde to povaha pozície umožňuje, zamestnanci si sami volia, kedy pracujú z domu a kedy z kancelárie. Technológie vnímame ako kľúč k budúcnosti – neustále hľadáme digitálne riešenia, ktoré zjednodušujú prácu a posúvajú nás vpred. items.desc:
As a Digital HW Engineer, you will join X-Haul team as part of MW&CSN Business Unit, which provides Microwave transport solution within Nokia, reference product family is Wavence. You will work effectively as part of a worldwide team, in a multicultural and dynamic context, stay at the state of the art both in terms of technical knowledge and development methodologies, derive from high level product/system requirements detailed HW solutions, take fast ownership of complex existing designs, developing new features, proposing optimizations.
 Digital Hardware (DHA) comprises the specification, design, and implementation of digital hardware. This HW will be part of indoor equipment or uW transceivers, and consists of modems, Ethernet switches, uC, associated power supply circuits to be integrated at module level for verification and product integration.
Requirement analysis and feasibility studies 
 HW architecture definition and selection of relevant technologies/components 
 HW development and technical detailed design 
 HW unit test/qualification and reporting 
 HW project status reporting and tracking 
 HW Configuration management 
 HW pre-integration at system level, including modem and RF parts 
 Contribute to process improvement and innovation
You have: 
 Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Telecommunication Engineering or any related field 
 Deep theoretical knowledge of techniques/technologies related to electronic domains 
 Solid background in maths and physics as provided by engineering university courses 
 Experience to use specific test equipment such as Ethernet tester, power supply, scopes 
 Knowledge in digital components such as Ethernet switch, memories, modem, microprocessor 
 Experience on HW design and product life cycle 
 Knowledge of schematic capture tools such as Mentor or similar 
 Fluent spoken and written English and Italian 
 Good teamwork skills 
 Adaptability and accountability 
 Effectively cooperating with people with different technical background and culture, dealing with diverse situations and viewpoints 
 Eager to learn and expand own knowledge 
 It would be nice if you also had : 
 Knowledge of active devices and electronic system thermal management 
 Knowledge in analog circuit design, linear and non-linear 
 Knowledge of modulation and demodulation theory, QAM signals 
 Experience to use specific test equipment as spectrum analyzer, TDR 
 Knowledge of widely used simulators such as ADS, CST and SPICE

items.desc:
Join our global Cybersecurity Central Coordination team and help turn Information Security governance into effective action across Continental regions, locations and business functions. As Cybersecurity Central Coordinator , you will translate policies, standards and regulatory requirements into coordinated activities and measurable outcomes.
You will connect central, regional and local Cybersecurity stakeholders, strengthen security awareness and compliance, and create transparency on risks, incidents and improvement measures.
 YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 • Coordinate Cybersecurity activities across assigned regions, locations and business functions.
• Support the implementation of Information Security policies, standards and service-management processes.
• Monitor Cybersecurity services and agreed service levels and follow up on delivery issues.
• Maintain dashboards and reports covering compliance, risks, incidents and improvement actions.
• Coordinate remediation of audit findings and support risk assessments and security controls.
• Contribute to Information Security roadmaps, standards, solution concepts and operating-model improvements.
• Support Cybersecurity projects by tracking milestones, dependencies, risks and actions.
• Facilitate stakeholder collaboration, knowledge sharing, awareness, training and phishing-resilience activities.
• Support provider, portfolio and sourcing activities and assess relevant market and technology trends.
• University degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a comparable qualification.
• +3 years of experience in Cybersecurity or Information Security.
• Strong knowledge of Cybersecurity governance, processes, service management and risk management.
• More than 3 years experience in coordinating cross-functional and international stakeholders.
• Experience in project or process coordination and collaboration with service providers.
• Ability to translate legal, regulatory and business requirements into practical actions.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills.
• Business-fluent English and excellent communication skills.
• Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC or ISO 27001 are an advantage.

Ready to create a smarter world? Join the future of Innovation. Join NXP. 
 NXP Semiconductors enables secure connections and infrastructure for a smarter world, advancing solutions that make lives easier, better and safer. As the world leader in secure connectivity solutions for embedded applications, we are driving innovation in the secure connected vehicle, end-to-end security & privacy and smart connected solutions markets. We are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic AI Software developer. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a dynamic semiconductor environment, supporting and maintaining critical software systems.
 We expect 
 Experience with Python (and writing production software in Python) . Familiarity with software engineering best practices. 
 Nice-to-have J ava S cript /T ype S cript/React experience or minor-scale GUI/UI/UX development. 
 Academical background or e xperience with neural networks or machine learning algorithms. 
 Nice-to-have experience with AI/ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch or with compiler technologies. 
 Passion for artificial intelligence, machine learnin g, smart devices, agentic systems or similar. 
 Curious and innovative thinking . R esponsibility for meeting goals and deadlines. 
 We offer 
 Work in a n awarded team with high energy , an open collaboration environment and eagerness for continuous improvement. 
 Experience in a multinational world-leading semiconductor company​. 
 Work with the latest innovations and become a contributor to state-of-the-art technologies in the field of artificial intelligence. 
 Opensource contributions to the World ’ s leading repositories on GitHub. 
 Co-develop technologies used by hardware in state-of-the-art devices by our customers such as smart glasses, self-driving cars or in medical/industrial segments 
 Job summary 
 Develop tools , libraries and algorithms in Python for optimizing neural network models for embedded and mobile devices. 
 Develop tools in Python to deploy, profile, benchmark neural network models on embedded and mobile devices 
 Contribute to opensource (e. g., PyTorch, ONNX, TensorFlow or other popular opensource communities ). 
 Enable audio, vision, generative AI and/or l anguage models on mobile and embedded devices. 
 Explore latest research and technologies . Implement proof-of-concepts or invent something of your own, and pursue a paper or a patent. Present your work on World's leading software conferences.

items.desc:
Bij Tonny Media zijn we op zoek naar een redactiestagiair om ons team te komen versterken. Ben jij iemand die extreem handig is met social media? Lees dan snel verder!
 DISCLAIMER: wij werken met twee vaste stageperiodes van een half jaar (van februari t/m juni en van september t/m januari). Ongeacht de stageperiodes mag solliciteren natuurlijk altijd, zeker als je echt een 11/10 bent! Weet dan wel dat wij jouw sollicitatie waarschijnlijk pas voor aanvang van de eerstvolgende stageperiode zullen bekijken. 
 Over ons
 Wij zijn Tonny Media, het spannendste (media)bedrijf van Nederland. Je kunt ons kennen van de bovenste regionen van de podcastlijstjes. Maar het kan ook zijn dat je ons nog niet kent, wat het des te raarder maakt dat je deze vacature nu leest. Wij maken podcasts, videoproducties, bedenken reclamecampagnes, ontwikkelen social media strategieën en maken podcasts in opdracht van bekende merken. We kunnen heel veel, maar willen meer. Onze talentvolle redactie heeft nóg meer talent nodig, en daarom zoeken we een redactiestagiair.
 Wat je gaat doen
 We zijn op zoek naar een redactionele allrounder die even gestructureerd als creatief is. Iemand met gekke ideeën, die altijd alles op tijd af heeft. Jouw skills zullen dagelijks worden benut voor het bedenken en uitwerken van geniale dingen.
 Wie zoeken wij?
 Iemand die handig is met social media.
 Iemand die energie krijgt van waterdichte scripts schrijven.
 Iemand die weet wat een podcast is, daar affectie mee heeft en een mening over heeft.
 Iemand die het begrip ‘tijdnood’ niet kent, ‘agendamanagement’ wél.
 Pietje Precies (als je echt zo heet, ben je nu al aangenomen).
 Iemand met een 9-tot-5-mentaliteit, maar die niks durft te zeggen als hij/zij moet overwerken.
 Iemand met basisvaardigheden in Adobe Photoshop.
 Iemand die snapt waarom het ene TikTok/Reels filmpje leuker is dan de andere.
 Wat bieden wij?
 6 maanden onderdak en een leuke stagevergoeding.
 Veel vrijheid en nog meer verantwoordelijkheid.
 Een leeromgeving waarin je alle kneepjes van het vak kan leren.
 Een groep jonge collega’s met de beste intenties.
 Een (werk)plek in Amsterdam om je vriend(in) te ontvluchten.
 Leerzame samenwerking met talentvolle makers.
 Een MacBook in bruikleen.
 Een bedrijf zonder diversiteit is als elke dag hetzelfde bord koude aardappelen eten. En wie wil dat nou? Bij Tonny geloven we dat het samenbrengen van verschillende achtergronden en identiteiten de vruchtbare grond is waaruit een mooie tuin van bloeiende content kan komen groeien, en dat is precies wat we willen. We heten daarom alles en iedereen welkom, omdat een inclusieve cultuur de sluizen opengooit waar ideeën doorheen kunnen vloeien. Lang (wollig proza) verhaal kort: wie je ook bent, doe alsof je thuis bent.
 Solliciteer
 Ben jij de redactionele allrounder die wij zoeken? Solliciteer dan zo snel mogelijk en wie weet nodigen we je uit voor een gesprek.

items.desc:
Zorg ervoor dat de dagelijkse werkzaamheden van onze Benelux-klanten soepel verlopen 
 Bij tamigo zijn wij dé vertrouwde partner voor Workforce Management in heel Europa. We helpen bekende internationale retail- en horecamerken om hun dagelijkse werkzaamheden efficiënter en transparanter te maken.
 Als onze nieuwe Medewerker customerservice ben jij van cruciaal belang voor het succes van de bedrijfsvoering van onze klanten in de Benelux-markt. Dit gaat niet alleen om het oplossen van tickets — elke dag speel je detective: een klant loopt tegen een probleem aan, jij duikt erin, achterhaalt wat er werkelijk aan de hand is en zet dat om in een oplossing. Jouw werk bepaalt rechtstreeks of onze Benelux-klanten kunnen vertrouwen op tamigo om hun dagelijkse werkzaamheden zonder verstoringen te laten verlopen. Zo word je een echte expert in onze Workforce Management-software, leer je werken met de tools die een modern SaaS-supportteam gebruikt en ontdek je hoe je technische zaken uitlegt op een manier die mensen echt verder helpt.
 Je werkt nauw samen met onze klanten in de Benelux-markt, met de afdeling Customer Experience en met collega's binnen heel tamigo — en vanaf dag één maak je volwaardig deel uit van het team.
 Wat je gaat doen 
 Klanten in de Benelux-markt ondersteunen via e-mail en telefoon, met technische hulp en probleemoplossing
 Klanten opleiden en in staat stellen om tamigo optimaal te benutten
 Helpen bij contractverlengingen en documentatie vertalen van het Engels naar het Nederlands
 Uitgebreide product- en marktkennis opdoen en die inzetten om echt waarde toe te voegen voor de klant
 De kenniskloof voor onze klanten overbruggen en echte impact maken op hun dagelijkse werkzaamheden
 Je bent de juiste kandidaat als 
 Je beheerst het Nederlands op professioneel niveau, in woord en geschrift, plus professioneel Engels 
 Je bent nieuwsgierig, technisch onderlegd en geduldig — je gaat liever tot de kern van een probleem dan het alleen maar af te vinken
 Je bent open, makkelijk in de omgang en leergierig
 Eerdere ervaring is niet vereist — wij hechten meer waarde aan mentaliteit dan aan jaren op een cv
 Wat wij jou bieden 
 Een fulltime functie bij een echt internationaal, groeiend SaaS-bedrijf
 De kans om diepgaande productexpertise op te bouwen en je carrière uit te bouwen in customer support of customer success
 Een vriendelijk, plat team verspreid over Europa, met collega's die je helpen om snel op weg te komen
 Probeer het product dat je gaat ondersteunen Maak kennis met de oplossing waarin jij expert wordt: https://tamigo.com/free-trial Meld je aan met 'Candidate' als bedrijfsnaam en test onze oplossing zelf.
 Houd er rekening mee dat u een geldige EU-werkvergunning moet hebben om voor deze functie in aanmerking te komen
 De functie is gevestigd op ons kantoor in Houten, Nederland.
 salarisbereik: 2.600 - 3.100 maandelijks

items.desc: A propos La Société des Colorants du Sud-Ouest (SCSO) - UNIKALO , créée en 1936 est une entreprise familiale actuellement dirigée par la 3ème génération de la famille fondatrice et regroupe deux activités distinctes : La production de peintures bâtiment et de produits de traitements de surface, sur 3 sites industriels répartis à Mérignac (33), Cestas (33) et Carbonne (31 ), sous les marques Unikalo et Prodirox. E n 2025, plus de 52 000 tonnes de peintures ont été produites. La Distribution de produits de peinture et décoration au travers de son réseau Nuances Unikalo, composé de plus de 250 points de vente sur le territoire français ainsi que 5 en Suisse Par ces deux activités, SCSO-UNIKALO a réalisé un CA de 618,6 M€ en 2025. SCSO-UNIKALO se positionne comme le 1er fabricant indépendant Français et le 1er réseau de négoce en décoration professionnelle . Cette formidable réussite est le fruit d’une parfaite cohésion entre un réseau à forte valeur humaine, Nuances Unikalo, et la force du fabricant de peinture, Unikalo. Notre volonté est de proposer des produits toujours plus innovants et respectueux de l’homme et de l’environnement. Ainsi, Unikalo est certifié ISO 14001 depuis 2008 et nous proposons à nos clients une large gamme de produits certifiée NF environnement. En 2026, nous poursuivons notre engagement dans une démarche RSE (Responsabilité Sociétale des Entreprises) pour porter ces valeurs et répondre aux enjeux de demain. Rejoindre les équipes Unikalo et Nuances Unikalo, composées de plus de 1 700 collaborateurs, c’est intégrer une entreprise familiale française attachée au respect de ses Collaborateurs, ainsi qu’à la satisfaction de ses Clients pour participer à un projet d’Entreprise en plein essor en bénéficiant d’un accompagnement et de formations personnalisées. Description Rattaché(e) à la Direction des Systèmes d’Information, le Chef de projet IA & Transformation des usages a pour mission de piloter le déploiement de l’IA dans les différents services de l’entreprise, d’accompagner les collaborateurs dans l’appropriation de ces nouveaux outils et de contribuer à faire émerger une véritable culture de l’IA au sein du Groupe . Il est un acteur central de la transformation de nos modes de travail. Votre mission Nous recherchons notre futur(e) Chef de projet IA & Transformation des usages H/F , capable de faire le lien entre les nouvelles technologies et les besoins opérationnels de nos équipes. Rattaché(e) à la Direction des Systèmes d’Information (DSI), vous jouerez un rôle central dans le déploiement des solutions d’IA, l’accompagnement des collaborateurs et le développement d’une culture commune autour de ses usages. Un poste transverse, au cœur des métiers, où votre curiosité, votre sens du contact et votre capacité à transformer les idées en solutions concrètes feront la différence. 1. Identifier les opportunités et déployer l’IA dans les métiers Vous partez des besoins du terrain pour identifier les usages à valeur ajoutée et transformer le potentiel de l’IA en bénéfices concrets pour l’entreprise. Collaborer avec les directions et les équipes métiers pour identifier les cas d’usage pertinents. Analyser les besoins, évaluer les solutions disponibles et proposer les approches les plus adaptées. Piloter les projets de déploiement des solutions d’IA, de l’identification du besoin à leur mise en œuvre opérationnelle. Accompagner les équipes dans la prise en main des outils et leur intégration dans les pratiques quotidiennes. Mesurer les bénéfices obtenus, identifier les axes d’amélioration et faire évoluer les usages. Assurer une veille active sur les innovations, les outils et les nouvelles possibilités offertes par l’IA. 2. Accompagner les collaborateurs et faciliter l’adoption des usages L’IA ne crée de valeur que lorsqu’elle répond à un besoin réel et que chacun sait s’en saisir. Vous serez un interlocuteur privilégié pour aider les collaborateurs à découvrir son potentiel et à l’intégrer dans leur quotidien. Être le référent IA auprès des équipes et répondre à leurs questions. Aider les collaborateurs à identifier les tâches pouvant être simplifiées, optimisées ou automatisées grâce à l’IA. Partager les bonnes pratiques et accompagner les premiers usages. Identifier les freins à l’adoption, accompagner le changement et faciliter l’appropriation des nouveaux outils. Repérer les initiatives inspirantes dans les différents services et favoriser le partage d’expérience. Votre objectif : faire émerger des usages utiles, encourager l’expérimentation et permettre à chacun de gagner en efficacité. 3. Former, transmettre et développer une culture commune de l’IA Vous aurez également un rôle essentiel dans la montée en compétences des collaborateurs. Votre pédagogie vous permettra de rendre ces technologies accessibles et de donner à chacun les clés pour les utiliser efficacement. items.desc: Périmètre & Responsabilités Pipelines RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) : conception et mise en ?uvre des stratégies de récupération, segmentation (chunking), reclassement (reranking) et recherche hybride. Les décisions sur le stockage et la couche vectorielle sont encore ouvertes ; vous y contribuerez. Ce travail s'inscrit dans la construction de systèmes RAG adaptés aux besoins des cas d'usage. Architecture d'agents : modèles d'utilisation d'outils (tool use), flux de raisonnement en plusieurs étapes, conception avec humain dans la boucle (human-in-the-loop), gestion des fenêtres de contexte. Harnais d'évaluation : échafaudage de tests construit en coordination avec l'ingénieur LLMOps (LLM Operations). Ingénierie des prompts : prompts structurés, conception few-shot, modèles de chaîne de pensée (chain-of-thought). Bibliothèque de composants partagés : composants TypeScript réutilisables issus des cas d'usage, qui alimentent le SDK (Software Development Kit) IA interne du client, en complément de la surface de développement de l'équipe Platform. Lancement et construction de cas d'usage aux côtés des ingénieurs FDE (Forward Deployed Engineer) et des équipes de livraison. Exigences techniques Compétences obligatoires Systèmes LLM en production : capacité à faire passer des systèmes basés sur des LLM du prototype au déploiement en production, en passant par le harnais d'évaluation. RAG et récupération d'information : conception de pipelines de récupération, connaissance des points de rupture d'un RAG naïf et des compromis entre approches dense, clairsemée (sparse) et hybride. Modèles agentiques : appels d'outils et flux d'agents en plusieurs étapes, y compris leurs caractéristiques de fiabilité. Évaluation : conception de jeux de données d'évaluation pertinents pour des domaines inconnus. La capacité de rédaction est évaluée pendant le processus de construction. Stack principale : TypeScript et Node.js. Langues : anglais professionnel et français courant. Environnement technique de référence SDK Vercel AI et AWS Bedrock comme environnements représentatifs. Modèle principal : Claude, via l'API Anthropic et Claude Enterprise. Profil candidat: Ingénieur expérimenté ayant déjà livré des systèmes LLM en production (pas uniquement des prototypes ou des POC (Proof of Concept)). Expérience de collaboration avec des profils variés : chefs de produit, ingénieurs métier, contributeurs plateforme. Autonomie et capacité à travailler sur des cas d'usage réels, intégré aux équipes de livraison. Posture de transfert de compétences : l'objectif de l'équipe Enablement est de rendre les équipes autonomes. Compétences obligatoires : Systèmes LLM en production : capacité à faire passer des systèmes basés sur des LLM du prototype au déploiement en production, en passant par le harnais d'évaluation. RAG et récupération d'information : conception de pipelines de récupération, connaissance des points de rupture d'un RAG naïf et des compromis entre approches dense, clairsemée (sparse) et hybride. Modèles agentiques : appels d'outils et flux d'agents en plusieurs étapes, y compris leurs caractéristiques de fiabilité. Évaluation : conception de jeux de données d'évaluation pertinents pour des domaines inconnus. La capacité de rédaction est évaluée pendant le processus de construction. Stack principale : TypeScript et Node.js. Langues : anglais professionnel et français courant. Critères décisifs (différenciants) : Expérience de construction de harnais d'évaluation et de jeux de données d'évaluation sur des domaines nouveaux. You can count on: A competitive salary with a full benefits package including meal vouchers, eco vouchers, health insurance, group insurance, net expense allowance and a company car with charging or fuel card Personal growth support with tailored training and clear career development A stable environment where your technical skills directly contribute to improved patient care The chance to work with high tech diagnostic systems at top tier healthcare institutions A warm and collaborative culture focused on trust, ownership and long term impact Job description Our client is looking for an Analytical Method Development Scientist to strengthen its analytical development activities at a biopharmaceutical manufacturing facility in Geel. Data analysis: Perform analytical data trending, statistical evaluations and method performance monitoring to ensure continued reliability. Deviation investigations: Investigate analytical deviations, identify root causes and develop scientifically justified corrective actions. Scientific documentation: Prepare comprehensive analytical protocols, validation documentation, technical reports and scientific conclusions. Laboratory activities: Support practical laboratory testing and contribute to the successful implementation of analytical methods. Scientific collaboration: Communicate analytical findings, present study results and collaborate with multidisciplinary stakeholders. Analytical method development: Proven experience developing, qualifying and validating analytical methods within a biopharmaceutical environment. Regulatory knowledge: Excellent understanding of cGMP requirements and the ability to translate regulatory expectations into practical analytical activities. Experimental design: Experience designing and executing DOE studies for analytical method qualification and validation. Statistical analysis: Ability to perform statistical evaluations, interpret analytical method performance parameters and critically assess complex datasets. Scientific documentation: Strong technical writing skills with experience preparing analytical protocols, validation reports and scientific documentation. Independent working: Ability to plan and execute analytical studies independently, manage multiple priorities and formulate scientifically sound conclusions. Protein characterisation: Knowledge of SDS PAGE, Western blotting, Southern blotting or Northern blotting is a plus. Communication and languages: Excellent communication skills, fluency in written and spoken English and knowledge of Dutch. Willingness to combine laboratory activities with analytical desk work and work full time onsite in Geel. items.desc: Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects. Who we are supporting The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium. The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including: Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats. Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations. Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces. Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks. Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers. Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities. The program Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS) The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCI Agency) is NATO's principal C3 capability deliverer and CIS service provider. It provides, maintains and defends the NATO enterprise-wide information technology infrastructure to enable Allies to consult together under Article IV, and, when required, stand together in the face of attack under Article V. To provide these critical services, in the modern evolving dynamic environment the NCI Agency needs to build and maintain high performance-engaged workforce. The NCI Agency workforce strategically consists of three major categorise's: NATO International Civilians (NIC)'s, Military (Mil), and Interim Workforce Consultants (IWC)'s. The IWCs are a critical part of the overall NCI Agency workforce and make up approximately 15 percent of the total workforce. Provision and maintain VMs, storage on cloud and databases on prem and on cloud, ensuring high availability and performance. Manage and optimize cloud components. Automate the deployment and management of AWS or Azure resources using Terraform, or similar tools. Experience with VMs, storage accounts, virtual networks and monitoring tools on Cloud. Experience with DevOps practices, including continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD). Knowledge of monitoring and logging tools (CloudWatch, ELK Stack, Prometheus). Excellent communication skills to effectively interact with users, team members and stakeholders Must demonstrate the ability and self-motivation to work on his/her own but must also work well within groups as part of a team; Must demonstrate an ability and keen sense for problem-solving. Motivated, good communication skills, team player. Able to work independently with minimal supervision. Knowledge of NATO responsibilities and organization. Daarbij onderzoek je hoe de verwachtingen van de business aansluiten op de kwaliteit en efficiëntie van de vertalingen die het interne team en de externe vertaalpartner leveren. Een belangrijk aandachtspunt is de kwaliteit van machinevertaling . Je beoordeelt de huidige aanpak, onderzoekt moderne AI-alternatieven en vertaalt je bevindingen naar een onderbouwde verbeterstrategie. Je advies omvat mensen, processen, governance, middelen, AI-capaciteiten en tools . Hiermee geef je het management een objectieve basis om beslissingen te nemen over de toekomstige organisatie van vertaalactiviteiten, technologiekeuzes en procesverbeteringen. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Het volledige vertaalecosysteem analyseren en de onderliggende oorzaken van ontevredenheid bij stakeholders identificeren. De behoeften en verwachtingen van de business vergelijken met de geleverde vertaalkwaliteit en efficiëntie. De huidige Machine Translation-kwaliteit , feedbackprocessen en dienstverlening van de externe partner beoordelen. Alternatieve AI-vertaaltools en vertaalengines voor bedrijfsgebruik onderzoeken, testen en benchmarken. Nauw samenwerken met de interne verantwoordelijke om bestaande workflows te begrijpen en relevante stakeholders te betrekken. Opleidingsbehoeften identificeren en aanbevelingen formuleren voor de inzet van mensen en middelen. Verbeteringen voorstellen voor processen, governance en leveranciersbeheer, waaronder SLA’s en duidelijke verantwoordelijkheden . De bevindingen bundelen in een helder managementrapport en een concrete, uitvoerbare verbeterroadmap. Jouw profiel Aantoonbare ervaring in een vergelijkbare analytische of adviserende rol binnen vertaling en lokalisatie . Sterke praktijkkennis van Machine Translation (MT), Neural Machine Translation (NMT) en vertaalworkflows met Large Language Models (LLM’s) . Ervaring met vertaaltools voor bedrijfsgebruik en kennis van belangrijke Translation Management Systems (TMS) en vertaalleveranciers. Het vermogen om operationele problemen vanuit een breder perspectief te analyseren en onderliggende oorzaken bloot te leggen. Een onafhankelijke, analytische en resultaatgerichte adviesaanpak. Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden om technische tekortkomingen te vertalen naar concrete gevolgen voor de business. Sterke vaardigheden in stakeholdermanagement en het presenteren van heldere strategische keuzes aan het management. Wat maakt deze opdracht interessant? Je krijgt de kans om richting te geven aan de toekomstige vertaalstrategie van een internationale organisatie. Je combineert onafhankelijke analyse met praktijkgericht onderzoek naar AI-technologie en levert concrete aanbevelingen voor betere vertaalkwaliteit, efficiëntere processen en een sterkere samenwerking met externe partners.

items.desc: Environment de travail Le Service général du renseignement et de la sécurité (SGRS) - QUAERO ET TEGO : JE CHERCHE ET JE PROTÈGE Les menaces à l’encontre de notre société évoluent en permanence. Le SGRS est le service belge de référence en matière de renseignement extérieur et de défense. Par notre renseignement, nous contribuons à protéger les intérêts de la Défense, de notre pays et de sa population. Nous appréhendons au mieux les défis actuels et futurs dans le domaine du Renseignement, de la Sécurité et du Cyberespace. Grâce à une approche intégrée, tant sur le plan national qu’international, nous participons ensemble avec nos différents partenaires au maintien et au renforcement de la sécurité intérieure. Le Cyber Command est une entité transversale appelée à grandir au sein de la Défense tout en restant dans le giron du SGRS dont elle partage le cadre légal et les missions. Son rôle est double. Le Cyber Command est aussi bien en charge de la cybersécurité des réseaux et systèmes d’armes employés par la Défense que de collecter des informations et mener des opérations dans le cyberespace au profit du SGRS. En tant que membre de la capacité cybernétique militaire, vous êtes non seulement responsable de la protection des réseaux militaires et des systèmes d'armes, mais vous analysez et combattez également les cyberincidents nationaux en collaboration avec des organisations partenaires. En outre, au sein du Service de Renseignement et de Sécurité, vous collectez activement des renseignements dans le domaine cybernétique pour protéger, soutenir et exécuter des opérations militaires. Description de fonction En tant que « Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst », vous contribuez à former l'image la plus claire possible de la cybermenace dominante. Sur la base de cette évaluation des menaces, les priorités sont déterminées et le fonctionnement du Cyber Command est défini. Vous êtes en contact étroit avec les différentes sections du Cyber Command et assurez une circulation optimale de l'information. Vous déterminez la cybermenace en analysant les informations que vous collectez auprès de sources publiques et les renseignements provenant de sources fermées (telles que les services de renseignement partenaires). Nous enrichissons ces informations avec des informations provenant de nos propres systèmes de détection et d'analyses effectuées par vos collègues (telles que l'analyse des logiciels malveillants, l'analyse médico-légale et la réponse aux incidents). Vous vous plongerez dans les méthodes de travail et les intentions des acteurs qui représentent la plus grande menace pour la Défense belge et, par extension, pour la Belgique. Vous étudiez leur fonctionnement et collectez des indicateurs qui nous permettent d'affiner nos systèmes de détection et de défense. Vous réfléchissez de manière proactive à de nouvelles méthodes de détection et de défense. La recherche active et l’identification des infrastructures adverses sur Internet peuvent également aider à détecter les attaques ultérieures. Vous contribuez à une base de connaissances que vos collègues peuvent consulter lors de la réponse aux incidents. Grâce à nos dispositifs de détection, nous détecterons et visualiserons les attaques adverses. Vous aidez vos collègues à hiérarchiser les signalements d’incidents potentiels. Sur la base des informations collectées, vous établissez des statistiques et ajustez l’évaluation des menaces. Vous rédigez des rapports (périodiques), des rapports de renseignement ponctuels sur vos analyses et répondez à des questions spécifiques des services partenaires de la Défense, nationaux et internationaux. Vous maintenez le contact avec tous ces partenaires pour assurer un échange d'informations optimal. Sur la base des informations que vous collectez, traitez et analysez, vous contribuez également à : Protéger les réseaux et les systèmes d'armes de la Défense ; Protéger le personnel militaire contre les cybermenaces actives, tant en Belgique que dans les régions où le personnel militaire belge est déployé ; Trouver l'aiguille (cyber) dans la botte de foin lors des enquêtes sur les incidents cybernétiques ; Identifier les attaquants et fournir des conclusions techniques qui peuvent contribuer au niveau politique à attribuer une cyberattaque à un acteur et pays spécifique ; Contribuez aux opérations cybernétiques offensives en vous basant sur les renseignements que vous collectez. Description de profil Vous êtes titulaire d’un Master ou d’un Bachelier en informatique ou vous disposez d’une expérience équivalente Vous connaissez Microsoft Windows et Office et avez une aptitude à prendre rapidement en main de nouveaux outils et logiciels. Vous êtes capable d'analyser des documents stratégiques et techniques et de distinguer les informations pertinentes des détails grâce à votre esprit d'analyse. Vous pensez de manière critique et orienté vers les solutions. Vous êtes capable d’expliquer des questions techniques de manière simple et …

Interested in a career that matters? 
 Are you passionate about using sensory science to turn product experiences into insights that make a difference? Join our Food & Beverage sensory team in Food & Protein Applied R&D in Lyngby, where you will help strengthen sensory capabilities across Novonesis Food & Beverage Biosolutions. Working in a team of sensory scientists and a sensory technician, you will collaborate closely with application scientists, technical service, commercial teams, marketing, consumer insights, and sensory colleagues globally. We value scientific quality, curiosity, collaboration, openness, and practical solutions that create value for our customers. The role & your impact As our Sensory Scientist, you will play a central role in turning project and customer needs into robust sensory studies and actionable insights. You will combine hands-on sensory science with capability building, supporting colleagues across regions in establishing fit-for-purpose sensory practices and developing local competencies. Your work will support new product development, launches, customer projects, and commercial activities across Food & Beverage Biosolutions. Your key responsibilities in this role Translate project and customer needs into fit-for-purpose sensory study designs. Plan and conduct sensory evaluations using trained panels, including descriptive, discriminative, and fast methods. Analyze sensory data, assess data quality and panel performance, and translate findings into actionable insights. Support regional colleagues in building sustainable sensory capabilities and applying consistent sensory practices. Develop and deliver sensory training, practical guidance, methods, and supporting materials for regional and global teams. Contribute sensory expertise to new product development, launches, customer engagements, market and competitor mapping, best practices, digital tools, and data management. What you’ll need to be successful in this role We are looking for someone who brings: An MSc or PhD in sensory science, food science, consumer science, or a related field. Several years of practical experience designing and conducting sensory studies, preferably in a food industry setting. Experience working with trained sensory panels, including training, calibration, and performance monitoring. Strong knowledge of sensory methodologies, experimental design, and data analysis. The ability to translate scientific results into clear recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders and facilitate discussions about sensory results with colleagues and customers. Strong written and spoken English. You are scientifically rigorous, analytical, curious, and well organized. You enjoy hands-on sensory work and are comfortable turning open questions into structured studies and practical recommendations. You are also people-oriented and enjoy training, presenting, and engaging with colleagues across cultures and geographies. You involve others, listen to understand their needs, and build constructive relationships across different perspectives. Additional skills & interests we value It would be an advantage if you bring: Experience with EyeQuestion or similar sensory software. Experience with statistical tools such as EyeOpenR, R, or JMP. Experience from the food, beverage, ingredients, or consumer-goods industry. What we offer you You will become part of a collaborative sensory team where scientific quality, curiosity, openness, and practical problem-solving are valued. The role gives you the opportunity to combine hands-on sensory science with broader capability building, collaborating with colleagues across functions and geographies while contributing to sensory practices, training, and insights across Food & Beverage Biosolutions. Working conditions The position is based in Lyngby and includes hands-on panel and laboratory activities. Some travel will be required for customer engagements, training, and collaboration with regional teams. Some hybrid working may be possible when compatible with project and panel needs. Application deadline Please submit your application by November 9 th 2026 . items.desc: NestAI builds the adaptive operating system for modern battlefield operations. Most AI systems are built once, validated at deployment, and expected to stay sufficient after that. That assumption holds until conditions change, and in defence, they always do. Our team develops adaptive intelligence for unmanned and command systems: AI that continuously learns from operational data and adapts to changing conditions, deployed in environments where there is no internet, no GPS, and failure is not an option. NestOS, our open, modular, and interoperable platform, enables this at scale and keeps capability evolution under sovereign European control. Founded in 2025 by Peter Sarlin, whose previous company Silo AI became Europe's largest AI acquisition, NestAI has grown to over 200 engineers and scientists and partners with leading European defence forces and industry. We're ambitious about what we're building and honest with each other. The bar is high, and so are the standards we hold ourselves to. But this is also a place built on humility, trust, and looking after each other. If that sounds like the kind of work you want to do, keep reading. Join us as a Forward Deployed Field Engineer As an Forward Deployed Field Engineer, you'll be NestAI's point person on the ground with our customers, from exercises to daily operations. You'll see first-hand how a customer's capabilities fit into the bigger operational picture, and get exposure to genuinely varied technical contexts along the way. When something needs fixing, whether that's a line of code or a piece of hardware, you're the person who works it out with whatever is at hand. What you'll work on You'll be the main technical point of contact for customers in the field, working across exercises and daily operations where every day looks different. Day-to-day, you will: Own the technical relationship with customer stakeholders, communicating daily with their project managers and technical teams Develop and adapt NestOS capabilities to fit each customer's operational context Work on site during field exercises and daily customer operations, troubleshooting issues as they come up Solve problems with whatever is at hand, whether that means debugging software or picking up a soldering iron, because no task is too small and no two days are the same Collaborate closely with NestAI's project manager, the FDE team assigned to the project, and the customer's technical team to keep operations running What we're looking for If your background doesn't match every requirement but the work resonates with you, we'd encourage you to apply. How you think, learn, and take ownership matters more to us than ticking every box. Here is what we are looking for: Comfortable with Generic Linux systems and the command line Understanding of network technologies, covering both IP and radio networks Some experience across the full stack Experience with Python or scripting more broadly Comfortable working with ambiguity, finding solutions in the field with whatever tools are at hand Willingness to travel to and work in customer environments as needed, including domestic and international trips lasting a few days at a time Nice to have: Familiarity with UXV (uncrewed vehicle) hardware Deep expertise in one relevant specialist area, such as spectrum and frequency management or tactical systems such as TAK Why join NestAI Work alongside over 200 engineers and scientists, including 60+ PhDs. People who've built AI platforms, autonomous systems, and defence technology across Europe. Most of our people say the best thing about NestAI is the people you get to work with. Work with real ownership. You identify what needs building, talk to the right people, and ship. Ownership here is the expectation, not a talking point. Work at a company where the platform, the practices, and the standards are all being built right now. The people here get to define how things work and how they scale. items.title: Fabrication by Binder Jetting and functionalization by DLI-CVD of catalytic objects with high specific surface area
items.card: Fabrication by Binder Jetting and functionalization by DLI-CVD of catalytic objects with high specific surface area Réf ABG-140721 Sujet de Thèse 26/10/2026 Contrat doctoral CIRIMAT Lieu de travail TOULOUSE - Occitanie - France Intitulé du sujet Fabrication by Binder Jetting and functionalization by DLI-CVD of catalytic objects with high specific surface area Champs scientifiques Matériaux Description du sujet
items.desc: Fabrication by Binder Jetting and functionalization by DLI-CVD of catalytic objects with high specific surface area Réf ABG-140721 Sujet de Thèse 26/10/2026 Contrat doctoral CIRIMAT Lieu de travail TOULOUSE - Occitanie - France Intitulé du sujet Fabrication by Binder Jetting and functionalization by DLI-CVD of catalytic objects with high specific surface area Champs scientifiques Matériaux Description du sujet Context This thesis is part of the INCANTO project (funded by french national research agency ANR) that aims to overcome a barrier for catalytic reactors operating in gas-liquid mixtures: in the common case of viscous reactive liquids in exothermic reactions, these reactors suffer from the difficulty of reactants to diffuse into porous catalytic grains, the inhomogeneous distribution of phases in the granular bed, and the inefficient removal of reaction heat. It is proposed to replace traditional catalytic grains with specifically designed, aerated objects with a high surface area . Arranged in a bed, these objects will ensure efficient phase distribution with moderate pressure drop. Some objects will be manufactured in alumina using the Gel Casting method , others additively printed in SiC using the Binder Jetting technique . They will offer variable internal porosity (via thermal consolidation up to sintering, with or without the addition of porogenic compounds) and, if possible, conductive areas. They will be functionalised by vapor phase deposition processes: DLI-CVI (Chemical Vapor Infiltration by Direct Liquid Injection) as the first option, ALD (Atomic Layer Depostion) to overcome potential CVI limits and AP-SALD (spatial ALD at atmospheric pressure) to operate at atmospheric pressure. The objects obtained will be characterised in terms of porosity, specific surface area, wettability, thermal conductivity, morphology, and deposit composition. They will be tested in cold mock-ups (fluid distribution) and then in catalytic reactors for the synthesis of ‘ricin-like’, a compound that could solve the environmental and societal problem associated with the industrial use of castor oil, the development of which is hampered by diffusion and thermal limitations in catalytic grains. This case is representative of many other limited reactions: hydrotreatment of petroleum asphaltenes, or synthesis of biodiesels from biomass. Aims of the thesis This thesis focuses on the “ fabrication / functionalization / characterizations of catalytic objects ” aspects of the INCANTO project. The PhD student is responsible for (1) developing three-dimensional aerated SiC structures by Binder Jetting, (2) functionalizing them by a Palladium coating, carried out by vapor phase infiltration (DLI-CVI as a first option, ALD as a mitigation plan if CVI proves to present too many limitations, and AP-SALD to operate at atmospheric pressure), and (3) implementing ad-hoc multi-scale characterization techniques to better understand each of these steps. The choice of the object's structure relies (i) on models created by other members of the project team and (ii) on physical characterizations (i.e. mechanical, thermal, morphological, and structural) as an input for the models. Characterizations of the coatings (coverage, infiltration, structure, oxidation degree, etc…) will allow the tuning of the deposition parameters. The resulting catalytic objects will be tested in a reactor to evaluate their catalytic activity and suggest improvements for the second iteration loop "object development / functionalization / characterization – testing." items.desc: En un clin d’œil Notre client grand groupe international renforce le socle tech de ses applications stratégiques, dont son application phare de clienteling. Les bonnes pratiques de qualité logicielle et d’industrialisation. Tu as également : Une vraie appétence pour la CI/CD et l’industrialisation. Une expérience en fort trafic Un usage quotidien et avancé des outils d’IA pour développer. Ce point est éliminatoire : les profils qui codent exclusivement à la main ne seront pas retenus. Un regard critique sur le code généré par l’IA et la capacité à défendre tes choix techniques. De la rigueur, de l’autonomie et le sens de la qualité sur des produits à forte visibilité. Un français courant. L’anglais professionnel est apprécié. C’est un gros plus si tu as : Une expérience dans l’écosystème mobile : iOS / Swift ou React Native. Développé des API pour des applications publiées sur les stores. Travaillé dans le luxe, le retail ou sur des produits grand public à fort trafic. Good to know ️ Chez TOS, on ne t’envoie pas en mission à l’aveugle. Tu sais sur quel projet tu vas travailler, avec qui et pourquoi, avant de dire oui. Pas de jargon, pas d’intermédiaires en cascade : on se parle directement et on reste disponibles pendant toute ta mission. Le plus simple pour en savoir plus, c’est d’en discuter ensemble. Le café est offert, et les blagues nulles aussi ! En résumé Un produit luxe à fort impact. L’IA au cœur de ton quotidien de développeur·se. Un vrai rôle full-stack, à dominante back-end. items.desc: Description de l'entreprise Qui sommes-nous ? Donnez la bonne énergie à votre avenir, rejoignez RTE. RTE est le gestionnaire du réseau français de transport d’électricité. Investi d'une mission de service public, RTE respecte le principe de neutralité religieuse et politique. Horaires : 35h/semaine, télétravail possible Rémunération : Entre 29k€ et 39k€ brut annuel fixe, selon notre grille de rémunération, en fonction du diplôme obtenu, des compétences et des expériences professionnelles. Informations supplémentaires Votre quotidien ? Contribuer chaque jour à acheminer l’électricité dont tout le monde a besoin pour se déplacer, se chauffer, recharger son véhicule ou faire tourner son entreprise. Un quotidien utile, sans routine, où l’impact de votre travail se voit tout de suite et à long terme. Envie de rejoindre une entreprise qui compte vraiment ? items.desc: A Snapshot of Your Day This position combines the working fields of Project, Quality, and Supplier Management. As a Quality Engineer (f/m/d) for Investment Castings, you will be crucial in ensuring the highest quality standards in the production of hot gas components for gas turbines supplier network. Your main responsibility will be to maintain highest quality standards throughout the production process. This includes planning and implementing continuous improvement activities and conducting technical reviews at supplier locations in Europe and Asia. Building strong supplier relationships will be essential to ensure timely execution of quality improvements and maintaining schedules for both new product implementation and series production. How You’ll Make an Impact Driving quality improvement initiatives in collaboration with suppliers Enhancement of casting quality for hot gas components through targeted actions Leadership of supplier-related continuous improvement projects to optimize processes and ensure compliance with quality standards Reduction of non-conformance costs through structured problem-solving and improvement measures Development and maintenance of strong supplier partnerships to achieve quality, cost, and delivery targets Contribution to operational excellence and reduction of cost and lead times through close collaboration with suppliers and cross-functional teams What You Bring Degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field Extensive experience in quality methodologies and manufacturing management Proven experience working with cross-functional teams, ideally in turbine hot gas parts Strong project management expertise, organizational skills, and critical thinking abilities Fluency in English and German, with additional languages considered a plus Intercultural competence, willingness to travel approximately 25%, and legal authorization to work in Germany About the Team Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. items.desc: Job-ID: 70914/26 | Department: Technology | Salary: as per tariff (TV-L) | Working Time: 40h/week (part-time work option) | Limitation: initially 2 years with option of extension for three more years | Starting Date: as soon as possible IHP is an institute of the Leibniz Association and conducts research and development of silicon-based systems and ultra-high-frequency circuits and technologies including new materials. It develops innovative solutions for application areas such as wireless and broadband communication, security, medical technology, industry 4.0, automotive industry, and aerospace. IHP employs approximately 400 people. It operates a pilot line for technological developments and the preparation of high-speed circuits with 130 nm-SiGe-BiCMOS technologies, located in a 1500 m² cleanroom that meets the highest industrial nanotechnology requirements. The position As a member of the Process Integration Group within IHP’s Technology Department, you will contribute to the research and development of advanced semiconductor technologies. You will work in an international team of highly motivated researchers, engineers, PhD candidates and technicians. Flat hierarchies, close collaboration and mutual support are important to us, and we value the diversity of perspectives and expertise within our team. Your work will focus on the development and integration of photonic devices and technologies within advanced silicon-based technology platforms, in particular SiGe BiCMOS and photonic BiCMOS technologies. This includes the development and optimization of devices such as germanium photodetectors, as well as related process modules and their integration into complex semiconductor technology platforms. Your tasks will comprise device and process development, characterization, data analysis and the evaluation and optimization of semiconductor fabrication processes. The work will focus on extending the functionality of integrated photonic and SiGe BiCMOS technologies through novel devices and enabling applications beyond current technology capabilities. Your qualifications You hold a Master’s or PhD degree in electrical engineering, physics, materials science or a related field. You have a solid understanding of semiconductor device physics and ideally experience in the development of semiconductor or photonic devices. Knowledge of silicon-based semiconductor technologies, SiGe BiCMOS, silicon photonics or germanium-based optoelectronic devices is particularly welcome. Practical experience with common semiconductor cleanroom processes, such as lithography, etching, thin-film deposition, epitaxy, ion implantation or thermal processing, is an advantage. You enjoy working in an interdisciplinary team and are able to organize your work independently and systematically. We are looking for a colleague with strong experimental, analytical and problem-solving skills, who is motivated to develop a deep understanding of the interaction between device design, fabrication processes and device performance. Good communication skills and the ability to quickly become familiar with new experimental equipment and software tools are important for this position. A confident command of English is required. Knowledge of German is welcome; further development of German language skills is encouraged and supported, for example through in-house language courses and intensive courses. Our Offer Do research in a challenging, multinational environment giving you excellent career opportunities. You will have the chance to establish international reputation at the edge of top-notch technologies. An orientation guide will help you to quickly integrate into the institute and to familiarize yourself with the field. It is important to us to support the individual career developments (e.g. conferences, advanced trainings) as well as the personal needs of our employees by offering flexible working hours and the possibility to work off-site. The compatibility of work and family is highly valued. More information about our scientific excellence and the working environment at IHP can be found on our website. IHP is TOTAL E-QUALITY-certified for equal opportunities for women and men at work and actively pursues the equality of all gender and all groups of people. We promote the professional development of women and strongly encourage them to apply. Disabled applicants, qualified according to the above criteria, will be given preference over other candidates with equivalent relevant qualifications. How You’ll Make an Impact Own data products end-to-end, from understanding business requirements to delivering tested, documented, and production-ready transformation logic Design and apply layered data models using medallion architecture and dimensional modeling to create reusable and scalable data products Define and standardize KPIs by translating requirements from global factories and business functions into shared business metrics Build data quality checks, governance practices, and maintainability standards into data solutions from the start, while contributing to engineering standards through code reviews and shared development practices Collaborate with Data Engineers, Product Owners, and domain experts to support the Factory Data Cloud implementation and turn operational and IoT data into trusted assets What You Bring University degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data and Process Management, or a comparable discipline Many years of hands-on experience developing and operating analytics or data warehouse models in production environments, including dbt and Snowflake Strong expertise in dimensional modeling, medallion architecture, advanced SQL, dbt, and Snowflake Data Cloud Experience with Git, code reviews, testing, data quality, data governance, and CI/CD pipelines for analytics Knowledge of manufacturing and Industrial IoT data, KPI definition and standardization, strong stakeholder communication skills Fluency in English, and Good German dbt Certified Developer and Snowflake SnowPro Core Certification are a plus About the Team Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. Insbesondere sollen vertiefte Kenntnisse im Bereich Double Machine Learning, Deep Learning und Programmierung vorliegen. Auch sollen erste Publikationen und Working Paper vorliegen, die das Potenzial zur Veröffentlichung in referierten Fachzeitschriften haben. items.title: Robotics Software Engineer - Counter-Drone Systems (m/f/d)
items.card: Your mission Build real autonomous systems that operate in the real world, not in the lab. Join our engineering team and help build the core autonomy that powers our next generation robotic systems used for defense and mission-critical operations. You will design, implement, and harden robotic software that must perform under real operational conditions : outdoors, under uncertainty, with real consequences. Your
items.desc: What we offer Work in an international, agile team creating the future of autonomous systems Grow your career in a expanding and ambitious engineering team Build innovative products using state-of-the-art technologies in AI, robotics, and autonomy Benefit from a steep learning curve and continuous development Enjoy team events and a strong, collaborative culture Your mission Build real autonomous systems that operate in the real world, not in the lab. Join our engineering team and help build the core autonomy that powers our next generation robotic systems used for defense and mission-critical operations. You will design, implement, and harden robotic software that must perform under real operational conditions : outdoors, under uncertainty, with real consequences. Your work will directly shape the reliability, safety, and tactical capability of the systems we deliver. You will contribute to the development and integration of core robotic capabilities, including: Designing and implementing robust, real-time robotics software components Working with multi-modal sensor data, ensuring timing, synchronization, and frame correctness Developing and improving algorithms in areas such as estimation, perception, planning, control, or integration Ensuring deterministic behavior, reliability, and system-level stability Debugging and validating robotic systems during field tests, under real-world constraints Collaborating with a cross-functional team of robotics, embedded, and domain experts Maintaining high engineering standards: code reviews, CI, reproducible builds, documentation You will execute on real hardware and iterate based on operational performance, field results are the final metric. Your profile Technical Fundamentals : Strong proficiency in modern C++ (17/20) Experience with ROS/ ROS 2 Solid foundation in algorithms, data structures, and numerical methods Experience developing software that runs on real robots, embedded systems, or hardware-in-the-loop setups Comfortable working with raw sensor data (timing, noise characteristics, transforms, calibration) Strong debugging skills: runtime issues, latency, performance bottlenecks, integration failures Ability to architect clean, modular, maintainable software systems R obotics Foundation : Understanding of at least one robotics domain: state estimation, perception, tracking, planning, control, sensor fusion, or integration Ability to reason about real-time behavior, latency budgets, and reliability requirements End-to-end thinking: understanding how individual modules affect the whole system Nice to have Python for tooling or prototyping Experience with robotics middleware or real-time systems Background in optimization, filtering, or physical modeling Experience with embedded platforms, GPUs, or simulation tools We hire for core engineering ability, everything else can be learned here. What else Builder mentality: you ship working solutions, not theoretical concepts Hands-on ownership: you proactively solve problems, even outside your direct scope Field-driven mindset: you care about what survives real operations, not “lab perfect” High quality bar: you aim for reliability, determinism, and clarity in your engineering Startup drive: you execute fast despite ambiguity, and adapt quickly Mission alignment: genuine motivation to work on defense-relevant, safety-critical robotics Nationality of a NATO member nation or close ally is required About us The world is changing. Exponential technologies are enabling new types of security threats. ATS is committed to staying ahead by building nimble, scalable, and cost-effective defences. We are looking for passionate team members who are eager to create exceptional products, safeguard our freedom, and strengthen the resilience of democracies. Who we are: Autonomous Teaming is a defence-tech start-up specializing in machine vision solutions. Driven by cutting-edge innovation, our team works on next-generation technologies designed to meet rapidly evolving security challenges. What we do: We develop systems that enable computers and sensors to operate as coordinated teams, collaborating in real time to counter AI-powered asymmetric threats at scale — including drone swarms and other UXVs. Our mission is to build resilient, intelligent defence capabilities that perform reliably in the most demanding environments. How we work: We value close, in-person collaboration as the foundation for building complex, high-impact technology, while maintaining flexibility aligned to role and team needs. Our culture is built on ownership, responsibility, and trust — with a shared commitment to growing and building together. Where we are: Based in Munich, Berlin, and Toulouse, we are expanding rapidly across Europe with plans to open additional office hubs.

items.title: Deployment Engineer | Robotic Kitchens (all genders)
items.card: Your Role Freshly cooked food. Everywhere. All the time. With our robots, we’re transforming the way the world cooks and enjoys food. Through technology that empowers the foodservice industry, automates fresh meal preparation, and elevates culinary quality to a new, scalable level. Accessible to everyone. Everywhere. Anytime. We give our all to make this happen – across every level, team and function. As Deployment
items.desc: Your Role Freshly cooked food. Everywhere. All the time. With our robots, we’re transforming the way the world cooks and enjoys food. Through technology that empowers the foodservice industry, automates fresh meal preparation, and elevates culinary quality to a new, scalable level. Accessible to everyone. Everywhere. Anytime. We give our all to make this happen – across every level, team and function. As Deployment Engineer , you make sure our robotic kitchens are prepared correctly and run reliably in the field. You install and configure operating systems and the required components on our edge servers, deploy release updates, verify system health, and troubleshoot technical issues across Kubernetes, Linux, networking, server hardware, and applications. You work with established processes and tools while continuously expanding your knowledge of our systems and technologies. These are the tasks you will be responsible for: Edge-server preparation & deployment: You prepare the edge servers that run our robotic kitchens – from checking the server hardware and installing the operating system to configuring the required system and application components. Software release deployments: You deploy release updates to our robotic kitchens using our existing processes and tools, and verify that the systems and applications are working correctly before and after deployment. Kubernetes operations: You deploy and operate applications in existing Kubernetes environments and investigate workload issues using logs, events, resource status, and configuration. System troubleshooting: You investigate technical issues systematically across applications, Kubernetes, Linux, networking, and server hardware. You gather the relevant information, identify possible causes, resolve manageable issues, and provide clear findings when support from another team is required. System health & maintenance: You monitor the health of deployed systems, perform routine maintenance, and follow established procedures for updates, backups, recovery, and other operational activities. Documentation & collaboration: You document deployments, technical findings, and solutions, and work closely with DevOps, Software, Robotics, Manufacturing, and Operations to keep our robotic kitchens running reliably. Continuous improvement: You contribute to improving deployment procedures, troubleshooting guides, scripts, and automation as your knowledge of our environment grows. Your profile You’re passionate about innovative technologies, excited about the role, and ready to help us revolutionize the worlds of tech and culinary even further? Let’s get cooking! These are the qualities helping you thrive in this role: Linux foundation: You have a solid grasp of Linux systems and feel at home on the command line. You understand core concepts like services, processes, permissions, logs, storage, and resource usage – and you can install and set up the basic configuration of a Linux OS yourself. Kubernetes & containers: You understand container fundamentals and bring hands-on Kubernetes experience – deploying and troubleshooting containerized workloads in an existing cluster. Logs, events, resource status, and configuration are your go-to tools for investigating common issues. Troubleshooting mindset: You tackle unfamiliar technical problems in a structured way – gathering information, checking logs and system state, testing assumptions, and narrowing down causes. You don't need to have seen every issue before; you just know how to start digging. Infrastructure know-how: You understand networking fundamentals like IP addressing, gateways, DNS, DHCP, ports, and connectivity, and you know your way around core server hardware – CPU, memory, storage, network interfaces. You can run basic troubleshooting on both. Scripting & release workflows: You bring basic scripting skills, ideally in Bash or Python – reading and adapting existing scripts, working with config files, and building simple automation. You're also comfortable with Git and understand repositories, branches, commits, tags, and release versions. Hands-on edge & robotics mindset: You love working close to the hardware and are drawn to self-managed edge infrastructure – not just cloud-based systems. Learning, collaboration & languages: You're eager to learn, enjoy new technical challenges, and bring a careful, reliable approach. You thrive in cross-functional teams, communicate your findings clearly, and are fluent in English. About us At goodBytz, you're more than just part of a team – you'll be a key contributor who helps shape what we build. We're looking for colleagues who don't just go along for the ride, but have the courage to speak up and share critical perspectives. Because respect, trust, and open dialogue are the foundation of our success and satisfaction. What's waiting for you: goodBytz Culineers Canteen Our demo robot felix keeps you fueled around the clock with fresh meals at a discounted employee …
