We achieve this by pairing an advanced AI co-pilot with expert
items.desc: Location: Berlin, Germany (100% Full-Remote anywhere within Germany possible) Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent Employment Contract Team: Sustainability Advisory & Customer Success Compensation: €50,000 – €70,000 annual gross salary (commensurate with qualifications and experience) About the Role Are you eager to harness cutting-edge software applications to actively accelerate real-world corporate decarbonization? Established in Berlin, our Climate Tech enterprise equips corporate sustainability divisions with automated workflow solutions, comprehensive CSRD compliance capabilities, and actionable net-zero transition roadmaps. We achieve this by pairing an advanced AI co-pilot with expert human consulting. We are actively looking for an ambitious, highly proactive Sustainability Consultant (m/f/d) to expand our advisory practice. In this strategic client-facing role, you will take full ownership of corporate accounts, validate AI-generated carbon accounting data, and continuously refine our internal delivery frameworks to support rapid operational scaling. Key Responsibilities End-to-End Advisory Management Direct comprehensive enterprise client projects focusing on Corporate Carbon Footprints (CCF), Product Carbon Footprints (PCF), and strategic climate neutrality roadmaps, leveraging our proprietary software tools. Carbon Accounting & Data Audit Audit client operational inputs and primary data to build precise CCF and PCF profiles, carefully validating AI-assisted software calculations and emission factor databases. Process Standardization Analyze, refine, and re-engineer current consulting workflows to eliminate operational bottlenecks, streamline service delivery, and expand overall team capacity. Customer Success & Education Serve as the primary, trusted advisor for client inquiries while actively developing self-service onboarding resources, user guides, and structured knowledge bases. Executive Presentations Structure and present clear, high-impact technical reports, decarbonization roadmaps, and strategic debriefs directly to executive stakeholders and decision-makers. Cross-Functional Feedback Loop Consolidate frontline client feedback, user pain points, and technical requirements into structured feature requests to inform our product engineering roadmap. Candidate Profile Required Skills Language Proficiency: C2 native or bilingual German fluency (strictly required for client-facing consultations) paired with C1/C2 professional English proficiency. Field Experience: A minimum of 2 years of practical experience within sustainability consulting or internal corporate sustainability departments, with a direct focus on CCF, PCF, or Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) methodologies. Practical Execution: Hands-on experience calculating and constructing carbon accounting metrics (beyond high-level strategy or purely academic coursework). Pragmatic Mindset: A pragmatic, execution-focused working style capable of managing complex client deliverables while building automated, scalable processes. Project Delivery: Exceptional project management skills paired with a structured, transparent, and articulate communication approach. Desirable Attributes Prior exposure to mid-market enterprise accounts (Mittelstand) or large multinational corporate structures. Familiarity with Climate Tech environments, SaaS platforms, or specific retail, consumer goods, and food industry sustainability frameworks. Proven background authoring customer onboarding guides, building internal knowledge repositories, or utilizing workflow automation tools. Compensation & Benefits Purposeful Impact Work directly with leading enterprise organizations to help them achieve meaningful sustainability targets and accelerate genuine decarbonization. Innovative Tech Stack Stand at the absolute forefront of applied AI innovation within the rapidly growing Climate Tech and ESG software ecosystem. High Ownership Enjoy extensive autonomy to design consulting methodologies, restructure internal documentation, and optimize client engagement strategies. Professional Growth Benefit from clear progression pathways and rapid career advancement opportunities as our advisory organization expands. Maximum Flexibility Enjoy complete location flexibility to work 100% remotely from anywhere within Germany, alongside adaptable working hours, 28 paid vacation days, and an outcome-oriented workplace culture. Competitive Remuneration Attractive annual gross compensation between €50,000 and €70,000, complemented by flexible corporate perks and employee benefits.

This
items.desc: HR Systems & Integration Engineer - SAP BTP / SuccessFactors & Concur Location : Hamburg or remote from Germany Contract : full time & indefinite Language(s) : fluent English Serrala is the global leader in finance process automation. For over 40 years, we have been advancing the office of the CFO with our award-winning suite of finance automation applications. Our solutions streamline all working capital-related processes, including Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Cash Flow Management, and Treasury, across both cloud and SAP environments. Our 10+ hubs across Europe, North America, and India support over 2,800 clients worldwide, reflecting the trust we've built with a diverse global community. Join us as we lead the future of finance automation! Your role At Serrala, we are strengthening the way our core HR and Finance platforms connect across our enterprise landscape. As our SAP BTP Integration Engineer , you will take end-to-end technical ownership of the integration landscape around SAP SuccessFactors and SAP Concur, connecting these platforms with SAP S/4HANA and non-SAP systems such as identity management, payroll, banking, and benefits providers. This is not a traditional SuccessFactors administration role. It is a hands-on integration engineering position with real ownership: designing and improving integrations, ensuring data quality and reliability, establishing effective monitoring, and working closely with HR, Finance, platform teams, architects, and external SAP partners. If you enjoy solving complex integration challenges and want the opportunity to shape how enterprise applications work together, this role gives you the scope to make a visible impact. What you’ll do Own and evolve our SAP integration landscape around SuccessFactors and Concur using SAP BTP / SAP Integration Suite and MuleSoft. Design, build, and maintain integrations between SuccessFactors, Concur, SAP S/4HANA, and non-SAP platforms. Establish robust monitoring, alerting, error handling, and troubleshooting to ensure reliable end-to-end data flows. Own data mapping, reconciliation, and data-quality standards across connected systems. Support and configure key SuccessFactors modules, including Employee Central, Recruiting, Onboarding, Performance & Goals, and Compensation, with a particular focus on integration and data quality. Manage the technical impact of SAP SuccessFactors releases, from impact assessment and testing through deployment. Take technical ownership of SuccessFactors and Concur integrations within HR- and Finance-led transformation initiatives. Work closely with our Integration Platform, Data Platform, Identity, HR, and Finance teams to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions. Guide external SAP SuccessFactors and Concur AMS partners, challenge proposed solutions, and drive technical escalations and delivery priorities. Ensure integrations meet GDPR and EU data-residency requirements for sensitive HR data. Maintain clear integration architecture documentation, interface inventories, operational runbooks, and knowledge documentation. What you bring You don’t need to tick every box. What matters most is strong integration expertise, technical curiosity, and the ability to take ownership across systems and teams. Ideally, you have: 4+ years of experience with SAP BTP / SAP Integration Suite or comparable enterprise middleware such as MuleSoft or Dell Boomi. Strong hands-on experience designing, implementing, and operating integrations between SAP and non-SAP systems Experience with SAP SuccessFactors, ideally Employee Central plus at least one additional module. Experience with SAP Concur is a strong advantage. Strong troubleshooting skills across complex, multi-system integration environments. Experience with APIs, data mapping, integration monitoring, error handling, and data-quality management. Experience working directly with HR and/or Finance stakeholders and translating business requirements into technical solutions. Confidence working with and technically guiding external implementation or AMS partners. Familiarity with Agile delivery, Jira Software, and Jira Service Management. items.desc: GEOSYSTEMS HELLAS S.A. , a Geoinformatics company based in Pangrati (Athens), is seeking a Software QA Engineer to join our dynamic team. About Geosystems Hellas GEOSYSTEMS HELLAS S.A. is a top-tier provider of advanced Earth Observation technologies, downstream space application solutions, geospatial intelligence and AI. Many of our solutions are GIS-based and developed within national and European projects. The role will therefore include testing spatial data, map-based functionality and complex user workflows. Test plans, test cases and test results may also form part of formal project deliverables, making clear documentation and technical writing important aspects of the position. Previous GIS experience is an advantage but is not required. items.desc: Job Description: Closer to Space, closer to the Future: join Telespazio – Leonardo Space Division! Leonardo is a leading global industrial group in Aerospace, Defence and Security, delivering advance multi-domain technologies across Helicopters, Aircraft, Aerostructures, Electronics, Cybersecurity, and Space. As part of the Leonardo Space Division, Telespazio a joint venture between Leonardo (67%) and Thales (33%) , is a global reference in the field of satellite solutions and services. With a workforce of over 3.500 professionals across its offices in Europe and around the world, Telespazio operates an international network of Space Centres and Teleports, offering cutting-edge solutions in Geoinformation Services, Satellite Systems and Operations, and Satellite Communications. Join us as we continue to push the boundaries of what’s possible in Space. Inside the Satellite Operations Area at the Fucino Space Centre, we are looking for an enthusiastic and motivated Junior Spacecraft Operations Engineer to join our Flight Control Team. In this role, you will be actively involved in supporting in-orbit spacecraft operations and preparing future satellite missions at one of the world's premier commercial spaceports. RESPONSIBILITIES & ACTIVITIES The selected candidate will report to the Head of the Satellite Operations Organizational Unit and will be responsible for the following activities: Operations Preparation & Execution: Assist in preparing, planning, and executing satellite flight operations across all mission phases, including Launch and Early Orbit Phase (LEOP), Commissioning, and Routine operations. Flight Documentation & Database Management: Support the development, testing, validation, and maintenance of Flight Operations Plans (FOP), operational procedures, satellite databases, and critical flight tools. Testing & Simulation Campaigns: Contribute to the preparation and execution of System Validation Tests (SVT) with the satellite on the ground, participate in mission simulation campaigns, and support operational readiness activities. In-Orbit Operations & Anomaly Resolution: Monitor satellite health and status, assist in long-term trend analyses and performance assessments, and support the investigation of operational events and anomalies across satellite and ground segment elements. Control Centre Operations & Training: Support the operational validation of the Mission Control Centre (MCC), assist in providing training to operational personnel, and coordinate satellite activity schedules with system-level operations. Technical Reporting & Reviews: Prepare technical notes, generate mission operations reports, and participate in technical meetings and project reviews. REQUIREMENTS Academic Background & Experience: Master’s Degree in Aerospace, Astronautical, Electronic, or Telecommunications Engineering. Desirable: 2–3 years of experience in satellite operations; alternatively, academic project experience, master's thesis work, or internships focused on satellite operations, flight dynamics, or space mission design/analysis will be highly considered. Technical Skills and IT Tools: Solid programming and software development skills, with proficiency in MATLAB and at least one of the following languages: Python, C++, or Java . Knowledge of satellite subsystems, space mission phases (LEOP, Commissioning, Routine), and ground segment/Mission Control Centre architectures. Familiarity with satellite databases, flight operations procedures, and system validation testing (SVT) concepts. Soft Skills: System-minded approach with strong analytical, synthesis, and problem-solving skills. High self-motivation, discipline, and a results-oriented mindset. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a strong capability for teamwork in complex, technical environments. Flexibility and adaptability to dynamic operational scenarios. items.title: Cloud Systems Analyst
items.card: Your role We are looking to recruit a Cloud Systems Analyst to work as a member of the Cloud Systems team in support of activities in all aspects related to the evolution, release, and deployment of our on-premises OpenStack and Proxmox Cloud environments. ECMWF provides high quality on-premises Cloud Computing services to its Member States and internal users by providing state-of-the-art compute and object storage
items.desc: Your role We are looking to recruit a Cloud Systems Analyst to work as a member of the Cloud Systems team in support of activities in all aspects related to the evolution, release, and deployment of our on-premises OpenStack and Proxmox Cloud environments. ECMWF provides high quality on-premises Cloud Computing services to its Member States and internal users by providing state-of-the-art compute and object storage resources available in close proximity to the meteorological data archive and the existing HPC facilities. The cloud services are based on two platforms, the Common Cloud Infrastructure (CCI) and the MCLOUD, both supported 24x7. The CCI service consists of two OpenStack Clusters with approximately ten-thousand cores and two CEPH storage clusters of approximately six petabytes each. On these systems ECMWF runs a number of operational services such as the European Weather Cloud (http://europeanweather.cloud) and the new version of the Copernicus Data Stores (http://cds.climate.copernicus.eu) as well as many other internal and external projects. The MCLOUD holds the virtual machines and processes that are critical to the delivery of our daily weather forecasts. The service is in the later stage of being migrated from vSphere to five Proxmox clusters. Both platforms provide services for a growing number of AI ecosystems, like Anemoi, MLflow services, AIFS Assistant, and several Member States and internal AI workloads. ECMWF is now looking for a qualified Cloud Systems Analyst to help support the Cloud platforms that power both services. ECMWF recognises that the role requires a broad skill set and offers training to help applicants develop any missing skills. Your responsibilities You will: Assist with the platform migration from vSphere to Proxmox Monitor, manage and optimize our on-premises Cloud solutions based on Proxmox and OpenStack, including CEPH and virtual networking, and optimize performance Collaborate with other sections and departments at ECMWF to ensure proper integration with our Cloud environments Use automation and AI tools to efficiently manage our Cloud environments Liaise with vendors, external partners and provide support to users for the collaborative support of our Clouds Work closely with Development teams in identifying and finding solutions to problems Participate in a 24/7 on-call system What we are looking for You will bring: Ability to communicate with and understand complex requirements Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, listening to and respecting the views of others Good analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive approach An interest in identifying, investigating and resolving technical problems The ability to work under pressure and with limited supervision The flexibility to adapt to changing organisational priorities and user needs Dedication and enthusiasm to work in a small team Your profile Education & Experience University degree, or equivalent, in a discipline related to IT, science or mathematics Strong background in Linux based systems Strong background in Proxmox, OpenStack, Ceph and/or other Cloud technologies is a strong requirement with demonstratable experience Experience with vSphere would be advantageous Experience in configuring and scripting automation tools such as Ansible and Terraform. Experience with monitoring/visualizing stacks like ELK, Grafana, Prometheus/InfluxDB, Fluentd or similar would be advantageous Understand the complexities of the underlying IP fabric and related technologies which power a high bandwidth system would be advantageous Understanding and deploying Kubernetes would be an asset. Experience with Veeam Backup and Recovery would be advantageous Basic experience running AI/ML workloads locally or on cloud platforms, like Ollama or LMStudio, GPU-enabled services, or managed AI platforms, including familiarity with MCP for managing infrastructure, would be advantageous Knowledge & Skills Training opportunities are available to support the development of needed skills Candidates must be able to work effectively in English and interviews will be conducted in English. A good knowledge of one of the Centre’s other working languages (French or German) is an advantage but not required If you feel that you have the motivation and many of the skills for this role but don't meet precisely all of the criteria listed above, we still encourage you to apply. About ECMWF The European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF) is a world leader in Numerical Weather Predictions providing high-quality data for weather forecasts and environmental monitoring. As an intergovernmental organisation we collaborate internationally to serve our members and the wider community with global weather predictions, data and training activities that are critical to contribute to safe and thriving societies. The success of our activities depends on the funding and partnerships of our 35 Member and Co-operating States who …

items.desc: Onderzoeksmedewerker selectieve vangmethoden voor platvis Wil jij bijdragen aan innovatieve vistechnologie voor een selectieve en toekomstgerichte platvisvisserij? Functieomschrijving Als onderzoeksmedewerker ben je betrokken bij het volledige ontwikkeltraject: van het bedenken en ontwerpen van nieuwe concepten tot het testen en valideren van prototypes. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Ontwerpen en ontwikkelen: Uit het onderzoek ontstaat een conceptueel ontwerp, je maakt de vertaalslag van het onderzoeksidee naar een praktisch werkbare opstelling/experiment Experimenteren en testen: je bereidt de experimenten voor en voert ze uit met behulp van bestaande methoden en technieken Rapid prototyping en proof-of-principle: je ontwikkelt, ontwerpt, bouwt en test diverse opeenvolgende prototypes om de technische haalbaarheid van verschillende oplossingen aan te tonen. De aanpassingen aan het ontwerp worden samen met de betrokken wetenschappers uitgewerkt Je rapporteert de resultaten aan de onderzoekers betrokken bij het onderzoeksproject Prototypeontwikkeling op praktijkschaal: je ondersteunt binnen het project de ontwikkeling naar een minimum viable product (MVP) dat op ware grootte kan worden ingezet tijdens prototypetests in het Visinnovatiecentrum in Stellendam Je werkt nauw samen met een promovendus aan de TU Delft en de vakgroep Experimentele Zoölogie van Wageningen University & Research. Deze samenwerking biedt je de mogelijkheid om technische kennis en experimenteel onderzoek te combineren en bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van innovatieve en toekomstgerichte vismethoden. De functie is ondergebracht bij de vakgroep Maritieme en Transporttechnologie en wordt begeleid door Rudy Helmons en Geert Keetels. Functie-eisen Achtergrond in werktuigbouwkunde of een vergelijkbare opleiding Kennis en ervaring met gereedschap-zeebodem interactie is een pre Ervaring met (conceptueel) ontwerpen en het doen van experimenten is een pre Kan goed communiceren in zowel Nederlands als Engels TU Delft Werken bij TU Delft betekent bijdragen aan oplossingen die er echt toe doen. Al meer dan 180 jaar leiden we ingenieurs op die wereldwijd impact maken bij bedrijven, overheden of als ondernemer. Onze alumni zetten kennis om in concrete oplossingen voor de uitdagingen van vandaag en morgen. Die uitdagingen veranderen snel. Daarom werken we elke dag aan thema’s zoals energie, klimaat, digitalisering, AI en slimme mobiliteit. Ons onderwijs en onderzoek sluiten direct aan op wat de samenleving nodig heeft, nu en straks. Bij TU Delft maken mensen het verschil. Met hun kennis en nieuwsgierigheid zorgen zij voor sterk onderwijs, vernieuwend onderzoek en innovaties die verder komen dan de campus. Je krijgt de ruimte om initiatief te nemen, samen te werken en jezelf te ontwikkelen. Wie bij TU Delft werkt, sluit zich aan bij een internationale community van professionals en studenten. Samen bouwen we aan kennis, innovatie en oplossingen die de wereld vooruithelpen. Faculteit Mechanical Engineering Van chip tot schip. Van machine tot mens. Van idee naar oplossing. items.desc: Eindhoven | 32-40 uur | Data Science Bouw mee aan data science in een snel veranderende energiemarkt Hezelaer Energy groeit hard. Met die groei neemt ook de rol van data binnen onze organisatie steeds verder toe. Daarom bouwen we aan een sterk en professioneel Data Science-team dat de organisatie helpt om betere beslissingen te nemen en slimmer te werken. Binnen het team werken we onder andere aan forecasting, pricing, reporting en energy trading. Van het voorspellen van ontwikkelingen op de energiemarkt tot het ontwikkelen van modellen die commerciële en operationele beslissingen ondersteunen. Er is het afgelopen jaar al veel opgebouwd. Tegelijkertijd zijn we nog volop in ontwikkeling. We willen onze manier van werken verder professionaliseren, nieuwe toepassingen ontdekken en Data Science steeds beter laten aansluiten op de behoeften van de organisatie. Daarom zoeken we een Data Scientist die niet alleen graag met data, modellen en machine learning werkt, maar het ook interessant vindt om mee te bouwen aan een vakgebied dat binnen Hezelaer volop in beweging is. Wat ga je doen? Als Data Scientist werk je aan uiteenlopende Data Science-vraagstukken binnen Hezelaer Energy. De ene keer ontwikkel je een forecastingmodel voor de energiemarkt, de volgende keer onderzoek je hoe data kan helpen bij pricing of energy trading. Ook werk je aan vraagstukken vanuit Finance, Operations of Sales. Je werkt onder andere met Python, SQL, statistische modellering en machine learning. Afhankelijk van het vraagstuk gebruik je bijvoorbeeld predictive modelling, forecasting en tijdreeksanalyse om data om te zetten in bruikbare voorspellingen en inzichten. Je werkzaamheden kunnen daardoor behoorlijk verschillen. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan: Ontwikkelen, verbeteren en toepassen van Data Science- en machine learning-modellen; Ontwikkelen van forecastingmodellen en toepassen van tijdreeksanalyse; Werken aan vraagstukken rondom pricing en energy trading; Analyseren en verwerken van datasets met Python en SQL; Onderzoeken hoe predictive analytics en nieuwe AI-technieken waarde kunnen toevoegen; Ontwikkelen en verbeteren van rapportages en dashboards; Vertalen van data en analyses naar concrete inzichten en praktische toepassingen; Ondersteunen van collega's en teams bij datagedreven vraagstukken; Signaleren van kansen om processen en besluitvorming slimmer en meer datagedreven te maken; Samenwerken met IT, Finance, Operations, Sales, Trading en andere disciplines; Bijdragen aan het verder professionaliseren van Data Science binnen Hezelaer Energy. Je bent daarbij niet alleen bezig met de technische oplossing. Je probeert vooral te begrijpen welk probleem we willen oplossen, welke data daarvoor nodig is en hoe een model of analyse daadwerkelijk waarde kan toevoegen. Een Data-Science-team dat nog volop in ontwikkeling is Het Data Science-team maakt onderdeel uit van een organisatie die sterk groeit. Dat betekent dat we voortdurend in beweging zijn. We hebben de afgelopen periode al veel stappen gezet, maar we zijn er nog niet. We willen onze processen, technieken en manier van samenwerken verder ontwikkelen. Dat betekent dat je niet in een omgeving terechtkomt waarin alles al is bedacht en vastgelegd. Sommige vraagstukken zijn duidelijk. Andere moeten we samen nog ontdekken. Soms is vooraf niet precies duidelijk wat de beste oplossing is en verandert de vraag onderweg. Dat vinden we juist interessant! We zoeken daarom iemand die energie krijgt van die dynamiek. Iemand die het leuk vindt om zelf structuur aan te brengen, vragen te stellen, mogelijkheden te onderzoeken en samen met collega's tot een goede oplossing te komen. Met wie werk je? Data Science raakt binnen Hezelaer Energy steeds meer onderdelen van de organisatie. Je werkt daarom nauw samen met verschillende teams, waaronder IT, Trading, Finance, Operations en Sales. Je werkt met mensen die vanuit verschillende perspectieven naar een vraagstuk kijken. Jij brengt jouw kennis van data, analyses, modellen en machine learning mee en helpt collega's om data op een praktische manier in te zetten. Daarbij is het belangrijk dat je complexe materie kunt uitleggen aan mensen die niet dagelijks met Data Science bezig zijn. Je kunt de diepte in wanneer dat nodig is, maar weet ook wanneer een helder en praktisch antwoord belangrijker is dan een ingewikkeld model. Dit ben jij Je bent analytisch, nieuwsgierig en vindt het leuk om complexe vraagstukken uit te pluizen. Je hoeft niet voor ieder probleem vooraf het antwoord te kennen. Je vindt het juist interessant om samen te onderzoeken wat werkt. Je werkt graag in een multidisciplinair Scrum-team en draagt actief bij aan refinement, planning en retrospectives. Daarnaast: Duik je graag in data en modellen; Ben je analytisch en conceptueel sterk; Werk je zelfstandig en neem je verantwoordelijkheid; Stel je vragen en bent niet bang om bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen; Vind je het leuk om nieuwe technieken, AI-toepassingen en mogelijkheden …

items.desc: Millions of people use Funda to find their next home. Behind every search, property listing and housing market insight lies an enormous amount of data. And that’s where you come in. As a Data Engineer at Funda, you turn complex data into reliable, well-structured data models. You help our teams make better decisions and contribute to data products that make life easier for homebuyers, sellers and real estate agents. You'll work with BigQuery, DBT, Python and GCP, building on our recently revamped data warehouse. Love a good SQL challenge? And enjoy making complex data surprisingly simple? Then you might just feel right at home with us. Your job in a nutshell You'll join our Core Data Team. Together, you'll make sure Funda's data is reliable, accessible and ready to use. We've recently rebuilt our data warehouse following the principles of Kimball dimensional modelling. Now it's time for the next step: expanding our data models, improving monitoring and developing new data products. Your work will provide the data that drives our strategic choices and product decisions, including those behind products like Waardecheck and Vraagscan. In doing so, you'll help people navigate one of the biggest decisions of their lives: buying or selling a home. And because you'll be part of a small team, your ideas won't get lost at the bottom of a backlog. You'll have plenty of ownership, room to experiment and a direct say in how we develop our data platform. What you'll be doing Build data models that actually make sense. You'll design, develop and maintain DBT models in BigQuery using Kimball star schemas, turning complex datasets into a reliable foundation for analysis. Make good data even better. You'll develop DBT macros, automated tests and monitoring to improve data quality, performance and reliability. And yes, that includes being able to prove the numbers really do add up. Keep the data flowing. You'll build and maintain ETL pipelines using Python, Airbyte and Azure, connecting different data sources to our data warehouse. Automate the smart way. You'll improve CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and manage job orchestration through Cloud Run, making our processes more efficient and reliable. Turn data into impact. You'll collaborate with data analysts and data scientists to unlock new insights, expand our analytics capabilities and develop machine learning pipelines. Your team You'll join the Core Data Team within Engineering, working closely with Data Engineer Esther Schrijer, Senior Data Scientist Edwin Thoen and Lead Service Owner Stephen Willems. We're a small, pragmatic team with a big love for data. We enjoy solving complex puzzles, bouncing ideas off each other and coming up with solutions that actually work in practice. Making things complicated just for the sake of it? Not really our style. We work in two-week sprints, with short daily stand-ups, regular refinement sessions and sprint reviews where everyone shares what they've been working on. You'll also collaborate closely with data analysts across our product teams. That way, you'll make sure the data you develop doesn't just sit neatly in our data warehouse, but actually gets put to good use. “We have so much interesting data, and I love bringing it all together and turning it into something valuable for our different users. Because we're a small team, we have a lot of freedom to decide what we work on. You can really take ownership from start to finish, from data ingestion to data modelling. And there's plenty of room to learn new things along the way.” Esther Schrijer, Data Engineer at Funda Why you'll love being a Data Engineer at Funda Data you won't find anywhere else. Funda has the most comprehensive dataset on housing demand in the Netherlands. That means you'll work with data that offers unique insights into how people search for properties, discover homes and ultimately choose their next place to call home. Build things people actually use. Your data models won't just sit somewhere in a data warehouse. They'll help our teams build better features and power products that provide valuable insights for sellers, real estate agents and home seekers. A modern platform, ready for your ideas. With our recently revamped, Kimball-based data warehouse, there's plenty of interesting work waiting for you. From developing new DBT models to improving our analytics macros and monitoring, you'll help shape the future of our data platform. Small team. Big impact. You'll have the freedom to improve the way we work, bring fresh perspectives and make important technical decisions. We love curious, pragmatic colleagues who enjoy figuring things out together. This is you You're a curious, detail-oriented Data Engineer who loves getting to the bottom of how things work. You appreciate well-structured data models, reliable pipelines and the little details that make sure the data really does add up. You also know that great data engineering is about more than just …

items.desc: Business Developer - Credits Data Domain (Hay 10) At a glance At ABN AMRO, our strategy is to be a personal bank in the digital age. We provide a fully digital banking experience while maintaining strong personal relationships with our clients. Reliable, high-quality credit data is essential to making informed lending decisions and supporting our customers when it matters most. We are looking for a highly motivated and solution-oriented Business Developer to join the Credits Data Domain Store (CDDS) department within Financing Solutions. Within CDDS, the Task Force team acts as the operational backbone of the department, supporting all other CDDS teams in maintaining stable, reliable, and efficient credits data. In this role, you will work in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same. You will investigate production issues, support releases, analyze incidents, resolve real-time data problems, and help prevent future disruptions. You will combine analytical thinking, business understanding, technical knowledge, and stakeholder management skills to ensure the continuity and quality of critical credit data services across the bank. Your job As a Business Developer within the CDDS Task Force team, you will be responsible for identifying, analyzing, coordinating, and resolving complex operational and data-related challenges. You thrive on investigating unknown situations, asking the right questions, and driving structural improvements that strengthen our services and data products. Your responsibilities will include: Supporting the daily operations of all CDDS teams by coordinating and resolving production incidents, data issues, and platform disruptions. Investigating complex production problems and performing root cause analyses to identify sustainable long-term solutions. items.desc: Medior Data Analyst / Data Modeler (Credit & Collateral Data) At a glance At ABN AMRO, we're building the future of lending through data. As we continue our journey to become a personal bank in the digital age, high-quality credit and collateral data is more important than ever. It powers lending decisions, strengthens risk management, supports regulatory compliance, and enables innovation across the bank. We're looking for a Medior Data Analyst / Data Modeler to join the Credits Data Domain Store (CDDS) within Financing Solutions. This is an opportunity to work on some of the bank's most strategic data initiatives and play a key role in shaping the Credit & Collateral Data Products that enable smarter lending decisions, stronger risk management, and sustainable growth across the bank. If you enjoy solving complex data challenges, influencing business change, and working with stakeholders across business and technology, this role offers the ownership, visibility, and impact you're looking for. Your job As a Medior Data Analyst / Data Modeler, you will be at the heart of ABN AMRO's credit data landscape. You won't simply gather requirements or create models; you'll help drive strategic change by turning business ambitions into trusted data products that enable better decisions throughout the bank. You will: Take ownership of high-impact data initiatives within the Credit & Collateral domain. Translate business challenges into scalable, future-proof data solutions. Work on strategic programs such as Definition of Default (DoD), Significant Risk Transfer (SRT), Early Warning Models (EWM), and NextGen Lending. Partner with business stakeholders, architects, engineers, and risk specialists to deliver business value through data. Analyse complex datasets, identify opportunities for improvement, and drive data quality enhancements. Shape and maintain the Credits Business Data Model (CBDM), ensuring consistency, traceability, and regulatory compliance. Support the development of advanced analytics and AI use cases by providing reliable and well-governed credit data. Lead initiatives from idea to implementation, including analysis, design, testing, and release activities. You will have the autonomy to drive multiple initiatives simultaneously while helping define how Credit & Collateral Data Products evolve within ABN AMRO. Working environment You will join the Credits Data Domain Store, a team with a clear mission: creating trusted Credit & Collateral Data Products that support lending, risk management, regulatory reporting, and capital optimisation across the bank. Our environment combines the pace of a large-scale digital transformation with the complexity of a highly regulated banking domain. You will collaborate with professionals from Financing Solutions, Risk, Data Engineering, Architecture, Analytics, and AI. What makes this role particularly exciting is the combination of: Strategic visibility across the bank. Direct impact on key lending and risk processes. Exposure to senior stakeholders and decision makers. A modern data environment focused on innovation and continuous improvement. Opportunities to deepen both your banking expertise and your technical data skills. You'll be part of a team that values ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and the courage to challenge the status quo. Your profile You are an analytical professional who enjoys connecting business objectives with data-driven solutions. You understand that data is not the goal itself, but a powerful enabler for better decisions and better customer outcomes. We're looking for someone who brings: Professional Experience 3-7 years of experience in Data Analysis, Business Analysis, Data Modelling, or a related discipline. Experience working within banking, lending, risk management, or another complex financial environment. Strong SQL skills and the ability to independently analyse large datasets. Experience with conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling. Understanding of data integration, ETL processes, and data quality management. Experience with testing, implementation, and release activities. Familiarity with Databricks, JSON, and modern data platforms is a strong advantage. Banking & Credit Expertise Strong understanding of lending processes and credit risk management. Knowledge of Credit & Collateral products and their lifecycle. Understanding of how data supports regulatory reporting, risk monitoring, and business decision-making. Experience working in complex stakeholder environments where business and technology come together. Personal Skills You take ownership and enjoy driving topics from idea to delivery. items.desc: About this position Do you want to contribute to innovations that make the Netherlands smarter, more sustainable, and future-proof? As a Project Controller at TNO, you play a key role in a wide range of projects within the Services Organisation. You are more than a financial professional. You are a trusted sparring partner for project leaders, researchers, and managers. Through your advice, you help project teams turn ideas into tangible results. The profession is evolving rapidly. Digitalisation, data analytics, and AI are transforming the way we work and make decisions. At TNO, you will have the opportunity not only to follow these developments but also to help shape them. You will contribute to new ways of working, smart solutions, and the further development of project control within an innovative knowledge organisation. We are also committed to your personal growth. Whether you want to advance as a controller, deepen your expertise, or broaden your skill set, TNO offers the freedom, guidance, and training to help you achieve your ambitions. You work closely with project leaders and help them stay in control of the financial aspects of their projects. You advise on budgets, project performance, and the financial implications of decisions. In addition, you review project proposals, quotations, cost calculations, and contracts. You identify opportunities and risks at an early stage and translate financial information into clear, practical insights that colleagues can act on immediately. You look beyond individual projects and focus on the bigger picture, creating value not only for today’s projects but also for tomorrow’s developments. Alongside your project responsibilities, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the further professionalisation of Finance & Control within TNO. This includes improving processes, developing management information, and applying new technologies such as data analytics and AI. It is a varied and challenging role. You will focus on projects within the Services Organisation and be responsible for a portfolio of approximately 80 projects. You will oversee monitoring, analysis, and reporting within the Project Fitness system. As this is a relatively new approach within the Services Organisation, you will have plenty of opportunity to contribute your ideas, shape the way forward, and truly pioneer new practices. Your office location is The Hague (AvB). As a Project Controller within the Services Organisation, you will join an experienced, collaborative, and professional team. You will work closely with five direct colleagues and report to the Manager Corporate Control. Together, you will act as the financial conscience of the organisation. What we expect from you You are a confident and analytically strong professional who quickly distinguishes between main and secondary issues and effortlessly switches between different topics, interests, and priorities. In a complex environment with peaks in workload and tight deadlines, you are able to identify risks early and provide proactive advice. As a valued sparring partner, you build strong and lasting relationships and earn the trust of project leaders, researchers, and managers. Thanks to your organisational awareness, communication skills, and broad perspective, you connect different interests and make financial topics understandable for a wide range of stakeholders. You are conceptually strong, able to connect projects, business objectives, and TNO’s strategic ambitions, and you thrive in an environment where innovation, digitalisation, data analytics, and AI play an increasingly important role. You are also accurate, proactive, and enjoy solving complex puzzles, enabling you to make a meaningful contribution to both content-driven and process-related improvements. You also bring: A completed bachelor's degree (HBO) in Business Economics, Accountancy, Controlling, or a related field. At least 2 years of experience in a (project) control position, preferably within a complex, project-based environment. Affinity with digitalisation, data-driven decision-making, and emerging technologies that make the finance and control profession smarter and more effective. Preferably knowledge of SAP and Power BI. We deliver advanced ocean and space technologies from autonomous marine systems to satellites and data services supporting sustainability, climate monitoring, infrastructure protection, and security. KONGSBERG also develop innovative technologies for defence, security, and surveillance markets, combining military and civilian expertise. Our defence and security solutions span missiles, weapon stations, air defence, command and control, and digital towers. Today, we have more than 7,500 employees in about 20 countries. The company is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange and the Norwegian government controls about 50.01 percent of the shares. Its technology platforms and solutions support offshore operations, fisheries, ocean research, maritime operations, sea-based energy production, and naval defence. Products include sonars, underwater communication equipment, satellites, surveillance and positioning systems, and autonomous vehicles. Customers span offshore, fisheries, marine research, maritime, energy, surveillance, defence, and naval sectors. items.desc: Fornebu, Norway Full-time Sales and Business Development Onsite Tieto Caretech Job Description At Tieto Caretech you’ll get a chance to provide patients and end users with product offerings that help them in their life, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading. About us Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high-quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency - have more time to care. We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors, from intensive care to laboratory and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need. About the role We are looking for an Enterprise Solution Architect to join Tieto Caretech’s Nordic Market team and support new business growth across the Nordic countries. Reporting directly to the Nordic Market Leader and being member of Nordic Market leadership team, you will work closely with Customer Executives, Business Developers and Sales managers across the Nordics to understand customer needs and shape solutions that address them. Enterprise Architect translates customer’s business strategy into target solutions provided by Tieto and its partners and transition roadmaps how to achieve the desired state across application, data, integration, cloud, technology, and AI domains. You will also collaborate with Product and Delivery teams to ensure that proposed solutions reflect product roadmaps and delivery considerations and can be translated into successful customer outcomes. In addition, you will contribute customer and market insights to the continued development of our offering and sales approach across the region. In this role you will Support Sales Managers and Business Developers across the Nordic countries in understanding customer needs and developing solution approaches. Translate business and customer requirements into solution concepts, architecture overviews and proposals. Become a trusted Advisor for customers Connect with senior stakeholders at customer side Present our solutions and explain how they can support customer priorities. Coordinate input from Delivery teams and other relevant experts when shaping solutions. Identify risks, dependencies, assumptions and delivery considerations related to proposed solutions. Share customer and market insights with relevant teams to support the development of our offering and go-to-market approach across the Nordics. We are looking for someone with Has experience in solution architecture or a similar customer-facing role. Can connect business needs with technology and practical solution design Has deep experience with complex software solutions and integrations. Communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders at senior level Is proactive, structured and able to explain complex topics in an accessible way. Is fluent in one of the Nordic languages as well as English, with strong verbal and written communication skills It would be beneficial if you also Have knowledge of and experience with healthcare systems and architectures in the Nordic countries. AI knowledge requirement AI literacy is expected for this role. You will be comfortable using approved AI tools to improve quality and productivity in everyday work (e.g., drafting, summarising, analysing, and automating routine tasks). You can write clear prompts/instructions, critically evaluate and validate AI outputs, and apply sound judgement when results are incomplete, biased, or incorrect. You understand and follow company policies and applicable legal/regulatory requirements for confidentiality, privacy, security, and responsible AI use (including not sharing sensitive data in unapproved tools). We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working. items.desc: Fast stilling Heltid Kløfta Søknadsfrist Snarest Mulighet for hjemmekontor Delvis hjemmekontor Arbeidsspråk Engelsk, Norsk Sektor Privat Brenner du for salg og friluftsliv? Ta Berettas klær og tilbehør videre i Norge! Salgs- og merkevareansvarlig | Schou AS Har du erfaring med forhandlersalg og lyst til å utvikle det norske markedet for Berettas klær og tilbehør? Hos Schou får du følge opp etablerte kunder, åpne nye dører og skape vekst for en kjent merkevare. Interesse for friluftsliv og godt utstyr kommer godt med. Med lidenskap for jakt siden 1909 Schou er grossist og distributør med sterke internasjonale merkevarer og forhandlere over hele landet. Presisjon, kvalitet og produktkunnskap har fulgt oss siden Gunerius Schou startet virksomheten i 1909. Schou har 18 ansatte og hovedkontor på Kløfta. I 2025 omsatte selskapet for rundt 180 millioner kroner, med solide resultater. Med eiere tilknyttet Knut Axel Ugland Holding har Schou et solid fundament for videre utvikling. Selskapet har også tre datterselskaper i Sverige og Danmark. En av merkevarene vi representerer er Beretta, som feirer 500 år i 2026. Nå skal vi løfte Berettas klær og tilbehør til jakt, skyting og friluftsliv videre i Norge. Det arbeidet får du en sentral rolle i. Utvikle kunder og skap salg Som salgs- og merkevareansvarlig får du ansvar for å utvikle lønnsomt salg av Berettas klær og tilbehør i Norge. Du besøker forhandlere, bygger nye kunderelasjoner og hjelper butikkene med å lykkes med salget. Rollen kombinerer aktivt salgsarbeid med oppfølging av sortiment og produkter. Du vil blant annet: Øke salget hos eksisterende forhandlere og etablere nye kunder og salgskanaler. Presentere kolleksjoner og lære opp butikkmedarbeidere. Følge opp sortiment, priser, produktinformasjon og varetilgjengelighet. Samarbeide tett med Beretta i Italia og delta på kolleksjonsgjennomganger og messer. Du dekker hele Norge, med Kløfta som base. Kundebesøk og reising med overnatting er en naturlig del av jobben. Du trives med salg og kundeutvikling Vi ser etter deg som har erfaring med salg og kundeutvikling, gjerne mot forhandlere innen klær, sport, friluftsliv eller arbeidsklær. Du kan vise til resultater og forstår hva som skal til for at en butikk både tar inn produktene og lykkes med å selge dem videre. Relevant butikkbakgrunn med tydelig salgsansvar kan også være et godt utgangspunkt. Du tar initiativ, liker å oppsøke kunder og følger opp det du lover. Du holder innsatsen oppe også når salget tar tid, og planlegger godt nok til å håndtere både kundemøtene og produktarbeidet mellom besøkene. Du kommuniserer godt på norsk og engelsk. Et godt utgangspunkt – og rom til å påvirke Du får en etablert kundebase å bygge videre på, kolleger i Schou og tett kontakt med Berettas internasjonale fagmiljø. Du rapporterer til daglig leder og får stor frihet til å forme arbeidsdagen og påvirke kategoriens utvikling. Vi tilbyr gode lønnsbetingelser, bilordning og fleksibilitet i en arbeidshverdag preget av tillit og ansvar. Klar for å ta Beretta videre? Kontakt Ken-Robin Utvik tlf.: 926 04 175 eller Johan Fredrik Bolli tlf.: 977 22 816 i SalesJobs for avklaringer, eller send oss din CV og en kort søknad via søknadslenken. items.desc: Miejsce pracy: Wrocław Nr referencyjny: DJdOK/10/CC Należymy do międzynarodowej Grupy Credit Agricole. Działamy od ponad 100 lat, dlatego jesteśmy stabilnym partnerem. Rozwijamy się dzięki ludziom i dobrym relacjom. Tworzymy przyjazną atmosferę, wymieniamy się wiedzą i… lubimy ze sobą pracować. Działamy odpowiedzialnie. Dbamy o naszych klientów, pracowników i lokalne społeczności – to dla nas bardzo ważne. Jakie będą Twoje zadania? Sprzedawanie produktów bankowych oraz wyjaśnianie klientom ich cech i standardowych warunków. Rozpoznawanie potrzeb klientów, aktywne słuchanie i dopasowywanie produktów bankowych. Wspieranie klientów w codziennym bankowaniu, odpowiadanie na pytania, rozwiązywanie problemów oraz obsługa zapytań i reklamacji. Wprowadzanie klientów w świat bankowości mobilnej i internetowej . Budowanie relacji z klientami i dbanie o najwyższą jakość obsługi podczas każdej rozmowy. Aktualizowanie danych klientów w systemie CRM po każdym kontakcie. Realizowanie powierzonych zadań zgodnie z wymaganymi standardami jakości i terminowości. Przestrzeganie polityk, procedur i przepisów dotyczących wykonywanej pracy. Rozwijanie wiedzy i umiejętności. Do jakiego zespołu dołączysz? Jako Doradczyni/Doradca Junior ds. Obsługi Klienta wzmocnisz zespół Centrum Kontaktu z Klientem – odpowiadamy w nim za różne formy rozmów z klientem, zarówno te tradycyjne, jak i bardziej nowoczesne (chat, narzędzia AI). Tutaj będziesz mieć przestrzeń na zdobywanie doświadczenia i uczenie się wśród specjalistek i specjalistów – wiemy, jak ważna jest praktyczna nauka. Zbudujesz solidne podstawy kariery w stabilnej organizacji i zdobędziesz praktyczne doświadczenie w pracy z klientem. Dobrze odnajdziesz się w tej roli, jeśli: lubisz realizować cele i motywują Cię wyniki sprzedażowe i jakościowe; chcesz poszerzać swoją wiedzę; mówisz wyraźnie i potrafisz dopasować styl komunikacji do rozmówcy; lubisz rozmawiać przez telefon i jesteś osobą komunikatywną; masz minimum średnie wykształcenie; pasuje Ci praca w systemie zmianowym (również w weekendy i święta). Co pomoże Ci osiągnąć sukces w tej roli? #Zorientowanie na klienta Rozumiesz potrzeby klientów i tworzysz rozwiązania, które na nie odpowiadają. #Odpowiedzialność za wyniki Bierzesz odpowiedzialność za realizację zobowiązań i osiągane rezultaty. #Skuteczna komunikacja Przekazujesz informacje jasno i dbasz o wzajemne zrozumienie. Co oferujemy Tobie w zamian? Umowę o pracę w stabilnym miejscu , które daje przestrzeń na długofalową współpracę opartą na zaufaniu. System wynagradzania, który obejmuje wynagrodzenie stałe oraz premie sprzedażowe i jakościowe. Pracę hybrydową – po 3 miesiącach wdrożenia, obejmuje 2 dni w tygodniu w biurze i 3 dni pracy zdalnej. Kompleksowe wdrożenie - dni adaptacyjne w centrali we Wrocławiu, szkolenia, programy rozwojowe i jasną ścieżkę kariery. Realne możliwości rozwoju wewnątrz banku oraz w strukturach Grupy Credit Agricole w Polsce. Inicjatywy pracownicze – rozwojowe, charytatywne, wellbeingowe i sportowe. Zależy nam, by wspierać dobre samopoczucie zespołu i robić razem coś dobrego. Otwarte i różnorodne środowisko pracy , w którym cenimy Twoją autentyczność. Twój rozwój W naszej organizacji masz realny wpływ na tempo swojej kariery. Oferujemy Ci: transparentną ścieżkę awansu – jasne kryteria, które określają każdy etap Twojego rozwoju; tempo rozwoju, które zależy od Ciebie – Twoje wyniki sprzedażowe i jakość pracy bezpośrednio przekładają się na kolejne kroki w strukturze banku; wsparcie na każdym etapie – od kompleksowego wdrożenia na starcie, po przygotowanie do roli eksperckiej lub menedżerskiej; praktyczne kompetencje – rozwiniesz się w zakresie profesjonalnych negocjacji, technik sprzedaży oraz budowania relacji biznesowych. Prywatna opieka medyczna Klub Korzyści (zniżki i oferty specjalne z kontem w Credit Agricole) Karta Multisport 5 dodatkowych dni wolnych w roku na wolontariat

We will be developing a new application that aims to serve as the global platform for managing cash position incorporating latest AI tools available. Designing high-level roadmaps categorized by system components and development streams. Acting as the key interface between business stakeholders and the delivery team, presenting functional requirements and resolving ambiguities to ensure seamless execution. Preparing comprehensive, high-quality documentation for both end-users and IT Support. Participation in the full rollout lifecycle, from strategic deployment planning to the delivery of user training. Strong capability in process analysis, synthesis, and the design of robust support systems. Good presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively to audiences of various sizes and levels of seniority. Deep understanding of the Scrum methodology and the software development lifecycle (SDLC). A solid understanding of front-end and back-end software development technologies, as well as UX/UI usability principles. Fluency in English is mandatory, as all project communication and documentation are conducted in English. WHY JOIN BNP PARIBAS? We are BNP Paribas S.A. (Branch in Poland), a part of BNP Paribas Group with 200years of experience in banking. Since 2008, we are at the heart of Warsaw, and now we are also in Krakow. As Corporate and Institutional Banking(CIB), we offer financial solutions for corporate and institutional clients in a number of locations globally. Our Securities Services business line is a multi-asset servicing specialist. We are an exciting, dynamic, and growing operations centre; therefore, we are looking for candidates who are willing to be a vital part of the expansion of BNP Paribas’ operational scope in Poland. It’s our values that drive us forward and are a cornerstone of our business. We rely on our strengths, which include stability, responsibility, expertise, and being a good place to work. READY TO MAKE A DIFFERENCE? RECRUITMENT PROCESS HR screening call – 15 min Technical interview with the hiring manager and future teammates Final interview with HR Offer & onboarding Recruitment process may differ depending on the position. items.desc: Dołącz do jednego z największych zespołów procesowych obsługujących sektor finansowy w Polsce. Nasz zespół liczy ponad 80 prawników i prowadzi kilkanaście tysięcy postępowań sądowych na rzecz czołowych banków oraz instytucji finansowych. Reprezentujemy klientów zarówno w sprawach masowych, dotyczących m.in. kredytów CHF, WIBOR, sankcji kredytu darmowego, jak i w najbardziej wymagających sporach precedensowych dotyczących zagadnień istotnych dla sektora finansowego. Poszukujemy radcy prawnego, adwokata lub aplikanta z doświadczeniem procesowym, który chce rozwijać się w obszarze sporów cywilnych oraz mieć realny wpływ na sposób prowadzenia powierzonych spraw. Należymy do grupy Play, będącej częścią francuskiej grupy telekomunikacyjnej Iliad. Specjalizujemy się w technologiach chmurowych, wysokiej skalowalności, sieciach i programowaniu niskopoziomowym. Discovery, Grupa Play, TVP, Canal+, Go3 czy Wirtualna Polska. Nasze rozwiązania są wdrażane przez czołowych graczy w Europie, na Bliskim Wschodzie oraz w Ameryce Południowej, co daje możliwość zdobycia doświadczenia w międzynarodowym środowisku. items.desc: At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This position reports to: T&E Hub Lead __ In this role, you will have the opportunity to ensure day-to-day processing of functional Travel and Expenses requests while handling both complex and escalated tasks. Each day, you will guarantee support to internal/ external customers and timely processing of information for all stakeholders. You will also showcase your expertise by delivering assigned T&E services in compliance with all procedures/policies that are in place and as per the defined Service Level Agreements. The work model for the role is: hybrid. You will be mainly accountable for: Auditing employee expense reports to ensure accuracy and compliance with Travel & Expenses (T&E) policies, identifying discrepancies, investigating audit-related issues, and supporting their resolution. Providing ad hoc guidance to employees on expense management systems and T&E policies, supporting resolution of inquiries and complaints through email and chat in a timely and professional manner, while ensuring effective customer service. Recommending process improvements and simplifications based on operational feedback and customer experience, while performing regular quality checks to improve team performance and ensure compliance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Supporting the optimization of expense management systems, supporting T&E operations during mergers and acquisitions, including system configuration and policy alignment. Collaborating with reporting and analytics teams to assemble and summarize data, prepare reports, and share findings, analyses, and recommendations with relevant stakeholders. Qualifications for the role: You have practical experience using MS Office applications; familiarity with SAP Concur, AI based tools or similar T&E management systems would be considered an advantage. You have knowledge of business administration, accounting, or finance. A relevant university degree would be considered an advantage but is not mandatory. You are comfortable communicating fluently in Business English (C1), both written and spoken, in an international professional environment. You demonstrate a customer-focused approach, with effective communication skills and the ability to respond to inquiries and resolve issues in a timely manner. Previous experience in a corporate environment, particularly in finance and/or Travel & Expenses services, would be considered an advantage. You enjoy collaborating with others and working in cross-functional, international teams, while ensuring tasks are completed within agreed deadlines. You have well-developed organizational and time management skills, with the ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously. Your benefits: Enjoy a stable employment in a company with a long history in innovation and technology. Collaborate with experienced experts in an international environment. Seize individual development and training opportunities, from job specific to soft skills. Private medical care (including offers for family members) and life insurance. Receive attractive remuneration based on your experience and skills, and other financial benefits, such as annual bonus and internal share purchase program. Choose from various benefits in kind, ranging from healthy lifestyle offerings, to knowledge sharing, to teambuilding activities. Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Potrafisz przekonywać do swoich rekomendacji, prowadzić wymagające uzgodnienia i skutecznie współpracować z interesariuszami reprezentującymi różne obszary organizacji. items.desc: Do you want to own how a bank secures the way its people work? At Avarda you get the mandate to design, enforce and improve the security of our laptops, mobile devices and Microsoft 365 identities. You will work hands-on with Intune, Defender, Entra ID and Sentinel, across Windows, macOS, iOS and Android, in a regulated environment with high demands on security and compliance. You will join the Workplace team in IT Operations, together with the IT Helpdesk, and work side by side with the rest of the operations team, our Security Engineer for infrastructure and our SOC partner. You will be the person who sets the security baseline for the workplace and the go-to person when security and workplace questions meet. About Avarda Avarda is an internet-based niche bank offering consumer banking and e-commerce solutions through our own highly automated IT platform. Our business spans Consumer Lending, E-commerce Solutions and Credit Cards, and we serve private individuals in 14 countries: Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Poland, Germany, Austria, Ireland, the Netherlands, Italy and Spain. We are growing fast, and so is the scope and complexity of what we need to protect. What you will own Endpoint security. Intune configuration profiles, compliance policies and security baselines, and device deployment with Windows Autopilot, across Windows, macOS, iOS and Android, including mobile device and app management. Microsoft 365 security. Entra ID, Conditional Access and Defender for Endpoint and Office 365, together with security settings in Exchange Online, SharePoint and Teams. Threat detection and response. Detection, investigation and response on clients together with our SOC partner, using Microsoft Defender and Sentinel. Data protection. DLP and information protection, including security evaluation of new AI tools before they reach our users. Vulnerability management. Vulnerability scanning and follow-up of penetration test findings for the workplace environment, driven through to resolution. Support and escalation. 2nd line escalation point for the IT Helpdesk on security and workplace issues, and a trusted contact for other teams with IT Operations questions. Also part of the role Supporting the security of our server and cloud environment, Group Policy and privileged access (PIM/PAM), as well as documentation, security policies, audits, and our Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity work. You will have plenty of opportunity to shape how we do things. If you see a smarter or safer way to work, we want to hear it. Your future team You will be part of the Workplace team, which runs our workplace environment and IT Helpdesk as a part of IT Operations. You will work daily with the Helpdesk and with the rest of the operations team, who own our global infrastructure and services. Together with the Security Engineer working with infrastructure, you form the core of our security engineering: you own the workplace side, they own the infrastructure side. You will also work with our SOC provider and external security partners. It is a hands-on, collaborative environment where knowledge-sharing makes everyone better. Who are you? You enjoy solving problems hands-on and take ownership of your area. You are comfortable in a 2nd line support role and see every support case as a chance to make the environment a little more secure. We expect that you have: Hands-on experience administering and securing endpoints with Microsoft Intune, including Windows Autopilot Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender, Entra ID and Conditional Access Experience from IT Operations or 2nd line support, helping end users and other IT teams A structured, analytical approach to problem-solving Strong communication skills, and the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical colleagues Fluency in English. Swedish is a plus It is a plus if you also have: Experience with macOS and mobile device management (iOS, Android) Experience with Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Purview (DLP, sensitivity labels) PowerShell or other scripting for automation Experience from a regulated environment, such as financial services Microsoft certifications such as MD-102, SC-200 or SC-300, or equivalent experience Do not worry if you do not check every box. If you are curious, driven and eager to grow into the role, we would still love to hear from you. Worth knowing This is a full-time, permanent position based in Málaga or Szczecin. Hybrid work flexibility is available. You will report into IT Operations and work in close proximity to the IT Helpdesk and the rest of the operations team, which gives you fast escalation paths and strong support from day one. We believe diverse teams build better solutions, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Ready to apply? If you have any questions about the role, feel free to reach out to our hiring manager, Robert Lööf, Head of IT Operations. We look forward to hearing from you!

items.desc: General Information Position Workday Functional Consultant Work arrangement Full-time City Gdansk, Katowice, Krakow, Lodz, Poznan, Warsaw, Wroclaw Country Poland Department Consulting Team Industry Solutions & Organization Transformation Area of interest Consulting, ERP Platforms Way of work Hybrid Description & Requirements Who we are looking for Workday Functional Consultant - Poland | Czech Republic | Hungary Take ownership of real HR transformation challenges You've built your first professional experience. Now you're ready for more ownership. As a Workday Functional Consultant at Deloitte , you'll work with local and international clients to understand business challenges, design better HR processes and translate them into technology solutions. You'll be more than someone who configures a system. We want you to develop into someone clients can trust to understand the problem, challenge assumptions and recommend a way forward. Who we're looking for We're looking for people with approximately 1–2 years of experience in HR technology and/or consulting . You don't need to come from a particular academic background. What matters more is whether you: Have initial experience with Compensation or Advance Compensation modules Learn quickly and enjoy tackling unfamiliar problems Can turn ambiguity into structured questions and actions Are comfortable speaking with clients Can explain complex topics simply Take ownership of your work and follow things through Manage deadlines and changing priorities Proactively seek answers, expertise and support Can challenge ideas constructively Enjoy building relationships and working with people Are fluent in English Previous Workday experience is valuable, but Workday knowledge alone isn't what we're hiring for . Your future role ‍ What you'll do Depending on the project and your experience, you'll: Translate business requirements into HR processes and Workday solutions Investigate complex problems and recommend practical solutions Run parts of client workshops and requirements discussions Challenge client requirements constructively when there's a better approach Configure and test Workday functional solutions Present designs and recommendations clearly Own defined project deliverables and deadlines Identify risks early and help resolve them Support your Stream Lead in keeping delivery moving Build your internal network and find the right expertise when you need it Collaborate with colleagues and clients across countries You'll have experienced colleagues and subject-matter experts around you. But at Consultant level, we also expect you to increasingly own the problem rather than wait for someone else to solve it . What you'll build This role gives you the opportunity to develop: Deep HR and business process expertise Workday functional expertise Client advisory and workshop skills Functional solution design capabilities Project delivery and stakeholder management skills Experience across local and international projects A strong network across Deloitte What we offer Grow from delivery professional to trusted adviser You'll develop through Workday training and certifications, client delivery and support from experienced Deloitte colleagues. But you'll also be expected to own your learning. Consulting means you will sometimes face a client question you've never answered before, an unfamiliar process or a challenging deadline. Success isn't about already knowing every answer. It's about being able to structure the problem, ask good questions, find the right expertise, make a recommendation and move things forward. And you'll do that within a team that helps each other learn and succeed. You'll work with one of today's leading HR technology platforms while developing capabilities that go beyond a single system. Technology will evolve. Great consultants evolve with it. If you're ready to take more ownership, work directly with clients and become a business and technology adviser, we'd like to meet you. ✈️ This role requires visits in office min. 2x/month and we are looking for candidates who accepts business travels. Selection process Application & Recruiter Call - we review your CV and, if there’s a good match, invite you to a short 15-minute conversation with our recruiter . Technical Interview - meet with a Senior Consultant to discuss your experience, expertise, and approach to technical and business challenges. Final Interview - have a conversation with a Senior Manager focused on the project, your potential role, and mutual fit. About Deloitte Deloitte is about diversity – of people, experiences, industries, and services delivered across 150 countries around the world. It’s a place of intellectual challenges, a strong start to your career, continuous growth, and valuable experiences that go beyond work. It all starts with one step – finishing your CV, sending it off, and eventually signing your contract. Deloitte is simply a good choice. Period. #LI-DS1

items.desc: Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects. Who we are supporting The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium. The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including: Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats. Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations. Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces. Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks. Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers. Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities. The program Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS) The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCI Agency) is NATO's principal C3 capability deliverer and CIS service provider. It provides, maintains and defends the NATO enterprise-wide information technology infrastructure to enable Allies to consult together under Article IV, and, when required, stand together in the face of attack under Article V. To provide these critical services, in the modern evolving dynamic environment the NCI Agency needs to build and maintain high performance-engaged workforce. The NCI Agency workforce strategically consists of three major categorise's: NATO International Civilians (NIC)'s, Military (Mil), and Interim Workforce Consultants (IWC)'s. The IWCs are a critical part of the overall NCI Agency workforce and make up approximately 15 percent of the total workforce. Role ID – 2026-0147 Role Background A leading NATO training academy in Oeiras, Portugal is seeking an experienced technical instructor to deliver user and data manager training on Joint Targeting System (JTS), FAST and ICC systems to students from the NATO Command Structure, NATO Force Structure, member nation MODs and Partners-for-Peace units. You will deliver course iterations on-site in Oeiras and as part of a Mobile Training Team at NATO and national locations in Europe and the US, and keep the associated training material up to date with the latest system versions. Role Duties and Responsibilities Prepare and deliver course iterations: review the training package, perform minor courseware updates, and validate the training environment, accounts, access and exercises before delivery Deliver theory, demonstrations and practical exercises, and support students throughout the course Run assessments, collect student feedback, and provide attendance and results with a short training completion report Complete the Quality Assurance report within one week of each course and the Course Improvement Plan within two weeks, using the Training Management System Update and maintain course materials (presentations, practical exercises, instructor and student materials) when authorised, in line with system updates Coordinate course scheduling with the Academy section head and the Learning Coordination and Support Branch Travel as part of a Mobile Training Team when courses are confirmed Meet agreed performance standards and obtain formal acceptance of each iteration via the Delivery Acceptance Sheet Courses in Scope JTS / FAST Combined User Course (5 days) JTS Data Manager Course (5 days) JTS User Course (4 days) ICC User Course (5 days) FAST User Course (3 days) JTS / FAST Train the Trainer (10 days) Essential Skills, Experience and Certifications Advanced knowledge of ICC, JTS and FAST systems, with in-depth experience of delivering courses to users and operators Deep knowledge and experience of NATO doctrine and standards relevant to Common Operations Knowledge and experience of the NATO Command Structure and NATO Force Structure Experience developing technical documentation, training materials and instructional aids Experience working in an international environment with military and civilian personnel Advanced English Willingness to travel and to deliver some training during national public holidays Desirable NATO CIS Technical Instructor qualification or equivalent …

items.desc: As a Performance Testing Engineer, you will help ensure that our applications deliver excellent performance, scalability, and reliability before reaching production. You will collaborate with business stakeholders, developers, testers, architects, DevOps Engineers, and Infrastructure Teams to design, execute, and analyze performance tests that validate system behavior under realistic workloads. Key responsibilities Performance Test Planning Participate in discovery/analysis sessions to understand business objectives and non-functional requirements (NFRs). Asses potential performance risks introduced by new features or architectural changes. Define appropriate performance testing strategies based on business and technical requirements. Design comprehensive Performance Test Plans/Assessment Documents, covering scope, objectives, workload models, success criteria, and execution approaches. Collaborate with stakeholders to clarify assumptions, risks, and expected system behavior. Test Design & Script Development Develop reusable and maintainable performance test scripts. Support testing across Web, Mobile, API, and microservice architectures. Maintain test assets following coding and documentation standards.
