Analyze test results to evaluate: response times, throughput, transaction success rates, error rates, resource utilization, scalability, system stability Identify performance bottlenecks and correlate application behavior with infrastructure metrics (from used observability tools) to determine root causes and provide recommendations. Reporting & Recommendations Produce clear technical and executive performance testing reports (following pre-existing templates or from scratch). Present findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Document risks, bottlenecks, trends, and improvement opportunities. Provide recommendations to improve application performance, scalability, and stability. Support development teams during performance optimization activities. Automation & Continuous Performance Testing Contribute to integrating performance testing into CI/CD pipelines. Support automated performance test execution using enterprise tools and APIs. Continuously improve testing processes, standards, and best practices. items.desc: Now Job ID R-558560 Category Quality Location Salamanca, Spain Region EMEA As a result of the combination of the BD Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions business with Waters Corporation (NYSE: WAT), by applying to this role, you will be applying for a position with Waters. Waters is a global leader in life sciences, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics, and service. With a focus on regulated, high-volume testing environments, Waters’ innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across biology, chemistry, and physics. Waters collaborates with analytical laboratories around the world to advance the release of effective, high-quality medicines, assure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combatting growing antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, Waters’ passionate team of approximately 16,000 colleagues partner with customers to turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide. We are the people who give possibilities purpose BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities. Job Description The Quality Technician reports to the Quality Manager in Salamanca. This position participates in activities supporting the design, manufacture, and release of clinical and research products that meet established specifications. These activities to be supported include: environmental monitoring, validation, material disposition, in-process product disposition, finished goods disposition, data collection/trend analysis, quality auditing, Quality/Compliance Training, CAPA, complaint processing & investigation, quality record retention, quality documentation and change control process. The role contributes to ensure product safety, product quality, QMS maintenance, the compliance with and application of quality standards, regulations and customer expectations. Responsibilities Assure that Quality Notifications (QN) are created, investigated, completed and closed in accordance to the established Standard Operating Procedures. Identify quality events and support investigations. Report quality issues to Quality Manager. Support other associates or departments in the proper follow-up, documentation and completion of complaints, changes, CAPAs, corrections and other quality records. Monitor, document and analyze Quality Metrics. Batch record QA review. Gather information for the Quality Management Reviews, for the preparation of reports and other department activities. Draft and update local SOPs or working instructions, analysis reports, plans and other quality documents. Support the Quality department in audits (external, internal and customer) and other investigations from regulatory agencies, Notifies Bodies, and customers. Act as a role model for Quality by the daily representation of all quality aspects and modeling and emphasizing quality in the workplace. Keep abreast of the basic requirements for compliance in own area of work and comply with those requirements. Participate as required in training on regulatory issues affecting own area of work. Bring regulatory compliance questions/issues to the attention of management. Provide recommendations to support systems that continuously improve product/process quality and product availability, reduce cost, and increase production capability. Education and experience Requires a bachelor's degree (preferred Life Sciences) A minimum of 1 year relevant technical experience in a regulated industry or a combination of equivalent education and experience. Knowledge of ISO 13485 and/or ISO 9001 standards is required Knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) is expected High level of English Salary for this role 24000€ + benefits Why Join Us? To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do. We welcome people with the imagination and drive to help us reinvent the future of healthcare. At BD, you’ll discover a culture in which you can learn, grow and thrive. We believe that when people connect in person, we learn faster, collaborate more deeply, and build a stronger culture. Join us and enjoy a culture where face-to-face collaboration supports your learning, your progress, and your success. To learn more about BD visit https://bd.com/careers. items.desc: Excited to grow your career? BBVA is a global company with more than 160 years of history that operates in more than 25 countries where we serve more than 80 million customers. We are more than 121,000 professionals working in multidisciplinary teams with profiles as diverse as financiers, legal experts, data scientists, developers, engineers and designers. Learn more about the area: Have you recently graduated? Are you interested in the Risks area and would like to develop your professional career in this field? The "Be Talent BBVA: Seed Program - Risks Edition" is an initiative designed for recent graduates. For 24 months, you will work on diverse projects, rotating every 6 months through different units within the Risks area at our Ciudad BBVA headquarters in Madrid. In Risks, we are a key piece in driving BBVA's growth. Our work goes far beyond identifying and controlling risks: we help the bank make better decisions, discover new business opportunities, and grow in a profitable and sustainable manner. We work in a global, dynamic, and constantly transforming environment where we combine business knowledge, data analytics, technology, and artificial intelligence. We analyze the impact of geopolitical events, participate in major financing operations, and develop innovative AI-based solutions, contributing to some of the bank's most strategic and relevant decisions. We will take into account your professional goals, experience, skills, and interests to align your rotations. International Experience and Consolidation: International Mission: Throughout the program, you will have the opportunity to complete a 4 to 6-week international stay at one of BBVA's global headquarters. Program Completion: Upon completing the program, you will consolidate into a team within the Risks area based on your skills, career path, and business needs. Key Objective: This program offers you a 360-degree view of BBVA's operations, allowing you to develop technical competencies and essential skills in an ever-evolving sector. We will provide you with the necessary support for a seamless integration into a modern and enjoyable work environment that fosters personal and professional growth. Discover more about BBVA: https://www.bbva.com/es/ About the job: Why join our rotation program? Contract Conditions and Location: Permanent full-time contract, starting in March 2027 (date subject to confirmation). Hybrid working model: 60% in-office and 40% remote per quarter. Ciudad BBVA, Madrid. Professional Development and Training: Transversal Experience and Vision: Rotations will allow you to integrate into different teams, learn about various areas and businesses, and gain a global perspective of the bank while developing your capabilities. Comprehensive Professional Development: You will have access to specific training and work in multidisciplinary teams. You will develop your skills to adapt to different work environments and build a strong network of contacts. Guidance and Mentoring: You will be part of the "BE TALENT BBVA" community, with an assigned "buddy" even before starting the program. You will have the support of a mentor. You will receive continuous feedback on your performance. Future Outlook: Upon completion of the program, you will have a cross-functional perspective and differential experience to continue growing your career within BBVA. Additional Benefits : Access to BBVA Social Benefits and the wide range of Services at Ciudad BBVA. Find out if Be Talent BBVA SEED is right for you : Academic Background and Knowledge: We are looking for graduates holding a higher degree (Bachelor's or Double Degree) with a graduation date between 2025 and 2026 (both inclusive). Academic background: University degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Actuarial Sciences, Econometrics, Economics, Business Administration, Finance, Data Science, Engineering, double degrees, or other scientific, technological, or legal disciplines, with interest and knowledge in the financial field and risk management. Master's/Postgraduate degree (desirable): Postgraduate education in Risk Management, Quantitative Finance, Actuarial Sciences, Statistics, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Quantitative Models, or related fields will be valued. Academic Record: An excellent academic transcript. Work Experience: Prior professional experience is not required, although internships or previous work experience will be positively considered. Language Skills: Spanish and English (C1 level). About You : You have a global mindset (an interest in intercultural exposure is favorable). You are eager to learn and develop your profile, trying out new ideas with a positive and enthusiastic attitude. items.desc: Excited to grow your career? BBVA is a global company with more than 160 years of history that operates in more than 25 countries where we serve more than 80 million customers. We are more than 121,000 professionals working in multidisciplinary teams with profiles as diverse as financiers, legal experts, data scientists, developers, engineers and designers. Learn more about the area: Dentro del área de Finance, nuestra unidad de Global Procurement es un equipo apasionante con un marcado espíritu global y capacidad de impacto transversal en todo el Banco. Somos el catalizador y enlace con todo el ecosistema de partners y proveedores que BBVA requiere para el desarrollo de su actividad. Desde nuestra función, trabajamos para contribuir a la eficiencia de BBVA mediante la negociación de las mejores condiciones de mercado, garantizando que los procesos de contratación se ejecuten en un contexto de igualdad de oportunidades, con total apego a la legalidad y buscando siempre ofrecer la mejor experiencia a nuestros clientes internos. About the job: Buscamos a una persona para incorporarse como Procurement Analyst en el equipo de Procurement Operation & Strategic Sourcing. Te integrarás en una estructura de pool horizontal basada en proyectos, donde tendrás la oportunidad de abordar retos tanto locales como globales. Este modelo te permitirá asegurar una visión transversal sobre todas las categorías de compras (Tecnología, Infraestructuras, Servicios al Negocio, Comunicación, etc.) y facilitará tu desarrollo profesional dentro de la función. Como Analyst, darás apoyo a compradores senior en ejecutar los procesos de negociación y gestión: Relación con áreas usuarias: Colaborarás directamente con los equipos internos para conocer sus necesidades, analizar volúmenes de compra y precios de adquisición. Ejecución de negociación y licitaciones: Prepararás la lista de proveedores participantes, elaborarás pliegos de licitación y establecerás criterios de selección. Análisis de costes: Realizarás evaluaciones de ofertas, desde análisis comparativos sencillos hasta modelos de sensibilidad complejos (TCO / TVO). Gestión del aprovisionamiento: Tramitarás las ofertas, calcularás los ahorros generados y prepararás la documentación para la Propuesta de Adjudicación ante la Comisión de Contratación. Contratación y Normativa: Aplicarás la Norma de Adquisición de bienes y servicios del Grupo y asegurarás el cumplimiento del flujo de firma de contratos. Sourcing de mercado: Participarás en la búsqueda de proveedores y en el control del riesgo proveedor de acuerdo a la estrategia del área. Conocimientos contractuales: Conocimiento de contratos. ¿Qué buscamos? Formación: Titulación universitaria superior o media en Ingeniería, Telecomunicaciones, Económicas, ADE o similar. Idiomas: Nivel alto de inglés (B2 o superior). Herramientas digitales: Experiencia en el uso de SAP/ARIBA y herramientas de negociación. Ofimática: Dominio avanzado de Excel y bases de datos, así como manejo fluido del entorno Google (AppScript, Data Studio, Sheets, etc.). Habilidades clave: Capacidades de negociación, comunicación e interlocución. Conocimientos técnicos: Interés y curiosidad por los mercados de tecnología, servicios profesionales o infraestructuras, valorando positivamente los conocimientos financieros. Valorable Experiencia previa 1 – 2 años en entornos multinacionales y gestión de proyectos. Disponibilidad para viajar a nivel internacional si el proyecto lo requiere. Skills: Client Orientation, Empathy, Ethics, Innovation, Proactive Thinking

items.desc: About Us / Who you will join: 130 years of trust, time to shape what's next. Allianz Group is one of the world's leading insurers and asset managers - built on over a century of stability, expertise, and financial strength. Allianz Services is where that legacy meets the future. 8,200+ people. Eight countries. Three continents. We deliver specialized services to clients within Allianz Group, powered by AI, advanced analytics, and a mindset that refuses to stand still. From core insurance operations to engineering and consulting services, we reimagine how insurance works. What truly sets us apart are our people and the trusted partnerships we build, anchored in our values of expertise, integrity, and empowerment. We don't support the business. We shape it. What you do: Develop and design data, productivity and automation strategies for clients, using a wide range of tools including (Gen)AI and PowerApps. Work with business and technology teams to understand requirements, develop solutions, and deliver results. Participate in the development of new business opportunities. Develop and present professional consulting decks (storytelling slides, one-pagers, and illustrative visuals) for senior stakeholders. What you bring: Minimum of 1 year experience in technology or data analytics role, and 2-3 years’ experience in strategy or management consulting. Solid understanding of the Microsoft 365 ecosystem. Experience in BI and data tools e.g. Power BI, PowerApps, Power Automate; SQL or similar a plus. Experience in (Gen)AI tools a plus. Fluency in English and Spanish, with other European languages as a plus. Degree in technology preferred, with a focus on analytics, engineering, business informatics or data / computer science. A complementing business degree is a plus. Awareness of cloud environments (AWS, Azure exposure a plus). Strong PowerPoint storytelling skills, including consulting-style decks and illustrative designs. Vill du arbeta med data som gör medicinsk forskning mer tillgänglig och användbar? Hos oss på Karolinska Institutets Universitetsbibliotek får du utveckla lösningar som samlar, berikar och tillgängliggör forskningsinformation. Du blir en del av ett litet och engagerat team där du får kombinera teknisk utveckling med verksamhetsnära samarbete. Din roll Du kommer arbeta med att samla in, strukturera och vidareutveckla data från flera olika system och källor. Ditt arbete bidrar till att skapa tillförlitlig och användbar information om den forskning som bedrivs vid Karolinska Institutet. Rollen är varierad och du kommer bland annat att arbeta med att: modellera data samt utveckla och optimera databaser utveckla och underhålla laddscript utveckla API: er och integrationer strukturera och koppla samman data från olika källor vidareutveckla arbetssätt och tekniska lösningar tillsammans med teamet aktivt bidra till tekniska lösningar som svarar mot behov i verksamheten Arbetet spänner över hela kedjan från datainsamling och datamodellering till integrationer, optimering och tillgängliggörande av information. Ena dagen kan du arbeta med att förbättra prestandan i ett dataladdningsflöde, nästa dag med att utveckla en integration eller förbättra teamets utvecklingsprocesser. Rollen är särskilt intressant för dig som tycker om att delta i hela processen, från att förstå användarnas behov, se samband och omsätta dem i hållbara tekniska lösningar. Vem är du? Vi söker dig som är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad, tycker om att förstå komplexa samband och lära nytt. Du tycker om att ta egna initiativ, identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och omsätta idéer till lösningar tillsammans med teamet. För att trivas i rollen ser vi att du är en lagspelare som uppskattar att samarbeta, dela kunskap och bidra till att utveckla teamets arbetssätt. Du trivs i en miljö där verksamheten både kan vara planerad och händelsestyrd. Vi söker dig som har: relevant utbildning eller motsvarande kompetens som du har förvärvat på annat sätt god erfarenhet av relationsdatabaser, datamodellering och SQL erfarenhet av att utveckla, vidareutveckla och optimera databaser och dataflöden erfarenhet av att hämta, bearbeta och koppla samman data från flera system eller datakällor erfarenhet av programmering i Python förmåga att kommunicera väl på svenska och engelska Det är meriterande om du har: arbetat med publikationsdata, forskningsinformation eller andra komplexa informationsmängder erfarenhet av automatiserad testning och kvalitetssäkring av kod erfarenhet av CI/CD och automatiserade utvecklings- eller driftsättningsflöden arbetat med agil systemutveckling erfarenhet av maskininlärning eller intresse av att utvecklas inom området Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. Teamet och vårt arbetssätt Du blir en del av ett litet team där vi stöttar varandra. Här finns utrymme att ställa frågor, testa idéer och bidra med egna perspektiv. Vi jobbar både i utvecklingsprojekt och löpande systemförvaltning, och du får möjlighet att vara med och påverka hur vi utvecklar våra arbetssätt och lösningar. Vi arbetar flexibelt med kontor på Karolinska Institutets båda campus, i Solna och Flemingsberg. För oss är det viktigaste att du vill vara en aktiv del av teamet, oavsett var du arbetar ifrån. Vad erbjuder vi? Hos oss får du arbeta i en kunskapsintensiv miljö där teknik, forskning och utveckling möts. Du får stor flexibilitet i arbetet, med möjlighet till distansarbete (del av veckan) och förtroendearbetstid, samt goda möjligheter att utvecklas i din roll. Som anställd vid Karolinska Institutet får du dessutom bra förmåner, generös semester och tjänstepension genom statligt kollektivavtal. Du kan också träna fritt i våra moderna friskvårdsanläggningar och får ersättning för läkarvård. Strävan efter jämställdhet, mångfald och lika villkor är både en kvalitetsfråga och en självklar del av Universitetsbibliotekets värdegrund. Vi vill att vår arbetsplats ska präglas av respekt, delaktighet och olika perspektiv. Placering: Solna / Flemingsberg Tio skäl att välja Karolinska Institutet Ansökan KI tillämpar individuell och differentierad lönesättning enligt våra kollektivavtal RALS och RALS-T. Ansökan ska göras via rekryteringssystemet Varbi. I denna rekrytering söker du med ditt CV samt personligt brev. Du kommer även få svara på några frågor om varför du söker jobbet. Sista ansökningsdag 2026-11-15. Vid tillsvidareanställning tillämpar Karolinska Institutet 6 månaders provanställning. Vill du göra skillnad – och bidra till en bättre hälsa för alla? items.desc: Security Operations Engineer We are now hiring for a Security Operations Engineer to join our Security team. This team drives the security programs within the business, with a heavy focus on people, processes, and automation of services. Kambi is looking for someone who wants to encourage and foster a culture of security awareness and regulatory compliance by making it easy for those less knowledgeable to Do It Right. About the Security team: You would be implementing technologies for vulnerability management, authentication and identity management, and creating security with automation. A focus for our team is to create paved roads for Development and Operations teams, to ensure they can easily secure their applications and maintain security throughout the organization. The Security Operations team also responds to incoming security threats and incidents. We provides expert security knowledge to the wider organisation. We use automation tools like Puppet, Ansible and Terraform, and work in a diverse environment with physical and virtual machines, as well as containerized workloads both on-prem and in AWS. About you: We will be very happy if you have commercial industry experience working in a security team, in either offensive or defensive roles. Additionally, previous experience working with Linux or AWS is needed, and it’s a huge bonus if you have spent time working with actively with security in these areas. Prior experience with identity and authentication systems for web and Linux integrations are valued. We'd love if you were investigative, curious and passionate about security and privacy. What We Offer: At Kambi, you'll join a collaborative and international team where innovation, learning, and personal growth are encouraged. We believe great work happens when people feel supported, valued, and empowered to make an impact. Some of the benefits you'll enjoy include: Generous paid time off to support a healthy work-life balance Health and wellbeing benefits for you and your family Pension, retirement, and insurance programs that provide peace of mind Employee Assistance Program and wellbeing resources Learning and development opportunities to support your career growth Flexible benefits designed to support your lifestyle and personal needs Recognition programs and company-wide celebrations Modern tools and a collaborative environment that help you do your best work Opportunities to connect, learn, and grow with colleagues across our global teams Whether you're solving complex challenges, collaborating with talented colleagues, or taking the next step in your career, you'll have the support and flexibility to thrive at Kambi. Ready to Apply? If you're excited about this opportunity and ready to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you—apply via our careers page. Security Engineer I Security Operations Engineer I Cyber Security Engineer I DevSecOps Engineer I Security Consultant Diversity & Inclusion: Kambi’s ongoing commitment to Diversity and Inclusion in the workplace If you require any reasonable adjustment during the recruitment process, please notify your recruiter, who will assist you however they can. Diversity and inclusion is at the heart of who we are and who we aim to be. While we are proud of the positive and inclusive company culture we have created, we know we can do so much more. Kambi constantly evolves its Diversity and Inclusion strategy to ensure it becomes an even more inclusive and positive place to work, with the core management team reaffirming its commitment to delivering on employee feedback. Creating an inclusive environment We believe Kambi’s greatest strength is the collective talent of our employees. Kambi is committed to ensuring we create an inclusive work environment where everyone can feel valued, thrive and achieve their potential, regardless of who they are or what their background is. We know that it is only by having a balance of different voices, values and opinions that Kambi is able to be the market leader it is today. #wearekambi

items.desc: Om arbetsplatsen Syftet med Bolagsverkets verksamhet är att ge förutsättningar för ett stabilt och väl fungerande näringsliv. Genom att registrera och tillhandahålla aktuell och korrekt företagsinformation bidrar vi med ökad transparens och trygghet för samhällets aktörer. Vi verkar för att göra det så enkelt som möjligt att starta och driva företag, och bidrar i samverkan med andra till att företag inte används som brottsverktyg. Hos oss arbetar omkring 700 medarbetare med bas i Sundsvall. Vi vill vara en arbetsplats där du trivs, känner engagemang i ditt uppdrag och får vardagen att fungera. En god arbetsmiljö och ett hållbart arbetsliv är viktigt för att vi ska lyckas med vårt uppdrag. Arbetsuppgifter Nu tar vi ett spännande kliv framåt inom vår it-verksamhet - vill du vara en del av resan och driva Bolagsverkets it-utveckling framåt? Vi söker dig som vill vara med och utveckla våra arbetssätt inom it-tjänsteprocesshantering på enheten för it-styrning och arkitektur. Tillsammans med engagerade kollegor får du möjligheten att göra skillnad i en organisation som befinner sig i ständig utveckling. Är du redo att ta nästa steg med oss? Som it-arkitekt hos oss kommer du att spela en central roll i att utveckla Bolagsverkets it-tjänsteprocesser och strategiska kravställning. I rollen ingår bland annat: • taktisk och operativ utveckling och arbete med arkitekturstyrning • arbete som systemarkitekt och systemförnyelse samt målarkitektur • framtagande av dokumentation och förslag till realisering i form av lösningsarkitektur, både i text och i modeller • framtagande av lösningsmönster för att arbeta med micro-services (API:er) och Kafkalösningar • framtagande av lösningsmönster för att arbeta med BI och AI med mönster, tränande, arkitektur, datastrategier och datarutinunderlag • presentation av lösningsarkitektur på ett tydligt sätt så att utvecklingsteam, it-styrning, verksamhet och att, i vissa • fall andra myndigheter förstår, och kan agera och implementera korrekt • samarbete med andra myndigheter i arkitekturfrågor, teknikstöd och normalisering. • arbete med Bolagsverkets datamanagement för utveckling av AI- och maskininlärningsmodeller • arbete med Front-end och Back-end arkitektur. Arkitekturrollen innebär att utvärdera, tydliggöra och utveckla arbetet inom arkitekturfrågor för respektive process. Rollen omfattar också nära samarbete med andra funktioner för att kontinuerligt förbättra och vidareutveckla arkitekturen och it-tjänsteprocessområdet på Bolagsverket. Som en nyckelspelare i både det strategiska och taktiska arbetet bidrar du till att omsätta strategier och processer till praktiska lösningar som stödjer kollegorna i deras dagliga arbete. Placeringsort är Sundsvall. Kvalifikationer Vi söker dig som har relevant akademisk it-utbildning eller flerårig erfarenhet inom it-området som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdig. items.desc: Vill du jobba med IT-säkerhet på riktigt? På CAG Security arbetar vi med säkerhet där den faktiskt gör skillnad. Vi hjälper företag och myndigheter att bygga säkrare system, hitta sårbarheter innan någon annan gör det och hantera en hotbild som förändras snabbare än någonsin. Nu söker vi fler erfarna IT-säkerhetsexperter som vill arbeta med tekniskt avancerade säkerhetsuppdrag – tillsammans med andra specialister som brinner för samma sak. Hos oss blir du inte en säkerhetsfunktion vid sidan av verksamheten. Säkerhet är vår verksamhet. Dina arbetsuppgifter Som IT-säkerhetsexpert på CAG Security arbetar du i varierande uppdrag hos kunder med höga krav på säkerhet, tillförlitlighet och kvalitet. Uppdragen kan exempelvis innebära att du: genomför penetrationstester av webbapplikationer, API, nätverk, molnmiljöer eller andra IT-system genomför tekniska säkerhetsgranskningar och sårbarhetsanalyser arbetar med Red Teaming och adversary simulation granskar arkitektur och design ur ett säkerhetsperspektiv tar fram säkerhetskrav och rekommendationer för tekniska lösningar hjälper kunder att bygga säkra infrastrukturer och plattformar arbetar med identitet, autentisering, behörighetsstyrning och Zero Trust analyserar och hanterar tekniska säkerhetsincidenter genomför tekniska riskanalyser och threat modelling hjälper utvecklings- och driftorganisationer att integrera säkerhet i sina processer deltar i utvecklingen av CAG Securitys tekniska tjänster och erbjudanden. Ett uppdrag kan vara ett fokuserat penetrationstest under några veckor. Ett annat kan innebära att du under längre tid fungerar som säkerhetsarkitekt eller teknisk säkerhetsexpert i ett större utvecklings- eller förändringsprojekt. Gemensamt är att du ska kunna omsätta teknisk kompetens till konkret säkerhetsnytta för kunden. Vem är du? Vi tror att du har flera års erfarenhet av IT- eller cybersäkerhet och har byggt upp en djup teknisk kompetens inom ett eller flera områden. Du kan exempelvis ha bakgrund inom penetrationstestning, säkerhetsarkitektur, infrastruktur, nätverk, cloud security, IAM, incidenthantering, utveckling eller teknisk säkerhetsgranskning. Du behöver inte kunna allt. Vi söker hellre personer som är riktigt bra inom sitt område och samtidigt är nyfikna på resten. Vi tror att du: har ett genuint tekniskt säkerhetsintresse förstår både hur system byggs och hur de kan angripas kan analysera komplexa tekniska miljöer kan förklara tekniska risker för både tekniker och beslutsfattare trivs med stort eget ansvar uppskattar att arbeta tillsammans med andra specialister behärskar svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Erfarenhet av exempelvis OWASP, MITRE ATT&CK, Active Directory/Entra ID, Azure/AWS, Kubernetes, Windows/Linux, nätverkssäkerhet, säker kodgranskning eller etablerade pentestverktyg är meriterande. Certifieringar som OSCP, OSCE, CISSP, CISM eller motsvarande är också meriterande – men vad du faktiskt kan väger tyngre än vilka bokstäver du har på ditt CV. Vissa av våra uppdrag kan omfattas av säkerhetsprövning och kan ställa ytterligare krav på dig som konsult. Vad vi erbjuder På CAG Security arbetar du tillsammans med människor som kan säkerhet och som vill fortsätta utvecklas. Vi tror på stor frihet under ansvar. Du får möjlighet att påverka både vilka uppdrag du arbetar i och vilka områden du vill utvecklas inom. Hos oss får du bland annat: arbeta med kvalificerade säkerhetsuppdrag hos organisationer med höga säkerhetskrav arbeta tillsammans med erfarna IT- och informationssäkerhetskonsulter möjlighet att påverka ditt eget uppdrag och din kompetensutveckling vidareutbildningar och relevanta certifieringar möjlighet att bidra till utvecklingen av våra tjänster och vårt bolag flexibla arbetsformer där det fungerar för uppdraget ett flexibelt lönesystem ett starkt kompetensnätverk inom hela CAG-koncernen. Vi gillar dessutom teknik på riktigt. Labbar, CTF, nya attackmetoder, märkliga sårbarheter och diskussioner om hur saker egentligen fungerar är en naturlig del av miljön hos oss. Om CAG Security CAG Security är ett specialistbolag helt fokuserat på IT- och informationssäkerhet. Vi hjälper företag och myndigheter genom hela säkerhetslivscykeln – från styrning, risk och säkerhetskrav till säker arkitektur, penetrationstest, Red Teaming, incidenthantering och IT-forensik. Vi är en del av CAG-koncernen, vilket innebär att vi kombinerar specialistbolagets korta beslutsvägar och stora individuella påverkan med kompetensen och möjligheterna i en större IT-koncern. Vår ambition är enkel: Vi ska hjälpa våra kunder att ligga steget före. Och vi vill göra det tillsammans med några av Sveriges bästa säkerhetsexperter. Intresserad? Då vill vi gärna prata med dig. Du behöver inte ha bestämt exakt vad nästa steg i karriären ska vara. Hör av dig så tar vi ett första samtal om vad du kan, vad du vill göra mer av och om CAG Security kan vara rätt plats för dig.

items.desc: Stockholm Ansök senast: 2026-11-19 Ansök nu Teracom är statens bolag för säker kommunikation. I våra nät når informationen fram opåverkad. Vår styrka ligger i att alltid vara redo, i hela landet, alla dagar, dygnet runt. Med ständig beredskap ska vår infrastruktur för kommunikation stå emot allt från naturkatastrofer till cyberhot och krig. Vi hjälper våra kunder med säkra och skalbara lösningar, från traditionell radio- och tv-utsändning till framtidens digitala kommunikationsvägar. Är du intresserad av att arbeta i en spännande och dynamisk bransch med erfarna och kompetenta kollegor? Är du ansvarstagande och gillar att tänka nytt? Då tror vi att du kommer att trivas hos oss! Om tjänsten: I rollen som IT-säkerhetsspecialist på Teracom:s SOC (Security Operations Center) arbetar du i ett team som tillsammans ansvarar för att skydda Teracoms nätverk och system, genom daglig uppföljning samt hantering av interna och externa projekt. Du arbetar med kunniga kollegor i din egen grupp samt andra delar av organisationen för att följa upp och integrera ny kunskap inom området både i nya och befintliga system. Ansvar och huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter: I rollen som IT-säkerhetsspecialist kommer du primärt att arbeta med: Drift och underhåll av SOC-system ur ett säkerhetsperspektiv Övervakning och förbättring av säkerheten i system och nätverk Vidareutveckling av vår SOC och SIEM-lösning Kontinuitetshantering Säkerhetsintegrationer Omvärldsbevakning Säkerhetsgranskningar Ansvarsområden sträcker sig från drift och förvaltning av SOC-system till design och implementation av övervakningslösningar. Det ingår även att stötta övriga gruppen i arbetet med övervakning av loggar, larm- och incidenthantering. En viktig del av arbetet är att förbättra de verktyg och processer som används för säkerhetsövervakningen. Är du den vi söker? Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av att ha arbetat inom drift och förvaltning av integrerade miljöer, incidenthantering och kontinuitetshantering. Du har god kommunikativ förmåga, både på svenska och engelska. Erfarenhet av säkerhetsstandards och ramverk är mycket meriterande. Du har djupa kunskaper om IT och datakommunikation och har några års erfarenhet av IT-säkerhetsarbete och har ett brinnande intresse för just säkerhet. Du har kunskaper inom: God förståelse inom nätverk, Windows och Linux Förståelse inom containerplattformar Incidenthantering och uppföljning Logghantering, intrångsdetektering och trafikövervakning Erfarenhet av säkerhetsprodukter som SIEM, IDS/IPS, proxy, etc. Erfarenhet av threat hunting Strukturerad dokumentation Meriterande om du har kunskaper inom: Query languages så som regex, KQL, DSL , DQL Scripting för generella ändamål i exempelvis Python, powershell eller bash Design, implementering och utveckling av SOC plattform Machine learning Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper och ser att du har en god förmåga att kommunicera med personer inom olika kompetensområden och visar på ett stort engagemang och driv. Du är en person med hög personlig integritet och har ett högt säkerhetstänk. Vidare är du analytisk, strukturerad och konstruktiv i ditt sätt att arbeta. Har du dessutom en god förmåga att ta egna initiativ samtidigt som du trivs att arbeta i team kommer du att lyckas väl i denna roll. Naturligtvis är du också en person som identifierar dig med Teracoms tre kärnvärden; Mod, ansvar, innovation. Då tjänsten är säkerhetsklassad krävs Svenskt medborgarskap. En registerprövning kommer genomföras. Beredskap förekommer. Vi erbjuder: Hos Teracom får du vara med och göra skillnad varje dag. Det är vårt gemensamma ansvar att de samhällsviktiga tjänster vi levererar, med höga krav på både tillgänglighet, säkerhet och kvalitet, fungerar dygnet runt, året runt - oavsett. Vi erbjuder ett positivt arbetsklimat med högt engagemang, stort ansvarstagande och kompetenta kollegor. På Teracom strävar vi efter att skapa en kultur som inspirerar till lärande och utveckling där medarbetarna känner engagemang och trivs på jobbet, samtidigt som vi värnar om balans mellan arbete och fritid. Vi betraktar olikheter mellan människor som en styrka och är övertygade om att det bidrar till ett kreativt och trivsamt arbetsklimat. Hos oss får du marknadsmässiga villkor och goda möjligheter att utvecklas i din roll. Vi söker två systemutvecklare som tillsammans med oss vill fortsätta introducera nya teknologier i svensk sjukvård. Du erbjuds ett meningsfullt arbete där det du utvecklar bidrar till att förbättra patientvården möjlighet att utvecklas i ett tvärvetenskapligt team med bred kompetens inom genomik, bioinformatik, mjukvaruutveckling och IT en arbetsmiljö där nya teknologier och lösningar är en naturlig del av vardagen flexibla arbetstider och möjlighet till hybridarbete en inkluderande kultur som präglas av öppenhet, mångfald och respekt. Självklart får du också ta del av de generella förmåner som Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset erbjuder. Om tjänsten Tjänsten är placerad vid Genomic Medicine Center Karolinska (GMCK), som är en del av Medicinsk diagnostik Karolinska (MDK). GMCK ansvarar för att tillhandahålla storskaliga och avancerade genomikanalyser till samtliga laboratoriemedicinska specialiteter inom MDK. Vårt team består av cirka 50 medarbetare med bred kompetens inom genomik, bioinformatik, mjukvaruutveckling och IT. Vi arbetar nära varandra och samarbete och hjälpsamhet är en naturlig del av vardagen. Nya teknologier och patientgrupper innebär att vi ständigt möter nya och meningsfulla utmaningar med målet att förbättra vården för fler patienter. Du kommer tillsammans med ett team på sex utvecklare att underhålla och vidareutveckla de system som automatiserar våra dataflöden och tillgängliggör resultaten för kliniska experter. Systemen består av både CLI- och webbapplikationer och är till största del skrivna i Python. Webbapplikationerna utvecklas med FastAPI och Flask. Vi använder GitHub för versionshantering och Docker för containerisering, och våra system driftas on-premises. items.desc: Ö-borgen är en familjeägd koncern med flera bolag inom den marina sektorn i Sverige. VesselCare är vår egenutvecklade Fleet Management-plattform som samlar in och analyserar sensordata från fartyg via IoT-enheter. Informationen används bland annat för realtidsövervakning, analys av resor och bränsleförbrukning samt automatiserad larmhantering. Vi utvecklar hela lösningen själva, från datainsamling och molninfrastruktur till backend och webbapplikationer. Plattformen används redan av våra kunder och vi fortsätter att utveckla den med nya funktioner, förbättrad användarupplevelse och bättre prestanda. Nu stärker vi utvecklingsgruppen och söker en embedded systemutvecklare som vill vara med och vidareutveckla tekniken bakom VesselCare och våra marina digitala lösningar. Arbetsuppgifter Som embedded systemutvecklare arbetar du med utveckling av mjukvara för inbyggda system med fokus på marina tillämpningar. Rollen kombinerar elektronik, kommunikationsprotokoll och modern systemutveckling där målet är att skapa robusta och tillförlitliga lösningar för en krävande miljö. Du kommer att: Utveckla mjukvara för inbyggda system Integrera fartygssystem via CANBUS, NMEA och Modbus Utveckla och underhålla firmware Designa och implementera signaltolkning och datamodeller Testa och verifiera kommunikation mot marina system Samarbeta med vårt cloudteam kring dataflöden och API: er Arbetet är varierat och innebär att du rör dig mellan hårdvara, firmware, kommunikationsprotokoll och systemintegration. Du kommer att arbeta nära både hårdvaru- och molnutvecklare för att skapa helhetslösningar som knyter samman fartygssystem och digitala tjänster. Vårt erbjudande Hos oss blir du en del av ett litet och prestigelöst utvecklingsteam där vi delar kunskap, samarbetar och välkomnar nya idéer. Du får vara med och vidareutveckla en produkt som redan gör skillnad, med stor frihet att påverka teknikval, arbetssätt och produktens framtid – och se resultatet av ditt arbete i praktiken. Vi erbjuder: Stort inflytande över en egen produkt: Du är med och påverkar teknikval, arkitektur och produktens fortsatta utveckling, och får se hur dina lösningar skapar värde för användarna Varierande och utvecklande arbetsuppgifter: Du får arbeta med hela teknikstacken, från moderna webbgränssnitt till backend, databaser och molninfrastruktur Flexibilitet och gemenskap: Vi erbjuder flexibla arbetstider och möjlighet till distansarbete, samtidigt som vi värdesätter samarbete och regelbundna träffar En familjär arbetsplats: Du blir en del av en familjeägd koncern med långsiktiga ambitioner och ett kontor med fantastiskt läge precis vid havet Vi söker dig som har en ingenjörsutbildning inom data eller motsvarande relevant utbildning. Du har erfarenhet av utveckling inom inbyggda system och har arbetat med databehandling, signalhantering eller liknande tekniska lösningar. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av: Rust, C och/eller C++. Utveckling av firmware och embedded-lösningar. CANBUS, NMEA, Modbus eller liknande industriella kommunikationsprotokoll. Integration mellan olika system och tekniska plattformar. Testning, verifiering och felsökning av tekniska system Du trivs med att arbeta nära andra kompetenser, är nyfiken på att lära dig nya tekniker och har ett lösningsfokuserat förhållningssätt. Du gillar att ta ansvar för dina leveranser och bidrar till en positiv och hjälpsam laganda. Du behöver behärska svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift. Mer om tjänsten och rekryteringsprocessen Du blir en del av koncernens IT-avdelning, som ansvarar för support, underhåll och utveckling av tekniska lösningar för alla våra bolag. Inom IT-avdelningen finns en utvecklingsgrupp som idag består av tre personer och som nu växer. Två nya roller tillsätts, en med fokus på embeddedutveckling och en inom cloud/fullstack. Gruppen arbetar till stor del på distans, och tillväxten innebär goda möjligheter att påverka både arbetssätt, teknikval och den fortsatta utvecklingen av VesselCare. Två av våra största kunder är Försvarsmakten och FMV vilket innebär att den som blir aktuell för tjänsten kommer genomgå en säkerhetsprövning. Har du frågor om tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Kim Svensson (031 756 00 71, eller kim.svensson@oborgen.se). Ansök genom att klicka på "ansök nu" och fyll i formuläret där du kommer få besvara urvalsfrågor som är relevanta för tjänsten - vi gör vårt första urval baserat på svaren på dessa frågor så vi ser gärna att du svarar utförligt. Vill du även bifoga ditt CV går det bra men det är inget måste. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Ö-borgen är en familjeägd koncern med flera bolag inom den marina sektorn i Sverige. Våra medarbetare är en viktig nyckel till framgång och i vår stora familj jobbar vi med olika saker men åt samma håll. Här får du möjlighet att utvecklas och växa tillsammans med oss! Du kan läsa mer om oss på vår hemsida: Ö-borgen

You'll: Own design projects end-to-end, from discovery and research to UX, UI, prototyping, and delivery. Solve real user problems by combining insights, creativity, and practical thinking. Conduct user research, including
items.desc: Love solving problems, building great digital products, and turning complex challenges into simple user experiences? Then we might be looking for you! About HomeQ HomeQ is Sweden's largest marketplace for first-hand rental apartments, connecting people looking for a home with property companies across the country. With over 1.4 million registered users and more than 1,000 property partners, we're making the rental market more accessible, transparent, and efficient. We're a small, ambitious team with big ideas. Since 2024, we've been part of Vend, the leading marketplace operator in the Nordics, giving us the best of both worlds: the speed and ownership of a scale-up, backed by the stability of an established company. Now we're looking for a curious and hands-on Product Designer to help us build even better experiences for our users. The team & how we work At HomeQ, we believe great products are built by small teams with a lot of ownership. We work with an adapted version of the Shape Up methodology, where small, cross-functional teams typically consist of a product designer, a frontend engineer, and a backend engineer. Together, you'll take on real user problems, explore solutions, and turn ideas into working products during six-week development cycles. You won't be handed a detailed list of tasks or told exactly what to design. Instead, we expect you to be curious, challenge assumptions, make decisions, and figure things out together with your team. Our product and engineering teams work across Stockholm and Lisbon, so collaboration and communication are a natural part of everyday life. What you'll do As a Product Designer at HomeQ, you'll have the opportunity to own the entire design process, from understanding a problem to shipping a solution that makes a difference. You'll: Own design projects end-to-end, from discovery and research to UX, UI, prototyping, and delivery. Solve real user problems by combining insights, creativity, and practical thinking. Conduct user research, including interviews, surveys, and usability testing. Work closely with engineers to turn ideas into well-designed, functional products. Create intuitive user experiences for both people looking for homes and the property companies using our platform. Challenge existing solutions and continuously look for ways to improve our products. Contribute to our design practices, tools, and design system. You'll have plenty of freedom to explore different approaches, experiment with new tools, and influence how we build products. Who we're looking for We're looking for a curious problem solver and design generalist who enjoys taking responsibility and turning ideas into reality. We think you'll thrive here if you: Have experience designing digital products and working closely with developers. Feel comfortable owning the full design process, from user research to polished interfaces. Have strong UX and UI skills and know when to focus on the details and when to keep things simple. Are confident using Figma and curious about exploring new tools, technologies, and AI. Enjoy understanding why something is a problem before jumping into solutions. Can make decisions independently, even when you don't have all the answers. Thrive in a small team where everyone contributes beyond their job description. Communicate confidently in both Swedish and English. Bonus points: You've built something cool on your own, experimented with AI or coding tools, or have a side project you're proud of. We'd love to see it! We're more interested in how you think, solve problems, and get things done than in a specific number of years of experience or a particular educational background. Why HomeQ? Real impact: Work on products used by over a million people, helping them with something as important as finding a home. Ownership from day one: Take responsibility for your work and see your ideas become real features. Small teams, big opportunities: Work closely with talented colleagues, with short decision-making paths and room to influence. Freedom to experiment: Explore new approaches, tools, and technologies to find better solutions. The best of both worlds: Enjoy the entrepreneurial energy of a scale-up with the backing of Vend. A word from our CPO, Felix Hey! I'm Felix, and I'll personally be looking at every application. I care much more about how you think and what you've created than about a perfectly polished CV or cover letter. So, if you want to catch my attention, make sure that: Your portfolio is easy to find. Show me what you've worked on and, ideally, how you approached the problems you were solving. You include three bullet points explaining why you're a great fit for HomeQ. That's it! We can talk about your experience and everything else later. Ready to help shape the future of renting? We'd love to hear from you!

items.desc: Company Description Arηs Group, Part of Accenture, specializes in the management of complex public sector IT projects, including systems integration, informatics and analytics, solution implementation and program management. Our team helps lead clients through digital and information systems design, bringing expertise in a variety of areas ranging from software development, data science and security management to machine learning, cloud, and mobile development. Arηs Group was acquired by Accenture in July 2024. Knowledge transfer and support Knowledge transfer client's report writers and key users on report usage and on building simple reports. Produce user guides and a report catalogue. Provide hypercare support after Go-Live and hand over to the support organization. Build reports used as data sources for integrations (e.g. RaaS / Workday web services) in coordination with the integration team. Configure report sharing, scheduling, bursting and output formats. Apply Workday domain and business process security correctly, ensuring users see only the data they are authorised to see. Optimise report performance and resolve defects.

items.desc: We are looking for a Technical Analyst to serve as a subject matter expert for an Open Banking platform in Zurich, Switzerland in a hybrid working mode. Our experience in the design of electric heaters for use in hazardous area locations is second to none. Our complete range of custom-engineered process and immersion heaters, together with our standard product portfolio which incorporates immersion heaters, room heaters and thermostats have extensive IECEx, ATEX and CSA certification. We are seeking a motivated Research & Development Engineer to join our progressive team and help develop innovative products for global markets. You will support product design, prototype assembly, testing, data analysis and technical documentation. As you develop, you will manage projects from concept to production, contributing to new product launches and improvements to existing ranges while meeting performance and certification requirements. Assemble prototypes and conduct product testing and analysis. Collect, analyse and document technical data and findings. Collaborate with engineering and other departments. Manage your workload, deadlines and project communications. Take projects from concept through to production. Review existing products and identify improvement opportunities. Develop designs that meet specifications and certification requirements. Support product and manufacturing improvements. Prepare technical documents, build guides, datasheets and user guides. As the world’s biggest medical research charity, we’ve helped bring eleven new cancer drugs to market. However, there is still an urgent need to bring more effective treatments to patients faster. Cancer Research Horizons (CRH) is CRUK’s internal translation engine. CRUK’s established drug discovery teams operate under one organisation and leadership team. Our unique combination of cancer biology expertise and access to CRUK’s world-class academic network, coupled with cutting edge technology platforms and clinical expertise enables us to 1) bring new treatments to patients faster and 2) tackle the biggest challenges in discovering cancer drugs by seeking out more radical ideas and embracing risk in our bid to achieve success. The Mechanistic Pharmacology team plays a vital role in advancing new cancer medicines, generating the data and insights that guide key drug discovery decisions. Whether you're passionate about building highly scalable and reliable systems in the cloud or a software developer who likes to solve interesting and complex business problems, Amazon Security has the challenges you are looking for. Amazon Security is responsible for the protection of customer and corporate data. We are connected to all parts of Amazon's business and its massive, worldwide service-oriented architecture. We are looking for a Software Development Engineers who are excited about leading the technical vision and architecture for innovative, mission critical software security systems that affect how Amazon developers create and deploy software that is secure and protects Amazon's and our customers data. Key job responsibilities You will work with the leadership team to drive key engineering and business decisions that will influence the Amazon developer experience. Your first mission is to build a new product that leverages application meta data from a variety of sources to synthesize in a human readable way a variety of application knowledge. This will require rapid iteration with a variety of software and security teams. Since our security systems are foundational to the Amazon ecosystem, you will also have the opportunity to learn about various Amazon business including the Amazon e-Commerce websites, Prime, Alexa, and AWS. We're looking for a creative, customer- and details-obsessed Software Development Engineer with strong software engineering fundamentals (object-oriented design, algorithms and data structures) and a good grasp of advanced systems concepts and design. You must possess strong verbal and written communication skills, be self-driven and be able to deliver high quality results in a fast-paced environment. You need to enjoy working closely with your peers of very talented engineers. A day in the life You'll solve complex challenges by designing and implementing scalable solutions that protect Amazon's customers and systems. You'll work with security engineering teams to transform domain expertise into software that mitigates risks at unprecedented scale. In a typical day, you might: Develop code that reduces manual security processes by 50% or more, enabling our teams to respond faster and more effectively Partner with cross-functional teams to translate intricate security requirements into elegant, high-performance software solutions Prototype and implement security tools that protect millions of customers and billions in transactions You'll work in an environment that values rapid innovation, where your ideas can move from concept to production in weeks, not months. Your work directly impacts Amazon's ability to maintain the highest standards of customer trust and system resilience. About the team This team will work with local and international security teams to design a greenfield product that solves the complex problem of rapidly knowing critical security details about every Amazon application. This team of problem solvers is heavily customer obsessed with a leaning toward rapid prototyping and implementation. Diverse Experiences Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why Amazon Security At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve. Inclusive Team Culture In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices. items.desc: The Application Support Administrator will play a key role in supporting the Trust’s evolving digital clinical environment, with particular responsibility for the Electronic Patient Record (EPR) and the clinical and administrative applications that support patient care. The role will provide day to day application support, administration and configuration, developing detailed technical and functional knowledge of the EPR, PAS, T-Pro and other integrated digital systems. The post holder will support incident resolution, system changes, testing, upgrades and optimisation to ensure applications operate reliably and effectively for end users. Working closely with the wider digital, clinical and operational teams, the post holder will help resolve application related issues and ensure staff are able to use digital systems effectively and efficiently. The role will also support the introduction of new applications, functionality and digital workflows as the Trust's EPR and wider digital services continue to evolve. The post holder will contribute to the ongoing optimisation and continuous improvement of the EPR and associated applications, ensuring systems are appropriately configured, supported and maintained throughout their lifecycle. Provide first and second-line application support, ensuring incidents and service requests are investigated and resolved promptly and to an appropriate standard. Log and manage complex user support requests within the ITSM system, ensuring accurate and detailed information is captured to support effective resolution. Provide specialist application support for the Trust’s Electronic Patient Record (EPR, Patient Administration System (PAS), T‑Pro and other associated clinical and administrative applications. Develop and maintain detailed technical, functional and system-specific knowledge to support the safe, reliable and effective use of these applications. Understand clinical and administrative processes and patient pathways, identifying where information is entered, required, exchanged, ordered, reported, validated, audited and stored. Work with clinical and operational teams to identify system-related bottlenecks and opportunities to improve existing models of care, clinical pathways and administrative processes. Undertake the day-to-day administration, configuration, maintenance and optimisation of supported applications, ensuring systems remain available, appropriately configured and fit for purpose. Maintain the integrity, quality and accuracy of information held within the EPR, PAS, T‑Pro and associated systems, taking appropriate action where recurring data-quality issues are identified. The Royal Orthopaedic Hospital NHS Foundation Trust is one of the largest specialist orthopaedic units in Europe. We offer planned orthopaedic surgery to people locally, nationally and internationally. Our Trust is a very special hospital; big enough to deliver world class services and small enough to offer exceptional patient and staff experience. We offer a working experience unique in the West Midlands and we're always on the lookout for passionate people to join our award-winning team. The ROH is an equal opportunities employer. We employ people of difference and are committed to growing an inclusive culture, where difference is celebrated, and people feel able to bring their whole and authentic self to work. We are a Disability Confident Leader and offer a range of inclusive, family friendly and flexible working arrangements and policies, to support our people in the workplace. Flexible working requests will be considered. The Trust is committed to the Disability Confident Interview Scheme and will offer an interview to disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria for a vacancy and consider them on their abilities. items.desc: We are looking to recruit an enthusiastic and self-motivated Occupational Therapy Assistant to work as part of the Tamarind Centre occupational Therapy Department . Tamarind Centre is a male medium secure service providing care for service users with challenging behaviours and a range of clinical presentations. You would be working with the Occupational Therapy team to deliver one to one interventions as well as in group work and will require practical and creative skills in order to promote independence and to improve overall emotional wellbeing. Therapeutic interventions are supported by a well-equipped environment which includes a gym, kitchen, education suite, art room, gardens, woodwork shop, library, and group rooms. We have our own forensic community OT team and partnerships that support transitions out into the community. Please note that there are two full time positions available. There is an expectation that one of the roles will include dedicated hours of the week to be specifically for the hospital shop where our service users access the shop. The successful applicant who will take the hospital shop responsibility will be expected to work on the days that the hospital shop opens. Overall we are looking for a motivated and confident member of staff who wants to work within a recovery and person centred model. Welcome to Birmingham and Solihull Mental Health NHS Foundation Trust. Education, training, work experience and volunteering should address identified barriers and provide purposeful steps towards paid work. items.desc: An exciting opportunity has arisen for an enthusiastic and highly organised Project Co-ordinator to support the delivery of a nationally significant workforce development programme for the Bowel Cancer Screening Programme (BCSP). This 12-month fixed-term role will coordinate the BCSP Accreditation and Mentorship Programme at a national level, supporting work across England rather than within a single region. The programme aims to increase the number of accredited BCSP endoscopists and help services prepare for the anticipated rise in demand associated with FIT80 implementation and the expansion of bowel cancer screening . Based within the North West Endoscopy Academy, the successful candidate will work as part of the Academy team while collaborating with multidisciplinary colleagues across England. This will include clinical leads, mentors, Higher Education Institution partners, NHS England colleagues, screening centres and representatives from Endoscopy Training Academies in other regions. Acting as the central point of coordination, the postholder will support delivery to agreed timescales, monitor progress against key milestones and provide high-quality project management support to this complex national initiative. The role offers a valuable opportunity to build relationships across regions and professions while contributing to a programme with national impact. The post holder will lead the day-to-day coordination of the project and will be responsible for: Maintaining project plans and ensuring delivery milestones are met. Coordinating trainee recruitment, onboarding and engagement activities. Collecting, monitoring and analysing programme data. Producing regular reports, dashboards and performance updates for governance groups. Supporting programme evaluation and the collection of outcome measures. Organising meetings, webinars, workshops and stakeholder events. Maintaining risk, issue and action logs and supporting mitigation plans. Developing effective working relationships with regional and national stakeholders. Liaising with trainees, mentors, Academy Leads, NHS England, higher education partners and screening centres. Supporting communication and engagement activities across all participating academies. Ensuring accurate documentation and audit trails are maintained throughout the project lifecycle. NHS University Hospitals of Liverpool Group (UHL Group) was formed on 1 November 2024, born from a shared aim to improve the care we provide our communities. We are one of the largest employers in region, with over 18,900 colleagues who are dedicated to caring for our communities - from birth and beyond. For the 630,000 people across Merseyside, we are their local NHS. We provide general and emergency hospital care, alongside highly specialised regional services that extend to more than two million people in the North West. We operate from five hospital sites: Aintree University Hospital is the single receiving site for adult major trauma patients in Cheshire and Merseyside, and hosts a number of regional services including an award-winning stroke facility. Broadgreen Hospital is home to several elective surgical, diagnostic and treatment services, together with specialist patient rehabilitation. Liverpool Heart and Chest Hospital provide specialist services in cardiothoracic surgery, cardiology and respiratory medicine, both in the hospital and out in the community. Liverpool Women’s Hospital specialises in the health of women and babies, delivering over 7,200 babies in the UK’s largest single site maternity hospital each year. The Royal Liverpool University Hospital is the largest hospital in the country to provide inpatients with 100% single en-suite bedrooms and mainly focuses on complex planned care and specialist services. The post holder will support: Onboarding and tracking of over 100 trainees nationally. Delivery of programme governance and reporting requirements. Data collection and evaluation activities. Stakeholder engagement across seven Endoscopy Training Academies. Delivery of project milestones within agreed timescales and budget. Development of a sustainable national model for BCSP screener development.

items.desc: Job Overview: Young People's Work Coach, Chawleigh. Devon EX18 7EX About Ambe r The Amber Foundation provides supported accommodation and a structured programme for homeless, unemployed and disadvantaged young people aged 18 to 30. Residents may experience multiple disadvantage, including homelessness, unemployment, substance misuse, mental health difficulties and offending histories. Our residential centres provide 24-hour support alongside a full-time programme covering employability, independent living, health and wellbeing, and personal development. We help young people build the skills, confidence and resilience needed to move into paid employment and safe, sustainable accommodat ion Responsible to - Senior Team Leader and Service Manager Hours of Work - Monday to Friday, 9.00am to 5.30pm + one overnight shift per month + on-call responsibility (1/5 weeks) (included in the salary) Job Types: Full-time, Fixed Term Contract for up to 18 months Salary: £30,283.47 per annum . Purpose of the role The Young People’s Work Coach leads a team of residents through Amber’s programme, taking responsibility for purposeful support and measurable progress towards paid employment and independent living. A central responsibility is to proactively engage employers and create paid employment opportunities for young people who may struggle to access standard recruitment processes. The Work Coach builds relationships with recruitment decision makers, understands employers’ needs, promotes residents’ potential and agrees practical routes into interviews, job offers and employment. The role requires initiative, persistence and confident employer engagement alongside compassionate support, positive challenge and clear professional boundaries. Education, training, work experience and volunteering should address identified barriers and provide purposeful steps towards paid work. Success is assessed through opportunities created and young people securing and sustaining suitable employment alongside stable accommodation. Key responsibilities -Creating employment opportunities with employers · Proactively identify, approach and visit local and regional employers, developing relationships with owners, managers and recruitment decision makers who can offer paid work. · Understand employers’ staffing needs, skills requirements and recruitment barriers, and identify how residents’ strengths, interests and potential can meet those needs. · Confidently promote Amber and its young people, challenge stereotypes constructively and persuade employers to consider residents who may otherwise be overlooked. · Work with employers to create routes into entry-level jobs, apprenticeships and other suitable paid roles, including supported interviews and adjustments to recruitment processes where appropriate. · Seek concrete commitments from employer engagement, including interviews, suitable vacancies and recruitment opportunities, and follow these through to job offers and starts. · Develop safe, structured work experience with employers, agreeing its purpose, supervision, feedback and potential route towards paid employment. · Agree practical preparation, workplace support and reasonable adjustments with employers and residents, sharing personal information only as appropriate and in line with Amber’s procedures. · Maintain an organised record of employer contacts, recruitment needs, opportunities, agreed actions and follow-up, coordinating with colleagues to make opportunities available to suitable residents. · Respond promptly to employer concerns and maintain contact after a resident starts work to support successful and sustained employment. · Review which employer relationships are producing opportunities and jobs, adapt unsuccessful approaches and continue developing new partnerships. Securing and sustaining paid employment · Make paid employment a central intended outcome of each resident’s stay, establishing aspirations, strengths, experience, qualifications and barriers from induction. · Agree an ambitious, realistic employment pathway with each resident, with clear actions, responsibilities and review dates in their support and action plan. · Actively identify suitable vacancies and opportunities, match residents to employers and help secure interviews and paid work. · Provide practical support with job searches, applications, CVs, cover letters, interview preparation, workplace expectations, travel and starting work. · Motivate and positively challenge residents to complete agreed actions, address disengagement promptly and adapt support to individual needs. · Arrange relevant education, vocational training, work experience and volunteering where these build skills, confidence, routine and references needed for paid work. · Build links with colleges, training providers, Jobcentre Plus, DWP partnership teams, local authorities and employment services to maximise access to appropriate support and schemes. · Support attendance at …

items.desc: This role is offered on a permanent basis. Working as an Employment Specialist for IPS Employment Services, for people with a serious and enduring mental health difficulties in Gloucester. Are you looking for a career where you can make a positive difference to the lives of people with Mental Health Difficulties? Do you believe you have the skills to support people back into employment? Are you passionate that occupation can support a person's wellbeing? If so these roles may be just what you're looking for! For people who need Mental Health support, getting back into work is a vital step on their recovery journey. The evidence backs this up and although 90% of people with Severe Mental Illness want to work, only 8% of them are in paid employment. This is why we are looking for people to join our friendly Individual Placement and Support (IPS) Service, as an Employment Specialist. This is an incredibly rewarding role - you will have the opportunity to transform the lives of your clients, to give them hope, direction and support their recovery journey. This is also a challenging role, so you’ll need to be resilient, empathetic and dedicated to finding clients employment that is right for them. As a people person, you will build a good rapport with your clients, gaining a real understanding of their key skills, their aspirations and their career goals. You will also spend time building productive relationships with employers, in order to identify and negotiate job opportunities in the hidden labour market. We welcome people from a range of backgrounds and with a variety of experience for this role. We will train you on the Individual Placement & Support (IPS) approach, giving you the tools you need to provide expert support and advice to clients, while also building positive relationships with employers and changing perceptions around mental health. The qualification, training & experience requirements for the role are underlined in the Job Description/Person Specification. We have a skilled and dedicated workforce of over 5000 colleagues working in a diverse range of services over 55 sites and within people’s homes. We strive to enable a welcoming workplace culture that builds and celebrates civility, inclusivity and diversity, while providing a sense of belonging and trust. Annual staff surveys, regular Pulse surveys and other engagement opportunities provide our people with lots of opportunity to tell us about their experiences of working with us. In the latest staff survey, 61% of colleagues gave us their views. It was great to hear that: 72% of colleagues would recommend the Trust as a place to work, ranking us 1st for Provider Trusts in the South West region on this question. 76% would recommend the standard of care provided in our services if a friend or relative needed treatment, also ranking us 1st in the South West region. 81% said that care of patients and service users is the Trust’s priority, compared with an average in comparable NHS Trusts in England of 64% This high-level overview shows we are in a healthy position, with higher scores than average for comparable organisations, alongside a great response rate, indicating good staff engagement. However, we also know we have plenty of room for improvement in many areas. To that end, we continue to prioritise and invest in our commitment to genuinely becoming a Great Place to Work with consistent top-quartile performance in the annual staff survey and Pulse surveys. You will be required to: Proactively manage a caseload of people, who have experienced Mental Health Difficulties, to either find and maintain paid employment, or to retain existing employment. Follow the IPS model, collate evidence and participate in Fidelity Reviews. Identify and meet the employment goals of clients by providing individually tailored programmes, using a person-centred approach. Work within a multi-disciplinary environment and liaise closely with a variety of stakeholders i.e. Department of Work and Pensions (DWP) and Citizen Advise Work proactively at Employer Engagement and research the labour market and spend time getting to know local employers, in order to negotiate job opportunities. Support Service Users and employers to identify reasonable adjustments and return to work strategies, to ensure job retention. Act independently, using own judgement, knowledge and initiative. The purpose of personalised care is to empower people to lead the lives they want to live. Personalised care starts with a conversation with people about what matters to them. It builds on what people can do, as well as addressing their health needs. items.desc: Lancashire & South Cumbria NHS Foundation Trust is on an exciting journey towards becoming a University Trust, strengthening our partnerships with leading academic institutions and expanding our research capability. Our Research & Development department plays a key role in achieving this ambition - driving innovation, collaboration and excellence across mental health research. We are looking for a Research Assistant to join the Mental Health Research Group (MHRG), a five year NIHR funded initiative based at Lancaster University. The MHRG is focused on tackling complex mental health needs among under served and excluded communities, co designing creative and inclusive solutions that improve access to care and reduce inequalities. The post holder will work within MHRG Research Theme 1, which focuses on co occurring mental health and drug or alcohol problems among people experiencing multiple disadvantages, such as substance use disorders, criminal justice involvement and other complex social challenges. These groups often face significant barriers to accessing mainstream services and are frequently excluded from traditional models of care. The research aims to understand their lived experiences, the difficulties they encounter when seeking support, and the opportunities for co designing more inclusive and effective mental health pathways. items.desc: Salary: 68000 - 87500 GBP Annual London Company Description Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money. Min fees. Max ease. Job Description We are looking for a Backend Software Engineer to join the Treasury Ledger team. Every time money moves at Wise, Treasury needs to know where it is and in which currency. Our team builds the ledger that answers that question: a real-time, accurate view of Wise's FX position and liquidity. This is high-volume, event-driven infrastructure where correctness matters. Your work directly supports how Treasury manages Wise's money, and the evolution of the ledger as the business grows. What will you be working on? Build new specialised ledgers that track Wise's FX risk and liquidity in real time, using modern stream-processing technology. Design real-time reconciliation and data-quality controls that catch discrepancies as they happen, not days later. Bring new Wise products into the ledger as they launch around the world, giving Treasury a complete picture of money moving across products and currencies.
