items.desc: Who are Eque2? Eque2 provides specialist software for the construction and housebuilding sectors, helping businesses manage everything from estimating and financial management to commercial operations and project delivery. We work with leading platforms including Microsoft, Sage and Xero, helping construction businesses improve visibility, stay in control and manage their operations more effectively. Today, we support over 3,000 construction businesses across the UK and Ireland, from growing contractors to large, complex organisations. Role Purpose To own and prioritise the delivery backlog for Eque2’s cloud estimating and cost-control product, translating product direction and validated customer needs into delivery-ready work. You will use AI-enabled development, design and product management tools to accelerate delivery and help build market-leading customer-facing Artificial Intelligence (AI) capabilities. About the Role We are seeking a Technical Product Owner to help shape the next generation of Eque2’s cloud estimating and cost-control software. Reporting to the Chalkstring Product Director, you will own backlog quality, prioritisation and day-to-day delivery decisions within the direction set by Product Management, defining clear requirements and testable acceptance criteria for Engineering and QA. You will partner with Product Management, Product Design, Engineering and QA from discovery and rapid prototyping through to customer delivery and validation. You will use AI-enabled product, design and development tools to accelerate this process and play a central role in expanding Chalkstring with capabilities from our established EValuate product. You will engage directly with customers to understand their processes, validate use cases, explore emerging AI opportunities and support acceptance testing, using customer and delivery evidence to inform product decisions. Location: This is a UK-based hybrid role, with office access in Maidenhead and Newcastle-upon-Tyne. Travel is required for team, customer and stakeholder meetings, with office attendance expected 1–2 days per week. Is this role right for you? This is a hands-on product delivery role rather than a Product Management position. You will have authority over the delivery backlog, priorities and day-to-day delivery decisions within the direction set by Product Management. Product Management retains ownership of overall product strategy, roadmap direction, pricing and market positioning. This role will suit someone who enjoys being close to customers, Engineering and delivery, and who can turn broad product direction and complex customer needs into well-defined work that teams can confidently build and test. Key Responsibilities Own and prioritise the delivery backlog within Product Management’s agreed direction, making trade-offs, dependencies and delivery decisions visible. Turn validated customer needs into delivery-ready epics, stories, workflows and acceptance criteria that Engineering and QA can implement and test without repeated clarification. Lead refinement and contribute actively to sprint planning and reviews, resolving ambiguity quickly and accepting completed work against agreed criteria. Engage directly with construction customers to understand estimating and cost-control workflows, validate use cases and edge cases, and support user acceptance and adoption. Use AI-enabled development, design and product management tools to accelerate research, requirements, prototyping and delivery while maintaining appropriate review, security and data controls. Identify and validate valuable customer-facing AI opportunities, defining quality thresholds, safeguards, human oversight and evaluation requirements for probabilistic features. Work closely with Product Design, Engineering and QA on workflows, data models, integrations, APIs, technical constraints and testability. Measure adoption, quality and customer outcomes; use evidence to guide iteration, priorities and recommendations to Product Management. Communicate progress, decisions, risks and dependencies clearly, and keep product documentation, release notes, Support and Customer Success briefings current. Knowledge, Skills & Experience Demonstrable experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst or in a closely related B2B SaaS delivery role. Practical experience owning and prioritising backlogs within an Agile delivery environment. A strong track record of translating customer and operational needs into clear user stories, requirements and testable acceptance criteria. Strong process, workflow and data analysis skills. Enough technical understanding to discuss APIs, integrations, data and dependencies confidently with Engineering teams. Hands-on experience using AI tools in areas such as product discovery, analysis, design, requirements or prototyping. An understanding of the quality, risk and human-oversight considerations associated with customer-facing AI. Confidence engaging directly …

items.desc: Great journeys start with great people Here at LNER, we're shaping the future of rail on one of the UK's most iconic routes. From our high-speed Azuma fleet, redefining long-distance travel, to our next generation of trains, Serenza, this is a moment of real transformation for LNER. We're investing in cutting-edge technology, sustainability, and most importantly our people, to deliver outstanding experiences for our customers. There has never been a more exciting time to grow your career with LNER! THIS VACANCY IS FOR OUR TALENT POOLS FOR KINGS CROSS Starting Salary £25,214 plus an attendance allowance of £3818 for FT hours. Pro rata for Part Time. So what is a Future Talent Pool: We're always looking for talented people to join us at LNER. To help make our recruitment process more efficient, we sometimes recruit in advance to build our talent pools. This means that when a suitable role becomes available, we can reach out to candidates straight away rather than restarting the entire recruitment process each time. We are looking for people interested in either FT or PT. Our standard working hours cover a 7 day working week, with early starts, late finishes and weekend working. Part time contracts do tend to be weekend working only. Do bear this in mind when applying as we need to you to be able to get to and from our stations to commence your shift. So, what exactly does a Customer Experience Host do? By joining LNER as a Customer Experience Host you could be serving early morning coffees to our business commuters, handing out sweet treats for families on day trips or even be found rustling up bacon sandwiches for football fans travelling to support their teams. No matter the journey, you'll be on hand to provide an exceptional and personalised experience. You'll have the opportunity to bring a smile to our customers' faces through creating a welcoming on board atmosphere, assisting with luggage, as well as ensuring our customers leave with a positive memory of their journey with us. For our customers travelling in standard class, you'll offer a service from either the cafe bar or deliver a personal at seat service for customers using our 'Lets eat at your seat' app, while taking responsibility for both cash and stock management. Within First Class you'll serve customers our complimentary food and beverage offering, delivered to the highest standards. As a Customer Experience Host you'll also develop a good understanding of health and safety and be trained to ensure a safe, clean and tidy environment onboard our trains at all times. Think you can manage all of this while travelling at 125mph? Then this is the job for you! What you'll need To make it as a Customer Experience Host you'll need: Plenty of customer service experience and strong interpersonal skills A good track record of providing customers with a personalised and memorable service as well as a genuine passion for helping customers The ability to communicate effectively through the toughest of situations and relish stepping up to the challenge of disruption You'll have proven soft sales skills and experience of product management. You'll also enjoy developing your knowledge around our on board offering to share with both customers and colleagues As you will be serving and selling alcohol, you will need to be aged 18 or over to apply Finally, you'll need to be flexible. Our Customer Experience Hosts are on hand to assist our customers early in the morning, late in the evening and over weekends, so you'll need to be able to fully commit to working shifts. As we receive a large number of applications, we're only able to offer personalised feedback once candidates reach the face‑to‑face interview stage. You'll enjoy Free travel on LNER, plus 75% off other companies' tickets (for you and your dependants). Discounted international train tickets (after one year's service). 50% discount on LNER tickets for friends and family. Generous pension scheme. Annual cycle to work schemes/electric vehicle scheme. Discount, savings and cashback scheme from top retailers. Health and wellbeing schemes and discounts. A host of training opportunities to help further your career. Rewards and awards to recognise when you shine. Life at LNER We're on a mission to become the UK's most loved, forward-thinking, and responsible train operating company in the UK. This means making a real difference by doing the right thing for our customers, our people, and the communities and destinations we serve. Together, we're shaping the future of rail travel through our passion, our innovation, and our extraordinary people. Our people are at the heart of everything we do. We're committed to creating an inclusive and engaged culture that supports everyone at every stage of their journey. This means that when you're with LNER, you can truly be yourself—and it's why so many of our colleagues choose to stay and grow with us. items.desc: Position Overview Are you passionate about helping organisations identify, manage and mitigate risk while strengthening resilience and supporting sustainable growth? Join Crux and play a key role in developing and embedding risk management and assurance practices across our global business. Reporting directly to the Head of Quality, Regulatory, Risk & Assurance (QRRA), you will work closely with business leaders across the organisation to lead risk management and assurance activities across all aspects of Crux's global operations. Working with stakeholders across the business, you will proactively identify and assess risks, coordinate assurance activities, monitor emerging risks and support the implementation of effective controls to ensure the business continues to operate safely, compliantly and efficiently. At Crux, we believe curiosity drives innovation. As a specialist consultancy supporting world-leading medical device and consumer product organisations, we combine technical excellence with a collaborative culture to deliver innovative solutions that improve lives. We are looking for an experienced professional who can help ensure our risk, assurance and governance practices evolve alongside our growing international business, enabling informed decision-making and supporting long-term business resilience. Why Crux? Work with top pharma clients on cutting-edge medical device projects. Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team across our Bristol (UK) and Boston (US) offices. Travel opportunities to support global project delivery Influence the development of life-changing healthcare technologies Be part of a consultancy that values curiosity, integrity, and collaboration Principal Responsibilities Own and develop the business risk and assurance framework across the organisation, ensuring governance, risk and assurance activities are aligned and consistently applied. Maintain and facilitate the company risk management process, working closely with business leaders across the organisation to ensure significant risks are identified, assessed, assigned, appropriately owned and periodically reviewed. Monitor emerging regulatory, technology, governance and operational risks, providing horizon-scanning insights to support proactive decision making. Support governance activities relating to clinical and pre-clinical research, research ethics, patient safety and adverse event management. Establish and oversee governance processes relating to confidentiality, intellectual property, conflicts of interest and sensitive client information. Coordinate assurance activities relating to insurance, liability exposure, international expansion and overseas operations, ensuring appropriate specialist input and risk ownership is established. Prepare risk and assurance reporting for leadership teams, highlighting key trends, emerging risks and areas requiring management attention. Coordinate internal assurance reviews and track the implementation of resulting corrective and improvement actions. Apply the Plan > Do > Check > Act methodology to governance and assurance programmes. Act as project manager for risk management and assurance initiatives, ensuring actions are effectively implemented and monitored. Oversee existing processes including change management, risk and opportunity registers, business policies, and client requests for information (RFIs). Act as Firewall Owner for projects subject to Independent Development controls, including oversight of conflict-of-interest assessments, maintenance of Firewall Registers, project onboarding activities and monitoring of firewall compliance. Maintain oversight of key business policies and controls, ensuring periodic review and organisational compliance. What We’re Looking For Essential Degree or equivalent experience in a relevant discipline such as quality, governance, risk, compliance, science, engineering or business management. Experience in governance, assurance, risk management or compliance activities, including business and operational risk identification and management. Experience delivering assurance activities, driving organisational improvement and preparing risk, assurance or compliance reporting for leadership teams. Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders in a regulated environment. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Desirable Experience developing or implementing governance, assurance or risk-management frameworks. Knowledge of research governance, data protection, AI governance or business compliance activities. Experience using Power Automate, Power BI or similar tools to automate workflows and develop risk/compliance reporting. Demonstrated awareness and practical experience applying AI tools and workflows to streamline review and reporting activities. Experience managing projects and coordinating cross-functional initiatives. Experience supporting international operations and cross-border business activities. Internal …

items.desc: Join the University of Salford as Project Archivist and play a leading role in unlocking one of our largest and most used archive collections. Funded by Archives Revealed, this exciting project will make 90 metres of the Bridgewater Estates Archive accessible, combining traditional archival expertise with innovative AI-assisted technology to create an online catalogue. We are looking for a proactive and collaborative archivist with experience in cataloguing, archives management and engagement. Working closely with academic colleagues, you will create the online searchable catalogue for the collection, while ensuring high standards of archival description and access. You will also work with researchers, students, community partners and creative practitioners to transform access to local history while developing engagement activities that support research, teaching and public engagement. Key Responsibilities Lead the cataloguing of the Bridgewater Estates Archive, applying ISAD(G) standards, collaborating with academic colleagues to develop an online catalogue, and quality assuring AI-generated metadata to enhance discovery and access. Apply professional archives and collections care expertise, assessing preservation needs and implementing appropriate rehousing and repackaging solutions. Develop and deliver public engagement activities, including a website, talks and learning resources that connect diverse audiences with the collection. Collaborate with academics, researchers, community partners, students and creative practitioners to support workshops that reinterpret the collection in new ways Manage project delivery and reporting, demonstrating strong organisational skills, initiative and the ability to work independently while contributing to a team environment. About the Department Archives and Special Collections is part of the Library, Careers & Skills at the University of Salford and plays a vital role in supporting teaching, learning, research and public engagement through access to unique primary source collections. Our archives document the histories of communities, organisations and individuals, creating opportunities for discovery, creativity and new research. As part of the Content Team, we are committed to making collections accessible, discoverable and impactful through innovative approaches to cataloguing, preservation, digitisation and engagement. We work closely with students, academics, researchers and community partners to unlock the potential of our collections and bring the stories they contain to new and diverse audiences. What's in it for you? Our community - there's a real sense of belonging here at Salford. We value diversity, in backgrounds and in experiences. Our difference makes us stronger, and together we share a passion for improving students' lives The Perks! MySalford, our online employee portal offers a wide range of lifestyle benefits and discounts. You can also access onsite sports and fitness facilities including discounted gym memberships Greater Manchester - live and work in one of the most vibrant regions in the UK Our Peel Park campus is unique with lots of green spaces and great transport links including Salford Crescent train station means we're easy to get to A rewarding career opportunity - where everything you do will make a difference. To our students, our local community, and the world around you Please note this opportunity may close early depending on applicant volume.

 Ako imate iskustvo u radu s klijentima i želite razvijati svoju karijeru u korporativnom bankarstvu, prijavite se! 
 Što ćete raditi
 • Biti prvi izbor klijenata: Vodite portfelj korporativnih klijenata, gradite dugoročne odnose temeljene na povjerenju i stručnosti 
 • Upravljati rizicima i osigurati usklađenost: Osiguravate da transakcije budu u skladu s propisima i internim politikama, uz odgovorno upravljanje rizicima 
 • Osvojiti nove klijente: Gradite mrežu kontakata, sudjelujete na poslovnim događanjima i koristite strateške pristupe za privlačenje novih klijenata 
 • Otkrivati prilike prije drugih: Pratite tržište, prepoznajete poslovne mogućnosti i inicirate projekte koji potiču rast

 Što će vam trebati da biste uspjeli
 • Iskustvo koje čini razliku: Minimalno 3 godina rada s klijentima pravnim osobama, uz dokazanu sposobnost izgradnje dugoročnih poslovnih odnosa. Vaše iskustvo u korporativnom bankarstvu i upravljanju odnosima s klijentima bit će presudno za uspjeh u ovoj ulozi 
 • Akademska osnova: Visoka stručna sprema (VSS) / diplomski studij iz ekonomije ili srodnog područja pružit će vam čvrstu podlogu za analitički pristup i strateško donošenje odluka 
 • Jezici: Izvrsno poznavanje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu; poželjno znanje njemačkog ili talijanskog jezika kao dodatna prednost 
 • Digitalne vještine: Sposobnost korištenja digitalnih alata i platformi za učinkovitu komunikaciju, prezentaciju i suradnju, uz napredno poznavanje MS Office paketa (Excel, PowerPoint) 
 Što ćete dobiti zauzvrat

 • Networking: Upoznat ćeš stručnjake iz različitih dijelova Banke kroz projekte i međunarodne inicijative 
 • Briga o zdravlju: Redoviti sistematski pregledi, dopunsko i dodatno zdravstveno osiguranje

 Nell’ambito del piano UniCredit Unlocked, che ha l’obiettivo di mettere al centro i nostri clienti in tutto ciò che facciamo, vogliamo rafforzare la nostra rete commerciale con consulenti solidi e competenti, che sappiano offrire servizi di qualità e soluzioni personalizzate, grazie al supporto di strutture dedicate alla ricerca e inserimento di professionisti. La struttura di Network Development si occupa di individuare ogni opportunità di crescita della Rete Wealth Management che del Private Banking attraverso anche l’analisi/scouting del mercato (ad es. consulenti finanziari abilitati all’offerta fuori sede con contratto di agenzia, dipendenti e/o figure con contratto misto) coordinando le connesse attività di value proposition del Gruppo e di relativa proposizione commerciale, nonchè contribuendo alla definizione dei relativi aspetti contrattuali e di commissioning.
 Cosa farai
 Le principali attività previste nel ruolo di Network Development Specialist sono le seguenti: 
 • Gestione del processo di reclutamento dei Consulenti Finanziari presidiandone, nel tempo, il rapporto contrattuale di concerto con le altre funzioni della Banca competenti nonché presidio del loro aggiornamento professionale, curandone le comunicazioni con gli enti interni ed esterni preposti; 
 • Coordinamento e controllo del processo di definizione, calcolo ed erogazione delle provvigioni agli Agenti; 
 • Predisposizione contrattualistica, sia in offerta che in ingresso, in collaborazione con le strutture di business; 
 • Presidio del rispetto dei requisiti regolamentari e delle disposizioni organizzative previste dal modello di servizio dedicato. 
 Cosa ti occorre
 I principali requisiti per il profilo richiesto sono: 
 o Almeno 2 anni di esperienza in posizione equivalente presso primarie banche o intermediari finanziari; 
 o Ottime capacità relazionali e negoziali 
 o Atteggiamento positivo, capacità di lavorare in team 
 Cosa ti offriamo
 Offriamo la possibilità di entrare in un gruppo bancario paneuropero, con un contratto a tempo indeterminato regolato da CCNL e un pacchetto retributivo competitivo, correlato alla tua reale esperienza. Potrai avvalerti di strumenti all'avanguardia e avrai l'opportunità di relazionarti con tutti i principali interlocutori dei business Private Banking e Wealth Management. 
 La nostra offerta di lavoro include anche: 
 o Salute e benessere: la tua salute e il tuo benessere sono importanti per noi. Ecco perché otterrai vantaggi come l'assicurazione sanitaria, un regime pensionistico completo e l'accesso scontato alle offerte di sport e benessere 
 o Equilibrio tra lavoro e vita privata: orari flessibili, periodi sabbatici e diritto a congedi straordinari (ad es. per gli eventi della vita più rilevanti) rendono possibile questo equilibrio 
 o Benefit e servizi agevolati: offriamo ai nostri dipendenti il nostro conto gratuito, ampie offerte assicurative e altri vantaggi di servizi bancari 
 o Ambiente dinamico: farai parte di un ambiente internazionale, collaborativo e di supporto in cui le persone contano. Un luogo dove le persone sanno di essere 
 apprezzate non solo per quello che fanno, ma soprattutto per quello che sono. 
 L’offerta finale sarà definita sulla base dell’esperienza, delle competenze e del livello di responsabilità della persona selezionata. Eventuali ulteriori elementi saranno valutati e considerati nella fase finale di definizione dell’offerta.

Er beinhaltet, allen Stakeholdern erstklassige Produkte und Services zu bieten und dadurch das Potenzial unserer Kund:innen und Mitarbeitenden in ganz Europa zur Entfaltung zu bringen.

 At evosoft – a trusted partner of Siemens – we don’t just write code, we create solutions that make life better. Our software powers Smart Industries, System Tests, IT Solutions, Digitalization and Medical Innovations, helping industries move forward and shaping the future of technology. 
 Our culture is defined by our values : you’ll join a team where innovative thinking, collaboration and continuous learning shape how we develop solutions that improve everyday life across industries. 
 If you’re looking for a place where your ideas matter and your work makes a real difference, this is the right opportunity for you. 
 You’ll make an impact by: 
 You will act as the Team Architect and Technical Leader of a cross-functional, multi-location Agile/Scrum team, aligning architectural designs within the Scaled Agile Framework environment (SAFe) 
 Drive the VIC Product Evolution: Define, design, and own the scalable platform architecture for the Visual Inspection Cockpit (VIC), Siemens' flagship Industrial AI edge product designed for high-speed, inline defect detection and metrology 
 Bridge AI and Computer Vision: Architect the integration of deep-learning-based semantic segmentation models with classic computer vision post-processing pipelines to ensure robust, real-time inspection 
 OT-IT & Edge Integration: Champion the technical solutions for deploying resource-efficient, GPU-accelerated workloads on Siemens Industrial Edge Devices, ensuring seamless closed-loop connectivity with PLCs and factory automation systems 
 Represent Technical Vision: Proactively collaborate with Product Owners and Portfolio Architects to translate complex business demands and emerging machine vision trends into production-ready software designs 
 Your success is grounded in: 
 At least 10 years of hands-on experience in software development 
 Proficiency in Python and C++ 
 Deep knowledge of Object-Oriented Design (OOD), Multithreaded/High-Throughput programming and complex, system-level software integration 
 Machine Vision & IP Integration 
 Solid theoretical and practical experience (ideally 8+ years of relevant experience) with traditional image processing techniques (OpenCV is a must) and deep learning-based object detection/segmentation 
 Hands-on experience integrating industrial cameras, lenses, customized illumination setups, and optical systems 
 Practical experience with Data Acquisition (DAQ) and interfacing vision applications with PLC systems via industrial protocols 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field 
 Proven track record of guiding engineering teams, defining software guidelines, and mentoring senior developers 
 You’ll stand out with: 
 Languages: Experience with Go 
 Deep Industry Experience: Proven track record of deploying complex machine vision products directly into production environments (e.g., CPG, Semiconductor, or Automotive lines) in a senior architect or tech lead role 
 High-Performance Architectures: Proven experience in designing real-time, low-latency architectures utilizing GPU-accelerated image processing (CUDA, TensorRT) 
 Edge & Cloud Technologies: Experience with Docker/containerization, Linux-based embedded OS, and Siemens Industrial Edge platform or Industrial AI Suite 
 Advanced Degrees: Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or Computer Vision 
 You’ll benefit from: 
 Cafeteria package 
 Private health care service provider 
 Hybrid working model (3 days/week home office on average) 
 Flexible working hours 
 Closed, guarded parking area

items.desc: We're starting a dedicated AI team to make our voice agents measurably better, and this is one of its first hires. You'll fine-tune models, build the tests that show what actually improved, dig through real call data, and turn new research into changes that ship. It's a hands-on Python role with plenty of room to shape what the team works on. 𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗖𝗵𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗶𝘁 Chaseit builds AI voice agents for loan servicing and collections. Our agents make tens of thousands of human-like calls every day for lenders across Europe and beyond. They handle everything from payment reminders to payment-plan negotiation, in 10+ languages, while staying compliant and genuinely empathetic. We're a VC-backed startup with live customers, real revenue, and a lean team where every person has outsized impact. 𝗪𝗵𝘆 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲 𝗲𝘅𝗶𝘀𝘁𝘀 Our agents already handle real conversations at scale. Making them meaningfully better from here takes more than prompt changes: models adapted to our domain, a rigorous way to measure every change, and someone keeping up with a field that moves every month. That's what the new AI team is for, and you'll be one of its first members. You'll work closely with our conversation design and deployment teams, who are closest to clients and live agents, and with the engineers who run our platform. What this team works on, and how, will be shaped a lot by its first people. 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝘄𝗶𝗹𝗹 𝗱𝗼 You'll work on the questions that decide how good our agents can get. Would a fine-tuned smaller model match our current setup at half the latency? Which of last month's changes actually improved payment-plan acceptance? Why do calls in one language escalate far more often than in others? You'll design the work to answer them, do it, and make sure the answer ships. You will: Fine-tune and adapt LLMs for our use cases: build training data from real calls, run supervised and preference tuning on open-weight models, and compare results against leading API models on quality, latency and cost Build our evaluation and testing setup: test sets, simulated callers, LLM-as-judge and human review, and regression checks that catch problems before a change goes live Analyse call data at scale: transcripts, outcomes and agent behaviour across clients and languages, to find where agents fail and which fixes are worth making Follow state-of-the-art research in LLMs, speech and agents, reproduce what looks promising, and turn it into experiments with clear answers Look beyond the LLM where it matters: turn-taking, interruptions, response latency, and how speech recognition errors ripple through a conversation Write a lot of Python: data pipelines, training and eval code, analysis, and tools the rest of the company can use Plan your own work: break vague goals like "sound more natural" into concrete experiments, estimate effort, and share findings so others can act on them 𝗪𝗵𝗼 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗮𝗿𝗲 Strong, hands-on Python. You write clean, tested code that others can run and build on, not only notebooks Practical LLM experience beyond calling an API: you've fine-tuned, trained or seriously evaluated models, and you know where that goes wrong Solid ML fundamentals: data splits and leakage, overfitting, choosing the right metric, and enough statistics to tell a real improvement from noise At home with data: SQL and pandas (or similar), and turning messy logs and transcripts into clear findings You read papers, can judge which ideas are worth trying, and can reproduce one from the paper and its code Independent and organised: you take an open-ended goal, plan the steps, and report progress without anyone chasing you Clear written English, because much of the job is explaining results and decisions to people who aren't ML specialists Typically a few years in ML or AI engineering or research, or a strong MSc/PhD with hands-on projects. What you've built matters more than titles 𝗡𝗶𝗰𝗲 𝘁𝗼 𝗵𝗮𝘃𝗲 Experience with voice AI: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, telephony, or real-time voice agent frameworks such as Pipecat or LiveKit Hands-on work with AI agents of any kind: tool use, multi-step workflows, frameworks such as LangGraph Fine-tuning and serving tools: Hugging Face Transformers and TRL, Unsloth or Axolotl, vLLM Industry-standard automation and analysis tools: orchestration such as Airflow, Prefect or n8n; experiment tracking such as Weights & Biases or MLflow; LLM observability such as Langfuse; BI tools such as Metabase Training and running models on AWS, including GPU jobs (our platform runs on AWS in Frankfurt) Multilingual NLP, especially European languages (our agents speak 10+) Publications, open-source contributions or competition results you can point to Familiarity with lending, collections, or another regulated industry 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂'𝗹𝗹 𝗴𝗲𝘁 Salary: €4500 - €7000 gross per month, or more in exceptional cases Equity: early team members get stock options, so you share in what we build One of the first seats on our AI team, with a real say in its direction, tools and …

items.desc: Company NestAI builds the adaptive operating system for modern battlefield operations. Most AI systems are built once, validated at deployment, and expected to stay sufficient after that. That assumption holds until conditions change, and in defence, they always do. Our team develops adaptive intelligence for unmanned and command systems: AI that continuously learns from operational data and adapts to changing conditions, deployed in environments where there is no internet, no GPS, and failure is not an option. NestOS, our open, modular, and interoperable platform, enables this at scale and keeps capability evolution under sovereign European control. Founded in 2025 by Peter Sarlin, whose previous company Silo AI became Europe's largest AI acquisition, NestAI has grown to over 200 engineers and scientists and partners with leading European defence forces and industry. We're ambitious about what we're building and honest with each other. The bar is high, and so are the standards we hold ourselves to. But this is also a place built on humility, trust, and looking after each other. If that sounds like the kind of work you want to do, keep reading. Role Description NestAI builds the software and intelligence layer for autonomous defense systems: technology deployed in live operational environments where "it worked in the demo" isn't good enough. We're looking for an AI Engineer (Forward Deployment Engineering) to sit at the center of that mission: embedded directly in customer environments, at the intersection of advanced machine learning and real-world execution. This is a high-agency role with no clean spec. You'll shorten the distance between prototype and fielded capability, validating our technology against operational reality, adapting it on the fly to the constraints and data of each deployment, and feeding what you learn back into the core product. Most of what you encounter here won't have a known answer yet; you'll work it out alongside a small, senior team that has full ownership of the problems in front of it, and a product organization that takes field feedback seriously enough to ship it back into the platform in days, not quarters. We're looking for strong AI/ML engineers with real breadth across machine learning, deep learning, decision-making, and increasingly LLM-driven or agentic workflows — people who can adapt to whatever a deployment demands. Solid grounding in signal processing, whether from classical methods or modern learned/deep approaches, is particularly valuable given the sensor-heavy, real-time nature of our operating environments, but we don't expect mastery of both AI and signal processing in one person. Day-to-Day Responsibilities: Working directly with customer teams to understand operational requirements, constraints, and failure modes, and translating those into concrete technical problems. Designing and implementing algorithms for sequential decision-making, autonomous behavior, or specialized application workflows — drawing on whichever combination of ML, LLMs, control, or signal processing the deployment calls for, often alongside teammates with complementary backgrounds. Adapting and fine-tuning models to perform reliably against real operational data, which is often noisier and more constrained than anything you've seen in the lab. Rapidly building and iterating on prototypes in the field or in customer development environments, then hardening the ones that prove out for production. Collaborating with our internal platform, embedded, and perception teams to bring field learnings back into NestOS and ensure deployed solutions are supportable long-term. Building lightweight simulations, test harnesses, or data pipelines on-site to validate algorithms before they scale. Adapting state-of-the-art research in deep learning, signal processing, reinforcement learning, or NLP/LLMs into working, production-ready code under real deployment pressure. Qualifications: Working knowledge of signal processing: either a strong background in classical Digital Signal Processing (filtering, spectral analysis, estimation) or in modern learned/deep approaches to signal data, with genuine curiosity about the other side. Strong working knowledge of machine learning theory and common deep learning architectures, with the ability to pick up new subfields (decision-making, reinforcement learning, LLMs, or signal processing) as a deployment requires. Proficiency in Python and hands-on experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and modern LLM tooling (e.g., Ollama, LangChain). Strong communication skills and genuine comfort engaging with customer or non-ML stakeholders; a consultative mindset is a plus but can be developed on the job with support from the team. You are also able to communicate fluently in Swedish with our local customers. Understanding of data processing pipelines and model deployment basics (predominantly edge-based). Experience with version control (Git) and …

Bonus Points For Experience building modern web applications, for example using React or TypeScript Experience using rapid prototyping or low/no-code tools such as Lovable Experience building AI tools that improve business processes or ways of working Experience taking early-stage AI experiments towards production Experience in the market research or insight sector What We Offer Exposure to cutting-edge AI tools and thinking — practical, not theoretical The opportunity to build AI products that solve genuine business and insight problems Working at the intersection of AI, technology, product and consultancy A fast-paced, agile and empowering environment Autonomy to experiment, test, learn and influence how things get built Collaboration with an ambitious global team solving real-world problems If you’re excited by the opportunity to build the tools shaping the future of AI-empowered consultancy — experimenting quickly, solving difficult technical problems and turning ideas into things people can actually use — we’d love to hear from you. items.desc: Role : AI Engineer -RAG Platform Location : Utrecht Netherlands (2-3days/week onsite Preferred) Type : Contract/Permanent Important: Please clearly indicate in the motivation field whether the candidate has any planned vacation or special leave during the duration of this assignment; Language: English mandatory; Job description Want to improve one of Client's most strategic AI platforms through data-driven experimentation and measurable model improvements? You & your role As an AI Engineer - RAG Platform, you are responsible for continuously improving the quality, accuracy and effectiveness of Client's internal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) platform. You work at the intersection of Information Retrieval, Data Science and Software Engineering. Rather than building AI applications or platform infrastructure, your primary responsibility is improving the performance of the RAG system itself. The RAG platform serves thousands of users across Client and acts as a foundation for multiple AI-powered products. Your focus is understanding where and why the system underperforms, designing experiments to validate improvements and translating insights into measurable production outcomes. You contribute across the entire improvement lifecycle, from failure analysis and hypothesis generation to evaluation, implementation and monitoring. You leverage user feedback, retrieval metrics, evaluation datasets and production telemetry to continuously increase answer quality and user trust. This role is designed for a highly analytical and hands-on specialist who wants to deepen their expertise in retrieval systems, evaluation methodologies and applied AI rather than moving towards people management or generic product development. You will work closely with Software Engineers, Platform Engineers, Data Scientists and Product Managers, while acting as the driving force behind the continuous improvement of Client's RAG capabilities. Examples of what you will work on What kind of challenges could land on your sprint board? Investigating why certain user questions produce lower-quality answers and identifying the underlying retrieval or grounding issues; Improving our automated evaluation framework to measure retrieval quality, answer quality and user satisfaction; Running large-scale experiments to determine the impact of different chunking, embedding and retrieval strategies; Analyzing user interactions and system performance data in Databricks to uncover improvement opportunities; Building feedback loops that continuously identify weak responses and feed insights back into the development process; Defining and monitoring quality metrics that ensure every release results in measurable model improvements. Facts & figures What gives this role its reach and relevance? 36 hours per week; A strategic AI platform used across Client; Working on a production AI system where quality improvements directly impact thousands of users; Part of a multidisciplinary team combining engineering, product and AI expertise; Key responsibilities Drive continuous RAG model improvement Improve retrieval performance, answer quality and overall user experience through experimentation, analysis and optimization. Build evaluation and measurement capabilities Develop automated frameworks that measure RAG quality, identify regressions and provide actionable insights for future improvements. Turn insights into production outcomes Translate data analysis and experimentation results into scalable, maintainable engineering solutions that deliver measurable business value. Together we achieve more than alone The RAG platform is not a research project. It is a production product that must continuously improve. You will join a team of experienced engineers who are building and operating critical AI capabilities within Client. Success in this role comes from combining scientific rigor with engineering excellence. We value people who challenge assumptions, validate ideas through data and continuously raise the quality bar. You & your talent We are looking for someone who enjoys solving hard problems and is driven by measurable outcomes. Someone who is equally comfortable discussing statistical significance, retrieval metrics and system architecture. You take ownership of results rather than activities. You are naturally curious, analytical and passionate about improving complex systems. Mandatory skills Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG); Large Language Models (LLMs); Python; Databricks; Evaluation frameworks for GenAI systems; Embedding models; Prompt optimization; Data pipelines and workflow automation; CI/CD practices; Azure. Nice to have Experience with fine-tuning language models; Experience with ranking and retrieval systems; Experience with AI observability and monitoring; Experience working with large-scale production AI platforms; Knowledge of synthetic evaluation datasets and benchmark creation. items.desc: Etjca Group S.p.A. - Filiale di Roma Galati , ricerca per azienda cliente leader nel settore delle Telecomunicazioni: INGEGNERE INFORMATICO AI La risorsa ideale Siamo alla ricerca di un/una Ingegnere Informatico con forte interesse e competenze nell'ambito dell'Intelligenza Artificiale , da inserire all'interno della divisione dedicata del team, impegnata su progetti pionieristici e ad alto impatto innovativo. La figura sarà coinvolta nello studio, sviluppo e implementazione di soluzioni basate su Intelligenza Artificiale, lavorando a stretto contatto con professionisti senior del settore. Principali attività: Supportare lo sviluppo di progetti innovativi legati all'Intelligenza Artificiale e ai modelli generativi. Analizzare e comprendere le architetture AI e le logiche di funzionamento dei principali modelli. Partecipare alla realizzazione di prototipi e proof of concept. Collaborare all'integrazione di strumenti AI in contesti applicativi reali. Contribuire alla definizione e all'ottimizzazione dei processi basati su tecnologie innovative. Interfacciarsi con team multidisciplinari per l'analisi e la risoluzione di problematiche tecniche. Requisiti: Laurea Magistrale in Ingegneria Informatica . Conoscenza teorica e pratica delle principali tecnologie e metodologie legate all'Intelligenza Artificiale, ai modelli generativi e alle architetture di rete. Esperienza, anche minima, maturata attraverso: progetti universitari strutturati; attività di tesi magistrale; prototipi o implementazioni applicative in ambito AI. Buone capacità analitiche e orientamento all'innovazione. Attitudine al lavoro in team e forte propensione all'apprendimento continuo. Requisiti preferenziali: Conoscenza del linguaggio di programmazione Python . Familiarità con API e modelli di frontiera (OpenAI, Anthropic o equivalenti). Conoscenza di framework quali LangChain , LlamaIndex e Hugging Face . Interesse verso le più recenti evoluzioni nel campo dell'Artificial Intelligence e del Machine Learning. items.desc: Are you a passionate Machine Learning Engineer eager to take on a new challenge that has the potential to revolutionize the European Job Ads Market? Then keep reading! We're seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join our cross-departmental Data Science unit. In this high-impact role, you'll work across multiple teams and projects throughout the organization, leading the development and deployment of production ML systems that serve diverse business needs. As a senior member of our team, you'll be responsible for architecting scalable ML infrastructure, mentoring team members, and driving technical excellence as we transform data science prototypes into robust production services that deliver value across the enterprise. WHAT IS JOBCLOUD HR TECH? JobCloud HR Tech is the Porto, Portugal based company of JobCloud, Switzerland’s number 1 job ads brand and the company behind jobs.ch and jobup.ch. We build software that helps companies spend their hiring budget efficiently and get their job ads in front of the right candidates. Millions of job seekers and thousands of companies use our platform to find each other. WHAT IS IT LIKE TO WORK AT JOBCLOUD? We work as one team of experts in our field. Our culture is inclusive and respectful, and it is built on openness and collaboration. Your skills and motivation count. Your skin colour, gender and beliefs do not matter to us. Come as you are. Our purpose is “Love what you do.” WHAT WILL YOU DO IN THIS ROLE? Partnering with Data Science to translate experimental models into scalable, production-grade ML systemsDesigning and build high-performance, low-latency model-serving architectures and infrastructure Defining and enforce best practices for ML productionization, including coding standards, testing, and deployment strategies Leading cross-functional collaboration between Data Science, Engineering, and Operations as the primary technical interface Defining and implementing model performance monitoring (e.g., drift detection, data quality, inference metrics) to ensure reliability in production Driving innovation by evaluating new tools, frameworks, and methodologies, and promoting their adoption across the organization Developing and maintain technical documentation, system designs, and operational runbooks WHAT SKILLS & EXPERIENCE WILL HELP YOU SUCCEED? items.desc: The Opportunity Newfire Global Partners is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer for a high-impact engagement with a national healthcare organization. You will build the production systems that move machine learning and AI from experimentation into secure, reliable use across clinical and operational workflows. This role sits at the intersection of data science, software engineering and cloud platforms. You will develop reusable pipelines and inference services, improve the machine learning platform and make sure models remain observable, scalable, governed and cost-effective in production. What You Will Do Production Machine Learning Own the engineering lifecycle from technical design and model handoff through deployment, monitoring, retraining, rollback, retirement and incident response. Build reusable batch, streaming and real-time pipelines for training and inference. Develop containerized model services and APIs with clear contracts, versioning, resilience and rollback patterns. Integrate model outputs into healthcare products and clinical or operational workflows. Platform Engineering and MLOps Build automated CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code workflows for packaging, validation, security scanning and deployment across environments. Use Python, SQL, PySpark, Delta Lake, MLflow and Unity Catalog within Azure and Databricks environments. Implement model registration, approval, lineage, reproducibility, access control and auditability. Improve developer experience through shared libraries, templates, automated testing, documentation and code review. Support capacity planning, performance tuning and cost-aware cloud architecture. Reliability and Observability Define controls for data quality, feature availability, latency, service reliability, model performance, drift, bias and cost. Establish service objectives, alerts, runbooks, escalation paths and production troubleshooting practices. Create safe processes for retraining, environment promotion, rollback and incident response. Healthcare Data and Governance Engineer dependable feature and training datasets from claims, EHR, laboratory and care operations data. Build controls for provenance, schema changes, freshness, data leakage and training-serving consistency. Protect health information through secure engineering practices appropriate for HIPAA-regulated environments and HITRUST-aligned controls. Support models that may influence clinical or patient-facing decisions with appropriate documentation and governance. Implement technical controls supporting clinical validation, human oversight, auditability, and safe-failure mechanisms for AI solutions influencing patient care. Applied Generative AI Evaluate and operationalize foundation models, retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, model gateways and agentic workflows when appropriate. Apply sound judgment about where generative AI adds value and where simpler approaches provide better reliability or economics. Implement evaluation, security, quality and supportability requirements before emerging capabilities reach production. Technical Partnership Convert research code into modular, tested and maintainable production software in partnership with data scientists. Establish engineering acceptance criteria and challenge designs that will not scale or operate safely. Translate ambiguous clinical or business needs into measurable engineering requirements. Explain architecture choices, delivery risks and production performance to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. What Success Looks Like Machine learning solutions move from experimentation to production through a repeatable engineering path. Production services remain reliable, observable, secure and cost-conscious. Data scientists can move faster because common platform capabilities and deployment patterns already exist. Models and AI services can be reproduced, governed, monitored and safely retired. Production performance is measured and continuously improved through KPIs for service reliability, inference latency, model quality, data freshness, and operating cost. Skills, Knowledge & Expertise Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, statistics or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. At least three years of experience building and operating production software, data or machine learning systems. At least two years of experience deploying and supporting machine learning models in production. Strong Python and SQL skills, plus experience with PySpark and distributed data processing. Demonstrated ability to write modular, tested and maintainable software. Hands-on experience with Azure and Databricks or comparable cloud and lakehouse platforms. Experience serving models through scheduled batch workloads, streaming pipelines or real-time APIs using containers and orchestration tools. items.desc: Role overview We're looking for a Data Engineer who enjoys working across the whole stack: building reliable data pipelines, putting AI and machine learning into production, and writing solid software to tie it all together. This isn't a narrow, single-lane role. You'll move between data, AI and engineering work depending on what the team needs most, and you'll be comfortable picking up new tools as our platform evolves. What you'll do Data engineering Design, build and maintain scalable data pipelines (batch and streaming) that feed analytics, reporting and AI workloads Model, clean and organise data so it's reliable, well documented and easy for others to use Look after data quality, monitoring and governance across the platform AI and machine learning Prepare and manage the data that powers machine learning models and AI features Help integrate AI technologies, such as large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and ML services, into our products and workflows Support the deployment, monitoring and improvement of models in production Keep an eye on the fast-moving AI landscape and suggest where new tools could add value Software engineering Write clean, tested, maintainable code, mainly in Python and Java Build services, APIs and tooling that connect data and AI components to the wider system Contribute to code reviews, CI/CD pipelines and good engineering practice across the team Across the team Work with analysts, data scientists, engineers and business stakeholders to turn problems into practical solutions Pick up whatever needs doing to move work forward, from infrastructure to documentation What we're looking for Proven experience in a data engineering, software engineering or similar technical role Strong programming skills in at least one general-purpose language, ideally Python or Java, and willingness to work in both Solid SQL and a good grasp of data modelling, ETL/ELT and pipeline design Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (e.g. AWS, Azure or GCP) Practical exposure to AI or machine learning, whether building models, integrating AI services or preparing data for them Familiarity with software engineering fundamentals: version control, testing, code review and CI/CD The ability to explain technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues Nice to have Experience with distributed data processing or streaming tools (e.g. Spark, Kafka) Workflow orchestration (e.g. Airflow, Dagster or similar) Working with LLMs, vector databases, embeddings or RAG patterns MLOps practices: model versioning, deployment and monitoring Containers and infrastructure as code (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform) Experience with modern data warehouses or lakehouses (e.g. Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery) The kind of person who thrives here We care more about range and attitude than ticking every box. You'll do well in this role if you: Enjoy variety and are happy to switch between data, AI and software work as priorities change Are curious and pick up new languages, tools and frameworks quickly Take ownership of problems end to end, rather than handing off at the edge of your specialism Prefer practical, working solutions over perfect ones, and know when to go deeper Share knowledge openly and enjoy helping the people around you improve If you don't meet every requirement but this sounds like you, we'd still encourage you to apply.

Du entwickelst
items.desc: Am DLR Institut für Quantentechnologien in Ulm entwickeln wir Präzisionsinstrumente für Raumfahrtanwendungen auf Basis von Quantentechnologien und bringen diese gemeinsam mit der Industrie zur Prototypreife. Zusätzlich treiben wir den Transfer in Luftfahrt, Digitalisierung, Energie, Sicherheit und Verkehr voran. Wir sind interdisziplinär ausgerichtet: Theoretische Grundlagenforschung und experimentelle Tests treffen auf ingenieurtechnische Implementierung. Das erwartet dich Die Abteilung Integration von Mikro- und Nanosystemen entwickelt Technologien zur Implementierung und Miniaturisierung von Quantensystemen. Dabei werden insbesondere die herausfordernden Anforderungen in der Luft- und Raumfahrt beachtet. Für eine Vielzahl von Quantensystemen werden kryogene Temperaturen benötigt. Sowohl im Bereich der Einzelphotonendetektoren, sowie für Festkörper Quantensysteme ist eine Kühlung in Bereich unter-halb der 10K der entscheidende Baustein für die Funktionalität. Zum aktuellen Stand gibt es noch keine Kryogene Technologie, die eine Einsatz unter Weltraumbedinungen erlaubt. Systeme die auf flüssigem Helium basieren sind für den Einsatz auf Satelliten auf Grund der Größe, Energieeffizienz und Anfälligkeit ungeeignet. Daher ist die Entwicklung neuartiger Technologien zur Kühlung ein entscheidender Enabling-Technologiebaustein für die Umsetzung von Quantensystemen im Weltraum. Der MEMS Prozessforscher Kryotechnologie verantwortet das neue Teilgebiet MEMS Kryotechnologie der Abteilung IMN. Auf Basis der bestehenden Technologiekette im Bereich der Miniaturisierung von Quantensystemen soll ein neuer Technologiebaustein entwickelt werden, der es ermöglicht, MEMS basierte Lösungen für die Kühlung zu Temperaturen unterhalb von 10K bereitzustellen. Diese Komponente soll institutsübergreifend als Technologiebaustein zur Verfügung gestellt werden und ermöglicht perspektivisch ein enormes Transferpotential. Deine Aufgaben Du entwickelst miniaturisierte MEMS-Thermoschalter für den kryogenen Temperaturbereich (10–30 K) – von der Konzeption neuartiger Prozessketten im Reinraum bis zum funktionsfähigen Prototyp. Du leitest technische Anforderungen aus dem Gesamtsystem ab und konzipierst multidisziplinäre Lösungsansätze an der Schnittstelle von Materialwissenschaft, Mikrosystemtechnik und Quantentechnologie. Du entwickelst Teststrukturen und Charakterisierungsmethoden zur prozessbegleitenden Qualitätssicherung und baust einen neuartigen kryogenen Messplatz zur Performancebewertung der entwickelten Bauteile auf. Du erstellst FEM-Simulationen zur Vorhersage thermischer Performance-Parameter und validierst diese experimentell an deinen Prototypen. Du planst und realisierst die Integration des Thermoschalters in eine magnetokalorische Kühlkette und führst eine Gesamtsystem-Funktionsdemonstration durch. Du betreust Masterarbeiten im Themenfeld, leitest Studierende in Reinraumprozessen und Tieftemperaturmesstechnik an und wirkst an Patenten sowie Fachpublikationen mit. Du baust das strategische Technologiefeld kryogener MEMS aktiv mit auf, wirst eigenständig Drittmittelprojekte einwerben und die wissenschaftliche Ausrichtung der Gruppe mitgestalten Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium (Master / Diplom Uni) der Naturwissenschaften (z.B. Physik) oder der Ingenieurswissenschaften (z.B. aus den Bereichen Mikrosystemtechnik, Elektrotechnik, Materialwissenschaften mit experimentellem Schwerpunkt) oder andere für die Tätigkeit relevanten Studiengänge Mehrjährige, nachgewiesene praktische Erfahrung in der MEMS-Entwicklung und Mikrofabrikation: Photolithographie, Trocken- und Nassätzverfahren, Dünnschichtabscheidung, Waferbonden und Erfahrung in der Arbeit im Reinraum und in der prozessbegleitenden Qualitätskontrolle Fundierte Kenntnisse in Wärmeübertragung und Thermodynamik, insbesondere im kryogenen Temperaturbereich; Verständnis des Temperaturverhaltens von Materialien unterhalb von 77 K Erste Erfahrung in mindestens einem der Bereiche: Betrieb kryogener Messaufbauten und Charakterisierungssystemen, Erstellung von Maskendesigns mit MEMS-Designwerkzeugen und Layoutsoftware, Erstellung thermomechanischer Analysen mittles FEM-Simulationssoftware (COMSOL, ANSYS o. ä.) Langjährige Projekterfahrung in der iterativen Entwicklung mikrotechnologischer Komponenten (Sensoren, Aktoren oder Schaltelemente) vom Konzept bis zum funktionsfähigen Prototyp Erfahrung im professionellen Qualitätsmanagement: strukturierte Dokumentation, Prozessfreigaben, Rückverfolgbarkeit – idealerweise in einem normierten Umfeld (ISO, ECSS o. ä.) Bereitschaft zur engen Zusammenarbeit mit angrenzenden Fachbereichen (Quantenoptik, Kryotechnik, Systemintegration) sowie zur Betreuung von Studierenden Die Vergütung erfolgt je nach Qualifikation und Aufgabenübertragung bis Entgeltgruppe E14 TVöD. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! Fragen Zu Dieser Position (Kennziffer 5541) Beantwortet Dir Gerne Dr. Jakob Buchheim Tel.: +49 731 400198 909

items.card: You will feel the support of being part of a strong and stable company committed to employee development, collaboration and long-term career growth. Role Overview: This is an exciting opportunity to join Zurich Resilience Solutions (ZRS) Benelux as a Risk Engineer / Consultant Construction & Liability . In this role, you will assess complex construction and liability risks and act as a trusted advisor to customers,
items.desc:
About Us: 
 In today’s complex world, tackling risk is fast-paced, unpredictable and rewarding. Challenge yourself to find ways to protect the things people value from all kinds of risks, big and small. If you want to love what you do, work with us.
With about 55,000 employees serving customers in more than 170 countries, Zurich is one of the world's leading insurers. Zurich Resilience Solutions (ZRS) is Zurich's global risk engineering and advisory business, bringing together approximately 1,000 risk professionals around the world who help customers understand, manage and build resilience against a wide range of risks. The success of our business is built on the contributions of our highly talented employees. You will feel the support of being part of a strong and stable company committed to employee development, collaboration and long-term career growth.
 Role Overview: 
 This is an exciting opportunity to join Zurich Resilience Solutions (ZRS) Benelux as a Risk Engineer / Consultant Construction & Liability .
In this role, you will assess complex construction and liability risks and act as a trusted advisor to customers, Underwriting and other key stakeholders. You will help customers identify, evaluate and manage risks across construction projects, operations, products and services, supporting both resilience and informed underwriting decisions. Drawing on your technical expertise and practical experience, you will provide risk consulting services, conduct site surveys and assessments, and deliver pragmatic recommendations that help customers manage risk effectively. As part of Zurich Resilience Solutions, a global network of approximately 1,000 risk professionals, you will collaborate with experts across disciplines including Property, Marine, Energy, Natural Hazards & Climate, Cyber and Business Continuity to deliver holistic risk solutions.
This is a full-time or part-time role with occasional travel in Benelux and internationally.
Key Responsibilities: 
 Deliver construction, product liability and general liability risk consulting services to customers across a range of industries.
 Act as a trusted advisor to customers, Underwriting and other stakeholders on construction and liability risk matters.
 Conduct desk-based reviews and on-site surveys, providing clear risk assessments and practical recommendations.
 Evaluate construction projects, operational activities and liability exposures to support underwriting and risk management decisions.
 Review project execution, quality and safety standards, and identify opportunities for risk improvement.
 Support claims investigations and provide expertise on losses and emerging risks.
 Collaborate with other ZRS risk disciplines to deliver integrated risk solutions.
 Contribute to knowledge sharing, business development and the continuous enhancement of Zurich's risk consulting capabilities.
Qualifications: 
 Degree in Engineering, Construction, or another relevant technical discipline.
 Experience in construction, liability, risk engineering or a related field.
 Strong understanding of construction risks, project execution, quality and safety standards, and risk management principles.
 Experience with complex commercial and/or industrial construction projects is preferred.
 Ability to analyse complex risks and translate findings into practical recommendations.
 Strong communication, relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.
 Collaborative mindset with an interest in working across multiple risk disciplines.
 Professional accreditation, international experience and additional language skills are an advantage.
What You Can Expect From Us: 
 Flexible working options include part-time, job-share and full-time opportunities. 
 A varied, challenging and rewarding role with significant autonomy. 
 Collaboration with an experienced and high-performing international team. 
 Exposure to a broad range of industries, construction projects and liability challenges.
 Access to innovative risk engineering tools, technologies and global expertise.
 Opportunities to work alongside specialists from multiple risk disciplines.
 Ongoing professional development and career growth opportunities within a leading global insurer.
How to Apply: 
 Please submit your resume and any supporting information demonstrating your experience and suitability for the role. We look forward to hearing from talented professionals who are passionate about risk consulting and helping customers thrive. 
Join Zurich Benelux and take the next step in your career. We can create a brighter future together!

items.desc:
High-tech car manufacturing fur us. An inspiring, innovative workplace for you.
 At the BMW Group, everything starts with passion. It turns a profession into a vocation. It drives us to keep reinventing mobility and bring innovative ideas onto the roads. Enthusiasm for joint projects turns a team into a strong unit where every opinion is valued. It is only when expertise, highly professional processes and enjoyment of work unite that we can shape the future together. All employees can and should contribute with their special skills to the unique culture of the BMW Group. We're searching for people who are as passionate as we are. Your expertise, your skill set, your motivation, and your individuality are what drive us forward. As a Quality Steering Specialist at BMW Group Plant Debrecen you're a crucial part of our vision to revolutionize the way we think about cars.
 What awaits you? 
 Work environment – you work in a modern and well-equipped office environment at Plant Debrecen, with access to all tools and systems needed for efficient daily operations. 
 Team environment – you become part of a motivated, supportive, and collaborative team of quality specialists working in a dynamic automotive production environment. 
 Quality steering & customer protection – you are responsible for quality steering and for identifying quality-related topics (Q-topics) for specific vehicle components, ensuring customer protection in close collaboration with various departments across the plant. 
 Cross-functional coordination – you act as the link between the plant and the broader process chain, introducing qualified quality topics into the control loops of product lines, driving their implementation, and confirming effectiveness after corrective measures have been applied. 
 Collaboration & stakeholder management – you work closely with quality specialists across plant technologies and product lines, as well as with counterparts at other production sites, ensuring alignment and best practice sharing.
 What should you bring along?
 Educational background – you have a degree in technical discipline or a comparable qualification with relevant advanced training. 
 Professional experience – you gained 2+ years of work experience in quality management and production, ideally within the automotive industry. 
 Work schedule – you are willing to work on-site during regular business hours. Remote work may be considered based on alignment with your line manager. 
 Industry knowledge – you obtain strong automotive product knowledge and experience within a vehicle development environment. 
 Technical skills – you are confident with handling of MS Office; experienced with big data analysis and identifying quality patterns is considered an advantage. 
 Additional expertise – if you have electrotechnical knowledge that is a plus. 
 Language skills – you speak English fluently; Hungarian and German language skills are an advantage.
 What do we offer?
 Our goal is to motivate our employees and recognize their performance, which is why our benefits package includes the following elements in addition to the base salary:
 Bonus – performance-based bonus calculated based on corporate and personal results. 
 Cafeteria – annual cafeteria allowance paid out monthly. 
 Commuting Support – free, direct bus and train services from major cities in the region, aligned with shift schedules. Travel cost reimbursement for personal car usage is provided at the legally prescribed rate. 
 Healthcare Services – high-quality healthcare services, physiotherapy, and therapeutic exercise options are available at the on-site health center. 
 Private Health Insurance – after probation time, all associates entitled for health insurance, which contains outpatient care, laboratory- and diagnostics tests, outpatient and one-day surgery, screening tests, patient transport. 
 Accident and Life Insurance – in work and out of work group accident and life insurance. 
 Subsidized Meals – one daily discounted hot meal at the company cafeteria. 
 Employee car rental programme . 
 Learn more about our benefits via this link: BMW Group Plant Debrecen Careers | About us | What we offer, 
 Type of employment: 
Full-time, permanent employment. 
 Please kindly be aware that we can only consider applications in English. If you have any further questions, please contact our recruitment partner at +3652333603 on weekdays between 8:00 AM and 4:30 PM. 
 At the BMW Group, we place great importance on equal treatment and equal opportunities. Our recruiting decisions are based on the personality, experience, and skills of the applicants. 
 Learn more here . 
 Build the future with us!

 A KUKA az esélyegyenlőség iránt elkötelezett vállalat. Minden jelentkezést aprólékos gondossággal és odafigyeléssel kezelünk – olyan döntéshozatali folyamattal, amelyet nem befolyásol a származás, az iskolai végzettség, az életkor, a nem, a szexuális irányultság, továbbá a vallási vagy a politikai meggyőződés sem. Ha csatlakozol a KUKA-hoz, rengeteg lehetőséged lesz arra, hogy megoszd, mi motivál téged, és mi határozza meg egyéniségedet, ha szeretnéd.
 Csatlakozz az utazáshoz! 
 Ha úgy gondolod, hogy a KUKA által kínált karrier az, amit keresel, szívesen hallanánk felőled.

items.desc: The Role We deploy agentic AI systems that handle real insurance claims for DAX-listed insurers. Not demos. Not decks. Production. We need an AI operator to get into the trenches - operate pilots hands-on, identify where AI replaces manual work, and build the systems that make it scalable. You will become our internal expert on frontier AI - and Claude specifically. That's not a side responsibility. It's a core part of the job. You will work directly with the founders (ex-BCG PLs) and elite AI engineers (ex-Amazon, ex-Meta). You'll sit in rooms with C-level insurance executives, helping us deliver product excellence and scale accounts. But first, you'll process claims, fix edge cases, and ship, leveraging AI. Aufgaben What You'll Do Master the tools. You'll develop deep, hands-on proficiency with Claude: prompt engineering, context management, multi-step reasoning, structured outputs, agentic workflows. You'll know the difference between a prompt that works in a demo and one that holds up across 10,000 real claims. You'll track model releases, test new capabilities the week they drop, and form a clear-eyed view of what's actually better - and what's hype. Deliver. Support enterprise pilot launches - from first claim to full operational rollout. You'll be in the room when things go wrong, and you'll be the one who fixes them. You'll learn what separates a pilot that converts into a multi-million € annual contract from one that stalls - and you'll build the operational muscle to make the former the default. Build. Every manual process is a target. You'll map workflows, identify failure points, and design automated systems that don't need babysitting. That means writing SOPs, building review queues, configuring AI pipelines, and ensuring the output meets the quality bar of a DAX-listed insurer communicating with its customers. Quality here isn't a vibe - it's measurable, and you own the measurement. Scale. Once something works, your job is to make it run without you. You'll identify bottlenecks, compress cycle times, and hand off systems that are documented, reliable, and ready for the next 10x of volume. The best outcome is that what you built keeps working after you've moved on to the next problem. (Internship) Year 1 Year 2+ (Internship): You start at the source. items.desc: About First Momentum Ventures We're engineers at heart and investors by choice. That's why, what started in 2019 as a campus spin-off, we've grown into one of Europe's leading pre-seed funds , backing 50+ deeply technical startups reshaping industries from new industrials to novel computing. With our €35M+ second fund in full swing and Fund III on the horizon , we're hiring a Visiting Associate to join our investment team and contribute to deal flow, technical evaluation, and portfolio projects. Our aim is to be the #1 destination for deeply technical founders in Europe . We believe great teams create the future, and we're here to back them early and support them deeply . We aren't just capital providers; we invest in incredible individuals and view EQ as our greatest competitive advantage over traditional funds. The same applies to our own team: we win as a team (not individuals), believe in high agency & independence, and have every team member participate directly in the fund's economic upside. The Role As a Visiting Associate , you'll be a full member of our investment team with real ownership from day one and direct exposure to how the venture capital world truly operates. This role is designed for people with 1–3 years of professional experience who want to break into the venture ecosystem and accelerate their career. It's the perfect launchpad for ambitious talent aiming to become a Chief of Staff at a leading European startup , land a full-time VC role , or start their own company down the road. Whether you're coming from consulting, a fast-growing startup , or hold a master's degree with several internships in the startup ecosystem, we're looking for Europe's most driven young professionals to join us in building the leading pre-seed tech-focused venture fund in Europe . Tasks Find the most promising tech founders in Europe: Take the lead in sourcing high-potential pre-seed startups, running first calls independently, and developing your own conviction about which founders and ideas are truly exciting. Gain full exposure to the investment process: Work side-by-side with our investment team through the entire deal flow, from first contact and due diligence to investment committee and closing. You'll play a key role in evaluating opportunities and shaping investment decisions. Lead deep-dive research: Explore emerging technologies and market trends every week. Conduct sharp, data-driven analysis and present insights that influence our investment theses and strategic direction. Drive impact in portfolio projects: Support our portfolio founders hands-on, from building their go-to-market motion to automating workflows with AI and optimizing operations. Requirements You have 1-3 years of work experience in the startup ecosystem, consulting, or a technical role. You bring strong analytical capabilities and can move from technical papers to business models to founder conversations with ease. You work with extreme ownership and high agency, spotting opportunities, designing a plan, and executing without waiting for permission. You're genuinely curious about deeply technical domains. Whether you have an engineering background or just love learning how breakthrough technologies work, you're energized by technical depth. You communicate clearly and convincingly in both German and English, whether you're pitching a deal to partners or giving feedback to founders. Benefits Real ownership, not busy work : You'll make independent calls on deals, lead founder conversations, support DD processes end-to-end, and help drive critical projects for our portfolio companies. Technical depth you won't find elsewhere : Most of our team are engineers and scientists, which lets you develop a genuine understanding of breakthrough technologies, not just assessment skills. Exceptional colleagues who challenge you : Work alongside a team that values rigorous debate, mutual support, and winning together. You'll become part of the First Momentum family, even beyond your time with us. Full venture stack visibility : See everything from AI-powered sourcing to automated portfolio support. Gain the whole picture of how a leading European Deep Tech fund operates. Full flexibility with a remote-first culture balanced by regular in-person gatherings across Europe. Competitive pay: The compensation package will be adjusted to your professional experience and will be well above an internship salary. The perfect launchpad for your next move : Whether you're heading toward a full-time VC role, a Chief of Staff position in our portfolio, or eventually starting your own venture, this position sets you up for what's next. We're looking for candidates available for 6-12 months, starting soon or in January 2027 if preferred.
