items.desc: Batch Robotics is revolutionizing how robots operate in factories — not through rigid programming or teaching by human demonstration, but with smart perception and AI intelligence. We are a team of 8 motivated people with 50 years of experience in industry and robotics. Our mission is to make robots smarter and more flexible, enabling batch-size-1 automation for surface treatment economically. Our technology helps factories in Europe to remain competitive with intelligent robotics. We are now looking for a Forward Deployed Robotics Engineer / Application Engineer (m/f/d) with technical excellence and entrepreneurial drive to take full ownership of our physical systems and lower-level control interfaces — and to bring them to life at our customers' factories — mostly in Germany, Austria and Switzerland (DACH) for now, later across Central Europe. Around 60% of your working time you will be on the road , installing, commissioning and improving our systems on site. Tasks Customer Installations (approx. 60% travel, mainly DACH): Install, commission and hand over Batch Robotics systems at customer sites — currently mostly in the DACH region, later across Central Europe — typically trips of one day up to one week, from first site survey to final acceptance. Application Engineering: Analyse the customer's parts, factory process and production line, define the cell layout and integration concept, and adapt our system to each new application. Forward Engineering: Be the team's eyes, ears and hands at the customer: debug and fix issues directly on the factory floor, collect real-world data and feed field learnings back into our product, vision and ML teams. Commissioning, Acceptance & Training: Run on-site tests and acceptance (FAT/SAT), train operators and maintenance staff, and provide hands-on support after go-live. Hardware & CAD: Design all physical hardware like mounts or adapters around standard cobots and cameras in CAD. Sourcing & Logistics: Evaluate, select, and order the right mechanical and electrical components from suitable suppliers to meet design specifications, budgets, and timelines. Manage production and logistics of our system hardware, including shipping systems to customer sites. Assembly, Testing & On-Site Deployment: Physically assemble, wire, and test hardware prototypes and production systems in our lab in Munich and in factories. Factory Integration: Integrate our systems with the factory's existing manufacturing infrastructure and processing tools (e.g., process equipment, conveyors, welding equipment, PLCs). Requirements Travel (must-have): You are willing and able to travel around 60% of your working time — mainly within DACH for now, later also across Central Europe, and you hold a valid driving licence (class B). Background (must-have): Degree in mechatronics, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, robotics, or a related field with strong cross-disciplinary knowledge, plus first hands-on professional experience with robots or automation systems. Field & Commissioning Experience: Hands-on experience installing, commissioning or servicing robots or automation systems at customer sites (e.g., as commissioning, application, field service or integration engineer) is a strong plus. Mechanical & CAD Proficiency: Proven practical experience in 3D CAD modeling, structural design, and understanding of manufacturing processes and component sourcing. Hands-On & Field Mindset: A true builder who enjoys working with physical tools, assembling hardware in the lab, wiring components, 3D printing — and who gets energy from being on the factory floor with customers. Nice to have – Lower-Level Software & Industrial Communication: Experience with lower-level software for automation components and industrial communication (fieldbuses, middleware) is a plus. Languages (must-have): German at C2 level and fluent English; Italian, Spanish or French is a plus. Soft Skills: Entrepreneurial drive, solution-oriented mindset, high agency, a confident and friendly way of dealing with customers, and the ability to take end-to-end responsibility from day one in a fast-paced startup environment. Benefits Real Impact on European Manufacturing: Your work goes straight into real factories. Every system you install helps a European manufacturer automate batch-size-1 production, takes repetitive and dangerous work off people's shoulders, and keeps production competitive here in Europe instead of moving it abroad. Industrial sovereignty you can see and touch. Customer Proximity: You are the face of Batch Robotics at our customers and see first-hand how your work changes real factories in DACH and beyond. Growth: Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts in a high-growth VC-funded startup. Ownership: Direct opportunity to actively shape the company's technical direction, deployment process and hardware strategy. Environment: A modern, central workspace and robot lab in Munich with a collaborative, …

items.desc: About First Momentum Ventures We're building one of Europe's most distinctive early-stage venture funds. As students, we've deployed two funds (now totaling €35m) into ~50 pre-seed Deep Tech companies across Europe. Our portfolio has raised follow-on funding from top-tier European and US investors. Today, we're a community of over 100 (mostly technical) scouts, founders, and operators who help us identify the best technical founders before anyone else does. We accept only 1 in 15 applicants; this isn't just another community. We operate under clear rules that ensure everyone is committed, and we kindly offboard those here only for the VC tag. Note: This is an unpaid role with performance-based referral bounties for successful investments. Tasks What You'll Do Source breakthrough companies. Connect us to the most promising technical founders in your ecosystem, people building in labs, at hackathons, in research groups, or launching their first startup. Represent us locally. Attend events, universities, and accelerators where technical founders gather. Make it easy for them to find us. Share your expertise. When we evaluate companies in your domain, semicon, robotics, climate tech, AI infrastructure, we'll tap your technical knowledge and ecosystem insights. Contribute to portfolio success. Our scouts don't just source deals. They actively support our portfolio companies through introductions, domain expertise, and ecosystem connections. Shape our strategy. Help us understand your local scene: which research is commercializing, which founders are worth watching, which technologies are gaining momentum. Requirements Who Thrives in This Role You're technically fluent, whether as a CS/engineering student, PhD researcher, startup operator, or technical founder. You know who's building what. You're genuinely curious about Deep Tech or industrial innovation. You create opportunities, follow through, and take ownership of your impact. You want to learn how early-stage investing works, and you're willing to put in the work. Go deep on emerging technologies through deal reviews and virtual sessions. Career acceleration. Many scouts join startups, launch companies, or build VC careers. This role opens doors. Community access. Join a European community of technical builders and attend startup events where the most interesting work happens. Chapter Lead Opportunities High-performing scouts can grow into Chapter Lead roles at their university or city. Chapter Leads take on additional responsibility: Recruit strategically. Build a scout presence across relevant faculties and fill gaps when scouts move on Foster community. Organize one meetup per quarter to keep your local scout network engaged Support events. Work with the First Momentum team to bring startup events to your ecosystem

We are looking for a motivated, hands-on Supervisor to help lead our team and keep the standard of food, service and presentation consistently high. Purpose of the Role The Café Supervisor leads the team on shift, ensuring smooth daily operations, excellent customer experience and full compliance with food safety and health and safety standards. The Supervisor works alongside the team on the floor and acts as the first point of contact in the absence of the Manager. Key Responsibilities Team Leadership Lead, motivate and support the team on each shift, setting a positive example in standards and attitude. Allocate duties and stations at the start of each shift and monitor workload throughout service. Assist in the induction and on-the-job training of new team members. Give day-to-day feedback and flag any performance, attendance or conduct issues to the Manager. Assist with staff rosters, shift cover and holiday planning as directed. Complete and sign off daily records, including opening and closing checklists, fridge and freezer temperature logs, cleaning schedules and delivery checks. Ensure correct allergen information is available and that all staff follow allergen procedures, in line with EU Food Information for Consumers (FIC) regulations. Maintain a safe working environment, report hazards or accidents promptly and follow fire safety and emergency procedures. Be fully prepared for inspections by the Environmental Health Officer (HSE). Operations and Stock Carry out opening and closing procedures, including cash handling, till reconciliation and securing the premises. Assist with stock control, ordering and receiving deliveries, checking quantities and quality against orders. Help minimise waste and manage portion control and stock rotation (FIFO). Report equipment faults and maintenance issues promptly. Operate the till and card payment systems accurately and follow cash-handling procedures. Standards and Presentation Ensure the café, counter, kitchen pass and toilets are clean and tidy at all times. Maintain high standards of personal hygiene and uniform for self and team. Ensure food and drink are presented to the café's standards of quality and consistency. Person Specification Essential Previous experience in a café, restaurant or food service setting, ideally with some experience in a lead or senior role. Strong communication and people skills, with the confidence to lead a team. Good knowledge of food hygiene and safety practice; Level 2 Food Safety (or willingness to complete it) is required. Reliable, punctual and able to remain calm and organised under pressure. Good numeracy and confident with cash handling and till systems. Flexibility to work weekends, early starts and bank holidays as the rota requires. Right to work in Ireland. Desirable Barista experience. Experience with stock ordering, rostering or basic admin. Occupational First Aid and manual handling certification. Experience of working in a busy, high-volume café. You will learn and broaden your perspective by working with 400 professionals from more than 50 different nations but also be part of a global organization allowing for collaboration with customers and colleagues across the world. Most importantly, you will be expected to make a difference. Build the platform that keeps aviation software flying. It is the foundation that lets our product teams ship securely and with confidence on AWS. We’re now looking for Cloud Platform Engineers, both junior and senior, to join Team Forerunners at our office in central Gothenburg. Forerunners owns the core infrastructure building blocks that product teams, implementation engineers and SREs rely on every day: ~40 production-grade Terraform modules for AWS services such as VPC, EKS, RDS, EFS, SNS and SQS Networking with Cloud WAN and multi-VPC architectures Kubernetes with Amazon EKS, ArgoCD and ECR AWS Landing Zone development, together with our CloudOps team We care about code quality, thorough testing and security-first design. What matters most is a genuine interest in cloud infrastructure, curiosity, and enjoying solving problems together with others. Everyone on the team needs: Fluent English, spoken and written (Swedish is not required) A basic understanding of cloud concepts, ideally AWS Some hands-on experience with code, scripting or Infrastructure as Code, for example from work, studies or personal projects If you’re earlier in your career , we’d love to see: Familiarity with Terraform, Linux and scripting in Python, Bash or similar An interest in Kubernetes, networking and security, and a drive to go deep Willingness to learn through pairing and code reviews with experienced colleagues If you’re more experienced , you likely bring several of the following: Solid experience building and maintaining Terraform modules Strong AWS knowledge, especially networking, EKS and security Experience testing infrastructure code Hands-on experience with Kubernetes tooling such as ArgoCD and Istio Knowledge of AWS Landing Zones and multi-account architectures A platform mindset: you think about the engineers using what you build, and you enjoy mentoring others Don’t tick every box? Work with industrial robots, sensors, cameras, external axes, and other automation hardware. Develop clean interfaces between robotics algorithms, hardware drivers, application software, and higher-level systems. Diagnose complex problems that span software, algorithms, networking, robot controllers, sensors, and hardware. Improve observability through structured logging, diagnostics, error reporting, and system health monitoring. Support deployment, commissioning, troubleshooting, and validation of robotic systems. Good understanding of several areas of robotics, such as, motion and trajectory planning, robot control, vision, sensor and robot calibration. Experience with robotics middleware such as ROS/ROS2 or similar Comfortable working with Linux and modern software development workflows using Git, code reviews, build systems, debugging tools, and automated testing. Ability to debug problems across multiple layers of a robotic system rather than treating individual components in isolation. Strong understanding of software architecture, modularity, interfaces, and maintainability. Collision detection, robot/world modeling, trajectory optimization, or numerical optimization. Real-time or high-performance robot communication and control. Profiling, performance optimization, concurrency, and multithreaded C++. Deploying and supporting robotic systems outside a controlled R&D environment. CI/CD and automated testing for robotics software. Experience working with industrial robotic arms such as ABB We do not expect you to be an expert in every part of the robotics stack. We are looking for strong software engineering fundamentals, depth in one or more robotics areas, and the ability and interest to work across subsystem boundaries. items.desc: You want to help build Europe’s resilience? You want to protect people and critical infrastructure – ultimately saving the lives of thousands? You want to work at the frontier of high-performance autonomous systems? Join us at CDDS to bring next-generation of control, state-estimation and computer cision algorithms into high-speed kinetic interceptor drones. CDDS specializes in developing low-collateral kinetic interceptors designed to neutralize malicious drones (Mavics, FPV racers and fast fixed wings). Our solutions are built for precision and safety, minimizing risk to surroundings while effectively countering unauthorized or threatening unmanned aerial systems. We work at the cutting edge of counter-drone technology, delivering reliable protection for critical assets and environments. Tasks Your Mission We are looking for an exceptional Control & Flight Test Engineer to drive the control, vision, hardware and operational stack of our interceptor drone platform to the next level. You will test, tune and develop state-estimation, control and vision algorithms that directly determine successful target interception. You will act as the eyes and ears of the R&D team on customer demos and field tests abroad. You will gain a big insights in all our systems as you have to make sure that they are working such that it can be deployed to a user. You will work closely with all teams, meaning control, vison, software and hardware experts — ensuring your and the teams algorithms translate directly into field performance. Core Responsibilities Designing and validate low-latency guidance and control strategies Help to push our multi-sensor fusion algorithms for state estimation Verify and test new computer vision approaches Test and Validate Low-Level Control Software and Hardware Changes Raise risks and issues you see on the field to the R&D team Analyse data, evaluate performance and failure modes of our full tactical unit while doing intercepts Requirements We are looking for people who thrive on mathematical depth , rapid iteration, and hands-on flight testing. You take full ownership of field test — Aligning with the R&D team and your Safety Pilot. Your Profile PhD or MSc in Robotics, Control Engineering, Electrical Engineering or similar field with strong academic record (from ETH Zürich or equivalent) Strong analytical mindset with the ability to derive, evaluate, and validate a complex system Good understanding of classical & optimal control, Kalman filtering, state estimation, and linear algebra (rotations and transformations in SE(3)) Proficiency in Python and Linux Comfortable in fast-paced, high-ownership environments with long hours when the mission demands it Openness to travel often Nice-to-Have ROS2, PX4, Ardupilot and real-time robotics software Fast-moving object interception / high-dynamics control Experience with Simulation Frameworks like Gazebo or Isaac Sim Background in drone flight testing or competitive robotics Benefits Why CDDS Direct impact on a mission‑critical technology shaping Europe’s security landscape Fast‑moving startup environment with high ownership Work with a highly technical, ambitious, and hands‑on team Real‑world testing, deployments, and customer demonstrations Attractive compensation Details Location: Schlieren (Zürich), on‑site Start date: ASAP Environment: High‑impact deep‑tech startup working on real deployments If your interested in the position please apply via this form. items.desc: Learning Experience Designer Remote – UK | Full time Help us design learning for a world being changed by AI The Virtual Training Team (VTT) designs learning experiences that help people change how they think, act and work. We're looking for a Learning Experience Designer to join our small, friendly and ambitious team. You'll design learning across a wide range of subjects, from management and people skills to talent development and future-focused workplace capabilities. But there's an important additional dimension to this role. AI is changing both what people need to learn and how great learning can be designed. We want someone who is excited by that. We're not looking for someone who simply knows how to use ChatGPT or Copilot. We're looking for a great learning designer who is genuinely curious about AI, already enjoys using it and wants to go deeper. You might already use AI confidently in your work, or you might have had fewer opportunities to explore it professionally but have been experimenting enthusiastically in your own time. What matters is the curiosity, judgement and appetite to learn, alongside excellent learning design skills. If an emerging AI topic lands on your desk, we'd like your first reaction to be curiosity: I'd love to get into that. What you'll be doing You'll take client needs, ideas and sometimes fairly challenging briefs and turn them into thoughtful, practical learning experiences. You'll: Design excellent virtual, face-to-face and blended learning experiences focused on meaningful behaviour change. Create comprehensive, intuitive coach notes and delivery guidance so our coaches can deliver your designs brilliantly. Work with clients, colleagues and subject-matter experts to understand what people really need - not simply what somebody initially thinks the training should contain. Produce clear, engaging and professionally presented participant and coach materials, using excellent written English. Design learning about AI, researching rapidly evolving subjects and translating them into practical, credible learning for workplace audiences. This could include Copilot, AI adoption, AI-enabled ways of working and the human and behavioural changes surrounding AI. Work in an AI-native way, using AI extensively and intelligently for research, exploration, challenge, ideation, prototyping, analysis and improvement - while knowing when human judgement needs to take over. Stay curious about developments in AI, learning, technology and the changing workplace, continually experimenting and bringing new thinking into VTT. Manage a varied portfolio of design projects and priorities, producing considered, high-quality work at pace and delivering reliably to demanding deadlines. Apply learning science, behavioural science and adult-learning principles in practical ways that improve the learning experience. Design for what happens in the room - thinking carefully about timings, instructions, activities, group dynamics, transitions and the differences between virtual and face-to-face delivery. The person we're looking for There's no single career path that leads to this job, and we're more interested in what you can do and how you think than whether you've followed a particular route. You'll probably recognise yourself in much of this: You start with the human. You're interested in participants - what they already know, what gets in their way and what will genuinely help them behave differently. You know that in a world where people can increasingly find information and answers for themselves, great learning needs to offer something more than they could readily discover on their own. You're a rapid learner and naturally curious. You enjoy getting your head around unfamiliar subjects, asking good questions and turning complexity into something clear, practical and useful. You're interested in people, learning, technology and how the world of work is changing. AI genuinely interests you. You experiment with it, learn about it and think critically about what it produces, whether that's in your current job or on your own initiative. You'd be excited about designing learning about AI as well as using AI to improve your own work . You're an excellent communicator. You can write clearly, naturally and concisely, and make complicated ideas understandable without making them simplistic. You combine pace with judgement. items.desc: _One of First Momentum's portfolio companies (Imperial alumni, £2M raised) is looking for a Founding Scientist in London to lead the chemistry program and help release geothermal energy worldwide: _ Deep tech startup unlocking stranded geothermal energy and critical minerals London (on-site) | Full-time | £50–70k salary + founding equity ————————————————————————————————————————— Our Mission Drilling advances are unlocking access worldwide to the Earth’s inner heat, creating the possibility for clean 24/7 power at civilisational scale. But reaching the heat is just the first step. The geothermal industry is still constrained by the chemistry of the fluids it brings to the surface. Today, plant operators are forced to reinject brines early to protect infrastructure from severe silica scaling, leaving usable energy and dissolved critical minerals out of reach. We raised £2 million to develop a silica removal retrofit module to boost geothermal power generation and create cleaner brines for co-production of energy and critical minerals from the same wells. Bring your talent to help create a new category of geothermal operations, built not just to survive brine chemistry but to master it. Tasks Your Role As the Founding Scientist, you will lead the chemistry programme from day one. Your mission will be to develop a recoverable process that selectively removes silica from hot geothermal brines , forming the scientific foundation for our first product and IP. You will work directly alongside the founder CEO and a process engineer to translate your results into continuous-flow prototypes and, ultimately, a pilot skid to be deployed at real power plants across Europe. Beyond developing the chemistry, you will generate data to secure pilot customers, de-risk the transition from lab to field, and join team trips to collect and test samples under live geothermal conditions. This is a founding role: we want someone who can work independently within a very small team, move fast under uncertainty, and prioritise viable outcomes that bring us closer to real-world operations over perfect experiments. Requirements Who we are looking for An ambitious scientist whose technical rigour is matched by the drive to turn lab results into commercial technology. Someone excited to build a company from its earliest days, work at the frontier of geothermal operations, and help reshape how clean energy and critical minerals are produced worldwide. Ideally, you have: A PhD in chemistry, chemical engineering, materials science, or closely related field, with proven ability to solve hard applied chemistry problems in aqueous real-world systems. Grounding in one or more of: silica chemistry, mineral precipitation, flocculation, polymer or surface chemistry, heterogeneous catalysis, water treatment, brine processing, or hydrometallurgy. Strong experimental and analytical chemistry skills, including the ability to design systematic experiments, build reliable assays, and interpret messy data without overfitting. Practical judgement around real-world process constraints, from recoverability and residual chemistry to operating windows, failure modes, and scale-up risk. Benefits Why join us Shape the company: Join early enough to shape the science, product, and culture with a path to leadership as we grow. Geothermal access: Operators, advisors from leading geothermal companies and investors with strong industrial networks. Physical impact: Build technology that leaves the lab: from real brine tests and customer pilots to adoption by geothermal plants. Founding team: Work in a small, high-trust founding team with the ambition to build something that does not exist yet. Are you an exceptional scientist ready to build this company from the ground up? Further details will be shared with shortlisted candidates under appropriate confidentiality.

Sobre nosotros: 
 Today Mobility ofrece soluciones de movilidad de última milla para toda la industria automotriz. En esencia, transportamos con un equipo profesional de conductores los vehículos de nuestros clientes hacia y desde concesionarios, talleres y otros puntos y prestamos cualquier servicio relacionado a nuestros clientes.
 Actualmente, Today Mobility ofrece servicios a algunos de los fabricantes de automóviles más grandes del mundo y a empresas con sus propias flotas de vehículos. Como resultado, los propietarios de automóviles disfrutan de servicios de valor añadido, las empresas obtienen eficiencias en la gestión de su flota ahorrando tiempo y dinero, y los fabricantes de automóviles logran una distribución equilibrada en sus talleres y concesionarios, ofreciendo un servicio aún mejor a sus clientes.
 El ADN de Today Mobility: 
 Exigimos altos estándares de profesionalidad, espíritu de servicio y un fuerte sentido de responsabilidad en nuestro trabajo diario.
 Today Mobility es una empresa amigable. Nos movemos con agilidad y hacemos todo lo necesario para ayudar a nuestros clientes, colaboradores y socios a tener un mejor día a día. Formamos equipos que actúan con un enfoque de "nosotros" en lugar de "yo", priorizando personas que valoran los resultados colectivos por encima de los individuales.
 Nuestro ADN impregna todo lo que hacemos, y nuestra identidad se demuestra con acciones más que con palabras. Por eso, nuestros socios nos eligen.
 ------------ 
 Conductor: 
 Como conductor, además de la conducción profesional y responsable exigida para el puesto, es importante que te sientas cómodo interactuando con clientes. En Today Mobility, nuestros clientes son grandes empresas y, en ocasiones, sus clientes finales, por lo que el trato con el cliente es necesario en el día a día.
 El rol de conductor es dinámico y cada jornada laboral es diferente, por lo que es fundamental que disfrutes estar en movimiento y viajar.
 Tipo de empleo: Jornada Completa
Fecha de inicio: próximamente
 Aplicación móvil (iOS, Android): Todas las tareas de conducción y turnos de trabajo se presentan en nuestra aplicación propia. Es la herramienta de trabajo básica. Es fundamental sentirse cómodo y con soltura en el manejo de aplicaciones móviles.

items.desc: Sobre Libeen Libeen es una scale-up que ayuda a gente joven a vivir en su propia casa sin tener ahorrada la entrada que pide un banco. Para muchas personas con buenos ingresos, la entrada es lo único que se interpone entre ellas y su casa, y SmartHousing resuelve justo eso. Libeen compra la casa que elige cada cliente y él entra a vivir desde el principio. Mientras paga su cuota va construyendo su entrada, y entre el tercer y el séptimo año compra la vivienda a un precio protegido, fijado desde el primer día. Producto y Tecnología está construyendo ahora, desde cero, la plataforma que hace posible ese camino: el agente de Libeen, que acompaña a cada persona por WhatsApp desde el primer mensaje; una web y un área de cliente con la experiencia de un neobanco; y la automatización de ventas, finanzas y legal hasta la compra de la casa. Es un equipo pequeño a propósito, que construye con agentes de IA, y el puesto reporta al CPTO. El rol Un AI Product Engineer es un ingeniero de software con mentalidad de producto que lleva funcionalidades completas de la definición a producción, con agentes de IA como su principal herramienta de construcción. Tu mayor aportación está en entender bien el problema y definirlo con precisión antes de construir: qué necesita el usuario, qué reglas de negocio aplican, qué casos límite existen y cómo se comprueba que funciona. Con esa definición diriges a los agentes que escriben el código y te aseguras de que el resultado es correcto, mantenible y seguro. Cubres todo el stack: modelo de datos, backend, frontend, integraciones y testing. El foco está en construir producto con IA, no en investigar ni entrenar modelos. Por harness se entiende todo lo que rodea a un modelo para que trabaje bien: contexto, especificaciones, instrucciones, herramientas, tests, evaluaciones y puertas de calidad. En Libeen lo aplicas en dos frentes: en el sistema con el que se desarrolla el producto y en el propio agente de Libeen, que conversa con clientes reales. Qué harás Definir funcionalidades de punta a punta con el CPTO y con los equipos de ventas, finanzas y legal: historias, reglas de negocio, criterios de aceptación y casos límite, escritos para que un agente pueda implementarlos sin ambigüedad. Diseñar el modelo de datos de cada dominio (leads, clientes, operaciones de compra, pagos, documentos) para que la plataforma propia sea la fuente de verdad del estado de cada cliente, sincronizada con el CRM. Construir backend, APIs e integraciones con servicios externos: CRM, pagos, firma electrónica, WhatsApp y bancos. Construir la web y el área de cliente a partir del sistema de diseño existente, con una experiencia sencilla, rápida y cuidada. Desarrollar y evolucionar el agente de Libeen: herramientas, flujos conversacionales, memoria, guardarraíles y evaluaciones con conversaciones reales. Automatizar procesos que hoy son manuales, como la generación y firma de contratos o los pagos. Trabajar dentro del sistema de desarrollo agéntico del equipo y mejorarlo: instrucciones, skills, subagentes, hooks, evaluaciones y control del coste de los modelos. Crear y mantener tests unitarios, de integración y end-to-end, y vigilar lo que se despliega: errores, métricas de producto y del funnel. ﻿ Requisitos Producto y definición funcional Experiencia demostrable definiendo funcionalidades: escribes especificaciones claras, con criterios de aceptación y casos límite, y haces las preguntas que faltan antes de empezar. Criterio para recortar alcance y llevar a producción algo pequeño que funcione antes que algo grande a medias. Interés por el usuario y por el negocio: miras los datos, hablas con quien usa lo que construyes y propones cambios. Ingeniería fullstack Formación en ingeniería informática o equivalente y experiencia sólida construyendo producto que está en producción. Modelado de datos: esquemas, relaciones, migraciones, integridad y rendimiento de consultas. Backend: diseño de APIs, integraciones con terceros, webhooks, procesos asíncronos, autenticación y seguridad. Frontend moderno con TypeScript y React, con atención al detalle visual y a la usabilidad. Testing como parte natural del trabajo: unitarios, integración y end-to-end, ejecutados en CI. Soltura con Git, pull requests, revisión de código y despliegue en la nube. IA, agentes y harness Es el bloque más importante del puesto. Experiencia real desarrollando con agentes de código (Claude Code u otros) como forma habitual de trabajo. Sabes montar el harness de un agente: contexto e instrucciones del proyecto, especificaciones, herramientas vía MCP, subagentes, hooks y puertas de calidad que hacen fiable el resultado. Revisas con criterio lo que generan los agentes: detectas errores sutiles, deuda técnica y problemas de seguridad. Has construido funcionalidades o productos sobre LLMs: tool calling, salida estructurada, gestión de contexto, RAG cuando aplica, evaluaciones y control de coste y latencia. Conoces cómo falla un agente en producción …

items.desc: Entity description: At Digital & IT, we harness the power of the latest technological advances and our history of industrial excellence to foster innovation and enable Air Liquide’s talents to thrive. How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW at Air Liquide? Au sein de Data & AI Applications, le Chapitre Engineering est une équipe mondiale, regroupant les experts techniques qui conçoivent, construisent, déploient et exploitent les applications data et IA. Le/la Machine Learning Engineer joue un rôle crucial au sein des produits, appliquant son expertise complète sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie des opérations de Machine Learning (MLOps). Il/Elle est censé exécuter des tâches complexes d'ingénierie ML, fournir des conseils techniques et endosser un haut niveau de responsabilité technique, ayant un impact significatif sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie de ML, la plateforme et la croissance des membres de l'équipe. Responsabilités & Missions : Soutenir les équipes Data Science en fournissant des environnements ML complets, conformément aux standards et normes d'Air Liquide, et en soutenant l'implémentation du code, de l'ingestion des données à la mise en service des modèles. Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les ingénieurs data, les software developers et les chefs de produit/propriétaires de produit pour intégrer de manière transparente les solutions ML dans les produits. Déployer et gérer des pipelines MLOps robustes pour l'intégration et la livraison continues, la surveillance et le réentraînement des modèles. Profiler, déboguer et optimiser la performance, la latence et la consommation des ressources des modèles et des pipelines de données en production. Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe plateforme ML Ops pour traduire les besoins réels des produits en demandes de fonctionnalités afin d'améliorer continuellement la plateforme. Nos milliers de collaborateurs le ressentent chaque jour. Ensemble, nous contribuons à une société plus saine pour tous. Cela donne de la satisfaction et de l’énergie. Pour vous aussi, la MC est un environnement de travail agréable et bienveillant, où vous échangez des idées et où vous vous développez. Où l’on peut compter sur ses collègues et où l’on est en relation les uns avec les autres. S’amuser dans ce que l’on fait, c’est notre raison d’être ! À la MC, chaque jour compte. Pour les gens, pour la société et pour soi-même. Description de fonction Avec 650 collègues ICT, nous travaillons ensemble chaque jour pour fournir le meilleur service à nos 4,5 millions de membres et à nos près de 8.000 membres du personnel . Flexibilité garantie ! Possibilité de travailler à domicile jusqu’à 4 jours par semaine ou depuis l’un de nos bureaux régionaux. Nous recherchons Dans le cadre de notre transformation digitale tournée vers l’avenir, nous recherchons un Technology Coach passionné par l’innovation et fortement motivé pour intégrer des outils d’IA au sein du département Infrastructure dans un contexte DevOps Agile . A la MC, en tant que Technology Coach, vous avez l’opportunité de contribuer activement à l’avenir de notre organisation. Nous intégrons l’intelligence artificielle et d’autres outils innovants au cœur de notre fonctionnement. Vous bénéficiez d’un véritable espace pour expérimenter, explorer de nouvelles technologies et participer à la définition de nos méthodes de travail. Votre rôle ne se limite pas à accompagner notre transformation digitale : vous en êtes un acteur clé. Et pendant que l’organisation évolue, vous progressez aussi grâce à des formations approfondies. Vous ne suivez pas simplement le mouvement — vous le devancez. Vous jouerez un rôle clé en accompagnant nos équipes Infra dans la mise en œuvre de processus de développement accélérés par l’IA. Songez à l’intégration d’agents et d’outils intelligents d’IA dans le processus de travail quotidien, en se concentrant sur les changements techniques et culturels. Vous suivrez les évolutions de l’IA et réfléchirez stratégiquement à la manière dont les solutions d’IA peuvent être intégrées à grande échelle dans les processus de développement existants. (SDLC). Vous êtes notre évangéliste IA : vous suivez de près les dernières évolutions (GenAI, copilots, agents), vous les traduisez en cas d’usage concrets et réalisables et vous suscitez l’enthousiasme de vos collègues grâce à des démonstrations, des workshops et des lignes directrices claires et pratiques. Vous aidez les équipes non seulement à « utiliser l’IA », mais à l’intégrer pleinement dans leur manière de travailler — de manière sécurisée, éthique et avec un impact mesurable. Votre impact Vous aiderez les équipes à repenser leurs processus de travail et les guiderez dans le déploiement efficace de l’IA. Grâce à votre expérience en matière de coaching , vous savez comment faire évoluer concrètement la technologie, la dynamique d’équipe et la culture organisationnelle. Votre contribution Grâce à votre regard visionnaire , votre approche pragmatique et votre style de coaching , vous aiderez à construire une organisation dans laquelle la technologie et les personnes se renforcent mutuellement. Vous contribuerez non seulement à des logiciels plus intelligents, mais aussi à des équipes plus agiles et autogérées qui déploieront l’IA d’une manière innovante et éthique . Le profil idéal Vous êtes, de préférence, titulaire d’un diplôme de bachelier ou équivalent par expérience. Vous combinez au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans le coaching et le mentorat d’équipes ICT avec une solide connaissance de l’infrastructure et un intérêt pour l’IA, complété par une expérience en infrastructure as code. Vous disposez d’une connaissance approfondie de l’IA/GenAI et êtes capable d’expliquer de manière claire ce qui fonctionne et ce qui ne fonctionne pas en pratique. Vous êtes un véritable ambassadeur : vous inspirez vos collègues, développez l’adhésion et mettez en place une dynamique de communauté (par exemple via des démos ou des formats de type Learning snacks). Vous traduisez les tendances en matière d’IA en cas d’usage concrets et évolutifs et accompagnez les équipes dans leur mise en œuvre au sein de leur flux de travail quotidien. L’expérience et la connaissance des outils d’intelligence artificielle sont un must, une expérience avec la méthode Agile Scrum est un atout. Une formation à Github Copilot ou à d’autres outils d’intelligence artificielle est un atout majeur. Vous maîtrisez très bien l’anglais et avez une bonne connaissance du néerlandais ou du français et des notions de l’autre langue nationale. Vous combinez une expertise technologique approfondie avec une forte approche de coaching et des compétences en communication. Vous êtes fasciné par le rôle de l’IA …

items.desc: Rejoindre Davidson, ce n’est pas seulement intégrer un groupe de 3000 consultants dans 6 pays et 2 continents, c’est intégrer LA société qui a été élue par ses salariés Great Place To Work France et Europe pendant 4 ans mais aussi une des plus grandes B Corp de France, nommée Best of the World dans la catégorie “collaborateurs” en 2022 ! (Les “B Corp” formant une communauté de sociétés qui ont décidé d’être non pas les meilleures du monde mais les meilleures POUR le monde). Parce que notre développement repose sur des principes forts : Un profond respect de l’ensemble de nos parties prenantes : consultant(e)s, clients et fournisseurs. Car si le travail “ne fait pas le bonheur”, il peut cependant “faire le malheur”. Nous nous engageons donc à écouter et agir avec honnêteté. Une égalité des chances dans le traitement de nos candidatures et dans la gestion de carrière de nos salarié(e)s. Nous croyons en un milieu de travail où équité F/H, inclusion et diversité sont la norme. Une empreinte environnementale minimale, et sociétale maximale. C’est pourquoi, au-delà des missions que vous réaliserez, vous pourrez également contribuer à des projets que Davidson soutient : missions de solidarité internationale (avec Planète Urgence), bénévolat auprès d’associations (chaque Davidsonien(ne) dispose de 3 jours par an pour intervenir à leurs côtés), accompagnement d’étudiant(e)s issus de milieux peu favorisés (avec Article 1), investissement dans des startups développant des solutions innovantes, actions collectives et individuelles pour la réduction de notre impact carbone… Un Management adhocratique basé sur la mise en œuvre des principes de “l’entreprise horizontale” et du “management tribal”. Sur ce dernier point une précision d’importance : le bien-être au travail est un luxe qu’il faut pouvoir s’offrir en étant une entreprise “solide”. Ceci induit pour les Davidsonien(ne)s d’allier prises d’initiative, engagement et professionnalisme. Car “sans travail, le talent n’est qu’une sale manie”. Et cela nous incite à chercher à recruter des personnes… meilleures que nous… Nous encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap, et nous nous engageons à répondre au mieux à leurs besoins spécifiques. Profil / Mission Contexte Mission au sein d’un programme stratégique de transformation data et IA dans un grand groupe bancaire. Objectif : moderniser la Data Platform AWS afin d’alimenter des solutions d’IA (dont IA générative) et améliorer l’exploitation des données clients et ESG. Périmètre Intervention sur le stream Data Platform (AWS Cloud), en production depuis 2022, avec des enjeux d’industrialisation, de performance et de sécurité. Missions Définition et évolution de l’architecture Data Lake / Lakehouse Développement et industrialisation des pipelines de données Implémentation de solutions de data management AWS Mise en place des process CI/CD Contribution à un Data Lab Traduction des besoins métier en solutions techniques Participation aux mises en production et support en cas d’incident majeur Compétences requises ou à acquérir Environnement technique AWS (services data) PySpark (AWS Glue) Java (API) GitHub / Copilot CI/CD Profil 5+ ans d’expérience en Data Engineering Forte expertise Data Management Expérience Cloud AWS significative Contexte data volumétrique et critique Anglais professionnel obligatoire Aptitudes / Savoir-être Autonomie Bon relationnel Réactivité Force de proposition Dynamisme Savoir bien communiquer

items.desc: O nas allclouds.pl to pracujący ze sobą od lat kameralny zespół o wspólnej wizji rozwoju firmy w zakresie doradztwa informatycznego i integracji rozwiązań informatycznych. Jesteśmy propagatorami zastosowania AI w rozwiązaniach biznesowych. Tworzymy rozwiązania zgodnie z zasadą „ai by design not by upgrade”, stawiając na pierwszym miejscu bezpieczeństwo. Nasze produkty – SAIE, TWIN:DESK i PROXY:AI – oraz metodyka wdrożeniowa CDF pracują produkcyjnie w organizacjach sektora publicznego i w przedsiębiorstwach o znaczeniu krytycznym. Jak pracujemy Jesteśmy firmą, która żyje z AI i buduje AI – dlatego zasady, które rekomendujemy klientom, stosujemy najpierw u siebie. Naszą codzienną pracę reguluje wewnętrzny AI-Operating & Working Agreement – dokument, który definiuje, jak każdy członek zespołu korzysta ze sztucznej inteligencji od pierwszej do ostatniej minuty dnia pracy. Opiera się on na trzech fundamentach: 1. Człowiek decyduje – AI generuje propozycje, ale to Ty weryfikujesz, poprawiasz i podpisujesz się swoim nazwiskiem. 2. Wszystko jest jawne – plan dnia, zadania, artefakty tworzone z AI – wszystko widoczne w Asanie i Teams. Oznaczamy, gdzie użyliśmy AI. 3. Dane chronisz Ty – dane poufne i zastrzeżone nigdy nie trafiają do zewnętrznych modeli. Działamy na własnych narzędziach AI i firmowym Microsoft 365 Copilot, zgodnie z EU AI Act i standardami ISO. W praktyce oznacza to, że każdy dzień zaczynamy od planowania z AI, w ciągu dnia AI generuje „wersję zero” – drafty, analizy, kod – a my je finalizujemy. Cenimy kulturę pytania: „nie ufam temu wynikowi AI” to zawsze OK i nigdy nie opóźnia projektu. Działamy w oparciu o zintegrowany system zarządzania (ISO 9001, 27001, 27017, 27018, 14001, 22301) oraz certyfikowany system zarządzania AI zgodny z ISO/IEC 42001 – jako pierwsza organizacja w Polsce uzyskaliśmy ten certyfikat od Bureau Veritas. Za governance AI odpowiada wewnętrzna AI Council, a w każdym zespole działa AI Champion wspierający kolegów w codziennym korzystaniu z narzędzi. Jeśli chcesz współtworzyć przyszłość europejskiej AI w zespole, który traktuje sztuczną inteligencję jako fundament operacyjny, a nie eksperyment – dołącz do nas. Konsultant ds. wdrożeń i szkoleń AI (AI Implementation & Training Consultant) Miejsce pracy: Warszawa, praca stacjonarna z biura allclouds.pl; wdrożenia i szkolenia stacjonarne wymagają okresowej obecności u klientów. Kogo szukamy Szukamy konsultanta z doświadczeniem w IT, który weźmie odpowiedzialność za dwa obszary: wdrażanie nowych funkcjonalności produktów allclouds.pl (SAIE, TWIN:DESK, PROXY:AI) u klientów oraz prowadzenie szkoleń z zakresu AI dla administracji publicznej i firm. To rola na styku technologii, procesu i ludzi – wymaga zarówno sprawności technicznej, jak i umiejętności przeprowadzenia organizacji przez zmianę. Nasze oczekiwania · Doświadczenie w IT: Min. 3 lata doświadczenia w roli konsultanta wdrożeniowego, inżyniera wdrożeń, analityka systemowego lub administratora systemów. Samodzielnie prowadziłeś(-aś) wdrożenia oprogramowania u klienta – od analizy wymagań, przez konfigurację i testy akceptacyjne, po przekazanie do utrzymania. · Zrozumienie architektury rozwiązań AI: Wiesz, czym jest LLM, RAG, agent AI i brama kontroli zapytań do modeli. Rozumiesz różnice między modelami chmurowymi a uruchamianymi lokalnie, potrafisz czytać dokumentację API, konfigurować integracje (m.in. z Microsoft 365, systemami obiegu dokumentów) i diagnozować problemy na styku aplikacji, infrastruktury i modelu. · AI Power User: Biegle korzystasz z czołowych modeli językowych (GPT, Claude, Gemini) oraz modeli otwartych. Znasz ograniczenia modeli – okno kontekstowe, pamięć, halucynacje – i potrafisz budować dedykowanych asystentów oraz agentów, konfigurując ich instrukcje systemowe i bazy wiedzy pod konkretne zadania działu. · Doświadczenie trenerskie: Prowadziłeś(-aś) szkolenia lub warsztaty dla dorosłych – online i stacjonarnie – i potrafisz tłumaczyć technologię w prosty, „ludzki” i zrozumiały sposób, bez żargonu IT. Umiesz utrzymać uwagę grupy 8–18 osób i pracować na przykładach z codziennej pracy uczestników. · Empatia i cierpliwość: Rozumiesz, że część pracowników obawia się nowych technologii. Potrafisz słuchać, rozwiewać wątpliwości i zachęcać do testowania – także w organizacjach, w których AI budzi opór. · Zrozumienie bezpieczeństwa i zgodności: Masz praktyczną wiedzę o bezpiecznym korzystaniu z AI w organizacji: ochrona danych i własności intelektualnej, podstawy RODO i AI Act, nadzór człowieka nad wynikami. Mile widziana znajomość wymagań ISO/IEC 27001 i ISO/IEC 42001. · Umiejętności analityczne: Potrafisz wejść do dowolnego działu, zmapować powtarzalne zadania, dobrać do nich funkcje produktu, zaprojektować kontrolowany pilotaż i ocenić, gdzie wdrożenie AI przyniesie największą oszczędność czasu i zwrot z inwestycji. · Dokumentowanie pracy: Pracujesz w sposób uporządkowany – protokoły, zapisy z wdrożeń, materiały szkoleniowe i raporty są dla Ciebie naturalną …

Description de fonction Dans le cadre de notre transformation digitale tournée vers l’avenir, nous recherchons un Technology Coach passionné par l’innovation et fortement motivé pour intégrer des outils d’IA au sein du Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) dans un contexte DevOps Agile. Nous intégrons l’intelligence artificielle et d’autres outils innovants au cœur de notre fonctionnement. Vous bénéficiez d’un véritable espace pour expérimenter, explorer de nouvelles technologies et participer à la définition de nos méthodes de travail. Traduire les connaissances relatives aux alliages d’aluminium, à la métallurgie, au laminage et aux procédés de finition en modèles prédictifs de microstructure et de performance permettant le développement virtuel de procédés et de produits. Collaborer avec les sites de production afin de garantir une adoption réussie et la concrétisation de la valeur ajoutée pour l’entreprise. Merci de postuler avant le 2 octobre 2026. Translate aluminium alloy, metallurgy, rolling and finishing process knowledge into predictive microstructure and performance models that enable virtual process and product development. Collaborate with manufacturing sites, ensuring successful adoption and business value realization. Strong expertise in physical metallurgy, with deep knowledge of texture evolution, recrystallization and precipitation phenomena Experience with computational materials engineering approaches and modelling tools such as VPSC, DAMASK, CP-FEM Proficiency in scientific programming and data analysis (e.g. Python, MATLAB or similar). Ability to bridge the gap between advanced materials science and industrial application by communicating complex technical concepts clearly across all organizational levels. Fluent in English; French is an advantage. Demonstrated innovation mindset, curiosity and passion for continuous learning, with a self-driven, highly autonomous and result-oriented working style. You will be building QuEra's compiler pipeline together with experimental & computational physicists from low-level
items.desc: Summary QuEra Computing, Inc. seeks a creative and collaborative Scientific Software Engineer to help solve the unique software challenges of developing state-of-the-art simulation tools and compilers for QuEra's neutral-atom quantum computers. You will have the opportunity to work with a vibrant scientific software team and a community of industry and academic collaborators and to help our growing team of diverse experts address fascinating challenges, ranging from classical compiler techniques to modern methods for quantum simulation. You will be building QuEra's compiler pipeline together with experimental & computational physicists from low-level hardware instructions to high-level programming languages using our internal toolchain. This involves development of new compiler infrastructure and new programming language design and implementation. You will be co-designing compilers with cutting edge neutral-atom hardware and quantum error correction technology. This new direction involves multiple new challenges in both engineering and science. Responsibilities Development and maintain QuEra's Static Single Assignment intermediate representations-based compiler infrastructure and compiler components at various abstractions used by our hardware engineers and scientists. Design novel domain specific languages specific to our hardware as well as Bloqade SDK together with the team. Integrate existing simulation tools with the compiler pipeline and cloud service. Communicate and collaborate with QuEra scientists and external customers to meet their use case requirements. Qualifications Ph.D. in Computer Science with focus on quantum computation/architecture/programming language/compiler, or equivalent professional experience. Enthusiastic in building software tools for scientists especially physicists. Experience with Python semantics, Python type hints, CPython interpreter. Experience with at least one of the compiled languages and experienced with their type system, e.g C++, Julia, Rust, Haskell, OCamel, etc. Experience with Static Single Assignment intermediate representations-based compiler development. Knowledge of the full lifecycle of software development, including version control, code review, testing, CI/CD, logging, profiling, debugging, and documentation. Knowledge of quantum computing basics, e.g., common quantum algorithms, quantum information theory basics. Preferred Qualifications Experience with using LLVM or MLIR for compiler development, or experience with an existing compiler development Programming language design, especially programming language theory Quantum program optimization, e.g quantum circuit simplification, scheduling, routing, etc. Quantum error correction Contribution to existing open-source libraries Experience with existing circuit simulation tools, e.g, cirq, qiskit, CUDA Quantum, etc. The approximate base salary range for this position is $102,400 - $166,400. Wissenschaftlicher Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) an der Fakultät für Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik im Bereich Werkstoffe für die Additive Fertigung (Entgelt bis in die Entgeltgruppe 13 TVöD) Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt wird die Stelle zunächst befristet auf zwei Jahre in Voll- oder Teilzeit gesucht. Eine Weiterbeschäftigung bei der Bewilligung eines weiteren Projekts zur Finanzierung ist vorgesehen. Es handelt sich um eine Qualifikationsstelle, in deren Rahmen die Aufnahme einer Promotion möglich und ausdrücklich erwünscht ist. Die Professur Werkstoffe für Additive Verfahren beschäftigt sich mit der Erforschung und Entwicklung neuartiger Werkstoffe und Prozessstrategien für die Additive Fertigung. Unsere Forschung umfasst unter anderem metallische Multimaterial- und Multilaser-Verfahren, innovative Laserprozessstrategien, Prozess-Mikrostruktur-Beziehungen sowie die Charakterisierung additiv gefertigter Werkstoffe und Strukturen. Im Rahmen des Forschungsprojekts SPECTRE werden innovative Werkstoff-, Fertigungs- und Strukturkonzepte für thermisch funktionale Komponenten entwickelt. Der Schwerpunkt der ausgeschriebenen Stelle liegt auf der metallischen additiven Fertigung mittels Laser Powder Bed Fusion (PBF-LB/M). Untersucht werden innovative Prozessstrategien wie Laser Beam Shaping sowie die additive Fertigung von Multimaterial-Komponenten. Ziel ist die Entwicklung und wissenschaftliche Untersuchung neuer Prozess- und Materialkonzepte sowie deren Überführung in funktionale Bauteile. Die Arbeiten sind in ein interdisziplinäres Verbundprojekt mit Industriepartnern eingebettet. items.card: You will be responsible for turning raw hydrophone data into reliable, real-time tactical intelligence, ensuring our platforms maintain total domain awareness in the most challenging underwater environments. What you will do? Hydrophone Architecture: Design and deploy ruggedized, high-fidelity hydrophone arrays. You will move beyond standard setups to create configurations capable of handling the high-speed dynamics
items.desc: We are looking for an Acoustic Engineer who thrives on solving complex signal processing challenges. You will be responsible for turning raw hydrophone data into reliable, real-time tactical intelligence, ensuring our platforms maintain total domain awareness in the most challenging underwater environments. What you will do? Hydrophone Architecture: Design and deploy ruggedized, high-fidelity hydrophone arrays. You will move beyond standard setups to create configurations capable of handling the high-speed dynamics of our waterjet-driven platforms. Target Localization: Build the intelligence that allows our systems to "see" underwater. You will implement advanced TDOA and beamforming logic to pinpoint the position and velocity of objects in real-time. Noise Fingerprinting: Lead the classification of acoustic signatures. You will develop robust models to distinguish between engine noise, cavitation, biological interference, and target-specific signatures, ensuring our systems perform perfectly amidst high-noise ambient conditions. Rapid Iteration: Work hand-in-hand with our propulsion and electronics teams. You will move from simulation to hardware implementation, leading sea trials to validate your models in actual maritime conditions. Who are we looking for? You have a deep grasp of the sonar equation, multipath propagation, and acoustic impedance. You don't just run software; you understand the physics behind every signal. F ocus on shipping real, functional results. You are capable of defining technical requirements and executing them without constant oversight. Proficiency in DSP and data analysis (Python/MATLAB). Experience with underwater communication protocols is a major plus. What do we offer? Competitive Salary: Corresponding to the high responsibility of owning total vehicle architecture. Equity / Stock Options: Direct ownership stake in the hardware and platforms you bring to life. Real Authority: Full autonomy over technical budgets; you make the key engineering decisions that shape the vehicle. High-Impact Environment: Flat hierarchies, rapid execution, and a passionate team building cutting-edge maritime defense capabilities. We are a team of engineers, operating with action, a flat hierarchy, and a singular focus on out-performing the status quo in the maritime industry. If you want to contribute to the next generation of autonomous underwater vehicle platforms and see your work deployed in real-world environments, we would love to meet you.

items.desc: Requisition Number: 20228 Contract Type: Permanent Location(s): Munich (Unterföhring), DE Betzdorf, LU Engineer, Satellite Network Simulation & Emulation, IRIS2 The job responsibilities outlined in this document are not exhaustive and may evolve over time and be reviewed according to business needs. Programme Description IRIS2 is the new European Union secure satellite constellation. This project is the European Union's answer to the pressing challenges of tomorrow to provide secure connectivity services and enhanced communication capacities to the EU and its Member States. In addition, as well as to governmental users, private companies and European citizens while benefiting from ensuring high-speed internet broadband to cope with connectivity dead zones. SES – together with other consortium partners and core members, was selected by the European Commission to build and to operate the IRIS2 multi-orbit satellite constellation. The IRIS2 team enters next project phases, we seek and there is a strong need of support for all the activities around service provisioning and products that the system can offer in the future. Role Description Summary We are seeking a Satellite Network Simulation & Emulation Engineer to build and operate simulation, emulation, and digital twin environments dedicated to the networking aspects of the IRIS² and MEO programme architecture. This role works closely with constellation simulation teams while focusing specifically on routing, traffic engineering, SDN control-plane behavior, data-plane performance, congestion, failures, and service validation using networking tools and statistically rigorous evaluation methods. The position is ideal for an engineer who enjoys turning complex satellite network concepts into repeatable experimental platforms and decision-quality performance evidence. Primary Responsibilities / Key Result Areas Develop simulation, emulation, and digital twin frameworks for constellation-scale network experimentation across space and ground segments. Model dynamic satellite topologies, inter-satellite links, gateway connectivity, user traffic, failures, congestion, and service scenarios. Support evaluation of routing algorithms, SDN control-plane behavior, data-plane performance, traffic engineering strategies, congestion control, and resilience mechanisms. Build repeatable experiments and digital twin workflows for comparing architecture options and validating design assumptions. Integrate network simulation activities with constellation-level simulation teams, software teams, and validation environments. Define metrics, test scenarios, traffic models, data collection methods, and analysis procedures for network performance studies. Automate experiment execution, result processing, visualization, and reporting for technical stakeholders. Support transition from simulated scenarios to lab emulation, integration testing, and production validation planning. Qualifications Background And Experience Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Applied Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Strong background in network simulation, emulation, discrete-event simulation, performance modeling, or digital twin development. Hands-on experience with tools such as ns-3, OMNeT++, Mininet, container-based testbeds, traffic generators, or custom simulation frameworks. Solid understanding of routing, traffic engineering, congestion control, QoS, failure recovery, and distributed network systems. Programming skills in Python, C/C++, Rust, or similar languages used for simulation and systems engineering. Experience with statistical evaluation, experimental design, benchmarking, visualization, and analysis of large experiment data sets. Familiarity with satellite communications, orbital dynamics interfaces, dynamic topology modeling, or space-ground network constraints is highly valuable. Ability to collaborate across simulation, architecture, software, and validation teams and document experimental findings clearly. Other Key Requirements / Comments The candidate must be eligible for a “SECRET” security clearance, in accordance with the national regulations as well as EU/ESA/NATO equivalents Willing to work 60% onsite from office Travel as required for project realization purposes SES and its Affiliated Companies are committed to providing fair and equal employment opportunities to all. items.desc: Nous rejoindre, pour faire quoi ? Dans le cadre du développement de sa plateforme 300mm de fabrication de dispositifs quantiques supraconducteurs, le CEA Leti recherche un(e) ingénieur en caractérisation électrique de résonateurs, jonctions Josephson, et circuits supraconducteurs. Vous travaillerez au travers de projets de recherche et d’équipements de haute technologie à la mise au point de ces technologies. Description Du Labo/équipe Venez renforcer notre équipe constituée d’une quarantaine d’experts pluridisciplinaires travaillant principalement dans les domaines de la microélectronique en partenariat avec des industriels nationaux et internationaux. Notre équipe développe des méthodologies de mesures (caractérisations électriques et fiabilité) pour les composants fabriqués au sein de nos salles blanches. Pour ce faire nous nous appuyons sur un parc d’équipement de mesures à l’état de l’art mondial. Objectifs : Dans un premier temps, vous assurerez la mise en place des moyens de mesures requis pour l'évaluation des résonateurs, jonctions Josephson et circuits supraconducteurs élaborés au sein de nos salles blanches. Cette phase inclut l’acquisition et l’installation de cryostats à dilution et de leur instrumentation. Ces moyens de caractérisations doivent être dimensionnés pour répondre aux besoins de la plateforme 300mm, notamment avec l'étude de la variabilité ainsi que l'effet de différentes intégrations. Dans un second temps, vous vous concentrerez sur la réalisation des mesures pour statuer sur la performance des dispositifs supraconducteurs. Ces mesures comprennent la caractérisation de résonnateurs dans le régime de few-photons, et la performance des qubits supraconducteur. Vous serez responsable de la présentation des résultats à l'équipe projet ainsi qu'à nos partenaires externes. Votre expertise vous conférera un rôle clé dans l'évaluation, la caractérisation et la validation finale des technologies quantiques développées, contribuant directement à l'avancement de nos projets innovants. Profil du candidat Qu’attendons-nous de vous ? Vous êtes issu(e) d’une formation Bac+5, dans le domaine de de la physique des dispositifs quantiques. Vous maîtrisez les instruments de mesures et les jonctions supraconductrices n’ont aucun secret pour vous. Vous avez de bonnes connaissances des outils de programmation (par exemple Python) et des technologies de la cryogénie. Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre capacité à synthétiser des informations complexes et de les communiquer de manière claire et adaptée à différents publics. Vous avez encore un doute ? Nous vous proposons : Un écosystème de recherche à la pointe, unique en son genre et dédié à des thématiques à fort enjeu sociétal, Une expérience sur une thématique à la pointe de l’innovation, comportant un fort potentiel de développement industriel, Des activités porteuses dans un contexte économique favorable, Des formations pour développer ou renforcer vos compétences, Un poste au cœur de la métropole grenobloise, facilement accessible via la mobilité douce favorisée par le CEA, Un équilibre vie privée – vie professionnelle reconnu, Une rémunération selon vos diplômes et votre expérience, L’accès à une épargne abondée par le CEA, Un CSE actif en termes de loisirs et d’activités extra-professionnelles, Des restaurants d’entreprise Une politique diversité et inclusion. Nous avons hâte de vous accueillir dans notre équipe ! Conformément aux engagements pris par le CEA en faveur de l'intégration des personnes handicapées, cet emploi est ouvert à toutes et à tous. Le CEA propose des aménagements et/ou des possibilités d'organisation pour l'inclusion des travailleurs handicapés. Localisation du poste Site Grenoble Localisation du poste France, Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, Isère (38) Ville Grenoble Demandeur Disponibilité du poste 01/10/2026

items.desc: About Milliman Milliman is one of the world's leading independent consulting firms, helping clients solve some of the most complex challenges in insurance, financial services, healthcare, pensions, and risk management. In the Benelux, we combine deep subject matter expertise with advanced analytical capabilities to help clients transform their businesses. As artificial intelligence and cloud technologies rapidly reshape the financial industry, we are expanding our team with professionals who bring strong technical and data engineering expertise alongside an interest in financial services. The Role As a Data & AI Consultant, you will help financial institutions modernize their analytical landscape by designing and implementing scalable data solutions, cloud-based applications, and AI-enabled workflows. You will work closely with consultants, quantitative experts, actuaries, and clients to transform existing analytical models into modern, maintainable, and production-ready solutions. This includes migrating complex Excel-based models to cloud platforms, building robust data pipelines, and enabling organizations to leverage AI and advanced analytics effectively. This role offers an excellent opportunity to apply your technical expertise to challenging real-world problems while gaining exposure to the insurance and financial services industry. What You Will Do Design, build and maintain modern data solutions for clients in insurance and financial services. Help migrate analytical and financial models from Excel and legacy environments to cloud-based platforms, primarily Microsoft Azure. Develop scalable data pipelines and workflows for processing and managing large datasets. Design efficient data structures, databases, and data architectures. Support the implementation of AI and machine learning solutions within client environments. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to translate business challenges into technical solutions. Contribute to software development, automation, testing, and deployment of analytical applications. Stay up to date with emerging technologies in cloud computing, AI, and data engineering. What We Are Looking For We are looking for technically strong candidates who enjoy solving complex problems and are excited by the opportunities that AI and cloud technologies create. Required Master's degree (or equivalent) in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Econometrics, or another quantitative or technical discipline. Strong programming skills, preferably in Python. Solid understanding of data engineering concepts, including databases, SQL, data modelling, and data structures. Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure. Affinity with software engineering best practices, including version control, testing, and CI/CD. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work in multidisciplinary consulting teams. Fluent in Dutch and English. Preferred Experience with AI, machine learning, or large language model (LLM) applications. Knowledge of Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Azure Functions, Synapse, or similar cloud technologies. Experience with containerization and DevOps tooling. Familiarity with financial services, insurance, risk management, or quantitative modelling. Knowledge of actuarial modelling or financial mathematics is considered an advantage but is not required. What We Offer Challenging consulting projects with leading financial institutions across the Benelux. The opportunity to work at the forefront of AI, cloud technology, and data engineering. Collaboration with highly skilled consultants, actuaries, and technical specialists. A strong learning environment with extensive opportunities for professional development and certification. International collaboration within Milliman's global network. A competitive salary and attractive benefits package. Flexible working arrangements with offices in Amsterdam, Brussels, and Luxembourg. Why Join Milliman? The financial services industry is undergoing a fundamental technological transformation. At Milliman, we combine decades of industry expertise with modern technology to help our clients build the next generation of analytical platforms. If you enjoy combining software engineering, data, AI, and quantitative thinking to solve complex business challenges, we'd love to hear from you.

In particolare, il candidato selezionato si occuperà di: Eseguire analisi citofluorimetriche su campioni biologici; Eseguire attività di cell sorting secondo procedure e protocolli definiti; Preparare e processare campioni biologici, inclusi PBMC, linee cellulari e campioni tissutali; Supportare lo sviluppo e l’ottimizzazione di pannelli citofluorimetrici; Contribuire alla manutenzione ordinaria e alle verifiche prestazionali della strumentazione; Analizzare dati mediante software dedicati e predisporre report tecnici; Collaborare alla redazione di SOP e documentazione di qualità; REQUISITI E COMPETENZE Per l’ammissione alla procedura di selezione i candidati devono essere in possesso dei seguenti requisiti minimi: Laurea Magistrale in Biologia, Biotecnologie, Biotecnologie Mediche, Scienze Biomediche, Farmacia o discipline affini; Almeno 3 anni di esperienza professionale in attività di citometria a flusso; Esperienza nell’utilizzo di citofluorimetri analitici; Esperienza nell’esecuzione di saggi immunologici e citofluorimetrici; Capacità di gestione e preparazione di campioni biologici; Conoscenza di FlowJo o software equivalenti per l’analisi dei dati; Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. I requisiti di ammissione devono essere posseduti alla data di scadenza del termine utile per la presentazione delle candidature e desumibili chiaramente dal cv. Nella valutazione delle candidature, costituiscono requisiti preferenziali: Esperienza in attività di cell sorting; Esperienza in laboratori di immunologia, sierologia o malattie infettive; Conoscenza di GLP, GMP e procedure di biosicurezza BSL-2/BSL-3; Esperienza nella redazione di SOP e documentazione di qualità; Produzione scientifica documentata; PhD in discipline attinenti; INQUADRAMENTO La risorsa sarà assunta con un contratto di lavoro subordinato a tempo determinato (scadenza 31/12/2028), con qualifica di impiegato – livello C, CCNL industria chimica, chimico-farmaceutica. La retribuzione annua lorda sarà definita in coerenza con l’esperienza e la professionalità del candidato selezionato, all’interno della fascia retributiva prevista per il livello di riferimento, indicativamente compreso tra €32.914,18 – € 34.198,45. items.desc: Nous rejoindre, pour quoi faire ? Dans ce contexte d’innovation et de développement, nous recherchons un Ingénieur.e/chercheur.se en formulation et développement de procédés Votre action s’inscrira dans le cadre des projets à vocation industrielle ou académique que mène la plateforme NanO’up avec pour objectif le développement de produits Biopharma. Vous aurez pour missions de : Formuler des nanoparticules encapsulant différentes molécules actives et vérifier leur stabilité Mettre au point les méthodes caractérisation des échantillons (DLS, Potentiel Zeta) Participer au développement et à l’industrialisation les procédés de fabrication et de purification des produits Participer au fonctionnement du laboratoire (gestion des équipements, des stocks de matières et des consommables) Vous devrez également être force de proposition et vous impliquer avec les Ingénieurs/Chercheurs dans les tâches de développement des produits afin de participer à l’avancement global du projet en restant en phase avec les besoins exprimés par l’utilisateur final. Profil du candidat Qu’attendons-nous de vous ? L’indispensable, c’est votre connaissance et compréhension en : Formulation (lipides, systèmes tensioactifs, phospholipides, polymères) Procédés de fabrication et de purification de nanoparticules Caractérisations physico-chimiques Vos atouts, ce sont votre autonomie, sens pratique et de l’organisation, esprit d’équipe, bonne communication orale et écrite, et attrait pour la recherche. Sans compter tous ceux dont ne nous pouvons pas dresser la liste mais que vous aurez à cœur de nous montrer. Le petit plus, c’est votre maitrise de l’anglais ainsi que votre expérience en laboratoire. L’équipe sera ravie de vous permettre de monter en compétences sur ce sujet si vous ne le connaissez pas encore. Vous avez encore un doute ? Nous vous proposons : Un environnement unique de recherche dédié à des thématiques à fort enjeu sociétal, Une expérience sur une thématique à la pointe de l’innovation, comportant un fort potentiel de développement industriel, Des formations pour renforcer vos compétences ou en acquérir de nouvelles, Un équilibre vie privé – vie professionnelle reconnu, Un accord de télétravail, Une ambiance de travail collaborative, Une rémunération selon vos diplômes et votre expérience Conformément aux engagements pris par le CEA en faveur de l'intégration des personnes handicapées, cet emploi est ouvert à toutes et à tous. Le CEA propose des aménagements et/ou des possibilités d'organisation pour l’inclusion des travailleurs handicapés. Localisation du poste Site Autre Localisation du poste France, Occitanie, Haute Garonne (31) Ville Labège Demandeur Disponibilité du poste 02/11/2026
