items.desc: We’re looking for an enthusiastic colleague (m/f/d) who thrives on solving technical challenges and enjoys the satisfaction of making a real impact on their team. Your Mission You build AI products that advance our customers in their everyday lives, as well as AI-powered solutions for our internal processes – from ideation to production. These solutions apply AI consistently: automations, intelligent workflows, assistants, and tools that noticeably increase quality and efficiency. You take ownership of the entire journey independently – from the initial idea to the production-ready solution, without waiting for external direction. You have a product mindset and build it yourself: You understand the real problems of users and business departments, translate them into solutions, and see them through to completion. You live AI-First: You develop the spec together with the model and drive it through agentic loops. You define the tests and criteria against which the AI benchmarks its own code – enabling you to build faster and more reliably. You design the AI layer of our products yourself: Prompts, tool calls, RAG, and agent logic – including the conversation flows for our voicebot. For you, AI is product material, not just a tool. You also oversee your solutions after launch – you monitor how they perform in action and continuously improve them. You test new models, frameworks, and AI tools on your own initiative, keep an eye on the market, and proactively introduce relevant ideas. You don't record knowledge in traditional documentation, but rather as an AI-compatible knowledge base that is created concurrently while building – so that users can navigate more easily and the next agentic loop can build upon it more autonomously. You own and evolve the Audelia Voice Agent platform, including speech recognition, text-to-speech, conversational AI and real-time voice interactions. Tech Stack: Claude Code, Claude Design, OpenAI Codex Livekit, Realtime API, Deepgram, Elevenlabs Java, Python ReactJS, Angular … and others Your Profile You build complete applications across the entire stack and deploy them to production yourself – frontend with Angular and React, backend with Java and Python. You have built LLMs, agent systems, and RAG yourself – including prompt and tool-call design as well as evals. Not as a user, but as a builder. Spec-driven work with agentic loops is standard practice for you – you have brought software into production this way, not just experimented with it. You prioritize and structure requirements independently, thinking like a product person in the process. CO VÁM ROLE NABÍDNE Možnost být u rozvoje interní agentské platformy a prvních produkčních AI agentů v bance. Přímý dopad na změnu operačního modelu banky prostřednictvím zjednodušování procesů, kvality práce a uvolňování kapacity napříč útvary. Spolupráci s businessovými i technologickými týmy na praktických případech využití AI. Prostor ovlivnit standardy, způsob správy agentů i podobu vznikajícího portfolia. PRO KOHO JE TATO ROLE IDEÁLNÍ Pro člověka, který umí spojit technologické možnosti s reálnou potřebou uživatelů. Nemusí být vývojářem, ale měl by rozumět tomu, jak AI agent funguje, umět jej prakticky připravit a otestovat a převzít odpovědnost za jeho dlouhodobou kvalitu a správu. Role je vhodná pro kandidáta, kterého baví budovat novou oblast, nastavovat standardy a dotahovat řešení do každodenního provozu. NA ČEM BUDETE PRACOVAT Připravovat, konfigurovat, testovat a nasazovat AI agenty na interní agentské platformě. Převádět business požadavky do zadání agenta, navrhovat jeho workflow, instrukce, znalostní zdroje, nástroje a pravidla práce. Spolupracovat s business vlastníky na definici účelu, očekávaných přínosů, kvalitativních kritérií a způsobu akceptace agenta. Řídit životní cyklus svěřených agentů: evidence, verzování, dokumentace, přístupová oprávnění, změny a ukončení provozu. Průběžně sledovat kvalitu výstupů, využití, náklady a přínosy agentů; vyhodnocovat zpětnou vazbu a navrhovat zlepšení. Připravovat a provádět testovací scénáře, zachytávat chybové stavy a koordinovat jejich nápravu s vlastníkem platformy a IT. Dohlížet na dodržování interních standardů pro bezpečnost, ochranu dat, auditovatelnost, monitoring a zapojení člověka do rozhodování. Podporovat uživatele a business vlastníky při zavádění agentů do každodenní práce a sdílet osvědčené postupy. Řídit vydávání verzí agentů napříč prostředími (vývoj, akceptace, produkce) včetně schvalovacích kroků pro specifikaci a release a návratu na předchozí verzi. Nastavovat agentům nástroje a integrace (např. Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, Outlook) podle principu nejnižších oprávnění a připravovat žádosti o identity a přístupy. Připravovat referenční testovací sady a regresní evaluace před každým vydáním; nastavovat prahy jistoty a předávání nejistých výsledků k lidské kontrole. Analyzovat neúspěšné běhy agentů z logů a trasování (např. překročení kontextového okna modelu, odmítnutý nástroj, nečitelný vstupní dokument) a navrhovat nápravu. Využívat AI nástroje k návrhu, úpravám a testování agentů a sledovat náklady na jednotlivé běhy. CO BUDETE KE SVÉ PRÁCI POTŘEBOVAT Praktickou orientaci v generativní AI, práci s LLM a tvorbě instrukcí či promptů; zkušenost s AI agenty je výhodou. Schopnost rozložit business proces na jednotlivé kroky, rozhodovací pravidla, vstupy, výstupy a kontrolní body. Analytické a systematické myšlení, pečlivost při testování a schopnost pracovat s nejednoznačnými výsledky AI. Základní orientaci v API, datových formátech, znalostních bázích a integračních principech; není nutná role vývojáře. Cit pro bezpečné zacházení s daty, řízení přístupů, dokumentaci a dohledatelnost výstupů. Porozumění limitům jazykových modelů: kontextové okno, cena tokenů, nedeterministické odpovědi, halucinace a riziko prompt injection z nedůvěryhodných dokumentů. Schopnost měřit kvalitu agenta na datech (přesnost, míra lidské kontroly, náklady na běh) a rozhodovat podle výsledků, ne podle dojmu. Základní orientaci v Gitu a GitHubu a ve formátech YAML a JSON, ve kterých se popisuje konfigurace agenta. items.desc: About the Role Role Overview We are looking for a Data Scientist specialising in GenAI and Chatbot optimisation. In this role, you will work at the intersection of data science, engineering, and product development to improve the quality, accuracy, and effectiveness of AI-powered chatbot systems. Rather than developing foundation models, your primary focus will be on understanding chatbot behaviour, identifying performance gaps, and translating your findings into practical improvements. You will investigate questions such as: Why is the chatbot not delivering the expected results? Is the issue related to missing context, retrieval quality, prompt design, or data structure? What additional information does the AI assistant need to produce better responses? How can chatbot performance be evaluated and improved systematically? You will assess existing solutions against state-of-the-art GenAI approaches and drive improvements across retrieval, generation, reasoning loops, tool calling, and other relevant GenAI capabilities. This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong, analytical professional who enjoys debugging AI behaviour and making AI applications work more effectively in real-world scenarios. Responsibilities Analyse chatbot outputs and identify the improvements that will have the greatest impact. Diagnose context gaps and determine what additional information AI agents require to perform effectively. Collaborate with product managers and engineers to establish evaluation criteria for agent performance. Work closely with business use-case teams and stakeholders to understand real-world requirements and translate feedback into technical improvements. Improve retrieval mechanisms, data structuring, and the onboarding of contextual data sources. Design evaluation frameworks that support rapid experimentation, large-scale testing, and continuous improvement. Translate functional and business requirements into actionable technical solutions. Evaluate chatbot responses to understand why particular outputs are effective or ineffective. Assess existing implementations against current GenAI best practices and identify opportunities for innovation. Troubleshoot data flows, context ingestion, and integration issues affecting chatbot performance. Required Skills Essential Skills and Experience GenAI and LLM Expertise Strong understanding of Generative AI systems and their practical applications. Hands-on experience developing, evaluating, or optimising LLM-based applications. Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. Strong understanding of prompt engineering, context windows, retrieval strategies, and grounding. Ability to analyse AI-generated responses and identify the underlying causes of poor performance.

items.desc: Our client, a leading organization in the telecommunications and digital services sector, is seeking a professional to support the evolution of their internal AI platform. The role involves translating business needs into functional requirements while developing and validating AI-driven solutions to enhance digital workflows across the organization. Responsibilities Develop and validate AI platform functionality using LLM harnesses and agent workflows. Translate business needs into user stories, functional requirements, and acceptance criteria. Onboard teams to new AI capabilities through workshops, demonstrations, and hands-on sessions. Measure and collect user feedback to drive continuous improvement of the platform. Assess internal and external AI capabilities to provide recommendations for future enhancements. Maintain clear documentation ensuring traceability from business requirements to technical implementation. Requirements You have 3+ years of experience in functional analysis, requirements engineering, and process modeling. You bring technical knowledge of LLM harnesses, agent workflows, RAG, and prompt engineering. You possess a solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure tools such as Azure, Kubernetes, and Terraform. You're skilled in designing test scenarios and automated evaluations for model behavior and tool integration. You have experience inspecting logs and agent execution traces to debug issues related to token usage, context, and latency. You're proactive and solution-oriented with a proven track record in stimulating user adoption and onboarding. You are fluent in English. Nice to Haves Development experience in Python and TypeScript. Knowledge of Figma and design thinking practices. Experience with Targetprocess or similar Agile project management platforms. Familiarity with digital user experience, web design, or marketing content design. Offer Start date: ASAP Duration: 3 months (extendable) Work regime: Full-time Location: Brussels Working model: Hybrid (minimum 40% including one day per week onsite) Contract: open to both permanent employees and freelancers

items.desc: Job Title: AI Engineer Location: Cork, Dublin or Limerick, Ireland (Hybrid) Duration: 6 months Contract Type: Temp-to-Perm We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to join the team on a 6-month contract, with the potential to transition to a permanent position. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience building and deploying production-grade AI systems, particularly agentic AI, multi-agent architectures, RAG, and enterprise AI platforms. They should be comfortable leading technical design, building reusable engineering patterns, and improving the reliability, performance and scalability of AI solutions. Candidates should be based in Ireland and able to work in a hybrid model from Cork, Dublin or Limerick. Job Description We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to lead the design, development and delivery of production-ready AI systems. The ideal candidate will combine strong hands-on engineering skills with architectural thinking and technical leadership to build reliable, scalable and reusable AI solutions. The role focuses on agentic AI, multi-agent systems, LLM-based applications, context and memory engineering, retrieval systems, AI evaluation and production AI platforms. Key Responsibilities Design and build production-grade agentic AI and multi-agent systems. Develop agent orchestration, tool execution, state management, workflow, retry, fallback and recovery patterns. Build reliable agent workflows covering reasoning, action, observation, validation and termination. Design context, memory, retrieval and knowledge architectures for AI applications. Develop reusable AI capabilities, skills, plugins and integrations using technologies such as MCP and A2A. Build and maintain AI evaluation frameworks, testing harnesses, observability and production debugging processes. Apply software engineering best practices, including test-driven development (TDD), spec-driven development, Domain-Driven Design and API design. Design and develop scalable AI platforms and distributed systems. Optimise model inference, token usage, latency and operational costs. Implement LLMOps and AgentOps practices to support reliable production deployments. Explore multimodal AI capabilities involving text, images and voice. Collaborate with Product Managers, Architects, Engineers and subject matter experts to establish engineering standards and reusable patterns across teams. Contribute to technical roadmaps, platform reliability, serviceability and AI readiness. Required Skills and Experience Strong hands-on experience in AI engineering, agentic AI, multi-agent systems and LLM-based application development. Strong software engineering background with experience building APIs and distributed systems. Experience with context engineering, memory architecture, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and retrieval systems. Knowledge of graph technologies, including LPG, RDF, Knowledge Graphs and GraphRAG. Experience developing AI evaluation frameworks, testing harnesses and observability solutions. Familiarity with AI interoperability and tool integration, including MCP, A2A, plugins, skills and tool calling. Experience with LLMOps, AgentOps and deploying AI systems into production. Understanding of inference optimisation, model routing, token economics, latency and cost management. Experience with AI-assisted coding and agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices. Understanding of AI user experience patterns, including AG-UI and human-in-the-loop workflows. Exposure to multimodal AI technologies involving voice, image and text. Strong technical leadership, problem-solving and communication skills. Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across engineering teams. What We're Looking For A hands-on AI Engineer who can take ownership of complex AI engineering challenges, make sound architectural decisions, build reliable production systems and establish reusable engineering practices across multiple teams.

You will help build the systems behind Nadifor’s AI coaching, in-course tutoring, course creation, and learning workflows. This includes backend services, agent workflows, knowledge retrieval, evaluation loops, integrations, permissions, and automation that make these
items.desc: About Nadifor Nadifor helps companies grow their people as AI changes the way they work. We build Nadifor Grow, a platform for personalized learning, AI coaching, and learning operations, and run the Nadifor AI Program to help people apply AI in their roles. Our goal is to connect learning and practice to measurable improvements in what people can do. We are an early-stage company, which means the product, engineering culture, and operating model are still being shaped. We are looking for people who want to do more than write code. We want engineers who care deeply about the product, the customer, the craft, and the company we are building. Our engineering culture is inspired by strong product engineering teams: small teams, high ownership, direct customer context, fast iteration, and engineers who are expected to make thoughtful product and technical decisions. The role We are looking for an AI Product Engineer who enjoys building backend systems and turning AI capabilities into useful product experiences. You will help build the systems behind Nadifor’s AI coaching, in-course tutoring, course creation, and learning workflows. This includes backend services, agent workflows, knowledge retrieval, evaluation loops, integrations, permissions, and automation that make these experiences reliable and useful for customers. This is not a research ML role. We are looking for someone who can build production-grade AI product systems: pragmatic, reliable, understandable, and grounded in customer value. You should be comfortable working across the stack, partnering closely with product-minded engineers, founders, and customers, and making both product and technical decisions. Experience and scope We’re looking for someone who can independently take a customer problem through to a reliable production feature. You’ll join our four-person engineering team, working directly with the CTO to shape the product and our technical decisions. What you’ll do Build and improve backend and AI product systems, taking ownership of features or broader systems depending on your experience. Turn AI prototypes and customer problems into reliable production features. Design APIs, services, data models, jobs, workflows, and integrations. Build systems for LLM orchestration, retrieval, evaluation, observability, and feedback loops. Improve the reliability, explainability, and quality of AI-powered product behavior. Work on multi-tenant SaaS concerns such as permissions, auditability, data separation, and enterprise readiness. Partner with other product engineers to ship complete customer-facing features. Make pragmatic architecture decisions that balance speed, correctness, and future scale. Help define engineering practices around testing, monitoring, deployment, and operational excellence. Share knowledge and contribute to the team’s engineering practices. More experienced engineers will also mentor teammates and help guide technical decisions. What we’re looking for Experience building backend software, with deeper production and operational experience expected at more senior levels. Strong TypeScript and/or Python experience, or the ability to become highly productive in either quickly. Solid backend engineering fundamentals, including APIs, services, and data models. Practical experience building with LLMs or AI product systems. Good judgment around reliability, observability, testing, and operational tradeoffs. Ability to work full-stack when needed, even if your strongest spike is backend/platform. Strong product judgment: you care about whether the system actually solves the customer problem. Comfort with ambiguity and early-stage startup pace. Ability to make thoughtful tradeoffs without over-engineering. Strong written and verbal communication. A sense of ownership: you follow through, communicate clearly, and ask for help when you need it. Nice to have Experience in early-stage startups. Experience building B2B SaaS or enterprise software. Experience with RAG, evals, prompt/version management, LLM observability, agentic workflows, or human-in-the-loop systems. Experience with cloud infrastructure, DevOps, security, or compliance-heavy environments. Experience working directly with customers or customer-facing teams. What success looks like In your first months, you will have shipped useful improvements to our backend or AI product systems, built an understanding of our customers and architecture, and contributed to product quality and reliability. The scope of those contributions will reflect your experience. Over time, you will take on broader ownership and help shape how AI product engineering works at Nadifor. Let’s build something that matters. Send your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note about something you’ve built to careers@nadifor.ai. Include the role title in your subject line. Skip the cover letter.

items.desc: Description & Requirements Who we are looking for 📌 This is a future-oriented recruitment process. While we may not have an immediate opening, we're building a network of talented engineers interested in future opportunities with Deloitte. We expect demand to grow in the coming months, so we'd love to get to know great candidates in advance. We are looking for an experienced AI-native Full-Stack or Backend Engineer who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with advanced practical experience in AI-assisted and agentic development. You will work with clients, architects, product teams, and business stakeholders to turn complex and often ambiguous problems into production-ready solutions. AI-native engineering is a core capability of this role , with AI integrated across the SDLC while maintaining high standards of quality, security, and maintainability. The role is technology-agnostic. You should be comfortable working across different technology stacks, rapidly understanding unfamiliar systems, and selecting the right approach for the problem. Core Qualities: AI-native engineering You use AI and coding agents as an integral part of software engineering and understand the advanced practices required to make agentic development effective, reliable, and scalable across the SDLC. Technology-agnostic problem solving You have strong engineering fundamentals and can quickly become productive across unfamiliar languages, frameworks, platforms, and architectures. End-to-end ownership You take responsibility for outcomes across the complete lifecycle — from understanding the business problem and designing the solution to implementation, deployment, and production operation. Systems thinking You reason about complete systems, including applications, APIs, data, integrations, infrastructure, security, observability, and operational constraints. Customer-focused collaboration You work effectively with clients and multidisciplinary teams, translating ambiguous business needs into practical technical solutions and communicating decisions and trade-offs clearly. Curiosity and adaptability You enjoy solving unfamiliar problems, learning new technologies, and continuously improving how software is designed and delivered. Required experience and engineering capabilities: Advanced and proven experience designing, leading, and controlling agentic software development as a primary way of delivering complex software. You should be able to demonstrate how you structure the work of AI coding agents across the SDLC — providing them with the right specifications, context, tools, environments, orchestration, guardrails, and feedback mechanisms — to reliably deliver production-quality software while retaining engineering oversight and accountability. Approximately 5+ years of professional software engineering experience , preferably including consulting, client-facing engineering, solution engineering, or similar roles. Strong backend or full-stack engineering experience in one or more ecosystems such as Java, C#, Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go, or similar, combined with the ability to work effectively outside a primary technology stack. Experience designing and delivering APIs, integrations, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and data-intensive applications . Strong knowledge of relational and non-relational databases and experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. Strong understanding of software architecture, security, scalability, reliability, performance, and maintainability . Hands-on experience with Git, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, observability, and modern software delivery practices . Ability to independently investigate unfamiliar systems , operate effectively with incomplete or evolving requirements, and rapidly become productive in new technical environments. Strong problem-solving, client communication, and stakeholder-management skills , including the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences. Additional experience that will help you succeed: Frontend experience with React, Angular, Vue, or similar frameworks. Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, serverless architectures, microservices, and infrastructure as code. Knowledge of enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft platforms, Creatio, or comparable systems. Experience delivering AI agents, copilots, workflow automation, or intelligent enterprise applications. Familiarity with API management, enterprise integration platforms, event streaming, and advanced observability practices. Your future role Own solution delivery end-to-end: work directly with clients to understand business problems, design solutions, and deliver production-grade applications, services, APIs, integrations, and data solutions. Apply AI-native engineering across the SDLC: use advanced agentic development practices to accelerate discovery, design, implementation, testing, review, …

items.desc: Border is growing! We have an open position for a Junior Data Analyst (Big Data & AI) Border creates solutions that help people and businesses stay connected. We build digital products and provide expert consulting to prestigious clients, from our bright and sunny office by the river in Parque das Nações, Lisbon. The way data work is done has changed. At Border, analysts work alongside AI agents every day. Agents write much of the SQL, code and charts; people decide which questions matter, whether the numbers are right, and what they mean for the client. We’re looking for a junior who wants to learn data work this way, joining our data consulting team to build Big Data and AI solutions for our customers. What you’ll be doing Turning client questions into clear analysis plans, then carrying them out with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, notebooks with AI assistants or similar) Checking AI-generated queries, code and results: catching bad joins, missing data, wrong totals and misleading charts Exploring, cleaning and modelling large datasets, and building dashboards and visualizations that answer real business questions Helping build AI solutions for clients, from classic machine learning to LLM-based assistants and agents, and measuring whether they actually work Presenting findings to clients and teammates, clearly and honestly, including what the data can’t tell us Sharing what you learn about working with AI in our consulting team What you’ll need Responsibility and ownership: you own your results, including the queries and numbers an AI produced for you. If a number is wrong, it’s yours to find, fix and explain A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent proof of real data projects you’ve done Solid fundamentals: SQL, Python, basic statistics. You don’t need to know everything by heart, but you must be able to tell when an AI got it wrong Machine learning basics: how models are trained and evaluated, and common mistakes like overfitting and data leakage Hands-on experience using AI tools for data work, and examples you can show us (notebooks, repos, dashboards, how you worked) A critical, pragmatic eye: you sanity-check numbers before you trust them Clear communication in Portuguese (fluent) and English (good, spoken and written) Nice to have Big Data tools such as Spark or Databricks, and cloud data platforms Splunk: searching with SPL, building dashboards and analysing log and machine data A BI tool (Power BI, Tableau or similar) Experience building with LLMs: retrieval (RAG), agents, evaluating outputs How we hire You can use AI in our technical exercise. We’ll then ask you to walk us through your results, defend the numbers, and review a piece of AI-written analysis with us. What we offer Hybrid work model (remote + office) Above-market salary (according to experience) and productivity prizes Access to the latest AI tools Mentorship from senior consultants on judgment, not just tools Training and certifications, and lots of knowledge sharing Social and team-building events Fruit, coffee and snacks, a kitchenette, a leisure room (table tennis and snooker) and a nap room

items.desc: Buscamos talento apasionado por la IA (con ganas de aplicarla al mundo real) En Unnic AI llevamos la IA a empresas reales: analizamos sus procesos, diseñamos la solución y la construimos. Buscamos un/a desarrollador/a mid-junior que viva la IA más allá del trabajo: que pruebe cada modelo nuevo el día que sale y que disfrute de verdad haciendo que las cosas funcionen. Híbrido en Sant Cugat del Vallès (Barcelona) · 28.000–35.000 € brutos/año · Equipo técnico Qué vas a hacer Montar flujos de trabajo con IA para clientes: agentes, automatizaciones (n8n o código propio), RAG e integraciones con sus sistemas (ERP, CRM, documentación interna). Desarrollar aplicaciones web full-stack y productos con IA para el análisis de datos. Prototipar rápido: pasar de la idea a algo que funciona en días, no en meses. Llevar esos prototipos a producción con APIs, despliegue, evaluación y control del gasto en tokens. Probar herramientas, modelos y frameworks nuevos y contarle al equipo cuáles merecen la pena. Trabajar codo con codo con consultoría para dimensionar proyectos y explicar al cliente qué se puede hacer y qué no. Lo que buscamos 1–3 años desarrollando full-stack en proyectos de cliente que están en producción. Un ciclo formativo (DAM/DAW) nos vale igual que una carrera. TypeScript/JavaScript con soltura en el back (Node.js) y en el front (React o similar). Python suficiente para automatizar cosas y trabajar con datos. Si sabes algo de Go, mejor. Experiencia real con APIs de LLMs (Claude, OpenAI, modelos open source) y conceptos como prompting, tool use, embeddings y RAG. Te manejas bien con Linux, la terminal, Git y Docker. Con n8n o cloud (AWS, Cloudflare), mejor. Español y catalán para hablar con clientes, e inglés fluido para leer documentación y papers. No necesitas cumplirlo todo. Si encajas en buena parte y tienes ganas de aprender el resto, escríbenos. Lo que de verdad nos importa Los años de experiencia cuentan menos que esto: Tienes proyectos propios con el código publicado, y no solo para el porfolio: una web para tu juego favorito, un CLI que usas a diario o un juego multijugador hecho con amigos. Has configurado tu entorno a tu medida: dotfiles, Vim/Neovim, tmux, quizá Nix. Si además tienes algo autoalojado, ya nos caes bien. Te has montado tu propio agente, bot o automatización porque te apetecía, no porque te lo pidieran. Cuidas la experiencia de quien usa lo que construyes: que sea ágil e intuitivo, no solo que funcione. Sigues lo que sale cada semana (modelos, papers, repos) y tienes opinión propia sobre ello. Te picas con un problema hasta resolverlo y luego lo explicas para que el resto aprenda. Si al leer esto has pensado en un proyecto tuyo, enséñanoslo. Lo que te ofrecemos 28.000–35.000 € brutos/año según experiencia. Híbrido en Sant Cugat: 3-4 días de oficina a la semana para construir en equipo y el resto en remoto. [Ticket restaurante / tarjeta de comida de X €/día] . Acceso a los mejores modelos y herramientas de IA, sin pedir permiso para probarlos. Proyectos variados con clientes reales: cada pocas semanas, un problema distinto. Un equipo pequeño donde tu trabajo se ve y tus ideas se prueban. Tiempo para aprender y compartir lo que descubres. Cómo aplicar Mándanos tu CV a alba@unnic.ai, sobre todo, algo que hayas construido: un repo, una demo, un vídeo o un post. Cuéntanos en dos líneas qué es lo más friki que has hecho con IA.

items.desc: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this? Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier. Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust. Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them. We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 10x YoY. The Role We’re looking for an AI Ops Engineer to build the internal systems that help Kernel scale without adding unnecessary manual work. You’ll work across GTM, Marketing, Customer Success and Operations - finding the highest-leverage problems and building practical AI-powered workflows. This is a hands-on builder role. You’ll take ideas from a vague business problem to a tool or workflow that people use, then maintain and improve it in production. You’ll choose the fastest sensible approach for each problem - coding agents, automation platforms, APIs, data pipelines or lightweight code. You’ll report to Arvin Ashrafi, Head of Finance & Operations , and partner closely with GTM, Marketing, and Customer Success leadership. What You’ll Be Doing Define how an AI-native company operates: help build Kernel’s internal playbook for using AI across GTM, Marketing, Customer Success and Operations Make our GTM team more productive: automate the repetitive work in prospecting, account research, meeting prep and CRM hygiene, so BDRs, AEs and Account Managers spend more time with customers Build internal tools and workflows: use coding agents, APIs, automation platforms, no-code tools or lightweight code Turn company data into operational leverage: connect and improve data across our systems, then put it to work in AI agents, proactive workflows and better decision-making Put AI agents to work across Kernel: give teams agents with the right context, tools and guardrails so they can move faster without sacrificing judgement or reliability Be Kernel’s own internal customer: deploy Kernel on Kernel’s CRM, improve our GTM data and turn what you learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering Level up the team: help colleagues become confident AI users, document what works and turn successful experiments into repeatable ways of working Your First 6 Months For your first six months, you’ll focus on our sales team. You’ll sit with our BDRs, AEs and Account Managers and learn how they work day to day. Then you’ll automate everything that doesn’t need a human. That means going deep on Salesforce and our GTM stack, and owning the RevOps workflows behind them. After that, you’ll bring the same approach to Marketing, Customer Success and Operations. What You Bring A track record of shipping: you’ve built tools, automations or AI workflows that people use every day, ideally inside a small, fast-moving startup. Around 2–5 years of experience is typical, but what you’ve built matters more than your years. Ex-founders welcome Experience inside a high-growth startup, or building your own, is highly desirable Curious about sales: you’re keen to learn how our BDRs and AEs work, and how Salesforce is set up, before you build for them AI-tool obsessed: you are constantly testing new models, agents, MCPs and workflows, and you have the judgement to turn them into reliable systems that people actually adopt Strong data instincts: you can turn fragmented, messy information into reliable workflows and create feedback loops that keep it trustworthy Can’t unsee inefficiency: you see the company as a connected system; when you find a broken or unnecessarily manual process, your instinct is to understand it, build the fix and make sure it sticks ⚠️ This role may not be for you if you: Prefer deep specialization over breadth: this role means switching between projects and teams, depending on business needs Prefer steady-state work over project-based sprints: priorities will shift as the business evolves Only want “strategic” work: you will personally build the tools, clean the data and fix the workflows ❌ This role is definitely not …

items.desc: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role Secure BJAK's AI-enabled products and agent workflows using third-party models. Focus on customer data shared with model providers, agent permissions, user data isolation, and prompt injection through uploaded documents and other untrusted content. What You Will Build Assess customer data sent to third-party model vendors, including minimization, vendor controls, retention, logging, and approved use. Design controls limiting AI agent permissions, tools, actions, and system access using least privilege and explicit authorization. Implement and test tenant and user data isolation across prompts, conversation history, retrieval, memory, and AI-connected services. Threat model and test prompt injection and indirect injection through uploaded documents, retrieved content, links, and other untrusted inputs. Partner with Product and Engineering on safe document ingestion, content handling, output validation, and approval for sensitive actions. Support SC TRM and BNM RMiT for AI technology risks, including assessments, third-party oversight, control evidence, and remediation. Build security tests, monitoring, and response procedures for AI misuse, data exposure, unauthorized actions, and vendor incidents. What We Look For Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, AI, or related field, or equivalent experience. 3+ years in application security, product security, security engineering, or AI system security. Experience implementing or owning SC TRM and BNM RMiT controls, technology risk, or regulatory control evidence. Understanding of third-party LLM integrations, model APIs, agent tools, RAG, and AI application architectures. Knowledge of prompt injection, indirect injection, cross-user data leakage, excessive agent permissions, and vendor data disclosure risks. Programming or scripting skills, preferably Python and TypeScript/Node.js, plus APIs and AWS or GCP. Able to collaborate with Product, Legal, Compliance, Data, and Engineering on practical controls and risk communication. Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

items.desc: Why Shipio How do you price moving a hospital's MRI scanner, a wind farm's gearbox, a lab full of delicate instruments or a high-value sculpture? Twenty-five years ago, getting an instant price for a parcel was hard. Now it barely registers at checkout. Shipio is building the infrastructure that does the same for complex goods, so including the logistics price in the sale of a turbine blade becomes as simple as adding postage to a T-shirt. Today every one of those prices rests on dozens of judgement calls about handling, equipment, packing, routing, customs and timing. A specialist operator with years of experience pieces each quote together in spreadsheets and email, and a complex quote can take days. Shipio handles all of that variety inside one system: a vertical AI that reasons through each job, a deterministic pricing engine that produces the price, and a payments rail that settles the transaction. Pricing appears wherever customers want to buy, and for logistics companies quoting stops being the bottleneck and starts driving growth. It's already in customers' hands. Design partners have been using the product for around six months, and we're backed by Fuel Ventures. Our customers are specialist logistics companies, usually between 20 and 200 people, in a market worth around £1.2 trillion that still runs largely on email and spreadsheets. Shipio earns a fee on the transactions that run through it. Our founder, Hugo, is an engineer by background and designed both the pricing algorithm and the vertical AI. Before Shipio he founded a tech-enabled specialist freight forwarder in fine art, which is where he saw the problem first-hand. You'd be one of the first two engineers, building the core team alongside him, with real ownership from your first week, share options in what you build, and work that goes straight into live quotes for customers. The role You make Shipio's vertical AI sharper with every supplier that joins. It already reasons like a senior specialist operator: it understands why each decision on a job is made and makes those calls itself, including on jobs it has never seen. You own it end to end, from the data it learns from through to its architecture, training, calibration and evaluation, working on some of the hardest data in any industry: large, unreliable and endlessly varied. You take features from idea to release yourself, generating the idea, planning the product, designing it, building it and shipping it, and you're accountable for the value it creates for customers. It's a role for an engineer who wants full ownership of complex delivery and wants to push an agentic way of building further. What you'll do Work with Hugo to learn the domain and turn the product strategy into a roadmap for the vertical AI. Improve how the system models cause and consequence in complex, real-world physical operations: why an operator chose one strategy over another, so it reasons its way to the right answer on unfamiliar jobs. Run the model lifecycle as one continuous process: data curation, anomaly detection, training and calibration, evaluation, generalisation and feedback loops. Own the architecture of the vertical AI and how it works with the deterministic pricing engine. Maintain the tests and evaluation that prove the output is right, because prices and payments depend on it. Shape the agentic pipeline the whole team builds with: new agents, sharper checks and faster loops. What you'll bring Models you have built and shipped on highly variable, messy real-world data. A strong engineering mindset and a good head for numbers. End-to-end ownership of model architecture and calibration, rather than one stage of it. An agentic way of building. You read code closely and understand architecture properly, while much of the day-to-day build runs through AI agents. Product sense: you generate the ideas and plan the product as well as build it. Based in the UK and able to spend regular days in London. Nice to have Specialist logistics experience from the inside; logistics tech, freight or pricing systems; anomaly detection on operational data; working across models from more than one provider; early-stage start-up experience. What we offer Share options: Meaningful share options from day one Working pattern: London office or UK remote, with regular days together in London Influence: A seat at the table, shaping the product, the architecture and how the next engineers are hired Start date: We're happy to work around notice periods for the right person How we hire We keep it short, every step shows you how we work, and we'll tell you where you stand at each one. A 30-minute conversation with our talent partner. It's recorded, so you only tell your story once. A conversation with Hugo, our founder: hear where Shipio is going and pressure-test it. A paid live build using your own AI tools on a real slice of the problem, then a review together. You'll see how we work, and we'll see how you think. References, …

items.desc:
Job Title
Data and AI Engineer 
 Job Description
 Enterprise Informatics is Philips' software business. Decisions about where to invest, which opportunities and accounts to prioritize, and how the business will perform depend on data from CRM, ERP, service, contracts and other enterprise systems. The Data and AI Engineer works at the intersection of business analysis, data analysis, data engineering and agentic AI. The role turns ambiguous business needs into well-defined analytical problems and scalable solutions, from data discovery and rapid prototyping through deployment and adoption. It is a hands-on technical role requiring direct work in Python and SQL, alongside the ability to explain methods, data quality and business implications to senior stakeholders. 
 Your role: 
 Partner with Services, Sales Operations, Marketing, Business Operations and other stakeholders to translate ambiguous business questions into well-defined analytical problems, challenge assumptions where needed, and communicate clear conclusions.
 Find, acquire, explore, integrate and prepare data from enterprise systems such as Salesforce, SAP and ServiceNow, ensuring appropriate data quality, lineage, security and governance.
 Analyze commercial, financial and operational data to explain performance and support recurring business cycles, including revenue and order-intake bridges, pipeline, backlog, installed base and variance analysis.
 Build and maintain curated datasets, Python/SQL data solutions, and semantic and metric layers on the Databricks Lakehouse and cloud platforms, with Azure preferred and AWS experience valued.
 Rapidly prototype and productionize agentic AI solutions that put trusted insights into business users' hands. Design agent tools and skills, curate semantic metadata, create evaluation suites, and use modern AI development harnesses and coding agents while maintaining sound Git, testing and CI/CD practices.
 Coordinate cross-functional data, analytics and AI initiatives from requirements through deployment, testing, validation and adoption, working effectively across business and technical teams.

About the Team

The OpenAI for Government AI Architect team partners with public sector organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with government agencies, public institutions, and partner organizations serving the government to identify where AI can advance critical missions, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, Security, Global Affairs, and specialist delivery teams to help public sector customers adopt advanced AI responsibly and effectively.

About the Role

As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will shape each customer's AI strategy and guide their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable mission impact.

You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate mission priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value. The Account Director leads the overall account strategy and relationship, while you lead the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production impact.

You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong public sector fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations.

This role is based in Munich or London. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

 - Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities.

 - Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, identity, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.

 - Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, building confidence in both the solution and its path to production.

 - Help customers navigate the security, compliance, governance, and deployment requirements that shape AI adoption in the public sector.

 - Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans.

 - Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, Chief Data and AI Officers, program leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders.

 - Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, security, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.

 - Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged.

 - Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable mission impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization.

 - Apply public sector and mission expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities.

 - Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.

 - Have guided complex organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable impact.

 - Have experience working with government agencies, public institutions, or government contractors and understand how mission priorities, security, compliance, governance, and procurement considerations shape technology adoption.

ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an experienced Data Engineer to join our Data team. You will build and scale our data pipelines, establish best practices, ensure data quality, and enable self-service data access across teams.

 - Own and streamline data pipelines from ingestion to delivery, ensuring they are reliable, scalable, and efficient.

 - Implement and maintain dbt best practices, data standards, and quality controls.

 - Build self-service tooling and write clear documentation to empower cross-functional teams (Engineering, Revenue Operations, Growth, and others) to independently meet their data needs.

 - Create AI agents to serve data questions for others




REQUIREMENTS

Demonstrated experience formalising and scaling data pipelines, ideally as one of the first or early data engineers on a growing team.

 - Expert knowledge of dbt (required).

 - Proficiency with tools across the modern data stack (Python, SQL, BI tools).

 - Strong infra fundamentals (Terraform or other infrastructure as code, GCP or other cloud providers)

 - Structured thinking; ability to simplify complex, messy data into clear structures.

 - Strong ability to understand varied stakeholder requirements and build generalised solutions.




LOCATION

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, Warsaw, New York.

You’ve worked hands-on with LLM-based systems, agentic workflows, and distributed architectures, and you understand that building something is only half the job — the other half is making sure it stays healthy after go-live. You bring deep experience in observability, incident management, and production reliability across cloud environments. You can spot drift in agentic application behavior before it becomes a customer escalation. You’ve operated in regulated or enterprise-grade settings where compliance, security posture, and operational governance aren’t optional. And you can translate that experience into standards, playbooks, and repeatable processes that a growing team can follow. You’re comfortable working across organizational boundaries — with delivery squads, engineering/ platform teams, and customers/ external partners — and you can hold your ground in a room full of architects who built the thing you now need to run. Concretely, that means: Handover model: Take care of what “production-ready” looks like when an FDE engagement transitions from Value Delivery to Value Operation. You own the handover framework — what needs to be in place before your team takes over. AI quality in production: Drift detection, performance benchmarking, guardrails validation, retraining triggers. The solutions we deploy use LLMs and agents — production quality assurance looks fundamentally different here than in classical software. Operational governance: Establish best practices for production security, data boundaries, and compliance across customer engagements. Work with other engineers to ensure the enterprise bar holds post-deployment and establish self-healing capabilities. Scalable operations: What works for one customer engagement needs to work for fifty. You’ll design the operational model to scale — tooling, automation, partner integration — so that every new go-live doesn’t require reinventing the wheel. You’ll work closely with the Knowledge & IP team to capture operational learnings and feed them back into the delivery lifecycle, so the next engagement starts stronger. Where you belong T&O is the engineering backbone of CIS Forward Deployed Engineering. Our mission: ensure quality, security, and lasting impact across AI engagements for SAP’s industry customers. You’ll sit in the Intelligent Operations pillar — the part of T&O that owns what happens after go-live. Deployed solutions stay healthy and improve. That’s the mandate. If you’ve spent your career at the intersection of SRE, AI systems, and enterprise operations — and you want to build something new rather than maintain something existing — this is the role. Deployment and delivery pipelines: CI/CD for production AI solutions across customer/SAP-managed BAIP environments. Updates, patches, and rollbacks need to be safe, repeatable, and fast — regardless of how many customer landscapes are in play. Infrastructure automation: What works manually for one engagement breaks at twenty. You’ll design the automation that provisions, configures, and maintains production environments at scale — including partner-operated landscapes. Reliability engineering: SLI/SLO frameworks tailored to AI-native solutions. Error budgets, incident response tooling, and post-mortem processes that feed back into platform improvements. Security and governance tooling: Automated compliance checks, access management, data boundary enforcement — baked into the platform, not bolted on. Work with Engineering Excellence to ensure the enterprise bar holds in every production environment. You’ll work closely with the Application Engineering team who operates the solutions day-to-day. They’re your primary customer — what you build determines how effectively they can do their job. Where you belong T&O’s mission: ensure quality, security, and lasting impact across AI engagements for SAP’s industry customers. The CTO Office defines how we build. T&O manages what CIS has built — ensuring every engagement is production-grade and reusable. Within that, Intelligent Operations owns what happens after go-live. You’re the person who builds the stage that the operations team performs on. Without the platform, there’s no scalable operations — just ad-hoc firefighting. This is a technical leadership role. You’ll mentor engineers, define platform standards, and shape the tooling strategy for a capability that’s being stood up now. You’ll work globally, across FDE squads and hubs, with external delivery partners, and with the BAIP platform teams when infrastructure questions need answers. If you’ve spent your career making platforms that other teams depend on — and you want to define what operational platform engineering looks like for enterprise AI — this is the role. items.desc: We are looking for an experienced Economy & Balancing Game Designer who can design, model, and tune the economies, progression, and reward systems of casual HTML5 games played by millions of people worldwide. As part of one of our multidisciplinary game development teams, you will design, model, balance, test, and iterate game economies from early concept through live operations. You understand that a great casual game economy is not just “generous” or “tight”: it paces progression, makes every reward feel earned, gives every purchase a clear purpose, and stays healthy for years. About CoolGames At CoolGames, we’re proud to be a leading international HTML5 game studio, working with some of the world’s biggest ‘Big Tech’ game platforms, such as Netflix, Discord, Facebook and Microsoft Play. We also work with famous games IP such as Battleship, Angry Birds and Monopoly. CoolGames is part of Keesing, the world’s largest Braintainment company. Keesing is a financially strong publisher of engaging sudokus, crosswords and many other puzzles & games with a presence in over 20 countries headquartered in The Netherlands. With the CoolGames HQ in Amsterdam, supported by our global remote teams, we offer market-competitive salaries, the chance to contribute to successful casual games that are played by millions and work directly with some of the biggest brands in the world. We believe in creativity, collaboration and delivering world-class gaming experiences, while giving you the choice to either join our Amsterdam studio or become part of our remote teams. If you want to grow your career in a profitable, internationally recognized company, work closely with world-famous partners and be part of a highly professional international team, CoolGames is the right place for you. About the role As an Economy & Balancing Game Designer at CoolGames, you take ownership of the economies inside our casual games: the sources, sinks, progression, and reward systems that decide how players earn, spend, and advance. You will design systems that are fun, fair, understandable, and commercially effective. And you own the outcome: not just the analysis behind the numbers, but the retention and revenue they produce. You will be part of a multidisciplinary agile team. Together, you will work on new titles, improve existing live games, and help shape the models, tools, and processes that make good economy design scalable across our portfolio. Because our games run on a range of platforms with different monetization models, you know how to make an economy work whether it is driven by in-app purchases, ads, or a subscription platform. On new games you are involved from the very first design sessions, so that the economy, its sinks, and its progression are designed in from the start rather than balanced after the game has been built. On live games you take the economy apart per title, in enough depth to say what a change will do before it ships, and you model and simulate that change rather than shipping it and reading the result afterwards. You are comfortable working both creatively and analytically. You can feel when a progression curve or a reward loop is right, but you also know how to validate that instinct through models, simulations, A/B tests, and player data. About You You are proactive and thrive on taking ownership and responsibility. You care deeply about how players feel when they play, and you know that a healthy economy and a great player experience are the same goal, not a trade-off. You know how to design systems that motivate without manipulating, monetize without frustrating, and reward without devaluing progress. If you are: An experienced Economy, Systems or Balancing Game Designer Ready to work on long-lasting casual titles, and to move between them when needed A strong believer in teamwork Are not afraid of innovation and learning new tools on the go Then you are on the right track to be a great match with Coolgames. Responsibilities Design and balance the economy, progression, and reward systems of our casual games, from the first design sessions of a new title through live operations Own the revenue outcome of the economies you design Build and maintain the economy models, balancing sheets, and simulations for each title, in enough depth to say what a change will do before it ships. items.desc: Who we are Software Improvement Group (SIG) helpt organisaties grip te houden op de software waar hun business op draait. Ons platform Sigrid® bestaat uit twee delen. Beide zijn gebouwd op ’s werelds grootste benchmark voor softwarekwaliteit, met meer dan 40.000 systemen en ruim 600 miljard regels code, en op ruim 25 jaar ervaring in het enige ISO/IEC 17025-geaccrediteerde lab voor softwarekwaliteit ter wereld. Samen met onze consultants vertalen we die inzichten naar strategisch en praktisch advies, zodat technologie een aanjager van succes is in plaats van een bron van risico. Onze klanten zijn grote (internationale) ondernemingen, financiële instellingen en overheidsorganisaties. Zij vertrouwen op SIG om softwarekwaliteit structureel onderdeel te maken van de manier waarop ze hun IT-landschap besturen. Where you come in Als Senior Delivery Consultant zorg je ervoor dat onze grootste klanten Sigrid succesvol inbedden in hun organisatie. Sigrid is geen tool die je even installeert: het is complexe software voor kwaliteitsmanagement die raakt aan de ontwikkelstraat, de architectuur, de securityprocessen en de besluitvorming van een organisatie. Jij leidt die implementaties van begin tot eind: van kick-off en technische onboarding tot training, rapportage en de borging van softwarekwaliteit in de werkwijze van de klant. Of Sigrid nu als SaaS-oplossing wordt afgenomen of on-premise in de eigen infrastructuur van de klant draait, jij zorgt dat het project slaagt. Dat maakt het werk uitdagend en cutting edge. Na de implementatie draag je de klant over aan de Customer Success Manager, die de langetermijnrelatie voortzet. Je bent de projectleider: je bewaakt planning, scope en budget, managet risico’s en afhankelijkheden, en sluit aan op de governance van de klant, zoals stuurgroepen, security- en compliance-eisen en beheerprocessen. The opportunity We are seeking an experienced Cloud Security Architect to help define and implement next generation of secure Cloud platforms, data-driven solutions, and enterprise digital services. This role combines expertise in Cloud architecture and Cloud security. You will work closely with engineering, security, data, compliance, and product teams to establish secure architectural standards, reusable Cloud patterns, as well as modern software delivery practices that enable innovation while maintaining strong governance and compliance. As a technical leader, you will define reference architectures, mentor engineering teams, and drive modernization initiatives across Cloud infrastructure, and software delivery platforms. Your key responsibilities Design secure Cloud architectures in Microsoft Azure or Amazon AWS. Lead and support migration initiatives from On-Premises to Cloud. Establish modern CI/CD practices, including repository governance, branching strategies, pull request workflows, automated testing, release controls, and deployment approvals. Define and maintain Infrastructure as Code standards using Terraform, Bicep or ARM. Partner with engineering teams to deliver reusable templates, secure pipelines, and reference Cloud architecture. Conduct architecture and design reviews, identifying risks and recommending secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions. Collaborate with Cloud, security, AI, data, quality engineering, compliance, and product teams. Mentor engineers and contribute to the adoption of engineering best practices across cloud, security, DevOps, and infrastructure domains. Liaise with cyber leadership to review and implement security requirements across cloud platforms. Enforce security baselines, benchmarks, and standards across critical cloud infrastructure. Manage custom cloud infrastructure lifecycle. Skills and attributes for success Bachelor’s Degree in IT / Computer Science / Computer Engineering / Cybersecurity / Information Systems or relevant discipline. At least 3 years of experience in design of solutions in Microsoft Azure or Amazon AWS Cloud. Strong Cloud security expertise, including EntraID, RBAC, hardening, networking, encryption, secrets management, logging and monitoring. Strong knowledge of network segregation, private endpoints, firewalls, virtual networks, controlled egress, and runtime isolation. Experience with Terraform, ARM or Bicep for infrastructure provisioning and Cloud architecture enablement. Experience with Azure Policies, SCPs, OPA policies Experience with containers, Kubernetes, Azure Container Apps, Azure Functions, or similar runtime platforms. Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Advanced Security, code scanning, secret scanning, dependency scanning, or policy-as-code. Understanding of secure software delivery, release controls, traceability, and audit-ready engineering practices. Ability to work hands-on with engineers while also setting architecture direction and technical standards. Fluent or native English required – C1 / CAE certification preferred AI proficiency at business and personal level (Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT) To qualify for the role, you must have Experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale Landing Zones in Azure or AWS environments. Strong understanding of Zero Trust architecture principles. Experience performing security architecture reviews, threat modeling, and cloud security risk assessments. Strong knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and standards such as NIST, CIS Benchmarks, ISO 27001, and GDPR. Experience implementing DevSecOps practices and integrating security controls throughout the software development lifecycle. Experience designing and securing multi-subscription or multi-account Cloud environments. Knowledge of cloud governance, guardrails, and security baseline implementation at enterprise scale. Experience with Cloud Landing Zone automation, platform engineering, and shared services architecture. Experience supporting audit, compliance, and regulatory requirements within Cloud environments. Demonstrated ability to drive Cloud transformation and modernization programs within large enterprise environments. Experience with security monitoring, incident response integration, and Cloud security operations practices. Ideally, you’ll also have Experience in Project Management or project coordination Experience in Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Defender for CloudApps, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or Microsoft Intune Experience in Zscaler, Crowdstrike, PrismaCloud or Wiz is a big plus Experience with sandboxed code execution, Python runtime environments, …

items.desc: Location London or remote within the UK Employment Type Full time Location Type Remote Department Engineering About Griffin Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences. We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more. We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies. Learn more about what we do Our culture We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible. We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life. We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified. Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers. Learn more about our culture. The team Infrastructure sits within the Craft function. We’re a small team of three - two engineers and an engineering manager - who work closely with our CTO and Founder, Allen Rohner. It’s our job to build the foundations that everything else at Griffin runs on: the systems, the tooling, the automation that helps us run a highly resilient and reliable platform and lets other teams ship fast. We're a software engineering team as much as an infrastructure team: we write the code that runs our platform, not just the configuration around it. When we start work, we explore multiple solutions before picking one. We write RFCs, build proof-of-concepts, and run experiments to validate approaches. Once we commit to building something, we care about maintainability more than cleverness, observability more than hoping it works, and scalability over premature optimisation. We take the necessary time to ship quality solutions rather than hitting arbitrary deadlines. Once something goes live, we refactor the rough edges rather than polish what's already working. The opportunity Day to day, you'll built and manage the infrastructure the bank runs on - both in the cloud and on our own hardware in third party data centres. This means running FoundationDB clusters and writing the software and tooling for hitless upgrades, managing Kubernetes, writing infrastructure as code in Pulumi and CDK, running the Bazel build farm, and owning the deployment pipeline from CI to production. Operational resilience is a big part of the job: replica clusters, multi-region failover, and chaos engineering to test how systems handle failures. Security access, CircleCI pipelines, DataDog integration, and cloud spend all fall under infrastructure too. On our roadmap currently is: building out our self-hosted infrastructure to support a hybrid-cloud setup and remove single-vendor reliance, improving how Kubernetes scales, improving the build farm, and building out our PKI infrastructure. We also have plans for a global HTTP routing layer to allow seamless failover between sites. Much of this is software we built ourselves, and you'll shape it from the first design through to production. Our infrastructure as code is written in TypeScript. Where it makes sense, tooling gets written in Clojure. There's some Rust too. What success looks like Infrastructure problems become production problems fast. Success here means thinking ahead - identifying issues with scale, security, or compliance before they affect services. You've eliminated an entire class of incidents by fixing the underlying architectural issue. You've proven the database and compute platform can handle 10x current traffic volumes by working with backend teams to stress-test it. You've cut deploy times in half by rethinking how the pipeline works. You've tested multi-region failover under realistic failure scenarios and it worked. You've shipped well-tested software that turns risky manual operations, like database upgrades, into routine, hitless ones that the whole team maintains with confidence. You've redesigned service discovery to …
