items.desc: Founding Engineer, Vertical AI Shipio Location: London or UK remote, with regular days together in London Package: Competitive salary plus meaningful share options from day one Why Shipio How do you price moving a hospital's MRI scanner, a wind farm's gearbox, a lab full of delicate instruments or a high-value sculpture? Twenty-five years ago, getting an instant price for a parcel was hard. Now it barely registers at checkout. Shipio is building the infrastructure that does the same for complex goods, so including the logistics price in the sale of a turbine blade becomes as simple as adding postage to a T-shirt. Today every one of those prices rests on dozens of judgement calls about handling, equipment, packing, routing, customs and timing. A specialist operator with years of experience pieces each quote together in spreadsheets and email, and a complex quote can take days. Shipio handles all of that variety inside one system: a vertical AI that reasons through each job, a deterministic pricing engine that produces the price, and a payments rail that settles the transaction. Pricing appears wherever customers want to buy, and for logistics companies quoting stops being the bottleneck and starts driving growth. It's already in customers' hands. Design partners have been using the product for around six months, and we're backed by Fuel Ventures. Our customers are specialist logistics companies, usually between 20 and 200 people, in a market worth around £1.2 trillion that still runs largely on email and spreadsheets. Shipio earns a fee on the transactions that run through it. Our founder, Hugo, is an engineer by background and designed both the pricing algorithm and the vertical AI. Before Shipio he founded a tech-enabled specialist freight forwarder in fine art, which is where he saw the problem first-hand. You'd be one of the first two engineers, building the core team alongside him, with real ownership from your first week, share options in what you build, and work that goes straight into live quotes for customers. The role You make Shipio's vertical AI sharper with every supplier that joins. It already reasons like a senior specialist operator: it understands why each decision on a job is made and makes those calls itself, including on jobs it has never seen. You own it end to end, from the data it learns from through to its architecture, training, calibration and evaluation, working on some of the hardest data in any industry: large, unreliable and endlessly varied. You take features from idea to release yourself, generating the idea, planning the product, designing it, building it and shipping it, and you're accountable for the value it creates for customers. It's a role for an engineer who wants full ownership of complex delivery and wants to push an agentic way of building further. What you'll do Work with Hugo to learn the domain and turn the product strategy into a roadmap for the vertical AI. Improve how the system models cause and consequence in complex, real-world physical operations: why an operator chose one strategy over another, so it reasons its way to the right answer on unfamiliar jobs. Run the model lifecycle as one continuous process: data curation, anomaly detection, training and calibration, evaluation, generalisation and feedback loops. Own the architecture of the vertical AI and how it works with the deterministic pricing engine. Maintain the tests and evaluation that prove the output is right, because prices and payments depend on it. Shape the agentic pipeline the whole team builds with: new agents, sharper checks and faster loops. What you'll bring Models you have built and shipped on highly variable, messy real-world data. A strong engineering mindset and a good head for numbers. End-to-end ownership of model architecture and calibration, rather than one stage of it. An agentic way of building. You read code closely and understand architecture properly, while much of the day-to-day build runs through AI agents. Product sense: you generate the ideas and plan the product as well as build it. Based in the UK and able to spend regular days in London. Nice to have Specialist logistics experience from the inside; logistics tech, freight or pricing systems; anomaly detection on operational data; working across models from more than one provider; early-stage start-up experience. What we offer Share options: Meaningful share options from day one Working pattern: London office or UK remote, with regular days together in London Influence: A seat at the table, shaping the product, the architecture and how the next engineers are hired Start date: We're happy to work around notice periods for the right person How we hire We keep it short, every step shows you how we work, and we'll tell you where you stand at each one. A 30-minute conversation with our talent partner. It's recorded, so you only tell your story once. A conversation with Hugo, our founder: hear where Shipio is going and …

items.desc: Data Scientist – Generative AI / Chatbot Utrecht, Netherlands | Hybrid | 36 hours per week | Contract until May 2027 Help shape the future of conversational AI at one of the Netherlands’ leading financial institutions. We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist specialising in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs) and chatbot optimisation for an exciting assignment within a major Dutch financial institution. This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of applied AI, improving how intelligent assistants understand context, retrieve information, reason and deliver accurate, relevant responses. Rather than developing foundation models from scratch, you will focus on making existing AI systems perform better — understanding why they behave as they do, identifying weaknesses and developing practical, measurable improvements. The Role Working alongside Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Product Managers and business stakeholders, you will evaluate and optimise GenAI-powered chatbot solutions. Your work will cover retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), contextual data, prompt optimisation, agent reasoning, tool calling and performance evaluation. Key responsibilities include: Analyse chatbot responses to identify weaknesses, inconsistencies and improvement opportunities. Investigate context gaps and improve how AI agents access and use information. Optimise RAG pipelines, retrieval strategies and contextual data structures. Develop evaluation frameworks to measure chatbot accuracy, relevance, reliability and effectiveness. Work closely with engineering teams to troubleshoot data ingestion, API integrations and information flows. Assess emerging GenAI capabilities and identify opportunities for practical implementation. Collaborate with product teams and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical improvements. Support continuous experimentation and improvements to AI assistant performance. What We're Looking For We are particularly interested in professionals with a strong analytical mindset who enjoy understanding and improving the behaviour of AI-powered applications. Essential experience: Medior to senior-level experience in Data Science, Applied AI or a closely related field. Practical experience working with LLM-based applications and Generative AI. Strong understanding of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Knowledge of prompt engineering, context windows, grounding and retrieval techniques. Experience evaluating LLM outputs and identifying causes of poor performance. Familiarity with APIs, structured and unstructured data, and data integration

Backend engineers who moved into AI at a lab, an applied-AI company or a Big Tech applied team and have shipped an LLM or agent system to real users, measured it in production and changed it when the numbers said so. You will be tasked with building one production AI system at a time for a Fortune 500 client inside a $1.8B applied-AI company (ex-Palantir founders, $202M raised) opening its London office: scope it with the client’s senior stakeholders, build it on the company’s internal LLM application platform, prove it with evals, run it, and feed what you learn back into the platform. Own the system: one production AI system live at the London client in six months, with evals, observability and a client lead who trusts it. Own the measure: an eval set built from real traffic, a published accuracy and cost baseline, and every change gated on it. Own the room: scope the next two builds directly with the client’s senior stakeholders, and ship reusable components back into the platform. THE ROLE: Production AI systems: agents, tool use, retrieval, prompting and the full-stack product around them; from prototype to a system a Fortune 500 runs Evaluation infrastructure: eval sets built from production traffic, segmentation by case type, LLM-as-judge with independent scoring, confidence intervals, regression gates before any prompt, model or routing change ships Autonomous loops: the shift from deterministic workflows to agentic systems that self-improve from transcripts, tickets and NPS; versioning of every component so configurations can be compared Enterprise estates: integration with client CRMs, EMRs, telco back ends and data platforms; security reviews, SOC 2, data residency; cost and latency ceilings Platform contribution: reusable infrastructure, tools and workflows returned to the internal LLM application platform for use across deployments Voice and real-time: streaming pipelines, speech models, model fallback and routing under rate limits Client ownership: 60% building, 40% with the client; scoping with C-level stakeholders, pushing back when the brief is wrong, reframing the problem AI-native workflow: coding agents (Claude Code) used daily, with judgement about what they produce Languages and tools: Python first; TypeScript for product surfaces; AWS, GCP or Azure; evals, observability and CI/CD as standard Delivery: one 3-month build at a time, two or three concurrent across a long client relationship; works with AI strategists, architects, a Founding Data Scientist and the Head of Engineering Seniority: Senior / Staff (IC) Industry: Applied AI, Enterprise Software, AI Transformation Employment Type: Full-time, permanent Skills: Python, LLM systems, AI agents, Tool use, RAG and retrieval, Evaluation frameworks, LLM-as-judge, Observability, Prompt engineering, System architecture, Enterprise integration, Streaming and voice, Claude Code, AWS/GCP/Azure, Client-facing delivery

Bei uns trifft technologische Exzellenz auf eine starke menschliche Kultur – gemeinsam schaffen wir so messbare Erfolge für unsere Kunden. Das erwartet Dich Deine Benefits: Moderne Büros in Toplage in München und Frankfurt Flexibles Hybrid Working mit der Möglichkeit Deine Arbeitszeiten individuell auf Deine Bedürfnisse anzupassen Unsere Devoteam Academy bietet Dir ein großes Angebot an zertifizierten Trainings und Sprachkursen Internationale Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten für Deinen Karriereboost bei Devoteam Get-Together Partys und Teamevents für den regelmäßigen Austausch und Spaß mit Deinen Kollleg:innen Mitarbeiter:innen-Prämien beim Werben von neuen Mitarbeiter:innen Moderne IT-Ausstattung - Wähle aus einer Vielzahl von Möglichkeiten das für Dich passende Produkt Corporate Benefits mit großer Auswahl an zahlreichen Angeboten für nahezu jeden Bereich Stellenbeschreibung Darauf richtest du deinen Fokus: End-to-End KI-Entwicklung: Du entwirfst, baust und überführst LLM-Anwendungen, RAG-Systeme und Agenten (z. B. mit Amazon Bedrock und SageMaker) vom Prototyp in den produktiven Betrieb. KI-Integration & Architektur: Du bettest die KI-Komponenten passgenau in die Systemlandschaft der Kunden ein und klärst Aspekte wie Datenzugriff, Anbindung und den späteren Betrieb. MLOps & Pipeline-Aufbau: Du entwickelst automatisierte Deployments, Modellversionierung, Rollback-Strategien und überwachst kontinuierlich Latenz, Kosten sowie Modellqualität. Beratung & Use-Case-Evaluierung: Du bewertest KI-Vorhaben gemeinsam mit IT und Fachbereichen und berätst ehrlich zur technischen und wirtschaftlichen Machbarkeit. KI-Compliance & Qualitätssicherung: Du machst die Modell-Qualität messbar und sorgst für Nachvollziehbarkeit, die aktuellen Richtlinien (wie EU AI Act und ISO 42001) standhält. Teamwork & Wissenstransfer: Du arbeitest eng im Team sowie mit den Kunden zusammen und teilst dein Wissen aktiv in Code Reviews und internen Sessions. Qualifikationen Das bringst Du mit: Praxiserfahrung: 1 bis 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung. Entscheidend ist, dass du bereits KI-Lösungen gebaut hast, die über ein reines Notebook hinausgingen und produktiv von anderen genutzt wurden. Tech-Stack: Du programmierst sicher in Python und bist in mindestens einem relevanten Framework (z. B. PyTorch, Hugging Face oder LangChain) wirklich zu Hause. Cloud-Kenntnisse: Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit AWS, idealerweise speziell mit Amazon Bedrock oder SageMaker. Sprachen: Deutsch auf mindestens C1-Niveau für die Kundenprojekte sowie gutes Englisch für die Dokumentation und den internationalen Austausch. Wünschenswert: Erfahrung im Fine-Tuning oder dem Betrieb eigener KI-Modelle. Kenntnisse im Data Engineering sowie im Umgang mit Containern und CI/CD. Ein fachlicher Schwerpunkt in Bereichen wie Computer Vision, NLP oder Zeitreihenanalyse. Praktische Erfahrung in regulierten Branchen mit strengen Vorgaben zur Nachvollziehbarkeit. AWS-Zertifizierungen im AI/ML-Umfeld. Beiträge in der Tech-Community durch Open Source, Publikationen oder Vorträge. Zusätzliche Informationen Melde Dich bei unserem Recruiting Team! Durch unsere offene Unternehmenskultur legen wir großen Wert darauf, Menschen die Chance zu geben, sich zu bewerben, auch wenn nicht alle spezifischen Fähigkeiten der Stellenbeschreibung erfüllt werden. items.desc: Why we’re opening this position Claims handling has been the biggest pain point in insurance for decades. For insurers, the direct and indirect cost runs to 800B every year. For customers, it's the #1 driver of dissatisfaction. Insurers and brokers alike all agree AI will solve this, but they can't scale it. Nor are the generic AI workflow vendors any match for the messy reality of claims handling. As Warren Buffett put it himself: "insurance always looks easier than it is". Ellis was founded by insurtech veterans who have built and scaled fully automated AI claims handling. We're now building the leading vertical AI solution for it - designed from the ground up to integrate with systems no API can touch, and to reach human-grade accuracy in weeks instead of years . Doing this requires building one of the most sophisticated back-office automation products anywhere, where AI autonomy meets the complex reality of insurance claims. It requires redefining what AI engineering can actually do. Ellis is supported by top tier investors and successful business angels such as the founders of french unicorn Qonto and belgian unicorn Aikido. The position itself As a Founding AI Engineer, you own the thing our entire business is built on: a product that does in weeks what the rest of the industry needs quarters - or years - to deliver. Most companies in our space are still fighting to hit human-grade accuracy and reliability at all. We've cracked that. Your job is to make it repeatable, scalable, and fast to deploy - turning a hard technical edge into a durable business advantage. On the one hand, this means building the engine that powers every deployment: Shipping new features to our core AI engine - the models, pipelines, and logic that turn raw client processes into working solutions. Designing and building the agent s that do the heavy lifting: extracting data, making decisions, taking action, and catching their own mistakes. Owning the data layer - ingestion, storage, schema design, and the databases everything else reads and writes to. Building the infrastructure an agentic system needs to run reliably in production: orchestration, monitoring, evals, and the tooling to debug when something goes wrong. Every step of the way, you're: Working closely with the business team to translate what clients need into concrete product requirements. In the trenches, working side by side with the founders. Using AI to speed up your own process - We expect you to harness that power to speed up delivery. But on the other hand - and more importantly - you're the one making the calls that a senior/staff engineer would make at any other company, on day one: Architecture : you're not implementing someone else's design - you're deciding how the system is structured, what gets built vs. bought, and what the stack looks like a year from now. Security : as owner of the data layer and infra, you're responsible for how client data is handled, stored, and protected - there's no separate security team to hand this off to. Infrastructure & scale : the production, monitoring, and deployment decisions you make now are the difference between a system that scales 10x and one that falls over at 2x. Shaping the company vision: to your left and to your right, the business and delivery teams will rely on your technical judgment to set their roadmaps. Who we’re looking for: If you're excited by now, it's already a good sign. When it comes to your competencies: Deep technical fluency and genuine engineering craft - you don't just ship code, you understand why it works. This should be evidenced by a master's degree or above in a technical field (CS, Mathematics, or related), or equivalent hands-on experience. Experience building complex platforms - systems with real architectural depth, not just CRUD apps or thin wrappers around APIs, including experience building LLM-powered systems based on agent frameworks (LangGraph, ADK, or similar). Strong software engineering fundamentals, with deep proficiency in Python and solid grasp of API design (REST/gRPC), Git, and CI/CD. Experience with cloud infrastructure and production systems - deploying, monitoring, and debugging services at scale (GCP, Docker, and Terraform are all pluses). Bonus points if you've had exposure to the financial services industry, fast-paced start-ups, or if you've founded your own business before. When it comes to your approach to the job: A strong sense of ownership , work ethic, and a low-ego mindset: at Ellis, the best idea always wins, not the loudest voice. Excitement for open-ended problems without predetermined solutions. You've got all the support you need, but you're the one who makes the magic happen. Comfortable owning ambiguity: fast-moving priorities, evolving requirements, and problems with no textbook answer. You take your job seriously but not yourself - what's the point of all this if we're not having fun? What we offer in exchange Beyond working on one of the most …

items.desc: Suntem la începutul unei inițiative de AI Analytics într-unul dintre cele mai mari grupuri farmaceutice din România și construim capabilități AI care vor fi folosite pe date reale, la scară enterprise, pentru decizii reale de business. Vei avea ocazia să contribui pe întregul traseu, de la problemă la producție: date → AI → evaluare → API-uri → deployment → monitorizare → impact , folosind și extinzând arhitectura și componentele deja existente, cu suport și review tehnic senior. Ce vei construi: AI Assistants & Natural Language Analytics Soluții care permit utilizatorilor să pună întrebări despre vânzări, profit, stocuri și indicatori operaționali și să primească răspunsuri bazate pe datele companiei. RAG & Enterprise AI Pipeline-uri de retrieval, vector search, grounding și mecanisme prin care răspunsurile AI sunt ancorate în surse verificabile. AI Agents & Automation Workflow-uri AI care pot utiliza tool-uri, accesa sisteme interne și automatiza procese care astăzi necesită intervenție manuală. Data Integration, Reconciliation & Automation Fluxuri pentru integrarea, reconcilierea și validarea datelor din surse multiple, precum și automatizarea proceselor care susțin rapoartele și aplicațiile AI. Predictive & Data Analytics Vei contribui, cu suport și review tehnic senior, la dezvoltarea unor soluții de forecasting, detectarea anomaliilor, optimizarea stocurilor și alte probleme cu impact direct asupra businessului. AI Evaluation & Reliability Nu ne interesează doar dacă „răspunde”. Ne interesează cât de corect răspunde . Vei construi test sets, guardrails, evaluări automate și umane, validări cu sursa de adevăr și mecanisme de monitorizare. Production AI Engineering Vei transforma prototipurile în servicii robuste, scalabile și monitorizabile, cu atenție la latență, cost, securitate, observability și data quality . Tech stack Python · SQL · REST APIs · OpenAI / Azure OpenAI · RAG · Vector Databases · ETL/ELT · Relational Databases · Git În funcție de proiect, vei lucra și cu Azure/AWS/GCP, Docker, BI platforms, ML, agentic workflows și document AI/OCR . Ce căutăm: Căutăm un AI Engineer cu experiență reală de software engineering , nu doar experiență de prototyping. Dacă ești confortabil cu: Python și SQL; API-uri și integrarea serviciilor AI; date reale, inconsistente și volume mari; integrarea, reconcilierea și validarea datelor provenite din surse multiple; RAG, embeddings și vector search; testing, evaluation și monitoring; debugging și optimizarea aplicațiilor; transformarea unei probleme de business într-o soluție tehnică. 3+ ani experiență în Software Engineering, Data Engineering, BI sau AI reprezintă baza de la care pornim. Nu este obligatoriu să fii expert în toate tehnologiile de mai sus. Ne interesează mai mult profunzimea tehnică, capacitatea de a învăța și ce ai construit efectiv . Este binevenit sa fi lucrat in Claude Code / Codex. De ce merită? Pentru că nu vei intra într-un proiect în care primești o componentă bine definită și atât. Vei intra într-o echipă care construiește o nouă capabilitate AI de la început . Vei avea acces la: volume mari de date operaționale și comerciale; probleme reale de business; infrastructură și componente AI deja existente; suport și review tehnic senior; libertatea de a propune soluții și îmbunătățiri tehnice, în cadrul arhitecturii și componentelor existente; contact direct cu echipele BI, IT și business; posibilitatea de a vedea soluțiile pe care le construiești ajungând efectiv în producție. Succesul nu îl măsurăm în numărul de modele sau linii de cod. Îl măsurăm în cât de mult timp economisim, cât de bune devin analizele și cât de mult se schimbă modul în care oamenii iau decizii. Dacă te atrage ideea de a construi AI systems, nu doar AI demos, hai să vorbim!

items.desc: Role Description At Tata Technologies we make product development dreams a reality by designing, engineering and validating the products of tomorrow for the world’s leading manufacturers. Due to our continued growth we are now recruiting for an AI Engineer to be based at our customer site in Gaydon. Our Embedded Systems Solutions department (ESS) encompasses all activities outlined under the Automotive SPICE (ASPICE) process framework, including systems engineering, software engineering, coding, and all levels of functional testing. Beyond core development, ESS also integrates critical supporting processes such as project management, risk assessment, functional safety, and cybersecurity, ensuring compliance with ASPICE standards and delivering reliable, secure, and high-quality embedded systems & solutions. Role Summary Tata Technologies is looking for a hands-on AI / GenAI Application Engineer to design, develop, enhance and scale enterprise AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs) and the Databricks AI ecosystem. Dimension Of Function The successful candidate will work on existing AI solutions as well as new use cases, taking responsibility for application development, integration, maintenance, troubleshooting and scalability. The role requires strong Python software engineering skills combined with practical experience developing LLM-based applications and working with cloud platforms such as Azure and AWS. The engineer will help transition AI solutions from early-stage implementations and proofs of concept into robust, maintainable and scalable applications. Areas Of Responsibility AI / GenAI Application Development Design, develop and enhance LLM-based applications and AI agents using models available through Databricks. Develop reusable AI application components and workflows using Python. Build new AI capabilities and enhance existing GenAI use cases based on business and engineering requirements. Develop agent-based solutions capable of integrating multiple tools, APIs and enterprise data sources. Support model-agnostic application architectures where different LLMs can be adopted as needed. Existing Application Maintenance & Enhancement Take ownership of existing AI applications and associated Python components. Maintain, troubleshoot and enhance current solutions. Analyse application issues and implement appropriate fixes and improvements. Refactor existing code to improve maintainability, reliability and scalability. Manage technical improvements as solutions mature from prototype into production-oriented applications. Support feature enhancements and onboarding of new AI use cases. Python & Backend Engineering Develop high-quality, modular and maintainable Python code. Develop backend application components and APIs supporting AI functionality. Implement appropriate exception handling, logging, configuration and testing. Conduct debugging, code optimisation and peer code reviews. Develop automated tests for business-critical AI application components. items.desc: Vill du arbeta i teknikens absoluta framkant och skapa AI-lösningar som gör verklig skillnad? Som AI Engineer hos oss på Länsförsäkringar får du vara med och utveckla robusta, skalbara och användarvänliga AI-system som stöttar både våra kunder och medarbetare. Hos oss blir du en del av ett innovativt team där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och teknisk nyfikenhet står i centrum. Inom avdelningen Data & AI skapar vi nya möjligheter till proaktiva kundmöten och sömlösa helhetslösningar. Här kan du växa, utvecklas och vara med och bygga framtiden, på riktigt. Om jobbet Som AI Engineer med fokus på generativ AI blir du en nyckelperson i vårt tvärfunktionella spjutspetsteam inom Data & AI. Vi bygger lösningar från ax till limpa och arbetar med hela livscykeln – från idé och arkitektur till utveckling, driftsättning och vidareutveckling. En av våra mest centrala plattformar är vår interna GPT-lösning, som används av över 6000 medarbetare för att effektivisera arbetsflöden, beslutsfattande och kunskapsdelning. Du kommer framför allt att arbeta inom tre områden: Generativ AI och språkmodeller Utveckla lösningar baserade på språkmodeller, RAG och agentteknik. Du arbetar bland annat med prompt engineering, tool calling och agentramverk och gör tekniska avvägningar kring kvalitet, kostnad, prestanda och säkerhet. Data och backend Bygga robusta backend- och datalösningar som gör AI-applikationerna skalbara och användbara. Det innefattar bland annat API, datapipelines, databaser och integrationer mot andra system. Operationalisering Säkerställa att våra AI-lösningar fungerar stabilt och säkert i produktion. Du arbetar med deployment, CI/CD, observability, monitorering, prestanda och åtkomsthantering samt krav på säkerhet och dataskydd. Vår teknikstack Språk: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript Databaser: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis Frontend: React.js, Tailwind, DaisyUI API Gateway: Nginx Plattform: Azure Container Apps – planeras för Kubernetes Backend: FastAPI, Celery Lokal utvecklingsmiljö: Docker Compose, WSL, VS Code med GitHub Copilot CI/CD: Azure DevOps IaC: Bicep Teknikstacken utvecklas kontinuerligt och vi förväntar oss inte att du kan allt. Det viktiga är en stark teknisk grund och förmågan att snabbt sätta dig in i nya tekniker. För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har: flera års erfarenhet av mjukvaru- och backendutveckling, gärna med Python praktisk erfarenhet av generativ AI och LLM-baserade lösningar, exempelvis RAG eller agentlösningar erfarenhet av att designa tekniska lösningar och fatta arkitekturella beslut erfarenhet av molnplattformar, containerisering och CI/CD god förståelse för API, databaser och distribuerade system erfarenhet av att bygga och driftsätta lösningar i produktion förståelse för säkerhet, skalbarhet och observability förmåga att självständigt driva tekniska initiativ från problem till färdig lösning. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av: vector search, embeddings och vektordatabaser agentramverk och avancerade LLM-arkitekturer Kubernetes och IaC, exempelvis Bicep MLOps/LLMOps AI-säkerhet och guardrails asynkron programmering, exempelvis Celery att coacha andra utvecklare eller etablera tekniska arbetssätt Även frontendkunskaper är meriterande, men inget krav. Som person är du nyfiken, självgående och trygg i din tekniska kompetens. Du trivs med komplexa problem där lösningen inte alltid är given och kan göra kvalificerade tekniska avvägningar. Som senior ingenjör tar du ansvar för helheten, delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och kan kommunicera tekniska frågeställningar med både tekniska och icke-tekniska målgrupper. Om oss Vi står inför en omfattande utveckling inom data och AI – ett initiativ som kommer att påverka både vår organisation och vår bransch under lång tid framöver. Just nu bygger vi ett AI center of excellence, där vi tar fram gemensamma plattformar och riktlinjer för hela Länsförsäkringsgruppen, driver på användningen av nya AI-lösningar och säkerställer återanvändbarhet. Genom detta center stärker vi både lokal innovation och gemensamt lärande, samtidigt som vi ökar kunskap och kompetens i hela organisationen. Som AI-arkitekt tillhör du vår avdelning Data & AI, men får också breda kontaktytor över hela Länsförsäkringar. Vi är ett av Sveriges ledande företag inom bank, försäkring och fondliv, och vi satsar stort på digitalisering och innovation. Här får du möjlighet att växa och utvecklas tillsammans med engagerade kollegor, samtidigt som du bidrar till att stärka hela vår affär. Il profilo ideale ha: Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica, Intelligenza Artificiale o formazione equivalente e affine; Esperienza pregressa nello sviluppo sw o su progetti di AI; Ottima conoscenza di Python; Buona conoscenza e utilizzo dei sistemi Linux; Conoscenza di Docker per la containerizzazione delle applicazioni; Conoscenza di React per lo sviluppo di interfacce web; Esperienza nell’utilizzo di strumenti di AI a supporto dello sviluppo, come Codex, Skills e Plugin; Esperienza nell’integrazione di modelli OpenAI in soluzioni RAG e OCR; Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese (almeno B2); Ottime capacità organizzative, comunicative e di lavoro in team. 📍 Sede: Torino – Possibilità di lavoro in modalità ibrida settimanale. 💸 Proponiamo un iniziale contratto (in apprendistato/tempo indeterminato) con RAL compresa tra 26.000 - 29.000 euro, oltre a: Buoni pasto; Piattaforma fringe benefit; Accesso alla piattaforma E-Learning per la tua formazione continua. 🔮 Cosa succede dopo aver inviato la tua candidatura: Il primo step prevede un colloquio conoscitivo/motivazionale con il Team HR e un successivo incontro tecnico, dedicato ad approfondire gli aspetti progettuali e le competenze tecniche richieste dalla posizione. Se ti riconosci nel profilo e vuoi lavorare nel mondo dell’ AI e dello Sviluppo Software , candidati e parliamone! 🚀 La ricerca è rivolta a candidati appartenenti ad entrambi i sessi (L. 903/77). Si richiede di includere l'autorizzazione al trattamento dei dati personali ai sensi del Regolamento UE n. 679/2016 (GDPR).

items.desc: ¿Te imaginas participando en la transformación de las principales organizaciones nacionales e internacionales? En Deloitte estamos comprometidos con generar un impacto en la sociedad, en nuestros clientes y en ti. En Deloitte, sabemos que la mejor forma de afrontar los retos del entorno es a través del mejor talento, por eso buscamos personas con pasión por la innovación tecnológica y la transformación de los negocios. Desde nuestro equipo de Inteligencia Artificial (IA) buscamos incorporar un/a Senior Delivery Consultant – AI, Data & Azure para participar en proyectos de alto impacto relacionados con Inteligencia Artificial, Generative AI, Machine Learning y plataformas de datos cloud sobre Microsoft Azure. Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar en proyectos desafiantes y dinámicos, diseñando e implementando soluciones avanzadas de IA para clientes enterprise, colaborando con equipos multidisciplinares y participando en iniciativas end-to-end, desde el discovery hasta el delivery. ¿Cómo será tu día a día? Diseñar arquitecturas cloud escalables y seguras para soluciones de IA, Machine Learning, Generative AI y analítica avanzada sobre Azure. Participar en el desarrollo e implantación de soluciones con Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure ML, Databricks, Synapse/Fabric, Data Lake, AKS o Container Apps. Diseñar e implementar soluciones RAG, copilotos, asistentes conversacionales y agentes inteligentes. Participar en proyectos de ML y Deep Learning, desde la experimentación hasta producción. Trabajar en pipelines de datos batch y near real-time, modelado de datos y arquitecturas modernas de datos. Colaborar en prácticas de MLOps, LLMOps, CI/CD e infraestructura como código. Incorporar criterios de seguridad, observabilidad, escalabilidad y gobierno del dato en las soluciones. Liderar técnicamente iniciativas AI & Data y colaborar con cliente en workshops, discovery, roadmap y definición de soluciones. Coordinar equipos multidisciplinares y comunicar decisiones técnicas a perfiles técnicos y de negocio. ¿Qué estamos buscando? Experiencia sólida en proyectos de AI, Data o Machine Learning en entornos cloud. Experiencia práctica con Microsoft Azure y servicios de IA y datos. Experiencia en soluciones de Generative AI, RAG, copilotos o agentes inteligentes. Dominio de Python y librerías de datos/IA como Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain o similares. Experiencia con SQL, modelado de datos y despliegue de soluciones en producción. Conocimiento de arquitecturas cloud, seguridad, escalabilidad y buenas prácticas de desarrollo. Capacidad para trabajar directamente con cliente y liderar técnicamente iniciativas. Nivel alto de español e inglés. Será muy valorable si además cuentas con: Experiencia en MLOps, LLMOps, PromptOps o DevOps. Conocimiento de Docker, Kubernetes, AKS, Terraform, Bicep o GitHub Actions. Experiencia con Databricks, Spark, Delta Lake, Microsoft Fabric, BigQuery o Vertex AI. Experiencia en visión artificial, NLP, análisis documental o deepfakes. Conocimiento de OWASP, DAST o seguridad aplicada a IA. Experiencia en sectores regulados o proyectos internacionales. ¿Cómo es trabajar en Deloitte? 🤩 Proyectos de alto impacto donde tendrás un largo recorrido y aprendizaje ☯️ Un día a día híbrido-flexible: tendrás horario flexible y un buen equilibrio entre el teletrabajo y el trabajo en equipo en nuestras oficinas o las de nuestros clientes ⚽ Buen ambiente dentro y fuera de la oficina: disfrutarás de varios teambuildings al año, actividades culturales y deportivas… ¡y mucho más! 🧘‍♀️ Bienestar integral: cuídate con nuestro programa de salud física, mental y financiera… ¡y con equipo médico en las oficinas! 🤲 Impacto social: Podrás apuntarte a una gran cantidad de voluntariados de alcance nacional e internacional y a proyectos pro-bono con los que poner tu tiempo y talento al servicio de quienes más lo necesitan 🗣️ Cultura del feedback y aprendizaje continuo: crecerás en un entorno inclusivo donde la igualdad de oportunidades y tu plan personalizado de formación impulsarán tu desarrollo. ¿Ya te visualizas en la Deloitte University de París? 🤝 Beneficios exclusivos por ser parte de Deloitte: podrás disfrutar de un gran catálogo de beneficios y de un completo plan de retribución flexible Si te gusta lo que lees, estos son tus próximos pasos: Aplica a la oferta haciendo clic en ‘Enviar candidatura ahora’ y completa tu perfil Si encajas en el puesto, nuestro equipo de talento te contactará para conocerte mejor ¡Comienza el proceso! Te iremos guiando por las diferentes fases hasta tu incorporación.

items.desc: Our client is reimagining how professional services are delivered by combining human expertise with intelligent AI technology. With 450+ businesses served across 20+ industries, they are now building proprietary AI systems designed to automate complex workflows, empower specialists and turn traditional service delivery into scalable software. Role Overview You’ll join as a Software Engineer – Agentic AI, building production-grade multi-agent systems, backend infrastructure and data architectures that power the next generation of AI-driven professional services. Key Responsibilities Build the core product: Develop and enhance an internal platform that streamlines complex business workflows, turning user feedback and operational challenges into practical software features. Engineer intelligent agents: Extend production AI systems by working on agent coordination, context management, memory, retrieval and iterative improvement mechanisms. Shape the architecture: Influence technical decisions across application design, workflow orchestration, APIs, data structures, security and technology selection. Develop reliable data infrastructure: Design and improve relational and vector-based data storage, ensuring information can be retrieved efficiently and used effectively by AI applications. Own delivery end to end: Translate business needs into technical solutions, take responsibility for implementation and help establish maintainable engineering practices as the platform evolves. Collaborate across disciplines: Work closely with product stakeholders and internal users to prioritise improvements, validate solutions and deliver value through short development cycles. Qualifications A solid professional background in software engineering, with strong backend development fundamentals and experience delivering production applications. Practical experience building AI agents or agentic AI components, particularly involving orchestration, context handling, memory or retrieval. Proficiency in Python, TypeScript or a comparable programming language, together with experience using established backend frameworks. Familiarity with agent development frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI or comparable tools. Experience building backend services with technologies such as FastAPI, NestJS, Spring Boot or similar frameworks. Working knowledge of PostgreSQL, Docker, Git and GitHub. Experience with cloud-based or containerised environments, using technologies such as Kubernetes, AWS or equivalent platforms. Strong German communication skills at C1 level or Native. An ownership mindset, sound technical judgement and the ability to turn loosely defined requirements into working software. Additional skills that would be advantageous: Strong SQL skills, including database modelling, API design and query optimisation. Experience deploying AI or machine learning models into production and evaluating their practical limitations. A product-oriented approach to engineering, with the ability to work directly with users and understand their needs. Familiarity with event-driven systems, message brokers such as Kafka or RabbitMQ, or similar distributed architectures. Experience using AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex or comparable solutions. You do not need to have worked with every technology listed. Strong backend engineering fundamentals and hands-on experience building agentic AI solutions are the priorities. Ready to shape how intelligent agents transform complex workflows into scalable software? If you enjoy hands-on engineering, technical ownership and building AI systems that solve real operational challenges, we’d love to hear from you.

Working alongside senior engineers and technical advisors, you help turn concepts into concrete, implementable features. items.desc: Job ID: 5556 We are seeking a technically driven and motivated AI & Data Engineer Trainee to join our AI and Data Innovation team. This role is central to building and evolving our internal data platform, with a focus on data engineering tooling, pipeline automation and platform enablement. The trainee will be hands-on from day one, contributing to the infrastructure that powers both our data and AI capabilities across the organization. At Nordea, we see that the world is changing fast – and we want to be one step ahead of the curve. That's why we're deeply committed to providing the financial solutions of tomorrow to our customers. We're creating an agile environment where we experiment and grow together - and we need your ideas and personal background. With us, you'll be in good company with a chance to make your mark on something bigger. Nordea Asset Management (NAM) is the asset management arm of the Nordea Group, the leading financial services group in the Nordics with the vision of being a leading European Asset Manager. We want to do this by delivering returns with responsibility. The group has more than 30,000 employees. NAM has around 900 employees and manages more than EUR 325 billion of assets for institutional, wholesale, and retail clients across the Nordic region and the globe. About this opportunity: You will join our AI and Data Innovation team based in Oeiras, embedded in a cross-functional environment where engineering and innovation meet. Your primary focus will be on building and maintaining the data platform tooling that underpins our data and AI initiatives. You will contribute to driving platform adoption across the organization and act as a technical bridge between the data platform and our AI Lab. This is a hands-on role — expect to write code, build pipelines, and ship real solutions. The role is based in Oeiras (Quinta da Fonte). It’s expected you to work 100% on-site. Internship duration: 12 months. Salary offer: 1.400 € gross/monthly + meal allowance. Key responsibilities: Design, build and maintain data platform tooling and infrastructure, leveraging technologies such as Snowflake, dbt, dlt and Airflow. Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support reliable and automated data workflows. Contribute to infrastructure-as-code practices using Terraform and containerisation with Docker. Support the adoption and enablement of the data platform across business and technical teams, producing documentation and reusable components. Act as a technical bridge between the data platform and the AI Lab, ensuring data infrastructure is ready to support AI and LLM-driven use cases. Collaborate with engineers and data practitioners to identify improvements and new capabilities within the platform. Your profile Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us. To succeed in this role, we believe that you: Are eager to learn and get things done — you enjoy building things and are not afraid to get your hands dirty. Have a foundational understanding of data engineering concepts and curiosity about how modern data platforms work. Can write Python code and are comfortable picking up new libraries and tools as needed. Have had some exposure to workflow orchestration concepts — familiarity with Airflow or similar tools is a plus, not a requirement. Have a basic awareness of CI/CD practices and what good software delivery looks like. Are curious about AI and LLM tooling (RAG, agentic workflows, etc.) — no hands-on experience needed, just genuine interest. The following soft skills: Curious and self-driven with strong interest in data science and AI technologies. Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment. Efficient and delivery oriented. Persistent and determined. Innovative and like to sick new ways to solve issues. Your experience and background: Fluent in English. (Other European language are considered an asset). Master in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Maths or other numerate subject. Familiarity with one or more of the following is a plus: Snowflake, dbt, dlt, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes. Prior experience with data pipelines or platform engineering projects — academic or professional — will be valued. If this sounds like you, get in touch! Next steps If this opportunity is the challenge you are seeking, please send us your cover letter and CV in English latest on 31/10/2026. At Nordea, we recruit from the widest possible pool and hire the best person for the job. Because diversity makes us stronger. And once you are on board, you will find that we offer equal opportunities to everyone. #NAM #NAM-Portugal

items.desc: xHeron is building the Service-as-Software company for short-term rental operators. We take responsibility for guest communication, team coordination and issue resolution, so customers can hand over the work without handing over their business. Today, we deliver that service through people, software and AI. We’re turning the expertise behind it into autonomous systems that understand situations, take action and follow through. Not another tool to supervise. A service that gets the job done. We’re looking for an AI Engineer to build the agentic capabilities at the heart of xHeron. You’ll help shape how our agents reason, act and learn, and build a company where AI doesn’t just support the work, but increasingly delivers it. Tasks We are looking for an AI Harness Engineer to build the software layer that turns language models into dependable operational systems. You will work on orchestration, context assembly, tool execution, state, permissions, evaluations, observability, failure recovery, and human handoffs. The goal is not merely to generate a good response. What You’ll Own Agent harness architecture: Build the control layer around models: task decomposition, state management, model and tool selection, execution loops, checkpoints, retries, stopping conditions, and human handoffs. Decision and execution behavior: Design how agents interpret situations, choose actions, manage uncertainty, and complete bounded operational tasks—not only how they generate text. Context and memory: Determine what an agent needs to know at each step. Build context assembly, retrieval, memory, evidence selection, and knowledge-maintenance strategies while managing relevance, latency, and cost. Tools and real-world effects: Connect agents to APIs and operational systems through explicit tool contracts, permissions, validation, idempotency, and confirmation that the intended effect actually occurred. Evaluation and regression testing: Build representative evaluation suites and automated tests for decision quality, tool use, task completion, safety, escalation behavior, and recurring failure patterns. Observability and failure analysis: Make agent behavior inspectable through structured traces, state, outcomes, and error classification. Diagnose failures across models, prompts, context, tools, and surrounding software. Continuous improvement: Use evaluations, production traces, operator feedback, and controlled experiments to improve prompts, context, tools, model choices, and agent architecture. Production ownership: Ship and operate production Python software alongside our CTO and engineering team. Work closely with systems engineering on integrations, authorization, durable state, recovery, and safe execution. Requirements What Makes You a Great Fit You are a strong software engineer who can design, build, test, and operate reliable production systems in Python. You have built a substantial LLM-powered, automation, workflow, or decision system: not only notebooks, chat interfaces, prompt experiments, or a basic retrieval pipeline. You understand the engineering layer around a model: orchestration, state, context, tools, structured outputs, permissions, retries, fallbacks, observability, and evaluations. You can connect intelligence to real work: selecting relevant evidence, making a bounded decision, invoking tools or APIs, and verifying that the intended result occurred. You design for partial failure and uncertainty. You think deliberately about when an agent should act, retry, wait, stop, ask for help, or escalate. You evaluate behavior systematically. You use representative cases, traces, outcome checks, comparisons, and regression tests rather than treating a plausible response as proof of success. You have shipped software that people or operational processes depend on and have worked through debugging, timeouts, inconsistent data, changing APIs, and production incidents. You can investigate ambiguous problems independently, define a useful system boundary, explain trade-offs clearly, and turn decisions into working software. You care about simplicity and control. You know when a deterministic workflow is better than an agent and when additional autonomy is justified by evidence. You bring useful expertise and an independent perspective. Strong adjacent experience in workflow engines, developer tooling, distributed systems, automation platforms, or integration-heavy backend software can be highly relevant when paired with credible LLM-system understanding. Around 2+ years of professional software-engineering experience is a useful guide, not a hard requirement. What matters is the technical depth of what you built, the decisions and production outcomes you owned, and your ability to learn unfamiliar systems. You May Not Be a Great Fit If Your LLM experience is mainly prompt engineering, chatbots, basic RAG, or connecting a model API to a user interface. Your background is primarily offline data analysis, model training, …

The companies that master AI-native engineering and product development will build faster, learn faster, and out-execute competitors still operating with traditional processes. That's the company we're building. This is not an AI product company. This is an AI-native service company. Want to know how to build it? Watch this. items.card: You will work closely with software engineers, SREs, product managers, platform teams and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, build predictive models, evaluate AI solutions and take products from concept through to production. items.desc: ABOUT US: LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity. LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG. OUR PEOPLE: People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our culture of connecting, creating opportunity and delivering excellence shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential. We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 70 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers. ROLE SUMMARY: We are seeking an experienced Data Scientist to help develop and deploy enterprise-scale AI and machine learning solutions that improve operational efficiency, service resilience and customer outcomes. You will work closely with software engineers, SREs, product managers, platform teams and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, build predictive models, evaluate AI solutions and take products from concept through to production. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with commercial awareness and the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights and measurable business value. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING: AI & Machine Learning Solutions Design, build and deploy machine learning models to solve operational and business challenges. Develop predictive analytics capabilities focused on incident prevention, service health, operational risk and customer experience. Support the development of Generative AI applications leveraging LLMs, retrieval systems and agentic workflows. Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend practical applications across the organisation. Data Science & Analytics Perform advanced statistical analysis and modelling across large-scale operational and engineering datasets. Develop feature engineering, experimentation and model evaluation frameworks. Create insights and recommendations that drive decision making for senior stakeholders. Build and maintain reproducible data science workflows and pipelines. Product Delivery Partner with engineering and product teams to transition solutions from proof-of-concept into production. Define success metrics and measurement frameworks for AI products. Support model monitoring, governance and continuous improvement activities. Contribute to AI product roadmaps and prioritisation discussions. Collaboration & Innovation Work with subject matter experts from Engineering, Operations, Service Management and Product organisations. Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Contribute to the growth of LSEG's AI and Data Science community through knowledge sharing and mentoring. Promote responsible AI, model governance and data-driven decision making. WHAT YOU'LL BRING: Essential Experience Demonstrable experience delivering machine learning or AI solutions within a large-scale enterprise environment. Strong experience applying statistical modelling, predictive analytics and experimentation techniques. Experience working with structured and unstructured data at scale. Proven ability to translate business problems into measurable analytical outcomes. Experience taking models from development into production environments. Technical Skills Python and associated data science …

Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. We are looking for a Senior Python Developer to join our engineering team in Bucharest and help develop and enhance a platform that processes and analyzes diagnostic data from enterprise servers. The role focuses on Python-based parsers and backend tooling that enable technical support teams to identify hardware issues and determine appropriate corrective actions. You will also help prepare support capabilities for new server technologies, including AI and GPU-enabled hardware. This is a hybrid position in Bucharest, with three days per week in the office and two days working from home. You will collaborate with an experienced international engineering organization across multiple locations and time zones. No regular business travel is expected. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain Python-based parsers for diagnostic logs generated by enterprise server systems. Enhance backend capabilities that transform server diagnostic data into actionable information for technical support teams. Extend diagnostic and support tooling for new enterprise server technologies, including GPU and AI-enabled hardware. Contribute to automated support workflows that identify hardware faults and enable downstream remediation processes. Deliver reliable, production-ready functionality aligned with new hardware product releases and customer-support requirements. Investigate technical challenges involving complex server logs and develop maintainable software solutions to address them. Collaborate with engineering colleagues across Romania, India, the United States, and other international teams while coordinating dependencies and technical deliverables. Participate in regular team synchronization and knowledge sharing while independently owning assigned development activities. Position Requirements University degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience. Strong professional software-development experience (+4 years) with demonstrated senior-level capability in Python. Solid understanding of software engineering principles, maintainable code, debugging, testing, and reliable production software. + 4 years experience with backend development, data processing, parsing, log analysis, or comparable development involving complex technical data. Ability to independently take ownership of technical assignments, identify dependencies, solve problems, and drive work through completion. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a distributed international engineering environment. Fluent English sufficient for day-to-day technical communication and collaboration within a global team. Experience with enterprise infrastructure, Linux environments, large-scale data processing, server diagnostics, automation, AI/ML-related solutions, or hardware-support systems is an advantage. Il permet de réaliser des calculs à l’échelle de l’assemblage (dit réseau) et à l’échelle du cœur (en exploitant des bibliothèques multi-paramétrées assemblages). APOLLO3 est développé au sein du SERMA/LLPR par une équipe dynamique et motivée 🚀 comportant une vingtaine d’ingénieur.e.s-chercheurs.ses et doctorant.e.s. Les langages de programmation utilisés sont le C++ et le Python. Cette mission a lieu dans le contexte de l’industrialisation du code APOLLO3® en vue de son utilisation pour la simulation du parc nucléaire existant et futur jusqu'aux études du prototypes pour la fermeture du cyle. Vous intègrerez l’équipe de développement de ce code au SERMA/LLPR et interagirez avec les utilisateurs du code. 🤝 Vous participez au développement du code APOLLO3 ® pour consolider les versions actuelles et préparer l'indiustrialisation des prochaines versions permettant de mieux répondre aux besoins des utilisateurs du code au CEA et chez les partenaires industriels (EDF, Framatome, ORANO) pour la modélisation du parc nucléaire existant et futur y compris les prototypes envisagés pour la fermeture du cycle (réacteurs RNR de 4ème génération). Vous contribuez au développement et à la vérification de certains composants du code et leurs interfaces utilisateur en vue de la construction de schémas de calculs plus précis et performants Les points valorisants sont la contribution à un nouveau logiciel ainsi que la participation à des présentations, comme des conférences ou des publications dans des revues scientifiques 📚. Profil du candidat PARLONS DE VOUS ! Vous êtes un.e ingénieur.e de niveau Bac+5 , issu.e d’une école d’ingénieurs en informatique scientifique et/ou en physique des réacteurs. Expérience professionnelle de 3 à 5 ans dans le développement de composants logiciels et programmation orientée objet. Vous possédez de solides compétences dans les outils C++, Python, Linux, OpenMP et MPI. Le poste requiert une bonne aptitude au travail en équipe 🤝, de l'autonomie ainsi que des bonnes compétences en informatique 💻 scientifique, en particulier une bonne connaissance des méthodologies, outils et langages de développement logiciel en programmation parallèle : Linux, programmation orientée objet C++/Python, OpenMP, MPI, etc. Des connaissances en physique des réacteurs seront nécessaires. items.desc: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. The Customer Experience Engineering Team builds the internal and external technologies that scale Snowflake’s global support and sales organizations. We empower our technical experts by providing the advanced tools they need to resolve complex issues and drive customer success. Our team specializes in software engineering, data-driven decisions, ML, and LLM-based solutions . We build production-grade systems to automate manual processes and augment the capabilities of our technical staff. Our current focus includes: LLMs: Developing and deploying LLM and agent-based architectures for streamlining troubleshooting Scalable Evaluations: Implementing large-scale evaluations to ensure the quality and reliability of our internal and external tools Process Automation: Designing intelligent workflows that eliminate bottlenecks and allow our experts to focus on the most technical aspects of the Snowflake platform Incident discovery: using embeddings, LLMs, clustering, and agents to detect potential widespread issues more quickly Now, the team is growing, and we are looking for a Software Engineer to join us. In this role, you will work closely with the state of the art LLM models, fine-tune them, develop agents, apply various clusterings, summarizations, embeddings, and so on. Even though we usually use high-level libraries (e.g., scikit or Snowflake’s Cortex) rather than perform matrix multiplications ourselves, some prior ML experience is definitely useful. As a Software Engineer, you will contribute to the development of ML and LLM-based solutions, propose new ideas, and keep improving the existing models. You will: Develop and refine ML models that are critical to Snowflake’s business Design metrics and experiments to validate your insights Help to implement projects that span our stack, including Java and Python services hosted in Snowflake and Kubernetes Collaborate with a cross-functional team, including product management and design Deliver features requiring close coordination with several partner teams Be a participant in defining the product vision and team planning Pinpoint problems, instrument relevant components as needed, and ultimately implement solutions Our ideal Software Engineer will have: B.S. or M.S. degree in CS, or equivalent discipline 3+ years of hands-on software engineering experience 1+ years of working ML experience Interest in the State of the Art LLM-based solutions Great communication skills, both verbal and written and an interest in working with a diverse set of peers and external developers Genuine enjoyment of the art of building great software, and a love of learning new things Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact? For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

items.desc: About the role The Product Intelligence Platform is an AI-driven system that transforms how Tesco handles product data at scale. The platform leverages multi-agent AI systems to automate product categorization, enrichment, and matching across a vast number of products on a weekly basis. Built on event-driven architecture using Kafka, the platform processes millions of events monthly through core AI capabilities. A Software Engineer in this team will help build and maintain these AI-powered capabilities using Java/Spring Boot and Python, develop scalable event-driven microservices on Azure Kubernetes Service, and work with LLMs to solve product intelligence challenges. The role suits someone who enjoys connecting AI technology, engineering, and practical business needs, and who wants to grow while contributing to a platform that impacts millions of customer interactions weekly. You will be responsible for Developing and implementing microservices for product intelligence capabilities. Working with technologies including: Spring Boot, Python, Apache Kafka, PostgreSQL with PGVector for embeddings Contributing to the development of multi-agent systems. Building event-driven services for high-volume data processing. Implementing product matching logic using: text similarity techniques, image similarity techniques Helping ensure system scalability and reliability to process over 1 million events per week. Collaborating with product managers and data scientists to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Contributing to infrastructure as code using Terraform on the Azure cloud platform. Contributing to architectural discussions as the platform's AI capabilities grow. Sharing knowledge with teammates and upholding engineering excellence standards. Integrating with various Tesco systems, including both internal and external platforms. You will need Mandatory Skills: Solid experience with Java and Spring Boot for building enterprise-grade applications. Basic knowledge of Python. Good understanding of event-driven architectures and Apache Kafka. Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Azure. Familiarity with Kubernetes for container orchestration. Working knowledge of databases, including PostgreSQL and NoSQL solutions. Experience with RESTful API design and microservices architecture. Understanding of software engineering best practices, including CI/CD, testing, and code review. Comfort working with distributed systems. Nice-to-Have Skills: Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) and prompt engineering. Knowledge of vector databases and embedding technologies like PGVector. Familiarity with machine learning frameworks and computer vision. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. Knowledge of the retail or e-commerce domain. Experience with Couchbase or similar NoSQL databases. Understanding of data quality and governance principles. Previous experience building AI-powered applications. Experience working with multi-agent systems. Whats in it for you? Salary UoP 20 000 - 25 000 PLN gross/month Hybrid working We know life looks a little different for each of us. items.desc: Requisition Number: 19461 Contract Type: Permanent Location(s): Betzdorf, LU (Senior) Engineer, DSP Systems Engineering, meoSphere Programme Description meoSphere is SES’s next-generation Medium Earth Orbit (MEO) satellite constellation, designed to deliver secure connectivity services to government agencies, enterprises, and commercial customers. It will also provide high-speed broadband internet to eliminate global connectivity dead zones. To accelerate development timelines, reduce costs, and ensure quality, SES is internalizing a critical segment of the satellite supply chain: the final integration of partner satellite platforms with SES’s software-defined payloads, all within a cutting-edge manufacturing and test facility. Role Description As a DSP System Engineer, you will play a key role in the design, analysis, modelling and validation of multiple signal processing blocks implemented in ASIC and FPGA technology in in our satellite payloads. Embedded in an agile software/firmware and hardware development team, you will ensure optimized algorithms and accurate modelling are implemented along the signal processing chain. In your first six months, you will model and propose algorithms for state-of-the-art Digital Beamforming ASICs and 5G NTN waveform digital processing blocks. Within two years, your algorithms and modelled systems will have flown in space, demonstrating cutting-edge digital signal processing technologies. Key Responsibilities / Key Result Areas Develop and model DSP algorithms for digital beamforming and channelization, MIMO, DPD, CFR, calibration, and digital compensation in phased-array and satellite communication systems. Develop DUC/DDC blocks using multi-rate DSP techniques and ensure optimized implementation for low-power fixed point hardware (FPGA/ASIC). Create system-level MATLAB/Python/C++ models representing end-to-end RF and baseband processing, including beamforming algorithms, channelization, quantization effects, and channel impairments. Translate high-level system requirements into implementable DSP blocks for ASIC design, collaborating with RTL and physical design teams to define fixed-point accuracy, throughput, and latency targets. Evaluate fixed-point vs. floating-point architecture trade-offs for ASIC efficiency and precision across multiple channels. Develop hardware/software co-design models to partition algorithms between firmware, digital logic, and analog front end. Prototype and validate system performance via FPGA or simulation platforms; assist with pre-silicon and post-silicon validation workflows. Optimize DSP algorithms for low power and high throughput suitable for space or high-reliability communication ASICs. Support beamforming calibration strategies, including array calibration, gain/phase mismatch correction, and RF impairment compensation. Generate technical reports, design documentation, and test plans to validate DSP architecture performance. Required Qualifications COMPETENCIES, QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE MS/PhD in Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, or related field with 5 years of relevant DSP algorithm design experience. Proven background in digital beamforming, MIMO signal processing, and calibration algorithms for phased arrays. Strong experience with system-level modelling in MATLAB/Simulink and Python, including model-based design. Proficiency in DSP algorithm simulation in C/C++ or SystemC, especially fixed-point modelling for ASIC implementation. Deep understanding of OFDM, modulation schemes, adaptive filtering, channel estimation, and RF impairment modelling. Familiarity with ASIC flow integration of DSP algorithms — RTL handoff, verification, and bit-accurate modelling. Experience in lab-based silicon bring-up, calibration, and verification of beamforming performance. Understanding of FPGA prototyping, hardware emulation, and verification flows used for DSP system validation. Nice to have Strong grasp of digital communications theory and antenna array processing. Capability to bridge system, algorithm, and implementation levels in custom beamforming ASICs. Excellent communication skills for cross-functional coordination (DSP, RTL, RF, firmware, system integration). Analytical mindset for trade-off evaluations: precision vs. power, latency vs. accuracy, hardware cost vs. performance. Working Experience of radiation and thermal constraints relevant to satellite ASIC system design. Preferred Tools And Platforms Function Tools / Languages DSP Modeling & Simulation MATLAB, Simulink, Python, NumPy, TensorFlow (for ML-based optimization) Algorithm Implementation C/C++, VivadoAMD Analysis Tools ADS, Keysight SystemVue, or custom DSP simulation frameworks Other Key Requirements / Comments Eligibility for ESA/EU/NATO/National SECRET personnel security clearances. items.desc: About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. The Role At Legora, security is the foundation of the trust our customers place in us. The world’s leading law firms, as well as some of the biggest corporations use our platform for their most sensitive matters, and we need security to be built into how we design, ship, operate, and scale. We are looking for exceptional Security Engineers who can build leverage across a large surface area: a multi-tenant AI platform, a multi-cloud estate with Azure as our primary cloud, and an engineering organisation that ships fast. This is a hands-on engineering role. You will own security work end to end, build tooling and guardrails, embed with engineering teams, and make the secure path the default path. We hire T-shaped security engineers. You should bring real depth in one of Application Security, Detection Engineering & Response, or Cloud & Platform Security, while staying credible across the others. Tell us in your application which area is your specialisation. This role can be based in Stockholm or New York. It is a 5-day in-office role, we believe building together in person drives better outcomes. What You Will Be Doing Own security work end to end: architecture, tooling, roadmap, and outcomes. Work embedded with engineering teams to make secure design, development, and operations the default. Build and ship software: guardrails, detections, libraries, automation, and workflows that live in git, are reviewed, tested, and deployed through CI/CD. Raise the security bar across engineering through design reviews, threat modelling, tooling, and enablement. Fix the class of bug, not just the instance, by turning findings into patterns, defaults, or detections. Secure a multi-tenant AI platform, including identity, authorisation, tenant isolation, data handling, and model-facing attack surfaces. Build with LLMs and agents, and help secure code and workflows produced at agent speed. Respond to incidents and write post-mortems that lead to meaningful technical and organisational improvements. Your Specialisation Application Security: Threat model features and architectures, review high-risk changes across authentication, authorisation, tenant isolation, and data handling, and secure AI and agentic product features against prompt injection, tool-use abuse, data exfiltration, and related attack paths. Detection Engineering & Response: Own detection-as-code, security data pipelines, abuse and account-compromise detection, and incident response across corporate and product surfaces. Build the agents that run first-pass triage and investigation, plus the guardrails and evals that make their output trustworthy. No tiered queue. Cloud & Platform Security: Harden identity, access, cloud control planes, CI/CD, supply chain, infrastructure-as-code, AKS baselines, tenant isolation primitives, and least-privilege access for engineers, workloads, and AI agents. Who You Are Several years of engineering experience in your security specialisation, with real depth in vulnerabilities you have found, incidents you have run, systems you have hardened, or tooling you have built. You are an engineer who writes production-quality code; we work primarily in TypeScript/Node.js and Python. You are comfortable operating across application security, detection and response, and cloud/platform security, even if one of those areas is your main depth. You understand identity, authorisation, multi-tenancy, and where security boundaries tend to break. You communicate clearly, translate risk into engineering terms, and influence teams without relying on mandates. You are calm and structured under incident pressure, and honest …
