 Product Owner - RDT Data Platforms 
 As a strategic Product Owner within RDT Data Platforms, you own the GUPRI Service (Globally Unique, Persistent, Resolvable Identifiers) end to end: its vision, roadmap, adoption and value. The GUPRI Service is Roche's enterprise identifier service which today is used by more than 50 global solutions. The role goes beyond backlog ownership. You connect leadership, consuming teams and technical delivery, and you prioritise initiatives for measurable value and alignment with enterprise data goals. You govern the service within enterprise service management platforms and manage the external vendor relationships, contracts and budgets that deliver it. 
 Description of the area 
 Data Management & Data Quality Platforms (under RDT Data Platforms) provide foundational services that make Roche data findable, connected and trustworthy. These include identifier management, terminology management and master data. They support FAIR data , the enterprise semantic layer and AI use cases across R&D, Commercial and Group functions. Many systems across the enterprise depend on these services, so reliability, governance and long-term stability matter as much as new features. 
 The Opportunity 
 Scope / Content Leadership: Takes end-to-end responsibility for the daily management, operational excellence and continuous evolution of the GUPRI Service. Autonomously drives the roadmap and backlog, leads major initiatives such as platform re-architecture, cloud migration, API enablement and self-service improvements, and actively shapes the team's ways of working. 
 Accountability / Problem Solving: Accountable for the service's adoption, reliability and value realisation. Owns the service policies and governance standards that consumers rely on. Governs the service within enterprise service management platforms, covering intake, the service catalogue, the support model, SLAs and incident and change processes. Proactively identifies and manages risks and dependencies. 
 Stakeholder Management: Acts as the bridge between leadership, consuming teams and technical delivery. Builds strong relationships with source-system owners, data and analytics teams, governance forums and business stakeholders, and grows an active community of service consumers. Manages external vendor relationships, overseeing contract lifecycles, commercial agreements, budgets and deliverables. 
 Impact / Strategy: Shapes the long-term roadmap so the service becomes a trusted, widely adopted enterprise capability. Prioritises initiatives by measurable value, such as reduced integration and curation effort, faster time-to-insight, compliance traceability and AI readiness, and supports the value case with evidence. 
 Complexity / Product Size: Manages an enterprise-wide foundational service with many dependent consumers, where changes can have broad downstream impact. Handles complex interdependencies across platform engineering, source systems, governance bodies and third-party vendors. Weighs new features, policies and vendor agreements against both immediate needs and long-term enterprise implications. 
 Business / Technical ability: Combines strong product and service management skills with a solid conceptual understanding of data platforms. Applies Agile principles, backlog prioritisation frameworks and enterprise service management tools effectively. Can engage credibly with engineers on APIs, integration and data architecture, and can explain technical foundations clearly to business audiences. 
 Who you are: 
 Education / Experience 
 5+ years of Product Ownership / Solution Management experience, with at least 3+ years in life sciences/pharma or the assigned business function being supported. 
 Proven experience independently managing end-to-end solution workstreams, navigating ambiguous requirements, and evaluating strategic solution options. 
 Demonstrated experience in translating requirements into strategic implementation plans that align with overall business objectives. 
 Experience managing external contractor relationships, commercial agreements, and governing solutions within enterprise service management platforms. 
 Technical Skills 
 Advanced knowledge of Product Ownership and Agile delivery concepts and practices, with intermediate expertise in enterprise solution management. 
 Strong proficiency in backlog management, requirements elicitation, and documentation, ensuring comprehensive requirements traceability and consistent change …

items.desc:
Während Ihres Praktikums analysieren Sie unseren aktuellen Entwicklungsprozess (Anforderungen, Coding, Unit-Tests, Reviews und Integration) und identifizieren die Schritte mit dem höchsten Automatisierungspotenzial.
 Sie bewerten modernste agentische Coding-Tools und Frameworks (z. B. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot Agent Mode, MCP-basierte Toolchains, Multi-Agent-Orchestrierung) für den Einsatz mit C/C++ auf QNX sowie Embedded Linux.
 Darüber hinaus entwickeln Sie einen Prozess zur Erstellung einer Agent-Pipeline, die eine Anforderung oder ein Ticket entgegennimmt und einen Pull Request generiert. Dies umfasst Code, Unit-Tests sowie statische Analysen (MISRA C/C++, clang-tidy) und Builds sowie Tests in CI und Selbstkorrektur-Schleifen.
 Außerdem machen Sie die Agenten mithilfe einer strukturierten Wissensbasis aus dem Repository und der Architekturdokumentation sowie Coding-Guidelines mit unserem Kontext vertraut, z. B. mittels RAG, Projektregeln und Context Engineering.
 Sie arbeiten an der Berücksichtigung von Safety- und Security-Anforderungen, z. B. durch Sicherstellung der Rückverfolgbarkeit zu Anforderungen, Durchführung von Human-in-the-Loop-Reviews sowie Gewährleistung der Kompatibilität mit ISO 13849/IEC 61508 und CRA-getriebenen Prozessen.
 Ab dem ersten Tag messen Sie die Wirkung anhand klarer KPIs, z. B. Lead Time pro Ticket, Testabdeckung, Fehlerrate, Review-Findings und Kosten pro Feature. Diese werden mit einer manuellen Baseline verglichen.
 Nicht zuletzt liefern Sie einen funktionsfähigen Prototyp, Guidelines für die Teams in Deutschland, Polen und Indien sowie eine Empfehlung für den Rollout.
Ausbildung: Masterstudium im Bereich Informatik, Software Engineering, Elektrotechnik, Informationstechnologie, Mechatronik oder vergleichbar
 Erfahrungen und Kenntnisse: praktische Arbeit mit LLMs und KI-Coding-Assistenten (z. B. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot)
 Erfahrungen und Kenntnisse: Erfahrung mit Git, CI/CD (z. B. GitHub Actions, Jenkins) und Linux
 Erfahrungen und Kenntnisse: sehr gute Python-Kenntnisse, gute Arbeitskenntnisse in C oder C++
 Erfahrungen und Kenntnisse: erste praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung (z. B. durch ein Praktikum, eine Werkstudent:innentätigkeit, Hochschulprojekte oder persönliche Projekte – GitHub-Link willkommen)
 Erfahrungen und Kenntnisse: idealerweise erste Projekte mit LLMs über die reine Chat-Nutzung hinaus
 Persönlichkeit und Arbeitsweise: Sie arbeiten selbstständig, experimentieren gerne und präsentieren Ergebnisse klar sowie kritisch
 Arbeitsroutine: Ihre Präsenz vor Ort ist erforderlich
 Sprachen: verhandlungssicheres Englisch; gute Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil
Start: gemäß vorheriger Vereinbarung Dauer: 6 Monate Voraussetzung für dieses Praktikum ist die Immatrikulation an einer Hochschule. Bitte fügen Sie Ihren Lebenslauf, Ihren Notenspiegel, Ihre Immatrikulationsbescheinigung, Ihre Prüfungsordnung sowie – falls erforderlich – eine gültige Arbeits- und Aufenthaltserlaubnis bei. En tant qu’ Expert Logistique Clients & Opérations France au sein de Bosch Outillage France ,vous êtes le référent logistique de l'organisation commerciale Bosch Outillage France pour l'ensemble des sujets liés à l'exécution des commandes et à la satisfaction de nos clients.
 Véritable interface entre nos clients, les équipes commerciales, les centres de distribution, les prestataires logistiques et les fonctions Supply Chain, vous pilotez la résolution des problématiques opérationnelles et contribuez à garantir un niveau de service optimal.
 Ce poste est avant tout orienté vers la gestion des opérations clients, la coordination transverse et l'amélioration continue des processus logistiques. Vous travaillerez de concert avec le Demand Planner : le poste ne comporte pas de responsabilité de planification de la demande en tant que tel.
 Responsabilités principales 
 Relation clients et gestion des escalades 
 Être l'interlocuteur logistique privilégié des clients français et des équipes commerciales.
 Animer et coordonner la résolution des incidents de livraison, ruptures, litiges transport ou dysfonctionnements de traitement des commandes.
 Assurer la communication avec les clients et les partenaires internes jusqu'à la résolution complète des problématiques.
 Piloter les plans d'action associés et garantir leur mise en œuvre.
 Gestion des indicateurs de performance (KPI) 
 Garantir l’atteinte des objectifs fixés sur les indicateurs Supply Chain attribués (par exemple : Outbound Quota, OFQ1-3 également connu sous le nom d’OTIF, délai de livraison).
 Pilotage des KPI et des coûts 
 Suivre et piloter activement les KPI logistiques ainsi que les coûts régionaux de la Supply Chain, tout en identifiant les opportunités d’optimisation des processus et de réduction des coûts.
 Référent système (Key User) 
 Assumer le rôle de Key User SAP pour le processus de livraison aux clients et coordonner les interfaces systèmes entre SAP et le WMS (Warehouse Management System).
 Surcharges logistiques & contrats 
 Vérifier et garantir la bonne application des conditions logistiques standard ainsi que des règles relatives aux surcharges logistiques dans les contrats clients.
 Support aux appels d’offres 
 Fournir les exigences logistiques spécifiques à la France dans le cadre des appels d’offres régionaux concernant les entrepôts et le transport.
Un CV en anglais est exigé - entretien en anglais
 Formation 
 Diplôme universitaire Master en administration des affaires, gestion de la Supply Chain, ingénierie ou domaine équivalent.
 Expérience 
 5 ans minimum d'expérience dans un environnement de logistique opérationnelle, customer logistics, customer service, order management, transport ou distribution.
 Une expérience directe dans la gestion de la relation clients, le traitement des escalades opérationnelles et la coordination de prestataires logistiques est fortement appréciée.
 Les profils uniquement orientés Demand Planning, Forecasting ou Supply Planning ne constituent pas la cible principale de ce poste
 Compétences 
 Forte orientation service et satisfaction client.
 Capacité à gérer des situations complexes et à coordonner plusieurs parties prenantes.
 Expérience dans la résolution de problèmes opérationnels et la gestion des escalades.
 Aisance dans les interactions avec des clients, équipes commerciales et partenaires logistiques.
 Capacité à influencer sans lien hiérarchique.
 Outils et systèmes 
 Très bonne maîtrise des systèmes ERP/SAP (une expertise SAP S/4HANA constitue un atout).
 Connaissance de Power BI.
 Maîtrise des outils standards Microsoft (Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Outlook, etc.).
 Langues 
 Français courant.
 Anglais courant.
Ce poste appartient à l'entité juridique RBFR
 A l’occasion du CES2021, Bosch a annoncé avoir atteint la neutralité carbone en 2020 sur l’ensemble de ses 400 sites dans le monde et se fixe un nouvel objectif en tablant sur une réduction de 15 % des émissions sur le scope 3 à l’horizon 2030. Venez rejoindre une entreprise qui agit pour le climat !

La passione è il motore che guida il nostro Gruppo, ci permette di sviluppare idee e soluzioni per la mobilità sostenibile del futuro. Promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro stimolante e che dà l’opportunità ad ogni Persona di esprimere pienamente il proprio talento contribuendo al successo dell’azienda. 
 Siamo alla ricerca di un/una Residual Value Risk da inserire nel team Risk Management di Alphabet Italia. La risorsa contribuirà alla valutazione, al monitoraggio e alla gestione del rischio connesso ai valori residui dei veicoli nell’ambito del noleggio a lungo termine, supportando le decisioni aziendali attraverso analisi quantitative, modelli statistici e approfondimenti sul mercato automotive. 
 Cosa ti aspetta? 
 Gestire e consolidare il processo di definizione, aggiornamento e monitoraggio dei valori residui dei veicoli, assicurandone la coerenza con le politiche di rischio e con gli obiettivi aziendali. 
 Sviluppare e manutenere modelli quantitativi e statistici per la previsione dei valori residui e per la misurazione del relativo rischio nel portafoglio di noleggio. 
 Analizzare l’andamento del mercato automotive e dell’usato, individuando trend, scostamenti e fattori di rischio legati a marca, modello, alimentazione, anzianità, chilometraggio e canale di remarketing. 
 Eseguire analisi di scenario, sensitivity analysis e stress test per valutare gli impatti economici e patrimoniali derivanti dalle variazioni dei valori residui. 
 Monitorare le performance delle previsioni rispetto ai risultati effettivi di vendita, identificando tempestivamente gli scostamenti e proponendo azioni correttive. 
 Predisporre report, dashboard e presentazioni periodiche per il management, traducendo analisi complesse in indicazioni chiare a supporto delle decisioni. 
 Collaborare con le funzioni Pricing, Remarketing, Controlling, Sales, Fleet e con i referenti internazionali del Gruppo, garantendo qualità, tracciabilità e coerenza dei dati utilizzati. 
 Contribuire al miglioramento continuo dei processi, delle metodologie e degli strumenti di Residual Value Risk Management, anche attraverso l’automazione delle analisi e dei controlli. 
 Cosa porti con te? 
 Laurea magistrale in discipline economiche, finanziarie, statistiche, matematiche, ingegneristiche o in ambiti scientifici affini. 
 Esperienza precedente di almeno 5 anni in ruoli di Risk Management, Pricing, Analytics o Forecasting, preferibilmente maturata nel noleggio a lungo termine, nel leasing, nel settore automotive o nei servizi finanziari. 
 Conoscenza approfondita delle logiche di valutazione e gestione dei valori residui e dei principali fattori che influenzano il mercato dei veicoli usati. 
 Solide capacità analitiche e statistiche, con esperienza nella costruzione, validazione e interpretazione di modelli previsionali, analisi di scenario e stress test. 
 Ottima conoscenza operativa di R, Python e SAS, con capacità di utilizzare questi strumenti per l’analisi dei dati, la modellizzazione statistica e l’automazione dei processi. È inoltre richiesta una buona conoscenza di SQL e di altri strumenti analitici equivalenti. 
 Ottima padronanza di Excel e PowerPoint; la conoscenza di strumenti di data visualization e business intelligence, come Power BI o Tableau, costituisce un plus. 
 Capacità di gestire basi dati complesse, verificarne la qualità e comunicare con efficacia i risultati delle analisi a interlocutori tecnici e manageriali. 
 Forte orientamento al risultato, precisione, autonomia e attitudine a individuare rapidamente criticità e soluzioni efficaci in contesti complessi. 
 Spiccate capacità relazionali e di collaborazione con team multidisciplinari e internazionali. 
 Ottima padronanza della lingua inglese, sia scritta sia parlata.

 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Notre savoir-faire technologique
 Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…)
 Votre quotidien 
Sur un Campus Bordelais à la pointe de la technologie, entre océan et vignes, nous concevons et développons des systèmes, des équipements et services pour garantir le succès des missions aéroportées de nos clients. 
 Le projet de ce stage est d’intégrer le service méthodes industrielles afin d’alimenter et d’entrainer l’IA interne à répondre aux problématiques des différentes parties prenantes.
 Vos missions 
 Concevoir et améliorer des prompts + templates “méthode” : Mettre au point des gabarits de questions/réponses pour : définition (matière/spécification), fabrication (gamme/fiches), fabricants (qualification/capacités).

Cependant, il est nécessaire de maîtriser la nature et le déploiement des solutions IA utilisées mais également d’évaluer l’étendue des possibilités de ces solutions dans le cadre de ses activités.
 Les objectifs sont les suivants :
 • Sécurisation des solutions IA :
 • Etude et prise en main des solutions utilisées,
 • Durcissement des configurations des solutions,
 • Tests de non-régression et de performances suite au durcissement.
 • Proposition de nouveaux cas d’usage :
 • Test et implémentation de nouvelles solutions IA pour attaquer/sécuriser les SI,
 • Test et implémentation de nouvelles solutions IA pour enrichir les outils de sécurisation.
 Vos missions
 1. Sécurisation de l’environnement : Paramétrage sécurisé des solutions et des conteneurs.
 2. Robustesse aux entrants adversariaux (LLM, RAG, agents) :
 - Génération de prompts malveillants + frameworks d’évaluation,
 - Cadres de “red teaming” (jailbreak, prompt injection, contournement de policies),
 - Fuzzing / mutation de prompts pour tester la résistance.
 3. Sécurité RAG & injection de prompts :
 - Évaluation RAG (qualité du contexte, respect du system prompt),
 - Garde-fous / validateurs de sortie,
 - Tests d’ancrage (réponse basée sur les sources).
 4. Justesse & biais :
 - Outils d’audit (Aequitas, Fairlearn, AIF360),
 - Jeux de tests multi‑groupes + métriques de biais/toxicité.
 5. Garde-fous comportementaux : Apposition de règles de comportement et de sécurité.
 6. Orchestration & traçabilité : Industrialisation des évaluations via MLflow / W&B + carde d’évaluation.
 7. Stacks pratiques « cyber engineering » :
 - Option “Red team / robustesse”: prompts adversariaux + orchestrateur + scoring auto,
 - Option “justesse” : jeux de tests par groupes + métriques de justesse suivies dans MLflow.
 8. Utilisation métier :
 - Etude des possibilités agentiques dans l’attaque et la sécurisation de système,
 - Etude de nouveaux cas d’usage via modèles décisionnels (couverture de tests, matrices de conformité, etc.).

 Votre priorité est de contribuer à l’intégration de l’IA générative et des agents IA au sein d’environnements de test dédiés à la cybersécurité ?

items.desc:
Contexte   
 La Product Line Secure Transaction & Identification basée en France à Caen et Mougins, mais également en Autriche, États-Unis et Asie, assure la conception de circuits intégrés pour le marché de la téléphonie mobile et des montres connectées. 
 Nos équipes conçoivent des puces microélectroniques de communication sans contact utilisant les technologies Near Field Communication (NFC) , Ultra-WideBand (UWB) et Wi-INT . 
 Nous recrutons un ou une stagiaire pour une durée de 6 mois afin de faire évoluer no s outils d’analyse de données utilisés pour caractériser les circuits intégrés produits et testés à l’échelle industrielle. 
 Afin de pouvoir garantir la conformité des composants aux spécifications , des tests exhaustifs sont effectués dans une multitude de conditions de fonctionnement . 
 L ’analyse des résultats de ces tests est un enjeu crucial pour garantir les performances industrielles et minimiser le temps nécessaire à l’identification et résolution des problématiques rencontrées . 
 Au sein d’une équipe mixte d’ingénieurs produits (PE) d’horizons variés, aux compétences complémentaires, experts en microélectronique analogique et numérique ainsi qu’en analyse exploratoire des données, ce stage est une immersion totale dans un domaine technologique de pointe et d’importance géostratégique majeure. 
 Vos missions   
 Vous serez en charge du développement d’un outil d’analyse de données automatisant la caractérisation des circuits intégrés , incluant un processus de préparation des données de test récoltées, leur analyse statistique , et leur validation par rapport aux spécifications client . 
 Le processus de préparation des données sera à développer intégralement en Python avec Polars , et la gestion des spécifications reposera sur le déploiement d’un encodage sémantique ( embedding ) alimentant la génération à enrichissement contextuel (RAG) d’un grand modèle de langage (LLM) . 
 Vous aurez à communiquer de manière fréquente en anglais avec les ingénieurs produit d’Europe et d’Asie, pour implémenter une solution correspondant à leur besoin. 
 Votre profil 
 • Bac +5, dernière année d’école d’ingénieur en électronique , mathématiques statistiques ou informatique . 
 • Connaissances en analyse exploratoire des données et implémentation d’algorithmes statistiques. Vous avez déjà réalisé un projet utilisant Python 3 et êtes familier de son utilisation pour du traitement de données. 
 • Des connaissances en microélectronique et /ou analyse statistique de distributions multimodales sont un plus. 
 • Un très bon niveau d’anglais technique est exigé, l’équipe est internationale et l’utilise pour toute communication. Toutes les documentations existantes et à produire seront également en anglais. 
 Context 
 The Secure Transaction & Identification Product Line, based in Caen and Mougins, France, as well as in Austria, the United States, and Asia, is responsible for the design of integrated circuits for the mobile phone and smartwatch markets. 
 Our teams develop microelectronic chips for contactless communication using Near Field Communication (NFC), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), and Wi-INT technologies. 
 We are recruiting a 6-month intern to improve our data analysis tools used for the characterization of integrated circuits manufactured and tested at industrial scale. 
 To ensure compliance with product specifications, extensive testing is performed under a wide range of operating conditions. 
 The analysis of these test results is critical to ensure industrial performance and minimize the time required to identify and resolve issues. 
 As part of a multidisciplinary team of Product Engineers (PEs) with diverse backgrounds and complementary expertise in analog and digital microelectronics as well as data science, this internship offers full immersion in a cutting-edge technological field with major geopolitical stakes. 
 Your missions 
 You will be responsible for developing a data analysis tool that automates integrated circuit characterization, including: pre-processing of collected test data, statistical analysis of the resulting datasets, and validation of device performance against customer specifications. 
 The data pr ocessing pipeline workflow will be developed entirely in Python using Polars. Specification management will rely on the deployment of semantic embeddings supporting Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for a Large Language Model (LLM). 
 You will interact frequently in English with Product Engineers located across Europe and Asia to implement solutions that address their needs and requirements. 
 Your profile 
 • Master's degree ( Bac +5 ), final year of an Engineering School program in Electronics, Statistics/Mathematics, or Computer Science. 
 • Knowledge of data science and the implementation of statistical algorithms. 
 • Hands-on experience with Python 3 through one or more projects, with familiarity in data processing and analysis applications.

items.desc: Informations générales L’établissement Dassault Aviation de Mérignac est un site stratégique du Groupe qui rassemble plus de 3 200 collaborateurs. Dédié à l’assemblage final, aux essais et à la livraison des avions Falcon et Rafale, le site regroupe de nombreuses expertises couvrant l’ensemble du cycle de vie de ses avions: développement technologique, études et industrialisation, production, contrôle qualité, essais sol et mises en vol, soutien et support client. Il accueille également des fonctions support essentielles telles que les achats, l’informatique, les ressources humaines et la maintenance des infrastructures. Rejoindre le site de Mérignac, c’est intégrer un environnement industriel de haute technologie et contribuer à des programmes aéronautiques à rayonnement international. Au sein de la Direction Générale Technique et de la Direction Technique Architecture Intégration Certification, l'entité Certification des Evolutions et Opérations est notamment en charge d'activités d'expertises dans le domaine de la maintenance. Nos clients (CAMO, opérateurs, stations de maintenance, ...) définissent et suivent pour chaque Falcon en service un Aircraft Maintenance Programme (AMP) qui dépend des conditions d'utilisation de l'avion. Cet AMP est validé par l'Autorité Locale du client et s'appuie sur les recommandations de Dassault Aviation définies dans le Maintenance Planning Document (MPD). Le MPD est applicable à tous les avions du certificat de type et définit l'ensemble des tâches de maintenance programmée à réaliser. Pour diverses raisons (manque d'outillage, manque personnel de maintenance, manque de pièces de rechange...), nos clients sont amenés à demander à dévier de l'AMP et s'appuient sur Dassault Aviation pour obtenir une dérogation auprès de leur Autorité Locale. Pour s'adapter à leurs contraintes opérationnelles, nos clients sont amenés à demander le report de certaines tâches programmées et donc de déroger aux recommandations de notre MPD. Votre objectif sera de mettre en place un outil d'assistant permettant de définir, à partir d'une demande client donnée, des propositions de dérogation sur la base des données existantes. Pour atteindre cet objectif les étapes suivantes sont proposées : Vous découvrirez les règles de conception de la maintenance programmée et les MPD de l'ensemble de la gamme Falcon et vous prendrez en main les bases de données existantes des dérogations aux plans de maintenance Vous proposerez des architectures s'appuyant sur les méthodes d’IA à base de Large Language Model (LLM) permettant d’optimiser le process d'utilisation du retour d'expérience Vous définirez et mettrez en place un outil d'aide à la décision par prototypage pour démontrer la faisabilité de ce concept Vous établirez des recommandations sur les indicateurs dimensionnants pour uniformiser l'archivage des dossiers et permettre une amélioration de la qualité de la réponse Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau Bac+5 (Master 2, Ingénieur ou équivalent), avec une spécialisation aéronautique (avec option informatique) ou informatique ayant une appétence pour l'aéronautique. Vous vous intéressez au domaine de la maintenance aéronautique, vous avez des compétences de base en machine learning, vous avez utilisé le langage Python et vous maîtrisez l'anglais. Vous disposez d'une expérience dans l'utilisation de Large Language Model et de mise en place de Retrieval Augmented Generation. Vous faites preuve de curiosité, d'organisation et de dynamisme. #EnsemblePlusLoin Dassault Aviation est un groupe aéronautique français, concepteur et fabricant d'avions militaires, d'avions d'affaires et de systèmes spatiaux. Architecte du futur, le Groupe est le créateur, depuis plus d'un siècle, d'une centaine de prototypes et de plus de 10.000 avions vendus dans 90 pays. Riche de près de 14.000 collaboratrices et collaborateurs, Dassault Aviation prône une identité forte marquée par la dynamique du collectif et la passion d'entreprendre au sein d'un environnement technologique innovant. Le processus de sélection s’appuie sur les compétences et la motivation, sans distinction de genre, d’âge, d’origine ou de critères sans lien direct avec l’emploi proposé, et tous les postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. Dassault Aviation œuvre pour l’égalité des chances, ce qui permet de définir les adaptations aux situations de travail envisageables pour l’intégration et l’évolution professionnelle dans l’entreprise. Vous travaillerez à la fois sur les dimensions architecture, données, Intelligence Artificielle et expérience utilisateur, avec l'objectif de proposer une expérience capable d'agréger, structurer et restituer dynamiquement la connaissance R&D.
items.desc:
Au sein de l'organisation R&D de Dassault Systèmes, vous rejoindrez une équipe travaillant sur de nouvelles expériences permettant de mieux capitaliser, connecter et exploiter la connaissance produite par les activités de développement. Les informations essentielles à la R&D sont aujourd'hui réparties dans de multiples environnements : documentation technique, dépôts de code, spécifications, tickets, discussions, résultats d'expérimentation ou encore contenus produits par les différentes équipes. Dans ce contexte, nous souhaitons explorer le concept de R&D Virtual Twin : une représentation numérique, structurée et dynamique de l'écosystème R&D, permettant de connecter les projets, composants logiciels, fonctionnalités, équipes, documents, expérimentations et décisions techniques. L'ambition est de transformer cette connaissance distribuée en une expérience unifiée et interactive, permettant aux développeurs et aux équipes R&D de comprendre rapidement un projet, naviguer dans son historique, identifier les informations pertinentes et explorer les relations entre les différents éléments qui composent son environnement. Vos missions L'objectif du stage sera de concevoir et prototyper un système d'information intelligent et interactif permettant de construire et d'explorer ce R&D Digital Twin. Vous travaillerez à la fois sur les dimensions architecture, données, Intelligence Artificielle et expérience utilisateur, avec l'objectif de proposer une expérience capable d'agréger, structurer et restituer dynamiquement la connaissance R&D. Vous serez notamment amené(e) à : Définir un modèle de connaissance permettant de représenter et relier projets, composants, fonctionnalités, équipes, documents, expérimentations et décisions techniques ; Développer des mécanismes de collecte, transformation et synchronisation d'informations provenant de sources hétérogènes ; Étudier des représentations telles que les Knowledge Graphs, vues temporelles ou cartographies interactives de projets et composants ; Concevoir des mécanismes de recherche, navigation et exploration de la connaissance ; Exploiter les Large Language Models et technologies d'IA pour rechercher, synthétiser, contextualiser et mettre en relation les informations disponibles ; Développer les services backend et APIs permettant d'exposer cette connaissance aux différentes expériences ; Concevoir et développer un widget Full-Stack interactif permettant de visualiser et explorer dynamiquement le R&D Digital Twin ; Expérimenter de nouvelles formes d'interaction combinant visualisation, navigation et langage naturel. L'objectif final sera de démontrer une nouvelle expérience de capitalisation de la connaissance R&D, transformant des informations distribuées en une représentation structurée, navigable, contextualisée et directement exploitable par les équipes de développement.

Bonne maîtrise de Python et expérience dans le développement de services backend, APIs et manipulation de données. Un intérêt ou une première expérience autour des Knowledge Graphs, bases de données graphes, systèmes de recherche ou représentation de connaissances est apprécié. Capacité à concevoir une expérience utilisateur permettant de rendre accessibles des informations complexes à travers des interfaces interactives et des visualisations de données. Intérêt pour les problématiques de Software Engineering, architecture logicielle et environnements R&D complexes. Autonomie, curiosité technique, capacité à prototyper rapidement et à évoluer dans un environnement multidisciplinaire et international. Nous rejoindre c'est aussi Intégrer une entreprise scientifique au cœur de l'innovation technologique, portée par une forte croissance depuis plus de 40 ans. Principaux avantages et bénéfices : Environnement collaboratif et innovant Collaboration internationale Diversité des technologies, produits et solutions Engagement en faveur de la diversité et de l'inclusion

L'objectif final sera de démontrer une nouvelle expérience de capitalisation de la connaissance R&D, transformant des informations distribuées en une représentation structurée, navigable, contextualisée et directement exploitable par les équipes de développement. Monitor and troubleshoot cloud environments using Azure Monitor and Log Analytics. Support infrastructure requirements for emerging AI and data services About You In-depth experience with Microsoft Azure, including compute, networking, storage and identity/Entra ID. Strong understanding of infrastructure automation and Infrastructure as Code. Terraform and/or Bicep experience. Knowledge of Policy as Code, including technologies such as Azure Policy, Open Policy Agent or Terraform Sentinel. Strong understanding of Azure security controls, including: Identity and access management Network segmentation Private endpoints Azure Key Vault Microsoft Defender for Cloud Strong scripting experience using PowerShell, Python or Go. Experience with CI/CD and DevOps tooling. Understanding of container technologies. Good knowledge of Windows and Linux fundamentals, diagnostics and monitoring. Understanding of systems development and product lifecycles. Experience translating requirements into automated infrastructure solutions. Desirable / additional technical knowledge Exposure to some of the following would be particularly valuable: Azure AI Foundry Azure OpenAI Service Microsoft Fabric Semantic Kernel LangChain Azure Machine Learning GPU-enabled Azure virtual machines GPU-enabled AKS environments About Us FDM is an award-winning global leader in tech and business talent solutions, backed by more than 35 years of industry experience. About the Role: As a Technical Product Owner, you will be the driving force behind the delivery and lifecycle of our product features. Working within an Agile engineering team and partnering closely with our Tech Lead/Architect, you will act as the essential link between our customer-facing Product Managers and the development team. While the Tech Lead drives architectural decisions and manages the engineers, you will take full ownership of the team's backlog, feature planning, and post-deployment success. Because our current technical leadership leans heavily into complex systems architecture, we are looking for a proactive, communicative leader to champion Agile processes and cross-team relationships. Partner closely with strategic Product Managers to understand business roadmaps, translating high-level business goals into well-defined epics and user stories. Own, prioritize, and maintain the sprint backlog , partnering with the PMs, Tech Lead and Infrastructure teams to balance new feature delivery against technical debt, optimizations, and scalability. Serve as the primary liaison for internal teams (Support, Customer Success, Expert Services) to field product inquiries, triage and investigate production bugs, and gather operational feedback to continually improve the product. Contribute hands-on to code and technical initiatives , rolling up your sleeves to build prototypes, develop proof-of-concepts, and assist in technical investigations across our polyglot stack (spanning diverse frontend and backend environments). Collaborate closely with the QA team to define robust Acceptance Criteria and evaluate completed sprint deliverables, ensuring everything meets quality benchmarks and the team's Definition of Done. Leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to optimize Agile workflows, draft user stories, analyze backlog health, and streamline cross-functional communication. Required qualifications 10+ years of experience in the software industry, ideally transitioning from an engineering role into a Product Owner or Technical Program Manager. Proven track record of successfully managing technical backlogs, delivering complex projects, and demonstrating measurable impact on product performance or stability. Deep understanding of API design, system architecture, database interactions, and object-oriented programming principles. Ability to use AI tools across the product lifecycle (requirement analysis, story generation, acceptance testing definition, and workflow automations). Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure) and enterprise integrations (e.g., Salesforce). Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to foresee technical bottlenecks and effectively sequence development work. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to "translate" between business-focused Product Managers and deeply technical engineering teams. Self-motivated and proactive, with a strong desire to learn, grow, and optimize team delivery. Fluent in English and French Why Join Us? Le projet est porté par un directeur de projet métier. Nous cherchons son binôme technique : la personne qui conçoit, met en place et fait évoluer l'ensemble des solutions. Qui sommes-nous ? Créé en 2005 et basé à Illkirch-Graffenstaden en Alsace, Biosynex est un laboratoire français spécialiste du diagnostic rapide, coté sur Euronext Growth Paris. Ses autotests et produits de santé familiale sont vendus dans un large réseau de pharmacies et parapharmacies, tandis que ses solutions de diagnostic équipent laboratoires, hôpitaux, médecins et EHPAD. Avec plus de 450 collaborateurs, une présence dans 95 pays et 101 M€ de chiffre d'affaires en 2024, le groupe poursuit son développement en France et à l'international. Concevoir l'architecture de l'écosystème relation client : CRM, catalogue, sites BtoB et BtoC, et leurs flux avec les outils existants (ERP, logistique, paiement). Paramétrer et faire évoluer Salesforce : modèle de données, automatisations, droits, parcours clients, en lien avec l'intégrateur. Mettre en place les sites e-commerce sur Shopify ou une solution équivalente : choix techniques, configuration, applications, gestion des spécificités BtoB (tarifs clients, comptes professionnels, commandes en volume). Structurer le catalogue digital : modèle de données produits, alimentation, synchronisation entre CRM, catalogue et sites. Piloter les intégrations SaaS : API, connecteurs, flux de données, supervision et gestion des incidents. Garantir la qualité technique : recette, sécurité, conformité RGPD, performance, documentation. Être le référent technique du directeur de projet métier, des porteurs de projet et des prestataires : traduire les besoins métier en solutions concrètes et éclairer les arbitrages. Votre profil Vous justifiez de 3 à 5 ans d'expérience technique sur des projets CRM ou e-commerce. Compétences techniques Très bonne maîtrise de Salesforce : paramétrage avancé, automatisations, modèle de données (une certification Administrateur ou Consultant est un plus). Expérience concrète de Shopify ou d'une plateforme e-commerce équivalente, idéalement en BtoB et BtoC. Solide connaissance des solutions SaaS et de leurs intégrations : API REST, webhooks, connecteurs, outils d'intégration. Bonne compréhension des données produits et clients (catalogue, PIM, qualité de données). Maitrise de l’IA Compétences métier Retail : vous connaissez les enjeux du commerce de détail (parcours omnicanal, offre produits, clients professionnels et particuliers). Pilotage technique : vous savez organiser les travaux techniques, suivre les intégrateurs et tenir vos engagements dans le cadre du projet. Savoir-être Rigoureux·se : vous travaillez avec méthode et souci du détail. Communicant·e : vous savez expliquer des sujets techniques simplement. Curieux·se : vous suivez les nouveautés du digital et du retail et aimez proposer des idées. Proche du terrain : vous aimez travailler au quotidien, en proximité directe avec les porteurs de projet métier. Ce que nous offrons CDI, statut cadre. Avantages : télétravail, tickets restaurant, mutuelle, etc. Un rôle clé dans un projet structurant, avec une vraie autonomie technique.

items.desc: System Software / Embedded Engineer (Munich) About Tensordyne AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. While we have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe, this particular role is based on-site in Sunnyvale. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence! Location: This is an on-site role based in Sunnyvale, CA (required), with flexible office hours. Responsibilities The role will require you to join Tensordyne's Platform Software team to lead requirements gathering, design, and development of system-level services, tools, and supporting tests for Tensordyne's AI inference platform software, including debugging, profiling, and analysis capabilities. The successful candidate will support cross-functional engineering teams in the bring-up and validation of platform software on AI inference systems, and partner closely with the hardware, silicon, and validation teams to deliver robust, production-quality platform software. You will work close to the hardware on firmware and board bring-up, bootloaders and BSP development, device drivers, and Linux kernel modules, collaborating directly with the silicon and hardware teams on hardware/software co-design. The role also involves system-level performance and power optimization across the AI inference platform, working with low-level interfaces such as PCIe, I2C, SPI, and JTAG. Occasional travel (e.g., to partner, customer, or contract manufacturer sites) may be required but is not mandatory. Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience developing low-level systems and embedded software, firmware, and tooling for high-performance computing systems deployed to data center customers. Hands-on experience bringing up and debugging complex Linux-based systems at the kernel and driver level, including embedded Linux, device drivers, and/or RTOS environments; experience with SoC/silicon bring-up is highly desirable. Familiarity with AI inference frameworks and data center deployment/management environments is preferred. Expert programming experience in C and C++, with proficiency in Python, Bash/Shell, and/or related programming languages. Rust experience is a plus. Comfortable interfacing directly with hardware, reading schematics and datasheets, and debugging with tools such as JTAG, logic analyzers, and oscilloscopes. Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable working across hardware, silicon, and software teams in a fast-paced startup environment. Excellent technical communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts and practical solutions. BS or MS degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed. Ethics and integrity always; Being open, honest, and respectful of everyone. Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals. Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do. Own it and get it done. Results matter! Make each person better together, than they would be as an individual. Embrace each others' differences, and embrace that there will be differences. Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that a diverse team is better at tackling complex problems and coming up with innovative solutions. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

items.desc: From smartphones to electric vehicles, semiconductor chips power the devices that shape modern life. As these chips continue to shrink, traditional inspection and measurement methods can no longer meet the extreme precision required to test the quality of these chips. This is where Nearfield Instruments (NFI) makes a difference. We are a leading provider of advanced metrology solutions, utilizing cutting-edge technologies to deliver the highest accuracy in semiconductor manufacturing. As a Software Test Architect in our dynamic Software Group, you will play a crucial role in defining how the software behind these state-of-the-art tools is tested, validated, and guaranteed to perform. Your work ensures our systems meet the demanding reliability and precision that the industry requires. What will you be doing? As a Software Test Architect, you shape the testing strategy and architecture for high-precision metrology and configuration-management software for our QUADRA machine. You will be responsible for developing the test roadmap, defining test architecture, and working closely with software, systems, and hardware architects to ensure every feature and subsystem is testable by design. This role combines deep technical testing expertise, system-level architectural thinking with a hands-on approach. Meaning you combine a helicopter view with a getting things done mentality. Your main responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Develop and maintain the overall test strategy, while optimizing for requirements coverage and efficiency. Define, document, and maintain test plans, test specifications, and validation strategies. Identify test coverage, risks, and required test assets early in the design and development phases. Translate system requirements and specifications into structured test cases, both manual and automated. Root cause analysis of issues in production and field. Proactively contribute to sprint planning, backlog refinement, and Definition of Done discussions to embed testability early. What makes this role interesting? You work directly with high-tech semiconductor applications on the edge of hardware and software performance. You enjoy testing and validating complex machines and translating this complexity into reliable, easy-to-maintain software. You will be working with an amazing team working across the software stack: from semiconductor process logic and UI to control systems and precision measurement software down to IO and safety logic. You collaborate with highly skilled experts in AFM, physics, mechatronics, system engineering, and precision robotics. You thrive in a dynamic, scale-up environment where continuous learning, experimentation, and improvement are part of daily life. What makes you a fit? Mindset & Environment Fit You enjoy fast-paced, high-tech environments where innovation and iteration happen quickly. You are comfortable with ambiguity, continuous change, and taking ownership beyond your primary scope to help deliver high-quality products. You proactively introduce improvements and embrace modern testing practices. Experience & Skills You have 7+ years of experience as senior software test engineer or software test architect testing for high-tech, complex machine control systems, preferably in the semiconductor or advanced robotics domain. You bring experience in: Creating broad and deep understanding of a complex product. Using this understanding to keep overview of test vs requirement and test vs code coverage and mapping out risks where there are gaps. Creating and maintaining a test strategy on the best choices between unit and component testing, simulation and mocking to system level and Hardware in the Loop testing. Work effectively across mixed technology stacks, integrating C# and Python-based tools for automation or simulation. Certification doesn’t equate qualification, but you are able to apply structured testing principles from frameworks such as ISTQB. Preferably experience with using Jira test management plugins (e.g., X-Ray, Zephyr) Recruitment, consultancy and/or other agency? We appreciate the interest, but we source all our candidates directly. We understand that you as an intermediary want to present candidates to our interesting positions. This is not how we have structured our recruitment. This means that all profiles offered to Nearfield Instruments will be treated as direct applications unless we have explicitly agreed otherwise.

You work on assignments at our clients, where you analyze complex cases, advise on policies and processes, and help shape how financial crime risks are managed in practice. In our work environment, we combine professionalism with a fresh perspective and a lot of passion Your tasks and responsibilities Complex case analysis: Lead and carry out in-depth investigations into high-risk client profiles and intricate transaction patterns, identifying potential money laundering, terrorist financing or fraud that automated systems might overlook. Risk and policy advisory: Contribute to or lead SIRA, the design and improvement of FEC policies and procedures, and the setup of transaction monitoring frameworks. Translate complex AML/CTF (Wwft) and Sanctions regulations into practical steps for the client’s project team, ensuring a “first time right” approach. Data and process optimization: Identify bottlenecks in the client’s monitoring systems, data quality or manual investigation processes, and propose data-driven improvements that increase detection efficiency. Quality assurance and coaching: Act as first-line reviewer for dossiers completed by junior colleagues, giving constructive feedback so that all reporting meets both our internal standards and the client’s regulatory requirements. Stakeholder management: Serve as the primary point of contact for project leads and compliance stakeholders at the client, reporting on progress and defending findings in compliance committee meetings. Commercial contribution: Build and maintain relationships within your client network, spot follow-up opportunities on assignments, and help us grow our presence in the market, including in specialized areas such as crypto. Our culture is open, personal and team-oriented. We encourage you to ask questions, take initiative and keep developing. items.desc: We are looking for a talented Middle strong C++ Developer with 3.5+ years of programming background to make consistent, high-quality code contributions to a mature, high-performance C++ product in the energy commodities trading domain. This is not a from-scratch build — you'll be joining a live, production trading system where every millisecond counts, with real opportunity to influence the technical direction of a core part of the platform. JOB REQUIREMENTS: Must have: 3.5+ years of professional experience in software development Deep expertise in Modern C++ (17/20/23) : move semantics, constexpr, templates, etc. Strong experience with Linux / POSIX environments Profi/ciency with build systems and tools: CMake / vcpkg , Git Hands-on experience with concurrency and shared memory tools Networking skills: ZeroMQ (or similar), low-level socket programming (TCP/UDP) Proficiency in using AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude, Codex, etc.) to enhance the development workflow English: Upper-Intermediate or Advanced Nice to have: Experience with Svelte Familiarity with kdb+ , TypeScript , and code generation tools Experience in Financial or Trading domains (FIX Protocol, OMS, market data feeds like ITCH/OUCH) Knowledge of Redis or other in-memory data stores Familiarity with the Qt framework Team lead experience (optional, not required) WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR: Autonomy: You excel at working independently, learning on your own, and figuring out large, unfamiliar codebases without external support. Ownership: You are ready to take full responsibility for the core part of the system. Assertiveness: You can clearly communicate your technical vision and demonstrate your project understanding effectively. PROJECT Customer: Global company based in the US, serving large international clients. Type: Fintech / trading platform Product: A live, high-performance market order and trading system designed as an exchange for energy commodities. The platform connects global buyers and sellers of specialized commodities, providing trading, data insights, and market infrastructure used by large enterprises, financial institutions, and government agencies. Market: Global — primarily US and European markets, serving corporations, financial institutions, and governments across multiple regions. Stage: Existing, established platform. The Markets Engineering team is expanding internationally. Project team: C++ and UI developers (team of 4-6), reporting to a Lead C++ Engineer. [confirm exact composition with HM] Technical stack: Modern C++ (17/20/23), Linux/POSIX, CMake, vcpkg, Git, ZeroMQ, shared memory, TCP/UDP sockets; Svelte, TypeScript, kdb+, Redis, Qt (adjacent/nice to have) Work schedule: Full-time working day, fully remote. items.desc: Oeiras, Portugal | Full time | Hybrid | R1572580 Application Security Architect Location: Portugal Role and Responsibilities Protecting Personal Health Information (PHI) and other sensitive client data is a core responsibility of this position. The Application Security Architect will work with Cedar Gate application teams, who are based both in Nepal and the United States, to design and improve safeguards across healthcare applications, APIs, data exchanges, cloud services, and supporting infrastructure. This senior, hands-on role is an embedded design and risk advisor for Cedar Gate product, development, engineering, DevOps, and infrastructure teams where all services are hosted in AWS or Snowflake. Based in Portugal and reporting to the Cedar Gate Associate Director, Security, the architect will support new applications, functionality, material changes, and technology modernization. The role will influence Cedar Gate’s Secure SDLC and AIDLC, while engineering retains solution ownership and application security analysts perform routine testing, tooling, triage, and remediation tracking. Principal responsibilities include: Establish risk-based review criteria for new applications, functionality, material changes, AI features, and supporting infrastructure; perform complex reviews and document requirements, decisions, exceptions, and closure evidence. Identify systemic weaknesses and modernization priorities. Lead threat modeling for applications, APIs, administrative functions, sensitive data flows, trust boundaries, and AI-enabled features using STRIDE, misuse cases, and attack-path analysis; translate threats into design requirements. Maintain reusable application security patterns, architecture decision records, and guidance for identity, tenant isolation, input and file handling, cryptography, secrets, logging, PHI workflows, APIs, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and service communications. Influence the Secure SDLC and AIDLC through architecture gates, threat-modeling criteria, secure coding and AI guardrails, testing requirements, and risk-based release criteria. Address prompt injection, data leakage, insecure tool or output use, excessive agency, authorization bypass, and improper use of PHI, source code, or credentials. Define validation requirements for AI-generated code and AI-enabled applications, including developer review, provenance and licensing, secrets and dependency scanning, SAST, SCA, DAST, API, container, infrastructure-as-code, and pre-production testing; analysts execute routine reviews. Provide architectural guidance and escalation for testing, vulnerability management, supply-chain risk, penetration testing, and high-risk findings. Present design recommendations, tradeoffs, and remediation strategies to engineering, product, security leadership, and governance forums. Provide senior architectural review to Nepal application and cloud security personnel for complex reviews, threat models, AI assessments, risk decisions, and systemic findings without duplicating analyst work. Align Cedar Gate patterns with IQVIA security architecture requirements. Required Experience and Qualifications 6 or more years of progressive experience in application security, software engineering, product security, cloud security, security engineering, or application security architecture; 6–8 years of directly relevant experience is preferred. Experience reviewing new and existing application architectures, conducting threat modeling, documenting sensitive data flows and trust boundaries, and translating threats into practical requirements; strong knowledge of application and API security, multi-tenant SaaS, identity, cryptography, secrets, logging, supply-chain risk, and PHI processing. Experience influencing Secure SDLC and AIDLC practices, defining risk-based review and release criteria, and embedding security into CI/CD. Knowledge of SAST, SCA, DAST, API, secrets, container, infrastructure-as-code, and penetration testing; experience evaluating generated code, AI assistants, agents, LLM integrations, and sensitive-data handling is required. Working knowledge of application-facing AWS architecture and relevant standards, including OWASP ASVS, OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, OWASP SAMM, OWASP LLM guidance, NIST Secure Software Development Framework, MITRE CWE, HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, CIS, and NIST requirements. Strong analytical and communication skills; ability to work predominantly during U.S. business hours with teams in the United States, Nepal, Portugal, and other IQVIA locations; fluent English; bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience. Preferred Experience Healthcare SaaS, PHI exchange, analytics, managed file transfer or sFTP, and multi-tenant platforms. items.desc: Across Commodities and Global Markets, data is fundamental to how we trade, price, manage risk and make decisions. It flows through market feeds, cloud platforms and specialist systems, each serving different needs across the business. But having sophisticated data platforms is only part of the equation. When decisions are time-sensitive and carry significant financial and operational consequences, understanding what data is available, what it means, where it came from, how reliable and current it is, and who is entitled to use it becomes just as important. As the scale and complexity of our data estate grow, we want to make it easier for people and applications to find, understand and use the right data with confidence, without the complexity of the underlying systems standing in the way. We already use established solutions to manage and govern our data, but we believe there is an opportunity to go further. We’re building our own Data Control Plane from the ground up, designed around the needs of our business and the platforms that support it. Rather than replacing the systems that store and process data, it will provide a more consistent way to discover, understand and securely access information across our data estate. Starting with catalogue, metadata, lineage and discovery, we’re laying the foundations for more connected, transparent and effective governance, making it easier to put data to work without compromising control. As AI-enabled applications and agents become increasingly important, that foundation will be critical to enabling them to discover and interact with data in a secure, reliable and governed way. Building this platform brings together sophisticated application development and the challenges of engineering at scale. From intuitive interfaces that make complex data easy to explore, to high-performance APIs and services that connect securely across distributed systems, every layer needs to be designed for reliability, scalability and long-term evolution. We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future. What role will you play? As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you’ll help shape and build the Data Control Plane from the ground up. You’ll work across the product, from the experiences people interact with to the services and cloud infrastructure behind them. Using React and TypeScript, Python and AWS, you’ll build capabilities that make complex data easier to discover, understand and use. On the frontend, you’ll create intuitive experiences for exploring and interacting with data. You’ll develop features including catalogue browsing, search, data-rich grids, visualisations and workflow-driven functionality, working with reusable components, design systems and complex application state. As the product grows, you’ll also tackle the performance and usability challenges that come with increasingly rich applications and larger volumes of data. Beyond the frontend, you’ll design, build and operate the APIs and backend services that power these experiences. Working with Python and frameworks such as FastAPI, you’ll develop secure, high-performing services using SQL and relational data models. You’ll work across areas such as asynchronous processing, validation, pagination, caching, versioning and error handling to create APIs that can evolve reliably as the platform grows. Security and access will be built into the platform from the outset. You’ll integrate with identity and access-management services, developing authentication and role-based authorisation that allow people and applications to access data appropriately and securely. You’ll have the opportunity to work across the engineering lifecycle, taking new capabilities from design and development through to deployment and production. Using CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and observability practices, you’ll help ensure the platform can be released reliably, operated effectively and continually improved as it grows on AWS. Because this is a greenfield build, you’ll have the opportunity to influence how the product develops as well as what we build. You’ll contribute to architectural decisions, technical direction and the engineering standards that will support the platform as it grows, applying strong software engineering principles across testing, security, scalability, resilience and maintainability. You’ll also develop AI-enabled capabilities that create new ways for people to discover and understand data. This could include natural-language catalogue search, metadata enrichment and intelligent assistant-style features. You’ll integrate managed large language model services and apply appropriate evaluation, safeguards and responsible AI practices to make these …

items.desc: An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced and motivated Band 6 Clinical Practitioner to join the West Essex Hospital at Home Service. Hospital at Home provides safe, effective and person-centred care to patients who would otherwise require admission to an acute hospital or who can be supported to leave hospital earlier. Care is delivered through a combination of face-to-face clinical assessment, treatment and remote monitoring, supported by a multidisciplinary team. The successful candidate will work autonomously within their professional scope of practice, managing patients with a range of acute and complex health needs in their own homes. You will undertake comprehensive assessments, develop individualised care plans, deliver clinical interventions and recognise and respond to deterioration. We are looking for a compassionate and forward-thinking practitioner with strong clinical decision-making, communication and organisational skills. Community or acute-care experience would be beneficial, although appropriate induction, training and ongoing professional development will be provided. Deliver clinical interventions in accordance with professional competence and local policies. Participate in daily multidisciplinary discussions, clinical handovers and safety huddles. Support junior colleagues, students and newly appointed staff through supervision and role modelling. items.desc: Job Description Summary GE Vernova est une entreprise mondiale du secteur de l’énergie, organisée en trois segments : Power, Wind et Electrification. Fort de plus de 130 ans d'expérience dans la résolution des défis mondiaux, GE Vernova est idéalement positionnée pour jouer un rôle de leader dans la transition énergétique, en continuant à électrifier le monde tout en travaillant à sa décarbonation, avec plus de 70 000 employés répartis dans plus de 100 pays. Le segment Electrification de GE Vernova fournit des technologies et systèmes de réseau avancés, permettant la transmission et la distribution d'énergie depuis le point de génération jusqu'au point de consommation, et soutient une transition énergétique décarbonisée et sécurisée. Sur son site industriel situé à Villeurbanne (France), conçoit, teste et fabrique des disjoncteurs haute tension destinés aux opérateurs de réseaux et industriels nationaux et internationaux. Job Description Présentation du poste Chez GE Vernova, nous ne nous contentons pas de construire l'avenir de l'énergie ; nous le transformons grâce à la puissance des données et de l’intelligence artificielle. Vous rejoindrez une équipe à la pointe de la technologie où l'IA est un levier quotidien, comme en témoigne le succès de notre assistant interne Amp . Si vous souhaitez façonner les outils de demain et accompagner nos Project Engineering Managers (PEM) dans leur transition digitale, ce stage est fait pour vous Missions Au Sein De L’équipe Project Engineering Management, Vous Participerez Activement à L'amélioration De La Gestion De Nos Projets Complexes Développement d'outils IA : Concevoir et implémenter des solutions (LLM, analyse prédictive) pour automatiser les tâches répétitives des PEM. Analyse de données : Développer des algorithmes pour analyser l'avancement des projets en temps réel et optimiser le pilotage. Reporting intelligent : Automatiser la génération de rapports de situation pour fournir une vision synthétique et actionnable. Gestion de la qualité : Intégrer l'IA pour monitorer les standards de qualité et assurer la conformité des livrables. Collaboration transverse : Travailler avec des experts métiers pour co-créer des solutions adaptées. Formation Étudiant(e) en dernière année d'école d'ingénieur ou Master spécialisé (Data Science, Informatique, Génie Industriel). Connaissances requises Compétences techniques : Maîtrise de Python , bibliothèques Data Science (Pandas, Scikit-learn), et familiarité avec les LLM (ex: LangChain). Soft Skills : Curiosité intellectuelle, capacité à vulgariser des concepts techniques, force de proposition. Français et Anglais opérationne Date de début du stage et durée Au plus tôt pour 6 mois Début janvier 2027 Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: No

items.desc: About Us: Betty is an innovative entertainment company pioneering at the intersection of real-money online casinos and casual mobile gaming. Betty Canada is a scale up company accredited by the Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario (AGCO) as a B2C operator in February 2023, we've set a new standard in the industry. Our mission is to redefine the online casino experience by offering a uniquely transparent environment where players can relax, unwind, and enjoy themselves safely. We are committed to accessibility, fairness, and inclusivity, fostering a community of like-minded individuals who value ethical gaming practices and prioritize our players' safety and enjoyment above everything else. Our Values: We are honest : we value honesty in all aspects. Bring the Olives : we offer premium customer experience. Think Big : we believe in always striving for more. Key responsibilities: Design, build and ship AI solutions based on LLMs, such as AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and automated analysis and reporting, that teams across the business use every day. Help shape how Betty adopts AI: find high-value use cases, evaluate models and tools, and set up checks that AI outputs are accurate, reliable and cost-effective. Partner with the marketing and user acquisition teams on channel and campaign performance, using metrics such as CAC, ROAS, CPA, first-time depositors (FTDs), conversion rates and predicted LTV. Build marketing models such as predicted LTV for newly acquired players, attribution, marketing mix modeling, incrementality measurement and budget allocation across channels. Work with analysts, marketing, product and business stakeholders to turn business questions into clear requirements, success metrics and use cases. Work with large event-level data in Redshift, and combine and clean data from internal and external sources such as player activity, transactions, payments, CRM and marketing platforms. Build statistical and machine learning models for problems such as player lifetime value, churn and retention, segmentation, forecasting and driver analysis. Form and test hypotheses about player and commercial behavior, and turn the answers into clear recommendations, including how they affect our players. Find opportunities and inefficiencies across player segments, games, providers, payment flows and channels, and run deep-dives that support product launches and marketing campaigns. Support experimentation and A/B testing: define success metrics, analyze results and know when a result is real. Take models from prototype to production and own them end to end, from batch jobs on daily, weekly and monthly schedules to real-time inference where speed matters. Build and run real-time pipelines that stream player events (for example with Kafka or Flink), compute features on live data and serve predictions with low latency, such as real-time churn and retention signals. Set up the MLOps foundations: CI/CD for models, model registry and versioning, a feature store, automated retraining, and monitoring for drift, data quality and model performance. Present results through dashboards and clear recommendations to any audience, up to C-level. Help other teams use data and AI on their own, through self-service analytics and shared environments where they can safely deploy their own AI tools. Work within the rules of a regulated market, including responsible gambling and data privacy requirements. Requirements: 3+ years of experience as a Data Scientist/ML Engineer. Strong knowledge of statistics and machine learning methods, such as predictive modeling, classification, clustering, regression, and optimization. Advanced Python with strong software engineering practices (testing, code review, Git), and advanced SQL with Redshift or a comparable cloud data warehouse. Proven experience deploying and running ML models in production, including CI/CD, containers (Docker), model versioning, automated retraining and monitoring for drift and performance. Hands-on experience building solutions with LLMs and generative AI, such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents and tool use, prompt engineering and NLP. Experience working with LLM APIs and frameworks, and with evaluating AI outputs for accuracy, reliability, and cost. Good judgment on where AI adds value and where a simpler method works better, and you keep up with new models and tools. Proven experience applying models to business problems such as forecasting, segmentation, lifetime value, retention, churn, or engagement. Experience with large datasets (100M+ rows and many variables). The ability to work with messy, incomplete, and changing data and still produce reliable results. Clear communication: you can explain complex work to people who don't want the detail, and manage expectations honestly. Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Fluent English, written and spoken. Nice to have: Strongly preferred : experience with marketing …

items.desc: Description de l'entreprise Inetum est un leader européen des services numériques. Pour les entreprises, les acteurs publics et la société dans son ensemble, les 28 000 consultants et spécialistes du groupe visent chaque jour l'impact digital : des solutions qui contribuent à la performance, à l'innovation et au bien commun. Présent dans 19 pays au plus près des territoires, et avec ses grands partenaires éditeurs de logiciels, Inetum répond aux enjeux de la transformation digitale avec proximité et flexibilité. Porté par son ambition de croissance et d'industrialisation, Inetum a généré en 2023 un chiffre d'affaires de 2,5 milliards d'€. Pour répondre à un marché en croissance continue depuis plus de 30ans, Inetum a fait le choix délibéré de se recentrer sur 4 métiers afin de gagner en puissance et proposer des solutions sur mesure, adaptées aux besoins spécifiques de ses clients : le conseil (Inetum Consulting), la gestion des infrastructures et applications à façon (Inetum Technologies), l'implémentation de progiciels (Inetum Solutions) et sa propre activité d'éditeur de logiciels (Inetum Software). Inetum a conclu des partenariats stratégiques avec 4 grands éditeurs mondiaux - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft et SAP et poursuit une stratégie d'acquisitions dédiée afin d'entrer dans le top 5 européen sur ces technologies et proposer la meilleure expertise à ses clients. Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. Description du poste Au sein d’une organisation engagée dans le développement de solutions innovantes, le besoin porte sur un Ingénieur Intégration IA chargé d’accompagner les équipes dans l’intégration et le déploiement de capacités d’intelligence artificielle au sein des applications. La mission combine développement, intégration technique et accompagnement des équipes dans un environnement agile. Missions Participer aux ateliers de cadrage et à l’analyse des besoins techniques. Contribuer aux choix d’architecture et aux stratégies d’intégration. Développer des composants, services et connecteurs d’intégration. Intégrer des fonctionnalités basées sur l’IA générative dans les applications existantes. Accompagner les équipes dans l’adoption des bonnes pratiques IA et développement.
