items.desc: We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers. Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY). This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub. Are you excited about turning AI ideas into practical business solutions? In this internship, you will work directly with senior leaders to rapidly explore, prototype, and deliver focused AI, automation, and data solutions that address real business needs. You'll gain hands-on experience with modern AI technologies while building tools that create measurable impact across the organization. This is a highly practical role focused on delivering usable solutions quickly, learning through execution, and collaborating within a small delivery pod. What You Will Do Partner with senior leaders to understand business challenges, clarify requirements, and define realistic solution scopes. Prototype and deliver lightweight AI applications, automation tools, dashboards, scripts, and internal productivity solutions. Build solutions using modern AI technologies, including LLM APIs, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and AI-assisted development tools. Extract, process, and analyze structured and unstructured data to support business decision-making. Apply company security, confidentiality, and data-handling requirements throughout the development lifecycle. Iterate quickly based on stakeholder feedback and continuously improve delivered solutions. Create concise technical documentation, handover notes, and usage guidance to support future maintenance and scalability. Opportunity to collaborate with global stakeholders, with occasional meetings scheduled outside standard local business hours to support different time zones. Requirements Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. Programming experience in Python or another general-purpose language; JavaScript or TypeScript is a plus. Experience building at least one software, AI, or data-related project through coursework, personal projects, research, hackathons, open-source contributions, or internships. Familiarity with APIs, version-control tools such as Git, and working with data. Understanding of AI application concepts, such as prompt engineering, structured outputs, AI agents, or RAG. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences. Ability to manage well-defined assignments independently, communicate blockers proactively, and seek guidance when needed. Professional working proficiency in English. Preferred Qualifications Experience with lightweight application frameworks such as Streamlit, Gradio, Flask, FastAPI, React, or Next.js. Exposure to enterprise-approved LLM platforms, AI SDKs, or orchestration frameworks. Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, semantic search, vector databases, tool calling, or agentic workflows. Hands-on experience working with large datasets using standard data manipulation tool such as SQL, CSV data processing, pandas, Spark, R, PowerBI, or basic data visualization. Exposure to Microsoft 365, Microsoft Graph, Power Platform, Google Workspace, or related enterprise APIs. Familiarity with workflow-automation platforms such as Power Automate, n8n, or Retool. Basic understanding of cloud services, containers, application deployment, authentication, and access control. Experience evaluating AI outputs for accuracy, consistency, groundedness, or other quality measures. Mitarbeitenden-Empfehlungsprogramm mit attraktiver Prämienregelung Nutze die Chance, deine Abschlussarbeit mit Drees & Sommer zu schreiben und verbinde Theorie und Praxis!

items.desc: Description de l’entreprise Institution financière internationale de premier plan, Natixis Corporate & Investment Banking met à disposition des entreprises, institutions financières, fonds d’investissement, agences souverains et supranationaux une palette de services en conseil, investment banking, financements, banque commerciale et sur les marchés de capitaux. Ses équipes d’experts, présentes dans environ 30 pays, conseillent les clients sur leur développement stratégique en les accompagnant dans le développement et la transformation de leurs activités tout en maximisant leur impact positif. Natixis CIB s’engage sur un alignement de son portefeuille de financements sur une trajectoire de neutralité carbone d’ici 2050 tout en aidant ses clients à réduire l’impact environnemental de leur activité. Natixis CIB fait partie du Groupe BPCE, deuxième groupe bancaire en France à travers les réseaux Banque Populaire et Caisse d’Epargne. Elle bénéficie de la puissance financière et des solides notations du Groupe (Standard & Poor's : A+, Moody's : A2, Fitch Ratings: A+, R&I : A+). Poste et missions POSTE ET MISSIONS Vous rejoignez notre équipe Économétrie au sein du département Market & Counterparty Risk qui recherche un Développeur d'outils économétriques en Python , pour un stage de 6 mois à partir de Novembre 2026. Les outils d'analyse, de reconstruction de données historiques ou d'identification de valeurs aberrantes dans les séries temporelles sont intégrés dans une librairie commune développée en python, mis à disposition pour la plupart via un front-end utilisant le framework steamlit. D'autres fonctionnalités développées au sein de l'équipe pour des besoins spécifiques restent à intégrer dans la librairie globale, notamment autour de sujets de calibrations d'écart-types, de production de KPI réglementaires ou autres rapports d'impact de la mise à jour hebdomadaire de l'économétrie pour le calcul de VAR. Dans une volonté de moderniser les outils à disposition de l'équipe, une composante non négligeable du stage reposera sur la mise en place d'agents IA visant fluidifier les tâches quotidiennes. En collaboration avec votre tuteur, vos missions principales seront : Se familiariser avec les outils existant en lisant les documentations et le code associés. Être force de proposition pour l'intégration des outils d'analyse de l'équipe dans la librairie globale en python. Mettre à profit les ressources internes basées sur des LLM pour la mise en place d'agents IA permettant d'analyser les métriques produites par l'équipe ou la détection d'anomalies. Créer un socle commun sous forme de librairie incluant les fonctionnalités utiles à l'équipe dans leurs missions quotidiennes. Effectuer les tests de cohérence post migration. Éventuellement améliorer les performances du code. Documenter les différentes étapes ainsi que réaliser un modus operandi si nouvelles fonctionnalités ajoutées. Intervenir sur les facteurs de risque et les données de marché pour toutes les classes d’actifs (taux, crédit, trésorerie, change, actions, matières premières). #FinanceTransformative Nous plaçons nos collaborateurs au centre de nos attentions. Des dispositifs de mobilité interne, développement de carrière et de formation vous permettent de grandir et de vous épanouir tout au long de votre parcours. Vous évoluez dans un environnement de travail inclusif, favorisant le collaboratif avec des missions concrètes et un impact réel. Nous vous accompagnerons tout au long de votre expérience chez nous pour que vous puissiez apprendre et développer vos compétences en travaillant aux côtés de professionnels expérimentés. Vous avez également la possibilité de vous engager en faveur de la société et de causes qui vous tiennent à cœur via notre fondation d’entreprise. Vous bénéficiez d’une indemnité de stage en fonction de votre formation et de votre niveau d’études, également d’un remboursement de votre titre de transport à hauteur de 60 %, d’un jour d’absence autorisé payé pour chaque mois travaillé et de l’accès au restaurant de l’entreprise. Profil et compétences requises Étudiant de niveau BAC+ 4/5, vous préparez un diplôme universitaire, d’école de commerce ou d’école d’ingénieur, avec une spécialisation en Finance de Marché ou Risques. Vous maitrisez le langage de développement Python et dans l'idéal avez des notions en matière d'intelligence artificielle (Modèles de machine learning, agentique, RAG). Vous avez une appétence pour les métriques de risque en finance de marché (calcul d'une VaR, calculs statistiques ou économiques, produits financiers). Akkodis compte près de 40 000 ingénieurs et experts du digital dans le monde. Akkodis est une marque de The Adecco Group. Missions La ligne de service Consulting & Solutions d'Akkodis France renforce ses équipes en région Nouvelle-Aquitaine et recrute un(e) Ingénieur IA H/F en CDI à Bordeaux. Ce poste s'inscrit dans un contexte d'innovation autour de la conception, du déploiement et de l'optimisation de solutions d'intelligence artificielle et d'ingénierie des données pour des projets à forte valeur ajoutée. Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie des applications IA, depuis l'analyse des besoins jusqu'à la mise en production en environnement cloud. Responsabilités principales : Concevoir et développer des modèles d'intelligence artificielle adaptés aux besoins métiers, incluant des applications LLM (RAG, agents, assistants). Intégrer, optimiser et opérer les pipelines de données et de retrieval à grande échelle, en assurant la qualité et la sécurité des données. Orchestrer des agents et workflows multi-agents, définir les garde-fous et politiques d'usage, et mettre en œuvre des stratégies d'évaluation. Déployer, monitorer et maintenir les applications IA générative sur des plateformes cloud (Azure OpenAI, AWS, GCP) en s'appuyant sur les pratiques GenAIOps (observabilité, CI/CD, AKS). Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes produit, data et métiers pour définir les spécifications techniques et prioriser les cas d'usage IA générative à forte valeur ajoutée. Assurer une veille technologique active et diffuser les bonnes pratiques en IA, data engineering et sécurité applicative. Environnement de travail : Vous évoluerez dans un environnement stimulant, centré sur des plateformes ML/MLOps et GenAI cloud-native. L'équipe valorise la collaboration interdisciplinaire, la sécurité et la qualité logicielle. Les projets s'appuient sur des outils modernes (Python, Django, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, bases vectorielles, OCR) et une méthodologie orientée production et innovation continue. Profil du candidat Issu(e) d'une formation supérieure de niveau Bac+5 (Master ou équivalent) en informatique, data science ou domaine technique connexe, vous justifiez idéalement de minimum 5 années d'expérience en conception et déploiement de solutions IA et/ou data engineering. Vous maîtrisez Python, SQL, les frameworks de machine learning (TensorFlow, PyTorch), le prompt engineering, les plateformes cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP), et les outils d'orchestration d'agents (LangGraph, LlamaIndex). Vous avez une expertise en gestion de bases de données relationnelles, NoSQL et vectorielles, ainsi qu'en sécurité des LLM et protection des données. Des compétences en DevOps, CI/CD et gestion d'équipes projets sont appréciées. Votre sens de l'organisation, votre méthodologie et votre curiosité technologique vous permettent de vous adapter dans un environnement en évolution rapide. Akkodis accompagne ses clients dans la mondialisation de leurs projets, aussi un anglais courant est requis pour l'ensemble de nos collaborateurs.​

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for an Aerodynamics Engineer (f/m) to join our Aerodynamics Department in Toulouse, France . 
 You will take part in designing the next generation of commercial airliners for a sustainable future, developing innovative aircraft architectures and propulsion technologies. Working within the team in charge of overall aerodynamic characterization across all Airbus programmes, you will generate, calibrate, and validate models from early design phases through to wind-tunnel and flight testing. 
 Your working environment: 
 Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities! 
 How we care for you: 
 Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis. 
 Work / Life Balance: Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services. 
 Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application. 
 Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility. 
 At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking. 
 Your challenges: 
 Lead performance modeling campaigns through CFD and flight tests up to aircraft certification. 
 Coordinate technical deliverables across Aerodynamics disciplines and align with project stakeholders. 
 Develop accurate aerodynamic performance prediction methods for future aircraft concepts and configurations. 
 Continuously enhance existing aircraft models using flight-test data and high-fidelity CFD simulations. 
 Deploy machine learning and AI methods to accelerate aerodynamic trade studies and design iterations. 
 Your boarding pass: 
 Background in Aeronautical Engineering (or equivalent) with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience. 
 Solid technical background in aerodynamic modeling, flight mechanics, and CFD methodologies. 
 Proficiency in Python programming, with valuable exposure to data science and machine learning / AI. 
 Proven leadership track record with strong decision-making, stakeholder management, and influencing skills. 
 Advanced proficiency in English (written and spoken); French language skills are an advantage. 
 Willingness to travel for business and eligibility to obtain relevant security clearance. 
 Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions. Take your career to a new level and apply online now! #LI-YL1

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Join our SAP Team in Copenhagen: Ready to take direct ownership of the SAP BTP digital backbone connecting global aviation? We are looking for an SAP Integrations Specialist to join our team. While we operate as an integral part of the global Airbus ecosystem, this role offers high technical autonomy, direct communication channels, and end-to-end impact as you help drive our migration from PI/PO to the Cloud. 
 What the job is … 
 As an SAP Integrations Specialist, you will spearhead modern cloud integration design and serve as the local technical anchor for our integration landscape, ensuring stability while driving our transition toward a cloud-first architecture using SAP Integration Suite and BTP. Enforcing our global governance model across local and international business units, you will drive Satair’s disciplined federated development framework, where our Central Integration Team acts as the technical gatekeeper and operational authority to guarantee a "Zero-Disruption" production environment. 
 Your main responsibilities include:
 Platform Operations & High Availability: Supporting the daily operation, monitoring, maintenance, and proactive troubleshooting of the integration landscape to guarantee platform-level stability and performance across our SAP RISE environment. 
 PI/PO-to-BTP Cloud Migration: Leading and executing global project tracks to migrate legacy SAP PI/PO interfaces into SAP Integration Suite on BTP, ensuring minimal business disruption and streamlined system cut-overs. 
 Architecture & Best Practice Advisory: Advising solution architects, functional teams, and external IT suppliers on integration standards, reusable enterprise patterns, and modular cloud architectures. 
 Technical Quality Gatekeeping: Conducting formal "Gate Reviews" on incoming iFlows submitted by functional teams, auditing for robust exception handling, modularity, Groovy/mapping efficiency, and BTP resource/credit impact. 
 Sole Production Deployment Authority: Enforcing the "Zero-Disruption" governance policy by exercising exclusive deployment and transport rights into the Production tenant, ensuring zero unauthorized write access. 
 Security & Governance Enforcement: Verifying that all interfaces comply with global naming conventions, utilize the BTP Secure Store without hardcoded credentials, and adhere to strict enterprise security standards. 
 Landscape & Performance Optimization: Continuously monitoring runtime performance, memory footprints, and BTP tenant health to proactively resolve bottlenecks and optimize integration flows. 
 Multi-Adapter & Protocol Oversight: Governing end-to-end integration scenarios across diverse protocols and adapters, including HTTP/REST, SOAP, IDOC, JDBC, SFTP/File, OData, and SAP Graph. 
 SAP RISE & Ecosystem Connectivity: Supporting and securing integration touchpoints connecting our SAP RISE S/4HANA backbone with SAP Fiori, non-SAP systems, and third-party cloud services. 
 You will take ownership of platform-level monitoring, overall integration stability, and landscape performance across our SAP RISE environment. In this role, you will guide technical teams by promoting standard APIs and pre-delivered integration packages from SAP and partners to accelerate delivery and enforce enterprise consistency. Working closely with functional consultants, external developers, and global business stakeholders, you will review Solution Design Documents (SDDs) to ensure business requirements translate into secure, scalable, and compliant integration patterns. And assist with writing (ARDs) Architectural Requirement Dossier.
 Leveraging your ability to take the lead, you will drive both small- and large-scale initiatives—most notably our PI/PO-to-Cloud migration—in close collaboration with distributed international teams. Your role is central to maintaining high documentation quality in our knowledge repositories and upholding rigorous technical gate standards before any solutions reach production. Staying current with SAP BTP and cloud integration trends, you will balance architectural oversight with deep troubleshooting and operational governance to support continuous improvement across Satair’s digital backbone.
 Some travel days to be expected.
 How you will contribute to the team 
 With at least 5 years of enterprise integration experience, you bring a solid technical foundation, an architectural mindset, and a proactive approach to our Copenhagen-based integration team.
 With deep expertise in SAP Integration Suite, SAP API Management, SAP BTP, and legacy SAP PI/PO, you will steer the architecture, governance, and quality assurance of solutions across our complex enterprise landscape. Your comprehensive knowledge of legacy standards—such as IDOC, ALE, BAPI, RFC, SOAP, and REST—combined with modern cloud paradigms will be critical as you lead the technical migration of our on-premise interfaces into the cloud and serve as the authoritative technical gatekeeper …

Job Description: 
 An opportunity for a Future Projects Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid). As a member of the Future Projects Platform Systems, the component will be responsible of performing Technical Studies at system Level for Future Projects, Derivative concepts of existing programs and Commercial Campaigns. As Future Projects Platform System Engineer he/she will have close relation with the Chief Engineering Offices, Research
and Development, Research and Technology, Programmes, Customers, Systems Suppliers, Strategy and Marketing functions in addition to the different Centres of Competence within the Engineering function. As a member of the Future Projects Platform System he/she will develop his/her career in a multiprogram environment with tasks related to Medium & Light, A400M, Combat, Tankers and UAV programme.
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Ensure interface & integration of Engineering activities in support to the preparation of the Airbus product policy.
 Lead and/or Support & perform analysis of competitor’s products, at Aircraft and/or Vehicle & Components level, for the benefit of Strategy, Marketing, Sales, Engineering and Technology functions.
 Lead and/or support the intelligence activities within Engineering.
 Define the top level technical objectives and requirements up to MG3 allowing a robust launch of a new or incremental programme.
 Manage and lead all activities required to meet overall vehicle design and major constituents’ integration needs up to MG2 for new programmes.
 Perform trade-off analysis in order to select the best overall vehicle and system architecture fulfilling system/product requirements.
 Explore technical, manufacturing & operational aspects of innovative Aircraft and/or Vehicle configuration; this includes the capability to assess value & cost benefit (from both Aircraft and/or Vehicle manufacturer and operator perspectives).
 Define component design targets for best overall vehicle value and monitor and challenge their achievement with the CoCs.
 Define, prioritize and conduct research projects to adapt and develop technologies and competencies towards enhanced overall vehicle design and integrated constituents.
 Develop knowledge and propose directions on environmental aspects.
 SKILLS 
As the successful candidate, you will be able to demonstrate some of the following skills:
• Candidates must ideally have 5-10 years of experience within Engineering,
preferable in Systems Engineering and/or overall aircraft systems.
• Engineering degree.
• Good knowledge of general Platform Systems and its dependencies.
• Good level of English language.
• Ability to work with uncertainty, flexibility and scarcity of information.
• Team working skills and a pro-active approach to solve problems.
 • MBSE: Cameo including simulations skills
 WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE? 
 At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits:
 Vacation days plus additional days-off along the year.
 Attractive salary.
 Hybrid model of working when possible.
 Collective transport service subject to working calendar/home location.
 Benefits such as life insurance, health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants.
 On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office.
 Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives.
 Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environment.
 Option to access special rates in products & benefits.

Job Description: 
 Take off with Airbus Helicopters! 
 Airbus Helicopters is looking for a Sub System Responsible and Work Package Manager (m/f) to join the Mechanical Flight Controls, Hydraulics and Actuation department based in Marignane , France.
 Join us to shape the future of aeronautics and help protect lives during missions accomplished thanks to our helicopters. The Marignane site, the 3rd largest industrial site in France, near Marseille and Aix-en-Provence, is undergoing a deep transformation to offer a high-tech, inclusive, and environmentally friendly working environment. You will live a unique professional experience, at the heart of the manufacturing of our helicopters. To learn more about our site and our activities: Airbus Helicopters - Marignane
 Your future missions: 
 By joining our team, you will participate in different missions, all focused on designing, developing and assuring continuing airworthiness of civil and military Helicopter Flight Controls, Hydraulics and Actuation. Together, we will contribute to the activity of the Mechanical Flight Controls, Hydraulics and Actuation department to help shape our current and future projects.
 Your main missions will be: 
 Assume system responsibility for the entire product life cycle taking into account cost, certification, manufacturing and maintainability aspects.
 Develop system requirements, and create concept and detailed design of flight control, hydraulics and actuation systems.
 Plan and manage Development and Research projects, collaborating with internal and external partners, subcontractors, and suppliers.
 Integrate systems into the helicopters, execute assembly/integration studies in CATIA V5, and generate certification documentation.
 Contribute to maintaining continuing airworthiness, handle obsolescence, and implement product improvements in an international working environment.
 Your profile: 
 Minimum 5 years of professional experience in the field of development, project management and hydraulic systems
 Master/diploma degree in the field of aerospace or mechanical engineering, with the ability to master simulation of mechanical and hydraulic systems.
 Expert English language skills.
 Strong collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams in a strong transnational French-German environment.
 3 Reasons to join us: 
 Our Values: Six essential values form the core of our company. Defined for employees by employees, our Airbus values shape the DNA of our business, reflecting the unique mix of qualities found in each member of our global family. 
 Inclusion and diversity: We foster an inclusive and rewarding work environment, where everyone's diversity is valued and respected. An inclusive and diverse workforce is the engine of innovation at Airbus. It makes us unique and contributes to better problem-solving. 
 Compensation and benefits: At Airbus, we build the future together and your success is our priority. Expect a global, competitive, and transparent compensation package (including salaries, bonuses, profit-sharing, participation, and preferred share ownership plan), designed to reward the impact and performance you bring, both individually and collectively. We invest in your complete well-being: professional development (training, mentoring, international mobility), health coverage, retirement, and a commitment to a supported work-life balance (parental support, flexibility). And for your daily life, benefits that make a difference: A dynamic CSE (Social and Economic Committee) offering many advantages (company restaurant, children's leisure center, associations and sports complex, travel allowances, etc.). Transport facilities: Take advantage of our company shuttles or the reimbursement of your annual transport pass.
 Our recruitment process: 
 Apply online. Analysis of your application by the recruitment department. Our positions require a security clearance, complete the questionnaire that will be sent to you. Conduct recruitment interviews: HR interview and technical interview with your future manager Receive the job offer! Ready to take off? Give a new dimension to your career by applying online now

The world is how we shape it. Let’s shape it together. Description du poste En tant que (Cloud) System Engineer, vous jouez un rôle essentiel dans la conception, la mise en œuvre et la gestion de solutions cloud sécurisées, conformes et optimisées. Vous travaillez aussi bien sur des environnements cloud que hybrides, en combinant administration système, automatisation et technologies cloud. Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes : Concevoir, mettre en œuvre et assurer le support de solutions cloud et hybrides évolutives. Automatiser et maintenir les systèmes afin d’améliorer leur fiabilité et leur efficacité. Développer des scripts pour optimiser l’infrastructure et réduire les interventions manuelles. Effectuer des tâches d’administration système telles que l’installation, la configuration, le troubleshooting et le monitoring. Installer et gérer les upgrades, mises à jour et patches sur des plateformes on-premise et cloud. Optimiser et rationaliser les processus de déploiement. Utiliser Azure (ou AWS), ainsi que des technologies de virtualisation, de conteneurisation et d’orchestration telles que Kubernetes et Docker. Travailler avec le développement cloud-native, les architectures serverless et les pratiques DevOps. Mettre à profit vos connaissances en automatisation, réseaux et sécurité afin de soutenir la transformation numérique de nos clients. Collaborer avec différentes équipes afin de garantir des systèmes fiables, performants et rentables. Qualifications Nous recherchons des collègues prêts à repousser les limites de la transformation et de la technologie numériques. Vous évoluerez parmi des professionnels hautement qualifiés qui osent viser haut afin d’atteindre l’excellence. En outre, vous rejoindrez la Business Line DPS (Digital Platform Services). items.desc: Mission Overview: Keystone Solutions is seeking an expert Data Analyst for a consultancy mission in Brussels. You will be hired by Keystone Solutions and represent us on-site within our client's Corporate Banking transformation environment, working under the guidance of the client's Cluster Product Owner. The mission focuses on shaping the future of Corporate Banking data intelligence by modernising the BI and reporting ecosystem from SAS/SQL, Alteryx and JavaScript/React towards a future-proof Power BI platform integrated with Microsoft Dynamics 365. This is a strategic reinvention of how data flows, insights are delivered and business value is unlocked for Sales, Metiers and Leadership teams. Consultancy Responsibilities: Under Keystone Solutions' consultancy model, you will carry out the following responsibilities while representing Keystone Solutions in the client environment: Strategic Banking Transformation: Lead end-to-end banking data transformations, focusing on strategic planning and migration from legacy ETL workflows to Power BI-centric architectures. Drive adoption roadmaps for scalable, future-proof BI solutions aligned with enterprise data governance and regulatory requirements. Power BI Architecture and Team Upskilling: Design and enforce a scalable Power BI architecture. Coach and mentor team members to adopt Power BI best practices, including performance optimisation, security and deployment strategies. Upskill teams in advanced DAX development, including complex calculations, time intelligence and dynamic measures, as well as Power Query/M for efficient data transformation and custom functions. Promote reusable templates, standardised patterns and collaborative development, including shared datasets and Power BI Premium capacities. Data Modeling and Analytical Framework: Translate business requirements into optimised data models for analytics and reporting. Apply dimensional modelling, including star and snowflake schemas, to simplify cross-platform complexity. Design logical and physical data layers that ensure performance, scalability and maintainability. Manage metadata for traceability, including lineage, ownership and refresh cycles. ETL Pipeline and Data Integration: Own source-to-target mapping and ETL/ELT pipeline optimisation. Use SAS, SQL and Denodo VQL for high-performance data extraction, transformation and loading. Implement data quality controls, including validation rules, anomaly detection and reconciliation processes. Ensure seamless integration of new data sources with minimal latency and maximum reliability. Documentation and Governance: Establish and enforce documentation standards for datasets, including business definitions, technical specifications and refresh policies. Document workflows, including ETL logic, Power BI reports and dependency mappings. Establish naming conventions and metadata tagging to ensure discoverability, reusability and auditability across teams. Testing, Validation and Technical Debt Reduction: Orchestrate coexistence between legacy systems and the new Power BI ecosystem during transition phases. Develop reusable transformation patterns and consistent business logic across workflows to minimise technical debt. Design test cases, validate outputs with stakeholders and document changes for traceability. Proactively identify and remediate performance bottlenecks, data inconsistencies and integration gaps. Profile: A seasoned BI and Data Engineering expert with deep banking transformation experience. A strategic thinker able to assess legacy systems, data flows and business needs and contribute to architecting a scalable, future-ready solution. A change agent capable of guiding teams through technical transitions while ensuring business continuity and adoption. A collaborative leader who bridges technical execution and business vision. At least 5 years of relevant experience. Master's degree or equivalent experience. Strong analytical mindset. Mandatory Technical Experience: Advanced Power BI stack expertise: DAX, Power Query/M, Premium capacities, deployment pipelines and XMLA endpoints. SQL language. Data modelling expertise: star and snowflake schemas, dimensional modelling and Power BI dataflows. Preferable Technical and Business Experience: ETL tools: Alteryx, SAS, SQL, Denodo VQL and SSIS for legacy environments; Azure Data Factory is a plus. Banking data experience. Proven experience with Agile methods. Language Requirements: Fluent English. Fluent knowledge of at least one local language: Dutch or French. Dutch or French is required, with either language satisfying the local-language requirement. Agile Mindset and Soft Skills: Bring a positive attitude and pragmatism. Demonstrate a thirst for knowledge, embracing learning, adaptation and knowledge sharing as essential to Agile success. Focus on team success rather than individual success or heroic behaviour; achieving the team's goal takes priority over merely completing individual …

items.desc: Job Description: Skywise is a leading digital services company, wholly owned by Airbus. We deliver a first-of-its-kind offer that seamlessly integrates Planning & Operations Control, Flight, Technical, and Ground Operations. By providing interoperable digital solutions for end-to-end operations, Skywise combines aircraft manufacturer expertise and digital know-how to transform operational complexity into predictable and profitable performance, ensuring resilient and more sustainable operations. Role Summary: The Cloud Security Architect is a key member of the Security team playing an important role in the definition, management and improvement of our cloud infrastructure and platform services. This position ensures SKYWISE's robust security position is maintained by defining, implementing and improving our cloud security strategy. In this role, you will serve as the primary partner with the SKYWISE Data Platform Operations by defining the security architecture and tools used within our AWS platform for product landing, and other platforms for the company internal operations. In this frame you will be responsible for the identity and access definition, management and improvement ensuring a strong security posture. Finally this position will define and maintain our cloud security link with Airbus Security Operations Center in order to ensure an efficient monitoring of SKYWISE cloud platforms. Main Responsibilities: Cloud Infrastructure and Platform Security Design and enforce enterprise cloud security baselines, landing zones and internal infrastructure perimeters across SKYWISE cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, GCP) Define and implement cloud native Identity and Access Management (IAM) , emphasizing least privilege, short-lived service credentials, and key management infrastructure. Ensure regular reviews are performed and define improvements. Partner with the Cyber Security Architect to ensure our products are deployed onto secure, isolated and compliant platforms. Infrastructure governance Own SKYWISE platform level of compliance to our security standards and certification for cloud security controls. Define security controls to ensure global monitoring of our platforms and build a strong relationship with the SKYWISE Data Platform Operations teams. Posture Monitoring and Threat Defense Identify and manage our Cloud Security Posture tools to detect drift, unauthorized exposures and misconfiguration in real time. Define and implement the architecture rules to ensure global monitoring of our platforms to detect, manage and recover in case of security breaches. Be the focal point for the Airbus Security Operations Center with regards to the SKYWISE cloud platforms. Qualified Experience / Skills / Training: Experience & Capabilities: 7+ years in cyber security 3 or more years working experience in a cloud security architecture in a company or SaaS environment. Experience securing native cloud platform services (AWS, GCP, Azure) Advanced knowledge of cloud security controls definition (segmentation, key management,...) Experience in identity and access management in cloud environments. Knowledge, Skills, Demonstrated Capabilities & Competencies: AWS certified security or specialty Certified Cloud Security Professional (CSSP) Strong cross functional working skills Ability to identify and communicate on security risks related to cloud platforms. Pragmatic problem solving and proactive. A continuous improvement mindset Knowledge of DevOps practices and concepts What we Offer: Work-Life Balance & Flexibility Flexible working hours with a hybrid model (3 days per week in our Blagnac office). 25 annual paid leave days + Collective and individual JRTT (proportional to working time). Financial Wellbeing & Savings Success sharing (intéressement) and profit sharing (participation) schemes. Monthly seniority bonus for all employees with 3+ years of service. Access to Airbus Group saving plans (PEG) including investment in Airbus shares after 3+ months of service. Access to a TSA (Time Saving Account) Collective and Mandatory Retirement Savings Plans (PERCOL and PERO). On-site & Other Perks Several catering options for lunch (canteens, food trucks, bakeries, etc.). Staff councils (CSE) offer various social, cultural, and sports activities/services. items.desc: Mission Fayat IT recherche son futur Architecte Solution & Intelligence Artificielle (H/F) en CDI à Massy (91) ou Bordeaux (33). Au sein de la DSI Groupe, vous portez deux missions complémentaires au service des filiales et des métiers: Architecte solution : vous garantissez la cohérence fonctionnelle et technique du système d'information du Groupe FAYAT. Vous venez les cartographies applicatives, suivez les roadmaps des filiales, êtes le référent des architectures et des interfaces entre ERP et solutions satellites, et instruisez les synergies et rationalisations. Référent technique IA : vous accompagnez l'évaluation, la conception et le déploiement de solutions d'intelligence artificielle, de l'expression du besoin jusqu'à la mise en oeuvre, et construisez et opérez les capacités IA mises à disposition des filiales. Dans les deux cas, vous veillez à la création de valeur, à la maîtrise des risques et à l'intégration dans l'écosystème numérique du Groupe. Volet Intelligence Artificielle : Besoins métiers et scénarios : comprendre les processus et leurs enjeux, identifier les opportunités d'automatisation ou d'assistance par l'IA, évaluer les gains attendus ; comparer les approches (développement spécifique, solution du marché, Copilot Microsoft, agent IA, no-code, intégration existante) et produire des recommandations. Architectures de solution IA : définir l'architecture cible et les flux de données, garantir l'intégration avec le SI Groupe et la cohérence avec les standards, produire les dossiers d'architecture. Plateformes et enablers IA : concevoir, mettre en place et gérer des plateformes accueillant des projets IA (Snowflake, Databricks, plateformes Microsoft) ; souscriptions, modèles (LLM), conditions d'accès ; accompagner techniquement les projets filiales jusqu'au passage à l'échelle. Risques, conformité et modèles économiques : analyser les risques liés aux données et aux modèles, les enjeux réglementaires et cybersécurité ; évaluer les modèles de licence (SaaS, consommation, token utilisateur, agent), les coûts et la dépendance fournisseur ; contribuer aux appels d'offres et négociations. Veille et expérimentation : analyser les offres et la pérennité des éditeurs, réaliser benchmarks et comparatifs ; prototyper les technologies émergentes (agents, vibe coding, transposition d'applications obsolètes) et animer la relation avec les partenaires IA. Volet Architecture Solution : Cartographie du SI : établir et maintenir avec les Business Partners les cartographies fonctionnelles et applicatives des divisions (MyCarto), référentiel partagé de la DSI. Roadmaps et synergies : suivre les roadmaps applicatives des filiales, identifier et instruire les opportunités de synergie, de mutualisation et de rationalisation. Architecture des solutions et interfaces : interlocuteur de référence sur l'architecture des solutions, en particulier les interfaces ERP / solutions satellites ; participer aux cadrages des projets majeurs, conduire revues de design et audits d'architecture. Éditeurs, ESN et stratégie cloud : suivre les partenariats et les roadmaps éditeurs, préparer les arbitrages de la DSI ; contribuer à la gouvernance des landing zones et conseiller sur les trajectoires de migration. Périmètre exclu : l'animation globale de la démarche IA et de la communauté IA reste portée par la Responsable IA & Gouvernance SaaS ; Copilot M365 reste sous la supervision du service Change & M365. Profil recherché Les compétences recherchées : 1. Expertise IA : IA générative, LLM, RAG, agents IA, IA conversationnelle, Machine Learning, Knowledge Management 2. Architecture et intégration : architecture d'entreprise et applicative, middleware et interopérabilité, architecture Cloud 3. Gestion économique et contractuelle : TCO et ROI, modèles de licences, contrats SaaS, clauses spécifiques à l'IA, stratégie éditeurs. Ce que nous proposons : Une mutuelle prise en charge à 100%, Votre abonnement en transport en commun pris en charge à 100%, 2 journées fixes / semaine de télétravail après 3 mois d'ancienneté, Une rémunération en adéquation avec votre poste, vos expériences et compétences, Un accès au CSE, Une carte swile de 10.60€ prise en charge à 60% par l'entreprise, Une dynamique d'entreprise conviviale par l'organisation de divers évènements. S i votre candidature a été retenue : 1. Un échange avec Lisa, la recruteuse, afin de valider l'adéquation de votre profil avec notre recherche, 2. Un entretien avec le directeur du centre de compétence, où vous aurez l'occasion de rentrer dans les détails du poste, 3. Un entretien avec notre RRH afin de confirmer que nous sommes tous en phase sur le poste. Afin d'avoir une vision objective de votre profil, nous utilisons Assessfirst, une solution innovante basée sur l'IA pour cerner votre personnalité, vos motivations et vos capacités cognitives. Vous vous reconnaissez dans ce projet ? Vous savez ce qu'il vous reste à faire. Prêt à nous rejoindre ? Cliquez sur 'Postuler' !

items.desc: La mission est de réaliser ou de piloter les audits cybersécurité du SI et des plateformes de services du client : tests d'intrusion, audits de configuration et de durcissement, audits d'accès, audits d'architecture et audits organisationnels. Selon la nature du besoin, l'audit est conduit directement par le prestataire ou confié à un cabinet externe ? la mission couvre alors le cadrage, la sélection du cabinet, le pilotage de l'intervention et le challenge du livrable. Dans les deux cas, elle inclut la restitution aux parties prenantes et le suivi de la remédiation. Le périmètre est large : applications web et mobiles, API, infrastructures internes, exposition Internet, environnements Cloud et conteneurisés, briques d'identité et systèmes à base d'IA générative. La dominante est technique, sans se limiter au test d'intrusion. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn and Tik Tok. Job Description People. Passion. Possibilities. Three words that make a world of difference. More than a job. It's a chance to make a real difference. Welcome to AbbVie! As part of an international company with ca. 57,000 employees worldwide and around 3,500 employees in Germany, you will have the opportunity of addressing some of tomorrows unmet medical needs in close collaboration with your colleagues. Are you passionate about improving global health care? Do you want to contribute to improving patients' quality of life through your expertise? In a challenging work environment that offers opportunities of developing and increasing your own skills? Youve come to the right place! Together, we break through – as Method Development Scientist: Analytical method development for therapeutic proteins (all genders) In this role, you are responsible for developing robust, fit-for-purpose analytical methods for therapeutic proteins, including monoclonal antibodies, fixed-dose combinations, antibody-drug conjugates, and bispecific antibodies. You plan, conduct, and evaluate experiments to address scientific questions and support method development within a dedicated, highly skilled team. You communicate scientific data and conclusions through presentations to stakeholders and contribute to improving data visualization and scientific storytelling. You also document hypotheses, experimental results, and scientific evaluations accurately and promptly in digital systems. Make your mark : You will focus on the development of analytical methods for biologics, including monoclonal antibodies (mAbs), fixed-dose combinations (FDCs), antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), and bispecific antibodies, while taking a high level of personal responsibility within a dedicated and highly skilled team. You will plan, conduct, and evaluate experiments to address scientific questions and develop robust, fit-for-purpose analytical methods. You will prepare and deliver scientific presentations to communicate data and conclusions to stakeholders, while continuously improving our approaches to data visualization and scientific storytelling. You will document hypotheses, experimental results, and scientific evaluations accurately and in a timely manner in our digital systems. Qualifications This is how you make a difference: Scientist I: Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent education with typically 5 years of experience, or Master’s Degree or equivalent education with typically two years of experience. Scientist II: BS or equivalent education with typically 7 or more years of experience or MS or equivalent education with typically 5 or more years of experience Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities and skills and hands-on experience in method development. Strong practical expertise in the operation, troubleshooting, and routine maintenance of liquid chromatography systems are required. Candidate’s portfolio must consist of practical chromatographic separation techniques like HPLC/UPLC (e.g. SEC, IEX, RP or HIC) coupled to various detection systems (e.g. UV, FLD, CAD). Experience in chromatography data systems e.g. Chromeleon or Empower is beneficial. Knowledge or experience in capillary electrophoresis is a plus (CZE, CE-SDS or cIEF). Experience in Quality by Design (QbD), Design of Experiment (DoE) and software (like Fusion QbD) are an advantage. As a highly motivated, self-driven and results-oriented person with excellent communication and presentation skills you are driven by innovative ways of thinking to improve processes, methods or systems. As a global acting company, we presume excellent communication skills, including written and oral English and German. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities and skills and hands-on experience in method development. Strong practical expertise in the operation, troubleshooting, and routine maintenance of liquid chromatography systems …

items.desc: Company Description Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. In over 35 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of ca. 950 laboratories in 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. items.desc: About Nearfield Instruments Nearfield Instruments (NFI) is a fast-growing scale-up high-tech company. We design, develop, integrate, market and service advanced metrology machines. Our machines enable our customers - the world’s leading chipmakers – to increase the production yields, and thus, functionality of their microchips, which in turn leads to smaller, more powerful consumer electronics. Where you will be working? Within our Design & Engineering department this role is part of the Software Group. The SW Group consists of roughly 40 engineers within several teams working on the areas of Machine Control, Device Control, Integration and Data Science. Our technology stack is based on C# and Python but our true passion lies making customer solutions. Here are the different aspects of our stack: Machine Control: business logic, UI and semiconductor-foundry communication logic of our machines, giving commands to device control. Device Control: governing the motion and measurement aspects of our machine in close collaboration with mechatronics engineers in cross disciplinary teams. Data Science: Converting signals into images into KPI’s for our customers. Integration: Making sure individually tested components work together and with our machine. Further, there are cross-cutting concerns of customer integrations, cybersecurity, computation, requirement gathering and AI where architects play a crucial role. What will you be doing? You will take a responsible for the architecture, design, and lifecycle management of one of the aspects above, while taking the lead in one of the cross-cutting concerns. At the same time, you will have a deep understanding of our domain, our machine and use this to perform requirement-analysis and come up with MVP-proposal so that we can truly be agile. Your responsibilities include: Collecting requirements from (Internal) Customers and translate product requirements to SW level requirements for large projects Making a high-level architecture and design to fulfill both SW level requirements and product requirements Leading the development of multiple features along with a handful of other developers Troubleshooting technical issues that involve software development, engineering tasks and product releases Driving software quality and reliability through structured testing strategies, validation, and continuous improvement Proactively identifying system-level risks and resolving complex technical issues Leading and supporting the integration of multi-disciplinary subsystems Acting as a mentor and escalation point for senior software engineers While software architecture is mostly a post-developer role, you are expected to stay hands-on and enjoy locking yourself in and turning your brilliant ideas in to production code. That said, we don’t care what language you have developed in as long as its modern. Why is this position interesting for you? You take ownership of complex technical systems and make architectural decisions You are recognized as a subject matter expert within the organization You work on high-performance mechatronic systems using advanced technologies You operate in an environment where engineering excellence and autonomy are value As a scaleup, we can provide phenomenal learning and development opportunities but can also be a hectic environment at times. You should understand agile quite well. You embrace the culture and keep working on following aspects such as customer collaboration, Individuals and interaction, responding to change over following a structured plan, prototyping/working solutions over comprehensive documentation. Education: Master’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Physics or Electronics Above 10 years of experience in software development Above 7 years of experience in software architecture and design Experience with modern software development practices, languages and tools (git, CI/CD, automated testing, JIRA, C#, Python, PlantUML and use of LLMs) Outstanding communication skills: You can describe a complex technical topic in 2 sentences to a non-software person Above 7 years of experience with precision equipment or semiconductor industry Coaching ability, as a technical advisor, you make sure that the team stays up-to-date with relevant knowledge Ability to influence other lead engineers, managers and teams in the organization and convince them of your technical vision and direction

items.desc: About Us QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors. With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! As a 3D Packaging Engineer , you will collaborate closely with our engineering team to physically realize our VIO products. You will operate, adapt, and fine-tune high-precision assembly equipment to meet the precise tolerances required for optimal device performance. What You'll Be Doing Tooling Adaptation: Assist in modifying and calibrating high-precision assembly equipment (e.g., flip-chip bonders, die attach machines) to meet unique quantum 3D integration specifications. Process Optimization: Help develop and refine placement and bonding processes (thermo-compression bonding, laser-assisted bonding, coldwelding) for non-standard substrates. Test adhesives, glues, and solders to determine which materials survive extreme thermal cycling and cryogenic vacuum conditions. 3D Assembly Execution: Execute complex integration strategies, including multi-die stacking, interposer-based 3D architectures, and orthogonal (vertical) chip placement. Your Profile Education: BS, MS, or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Physics, Materials Science, or a related field. Tooling Experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience operating and adjusting high-accuracy semiconductor assembly platforms. Precision Assembly: Demonstrated experience achieving tight placement tolerances (around 1µm) in an R&D or pilot production environment. 3D Integration Knowledge: Solid foundational understanding of 3D integration (TSVs, micro-bumps, interposers) and how structural materials behave under thermal stress, high vacuum, or cryogenic conditions. Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection. What We Offer: At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect: Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance) Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage. Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture. As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

At Accenture, our Resources team is growing and looking for experienced Consultants to help global energy companies overcome challenges, optimize performance, unlock growth opportunities, and innovate their businesses. Working at the intersection of industry expertise, AI & Data, and business transformation, you will help clients navigate complex industry challenges and accelerate the transition towards a more sustainable and resilient energy future. Together with multidisciplinary teams across Accenture, you will combine strategic thinking, industry insight, and technology-enabled innovation to deliver tangible business outcomes. You will lead project workstreams, provide strategic recommendations to clients, manage project timelines and resources effectively, and develop and deliver high-quality presentations. In this role, you will tackle complex business challenges, lead project workstreams, and drive operating model design, strategic planning, due diligence, and organizational improvements. You will help clients translate strategic ambitions into measurable business outcomes by leveraging technology, AI, data, and new ways of working. You'll play a key part in helping clients optimize operations, achieve growth, and strategically position themselves for the future energy market, while continuously developing your skills and expertise. The appropriate employment level will be determined as part of the recruitment process, in consultation with the candidate. Key responsibilities include: Manage transformation projects: Oversee analysis, coordinate and lead resources, facilitate strategic planning sessions with client leadership, and ensure successful delivery of business transformation initiatives. Drive innovation: Apply AI, data, analytics, and emerging technologies to help clients improve operations, enhance decision-making, accelerate project execution, and unlock new sources of business value. Optimize business operations: Assess and improve client operating models, organizational structures, processes, and workflows, ensuring they are well-positioned to achieve strategic objectives and future growth. Facilitate workshops and deliver insights: Conduct workshops and presentations, develop business cases, and provide strategic recommendations that help clients address key challenges and opportunities. Be a trusted advisor: Guide clients through the energy transition and help them navigate changing industry dynamics, regulatory developments, and emerging technologies. Support business growth: Identify opportunities, strengthen client relationships, and contribute to proposal development and business development activities for future projects. Typical projects could be: Analysis of an energy company's operations, project portfolio, digital landscape, and data capabilities, assessing gaps to leading industry players and developing roadmap recommendations supported by AI, analytics, and industry-leading practices. Comprehensive market and business analysis for an energy client pursuing growth opportunities, including development of market entry approaches, operating model considerations, capability requirements, and implementation roadmaps. items.desc: Title: Sourcing Technology Services Location: Zürich, CH Date: Oct 27, 2026 At Chain IQ, your ideas move fast. Chain IQ is a global AI-driven Procurement Service Partner, headquartered in Baar, Switzerland, with operations across main centers and 16 offices worldwide. We provide tailored, end-to-end procurement solutions that enable transformation, drive scalability, and deliver substantial reductions in our clients' indirect spend. Our culture is built on innovation, entrepreneurship, ownership, and impact. Here, your voice matters - bold thinking is encouraged, and action follows ambition. Role Purpose The primary purpose is to deliver value-add sourcing services to clients in a structured, professional and consistent manner. Key Responsibilities: Develop and Execute Sourcing Strategies: Create and implement innovative sourcing strategies for IT procurement, ensuring cost-effective and high-quality acquisitions across IT services, software, hardware, cloud, and telecommunications. Manage Supplier Relationships: Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers, negotiate contracts, and ensure compliance with company policies and industry regulations. Market Research: Conduct thorough market research to identify new suppliers and cutting-edge sourcing solutions. Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with internal teams to understand and meet their IT requirements, ensuring alignment with business goals. Performance Analysis: Monitor and analyze procurement performance metrics to drive continuous improvement and optimize processes. Reporting and Documentation: Ensure timely and accurate procurement reporting and documentation. Qualifications: Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field. Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in a commercial environment, with a focus on IT procurement, including IT outsourcing, software, hardware, cloud, and/or telecommunications. Skills: Strong negotiation and contract management skills, excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, and proficiency in procurement software and Microsoft Office Suite. Communication: Fluent in English and German, both written and spoken. Team Player: Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, professional services environment. Global Mindset: Comfortable working in a global setup with clients in the US and other European countries. Join a truly global team. We offer a dynamic and international environment where high performance meets real purpose. We're proud to be Great Place to Work-certified and even prouder of the people who make that possible. Let’s shape the future of procurement - together. Chain IQ – Create. Lead. Make an impact. items.desc: Description The Team The Engineering team at FundApps by RegSensus is a team of ca. 50 smart, friendly people who collaborate closely and take pride in delivering best-in-class software and providing an extraordinary experience to our clients. We’re solving some of the most challenging problems in financial services - we operate in petabytes and milliseconds, not optimising the upload of cat photos. Our clients use our service for multiple hours a day - what we do as engineers has a real life impact on thousands of people across the globe! Our team values are professionalism, sustainability, and psychological safety; we hold each other to high standards, give each other considered and constructive feedback, work smart, and look out for each other. Learn more about our engineering culture here. The Role As part of the engineering team, you'll be working on a suite of innovative products that monitor over US$20 trillion in assets under management every single day, used by some of the world's largest Investment Managers. We are looking for a Mid-Level Back End Engineer who can help drive innovation and deliver great software at pace while also keeping sustainability in mind. We need highly motivated, intelligent people hungry for a challenge. At FundApps by RegSensus, you'll see the inner workings of a fast-growing, PE-backed scaleup where we expect all Engineers to take responsibility for their part in our success, seek support when needed, and care equally about our products and client outcomes as you do about writing code. We solve business problems through technology, not just ship code. We like keeping our tech stack modern and are not afraid to invest to keep it cutting edge! As such we’ve recently completed major projects which included distributing our main rules engine using AWS services, migrated terabytes of data from SQL server to Aurora Postgres, replaced our Single Sign On service with Auth0 and converted our frontend to React. Our Tech Stack Back-end: C# Data storage: PostgreSQL; Amazon storage including Aurora, DynamoDB, S3 Infrastructure: Terraform and AWS, using Fargate, Lambdas, Step functions, and a lot more! Pipeline: GitHub Actions, TeamCity, Octopus Deploy, Serverless Front-end: React, TypeScript How We Work Our engineers have a lot of freedom to solve problems in a way that achieves our outcomes, and works within our values. You will not be micro-managed - in fact, it's the opposite - you will be expected to take ownership of your work from Day 1. To thrive at FundApps by RegSensus, you will need to be comfortable with uncertainty, and embrace change as it comes. We value people who take charge of their destiny and help make things better for everyone around them. We release software when it's ready, not on a schedule - our teams deploy multiple times a day. We work agile, but do not follow any approach blindly - we seek 1% improvements in everything we do, try new things but don't hold to anything too tightly. Fundamentally, we follow a Kanban-inspired approach, but we also take inspiration from Team Topologies, 12-factor, DevOps culture - and all the good agile practices that you have read about. At FundApps by RegSensus we put these practices to work, reflect, and iterate to make sure our practices continue to serve us well. Our Engineers look after a wide set of products and technical services; we don't strictly follow a micro-services approach, however we are working over time to evolve our codebase and our core technology to be distributed, cloud-native and resource- and cost-effective to power our growth while doing our bit to help FundApps by RegSensus be carbon neutral. What You'll Bring To The Team Background: You are a mid engineer with generalist knowledge of product development concepts (software design, product requirements, work breakdown) and agile practices (TDD, CI/CD, architecture) and can apply them to solve well-defined problems independently and with your team. You are comfortable writing code in C#, Java or Python. Work-with-purpose: You can articulate the value of your own work in larger projects or team-wide goals. You have the space to own and deliver solutions and are comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving requirements. Have-courage: You are comfortable asking for and giving feedback. You help others when needed, and participate in debates, brainstorms, and other team conversations regularly. You build good relationships with your colleagues in Engineering, Product, and the wider company and are able to respectfully challenge each other to understand the problem and come up with the best solutions. As a company, we embrace change and the chance of failure. Be-transparent: As a company, we value and aspire for transparency at all levels; you’ll provide work updates to communicate regularly about progress and blockers and reach out for help when needed. Raise-the-bar: You seek out opportunities to improve our code, process, and practices; 1% …

items.desc: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: As a Core AE, you will be helping our largest and most strategic enterprise sized customers consolidate outdated technologies, digitize workflows, and unlock game-changing data insights that will transform their businesses. We are helping the companies that literally keep our lights on, put food on our tables, and build our communities to become safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. Typical sales will be $100k to $500k, and typically involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs. This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US and requires working in EST and CST timezone. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline. You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time. You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. In this role, you will: Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices Minimum requirements for the role: 5+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts and $100k+ ARR transactions Experience handling and owning enterprise deal sizes and C-Level relationships Willing and comfortable with strategic outbound prospecting Excellent interpersonal skills and demonstrated ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast paced environment Willing and comfortable traveling to meet customers on a monthly basis An ideal candidate also has: Experience working with line of business stakeholders (Operations, Finance, IT) Awards for top achievement (President's club, Winner's circle, Top 10%) Passion for the world of operations! Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term …
