items.desc: About the Role: Grade Level (for internal use): 11 The Team: You will join the Product Platform Design (PPD) team, a dynamic group responsible for designing, building, and evolving S&P Dow Jones Indices' (SPDJI) core product platforms. Our platforms drive index creation, calculation, rebalancing, analytics, and distribution. We operate on a product-led, service-based delivery model, organized into value streams that align with major business domains. You will collaborate closely with Index Management, R&D, Operations, and Technology teams to deliver scalable, reusable data services. The Impact: As a Technical Product Owner for Fixed Income Data, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our product direction and ensuring the operational robustness of our data platforms. You will act as a trusted advisor on complex data issues, using your analytical perspective to weave new approaches and innovative ideas into our processes. By bridging the gap between business and technology, you will deliver solutions that balance specific asset-class needs with the integrity of our shared data platform. Your work will directly improve efficiencies, enhance our organizational knowledge base, and influence peers to achieve defined strategic goals while leading by example in living the S&P Global purpose and values. Responsibilities: Serve as the Product Owner within the value stream, combining PO and BA responsibilities to define, prioritize, and lead the detailed delivery of work for agile teams. Translate complex business requirements into clear, actionable epics, features, and user stories. Own and manage the team backlog in Azure DevOps (ADO), ensuring alignment with broader business goals, platform standards, and the priorities of others. Act as a translator between business and technology, integrating and communicating complex technical information clearly to diverse audiences. Navigate incomplete or conflicting data to identify viable options and make pragmatic decisions in non-routine situations.` Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Index Management, R&D, Technology, Operations) and other Product Owners to manage cross-platform dependencies and sequencing. Advocate for high data quality, timeliness, and operational robustness, ensuring asset-specific requirements translate into reusable data services rather than bespoke silos. Define acceptance criteria, perform user acceptance testing (UAT), and actively support agile ceremonies. Proactively seek out new opportunities for innovation, leveraging the wider team and effective time management to ensure high-quality delivery on deadlines. All employees are required to work from the office a minimum of 2 days per week. What We're Looking For: Basic Required Qualifications: An S&P Global employee at this level would typically have 7+ years of experience in Product Owner, Business Analyst, or hybrid PO/BA in an agile environment. Strong domain expertise in fixed income market data, corporate actions, classifications, and calendars, with an understanding of how these nuances impact operational workflows. Proven ability to engage in technical discussions, simplify complexity, and communicate effectively with both engineering teams and business stakeholders. Proficiency in managing product backlogs and agile workflows using tools like Azure DevOps (ADO) or Jira. Strong emotional intelligence with the ability to bounce back from setbacks, remain positive, and stay focused even in the face of challenges and obstacles. We require all candidates who reach the final stage of our interview process to attend at least one in-person interview, which is ordinarily at your nearest S&P Global office. This must be completed before we can proceed to an offer. Additional Preferred Qualifications: Experience working within a horizontal data platform function, successfully balancing specific asset-class needs with shared platform integrity. Demonstrated ability to influence and advise junior colleagues in operational processes to achieve defined goals and objectives. Track record of building strong relationships and collaborating with peers outside of your immediate team or function. Familiarity with index calculation, rebalancing, and analytics platforms. About S&P Global Dow Jones Indic e s At S&P Dow Jones Indices, we provide iconic and innovative index solutions backed by unparalleled expertise across the asset-class spectrum. By bringing transparency to the global capital markets, we empower investors everywhere to make decisions with conviction. We’re the largest global resource for index-based concepts, data and research, and home to iconic financial market indicators, such as the S&P 500 ® and the Dow Jones Industrial Average ® . More assets are invested in products based upon our indices than any other index provider in the world. With over USD 7.4 trillion in passively managed assets linked to our indices and over USD 11.3 trillion benchmarked to our indices, our solutions are …

items.desc: Sambla Group is a fintech company with a clear goal – to be your trusted financial partner. We’ve grown into one of the fastest-growing fintech companies, bridging the gap between borrowers and lenders, thanks to the 500+ amazing people who work here. In the summer of 2026, we were granted authorisation as a credit market company, marking an important milestone in our continued journey to expand into own lending and opening an exciting new chapter for Sambla Group. We’re hiring an experienced AI engineer to help us build the next generation of AI financial products and help us scale AI across Sambla Group. You’ll sit at the intersection of Product & Tech and Data Science, working closely with our AI PM, DS/ML, MLOps, security and backend teams. Your focus is to turn AI ideas into robust, safe and value-driving products – and to put in place the patterns, tooling and guardrails that let other teams do the same. What You Will Do Help drive forward our GenAI / LLM foundations You design and evolve the architecture for LLM‑based products (chatbots, copilots, automation, retrieval) on AWS, integrating into our Python/TypeScript backend landscape. You define patterns for RAG, prompts, agents and evaluation that other teams can reuse. Make AI safe, reliable and cost‑efficient You work with Security and Legal on data privacy, access control and provider/model choices. Build and evolve the internal AI platform You create and maintain SDKs, libraries, templates and reference services so all Sambla Group product teams can ship GenAI features faster and more consistently. You turn ideas into clear technical plans and de‑risk new approaches through prototypes. Who You Are We believe you have: 5+ years in software and/or ML engineering, including at least 2–3 years working with LLM/GenAI systems in production. Proven track record of shipping AI/ML/LLM‑powered features to end users and operating them in production (monitoring, debugging, iterating). Deep practical experience with LLM ecosystems: Hosted and/or self‑hosted models. RAG pipelines, prompt patterns and guardrails. Evaluating and improving LLM outputs. Familiar with MLOps/LLMOps concepts and tooling: CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, monitoring (latency, error rates, quality metrics) and data pipelines. Strong system‑design skills for services/APIs, data flows and integrations in a microservice/product architecture. As Well As You Are Comfortable operating as an experienced individual contributor: setting technical direction, influencing without line authority and mentoring others. Used to working closely with product managers, data scientists and engineers, and explaining complex trade‑offs in a clear, structured way. Driven by curiosity and ownership, always looking for where AI and ML can make a real difference for our customers and across the business. Nice to have Experience from an AI‑mature, product‑led company using AI/LLMs at scale. Exposure to data/knowledge‑management for LLMs (enterprise search, ingestion pipelines, knowledge graphs, ontology/tagging). Data science / ML background strong enough to discuss when to use classic ML vs LLMs vs rules. Experience with security and compliance for AI in regulated or semi‑regulated environments (e.g. financial services). We might be a little different from most companies. items.desc: Les simulations multi-physiques de systèmes complexes comme les réacteurs nucléaires, dans lesquels différentes physiques sont couplées, sont essentielles pour décrire leur comportement lors de transitoires de fonctionnement incidentels ou accidentels, avec le plus haut niveau de fidélité. Ces simulations permettent de réduire avantageusement les marges à la conception par rapport aux approches mono-physiques chainées. En tant qu’ Ingénieur-Chercheur en Multiphysique H/F , vous participerez au développement des outils numériques nécessaires pour mettre en place un couplage entre différents solveurs physiques (thermo hydraulique, neutronique et thermomécanique par exemple). Plus précisément, vous serez amené(e) à : Réfléchir à la stabilité des schémas temporels et la cohérence spatiale aux interfaces ; Mener des activités en lien avec la démarche VVQI-T (Vérification, Validation, Quantification des Incertitudes et Transposition) appliquée aux systèmes couplés ; Estimer la propagation d'erreurs "d'une physique vers l'autre" ; Développer des méthodologies permettant d'appliquer les résultats à l'échelle du laboratoire aux cas industriels ; Développer et utiliser des plateformes numériques multi-physiques ; Rédiger rapports techniques et articles scientifiques dans des revues à comité de lecture ; Participer à des conférences internationales pour présenter vos travaux ; Contribuer au rayonnement scientifique du CEA. Pour mener à bien ces missions, vous collaborerez étroitement avec l'équipe multiphysique et avec le pôle "incertitude" du laboratoire, ainsi qu’avec les unités en charge du développement des outils de calcul scientifique (OCS) du CEA à Saclay. Ces activités se placent au cœur des thématiques de recherche et développement portées par l'Institut, en soutien aux études pour le parc actuel ainsi que pour le développement de nouveaux concepts de réacteurs (4ème génération, réacteur RnR-Na et MSR), et dans un objectif de fermeture du cycle du combustible. Rejoignez notre équipe pour contribuer à des enjeux sociétaux majeurs dans le domaine des applications nucléaires pour la décarbonation du système énergétique ! Profil du candidat Diplômé(e) d'un doctorat, vous êtes spécialisé(e) en thermo hydraulique et mécanique des fluides, et vous justifiez d’une expérience professionnelle de 3 à 5 ans en recherche et développement dans les domaines suivants : thermo hydraulique, physique des réacteurs, traitement des incertitudes. Une certaine aisance avec l'utilisation d'outils numériques, les langages de programmation (C++, Python), l'environnement Linux et le développement de scripts d'automatisation est demandée. En complément, la maîtrise des environnements de calculs parallèles (type MPI/OpenMP) et de l'architecture des supercalculateurs sera un plus. Autonome, rigoureux(se), organisé(e), vous avez le souci constant du travail soigné et vous savez travailler en équipe en ayant à cœur le partage des résultats et des connaissances. Vous faites preuve d’un excellent relationnel et vous êtes force de proposition. Enfin, vous disposez d’un très bon niveau d’anglais, à l’oral et à l’écrit. Faites-nous parvenir votre CV et votre lettre de motivation, nous avons hâte de découvrir votre profil ! Conformément aux engagements pris par le CEA en faveur de l'intégration des personnes handicapées, cet emploi est ouvert à toutes et à tous. Le CEA propose des aménagements et/ou des possibilités d'organisation pour l’inclusion des travailleurs handicapés. Poste basé à Saint-Paul-Lez-Durance (13), à pourvoir dès que possible. Vous avez un doute ? Nous vous proposons : Un environnement unique de recherche dédié à des thématiques à fort enjeu sociétal, Des formations pour renforcer vos compétences ou en acquérir de nouvelles, Un équilibre vie privée – vie professionnelle reconnu, Un poste facilement accessible via le réseau de lignes de bus proposé par le CEA, Une rémunération selon vos diplômes et votre expérience, Un CSE actif en termes de loisirs et d’activités extra-professionnelles, Un accord de télétravail, Une politique diversité et inclusion, Des opportunités d’évolution professionnelle. Localisation du poste Site Cadarache Localisation du poste France, Provence-Côte d'Azur, Bouches du Rhône (13) Ville Saint-Paul-Lez-Durance Critères candidat Langues Anglais (Courant) Formation recommandée Doctorat + spécialisation en thermo hydraulique et mécanique des fluides Demandeur Disponibilité du poste 01/08/2026

Job Description: 
 An opportunity for a Microwave Radiometer RF Architect has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid) .
 The selected candidate will join the Microwave Instrument Engineering Team , a specialized multidisciplinary department at the forefront of spaceborne Earth Observation (EO) payload engineering. In this technical leadership role, you will define and drive the RF system architecture for cutting-edge microwave and millimetre-wave (mmWave) radiometer payloads across current and next-generation satellite missions. You will steer end-to-end instrument design from early concept, TRL maturation, and customer milestones through to payload verification, ground testing, and in-orbit commissioning support.
 Responsibilities 
 The main tasks of the jobholder will be:
 RF Architecture Definition & Trade-Offs: Define baseline architectures for spaceborne radiometer payloads (L-band up to sub-THz) and lead technical trade-offs balancing RF performance, mass, DC power, and thermal constraints.
 Front-End & Calibration Engineering: Design and optimize high-sensitivity low-noise receivers, RF front-ends, and internal/external radiometric calibration subsystems, maintaining end-to-end budgets (noise figure, noise temperature, dynamic range, and sensitivity).
 System Modeling & Simulation: Develop high-fidelity electromagnetic and circuit-level simulations using tools such as Keysight ADS, CST Studio, and ANSYS HFSS to validate architecture concepts under operational flight conditions.
 Verification & Technical Governance: Generate and maintain Verification Control Documents (VCD), lead Technology Readiness Level (TRL) assessments, and establish ground support equipment (EGSE/MGSE) specifications.
 AIT & Test Campaign Leadership: Steer payload Assembly, Integration & Testing (AIT), environmental validation campaigns, and define in-orbit commissioning roadmaps in alignment with ECSS standards.
 Milestone Leadership & Proposal Elaboration: Represent RF engineering in formal ESA/customer milestones (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, TRB) and lead the technical baseline for future Earth Observation active and passive instrument proposals.
 Skills 
 Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to getting to know you:
 Education: Master’s degree (MSc) or PhD in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, RF/Microwave Engineering, or Physics.
 Experience: 5 to 10 years of professional experience in remote sensing microwave instrument design and payload development for space applications.
 Technical Knowledge: Deep command of passive microwave sensing, brightness/noise temperature theory, calibration topologies, active/passive antenna interfaces, and advanced RF simulation suites (ADS, CST, HFSS).
 Soft Skills: Proven technical leadership, strong capacity to interface with external customers, high autonomy in multi-project environments, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
 Languages: Advanced / Negotiation level in English (mandatory, written and spoken). Fluent Spanish is valuable; French or German is desirable.
 Valuable / Nice to Have: Solid understanding of ESA development lifecycles and space engineering standards (ECSS, MIL-STD, CCSDS).Hands-on experience with RF flight equipment testing and requirements management tools (IBM DOORS).Direct track record in satellite hardware qualification and international space project consortia.Availability to travel for test campaigns and customer review meetings.

Job Description: 
 An opportunity for a Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) Performance Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid) .
 The selected candidate will join the Microwave Instrument Engineering Team , a specialized multidisciplinary department dedicated to Earth Observation payload design and development. In this role, you will be responsible for defining, modeling, and optimizing end-to-end SAR system performance from early concept through to mission operations. You will act as a key technical reference across the SAR processing chain, image quality evaluation, and calibration/validation (Cal/Val) campaigns, working in close collaboration with RF, antenna, payload, and data processing teams on major international space programs.
 Responsibilities 
 The main tasks of the jobholder will be:
 End-to-End Performance Modeling: Develop, implement, and maintain system-level models and simulators (covering signal, geometry, propagation, and noise) to predict end-to-end SAR performance and establish requirement allocations.
 Image Quality Evaluation & Budgets: Generate and monitor comprehensive instrument-level performance budgets, assessing key radar metrics including spatial resolution, NESZ, radiometric accuracy, and ambiguity ratios (range/azimuth).
 System Architecture & Trade-Offs: Perform advanced trade-off analyses (orbit parameters, frequency bands, PRF selection, and antenna configurations) to support mission definition and instrument design optimization.
 Calibration & Processing Support: Drive SAR processing chain verification, focusing algorithms, and calibration/validation (Cal/Val) strategies using in-orbit and ground campaign data.
 AIT & V&V Integration: Define and support Assembly, Integration, and Testing (AIT) as well as payload Verification and Validation (V&V) activities across laboratory and environmental test phases.
 Project Milestones & Technical Leadership: Deliver key performance documentation and represent the system engineering team in formal reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR/TRB) as well as customer-facing technical exchanges and future mission proposals.
 Skills 
 Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to getting to know you:
 Education: Master’s degree (MSc) or PhD in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, RF/Microwave Engineering, or Physics.
 Experience: 5 to 10 years of professional experience in remote-sensing microwave instrument development, with a deep focus on SAR systems and radar signal processing.
 Technical Knowledge: Deep command of SAR principles, radar performance metrics (NESZ, SNR, ambiguity suppression), end-to-end signal processing chains, and advanced numerical modeling/simulation using Python, MATLAB, or equivalent.
 Soft Skills: Strong analytical problem-solving abilities, high autonomy in managing workload across multiple projects, and proven collaborative skills within multidisciplinary engineering teams.
 Languages: Advanced / Negotiation level in English (mandatory, written and spoken). Fluent Spanish is valuable; French or German is desirable.

items.desc:
Overview 
 Microsoft AI is looking for experienced Member of Technical Staff, Software Engineers - Compute Infra /HPC to build the compute infra software that brings frontier AI compute online and keeps it healthy at global scale. You will work across cluster bring-up and automation, fleet and node lifecycle and health, and automated operations at global scale. The systems you build will transform newly delivered compute capacity into secure, observable, schedulable clusters and continuously recover usable capacity when hardware or software fails.
 This is a hands-on software engineering role at the boundary of distributed systems and AI supercomputing. You will design control planes, APIs, workflow engines, state models, and hardware-aware automation for some of the largest GPU systems in the world. Rather than relying on manual intervention, you will turn recurring operational workflows and failure modes into durable platform capabilities that improve time to production, fleet availability, and researcher velocity.
 Microsoft AI 
 Our mission is to build AI that amplifies human potential and empowers people around the world. We strive to deliver breakthroughs that advance science, education, productivity, and global well-being.
 We’re also fortunate to partner with incredible product teams giving our models the chance to reach billions of users and create immense positive impact. If you’re a brilliant, highly-ambitious and low ego individual, you’ll fit right in—come and join us as we work on our next generation of models!
 MAI employees are expected to work from a designated Microsoft office at least four days a week if they live within 50 miles (U.S.) or 25 miles (non-U.S., country-specific) of that location. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.
 Responsibilities 
 Design and build distributed services, control planes, and platform APIs for the end-to-end lifecycle of AI compute clusters, from capacity ingestion and provisioning through certification, upgrades, maintenance, repair, and decommissioning.
 Build foundational primitives that make new capacity enablement repeatable and secure by default, including cluster bootstrap, Kubernetes control planes, networking, identity and access, image distribution, secrets, infrastructure as code, and cluster metadata across Azure and partner clouds.
 Own software systems that reduce cluster bring-up time by automating rack and node qualification, topology validation, scale testing, and the transition from newly delivered hardware to healthy, schedulable fleet.
 Develop the node and fleet health platform that combines telemetry, health signals, diagnostics, and lifecycle state to detect, isolate, and remediate unhealthy hardware, hosts, networks, and storage with minimal human intervention.
 Build policy-driven and agent-assisted automation for certification, maintenance, safe rollout or rollback of software and platform components.
 Use production evidence, benchmarks, workload profiles, and fault injection to improve system architecture, efficiency, failure detection, recovery time, and the quality of health and readiness decisions.
 Translate incidents and repeated operational work into durable software, stronger abstractions, automated guardrails, and clear ownership boundaries rather than one-off manual procedures.
 Partner closely with researchers, hardware health, networking, storage, security, and datacenter teams to shape the long-term architecture of Microsoft AI compute infrastructure.
 Provide technical leadership through design reviews, architecture decisions, code quality, mentoring, and execution of complex cross-team initiatives.
 Embody our culture and values. 
 Qualifications 
 Required Qualifications: 
 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field AND 4+ years of software engineering experience building production distributed systems, infrastructure platforms, or control-plane services OR equivalent experience
 4+ years of experience designing and implementing scalable software for cloud, datacenter, cluster, or fleet infrastructure using one or more general-purpose languages such as Go, Rust, C++, C#, Java, or Python
 Experience with Kubernetes or comparable cluster-orchestration systems, Linux systems, public-cloud infrastructure, and infrastructure-as-code or declarative configuration
 Demonstrated ability to debug complex behavior across service, control-plane, operating-system, networking, and hardware boundaries and turn findings into robust software improvements
 Experience leading projects across multiple teams and communicating technical tradeoffs clearly to engineering and non-engineering stakeholders
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Master's Degree in Computer Science or a related technical field AND 6+ years of software engineering experience building distributed systems or infrastructure platforms OR equivalent experience

items.desc: Vacancy ID 13047 Download as PDF In the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, researchers from the Social Sciences and Humanities as well as artists explore the relationships between technology, science, and society. The Lab was initiated by The Schaufler Foundation together with TUD Dresden University of Technology. The Lab's guiding theme for the upcoming third funding phase (April 2027–September 2030) is "Energy Cultures in Transition". The guiding theme is investigated from a humanities, cultural, social, and educational science perspective, explored through artistic practice, and communicated to the public. For the third funding phase, the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden comprises eight doctoral fellowships and an annually changing Artist in Residence program. TUD embodies a university culture that is characterized by cosmopolitanism, mutual appreciation, thriving innovation and active participation. For TUD, diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution. The Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden offers, subject to the availability of resources, a Doctoral Fellowship for a period of 2 years, with the option of extension by 1.5 years, starting on April 1, 2027 . The fellowship (EUR 1,850 per month, plus a grant for material costs of EUR 150 and, where applicable, a family supplement of EUR 315 per child) is aimed at early-career researchers in the field of Civil and Digital Law . Primary supervision will be provided by Jun.-Prof. Dr. Katharina Kaesling, LL.M., Juniorprofessorship in Civil Law, Intellectual Property Law, especially Patent Law and Legal Issues of AI. The guiding theme Energy Cultures in Transition understands energy as a cultural phenomenon deeply inscribed in aesthetic, historical, political, ecological, economic, and socio-technological practices and systems. Building on the dynamically growing research fields of the Energy Humanities, Science & Technology Studies, and the Digital Humanities, the aim is to examine how modern energy regimes—from petromodernity, to nuclear culture, and post-carbon futures—have shaped not only material infrastructures but also subjectivities, power relations, progress narratives, geopolitical orders, ecologies, and knowledge systems, while simultaneously being shaped by them. Interdisciplinary perspectives from the social sciences, cultural studies, humanities, and educational research represented at the Schaufler Kolleg@TU Dresden enable the analysis of the multifaceted entanglements of energy, culture, and society. The focus is on questions concerning the representation, communication, and aesthetics of energy transitions and resource paradigms as well as continuities between resource economies and information economies, the relationships between energy, labor, environment, and consumer culture, and the role of colonialism, gender, nationalism, geopolitics, education, and social justice in deciding energy futures and navigating collective transformation processes. In the field of Civil and Digital Law, the following research areas and questions are of particular relevance to the guiding theme: Energy- and resource-intensive digital infrastructures as a subject of EU regulation Systemic risks of digital platforms and AI systems in the context of energy use, resource consumption, and ecological sustainability, particularly under the Digital Services Act and the AI Act Ecological sustainability as a European value and as an interpretative principle in digital law Law and legal culture as elements of energy and technology cultures, particularly the interactions between legal categories, technological development, societal transformations, and concepts of sustainability Territorial and extraterritorial limits of European digital regulation in addressing global ecological impacts Tasks: Your tasks include independent research and academic further qualification with the goal of completing a doctorate at TUD, as well as writing a dissertation on a topic within the guiding concept "Energy Cultures in Transition" in the discipline of Civil and Digital Law. The fellowship requires a high degree of willingness to engage in interdisciplinary dialogue, particularly with the STEM partnerships of the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, as well as to conduct joint research with artists within the framework of the Schaufler Residency. In addition, engagement in the areas of science communication and outreach is expected. Shared office spaces will be made available to the fellows. Participation in the Kolleg's English-language training program is mandatory. Requirements: You hold an above-average university degree in law and have prior knowledge of, or at least a strong interest in, the regulation of digital services and AI, as well as in the role of energy (cultures) and/or ecological sustainability. You have a strong …

items.desc: As the CX Technical Enablement Partner, you will serve as the dedicated enablement partner for Asana's Support and Professional Services teams and lead technical training development across Customer Experience. In this role, you will diagnose technical capability gaps and design, build, and deliver high-impact learning programs to close them. Combining strategic advisory (roughly 40%) with hands-on curriculum and content creation (roughly 60%), you will also develop the technical depth Customer Success Managers need to drive adoption, retention, and consumption growth. Reporting to the Head of CX Enablement, you will be an integral member of a focused enablement team accelerating customer and team readiness across Asana and AI workflows. This role is based in our Dublin office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements. What you'll achieve Act as the primary enablement strategic partner for Support and Professional Services leadership, conducting recurring needs assessments to translate business goals into prioritized enablement roadmaps. Own and prioritize the Support and Services CX enablement roadmap, managing intake requests and establishing clear metrics to measure training effectiveness and business impact. Design, build, and deliver technical curricula, including product architecture, administrative configuration, demo workflows, APIs/integrations, and troubleshooting frameworks. Develop engaging digital content, eLearning modules, and live training sessions adhering to instructional design standards and frameworks. Build and scale technical certification programs for Support, Services, and Customer Success teams. Partner closely with the AI Product Enablement lead to ensure organizational readiness for new product capabilities and enterprise AI feature rollouts. Author and curate technical artifacts and documentation to maintain a centralized, up-to-date knowledge base across Customer Experience. About you Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making. 2+ years of experience implementing, architecting, or demonstrating the Asana platform or similar enterprise collaboration tools. Proven track record in technical enablement, instructional design, or customer-facing technical roles (such as Support, Professional Services, Solutions Engineering, or Implementation) with a dedicated training focus. Demonstrated experience partnering with senior cross-functional leaders to diagnose skill gaps and build scalable enablement roadmaps in a B2B SaaS environment. Deep technical acumen with the ability to quickly master complex SaaS concepts, including platform administration, data flows, APIs, and integrations. Experience building or managing role-based technical certification and credentialing programs. Strong self-starter with the ability to manage an independent roadmap, balance strategic alignment with content execution, and leverage modern digital enablement tools. At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. What we'll offer Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit. For this role, the estimated base salary range is between €95,000 - €121,000. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified. items.desc: Role Description: The DMLP 1st Line Risk & Compliance Officer owns the day-to-day coordination of risk, audit, and compliance activities for Booking.com's data and machine learning systems including Kafka, Flink, BDX, MySQL, and AI/ML platforms. This role establishes clear ownership, processes, and documentation across the DML risk landscape, acting as the primary risk partner to platform and service owners in this domain. B.responsible Risk & Compliance Partnership : Act as the 1st line risk partner to DML platform owners and data teams (Kafka, Flink, BDX, MySQL, AI/ML systems), advising on risk exposure and tailoring PCI-DSS, NIST, SOX, and any other regulatory compliance requirements to data and ML environments. Discovery & Risk Assessments : Lead discovery reviews and risk assessments across data and AI/ML systems, identifying gaps in ownership, controls, and documentation, and driving remediation with the relevant control owners. Control Ownership & R&R Clarity : Maintain clear roles and responsibilities (R&R) documentation for DML ITGCs (e.g., BDX DMA), ensuring every control has a named 1st line owner and a defensible rationale grounded in official documentation. Audit & Compliance Follow-Up : Coordinate and lead platform compliance controls and audit follow-ups and matters, tracking remediation actions to closure and liaising with 2nd line/audit stakeholders. Risk Register & Reporting : Maintain the DML risk inventory, report on risk coverage, issues, and remediation status through tools such as JIRA and ServiceNow. Right-Sized Control Design : Provide advice on control design that is sustainable and right-sized simple solutions for simple problems, avoiding overengineering while keeping controls effective. Stakeholder Coordination & TRO representation : Establish relationships with senior stakeholders. Build and maintain robust relationships across engineering, platform ownership, and risk/audit teams to keep ownership, processes, and documentation aligned as the DML platform evolves. Continuous Improvement : Identify opportunities to automate manual compliance and reporting bottlenecks, and refine risk assessment methodology to keep pace with a fast-moving data/AI environment. B.skilled Comfortable coordinating across many stakeholders with minimal day-to-day supervision , in a fast-changing, sometimes ambiguous environment. Strong documentation and communication skills and able to translate technical risk into clear, concise, business-friendly language. Platform Risk & Cloud Fluency : Broad job knowledge (typically 5–8 years) in IT risk, audit, or controls, with hands-on exposure to cloud environments (AWS preferred) and the ability to translate data platform and streaming architecture Kafka, Flink, BDX, MySQL, AI/ML pipelines into concrete risk assessments and control requirements. Control Framework Depth : Practical, applied knowledge of SOX and PCI-DSS, with the judgment to right-size controls so they stay effective and audit-ready without adding unnecessary friction for engineering teams. Audit Support Experience : Comfortable preparing evidence, coordinating walkthroughs, and drafting remediation memos for internal/external audit and SOX cycles. Structured Problem Solving : Able to work from individual findings toward reusable patterns, flagging when a local issue looks systemic so the wider team can decide on a shared guardrail. Clear Communicator : Can translate technical risk into plain language for engineering, platform, and audit stakeholders, and hold a respectful but firm line in day-to-day discussions. Certifications : CRISC (or actively working toward it) is preferred; the domains of Governance , IT Risk Assessment , Risk Response & Reporting , and Information Technology & Security map directly onto this role's daily work. CISA or equivalent is a plus. Strategic Leadership & Confidence: Demonstrated ability to lead risk strategy with confidence and conviction. You are comfortable challenging senior stakeholders, independently steering complex decisions, and maintaining clarity in ambiguous environments without softening the core message. Platform Risk & Cloud Expertise: Deep expertise in platform risk and compliance, with hands-on experience in cloud environments (AWS or cloud expertise preferred). You understand how to translate technical architecture, specifically data platforms, streaming infrastructure, and AI/ML systems into tangible risk assessments. Control Framework Mastery: Strong practical knowledge of SOx and AWS. You don't just know the frameworks, you know how to "right-size" controls so they are effective, scalable, and audit-ready without creating unnecessary friction for engineering teams. Systemic Problem Solving: A track record of moving beyond individual ticket-based risk management to designing scalable operating models. You can identify patterns, define reusable guardrails, and build "one coherent model" for risk that evolves alongside the platform. …

With headquarters in Madrid and our global hub in Barcelona, we’ve become an important international centre of excellence in the fight against critical disease. Cutting-edge innovators When you join us, you’ll be part of a team that embraces digital technology and data to transform the way we work and the work we do. What decides whether those tools help is the layer around them: the skills people can use, the connectors that give them governed access to company data, and the way people get onboarded, supported and measured. As the platform landscape changes, you will keep the user experience and the governance consistent for the people who depend on it. You will work with AI scientists and engineers, Enterprise AI platform and gateway teams, information security, architecture, data owners and external delivery partners. The role is hands-on and fast-moving. The ideal candidate is a product owner who is comfortable with technical detail, can say no clearly, and takes pride in how users experience the product. items.desc:
Description
 🚀 Le Bureau des Talents est spécialisé dans la chasse, l’accompagnement et le coaching des talents pour les startups, les scale-ups et les entreprises à impact.
 Notre client est une startup française spécialisée en cybersécurité , qui développe une plateforme logicielle intégrant des technologies d'intelligence artificielle.
 En pleine phase de développement, elle s'attaque à des problématiques techniques complexes, au croisement de l'IA appliquée, du développement logiciel et de la sécurité informatique.
 Vous rejoindrez une équipe d'ingénieurs aux expertises complémentaires, dans un environnement entrepreneurial où l'exigence technique, l'autonomie et la prise d'initiative sont essentielles.
 L'occasion de contribuer à la construction de systèmes IA ambitieux et d'avoir un impact direct sur le produit et ses fondations techniques.
 Le poste
 Nous recherchons un AI Engineer capable de concevoir et de développer des systèmes agentiques robustes, au-delà de la simple intégration de modèles de langage. 
 Vous interviendrez sur les mécanismes qui permettent aux agents IA de raisonner, de planifier leurs actions, d'utiliser des outils et d'exécuter des workflows complexes dans des environnements réels.
 De l'expérimentation à la production, vous contribuerez directement aux choix techniques et à la construction du produit.
 Ce poste s'adresse à un ingénieur disposant de solides fondamentaux en informatique, d'une expérience concrète en IA appliquée et d'une réelle capacité à résoudre des problèmes techniques complexes.
 L'enjeu : transformer les capacités des modèles d'IA en systèmes fiables, utiles et capables d'exécuter des tâches de manière autonome. 
 Mission
 Vos missions
 Concevoir des agents IA avancés
 Concevoir et développer des agents capables d'exécuter des tâches complexes dans des environnements informatiques réels. 
 Développer les mécanismes de raisonnement, de planification et d'utilisation d'outils nécessaires à leur autonomie. 
 Transformer des méthodes de cybersécurité en workflows automatisables, en collaboration avec les spécialistes du domaine. 
 Développer des systèmes IA en production
 Intégrer des LLM et d'autres modèles au sein de systèmes applicatifs robustes. 
 Concevoir des architectures permettant d'orchestrer les agents, les outils et les différentes étapes d'exécution. 
 Évaluer les comportements des modèles, identifier leurs limites et expérimenter différentes approches pour améliorer leurs résultats. 
 Améliorer la fiabilité et les performances
 Analyser les erreurs et les échecs des agents pour en identifier les causes. 
 Améliorer la fiabilité, les performances et la capacité des systèmes à fonctionner dans des environnements réels. 
 Participer aux décisions d'architecture et faire évoluer les solutions à partir des résultats observés. 
 Profile
 Profil recherché
 Nous recherchons un ingénieur IA doté d'excellents fondamentaux techniques, capable de concevoir et de développer des systèmes IA concrets, au-delà de la simple intégration de modèles existants.
 Les indispensables
 Formation 
 Diplôme d'une grande école d'ingénieurs ou d'une formation scientifique de haut niveau, avec de solides fondamentaux en informatique, mathématiques ou machine learning. 
 Bon niveau d'anglais. 
 Expérience 
 Au moins 2 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente , hors stages, en développement logiciel, IA appliquée ou machine learning. L'expérience acquise en alternance est comptabilisée à hauteur de 50 % de sa durée. 
 Expérience concrète avec des LLM, des agents IA ou des systèmes de machine learning appliqué. 
 Expérience dans la conception et le développement de systèmes IA, idéalement déployés en production. 
 Compétences techniques 
 Très bonne maîtrise de Python et des fondamentaux du développement logiciel. 
 Bonne compréhension du fonctionnement des LLM, de leurs limites, du prompting et des méthodes d'évaluation des modèles. 
 Capacité à analyser des problèmes complexes, à justifier ses choix techniques et à concevoir des solutions robustes. 
 Les plus
 Expérience dans la conception d'agents capables de planifier des actions, d'utiliser des outils et d'orchestrer plusieurs étapes d'exécution. 
 Spécialisation en IA ou en machine learning, notamment via un cursus tel que le Master MVA. 
 Expérience en cybersécurité, sécurité offensive ou pentesting. 
 Connaissances en RAG, embeddings, bases vectorielles ou environnements cloud (AWS, GCP). 
 Expérience en startup ou au sein d'une petite équipe technique, avec un niveau élevé d'autonomie. 
 Expérience dans une startup accompagnée par Y Combinator (YC). 
 Pourquoi rejoindre ce projet ?
 Travailler sur des problèmes techniques difficiles. Vous interviendrez sur des systèmes agentiques appliqués à des cas d'usage concrets, où le raisonnement, la planification et la fiabilité sont essentiels.
 Construire, plutôt que simplement intégrer. Vous participerez au développement des fondations techniques du produit, avec une …

items.desc: Vi tror på- och vill förverkliga en AI- och datadriven framtid. Vi söker AI Software Developers som vill vara med och hjälpa våra kunder inom olika branscher att omvandla AI-experiment till skalbara, säkra och värdeskapande lösningar. Hos oss blir du del av ett växande område med runt 20 konsulter inom Cloud, AI och systemutveckling. Samtidigt får du kollegor från hela Solita med expertis i allt från data, strategi och mycket mer att dela kunskap och perspektiv med, läs mer om det här. När vi växer gör dina möjligheter också det, du får vara med och påverka kulturen, affären och din roll. En dag på Solita En dag på Solita kan börja med ett standup-möte med ditt team på kunduppdraget, ibland består det av fler kollegor från Solita. Är det fredag kanske du jobbar från Solitas kontor i Stockholm för att starta dagen med frukost. Andra dagar jobbar du från kundens kontor eller hemifrån. Sen kliver du in i ditt arbete: när du stöter på ett problem söker du upp en lång diskussionstråd i slack med insikter från kollegor som haft samma problem. Andra gånger passar du på att fråga en kollega vid kaffemaskinen om deras perspektiv för att komma vidare. Du kan också delta i våra interna utbildningsmöten, där vi delar kunskap om allt från nya teknologier och arbetssätt till välmående. Vissa dagar avslutar du med AW, filmkväll, brädspel eller annan aktivitet du och kollegor tycker är kul. Din roll som AI Software Developer Du är med i hela utvecklingscykeln, inte sällan från tidigt pre-sales stadie eller i förstudier, för att utveckla, driftsätta och optimera agent-baserade och datadrivna system som hjälper kunder fatta bättre beslut eller automatisera processer på ett intelligent sätt. Exempelvis kan du arbeta med prompt optimering, designa och implementera RAG-arkitektur, utveckla AI-agenter, MCP-servrar, APIer och backend lösningar för att integrera befintliga system till LLM-tjänster. Läs mer om att jobba med AI på Solita här. Utöver moderna systemutveckling-tekniker kommer du arbeta med diverse AI-verktyg och ramverk som exempelvis LangChain, Tensorflow, AI Foundry och Semantic Kernel för att nämna några. Då vi jobbar teknikagnostiskt får du stor frihet att forma teknikval och arkitektur för att möta affärsbehov. Läs mer om hur kollegor jobbar och diskuterar kring olika teknikval i vår Dev blog här. Känner du igen dig i följande? Du kan kommunicera på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Det är ett plus om du varit konsult tidigare men det huvudsakliga är din förmåga att snabbt komma in i nya sammanhang och lära dig. Du är trygg i rollen tack vare din erfarenhet av både systemutveckling (särskilt om du jobbat i C# .NET eller Java Spring Boot) samt: RAG- eller AI-agentarkitektur Att bygga AI-drivna applikationer med moderna ramverk som ex. Semantic Kernel, LangChain eller liknande. Att implementera molnbaserade AI-tjänster och produktionssätta AI-lösningar med hjälp av DevSecOps och IaC. Vi letar inte bara efter tekniska skills, vi vill jobba med dig som tar ansvar för att bygga rätt lösningar på rätt sätt genom att utmana med omtanke. Du ser kod som ett hantverk, inte bara ett medel till funktion: du bryr dig om kvalitet, läsbarhet och hållbarhet. Du kommer trivas hos oss om du tycker om att dela med dig av din kunskap lika mycket som du är nyfiken på- och lyfter andras. . Vad vi erbjuder Vår företagskultur är väldigt viktig för oss. Vi värdesätter låg hierarki, självständighet och ansvar, värdeskapande arbete och trevliga kollegor. Här kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, och här kan du bläddra bland våra tech-bloggar. Meningsfulla projekt: Arbeta i en agil miljö där du kan påverka teknikval och arbetssätt för att skapa de bästa lösningarna Flexibilitet och autonomi för att utforma ditt arbete med flextider– läs mer från vår blogg. Ständig utveckling: Vi erbjuder kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling för att säkerställa att våra medarbetare ligger längst fram i teknikutvecklingen. Innovativ kultur: Arbeta tillsammans med några av de främsta experterna inom data, analys och utveckling Utöver detta får du även ta del av följande förmåner: 💰 Fast lön oberoende av beläggningsgrad med möjlighet till löneväxling till ditt pensionssparande 🏦 Pensionsavsättning i linje med ITP1 samt möjlighet till löneväxling till ditt pensionssparande vid inkomst över 8,07 inkomstbasbelopp 🏖️ 30 semesterdagar 😃 Sjukvårdsförsäkring för både din mentala och fysiska hälsa som täcker dig även utanför tjänstetid 🏋️ ♀️ Friskvårdsbidrag på 5000 kr via Benifex (tidigare Benify). 💻 Ett brett nätverk av erfarna specialister från olika områden inom tech att samarbeta med 🔗 Intern coach för att stödja ditt välbefinnande 🪩 After Work och hobbyaktiviteter 🥐 Fredagsfrukostar Vilka är vi? Solita är ett värderingsstyrt konsultbolag med över 2000 medarbetare i 9 länder, varav ca 230 i Sverige. Vår storlek gör oss tillräckligt stora för att vara en stabil och innovativ arbetsgivare, men samtidigt tillräckligt små för att värna om våra medarbetare och kunder. Med …

items.desc: NTT DATA somos todas las personas que la formamos . Un equipo de más de 190.000 profesionales, tan diverso como diversos son los 50 países en los que estamos presentes y los diferentes sectores en los que desarrollamos nuestra actividad: Telecomunicaciones, Sector Financiero (Banca y Seguros), Industria, Utilities, Sector Público y Sanidad . ¿Nuestra misión? Ofrecer soluciones estratégicas, de negocio y tecnológicas, así como el desarrollo y mantenimiento de aplicaciones , siendo un referente en consultoría. Todo gracias a la colaboración entre equipos, la calidad humana de nuestra gente y a que no nos conformamos con lo establecido, buscamos siempre la innovación que nos acerca al futuro . Nuestra esencia nos ha llevado a romper paradigmas y a brindar las soluciones que realmente se corresponden a las necesidades de cada cliente. Nuestro talento nos ha hecho poder decir con orgullo que somos una de las empresas reconocida un año más como Global Top Employer en 2026 . El modelo de Consultoría en Banca de NTT DATA se basa en el asesoramiento integral a nuestros clientes , desde el ámbito estratégico al operativo, de procesos y tecnológico. 🔎Qué buscamos Buscamos un perfil de desarrollo con un para una plataforma basada en agentes de IA que automatiza el análisis de código legacy y la generación de documentación y propuestas de arquitectura. El rol estará enfocado en el desarrollo de agentes, integración con modelos LLM y construcción de pipelines de procesamiento y análisis. Responsabilidades Desarrollar y mantener agentes de IA especializados (AS-IS y TO-BE). Implementar pipelines de ejecución de agentes (orquestación, dependencias, paralelismo). Integrar modelos LLM (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) en los agentes. Diseñar y mejorar prompts para diferentes casos de uso. Implementar tools para análisis de código y procesamiento de documentación. Optimizar el uso de contexto (filtrado, estructuración, reducción de tokens). Integrar mecanismos de RAG para enriquecer las respuestas. Trabajar con outputs en Markdown/HTML generados automáticamente. Requisitos Experiencia en desarrollo con Python . Conocimiento de APIs y servicios backend. Experiencia o interés en LLMs y agentes . Conocimiento básico de LangChain o frameworks similares . Experiencia trabajando con repositorios de código (Git). Capacidad para entender código legacy (Java, frontend, etc.). Valorable Experiencia con RAG (embeddings, vector stores). Experiencia con LangGraph o arquitecturas multi-agente. Conocimiento de cloud (AWS, Azure). Experiencia en análisis de código o tooling de desarrollo. Imprescindible: Mínimo 2 años de experiencia en las tecnologías requeridas. 💼¿Qué te ofrecemos? Te ofrecemos un puesto desafiante con un impacto directo en la práctica, en la que nos centramos en el máximo desarrollo profesional de cada uno de nuestros empleados: 🤝Formar parte de proyectos estratégicos donde la IA generativa es el motor de innovación 🎓 Acceso a formación continua y certificaciones en ML/IA y cloud. 🔝 Un equipo altamente técnico, colaborativo y orientado a la excelencia. 🆙 Plan de desarrollo profesional y tecnologías de última generación 🏫Mantenemos una fuerte relación con las principales universidades . 🌍Potenciamos el networking entre nuestros empleados a través de actividades afterwork , campeonatos deportivos, etc. 🧩Posibilidad de colaborar en la acción social de la Compañía , a través de su Fundación y las numerosas acciones que acometemos a lo largo del año. Trabajamos en un entorno smart working , flexible y con oficinas nuevas. En NTT DATA abunda la gente buena y la buena gente. Apostamos por una cultura inclusiva que reconoce y valora la diversidad. Trabajamos día a día para crear un entorno en el que podamos explorar, vivir y potenciar nuestra propia singularidad. #WeAreAllUnique #YouMakeUsUnique ¡Te esperamos!

items.desc: About The Company NTT DATA is a global business that empowers local teams to deliver work with the potential to make a meaningful difference. Our portfolio spans consulting, applications, business process, cloud, and infrastructure services. At NTT DATA UK&I, you will work alongside talented colleagues and clients on challenging projects in a supportive environment built on mutual respect, accountability, and continuous learning. Our inclusive culture encourages collaboration, wellbeing, growth, and agility. We believe that a diverse workforce helps us become more innovative and competitive, and we support a range of Inclusion Networks, including the Women’s Business Network, Cultural and Ethnicity Network, LGBTQ+ & Allies Network, Neurodiversity Network, and Parent Network. About The Role We are looking for a skilled and motivated Generative AI Specialist to join the Gen AI Centre of Excellence (COE) at NTT DATA UK&I. You will help design, implement, and deploy AI solutions, ideally using AWS technology, with a focus on a GraphRAG solution. This work will provide a practical foundation for contributing to a wider range of innovative projects across the COE. You will adapt a reusable deployment approach for customer environments, prepare customer documents for use in the solution, and develop the processes that connect information to useful AI-generated outputs. The role involves close collaboration with offshore teams and AI developers around the world. Applicants must be eligible to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance. Qualifications You will bring a technical data engineering background, curiosity about emerging technologies, and the drive to apply them to new challenges. You should be comfortable investigating and solving technical problems independently, with limited oversight, and able to communicate your approach clearly to colleagues and customers. We are looking for an understanding of artificial intelligence, AI ethics, and data safety when using large language models. Experience with AWS or Azure is required. Relevant AWS services and tools may include boto3, Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, S3, and EC2; relevant Azure experience may include Azure OpenAI Service and Cosmos DB. Useful technical experience includes Python, LangGraph, Neo4j and Cypher, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), GraphRAG, few-shot techniques, vector processing, graph extraction, embedding models, and large language models. Understanding how models work and are trained is valuable. Experience with other programming languages or frameworks, such as Java or .NET, is also beneficial. Responsibilities Deploy the GraphRAG solution into new customer tenants using a reusable, well-documented method. Onboard customer documents and check that diagrams and other visual content are parsed appropriately. Configure LangChain workflows for vector processing and knowledge graph extraction, and develop agents that generate useful outputs from existing knowledge graphs. Design, test, and refine prompts so customers can find relevant information effectively. Investigate deployment and data-processing issues, apply sound engineering practices, and contribute ideas for improving the solution. Work collaboratively with offshore colleagues, share knowledge with AI developers across the organisation, and support the COE as its project portfolio and responsibilities grow. Benefits NTT DATA offers tailored benefits designed to support your physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing. You will have access to ongoing learning and development opportunities to build your skills and progress your career, as well as flexible work options. You will also join a global organisation where you can collaborate with experienced professionals and contribute to exciting technology projects. Equal Opportunity NTT DATA is an equal opportunities employer committed to fair treatment, equity, and diversity in our employment practices. We are a Disability Confident Committed Employer and work to remove barriers for people with disabilities and long-term health conditions. Applicants who declare a disability during the application process and meet the minimum requirements for the role are guaranteed an interview. Please let us know if you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of recruitment. Join us in building a diverse and empowered team.

items.title: AI Engineer/Agentic Workflow Platform
items.card: You will work on agentic workflows, prompt engineering, evaluation pipelines, GitHub-based automation, and developer tooling that helps teams adopt AI agents consistently across repositories. You will join an existing initiative that already has working foundations in place. The immediate need is to strengthen, stabilise, and mature the current implementation through hands-on engineering, especially in agent
items.desc: Who We Are We are looking for a hands-on AI Engineer to help improve and scale an internal platform that enables engineering teams to ship faster and safer using AI-powered workflows. This role is focused on practical AI engineering, not AI research and not pure platform architecture. You will work on agentic workflows, prompt engineering, evaluation pipelines, GitHub-based automation, and developer tooling that helps teams adopt AI agents consistently across repositories. You will join an existing initiative that already has working foundations in place. The immediate need is to strengthen, stabilise, and mature the current implementation through hands-on engineering, especially in agent development, testing, evaluation, and workflow reliability. This is an excellent fit for someone who already uses AI coding agents as part of their daily workflow and knows how to turn AI capabilities into reliable engineering tooling. What You'll Be Doing Build and improve AI workflows across repositories Design agent workflows for docs, testing, code quality, reviews, and security Create effective prompts and multi-step interactions Improve reliability and usability of agents Use AI coding tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate delivery Design evaluation pipelines for prompts and agents Build datasets with edge and adversarial cases Add automated regression and behavior checks Use code-based and LLM-based evaluators Define quality gates before production Build reusable templates and onboarding tools Develop CLI/scripts for easy adoption Maintain workflow catalog and integrations Write clear docs and guides Enable self-service usage Maintain GitHub Actions and CI/CD patterns Ensure secure design (least privilege, secrets, OIDC) Improve security controls and automation safety Mitigate risks (prompt injection, data leaks) Keep changes testable and production-safe What You'll Bring Along BSc/MSc in Computer Science or related field Minimum 3-6+ years as a Platform Engineer Strong hands-on experience with Python for scripting, automation, evaluation tooling, or integrations Practical experience building with LLMs, prompts, AI agents, or agentic workflows in real engineering or production contexts Daily use of AI coding assistants or coding agents such as Copilot, Cursor, Kiro, Windsurf, Claude Code, or similar Experience designing, testing, and iterating prompts for reliable task execution Experience building evaluation or testing approaches for non-deterministic AI outputs Strong experience with GitHub Actions or equivalent CI/CD tooling, including reusable workflows and pipeline-as-code patterns Experience working with YAML, Markdown, JSON, and configuration-driven systems Good understanding of authentication, authorisation, secrets handling, and least-privilege access patterns Ability to write clear technical documentation for developers Strong hands-on engineering mindset with the ability to improve existing implementations quickly and pragmatically Preferred / Nice to Have Experience with AI evaluation frameworks such as promptfoo, DeepEval, RAGAS, Azure AI Evaluation SDK, or similar Experience with agentic frameworks such as LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, OpenAI Assistants API, or similar Background in internal developer platforms, developer tooling, or developer experience engineering Experience with docs-as-code and static documentation sites Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, Pulumi, or CDK Understanding of software supply chain security, dependency scanning, action pinning, and SBOM concepts Awareness of AI safety concerns such as prompt injection, adversarial testing, and OWASP Top 10 for LLM

items.desc: Hi, we're glad you're here! We are hiring to our Aviva Services Excellence Centre! Take a look at our job description - maybe it suits you or one of your friends? We are looking for an AI Quality Engineer to join Aviva Services Excellence Centre (ASEC) and help build confidence in the quality, safety and reliability of AI-powered products. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys understanding how AI systems behave, identifying weaknesses before they become customer problems, and creating reliable ways of measuring whether AI solutions are actually delivering the outcomes they were designed for. You will work across conversational AI, autonomous agents and other AI-powered systems, partnering closely with engineers, product teams and business stakeholders to ensure solutions are robust, trustworthy and ready for production use. What will you be doing? Translating business expectations, user outcomes and operational risks into measurable evaluation criteria. Defining what successful, partially successful and unsuccessful system behaviour looks like, including the gradient between clear success and clear failure. Designing evaluation approaches for conversational, multi-turn and non-deterministic AI systems. Building and maintaining representative evaluation datasets covering common, rare, boundary and high-risk scenarios. Assessing dataset quality, including coverage, class balance, duplicates, data leakage, label quality, synthetic-versus-production differences and dataset freshness. Selecting appropriate manual, deterministic, model-based and statistical evaluation methods. Analysing errors by category, user journey, risk level and likely root cause. Distinguishing model failures from failures in retrieval, chunking, ranking, prompts, tools, guardrails, integrations, source data and evaluators. Validating automated evaluators, including LLM-as-a-Judge, against human judgement. Detecting blind spots, noise, bias and misleading aggregation in evaluation results. Creating baselines, controlled comparisons and regression tests that allow meaningful comparison between system versions. Prioritising tests according to the probability and impact of failure rather than coverage alone. Communicating results, uncertainty, limitations and residual risks in a form that supports release and product decisions. Proactively identifying emerging failure modes based on system changes, production observations and research. What we're looking for: Professional experience in quality engineering, software testing, test automation, data science, software engineering or a related field (we can consider different seniority levels) . Experience or strong interest in working with AI-powered solutions, either through developing, testing, evaluating or supporting them. Good Python proficiency and experience writing clean, maintainable code for analysis, automation or testing purposes. Interest in understanding how AI systems behave, how reliable they are, and how their quality can be measured. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues and identify root causes. Ability to translate business objectives, customer outcomes and risks into practical evaluation approaches. Strong communication skills and the ability to explain findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. A curious, proactive mindset and a genuine interest in AI, emerging technologies and system robustness. Nice to have: Experience evaluating, testing or monitoring AI-powered systems in production environments. Working with structured data, especially JSON, logs and tabular evaluation results. Understanding of LLM behaviour, tokenisation, context limits, parameters and non-determinism. Understanding of multi-turn context, RAG, grounding, faithfulness, hallucinations, guardrails, attacks (like prompt injection etc.) and tool/function calling. Software engineering practices: Git, modular code, configuration management and automated tests. In Aviva Services Excellence Centre, we provide: Contract of employment Performance Bonus Private medical care (ENEL-MED) Cafeteria system of benefits (e.g. MultiSport card) Additional parent privileges: - baby leave – 6 weeks leave for second parent - shortened working time after parental leave Employer-funded group insurance Employee Shares Plan Extra day off for birthday Paid time off to volunteer Additional leave acquired over the years in the company (even 5 days more in a year) Wellbeing Leave - additional two weeks paid leave after 10 years of service Psychological support consultations Access to the e-learning platforms Internal employee referral program Hybrid working model from Poland with a few days in Warsaw office per month Attractive office location in Warsaw - Gdański Business Center Additional entitlements for people with disabilities - Work Without Barriers Work environment that promotes diversity - Diversity Charter Do you see yourself in Aviva Services Excellence …

Vous ne créez pas seulement des modèles, vous concevez les autoroutes (Data Lakes, pipelines RAG, orchestrateurs) qui permettent à l'IA générative et agentique de transformer réellement les grandes organisations mondiales. Vos Piliers D'intervention Vision Stratégique & Design : Définir l'architecture cible des plateformes IA au sein des SI complexes (Cloud, Hybride, Souverain). Construction de Plateformes de Nouvelle Génération : Déploiement de Vector Stores, pipelines RAG et orchestrateurs d’agents pour donner vie aux solutions GenAI. Maîtrise de la Donnée (Lakehouse) : Pilotage de l'ingestion massive, de la qualité et du lignage de la donnée, socle indispensable de toute IA performante. Industrialisation (DataOps / LLMOps) : Mise en place du CI/CD, de l'observabilité et du monitoring pour garantir des solutions fiables et scalables. items.desc: Location: Manchester & Hybrid Type: Full-Time (37.5 hours over 5 days per week) The Opportunity Are you a hands-on engineer who thrives on building, maintaining, and shipping production-grade tech? Open Partners is looking for an AI & Automation Partner to join our AI & Automation Centre of Excellence (CoE). Reporting to our AI & Automation Senior Partner, you will add crucial engineering capacity to the team by building the technical pipelines, platforms, and tools that power our data and AI products. This is a technical, delivery-focused role working alongside our Data Planning Senior Partner to turn client requirements into robust, high-performing software. Your Role & Responsibilities Pipeline & Platform Engineering: Build, maintain, and improve data pipelines and integrations across agency platforms such as BigQuery, GCP, and ThoughtSpot. Technical Delivery: Support the rollout of AI and automation-powered tools across data, media, and reporting workflows to standards set by CoE leadership. Clean & Production-Grade Code: Write clean, well-documented code while maintaining and scaling existing CoE tools and pipelines. Commercial AI Integration: Support the integration of commercial AI platforms and APIs, including OpenAI and Google Gemini/Vertex AI, into agency tooling. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with the Data Planning Senior Partner to translate client-facing needs into technical builds. Security & Governance: Adhere strictly to agency standards for security, data handling, GDPR, and governance, registering builds through the App Passport process. Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to the CoE knowledge base and support agency-wide AI and automation upskilling. What Success Looks Like Roadmap Delivery: Consistently shipping build tasks against the quarterly CoE roadmap. Unblocking Capacity: Effectively reducing delivery bottlenecks and increasing total CoE output. Governance Compliance: Maintaining high percentages of documented, governance-compliant, and App Passport-registered builds. System Reliability: Ensuring high uptime and performance across all pipelines and tools you maintain. Stakeholder Satisfaction: Positive feedback from delivery leads on technical responsiveness and execution quality. What You’ll Bring Hands-On Engineering: Strong software engineering capabilities (e.g. Python, TypeScript/Node.js) with experience building and maintaining production systems. Cloud & Data Experience: Practical experience with cloud infrastructure (preferably GCP: Cloud Run, BigQuery, Secret Manager) and building API-driven data pipelines. Automation & AI Capabilities: Working knowledge of workflow automation tools like n8n, along with exposure to commercial AI platforms, APIs, or LLM applications (e.g. RAG, LangGraph). Data Governance Discipline: Solid understanding of security, data handling, and GDPR principles in an engineering setting. Communication & Mindset: Clear communication skills, an ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical partners, and a drive to build deep AI expertise. Our Values & Mindset Skills At Open Partners, we hire mindset first. It is the single biggest factor of success in our business, and we believe you can grow that mindset in any walk of life and career background. If you do not have direct industry experience but possess a fierce growth mindset and transferable engineering skills, we want to hear from you. We hold ourselves to three simple standards: Smarter: Aim high, train hard, embrace next. Faster: Learn fast, adapt fast, act fast. Better: Think, say, and do what is best. Ready to elevate your career? Apply today! Open Partners was founded in 2017 to be The Agency of Next . Designed to be constantly focussed on the future, we think ahead for our clients, quickly pivoting them to new areas of opportunity as they arise. Delivering marketing transformations for over 50 clients, Open Partners’ integrated Media, Data and Creative capabilities drive more accountable and effective returns for international performance advertisers. We strive to always be smarter, faster, and better - all the while upholding the very highest standards of commercial and operational integrity.

items.desc: WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy. As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in. We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide. This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today. We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level. Join us and let’s shape the future of data. Job Description The next era of intelligent systems will require entirely new approaches to photonic device design, optical architectures, simulation, and system integration. Solving these problems demands deep physical intuition, advanced computational modeling, and the ability to bridge simulation with experimental reality. We are looking for a Principal R&D Engineer to lead advanced optical design and computational photonics development for next-generation semiconductor and photonic systems. This role combines: optical simulation, inverse design, electro-thermal modeling, computational optimization, experimental interpretation, and system-level co-development. You will define and drive the optical architecture behind advanced device platforms and work across multidisciplinary teams spanning device physics, packaging, process development, characterization, and system integration. What you’ll be doing: Lead advanced optical and multiphysics simulation activities for next-generation photonic systems. Develop inverse-design and optimization methodologies for complex optical structures. Build scalable computational frameworks spanning optics, thermal, and electrical domains. Drive architecture-level tradeoff studies and system-level optical design decisions. Collaborate closely with characterization teams to correlate simulations with experimental measurements. Support co-development between devices, packaging, thermal systems, and photonic integration platforms. Develop reduced-order analytical models alongside full numerical simulation workflows. Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across optical design and simulation activities. Help define future AI-assisted computational photonics workflows and design infrastructure. Qualifications What we need to see: PhD or equivalent experience in Physics, Photonics, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related field. 8+ years experience in optical design, computational photonics, or advanced device simulation. Strong background in optical simulation and numerical modeling. Experience with electromagnetic, optical, thermal, or multiphysics simulation tools. Strong programming capability in Python, MATLAB, or scientific computing environments. Ability to connect theoretical modeling with experimental validation and engineering constraints. Strong technical leadership and communication skills. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Experience with inverse design or optimization algorithms. Experience with semiconductor or integrated photonic devices. Strong multiphysics modeling capability. AI/ML-assisted simulation or optimization experience. Experience bridging device-level and system-level optical design. Demonstrated ability to solve difficult first-principles engineering problems. Additional Information WD thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us. We are committed to an inclusive environment where every individual can thrive through a sense of belonging, respect and contribution. WD is committed to offering opportunities to applicants with disabilities and ensuring all candidates can successfully navigate our careers website and our hiring process. Please contact us at jobs.accommodations@wdc.com to advise us of your accommodation request. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying. Notice To Candidates: Please be aware that WD and its subsidiaries will never request payment as a condition for applying for a position or receiving an offer of employment. Should you encounter any such requests, please report it immediately to WD Ethics Helpline or email compliance@wdc.com.
