items.desc: Nel mondo del packaging industriale, la vera innovazione nasce all'incrocio tra scienza dei materiali, ingegneria di processo e sostenibilità concreta. In SIPA , leader riconosciuto a livello globale nelle soluzioni di confezionamento e trasformazione dei polimeri, stiamo ridisegnando gli standard del settore per rispondere alle sfide dell’ economia circolare e della transizione verso materiali a basso impatto ambientale. Per potenziare la nostra direzione Marketing & Innovation Group , siamo alla ricerca di un/una R&D / Innovation Engineer appassionato/a di ricerca applicata, desideroso/a di unire modellazione teorica avanzata e sperimentazione pratica sul campo. All'interno del nostro team R&D sarai il punto di riferimento tecnico per lo sviluppo di contenitori innovativi, seguendo l'intero ciclo di vita dell'idea: dal concept al brevetto, passando per i test sul campo. Nello specifico: Simulazione e Design Predittivo: Valuterai le performance teoriche di nuovi concept di contenitori e preforme avvalendoti di software di simulazione avanzata (es. MoldFlow, FEA). Project Management Tecnico & Prototipazione: Guiderai operativamente le fasi di prototipazione, coordinando le prove di laboratorio, la validazione sperimentale e l'analisi critica delle proprietà meccaniche e di processo dei campioni. Focus Circolarità & Nuovi Materiali: Analizzerai e valuterai la reale riciclabilità dei polimeri (closed-loop economy), conducendo studi e caratterizzazioni su resine alternative, materiali riciclati (rPET) e biopolimeri emergenti. Proprietà Intellettuale & Brevetti: Condurrai analisi bibliografiche sullo stato dell'arte e sull'Intellectual Property (IP) dei competitor, collaborando a stretto contatto con i team di ingegneria per identificare soluzioni proprietarie e depositare nuovi brevetti SIPA. Digital & AI Integration: Integrerai metodologie e strumenti digitali, automazione e tool basati su AI per accelerare le analisi predittive e la gestione della conoscenza R&D. Il profilo che stiamo cercando: Cerchiamo un profilo tecnico completo: capace di muoversi agilmente tra formule, articoli scientifici e macchine di processo, con una forte attitudine "hands-on". Percorso accademico: Laurea Magistrale in Ingegneria Chimica (requisito preferenziale) o in Ingegneria dei Materiali / Scienza dei Materiali . Esperienza: Dai 2 ai 5 anni maturati in reparti R&D, preferibilmente all'interno dell'industria delle materie plastiche, della trasformazione dei polimeri o del packaging avanzato. Competenze tecniche & teoriche: Profonda comprensione della chimica macromolecolare, delle tecnologie di trasformazione dei polimeri (stampaggio a iniezione, soffiaggio) e delle proprietà termomeccaniche e strutturali. Comprensione di base delle logiche di automazione e del funzionamento degli impianti di processo industriale. Familiarità con banche dati brevettuali, stesura e analisi di brevetti (IP search). Strumenti digitali: Conoscenza di software di simulazione virtuale (es. MoldFlow, ANSYS/FEA) e apertura all’uso di tool AI per l'ingegneria. Lingue: Conoscenza fluente della lingua Italiana e della lingua Inglese (scritta e parlata). Soft skills: Mente analitica, cura rigorosa per i dettagli, spiccata curiosità scientifica, autonomia operativa unita a un forte spirito di squadra e ottime doti relazionali/comunicative. Descrizione azienda: SIPA progetta, produce e vende sul mercato mondiale tutte le tecnologie per la produzione, riempimento e confezionamento secondario di contenitori in PET, dalla preforma al prodotto finale, per bevande, alimenti, detergenza, cosmetica e farmaceutica. SIPA possiede un elevato grado di specializzazione ed è un partner tecnologico il cui obiettivo principale è quello di offrire ai propri clienti soluzioni innovative e competitive per ogni specifica esigenza. La gamma di prodotti è molto ampia e comprende macchine singole per la produzione di preforme e bottiglie come pure soluzioni chiavi in mano di linee complete. SIPA fornisce altresì soluzioni di packaging e servizi di design bottiglia, simulazione computerizzate e prototipazione contenitori. Situata a Vittorio Veneto, in provincia di Treviso, l'azienda dispone di 22 filiali di vendita a livello mondiale, 4 stabilimenti produttivi (due in Italia, uno in Romania e uno in Cina) e 35 centri di assistenza post-vendita per la fornitura di ricambi e assistenza tecnica. Informazioni retributive: In linea con il nostro impegno verso la trasparenza retributiva, per questa posizione è prevista una Retribuzione Annua Lorda indicativa di €35.000-45.000, commisurata all’esperienza professionale e alle competenze del/la candidato/a. Pari opportunità e Privacy: La presente offerta di lavoro si intende rivolta ai candidati di entrambi i sessi ai sensi della legge 903/1977 e del D.Lgs. 198/2006. SIPA promuove un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo e garantisce pari opportunità di accesso, crescita e sviluppo professionale nel rispetto della normativa vigente. Per proporre …

items.desc: The Company JSM Group designs and builds the power networks and digital infrastructure that clients across the UK, Europe and beyond depend on — from high-voltage grid connections and critical utilities to data centres and renewable energy. Our civil, power and digital engineers work under one roof, giving clients one team from design to energisation, with the technical, commercial and consenting risk managed from day one. THE TEAM Most AI roles hand you a ticket. This one hands you a problem. JSM Group builds the infrastructure behind the UK's energy and communications networks. We're rolling out AI across the business, and we need someone who can work out where it helps, and then build it. Expect to spend as much time with the business as at your keyboard. You'll sit with teams across finance, operations, field delivery and support. You'll find out where their time goes, spot the tasks AI can take on, and prototype solutions with the people who'll use them. When a prototype proves itself, you'll take it into production as an agent, an automated workflow or an integration with our core systems. SCOPE OF ROLE The AI Solutions Engineer works directly with end users to build and deliver AI use cases across JSM, under the direction of the Change & Business Improvement Lead. This is a hands-on, technical role at the heart of the AI adoption programme. What You'll Do Run workshops and interviews with departments to map how work gets done and where time is lost Capture requirements and build the business case for each opportunity Recommend the right fix, whether that's an AI agent, a standard automation or a process change Model and test AI solutions with users before committing to a build Build agents, automated workflows and integrations using Python, APIs and large language model platforms Help users adopt what you build, and measure the impact What You'll Bring A degree in Computer Science or a related subject, with AI or machine learning content, or equivalent hands-on experience At least one year of commercial experience (a placement year counts), with exposure to project delivery Business analysis skills: running workshops, mapping processes and turning conversations into requirements Python and API skills, and a portfolio or projects that show you can build Hands-on experience with large language models: prompting, agents, tool use The confidence to work with colleagues from field teams to directors and explain your work in plain terms Experience with Claude, Claude Code or MCP connectors is a plus. So is any background in construction, utilities or infrastructure. What We Offer Pay & reward — competitive salary, performance-linked bonus and car allowance (where applicable), 4% matched pension Time off — 28 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays Health & wellbeing — BUPA health cash plan, Benenden Health, employee assistance programme Career growth — funded training through our Training Centre and Competency Cloud, professional memberships and a clear route to chartership or higher authorisation Extras — electric car salary-sacrifice scheme ENGINEERED TO BELONG Our values — personal responsibility, sound judgment, drive, and being brilliant individually but unbeatable as one — shape how we work on every project. We give you the work to stretch you and the support to develop fast. See what life at JSM looks like at careers.jsmgroup.com. READY TO APPLY? Introduction of the job 
 You are the end-to-end owner for the Low Code & No Code Automation domain within the Enterprise Platforms value stream, managing the domain teams to deliver the roadmap and ensuring the triple constraint of quality, time, and cost is met.​ 
 In this role you will report into the Head of Enterprise Platforms.

 Roadmapping & Planning: translate the Enterprise Platforms value stream roadmap into Low Code & No Code Automation domain plans; maintain the rolling six-quarter plan, including low-code adoption, Mendix, Test Automation and RPA advancement considering AI roadmaps, and platform enablement, driving measurable improvements in development speed, reuse, and platform adoption​ 
 Delivery Management & Governance: manage dependencies, risks, and governance, ensuring measurable improvements in platform stability, scalability, and compliance, while enforcing standardization across citizen development initiatives​ 
 Stakeholder & Supplier Management: engage business stakeholders, IT teams, and suppliers, including relevant software vendors, driving measurable improvements in platform adoption, cost efficiency, and alignment with enterprise standards​ 
 Platform Enablement & Adoption: enable business teams to consume low-code platforms as a service, supporting citizen development through governed frameworks, reusable components, and managed delivery via suppliers​ 
 Team Performance & Coaching: drive engineering and enablement practices, improving delivery predictability and platform usage across teams​ 
 People Leadership: lead domain teams, fostering high-performing teams focused on automation, platform engineering, and citizen development enablement 
 Education, experience and role-relevant background  
 Master’s degree or equivalent in IT, Engineering or related field 
 Minimum requirements 
 Extensive experience (5+ years) in low‑code/no‑code, workflow and citizen development architecture and governance 
 Demonstrable experience with Mendix, Microsoft Power Platform, UiPath, Test automation or equivalent workplace automation and citizen development platforms 
 Technical & functional skills 
 End‑to‑end architecture & TCO ownership: Ability to low‑code/no‑code, workflow and citizen development architecture and TCO 
 Governance & secure‑by‑design: Set platform governance, reuse, security and compliance rules 
 Architecture modelling & runway: Produce and maintain low‑code, workflow, RPA and citizen development platform models 
 Low‑code/Workflow tooling : Microsoft Power Platform, Mendix, SAP BPA, UiPath and workflow platforms 
 Compliance & lifecycle: App lifecycle, governance, security and scaling practices 
 Behavioral & leadership skills

 Collaborates: Build partnerships and work collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. 
 Decision Quality: Make good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward. 
 Business Insight: Apply knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization’s goals. 
 Strategic Mindset: See ahead to future possibilities and translates them into breakthrough strategies.

Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require ASML to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology.

items.desc:
Location: Praha, Czechia 
Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure. 
Thales in the Czech Republic employs over 400 people from 45 different nationalities. A total of 15 teams work on projects for government agencies, banking, mobile services and the Internet Of Things (IoT) technology. At the core of our business is the development of software which we configure and embed in a multitude of different devices and form factors. These include many kinds of payment cards, SIM cards, travel passes, secure eBanking devices, authentication tokens, machine identification modules (MIM), and secure ID documents including ePassports, eID and eHealth cards, as well as eDriving licenses. Because of the international environment surrounding us every day, it comes as no surprise that English is our official corporate language. 
 Build security-critical backend system that millions of users rely on - with modern Java, modern Spring, and a team that ships, owns, and continuously improves the platform.
 We’re a product company in the cybersecurity/identity space . That means real engineering problems (security, scale, correctness, reliability), real ownership (you build it, you run it), and real influence (strong partnership with Product, not ticket-taking).
 Why this role is different 
 Modern stack, by design : We stay on the newest Java LTS and the newest Spring Framework (security expectations make this non-negotiable - and it’s a great side effect for engineers).
 Pragmatic testing : We value confidence over coverage . Integration-first where it matters. Minimal mocking. Tests that catch real issues.
 Strong CI/CD culture : Automated pipelines, multiple test layers, fast feedback, high signal.
 True ownership : We deploy to production ourselves and own the full lifecycle.
 AI-enabled engineering (for real) : Company-backed initiative with tooling, guidelines, and people driving adoption - great opportunity to level up how you use AI effectively.
 Voice and influence : Engineers are expected to speak up, challenge solutions, and improve the platform, even beyond our team boundaries.
 What you’ll do 
 Design and deliver backend services where security, correctness, and maintainability are first-class requirements.
 Break down ambiguous, high-impact problems into a clear plan and ship iteratively.
 Collaborate closely with Product to craft solutions that are both technically sound and user-aware.
 Improve platform-wide concerns: reliability, observability, performance, developer experience, and deployment safety.
 Raise the bar through thoughtful code reviews, pragmatic architecture decisions, and knowledge sharing.
 Our tech stack (high-level) 
 Java (latest LTS) , Spring Framework (latest) 
 Kubernetes , Helm , Skaffold , GitOps 
 AWS 
 CI/CD with extensive automated testing
 Strong automation mindset across build, deploy, and operations
 What we’re looking for 
 Must-haves 
 8+ years of professional software engineering experience
 Deep expertise in Java and strong hands-on experience with Spring 
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills
 Fluent English (spoken and written)
 Ability to work autonomously: you can take a big problem, de-risk it, and drive it to completion, while pulling others in when needed
 Strong engineering intuition: you challenge weak solutions, avoid “bare minimum,” and care about long-term quality
 How you work 
 You like clarity, but you’re not blocked by ambiguity
 You optimize for outcomes, not just activity
 You enjoy improving shared foundations (platform, tooling, patterns), not only “your” service
 Bonus points (nice to have, not required) 
 If you don’t have these yet - curiosity and the willingness to learn matter more. We’ll help you grow through hands-on work with experienced engineers.

 Interest in CIAM/IAM concepts: consent, identity lifecycle, federation, credential management, RBAC, token-based security
 Distributed systems / event-driven experience where scale, availability, and consistency matter
 Observability & performance tuning: metrics/tracing, JVM optimization, load testing
 Cryptography fundamentals: key management, secure hashing, TLS, JWT signing

 IaC / DevOps: Terraform, CloudFormation, GitOps workflows
 Balanced testing strategy: contract tests, integration-first, minimal mocking, maintainable test suites

items.desc:
Who we are 
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 
 The role 
 As a Specialist Export Control, you will hold a critical position in bridging the gap between regulatory compliance and operational execution. You will act as a high-agency professional, taking full ownership of our daily export control operations—including licensing, releases, screening, and the customs interface. Beyond day-to-day throughput, your work will directly enable our growth by driving the projects that make these operations scalable, such as system rollouts, process automation, and building licensing architectures for new programs and sites. This role requires a hands-on specialist who thrives on operational excellence, complementing our ITAR/EAR regulatory function by owning our process architecture. You will work directly with our Executive Export Control Officer ( Ausfuhrverantwortlicher ) and design the vital controls they rely on, while formal personal liability remains at the management level.
 The day-to-day 
 Operations — Driving Daily Execution 
 End-to-End BAFA Licensing: Manage individual, global, and general licenses (AGG) for exports, transfers, and tech data, including conditions and deadlines.
 Transaction Releases: Clear shipments, services, and software releases (list checks, end-use/end-user verification, catch-all assessments).
 Sanctions Screening: Execute and document EU, UN, OFAC, and UK list screenings, resolving hits and false positives.
 ERP Master Data: Ensure export control classifications (AL-No., ECCN) in the ERP match the reality of our products.
 Customs Interface: Align with logistics and brokers on ATLAS filings, proofs of origin, and Carnets.
 Advisory & Documentation: Guide internal stakeholders (Sales, Engineering, Procurement) and maintain an audit-proof record of all compliance decisions.
 Projects — Scaling for Tomorrow 
 Program Export Concepts: Build licensing architectures for new programs, consortia, and sites right from the proposal phase.
 System Rollouts & Automation: Drive the implementation and optimization of export control tools (e.g., SAP GTS, AEB, Descartes) to automate workflows.
 ICP Evolution: Upgrade internal processes and control mechanisms to meet BAFA ICP requirements.
 Audits & Metrics: Lead internal checks, support external/AEO audits, and establish hard KPIs (lead times, hit rates) over gut feeling.
 Team Enablement: Design and roll out practical, target-group-specific compliance trainings.
 You should apply if you 
 Have deep operational expertise: You bring at least 5 years of hands-on experience in operational export control within an industrial, technology, or defense company—or in a comparably transaction-heavy role
 Drive outcomes through project leadership: You have a proven track record of independently leading projects—such as system rollouts, process digitization, or building export frameworks—while steering stakeholders across departments
 Are a BAFA & EU regulatory specialist: You confidently apply AWG/AWV, the EU Dual-Use Regulation (EU) 2021/821, national control lists ( Ausfuhrliste ), and EU sanctions law in your daily practice, and have extensive experience with BAFA licensing procedures including ELAN-K2
 Understand systems beyond the user interface: You have practical experience with ERP or export control software (e.g., SAP, SAP GTS, AEB) coupled with a strong grasp of underlying master data and screening logic
 Thrive under real time pressure: You maintain a structured, deadline-driven approach and autonomously prioritize when twenty release requests hit your desk at once
 Are a clear communicator: You navigate complex topics with professional fluency in both written and spoken German and English 
 Can obtain security clearance: You are willing and eligible to undergo a national security clearance check (SÜG)
 Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. 
 Nice to Have 
 Knowledge of ITAR/EAR and US (re-)export regulations—while deep regulatory expertise sits with the …

items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

ElevenCreative brings together leading image and video models alongside our own audio models, so our users can make everything they need in one place. We are looking for someone to own our relationships with the model providers who make that possible, starting with video.

You will be the main point of contact for our model partners, help bring new models to ElevenCreative, and build partnerships that are good for our partners, our users, and our business. You will work closely with product, engineering, finance, marketing, and sales.

This is a green-field role. You will define how we work with model partners as the ecosystem grows.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL

 - Build and manage relationships with image and video model providers.

 - Identify and evaluate new partners and models to bring to ElevenCreative.

 - Own the commercial side of our partnerships, working closely with finance.

 - Drive marketing including joint launches, campaigns, and co-marketing.

 - Work with product and engineering to shape which models we offer and when.

 - Support enterprise sales on partnership needs for large customers.

 - Stay close to the generative video landscape and the models creators and marketers want next.


WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for someone who combines strong partnership skills with sound commercial judgment. You will thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, or commercial roles at a technology company, ideally in AI or infrastructure.

 - Have deep familiarity with the generative AI model landscape.

 - Are comfortable with numbers and can connect partnership decisions to business outcomes.

 - Can manage several partner relationships at once and build trust with senior stakeholders.

 - Have worked cross-functionally with product, engineering, finance, and marketing.

 - Can operate with US and European timezone overlap, with flexibility for partners in Asia.

 - Thrive in fast-moving environments where you define the playbook rather than follow one.


BONUS

 - Experience working with AI model or API providers.

 - Familiarity with usage-based or credit-based pricing.

 - Experience running co-marketing or channel partnerships.

items.desc:
At Verda, we're building a full-stack AI cloud, covering everything from data centers and hardware to our own cloud platform that the world's leading AI teams use to do serious AI work.
 We strive to make a positive mark on the world through the infrastructure we build and give leading teams a service they can truly depend on. Headquartered in Helsinki, we operate globally with offices in London and San Francisco.
 Join Verda while it’s still being built - not once it’s finished.
 Why Verda
 Cash and equity compensation along with local benefits.
 40+ nationalities, with 6 different ones on the management team.
 A real chance to make an impact and work alongside world class engineers, researchers, and partners across the global AI ecosystem.
 Practicalities
 Work mode: On-site, 8-hour shift rotation covering 24/7 operations
 Level: Mid/Senior level
 Employment type: Full time and permanent
 Salary range - 23,000 - 35,000 euros gross/annually
 About the role
 Our sites runs on high-density GPU infrastructure around the clock, and we are hiring at both Data Center Technician and Senior Data Center Technician levels. Your level will be determined by your experience, technical capability and the complexity of work you can handle independently.
 This is a hands-on, all-rounder role covering server installation, hardware break/fix, rack builds, copper and fibre cabling, link-level troubleshooting and general site operations. You will work independently within your level of responsibility while collaborating closely with other technicians, network engineers, system administrators and wider infrastructure teams.
 At the senior level, you will take on more complex technical work, lead the technical execution of deployments and build-outs, mentor junior technicians and help improve operating procedures and technical standards.
 Your responsibilities
 Install, configure, and maintain servers, storage systems, networking equipment, and other data center hardware.
 Monitor data center environmental conditions — temperature, humidity, power — and respond to alerts.
 Ensure uptime and availability of data center infrastructure in a 24/7 environment, including participation in on-call.
 Lead or contribute to data center build-outs, migrations, and refresh projects — including opening new data halls and extensions.
 Plan and schedule machine installations independently, and plan future site upgrades as power capacity grows.
 Collaborate closely with remote hands teams, network engineers, system administrators, the Site Manager, and Head of DC Operations.
 Mentor junior technicians and, as the site grows, take part in hiring and building the on-site team.
 Clear communication and stakeholder-management skills, with professional fluency in English — our internal working language and the language of daily contact with colleagues in Finland. Fluency in Latvian is required for work with local parties.
 Your key competencies
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
 3–5+ years of progressive data center or IT infrastructure experience.
 Direct hands-on experience with enterprise GPU servers (NVIDIA Ampere, Hopper, or Blackwell generations).
 Ability to operate independently and improvise — you don't need check-ins or supervision to know what matters.
 Ability to work on-site full-time in shift rotation.
 Comfortable with ambiguity and a broad scope of work
 Nice to have
 Experience with liquid cooling — DLC loops, and maintenance of liquid cooling solutions.
 Hands-on exposure to enterprise GPU servers (NVIDIA Ampere, Hopper, or Blackwell generations) or switch integration work.
 Experience across more than one operational environment.
 Experience contributing to cluster deployments or data hall build-outs as a hands-on technician.
 Experience leading site build-outs, data hall openings, or large cluster deployments.
 Experience mentoring or leading junior technicians.
 What's next
 We're building fast and this role needs the right person behind it. There's no artificial deadline, but when we find who we're looking for, we move. If this sounds like your next move, apply now.
 If you have a CV in English, you are welcome to submit it. Applications in Latvian are equally accepted. Please apply through our careers page, as we do not accept applications by email.

Nous intégrons l'IA à nos propres pratiques d'ingénierie (utilisation quotidienne de RAISE et Claude Code) pour automatiser les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée et concentrer nos efforts sur la conception d'architectures résilientes. ️ À propos du poste Tu conçois et déploies des agents IA et systèmes agentiques complets exécutant des processus métier de bout en bout : support client avancé, recherche multi-sources, opérations IT, ainsi que des cas d'usage avancés liés à l'industrie du futur et à la continuité digitale (ex. traçabilité des exigences, maintenance prédictive, continuité de l'ingénierie et jumeaux numériques). Maîtriser la fiabilité : gestion des erreurs et des reprises, boucles de contrôle, limites de budget et de pas, comportement face à l’imprévu. Évaluer les agents : jeux de scénarios, analyse des trajectoires, taux de réussite des tâches, LLM-as-judge, tests de non-régression à chaque changement de prompt, d’outil ou de modèle. S'intégrer dans le cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) complet et déployer sur le cloud (Google Cloud / Vertex AI) avec intégration CI/CD et gestion des coûts. items.desc: Joining KEYES means giving purpose to your talent. Are you looking for an environment where technology is not an end in itself, but a lever to build a sustainable future? At KEYES , we are not just looking for technical expertise; we are looking for people who share our values. Do you want to continue your career and grow within one of Belgium’s leading IT companies? Join KEYES as a Technical Infrastructure & Network Architect! KEYES supports private and public organizations in Belgium and across Europe in their digital transformation by combining business expertise, technological mastery, and a long-term vision. We support large enterprises, the public sector, healthcare organizations, and SMEs in all their digital challenges : Infrastructure & Cloud Solutions, Cybersecurity Solutions, Business Software Solutions, Mainframe Solutions, Data & AI Solutions, Advisory Solutions, and Staffing Solutions. More information: www.keyes.eu YOUR MISSION Provide technical architecture leadership across infrastructure, network, cloud and hybrid environments, supporting transformation, modernization and operational initiatives across multiple projects and sites, including industrial/OT environments. The role is to define coherent, secure, resilient and operable technical architectures and support their delivery from design through implementation and transition to operations. The architect must be able to reason beyond individual infrastructure components and understand the broader architecture context: applications, data flows, trust zones, integration mechanisms, cloud connectivity, security and operational constraints. Positioning within the Architecture Organization The Technical Infrastructure & Network Architect works closely with Enterprise, Solution, Application, Data, Cloud and Security Architects, as well as Infrastructure, Network, DevOps and project teams. The role is accountable for the technical infrastructure architecture required to host, connect, secure, operate and recover solutions, including network, compute, storage, backup, cloud/hybrid infrastructure, container foundations and observability. End-to-end architecture is developed jointly. The architect must actively contribute to cross-domain architecture decisions and challenge proposed solutions when required. Network and infrastructure architecture are considered part of the overall solution architecture, not isolated technical domains. items.desc: Are you a high-caliber finance professional who loves turning data into direction and insight into impact? Join us as Group FP&A Lead and play a central role in shaping performance, guiding strategic decisions, and elevating financial rigor across the organization. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on building robust forecasting frameworks, partnering with leaders, and driving continuous improvement in a dynamic, growth-focused environment. Principal Accountabilities Develop and apply professional expertise; use company policies and procedures to resolve a variety of issues and recommend process improvements. Determine appropriate courses of action within established guidelines; adapt processes and methods when required. Work on problems of moderate scope, often varied and routine, requiring review of multiple factors and sound judgment within defined procedures. Apply learned techniques; contribute to analysis and investigation to solve problems with limited day-to-day instruction. Build productive internal and external relationships; collaborate to resolve mutual problems and improve procedures or transactions. Provide standard professional advice; create initial reports/analyses for review by senior team members. Minimum Education/Experience Requirements Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 2 years of related experience; or An advanced degree without experience; or Any combination of education and experience, which would provide an equivalent background to deliver against role expectations. Lead monthly performance reviews, including variance analysis, KPI tracking, and insight-rich commentary for senior leadership. Build driver-based financial models, scenario/what-if analyses, and sensitivity testing to inform strategic choices and resource allocation. Partner with leaders across functions (Commercial, Operations, People, Tech) to translate strategy into numbers and numbers into action. Prepare high-impact board and executive materials: dashboards, trend analyses, cash flow outlooks, risks/opportunities, and recommendations. Enhance FP&A processes, calendar discipline, and governance; improve close-to-forecast cycle time and forecast accuracy. Strengthen data and reporting foundations; leverage BI and planning tools to automate recurring reports and elevate analytical depth. Support investment cases, pricing, and unit economics; contribute to capital allocation discipline and performance management. Coach and elevate the broader finance team’s analytical toolkit and stakeholder engagement. What You’ll Bring A strong finance toolkit: advanced Excel/Google Sheets, driver-based modeling, scenario analysis, and executive-ready storytelling. Proven ability to synthesize complex data, challenge constructively, and influence decisions with clear, commercially focused insights. Track record of improving processes, closing gaps in data/controls, and driving scalable reporting solutions. Curiosity, accountability, and a bias for action—comfortable operating with autonomy while collaborating cross-functionally. Preferred Qualifications 5+ years of FP&A or corporate finance experience, ideally in multi-entity/group or fast-paced environments. Professional qualification (e.g., CPA, ACCA, CIMA) or MBA. Experience with planning and BI tools (e.g., Anaplan, Adaptive, NetSuite Planning, Power BI, Tableau, Looker). Exposure to board reporting, consolidation, and cash flow forecasting. This is a global position based at our Hillerød site in Denmark. In this role you will support all our FUJIFILM Biotechnologies sites. items.desc: Pour un grand compte en Île-de-France, nous recherchons un Chef de projet infrastructure sénior pour renforcer, au sein de la DSI, l'équipe en charge de la roadmap et des projets d'infrastructure. Cette équipe pilote les projets techniques de l'entreprise : briques techniques (montées de version de palier OS, SGBD, nouvelles offres de service), reprises d'exploitation (reprise d'infrastructures, définition du modèle d'exploitation) projets autour des nouvelles technologies (cloud, conteneurs, Infrastructure as Code). Vous conduisez ces projets depuis l'étude d'opportunité jusqu'au déploiement et à l'intégration complète en production, dans le respect des engagements de qualité, coûts, délais et sécurité. Démarrage en binôme avec le chef de projet en place pour une reprise progressive du portefeuille. Missions Rédiger et porter les demandes de financement des études et des projets (fiche d'opération, dossier d'opportunité, dossier de décision d'investissement). Piloter la conception générale des projets : cahier des charges, dossier de conception générale. Organiser, planifier, coordonner et piloter l'ensemble des ressources, processus et intervenants internes et externes mobilisés. Contribuer aux phases d'achats : RFI, POC, appel d'offres, dossier de consultation, sélection des fournisseurs. Assurer le suivi financier, le plan de charges, le planning et la gestion des risques ; définir le plan de management et le plan d'assurance qualité du projet. Assurer les activités d'AMOA projet : analyse fonctionnelle du besoin, rédaction des spécifications, réalisation des recettes. Animer les revues et comités de pilotage, produire ordres du jour et comptes rendus. Conduire le changement de bout en bout et assurer le transfert de compétences aux équipes de production ; définir et piloter la mise en ?uvre de la maintenance des nouvelles solutions. Environnement technique Deux datacenters, 550 applications, 1 500 serveurs physiques, 5 300 serveurs virtuels, 3 Po de stockage, plus de 2 000 instances de bases de données. Stockage EMC et NetApp, sauvegarde Commvault, réseau Cisco / Checkpoint / Fortinet / F5, RedHat Linux et Windows, VMware, OpenStack, Docker, Kubernetes, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQL Server, WebLogic, Tomcat, Apache, GitLab, Ansible, Terraform, Azure, AWS, ServiceNow, Centreon, Nagios. Profil candidat: Compétences attendues Expérience confirmée de conduite de projets d'infrastructure de bout en bout en DSI de grand compte : migrations de datacenter, montées de palier OS ou SGBD, reprises d'exploitation, projets cloud, conteneurs ou Infrastructure as Code. Bonne connaissance des architectures techniques : stockage, sauvegarde, virtualisation, systèmes d'exploitation, bases de données, middleware, réseau. Maîtrise des processus de gestion de projet : planning, budget, plan de charges, risques, achats et appels d'offres, reporting en comité de pilotage. Pratique des méthodologies agiles (Scrum, JIRA) et de la culture ITIL (transition projet vers RUN, modèle d'exploitation, CAB, recette). Qualités rédactionnelles pour les dossiers d'opportunité, cahiers des charges et comptes rendus. Autonomie, méthode, rigueur, bon relationnel ; capacité d'organisation, d'anticipation, de priorisation, de proposition, de conseil et d'alerte ; goût du travail en équipe. Rapidement opérationnel ; français courant.

items.desc: Qui sommes-nous ? Cybersecura est une équipe de passionnés par la gouvernance en cybersécurité et qui met l'exigence au centre de leur quotidien. Nous sommes persuadés que la sécurisation du numérique ne doit pas être un privilège des grandes entreprises. C’est pourquoi nous avons décidé d’accompagner les TPE et PME avec la même exigence. Être RSSI à temps partagé chez Cybersecura , ce n’est pas juste vendre une offre, c’est être au côté de nos clients avec un accompagnement personnalisé, un service de qualité et une écoute active afin de délivrer des solutions pertinentes avec leurs besoins. Nous nous sommes lancés il y a 10 ans et nous avons conservé l’énergie d’une entreprise qui n’a pas peur d’évoluer chaque jour . Nous recherchons une personne qui a cette envie d'allier exigence et passion et qui se sent prête à co-construire avec nous. Ton rôle et tes missions : En tant que Consultant(e) GRC Cybersécurité, tes missions seront les suivantes : Piloter la sécurité de nos clients de la stratégie à l'exécution. Participer à l’accompagnement de nos clients vers les certifications clés (ISO 27001, SOC 2) en contribuant à la mise en place de leur SMSI. Réaliser des analyses de risques pour identifier les menaces et concevoir des plans d'action adaptés. Rédiger des documents de gouvernance (PSSI, PCA/PRA, PAS). Ton profil : Nous recherchons un profil capable d'allier l'exigence de la sécurité à la réalité métier de nos clients. L'envie d'apprendre et de progresser est primordiale chez Cybersecura ! Tu as 3 ans d’expérience minimum dans le domaine de la GRC ou de l'audit en cybersécurité dans une entreprise similaire à la nôtre ou chez un client final. Tu possèdes un Bac+5 informatique/Sécurité ou une solide expérience professionnelle équivalente. Tes savoir-faire : Cartographie & Architecture : Cartographier un système d’information, analyser des zones de confiance et des flux (TCP/IP, DNS, TLS). Analyse d'architecture : Identifier les données sensibles et les points d’exposition. Analyse de vulnérabilités : Interpréter les rapports de pentest et de scan pour prioriser les actions. Environnements & sécurité technique : Maîtrise des environnements (Active Directory, M365, AWS/Azure, Linux/Windows) et évaluation des mesures de sécurité (MFA, EDR, sauvegardes, pentests). Gestion des risques : Conduite d’analyses de risques et élaboration de plans de traitement adaptés. Normes & Gouvernance : Maîtrise de la norme ISO 27001 et structuration de l'architecture documentaire (PSSI, politiques, procédures). Communication : Capacité à vulgariser des concepts complexes et à interagir avec tous types d'interlocuteurs. Tes savoir-être : Autonomie : Gérer ses missions, anticiper les besoins et proposer des solutions. Rigueur : Adopter une approche méthodique et exigeante pour garantir la qualité. Adaptabilité : Maîtriser rapidement les outils et respecter les procédures internes. Co-construction : Contribuer au développement de l'entreprise. Collaboration : Avoir un esprit d'équipe, faire preuve de bienveillance et d'entraide. Pourquoi rejoindre CyberSecura ? Nous créons la cybersécurité ensemble et en équipe . Un environnement où l'humain, la pédagogie et l'accompagnement sont au centre de nos méthodes. Des possibilités d’évolution tout au long de ton aventure Cybersecura grâce à des feedbacks constructifs et des mobilités internes. Une grande diversité de missions (audit, conseil, rédaction, formation) qui te permet de développer de nouvelles compétences et d’éviter la routine. Des avantages tout au long de l’année : 2 jours de télétravail, ticket restau 7€ avec une prise en charge à 60 % par l’entreprise, des certifications financées après la validation de ta période d’essai. Notre processus de recrutement : Entretien d’une heure avec Sarah (notre Consultant RH) et Soroush (notre Directeur des Opérations) Cas pratique d’une heure maximum Entretien de 40 minutes avec Saghar notre Directrice Générale Tu as envie de relever de nouveaux défis, d’avoir des missions à impact et de participer au développement d’une belle entreprise ? Alors envoie-nous ton CV et explique-nous rapidement ta passion pour la cybersécurité. P.S. Chez CyberSecura, nous privilégions l'authenticité, donc n’hésite pas à nous le montrer à travers ton CV ! Trinzic is the future independent company to be created through the planned spin-off of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, expected in January 2027. Our people work at the frontier of what is possible, delivering solutions in challenging environments and advancing some of the world's highest-priority national security and space missions. Backed by decades of mission success, deep expertise, and trusted partnerships, Trinzic will launch as a global organization with more than 18,000 employees supporting customers around the world. About Us KBR GmbH was established in October 2000 to provide human spaceflight medical support services to the European Space Agency’s (ESA) Space Medicine Team (SMT) at the European Astronaut Center (EAC) in Cologne, Germany. KBR GmbH specializes in the provision of biomedical engineering, space medicine projects including Crew Health and Performance (CHP) technology evaluation, health care administration, psychology, nutrition, medical informatics and technology, fitness and rehabilitation, physiotherapy, and medical education. By developing expertise in these core areas whilst supporting capacity building and broader strategy/risk management, KBR GmbH has expanded to provide support services to a range of customers in aerospace, government and space life science/medical research. Thus, KBR GmbH’s employees contribute to a wide range of projects including astronaut selection and training, ongoing medical operations to the International Space Station and other Low Earth Orbit (LEO) missions, whilst supporting the ESA SMT’s endeavors in preparation for space exploration beyond LEO. The general function of the BME is to ensure astronaut health and well-being by providing medical operational, engineering, and project support to the ESA crew surgeons, the SMT medical project unit, and other ESA human spaceflight mission support disciplines. This includes medical technology development support, document preparation, operational processes development, flight controller training, and console support in the role of EAC Crew Operations Support (ECOS) Flight Controller and/or EUROCOM Flight Controller. As ECOS Flight Controller, the BME ensures the ops preparation and real time implementation of ESA activities assigned to ECOS in the domain of crew support, astronaut training, medical operations and technology testing. As EUROCOM flight controller, the BME is responsible for Crew Communications and Medical Operations. In the EUROCOM role on console, the BME facilitates communication between the ESA Flight Controllers on the ground and the crew on board the ISS and represents the ESA crew’s interest in the ESA Flight Control Team. He/she ensures the implementation of the ESA Flight Program, monitors and annotates biomedical, environmental, and other crew-related data, maintains awareness of ongoing on-orbit operations, and ensures the implementation of the ESA Medical Support Program. A large portion of the job corresponding to flight operations involves responding to new situations as they arise. items.desc: Über thexton armstrong "Wir glauben: Nicht jeder Unternehmer ist ein geborener Entrepreneur. Aber jeder Unternehmer kann einer werden – mit der richtigen Begleitung." thexton armstrong wurde 2011 in den Niederlanden gegründet mit einer klaren Mission: KMU-Inhabern die Unterstützung geben, die sie wirklich brauchen – nicht als externe Berater, die Präsentationen liefern, sondern als Vertrauenspersonen, die langfristig an ihrer Seite bleiben. Heute ist das Netzwerk in 5 Ländern aktiv, zählt über 100 Partner und hat Hunderte von KMU geholfen, profitabler, stabiler und besser managebar zu werden. In Deutschland startete das Franchise Ende 2024 – jetzt kommt Nord- und Ostdeutschland. Als thexton armstrong Partner in Berlin, Hamburg, Hannover, Bremen, Leipzig, Dresden oder einer der anderen Metropolregionen der Region arbeiten Sie mit einem bewährten System, einer anerkannten Marke und einem Netzwerk gleichgesinnter Profis – europaweit. Das Geschäftsmodell Als Franchise Partner gewinnen Sie KMU-Inhaber (5-10 Klienten) als langfristige Mentoring-Mandate. Die Zusammenarbeit läuft über strukturierte KMU-Programme in drei Phasen: Discovery Session – Sie knüpfen eine Verbindung, verstehen die persönliche Motivation des Unternehmers, seine Hoffnungen und Herausforderungen. Profit Leakage Session – Mit dem thexton armstrong Online-Tool identifizieren Sie live, wo und wie viel Profit aus dem Unternehmen fließt. Sofortige, greifbare Erkenntnisse. Proposal Session – Gemeinsam planen Sie die Zusammenarbeit: welches Programm, welche Ziele, welche Schritte. Klienten unterschreiben Verträge mit monatlicher Abrechnung – das schafft planbare, wiederkehrende Einnahmen für Sie und entlastet die Cashflow-Planung des Klienten. Ein typisches Klienten-Portfolio: 5–10 KMU mit Mandatslaufzeiten von 12+ Monaten. Viele Beziehungen dauern mehrere Jahre. Ihre Aufgaben als Franchise Partner Klientenakquisition: Sie identifizieren und gewinnen KMU-Inhaber in Ihrer Region – durch Netzwerkarbeit, Empfehlungen und aktives Outreach. items.desc: Vacancy ID 13045 Download as PDF In the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, researchers from the Social Sciences and Humanities as well as artists explore the relationships between technology, science, and society. The Lab was initiated by The Schaufler Foundation together with TUD Dresden University of Technology. The Lab's guiding theme for the upcoming third funding phase (April 2027–September 2030) is "Energy Cultures in Transition". The guiding theme is investigated from a humanities, cultural, social, and educational science perspective, explored through artistic practice, and communicated to the public. For the third funding phase, the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden comprises eight doctoral fellowships and an annually changing Artist in Residence program. TUD embodies a university culture that is characterized by cosmopolitanism, mutual appreciation, thriving innovation and active participation. For TUD, diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution. The Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden offers, subject to the availability of resources, a Doctoral Fellowship for a period of 2 years, with the option of extension by 1.5 years, starting on April 1, 2027 . The fellowship (EUR 1,850 per month, plus a grant for material costs of EUR 150 and, where applicable, a family supplement of EUR 315 per child) is aimed at early-career researchers in the field of Cultural Studies . Primary supervision will be provided by Prof. Dr. Orit Halpern, Chair of Digital Cultures. The guiding theme Energy Cultures in Transition understands energy as a cultural phenomenon deeply inscribed in aesthetic, historical, political, ecological, economic, and socio-technological practices and systems. Building on the dynamically growing research fields of the Energy Humanities, Science & Technology Studies, and the Digital Humanities, the aim is to examine how modern energy regimes—from petromodernity, to nuclear culture, and post-carbon futures—have shaped not only material infrastructures but also subjectivities, power relations, progress narratives, geopolitical orders, ecologies, and knowledge systems, while simultaneously being shaped by them. Interdisciplinary perspectives from the social sciences, cultural studies, humanities, and educational research represented at the Schaufler Kolleg@TU Dresden enable the analysis of the multifaceted entanglements of energy, culture, and society. The focus is on questions concerning the representation, communication, and aesthetics of energy transitions and resource paradigms as well as continuities between resource economies and information economies, the relationships between energy, labor, environment, and consumer culture, and the role of colonialism, gender, nationalism, geopolitics, education, and social justice in deciding energy futures and navigating collective transformation processes. In the field of Cultural Studies, the following research areas and questions are of particular relevance to the guiding theme: AI and Energy Histories/STS studies of Finance, Digitalization, and Energy Energy Infrastructures Environment, Energy, and Design Cybernetics and Energy Cultures Tasks: Your tasks include independent research and academic further qualification with the goal of completing a doctorate at TUD, as well as writing a dissertation on a topic within the guiding concept "Energy Cultures in Transition" in the discipline of Cultural Studies. The fellowship requires a high degree of willingness to engage in interdisciplinary dialogue, particularly with the STEM partnerships of the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, as well as to conduct joint research with artists within the framework of the Schaufler Residency. In addition, engagement in the areas of science communication and outreach is expected. Shared office spaces will be made available to the fellows. Participation in the Kolleg's English-language training program is mandatory. Requirements: You hold an excellent university degree in Cultural Studies or a comparable field such as Geography, Anthropology or History. We especially welcome studies with global perspectives, particularly from North America, Asia or Africa. You possess strong teamwork skills and a willingness to collaborate across disciplines, and demonstrably excellent English language skills (C1 level minimum). Knowledge of German is desirable but not a requirement. We offer: The opportunity to pursue a doctorate within the Schaufler Kolleg with a structured qualification program and integration into an interdisciplinary research project. You will receive a fully equipped office workspace on the premises of TUD and access to an excellent research infrastructure, including participation in Research Studios and writing retreats. items.desc: Job Description Network Engineer Job Location: Stockholm Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations in Country Req Id: 13203 Posting Start Date: 10/26/26 At Fujitsu, our purpose is to make the world more sustainable by building trust in society through innovation. Founded in Japan in 1935, Fujitsu has been a pioneer in technology and innovation for decades. Today, as a world-leading digital transformation partner, we are committed to transforming business and society in the digital age. With approximately 130,000 employees across over 50 countries, Fujitsu offers a broad range of products, services, and solutions. We collaborate with our customers to co-create solutions that drive enterprise-wide digitalization while actively working to address social issues and contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). About the role: We are looking for a highly skilled Network Engineer with 5+ years of experience who thrives on solving complex network issues and wants to help drive our service delivery to the next level. The position is within our Stockholm-based Network team, part of Hybrid IT Services. This role plays a central part within the team and offers the opportunity to become a trusted network expert across the organization. We are looking for someone, who has a strong background in implementing and developing large-scale network solutions, a solid understanding of network infrastructure fundamentals, and a hands-on approach to network architecture and design. Proficiency in Swedish is a plus, while fluency in English, both written and spoken, is required. We are looking for: Extensive experience operating and troubleshooting enterprise firewalls (Palo Alto, Check Point), along with experience in Cisco, Cisco ISE, and HPE/Aruba troubleshooting, and a solid understanding of best-practice configurations. Deep understanding of routing and switching protocols (OSPF, BGP, VLANs, STP). In-depth knowledge of firewall architectures and technologies (Palo Alto, Juniper, Fortinet/FortiGate). Proficient in implementing VPN solutions (Site-to-Site and GlobalProtect). Skilled in performing packet captures, analyzing traffic flows, and interpreting logs. Proactive, analytical mindset with a strong focus on root-cause analysis. Solid understanding of automation, Ansible/Python, and Linux. Strong team player with excellent communication skills, capable of taking a lead role when needed, and able to remain calm under pressure. Bonus if you have: Experience with monitoring and alerting tools (Zabbix, Prometheus, Op5, Cisco Catalyst Center, etc.). Familiarity with Linux networking tools (tcpdump, traceroute, iptables). Network/security certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, PCNSE, or CCSA/CCSE. In this role, you will: Play a key role in a high-availability environment where your expertise has direct impact. Collaborate in a culture centered on teamwork, continuous learning, and technical excellence. Have opportunities to cross-train in automation, security, and advanced routing. Benefit from flexible working conditions and modern tools to support your work. For the consultant/employee selected for the role, checks of public registers and records relating to financial and legal status will be conducted. By submitting an application, the candidate consents to such checks being carried out. Relocation Supported: No Visa Sponsorship Approved: No At Fujitsu, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process that values the diverse backgrounds and experiences of all applicants. We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

We equip operators with the foundational software to orchestrate their mix of platforms and capabilities, and then take mission-critical decisions faster than their adversaries. We exist to ensure the UK and its allies out-think, out-pace and out-adapt those who seek to threaten our values and way of life. Our technology is designed for deployment in the world’s most austere environments, and is relied upon by the world’s most demanding operators. We deploy alongside them, bringing our technical expertise wherever it is needed. You will join Arondite at a pivotal moment in the company’s journey. We are ambitious, building for the long-term and backed by globally renowned investors including Index Ventures (Anthropic, Wiz, Figma, Revolut). Our company is being built by exceptional engineers - people who find high-impact and technically challenging work engaging and exciting, and who consistently deliver outsized impact. You will collaborate with other brilliant minds to solve some of the world’s hardest and most important problems. You will have ownership and autonomy from Day One. If you are motivated by our mission and if you want to be part of a growing team of outstanding people, then we want to hear from you. About the role Arondite is looking for mission-driven technologists to lead the planning and execution of implementing our technology with customers. You'll be responsible, end-to-end, for making sure we solve customers' real-world problems, from configuring Cobalt in customer environments and integrating with customer hardware and software, to managing edge deployments and cloud infrastructure. You will work closely with users to ensure our systems are deployed effectively, safely, and with maximum operational impact. This role requires significant travel, often in challenging environments, whether in the field alongside users or embedded with teams in military HQs. You will need to be adaptable, resilient, and comfortable working under pressure. You will need to understand both technical systems and operational realities, and be able to quickly navigate new technical domains as required. Your responsibilities will include: Engaging with users to map workflows, pain points, and operational constraints Identifying and framing customer problems that align with our product vision for Cobalt Configuring Cobalt in customer environments and ensuring deployments are reliable, usable, and operationally relevant Integrating with tactical assets, sensors, data feeds, and customer systems in field and HQ environments Utilising edge deployments and cloud infrastructure to deliver capability where users need it Collaborating with customers to prioritise the highest-value problems to solve Designing and guiding iterative delivery plans that alleviate user pain and demonstrate value quickly Acting as the bridge between users, product, and engineering to ensure solutions remain aligned with operational realities Continuously refining priorities with customers to ensure adoption and measurable impact Championing a user-centric approach across the deployment and wider company Deployed work at Arondite All 'deployed' roles at Arondite involve working closely with customers at their UK locations, and when they go abroad. This can mean being away from our office for between 1 and 4 days a week on a regular basis, or going abroad for up to 2 or 3 weeks every few months. As this is a big commitment, we endeavour to maintain flexibility in resourcing to support people's personal circumstances. Requirements Arondite aims to bring together individuals from diverse backgrounds and with different perspectives. We therefore don’t expect people to have experience across every area of the requirements. Please apply even if you only partially fulfil the following lists. In this role, you will help protect cloud infrastructure, strengthen security controls, and ensure business systems remain resilient against emerging cyber threats. You will work closely with cloud engineers, software developers, IT operations, and compliance teams to build secure environments that support business growth. The successful candidate will play a key role in identifying vulnerabilities, implementing cloud security best practices, monitoring potential threats, and improving the organisation's overall security posture. This opportunity is ideal for someone with strong technical knowledge, a proactive approach to risk management, and a genuine interest in developing secure cloud solutions. Key Responsibilities Cloud Infrastructure Security: Design, implement, and maintain security controls across cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. Identity & Access Management: Configure and manage identity policies, role-based access controls, multi-factor authentication, and least-privilege permissions. Threat Monitoring & Detection: Monitor cloud environments for suspicious activity, investigate security alerts, and coordinate responses to potential incidents. Vulnerability Management: Conduct security assessments, identify weaknesses in cloud configurations, and coordinate remediation activities. Security Automation: Develop scripts and automated processes to improve security monitoring, compliance checks, and incident response. Network & Data Protection: Implement cloud network security measures, encryption standards, secure connectivity, and appropriate data protection controls. DevSecOps Integration: Work with development teams to integrate security checks into CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code workflows. Compliance & Governance: Support compliance with relevant security frameworks, internal policies, and data protection requirements through effective documentation and reporting. Incident Response: Investigate security incidents, assist with root-cause analysis, and implement measures to prevent similar issues from recurring. Collaboration & Reporting: Work with technical teams and business stakeholders to communicate security risks, recommend improvements, and maintain clear records of security activities. Requirements & Qualifications Experience: At least 3–5 years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity, infrastructure security, or a related technical role. Cloud Platforms: Practical experience securing AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud environments. Security Fundamentals: Strong understanding of network security, encryption, vulnerability management, identity controls, and security monitoring. Identity Management: Experience with IAM, role-based access control, multi-factor authentication, and privileged access management. Automation & Scripting: Familiarity with Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar scripting tools for security automation. DevSecOps Knowledge: Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, container security, infrastructure as code, and secure software delivery practices. Security Frameworks: Familiarity with standards and guidance such as ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Benchmarks, or the Cloud Security Alliance framework. Analytical Skills: Ability to investigate technical issues, assess security risks, and develop practical remediation plans. Communication: Strong documentation and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical risks to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Qualifications: Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate, CompTIA Security+, or equivalent credentials would be advantageous. Benefits Competitive salary based on experience and technical expertise. Company pension contribution scheme. 25 days of annual leave, plus public holidays. Annual performance-related bonus, subject to company policy. Funding for relevant cybersecurity certifications and professional development. Access to technical training, industry events, and knowledge-sharing opportunities. Private healthcare options and employee wellbeing support, subject to the benefits package. Flexible hybrid working arrangements, depending on team and security requirements. Work Set up This role is based in Liverpool, Merseyside, with a hybrid working arrangement that combines office collaboration with remote work where appropriate. You will work alongside cloud infrastructure, IT operations, and development teams to implement security improvements and maintain reliable cloud services. We use cutting-edge technology, ingenuity and partnerships to identify, analyse and disrupt threats. Working with our intelligence partners MI5 and MI6, we protect the UK from terrorism, cyber-attacks and espionage. At GCHQ youll do varied and fascinating work in a supportive and inclusive environment that puts the emphasis on teamwork. The National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC), part of GCHQ, is the UK Governments lead authority on cyber security. The organisation is at the heart of the Governments cyber security strategy and has the aim of making the UK the safest place to live and work online. Job description This is an exciting opportunity to join NCSCs multidisciplinary User Centred Research and Design (UCRD) team. Strengthening the UKs ability to protect itself against cyber security threats depends on NCSC guidance, tools and services being accessible, usable and trusted by millions of diverse users. Our multidisciplinary User Research and User Experience specialists are critical to the success of these capabilities and work hard to ensure user needs are central to the strategy, design and implementation of capabilities that help to protect people and organisations across all levels of society. Through mixed-method research, iterative testing and evidence-based design approaches, we help shape end-to-end services based on user insight rather than assumption. By identifying risks and validating ideas early, we inform strategy, support teams to make informed delivery decisions, reduce avoidable cost and technical debt, and improve the UKs cyber resilience. We are recruiting for multiple positions within the team, with responsibilities and seniority aligned to the successful candidate's skills, experience and interview outcome. As a User Research or User Experience specialist, you will play a key role in helping the NCSC deliver services, guidance and interventions that protect UK cyber security and improve outcomes for people, organisations and society. Working across a diverse portfolio of projects and services, you will ensure that decisions are informed by a robust understanding of user needs, behaviours and contexts. You will work alongside multidisciplinary delivery teams, applying user-centred approaches to support the development of effective, accessible and inclusive services. You will plan and conduct user research or user experience activities, generate actionable insights, advocate for diverse users and help teams make informed decisions based on evidence rather than assumptions. Senior User Research or User Experience specialists: will lead the delivery of research and design activities across projects, advising teams on appropriate methods and helping colleagues embed user-centred approaches throughout delivery. They will share insights with stakeholders, provide constructive challenge, support decision-making, and contribute to peer review and continuous improvement within the wider User Research and User Experience community. Lead User Research or User Experience specialists: will provide expert strategic advice to multidisciplinary teams and senior stakeholders, shaping requirements, influencing delivery approaches and ensuring user needs are considered from the earliest stages of work. They will apply their specialist expertise to balance user needs, organisational priorities and technical constraints, provide technical leadership and quality assurance across the UCRD capability, mentor and support senior practitioners, and escalate significant risks or blockers where required. Alongside project delivery, you will provide specialist User Research or User Experience consultancy and support to a variety of NCSC initiatives, including large-scale public-facing campaigns that help individuals and organisations stay secure online. You will also have opportunities to collaborate with user-centred specialists across government, contributing to nationally significant services and sharing best practice across the wider profession. As part of a growing team, you will help shape the future of UCRD within the NCSC. You will contribute to the development of our ways of working, support capability growth, and strengthen professional relationships across the government user-centred research and design community to promote …

items.desc:
À propos du rôle 
 Au sein de la practice AI & Data , nous recherchons un(e) AI Engineer / Agentic AI Engineer – Consultant pour piloter la conception et la mise en œuvre de solutions avancées en Intelligence Artificielle, Machine Learning, IA Générative et IA Agentique pour des clients grands comptes.
 Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable de certains streams clés des missions clients, du cadrage des problématiques et de la définition de l’architecture jusqu’au déploiement et à l’adoption. Vous jouerez un rôle de passerelle entre le métier et la technologie, en traduisant les enjeux clients en solutions IA scalables et en orientant les choix d’architecture entre ML, GenAI et approches agentiques.
 Vous ne vous limiterez pas à la construction des solutions, mais contribuerez également à leur définition, leur positionnement et leur adoption. Cela inclut l’animation de discussions techniques, la contribution aux propositions commerciales et le conseil aux parties prenantes sur les approches les plus pertinentes — des applications basées sur des LLM (RAG, copilotes, automatisation) aux systèmes agentiques (architectures multi-agents, workflows augmentés par des outils, processus autonomes).
 En collaboration étroite avec des parties prenantes seniors, des architectes et des équipes transverses, vous occuperez un rôle client-facing avec une autonomie croissante, tout en contribuant au développement d’actifs réutilisables et de bonnes pratiques en GenAI et Agentic AI.
 Responsabilités clés 
 • Piloter la conception, le développement et la validation de modèles de machine learning alignés avec les objectifs métiers, en garantissant scalabilité, robustesse et impact mesurable
• Concevoir et délivrer des solutions d’IA Générative de bout en bout : architectures RAG, stratégies de prompt engineering, applications LLM de niveau entreprise

items.desc: SFEIR est un cabinet d'expertise technologique spécialisé dans la conception, l'architecture et l'industrialisation de solutions numériques sur-mesure. Nous accompagnons les organisations dans leurs transformations les plus complexes en combinant la rigueur du Software Craftsmanship avec la maîtrise des technologies d'avenir. Convaincus que la souveraineté numérique est un enjeu stratégique majeur, nous concevons des architectures sécurisées, performantes et indépendantes, portées par des partenariats solides avec des acteurs clés comme SENS et Scaleway. Acteur de référence sur l'intelligence artificielle, nous faisons évoluer les standards d'ingénierie modernes. À travers notre plateforme GenAI RAISE et notre statut de partenaire Anthropic Preferred (au sein du Claude Partner Network), nous plaçons le Context Engineering et l'IA générative au cœur de nos pratiques. Nos chiffres clés : 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l’IA. 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et en Belgique. Partenaire Anthropic Select au sein du Claude Partner Network. 15 ans de partenariat avec Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, Confluent... +5000 personnes formées par an via le SFEIR Institute. Rejoindre SFEIR, c'est intégrer un collectif où la culture technique prévaut. Nous offrons des trajectoires de carrière dédiées aux experts (Individual Contributor / IC), te permettant de progresser en haute maîtrise technique sans devoir basculer vers du management organisationnel. Nous intégrons l'IA à nos propres pratiques d'ingénierie (utilisation quotidienne de RAISE et Claude Code) pour automatiser les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée et concentrer nos efforts sur la conception d'architectures résilientes. ▪️ À propos du poste Tu conçois et déploies des agents IA et systèmes agentiques complets exécutant des processus métier de bout en bout : support client avancé, recherche multi-sources, opérations IT, ainsi que des cas d'usage avancés liés à l'industrie du futur et à la continuité digitale (ex. traçabilité des exigences, maintenance prédictive, continuité de l'ingénierie et jumeaux numériques). Tu sais aussi bien développer des agents sur-mesure en code que configurer des agents via des plateformes low-code/no-code avec des plateformes type Gemini Enterprise. Ton terrain d'action combine maîtrise technique du cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) et compréhension fonctionnelle fine des enjeux métiers. Tu orchestres l'autonomie des agents, la planification, le choix des outils et la mémoire, tout en garantissant la fiabilité, la gouvernance et le respect des garde-fous. Les missions : Analyser et appréhender les besoins et processus métiers avec une vision fonctionnelle claire pour définir les cas d'usage d'automatisation et la répartition des tâches (autonomie agentique vs validation humaine). Concevoir et développer des systèmes agentiques complets (mono ou multi-agents), en choisissant l'approche adaptée : développement sur-mesure ou programmation/configuration d'agents low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, Vertex AI Agent Builder, AWS). Construire les outils des agents : function calling, intégration d’API et de systèmes d’information, création et consommation de serveurs MCP, workflows asynchrones et longue durée. Maîtriser la fiabilité : gestion des erreurs et des reprises, boucles de contrôle, limites de budget et de pas, comportement face à l’imprévu. Évaluer les agents : jeux de scénarios, analyse des trajectoires, taux de réussite des tâches, LLM-as-judge, tests de non-régression à chaque changement de prompt, d’outil ou de modèle. Observer en production : traces détaillées, coûts par tâche, détection des dérives et des boucles, tableaux de bord. Sécuriser l’autonomie : permissions minimales sur les outils, protection contre la prompt injection, isolation des actions sensibles, validation humaine, traçabilité, conformité (RGPD, AI Act). S'intégrer dans le cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) complet et déployer sur le cloud (Google Cloud / Vertex AI) avec intégration CI/CD et gestion des coûts. Partager : documenter les patterns, former les équipes clientes, contribuer aux publications et événements SFEIR. ▪️ Le profil idéal 5 ans d’expérience en développement logiciel (hors stage et alternance) avec une vision transverse du SDLC et une première expérience solide sur des projets LLM / IA Pratique démontrée de la création d'agents IA : développement custom (frameworks/code) ou création via des environnements low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, AWS,...) Connaissance de MCP et des protocoles d’interopérabilité entre agents (A2A) Compréhension fine des modes d’échec des agents : dérive, boucles, mauvais choix d’outil, perte de contexte Solide maîtrise des API, de l’asynchrone et des architectures événementielles Rigueur d’ingénierie : tests, observabilité, code relu Aisance relationnelle et bon niveau fonctionnel pour échanger avec les équipes métiers, comprendre leurs enjeux et leur expliquer les possibilités et limites …
