items.desc: ¿Quiénes somos? Somos una compañía tecnológica especializada en Inteligencia Artificial , IA Generativa, Analytics, Gobierno del Dato, Cloud y arquitecturas Event Driven, pero sobre todo somos un equipo con conocimiento, criterio y muchas ganas de hacer las cosas bien. Trabajamos con talento altamente especializado, esté donde esté, y apostamos por una forma de crecer basada en la confianza, la autonomía y la participación. Nos mueve la excelencia tecnológica , la orientación a negocio y el sentido común, pero también el entusiasmo, la creatividad y la convicción de que la tecnología necesita alma, propósito y personas capaces de convertir la complejidad en soluciones reales. ¿Qué buscamos? Buscamos a un/a IA Engineer con 3-4 años de experiencia profesional que haya podido trabajar con IA Generativa en proyectos reales durante mínimo 6 meses . Te formarás tanto en la construcción de agentes, como del desarrollo asistido con IA, potenciando tus capacidades y convirtiéndote en un integrante del equipo multidisciplinar de aceleración de IA dentro de Mática. Experiencia sólida en Python para el desarrollo de aplicaciones de IA. Experiencia en integración de LLMs vía API (OpenAI, Azure OpenAi, Gemini…etc.) Conocimiento en LangChain y/o LangGraph. Se valorará diseño de agentes LLM y flujos multiagente. Diseño e implementación de sistemas RAG. Uso de embeddings, vector databases y búsqueda semántica. Experiencia en la evaluación de respuestas de modelos (calidad, precisión, alucinaciones) Buen nivel de inglés , tanto oral como escrito. ¿Cómo será tu día a día? Te encargarás de la creación y optimización de prompts y agentes, así como de la integración de LLMs en aplicaciones reales. Colaborarás con equipo interno y de cliente para construir aplicaciones escalables, seguras y alineadas con las necesidades del negocio. Mejorarás la fiabilidad, escalabilidad y observabilidad de las soluciones en producción, incorporando buenas prácticas de ingeniería de software aplicadas a LLMs. Tendrás autonomía para investigar tecnologías emergentes. ¿Qué ofrecemos? Pertenecer a una empresa a la vanguardia tecnológica y centrado en las Personas , ponemos al trabajador en el centro de todo lo que hacemos. Creemos en una cultura horizontal, sin egos, en un entorno donde se valoran tanto las ideas como las personas. Contrato indefinido y salario de entre 38.000 y 44.000 euros brutos/año de entrada , ajustado según tu experiencia. También tendrás a tu disposición un plan de formación especializado, participación en la propiedad y los beneficios de Mática: Wetaca gratuito en la oficina dos días a la semana, horario flexible con facilidades para trabajar desde donde quieras, seguro de salud, retribución flexible con Cobee, además de las vacaciones habituales, ofrecemos una semana extra en Navidad y tres días adicionales en Semana Santa. También recibirás un divertido Welcome Kit con portátil (podrás escoger entre varios modelos Mac o Windows), móvil, botella personalizada, auriculares bluetooth y golosinas. Cuando estés en nuestra oficina, en el centro de Barcelona o Madrid , la fruta, los cafés y los refrescos corren a cuenta de Mática. ¡Ah! Y si eres amante de los animales, te gustará saber esto: ¡nuestras oficinas son Pet-friendly ! Si te interesa, escríbenos por LinkedIn o envía tu CV a seleccion@maticapartners.com Do you want to be Mática? Be Mática!

items.card: You will design, build and deploy AI agents and automations that make a real difference to how we work. Across our organisation, too much time still goes on work that is manual, repetitive or slow. As our AI Automation Intern, you will find the workflows where AI can make the biggest difference, then build practical AI agents, automations and integrations that people use every day. Working with Python, LLMs, APIs
items.desc: The TLC Group ethos is people come first. We have an impressive track record of delivering high quality services, and we expect our team members to give their best and strive for continuous improvement in everything we do. You will design, build and deploy AI agents and automations that make a real difference to how we work. Across our organisation, too much time still goes on work that is manual, repetitive or slow. As our AI Automation Intern, you will find the workflows where AI can make the biggest difference, then build practical AI agents, automations and integrations that people use every day. Working with Python, LLMs, APIs and databases, you will take ideas from prototype to production and show the measurable impact they have. This is not a theoretical research project. It is a hands-on build role, focused on real deployment in a live organisation. About TLC Group. Our Support Office provides the central People, Finance, Operations and Marketing services that keep our organisation running smoothly. We hold Investors in People Platinum because we invest meaningfully in our team members, and our values of Truth, Love and Compassion run through everything we do. We believe digital readiness and the confident use of AI are essential to our future, and this role sits at the heart of that ambition, helping our teams to work smarter and spend more time on the work that matters most. The Role. You will work across the business to understand how current workflows operate, identify high-value opportunities for AI and automation, and design, build and test solutions with the people who will use them. Examples could include AI agents that handle administrative workflows end to end; automations that connect our systems through APIs and remove manual data entry; retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) assistants that give teams fast, accurate answers from our policies, procedures and knowledge bases; tools that pull, clean and report on data from our databases; and LLM-powered agents that help teams draft documents, correspondence and marketing content. What You Will Be Doing. Spending time with teams across the business to understand how work gets done and where the inefficiencies are. Identifying tasks that can be automated or significantly improved with AI, and prioritising those with the greatest value. Designing and building AI agents and automations in Python, using LLMs and agent-based workflows to complete multi-step tasks. Integrating with internal and third-party systems through APIs, and reading from and writing to databases to keep information accurate and connected. Building RAG pipelines that ground LLM responses in our own documents and data, with a focus on accuracy and reliability. Managing your code with version control in GitHub, using branches, pull requests and clear documentation so your work can be reviewed, maintained and built upon. Testing your solutions with real users, gathering feedback and improving them quickly. Making sure everything you build handles personal and sensitive information safely and in line with data protection requirements. Measuring and reporting the impact of your work, such as time saved, faster turnaround and improved consistency or quality. What Success Looks Like. By the end of your placement, you will have delivered several working AI agents or automations, reduced manual effort in important workflows, improved speed, consistency or quality for our teams, built solutions that can be scaled across the business, and demonstrated clear, practical impact from your work. What We Are Looking For. Hands-on experience of building AI agents, automations or workflow tools, whether through study, side projects, hackathons or work. Strong Python skills. A good understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering and agent-based workflows. Experience of working with APIs, including REST APIs and JSON. Working knowledge of databases and SQL. Familiarity with RAG, including embeddings and vector search. Confident use of version control with Git and GitHub. Strong problem-solving skills and a practical, delivery-focused mindset, with the ability to work independently and take ownership. Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain technical ideas simply to colleagues who are not technical. Experience with automation and orchestration tools or agent frameworks, cloud platforms, an awareness of data protection and GDPR, and examples of prototypes or projects you have already shipped are all desirable. We care more about what you have built than your formal experience. All appointments are subject to a satisfactory DBS check, references and evidence of the legal right to work in the UK. Key Skills. AI Agents, LLMs, RAG, Python, APIs, Databases, Automation and Version Control (GitHub). Personal Qualities. You are values-led and role model Truth, Love and Compassion in everything you do. You are curious, resourceful and quick to learn, and you enjoy turning ideas into working …

items.card: you will be responsible for transforming massive, high-frequency streams of vehicle sensor observations into highly accurate, dynamic map features that the vehicle can use for localization, routing, and advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS). You will apply advanced computational statistics, machine learning, and spatial analysis to process and model large datasets, drawing actionable insights that translate raw
items.desc: Unikie is seeking a Geospatial Data Science Engineer to pioneer the data layer powering our next-generation software-defined electric vehicles. In this senior role, you will be responsible for transforming massive, high-frequency streams of vehicle sensor observations into highly accurate, dynamic map features that the vehicle can use for localization, routing, and advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS). You will apply advanced computational statistics, machine learning, and spatial analysis to process and model large datasets, drawing actionable insights that translate raw fleet telemetry into live, high-definition maps. We value proactive problem-solvers who thrive in autonomous roles and are passionate about building performant, scalable systems at the intersection of data science and robotics. Responsibilities Geospatial Pipeline Engineering: Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines that ingest, clean, and segment billions of daily vehicle sensor observations into consumable map features and geometries. Statistical Modeling & Insights: Apply advanced data mining and analytic methods to detect real-world changes (e.g., road closures, new lanes, construction) and design rigorous statistical tests to validate map accuracy. Map Generation & Map Matching: Develop robust algorithms for map matching, trajectory smoothing, and sensor fusion to convert noisy probe data into high-fidelity road geometry and attributes. System Design & Architecture: Lead the technical design of spatial data systems, ensuring low-latency query performance, efficient spatial indexing (e.g., H3, S2), and scalable storage of vector/raster map data. Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with embedded software engineers, perception teams, and cloud architects to align onboard vehicle capabilities with cloud-based mapping platforms. Staying Ahead of the Curve: Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in big data technologies, computational statistics, machine learning, and automated mapping practices. Skills Required Python SQL SLAM LiDAR Sensor Fusion PostGIS GCP Point Clouds Data Engineering MATLAB Machine Learning Data Science Shell Scripting Big Data QGIS Data Clustering Robotics Statistics System Design Bayesian inference Locations Tallinn Helsinki Szczecin Qualifications Minimum Qualifications: Education: Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Geoinformatics, Robotics, or a related quantitative field with an emphasis or thesis work on computational statistics, data mining, machine learning, or spatial optimization. Experience: 8+ years of related professional experience building and maintaining large-scale data processing and predictive systems. Advanced Analytics & Data Mining: Expert-level knowledge in data mining and analytic methods such as regression, classifiers, clustering, association rules, decision trees, and Bayesian network analysis. Geospatial Expertise: Proven experience working with geospatial data, handling noisy time-series datasets, writing advanced spatial queries in PostGIS, and utilizing spatial libraries/indexing systems (e.g., H3, S2, GeoPandas). Programming & Scripting: Proficiency with statistical analysis packages and programming languages, including Python, SQL, and shell scripting (or familiarity with R/MATLAB). Statistical Testing: Strong statistical foundation with proven expertise in designing, executing, and analyzing complex data tests and validation methodologies. Preferred Qualifications Crowdsourced Mapping: Experience with fleet-based, crowdsourced map generation methodologies, including probe-data aggregation, change detection, and incremental map updates. Cloud Ecosystems: Experience deploying large-scale geospatial pipelines and machine learning workloads within cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Databricks). Open-Source Infrastructure: Experience with standard open-source vector tile formats, tools like Martin, QGIS, and geospatial processing engines (GDAL/OGR, GEOS). Automotive Map Formats: Familiarity with automotive map standards, routing schemas, and data structures such as NDS (Navigation Data Standard), OpenStreetMap (OSM), and Lanelet2/HD Maps. Robotics Algorithms: Familiarity with core robotics concepts, including SLAM (Simultaneous Localization & Mapping), Sensor Fusion, and Point Cloud / Sensor Processing (LiDAR, radar, vision). This is an initial six-month contract, with the possibility of extending the assignment. WHY JOIN UNIKIE? We are dedicated partner for global players in our segments – Unikie supplies technology solutions and services to several global Fortune 500 companies in EMEA and America. As a responsible and competent partner, we have access to some of the most interesting projects. Technology we create enables our clients to become digital leaders in their own industries. We cherish transparency and do our best that it shows up in as many processes as possible. One example of this is our salary model. We have top-notch …

In this role, you will design, build, and run production-grade AI applications powered by large language models, agentic AI, RAG, and multimodal technologies. You will work across the full engineering lifecycle: from architecture and backend development to cloud deployment and continuous improvement and help shape AI solutions used by leading Swiss companies across different industries. You will be part of a small, experienced team where you can take real ownership, work directly on customer-facing products, and turn the latest advances in AI into reliable applications used in the real world. About ParetoLabs ParetoLabs is a Zurich-based AI software company building customized AI applications for conversation, knowledge, and process automation. We develop solutions ranging from intelligent assistants and enterprise search to agentic AI and next-generation voice applications. Since 2023, we have been combining cutting-edge AI technologies with the security, reliability, and integration requirements of Swiss companies. As a Microsoft for Startups partner, we work closely with our customers to bring AI solutions from idea to production. Aufgaben Design, build, and continuously improve production-grade AI applications powered by LLMs, RAG, agentic workflows, and multimodal AI. Develop robust Python backend services, APIs, and integrations that connect AI capabilities with enterprise systems and data sources. Build intelligent agents and end-to-end AI workflows capable of reasoning, using tools, interacting with APIs, and automating complex user requests. Take ownership of bringing AI solutions into production, including testing, deployment, monitoring, observability, and continuous optimization. Design scalable and reliable cloud architectures and contribute to the evolution of our shared AI platform and engineering standards. Evaluate and integrate new models, frameworks, and AI technologies where they create real value for our products and customers. Collaborate closely with other engineers, product teams, and customers to turn complex requirements into practical AI solutions. Share your knowledge within our international team and, depending on your experience, mentor other engineers. Take real ownership and bring your own ideas into products that are used by leading companies in Switzerland. Qualifikation Educational Background: A solid foundation in computer science. Proven Experience: Extensive experience as a full-stack developer with a strong focus on backend technologies (Python preferred) and familiarity with front-end frameworks (React, Angular). DevOps Proficiency: Expertise in Shell Scripting, CI/CD pipelines, Cloud services (AWS, Azure), Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), Server Provisioning, and Monitoring & Alerting techniques. Technical Skills: A good understanding of networking, databases, backup strategies, and disaster recovery scenarios to support robust and scalable applications. Team Player: An open-minded, solution-oriented team player who thrives in collaborative environments. Communication Skills: Excellent communication skills in English or German. Capable of interacting effectively with clients and team members alike. Benefits Competitive Remuneration: A competitive salary package reflecting your experience and contributions. Employee Participation: Opportunity to participate in the long-term success and growth of ParetoLabs through our employee participation program. Pick Your Gear: Choose your preferred devices for work. Attractive Benefits: Above-market pension benefits and private accident insurance. Professional Growth: Participation in the Microsoft for Startups program, providing access to valuable resources, events, and support. If you're a ( Senior) AI Engineer and a desire to impact the AI application landscape, we invite you to apply to ParetoLabs . Please send your resume and portfolio showcasing your relevant experience (GitHub links preferred). Join us in our mission to deliver cutting-edge AI solutions and shape the future of technology across industries!

items.desc: Dans le cadre de nouveaux projets dans le secteur du Véhicule Industriel, vous prenez en charge les projets de développement des fonctionnalités du véhicule (processeur central qui gère toutes les fonctions intérieures du véhicule (écrans du tableau de bord, système d'infodivertissement, affichage tête haute, etc., et Boîtier télématique ), de la définition des exigences pour l'interface homme machine, jusqu'à la sécurisation de l'intégration des développements dans la plate-forme électronique, en passant par le suivi des tests de fonctionnalités. Vous prenez en charge la coordination technique du développement pour les fonctions impactées (télématique, infodivertissement, lumière, climatisation....). Vous définissez les exigences et les méthodes de vérification afin de valider le niveau de fonctionnalité convenu par la Direction produit. Vous suivez les développements liés aux fonctions ( les demandes de fonctionnalités, les demandes de changement), suivez les essais. Vous accompagnez l’industrialisation avec les équipes de production, de la phase prototype jusqu’au lancement de la production. Vous gérez les activités d’intégration logicielle impliquant équipes de développement et sous-traitants, incluant des routines et des scripts d’automatisation permettant d’assembler le progiciel final contenant toutes les applications validées, et supervisez les tests d'intégration système. Vous produisez la documentation technique (tutoriels et guides), conformes à la norme ASPICE. Vous planifiez les campagnes de mise à jour FOTA. Vous communiquez sur l'avancement du projet, retards, problèmes, fournir des rapports d'état d'avancement et des indicateurs de performance (KPI). De formation Ingénieur Electronique embarquée, Systèmes embarqués, vous justifiez d’une expérience similaire de 5 ans minimum, sur un poste en développement et intégration de solutions ou de produits, de préférence dans le secteur automobile ou du véhicule industriel. Vous avez développé des compétences et une expérience en électronique et logiciel, en gestion des exigences. Vous avez géré l'intégration de systèmes logiciels complexes pour des plateformes embarquées automobiles, notamment des unités de contrôle électronique (ECU) télématiques. Vous avez acquis des compétences avancées en scripting shell Linux pour l'automatisation, le débogage et les tâches d'intégration. Vous maîtrisez les mises à jour logicielles FOTA (Firmware Over-The-Air), les frameworks OTA et les outils d’orchestration des mises à jour. Vous connaissez l’architecture PCM (Powertrain Control Module) et les protocoles télématiques, les plateformes cloud (AWS) pour le déploiement et le suivi des campagnes de mise à jour. Vous connaissez ASPICE (qualité) et les normes ISO 26262 (sécurité fonctionnelle) et ISO/SAE 21434 (cybersécurité). Vous parlez anglais couramment. items.desc: Qui sommes-nous ? Au sein d'ALKERA SAS, structure de tête de notre groupe, la Direction des Opérations du Groupe renforce ses équipes et recrute un Data Analyst (H/F). La Direction des Opérations du Groupe composée d'environ 130 personnes gère 3 entités opérationnelles dont 2 liées à Polyexpert France, filiale spécialisée dans l'expertise de Dommages aux biens et 1 équipe de renfort administratif. La Direction des Opérations du Groupe a un rôle de chef d'orchestre qui doit s'assurer que la symphonie opérationnelle soit la plus juste possible. Outre la gestion de ses entités opérationnelles, les activités de la Direction des Opérations du Groupe reposent sur 5 piliers vis-à-vis des filiales du groupe : le suivi opérationnel, la gestion de la qualité, la gestion des projets métiers en lien avec notre DSI, la gestion de la relation client et l'expérience clients. Le poste est rattaché au Directeur des Opérations du Groupe. Vous rejoindrez une équipe dynamique et enthousiaste. Descriptif du poste Au sein de la Direction des Opérations du Groupe, vous serez amené à : Concevoir des outils de pilotage Maintenir et faire évoluer les outils de pilotage existant Editer et mettre en forme les données de pilotage de nos différents clients Préparer les supports de Comité de Pilotage de nos différents clients (plusieurs par mois) Concevoir, implémenter et développer des tableaux de bord, des reportings de performance, d'analyse de données ou de visualisations de données (Power BI, Tableau...) Rencontrer les parties prenantes de l'entreprise pour recenser les besoins Accompagner nos différentes filiales et nos clients sur leurs différents besoins de traitement de données, d'analyses et de mise en place de reporting Comprendre, recueillir et analyser les besoins des clients Echanger avec les clients pour analyser les mesures de performance Vos compétences : Vous avez un niveau avancé sur Excel, vous savez également coder des macros simples en VBA voire en Python Vous maîtrisez le langage de programmation Dax (PowerBI) et éventuellement celui de requête de bases de données : SQL Vous maîtrisez au moins un outil avancé de visualisation de données, de préférence Power BI Vous êtes reconnu pour votre esprit analytique, structuré et rigoureux Vous êtes organisé, curieux, autonome avec une bonne expression écrite et une aisance relationnelle Vous êtes impliqué et dynamique, vous appréciez évoluer dans un environnement dynamique Vous avez le sens du client, le souci du détail et un " sens " de la donnée Profil recherché De formation Bac +5, école d'ingénieur, école de commerce et / ou universitaire (data science, gestion de projets, système d'informations, etc.) Vous justifiez de 4 à 5 ans d'expérience, de préférence dans le secteur de l'assurance ou de l'expertise en assurance, Au moins une expérience prouvée dans l'univers de la Data Analyse, l'utilisation d'outils d'analyse de données et la préparation de supports de comité de pilotage.

items.desc: You're not managing implementations, you're building how enterprise procurement actually works. As Implementation & Success Consultant, you own the full journey: from first kick-off to production rollout to long-term success. You translate what customers need into what the product delivers. Tasks Own end-to-end enterprise implementations from kick-off to go-live — on time, on scope, on quality Translate complex customer requirements into scalable solution designs and structured rollout plans Become a product expert and train customers to integrate Prospeum into their operational and strategic procurement processes Act as the central project owner and trusted advisor throughout the customer relationship Drive customer retention and identify expansion opportunities in close collaboration with sales Coordinate across Product, Engineering, and Leadership to unblock delivery Manage risks, escalations, and stakeholder communication proactively — not reactively Turn customer feedback and usage patterns into concrete product improvement proposals Build standardized implementation playbooks that make every rollout faster than the last Requirements Entrepreneurial mindset: you thrive when building from scratch, not when following a manual 3–5 years of experience in software/SaaS implementation, customer success, or consulting Ambitious and ownership-driven: you want to shape a function, not just fill a role Background in startups, enterprise software, or consultancies: ideally with procurement or supply chain exposure Strong project management instincts: timelines, stakeholders, dependencies Comfortable with enterprise architectures, integrations, and system landscapes at a conceptual level Technical curiosity: you don't need to code, but APIs, data models, and JSON shouldn't intimidate you Confident communicating with C-level stakeholders and managing expectations clearly Fluent German and strong English Benefits Hybrid work: 3 days in the office, 2 from home. Competitive salary with performance-based bonus tied to customer success Direct impact: with 60+ enterprise customers, your work shapes how major organizations run procurement Annual development budget for courses, conferences, and certifications Small team, short paths: you'll work directly with the founders and engineering AI-native product: you'll be implementing cutting-edge procurement intelligence, not legacy software Why Join Prospeum? items.desc: About Maritime Ventures Maritime Ventures is a venture builder supported by CDP Venture Capital, together with leading industrial, financial, and innovation players from Italy and Germany. Our mission is to launch 10 high-impact startups to drive the digital and sustainable transformation of the maritime industry. Backed by key partners like Fincantieri, PSA Italy and Intesa Sanpaolo, among others, we provide a unique ecosystem where experienced founders, technologists, and operators collaborate to turn bold ideas into scalable companies. We are continuously looking for Entrepreneurs in Residence who aspire to become CEO and co-founder of one of the startups emerging from Maritime Ventures’ venture building pipeline. Selected candidates will receive further information about the programme structure, participation requirements and next steps before making any commitment.

items.card: you will be responsible for transforming massive, high-frequency streams of vehicle sensor observations into highly accurate, dynamic map features that the vehicle can use for localization, routing, and advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS). You will apply advanced computational statistics, machine learning, and spatial analysis to process and model large datasets, drawing actionable insights that translate raw
items.desc: Unikie is seeking a Geospatial Data Science Engineer to pioneer the data layer powering our next-generation software-defined electric vehicles. In this senior role, you will be responsible for transforming massive, high-frequency streams of vehicle sensor observations into highly accurate, dynamic map features that the vehicle can use for localization, routing, and advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS). You will apply advanced computational statistics, machine learning, and spatial analysis to process and model large datasets, drawing actionable insights that translate raw fleet telemetry into live, high-definition maps. We value proactive problem-solvers who thrive in autonomous roles and are passionate about building performant, scalable systems at the intersection of data science and robotics. Responsibilities Geospatial Pipeline Engineering: Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines that ingest, clean, and segment billions of daily vehicle sensor observations into consumable map features and geometries. Statistical Modeling & Insights: Apply advanced data mining and analytic methods to detect real-world changes (e.g., road closures, new lanes, construction) and design rigorous statistical tests to validate map accuracy. Map Generation & Map Matching: Develop robust algorithms for map matching, trajectory smoothing, and sensor fusion to convert noisy probe data into high-fidelity road geometry and attributes. System Design & Architecture: Lead the technical design of spatial data systems, ensuring low-latency query performance, efficient spatial indexing (e.g., H3, S2), and scalable storage of vector/raster map data. Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with embedded software engineers, perception teams, and cloud architects to align onboard vehicle capabilities with cloud-based mapping platforms. Staying Ahead of the Curve: Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in big data technologies, computational statistics, machine learning, and automated mapping practices. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications: Education: Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Geoinformatics, Robotics, or a related quantitative field with an emphasis or thesis work on computational statistics, data mining, machine learning, or spatial optimization. Experience: 8+ years of related professional experience building and maintaining large-scale data processing and predictive systems. Advanced Analytics & Data Mining: Expert-level knowledge in data mining and analytic methods such as regression, classifiers, clustering, association rules, decision trees, and Bayesian network analysis. Geospatial Expertise: Proven experience working with geospatial data, handling noisy time-series datasets, writing advanced spatial queries in PostGIS, and utilizing spatial libraries/indexing systems (e.g., H3, S2, GeoPandas). Programming & Scripting: Proficiency with statistical analysis packages and programming languages, including Python, SQL, and shell scripting (or familiarity with R/MATLAB). Statistical Testing: Strong statistical foundation with proven expertise in designing, executing, and analyzing complex data tests and validation methodologies. Preferred Qualifications Crowdsourced Mapping: Experience with fleet-based, crowdsourced map generation methodologies, including probe-data aggregation, change detection, and incremental map updates. Cloud Ecosystems: Experience deploying large-scale geospatial pipelines and machine learning workloads within cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Databricks). Open-Source Infrastructure: Experience with standard open-source vector tile formats, tools like Martin, QGIS, and geospatial processing engines (GDAL/OGR, GEOS). Automotive Map Formats: Familiarity with automotive map standards, routing schemas, and data structures such as NDS (Navigation Data Standard), OpenStreetMap (OSM), and Lanelet2/HD Maps. Robotics Algorithms: Familiarity with core robotics concepts, including SLAM (Simultaneous Localization & Mapping), Sensor Fusion, and Point Cloud / Sensor Processing (LiDAR, radar, vision). This is an initial six-month contract, with the possibility of extending the assignment.

items.desc: Job Description onsemi is seeking a highly motivated System Validation Engineer to join our growing System Validation team in Limerick. The successful candidate will play a key role in validating next-generation power management solutions, including multiphase digital controllers, Smart Power Stages (SPS), SmartFET, eFuse, Gate Driver devices, and associated power-delivery systems. Working as part of a cross-functional product development team, you will be responsible for developing validation strategies, executing system-level testing, identifying root causes of complex issues, and ensuring products meet all functional, performance, reliability, and customer requirements. This position offers the opportunity to work directly with cutting-edge power solutions used in Automotive, AI, server, cloud computing, CPU, and GPU applications. The role aligns with internal System Validation activities covering validation planning, pre silicon validation execution, board bring-up, characterization, automation, and silicon readiness. Responsibilities Develop and execute comprehensive system validation plans covering functional, electrical, system, reliability, and application-level requirements. Design and implement validation methodologies, measurement techniques, and test systems for new product development. Perform hands-on laboratory validation, characterization, and debug of silicon and system platforms. Develop automated test solutions using Python, LabVIEW, or similar software tools. Create validation hardware, test fixtures, and supporting circuitry as required. Validate product functionality, protection features, telemetry, comms interfaces, power sequencing, fault handling, and system performance. Execute electrical characterization across operating conditions including voltage, load, temperature, and transient scenarios. Analyze validation data, identify root causes, and work closely with Design, Product Engineering, Applications, Firmware, and ATE teams to resolve issues. Support silicon bring-up activities and contribute to release to market readiness. Document validation results, generate technical reports, and present findings to project teams and management. Support continuous improvement of validation methodologies, test automation frameworks, and best practices. Qualifications Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Electronic Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline. 8–12 years of relevant industry experience in semiconductor, power electronics, system validation, or hardware development. Strong understanding of analog and digital circuit fundamentals. Experience using laboratory equipment such as: Oscilloscopes, Electronic loads, Logic analyzers, Signal and spectrum analyzers. Experience troubleshooting complex hardware and silicon-related issues. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively within cross-functional global teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience in one or more of the following areas would be highly beneficial: System-level validation of: Multiphase power controllers Digital VR controllers Smart Power Stages (SPS) POL (Point-of-Load) regulators PMIC products Power conversion topologies including Buck, Multiphase Buck, and TLVR architectures. Validation of CPU/GPU power delivery solutions. Functional Safety, ISO 26262, ISO 21780, SiC/GaN. AI-assisted validation experience. Test automation using Python, LabVIEW, C/C++, or similar languages. FPGA-based validation and emulation. Familiarity with Jama, Jira, and Confluence. PCB design and schematic review experience. Validation planning, compliance testing, characterization, and correlation methodologies. About Us onsemi (Nasdaq: ON) is driving disruptive innovations to help build a better future. With a focus on automotive and industrial end-markets, the company is accelerating change in megatrends such as vehicle electrification and safety, sustainable energy grids, industrial automation, and 5G and cloud infrastructure. With a highly differentiated and innovative product portfolio, onsemi creates intelligent power and sensing technologies that solve the world’s most complex challenges and leads the way in creating a safer, cleaner, and smarter world. More details about our company benefits can be found here: https://www.onsemi.com/careers/career-benefits About The Team We are committed to sourcing, attracting, and hiring high-performance innovators, while providing all candidates a positive recruitment experience that builds our brand as a great place to work.

items.title: Smart Manufacturing Engineer, SW & Electronics
items.card: you will help ensure our satellites can be tested reliably and efficiently before they are launched to space. You will design and own Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE) and satellite‑level test systems that combine electronics, embedded software and automation. Your work will directly support AIT and Production teams, keeping critical test setups running while building the next generation of EGSEs to scale
items.desc: Role Highlights Smart Manufacturing Engineer, SW & Electronics Location: Espoo, Finland Department: Global Manufacturing Organization Reports to: Smart Manufacturing, Team Leader Employment type: Permanent Workplace model: Hybrid Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required) Why This Role Matters As a Smart Manufacturing Engineer, SW & Electronics, you will help ensure our satellites can be tested reliably and efficiently before they are launched to space. You will design and own Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE) and satellite‑level test systems that combine electronics, embedded software and automation. Your work will directly support AIT and Production teams, keeping critical test setups running while building the next generation of EGSEs to scale ICEYE’s manufacturing. Who We Are ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE’s world-leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world’s largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy – day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits. As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE’s near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. Designed for dual use, the platform also serves civil protection and commercial users for natural-catastrophe intelligence, insurance, maritime monitoring (including oil-spill detection), and finance, contributing to global security and community resilience. ICEYE is headquartered in Finland and operates globally across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We have more than 900 employees, united by a shared vision: improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation. Your Day-to-day Responsibilities Support AIT and Production teams in running and troubleshooting RF, electronics and satellite‑level test setups, especially in your first months. Design, develop and maintain EGSE systems that combine electronics, embedded software and Python-based test automation. Capture requirements and define architectures for new test systems together with AIT Engineering, Production and other Engineering teams. Implement and debug embedded C/C++ code on ARM‑based MCUs (e.g. STM32, TI), including bring‑up, interface control and communication with instruments. Design or adapt electronics for EGSE (schematics, interfaces, power, measurement paths) and work with mechanical engineers on the overall solution. Use Python and tools like PyVISA to automate instruments, collect data and improve test workflows. Write clear, maintainable documentation and user guides so others can operate and maintain the systems you build. Contribute to improving existing legacy test setups, increasing reliability, repeatability and ease of use. Collaborate closely with other Smart Manufacturing engineers (mechanical, electronics, software) and share knowledge within the team. Must Haves What we’re looking for 5+ years of experience in electronics / embedded systems / test development, ideally in complex or high‑reliability products. Hands‑on experience with ARM‑based MCUs (e.g. STM32 or TI), including embedded C/C++ development and debugging. Practical experience designing or modifying electronics for test or control (schematics, interfaces, power, signal integrity basics). Strong Python skills for test automation, scripting and instrument control (e.g. PyVISA or similar). Familiarity with Altium Designer (or similar) for PCB design Comfortable using common lab and RF test equipment such as oscilloscopes, PSUs, multimeters, power loads, VNAs and spectrum analyzers. Ability to work onsite in Espoo in labs and production areas, including hands‑on support when issues arise. Strong communication and documentation skills, and a collaborative mindset Experience with satellite or spacecraft EGSE, nanosatellites or other space/aerospace test systems. Nice To Haves Exposure to RF test setups (antennas, payloads, RF front‑ends) beyond the basic use of the instruments. Experience in automation, robotics or similar domains where HW+FW+SW test systems are common. Familiarity with KiCad, STM32CubeIDE, GCC/GDB or similar toolchains. Experience developing and standardizing test setups, including documentation and process improvements. Application Process TA screen Hiring manager interview Technical interview + take‑home task Final onsite interviews Working at ICEYE At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the …

items.desc: About The Role Backend Engineer Location: Mendrisio, Switzerland Please note, this position is based in our Swiss HQ in Mendrisio, Switzerland, which is 7km over the border from Italy and easily commutable from Milan, Como, Varese or Lugano. We are also happy to assist with your relocation to this beautiful part of Europe and we have a hybrid remote working policy. Your Role We’re looking for a Backend Engineer to help us take our product to the next level. This position will take end-to-end ownership of product and feature delivery, from system design and backend architecture to integration with our infrastructure, observability of what gets shipped, and the best practices that keep the team moving fast and sustainably. You'll also help shape how we integrate AI into our workflow and products, both as a tool that makes the team more effective, and as a capability we build for our users. Key Responsibilities Play a key role in QA’s shift to an AI-first ecosystem Be able to produce well-structured, maintainable, idiomatic code with good documentation; unit tests for every feature, bug fixing, and code reviews. Collaborate on a cross-functional team, including front-end developers, UI/UX designers and product managers, to quickly deliver new features. Work closely with the SRE Team to ensure smooth deployments, ensuring that errors are logged with enough info to debug effectively. Contribute to the Backend Chapter, participating in technical discussions and cross-team activities Your Experience Effective use of AI tools in the development workflow (IDE-integrated assistants, chat-based tools) with strong critical thinking: ability to review, challenge, and validate AI-generated code, craft effective prompts, and still reason independently about algorithms, requirements, and trade-offs Solid experience in coding with backend programming languages. Experience with Kotlin and/or Python is an advantage Solid experience with relational databases and with other types of databases: PostgreSQL and Redis are an advantage Advanced knowledge and experience on modern web patterns: RESTful APIs, WebSocket, GraphQL are an advantage Experience with distributed version control systems: Git (GitHub and/or Bitbucket) Familiarity with cloud-oriented technologies: Docker, AWS or Azure is an advantage Familiar with cloud architecture patterns and best practices for designing highly available, scalable, and secure distributed systems; experience with event-driven architectures is an advantage Experience with observability and troubleshooting in production: log monitoring, error tracking, and APM Security-minded approach to development: secure coding practices and vulnerability remediation as part of the regular workflow Good level of English proficiency, both spoken and written Ability to work independently and as part of a team, with a sense of urgency and integrity Nice To Have Passion for or experience in e-learning projects is a strong bonus Hands-on experience building AI-powered features (e.g. LLM integrations, RAG, AI-assisted user experiences) is a strong bonus Experience running and monitoring AI products in production: evals, output quality tracking, and observability specific to AI/LLM systems is a strong bonus About Us Wellbeing & benefits Your wellbeing matters to us. That’s why we offer benefits designed to help you recharge and thrive, including: Four weeks of paid vacation per year (that increases to five weeks after two years with the company!) plus two days off per year to volunteer at your favorite non-profit 3 days per year for professional development Access to our Benefits Hub, with many discounts and savings! Train subscription Relocation bonus Highly-skilled teammates and lots of opportunities for growth and development Personal growth Learning and opportunity is at the core of what we do - and that applies to you too! You’ll have the unique opportunity to develop your skills on our QA authored courses in the latest tech (you’ll get 3 training days/year to do this). You can also delve deep into our world-class digital learning content on a variety of tech and business topics. Our people We are an equal opportunity employer, focused on promoting a welcoming and inclusive environment. We embrace diversity, welcome applications from all candidates and aim to support the career growth of everyone. This means no matter what your gender, age, ethnicity, beliefs, or sexual orientation, or if you are disabled or a carer, we welcome you and the different perspectives you bring to our diverse family. We’re proud of the progress we’ve achieved over the last few years to build an inclusive culture and celebrate our diversity. As a Disability Confident Employer, we guarantee that all applicants with a disability who meet the role criteria will progress to the next stage of the process. Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments. A Little About QA At QA, we believe the future belongs to organisations …

items.desc: Die Hamburger Energienetze bieten dir eine spannende Karriere in der zukunftssicheren Energiebranche! Mit über 2.400 engagierten Mitarbeitenden meistern wir täglich die Herausforderungen der Energieversorgung für Hamburgs Bürgerinnen und Bürger. Durch unsere Fusion aus Stromnetz Hamburg und Gasnetz Hamburg eröffnen sich dir zahlreiche neue Chancen. Werde Teil unseres Teams, gestalte die Zukunft aktiv mit und profitiere von attraktiven Benefits! Aufgaben Zu deinen Aufgaben gehört der Aufbau sowie die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung von Azure-(AI)Lösungen und damit die aktive Mitgestaltung der Energiewende in Hamburg. Du stellst sicher, dass die Entwicklung und der Betrieb von Azure-(AI)Lösungen koordiniert, sicher, wirtschaftlich und im Einklang mit der Digitalisierungs- und KI-Strategie erfolgen. Darüber hinaus definierst und entwickelst du Azure-(AI) Zielarchitekturen sowie Governance- und Securitystrukturen. Zudem verantwortest du die zentrale Kostensteuerung für den plattformspezifischen Betrieb und dessen Weiterentwicklung. Du entwickelst und betreibst standardisierte CI/CD-Pipelines sowie Infrastructure-as-Code-Komponenten auf Basis von Terraform. Ergänzend dazu erstellst du Templates, Starter-Kits und Referenzlösungen. Außerdem berätst und unterstützt du unsere IT-Plattform-Teams, beispielsweise bei der Bewertung und Umsetzung konkreter AI-Use-Cases. Profil Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Data Science, Mathematik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Als Microsoft Azure DevOps Spezialist gehören Azure DevOps, Git, Terraform, Entra ID, Key Vaults, Private Endpoints, Networking, Landing Zones sowie Monitoring zu deinem täglichen Handwerkszeug. Zudem verfügst du über fundierte Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung und Pflege von Infrastructure-as-Code-Projekten zur Bereitstellung von Azure-Ressourcen mit Terraform und Azure DevOps. Idealerweise bringst du nachweisbare Erfahrung im Umgang mit dem Microsoft Azure AI Stack, insbesondere Azure OpenAI, AI Foundry, Cognitive Services, AI Search und Azure DevOps, mit. Kenntnisse im Einsatz von Large Language Models (LLMs) sowie RAG-Technologien und -Architekturen sind von Vorteil. Eine strukturierte, konzeptionelle und zugleich praxisorientierte Arbeitsweise zeichnet dich ebenso aus wie Deine Fähigkeit, Lösungen erfolgreich in den operativen Betrieb zu überführen. Selbstständiges und eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten sowie Teamfähigkeit und Kommunikationsstärke bringst du mit. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden dein Profil ab. Wir bieten Flexibles Arbeiten: Gestalte deine Arbeitszeit variabel nach deinen individuellen Bedürfnissen, im Büro und im mobilen Arbeiten. Attraktive Vergütung: Freue dich auf eine überdurchschnittliche und attraktive Vergütung durch unseren tollen Tarifvertrag. Beruf & Familie: Freue dich auf ein familienfreundliches Unternehmen mit einer ausgewogenen Work-Life-Balance. Weiterbildung & Qualifizierung: Entwickle dich kontinuierlich weiter, durch zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Qualifizierungsangebote. Kantine: Freue dich auf gesunde, abwechslungsreiche und durch uns bezuschusste Gerichte in unseren Kantinen. Important note Please be advised that a valid work permit for Germany is required for non-EU citizens. Unfortunately, applications without a valid work permit and sufficient German language skills may not be considered. LNKD1_DE

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Envie de déployer vos ailes ? Et si votre aventure commençait avec nous ? Quel que soit le métier de vos rêves, nous avons peut-être le stage qu’il vous faut ! 
 Vous êtes étudiant(e) et à la recherche d'un stage ou d'une année de césure vous permettant de valider votre diplôme et qui fera décoller votre carrière ? 
 Imaginez-vous au cœur d’une entreprise reconnue à l’international, implantée sur tous les continents du monde et riche d’une diversité de parcours, d’expertise et de culture. Tournée vers le digital, à la pointe de la recherche et de l’innovation, vous avez l’opportunité de faire partie de cette aventure passionnante.
 Votre mission, si vous l'acceptez : Une offre de stage intitulée « Artificial Intelligence and Digital Workplace Product Developer (h/f) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein de Airbus Defence and Space sur son site de Toulouse-Palays.
 Vous rejoindrez le département « Space Ground Segment Engineering » en charge d'accélérer la transformation numérique du département en rendant le référentiel opérationnel des processus et méthodes d'ingénierie plus fluide, intuitif et intelligent. Votre stage consistera à combiner l'ingénierie logicielle/IA, le design d'applications et web, ainsi que l'ingénierie des processus (BPMN). Vous développerez un assistant documentaire intelligent et un outil de recherche avancée tout en modélisant les processus opérationnels du département.
 Ce stage, d'une durée d e 6 mo is, débutera idéalement en mars 2027 (cette période est indicative et pourra être ajustée). 
 Ce stage nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues. (Le candidat doit être de nationalité française conformément à l'IGI 1300 du 9 août 2021).
 Vos principales missions consisteront à : 
 ● Conception et déploiement d'un assistant documentaire IA (Chatbot) : concevoir, configurer et entraîner un agent conversationnel LLM sécurisé, créer une grille d'évaluation scientifique de ses performances et animer la conduite du changement. 
 ● Développement d'un outil de recherche avancée (Google Sites) : concevoir une interface moderne centrée utilisateur (UI/UX), gérer la phase de tests, documenter le code/l'architecture et créer les guides d'utilisation.
 ● Modélisation de processus : mener les entretiens opérationnels, transcrire les flux de travail en modèles interactifs BPMN et les interconnecter avec l'assistant IA et l'outil de recherche.
 Votre tuteur ou tutrice vous accompagnera tout au long de votre stage, vous aidant à développer vos compétences et à atteindre vos objectifs professionnels.
 Ce stage vous permettra notamment de développer les compétences suivantes : 
 ● Ingénierie de l'IA appliquée (configuration/optimisation de prompts et LLM, évaluation et suivi IA) 
 ● Analyse fonctionnelle et processus opérationnels (ingénierie, modélisation de processus, BPMN) 
 ● Conduite du changement dans un environnement industriel
 Votre carte d’embarquement pour cette aventure :
 Vous êtes actuellement en dernière année préparant un diplôme de niveau Bac+5 (Master 2, école d'ingénieur ou équivalent) en informatique, science des données, ingénierie des systèmes ou un domaine équivalent.
 Vous possédez idéalement les compétences suivantes : 
 ● Compétences techniques : 
 ○ Ingénierie de l'IA : Prompt Engineering, intégration LLM / RAG 
 ○ Design Web & Applicatif : JavaScript, intégration d'outils de recherche, suite Google Workspace avancée (Google Sites) 
 ○ Ingénierie des processus : Connaissances théoriques ou pratiques du formalisme BPMN
 ● Soft Skills : 
 ○ Excellentes qualités relationnelles et de communication 
 ○ Méthodologie rigoureuse, documentation stricte et traçabilité
 ○ Créativité, autonomie et résolution de problèmes dans un environnement complexe 
 ● Langues : 
 ○ Anglais : Niveau Négociation 
 ○ Français : Niveau Courant 
 Notre processus de recrutement : 
 Votre candidature sera analysée attentivement par notre équipe de recrutement. Si votre profil correspond à nos attentes, vous serez invité(e) à réaliser un entretien vidéo. Suite à cette étape, si votre candidature est retenue, elle sera alors proposée au manager pour un entretien. Envie de faire partie de l'aventure Airbus ? Postulez dès maintenant et rejoignez-nous !

Job Description: 
 Envie de déployer vos ailes ? Et si votre aventure commençait avec nous ? 
 Quel que soit le métier de vos rêves, nous avons peut-être le stage qu’il vous faut !

Imaginez-vous au cœur d’une entreprise reconnue à l’international, implantée sur tous les continents du monde et riche d’une diversité de parcours, d’expertise et de culture. Tournée vers le digital, à la pointe de la recherche et de l’innovation, vous avez l’opportunité de faire partie de cette aventure passionnante.
 Votre mission, si vous l’acceptez : 
 une offre de stage intitulée « Déploiement et intégration de la solution STYRIS augmentés par l'IA (F/H) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein de Airbus Defence and Space sur son site d’Elancourt (78) and le département TCDEF4 « Maritime, Decision Superiority & Military Comms System IVV».
 Ce stage, d'une durée de 6 mois , débutera idéalement en mois de février 2027 (cette période est indicative et pourra être ajustée).
 Ce stage nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues. 
 Vos principales missions consisteront à : 
 Analyse et Ingénierie de la donnée (Phase d'étude) Analyser et comprendre l'architecture de la solution STYRIS (solution Airbus de surveillance Maritime).
 Étudier le modèle de données actuel pour identifier les paramètres clés à automatiser.
 Cartographier les relations entre les exigences métier et les fichiers de configuration techniques.
 Conception et Optimisation de l'IA (Phase de développement IA) Concevoir des stratégies de Prompt Engineering pour guider l'IA dans la génération de fichiers YAML conformes.
 Développer des templates de référence (modèles) servant de base d'apprentissage ou de structure à l'IA.
 Expérimenter différentes approches (ex: intégration de documentation via RAG) pour maximiser la précision de la génération.
 Développement de l'outil de contrôle (Phase de développement Software) Concevoir et développer un outil (script Bash, Ruby ou Python) de validation automatique des fichiers générés.
 Implémenter des tests de conformité : Validation syntaxique : le fichier est-il un YAML valide ? et Validation sémantique : les paramètres générés existent-ils réellement dans Puppet/STYRIS ?.
 Validation métier (la configuration respecte-t-elle les contraintes de l'architecture ?).
 Évaluation et Documentation (Phase de clôture) Mesurer la performance de la solution (taux d'erreur de l'IA, gain de temps par rapport à une saisie manuelle).
 Rédiger la documentation technique de l'outil et des processus mis en place.
 Présenter les résultats et les préconisations pour une éventuelle mise en production.
 Votre tuteur ou tutrice vous accompagnera tout au long de votre stage, vous aidant à développer vos compétences et à atteindre vos objectifs professionnels.
 Ce stage vous permettra notamment de développer les compétences suivantes : 
 Compétences en Intelligence Artificielle (IA Générative) Prompt Engineering avancé : Apprendre à structurer des instructions complexes pour obtenir un résultat technique précis et reproductible.
 Stratégies d'intégration de LLM : Comprendre comment coupler un modèle de langage) avec des données métier (le data model de STYRIS).
 Gestion des hallucinations : Apprendre à mettre en place des garde-fous pour éviter que l'IA ne génère des configurations erronées ou inexistantes.
 Notions de RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) : à travers la fourniture des documents de référence à l'IA pour qu'elle apprenne le format YAML, etcc.
 Compétences DevOps et Infrastructure Comprendre comment on gère une infrastructure de manière automatisée
 Maîtrise de Puppet et du format YAML : Compréhension profonde de la gestion de configuration et de la syntaxe de déploiement.
 Modélisation de données : Capacité à traduire des besoins métier ou des architectures systèmes en modèles de données structurés.
 Automatisation du cycle de vie : Comprendre comment passer d'une exigence projet à une exécution technique.
 Compétences en Intégration et Développement Logiciel Développement de scripts/outils : Utilisation de langages comme Le Bash, Ruby ou Python pour créer des outils de traitement de données.
 Tests et Qualité Logicielle : Mise en place de tests de validation (syntaxiques, sémantiques, de conformité).
 Parsing et manipulation de données : Manipulation de fichiers complexes (parsing de YAML, JSON, TXT, etc.).
 Compétences Transverses (Soft Skills) Capacité d'analyse et de synthèse : comprendre un système existant (STYRIS) pour pouvoir l'automatiser.
 Rigueur scientifique : La validation automatique demande une approche très structurée pour ne laisser passer aucune erreur.
 Autonomie et résolution de problèmes : Faire le pont entre l'IA (souvent imprévisible) et l'infrastructure (qui doit être rigoureuse) est un défi …

items.desc:
Contexte 
 NXP Semiconductors fournit les connexions et les infrastructures nécessaires à un monde plus intelligent et propose des solutions pour une vie plus simple, meilleure et plus sûre. 
 Leader mondial des solutions de connectivité sécurisée pour les applications embarquées, NXP stimule l’innovation pour les véhicules connectés et sécurisés. 
 Forte de plus de 60 ans d’expérience et d’expertise, l’entreprise compte 34 000 collaborateurs dans plus de 30 pays. 
 Votre stage se déroulera au sein du département « Design Enablement », situé à Toulouse et composé d’ingénieurs passionnés chargés de développer des outils et des solutions innovantes pour nos équipes de conception de circuits.
 Vos responsabilités 
 Vous explorerez et développerez des méthodologies innovantes visant à améliorer la génération et la qualification de modèles comportementaux de substitution (surrogate behavioral models). 
 Vos travaux s'appuieront sur les technologies d'IA générative les plus récentes disponibles chez NXP, notamment les approches d'IA agentique (Agentic AI).
 Vos principales missions seront les suivantes :
 Analyser les besoins des équipes d'ingénierie et les traduire en exigences techniques claires.
 Explorer l'utilisation des grands modèles de langage (LLM), de la génération augmentée par récupération (RAG) et de l'IA agentique dans les méthodologies de conception de semi-conducteurs.
 Concevoir et développer des agents d'IA et des outils d'automatisation en Python.
 Prototyper et évaluer la génération, la vérification et la qualification de modèles par l’IA
 Mesurer les gains de performance obtenus et identifier de nouvelles opportunités d'automatisation.
 Documenter et présenter les conclusions techniques, les résultats et les modalités de déploiement.
 Votre profil 
 Formation d’ingénieur ou Master en électronique, génie électrique ou dans un domaine connexe.
 Bonne connaissance de l’électronique analogique et des principes fondamentaux des circuits intégrés.
 Solides compétences en programmation Python et capacité à développer des solutions techniques.
 Bases solides en intelligence artificielle et en apprentissage automatique.
 Fort intérêt pour l’IA générative et l’automatisation des flux d’ingénierie.
 Esprit analytique, proactif et orienté solutions, avec de solides capacités de résolution de problèmes.
 Excellentes compétences de communication écrite et orale, avec la capacité de collaborer efficacement au sein d’une équipe internationale.
 Context 
 NXP Semiconductors provides connections and infrastructure for a smarter world and delivers solutions for an easier, better and safer life. 
 As the global leader in secure connectivity solutions for embedded applications, NXP is driving innovation for the secure connected vehicle. 
 Based on more than 60 years of experience and expertise, the company has 34,000 employees in over 30 countries. 
 Your internship will take place within the “Design Enablement” department located in Toulouse and made up of passionate engineers, responsible for developing innovative tools and solutions for our circuit design teams.
 Your responsibilities 
 You will explore and develop innovative methodologies to improve the generation and qualification of surrogate behavioral models. 
 Your work will leverage the latest Generative AI technologies available at NXP, including agentic AI approaches. 
 Your main responsibilities will include:
 Assessing engineering needs and translating them into clear technical requirements.
 Exploring the use of large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic AI in semiconductor design methodologies.
 Designing and implementing Python-based AI agents and automation tools.
 Prototyping and evaluating AI-assisted workflows for model generation, verification, and qualification.
 Measuring performance improvements and identifying further opportunities for automation.
 Documenting and presenting technical findings, results, and deployment to engineering teams.
 Your profile 
 Engineering degree or Master’s degree in electronics, electrical engineering, or a related field
 Good knowledge of analog electronics and integrated circuit fundamentals.
 Strong Python programming skills and the ability to develop reliable technical solutions.
 A solid foundation in artificial intelligence and machine learning concepts.
 Strong interest in Generative AI and the automation of engineering workflows.
 An analytical, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset, with strong problem-solving abilities.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, to collaborate effectively in an international team.

items.desc: Tony Gee is currently recruiting for a Senior Project Planner based in our Manchester office. This is an opportunity to work on a range of exciting projects across the Highways, Rail and Energy sectors. Whilst our immediate need is for a planner to support our growing portfolio of major projects for the Energy Sector, we can offer variety and interest with opportunities on our Network Rail and National Highways framework projects also. We are looking for someone comfortable working as part of the project management team and, when required, autonomously using initiative to overcome challenges and unknowns. We are looking for a planner competent to construct and manage NEC3 and NEC4 compliant programmes but are also very interested in candidates who have a passion to share knowledge and develop others. Key Responsibilities Manage integrated project programmes meeting internal / external reporting timelines Correlate schedule, cost and risk assessment through integrated solutions to influence critical path analysis Lead in What-if scenario planning providing integrated solutions to programme/project conflicts and recoveries Manage and monitor processes to integrate scheduling from across all projects within the area of work Work closely with Project Managers to maintain programme schedules and manage the interface between schedules Support contractor requirements working with the Planning Manager and/ or Project Controls Manager Collaborate with project delivery teams and external stakeholders (including clients and suppliers) where necessary to integrate all time, cost and quality information to support the monitoring of project performance Capture and communicate best practice project planning policy, processes and procedures across the business to drive continuous improvement and provide specialist advice where required Provide support and advice to your project team member(s) at all times and ensure that all tasks are being delivered to a high level of quality Provide programme structure and programme software training to Project Managers and other engineering staff as may be relevant to their needs in order to interact with project programmes Essential Skills: Competent in P6 primavera Accredited training / competent in Microsoft Project Numerate and able to demonstrate strong excel, project and PowerPoint skills, computer literacy is essential Understanding and working experience of Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project Understanding of best practise, Standards and Procedures Experience. The ability to create Project Schedules at various development stages, developing from first principles and ensuring the schedules are maintained effectively Experience and knowledge of NEC contracts and commercial aspects relating to planning/programming Experience in infrastructure planning/programming Demonstrable understanding of commercial elements within large, complex projects, and a track record of achievement in complex projects Desirable Skills Association of Project Management member or similar (or working towards), APMG Project Planning & Control Foundation and Practitioner or similar (or working towards), Why Work for Tony Gee? We are an engineering consultancy renowned for delivering complex and innovative design solutions to the global construction industry. Our people make our business a success and so we invest in your development and wellbeing providing an environment that supports you at whatever career level you are at. We believe that there is more to a job than work. We encourage a healthy work/life balance through a wide range of social activity groups. items.desc: Posting Type Hybrid/Remote Poland Job Overview WHO WE ARE Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial. The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant information in their matters. What We Do At Relativity, engineers do more than write code — they build systems that let users uncover insights from complex data at scale using cloud-native architecture, AI, and modern tools. The AI Platform group builds the agentic foundation that powers Relativity’s AI products, including aiR Assist and ClaiR. The Agent Harness team owns the runtime that runs our agents: agent orchestration, tool and skill execution, memory, and the protocols that let agents interact with each other and with external systems. About The Role As an Advanced AI Engineer on the Agent Harness team, you will build and extend Relativity’s agent runtime — working hands-on with industry frameworks like LangGraph, LangChain, and Deep Agents and fitting them to Relativity’s needs so every Relativity agent has a solid runtime to build on. You will help mature the harness with industry-standard capabilities like long-session handling or broader protocol support, so it is ready before ClaiR and aiR Assist multiply agentic traffic, rather than after. You will contribute to design discussions and turn agreed designs into well-tested, production-ready capabilities that application teams adopt. You will work in a fast-moving space where agent architecture changes quickly, and grow your depth in agent engineering as you go. Job Description And Requirements WHAT YOU’LL DO Build and extend the agent runtime in Python using LangGraph, LangChain, and Deep Agents (deepagents) — stateful graph agents, harness profiles, and multi-agent / subagent orchestration. Implement harness capabilities that application teams rely on — for example streaming and structured/generative output, tool calling, human-in-the-loop review, conversation branching and message queues, session memory, and checkpoint/resume (time-travel) over long-running work. items.desc: About Hilbert Hilbert is a scalable, data science-first growth engine that gives B2C teams predictive clarity into user behavior, revenue drivers, and the actions that drive sustainable growth. Fully agentic by design, Hilbert shrinks months-long decision cycles to minutes. From Fortune 10 enterprises to beloved brands like FreshDirect, Blank Street, and Levain Bakery, operators run their growth on Hilbert. We’re also co-building alongside leading AI companies. Position Overview Hilbert is building a reasoning engine that must navigate non-deterministic user behavior across data silos. Our demand intelligence platform doesn’t just call APIs. It solves the hard problem of orchestrating multi-step inference over messy, high-stakes enterprise data where deterministic answers don’t exist. We’re looking for an AI Engineer who can build production-grade AI systems end-to-end, from prototype to pipeline to product, with the ownership and urgency of a startup culture. This is not a “wire up a prompt chain and move on” role. You’ll own core pieces of the AI stack that power Hilbert’s platform: designing agent architectures, building evaluation systems, and making hard tradeoffs between accuracy, latency, and cost in production. You’ll ship fast while the spec is still evolving, and you’ll explain what you’re building (and why) clearly to the rest of the team. If you think in systems, have opinions about how agentic workflows should actually work, and want to build AI products that drive real enterprise outcomes, we want to meet you. What you’ll own first: evaluation and testing for our agents Hilbert’s agents are in production with enterprise customers today. Before we expand what they do, we need to know, reproducibly, when a change makes them better or worse. You’ll design the eval harness, define what “correct” means for a multi-step agent trajectory, build the regression gates that run before anything ships, and turn production failures into test cases. From there, your scope widens to retrieval, orchestration, and execution across the AI stack. What You’ll Do Own the evaluation layer for our agents: harnesses, metrics, golden datasets, regression gates, and human-in-the-loop review. Architect and implement agent workflows using LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent, including state memory, routing, tool registries, and recovery paths. Own systems from experimentation through production, and operate them once they’re live: tracing, monitoring, latency, cost-per-task budgeting, and on-call for what you build. Diagnose real production failures (hallucination, tool misuse, retrieval misses, silent degradation) and turn each one into a durable fix and a test. Set the technical standard for agent work at Hilbert: review designs, define patterns others build on, and raise the bar across the team. Collaborate closely with the founding team and cross-functional partners, communicating tradeoffs, progress, and technical decisions clearly. Make pragmatic engineering decisions under ambiguity: ship, learn, iterate. Our current hurdles: the kinds of problems you’ll walk into on day one Intelligent retrieval across different approaches. Our agents need the right information at exactly the right moment. The challenge isn’t picking one retrieval method. It’s combining RAG, graph-based retrieval, and other approaches into one strategy that fetches the most relevant content exactly when the agent needs it, no more and no less. Agentic workflows that solve real-world problems. Workflows have to be robust enough to handle the unexpected. When an agent hits an edge case, missing data, or a situation it wasn’t designed for, it needs to reason through it: use the context it has, escalate to a human when it can’t, and never fail silently. Evaluation beyond vibes. We need systematic, reproducible evals that actually predict real-world performance. If you’ve built custom evaluators for RAG or agent workflows, we want to talk. Execution and real-world integration. An agent that only surfaces insights isn’t enough. We’re building systems where agents take action: integrating with external platforms, executing workflows, and doing real work with the information they have, with human-in-the-loop checkpoints that keep enterprise trust intact. Who Thrives In The Role We care about what you’ve shipped and how you think. We expect 4+ years of building production software, with at least 2 of those on LLM or agentic systems that real users depend on. Must-haves 4+ years of production software engineering (APIs, services, data infrastructure). You’ve owned code other people depended on, with tests, CI/CD, and on-call attached. 2+ years building LLM or agent systems that shipped to production and were adopted by real users. Not internal demos, not prototypes. Be ready to talk about what broke in production and what you did about it. Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent agent/orchestration frameworks. You’ve built with them, …

items.desc: Posting Type Hybrid/Remote Poland Job Overview WHO WE ARE Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial. The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant information in their matters. What We Do At Relativity, engineers do more than write code — they build systems that let users uncover insights from complex data at scale using cloud-native architecture, AI, and modern tools. The AI Platform group builds the agentic foundation that powers Relativity’s AI products, including aiR Assist and ClaiR. The Agent Harness team owns the runtime that runs our agents: agent orchestration, tool and skill execution, memory, and the protocols that let agents interact with each other and with external systems. About The Role As an Advanced AI Engineer on the Agent Harness team, you will build and extend Relativity’s agent runtime — working hands-on with industry frameworks like LangGraph, LangChain, and Deep Agents and fitting them to Relativity’s needs so every Relativity agent has a solid runtime to build on.
