items.desc: Posting Type Hybrid/Remote Poland Job Overview WHO WE ARE Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial. The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant information in their matters. What We Do At Relativity, engineers do more than write code — they build systems that let users uncover insights from complex data at scale using cloud-native architecture, AI, and modern tools. The AI Platform group builds the agentic foundation that powers Relativity’s AI products, including aiR Assist and ClaiR. The Agent Harness team owns the runtime that runs our agents: agent orchestration, tool and skill execution, memory, and the protocols that let agents interact with each other and with external systems. About The Role As an Advanced AI Engineer on the Agent Harness team, you will build and extend Relativity’s agent runtime — working hands-on with industry frameworks like LangGraph, LangChain, and Deep Agents and fitting them to Relativity’s needs so every Relativity agent has a solid runtime to build on. You will help mature the harness with industry-standard capabilities like long-session handling or broader protocol support, so it is ready before ClaiR and aiR Assist multiply agentic traffic, rather than after. You will contribute to design discussions and turn agreed designs into well-tested, production-ready capabilities that application teams adopt. You will work in a fast-moving space where agent architecture changes quickly, and grow your depth in agent engineering as you go. Job Description And Requirements WHAT YOU’LL DO Build and extend the agent runtime in Python using LangGraph, LangChain, and Deep Agents (deepagents) — stateful graph agents, harness profiles, and multi-agent / subagent orchestration. Implement harness capabilities that application teams rely on — for example streaming and structured/generative output, tool calling, human-in-the-loop review, conversation branching and message queues, session memory, and checkpoint/resume (time-travel) over long-running work. Contribute to the harness’s extensibility and protocol layer: Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool servers and clients, Agent-to-Agent (A2A) interoperability, and a registry of skills, tools, and configurations composed at runtime. Help agents use the model that fits each use case, working across a range of LLM providers (e.g. OpenAI, Gemini). Write clean, well-tested code and participate in design and code reviews; take ownership of components and see them through to production. Collaborate with teammates, Applied Science, and aiR application teams to move new capabilities from experiment into production safely. items.desc: NVIDIA is looking for a Software Engineering Intern to join a team that builds infrastructure and agentic AI services for teams across the company. Our job is to remove other teams' bottlenecks: we build and run core internal services that power large geo-distributed infrastructure, and a growing share of what we ship is driven by AI agents. As an intern, you will work alongside senior engineers to design, build, and ship production systems – from backend services that run automated workflows at massive scale to AI agents that take routine work off engineers' plates. This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience with agentic AI and modern infrastructure while contributing to real products used by teams across NVIDIA. What You'll Be Doing Work with senior engineers to design, build, and improve backend services and APIs for internal platforms that run automated workflows at massive scale Build AI agents and agentic workflows that connect LLMs to tools and internal services, and integrate them into production systems Help make agents reliable and safe in production – from access control and guardrails to evaluating agent quality Assist in building data pipelines and GPU job orchestration for synthetic data generation and model evaluation at scale Implement and improve observability (tracing, metrics, logging) for distributed services and agents Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging, and apply software engineering best practices in a production environment Work in a product-minded way: talk to internal users, prototype quickly, collect feedback, and iterate What We Need To See Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field Strong programming fundamentals in at least one of: Go (preferred), Python, or C# Solid understanding of data structures and algorithms Basic knowledge of software design patterns and API design concepts Hands-on experience building with LLMs – for example, a project, prototype, or coursework that uses LLM APIs Familiarity with version control systems (Git) Understanding of database concepts and SQL Strong problem-solving skills and eagerness to learn new technologies Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively in a team environment Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd Experience building AI agents or LLM-powered applications: tool/function calling, MCP, RAG, or agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, NVIDIA NeMo Agent Toolkit) Experience with distributed systems concepts (REST APIs, microservices architecture) and containerization (Docker) Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), GPU workloads, and infrastructure automation Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana), and orchestration platforms (Kubernetes) Experience with database technologies (MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch) With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the most desirable employers in the world. items.desc: _ YOU WORK FOR WE® Bij WE Fashion transformeren we de toekomst van fashion retail en e-commerce met behulp van innovatie en slimme technologie. Binnen ons Data & BI-team bouwen we niet alleen dashboards, maar verbeteren en vernieuwen we bedrijfsprocessen actief met behulp van moderne AI-technologie. Als AI & Automation Stagiair vorm je de belangrijke schakel tussen verschillende bedrijfsafdelingen en geavanceerde technologie. Je gaat rechtstreeks aan de slag met verschillende teams binnen ons hoofdkantoor, leert hoe hun dagelijkse processen verlopen en zet handmatige werkzaamheden om in intelligente, geautomatiseerde oplossingen op basis van agentic AI. Tijdens je stage draag je bij aan: Het rechtstreeks samenwerken met verschillende teams binnen WE Fashion om dagelijkse werkprocessen in kaart te brengen en mogelijkheden voor automatisering te ontdekken; Het ontwerpen, prototypen en ontwikkelen van complete agentic AI-oplossingen en moderne automatiseringsprocessen; Het vertalen van concrete bedrijfsuitdagingen naar praktische code en schaalbare technische oplossingen; Het continu experimenteren met nieuwe AI-frameworks, RAG-architecturen en tools om een tastbare bijdrage te leveren aan de organisatie; Het ter discussie stellen van traditionele werkwijzen en het presenteren van creatieve, praktische ideeën aan verschillende belanghebbenden binnen de organisatie. Wat we van jou verwachten? Soft Skills Communicatief en empathisch: Je vindt het leuk om met mensen uit verschillende teams in gesprek te gaan, te luisteren naar de uitdagingen waar zij in hun dagelijkse werk tegenaan lopen en sterke werkrelaties op te bouwen. Initiatief en eigenaarschap: Je wacht niet op stapsgewijze instructies, maar neemt zelf de verantwoordelijkheid voor je projecten en zorgt ervoor dat deze vooruitgang boeken. Een out-of-the-boxmentaliteit: Je durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen, bekijkt problemen vanuit nieuwe perspectieven en richt je op praktische oplossingen met een grote impact. Het grotere geheel kunnen overzien: Je houdt het uiteindelijke bedrijfsdoel voor ogen en richt je niet uitsluitend op het afronden van afzonderlijke taken. Hard Skills Relevante opleiding: Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding in de richting van Data, IT, Artificial Intelligence, Business & Technology of een vergelijkbare studierichting. Praktische programmeervaardigheden en technische kennis: Je kunt zelfstandig programmeren, bent vertrouwd met moderne softwareontwikkeltechnologieën en begrijpt de basisprincipes van cloudarchitectuur. Enthousiast over AI en praktisch ingesteld: Je integreert AI-tools in je dagelijks leven en maakt actief gebruik van Claude bij softwareontwikkeling. Kennis van agentic AI en RAG: Je begrijpt de basisarchitectuur van agentic AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) en de manier waarop moderne AI-modellen onder de motorkap functioneren. Leergierig en flexibel: Je gaat nieuwe tools en technologieën met vertrouwen tegemoet. Je gebruikt AI als programmeerpartner om snel nieuwe kennis op te doen, problemen op te lossen en onbekende technologieën onder de knie te krijgen. WE WORK FOR YOU Jij zorgt er met vernieuwende ideeën voor dat wij dagelijks kunnen blijven groeien en innoveren, dus daar mag ook wat tegenover staan. You work for WE®, WE work for you. Je krijgt daarom van ons: Een toffe, leerzame stage met enthousiaste collega’s die staan te springen om hun kennis met jou te delen. Een stagevergoeding van €350,- per maand op basis van 40 uur per week. 100% OV-reiskostenvergoeding vanaf 10 km. Standaard 20% shopkorting op onze hele collectie. De kans om continu te leren en te ontwikkelen, zowel vakinhoudelijk als persoonlijk. Vanuit onze WE® Academy bieden we bijvoorbeeld verschillende opleidings- en trainingsmogelijkheden die jij nodig hebt om bij ons te excelleren. Teamuitjes, BBQ’s, events en meer! Who We Are Als modeliefhebber ken je WE Fashion natuurlijk allang. Maar wist je ook dat wij een succesvol Nederlands multi-channel merk zijn dat volop in de transitie is om niet alleen de beste fashion retailer, maar ook fashion e-tailer van West-Europa te worden? De fashionwereld is altijd in beweging! En dat maakt WE Fashion dé plek waar je de kans krijgt om trends te zien, erop in te spelen of ze zelf te creëren. Maar daar laten we het niet bij: we blijven dagelijks zoeken naar groeikansen, ook rondom maatschappelijk verantwoord en duurzaam ondernemen. Want WE Care. Daarom liggen ontwikkeling, verbetering en creatie ook nooit stil bij ons. WE Fashion is dé plek waar jij de kans krijgt om te innoveren en persoonlijk te groeien. Goede ideeën? Laat van je horen en word een trendsetter!

items.desc: Contexte Chez JCDecaux, leader mondial de la communication extérieure, nous nous engageons à être le média responsable et durable qui sert la communauté, tant en ville que dans les lieux de transport et de commerce. Notre histoire commence en 1964 avec la création d’un nouveau modèle économique : proposer des produits et des services utiles et durables (Abribus, Mobilier Urbain pour l’Information, Kiosques, Sanitaires à entretien automatique, Vélos en libre-service…), financés par la publicité, au bénéfice des villes, de leurs résidents et visiteurs, puis, à partir des années 2000, au bénéfice des aéroports et des compagnies de transports. Innover toujours, rechercher l’excellence dans tous nos métiers, agir de façon responsable… voilà les valeurs qui nous animent au quotidien. Au sein du groupe JCDecaux, la Direction Générale FINSOG (Finance Systèmes d’Information et Opérations Groupe) regroupe les métiers R&D, Développement Durable, Achats, Supply Chain, Contrôle financier, M&A, juridique, IT, trésorerie, fiscalité, exploitation internationale. Cette direction souhaite accélérer sa transformation digitale en faisant de l'IA un levier de performance sur l'ensemble de sa chaîne de valeur. L’objectif est d’augmenter significativement l'usage de l'IA générative et mettre en place les premiers POC d'IA agentique à forte valeur métier. Le stagiaire sera la force d'accélération opérationnelle du dispositif. Il devra accompagner la direction et les représentants métiers IA FINSOG afin de transformer les intentions en résultats concrets : des roadmaps 2030 priorisées et chiffrées, des usages d'IA générative ancrés dans le quotidien des équipes, et des agents IA prototypés, testés et prêts à être industrialisés. Missions principales Axe 1 – Participer à la finalisation des roadmaps IA 2030 des directions Qualifier chaque cas d'usage : description, données mobilisées, faisabilité technique, risques (sécurité, conformité, RGPD, AI Act), type de solution (IA générative, agent, outil métier embarqué). Préparer et co-animer, avec chaque représentant métier, des ateliers de génération de cas d'usage (cartographie des processus, irritants, tâches répétitives, besoins d'analyse). Estimer la valeur métier (temps gagné, fiabilisation, qualité, ROI) et construire les business cases avec les représentants métiers. Proposer une priorisation (matrice valeur / faisabilité) pour les arbitrages avec les directeurs métiers. Consolider les roadmaps dans une vision FINSOG 2030 (quick wins 2027, projets structurants, cibles 2030), alignée avec la démarche « BU AI Journey » et les solutions Groupe existantes ou à venir. Alimenter le suivi du portefeuille d'initiatives. Axe 2 – Accélérer l'usage de l'IA générative Concevoir une bibliothèque de prompts experts par métier FINSOG, à intégrer au Prompt Catalog de ChatJCD. Produire des supports de formation prêts à l'emploi (guides, tutoriels, cas pratiques, vidéos courtes) pour permettre aux représentants métiers de former les utilisateurs de leur direction. Contribuer à la définition du plan de formation IA de chaque direction et à la formation des formateurs internes. Organiser des permanences et démonstrations (« art du possible ») sur les nouvelles fonctionnalités : synthèse de réunions, intégration Office 365, agents de l'Agent Market Place. Mettre en place des indicateurs d'adoption (utilisateurs actifs, fréquence, cas d'usage déployés, satisfaction) et un tableau de bord de suivi. Axe 3 – Concevoir et piloter des POC d'IA agentique Sélectionner, avec la direction et les représentants métiers, 3 à 5 cas d'usage agentiques à fort potentiel (ex. : agents de contrôle et de cohérence, agent de veille réglementaire, préparation de dossiers ou de reportings, analyse de contrats ou d'appels d'offres, suivi d'actions). Cadrer chaque POC : processus cible, sources de données, périmètre d'autonomie de l'agent, points de validation humaine, critères de succès. Concevoir et développer les agents dans les environnements validés par le Groupe en lien avec l'AI Factory et les AI Core Enablers. Tester avec les utilisateurs métiers, mesurer les gains réels et documenter les résultats (bénéfices, limites, coûts en tokens, risques). Garantir le respect des politiques Groupe (sécurité, éthique, conformité, data) et remonter tout risque ou dérogation à l'IA Leader. Axe 4 – Animation du réseau et veille Préparer les contenus des comités trimestriels et des ateliers transverses métiers (toutes les 6 à 8 semaines). Animer l'équipe Teams des représentants métiers : documentation, cas d'usage identifiés, retours d'expérience, succès et difficultés. Assurer une veille ciblée sur les usages IA en finance, juridique, achats, supply chain et fonctions support, en complément de la JCDecaux AI Watch. Formation Dernière année d'école d'ingénieurs ou Master 2 en intelligence artificielle, data science, informatique ou génie industriel avec une forte spécialisation IA. Compétences techniques Bonne maîtrise des LLM et …

Wir automatisieren zentrale Prozesse unserer Media-Organisation und unserer Kunden und überführen heute noch manuelle oder Excel-basierte Abläufe in skalierbare, intelligente Anwendungen. Dabei arbeitest du an modernen Agentic-AI-, LLM-, Retrieval- und Automatisierungslösungen und begleitest sie von der Idee und dem Prototyping bis in den produktiven Betrieb. items.desc: You build the systems that actually make AI work in enterprise environments, not demos, not prototypes that stall after a pilot, but production agentic architectures running inside real client organizations. The difference between an AI Engineer and what we are looking for is straightforward: you have shipped a multi-agent system in production, you have owned the eval harness, and you know what happens when your agent fails at 2am because you have lived it. This role sits within our Manufacturing and System Integration practice , where AI is applied to real-world SAP, logistics, and manufacturing transformation challenges. As demand for AI engineering talent continues to outpace supply, we offer something no single product company can: exposure to complex enterprise environments across industries, technologies, and operating models, combined with vendor fellowship access inside Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google engineering teams. Key Responsibilities Design and build production-grade agentic systems end-to-end: multi-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, policy-based routing, tool invocation, memory management, and lifecycle observability; Build and own RAG pipelines: embeddings, chunking strategy, vector search, context window engineering and tuning against real quality targets; Integrate and abstract across multiple LLM providers — OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI, and open-source models — with fallback routing, token, cost, and latency management; Implement LLMOps in production: eval harnesses with real quality metrics, prompt versioning, observability tooling (LangSmith, Braintrust, or equivalent), cost and safety monitoring; Embed directly with client engineering teams to design, prototype, and deploy agentic solutions — workshops, proofs of concept, code-with sessions, and architecture walkthroughs; Define and use metrics to measure agent accuracy, latency, safety, and cost-effectiveness; present findings and recommendations to client stakeholders in business terms. Software engineering experience in production environments, coupled with experience in SAP, manufacturing, logistics, or system integration domains where technology solutions support complex business operations. Hands-on experience designing and deploying agentic AI solutions in a production environment — non-negotiable; Demonstrated experience with agentic orchestration frameworks: LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent — at production depth, not tutorial level; Direct experience calling LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI) in production code: provider abstraction, token management, latency and cost tradeoffs; RAG pipeline ownership: embeddings, chunking strategy, vector databases, and context engineering; LLMOps fundamentals: eval harness design, prompt versioning, and production observability; Cloud-native engineering maturity: Kubernetes, Docker, microservices, serverless, CI/CD, and IaC (Terraform or Helm); Strong Python; Java or equivalent backend language acceptable; production debugging and observability experience; Quality of experience is weighted over years, a candidate who has shipped three production agentic systems in four years is preferred over a generalist with passive AI exposure. Very good German and English language skills, as well as a willingness to travel occasionally for business purposes. What We Offer A workplace culture that celebrates diversity, inclusion, and a sense of belonging. Extensive learning and development opportunities to help you continuously build your skills and advance your career. Dedicated mentoring and structured onboarding to support your professional growth from day one. The flexibility to work where you can make the greatest impact: from an Accenture office, remotely, or directly with clients. And when diverse talents, strengths, and perspectives come together, something extraordinary happens: ideas that create real impact in the world. That's why, at Accenture, we champion diversity and individual growth. Create a work environment where you can thrive. Take on challenges that matter to you. Shape a workload that fits your life. Work in ways that support your goals. How you connect, learn, and grow is up to you. This is your career. We're here to help you build it the way you envision it.

Cutting-edge innovators When you join us, you’ll be part of a team that embraces digital technology and data to transform the way we work and the work we do. Agent Development Exposure: Experience in building and orchestrating complex AI workflows using state-of-the-art frameworks, specifically: LangChain, LangGraph, and ADK (Agent Development Kit). Documentation & Best Practices: Document agent architectures, development processes, and promote reusable design patterns across the engineering team.

items.desc: AI Engineer - Experto en IA Agéntica Misión del puesto Buscamos un/a Senior Agentic AI Lead que diseñe, construya y lleve a producción los sistemas multiagente para definir el futuro de Verti hacia una compañía agéntica. Trabajará de forma transversal con los equipos multidisciplinares, de Data y TI de la compañía, así como con los product owners de los agentes. Es un rol híbrido dentro del equipo Data & IA para trabajar en equipos multidisciplinares con metodologías ágiles: 80% rol técnico para la construcción de agentes, casos de uso y capacidades cross (arquitectura, código y evaluación) y 20% liderazgo (estándares, negocio y gobierno). Será la referencia interna en IA agéntica. Funciones del puesto Técnicas Definir, diseñar e implementar los principales casos de uso agénticos para la contratación de seguros, gestión técnica y servicios a los clientes. Definir, desarrollar y evolucionar las capacidades cross de sistemas multiagente: arquitectura, orquestación, agentes especializados, bus de datos compartido, memoria y herramientas. Diseñar la capa ontológica que da a los agentes un modelo semántico común de entidades de negocio, acciones permitidas y guardarraíles regulatorios. Establecer estándares de evaluación: métricas de calidad, pruebas offline y online, red teaming y observabilidad de trazas de agentes. Definir patrones de human-in-the-loop y escalado, calibrando el nivel de autonomía de cada agente según riesgo. Integrar los agentes con los sistemas core de la aseguradora y con la plataforma de datos y diseñar la capa ontológica de datos necesarios para el consumo de los agentes. Desplegar agentes en entornos contenerizados. Documentar mejores prácticas y generar la metodología de trabajo. Operación, monitorización, mantenimiento y gobierno de agentes. Capacidad de innovación a la hora de investigar nuevas tecnologías. Liderazgo Ser la referencia interna en IA agéntica: definir estándares, buenas prácticas y formación a las tribus de datos. Coordinarse con iniciativas de IA del Grupo MAPFRE y la plataforma de datos y agentes corporativos. Definir el gobierno y arquitectura de agentes dentro de Verti. Formación y conocimientos requeridos Dominio de Python y de frameworks agénticos (p. ej. LangGraph o similares) y de protocolos como MCP o A2A. Conocimiento sólido de RAG, embeddings, bases vectoriales y grafos de conocimiento u ontologías. Experiencia en evaluación y observabilidad de LLMs (LLM-as-judge, datasets de evaluación, trazas, coste y latencia). Conocimientos de ElevenLabs. Experiencia cloud en AWS. Prácticas de MLOps/LLMOps: CI/CD, despliegue en cloud (AWS, Azure o GCP), contenedores y APIs. Experiencia en desarrollo de APIs. Uso de herramientas de asistencia al desarrollo como GitHub Copilot. Criterio de seguridad en IA: prompt injection, control de permisos de herramientas y protección de datos personales. Pensamiento de producto: prioriza por impacto, mide resultados y sabe decir no. Mentalidad de construir cultura: documenta, comparte y eleva el nivel del resto de equipos. Capacidad de traducir necesidades de negocio en soluciones productivas, escalables y gobernadas. Experiencia profesional requerida 8+ años en ingeniería de software, ML o datos, con al menos 2 años construyendo aplicaciones basadas en LLM en producción. 8 años de experiencia como líder técnico. 2 años de experiencia demostrable diseñando sistemas agénticos: tool use, planificación, memoria, orquestación multiagente y manejo de fallos. Idiomas Español. Inglés. Competencias Compromiso. Orientación a resultados. Iniciativa y proactividad. Orientación al cliente. Aptitudes para las relaciones sociales con clientes y proveedores. Capacidad de negociación. Capacidad de innovación y transformación. Liderazgo. Trabajo en equipo. Pensamiento analítico. Análisis y toma de decisiones. Impacto e influencia. Flexibilidad. Capacidad de adaptación, alta tolerancia a los cambios y rápida adaptación a ellos. Orientación al orden y la calidad. Comunicación fluida oral y escrita. Mentalidad abierta y amplitud de miras. Respeto a otras culturas y costumbres.

items.desc: Project description Our Surveillance and Regulatory Technology division delivers innovative solutions that protect financial and reputational interests from potentially criminal or inappropriate behaviour. Through real-time sanction and embargo filtering, operational risk controls, and sophisticated fraud detection, our systems protect both clients and the organization, ensuring compliance with global regulations. We are launching several new AI initiatives to integrate advanced machine learning and cognitive capabilities into our platforms. We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Software Engineer to participate actively in every phase of the software development lifecycle. In this role, you will help design and build modern applications, with a strong focus on implementing Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG systems, and agentic workflows. Responsibilities Application Development: Collaborate within a global, distributed team to build and deliver robust, scalable, and secure microservices and applications. AI & LLM Integration: Actively contribute to the development of new AI features, implementing LLM-based solutions, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and LLM agents. Full SDLC Participation: Engage in the entire software development lifecycle, from analysing requirements and brainstorming technical solutions to writing clean code, testing, and deployment. Quality & Automation: Embrace automated unit/integration testing (TDD/BDD) and modern CI/CD practices as standard engineering disciplines. Skills Must have AI & Emerging Technologies Generative AI & LLMs: Solid conceptual and practical understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs). Advanced AI Architectures: Knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), LLM agents, and agentic architectures. AI Frameworks & Tools: Exposure to or experience with Spring AI, Python-based AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex), and cloud AI platforms such as Google Cloud Vertex AI. Backend Engineering & Language Skills Java & Spring Boot (Strong Advantage): Prior experience with modern Java (Java 17/21) and the Spring Boot framework is highly preferred and considered a major asset, though candidates with strong backgrounds in other enterprise languages (such as Python) who are willing to work in a hybrid environment are welcome. Message-Driven Systems: Experience with data streaming and messaging technologies like Apache Kafka, IBM MQ, or equivalent tools. Cloud & DevOps: Practical experience with cloud-native application development (Google Cloud Platform experience is a strong plus) and container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, or OpenShift). Mindset & Methodology 3+ years of software engineering experience with a highly analytical and problem-solving mindset. Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum, Jira, Confluence). Commitment to high-quality code, testing standards (TDD/BDD), and modern CI/CD build chains (Maven, Gradle, Git, Jenkins/TeamCity).

items.card: What You'll Do Real engineering. Real users. Real impact. Understand problems deeply. Engage directly with clients and their domain experts. Ask the right questions, map the problem, challenge assumptions. Build fast, build well. Prototype quickly, then turn prototypes into robust, production-ready systems. items.desc: Basel, Switzerland · Full time · Permanent · On-site, with time at client sites For people who figure things out, stay curious, and build things that actually work. At ekona , we build production-grade AI systems for clients in life sciences , supply chain and finance , where quality is not optional. That means complete applications, AI agents embedded in real business processes, and governed AI platforms, all running in our clients' own cloud. Our clients trust us because we think independently, move fast, and deliver with Swiss reliability . We're looking for engineers who do not wait for perfect instructions. Who explore, experiment, break problems down, and build solutions that matter. Who enjoy ambiguity because it gives them room to think. Who can sit with a client, understand their pain, and fix it with the right mix of engineering and AI. If that sounds like you, keep reading. What You'll Do Real engineering. Real users. Real impact. Understand problems deeply. Engage directly with clients and their domain experts. Ask the right questions, map the problem, challenge assumptions. Build fast, build well. Prototype quickly, then turn prototypes into robust, production-ready systems. Design and deploy multi-agent workflows, document and vision AI, and LLM-powered applications. Working software reaches users within weeks, and we demo it every week. Ship end-to-end. Own your work from architecture through testing, deployment, observability and iteration in cloud environments. You'll work in small project teams, with AI coding tools as part of your daily workflow. Shape how we work. Influence our technical roadmap. Help develop our AI engineering playbook, frameworks and internal tooling. Your ideas will be heard. What We're Looking For The exact stack matters less than how you think, learn, and build . That said, you'll likely be a fit if you have: Several years of professional software engineering experience , shipping systems to real users Comfort with cloud-native development : containers, CI/CD, at least one major cloud platform Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agent frameworks , or a clear track record of picking up new technical domains fast The ability to talk to non-technical stakeholders and translate their problems into working software A strong bias toward shipping Very good English , spoken and written. German is a plus What you'll work with (you don't need all of it): Python and FastAPI; TypeScript, Next.js and React; Postgres; LLM APIs from OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini and Anthropic; LangGraph and our own agent tooling; Neo4j knowledge graphs; GCP, Azure and AWS. Nice to have: domain experience in life sciences, pharma, supply chain or finance; knowledge graphs, RAG systems or LLM observability; experience in regulated environments. Why ekona Momentum. We've grown steadily through 2026, and there's a lot more to build. Engineering quality actually matters. Our clients feel the difference, and so will you. Real projects, regulated industries. The work has weight. Early-team environment. Autonomy, trust, and direct influence on where we go next. No AI theater. No bureaucracy, no endless meetings, no demos dressed up as deliverables. Entrepreneurial culture. Fast-moving, pragmatic, grown-up. Is This You? If you're happiest planning, specifying, and polishing without ever putting something in front of a user, this probably isn't the right place. If you want to ship impactful AI products alongside a small team that holds itself to a high bar, it probably is. Interested? Apply on our careers page with your CV and a link to something you built. Questions first? Write to careers@ekona.ai.

items.desc: At Indeep AI , we are an applied AI research laboratory working at the intersection of natural language processing, linguistics, and human cognition. Our work is grounded in a simple conviction: the tools we use to write and understand documents should make communication clearer and more trustworthy, not less. That research powers Typewiser, our document intelligence platform. Typewiser helps people produce and understand high-stakes documents with greater clarity and rigour, analysing how information is communicated, surfacing where meaning breaks down, and supporting the writer in real time. It is backed by European research funding and built on peer-reviewed scientific foundations. We are a small, multidisciplinary team of linguists, engineers, scientists, and operators. We are at the stage where the way we present ourselves to the world is still being built. That is where you come in. We’re looking for a versatile Full-Stack AI Engineer to join our team at Indeep Artificial Intelligence (IAI) at our office in Barcelona . We need someone who can support our technical efforts across the board. Working closely with and directly supporting our CTO, you will move fluidly across the whole stack — from backend and platform engineering, to the LLM and AI pipelines at the core of our product, to the infrastructure that runs it, to the frontend that users touch. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for someone who is happiest when they can pick up almost any part of the system and make progress on it. We are not looking for a specialist in a single layer. We need a strong generalist: someone who can context-switch, learn quickly, and be trusted to deliver across whatever the week demands. You won’t own the architecture, but you will be the person who helps turn it into working, reliable software, and your judgement will carry real weight. We need someone with a strong startup attitude: sharp problem-solving skills, the ability to manage priorities and deliverables autonomously without rigid timeframes, and the capacity to handle diverse task assignments. If you thrive in ambiguity, move fast without sacrificing quality, and can pivot when priorities shift, you’re exactly who we’re looking for. This role is for someone energised by wearing multiple hats and making an impact without needing a detailed playbook. If that sounds like you, we’d be excited to hear from you. Contract Type: Permanent Full Office-Based Work Modality: Monday to Friday from 9:00 to 18:00 at WeWork Glòries Barcelona Duties & Responsibilities Backend & Platform Engineering Build, extend, and maintain the backend services and platform logic that power Typewiser. Write clean, tested, maintainable code, and contribute to the overall health of the codebase. Implement features end-to-end, from data layer through to API, in collaboration with the CTO. LLM & AI Pipeline Work Develop and integrate the LLM-driven pipelines at the core of the product, including prompting strategies, orchestration, structured outputs, and RAG and validation layers. Integrate and evaluate third-party AI models and APIs, balancing quality, latency, and cost. Help build the tooling and evaluation needed to keep AI-driven features reliable and reproducible. Infrastructure & Deployment Set up, maintain, and improve our deployment pipelines, infrastructure, and environments. Handle the operational side of running the platform: CI/CD, monitoring, and keeping things stable and secure. Frontend & Full-Stack Contribute to the frontend and deliver full-stack features as needed, ensuring a coherent experience from interface to backend. Collaborate on the product’s UI where engineering and design meet. Qualifications Required: 5 to 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrable full-stack breadth. Strong backend engineering skills, with proficiency in Python (our primary backend language). Hands-on experience integrating and working with LLMs or other AI/ML models in production, including prompt engineering. Working experience with frontend development and modern web frameworks. Practical experience with infrastructure, deployment, and DevOps practices (CI/CD, cloud environments, containerisation). A genuine generalist mindset: comfortable owning a problem across the entire stack rather than a single layer. C1-level proficiency in English. items.desc: AI Engineer (GenAI & Agentic AI) – Financial Services Workflows International Tech Co Birmingham, UK (Onsite) Full-time Role Overview International Tech Co is hiring hands-on AI Engineers to build enterprise-grade GenAI and Agentic AI solutions for complex financial-services workflows. You will focus on AI-assisted exception classification, triage, root-cause analysis, impact assessment, workflow orchestration, and remediation across large-scale transaction and data-processing environments. This role requires strong Python, SQL, API, and software-engineering fundamentals, plus practical experience building LLM and agentic AI applications with controls, reliability, and auditability in mind. What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities) - Build AI workflows for exception classification, triage, root-cause analysis, impact assessment, and remediation recommendations. - Develop agentic workflows including orchestration, tool​/​function calling, state management, and human-in-the-loop validation. - Correlate new exceptions with historical issues, known root causes, business rules, and transaction​/​data attributes. - Build Python and SQL-based services to query, transform, and analyze structured enterprise datasets. - Integrate AI applications with enterprise APIs, databases, workflow​/​ticketing platforms, and internal data sources. - Develop reusable tools and services that AI agents can invoke for retrieval, investigation, analysis, and workflow execution. - Apply RAG​/​context retrieval to search regulatory documents, historical knowledge, and issue repositories where needed. - Implement confidence scoring, validation, guardrails, traceability, and audit-ready evidence for AI-generated outcomes. - Build backend services and APIs using Python and FastAPI. - Implement testing, logging, evaluation, observability, exception handling, and production engineering best practices. - Collaborate with AI engineers, architects, business analysts, data engineers, and application teams. Minimum Qualifications (Must-Have) - Strong​/​expert Python skills with solid software-engineering fundamentals (Git, code quality, testing, production readiness). - Strong SQL and data analysis skills, including complex relational queries and working with structured enterprise datasets. - Strong hands-on experience building GenAI​/​LLM applications for real workflows (not only demos). - Hands-on experience implementing agentic AI workflows with orchestration, tool​/​function calling, and state management. - Strong experience building and integrating APIs, including Python​/​FastAPI services and REST​/​JSON integrations. - Proven ability to solve ambiguous problems and perform root-cause analysis across data, systems, and process context. Agentic AI Experience (Required) - Hands-on experience with at least one agent​/​workflow orchestration framework such as LangGraph, Google ADK, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or an equivalent custom framework. - Ability to implement patterns such as Input → Classification → Tool​/​Data Retrieval → Investigation → Reasoning → Validation → Action. Data & Integration Experience (Required) - Experience working with structured transaction, event, or operational data in enterprise environments. - Experience integrating across multiple data sources and systems, including workflow​/​ticketing data and historical issue​/​event repositories. - Comfort handling incomplete, inconsistent, or changing enterprise data and building resilient correlation logic. GenAI Controls, Safety, and Quality (Required) - Experience implementing confidence-based or known-vs-unknown classification approaches. - Working knowledge of RAG​/​semantic matching and contextual retrieval. - Working knowledge of LLM​/​agent evaluation, output validation, and guardrails. - Ability to design deterministic + LLM hybrid workflows with traceability and audit trails. - Familiarity with observability practices for AI systems (logging, metrics, evaluation runs, error analysis). Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Have) - Financial-services domain exposure (preferred but not mandatory), including regulatory reporting, capital markets, trade lifecycle, post-trade processing, transaction reporting, reconciliations, exception management, risk, or controls. - Familiarity with regulations such as EMIR, MiFID II, or SFTR. - Exposure to cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure). What Success Looks Like - You rapidly build working prototypes that connect to real enterprise data and systems and then harden them into reliable services. - You produce agentic workflows that are controllable, testable, observable, and safe for enterprise use with human-in-the-loop gates. - You deliver measurable improvements in exception classification accuracy, investigation speed, and remediation consistency with clear auditability. International Tech Co is an equal opportunity employer. Please get in touch on info@projectbrains.io

(Les “B Corp” formant une communauté de sociétés qui ont décidé d’être non pas les meilleures du monde mais les meilleures POUR le monde). Parce que notre développement repose sur des principes forts : Un profond respect de l’ensemble de nos parties prenantes : consultant(e)s, clients et fournisseurs. Car si le travail “ne fait pas le bonheur”, il peut cependant “faire le malheur”. Nous nous engageons donc à écouter et agir avec honnêteté. Une égalité des chances dans le traitement de nos candidatures et dans la gestion de carrière de nos salarié(e)s. Nous croyons en un milieu de travail où équité F/H, inclusion et diversité sont la norme. Une empreinte environnementale minimale, et sociétale maximale. C’est pourquoi, au-delà des missions que vous réaliserez, vous pourrez également contribuer à des projets que Davidson soutient : missions de solidarité internationale (avec Planète Urgence), bénévolat auprès d’associations (chaque Davidsonien(ne) dispose de 3 jours par an pour intervenir à leurs côtés), accompagnement d’étudiant(e)s issus de milieux peu favorisés (avec Article 1), investissement dans des startups développant des solutions innovantes, actions collectives et individuelles pour la réduction de notre impact carbone… Un Management adhocratique basé sur la mise en œuvre des principes de “l’entreprise horizontale” et du “management tribal”. Sur ce dernier point une précision d’importance : le bien-être au travail est un luxe qu’il faut pouvoir s’offrir en étant une entreprise “solide”. Ceci induit pour les Davidsonien(ne)s d’allier prises d’initiative, engagement et professionnalisme. Car “sans travail, le talent n’est qu’une sale manie”. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. Location: Madrid for an onboarding period of 2 years and a possible relocation to Munich after. Customer base will be in Germany/DACH area, involving travel to meet clients in person. Role Description As an (AI) Solution Consultant you are pushing the envelope in solving business-critical problems for our customers. You are part of our Value Engineering team and are the trusted advisor for customers working on the intersection of technology and business. You will be working with our most strategic customers, understanding their objectives and key challenges, and building Celonis solutions using the world’s leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with the largest AI and ML technology partners, such as Microsoft, OpenAI and Databricks. With Celonis’ Process Intelligence (PI) platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers’ business and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. There is no AI without PI. During the Orbit Graduate program, you will be joining the Global VE Center of Excellence which is an international, diverse, and dynamic organization at the core of the Celonis Value Engineering team supporting our local field teams. As a team, we enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and share a sense of belonging to an international community that wants to learn and grow together. The team culture is one based on building trust, continuous development, and improvement through coaching & mentoring. This program offers a unique blend of client engagements, dedicated mentorship, and a strong team culture where collaboration and shared success are paramount. You'll leverage your technical background to develop essential skills, build lasting client relationships, and establish yourself as a trusted advisor, paving the way for significant career growth within Celonis. Your journey begins with comprehensive onboarding and enablement, followed by hands-on experience in customer engagements and targeted training. items.desc: **We only consider candidates based out of the Netherlands for this role.** Title: Junior AI Engineer Company: FRISS Location: Utrecht, the Netherlands Workplace type: Hybrid (1 to 2 days per week at the Utrecht office) Employment type: Full-time Seniority level: Entry level About FRISS FRISS builds fraud detection, claims automation, and underwriting risk software for P&C insurers. Our software helps carriers settle honest claims faster and send the suspicious ones to the investigators who need to see them. About the role Fraud hides in the details: a claim description that doesn't add up, or a pattern no single file shows. Our ML team builds the AI that finds those signals and helps investigators act on them: models that detect fraud in claims and unstructured text, AI agents that support fraud investigators, and explanations that show why a claim was flagged. As a Junior AI Engineer, you help build, test, and run these machine learning and generative AI features. Senior engineers in the team mentor you as you take AI features from prototype to production on Azure, and you grow into a fully independent engineer. The team builds with Claude Code as part of its daily engineering work. What you will do Build and improve fraud detection features using ML models, LLMs, and AI Agents (prompting, RAG, tool use) with senior engineers Write clean, tested Python code and contribute to shared agent and LLM components Build evaluation datasets and automated tests for the quality and groundedness of LLM outputs Support the deployment of AI services in Azure (Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, containerized APIs) through CI/CD pipelines Help monitor AI services in production (logs, traces, latency, cost) and fix issues Prepare and analyze data, including unstructured text such as claim descriptions, in line with privacy (GDPR) and security practices Document your work and share findings with the team and product stakeholders What you bring An MSc in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field 0 to 2 years of experience with ML or LLM applications; internships, thesis, and personal projects count Good knowledge of Python, Git, writing tests, and REST APIs (for example FastAPI); SQL is a plus A solid understanding of ML fundamentals and of how LLMs work (prompting, embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation) Hands-on experience with at least one of: OpenAI or Azure OpenAI APIs, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face Transformers, PyTorch, or scikit-learn Curiosity, eagerness to learn, and openness to feedback; you take ownership and work well in a team Excellent communication skills in English Nice to have Exposure to Azure: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure Machine Learning Basic experience with Docker and CI/CD (for example Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions) Experience evaluating LLM outputs or using observability tooling for AI applications Experience with AI coding assistants such as Claude Code Interest in insurance, fraud detection, or financial crime What we offer €3,000 to €4,000 gross per month Holiday allowance, pension, training budget Hybrid working: 1 to 2 days per week at the office in Utrecht An international team and setting, with English as the working language Mentoring from senior engineers, and AI work that runs in production for insurers

O teu dia a dia e responsabilidades vão ser compostos por: Desenhar, desenvolver e operar soluções de Inteligência Artificial baseadas em LLMs e Agentic AI; Implementar arquiteturas multi-agent e soluções de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG); Desenvolver integrações com APIs e plataformas líderes de IA; Participar em iniciativas de investigação, inovação e experimentação em GenAI; Colaborar com equipas multidisciplinares na conceção de soluções tecnológicas inovadoras; Contribuir para a evolução de plataformas e aceleradores de Inteligência Artificial; Participar em projetos nacionais e internacionais com foco em transformação digital. Licenciatura ou Mestrado em Engenharia Informática ou áreas similares; Entre 2 a 5 anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de soluções de Inteligência Artificial; Experiência em Python e frameworks de AI como LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI ou equivalentes; Conhecimentos de RAG, Vector Databases, Semantic Retrieval Platforms, MCP e Function Calling; Experiência com plataformas como OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini ou AWS Bedrock; Forte capacidade analítica, orientação para inovação e resolução de problemas; Capacidade para trabalhar em equipas multidisciplinares e comunicar com diferentes stakeholders; Domínio da língua inglesa, falada e escrita. items.desc: Company Description We believe in the power of ingenuity to build a positive human future. As strategies, technologies, and innovation collide, we create opportunity from complexity. Our teams of interdisciplinary experts combine innovative thinking and breakthrough technologies to progress further, faster. Our clients adapt and transform, and together we achieve enduring results. We are over 4,000 strategists, innovators, designers, consultants, digital experts, scientists, engineers, and technologists. And we have deep expertise in consumer and manufacturing, defence and security, energy and utilities, financial services, government and public services, health and life sciences, and transport. Our teams operate globally from offices across the UK, Ireland, US, Nordics, and Netherlands. PA. Bringing Ingenuity to Life. Job Description Hybrid working - our approach is to be in the office a minimum of 2 days per week. PA’s IT team, internally known as Group Systems, is comprised of a variety of areas that support the wider firm, consisting of four key pillars: Strategy, Architecture and Infrastructure Services; Enterprise Solutions; Technology and Operations ; and Cyber Security and Compliance . The successful candidate will be covered two primary areas: the security of AI (protecting the organisation's own AI systems and use of AI) and AI for security (using AI to strengthen protection, detection and response). This role will sit within Cyber Security and Compliance. Technical ownership of AI security tool selection and deployment Define requirements, run structured evaluations and proofs of concept, and judge vendor claims on evidence rather than marketing. That means measuring detection efficacy, false positive rates, latency and operational overhead. The tool categories to cover include AI security posture management, LLM guardrails and firewalls, model and supply-chain scanning, GenAI data loss prevention, and AI-enabled SOC tooling. They should also own the deployment itself: integration with existing SIEM, SOAR, EDR and identity tooling, architecture decisions, and making sure the tools are tuned and producing value after go-live rather than becoming shelfware. Input to vendor risk assessments fits here too, particularly on how vendors handle your data in their own models. Understanding the AI threat landscape They need a working knowledge of AI-specific attack techniques and should be fluent in the reference frameworks, mainly the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS. Key threats include: Direct and indirect prompt injection Data and model poisoning Sensitive data leakage through prompts and outputs Model theft and extraction Malicious model files in the supply chain The growing set of risks from agentic AI, such as excessive permissions and tool misuse They also need to understand how attackers use AI against the organisation (more convincing phishing, deepfake-enabled fraud, faster reconnaissance and exploit development) and how that changes your threat model. Shadow AI, meaning unsanctioned use of AI tools by staff, is a practical, near-term issue they should be able to discover and manage. Demonstrating AI in protection, detection and response This is where the role earns its keep with stakeholders. In protection, that might mean AI-assisted vulnerability prioritisation, secure code review, or posture analysis. In detection, it covers behavioural anomaly detection, alert triage and enrichment, and LLM-assisted threat hunting. In response, it includes AI copilots for investigation and incident summarisation, automated playbooks, and agentic response actions. A good candidate will be clear-eyed about limits: where human-in-the-loop controls are needed, how to validate AI outputs, and how to avoid automating mistakes at speed. The ability to build or run demonstrators that show value concretely is a strong differentiator. Assurance and testing The role should include adversarial testing and red teaming of the organisation's AI systems, whether done directly or by scoping and overseeing third parties. Examples are testing RAG applications for injection and data exposure, or checking that an agent can't be manipulated into acting outside its intended permissions. Alignment with governance and standards This isn't primarily a governance role, but the engineer should translate frameworks into technical controls and evidence. The relevant reference points are: NCSC's Guidelines for Secure AI System Development The UK government's AI Cyber Security Code of Practice NIST AI RMF ISO/IEC 42001 The EU AI Act, where relevant to clients or operations Qualifications Skills and background The ideal profile is a security engineer (typically from cloud security, security architecture, or SOC engineering) who has built genuine ML and LLM literacy. That means understanding how models, RAG pipelines and agents work, reasonable Python or scripting ability, and cloud platform experience. Communication …

Unser Ansatz ist anders: KI-gestützte Werkzeuge übernehmen Discovery, Routine-Analysen und Mustererkennung – unsere Berater:innen validieren, interpretieren und konzentrieren sich auf Strategie und maßgeschneiderte Lösungen. Das ergibt tiefere Analysen und belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlagen in kürzerer Zeit, bei 40–60 % weniger Aufwand für Routinearbeit. KI nur mit höchster Sensibilität für Kundendaten: Datenschutz steht über jedem Effizienzgewinn. KI ausschließlich auf vertraglich abgesicherten, datenschutzkonformen Plattformen, minimierte und anonymisierte Daten, niemals Kundendaten im Modelltraining. Diesen Umgang – und die Bereitschaft, unsere Prozesse und Produkte kontinuierlich mit KI weiterzuentwickeln – erwarten wir von allen Berater:innen. Schwerpunkt dieser Rolle ist Detection Engineering: SIEM- und XDR-Plattformen, Log-Qualität, Detectionas-Code und Automatisierung – sicher in KQL, Sigma und MITRE ATT&CK. items.desc: Remora Robotics AS Dusavikveien 39, 4007 Stavanger Om jobben Lagre favoritt Type ansettelse Fast, heltid 100% Antall stillinger 1 Arbeidsspråk Engelsk Mulighet for hjemmekontor Delvis hjemmekontor Can you design a robot that works in the sea around the clock, through currents, corrosion, biofouling and the occasional curious salmon? Remora Robotics is looking for a senior mechanical design engineer to strengthen our R&D team and help take our underwater robots to the next level. About the role At Remora Robotics, we build autonomous underwater robots operating at commercial scale in one of the world’s most demanding industries - aquaculture. Our robots continuously clean and inspect fish farm nets, combining robotics, autonomy, AI, computer vision, and real-world operations into one integrated platform. We are now developing the next generation of our robots, and we’re looking for an experienced mechanical engineer who can turn ideas into robust hardware and help the hardware team deliver on its plans. You will join a small R&D team where your experience will be valued and your input will help shape both what we build and how we build it. You’ll work closely with electronics, software and our field operations team, and your designs will be tested at sea, not just in CAD. What you will work on Mechanical design of underwater robots, from early concepts and creative solutions to detailed CAD and complete assemblies. Pressure-rated housings, sealing solutions and structures built to survive long-term operation at sea. Material selection and tolerance analysis for components exposed to seawater, corrosion and continuous operation. Strength and structural analysis, including rotating parts, shafts, bearings and motor integration. Design for manufacturing and assembly, choosing the right production methods and working with suppliers. Technical drawings, documentation and revision control for prototypes and production. Planning and following up prototyping, testing and validation, coordinating priorities across the hardware team, and making sure projects reach their goals on time. Taking designs all the way from prototype to stable production. We are looking for someone who Has several years of experience with mechanical design and product development, ideally including products that went into production. Has strong CAD skills, including assemblies and production-ready drawings, and good habits around documentation and revision control. Knows a range of production methods and designs with manufacturability and cost in mind. Has experience with material selection, tolerance analysis, and structural and strength calculations. Can take a concept to a working prototype within tight timelines, balancing quality, speed and cost. Has experience leading hardware projects, with responsibility for planning, priorities and follow-up across disciplines. Brings structure and overview, and naturally takes responsibility for keeping the team aligned on priorities. Shares knowledge and supports colleagues, and values input from those with field experience. Has a degree in mechanical engineering, product development or a related field. It’s a plus if you have experience with Subsea or marine equipment, especially pressure testing and sealing Underwater or field robotics FEA and simulation tools Electromechanical design, such as motors, thrusters or actuators Additive manufacturing We offer An important role in a small, skilled team where you get to see your designs go from sketch to robots operating at sea. Work on autonomous robots operating in the real world, with all the fun challenges that brings. A company with strong momentum, ambitious goals and global potential. Office in Stavanger with easy access to our workshop and test facilities. Om bedriften At Remora Robotics, we build autonomous underwater robots operating at commercial scale in one of the world’s most demanding industries - aquaculture. Our robots continuously clean and inspect fish farm nets, combining robotics, autonomy, AI, computer vision, and real-world operations into one integrated platform. We develop both the hardware and software powering our systems. From embedded software and cloud infrastructure to AI-driven inspection and real-time operations, we are building the next generation of autonomous subsea robotics. items.desc: At 5Plus (part of Pentadoc Group), we build production-grade AI systems that solve real operational problems for our customers. As a AI Engineer (m/f/d), you will take technical responsibility for customer-facing AI solutions — from early design decisions to production deployment and operation. You will design, build, and operate AI applications ranging from LLM-powered workflows (e.g., intelligent document processing, RAG systems) to agentic AI systems that are actively used in customer environments. German language skills at C1 level and above are mandatory for this role. You’ll work closely with customers and internal engineers to translate ambiguous requirements into reliable, scalable systems and guide AI-driven product development within customer projects. This role is hybrid , with predominantly remote work and occasional on-site presence at customer locations across Germany and our office in Würzburg, Bavaria. Your profile Several years (3–6) of hands-on experience building and operating AI/ML systems in real-world projects . Solid experience implementing agents on the LangChain stack ( LangGraph , DeepAgents ) in Python , including FastAPI interfaces. Experience with AWS (e.g. ECS , CDK , …) Strong Python expertise ( app. 5 years) and experience with modern AI/LLM tooling; framework-agnostic mindset. Proven experience with LLM-based systems (e.g., RAG, embeddings, tool usage) and an understanding of trade-offs between quality, cost, latency, and complexity. Ability to work independently in customer-facing environments , taking ownership of technical decisions under uncertainty. Professional communication skills in customer contexts. Residence in Germany . Bonus points to score Deeper experience with agentic architectures (planning, memory, multi-agent coordination). Contributions to open-source projects, technical writing, or applied research. Your daily business Design and ship end-to-end AI systems, from prototype to production. Build LLM-powered applications (incl. RAG, tool usage, validations) with a focus on reliability and cost-efficiency. Develop and operate agentic AI systems (e.g., planning, tool orchestration, multi-step workflows) with clearly defined safety and integrations into customers’ systems. Define evaluation strategies (offline + online), including metrics, benchmarks, and monitoring. Optimize system performance across latency, cost, and quality. Take technical leadership within customer project teams , coordinating architecture, implementation, and iteration cycles. Act as a technical point of contact for customers , explaining trade-offs and guiding solution decisions. Work directly with customers and internal teams to turn ambiguous, real-world problems into concrete AI solutions. Contribute to architectural decisions and support less-experienced engineers through technical guidance (no people management). Some of your benefits at 5Plus Real ownership: Build and own AI solutions that go live quickly! Small, experienced team with fast decision-making . Flexible working hours and freedom to choose your workplace . Learning budget and support for conferences and publications . Pentadoc Group offers additional benefits, feel free to check out everything. To plan an initial conversation quickly, please make sure your application contains all relevant documentation and information, you'd like to share with us. We look forward to meeting you!

Det här är inte en roll med fokus på förvaltning. Du får vara med och bygga nytt, testa idéer och bidra till hur vi använder AI och ny teknik i vår produktutveckling. Du arbetar nära verksamhet, kunder och andra specialistroller och får goda möjligheter att påverka både lösningar och arbetssätt. Du arbetar tillsammans med verksamhet, kunder och andra specialistroller för att förstå behov och omsätta dem till användbara tekniska lösningar. Vi arbetar idag brett med produktivitetsverktyg och AI-relaterade initiativ i flera delar av organisationen. Nu samlar vi dessa satsningar i ett gemensamt team för att accelerera utvecklingen av både interna verktyg, arbetssät och nya funktioner som skapar värde för våra kunder. Du kommer bland annat att: Utveckla moderna mjukvaruprodukter där AI är en viktig del av lösningen Arbeta med integration av AI-tjänster, API, verktyg och affärsprocesser Utforska nya möjligheter inom AI, testa idéer och omsätta dem till praktiska lösningar för kunder och användare Bidra till tekniska vägval, systemdesign och utvecklingen av våra arbetssätt Arbeta med moderna utvecklingsmetoder, automatiserad testning och CI/CD Dela med dig av din erfarenhet och bidra till kunskapsdelning och teknisk utveckling i teamet Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling och ett stort intresse för hur AI kan användas för att utveckla bättre produkter och arbetssätt. items.desc: This role is with one of Dex's trusted partner companies. We work closely with their teams to truly understand their culture, goals, and what they're looking for, so we can match you with the right opportunity and give you context about the role before you commit to a process. If you're interested sign up to Dex to apply. Dex is an AI recruiter agent that helps you run your job search. Tell Dex your stack, seniority, and what you want to build. We will manage your applications and surface other opportunities that are a fit. The role Most robotics simulation still relies on engines built for video games or legacy CPU physics packages never designed for massive parallelisation. This Cambridge-based startup, backed by leading VCs with a long runway and founded by veteran architects who spent over a decade building physics engines at a major semiconductor giant, is rewriting the simulation and learning stack for modern robotics from the ground up. They are a lean, deeply technical team of eleven working alongside live humanoid and quadruped hardware. You will lead the hands-on development of the core simulation and engine infrastructure, coding alongside founders who still commit engine code daily. This is a senior IC anchor seat, not an ivory-tower management track: the on-site engineering team is early-career and needs a senior systems engineer in the room to review, unblock, and mentor. If you want layers of middle management and abstracted ticket-shuffling, this is not it; if you want to write modern C++ close to the hardware and watch your simulation train physical robots in the lab, it is. The work Architect and implement the core GPU-accelerated simulation engine powering massive-scale robot learning pipelines. Write, profile, and tune performance-critical modern C++ where throughput and execution speed directly dictate training viability. Bridge the engine to real-world edge hardware, validating simulation fidelity against in-house humanoid and quadruped robots. Act as the senior technical anchor on site—setting engineering standards, unblocking complex bugs, and mentoring early-career engineers through pairing and rigorous code reviews. What You Bring Deep expertise in modern C++ with a track record of shipping performance-critical, low-level systems where speed and determinism are the product. Direct experience building or working deep inside physics engines, game engines, or comparably complex systems close to the silicon. Demonstrated seniority through mentoring earlier-career engineers, levelling up the room via pairing, rigorous code reviews, and clear technical guidance. Comfort debating technical trade-offs openly and iterating directly alongside highly technical, code-writing founders. Based in or able to relocate to Cambridge, UK, to work fully on site with the lab and robotics hardware every day. Why apply through Dex Exceptional low-level systems roles in robotics simulation are scarce, often masked by generic game-dev or robotics listings, and run by founders with a razor-thin tolerance for superficial code. Applying through Dex cuts out cold outreach and puts your systems depth directly in front of technical decision-makers. We brief you thoroughly on the underlying architecture and the team before you ever enter the room. items.desc: About Chrono24 is the world’s leading online marketplace for luxury watches, connecting buyers and sellers from over 80 countries. We’re a fast-growing international tech company headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, with a passionate team that puts our customers first every day. As AI Solution Engineer, you help teams across Chrono24 turn everyday manual work into working AI-powered automations. You sit close to the business, partnering with non-technical departments across the company, from Growth and Marketing to Finance, People & Culture and beyond, to discover where AI can remove effort, and you build the solution together with them. You are the bridge between a business problem and a working solution. You bring both sides together: business understanding to see what a team really needs, and technical skill to build it. You consult on what's possible, scope it, and build quick, practical automations and proofs-of-concept using existing AI models and tooling. You build on the tools, integrations and platform that the Tool Enablement team provides, and you partner with the Machine Learning team whenever a solution is ready to scale, move into monitored production, or needs deeper engineering. What you can expect Consult and partner with commercial teams: Sit with non-technical departments to understand their processes, surface high-value automation opportunities, and shape solutions together with them. Build practical automations and POCs: Connect existing tools and LLMs into working workflows fast, to prove value before anything scales. Know our systems: Understand which internal systems and data a use case needs, judge what has to be made accessible, and articulate the requirement clearly (via APIs and, ideally, MCP). Enable teams to help themselves: Hand over working first versions and equip teams to run, adjust, and maintain simple solutions themselves. Know when to hand off: Recognize when a use case needs the ML team (scaling, self-hosting, cost or quality optimization, monitored production), Tool Enablement (tools, integrations) or IT (server infrastructure, access and security), and route it cleanly. Work in the open: Collaborate closely with the ML team, Tool Enablement and IT, whose use-case knowledge and infrastructure this role builds on. What sets you apart A blend of business and technical understanding: With a minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience you combine solid business sense with a hands-on technical foundation, for example a information systems or computer science background or a comparable mix of experience. Solid programming fundamentals: You build working MVPs yourself, wiring existing tools, LLMs and integrations into working solutions at a practical, not production-grade, level. Applied AI experience: Hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering in real use cases (Claude, GPT or similar), not just experimenting. Integration awareness: A working understanding of APIs, HTTP/JSON and, ideally, MCP, enough to connect tools and judge what data and access a solution needs. You get up to speed fast on the tools and systems our teams use day to day, so you can advise them credibly and spot where AI fits. Enabling communicator: you explain options clearly to non-technical stakeholders, translate fluently between business and technical worlds, and shape solutions together with the teams. Strong, direct communication is core to the role. Ownership: you spot opportunities, scope them, and bring a first version to life without waiting for tickets. Challenges the status quo: You question how work gets done today and look for where AI can meaningfully change the process. Language: Very good German and English skills. Out of scope (so expectations are clear) Training or fine-tuning models: this role uses existing models in a deployment setup; it does not build them. Building and owning infrastructure, platforms, or self-hosted models: provided by Tool Enablement, IT / ML. Long-term, monitored, scaled production systems: handed to the ML team once a use case grows beyond a POC. What we offer A strategically important role with real room to shape and build. A dynamic, international company with leading Private Equity involvement. A modern work environment with flexible hours and hybrid working options. A benefits app with a monthly allowance of €80 for sports, childcare, or flexible mobility. Free lunch to keep you energized and bring the team together. A permanent employment contract with long-term development opportunities. 30 days of annual leave. Additional paid time off on December 24 and December 31. Option to work up to 20 days per year from abroad. About Us JOIN US NOW! We stand for a dynamic company culture with flat hierarchies and strong team spirit. We are growing fast - and love pushing beyond our limits. By actively shaping our future, we create an inspiring and attractive work environment. Do you want to be part of it? Then apply now and become a valuable member of …

items.card: Aufgaben Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer Teststrategie für Conversational AI, GenAI und Automationslösungen (Testpyramide, Quality Gates, Releasekriterien) Aufbau eines AI Test Harness inkl. Golden Datasets/Conversations, automatisierter Regression und relevanter Qualitätsmetriken Sicherstellung von Security & Robustness (z. B. Prompt Injection, Data Leakage, Rollen-/Rechtekonzepte) Durchführung spezifischer Tests
items.desc: Stellenbeschreibung Wir bauen ein neues Team für große Umsetzungsvorhaben im Umfeld von Conversational und Generative AI Initiativen bei unseren Kunden auf. Als AI QA Engineer übernimmst du Verantwortung für eines proaktives Quality Engineering und die Testaktivitäten für entsprechende Lösungen in deinen Projekten. GenAI Qualität ist mehr als „Testfälle grün“: Bei CGI sorgst du dafür, dass Chat- und Voicebots sowie agentische GenAI Workflows verlässlich, sicher und nachvollziehbar funktionieren – auch dann, wenn sie in Workflow Engines und RPA Automationen eingebettet sind. Du definierst Teststrategien, baust Evaluations- und Regressions-Setups, testest Robustheit und stellst Produktionsreife mit klaren Qualitätsmetriken sicher. Dir sind die besonderen Qualitätsanforderungen an KI-basierte Systeme bekannt und du stellst sicher, dass regulatorische Vorgaben von Anfang an in Design, Architektur und Entwicklung mit einfließen. Aufgaben Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer Teststrategie für Conversational AI, GenAI und Automationslösungen (Testpyramide, Quality Gates, Releasekriterien) Aufbau eines AI Test Harness inkl. Golden Datasets/Conversations, automatisierter Regression und relevanter Qualitätsmetriken Sicherstellung von Security & Robustness (z. B. Prompt Injection, Data Leakage, Rollen-/Rechtekonzepte) Durchführung spezifischer Tests für Voice (Robustheit, Latenz, Handover) sowie End-to-End-Tests über GenAI-, Workflow- und RPA-Komponenten Integration von Testautomatisierung in CI/CD sowie Berücksichtigung von Monitoring- und Betriebsanforderungen Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering, Architektur und Fachbereichen zur Definition von Akzeptanzkriterien und Begleitung von Releases Qualifikation Mehrjährige Erfahrung in QA/Testmanagement und/oder Testautomatisierung in agilen & klassischen Umfeldern Kenntnis von KI-spezifischen Qualitätsmerkmalen und zugehörigen Testmöglichkeiten und -verfahren Know-how für Testautomation mit z. B. Selenium und API-Tests sowie Script Coding Skills für z.B. Python/JS/Java Verständnis für GenAI Spezifika: Prompting, RAG, Tool Calling, Guardrails/Evaluation Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, analytisches Denken, Kommunikationsstärke Deutsch sehr gut, Englisch gut Nice to have: ISTQB Zertifizierungen wie TTA/TAE, Erfahrung mit Workflow Automation Testing, RPA Testing, Cloud Testing Was wir dir bieten Bei uns findest du Kolleg:innen, mit denen die Zusammenarbeit Spaß macht. Wir begegnen uns offen, duzen uns über alle Positionen hinweg und denken nicht in Hierarchien oder Silos. Du arbeitest meist direkt an deinem Heimatort – weil wir Kundennähe wörtlich nehmen und uns Work-Life-Balance am Herzen liegt. Du profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und hast je nach Kundensituation die Möglichkeit, von zuhause zu arbeiten. Die richtigen Trainings und Zertifikate bringen deine Weiterbildung voran. Unsere E-Learning-Plattform Academia ermöglicht dir das Lernen, wo und wann du willst. Einen Teil deines Bruttogehalts kannst du in CGI Aktien investieren – bis maximal 3 % des Monatsgehalts geben wir für jeden Euro einen weiteren hinzu. Außerdem beteiligen wir dich am Unternehmenserfolg: Du erhältst eine Gewinnbeteiligung, die sich nach deiner individuellen Leistung richtet, sowie danach, wie wir als Unternehmen unsere finanziellen Ziele erreichen konnten. Mit Jobticket und Jobbike fördern wir umweltfreundliche Mobilität. Abhängig von deiner Rolle und Projektsituation sind auch Bahncard oder Elektro-Firmenwagen möglich. Sabbatical oder Elternzeit werden unterstützt. Sie sind bei uns kein Karriere-Stopper! Wir sind an deiner Seite, auch wenn es einmal nicht so gut läuft: Du kannst Sonderurlaub nehmen, und unsere Beratungshotline steht dir immer zur Verfügung. Eine Vielzahl an gemeinsamen Events und Freizeitaktivitäten stärkt deine Verbundenheit mit deinen Kolleg:innen. Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action. 1976 gegründet und nach wie vor familiengeführt, ist CGI heute einer der weltweit größten unabhängigen Anbieter von IT und Business Consulting. Ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, Teamwork, Respekt und Zusammenhalt machen das Arbeiten bei uns besonders. Bei uns kannst du dein volles Potenzial entfalten! Du darfst dich vom ersten Tag an als Miteigentümer:in von CGI verstehen. Wir lassen unsere Vision gemeinsam Wirklichkeit werden. Wir profitieren von unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg und haben die Möglichkeit und die Verantwortung, die Strategie und Ausrichtung unseres Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten. Deine Arbeit schafft Mehrwert. Du findest innovative Lösungen und stärkst dein Netzwerk aus Kolleg:innen und Kunden. Gleichzeitig hast du Zugang zu globalen Ressourcen, um große Ideen zu verwirklichen, neue Chancen zu nutzen und von der immensen Branchen- und Technologie-Kompetenz zu profitieren. SIXT Data Shop You collaborate cross-functionally with Data Engineers, BI Analysts, and Data Scientists to architect optimal solutions for diverse analytical use cases, including dashboarding, ad hoc transformation pipelines feeding into Redshift AI Proficiency You have hands-on experience with AI coding assistants and agentic workflow automation, and ideally a solid understanding of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems and how to leverage LLMs with contextual data Engineering Excellence You apply strong engineering best practices across the full development lifecycle —
