What We Offer AI Grant — Stop talking about AI and start building it. Our AI Grant gives you dedicated budget and resources to turn your wildest AI idea into a working project, backed by two paid weeks to focus on
items.desc: Most AI initiatives stall somewhere between a promising prototype and a system that actually runs in production. We need an architect who closes that gap — someone who can look at a client’s problem, design a solution that makes technical sense, estimate what it will take to build, and then stay involved long enough to make sure it ships. You’ll work across both generative and classical AI pipelines — knowledge-grounded AI systems, agent frameworks, model serving, and data infrastructure on the GenAI side, alongside prediction, recommendation, and optimization models where they’re the right tool for the job. You’ll also be client-facing: leading technical conversations, pulling apart RFPs, scoping projects, and being honest about what’s feasible and what isn’t. This role requires deep fluency in at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and the judgment to know when a simpler solution is the better one. You will report directly to the Head of AI. Expect a roughly 50/50 split between hands-on technical leadership on active projects and preparing new engagements — scoping, estimating, and shaping proposals. What We Offer AI Grant — Stop talking about AI and start building it. Our AI Grant gives you dedicated budget and resources to turn your wildest AI idea into a working project, backed by two paid weeks to focus on nothing else. AI Center of Excellence — Work alongside specialists in agentic AI, sovereign AI, generative and discriminative AI. This isn’t a siloed team — it’s the people you’ll learn from and build with daily. Your tools, your choice — Full access to AI-powered development tools including Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. Pick what works best for you. Real project variety — From generative AI for legal document compliance, through agentic systems in manufacturing environments, to enterprise-scale AI platforms, computer vision, and autonomous driving. You won’t get bored. Conference and speaking support — Want to attend conferences? We’ll back you. Want to speak at them? Even better — we’ll support you with dedicated preparation time and bonuses. Your tasks Lead client-facing engagements — discovery sessions, technical workshops, architecture presentations — and translate business problems into well-defined AI solution specifications Analyze RFP/RFI documents, assess feasibility, and build technical proposals including architecture diagrams, delivery timelines, team composition, and cost breakdowns Scope and estimate AI projects end-to-end — from data readiness and infrastructure needs through cloud costs and ongoing operational expenses Design end-to-end architectures for generative and classical AI systems: knowledge-grounded AI, agentic workflows, multi-model orchestration, and hybrid search solutions Make and defend technology choices — foundation models, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, inference infrastructure — matching each to the problem, not the hype Define MLOps/LLMOps practices and data pipelines: CI/CD for models and prompts, evaluation pipelines, chunking strategies, embedding generation, and drift monitoring Lead technical design reviews, produce architecture decision records, and mentor engineers on AI engineering best practices Requirements At least 10 years in software/data/ML engineering, with at least 3 years focused on AI/ML architecture at scale Deep, production-level fluency in at least one major cloud AI ecosystem: Azure, AWS, or GCP Experience in client-facing roles — comfortable leading technical workshops and presenting to both C-level and engineering audiences Ability to scope and budget AI projects, including cloud cost modeling, team sizing, and delivery planning Strong hands-on skills in Python and practical experience with AI/ML frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent Practical experience building knowledge-grounded AI systems and agent architectures in production — not just prototypes Solid understanding of transformer architectures and how they affect system design decisions (context windows, latency, cost) Fluent English, both written and spoken Fluent Polish required Residing in Poland required Nice to have Experience fine-tuning LLMs (LoRA, QLoRA, RLHF/DPO) and understanding when fine-tuning is worth the investment vs. in-context learning Background in consulting, system integration, or services delivery with exposure to enterprise procurement processes Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or published technical writing Experience with graph databases for knowledge graph-augmented search and reasoning Background in classical ML — because not every problem needs an LLM Job no. JOB-9P9KG Sii ensures that all hiring decisions are made solely on the basis of qualifications and competence. We are committed to equal and fair treatment of all, regardless of legally protected characteristics. You’ll work across both generative and classical AI pipelines — knowledge-grounded AI systems, agent frameworks, model serving, and data infrastructure on the GenAI side, alongside prediction, recommendation, and optimization models where they’re the right tool for the job. You’ll also be client-facing: leading technical conversations, pulling apart RFPs, scoping projects, and being honest about what’s feasible and what isn’t. This role requires deep fluency in at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and the judgment to know when a simpler solution is the better one. You will report directly to the Head of AI. Expect a roughly 50/50 split between hands-on technical leadership on active projects and preparing new engagements — scoping, estimating, and shaping proposals. What We Offer AI Grant — Stop talking about AI and start building it. Our AI Grant gives you dedicated budget and resources to turn your wildest AI idea into a working project, backed by two paid weeks to focus on nothing else. AI Center of Excellence — Work alongside specialists in agentic AI, sovereign AI, generative and discriminative AI. This isn’t a siloed team — it’s the people you’ll learn from and build with daily. Your tools, your choice — Full access to AI-powered development tools including Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. Pick what works best for you. Real project variety — From generative AI for legal document compliance, through agentic systems in manufacturing environments, to enterprise-scale AI platforms, computer vision, and autonomous driving. You won’t get bored. Conference and speaking support — Want to attend conferences? We’ll back you. Want to speak at them? Even better — we’ll support you with dedicated preparation time and bonuses. Your tasks Lead client-facing engagements — discovery sessions, technical workshops, architecture presentations — and translate business problems into well-defined AI solution specifications Analyze RFP/RFI documents, assess feasibility, and build technical proposals including architecture diagrams, delivery timelines, team composition, and cost breakdowns Scope and estimate AI projects end-to-end — from data readiness and infrastructure needs through cloud costs and ongoing operational expenses Design end-to-end architectures for generative and classical AI systems: knowledge-grounded AI, agentic workflows, multi-model orchestration, and hybrid search solutions Make and defend technology choices — foundation models, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, inference infrastructure — matching each to the problem, not the hype Define MLOps/LLMOps practices and data pipelines: CI/CD for models and prompts, evaluation pipelines, chunking strategies, embedding generation, and drift monitoring Lead technical design reviews, produce architecture decision records, and mentor engineers on AI engineering best practices Requirements At least 10 years in software/data/ML engineering, with at least 3 years focused on AI/ML architecture at scale Deep, production-level fluency in at least one major cloud AI ecosystem: Azure, AWS, or GCP Experience in client-facing roles — comfortable leading technical workshops and presenting to both C-level and engineering audiences Ability to scope and budget AI projects, including cloud cost modeling, team sizing, and delivery planning Strong hands-on skills in Python and practical experience with AI/ML frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent Practical experience building knowledge-grounded AI systems and agent architectures in production — not just prototypes Solid understanding of transformer architectures and how they affect system design decisions (context windows, latency, cost) Fluent English, both written and spoken Fluent Polish required Residing in Poland required Nice to have Experience fine-tuning LLMs (LoRA, QLoRA, RLHF/DPO) and understanding when fine-tuning is worth the investment vs. in-context learning Background in consulting, system integration, or services delivery with exposure to enterprise procurement processes Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or published technical writing Experience with graph databases for knowledge graph-augmented search and reasoning Background in classical ML — because not every problem items.desc:
Your contribution to something big: 
 Join us in shaping the future of software engineering through Generative AI. As an AI-Assisted Software Engineering Intern, you will contribute to the development of innovative AI-powered solutions that support software engineers throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Working alongside experienced engineers, you will research, prototype, and evaluate technologies that help improve development efficiency, software quality, and developer experience.
 In this role, you will:
 Research emerging AI-assisted software engineering workflows and identify opportunities to apply Generative AI across the SDLC.
 Design and develop automated solutions using LLM APIs, prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and context-window optimization techniques.
 Support the integration of AI-powered tools into software development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud environments.
 Define and implement metrics to evaluate the impact of AI solutions on productivity, software quality, usability, and adoption.
 Collaborate with software engineers to gather feedback, validate concepts, and continuously improve developed solutions.
 Contribute through code reviews, technical documentation, demonstrations, and knowledge-sharing activities.
 Explore and evaluate emerging AI technologies and translate them into practical developer tools.
What distinguishes you? 
 Education:
 Final-year Bachelor's or Master's student, or recent graduate (less than one year), in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
 Experience:
 Initial academic, personal, or internship experience in software development or AI-related projects.
 Exposure to Generative AI technologies and modern software development practices is advantageous.
 Know-how:
 Knowledge of Python programming; experience with C or C++ is a plus.
 Familiarity with some of the following areas: LLM APIs, prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, CI/CD pipelines, cloud platforms, or AI-assisted development tools.
 Understanding of software development processes and developer workflows.
 Languages:
 Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken.
 Working Style and Methods:
 Structured and analytical approach to problem-solving.
 Ability to learn independently and experiment with new technologies.
 Interest in transforming innovative AI concepts into practical engineering solutions.
 Personality:
 Curious, proactive, and eager to learn.
 Collaborative team player with strong communication skills.
 Passionate about software engineering, emerging technologies, and continuous improvement.
 What you can expect to learn 
 How Generative AI can enhance software engineering activities across the Software Development Life Cycle.
 How to design, build, and integrate AI-powered developer tools using LLMs, RAG, AI agents, cloud services, and CI/CD platforms.
 How to measure the impact of AI solutions through meaningful metrics and developer-centric evaluations.
 How to bring innovative ideas from research and prototyping to adoption in real-world software development environments.
 How AI-driven engineering practices are applied in an international industrial environment.
 At Bosch, we value diversity and equal opportunities. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

Lieu : Lille, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Notre savoir-faire technologique
 Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs

 Votre quotidien 
Nos équipes de l'activité Systèmes de réseaux d'infrastructures sont présentes à Lambersart, site localisé à dix minutes de la métropole Lilloise, et fournissent des services et des solutions globales optimisant la performance, la résilience et la sécurité des systèmes de défense. 
 Au sein d’une direction d’ingénierie, vous intégrez l’équipe de Validation, de Qualification et Support, qui a pour mission de piloter la validation de l’ensemble des fournitures de l’ingénierie amont des infrastructures d’hébergement de type cloud ou on-premise pour nos clients. Dans un marché de niche mais de plus en plus concurrentiel, l'enjeu pour le déploiement d’infrastructures, de datacenter sécurisé est de garantir à nos clients robustesses, flexibilité, rapidité de déploiement d’Infrastructures informatiques dans un contexte de sécurité Cyber élevé tout en renforçant notre compétitivité. 
 Le poste est basé sur le site de Lambersart (59)
 Vos missions 
 En tant que stagiaire, vous participerez au projet de conception et PoC d’un outil d’aide au à la validation et tests liés aux composants produit assisté par IA A ce titre votre mission principale sera de participer à la mise en place d’une IA local contextualisé avec les documents de design qui à pour objectifs de :
 • Simplifier et automatiser de la mise en place d’un RAG
 • Automatiser l’import de documents dans le RAG
 • Connection du RAG à un agent IA 
 • Générer du code robotframework afin d’optimiser l’écriture des fiches de test
 Dans un second, temps vous pourriez également aborder l’amélioration d’un outil afin de :
 • Analyser les résultats produit par robot-framework par une IA en relation avec le « sujet 1 » ou un agent autorisé THALES
 • Automatiser la création des faits techniques associé dans l’outil de gestion projet (JIRA)
 • Importer les résultats et les FTs associé dans Polarion via les APIs mis à disposition
 Votre profil 
 De formation BAC+5, vous recherchez stage de 6 mois dans de domaine de l'informatique. 
 Vous avez les compétences suivantes :
 Bonnes bases en développement logiciel. 
 Intérêt marqué pour l 'intelligence artificielle et les LLM .
 Intérêt pour le Prompt Engineering , les AI Agents ou le RAG. 
 Les compétences suivantes seraient un plus :
 - Outils d'automatisation et de gestion de configuration d'infrastructure: Ansible 
 - Langage Python 
 - Framework de test Robot Framework 
 - Développement assisté par LLM
 - Capacité de synthèse et de rédaction documentaire

items.desc: AU QUOTIDIEN, ÇA DONNE QUOI ? Vous rejoindrez l’équipe ALMT Digital Innovations & AI de l’ALM Treasury de BNP Paribas. Notre équipe travaille à l’interface entre les métiers de la banque, la data et les nouvelles technologies d’intelligence artificielle. Nous recherchons un stagiaire souhaitant contribuer au développement de cas d’usage concrets autour de la Generative AI, des LLMs et de l’IA agentique, tout en découvrant les problématiques de l’ALM Treasury et des marchés financiers. Votre stage sera principalement orienté vers la conception et l’évaluation de solutions GenAI et agentiques, depuis la compréhension du besoin métier jusqu’à la réalisation. Vous serez amené à vous interroger sur la qualité, la sécurité, la robustesse et la capacité de passage à l’échelle dans un environnement bancaire. Vos principales missions pourront notamment être de : Concevoir et développer des solutions GenAI et agentiques capables d’exploiter des documents, base de données, outils, APIs et MCP internes pour réaliser des tâches complexes. Tester et comparer différents modèles, architectures et évaluer leur pertinence pour des problématiques concrètes de l’ALMT. Contribuer à des projets de Machine Learning appliqués aux marchés financiers : analyse de données, séries temporelles, modélisation statistique économétrique, visualisation. Vous contribuerez également à l’organisation d’un point bimensuel consacré à l’actualité des marchés financiers. L’Asset Liability Management Treasury (ALMT) est une activité transverse présente dans l’ensemble du Groupe BNP Paribas. Elle intervient notamment dans la gestion des risques de liquidité, de taux et de change du bilan de la Banque, ainsi que dans le financement et la gestion de la liquidité du Groupe. L’ALM Treasury est organisée autour d’une équipe Head Office rattachée au COO du Groupe et d’équipes ALM Treasury locales présentes dans les succursales et filiales de BNP Paribas à travers le monde. Votre stage se déroulera au Head Office de BNP Paribas, rue de Hanovre – Paris 2e. Vous serez intégré au sein de l’équipe ALMT Digital Innovations & AI composé de 9 collaborateurs. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement international, au contact de problématiques financières concrètes et de technologies d’intelligence artificielle de nouvelle génération. Ce stage est à pourvoir entre janvier et mars 2027 pour une durée de 6 mois. ET APRÈS ? Ce stage vous permettra de mettre en pratique et d’approfondir vos connaissances en IA générative, en développant des systèmes agentiques capables de mobiliser des données et des outils pour réaliser des tâches complexes dans un environnement bancaire exigeant en matière de fiabilité et de sécurité. Vous renforcerez vos compétences en conception, en expérimentation et en évaluation de ces solutions. Cette expérience vous permettra également d’acquérir des connaissances en ALM et en économétrie, et plus largement de mieux comprendre les marchés financiers. D’autres opportunités pourront s’offrir à vous, favorisant votre insertion professionnelle : Le Graduate Programme vous permet de booster votre avenir, de développer vos compétences et votre leadership grâce à des missions à responsabilité, Le Volontariat International en Entreprise vous donne l’opportunité d’enrichir votre parcours avec une expérience internationale unique de 12 à 24 mois. LES AVANTAGES À NOUS REJOINDRE Une gratification mensuelle brute, supérieure au minimum prévu par la loi, variable selon le niveau d’études et le diplôme préparés, comprise entre 1050 € et 1500 € brut par mois dans le cadre d’un bac+4 et entre 1250 € et 2100 € brut par mois dans le cadre d’un bac+5, Un accès au restaurant d’entreprise ou à des tickets restaurant, Des activités sociales et culturelles via le comité le comité social et économique, La possibilité de télé-stage selon l’environnement et sous réserve d’accord tuteur, conformément aux règles de l’entité d’accueil pour les stages de 6 mois. Rejoignez un Groupe engagé et prenez part à notre grand projet de transformation vers la construction d’un monde plus durable. Découvrez nos engagements pour notre clientèle et la société. ÊTES-VOUS NOTRE PROCHAIN OU PROCHAINE STAGIAIRE ? Vous préparez une formation de niveau Bac+5 en école d’ingénieur ou équivalent universitaire avec une spécialisation en Mathématiques , Statistiques ou Data Science .  D'ici 2050, près de 70 % de la population mondiale vivra en ville. Pour répondre aux enjeux de mobilité urbaine durable, Siemens Mobility conçoit les trains et systèmes de signalisation qui dessinent la mobilité de demain : connectée, décarbonée et fluide.
 De la ligne 14 à Paris aux lignes de Riyadh ou New York, nos technologies rendent déjà les transports plus intelligents, sûrs et accessibles. Chaque jour, nous réduisons l'empreinte carbone de millions de trajets, une réussite portée par la diversité des profils présents dans notre entreprise.
 Et ce n'est qu'un début. Rejoignez-nous et venez mettre votre talent au service des mobilités de demain et d'un futur plus responsable.

 Vos missions 
 Intégré à l'équipe innovation de Siemens Mobility, vous participez au développement de solutions basées sur l'IA générative pour accompagner les activités d'ingénierie logicielle. Vous explorez des cas d'usage concrets et contribuez à l'industrialisation de prototypes existants.

 Vous êtes étudiant en école d'ingénieur ou en Master (Bac+5) avec un intérêt marqué pour l'intelligence artificielle et le développement logiciel. Vous maîtrisez Python et avez une bonne compréhension des principes fondamentaux de la programmation et du génie logiciel.

items.desc: About Pillar Pillar was founded in 2025. Today, we are 80+ people, serve 900+ customers, raised €12 million in 2026, and are expanding internationally. We are building the financial operating system for construction: bringing AI, automation, and modern software to an enormous industry still full of slow, fragmented processes. We are looking for an AI Engineer who knows how to turn LLMs into reliable product experiences, moves fast, and wants to build. The mission Build production-grade AI systems that solve real customer problems. We want someone who can move beyond prototypes and build agents, retrieval systems, document pipelines, and AI-native product features that are reliable, measurable, and deeply integrated into Pillar. What You'll Do Own AI features end to end, from product problem to production. Design and build agentic workflows using tool orchestration, structured outputs, and multi-step reasoning. Build RAG and semantic search pipelines using embeddings, vector databases, hybrid search, and re-ranking. Develop document extraction workflows that turn invoices, reports, and forms into structured data. Build observability and evaluation systems for AI features, including tracing, experimentation, and automated quality checks. Optimize context, retrieval, and prompting strategies to improve accuracy and product quality. Work across our TypeScript stack when AI features require it, from backend logic to product integration. Use AI as a native part of your own engineering workflow, not only as something you build for customers. Move quickly from ambiguity to working product, making pragmatic technical decisions along the way. Our stack Product: Next.js React TypeScript Backend & data: Supabase Node/Deno Postgres AI: Mastra LLM APIs embeddings vector search AI-native workflows What You'll Bring AI engineers with product mindset and high agency You have experience building LLM-based applications in production, not only prototypes. You are comfortable with agents, tool use, structured outputs, and orchestration. You have hands-on experience with RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval strategies. You are comfortable with TypeScript or can become productive in it quickly. You have worked with AI orchestration frameworks such as Mastra, LangChain, CrewAI, or similar. You are strong with SQL and relational databases. You understand prompt design, evaluation, and the trade-offs involved in building reliable AI systems. You have worked in a startup or scaleup environment and understand the pace, ambiguity, and ownership it requires. You take initiative, get your hands dirty, and get things done without waiting for perfect instructions. You can zoom out to understand the full product problem and zoom in when technical details matter. You communicate openly, learn quickly, and collaborate without ego. How we work Agile and squad-based: small teams own their domains, with no unnecessary layers. AI-first: we build and work in the age of AI. Product ownership: engineers are hands-on and accountable for delivered value. Bottom-up: initiative is expected, not delegated. The profile that can succeed AI-native Product-minded Startup DNA The sweet spot: a hands-on engineer who has already built real AI products, ideally in a startup or scaleup environment, and knows how to combine LLM capabilities, software engineering, data, and product judgment to ship reliable features. Location & languages Milan or Barcelona; professional working English is required regardless of location. What we offer Gross salary 55,000-75,000 € depending on experience. The opportunity to build core parts of Pillar’s AI product and engineering foundations as we scale. End-to-end ownership: from AI architecture and experimentation to shipping features used by real customers. The chance to work in an AI-native engineering team, where AI is part of both the product and the way we build it. Close collaboration with Product, AI, and Engineering, with direct exposure to the problems we are solving for customers. Real autonomy, responsibility, and room to grow as Pillar and the engineering team scale. Hiring process CV screening. 30-min Talent Call - motivation, Pillar knowledge, mindset, and startup fit. Two 30-min Technical Interviews - one focused on AI systems and architecture, one focused on product engineering and execution. Final Interview with our CTO. One last thing Pillar is hiring this person while all of that is still taking shape. Build the system behind the scale. Compensation Range: €55K - €75K

We are looking for an adaptable, highly autonomous senior engineer to tackle rapid prototyping, architectural de-risking, and tactical engineering initiatives. Rather than maintaining a traditional product lifecycle, you will partner closely with our leadership team, including the CTO, senior engineers and architects on short-cycle strategic initiatives. Your customers are Bentley's global Product & Technology (P&T) organization - the teams responsible for building and operating the products and solutions that power our customers' success. You will take on complex, ambiguous technical challenges, rapidly evaluate solution options across the full stack, from architecture and design to hands-on implementation, build functional proof-of-concepts, and transition successful solutions to our core product teams. Responsibilities: Full-Spectrum Problem Solving: Fluidly navigate across varied technical domains depending on the project. One month you may be addressing deep performance profiling and cloud reliability; the next, you may be building modern front-end spikes or evaluating microservice patterns. De-Risk Architecture: Architect, code, and benchmark functional proof-of-concepts (PoCs) to validate performance and evaluate emerging technologies before Bentley makes a company-wide commitment. Operate Across the Stack & Cloud: Leverage a wide range of technologies, acting as a polyglot across multiple programming languages and major cloud platforms to deliver the right solution for the business. Ensure Frictionless Hand-offs: Package your validated architectures, write the technical summary, and hand the clean, maintainable deliverables over to our global P&T teams so you can pivot to the next strategic unknown. Qualifications: 0-to-1 Experience: 7+ years of software engineering experience with a demonstrable track record of designing, building, and delivering complex, high-performance software in fast-paced environments. Ownership and Bias for Action: You are highly self-directed, comfortable operating autonomously without extensive supervision, and driven to turn ambiguity into actionable solutions. Curiosity and Learning Agility: You possess an aptitude to select the best tool for the specific problem at hand. You have working fluency across multiple programming languages (such as C#, TypeScript, Python, Java, or C++) and continuously learn new ones. Empathy and Partnership: You view the global P&T organization as your customer, maintaining strong relationships and ensuring your prototypes are built with their eventual operational needs in mind. AI-Amplified Output: Practical experience leveraging generative AI APIs, vector retrieval/RAG patterns, or daily integration of AI-assisted engineering tools to amplify output. items.desc: ¡Ampliamos nuestro equipo! 🔎 ¿Te apasiona la Inteligencia Artificial Generativa , las arquitecturas escalables y liderar proyectos innovadores con impacto internacional? Entonces sigue leyendo porque esto te puede interesar. Scalian es una empresa de más de 6.000 personas , con dimensión internacional y oficinas en Europa y América del Norte . Estamos especializados en dar servicios a diferentes clientes enfocados en Data, Cloud e Inteligencia Artificial , participando en proyectos estratégicos de gran escala. ¿Qué buscamos? Como miembro clave del equipo de Data Scientists (GenAI), tu propósito será desarrollar e implementar soluciones avanzadas basadas en Inteligencia Artificial Generativa. Tendrás un impacto directo en la transformación de la interacción con el cliente mediante la creación de arquitecturas de LLMs robustas y escalables, asegurando la excelencia técnica y el rigor analítico en cada despliegue. Responsabilidades Principales: Construir sistemas multiagente aplicados a distintos casos de uso en el contexto bancario. Desarrollar y validar pipelines de datos específicos para GenAI. Experimentar con modelos generativos, optimizando el rendimiento mediante prompt engineering avanzado y marcos de evaluación (evals) de seguridad y coherencia. Gestionar riesgos asociados a la IA (sesgos, alucinaciones y privacidad) cumpliendo con los estándares de gobernanza del banco. Colaborar estrechamente con equipos de producto, ingeniería y diseño para traducir necesidades de negocio en soluciones técnicas de alto impacto. Requisitos mínimos: Mínimo 4 años de experiencia específica en IA Generativa. GenAI & LLMs: Experiencia demostrable en diseño y construcción de arquitecturas y sistemas multiagente, planificación, tool-calling y workflows agentic. Conocimiento de patrones RAG (hybrid search, metadata filtering, re-ranking, contextual retrieval). Dominio experto de Python (Pandas, NumPy, Pydantic, Scikit-learn). Manejo de frameworks como LangChain, LangGraph y librerías como AgentsSDK Experiencia demonstrable en entornos Cloud, fundamentalmente AWS Valorable conocimiento del mundo financiero y bancario. items.desc: The impact you will create: Architect, implement, and iterate on complex prompt logic, agentic decision flows, and multi-agent routing graphs. Design tool schemas, API integrations, and structured outputs for LLM reasoning and execution. Implement OpenTelemetry tracing and observability across agent pipelines, LLM calls, and tool interactions to track decision paths and performance. Build robust context management and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) strategies to ensure accuracy and low latency. Handle AI error modes and edge cases, designing fallbacks and safety guardrails for when models hallucinate or are uncertain. Conduct continuous evaluation and testing of LLM behavior, aligning outputs directly to business logic and user intents. Embed traceability and logging into AI decision paths to support auditability and compliance (e.g., EU AI Act). Collaborate with Data Scientists (metrics/evals) and DevOps/Data Engineers (infrastructure) to deploy scalable agentic systems. Experience and skills you will need: Demonstrated software engineering background combined with deep hands-on expertise in LLMs, prompt engineering, and agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen). Non-negotiable: Strong business and domain understanding with the ability to translate ambiguous business goals into behavioral LLM design. Practical experience with model routing, cost/latency tradeoffs, and failure-mode mitigation in production GenAI applications. Proficiency in Python, API development, and software development practices (Git, unit testing, CI/CD). Demonstrated ability in stakeholder communication and management. Good understanding of related data disciplines (e.g., Data Engineering, Data Science, MLOps). Ability to understand, analyze and translate business requirements into data-driven solutions. Enthusiasm for collaboration, knowledge sharing, and joint learning in a fast-evolving AI landscape. Very good English skills — German is a plus

items.desc: N-iX is a global software engineering and technology services company, building solutions for clients since 2002. Our teams work across Europe, the Americas, and Asia for Fortune 500 companies and fast-growing businesses in finance, retail, manufacturing, telecom, healthcare, and more. Our Data & Analytics practice designs and delivers modern data platforms on Snowflake, Databricks, Azure and AWS, from first assessment to production at scale. About the role We are looking for a Spanish-speaking Data Architect to lead the design of cloud data platforms for our clients. You will own the target architecture end-to-end, work directly with client stakeholders in Spanish, and guide engineering teams through delivery. The role mixes hands-on technical leadership with consulting: you will shape solutions in pre-sales, run discovery workshops, and stay accountable for architecture quality once the project is live. Responsibilities Design end-to-end data architectures on Snowflake and/or Databricks, deployed on Azure and/or AWS: ingestion, storage, processing, serving and consumption layers. Define lakehouse and data warehouse patterns (medallion architecture, data vault, dimensional models) and choose the right one for each use case. Lead migrations from legacy platforms (on-prem DWH, Hadoop, Teradata, Oracle, SQL Server) to the cloud, including assessment, roadmap and cutover plan. Set standards for data modelling, pipeline design, CI/CD, infrastructure as code and environment strategy. Design data governance, security and compliance: access control, data lineage, cataloguing (Unity Catalog, Snowflake Horizon, Purview), GDPR and local LATAM privacy laws. Optimise platform cost and performance (warehouse sizing, cluster policies, FinOps practices). Run discovery workshops and architecture reviews with client business and technical stakeholders, in Spanish and English. Support pre-sales: solution design, effort estimates, technical sections of proposals and client presentations. Mentor data engineers and review their designs and code; act as the technical point of escalation on the project. Prepare data foundations for BI, advanced analytics, ML and GenAI use cases. Requirements 8+ years in data engineering or data platforms, including 3+ years as a Data or Solution Architect. Hands-on production experience with Snowflake and/or Databricks (at least one in depth). Strong knowledge of Azure and/or AWS data services, for example: Azure: ADLS Gen2, Data Factory, Synapse/Fabric, Event Hubs, Purview, Key Vault AWS: S3, Glue, Redshift, Kinesis, Lambda, Lake Formation, IAM Expert SQL and solid Python or Scala; experience with Spark. Proven experience with data modelling (dimensional, data vault) and lakehouse design. Experience with orchestration and transformation tools such as Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory or Databricks Workflows. Working knowledge of infrastructure as code (Terraform, Bicep or CloudFormation) and CI/CD for data. Track record of leading at least one cloud data platform build or migration from design to production. Client-facing consulting experience: running workshops, presenting architecture decisions, managing expectations. Fluent or native Spanish and at least B2 English, written and spoken. Based in an EU or LATAM country with the right to work there. Nice to have Certifications: SnowPro Advanced Architect, Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Solutions Architect Professional or AWS Data Analytics/Data Engineer. Streaming architectures (Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming, Snowpipe Streaming, Delta Live Tables). Data mesh, data products and data contracts in practice. MLOps and GenAI data foundations (feature stores, vector search, RAG pipelines). Domain experience in banking, insurance, retail, telecom or energy. Portuguese for Brazil-based clients. items.desc: Advertising location Krakow Hours 40 Job description Shape the future of gaming technology with cutting-edge Java development and AI innovation. We're looking for a talented Software Developer to join our collaborative engineering team, building high-performance platforms that power online gaming experiences for millions of customers. This is an exciting opportunity to work on complex, large-scale systems while helping to integrate modern AI capabilities into our products, engineering processes, and platform services. Working within a DevOps culture and Agile environment, you'll collaborate with experienced engineers, QA specialists, and cloud experts to deliver scalable, reliable, and innovative solutions that make a real impact. What you will be doing: Design, develop and maintain high-volume, low-latency applications that deliver exceptional performance and reliability. Build scalable backend services using Java and modern microservices architectures. Develop and enhance user-facing applications and platform capabilities. Integrate AI technologies, including LLMs and intelligent automation solutions, into production environments. Contribute throughout the full software development lifecycle, from design through to deployment and support. Create clean, efficient, testable code that meets quality, security, and performance standards. Develop and maintain APIs, integrations, and cloud-native solutions running on AWS and Kubernetes. Drive continuous improvement by exploring emerging technologies and contributing to architectural decisions. Who we are looking for: We are committed to responsible gambling, and we are looking for people who can support our ethos. To apply to this post, you will have: Commercial experience developing large-scale backend systems using Java (Java 17+), Spring Boot, microservices and distributed architectures. Knowledge of modern AI technologies, including LLM integrations, RAG, AI agents, vector databases, prompt engineering, or AI workflow automation. Experience with cloud-native development, including AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD practices, and API development. A passion for technology, innovation, and identifying opportunities to use AI to improve products, processes, and developer productivity. What we offer: Our roles offer more than just a job, you’ll become part of the evoke family! We have created an environment where our people can thrive. Check out some fantastic benefits on offer: – Financial: You’ll be compensated a competitive base salary and benefits. Healthcare: We prioritise your health and well-being, offering fully paid private healthcare via Lux Med. Life assurance: Safeguarding your financial future and offering peace of mind with a company-sponsored life assurance plan. Wellbeing events: Including workshops, webinars; Psychological Helpline for you and your loved ones; access to psychological platforms such as Unmind. Social activities: We love a chance to share knowledge and have fun, coordinating meetups, quality questions events and hackathons. Free parking: You’ll have access to underground parking space for cars, motorcycles and bikes. Other perks: Fully paid Multisport pass or MyBenefit cafeteria points, employee referral program, and an extra day off for your birthday. We also offer free English and Polish classes for our colleagues! Hybrid working: Our employees can work from home up to 80% of the time with 20% of office time built in to ensure we get some face-to-face collaborative team time - and the chance for a coffee and a catch-up! More about Grand Parade We’re a business that embraces change and progress. With a rich history behind us, we’ve learned a lot and have led the industry in many ways. Now part of evoke, we are marking a new sense of purpose, direction and ambition for the business. Our culture is all about creating great experiences, for both our customers and our people. You’ll benefit from flexibility and trust. We’ll give you the space to be yourself and the tools you need to protect our customers while they play. We’ll invest in your future to help you develop your unique strengths and build a career that’s right for you. By investing in you, we’ll raise our game. Across all that we do, we aim for excellence, encourage creativity, and have fun. Apply At evoke, we prioritise diversity, equity, and inclusion for the benefit of our company, employees, and communities. We foster a welcoming and safe workplace that values all forms of diversity and provides opportunities for growth. We win together by working as one inclusive team to achieve great things. So, what’s next? The first step in the recruitment process is to submit your online application, which will be followed by an initial screening call with our Talent Acquisition team, and if successful, you will then be invited to interview. Apply today to kickstart your application with the evoke family!

Our Data & Analytics practice designs and delivers modern data platforms on Snowflake, Databricks, Azure and AWS, from first assessment to production at scale. About the role We are looking for a Spanish-speaking Data Architect to lead the design of cloud data platforms for our clients. You will own the target architecture end-to-end, work directly with client stakeholders in Spanish, and guide engineering teams through delivery. The role mixes hands-on technical leadership with consulting: you will shape solutions in pre-sales, run discovery workshops, and stay accountable for architecture quality once the project is live. items.desc: Join Whizdom.ai as a Founding Machine Learning Engineer to design and build the core intelligence behind everything the company create. About the company: Whizdom AI is an early-stage AI startup building products around recommendation systems, personalisation, and GenAI agents. We are a small team working directly on real customer problems, shipping quickly, measuring outcomes, and iterating fast. Everyone here is expected to take ownership, improve systems proactively, and help build the engineering foundations the company will scale on. The Role: We are hiring a Founding Machine Learning Engineer to own the intelligence layer of Whizdom AI products. You will design, build, and improve the models and decision systems behind recommendations, ranking, personalisation, retrieval, agent behaviour, and selected predictive analytics use cases. You will work directly with the founders to turn ambiguous product ideas into production systems that create measurable customer value. In a team of the company size, this is an end-to-end role: you may touch data exploration, modelling, evaluation, experimentation, and production iteration in the same week. This is not a pure research role. We care about people who can move from data and hypotheses to shipped systems and business impact. What You’ll Own: Design, build, and improve ML systems for recommendations, ranking, personalisation, retrieval, and GenAI workflows; Turn product goals into concrete ML problems, evaluation plans, experiments, and shipped features; Work with behavioural, transactional, contextual, and unstructured data to identify signals and improve model quality; Build offline evaluation frameworks and online experiments to measure relevance, quality, latency, cost, and business impact; Improve GenAI agent behaviour through better retrieval, context management, prompting, tool use, orchestration, and evaluation; Investigate failure modes, run error analysis, and make practical tradeoffs across quality, reliability, speed, and complexity; Partner closely with platform and backend engineers to deploy, monitor, and iterate on models in production; Help define how Whizdom AI does ML: metrics, experimentation discipline, technical standards, and long-term direction; Work with real-time behavioural and transactional signals to improve recommendations, personalisation, and intelligent product behaviour; Contribute to predictive and insight-driven ML use cases such as segmentation, churn prediction, recommendation measurement, and opportunity ranking; Write clean, testable Python and contribute reusable ML components and shared libraries used across the platform. What Success Looks Like in the First 6 Months: You ship meaningful improvements to a recommendation, personalisation, or GenAI workflow used in production; You establish a practical evaluation framework for one or more core ML systems; You turn ambiguous product opportunities into clear experiments and sound technical decisions; You improve at least one metric that matters, such as relevance, task completion, conversion, retention, latency, or cost efficiency; You become a trusted owner who spots high-leverage ML opportunities and drives them forward without needing detailed instruction; You help establish a repeatable approach to experimentation, model iteration, and production-quality ML development at Whizdom AI. What We’re Looking For: Strong foundations in machine learning, statistics, computer science, or a similar quantitative discipline; Experience building and shipping ML systems or intelligent product features in production or near-production environments; Strong Python skills and comfort working across data, modelling, evaluation, and production collaboration; Good understanding of experimentation, model evaluation, feature engineering, data quality, and error analysis; Clear communication and the ability to work through messy, ambiguous product problems; High ownership, self-direction, and a strong bias toward action; 5+ years building and shipping ML systems or intelligent product features in production; Strong understanding of model evaluation, cross-validation, feature engineering, and data quality challenges in real-world environments; Experience working with large-scale behavioural, transactional, or contextual data; Strong software engineering habits, including writing clean, testable, maintainable Python code. Nice to Have: Experience with recommendation systems, ranking, search, personalisation, or marketplace/feed optimisation; Experience with LLM applications, RAG, GenAI agents, prompt iteration, or evaluation of GenAI systems; Experience running A/B tests or online experiments; Experience working closely with product teams and translating user problems into ML solutions; Experience with real-time ML, streaming features, low-latency inference, or online learning; Experience with causal inference, uplift modelling, multi-armed bandits, or other decision-optimisation methods; …

items.desc: Missione del ruolo L’AI Software Engineer progetta e sviluppa le componenti software alla base delle soluzioni di Intelligenza Artificiale aziendali. Il ruolo ha una forte connotazione hands-on e trasforma architetture e use case AI in soluzioni sicure, scalabili, osservabili, riutilizzabili e production-ready, collaborando con AI Architect, Platform Engineer, Data Scientist e team applicativi. Principali responsabilità Progettare e sviluppare applicazioni enterprise basate su Generative AI, LLM, RAG e Agentic AI. Realizzare agenti AI, workflow di orchestrazione, framework, SDK, librerie e componenti comuni riutilizzabili. Implementare pipeline di document ingestion, embedding, retrieval, vector search e gestione delle knowledge base. Integrare modelli e servizi AI tramite API e model gateway con microservizi, piattaforme dati e sistemi legacy. Contribuire alle pipeline CI/CD e alle pratiche LLMOps/MLOps per deployment, versioning, testing ed esercizio. Definire standard di sviluppo e design pattern, svolgere code review e supportare la crescita tecnica del team. Industrializzare i PoC, riducendo debito tecnico, tempi di delivery, costi di esercizio e dipendenza da componenti proprietari. Competenze tecniche richieste Ottima conoscenza di Python; TypeScript/JavaScript e/o Java costituiscono titolo preferenziale. Esperienza nello sviluppo di API REST, microservizi, architetture distribuite e processi asincroni. Conoscenza concreta di LLM, prompt engineering, structured output, embedding, vector database, RAG, tool/function calling, agent orchestration, context e memory management Esperienza con framework quali LangChain/LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex o soluzioni equivalenti. Esperienza con Git, CI/CD, container, kubernetes, cloud (AWS, GCP) e pratiche di software engineering enterprise. Conoscenza di evaluation e testing GenAI, observability, gestione di latenza, consumi e costi dei modelli e gestione del ciclo di vita dei modelli. Competenze architetturali e di sicurezza Il candidato deve saper progettare l’intera catena applicativa: Business Application > Agent/Orchestrator > LLM > RAG/Knowledge > API/Tools > Enterprise Systems. Le soluzioni devono essere modulari, API-first, resilienti, loosely coupled, osservabili, manutenibili e orientate al riuso. AI guardrails, protezione dei dati, gestione sicura di prompt, context, secret e credential. Prompt injection, controllo degli accessi, auditability e tracciabilità delle interazioni. Secure coding, troubleshooting e gestione operativa in contesti enterprise regolamentati. Esperienza richiesta Almeno 2 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo software enterprise in ruoli di Software Engineer, Backend Engineer o equivalenti. Esperienza concreta nella realizzazione di soluzioni AI/GenAI, preferibilmente con almeno una soluzione LLM, RAG o AI Agent evoluta oltre la fase sperimentale. Gradita esperienza in organizzazioni complesse e regolamentate, in particolare banking o financial services. Competenze personali Forte orientamento al problem solving, al coding e alla qualità del software. Autonomia nel passaggio dal design all’implementazione, con attenzione alla semplicità e al riuso. Capacità di collaborare con architetti, data scientist, security e team applicativi. Approccio pragmatico, capacità di evitare sovraingegnerizzazione e attitudine al mentoring tecnico. Risultati attesi Software funzionante in produzione: framework, agenti, API, componenti RAG, SDK, integrazioni e tooling comuni. Il successo del ruolo si misura attraverso qualità, riuso, affidabilità, sicurezza, manutenibilità e velocita di industrializzazione delle soluzioni AI. items.desc: Role Highlights Role: Forward Deployed AI Engineer Department: Forward Deployed Engineering Location: Germany Reports to: VP, Forward Deployed Engineering Working type: Hybrid (On-site at customer locations approx. 50% of time) German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung Ü1/Ü2/Ü3) Must be eligible and able to attain relevant national and NATO security clearances Must be based in-country and native level speaker of the country you're deploying to. The Mission of the Forward Deployed AI Engineer In this role, you'll be the hands-on AI builder defense and intelligence customers rely on. You’ll deploy ICEYE’s intelligence platform into secure (often air-gapped) environments and rapidly ship AI-powered workflows on top of it—everything from Docker-based deployments to RAG systems fusing SAR imagery with intelligence reports. This is a ship-code-daily role: turning raw satellite data into mission-critical tools analysts use to protect nations. Who We Are ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth. ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system. ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future. Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. Day To Day Responsibilities Platform Deployment & Integration Deploy ICEYE's intelligence platform into customer secure environments (on-premise, air-gapped networks, classified data centers). Build and maintain containerized applications (Docker) and manage deployments in customer Kubernetes clusters. Develop APIs and data pipelines connecting ICEYE systems to customer C4ISR infrastructure and intelligence tools. Troubleshoot deployment issues in disconnected environments without external internet access. AI Solution Development & Customization Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems that combine ICEYE SAR data with customer intelligence documents for context-aware analysis. Develop AI agents and workflows using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or similar tools to automate analytical tasks. Implement prompt engineering strategies and conversational AI interfaces that enable analysts to query satellite data using natural language. Create Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations connecting AI systems with customer data sources. Data Fusion & Intelligence Workflows Build data fusion pipelines combining SAR imagery with additional intelligence sources (AIS, RF signals, optical imagery, SIGINT). Develop automated workflows that correlate and cross-reference information across different data modalities. Create lightweight tools, dashboards, and alerting systems tailored to customer operational needs. Customer Engagement & Rapid Prototyping Work embedded with intelligence analysts, data scientists, and military operators to understand mission-critical problems. Rapidly prototype AI-powered solutions (code first, polish later) that address immediate operational requirements. Conduct hands-on training sessions on platform capabilities and AI workflow usage. Gather customer feedback and translate it into technical requirements for ICEYE's product and engineering teams. What we are looking for Must Have Skills 3+ years hands-on software engineering building and deploying production systems. Strong Python programming skills (required) plus one of: Go, TypeScript, or Rust. Hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and RAG systems. Working knowledge of agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, pydantic-ai) and vector databases. Experience with Docker and deploying in secure / isolated / air-gapped environments. Practical experience with APIs, data pipelines, and integrating systems in production, Familiarity with Linux and basic Kubernetes operations. Builder mindset: ship fast, iterate with feedback, and prioritize working solutions over perfect architecture. Strong communication + customer engagement, able to work embedded with intelligence analysts / military operators. Strong spoken and written English, able to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Willingness to travel 40–60% to customer sites within the region. Nice To Have Skills Experience in defense, intelligence, or government operational environments. Deploying to on-prem data centers and/or air-gapped networks. Familiarity with geospatial data, satellite imagery, or remote sensing. Experience with MCP integrations, …

items.desc: CHI SIAMO ADENTIS Italia è un gruppo europeo di consulenza ingegneristica e operativa facente parte del Gruppo MoOngy. Presente in 14 paesi europei con oltre 9.000 dipendenti, abbiamo aperto, da quattro anni, la prima sede italiana a Milano e, vista la continua crescita, stiamo rafforzando e ampliando il nostro team con persone che condividano gli stessi valori della nostra società: AMBIZIONE, DINAMISMO e VOGLIA DI METTERSI IN GIOCO, il tutto in una realtà in continua evoluzione, nella quale le relazioni umane sono sempre al primo posto. Ruolo: AI Engineer – Generative AI Modalità: Full Remote IL TUO RUOLO ADENTIS Italia è alla ricerca di un/una AI Engineer da inserire su un’importante progettualità in ambito Generative AI e Innovation. La risorsa avrà un ruolo fortemente hands-on e si occuperà della progettazione e dello sviluppo di soluzioni AI, trasformando esigenze e opportunità di business in prototipi, Proof of Concept e applicazioni concrete basate su LLM. Attività: Sviluppare prototipi e applicazioni basate su LLM . Progettare e implementare soluzioni RAG e AI Agent . Lavorare su attività di Prompt Engineering e valutazione dei modelli . Utilizzare framework come LangChain, LangGraph, Langflow o equivalenti. Sviluppare e integrare API tramite Python . Implementare workflow attraverso strumenti di orchestrazione come n8n . Valutare modelli e architetture in termini di qualità, sicurezza, scalabilità, costi e performance . Portare PoC e prototipi verso soluzioni potenzialmente production-ready . Requisiti: Esperienza concreta su progetti di Generative AI e LLM . Ottima conoscenza di Python e sviluppo/integrazione API. Esperienza con LangChain, LangGraph, Langflow o framework analoghi. Esperienza nello sviluppo di soluzioni RAG e/o AI Agent . Conoscenza di piattaforme Cloud AI quali Azure OpenAI/Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock o Google Vertex AI . Esperienza con framework Agentic AI quali LangGraph, Semantic Kernel o AutoGen . Familiarità con Model Context Protocol (MCP) . Conoscenza di LLMOps, model evaluation, observability e tracing . Conoscenza delle principali tematiche di AI Security e Compliance , inclusi GDPR ed EU AI Act . Familiarità con strumenti di workflow orchestration come n8n o equivalenti. Nice to have: Databricks, Delta Lake, MLflow, Mosaic AI e Vector Search . SQL e Spark/PySpark . Esperienza avanzata su RAG : chunking, embeddings, vector database e retrieval evaluation. Competenze Machine Learning e MLOps . Cosa offriamo? Contratto a tempo indeterminato. Formazione continua su hard e soft skills. Follow-up costante con HR e Business Manager. Un percorso di crescita chiaro e strutturato in un ambiente innovativo, dinamico e internazionale. La retribuzione annua lorda per questo ruolo è compresa tra 28.000 EUR e 32.000 EUR. La posizione è inquadrata nell'ambito del CCNL del Commercio e Terziario applicato dalla nostra società. Il posizionamento all'interno del range sarà definito in base alle competenze tecniche, all'esperienza specifica nel ruolo e agli esiti del processo di selezione, secondo criteri oggettivi e predefiniti. In presenza di profili con caratteristiche eccezionali rispetto al range indicato, una revisione potrà essere valutata previa approvazione interna. The world needs you ADENTIS Italia è un equal opportunities employer: crediamo che tutte le forme di diversità siano fonte di arricchimento reciproco. Ci impegniamo a garantire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, nel quale ogni singola risorsa possa apportare un valore unico alla nostra realtà. Pertanto, accogliamo candidature senza distinzione di età, genere, nazionalità, disabilità, orientamento sessuale, religione o stato civile. Inoltre, teniamo fede ai nostri impegni prestando attenzione alle risorse appartenenti alle categorie protette ai sensi degli articoli 1 e 18 della Legge 68/99. I dati personali saranno trattati in conformità alle disposizioni contenute nel regolamento UE 2016/679.

items.desc: Tätigkeitsbeschreibung Healthcare trifft KI: Modelle, die im Krankenhausalltag wirklich ankommen. Bei DaphOS entwickelst du KI-Funktionen für eine B2B-Healthcare-Plattform, mit der Krankenhäuser ihre Prozesse und ihren Personalbedarf schneller und fundierter planen und steuern. Im Mittelpunkt deiner Arbeit stehen klassische Machine Learning Methoden, probabilistische Modellierung sowie mathematische Optimierung. Ein erster Schwerpunkt liegt außerdem auf der Anwendung von Large Language Models in strategischen Zukunftsthemen: Du erkundest neue Einsatzfelder, baust belastbare Prototypen und findest gemeinsam mit uns heraus, welche Ansätze echten Mehrwert für Klinik und Pflege bringen. Dabei bewegst du dich an der Schnittstelle von Data Science und Engineering und prägst die KI-Ausrichtung unseres Produkts mit. Zusätzlich arbeitest du in einem laufenden Forschungsprojekt mit, in dem wir LLM-Anwendungen für die Langzeit-Pflege entwickeln und erproben. So verbindest du angewandte Forschung direkt mit der Produktentwicklung. Deine Aufgaben Du konzipierst und entwickelst LLM-basierte Features, etwa Retrieval-Augmented Generation, Informationsextraktion aus strukturierten und unstrukturierten Daten oder agentische Workflows. Im Rahmen eines laufenden Forschungsprojekts entwickelst und evaluierst du LLM-Anwendungen für Langzeitpflege. Du arbeitest dabei eng mit Forschungspartnern und Anwender:innen aus der klinischen Praxis zusammen und überführst vielversprechende Ergebnisse ins Produkt. Du baust belastbare Evaluierungen für LLM-Anwendungen auf (Testsets, Metriken, Fehleranalyse) und entscheidest datenbasiert über Modelle, Prompts und Architekturen. Du integrierst gemeinsam mit dem Backend-Team Modelle über saubere Schnittstellen (z. B. REST-APIs in Python) in unsere Plattform und sorgst für Monitoring im Produktivbetrieb. Du wählst geeignete Modelle aus (kommerzielle APIs und Open-Weight-Modelle) und berücksichtigst dabei Qualität, Kosten, Latenz und Datenschutz. Du arbeitest an Prognose- und Optimierungsmodellen mit, etwa für Patientenströme und Personalplanung. Du entwickelst Features zusammen mit unseren Backend- und Frontend-Engineers sowie Product Management und bringst deine Expertise aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer KI-Strategie ein. Dein Profil Du hast ein naturwissenschaftliches oder technisches Studium (Physik, Mathematik, Informatik, Statistik o. ä.) oder vergleichbare nachgewiesene Erfahrung in Data Science, ML oder AI. Du bringst ab ca. 5 Jahre professionelle Erfahrung in Data Science oder Machine Learning mit, davon nachweislich praktische Erfahrung mit LLM-Anwendungen. Du programmierst sicher in Python und hast Modelle bereits selbst in Backend-Systeme integriert (z. B. mit FastAPI, Docker, CI/CD). Du gehst methodisch an Evaluierung heran und kannst die Grenzen von Modellen klar einschätzen und kommunizieren. Du sprichst Deutsch und/oder Englisch mindestens auf C1-Niveau. Plus: Du hast Open-Weight-Modelle (z. B. vLLM, Ollama) betrieben oder Erfahrung mit Fine-Tuning. Plus: Du kennst Daten aus dem Gesundheitswesen (z. B. HL7/FHIR) oder Regulatorik wie DSGVO und EU AI Act. Klares Plus: Du hast schon eigenständig klassische ML-Modelle, Zeitreihenprognosen oder Optimierungsmodelle entwickelt. Weiteres Plus: Du hast Forschungserfahrung (Promotion, Publikationen oder geförderte Projekte) und arbeitest gern mit Partnern aus Wissenschaft und klinischer Praxis zusammen. Du findest bei uns Attraktives Gehalt, angemessen nach Qualifikation, Erfahrung und IT-KV (38,5 Std./Woche) Flexibles Arbeitsmodell (hybrid) - die Stelle kann in Graz, Wien oder Linz angetreten werden, vorzugsweise in Graz – und du kannst bis zu 2 Tage pro Woche von zu Hause arbeiten (aus Österreich) Die Möglichkeit, an angewandter Forschung mitzuwirken und die Ergebnisse direkt in den Klinik- und Pflegealltag zu bringen Ein Umfeld, in dem du vom ersten Tag an etwas bewegen kannst – keine langen Anlaufzeiten Kurze Entscheidungswege und direkter Einfluss auf die KI-Ausrichtung des Produkts Viele Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung, vor allem an der Schnittstelle von Data Science und Engineering Ausgezeichnetes Arbeitsklima und regelmäßige Teamevents Die Einstufung erfolgt nach IT-KV in ST2 Regelstufe ab 4.611 € brutto/Monat (Basis 38,5 Std./Woche). Wo du genau liegst, finden wir im Gespräch heraus. Wir überzahlen abhängig von Qualifikation und Erfahrung. Kontaktinformationen Du möchtest Teil vom Team DaphOS werden? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung z. H. Maria Hierling (Interim Head of People - ext). Ein Lebenslauf reicht aus. Andere Dokumente fordern wir ggfs. noch nach. items.desc: As a leading European research centre, VITO brings together more than 1,300 employees to translate scientific insights into technological innovations, AI-driven solutions, and policy advice with real societal impact. Our mission is clear: to create a sustainable and promising future for our world. Join us in making this vision a reality! The group for Construction Robotics and Innovative Building Envelopes (CRIB) at VITO is dedicated to advancing sustainable and industrialised construction. Our primary objective is to develop next-generation building envelope systems, supported by innovative design methodologies, robotics, and digital construction workflows. We coordinate and contribute to high-impact Flemish and European R&I projects in industrial renovation and construction innovation, such as RENOMIZE, SOLMATE, oPEN Lab, and FRAIMwork. Within these projects, we develop innovative prefabricated façade systems, automated construction processes, and robotics solutions for the built environment. Our team is equipped with the THOREAQ lab infrastructure, which includes real-scale twin buildings for A-B testing of novel construction systems and components, a robotic workshop for system development and prototyping, and – to be complemented by fall 2026 – a fully instrumented outdoor construction lab for demonstration and implementation of robotic construction solutions. Through our active involvement in applied R&I projects and strategic collaborations with industrial and academic partners, CRIB contributes to a more climate-resilient, affordable, and circular built environment. To strengthen our research coordination and strategic innovation activities, we are looking for a R&D Expert Construction Automation & Building Envelopes to join our interdisciplinary team. Are you a senior innovator with a strong strategic mindset, capable of connecting research, industrial innovation, valorisation potential, and market opportunities into a coherent long-term vision? Do you thrive in interdisciplinary and international environments, enjoy shaping innovation roadmaps and collaborative research initiatives, and want to help accelerate the transition towards scalable and impactful sustainable construction solutions? Then join us at VITO and drive the future of industrialised and sustainable construction innovation. Your role As R&D Expert Construction Automation & Building Envelopes, you will play a central role in further developing and steering the innovation roadmap of the CRIB team. Working at the intersection of research, technology development, and valorisation, you will help steer the team’s future direction in domains such as industrialisation of building renovation workflows, advanced building envelopes, on-site construction robotics, and digital construction. You will work closely with researchers, business developers, industry partners, and external stakeholders to translate ambitious ideas into impactful innovation trajectories. items.desc:
Lieu : Issy-les-Moulineaux, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée
 Un package de rémunération attractif
 Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes
 Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu
 Votre quotidien 
 CortAIx : CortAIx est la nouvelle entité du groupe dédiée à l'innovation en IA de défense. Elle se compose de 3 piliers cortAIx Labs concentre ses efforts sur la recherche, CortAIx Sensors vise à l’intégration de l’IA dans les capteurs, et enfin CortAIx Factory qui vise à industrialiser des solutions d’IA avancées dans les systèmes des forces armées, des avionneurs, et des aéroports. Cette initiative reflète l'ambition de Thales d'améliorer significativement l'analyse de données et la prise de décision dans des contextes critiques, en répondant à des exigences élevées de cybersécurité, d'embarquabilité et de frugalité. CortAIx s'appuie sur l'expertise de plus de 600 spécialistes en IA et engage annuellement une centaine de doctorants, témoignant de l'importance accordée à la recherche et à l'innovation. Avec un réseau étendu de partenaires industriels, de start-ups, et d'institutions académiques, Thales s'impose comme un leader de l'IA dans les systèmes critiques, en tête des dépôts de brevets dans ce domaine en Europe. Cette démarche s'inscrit dans la vision à long terme de Thales pour une IA transparente, explicable, et éthique, affirmant son rôle de pionnier dans le développement de solutions embarquables et sécurisées répondant aux enjeux de souveraineté et de sécurité de ses clients.
 Poste basé à Issy les Moulineaux. 
 Votre profil: 
 Vous êtes passionné par l’ingénierie des systèmes complexes, l’architecture de solutions critiques et l’intégration de technologies d’IA dans des environnements opérationnels exigeants.
 Vous avez une expérience démontrée dans la définition d’environnements techniques mutualisés au service d’équipes de développement, avec une forte orientation plateforme, standardisation et enablement. 
 Vous avez déjà contribué à la sélection, l’intégration ou l’urbanisation de solutions technologiques complexes, idéalement dans des contextes mêlant infrastructure, sécurité, développement logiciel et IA. 
 Vous savez travailler dans une logique de consommation et d’intégration de solutions existantes à l’échelle d’un groupe, en recherchant le meilleur compromis entre standardisation, valeur d’usage, sécurité, coûts et vitesse de déploiement. 
 Vous faites preuve d’esprit collaboratif, de pragmatisme et d’une forte capacité à interagir avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires : équipes de développement, Data/AI engineers, architectes solution, cybersécurité, opérations, responsables infrastructure et parties prenantes groupe. 
 Vous êtes reconnu pour votre capacité à structurer une vision d’architecture et à la traduire en trajectoire opérationnelle. 
 Vous avez une sensibilité forte aux contraintes de sécurité, de confidentialité, de souveraineté et de déploiement on-premise / hybride, en particulier dans des environnements critiques. 
 Vos compétences : 
 Vous êtes titulaire d’un Master 2 / BAC+5 (école d’ingénieur ou université) et disposez de ≥ 7 ans d’expérience en architecture IT, infrastructure, cloud platform engineering et/ou environnement Data/AI. 
 Vous maîtrisez les fondamentaux de l’architecture IT : infrastructure, réseau, sécurité, IAM, stockage, calcul, résilience, observabilité, intégration et exploitation. 
 Vous avez une expérience concrète dans la définition de plateformes techniques ou de socles mutualisés à destination d’équipes de développement ou de delivery. 
 Vous savez concevoir des environnements permettant d’accélérer le développement de solutions IA et agentiques : environnements de développement, services partagés, orchestration, APIs, pipelines, observabilité, accès aux ressources de calcul et services de sécurité. 
 Vous avez une bonne compréhension des composants d’une AI Stack moderne : environnements d’expérimentation, composants de serving, orchestration, gestion de modèles, composants RAG, gateways LLM, vector stores, monitoring, sécurité et gouvernance.

C1) in Wort und Schrift, denn Sie arbeiten mit deutschsprachigen Fachdokumenten, und gutes Englisch (mind. B2). Flache Hierarchien und viel Eigenverantwortung geben Ihnen den Raum, Ihre Projekte selbst zum Erfolg zu führen. Flexibles Arbeitszeitmodell: Bei uns können Sie sich Ihre Arbeitszeit nicht nur flexibel einteilen. Sie entscheiden selbst, was Sie mit jeder zusätzlich geleisteten Arbeitsstunde machen möchten: ausbezahlen, in Freizeit ausgleichen oder als Puffer in den nächsten Arbeitsmonat übertragen. Faire Gehaltsstruktur: Je nach Erfahrung und Qualifikation bieten wir Ihnen ein Jahresgehalt zwischen 55.000 und 80.000 Euro mit weiterer Entwicklungsperspektive. „Klassiker“ und mehr: Ihr Kind ist krank? Kein Problem. Wir bieten den Eltern unter uns zusätzliche Kinderkranktage. Natürlich unterstützen wir auch die „Klassiker“ unter den Benefits: Von Mobile Office, über vermögenswirksame Leistungen und eine zusätzliche Unterstützung zur Altersvorsorge bis hin zu Sonderurlauben und dem BusinessBike.

items.desc: AI Engineer - rate: £610 per day inside IR35 - Remote (on-site once a month) - 6 months The AI Engineer role will be responsible for working within a Product squad to design, build and deliver GenAI and Agentic AI products. The individual must have hands-on experience developing production-grade GenAI/Agentic AI solutions using LLMs, RAG and agentic workflow technologies. The role requires strong Python software engineering skills alongside practical experience designing reliable, secure and maintainable AI-enabled applications. Key responsibilities include: Technical Scoping & Estimation: Break down product requirements and user stories into technical tasks, provide estimates, identify dependencies, risks and integration requirements, and support delivery planning. Data Analysis, Engineering & Discovery: Explore and assess structured and unstructured data, identify key data dependencies and quality issues, and prepare, transform and integrate data for use in RAG pipelines, agentic workflows and downstream applications. Agentic AI Development: Design and implement multi-step Agentic AI workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, including workflow state, routing, parallel execution, tool use, human-in-the-loop review, checkpointing and recovery. LLM Application Development: Design and develop LLM-powered application capabilities, including prompt engineering, structured outputs, context management, model configuration and validation of model responses. RAG & Knowledge Retrieval: Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation solutions, including document ingestion, parsing and chunking, embeddings, indexing, semantic/hybrid search, filtering, reranking and evidence grounding. AI Evaluation & Assurance: Develop approaches to evaluate LLM and RAG quality, including grounding, retrieval quality, hallucination, output consistency and regression testing. Implement appropriate guardrails, human review, citations, traceability and auditability. Reliability & Error Handling: Design AI workflows to handle rate limits, timeouts, malformed model outputs, partial failures and other non-deterministic behaviours, including retry, recovery and resumability where required. Observability & Monitoring: Implement logging, tracing and monitoring across LLM calls, agent workflows and retrieval pipelines to support troubleshooting, performance monitoring, quality assurance and operational support. Security & Data Access: Ensure AI solutions follow appropriate authentication, authorisation, data access and secure development practices, particularly when integrating agents with enterprise systems and sensitive information. Testing & Peer Review: Develop automated tests for AI and application components, participate in peer reviews and ensure solutions meet agreed quality, security and engineering standards. Performance, Cost & Scalability: Consider model selection, token usage, latency, concurrency, retrieval performance and infrastructure cost when designing and optimising AI solutions. Technical Documentation: Create and maintain documentation covering solution design, workflows, prompts, dependencies, APIs, operational considerations and support requirements. Un package complet : un bonus discrétionnaire annuel, une prime de participation, des RTT, une mutuelle avantageuse, une carte titre-restaurant, le remboursement de votre abonnement de transports en commun à hauteur de 75% ou une aide financière pour l’achat d’un vélo. Maîtrise du développement applicatif Java ou Python (API, microservices, intégration modèle) et des environnements DevSecOps (GitLab, Docker, Kubernetes…). Compétences sur les technologies d’IA agentique : LangChain, LangGraph, Spec Driven Developement… Connaissance des architectures et outils IA : RAG, agentique, pipelines ML, MLOps, vector databases, monitoring, data versioning Compréhension des pratiques IA en entreprise et du cadre réglementaire associé (AI Act, gouvernance…).
