items.desc: Rejoindre Davidson, ce n’est pas seulement intégrer un groupe de 3000 consultants dans 6 pays et 2 continents, c’est intégrer LA société qui a été élue par ses salariés Great Place To Work France et Europe pendant 4 ans mais aussi une des plus grandes B Corp de France, nommée Best of the World dans la catégorie “collaborateurs” en 2022 ! (Les “B Corp” formant une communauté de sociétés qui ont décidé d’être non pas les meilleures du monde mais les meilleures POUR le monde). Parce que notre développement repose sur des principes forts : Un profond respect de l’ensemble de nos parties prenantes : consultant(e)s, clients et fournisseurs. Car si le travail “ne fait pas le bonheur”, il peut cependant “faire le malheur”. Nous nous engageons donc à écouter et agir avec honnêteté. Une égalité des chances dans le traitement de nos candidatures et dans la gestion de carrière de nos salarié(e)s. Nous croyons en un milieu de travail où équité F/H, inclusion et diversité sont la norme. Une empreinte environnementale minimale, et sociétale maximale. C’est pourquoi, au-delà des missions que vous réaliserez, vous pourrez également contribuer à des projets que Davidson soutient : missions de solidarité internationale (avec Planète Urgence), bénévolat auprès d’associations (chaque Davidsonien(ne) dispose de 3 jours par an pour intervenir à leurs côtés), accompagnement d’étudiant(e)s issus de milieux peu favorisés (avec Article 1), investissement dans des startups développant des solutions innovantes, actions collectives et individuelles pour la réduction de notre impact carbone… Un Management adhocratique basé sur la mise en œuvre des principes de “l’entreprise horizontale” et du “management tribal”. Sur ce dernier point une précision d’importance : le bien-être au travail est un luxe qu’il faut pouvoir s’offrir en étant une entreprise “solide”. Ceci induit pour les Davidsonien(ne)s d’allier prises d’initiative, engagement et professionnalisme. Car “sans travail, le talent n’est qu’une sale manie”. Et cela nous incite à chercher à recruter des personnes… meilleures que nous… Nous encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap, et nous nous engageons à répondre au mieux à leurs besoins spécifiques. Profil / Mission Davidson accompagne un acteur majeur de l’immobilier institutionnel, intégré à un grand groupe bancaire, dans la structuration de son pôle IA & Architecture à Toulouse. Dans un contexte où les solutions d’IA générative et de Machine Learning prédictif sont progressivement intégrées aux activités métiers, vous participerez à la définition et à l’industrialisation des services IA de la DSI. Les cas d’usage validés ont vocation à être déployés en production, intégrés au catalogue de services et supervisés dans la durée. En tant qu’Architecte IA & MLOps Davidsonien(ne), vos responsabilités seront les suivantes : Étudier la faisabilité technique des cas d’usage IA : disponibilité des données, intégration au SI, sécurité et exigences MLOps Définir les architectures cibles pour des solutions de Machine Learning prédictif, de RAG et d’IA générative Garantir la cohérence des solutions proposées avec le système d’information existant et les standards du Groupe Formaliser les choix techniques au sein de dossiers d’architecture clairs et exploitables Piloter des POC IA courts afin d’évaluer rapidement la viabilité des cas d’usage Concevoir et mettre en œuvre les chaînes MLOps permettant le passage des modèles du prototypage à la production Accompagner l’intégration des solutions IA dans le système d’information Définir et déployer les dispositifs d’observabilité ML : indicateurs, alertes, supervision et pilotage du run Contribuer à la définition de la stratégie de run des services IA Participer aux comités IA et Architecture ainsi qu’aux travaux de gouvernance associés Veiller à la conformité des solutions avec les exigences réglementaires, notamment le RGPD et l’AI Act Intervenir en tant que référent(e) technique auprès des Data Engineers, des équipes projets et des prestataires Diffuser les bonnes pratiques MLOps et contribuer à la montée en compétence collective sur l’industrialisation de l’IA Compétences requises ou à acquérir: Vous avez suivi une formation supérieure de niveau Bac +5 en informatique, Data, Intelligence Artificielle ou dans un domaine équivalent Vous disposez d’une première expérience significative en architecture IA, MLOps, Data Engineering ou Machine Learning Vous maîtrisez ou souhaitez approfondir tout ou partie des environnements et technologies suivants : Python Docker et Kubernetes Cloud public : Microsoft Azure, AWS ou Google Cloud Platform Intégration et déploiement continus — CI/CD MLflow LangChain et/ou LlamaIndex Architectures RAG et solutions d’IA générative API REST Bases de données vectorielles Une expérience dans le secteur bancaire ou dans un environnement fortement réglementé serait appréciée Vous disposez d’un niveau d’anglais professionnel Aptitudes / Savoir-être : …

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
 This Position reports to:
Senior Operation Manager for D&A 
 Mission of the Role 
 Are you passionate about turning business needs into practical, AI-enabled solutions and excited to be part of a global company transforming industry with cutting-edge technology? ABB is looking for an AI Solution Engineer to join our Automation IS team.

You will assess whether AI is the right approach and recommend an implementation approach based on the standards, reference architectures and technology guidance defined by the Advanced Analytics Architect and relevant platform architects. You will stay hands-on throughout delivery, working with Data Analysts, Snowflake Developers, Power BI/Fabric Developers, Data Engineers and other specialists to build, validate and hand over working solutions. You will also contribute to project set-up, incremental delivery, solution quality, production readiness and reuse across Automation.

 Work with Data Analysts and business stakeholders to clarify:business needs and expected outcomessuccess measuresAI-specific data and context requirementsrisks and ownership 
 Assess whether AI, analytics, automation or a conventional solution best addresses the identified business need. 
 Recommend solutions based on approved patterns and guidance from the Advanced Analytics Architect and the Snowflake, Azure and Fabric platform architects. 
 Build and development 
 Develop and validate AI components, proofs of concept, prototypes and minimum viable solutions using Python, SQL and approved technologies. 
 Build Azure- or Snowflake-based AI applications and services, including orchestration, retrieval, RAG, agent logic, APIs, evaluation and integration components. 
 Create implementation assets, including prompts, agent instructions, evaluation datasets, notebooks, application logic, automated workflows, tests and deployment assets. 
 Use enterprise data from SAP and Salesforce to develop AI/ML solutions that address business needs and deliver measurable business value. These include predictive models, GenAI applications and AI agents. 
 Apply Snowflake AI/ML capabilities to build and validate machine learning and generative AI solutions using enterprise data. These include Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Search and AI Functions. 
 Quality, compliance and operations 
 Evaluate and test solutions for grounding, answer quality, model or agent behaviour, business value, safety, cost and operational reliability. 
 Apply the defined Responsible AI, information security, privacy, access-control and IT compliance requirements within the assigned solution scope. Work with architecture, platform, security and operations specialists where required. 
 Contribute to CI/CD, production readiness, handover and monitoring design. 
 Support incident and problem analysis related to AI solutions within the assigned scope. 
 Document AI solutions, including their logic, assumptions, limitations, test results and operational requirements. 
 Collaboration 
 Work as part of a multidisciplinary delivery team with Data Analysts, Snowflake Developers, Data Engineers, Power BI/Fabric Developers and platform specialists. 
 Requirements (Mandatory) 
 Experience and education 
 At least 2 years of relevant experience delivering AI, ML or advanced analytics solutions, including at least one solution taken from requirements through implementation. 
 4–6 years of professional experience in Data Science, AI/ML Engineering, BI analytics or a similar data-focused role. 
 Master's degree in a technical discipline or equivalent practical experience. 
 Fluent spoken and written English (minimum C1 level). 
 Technical skills 
 Hands-on proficiency in Python and SQL for data preparation, API integration, testing and solution development. 
 Strong practical understanding of generative AI application patterns, including RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt/context engineering and evaluation. 
 Practical experience with at least one enterprise AI development platform, preferably Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Snowflake Cortex or Snowflake Intelligence. Experience with Microsoft Fabric or Power BI AI capabilities is an advantage. 
 General understanding of classical machine learning concepts. Hands-on experience is an advantage where relevant to the use case. 
 Working experience with version control and testing, preferably using GitHub or Azure DevOps. Exposure to CI/CD and deployment processes is an advantage. 
 Experience documenting AI solutions and understanding data quality …

items.desc:
Lieu : Rungis, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Notre savoir-faire technologique
 Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…)
 Votre quotidien 
Nous fournissons et soutenons des systèmes pour la gestion et la protection de l'espace aérien. Nous travaillons avec passion dans un cadre architectural moderne, et s'efforce de repousser les limites de la technologie dans nos secteurs clés. Au sud de Paris, notre site est facilement accessible en transport en commun. 
 Vous serez intégré à l’équipe transverse IA en charge des activités de mise à l’échelle des PoCs IA pour les pratiques d’ingénierie. Vous rejoindrez une équipe innovante à taille humaine travaillant sur le développement de systèmes agentiques multi‑LLM déployés dans différents environnements. 
 Vous contribuerez à la conception et à l’industrialisation de solutions d’intelligence artificielle, intégrant des agents intelligents capables d’orchestrer des modèles de langage, de traiter des données complexes et de répondre à des cas d’usage métier à forte valeur ajoutée. 
 Vous évoluerez dans un environnement technique riche, au croisement de l’IA, des architectures distribuées et des 
 systèmes de données. 
 Vous serez dans un premier temps basé sur le site de Rungis, puis sur le site de Vélizy-Villacoublay. 
 En nous rejoignant, vous vous verrez confier les missions suivantes : 
 1. Développement des agents IA 
 Implémenter et améliorer des agents spécialisés
 Ecrire et optimiser les system prompts et configurations de chaque agent
 Développer les skills agentiques
 Mettre en place les meilleurs patern d’architecture en IA Agentique (ReAct, Plan&Execute, ReWOO, Reflection..)
 Mettre en place des tests unitaires et d'intégration sur les agents et les skills
 2. Knowledge assistant et apprentissage continu 
 Implémenter le pipeline d'embedding et d'apprentissage continu
 Evaluer la qualité des embeddings et améliorer la pertinence des recherches sémantiques
 3. Connecteurs MCP et intégrations système 
 Développer et maintenir les serveurs MCP (FastMCP)
 Implémenter de nouveaux outils MCP selon les besoins métier
 Tester, documenter et monitorer chaque connecteur avec des cas d'usage réels
 4. Evaluation et qualité des LLMs 
 Concevoir et exécuter des benchmarks pour comparer les performances des modèles onprem
 Mettre en place des pipelines d'évaluation automatique (LLM-as-judge, RAGAS, métriques custom)
 Contribuer aux travaux de fine-tuning
 Mesurer les métriques de qualité : confiance, pertinence, cohérence, temps de réponse
 Votre profil : 
 Vous préparez un BAC+5 (école d'ingénieur, commerce ou université) avec une spécialisation en IA / Machine Learning / Data Science ou systèmes distribués et recherchez un stage de 6 mois ?
 Vous disposez d'une maîtrise avancée de Python et êtes capable de développer des applications ou des automatisations complexes ?
 Vous maîtrisez Docker ainsi que la mise en place et l'utilisation de chaînes CI/CD sous GitLab ?
 Vous avez une bonne maîtrise des LLM (Large Language Models) et des techniques de prompt engineering ?
 Vous avez une expérience des frameworks IA tels que LangChain ou LangGraph ?
 Vous connaissez les bases de données vectorielles telles que Qdrant, Chroma ou des solutions équivalentes ?
 Vous avez une bonne compréhension des architectures RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) et des mécanismes d'embeddings ?
 Vous possédez des connaissances en SQL et PostgreSQL ?
 Vous connaissez les méthodes d'évaluation des LLMs, notamment RAGAS ?
 Vous êtes à l'aise dans les environnements Linux et avec les scripts Bash ?
 Autonomie, capacité d’analyse, curiosité, esprit d’équipe et force de proposition sont des atouts que l’on vous reconnait ?
 Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !
 Mot de l'équipe : 
 En rejoignant notre équipe, vous évoluerez au cœur des technologies les plus récentes en intelligence artificielle, avec un focus sur les systèmes agentiques et les LLMs. Vous serez accompagné par des experts passionnés et contribuerez à des projets innovants à fort impact.
 Ce stage vous permettra de développer une expertise reconnue sur des sujets en pleine transformation et d’être acteur des systèmes intelligents de demain.
 Innovation, passion, ambition : …

En nous rejoignant à Gémenos, vous intégrez un site localisé entre mer et collines provençales, regroupant nos activités d’identité et de sécurité numériques et nos activités de défense alliant à la fois ingénierie et production, et favorisant un environnement de travail collaboratif et convivial.

 Pour ce faire , vous avez à : 
 Voici un résumé en gardant les titres :
 - Analyser les besoins marketing et identifier les cas d’usage IA : cartographier les tâches clés et proposer des solutions IA adaptées. 
 - Concevoir et développer des outils IA et agents IA : créer des assistants et agents pour automatiser ou assister les processus marketing via LLM, workflows, API et RAG. 
 - Construire et maintenir des bibliothèques réutilisables : documenter cas d’usage, instructions et procédures pour faciliter l’adoption par l’équipe. 
 - Intégrer les solutions aux outils marketing existant s : connecter les agents IA aux environnement CRM, tableurs, SharePoint, Power BI, etc. 
 - Tester, évaluer et améliorer les performances des solutions : définir indicateurs, réaliser tests utilisateurs et itérer. 
 - Accompagner l’adoption et la montée en compétences : former, produire des guides et collecter les retours pour faire évoluer les outils.
 Votre profil :
 Vous rechechez un stage de niveau Bac +5 dans le domaine Informatique , Intelligence Artificielle : 
 Vous possédez les coméptences suivantes :
 - Maîtrise l’IA générative et les agents IA (LLM, prompt engineering, workflows multi-étapes),
 - Compétences en automatisation et intégratio n (plateformes no-code/low-code, API), 
 - Compétences en outils Microsoft 365 pour la conception de livrables et comprend les processus du marketing digital. 
 - Anglais professionnel, 
 - une expérience avec des frameworks agentiques (LangChain, CrewAI, etc.), de connaissances en data et analyse (SQL, Power BI) ainsi que d’une sensibilité à la gouvernance et qualité de l’IA. 
 Autonome, prise d’initiative, rigueur analytique, communication pédagogique claire et curiosité sont des atouts que l'on vous reconnait !
 Alors cette mission est faite pour vous.
Tous nos stages sont conventionnés et soumis à une gratification dont le montant est déterminé selon votre niveau d’études. 
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

items.desc: Application Process & Requirements: Interview Process Technical roles: Our technical roles' process includes submitting a CV and short written statement, 1-2 skills assessments such as technical interviews and take-home coding tests and 2-4 interviews, including a conversation with leadership. We tailor this process as needed for each role and candidate. If you're applying to our technical roles, this privacy policy applies. Non-technical roles: Our non-technical roles' process includes submitting a CV, 2-4 interviews including a conversation with leadership and sometimes presentation or take-home task assessments. While our interviews follow civil service requirements, we do not require answering in STAR or other rigid formats. We recommend preparing to speak about your past career experience and how you would approach problems you would face in your AISI role. Nationality Requirements & Visas Technical roles: we can hire almost all nationalities and sponsor visas. Non-technical roles: you must meet civil service nationality requirements (by having Commonwealth citizenship, indefinite leave to remain, EU settled status, or meeting some other criteria). National Security Vetting Requirements vary by role and not all roles require vetting; check each job ad. Counter Terrorism Check (CTC) and Security Clearance (SC) vettings usually require 2+ years of recent UK residency . Developed Vetting (DV) clearances usually require 10+ years. Technical Salaries On technical job ads, you'll see our total packages include a "base salary" and a "technical talent allowance". This is civil service terminology. The technical talent allowance is part of your total salary and paychecks; there are no restrictions on how you spend it. About the AI Security Institute The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally. We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action. The deadline for applying to this role is Sunday 15th November 2026, end of day, anywhere on Earth. About the team Security Engineering at the AI Security Institute (AISI) protects our people, partners, models, data and the research infrastructure that AISI's work depends on. We build secure-by-design platforms, automated governance and intelligence-led detection. We work closely with research units and technology teams so researchers can get on with their work. We're now building an offensive security team and have three roles available. About the role We're looking for an experienced offensive security engineer who builds and breaks. You should be able to find and exploit vulnerabilities across cloud, infrastructure and application layers, and want to apply that work to containing and evaluating frontier AI models. Offensive security testing is one of the key controls behind AISI's model evaluations. You'll run engagements against our evaluation and research infrastructure. That includes the sandboxes, Inspect (our open-source evaluation framework), and the supporting cloud, identity and platform services. Alongside testing, you'll build and own agent-assisted red-teaming harnesses that test this infrastructure continuously. You'll work directly with the engineers and with research teams on cyber ranges and evaluation tasks, and there's scope to publish and present your work externally. If you want to attack the systems frontier AI is tested in, use AI agents for offensive work on real targets, and see your findings change how those systems are built, we'd like to hear from you. What you'll be doing: Attacking evaluation sandboxes. Testing the environments that contain frontier models during evaluations, including container and VM escape, egress controls, and attacking on the evaluation host from inside the sandbox. Finding vulnerabilities in Inspect. Finding vulnerabilities in our open-source evaluation framework and the infrastructure around it, and coordinating fixes and disclosure with maintainers and downstream users. Building and running agent-assisted harnesses. Building, operating and maintaining agent-assisted red-teaming harnesses end to end. Running them, along with manual testing, against every new sandbox and evaluation infrastructure release before evaluations depend on it. Triaging and proving findings. Separating real issues from noise in what the agents find and confirming the real ones with working exploits. Comparing agents and humans. Running agent and human red-teaming against the same targets, and feeding what you learn back into the tooling. Running wider …

items.desc: Contexte Au sein d'un grand groupe de télécommunications, le département dans lequel vous évoluez accompagne les clients dans l'adoption de l'intelligence artificielle et dans l'exploitation des API. Il a une double vocation : conseiller et accompagner les clients, du cadrage du besoin jusqu'à la mise en production, et concevoir et développer les API et les services d'IA qui permettent de concrétiser ces cas d'usage. Pilotage et chefferie de projet (environ 80 %) ? Piloter de bout en bout des projets API et IA : cadrage, planification, budget, suivi des jalons, gestion des risques et reporting auprès des instances de gouvernance. ? Recueillir et formaliser les besoins des clients, des partenaires et des équipes internes, puis construire la feuille de route et prioriser les cas d'usage. ? Coordonner des équipes pluridisciplinaires (développeurs, data scientists, architectes, sécurité, juridique, produit) ainsi que des prestataires et des partenaires technologiques. ? Animer le management des équipes projet : répartition de la charge, suivi de la performance, montée en compétences, rituels agiles. ? Piloter les relations avec les fournisseurs et les sous-traitants : cahiers des charges, recettes, suivi contractuel et financier. ? Définir et faire appliquer les standards d'API du Groupe (design, versioning, sécurité, observabilité), en cohérence avec les initiatives d'ouverture du réseau (par exemple CAMARA). ? Garantir la sécurité, la conformité (RGPD, AI Act) et l'IA responsable dans l'ensemble des solutions livrées. ? Piloter l'industrialisation des cas d'usage IA (MLOps / LLMOps) : déploiement, monitoring, qualité, maîtrise des coûts. ? Accompagner les équipes produit, les partenaires et les développeurs : documentation, portail développeurs, support. ? Assurer une veille sur l'écosystème API et IA et diffuser les bonnes pratiques. Maîtrise d'?uvre (environ 20 %) ? Assurer la maîtrise d'?uvre technique de projets ciblés : choix d'architecture, spécifications techniques, revue de conception et de code. ? Valider les solutions d'intégration de modèles d'IA et de LLM (agents, RAG, assistants, automatisation de parcours). ? Contribuer à la qualité des livrables : tests, recette, mise en production, résolution des points techniques bloquants. ? Intervenir ponctuellement en appui des équipes de développement sur les sujets les plus complexes. Profil candidat: Formation : Bac+5 (école d'ingénieur ou université) en informatique, data ou domaine équivalent. Expérience : [5 ans minimum] dont une expérience confirmée de pilotage de projets techniques et, idéalement, d'encadrement d'équipes, dans les API, le développement logiciel ou l'IA appliquée. Compétences en gestion de projet et management Conduite de projet complexe, en cycle en V comme en agile (Scrum, SAFe). Gestion de budget, de planning et de risques ; pilotage de prestataires. Management d'équipes et animation de collectifs pluridisciplinaires, y compris à distance. Reporting, communication auprès de décideurs et conduite du changement. Compétences techniques (niveau suffisant pour assurer la MOE) API : OpenAPI / Swagger, OAuth2 / OIDC, API gateways, microservices. Langages : bonne lecture de code et pratique de Python, Java ou Node.js / TypeScript. IA : LLM, prompt engineering, RAG, bases vectorielles, orchestration d'agents. Cloud et DevOps : Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, observabilité. Appréciés : MLOps, télécoms (5G, réseaux ouverts), architecture événementielle (Kafka). items.desc: What is Contentstack? Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system. While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time. Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program. Learn more at www.contentstack.com. Who Are We? At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let's go! What Are We Looking For? We're looking for a Business Intelligence Data Architect to shape the analytical architecture, data modeling standards, and engineering practices that power enterprise reporting, governed metrics, and AI-enabled analytics at Contentstack. In this high-impact role, you'll establish scalable, reusable modeling frameworks across Snowflake and dbt, lead the implementation of governed semantic models, and partner with Data Engineering, BI & Analytics, Revenue Operations, Finance, and executive leadership to build a trusted foundation for data-driven decision-making. If you're passionate about modern analytics architecture, translating complex business needs into scalable solutions, and enabling the next generation of AI-powered analytics, we'd love to hear from you! Establish conventions for model grain, naming, ownership, lineage, and documentation, and lead architectural design reviews. Partner across the business: Work closely with Data Engineering, BI & Analytics, Revenue Operations, Finance, and executive stakeholders to translate business requirements into trustworthy data models and scalable analytics solutions. Mentor and enable the team: Guide analytics engineers on modular architecture, semantic implementation, reusable modeling patterns, and modern analytics engineering practices. Drive platform evolution: Evaluate tools, semantic technologies, governance capabilities, and architectural improvements that support long-term scalability while reducing technical debt. items.desc: Semidynamics is a Barcelona-based semiconductor company, founded in 2016, that designs European processor technology built on the open RISC-V standard. We develop fully customisable 64-bit RISC-V processor IP, including out-of-order and in-order CPU cores and dedicated vector and tensor units, for demanding AI, machine learning and high-performance computing workloads. Our team combines deep architecture expertise with hands-on silicon experience, and we are growing to deliver complete, high-performance SoC solutions to our customers. Role overview We are looking for an SoC Top RTL Integration Engineer to integrate multiple subsystems into the top level of our high-performance SoCs. You will connect CPU clusters, IP blocks and peripherals through interconnects and NoCs, and make sure the integrated design is clean, constrained and ready for tape-out. This is a senior, hands-on role for an engineer who has already integrated large SoCs and taken them to silicon. Key responsibilities Integrate multiple subsystems (CPU clusters, memory, accelerators, peripherals and third-party IP) into the SoC top-level RTL . Connect subsystems through interconnects and NoCs using protocols such as AXI, APB and CHI . Define and integrate the chip's IOs , including connections to pads . Write and maintain SDC timing constraints for the integrated design, working with physical design teams. Run, debug and close lint, CDC and RDC checks at SoC top level. Integrate the top-level clock, reset and power infrastructure, and contribute to UPF power intent. Develop Python and C scripts and tests to automate integration flows and support bring-up. Work closely with architecture, verification, DFT and physical design teams to drive the SoC through to tape-out . Required qualifications Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related field. 8+ years of experience in digital/SoC design. Strong hands-on RTL design experience (SystemVerilog/Verilog). Proven experience integrating multiple subsystems on large SoCs. Experience connecting subsystems through interconnects and/or NoCs, with solid knowledge of AXI and APB. Proven track record on one or more tape-outs. Hands-on experience with lint, CDC and RDC checks. Experience writing and managing SDC constraints and integrating chip IOs. Working knowledge of Python and C for scripting and automation (user level). Fluent English, written and spoken. Nice to have Knowledge of clock, reset and power architectures. Experience with the CHI coherent interconnect protocol. Experience with UPF-based low-power design flows and pad ring integration. Why Semidynamics Work at one of Europe's most promising deep-tech semiconductor scale-ups Accelerated development path, with room to grow into confidential computing, memory isolation and software security 4 days per week in the Barcelona office (city center), 1 day working from home 1 week of work from anywhere in the world Competitive package A collaborative, technical, growth-oriented environment that values direct ownership and clear thinking

items.desc: ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them. AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. CPU Core Physical Design Engineer   The Role:  We are seeking a seasoned Physical Design Engineer with expertise in Microprocessor Design and Design Techniques. You are meticulous about Power, Performance and Area while balancing the business needs. This senior role will stretch you as you lead the physical design team to help create new design for AMD.   The Person:  You have excellent communication and presentation skills, demonstrated through technical publications, presentations, trainings, executive briefings, etc. You are highly adept at collaboration among top-thinkers and engineers alike, ready to mentor and guide, and help to elevate the knowledge and skills of the team around you. You are experienced in leading teams of senior engineers Key Responsibilities: Primary technical contact for your focus area Pro-actively works with peers in technology and design reviews Quantify impacts of technology issues in design reviews Work cross functionally across CPU Cores team to identify and assess complex technical issues/risks, and develop solutions Work closely with Design teams for Area and Floorplan refinement, Timing targets, Power targets. items.card: About the Role As a Database Engineer III on the RDS Oracle team, you will serve as an expert in Oracle database architecture and internals, operating with high autonomy and limited guidance to lead complex investigations and deliver solutions that span multiple engineers and teams. You will lead design reviews for new features, architect solutions to systemic issues, and standardize approaches across the broader
items.desc: DESCRIPTION Amazon Web Services is hiring a Database Engineer III for the RDS for Oracle team. We are looking for a Senior Database Engineer to join the RDS Oracle Database Engineering team and take a leadership role in ensuring customer success and shaping the future of our managed database service. About the Role As a Database Engineer III on the RDS Oracle team, you will serve as an expert in Oracle database architecture and internals, operating with high autonomy and limited guidance to lead complex investigations and deliver solutions that span multiple engineers and teams. You will lead design reviews for new features, architect solutions to systemic issues, and standardize approaches across the broader RDS organization. During critical customer escalations, you will rapidly assess scope and urgency, implement effective mitigations, and drive cross-functional efforts to permanently eliminate root causes, collaborating across RDS engine teams where solutions can be shared. Beyond reactive support, you will proactively establish monitoring, testing, and prevention strategies that identify and address potential issues before they impact customers. You will bring customer learnings back to the engineering org to influence roadmaps, validate feature designs through end-to-end test scenarios, and build automation that improves operational efficiency at scale. You will lead complex projects requiring multiple engineers, mentor junior DBEs and SDEs, and establish best practices that become team and organizational standards. We are looking for someone who is passionate about databases, customer-obsessed, and ready to own ambiguous, high-impact problems end to end with minimal direction. Your work directly impacts how enterprises run their most critical databases on AWS. If you want to lead technical strategy for how enterprises run Oracle workloads in the cloud, we'd love to hear from you. Key job responsibilities You will own database architecture for Oracle on RDS, driving best practices and setting team standards while proactively identifying and addressing architectural deficiencies. You will work on Oracle database internals, storage architecture, replication, performance optimization, and integration with AWS services such as EC2, VPC, and IAM. You will lead design and implementation of complex features that scale to millions of database instances, from database automation and infrastructure to operational tooling. You will perform on-call duties encompassing incident response, troubleshooting, and customer support. Acting as the voice of the customer, you will bring learnings into the engineering process to design new features and plan end-to-end test scenarios. You will present database best practices at conferences and workshops, mentor junior DBEs and SDEs, and influence team strategy to resolve complex or systemic problems across the organization. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field and five years of progressive post-baccalaureate experience in the job offered or a related occupation. Must have five years of experience in the following skill(s): (1) designing, architecting, and leading development of robust and scalable database automation solutions; (2) mentoring software engineers and database engineers on database internals and best practices; (3) leading execution of and building comprehensive automation frameworks around database benchmarking and performance validation; (4) with code database management tooling in PL/SQL and Java, including establishing coding standards and reusable patterns; (5) defining specifications and driving technical strategy for database-specific roadmap items; and (6) leading on-call operations for managed database services, including incident response, root cause analysis, and driving permanent resolution of systemic issues. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 10 or more years of experience working with relational database systems, with deep knowledge of Oracle database internals including storage engines, query optimization, PGA/SGA memory management, and replication mechanisms. Experience designing and operating Oracle high availability solutions including Multi-AZ deployments, Data Guard configurations, and read replicas on Amazon RDS. Experience with RDS Custom for Oracle, including migration planning and enterprise-scale optimization. Experience architecting Oracle database solutions integrated with AWS services such as EC2, VPC, IAM, and CloudWatch. Experience building operational tooling and automation for managed Oracle database services at scale, leading customer engagements for Oracle database migration and optimization on AWS, and presenting database best practices at conferences or workshops. Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and …

Responsibilities Design and implement enterprise AI platform
items.desc: At Intact Insurance, we're building next-generation AI capabilities that leverage Generative AI, Machine Learning, and cloud-native technologies. As an AI Platform Architect, you will be responsible for designing and governing the enterprise AI platform, enabling the secure deployment of AI solutions across the business. You will define technical standards, platform architecture, and engineering patterns that support scalable AI development, model deployment, and intelligent automation across a modern Azure-based ecosystem. Responsibilities Design and implement enterprise AI platform architecture leveraging Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Define architecture patterns for Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, and Prompt Engineering frameworks. Develop platform standards for MLOps and LLMOps including model deployment, monitoring, versioning, and lifecycle management. Architect data solutions using Azure Data Lake, Databricks, Synapse Analytics, and Microsoft Fabric. Design vector search and knowledge retrieval solutions using vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation architectures. Establish Infrastructure as Code (IaC) standards using Terraform, Bicep, ARM Templates, and GitHub Actions. Architect containerised solutions using Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, and event-driven architectures. Define API integration patterns using REST APIs, GraphQL, service buses, and cloud-native messaging services. Experience Proven experience designing enterprise AI, Machine Learning, or Advanced Analytics platforms within cloud environments. Strong expertise with Microsoft Azure including Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, AKS, and Microsoft Fabric. Experience developing Generative AI solutions using LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search technologies. Hands-on knowledge of MLOps and LLMOps practices including CI/CD pipelines, model governance, feature stores, model monitoring, and experimentation frameworks. Strong development experience with Python, SQL, PySpark, Spark, and machine learning libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, or LangChain. Experience working with Databricks, Synapse Analytics, distributed computing, and large-scale data processing platforms. Knowledge of containerisation technologies including Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and cloud-native application architectures. Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, ARM Templates, Azure DevOps, and GitHub. Strong understanding of API architecture, event-driven systems, messaging platforms, and enterprise integration patterns.

items.desc: Vous êtes le pont entre l'ambition IA de nos clients et la réalité de leurs équipes terrain. Vous ne vous arrêtez pas au prototype qui impressionne en démo : vous allez jusqu'à l'usage qui tient, six mois après votre départ. Un agent déployé n'est pas un agent adopté. Un copilote métier n'a de valeur que s'il change concrètement le quotidien d'un collaborateur ou d'un manager ; pas seulement celui d'un comité de pilotage. Vous intervenez en mission chez nos clients grands comptes et ETI, ou sur nos propres chantiers internes, avec une vraie autonomie et un impact mesurable dès les premières semaines. Vos missions Diagnostiquer le terrain Cartographier les processus métiers et les compétences des équipes pour repérer où l'IA créera un vrai gain — et où elle n'en créera pas Évaluer la maturité data, SI et RGPD de chaque cas d'usage avant de s'engager Prioriser les cas d'usage avec les sponsors métiers, sur la base de la valeur et de la faisabilité, pas de l'effet de mode Concevoir & prototyper Construire prompts, workflows et agents en autonomie Coordonner les expertises internes nécessaires à l'industrialisation (data, UX, développement) Tester chaque prototype avec les utilisateurs finaux dès les premières semaines, et ajuster en boucle courte Ancrer l'usage Concevoir les parcours de formation et d'accompagnement du changement, adaptés aux équipes terrain Animer des ateliers — jusqu'en magasin ou en agence, pas seulement en comité de pilotage Mesurer ce qui compte réellement : taux d'usage à 3 et 6 mois, temps gagné, écarts entre équipes — pas seulement le taux de déploiement Profil recherché Compétences techniques Compréhension très solide des LLM, du RAG, des architectures agentiques et multi-agents Pratique du prompt engineering avancé et des outils d'automatisation (n8n, Make, Zapier, Power Platform…) Appétence prouvée pour le vibecoding (Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable…) : vous avez déjà construit un POC, seul·e ou en équipe Culture produit : backlog, priorisation par la valeur, itération data-driven Compétences humaines et méthodologiques Capacité à vulgariser un sujet technique face à un directeur des ventes, un formateur ou un vendeur en magasin : sans jamais les perdre Vraie appétence terrain : vous êtes aussi à l'aise en point de vente qu'en comité de direction 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en conseil, transformation digitale ou gestion de projet Ce qui vous définit Vous préférez l'adoption mesurée à la démo impressionnante Vous savez dire non à un cas d'usage séduisant mais peu pertinent Vous apprenez en marchant, vous itérez vite, et vous documentez ce que vous apprenez pour que d'autres puissent le réutiliser Qui sommes-nous Chez Chrysalides, nous ne vendons pas de la technologie : nous transformons durablement la façon dont les équipes We have been around for almost twenty years and we are still growing. Our team now consists of more than 90 colleagues, working together from two offices and various home offices throughout Europe. A large part of the construction world in the Benelux, Germany and Denmark already works on our platform and uses our software on a daily basis. items.desc: Contribuez aux grandes transformations des entreprises et des acteurs publics en alliant innovation technologique et expertise métier, au service de nos clients et de la société pour les faire avancer durablement. Au-delà de la RSE, nous avons développé notre propre approche, RESET, qui englobe l’ensemble de nos engagements en matière de responsabilité économique, sociale, environnementale et technologique, tant au sein de notre collectif que chez nos clients. Onepoint, est une entreprise inclusive, handi accueillante, avec une politique de diversité affirmée. Votre futur collectif Communauté Sud Est Collectif de 100 personnes Une communauté multi expertises Au sein de la maison du célèbre compositeur Darius Milhaud qui a rouvert ses portes à l’été 2023, en plein cœur d’Aix en Provence. Ancien logis du bras d’or bâtie en 1670, cette bâtisse provençale réhabilitée en haut-lieu de la création et de l’innovation compose avec son passé de lieu de rencontre et de foyer d’exploration musicale. Entre ses murs chargés d’histoire, elle invite les arts et la culture mais également nos équipes locales à travailler de concert autour d’espaces de travail, de sociabilité et de détente. Fort de nos multiples expertises et de notre ADN technologique, nous avons pour ambition de devenir l’acteur numérique incontournable de la région Sud-Est. Nous croyons que l'IA transforme profondément la manière dont nous concevons, développons et livrons du logiciel. En tant que Développeur/Développeuse AI-Augmented, vous serez au cœur de cette transformation : vous combinerez une expertise solide en développement fullstack TypeScript avec une maîtrise des outils et pratiques d'IA générative appliqués au delivery logiciel. Votre mission : concevoir des applications robustes et scalables tout en exploitant l'IA comme accélérateur à chaque étape du cycle de développement — de la génération de code à l'automatisation des tests, en passant par l'orchestration d'agents intelligents. Vos nouveaux challenges pour ce poste : Développement Fullstack TypeScript Concevoir, développer et maintenir des applications complètes (backend & frontend) en TypeScript, en collaboration avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires et au contact direct des clients. Garantir la qualité technique : applications testables, résiliantes, performantes et sécurisées (OWASP). Concevoir des APIs REST et GraphQL robustes, intégrer et maintenir des bases de données (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.). Mettre en place des architectures modernes (microservices, event-driven, serverless) adaptées aux besoins métier. IA-Augmented Development — Au quotidien Coder avec un assistant IA au quotidien : GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor — génération de code, débogage augmenté, revue de code et documentation assistés par IA. Adopter une approche Spec-Driven Development : rédiger des spécifications claires (prompts, specs techniques, user stories structurées) pour piloter la génération de code par les agents IA. Tirer parti des custom agents, skills et serveurs MCP existants pour accélérer votre workflow et celui de l'équipe. Adopter les bons réflexes de qualité : tests et revue assistés par IA, pipelines CI/CD augmentées. Évaluer en continu les nouveaux outils, workflows et plateformes émergents susceptibles d'accélérer le delivery. IA dans les solutions — Intégrer l'IA dans les produits clients Connecter un LLM à une application via API et en maîtriser les limites (coûts, latence, hallucinations). Construire des cas d'usage RAG ou agents avec les frameworks adaptés (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen…). Brancher des outils via le protocole MCP (Model Context Protocol) et gérer les erreurs propres aux LLM. Définir des patterns d'architecture et d'orchestration multi-agents (LangGraph) pour des plateformes Agentic de bout en bout. Mettre en place guardrails, évaluation et observabilité des modèles — cadrer sécurité, coûts et gouvernance IA jusqu'en production. Auprès des équipes — Diffuser un workflow de delivery augmenté Concevoir des custom agents, skills et serveurs MCP adaptés à l'équipe et aux projets. Outiller le harness de développement : hooks, permissions, observabilité. Accompagner la montée en compétence : mentorat des profils juniors, revue, partage de pratiques. Conseiller les clients sur leurs besoins et cas d'usage IA, être force de proposition sur un delivery boosté par les agents. Veille & amélioration continue Maintenir une veille active sur les technologies émergentes (LLM, MLOps, DevOps augmenté, sécurité IA, protocole MCP). Promouvoir les bonnes pratiques de qualité, performance, sécurité et cloud. Exemples de projets Domaine éducation — Application d'examen multi-plateforme : Electron, React, Node.js, TypeScript Domaine énergie — Portail DATA avec rapports embarqués : Node.js Fastify, React, PostgreSQL, Prisma Domaine santé — Application de prise de rendez-vous sur serveurs HDS : Next.js, Fastify, Prisma, Graph DB Domaine transverse — Développement d'agents IA internes …

items.title: Search Engineer (Elasticsearch & Vector Search)
items.card: Role Overview: You will take ownership of the search infrastructure for Ask Seeking Alpha — a financial intelligence platform powered by LLMs. Your main goal is to ensure our AI agents can find the exact financial data they need (articles, transcripts, news) in milliseconds. You will work on the Retrieval layer of our RAG architecture, combining traditional text search with modern vector search techniques. Tech
items.desc: Join a Company That Invests in You Seeking Alpha is the world’s leading community of engaged investors. We’re the go-to destination for investors looking for actionable stock market opinions, real-time market analysis, and unique financial insights. At the same time, we’re also dedicated to creating a workplace where our team thrives. We’re passionate about fostering a flexible, balanced environment with remote work options and an array of perks that make a real difference. Here, your growth matters. We prioritize your development through ongoing learning and career advancement opportunities, helping you reach new milestones. Join Seeking Alpha to be part of a company that values your unique journey, supports your success, and champions both your personal well-being and professional goals. What We're Looking For Role Overview: You will take ownership of the search infrastructure for Ask Seeking Alpha — a financial intelligence platform powered by LLMs. Your main goal is to ensure our AI agents can find the exact financial data they need (articles, transcripts, news) in milliseconds. You will work on the Retrieval layer of our RAG architecture, combining traditional text search with modern vector search techniques. Tech Stack: Elasticsearch (v8+), Python (FastAPI, Asyncio), OpenAI Embeddings, LangChain, LangSmith . The Senior Search Engineer will be engaged with the company as a contractor (Private Entrepreneur). Key Responsibilities Search Engine Development: Design and implement Hybrid Search strategies. You will figure out how to best combine "keyword matching" (finding specific tickers like 'AAPL') with "semantic search" (finding concepts like 'revenue growth'). Relevance Tuning: You are responsible for the quality of search results. You will build systems to measure and improve how well the search engine answers user queries (using tools like LangSmith ). Vector Search & RAG: Manage the integration of OpenAI embeddings into Elasticsearch. You will solve challenges related to indexing long documents (e.g., earnings transcripts) so the AI retrieves only the most relevant parts. Performance Optimization: Optimize Elasticsearch queries and index settings to ensure low latency, even for complex queries with many filters. Python Backend: Develop and maintain the Python services that build queries and process results. We use FastAPI and Asyncio heavily. Requirements (Hard Skills) Elasticsearch Expert: experience of working with Search Engines in production. You understand how indices, analyzers, and mappings work "under the hood." Search Theory: You understand the difference between Lexical Search (keywords) and Vector Search (meaning), and know when to use which. Python Proficiency: Strong experience with Python 3.10+. You are comfortable writing asynchronous code (async/await) and building APIs. Data Engineering: Experience designing data schemas for search (how to structure JSON documents for efficient retrieval). Nice to Have Experience building RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines. Familiarity with LangChain or similar LLM frameworks. Experience with Evaluation tools (like LangSmith) to test search quality automatically. Background in Finance (understanding tickers, earnings calls, etc.).

With strong client relationships and deep industry expertise, we help our clients operate efficiently and sustainably through the unlimited potential of imagination, technology and intelligence. Visit us at: https://www.accenture.com/gb-en/about/accenture-song-index The Team Within Accenture Song sits AI & Data, the practice that builds the data-led intelligence behind the customer work. Song AI & Data helps organisations unlock value from data, analytics and AI by creating more relevant, personalised and effective customer experiences. Our expertise spans customer insight, data strategy and platforms, advanced analytics, performance optimisation, and AI (including generative AI and agentic AI) transformation. You will join the Song AI & Data UK practice, within the AI & Modelling Craft: a community of data scientists, AI engineers, modellers and solution architects focused on applying AI, machine learning and advanced analytics to solve customer and growth challenges. Our teams work across the full lifecycle, from identifying opportunities and designing solutions through to building, deploying and operating AI products that deliver measurable business value. The Role As an AI Solution Architect, you will design and deliver customer-focused data and AI solutions, spanning machine learning products, generative AI solutions and agentic AI systems. Working alongside a Lead Solution Architect, you will help shape the target architecture, take ownership of specific workstreams or components, and provide day-to-day technical direction to the engineers and data scientists building them, from design through to live service and continuous improvement. This could include designing the retrieval and evaluation approach for an AI-powered customer service assistant, building the recommendation components of a personalisation engine that suggests the next best action for customers across digital channels, or developing the agentic workflows that automate parts of campaign planning, execution and optimisation. Within your area of the solution, you will contribute to technology and design decisions, identify and manage technical risks, and make sure what is built is secure, scalable and aligned to client objectives. You will work closely with product owners, designers, engineers and business stakeholders to turn ideas into production-ready solutions. You will also be expected to explain technical concepts in business terms. Working with customer experience, marketing and service teams, you will help them understand what an AI solution does, how it fits with their existing systems and processes, and how it contributes to customer satisfaction, revenue, cost to serve and measurable business value. What makes this role unique is the opportunity to apply AI directly to customer growth, marketing, commerce and service challenges, helping some of the world's leading organisations create more relevant and valuable customer experiences. What You Will Do Design architectures for AI, generative AI and advanced analytics solutions across the customer lifecycle, spanning marketing, commerce, product, sales and customer service. Contribute to the technical architecture for customer-focused AI solutions, taking ownership of defined components or workstreams and ensuring they are scalable, secure, resilient and aligned to business objectives. Design and build AI applications and platform components, integrating machine learning, generative AI and agentic AI capabilities with enterprise systems such as CRM, CDP, CMS, DAM and cloud data platforms. Contribute to architectural decisions covering technology selection, integration patterns, build-versus-buy approaches, security, governance, performance and operational support, and document the rationale so decisions can be reviewed and reused. Provide technical direction to small delivery teams of engineers, data scientists and AI specialists, from initial concept through to production deployment and optimisation. Design solutions that meet responsible AI, security, privacy and regulatory requirements, including appropriate evaluation, monitoring and governance controls. Apply and help improve technical standards and best practices across the AI & Modelling Craft, sharing knowledge and mentoring more junior engineers and data scientists. Build effective working relationships with client stakeholders, contributing to architectural discussions and explaining technical concepts to both technical and non-technical …

items.desc: About Ema Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs. We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale. The Role You'll be an engineer who builds AI agents in production, sitting close to the customers who depend on them. This is a full-stack engineering job with an unusually short distance between your code and someone's actual workday. You'll write Go and Python, design schemas, build evals, and present your solution to a senior executive at an enterprise - often in the same week. What You'll Do Design and ship production agents. You'll build agents that are mission-critical from day one: embedded in Teams, Slack, intranets, voice lines, and email, taking real actions against SAP, ServiceNow, Workday, and a long tail of systems nobody has heard of. These run at enterprise volume under enterprise scrutiny. Own the full lifecycle. Discovery, build, eval, launch, and the unglamorous months afterward where an agent goes from good to genuinely reliable. Work directly with the people whose problem it is. You'll sit with leaders at global enterprises, extract the process from their heads, and decide what should be an agent, what should be a workflow, and what should stay human. Push your work back into the platform. The best patterns you find in the field become part of Ema's core product - new connectors, new agent primitives, new tooling. You'll surface unmet needs and prototype the fix, working with product and platform engineering to make it general. Example Projects Recent Work By Our Engineers Built the orchestration layer for a 200,000+ employee IT services firm spanning 65 countries, unifying HR, IT, and payroll into a single interface across SAP, ServiceNow, and Teams. Rebuilt a recruiting firm's core stack - sourcing, screening, ranked shortlists - cutting time-to-hire by 67% and retiring their legacy ATS along the way. Cut first-response time from two hours to under 90 seconds for an e-commerce logistics platform, including live carrier-site lookups, and held SLAs through peak holiday volume with no temporary hiring. At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together. 
You will join our ML & AI ART as a Senior Test Automation Engineer, responsible for the technical test automation solution supporting our AI and MLOps platform. You will work within the Bank's Test Strategy, while owning the technical depth and hands-on delivery of automation for your platform.

 Define and evolve the technical test automation approach and framework architecture for the ML & AI ART, aligned with the Bank's Test Strategy and Test Policy

 Integrate and orchestrate automated tests in GitLab CI/CD pipelines, including merge request pipelines, GitLab runners

items.desc: Hey there! We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment. Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment. Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences. Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right? To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment! Ready to be part of the experience? Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission. The Role We're looking for a Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer to accelerate Fever's company-wide AI transformation from the inside out. This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who thrives embedded with business teams — not behind a backlog. You will sit with teams across Operations, Creative, Support, and beyond, shadow how they actually work, spot where AI can genuinely give them their time back, and then build the solution yourself: end to end, from discovery to production. You find the problem, decide what to build, build it, ship it, and make sure it sticks. We trust your judgment. You'll operate with a high degree of autonomy, and we expect you to use it: identify what matters, make the call, and own the outcome. What You'll Do Embed with business teams — shadow real workflows, spot where AI can remove genuine pain (not from a spec, from the field). Design and ship AI systems — LLM applications, agents, RAG pipelines, chatbots, automated workflows that solve it. Own the full lifecycle — discovery, prototyping, production deployment, adoption. No handoffs. Measure and iterate — track the time and effort you're actually giving back, and refine based on real usage. Prioritize your own roadmap — you decide what's next; no one's assigning you tickets. What We're Looking For 6+ years of software engineering, with hands-on production experience shipping AI systems — LLM frameworks like LangGraph or LlamaIndex, agentic workflows, or similar — not just prototypes or research. A track record of owning something end-to-end without a team behind you: you've been the discovery, the build, and the rollout on at least one project. Strong engineering foundations: Python, APIs, microservices, databases, AWS. Comfortable with ambiguity: given a business domain, you can figure out what to build without a brief. Excellent communication with non-technical stakeholders — you can translate a messy manual process into a technical solution, and bring the team along with you. This is an individual contributor role, not people management. You'll be part of a small AI enablement squad — collaborative day to day, but you'll own your own domains independently Benefits & Perks Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth in one of the most exciting AI roles in the company. Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader. A compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance. Stock options plan. 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences. Based in Madrid, with a home office friendly setup. Health insurance and other benefits such as Flexible remuneration with a 100% tax exemption through Cobee. English / Spanish lessons. Wellhub membership. Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow. Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you! If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply! If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.
